t.95: They sought Our judgement. And (thanks to that judgement) every obstinate tyrant opposed to the Truth was brought to naught.
t.19: And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught;
t.22: But they sought victory and decision (there and then), and frustration was the lot of every powerful obstinate transgressor.
t.203: And they (the Messengers) sought victory and help [from their Lord (Allâh)]; and every obstinate, arrogant dictator (who refuses to believe in the Oneness of Allâh) was brought to a complete loss and destruction.
t.54: اور انہوں نے فیصلہ طلب کیا اور تمام سرکش ضدی لوگ نامراد ہوگئے.

t.149: beyond him lies Hell, and he is given, for drink, purulent water
t.84: The Hell is pursuing him, and he shall be made to drink pus-fluid,
t.85: Hell awaits each one; he will be given foul water to drink,
t.95: Hell is before him and he shall be made to drink of the oozing pus,
t.19: Hell is before him, and he is made to drink a festering water,
t.22: In front of such a one is Hell, and he is given, for drink, boiling fetid water.
t.203: In front of him (every obstinate, arrogant dictator) is Hell, and he will be made to drink boiling, festering water.
t.54: اس کے سامنے دوزخ ہے جہاں وه پیﭗ کا پانی پلایا جائے گا.

t.149: which he sips, though he can barely swallow. And death comes at him from everywhere but he is not to die, and beyond him is a harsh punishment.
t.84: which he will arduously sip, and will not be able to swallow. Death will come upon him from every side, yet he will not die, and still a heavy chastisement will be ahead of him.
t.85: which he will try to gulp but scarcely be able to swallow; death will encroach on him from every side, but he will not die; more intense suffering will lie ahead of him.
t.95: which he will gulp but will scarcely swallow, and death will come upon him from every quarter, and yet he will not be able to die. A terrible chastisement lies ahead in pursuit of him.
t.19: Which he sippeth but can hardly swallow, and death cometh unto him from every side while yet he cannot die, and before him is a harsh doom.
t.22: In gulps will he sip it, but never will he be near swallowing it down his throat: death will come to him from every quarter, yet will he not die: and in front of him will be a chastisement unrelenting.
t.203: He will sip it unwillingly, and he will find a great difficulty to swallow it down his throat; and death will come to him from every side, yet he will not die and in front of him, will be a great torment.
t.54: جسے بمشکل گھونٹ گھونٹ پئے گا۔ پھر بھی اسے گلے سے اتار نہ سکے گا اور اسے ہر جگہ سے موت آتی دکھائی دے گی لیکن وه مرنے واﻻ نہیں۔ پھر اس کے پیچھے بھی سخت عذاب ہے.

t.149: The parable of those who denied their Lord: their deeds are like ashes on which the wind blew severely upon a stormy day; they have no control over anything they have earned. That is the extreme misguidance.
t.84: The deeds of those who refuse to believe in their Lord are like ashes blown away by the wind on a stormy day. They will not be able to gain anything out of what they did. That is the farthest point of straying away from the right path.
t.85: The deeds of those who reject their Lord are like ashes that the wind blows furiously on a stormy day: they have no power over anything they have gained. This is to stray far, far away.
t.95: This is the example of those who disbelieve in their Lord: their works are like ashes upon which the wind blows fiercely on a tempestuous day. They shall find no reward for their deeds. That indeed is the farthest point in straying.
t.19: A similitude of those who disbelieve in their Lord: Their works are as ashes which the wind bloweth hard upon a stormy day. They have no control of aught that they have earned. That is the extreme failure.
t.22: The parable of those who reject their Lord is that their works are as ashes, on which the wind blows furiously on a tempestuous day: No power have they over aught that they have earned: that is the straying far, far (from the goal).
t.203: The parable of those who disbelieved in their Lord is that their works are as ashes, on which the wind blows furiously on a stormy day; they shall not be able to get aught of what they have earned. That is the straying, far away (from the Right Path).
t.54: ان لوگوں کی مثال جنہوں نے اپنے پالنے والے سے کفر کیا، ان کے اعمال مثل اس راکھ کے ہیں جس پر تیز ہوا آندھی والے دن چلے۔ جو بھی انہوں نے کیا اس میں سے کسی چیز پر قادر نہ ہوں گے، یہی دور کی گمراہی ہے.

t.149: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth with the truth? If He wills, He can do away with youand bring a new creation.
t.84: Have you not seen that Allah has created the heavens and the earth with truth? If He wills, He can put you away and bring a new creation;
t.85: [Prophet], do you not see that God created the heavens and the earth for a purpose? He could remove all of you and replace you with a new creation if He wished to:
t.95: Do you not see that Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth? Were He to will, He could take you away and bring a new creation.
t.19: Hast thou not seen that Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth? If He will, He can remove you and bring (in) some new creation;
t.22: Seest thou not that Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth? If He so will, He can remove you and put (in your place) a new creation?
t.203: Do you not see that Allâh has created the heavens and the earth with truth? If He wills, He can remove you and bring (in your place) a new creation!
t.54: کیا تو نے نہیں دیکھا کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے آسمانوں کو اور زمین کو بہترین تدبیر کے ساتھ پیدا کیا ہے۔ اگر وه چاہے تو تم سب کو فنا کردے اور نئی مخلوق ﻻئے.

t.149: And that is not too mighty for Allah.
t.84: and that is not at all difficult for Allah.
t.85: that is not difficult for God.
t.95: That is not at all difficult for Allah.
t.19: And that is no great matter for Allah.
t.22: Nor is that for Allah any great matter.
t.203: And for Allâh that is not hard or difficult.
t.54: اللہ پر یہ کام کچھ بھی مشکل نہیں.

t.149: And they emergedbefore Allah all together. And the weak said to the arrogant leaders, “We were your followers, so can you avail us in any way against Allah’s punishment?” They said, “Had Allah guided us, we would have guided you. It is the same for us: whether we mourn or are patient, there is no escape for us.”
t.84: All of them shall appear before Allah. Then, the weak shall say to the arrogant, “We were your followers. So, can you relieve us a little from Allah’s punishment?” They will say, “Had Allah guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we deplore or endure, we have no way out.”
t.85: When they all appear before Him, the weak will say to the powerseekers, ‘We were your followers. Can you protect us from any of God’s punishment?’ They will reply, ‘If God had guided us, we would have guided you. It makes no difference now whether we rage or endure with patience: there is no escape.’
t.95: Then all of them will appear exposed before Allah, and the weak ones will say to the haughty ones: "We merely followed you. Will you, then, protect us from Allah's chastisement?" They will say: "Had Allah shown us the Way to our salvation, we would surely have also guided you. Now it is all the same whether we cry or suffer patiently, we have no escape."
t.19: They all come forth unto their Lord. Then those who were despised say unto those who were scornful: We were unto you a following, can ye then avert from us aught of Allah's doom? They say: Had Allah guided us, we should have guided you. Whether we rage or patiently endure is (now) all one for us; we have no place of refuge.
t.22: They will all be marshalled before Allah together: then will the weak say to those who were arrogant, "For us, we but followed you; can ye then avail us to all against the wrath of Allah?" They will reply, "If we had received the Guidance of Allah, we should have given it to you: to us it makes no difference (now) whether we rage, or bear (these torments) with patience: for ourselves there is no way of escape."
t.203: And they all shall appear before Allâh (on the Day of Resurrection); then the weak will say to those who were arrogant (chiefs): "Verily, we were following you; can you avail us anything against Allâh’s Torment?" They will say: "Had Allâh guided us, we would have guided you. It makes no difference to us (now) whether we rage, or bear (these torments) with patience; there is no place of refuge for us."
t.54: سب کے سب اللہ کے سامنے روبرو کھڑے ہوں گے۔ اس وقت کمزور لوگ بڑائی والوں سے کہیں گے کہ ہم تو تمہارے تابعدار تھے، تو کیا تم اللہ کے عذابوں میں سے کچھ عذاب ہم سے دور کرسکنے والے ہو؟ وه جواب دیں گے کہ اگر اللہ ہمیں ہدایت دیتا تو ہم بھی ضرور تمہاری رہنمائی کرتے، اب تو ہم پر بے قراری کرنا اور صبر کرنا دونوں ہی برابر ہے ہمارے لیے کوئی چھٹکارا نہیں.

t.149: Thus Satan said, when the matter had been concluded, “Indeed, Allah promised youthe promise of truth, and I promised you but I failed you. And never did I have any authority over you except that I called you and you responded to me. So do not blame me, but blame yourselves; I cannot come to your aid nor can you come to my aid;(now) I have indeed denied your earlier association of me(with Allah) . Indeed, for the unjust is a painful punishment.”
t.84: The Satan will say when the matter will have been decided, “Allah promised you a truthful promise while I gave you a promise and did not fulfill it. I had no authority over you, except that I invited you and you accepted my call. So, do not blame me, but blame yourselves. Neither I can come to your help, nor can you come to my help. I disown your associating me with Allah in the past. Surely, there is a painful punishment for the unjust.”
t.85: When everything has been decided, Satan will say, ‘God gave you a true promise. I too made promises but they were false ones: I had no power over you except to call you, and you responded to my call, so do not blame me; blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can you help me. I reject the way you associated me with God before.’ A bitter torment awaits such wrongdoers,
t.95: After the matter has been finally decided Satan will say: "Surely whatever Allah promised you was true; as for me, I went back on the promise I made to you. I had no power over you except that I called you to my way and you responded to me. So, do not blame me but blame yourselves. Here, neither I can come to your rescue, nor can you come to mine. I disavow your former act of associating me in the past with Allah. A grievous chastisement inevitably lies ahead for such wrong-doers."
t.19: And Satan saith, when the matter hath been decided: Lo! Allah promised you a promise of truth; and I promised you, then failed you. And I had no power over you save that I called unto you and ye obeyed me. So blame not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can ye help me, Lo! I disbelieved in that which ye before ascribed to me. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful doom.
t.22: And Satan will say when the matter is decided: "It was Allah Who gave you a promise of Truth: I too promised, but I failed in my promise to you. I had no authority over you except to call you but ye listened to me: then reproach not me, but reproach your own souls. I cannot listen to your cries, nor can ye listen to mine. I reject your former act in associating me with Allah. For wrong-doers there must be a grievous penalty."
t.203: And Shaitân (Satan) will say when the matter has been decided: "Verily, Allâh promised you a promise of truth. And I too promised you, but I betrayed you. I had no authority over you except that I called you, and you responded to me. So blame me not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can you help me. I deny your former act in associating me (Satan) as a partner with Allâh (by obeying me in the life of the world). Verily, there is a painful torment for the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."
t.54: جب اور کام کا فیصلہ کردیا جائے گا تو شیطان کہے گا کہ اللہ نے تو تمہیں سچا وعده دیا تھا اور میں نے تم سے جو وعدے کیے تھے ان کے خلاف کیا، میرا تم پر کوئی دباؤ تو تھا ہی نہیں، ہاں میں نے تمہیں پکارا اور تم نے میری مان لی، پس تم مجھے الزام نہ لگاؤ بلکہ خود اپنے آپ کو ملامت کرو، نہ میں تمہارا فریاد رس اور نہ تم میری فریاد کو پہنچنے والے، میں تو سرے سے مانتا ہی نہیں کہ تم مجھے اس سے پہلے اللہ کا شریک مانتے رہے، یقیناً ﻇالموں کے لیے دردناک عذاب ہے.

t.149: But those who had attained faith and had done righteous deeds were entered into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein by their Lord’s leave; their greeting therein is: “Peace.”
t.84: And those who believed and did good deeds shall be admitted to Gardens beneath which rivers flow, living there forever by the will of Allah. There they shall greet each other with “Salām.”
t.85: but those who believed and did good deeds will be brought into Gardens graced with flowing streams, there to remain with their Lord’s permission: their greeting there is ‘Peace’.
t.95: As for those who had believed and did good in the world, they shall be admitted to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. There, with the leave of Allah, they shall abide forever, and will be greeted with: "Peace".
t.19: And those who believed and did good works are made to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein abiding by permission of their Lord, their greeting therein: Peace!
t.22: But those who believe and work righteousness will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow,- to dwell therein for aye with the leave of their Lord. Their greeting therein will be: "Peace!"
t.203: And those who believed (in the Oneness of Allâh and His Messengers and whatever they brought) and did righteous deeds, will be made to enter Gardens under which rivers flow, - to dwell therein for ever (i.e. in Paradise), with the Permission of their Lord. Their greeting therein will be: Salâm (peace!).
t.54: جو لوگ ایمان ﻻئے اور نیک عمل کیے وه ان جنتوں میں داخل کیے جائیں گے جن کے نیچے چشمے جاری ہیں جہاں انہیں ہمیشگی ہوگی اپنے رب کے حکم سے۔ جہاں ان کا خیر مقدم سلام سے ہوگا.

t.149: Have younot seen how Allah has set forth a parable? A good word is like a good tree—its root is firm and its branches are in heaven,
t.84: Have you not seen how Allah has set forth a parable: A good word is like a good tree, having its root firm and its branches in the sky.
t.85: [Prophet], do you not see how God makes comparisons? A good word is like a good tree whose root is firm and whose branches are high in the sky,
t.95: Do you not see how Allah has given the example of a good word? It is like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed, and whose branches reach the sky,
t.19: Seest thou not how Allah coineth a similitude: A goodly saying, as a goodly tree, its root set firm, its branches reaching into heaven,
t.22: Seest thou not how Allah sets forth a parable? - A goodly word like a goodly tree, whose root is firmly fixed, and its branches (reach) to the heavens,- of its Lord. So Allah sets forth parables for men, in order that they may receive admonition.
t.203: See you not how Allâh sets forth a parable? A goodly word as a goodly tree, whose root is firmly fixed, and its branches (reach) to the sky (i.e. very high).
t.54: کیا آپ نے نہیں دیکھا کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے پاکیزه بات کی مثال کس طرح بیان فرمائی، مثل ایک پاکیزه درخت کے جس کی جڑ مضبوط ہے اور جس کی ٹہنیاں آسمان میں ہیں.

t.149: yielding its crop every season by its Lord’s leave. And Allah sets forth parables for mankind, that they may remind themselves.
t.84: It brings its fruits at all times with the will of its Lord. Allah sets forth the parables for the people, so that they may take lesson.
t.85: yielding constant fruit by its Lord’s leave- God makes such comparisons for people so that they may reflect-
t.95: ever yielding its fruit in every season with the leave of its Lord. Allah gives examples for mankind that they may take heed.
t.19: Giving its fruit at every season by permission of its Lord? Allah coineth the similitudes for mankind in order that they may reflect.
t.22: It brings forth its fruit at all times, by the leave of its Lord. So Allah sets forth parables for men, in order that they may receive admonition.
t.203: Giving its fruit at all times, by the Leave of its Lord, and Allâh sets forth parables for mankind in order that they may remember.
t.54: جو اپنے پروردگار کے حکم سے ہر وقت اپنے پھل ﻻتا ہے، اور اللہ تعالیٰ لوگوں کے سامنے مثالیں بیان فرماتا ہے تاکہ وه نصیحت حاصل کریں.

t.149: And the parable of a nasty word is that of a nasty tree that has been uprooted: it has no stability.
t.84: And the parable of a bad word is like a bad tree, removed from the top of the soil, having no firm root.
t.85: but an evil word is like a rotten tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, with no power to endure.
t.95: And the example of an evil word is that of an evil tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, wholly unable to endure.
t.19: And the similitude of a bad saying is as a bad tree, uprooted from upon the earth, possessing no stability.
t.22: And the parable of an evil Word is that of an evil tree: It is torn up by the root from the surface of the earth: it has no stability.
t.203: And the parable of an evil word is that of an evil tree uprooted from the surface of earth, having no stability.
t.54: اور ناپاک بات کی مثال گندے درخت جیسی ہے جو زمین کے کچھ ہی اوپر سے اکھاڑ لیا گیا۔ اسے کچھ ﺛبات تو ہے نہیں.

t.149: Allah gives firmness to those who have attained faith with the firm statement in the Earlier Life and in the Hereafter, and Allah leads the unjustastray. And Allah does whatever He wills.
t.84: Allah keeps the believers firm with the stable word in the worldly life and in the Hereafter; and Allah lets the unjust go astray; and Allah does what He wills.
t.85: God will give firmness to those who believe in the firmly rooted word, both in this world and the Hereafter, but the evildoers He leaves to stray: God does whatever He will.
t.95: Thus, through a firm word, Allah grants firmness to the believers both in this world and in the Hereafter. As for the wrong-doers, Allah lets them go astray. Allah does whatever He wills.
t.19: Allah confirmeth those who believe by a firm saying in the life of the world and in the Hereafter, and Allah sendeth wrong-doers astray. And Allah doeth what He will.
t.22: Allah will establish in strength those who believe, with the word that stands firm, in this world and in the Hereafter; but Allah will leave, to stray, those who do wrong: Allah doeth what He willeth.
t.203: Allâh will keep firm those who believe, with the word that stands firm in this world (i.e. they will keep on worshipping Allâh Alone and none else), and in the Hereafter. And Allâh will cause to go astray those who are Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers), and Allâh does what He wills.
t.54: ایمان والوں کو اللہ تعالیٰ پکی بات کے ساتھ مضبوط رکھتا ہے، دنیا کی زندگی میں بھی اور آخرت میں بھی، ہاں ناانصاف لوگوں کو اللہ بہکا دیتا ہے اور اللہ جو چاہے کر گزرے.

t.149: Have younot seen those who exchanged the blessing of Allah for denial and landed their people into the home of perdition?
t.84: Have you not seen those who adopted disbelief in exchange of Allah’s favor and caused their people to disembark at a land of total destruction,
t.85: [Prophet], do you not see those who, in exchange for God’s favour, offer only ingratitude and make their people end up in the home of ruin, Hell,
t.95: Did you not see those who have exchanged Allah's favour with ingratitude to Him, causing their people to be cast in the abode of utter perdition
t.19: Hast thou not seen those who gave the grace of Allah in exchange for thanklessness and led their people down to the Abode of Loss,
t.22: Hast thou not turned thy vision to those who have changed the favour of Allah. Into blasphemy and caused their people to descend to the House of Perdition?-
t.203: Have you not seen those who have changed the Blessings of Allâh into disbelief (by denying Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم and his Message of Islâm), and caused their people to dwell in the house of destruction?
t.54: کیا آپ نے ان کی طرف نظر نہیں ڈالی جنہوں نے اللہ کی نعمت کے بدلے ناشکری کی اور اپنی قوم کو ہلاکت کے گھر میں ﻻ اتارا.

t.149: Hell, wherein they roast, and what a miserable settlement!
t.84: (which is) the Jahannam. They shall enter it; and it is an evil place to dwell.
t.85: where they burn? What an evil place to stay!
t.95: Hell, wherein they shall roast? How wretched a place to settle in!
t.19: (Even to) hell? They are exposed thereto. A hapless end!
t.22: Into Hell? They will burn therein,- an evil place to stay in!
t.203: Hell, in which they will burn, - and what an evil place to settle in!
t.54: یعنی دوزخ میں جس میں یہ سب جائیں گے، جو بدترین ٹھکانا ہے.

t.149: And they set up rivals to Allah in order to make(others) stray from His way. Say, “Enjoy yourselves, for surely your destiny is to the Fire.”
t.84: They have set up partners with Allah, so that they may mislead (the people) from His path. Say, “Enjoy (for a while). Then your ultimate journey is to the Fire.”
t.85: They set up [false deities] as God’s equals to lead people astray from His path. Say, ‘Take your pleasure now, for your destination is the Fire.’
t.95: They have set up rivals to Allah that they may lead people astray from His way. Tell them: "Enjoy for a while. You are doomed to end up in the Fire!"
t.19: And they set up rivals to Allah that they may mislead (men) from His way. Say: Enjoy life (while ye may) for lo! your journey's end will be the Fire.
t.22: And they set up (idols) as equal to Allah, to mislead (men) from the Path! Say: "Enjoy (your brief power)! But verily ye are making straightway for Hell!"
t.203: And they set up rivals to Allâh, to mislead (men) from His Path! Say: "Enjoy (your brief life)! But certainly, your destination is the (Hell) Fire!"
t.54: انہوں نے اللہ کے ہمسر بنالیے کہ لوگوں کو اللہ کی راه سے بہکائیں۔ آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ خیر مزے کرلو تمہاری بازگشت تو آخر جہنم ہی ہے.

t.149: Tell My servants who have attained faith to establish the prayers and to spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a day comes in which there is neither trade nor close friendship.
t.84: Say to My believing servants that they should establish Salāh and spend, secretly and openly, out of what We have given to them before there comes a day in which there is neither a trade nor friendship.
t.85: Tell My servants who have believed to keep up the prayer and give, secretly and in public, out of what We have provided them, before a Day comes when there will be no trading or friendship.
t.95: (O Prophet), tell those of My servants who believe that they should establish Prayer and spend out of what We have provided them with, both secretly and openly, before there arrives the Day when there will be no bargaining, nor any mutual befriending.
t.19: Tell My bondmen who believe to establish worship and spend of that which We have given them, secretly and publicly, before a day cometh wherein there will be neither traffick nor befriending.
t.22: Speak to my servants who have believed, that they may establish regular prayers, and spend (in charity) out of the sustenance we have given them, secretly and openly, before the coming of a Day in which there will be neither mutual bargaining nor befriending.
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) to ‘Ibâdî (My slaves) who have believed, that they should perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât ), and spend in charity out of the sustenance We have given them, secretly and openly, before the coming of a Day on which there will be neither mutual bargaining nor befriending.
t.54: میرے ایمان والے بندوں سے کہہ دیجئے کہ نمازوں کو قائم رکھیں اور جو کچھ ہم نے انہیں دے رکھا ہے اس میں سے کچھ نہ کچھ پوشیده اور ﻇاہر خرچ کرتے رہیں اس سے پہلے کہ وه دن آجائے جس میں نہ خرید وفروخت ہوگی نہ دوستی اور محبت.

t.149: Allah is the One Who created the heavens and the earth and sent down water from the sky, then brought out with it, of the products, provision for you; and He has subjected to you the ships to run in the sea by His command, and He has subjected to you the rivers.
t.84: Allah is the One who created the heavens and the earth and sent down water from the sky, then brought forth with it sustenance for you from the produce, and subjugated for you the ships, so that they may sail in the sea with His command, and subjugated for you the rivers;
t.85: It is God who created the heavens and earth, who has sent down water from the sky and with it brought forth produce to nourish you; He has made ships useful to you, sailing the sea by His command, and the rivers too;
t.95: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth, Who sent down water from the heaven and thereby brought forth a variety of fruits as your sustenance, Who subjected for you the ships that they may sail in the sea by His command, Who subjected for you the rivers,
t.19: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth, and causeth water to descend from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you, and maketh the ships to be of service unto you, that they may run upon the sea at His command, and hath made of service unto you the rivers;
t.22: It is Allah Who hath created the heavens and the earth and sendeth down rain from the skies, and with it bringeth out fruits wherewith to feed you; it is He Who hath made the ships subject to you, that they may sail through the sea by His command; and the rivers (also) hath He made subject to you.
t.203: Allâh is He Who has created the heavens and the earth and sends down water (rain) from the sky, and thereby brought forth fruits as provision for you; and He has made the ships to be of service to you, that they may sail through the sea by His Command; and He has made rivers (also) to be of service to you.
t.54: اللہ وه ہے جس نے آسمانوں اور زمین کو پیدا کیا ہے اور آسمانوں سے بارش برسا کر اس کے ذریعے سے تمہاری روزی کے لیے پھل نکالے ہیں اور کشتیوں کو تمہارے بس میں کردیا ہے کہ دریاؤں میں اس کے حکم سے چلیں پھریں۔ اسی نے ندیاں اور نہریں تمہارے اختیار میں کردی ہیں.

t.149: And He has subjected to you the sun and the moon, both moving constantly, and He has subjected to you the night and the day.
t.84: and He subjugated for you the sun and the moon, moving constantly, and subjugated for you the day and the night,
t.85: He has made the sun and the moon useful to you, steady on their paths; He has made the night and day useful to you
t.95: Who subjected for you the sun and the moon and both of them are constant on their courses, Who subjected for you the night and the day,
t.19: And maketh the sun and the moon, constant in their courses, to be of service unto you, and hath made of service unto you the night and the day.
t.22: And He hath made subject to you the sun and the moon, both diligently pursuing their courses; and the night and the day hath he (also) made subject to you.
t.203: And He has made the sun and the moon, both constantly pursuing their courses, to be of service to you; and He has made the night and the day, to be of service to you.
t.54: اسی نے تمہارے لیے سورج چاند کو مسخر کردیا ہے کہ برابر ہی چل رہے ہیں اور رات دن کو بھی تمہارے کام میں لگا رکھا ہے.

t.149: And He has brought youof all what you asked Him, and if you were to count Allah’s blessings, you would not be able to enumerate them. Surely, man is constantly unjust, a relentless denier.
t.84: and He gave you whatever you asked for. If you (try to) count the bounties of Allah, you cannot count them all. Indeed, man is highly unjust, very ungrateful.
t.85: and given you some of everything you asked Him for. If you tried to count God’s favours you could never calculate them: man is truly unjust and ungrateful.
t.95: and Who gave you all that you asked Him for. Were you to count the favours of Allah you shall never be able to encompass them. Verily man is highly unjust, exceedingly ungrateful.
t.19: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.
t.22: And He giveth you of all that ye ask for. But if ye count the favours of Allah, never will ye be able to number them. Verily, man is given up to injustice and ingratitude.
t.203: And He gave you of all that you asked for, and if you count the Blessings of Allâh, never will you be able to count them. Verily, man is indeed an extreme wrong-doer, a disbeliever (an extreme ingrate who denies Allâh’s Blessings by disbelief, and by worshipping others besides Allâh, and by disobeying Allâh and His Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم).
t.54: اسی نے تمہیں تمہاری منہ مانگی کل چیزوں میں سے دے رکھا ہے۔ اگر تم اللہ کے احسان گننا چاہو تو انہیں پورے گن بھی نہیں سکتے۔ یقیناً انسان بڑا ہی بے انصاف اور ناشکرا ہے.

t.149: And recall when Abraham said, “O my Lord, make this land safe and keep me and my sons away from worshiping human-shaped idols.”
t.84: (Recall) when Ibrāhīm said, “My Lord, make this city peaceful, and keep me and my children away from worshiping idols.
t.85: Remember when Abraham said, ‘Lord, make this town safe! Preserve me and my offspring from idolatry,
t.95: And call to mind when Abraham prayed: "My Lord! Make this city secure, and keep me and my sons away from worshipping the idols.
t.19: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.
t.22: Remember Abraham said: "O my Lord! make this city one of peace and security: and preserve me and my sons from worshipping idols.
t.203: And (remember) when Ibrâhîm (Abraham) said: "O my Lord! Make this city (Makkah) one of peace and security, and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
t.54: (ابراہیم کی یہ دعا بھی یاد کرو) جب انہوں نے کہا کہ اے میرے پروردگار! اس شہر کو امن واﻻ بنادے، اور مجھے اور میری اوﻻد کو بت پرستی سے پناه دے.

t.149: “My Lord, they have indeed led many people astray. So whoever follows me, then surely he is of me; and whoever disobeys me, then You are Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
t.84: My Lord, they have misled many a people. So, the one who follows me does surely belong to me. As for the one who disobeys me, then You are Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
t.85: Lord, the [idols] have led many people astray! Anyone who follows me is with me, but as for anyone who disobeys me- You are surely forgiving and merciful.
t.95: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. Now, if anyone follows my way, he is from me; and if anyone follows a way opposed to mine, then surely You are Ever-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
t.19: My Lord! Lo! they have led many of mankind astray. But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeyeth me - Still Thou art Forgiving, Merciful.
t.22: "O my Lord! they have indeed led astray many among mankind; He then who follows my (ways) is of me, and he that disobeys me,- but Thou art indeed Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.203: "O my Lord! They have indeed led astray many among mankind. But whoso follows me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeys me, still You are indeed Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.54: اے میرے پالنے والے معبود! انہوں نے بہت سے لوگوں کو راه سے بھٹکا دیا ہے۔ پس میری تابعداری کرنے واﻻ میرا ہے اور جو میری نافرمانی کرے تو تو بہت ہی معاف اور کرم کرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Our Lord, I have indeed settled of my offspring in a valley devoid of vegetation at Your House which has been made Inviolable, Our Lord, that they may establish the prayers. So make some people’s burning hearts incline towards them, and provide them with products, that they may give thanks.”
t.84: Our Lord, I have settled some of my children in a valley of no vegetation, close to Your sanctified House, so that, Our Lord, they may establish Salāh. So, make hearts of people yearn towards them, and provide them with fruits, so that they may be grateful.
t.85: Our Lord, I have established some of my offspring in an uncultivated valley, close to Your Sacred House, Lord, so that they may keep up the prayer. Make people’s hearts turn to them, and provide them with produce, so that they may be thankful.
t.95: "Our Lord! I have made some of my offspring settle in a barren valley near Your Sacred House! Our Lord! I did so that they may establish Prayer. So make the hearts of people affectionately inclined to them, and provide them with fruits for their sustenance that they may give thanks.
t.19: Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful.
t.22: "O our Lord! I have made some of my offspring to dwell in a valley without cultivation, by Thy Sacred House; in order, O our Lord, that they may establish regular Prayer: so fill the hearts of some among men with love towards them, and feed them with fruits: so that they may give thanks.
t.203: "O our Lord! I have made some of my offspring to dwell in an uncultivable valley by Your Sacred House (the Ka‘bah at Makkah) in order, O our Lord, that they may perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât). So fill some hearts among men with love towards them, and (O Allâh) provide them with fruits so that they may give thanks.
t.54: اے ہمارے پروردگار! میں نے اپنی کچھ اوﻻد اس بے کھیتی کی وادی میں تیرے حرمت والے گھر کے پاس بسائی ہے۔ اے ہمارے پروردگار! یہ اس لیے کہ وه نماز قائم رکھیں، پس تو کچھ لوگوں کے دلوں کو ان کی طرف مائل کردے۔ اور انہیں پھلوں کی روزیاں عنایت فرما تاکہ یہ شکر گزاری کریں.

t.149: “Our Lord, You surely know whatever we hide and whatever we make public. For nothing is hidden from Allah, whether in the earth or in the heaven.”
t.84: Our Lord, surely You know what we conceal and what we reveal.-Hidden from Allah is nothing whatsoever, neither in the earth nor in the heavens.
t.85: Our Lord, You know well what we conceal and what we reveal: nothing at all is hidden from God, on earth or in heaven.
t.95: Our Lord! Surely You know all that we conceal and all that we reveal, and nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
t.19: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
t.22: "O our Lord! truly Thou dost know what we conceal and what we reveal: for nothing whatever is hidden from Allah, whether on earth or in heaven.
t.203: "O our Lord! Certainly, You know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing on the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allâh.
t.54: اے ہمارے پروردگار! تو خوب جانتا ہے جو ہم چھپائیں اور جو ﻇاہر کریں۔ زمین و آسمان کی کوئی چیز اللہ پر پوشیده نہیں.

t.149: “Praise be to Allah Who has given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac; my Lord is indeed All-Hearing of supplication.”
t.84: Praise be to Allah who, despite my old age, blessed me with Ismā‘īl (Ishmael) and IsHāq (Isaac). Surely, my Lord is the One who listens to the prayer.
t.85: Praise be to God, who has granted me Ishmael and Isaac in my old age: my Lord hears all requests!
t.95: All praise be to Allah Who, despite my old age, has given me Ishmael and Isaac. Surely my Lord hears all prayers.
t.19: Praise be to Allah Who hath given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of Prayer.
t.22: "Praise be to Allah, Who hath granted unto me in old age Isma'il and Isaac: for truly my Lord is He, the Hearer of Prayer!
t.203: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has given me in old age Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael) and Ishâq (Isaac). Verily! My Lord is indeed the All-Hearer of invocations.
t.54: اللہ کا شکر ہے جس نے مجھے اس بڑھاپے میں اسماعیل واسحاق (علیہما السلام) عطا فرمائے۔ کچھ شک نہیں کہ میرا پالنہار اللہ دعاؤں کا سننے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: “My Lord, make me one who establishes the prayer, and(also) of my offspring. OurLord, and accept my supplication.”
t.84: My Lord, make me steadfast in Salāh, and my offspring as well. And, Our Lord, grant my prayer.
t.85: Lord, grant that I and my offspring may keep up the prayer. Our Lord, accept my request.
t.95: My Lord! Enable me and my offspring to establish Prayer, and do accept, our Lord, this prayer of mine.
t.19: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer.
t.22: O my Lord! make me one who establishes regular Prayer, and also (raise such) among my offspring O our Lord! and accept Thou my Prayer.
t.203: "O my Lord! Make me one who performs As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât ), and (also) from my offspring, our Lord! And accept my invocation.
t.54: اے میرے پالنے والے! مجھے نماز کا پابند رکھ اور میری اوﻻد سے بھی، اے ہمارے رب میری دعا قبول فرما.

t.149: “Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the day when the reckoning takes place.”
t.84: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and all believers on the day when reckoning shall take place.”
t.85: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day of Reckoning.’
t.95: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day when the reckoning will take place."
t.19: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.
t.22: "O our Lord! cover (us) with Thy Forgiveness - me, my parents, and (all) Believers, on the Day that the Reckoning will be established!
t.203: "Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and (all) the believers on the Day when the reckoning will be established."
t.54: اے ہمارے پروردگار! مجھے بخش دے اور میرے ماں باپ کو بھی بخش اور دیگر مومنوں کو بھی بخش جس دن حساب ہونے لگے.

t.149: Donot ever think that Allah is oblivious of what the unjustare doing. He only defers them to a day when sight(s) glaze over,
t.84: Never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers are doing. He is but giving them respite up to a day when the eyes shall remain upraised (in terror).
t.85: Do not think [Prophet] that God is unaware of what the disbelievers do: He only gives them respite until a Day when their eyes will stare in terror.
t.95: Do not think Allah is heedless of the evil deeds in which the evil-doers are engaged. He is merely granting them respite until a Day when their eyes shall continue to stare in horror,
t.19: Deem not that Allah is unaware of what the wicked do. He but giveth them a respite till a day when eyes will stare (in terror),
t.22: Think not that Allah doth not heed the deeds of those who do wrong. He but giveth them respite against a Day when the eyes will fixedly stare in horror,-
t.203: Consider not that Allâh is unaware of that which the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers) do, but He gives them respite up to a Day when the eyes will stare in horror.
t.54: ناانصافوں کے اعمال سے اللہ کو غافل نہ سمجھ وه تو انہیں اس دن تک مہلت دیے ہوئے ہے جس دن آنکھیں پھٹی کی پھٹی ره جائیں گی.

t.149: as they rush forward with their necks outstretched, their heads upraised, their eyes unblinking and their hearts void.
t.84: They shall be rushing with their heads raised upward; their eyes shall not return towards them and their hearts shall be hollow.
t.85: They will rush forward, craning their necks, unable to divert their eyes, a gaping void in their hearts.
t.95: when they shall keep pressing ahead in haste, their heads lifted up, their gaze directed forward, unable to look away from what they behold, their hearts utterly void.
t.19: As they come hurrying on in fear, their heads upraised, their gaze returning not to them, and their hearts as air.
t.22: They running forward with necks outstretched, their heads uplifted, their gaze returning not towards them, and their hearts a (gaping) void!
t.203: (They will be) hastening forward with necks outstretched, their heads raised up (towards the sky), their gaze returning not towards them and their hearts empty (from thinking because of extreme fear).
t.54: وه اپنے سر اوپر اٹھائے دوڑ بھاگ کر رہے ہوں گے، خود اپنی طرف بھی ان کی نگاہیں نہ لوٹیں گی اور ان کے دل خالی اور اڑے ہوئے ہوں گے.

t.149: And warnmankind of the day when punishment comes upon them, and the unjustsay, “Our Lord, defer us for a little while and we will respond to Your call and follow the messengers.” Did younot swear earlier that in no way would you face extinction?
t.84: Warn the people of a day when punishment will come upon them, and the wrongdoers will say, “Our Lord, give us respite for a short term, and we will respond to Your call and will follow the messengers.” (Allah will say), “Is it not that you had sworn oaths earlier that you would not have to leave (the world)?
t.85: So warn people of the Day when punishment will come to them, and when the disbelievers will say, ‘Our Lord, give us a little more time: we shall answer Your call and follow the messengers.’ Did you [disbelievers] not swear in the past that your power would have no end?
t.95: (O Muhammad), warn mankind of the Day when a severe chastisement shall overtake them, and the wrong-doers will say: "Our Lord, grant us respite for a short while; we shall respond to Your call and will follow Your Messengers." (But they will be clearly told): "Are you not the same who swore earlier that they shall never suffer decline?"
t.19: And warn mankind of a day when the doom will come upon them, and those who did wrong will say: Our Lord! Reprieve us for a little while. We will obey Thy call and will follow the messengers. (It will be answered): Did ye not swear before that there would be no end for you?
t.22: So warn mankind of the Day when the Wrath will reach them: then will the wrong-doers say: "Our Lord! respite us (if only) for a short term: we will answer Thy call, and follow the messengers!" "What! were ye not wont to swear aforetime that ye should suffer no decline?
t.203: And warn (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) mankind of the Day when the torment will come unto them; then the wrong-doers will say: "Our Lord! Respite us for a little while, we will answer Your Call and follow the Messengers!" (It will be said): "Had you not sworn aforetime that you would not leave (the world for the Hereafter).
t.54: لوگوں کو اس دن سے ہوشیار کردے جب کہ ان کے پاس عذاب آجائے گا، اور ﻇالم کہیں گے کہ اے ہمارے رب ہمیں بہت تھوڑے قریب کے وقت تک کی ہی مہلت دے کہ ہم تیری تبلیﻎ مان لیں اور تیرے پیغمبروں کی تابعداری میں لگ جائیں۔ کیا تم اس سے پہلے بھی قسمیں نہیں کھا رہے تھے؟ کہ تمہارے لیے دنیا سے ٹلنا ہی نہیں.

t.149: And you settled in the residences of those who were unjust to themselves and it became clear to you how We dealt with them, and We set forth for you the parables.
t.84: And you dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it became clear to you how We dealt with them, and We put forth for you the examples.”
t.85: You lived in the same places as others who wronged themselves before, and you were clearly shown how We dealt with them––We gave you many examples.
t.95: You said so even though you had lived in the dwellings of those who had wronged themselves (by sinning), and you were aware how We dealt with them, and We had even explained to you all this by giving examples.
t.19: And (have ye not) dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves (of old) and (hath it not) become plain to you how We dealt with them and made examples for you?
t.22: "And ye dwelt in the dwellings of men who wronged their own souls; ye were clearly shown how We dealt with them; and We put forth (many) parables in your behoof!"
t.203: "And you dwelt in the dwellings of men who wronged themselves, and it was clear to you how We had dealt with them. And We put forth (many) parables for you."
t.54: اور کیا تم ان لوگوں کے گھروں میں رہتے سہتے نہ تھے جنہوں نے اپنی جانوں پر ﻇلم کیا اور کیا تم پر وه معاملہ کھلا نہیں کہ ہم نے ان کے ساتھ کیسا کچھ کیا۔ ہم نے تو (تمہارے سمجھانے کو) بہت سی مثالیں بیان کردی تھیں.

t.149: And very truly they had schemed their scheming, yet their scheming is known to Allah, even though their scheming was enough to remove mountains.
t.84: And they worked out their plot and whatever they plot is before Allah, even though their plot is such as would move the mountains.
t.85: They made their plots, but, even if their plots had been able to move mountains, God had the answer.
t.95: Indeed the unbelievers contrived their plan, but it is in Allah's power to nullify their plan, even though their plans were such that would move even mountains.
t.19: Verily they have plotted their plot, and their plot is with Allah, though their plot were one whereby the mountains should be moved.
t.22: Mighty indeed were the plots which they made, but their plots were (well) within the sight of Allah, even though they were such as to shake the hills!
t.203: Indeed, they planned their plot, and their plot was with Allâh, though their plot was not such as to remove the mountains (real mountains or the Islâmic law) from their places (as it is of no importance)[Tafsir Ibn Kathir].
t.54: یہ اپنی اپنی چالیں چل رہے ہیں اور اللہ کو ان کی تمام چالوں کا علم ہے اور ان کی چالیں ایسی نہ تھیں کہ ان سے پہاڑ اپنی جگہ سے ٹل جائیں.

t.149: So never thinkthat Allah will break His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Almighty, Capable of vengeance
t.84: So, never think that Allah will do against His promise to His messengers. Surely, Allah is Mighty, the Lord of Retribution
t.85: So do not think [Prophet] that God will break His promise to His messengers: He is mighty, and capable of retribution.
t.95: So, do not think, (O Prophet), that Allah will go back upon His promise to His Messengers. Surely Allah is Mighty, Lord of retribution.
t.19: So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).
t.22: Never think that Allah would fail his messengers in His promise: for Allah is Exalted in power, - the Lord of Retribution.
t.203: So think not that Allâh will fail to keep His Promise to His Messengers. Certainly, Allâh is All-Mighty, All-Able of Retribution.
t.54: آپ ہرگز یہ خیال نہ کریں کہ اللہ اپنے نبیوں سے وعده خلافی کرے گا، اللہ بڑا ہی غالب اور بدلہ لینے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: on the day when the earth is changed into another earth, as well as the heavens, and they emergedbefore Allah, the One, the Subduer.
t.84: the day on which this earth will be turned into some other earth, and the skies as well, and they all shall appear before Allah, the One, the All-Dominant.
t.85: One Day- when the earth is turned into another earth, the heavens into another heaven, and people all appear before God, the One, the Overpowering-
t.95: (Do warn them of the) Day when the heavens and the earth shall be altogether changed; when all will appear fully exposed before Allah, the One, the Irresistible!
t.19: On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty,
t.22: One day the earth will be changed to a different earth, and so will be the heavens, and (men) will be marshalled forth, before Allah, the One, the Irresistible;
t.203: On the Day when the earth will be changed to another earth and so will be the heavens, and they (all creatures) will appear before Allâh, the One, the Irresistible.
t.54: جس دن زمین اس زمین کے سوا اور ہی بدل دی جائے گی اور آسمان بھی، اور سب کے سب اللہ واحد غلبے والے کے روبرو ہوں گے.

t.149: And yousee the criminals on that day bound together in fetters,
t.84: On that day you will see the culprits tied up together in chains,
t.85: you [Prophet] will see the guilty on that Day, bound together in fetters,
t.95: On that Day you shall see the guilty ones secured in chains;
t.19: Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains,
t.22: And thou wilt see the sinners that day bound together in fetters;-
t.203: And you will see the Mujrimûn (criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism, polytheists) that Day Muqarranûn (bound together) in fetters.
t.54: آپ اس دن گناه گاروں کو دیکھیں گے کہ زنجیروں میں ملے جلے ایک جگہ جکڑے ہوئے ہوں گے.

t.149: their attires made of tar, and the Fire covering their faces.
t.84: their shirts will be of rosin, and their faces will be covered with Fire
t.85: in garments of pitch, faces covered in fire.
t.95: their garments shall be black as if made out of pitch, and flames of the Fire shall cover their faces
t.19: Their raiment of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces,
t.22: Their garments of liquid pitch, and their faces covered with Fire;
t.203: Their garments will be of pitch, and fire will cover their faces.
t.54: ان کے لباس گندھک کے ہوں گے اور آگ ان کے چہروں پر بھی چڑھی ہوئی ہوگی.

t.149: That Allah may repay every single self according to what it has earned. Indeed, Allah is Swift in reckoning.
t.84: so that Allah repays everyone in full whatever he earned. Indeed, Allah is swift at reckoning.
t.85: [All will be judged] so that God may reward each soul as it deserves: God is swift in His reckoning.
t.95: so that Allah may requite each person for his deeds. Allah is swift in reckoning.
t.19: That Allah may repay each soul what it hath earned. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.
t.22: That Allah may requite each soul according to its deserts; and verily Allah is swift in calling to account.
t.203: That Allâh may requite each person according to what he has earned. Truly, Allâh is Swift at reckoning.
t.54: یہ اس لیے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ ہر شخص کو اس کے کیے ہوئے اعمال کا بدلہ دے، بیشک اللہ تعالیٰ کو حساب لیتے کچھ دیر نہیں لگنے کی.

t.149: Thisis a proclamation for mankind, and that they may be warned by it, and that they may know that He is one God, and that people of understanding may constantly remember.
t.84: This is a message for mankind, so that they (take lesson and) be warned, and so that they may know that He is One God, and so that the people of understanding may observe the advice.
t.85: This is a message to all people, so that they may be warned by it, and know that He is the only God, and so that those who have minds may take heed.
t.95: This is a proclamation for all mankind that they may be warned by it, and that they may know that their God is none but the One True God, and that men of understanding may take heed.
t.19: This is a clear message for mankind in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is only One Allah, and that men of understanding may take heed.
t.22: Here is a Message for mankind: Let them take warning therefrom, and let them know that He is (no other than) One Allah: let men of understanding take heed.
t.203: This (Qur’an) is a Message for mankind (and a clear proof against them), in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is the only One Ilâh (God - Allâh) - (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh) - and that men of understanding may take heed.
t.54: یہ قرآن تمام لوگوں کے لیے اطلاع نامہ ہے کہ اس کے ذریعہ سے وه ہوشیار کر دیے جائیں اور بخوبی معلوم کرلیں کہ اللہ ایک ہی معبود ہے اور تاکہ عقلمند لوگ سوچ سمجھ لیں.

t.149: Alif Lām Ra. Those are the signsof the Scripture and an evident Recital.
t.84: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are verses of the Book and the enlightening Qur’ān.
t.85: Alif Lam Ra These are the verses of the Scripture, a Quran that makes things clear.
t.95: Alif. Lam. Ra'. These are the verses of the Book, and a Clear Qur'an.
t.19: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.
t.22: A. L. R. These are the Ayats of Revelation,- of a Qur'an that makes things clear.
t.203: Alif-Lâm-Râ. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings].These are Verses of the Book and a plain Qur’ân.
t.54: الرٰ، یہ کتاب الٰہی کی آیتیں ہیں اور کھلے اور روشن قرآن کی.

t.149: Perhaps those who have denied will wish they had been Muslims.
t.84: On many occasions, the disbelievers will wish that they were Muslims.
t.85: The disbelievers may well come to wish they had submitted to God,
t.95: Soon will the time come when the unbelievers will wish they were Muslims.
t.19: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.
t.22: Again and again will those who disbelieve, wish that they had bowed (to Allah's will) in Islam.
t.203: How much would those who disbelieved wish that they had been Muslims [those who have submitted themselves to Allâh’s Will in Islâm i.e. Islâmic Monotheism - this will be on the Day of Resurrection when they will see the disbelievers going to Hell and the Muslims going to Paradise].
t.54: وه بھی وقت ہوگا کہ کافر اپنے مسلمان ہونے کی آرزو کریں گے.

t.149: Letthem eat and enjoy and be distracted by(false) hope, for they willcome to know.
t.84: Let them eat and enjoy, and let (their) fancy make them neglectful, for they shall soon come to know (their ultimate end).
t.85: so [Prophet] leave them to eat and enjoy themselves. Let [false] hopes distract them: they will come to know.
t.95: Leave them to eat and enjoy life and let false hopes amuse them. They will soon come to know.
t.19: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!
t.22: Leave them alone, to enjoy (the good things of this life) and to please themselves: let (false) hope amuse them: soon will knowledge (undeceive them).
t.203: Leave them to eat and enjoy, and let them be preoccupied with (false) hope. They will come to know!
t.54: آپ انہیں کھاتا، نفع اٹھاتا اور (جھوٹی) امیدوں میں مشغول ہوتا چھوڑ دیجئے عنقریب یہ خود جان لیں گے.

t.149: For in no way did We annihilate any town except that it had a known written decree.
t.84: We did not destroy any town without having a pre-determined time for it.
t.85: Never have We destroyed a community that did not have a set time;
t.95: Whenever We destroyed a town, a definite term had previously been decreed for it.
t.19: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.
t.22: Never did We destroy a population that had not a term decreed and assigned beforehand.
t.203: And never did We destroy a township but there was a known decree for it.
t.54: کسی بستی کو ہم نے ہلاک نہیں کیا مگر یہ کہ اس کے لیے مقرره نوشتہ تھا.

t.149: No community can advance its time, nor can they delay it.
t.84: No people can precede their appointed time, nor can they exceed it.
t.85: no community can bring its time forward, nor delay it.
t.95: No people can outstrip the term for its destruction nor can it delay it.
t.19: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.
t.22: Neither can a people anticipate its term, nor delay it.
t.203: No nation can advance its term, nor delay it.
t.54: کوئی گروه اپنی موت سے نہ آگے بڑھتا ہے نہ پیچھے رہتا ہے.

t.149: And they said, “O you upon whom the Reminder has been bestowed from on high, very truly you are insane.
t.84: They say, “O you to whom the Dhikr (the Qur’ān) has been revealed, you are surely insane.
t.85: They say, ‘Receiver of this Quran! You are definitely mad.
t.95: They say: "O you to whom the Admonition has been revealed, you are surely crazed.
t.19: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!
t.22: They say: "O thou to whom the Message is being revealed! truly thou art mad (or possessed)!
t.203: And they say: "O you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) to whom the Dhikr (the Qur’ân) has been sent down! Verily, you are a mad man!
t.54: انہوں نے کہا کہ اے وه شخص جس پر قرآن اتارا گیا ہے یقیناً تو تو کوئی دیوانہ ہے.

t.149: If only you would bring us the angels, if you are one of the truthful!”
t.84: Why do you not bring the angels to us, if you are one of the truthful?”
t.85: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are telling the truth?’
t.95: Why do you not bring down angels upon us if you are indeed truthful?"
t.19: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful?
t.22: "Why bringest thou not angels to us if it be that thou hast the Truth?"
t.203: "Why do you not bring angels to us if you are of the truthful?"
t.54: اگر تو سچا ہی ہے تو ہمارے پاس فرشتوں کو کیوں نہیں ﻻتا.

t.149: We bestow not the angelsfrom on high except with the truth, and in no way would theythen be respited.
t.84: We do not send down the angels except with truth, and then they shall be given no respite.
t.85: But We send down the angels only to bring justice and then these people will not be reprieved.
t.95: We do not send down the angels (in frivolity); and when We do send them down, We do so with Truth; then people are granted no respite.
t.19: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.
t.22: We send not the angels down except for just cause: if they came (to the ungodly), behold! no respite would they have!
t.203: We send not the angels down except with the truth (i.e. for torment), and in that case, they (the disbelievers) would have no respite!
t.54: ہم فرشتوں کو حق کے ساتھ ہی اتارتے ہیں اور اس وقت وه مہلت دیئے گئے نہیں ہوتے.

t.149: Indeed, We—We alone—have bestowed the Reminder from on high, and We will most surely preserve it.
t.84: We, Ourselves, have sent down the Dhikr (the Qur’ān), and We are there to protect it.
t.85: We have sent down the Quran Ourself, and We Ourself will guard it. Even before you [Prophet],
t.95: As for the Admonition, indeed it is We Who have revealed it and it is indeed We Who are its guardians.
t.19: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.
t.22: We have, without doubt, sent down the Message; and We will assuredly guard it (from corruption).
t.203: Verily, We, it is We Who have sent down the Dhikr (i.e. the Qur’ân) and surely, We will guard it (from corruption).
t.54: ہم نے ہی اس قرآن کو نازل فرمایا ہے اور ہم ہی اس کے محافﻆ ہیں.

t.149: And most surely We sent(messengers) before youto the sects of the ancients,
t.84: We did send the messengers before you among the groups of earlier peoples.
t.85: We sent messengers among the various communities of old,
t.95: (O Muhammad), certainly We did send Messengers before you among the nations which have gone by.
t.19: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.
t.22: We did send messengers before thee amongst the religious sects of old:
t.203: Indeed, We sent (Messengers) before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) amongst the sects (communities) of old.
t.54: ہم نے آپ سے پہلے اگلی امتوں میں بھی اپنے رسول (برابر) بھیجے.

t.149: but no messenger comesto them but they used to ridicule him.
t.84: No messenger came to them but they used to mock at him.
t.85: but they mocked every single messenger that came to them:
t.95: And whenever a Messenger came to them, they never failed to mock him.
t.19: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.
t.22: But never came a messenger to them but they mocked him.
t.203: And never came a Messenger to them but they did mock at him.
t.54: اور (لیکن) جو بھی رسول آتا وه اس کا مذاق اڑاتے.

t.149: Thus We insert itinto the hearts of the criminals—
t.84: Likewise, We make it (i.e. disbelief) enter into the hearts of the sinners,
t.85: in this way We make the message slip through the hearts of evildoers.
t.95: Even so We make a way for it (that is, the Admonition) in the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod);
t.19: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:
t.22: Even so do we let it creep into the hearts of the sinners -
t.203: Thus do We let it (polytheism and disbelief) enter the hearts of the Mujrimûn [criminals, polytheists and pagans (because of their mocking at the Messengers)].
t.54: گناه گاروں کے دلوں میں ہم اسی طرح یہی رچا دیا کرتے ہیں.

t.149: they do not believe in it, though the rule of(God regarding) the ancients has surely passed before.
t.84: (whereby) they do not believe in it (the Qur’ān), and this has been the way of earlier people.
t.85: They will not believe in it. That was what happened with the peoples of long ago,
t.95: they do not believe in it. This has been the wont of people of this kind from ancient times.
t.19: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.
t.22: That they should not believe in the (Message); but the ways of the ancients have passed away.
t.203: They would not believe in it (the Qur’ân); and already the example of (Allâh’s punishment of) the ancients (who disbelieved) has gone forth.
t.54: وه اس پر ایمان نہیں ﻻتے اور یقیناً اگلوں کا طریقہ گزرا ہوا ہے.

t.149: And if We were to open for them a gateway into the sky so that they were to continue ascending through it,
t.84: Even if We open a gate in the sky and they keep ascending through it,
t.85: and even if We opened a gateway into Heaven for them and they rose through it, higher and higher,
t.95: If We were even to open for them a way to the heavens, and they could continually climb up to it in broad daylight,
t.19: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,
t.22: Even if We opened out to them a gate from heaven, and they were to continue (all day) ascending therein,
t.203: And even if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they were to keep on ascending thereto (all the day long)
t.54: اور اگر ہم ان پر آسمان کا دروازه کھول بھی دیں اور یہ وہاں چڑھنے بھی لگ جائیں.

t.149: they would surely say, “Indeed, our sight(s) have been stupefied ; rather, we are a people bewitched.”
t.84: still they will say, “In fact our eyes have been deluded; rather we are enchanted people.
t.85: they would still say, ‘Our eyes are hallucinating. We are bewitched.’
t.95: they would still have said: "Surely our eyes have been dazzled; rather, we have been enchanted."
t.19: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.
t.22: They would only say: "Our eyes have been intoxicated: Nay, we have been bewitched by sorcery."
t.203: They would surely say (in the evening): "Our eyes have been (as if) dazzled (we have not seen any angel or heaven). Nay, we are a people bewitched."
t.54: تب بھی یہی کہیں گے کہ ہماری نظر بندی کر دی گئی ہے بلکہ ہم لوگوں پر جادو کر دیا گیا ہے.

t.149: And most surely, We have made constellations in the sky and adorned it to the beholders;
t.84: We have created stellar formations in the sky and have beautified them for onlookers,
t.85: We have set constellations up in the sky and made it beautiful for all to see,
t.95: We have indeed set constellations in the heavens and have beautified them for the beholders,
t.19: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.
t.22: It is We Who have set out the zodiacal signs in the heavens, and made them fair-seeming to (all) beholders;
t.203: And indeed, We have put the big stars in the heaven and We beautified it for the beholders.
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے آسمان میں برج بنائے ہیں اور دیکھنے والوں کے لیے اسے سجا دیا ہے.

t.149: and We have preserved it from every outcast devil,
t.84: and have protected them from every outcast devil,
t.85: and guarded it from every stoned satan:
t.95: and have protected them against every accursed satan
t.19: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,
t.22: And (moreover) We have guarded them from every cursed devil:
t.203: And We have guarded it (near heaven) from every outcast Shaitân (devil).
t.54: اور اسے ہر مردود شیطان سے محفوظ رکھا ہے.

t.149: except the one who eavesdrops and is followed by an evident meteor.
t.84: but the one who tries to eavesdrop is chased by a clearly visible flame.
t.85: any eavesdropper will be pursued by a clearly visible flame.
t.95: save him who may eavesdrop, and then a bright flame pursues him.
t.19: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.
t.22: But any that gains a hearing by stealth, is pursued by a flaming fire, bright (to see).
t.203: Except him (devil) who steals the hearing then he is pursued by a clear flaming fire.
t.54: ہاں مگر جو چوری چھپے سننے کی کوشش کرے اس کے پیچھے دہکتا ہوا (کھلا شعلہ) لگتا ہے.

t.149: And the land—We spread it and cast firm mountains in it, and We germinated therein of everything in proper measure.
t.84: As for the earth, We have stretched it out and placed on it firm mountains, and We have caused to grow in it everything well-balanced,
t.85: As for the earth, We have spread it out, set firm mountains on it, and made everything grow there in due balance.
t.95: As for the earth, We have stretched it out and have cast on it firm mountains, and have caused to grow in it everything well-measured.
t.19: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.
t.22: And the earth We have spread out (like a carpet); set thereon mountains firm and immovable; and produced therein all kinds of things in due balance.
t.203: And the earth We have spread out, and have placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein all kinds of things in due proportion.
t.54: اور زمین کو ہم نے پھیلا دیا ہے اور اس پر (اٹل) پہاڑ ڈال دیئے ہیں، اور اس میں ہم نے ہر چیز ایک معین مقدار سے اگا دی ہے.

t.149: And We made livelihoods for youin it, as well as for those for whom you are not the providers.
t.84: and created in it sources of sustenance for you and those (creatures) for whom you are not the sustainers.
t.85: We have provided sustenance in it for you and for all those creatures for whom you do not provide.
t.95: And We have provided sustenance for you on it and also for those of whom you are not the providers.
t.19: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.
t.22: And We have provided therein means of subsistence,- for you and for those for whose sustenance ye are not responsible.
t.203: And We have provided therein means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not [moving (living) creatures, cattle, beasts, and other animals].
t.54: اور اسی میں ہم نے تمہاری روزیاں بنا دی ہیں اور جنہیں تم روزی دینے والے نہیں ہو.

t.149: For there is not a thing but with Us are its treasuries, yet in no way do We bestow it from on high except in a known measure.
t.84: We have treasures of every thing, but We send it down only in a determined quantity.
t.85: There is not a thing whose storehouses are not with Us. We send it down only according to a well-defined measure:
t.95: There is nothing except that its treasuries are with Us and We do not send it down except in a known measure.
t.19: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.
t.22: And there is not a thing but its (sources and) treasures (inexhaustible) are with Us; but We only send down thereof in due and ascertainable measures.
t.203: And there is not a thing, but with Us are the stores thereof. And We send it not down except in a known measure.
t.54: اور جتنی بھی چیزیں ہیں ان سب کے خزانے ہمارے پاس ہیں، اور ہم ہر چیز کو اس کے مقرره انداز سے اتارتے ہیں.

t.149: And We sent the winds , fertilizing, then sent down water from the sky and gave it to youto drink, and in no way are you its keepers.
t.84: And We sent forth winds carrying the clouds, then sent down water from the sky and gave it to you to drink, and you are not able to store it.
t.85: We send the winds to fertilize, and We bring down water from the sky for you to drink- you do not control its sources.
t.95: We send fertilizing winds, and then cause rain to descend from the sky, providing you abundant water to drink even though you could not have stored it up for yourselves.
t.19: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.
t.22: And We send the fecundating winds, then cause the rain to descend from the sky, therewith providing you with water (in abundance), though ye are not the guardians of its stores.
t.203: And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then cause the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We give it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like].
t.54: اور ہم بھیجتے ہیں بوجھل ہوائیں، پھر آسمان سے پانی برسا کر وه تمہیں پلاتے ہیں اور تم اس کا ذخیره کرنے والے نہیں ہو.

t.149: And indeed, We—surely, We—give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors.
t.84: It is indeed We, and only We, who give life and bring death, and We are the ultimate inheritor (of everything).
t.85: It is We who give life and death; it is We who inherit [everything].
t.95: It is indeed We Who grant life and cause death and it is We who shall be the sole Inheritors of all.
t.19: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.
t.22: And verily, it is We Who give life, and Who give death: it is We Who remain inheritors (after all else passes away).
t.203: And certainly We! We it is Who give life, and cause death, and We are the Inheritors.
t.54: ہم ہی جلاتے اور مارتے ہیں اور ہم ہی (بالﺂخر) وارث ہیں.

t.149: And most surely We have known those of you who passed away, and most surely We have known those who come afterwards;
t.84: We know those of you who went ahead, and We know those who remained late.
t.85: We know exactly those of you who come first and those who come later.
t.95: Surely We know those of you who have passed before and those who will come later.
t.19: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.
t.22: To Us are known those of you who hasten forward, and those who lag behind.
t.203: And indeed, We know the first generations of you who had passed away, and indeed, We know the present generations of you (mankind), and also those who will come afterwards.
t.54: اور تم میں سے آگے بڑھنے والے اور پیچھے ہٹنے والے بھی ہمارے علم میں ہیں.

t.149: and indeed, it is yourLord Who herds themtogether; indeed, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
t.84: Surely, your Lord will gather all of them together. Indeed He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
t.85: [Prophet], it is your Lord who will gather them all together: He is all wise, all knowing.
t.95: Indeed your Lord will gather them all together. Surely He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
t.19: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.
t.22: Assuredly it is thy Lord Who will gather them together: for He is perfect in Wisdom and Knowledge.
t.203: And verily, your Lord will gather them together. Truly, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
t.54: آپ کا رب سب لوگوں کو جمع کرے گا یقیناً وه بڑی حکمتوں واﻻ بڑے علم واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And most surely We created man from potter’s clay, of fermented mud,
t.84: Indeed We created man from a ringing clay made of decayed mud.
t.85: We created man out of dried clay formed from dark mud-
t.95: Surely We brought man into being out of dry ringing clay which was wrought from black mud,
t.19: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,
t.22: We created man from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape;
t.203: And indeed, We created man from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud.
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے انسان کو کالی اور سڑی ہوئی کھنکھناتی مٹی سے، پیدا فرمایا ہے.

t.149: while We created the unseen beingbefore from the fire of the searing wind.
t.84: As for the Jānn (the first Jinn), We had created him earlier from the fire of the scorching wind.
t.85: the jinn We created before, from the fire of scorching wind.
t.95: while We had brought the jinn into being before out of blazing fire.
t.19: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.
t.22: And the Jinn race, We had created before, from the fire of a scorching wind.
t.203: And the jinn, We created aforetime from the smokeless flame of fire.
t.54: اور اس سے پہلے جنات کو ہم نے لو والی آگ سے پیدا کیا.

t.149: And recall when yourLord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from potter’s clay, of fermented mud.
t.84: Recall when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from a ringing clay made of decayed mud.
t.85: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a mortal out of dried clay, formed from dark mud.
t.95: Recall when your Lord said to the angels: "I will indeed bring into being a human being out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud.
t.19: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,
t.22: Behold! thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man, from sounding clay from mud moulded into shape;
t.203: And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "I am going to create a man (Adam) from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud.
t.54: اور جب تیرے پروردگار نے فرشتوں سے فرمایا کہ میں ایک انسان کو کالی اور سڑی ہوئی کھنکھناتی مٹی سے پیدا کرنے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: So when I have formed him and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down to him, prostrating.”
t.84: When I form him perfect, and blow in him of My spirit, then you must fall down before him in prostration.”
t.85: When I have fashioned him and breathed My spirit into him, bow down before him,’
t.95: When I have completed shaping him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall you down before him in prostration."
t.19: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.
t.22: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
t.203: "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves unto him."
t.54: تو جب میں اسے پورا بنا چکوں اور اس میں اپنی روح پھونک دوں تو تم سب اس کے لیے سجدے میں گر پڑنا.

t.149: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together—
t.84: So the angels prostrated themselves, all together,
t.85: and the angels all did so.
t.95: So, the angels - all of them - fell down in prostration,
t.19: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together
t.22: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
t.203: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together.
t.54: چنانچہ تمام فرشتوں نے سب کے سب نے سجده کر لیا.

t.149: but not Iblis. He refused to be with those who prostrated themselves.
t.84: except Iblīs (Satan). He refused to join those who prostrated.
t.85: But not Iblis: he refused to bow down like the others.
t.95: except Iblis; he refused to join those who prostrated.
t.19: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.
t.22: Not so Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
t.203: Except Iblîs (Satan) - he refused to be among the prostrators.
t.54: مگر ابلیس کے۔ کہ اس نے سجده کرنے والوں میں شمولیت کرنے سے (صاف) انکار کر دیا.

t.149: He said, “O Iblis, what keeps you from being with those who prostrate themselves?”
t.84: He (Allah) said, “O Iblīs, what is the matter with you that you did not join those who prostrated?”
t.85: God said, ‘Iblis, why did you not bow down like the others?’
t.95: The Lord inquired: "Iblis! What is the matter with you that you did not join those who prostrated?"
t.19: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate?
t.22: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! what is your reason for not being among those who prostrated themselves?"
t.203: (Allâh) said: "O Iblîs (Satan)! What is your reason for not being among the prostrators?"
t.54: (اللہ تعالیٰ نے) فرمایا اے ابلیس تجھے کیا ہوا کہ تو سجده کرنے والوں میں شامل نہ ہوا؟

t.149: He said, “Never would I prostrate myself to a human being whom You created from potter’s clay, of fermented mud.”
t.84: He said, “I am not such that I should prostrate myself before a mortal whom You have created from a ringing clay made of decayed mud.”
t.85: and he answered, ‘I will not bow to a mortal You created from dried clay, formed from dark mud.’
t.95: He said: "It does not behove of me to prostrate myself before a human being whom You have created out of dry ringing clay wrought from black mud."
t.19: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered!
t.22: (Iblis) said: "I am not one to prostrate myself to man, whom Thou didst create from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape."
t.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "I am not the one to prostrate myself to a human being, whom You created from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud."
t.54: وه بوﻻ کہ میں ایسا نہیں کہ اس انسان کو سجده کروں جسے تو نے کالی اور سڑی ہوئی کھنکھناتی مٹی سے پیدا کیا ہے.

t.149: He said, “Then get out of it, for indeed you are an outcast,
t.84: He said, “Then, get out of here, for you are an outcast,
t.85: ‘Get out of here!’ said God. ‘You are an outcast,
t.95: The Lord said: "Then get out of here; you are rejected,
t.19: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.
t.22: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here; for thou art rejected, accursed.
t.203: (Allâh) said: "Then, get out from here, for verily, you are Rajîm (an outcast or a cursed one)." [Tafsîr At-Tabarî]
t.54: فرمایا اب تو بہشت سے نکل جا کیوں کہ تو رانده درگاه ہے.

t.149: and indeed the curse is upon you until the Day of Recompense.”
t.84: and upon you is the curse up to the Day of Judgment.”
t.85: rejected until the Day of Judgement.’
t.95: and there shall be a curse upon you till the Day of Recompense."
t.19: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.
t.22: "And the curse shall be on thee till the day of Judgment."
t.203: "And verily, the curse shall be upon you till the Day of Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)."
t.54: اور تجھ پر میری پھٹکار ہے قیامت کے دن تک.

t.149: He said, “My Lord, then reprieve me until the day they are resurrected.”
t.84: He said, “My Lord, then give me respite up to the day they (the dead) shall be raised.”
t.85: Iblis said, ‘My Lord, give me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead.’
t.95: Iblis said: "My Lord! Grant me respite till the Day when they will be resurrected."
t.19: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
t.22: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
t.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected."
t.54: کہنے لگا کہ اے میرے رب! مجھے اس دن تک کی ڈھیل دے کہ لوگ دوباره اٹھا کھڑے کیے جائیں.

t.149: He said, “Then, you are indeed of the ones reprieved
t.84: He (Allah) said, “Well, respite is given to you
t.85: ‘You have respite,’ said God,
t.95: Allah said: "For sure you are granted respite
t.19: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved
t.22: (Allah) said: "Respite is granted thee
t.203: Allâh said: "Then, verily, you are of those reprieved,
t.54: فرمایا کہ اچھا تو ان میں سے ہے جنہیں مہلت ملی ہے.

t.149: until the Day of the Time Appointed.”
t.84: till the day of the Appointed Time.”
t.85: ‘until the Day of the Appointed Time.’
t.95: until the day of a known time."
t.19: Till the Day of appointed time.
t.22: "Till the Day of the Time appointed."
t.203: "Till the Day of the time appointed."
t.54: روز مقرر کے وقت تک کی.

t.149: He said, “My Lord, since You have deluded me, I will most surely adorn for them(evil deeds) on earth, and I will most surely delude them all,
t.84: He said, “My Lord, since You made me go astray, I swear that I shall beautify for them (evils) on the earth, and shall lead all of them astray,
t.85: Iblis then said to God, ‘Because You have put me in the wrong, I will lure mankind on earth and put them in the wrong,
t.95: Iblis said: "My Lord! In the manner You led me to error, I will make things on earth seem attractive to them and lead all of them to error,
t.19: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,
t.22: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! because Thou hast put me in the wrong, I will make (wrong) fair-seeming to them on the earth, and I will put them all in the wrong,-
t.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Because you misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all.
