t.54: (شیطان نے) کہا کہ اے میرے رب! چونکہ تو نے مجھے گمراه کیا ہے مجھے بھی قسم ہے کہ میں بھی زمین میں ان کے لئے معاصی کو مزین کروں گا اور ان سب کو بہکاؤں گا بھی.

t.149: except for Your sincere chosen servants among them.”
t.84: except those of Your servants from among them who are chosen (by You).”
t.85: all except Your devoted servants.’
t.95: except those of Your servants whom You have singled out for Yourself."
t.19: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves.
t.22: "Except Thy servants among them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
t.203: "Except Your chosen, (guided) slaves among them."
t.54: سوائے تیرے ان بندوں کے جو منتخب کر لیے گئے ہیں.

t.149: He said, “This is a straight path which is binding on Me :
t.84: He (Allah) said, “This is the straight path leading to Me (that a person is chosen by Me through his good deeds).
t.85: God said, ‘[Devotion] is a straight path to Me:
t.95: Allah said: "Here is the path that leads straight to Me.
t.19: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me:
t.22: (Allah) said: "This (way of My sincere servants) is indeed a way that leads straight to Me.
t.203: (Allâh) said: "This is the Way which will lead straight to Me."
t.54: ارشاد ہوا کہ ہاں یہی مجھ تک پہنچنے کی سیدھی راه ہے.

t.149: over My servants youhave no authority indeed, except for those who follow you of the deluded ones.
t.84: My servants are such that you have no power over them except those of the deviators who will follow you.
t.85: you will have no power over My servants, only over the ones who go astray and follow you.
t.95: Over My true servants you will be able to exercise no power, your power will be confined to the erring ones, those who choose to follow you.
t.19: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee,
t.22: "For over My servants no authority shalt thou have, except such as put themselves in the wrong and follow thee."
t.203: "Certainly, you shall have no authority over My slaves, except those who follow you of the Ghâwûn (Mushrikûn and those who go astray, criminals, polytheists, and evil-doers).
t.54: میرے بندوں پر تجھے کوئی غلبہ نہیں، لیکن ہاں جو گمراه لوگ تیری پیروی کریں.

t.149: And indeed, Hell is the meeting place for them all.
t.84: And Jahannam (Hell) is the promised place for them all.
t.85: Hell is the promised place for all these,
t.95: Surely Hell is the promised place for all of them."
t.19: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place.
t.22: And verily, Hell is the promised abode for them all!
t.203: "And surely, Hell is the promised place for them all.
t.54: یقیناً ان سب کے وعدے کی جگہ جہنم ہے.

t.149: It has seven gates; for each gate is an assigned class.”
t.84: It has seven gates. For each gate there is a group apportioned from them.”
t.85: with seven gates, each gate having its allotted share of them.
t.95: There are seven gates in it, and to each gate a portion of them has been allotted.
t.19: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion.
t.22: To it are seven gates: for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned.
t.203: "It (Hell) has seven gates, for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned.
t.54: جس کے سات دروازے ہیں۔ ہر دروازے کے لیے ان کا ایک حصہ بٹا ہوا ہے.

t.149: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are amid Gardens and springs.
t.84: Surely, the God-fearing will be in gardens and streams:
t.85: But the righteous will be in Gardens with springs-
t.95: As for the God-fearing, they shall be amid gardens and springs.
t.19: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings.
t.22: The righteous (will be) amid gardens and fountains (of clear-flowing water).
t.203: "Truly! The Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) will be amidst Gardens and water-springs (Paradise).
t.54: پرہیزگار جنتی لوگ باغوں اور چشموں میں ہوں گے.

t.149: “Enter it in peace, feeling safe.”
t.84: “Enter here in peace, free of fear.”
t.85: “Enter them in peace and safety!”––
t.95: They will be told: "Enter it in peace and security."
t.19: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.
t.22: (Their greeting will be): "Enter ye here in peace and security."
t.203: "(It will be said to them): ‘Enter therein (Paradise), in peace and security.’
t.54: (ان سے کہا جائے گا) سلامتی اور امن کے ساتھ اس میں داخل ہو جاؤ.

t.149: And We removedwhatever malice was within their chests—as brethren, on couches facing each other.
t.84: We shall have removed whatever grudge they had in their hearts, (thus making them) brothers, sitting on couches, face to face.
t.85: and We shall remove any bitterness from their hearts: [they will be like] brothers, sitting on couches, face to face.
t.95: And We shall purge their breasts of all traces of rancour; and they shall be seated on couches facing one another as brothers.
t.19: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.
t.22: And We shall remove from their hearts any lurking sense of injury: (they will be) brothers (joyfully) facing each other on thrones (of dignity).
t.203: "And We shall remove from their breasts any deep feeling of bitterness (that they may have). (So they will be like) brothers facing each other on thrones.
t.54: ان کے دلوں میں جو کچھ رنجش وکینہ تھا، ہم سب کچھ نکال دیں گے، وه بھائی بھائی بنے ہوئے ایک دوسرے کے آمنے سامنے تختوں پر بیٹھے ہوں گے.

t.149: No fatigue touchesthem therein, nor from it will they ever be brought out.
t.84: No weariness shall touch them nor will they be expelled from there.
t.85: No weariness will ever touch them there, nor will they ever be expelled.’
t.95: They shall face no fatigue in it, nor shall they ever be driven out of it.
t.19: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.
t.22: There no sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave.
t.203: "No sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave it."
t.54: نہ تو وہاں انہیں کوئی تکلیف چھو سکتی ہے اور نہ وه وہاں سے کبھی نکالے جائیں گے.

t.149: InformMy servants that I—only I—am the Oft-Forgiving, the Bestower of mercy,
t.84: Tell My servants that I am the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful
t.85: [Prophet], tell My servants that I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
t.95: (O Prophet), declare to My servants that I am indeed Ever Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.19: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
t.22: Tell My servants that I am indeed the Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful;
t.203: Declare (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) unto My slaves, that truly, I am the Oft-Forgiving, the Most-Merciful.
t.54: میرے بندوں کو خبر دے دو کہ میں بہت ہی بخشنے واﻻ اور بڑا ہی مہربان ہوں.

t.149: and that My punishment is the painful punishment.
t.84: and that My punishment is the painful punishment,
t.85: but My torment is the truly painful one.
t.95: At the same time, My chastisement is highly painful.
t.19: And that My doom is the dolorous doom.
t.22: And that My Penalty will be indeed the most grievous Penalty.
t.203: And that My Torment is indeed the most painful torment.
t.54: اور ساتھ ہی میرے عذاب بھی نہایت دردناک ہیں.

t.149: And inform them of the guests of Abraham,
t.84: and tell them about the guests of Ibrāhīm.
t.85: Tell them too about Abraham’s guests:
t.95: And tell them about Abraham's guests.
t.19: And tell them of Abraham's guests,
t.22: Tell them about the guests of Abraham.
t.203: And tell them about the guests (the angels) of Ibrâhîm (Abraham).
t.54: انہیں ابراہیم کے مہمانوں کا (بھی) حال سنا دو.

t.149: when they entered upon him and said, “Peace.” He said, “We are truly scared of you.”
t.84: When they visited him, they greeted him with Salām (peace on you). He said, “We are scared of you.”
t.85: when they came to him and said, ‘Peace,’ he said, ‘We are afraid of you.’
t.95: When they came to Abraham they said: "Peace be upon you!" He replied: "Indeed we feel afraid of you."
t.19: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.
t.22: When they entered his presence and said, "Peace!" He said, "We feel afraid of you!"
t.203: When they entered unto him, and said: Salâm (peace)! [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Indeed! We are afraid of you."
t.54: کہ جب انہوں نے ان کے پاس آکر سلام کہا تو انہوں نے کہا کہ ہم کو تو تم سے ڈر لگتا ہے.

t.149: They said, “Do not be scared; we bring youglad tidings of a knowledgeable boy.”
t.84: They said, “Do not be scared. We give you good news of a boy who will be knowledgeable.”
t.85: ‘Do not be afraid,’ they said, ‘We bring you good news of a son who will have great knowledge.’
t.95: They said: "Do not feel afraid, for we give you the good news of a wise boy."
t.19: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.
t.22: They said: "Fear not! We give thee glad tidings of a son endowed with wisdom."
t.203: They (the angels) said: "Do not be afraid! We give you glad tidings of a boy (son) possessing much knowledge and wisdom."
t.54: انہوں نے کہا ڈرو نہیں، ہم تجھے ایک صاحب علم فرزند کی بشارت دیتے ہیں.

t.149: He said, “Have you brought me glad tidings when old age has touched me? So what glad tidings could you give ?”
t.84: He said, “Do you give me the good news despite the old age has befallen me? So what good news you are giving to me?”
t.85: He said, ‘How can you give me such news when old age has come to me? What sort of news is this?’
t.95: Abraham said: "What, do you give me this tiding though old age has smitten me? Just consider what tiding do you give me!"
t.19: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings?
t.22: He said: "Do ye give me glad tidings that old age has seized me? Of what, then, is your good news?"
t.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Do you give me glad tidings (of a son) when old age has overtaken me? Of what then is your news?"
t.54: کہا، کیا اس بڑھاپے کے آجانے کے بعد تم مجھے خوشخبری دیتے ہو! یہ خوشخبری تم کیسے دے رہے ہو؟

t.149: They said, “We brought you true glad tidings, so be not of the despairing ones.”
t.84: They said, “We have given to you the good news of a fact. So do not be one of those who lose hope.”
t.85: They said, ‘We have told you the truth, so do not despair.’
t.95: They said: "The good tiding we give you is of truth. Do not, therefore, be of those who despair."
t.19: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing.
t.22: They said: "We give thee glad tidings in truth: be not then in despair!"
t.203: They (the angels) said: "We give you glad tidings in truth. So be not of the despairing."
t.54: انہوں نے کہا ہم آپ کو بالکل سچی خوشخبری سناتے ہیں آپ مایوس لوگوں میں شامل نہ ہوں.

t.149: He said, “And who despairs of his Lord’s mercy except for thoseastray?”
t.84: He said, “Who can lose hope in the mercy of his Lord except those who have lost the straight path?”
t.85: He said, ‘Who but the misguided despair of the mercy of their Lord?’
t.95: Abraham said: "Who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except the misguided?"
t.19: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray?
t.22: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, but such as go astray?"
t.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "And who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except those who are astray?"
t.54: کہا اپنے رب تعالیٰ کی رحمت سے ناامید تو صرف گمراه اور بہکے ہوئے لوگ ہی ہوتے ہیں.

t.149: He said, “So what is your business, O emissaries?”
t.84: He said, “Then, what is your mission, O messengers?”
t.85: and then asked, ‘Messengers, what is your errand?’
t.95: He added: "What is your errand O sent ones?"
t.19: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)?
t.22: Abraham said: "What then is the business on which ye (have come), O ye messengers (of Allah)?"
t.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham) again] said: "What then is the business on which you have come, O Messengers?"
t.54: پوچھا کہ اللہ کے بھیجے ہوئے (فرشتو!) تمہارا ایسا کیا اہم کام ہے؟

t.149: They said, “We have been sent to a people of criminals,
t.84: They said, “We have been sent to a sinful people,
t.85: They replied, ‘We have been sent to a people who are guilty.’
t.95: They said: "Verily we have been sent to a guilty people
t.19: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,
t.22: They said: "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin,
t.203: They (the angels) said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners).
t.54: انہوں نے جواب دیا کہ ہم مجرم قوم کی طرف بھیجے گئے ہیں.

t.149: except for Lot’s folk; we will most surely deliver them all,
t.84: except the family of LūT - all of whom we shall save,
t.85: But We shall save the household of Lot,
t.95: excepting the household of Lot. We shall deliver all of them,
t.19: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,
t.22: "Excepting the adherents of Lut: them we are certainly (charged) to save (from harm),- All -
t.203: "(All) except the family of Lût (Lot). Them all we are surely going to save (from destruction).
t.54: مگر خاندان لوط کہ ہم ان سب کو تو ضرور بچا لیں گے.

t.149: except for his wife.” We have determined that she will most surely be of those who linger behind.
t.84: but his wife. We have ordained that she will be among those who will remain behind.”
t.85: all except his wife: We have decreed that she will be one of those who stay behind.
t.95: except his wife (about whom Allah says that) We have decreed that she shall be among those who stay behind."
t.19: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind.
t.22: "Except his wife, who, We have ascertained, will be among those who will lag behind."
t.203: "Except his wife, of whom We have decreed that she shall be of those who remain behind (i.e. she will be destroyed)."
t.54: سوائے اس (لوط) کی بیوی کے کہ ہم نے اسے رکنے اور باقی ره جانے والوں میں مقرر کر دیا ہے.

t.149: So when the emissaries came to Lot’s folk,
t.84: So when the messengers came to the family of LūT,
t.85: When the messengers came to the household of Lot,
t.95: So when the envoys came to the household of Lot,
t.19: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,
t.22: At length when the messengers arrived among the adherents of Lut,
t.203: Then, when the Messengers (the angels) came unto the family of Lût (Lot).
t.54: جب بھیجے ہوئے فرشتے آل لوط کے پاس پہنچے.

t.149: he said, “You are an unknown people.”
t.84: he said, “You are an unfamiliar people.”
t.85: he said, ‘You are strangers.’
t.95: he said: "Surely you are an unknown folk."
t.19: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me).
t.22: He said: "Ye appear to be uncommon folk."
t.203: He said: "Verily! You are people unknown to me."
t.54: تو انہوں (لوط علیہ السلام) نے کہا تم لوگ تو کچھ انجان سے معلوم ہو رہے ہو.

t.149: They said, “Rather, we have come to youwith that about which they were skeptical,
t.84: They said, “No, but we have brought to you that (scourge) in which they have been doubting,
t.85: They said, ‘We have brought you what they said would never happen:
t.95: They said: "Nay, we have brought to you that concerning which they have been in doubt.
t.19: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,
t.22: They said: "Yea, we have come to thee to accomplish that of which they doubt.
t.203: They said: "Nay, we have come to you with that (torment) which they have been doubting.
t.54: انہوں نے کہا نہیں بلکہ ہم تیرے پاس وه چیز ﻻئے ہیں جس میں یہ لوگ شک شبہ کر رہے تھے.

t.149: and we have brought you the truth, and very truly we are truthful.
t.84: and we have come to you with a definite matter and surely we are truthful.
t.85: we have brought you the Truth. We speak truly,
t.95: We truly tell you that we have brought to you the Truth.
t.19: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers.
t.22: "We have brought to thee that which is inevitably due, and assuredly we tell the truth.
t.203: "And we have brought you the truth (the news of the destruction of your nation) and certainly, we tell the truth.
t.54: ہم تو تیرے پاس (صریح) حق ﻻئے ہیں اور ہیں بھی بالکل سچے.

t.149: So journey with your family at the latter part of the night and follow at their rear, and let none of you turn around, and proceedwherever youare commanded.”
t.84: So, carry your family after a part of the night (has passed), and follow them at the rear (to make sure that all of your family has joined you), and no one from you should look back; and keep going to where you are commanded.”
t.85: so leave in the dead of the night with your household, and walk behind them. Let none of you look back. Go where you are commanded.’
t.95: So set out with your family in a watch of the night, and keep yourself behind them, and no one of you may turn around, and keep going ahead as you have been commanded."
t.19: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.
t.22: "Then travel by night with thy household, when a portion of the night (yet remains), and do thou bring up the rear: let no one amongst you look back, but pass on whither ye are ordered."
t.203: "Then travel in a part of the night with your family, and you go behind them in the rear, and let no one amongst you look back, but go on to where you are ordered."
t.54: اب تو اپنے خاندان سمیت اس رات کے کسی حصہ میں چل دے اور آپ ان کے پیچھے رہنا، اور (خبردار) تم میں سے کوئی (پیچھے) مڑکر بھی نہ دیکھے اور جہاں کا تمہیں حکم کیا جارہا ہے وہاں چلے جان.

t.149: And We decreed to him that matter: that the last trace of these would be uprooted by the morning.
t.84: We conveyed to him Our decision that they (the unbelievers) were to be totally uprooted when they would see the morning.
t.85: We made this decree known to him: the last remnants of those people would be wiped out in the morning.
t.95: And We communicated to him the decree that by the morning those people will be totally destroyed.
t.19: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn.
t.22: And We made known this decree to him, that the last remnants of those (sinners) should be cut off by the morning.
t.203: And We made known this decree to him, that the root of those (sinners) was to be cut off in the early morning.
t.54: اور ہم نے اس کی طرف اس بات کا فیصلہ کر دیا کہ صبح ہوتے ہوتے ان لوگوں کی جڑیں کاٹ دی جائیں گی.

t.149: And the people of the town came anticipating glad tidings.
t.84: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
t.85: The people of the town came along, revelling,
t.95: In the meantime the people of the city came to Lot rejoicing.
t.19: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals).
t.22: The inhabitants of the city came in (mad) joy (at news of the young men).
t.203: And the inhabitants of the city came rejoicing (at the news of the young men’s arrival).
t.54: اور شہر والے خوشیاں مناتے ہوئے آئے.

t.149: He said, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me,
t.84: He (LūT) said, “They are my guests; so do not put me to shame,
t.85: and he told them, ‘These are my guests, do not disgrace me.
t.95: He said: "These are my guests, so do not disgrace me.
t.19: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!
t.22: Lut said: "These are my guests: disgrace me not:
t.203: [Lût (Lot)] said: "Verily! these are my guests, so shame me not.
t.54: (لوط علیہ السلام نے) کہا یہ لوگ میرے مہمان ہیں تم مجھے رسوا نہ کرو.

t.149: and be mindful of Allah and do not disgrace me.”
t.84: and fear Allah and do not disgrace me.”
t.85: Fear God, and do not shame me.’
t.95: Have fear of Allah, and do not humiliate me."
t.19: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!
t.22: "But fear Allah, and shame me not."
t.203: "And fear Allâh and disgrace me not."
t.54: اللہ تعالیٰ سے ڈرو اور مجھے رسوا نہ کرو.

t.149: They said, “Did we not forbid youfrom(receiving) any people?”
t.84: They said, “Had we not forbidden you from (being the guardian of) the whole world?”
t.85: They answered, ‘Have we not told you not to interfere [between us and] anyone else?’
t.95: They replied: "Did we not forbid you again and again to extend hospitality to all and sundry?"
t.19: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone?
t.22: They said: "Did we not forbid thee (to speak) for all and sundry?"
t.203: They (people of the city) said: "Did we not forbid you from entertaining (or protecting) any of the ‘Âlamîn (people, foreigners and strangers from us)?"
t.54: وه بولے کیا ہم نے تجھے دنیا بھر (کی ٹھیکیداری) سے منع نہیں کر رکھا؟

t.149: He said, “These are my daughters, if you must.”
t.84: He said, “These are my daughters, if you are to do something.”
t.85: He said, ‘My daughters are here, if you must.’
t.95: Lot exclaimed in exasperation: "If you are bent on doing something, then here are my daughters."
t.19: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so).
t.22: He said: "There are my daughters (to marry), if ye must act (so)."
t.203: [Lût (Lot)] said: "These (the girls of the nation) are my daughters (to marry lawfully), if you must act (so)."
t.54: (لوط علیہ السلام نے) کہا اگر تمہیں کرنا ہی ہے تو یہ میری بچیاں موجود ہیں.

t.149: By yourlife, in their drunkenness they certainly do blunder!
t.84: By your life, (O prophet) they were wandering blindly in their intoxication (misguidance).
t.85: By your life [Prophet], they wandered on in their wild intoxication
t.95: By your life, (O Prophet), they went about blindly stumbling in their intoxication.
t.19: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death.
t.22: Verily, by thy life (O Prophet), in their wild intoxication, they wander in distraction, to and fro.
t.203: Verily, by your life (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم), in their wild intoxication, they were wandering blindly.
t.54: تیری عمر کی قسم! وه تو اپنی بدمستی میں سرگرداں تھے.

t.149: So the Shout took them away at sunrise.
t.84: So, they were seized by the Cry at sunrise.
t.85: and the blast overtook them at sunrise:
t.95: Then the mighty Blast caught them at sunrise,
t.19: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.
t.22: But the (mighty) Blast overtook them before morning,
t.203: So As-Saihah (torment - awful cry) overtook them at the time of sunrise.
t.54: پس سورج نکلتے نکلتے انہیں ایک بڑے زور کی آواز نے پکڑ لیا.

t.149: And We turned it upside down and rained down upon them stones of hard clay.
t.84: Then, We turned it (the city) upside down and rained down upon them stones of baked clay.
t.85: We turned their city upside down and rained on them a shower of clay stones.
t.95: and turned the land upside down, and rained down stones of baked clay.
t.19: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.
t.22: And We turned (the cities) upside down, and rained down on them brimstones hard as baked clay.
t.203: And We turned (the towns of Sodom in Palestine) upside down and rained down on them stones of baked clay.
t.54: بالﺂخر ہم نے اس شہر کو اوپر تلے کر دیا اور ان لوگوں پر کنکر والے پتھر برسائے.

t.149: Indeed, in that are certainly signs for those who contemplate.
t.84: Surely, in that there are signs for those who read signs.
t.85: There truly is a sign in this for those who can learn-
t.95: There are great Signs in this for those endowed with intelligence.
t.19: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs.
t.22: Behold! in this are Signs for those who by tokens do understand.
t.203: Surely! In this are signs for those who see (or understand or learn the lessons from the Signs of Allâh).
t.54: بلاشبہ بصیرت والوں کے لیے اس میں بہت سی نشانیاں ہیں.

t.149: And indeed, itis certainly on an existing way.
t.84: Surely, it (their city) is located on the straight road.
t.85: it is still there on the highway-
t.95: The place (where this occurred) lies along a known route.
t.19: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced.
t.22: And the (cities were) right on the high-road.
t.203: And verily! They (the cities) were right on the highroad (from Makkah to Syria i.e. the place where the Dead Sea is now).
t.54: یہ بستی ایسی راه پر ہے جو برابر چلتی رہتی (عام گذرگاه) ہے.

t.149: Indeed, in that is certainly a sign for the believers.
t.84: Surely, in it there is a sign for the believers.
t.85: there truly is a sign in this for those who believe.
t.95: Verily there is a Sign in this for the believers.
t.19: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.
t.22: Behold! in this is a sign for those who believed.
t.203: Surely! Therein is indeed a sign for the believers.
t.54: اور اس میں ایمان والوں کے لیے بڑی نشانی ہے.

t.149: And indeed, the fellows of the Thicket were certainly unjust,
t.84: And the people of Aikah were (also) transgressors.
t.85: The forest-dwellers, too, were wrongdoers
t.95: And the people of Aykah were also wrong-doers.
t.19: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers.
t.22: And the Companions of the Wood were also wrong-doers;
t.203: And the Dwellers in the Wood [i.e. the people of Madyan (Midian) to whom Prophet Shu‘aib (عليه السلام) was sent by Allâh), were also Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers).
t.54: اور بے شک اَیکَہ بستی کے رہنے والے يقيناً ﻇالم تھے.

t.149: so We took retribution on them, and indeed, both are certainly in an evident archive.
t.84: So, We punished them in retribution, and both of them are (situated) by a highway, clearly visible.
t.85: and We took retribution on them; both are still there on the highway, plain for all to see.
t.95: So We chastised them. The desolate locations of both communities lie on a well-known highway.
t.19: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.
t.22: So We exacted retribution from them. They were both on an open highway, plain to see.
t.203: So, We took vengeance on them. They are both on an open highway, plain to see.
t.54: جن سے (آخر) ہم نے انتقام لے ہی لیا۔ یہ دونوں شہر کھلے (عام) راستے پر ہیں.

t.149: And most surely, the fellows of Al-Hijrdisbelievedthe emissaries.
t.84: And the people of Al-Hijr gave the lie to the messengers.
t.85: The people of al-Hijr also rejected Our messengers:
t.95: Surely the people of al-Hijr also rejected the Messengers, calling them liars.
t.19: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.
t.22: The Companions of the Rocky Tract also rejected the messengers:
t.203: And verily, the dwellers of Al-Hijr (the rocky tract) denied the Messengers.
t.54: اور حِجر والوں نے بھی رسولوں کو جھٹلایا.

t.149: So We brought them Our signs, but they used to disregard them.
t.84: We provided them with Our signs, yet they kept turning away from them.
t.85: We gave them Our signs, but they turned their backs.
t.95: We also gave them Our Signs, yet they turned away from them.
t.19: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.
t.22: We sent them Our Signs, but they persisted in turning away from them.
t.203: And We gave them Our Signs, but they were averse to them.
t.54: اور ہم نے ان کو اپنی نشانیاں بھی عطا فرمائیں (لیکن) تاہم وه ان سے روگردانی ہی کرتے رہے.

t.149: And of the mountains they used to carve homes, feeling safe.
t.84: They used to hew out houses from the hills peacefully.
t.85: They carved out dwellings in the mountains, and lived in security-
t.95: They used to hew out houses from the mountains and lived in security.
t.19: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.
t.22: Out of the mountains did they hew (their) edifices, (feeling themselves) secure.
t.203: And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains (feeling themselves) secure.
t.54: یہ لوگ پہاڑوں کو تراش تراش کر گھر بناتے تھے، بے خوف ہوکر.

t.149: But the Shout took them away by the morning,
t.84: Then, the Cry seized them by the morning.
t.85: the blast overwhelmed them early in the morning.
t.95: Then the Blast caught them in the morning
t.19: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,
t.22: But the (mighty) Blast seized them of a morning,
t.203: But As-Saihah (torment - awful cry) overtook them in the early morning (of the fourth day of their promised punishment days).
t.54: آخر انہیں بھی صبح ہوتے ہوتے چنگھاڑنے آدبوچا.

t.149: so all what they used to earn was of no avail to them.
t.84: So, whatever they earned did not come to their help.
t.85: What they had gained was of no use to them.
t.95: and whatever they had been earning proved of no avail.
t.19: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.
t.22: And of no avail to them was all that they did (with such art and care)!
t.203: And all that they used to earn availed them not.
t.54: پس ان کی کسی تدبیروعمل نے انہیں کوئی فائده نہ دیا.

t.149: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them except with the truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming, so pardon(with) gracious pardoning.
t.84: We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them without a truthful purpose. The Hour is sure to come. Therefore, overlook (their evil behavior) in a gracious manner.
t.85: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them without a true purpose: the Hour will certainly come, so [Prophet] bear with them graciously.
t.95: We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them except with Truth. Surely the Hour will come. So, (O Muhammad), do graciously overlook them (despite their misdeeds).
t.19: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.
t.22: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, but for just ends. And the Hour is surely coming (when this will be manifest). So overlook (any human faults) with gracious forgiveness.
t.203: And We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with truth, and the Hour is surely coming, so overlook (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) their faults with gracious forgiveness. [This was before the ordainment of Jihâd - holy fighting in Allâh’s cause].
t.54: ہم نے آسمانوں اور زمین کو اور ان کے درمیان کی سب چیزوں کو حق کے ساتھ ہی پیدا فرمایا ہے، اور قیامت ضرور ضرور آنے والی ہے۔ پس تو حسن وخوبی (اور اچھائی) سے درگزر کر لے.

t.149: Indeed, yourLord is the One Who is the All-Creating, the All-Knowing.
t.84: Surely, your Lord is the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.
t.85: Your Lord is the All Knowing Creator.
t.95: Your Lord is indeed the Creator of all, the All-Knowing.
t.19: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.
t.22: For verily it is thy Lord who is the Master-Creator, knowing all things.
t.203: Verily, your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator.
t.54: یقیناً تیرا پروردگار ہی پیدا کرنے واﻻ اور جاننے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And most surely, We have brought youseven of the oft-repeatedand the great Recital.
t.84: We have given you the seven oft-repeated verses and the glorious Qur’ān.
t.85: We have given you the seven oft-recited versesand the whole glorious Quran.
t.95: We have indeed bestowed on you the seven oft-repeated verses and the Great Qur'an.
t.19: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.
t.22: And We have bestowed upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Grand Qur'an.
t.203: And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of Al-Mathâni (seven repeatedly recited Verses), (i.e. Sûrat Al-Fâtihah) and the Grand Qur’ân.
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے آپ کو سات آیتیں دے رکھی ہیں. کہ دہرائی جاتی ہیں اور عظیم قرآن بھی دے رکھا ہے.

t.149: Donot look longingly at the good things We have given some classes of them to enjoy, and do not grieve over them, and lower your wingtowards the believers.
t.84: Never stretch your eyes towards what We have given to groups of them to enjoy, and do not grieve for them, and be kind to believers in humbleness,
t.85: Do not look longingly at the good things We have given some to enjoy. Do not grieve over the [disbelievers], but lower your wings over the believers
t.95: Do not even cast your eyes towards the worldly goods We have granted to different kinds of people, nor grieve over the state they are in, but turn your loving attention to the believers instead,
t.19: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.
t.22: Strain not thine eyes. (Wistfully) at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them, nor grieve over them: but lower thy wing (in gentleness) to the believers.
t.203: Look not with your eyes ambitiously at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them (the disbelievers), nor grieve over them. And lower your wings for the believers (be courteous to the fellow-believers).
t.54: آپ ہر گز اپنی نظریں اس چیز کی طرف نہ دوڑائیں، جس سے ہم نے ان میں سے کئی قسم کے لوگوں کو بہره مند کر رکھا ہے، نہ ان پر آپ افسوس کریں اور مومنوں کے لیے اپنے بازو جھکائے رہیں.

t.149: And say, “Indeed, it is I—I who am the evident warner.”
t.84: and say, “I am a plain warner indeed”
t.85: and say, ‘I am here to give plain warning,’
t.95: and clearly tell the unbelievers: "I am most certainly a plain warner,"
t.19: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,
t.22: And say: "I am indeed he that warneth openly and without ambiguity,"-
t.203: And say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم): "I am indeed a plain warner."
t.54: اور کہہ دیجئے کہ میں تو کھلم کھلا ڈرانے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: So too did We send down to those who divide among themselves—
t.84: (to warn them that We may send down the scourge upon them) as We sent down upon the dividers.
t.85: like the [warning] We have sent down for those who divide themselves into bands
t.95: even as We had sent warning to those who had divided their religion into fragments;
t.19: Such as We send down for those who make division,
t.22: (Of just such wrath) as We sent down on those who divided (Scripture into arbitrary parts),-
t.203: As We have sent down on the dividers, (Quraish pagans or Jews and Christians).
t.54: جیسے کہ ہم نے ان تقسیم کرنے والوں پر اتارا.

t.149: those who have made the Recitalinto fragments.
t.84: who had split the divine recitation (Scriptures) into bits.
t.85: and abuse the Quran––
t.95: those who had split up their Qur'an into pieces.
t.19: Those who break the Qur'an into parts.
t.22: (So also on such) as have made Qur'an into shreds (as they please).
t.203: Who have made the Qur’ân into parts. (i.e. believed in one part and disbelieved in the other). [Tafsir At-Tabari]
t.54: جنہوں نے اس کتاب الٰہی کے ٹکڑے ٹکڑے کر دیئے.

t.149: So by yourLord, We will surely ask them all
t.84: So, by your Lord, We shall question all of them.
t.85: by your Lord, We will question them all
t.95: By your Lord, We will question them all
t.19: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,
t.22: Therefore, by the Lord, We will, of a surety, call them to account,
t.203: So, by your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم), We shall certainly call all of them to account.
t.54: قسم ہے تیرے پالنے والے کی! ہم ان سب سے ضرور باز پرس کریں گے.

t.149: about what they used to do.
t.84: about what they have been doing.
t.85: about their deeds.
t.95: concerning what they have been doing.
t.19: Of what they used to do.
t.22: For all their deeds.
t.203: For all that they used to do.
t.54: ہر اس چیز کی جو وه کرتے تھے.

t.149: So proclaimopenly what you are commanded and disregard the polytheists.
t.84: Now, proclaim what you are commanded to, and turn away from those who ascribe partners to Allah.
t.85: So proclaim openly what you have been commanded [to say], and ignore the idolaters.
t.95: (O Prophet), proclaim what you are commanded, and pay no heed to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity.
t.19: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.
t.22: Therefore expound openly what thou art commanded, and turn away from those who join false gods with Allah.
t.203: Therefore proclaim openly (Allâh’s Message - Islâmic Monotheism) that which you are commanded, and turn away from Al-Mushrikûn (polytheists, idolaters, and disbelievers - See V.2:105).
t.54: پس آپ اس حکم کو جو آپ کو کیا جارہا ہے کھول کر سنا دیجئے! اور مشرکوں سے منھ پھیر لیجئے.

t.149: Indeed, We have sufficed youagainst the mockers:
t.84: Surely, We are sufficient for you against those who deride,
t.85: We are enough for you against all those who ridicule your message,
t.95: Surely We suffice to deal with those who scoff at you,
t.19: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,
t.22: For sufficient are We unto thee against those who scoff,-
t.203: Truly! We will suffice you against the scoffers,
t.54: آپ سے جو لوگ مسخراپن کرتے ہیں ان کی سزا کے لیے ہم کافی ہیں.

t.149: those who set up another god with Allah. So they will come to know.
t.84: - those who believe in any other god along with Allah. So, they shall soon learn (the reality).
t.85: who set up another god beside God- they will come to know.
t.95: those who set up another deity alongside Allah. They shall soon come to know.
t.19: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.
t.22: Those who adopt, with Allah, another god: but soon will they come to know.
t.203: Who set up along with Allâh another ilâh (god); but they will come to know.
t.54: جو اللہ کے ساتھ دوسرے معبود مقرر کرتے ہیں انہیں عنقریب معلوم ہو جائے گا.

t.149: And most surely We are aware that yourchest tightens with what they say.
t.84: We know that your heart feels distressed for what they say.
t.85: We are well aware that your heart is weighed down by what they say.
t.95: We certainly know that their statements sorely grieve you.
t.19: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,
t.22: We do indeed know how thy heart is distressed at what they say.
t.203: Indeed, We know that your breast is straitened at what they say.
t.54: ہمیں خوب علم ہے کہ ان کی باتوں سے آپ کا دل تنگ ہوتا ہے.

t.149: So exalt your Lord with praise and be of those who prostrate,
t.84: So, proclaim the purity and glory of your Lord, and be among those who prostrate themselves (before Allah);
t.85: Celebrate the glory of your Lord and be among those who bow down to Him:
t.95: When (you feel so) glorify your Lord with His praise and prostrate yourself before Him,
t.19: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).
t.22: But celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves in adoration.
t.203: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be of those who prostrate themselves (to Him).
t.54: آپ اپنے پروردگار کی تسبیح اور حمد بیان کرتے رہیں اور سجده کرنے والوں میں شامل ہو جائیں.

t.149: and worship your Lord until Certitudecomes to you.
t.84: and worship your Lord until comes to you that which is certain.
t.85: worship your Lord until what is certain comes to you.
t.95: and worship your Lord until the last moment (of your life) that will most certainly come.
t.19: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.
t.22: And serve thy Lord until there come unto thee the Hour that is Certain.
t.203: And worship your Lord until there comes unto you the certainty (i.e. death).
t.54: اور اپنے رب کی عبادت کرتے رہیں یہاں تک کہ آپ کو موت آجائے.

t.149: Allah’s command has come, so donot rush it. Highly Exalted is He, and Most High above what they associate(with Him) .
t.84: Allah’s command has (almost) come. So, do not demand that it should come sooner. Pure is He, and much higher than their ascribing partners to Him.
t.85: God’s Judgement is coming, so do not ask to bring it on sooner. Glory be to Him! He is far above anything they join with Him!
t.95: Allah's judgement has (all but) come; do not, then, call for its speedy advent. Holy is He, and far above their associating others with Him in His Divinity.
t.19: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).
t.22: (Inevitable) cometh (to pass) the Command of Allah: seek ye not then to hasten it: Glory to Him, and far is He above having the partners they ascribe unto Him!
t.203: The Event (the Hour or the punishment of disbelievers and polytheists or the Islâmic laws or commandments) ordained by Allâh will come to pass, so seek not to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate as partners with Him.
t.54: اللہ تعالیٰ کا حکم آپہنچا، اب اس کی جلدی نہ مچاؤ۔ تمام پاکی اس کے لیے ہے وه برتر ہے ان سب سے جنہیں یہ اللہ کے نزدیک شریک بتلاتے ہیں.

t.149: Hebestows the angels from on highwith the Spirit by His command upon whom He wills of His servants: “Givewarning that there is no god but Me, so be mindful of Me.”
t.84: He sends down the angels at His behest with the spirit, (that is, the revelation), upon whom He wills from among His servants: “Warn people that there is no god but Me. So, fear Me.”
t.85: He sends down angels with inspiration at His command, to whichever of His servants He chooses, to give [His] warning: ‘There is no god but Me, so beware of Me.’
t.95: He sends down this spirit(of prophecy) by His command through His angels on any of His servants whom He wills, (directing them): "Warn people that there is no deity but Me; so hold Me alone in fear."
t.19: He sendeth down the angels with the Spirit of His command unto whom He will of His bondmen, (saying): Warn mankind that there is no Allah save Me, so keep your duty unto Me.
t.22: He doth send down His angels with inspiration of His Command, to such of His servants as He pleaseth, (saying): "Warn (Man) that there is no god but I: so do your duty unto Me."
t.203: He sends down the angels with the Rûh (revelation) of His Command to whom of His slaves He wills (saying): "Warn mankind that Lâ ilâha illâ Ana (none has the right to be worshipped but I), so fear Me (by abstaining from sins and evil deeds).
t.54: وہی فرشتوں کو اپنی وحی دے کر اپنے حکم سے اپنے بندوں میں سے جس پر چاہتا ہے اتارتا ہے کہ تم لوگوں کو آگاه کر دو کہ میرے سوا اور کوئی معبود نہیں، پس تم مجھ سے ڈرو.

t.149: He created the heavens and the earth with truth. Most High is He above what they associate(with Him) .
t.84: He created the heavens and the earth in the proper way. He is much higher than their ascribing partners to Him.
t.85: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose, and He is far above whatever they join with Him!
t.95: He created the heavens and the earth with Truth. Exalted is He above whatever they associate with Allah in His Divinity.
t.19: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him).
t.22: He has created the heavens and the earth for just ends: Far is He above having the partners they ascribe to Him!
t.203: He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. High is He, Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him.
t.54: اسی نے آسمانوں اور زمین کو حق کے ساتھ پیدا کیا وه اس سے بری ہے جو مشرک کرتے ہیں.

t.149: He created man from a sperm-drop, yet he becomes an evident adversary!
t.84: He created man from a drop, and soon he turned into a debating person, expressing himself openly.
t.85: He created man from a drop of fluid, and yet man openly challenges Him.
t.95: He created man out of a mere drop of fluid, and lo! he turned into an open wrangler.
t.19: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.
t.22: He has created man from a sperm-drop; and behold this same (man) becomes an open disputer!
t.203: He has created man from Nutfah (mixed drops of male and female sexual discharge), then behold, this same (man) becomes an open opponent.
t.54: اس نے انسان کو نطفے سے پیدا کیا پھر وه صریح جھگڑالو بن بیٹھا.

t.149: And livestock—He created them for you. In them are warmth and benefits for you, and of them you eat.
t.84: He has created cattle in which there is warmth and other benefits for you; and from them you have food;
t.85: And livestock––He created them too. You derive warmth and other benefits from them: you get food from them;
t.95: He created the cattle. They are a source of clothing and food and also a variety of other benefits for you.
t.19: And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat;
t.22: And cattle He has created for you (men): from them ye derive warmth, and numerous benefits, and of their (meat) ye eat.
t.203: And the cattle, He has created them for you; in them there is warmth (warm clothing), and numerous benefits, and of them you eat.
t.54: اسی نے چوپائے پیدا کیے جن میں تمہارے لیے گرمی کے لباس ہیں اور بھی بہت سے نفع ہیں اور بعض تمہارے کھانے کے کام آتے ہیں.

t.149: And there is beauty in them for you when you drive them home and when you drive them to pasture.
t.84: and in them there is a beautiful look for you when you drive them home in the evening and take them out to graze.
t.85: you find beauty in them when you bring them home to rest and when you drive them out to pasture.
t.95: And you find beauty in them as you drive them to pasture in the morning and as you drive them back home in the evening;
t.19: And wherein is beauty for you, when ye bring them home, and when ye take them out to pasture.
t.22: And ye have a sense of pride and beauty in them as ye drive them home in the evening, and as ye lead them forth to pasture in the morning.
t.203: And wherein is beauty for you, when you bring them home in the evening, and as you lead them forth to pasture in the morning.
t.54: اور ان میں تمہاری رونق بھی ہے جب چرا کر ﻻؤ تب بھی اور جب چرانے لے جاؤ تب بھی.

t.149: And they carry your heavy burdens to a land you could not have reached without great hardship to yourselves; indeed, your Lord is truly Compassionate, Bestowing of mercy.
t.84: And they carry your loads to a city where you were not able to reach without putting yourselves to arduous labor. Surely, your Lord is Very-Kind, Very-Merciful.
t.85: They carry your loads to lands you yourselves could not reach without great hardship––truly your Lord is kind and merciful––
t.95: and they carry your loads to many a place which you would be unable to reach without much hardship. Surely your Lord is Intensely Loving, Most Merciful.
t.19: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.
t.22: And they carry your heavy loads to lands that ye could not (otherwise) reach except with souls distressed: for your Lord is indeed Most Kind, Most Merciful,
t.203: And they carry your loads to a land that you could not reach except with great trouble to yourselves. Truly, your Lord is full of Kindness, Most Merciful.
t.54: اور وه تمہارے بوجھ ان شہروں تک اٹھالے جاتے ہیں جہاں تم بغیر آدھی جان کیے پہنچ ہی نہیں سکتے تھے۔ یقیناً تمہارا رب بڑا ہی شفیق اور نہایت مہربان ہے.

t.149: And horses and mules and donkeys—that you may ride them, and as an adornment; and He creates what you do not know.
t.84: And (He created) horses, mules and donkeys, so that you may ride on them, and they may give you a good look. And He creates what you do not know (as yet).
t.85: horses, mules, and donkeys for you to ride and use for show, and other things you know nothing about.
t.95: And He created horses and mules and asses for you to ride, and also for your adornment. And He creates many things (for you) that you do not even know about.
t.19: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not.
t.22: And (He has created) horses, mules, and donkeys, for you to ride and use for show; and He has created (other) things of which ye have no knowledge.
t.203: And (He has created) horses, mules and donkeys, for you to ride and as an adornment. And He creates (other) things of which you have no knowledge.
t.54: گھوڑوں کو، خچروں کو، گدھوں کو اس نے پیدا کیا کہ تم ان کی سواری لو اور وه باعﺚ زینت بھی ہیں۔ اور بھی وه ایسی بہت چیزیں پیدا کرتا ہے جن کا تمہیں علم بھی نہیں.

t.149: And it is upon Allah to point out the way, but some of themare crooked. And had He willed, He would surely have guided you all.
t.84: Undertaken by Allah is (to show) the right path, while there are some (paths) that are crooked. Had He so willed, He would have led all of you to the right path.
t.85: God points out the right path, for some paths lead the wrong way: if He wished, He could guide you all.
t.95: It rests with Allah alone to show you the Right Way, even when there are many crooked ways. Had He so willed, He would have (perforce) guided you all aright.
t.19: And Allah's is the direction of the way, and some (roads) go not straight. And had He willed He would have led you all aright.
t.22: And unto Allah leads straight the Way, but there are ways that turn aside: if Allah had willed, He could have guided all of you.
t.203: And upon Allâh is the responsibility to explain the Straight Path. But there are ways that turn aside (such as Paganism, Judaism and Christianity). And had He willed, He would have guided you all (mankind).
t.54: اور اللہ پر سیدھی راه کا بتا دینا ہے اور بعض ٹیڑھی راہیں ہیں، اور اگر وه چاہتا تو تم سب کو راه راست پر لگا دیتا.

t.149: It is He Who sent down to you from the sky water from which is a drink for you and from which are trees where you pasture.
t.84: He is the One who sent down water from the heavens, of which you have your drink; and with it (you grow) plants on which you pasture your cattle.
t.85: It is He who sends down water for you from the sky, from which comes a drink for you, and the shrubs that you feed to your animals.
t.95: He it is Who sends down water for you from the sky out of which you drink and out of which grow the plants on which you pasture your cattle,
t.19: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, whence ye have drink, and whence are trees on which ye send your beasts to pasture.
t.22: It is He who sends down rain from the sky: from it ye drink, and out of it (grows) the vegetation on which ye feed your cattle.
t.203: He it is Who sends down water (rain) from the sky; from it you drink and from it (grows) the vegetation on which you send your cattle to pasture.
t.54: وہی تمہارے فائدے کے لیے آسمان سے پانی برساتا ہے جسے تم پیتے بھی ہو اور اسی سے اگے ہوئے درختوں کو تم اپنے جانوروں کو چراتے ہو.

t.149: With it Hegerminates for you vegetation and olives and date-palms and grapevines and of all products. Indeed, in that is a sign for people who reflect.
t.84: He causes the crops therewith to grow for you, and olives, and date palms, and grape vines, and all the fruits. Surely, in that, there is a sign for a people who ponder.
t.85: With it He grows for you grain, olives, palms, vines, and all kinds of other crops. There truly is a sign in this for those who reflect.
t.95: and by virtue of which He causes crops and olives and date-palms and grapes and all kinds of fruit to grow for you. Surely in this there is a great Sign for those who reflect.
t.19: Therewith He causeth crops to grow for you, and the olive and the date-palm and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.
t.22: With it He produces for you corn, olives, date-palms, grapes and every kind of fruit: verily in this is a sign for those who give thought.
t.203: With it He causes to grow for you the crops, the olives, the date-palms, the grapes, and every kind of fruit. Verily! In this is indeed an evident proof and a manifest sign for people who give thought.
t.54: اسی سے وه تمہارے لیے کھیتی اور زیتون اور کھجور اور انگور اور ہر قسم کے پھل اگاتا ہے بےشک ان لوگوں کے لیے تو اس میں بڑی نشانی ہے جو غوروفکر کرتے ہیں.

t.149: And He has subjected to you the night and the day and the sun and the moon. And the starsare subjected by His command. Indeed, in that are signs for people who reason.
t.84: He has subjugated for you the day and the night and the sun and the moon, and the stars (too) are subservient by His command. Surely, in that, there are signs for a people who understand.
t.85: By His command He has made the night and day, the sun, moon, and stars all of benefit to you. There truly are signs in this for those who use their reason.
t.95: He has subjected for you the night and the day and the sun and the moon and the stars have also been made subservient by His command. Surely there are Signs in this for those who use their reason.
t.19: And He hath constrained the night and the day and the sun and the moon to be of service unto you, and the stars are made subservient by His command. Lo! herein indeed are portents for people who have sense.
t.22: He has made subject to you the Night and the Day; the sun and the moon; and the stars are in subjection by His Command: verily in this are Signs for men who are wise.
t.203: And He has subjected to you the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; and the stars are subjected by His Command. Surely, in this are proofs for people who understand.
t.54: اسی نے رات دن اور سورج چاند کو تمہارے لیے تابع کر دیا ہے اور ستارے بھی اسی کے حکم کے ماتحت ہیں۔ یقیناًاس میں عقلمند لوگوں کے لیے کئی ایک نشانیاں موجود ہیں.

t.149: And(He has subjected) whatever He has scattered for you in the earth of varying colors. Indeed, in that is a sign for people who constantly remember.
t.84: And (He subjugated to you) whatever He created for you on the earth having varied colors. Surely, in that, there is a sign for a people who accept advice.
t.85: He has made of benefit to you the many-coloured things He has multiplied on the earth. There truly are signs in this for those who take it to heart.
t.95: And there are also Signs for those who take heed in the numerous things of various colours that He has created for you on earth.
t.19: And whatsoever He hath created for you in the earth of divers hues, lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who take heed.
t.22: And the things on this earth which He has multiplied in varying colours (and qualities): verily in this is a sign for men who celebrate the praises of Allah (in gratitude).
t.203: And whatsoever He has created for you on the earth of varying colours [and qualities from vegetation and fruits (botanical life) and from animals (zoological life)] Verily! In this is a sign for people who remember.
t.54: اور بھی بہت سی چیزیں طرح طرح کے رنگ روپ کی اس نے تمہارے لیے زمین پر پھیلا رکھی ہیں۔ بیشک نصیحت قبول کرنے والوں کے لیے اس میں بڑی بھاری نشانی ہے.

t.149: And He is the One Who subjected the sea, that you may eat from it tender meat and extract from it ornaments that you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and(all this) so that you may seek of His bounties, and that you may give thanks.
t.84: He is the One who has subjugated the sea, so that you may eat fresh meat from it, and may take out from it ornaments you wear, and you see the boats cleaving through it, and so that you may seek His bounty, and that you may be grateful.
t.85: It is He who made the sea of benefit to you: you eat fresh fish from it and bring out jewellery to wear; you see the ships cutting through its waves so that you may go in search of His bounty and give thanks.
t.95: And He it is Who has subjected the sea that you may eat fresh fish from it and bring forth ornaments from it that you can wear. And you see ships ploughing their course through it so that you may go forth seeking His Bounty and be grateful to Him.
t.19: And He it is Who hath constrained the sea to be of service that ye eat fresh meat from thence, and bring forth from thence ornaments which ye wear. And thou seest the ships ploughing it that ye (mankind) may seek of His bounty and that haply ye may give thanks.
t.22: It is He Who has made the sea subject, that ye may eat thereof flesh that is fresh and tender, and that ye may extract therefrom ornaments to wear; and thou seest the ships therein that plough the waves, that ye may seek (thus) of the bounty of Allah and that ye may be grateful.
t.203: And He it is Who has subjected the sea (to you), that you eat thereof fresh tender meat (i.e. fish), and that you bring forth out of it ornaments to wear. And you see the ships ploughing through it, that you may seek (thus) of His Bounty (by transporting the goods from place to place) and that you may be grateful.
t.54: اور دریا بھی اسی نے تمہارے بس میں کر دیے ہیں کہ تم اس میں سے (نکلا ہوا) تازه گوشت کھاؤ اور اس میں سے اپنے پہننے کے زیورات نکال سکو اور تم دیکھتے ہو کہ کشتیاں اس میں پانی چیرتی ہوئی (چلتی) ہیں اور اس لیے بھی کہ تم اس کا فضل تلاش کرو اور ہوسکتا ہے کہ تم شکر گزاری بھی کرو.

t.149: And He cast firm mountains into the earth lest it sway with you, and rivers and ways, that you may be guided.
t.84: And He placed mountains on the earth, lest it should shake with you, and rivers and tracks, so that you may find the right way,
t.85: He has made mountains stand firm on the earth, to prevent it shaking under you, and rivers and paths so that you may find your way,
t.95: And He has placed firm mountains on the earth lest it should move away from you, and has made rivers and tracks that you may find your way,
t.19: And He hath cast into the earth firm hills that it quake not with you, and streams and roads that ye may find a way.
t.22: And He has set up on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you; and rivers and roads; that ye may guide yourselves;
t.203: And He has affixed into the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you; and rivers and roads, that you may guide yourselves.
t.54: اور اس نے زمین میں پہاڑ گاڑ دیے ہیں تاکہ تمہیں لے کر ہلے نہ، اور نہریں اور راہیں بنا دیں تاکہ تم منزل مقصود کو پہنچو.

t.149: And landmarks, and by the star they are guided.
t.84: and He has set landmarks. And by the stars they find the right way.
t.85: and landmarks and stars to guide people.
t.95: and He has set other landmarks in the earth. And by the stars too do people find their way.
t.19: And landmarks (too), and by the star they find a way.
t.22: And marks and sign-posts; and by the stars (men) guide themselves.
t.203: And landmarks (signposts during the day) and by the stars (during the night), they (mankind) guide themselves.
t.54: اور بھی بہت سی نشانیاں مقرر فرمائیں۔ اور ستاروں سے بھی لوگ راه حاصل کرتے ہیں.

t.149: Is One Who creates like one who does not create? Will you never remind yourselves ?
t.84: Is then the One who creates (everything) equal to one who does not create? Would you still pay no heed?
t.85: Can He who creates be compared to one who cannot create? Why do you not take heed?
t.95: Is then the One Who creates like the one who does not create? Will you not, then, take heed?
t.19: Is He then Who createth as him who createth not? Will ye not then remember?
t.22: Is then He Who creates like one that creates not? Will ye not receive admonition?
t.203: Is then He, Who creates as one who creates not? Will you not then remember?
t.54: تو کیا وه جو پیدا کرتا ہے اس جیسا ہے جو پیدا نہیں کرسکتا؟ کیا تم بالکل نہیں سوچتے؟

t.149: And if youwere to count the blessings of Allah, you would not be able to enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is certainly Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
t.84: If you count the bounties of Allah, you cannot count them all. Surely, Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
t.85: If you tried to count God’s blessings, you could never take them all in: He is truly most forgiving and most merciful.
t.95: For, were you to count the favours of Allah, you will not be able to count them. Surely Allah is Ever Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.19: And if ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving, Merciful.
t.22: If ye would count up the favours of Allah, never would ye be able to number them: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.203: And if you would count the favours of Allâh, never could you be able to count them. Truly! Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.54: اور اگر تم اللہ کی نعمتوں کا شمار کرنا چاہو تو تم اسے نہیں کر سکتے۔ بیشک اللہ بڑا بخشنے واﻻ مہربان ہے.

t.149: And Allah knows whatever you keep secret and whatever you make public.
t.84: Allah knows what you conceal and what you reveal.
t.85: He knows what you conceal and what you reveal.
t.95: Allah knows all that you conceal and all that you disclose.
t.19: And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim.
t.22: And Allah doth know what ye conceal, and what ye reveal.
t.203: And Allâh knows what you conceal and what you reveal.
t.54: اور جو کچھ تم چھپاؤ اور ﻇاہر کرو اللہ تعالیٰ سب کچھ جانتا ہے.

t.149: Yet those they call uponapart from Allah create nothing, while they(themselves) are created.
t.84: Those whom they invoke beside Allah do not create any thing; rather they are themselves created;
t.85: Those they invoke beside God create nothing; they are themselves created.
t.95: Those whom they call upon beside Allah have created nothing; rather, they themselves were created;
t.19: Those unto whom they cry beside Allah created naught, but are themselves created.
t.22: Those whom they invoke besides Allah create nothing and are themselves created.
t.203: Those whom they (Al-Mushrikûn) invoke besides Allâh have not created anything, but are themselves created.
t.54: اور جن جن کو یہ لوگ اللہ تعالیٰ کے سوا پکارتے ہیں وه کسی چیز کو پیدا نہیں کرسکتے، بلکہ وه خود پیدا کیے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: (They are, in fact) dead, not alive, and they are unaware of when they will be resurrected.
t.84: they are dead, having no life, and they do not know when they shall be raised again.
t.85: They are dead, not living. They do not know when they will be raised up.
t.95: they are dead, not living. They do not even know when they will be resurrected.
t.19: (They are) dead, not living. And they know not when they will be raised.
t.22: (They are things) dead, lifeless: nor do they know when they will be raised up.
t.203: (They are) dead, not alive; and they know not when they will be raised up.
t.54: مردے ہیں زنده نہیں، انہیں تو یہ بھی شعور نہیں کہ کب اٹھائے جائیں گے.

t.149: YourGod is one God. Therefore, those who do not believe in the Hereafter—their hearts are in denial and they act arrogantly.
t.84: Your God is One God. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are defiant and they are arrogant.
t.85: Your God is the One God. As for those who deny the life to come, their hearts refuse to admit the truth and they are arrogant.
t.95: Your God is the One God. But the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter are steeped in rejection of the Truth, and they are given to arrogance.
t.19: Your Allah is One Allah. But as for those who believe not in the Hereafter their hearts refuse to know, for they are proud.
t.22: Your Allah is one Allah: as to those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts refuse to know, and they are arrogant.
t.203: Your Ilâh[2] (God) is One Ilâh (God - Allâh, none has the right to be worshipped but He). But for those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts deny (the faith in the Oneness of Allâh), and they are proud.[3]
t.54: تم سب کا معبود صرف اللہ تعالیٰ اکیلا ہے اور آخرت پر ایمان نہ رکھنے والوں کے دل منکر ہیں اور وه خود تکبر سے بھرے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: Without doubt, Allah knows whatever they keep secret and whatever they make public; indeed, He does not like those who act arrogantly.
t.84: Invariably, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal. Surely, He does not like the arrogant.
t.85: There is no doubt that God knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He does not love the arrogant.
t.95: Surely Allah knows all that they conceal and all that they disclose. He certainly does not love those who are steeped in arrogance.
t.19: Assuredly Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He loveth not the proud.
t.22: Undoubtedly Allah doth know what they conceal, and what they reveal: verily He loveth not the arrogant.
t.203: Certainly, Allâh knows what they conceal and what they reveal. Truly, He likes not the proud.
t.54: بےشک وشبہ اللہ تعالیٰ ہر اس چیز کو، جسے وه لوگ چھپاتے ہیں اور جسے ﻇاہر کرتے ہیں، بخوبی جانتا ہے۔ وه غرور کرنے والوں کو پسند نہیں فرماتا.

t.149: And when it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “Legends of the ancients.”
t.84: When it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “It is nothing but the tales of the ancient people.”
t.85: When they are asked, ‘What has your Lord sent down?’ they say, ‘Ancient fables.’
t.95: When they are asked: "What is it that your Lord has revealed?" They answer: "They are merely tales of olden times!"
t.19: And when it is said unto them: What hath your Lord revealed? they say: (Mere) fables of the men of old,
t.22: When it is said to them, "What is it that your Lord has revealed?" they say, "Tales of the ancients!"
t.203: And when it is said to them: "What is it that your Lord has sent down (unto Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)?" They say: "Tales of the men of old!"
t.54: ان سے جب دریافت کیا جاتا ہے کہ تمہارے پروردگار نے کیا نازل فرمایا ہے؟ تو جواب دیتے ہیں کہ اگلوں کی کہانیاں ہیں.

t.149: Let them carry their burdens, complete, on the Day of Resurrection, and some of the burdens of those they lead astray without knowledge. Undoubtedly, evil is what they bear.
t.84: Hence, they shall bear the full weight of their burdens on the Day of Judgment, and also some of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge. Remember, evil is the burden they bear.
t.85: On the Day of Resurrection they will bear the full weight of their own burden, as well as some of the burden of those they misled with no true knowledge. How terrible their burden will be!
t.95: (They say so) that they may bear the full weight of their burdens on the Day of Resurrection and also of the burdens of those whom they misled on account of their ignorance. What a heavy burden are they undertaking to bear!
t.19: That they may bear their burdens undiminished on the Day of Resurrection, with somewhat of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge. Ah! evil is that which they bear!
t.22: Let them bear, on the Day of Judgment, their own burdens in full, and also (something) of the burdens of those without knowledge, whom they misled. Alas, how grievous the burdens they will bear!
t.203: They may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection, and also of the burdens of those whom they misled without knowledge. Evil indeed is that which they shall bear!
t.54: اسی کا نتیجہ ہوگا کہ قیامت کے دن یہ لوگ اپنے پورے بوجھ کے ساتھ ہی ان کے بوجھ کے بھی حصے دار ہوں گے جنہیں بے علمی سے گمراه کرتے رہے۔ دیکھو تو کیسا برا بوجھ اٹھا رہے ہیں.

t.149: Those before them did scheme, but Allah struck at the very foundations of their building, so the roof collapsed upon them from above them, and the punishment came upon them from where they were unaware.
t.84: Those (too) who were before them made plots. Then (the command of) Allah came upon their buildings (uprooting them) from the foundations. So roofs fell down upon them from above, and the chastisement came to them from where they could not even imagine.
t.85: Those who went before them also schemed, but God attacked the very foundations of what they built. The roof fell down on them: punishment came on them from unimagined directions.
t.95: Surely many people before them had plotted in a similar manner to (vanquish the Truth), but Allah uprooted the whole structure of their plot from its foundations so that the roof fell in upon them, and the chastisement (of Allah) visited them from unknown directions.
t.19: Those before them plotted, so Allah struck at the foundations of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them from above them, and the doom came on them whence they knew not;
t.22: Those before them did also plot (against Allah's Way): but Allah took their structures from their foundations, and the roof fell down on them from above; and the Wrath seized them from directions they did not perceive.
t.203: Those before them indeed plotted, but Allâh struck at the foundation of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them, from above them, and the torment overtook them from directions they did not perceive.
t.54: ان سے پہلے کے لوگوں نے بھی مکر کیا تھا، (آخر) اللہ نے (ان کے منصوبوں) کی عمارتوں کو جڑوں سے اکھیڑ دیا اور ان (کے سروں) پر (ان کی) چھتیں اوپر سے گر پڑیں، اور ان کے پاس عذاب وہاں سے آگیا جہاں کا انہیں وہم وگمان بھی نہ تھا.

t.149: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He disgraces them and says, “Where are My associates for whose sake you used to oppose (the believers) ? Those who were given knowledge said, “Today disgrace and misery are indeed upon the deniers
t.84: Then, on the Day of Judgment, He will put them to disgrace and will say, “Where are My partners for whose sake you used to quarrel (with the believers)?” Those endowed with knowledge will say, “Today, the disgrace and the evil (chastisement) has to befall the unbelievers,
t.85: In the end, on the Day of Resurrection, He will shame them, saying, ‘Where are these “partners” of Mine on whose account you opposed [Me]?’ Those given knowledge will say, ‘Shame and misery on the disbelievers today!’
t.95: And again, on the Day of Resurrection, He will bring them to disgrace, and say: "Tell Me, now, where are those to whom you ascribed a share in My Divinity, and for whose sake you disputed (with the upholders of the Truth)?" Those who were endowed with knowledge (in the world) will say: "Surely today humiliation and misery shall be the lot of the unbelievers";
t.19: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and will say: Where are My partners, for whose sake ye opposed (My guidance)? Those who have been given knowledge will say: Disgrace this day and evil are upon the disbelievers,
t.22: Then, on the Day of Judgment, He will cover them with shame, and say: "Where are My 'partners' concerning whom ye used to dispute (with the godly)?" Those endued with knowledge will say: "This Day, indeed, are the Unbelievers covered with shame and misery,-
t.203: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and will say: "Where are My (so called) partners concerning whom you used to disagree and dispute (with the believers, by defying and disobeying Allâh)?" Those who have been given the knowledge (about the Torment of Allâh for the disbelievers) will say: "Verily! Disgrace and misery this Day are upon the disbelievers.
t.54: پھر قیامت والے دن بھی اللہ تعالیٰ انہیں رسوا کرے گا اور فرمائے گا کہ میرے وه شریک کہاں ہیں جن کے بارے میں تم لڑتے جھگڑتے تھے، جنہیں علم دیا گیا تھا وه پکار اٹھیں گے کہ آج تو کافروں کو رسوائی اور برائی چمٹ گئی.

t.149: whom the angels take at death while they are unjust to themselves.” Then they offered submission: “We were doing no evil.” Yes! Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing of what youused to do.
t.84: the ones to whom the angels brought death while they were (still) wronging themselves.” Then, they will resort to submission, (yet will say), “We used to do nothing wrong.” (They will be answered) Why not? Allah knows well what you used to do.
t.85: Those whose lives the angels take while they are wronging themselves will show submission: ‘We were doing no evil.’ ‘Yes you were: God knows fully everything that you have done,
t.95: the same unbelievers who, when the angels seize them and cause them to die while they are engaged in wrong-doing, they will proffer their submission saying: "We were engaged in no evil." (The angels will answer them): "Surely Allah knows well all that you did.
t.19: Whom the angels cause to die while they are wronging themselves. Then will they make full submission (saying): We used not to do any wrong. Nay! Surely Allah is Knower of what ye used to do.
t.22: "(Namely) those whose lives the angels take in a state of wrong-doing to their own souls." Then would they offer submission (with the pretence), "We did no evil (knowingly)." (The angels will reply), "Nay, but verily Allah knoweth all that ye did;
t.203: "Those whose lives the angels take while they are doing wrong to themselves (by disbelief and by associating partners in worship with Allâh and by committing all kinds of crimes and evil deeds)." Then, they will make (false) submission (saying): "We used not to do any evil." (The angels will reply): "Yes! Truly, Allâh is All-Knower of what you used to do.
t.54: وه جو اپنی جانوں پر ﻇلم کرتے ہیں، فرشتے جب ان کی جان قبض کرنے لگتے ہیں اس وقت وه جھک جاتے ہیں کہ ہم برائی نہیں کرتے تھے۔ کیوں نہیں؟ اللہ تعالیٰ خوب جاننے واﻻ ہے جو کچھ تم کرتے تھے.

t.149: Thus enter the gates of Hell, abiding therein.” And how miserable is the dwelling of the arrogant!
t.84: Hence, enter the gates of Jahannam to live in it forever. So evil is the abode of the arrogant.
t.85: so enter the gates of Hell. There you will remain- the home of the arrogant is evil indeed.’
t.95: Go now, and enter the gate of Hell, and abide in it for ever." Evil indeed is the abode of the arrogant.
t.19: So enter the gates of hell, to dwell therein for ever. Woeful indeed will be the lodging of the arrogant.
t.22: "So enter the gates of Hell, to dwell therein. Thus evil indeed is the abode of the arrogant."
t.203: "So enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein, and indeed, what an evil abode will be for the arrogant."
t.54: پس اب تو ہمیشگی کے طور پر تم جہنم کے دروازوں میں داخل ہو جاؤ، پس کیا ہی برا ٹھکانا ہے غرور کرنے والوں کا.

t.149: And it was said to those who were mindful(of God) , “What did your Lord send down?” They said, “(All that is) good.” To those who have excelled in doing good in this Earlier(Life) is goodness, and the Home of the Hereafter is even better. And indeed, how excellent is the home of the people who are mindful(of God) :
t.84: And (on the other hand,) it is said to the God-fearing, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “(He has sent down) excellent (discourse).” For those who do good, there is good (end) in this world, and indeed the abode of the Hereafter is much better. Excellent is the abode of the God-fearing -
t.85: But when the righteous are asked, ‘What has your Lord sent down?’ they will say, ‘All that is good.’ There is a reward in this present world for those who do good, but their home in the Hereafter is far better: the home of the righteous is excellent.
t.95: And when the God-fearing are asked: "What has your Lord revealed?" they answer: "Something excellent!" Good fortune in this world awaits those who do good; and certainly the abode of the Hereafter is even better for them. How excellent is the abode of the God-fearing:
t.19: And it is said unto those who ward off (evil): What hath your Lord revealed? They say: Good. For those who do good in this world there is a good (reward) and the home of the Hereafter will be better. Pleasant indeed will be the home of those who ward off (evil) -
t.22: To the righteous (when) it is said, "What is it that your Lord has revealed?" they say, "All that is good." To those who do good, there is good in this world, and the Home of the Hereafter is even better and excellent indeed is the Home of the righteous,-
t.203: And (when) it is said to those who are the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) "What is it that your Lord has sent down?" They say: "That which is good." For those who do good in this world, there is good, and the home of the Hereafter will be better. And excellent indeed will be the home (i.e. Paradise) of the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).
t.54: اور پرہیز گاروں سے پوچھا جاتا ہے کہ تمہارے پروردگار نے کیا نازل فرمایا ہے؟ تو وه جواب دیتے ہیں کہ اچھے سے اچھا۔ جن لوگوں نے بھلائی کی ان کے لیے اس دنیا میں بھلائی ہے، اور یقیناً آخرت کا گھر تو بہت ہی بہتر ہے، اور کیا ہی خوب پرہیز گاروں کا گھر ہے.

t.149: Gardens of Perpetuity which they enter, beneath which rivers flow; therein they have whatever they desire. Thus Allah rewards the mindful(of Him) :
t.84: the eternal gardens they enter, with rivers flowing beneath them. For them there is what they desire. That is how Allah rewards the God-fearing -
t.85: They will enter perpetual Gardens graced with flowing streams. There they will have everything they wish. This is the way God rewards the righteous,
t.95: everlasting gardens that they shall enter; the gardens beneath which rivers shall flow, and where they shall have whatever they desire! Thus does Allah reward the God-fearing,
t.19: Gardens of Eden which they enter, underneath which rivers flow, wherein they have what they will. Thus Allah repayeth those who ward off (evil),
t.22: Gardens of Eternity which they will enter: beneath them flow (pleasant) rivers: they will have therein all that they wish: thus doth Allah reward the righteous,-
t.203: ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (Gardens of Eternity) which they will enter, under which rivers flow, they will have therein all that they wish. Thus Allâh rewards the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).
t.54: ہمیشگی والے باغات جہاں وه جائیں گے جن کے نیچے نہریں بہہ رہی ہیں، جو کچھ یہ طلب کریں گے وہاں ان کے لیے موجود ہوگا۔ پرہیز گاروں کو اللہ تعالیٰ اسی طرح بدلے عطا فرماتا ہے.

t.149: those whom the angels take up(at death) while they are goodly, saying, “Peace be upon you; enter the Garden(of Paradise) on account of what you used to do.”
t.84: the ones to whom angels bring death while they are pure (in beliefs and deeds). They (angels) say, “Peace on you! Enter Paradise for the deeds you have been doing.”
t.85: those whose lives the angels take in a state of goodness. They will say to them, ‘Peace be upon you. Enter the Garden as a reward for what you have done.’
t.95: those whose souls the angels seize while they are in a state of purity, saying: "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise as a reward for your deeds."
t.19: Those whom the angels cause to die (when they are) good. They say: Peace be unto you! Enter the Garden because of what ye used to do.
t.22: (Namely) those whose lives the angels take in a state of purity, saying (to them), "Peace be on you; enter ye the Garden, because of (the good) which ye did (in the world)."
t.203: Those whose lives the angels take while they are in a pious state (i.e. pure from all evil, and worshipping none but Allâh Alone) saying (to them): Salâmun ‘Alaikum (peace be on you) enter you Paradise, because of that (the good) which you used to do (in the world)."
t.54: وه جن کی جانیں فرشتے اس حال میں قبض کرتے ہیں کہ وه پاک صاف ہوں کہتے ہیں کہ تمہارے لیے سلامتی ہی سلامتی ہے، جاؤ جنت میں اپنے ان اعمال کے بدلے جو تم کرتے تھے.

t.149: Are they but waiting for the angels to come to them, or for the command of your Lord to come? Those before them did likewise. And Allah did not do them any injustice, but to themselves they used to do injustice.
t.84: They (the unbelievers) are waiting for nothing but that the angels should come to them, or comes the command of your Lord. Similar was the reaction of those who were before them. Allah did not wrong them; rather they were doing wrong to themselves.
t.85: Are the disbelievers waiting for the angels to come to them, or your Lord’s Judgement? Those who went before them did the same. God did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
t.95: (O Muhammad), are they waiting for anything else than that the angels should appear before them, or that your Lord's judgement should come? Many before them acted with similar temerity. And then what happened with them was not Allah's wrong-doing; they rather wronged themselves.
t.19: Await they aught say that the angels should come unto them or thy Lord's command should come to pass? Even so did those before them. Allah wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves,
t.22: Do the (ungodly) wait until the angels come to them, or there comes the Command of thy Lord (for their doom)? So did those who went before them. But Allah wronged them not: nay, they wronged their own souls.
