t.54: کہا اچھا تم پر سلام ہو، میں تو اپنے پروردگار سے تمہاری بخشش کی دعا کرتا رہوں گا، وه مجھ پر حد درجہ مہربان ہے.

t.149: And I shall withdraw from youand from what youcall upon apart from Allah, and I will call upon my Lord; hopefully, in calling upon my Lord, I shall never be wretched.”
t.84: And I go away from you and what you invoke besides Allah. And I shall invoke my Lord. Hopefully I shall not be a loser by invoking my Lord.”
t.85: but for now I will leave you, and the idols you all pray to, and I will pray to my Lord and trust that my prayer will not be in vain.’
t.95: I shall withdraw from you and all that you call upon beside Allah. I shall only call upon my Lord. I trust the prayer to my Lord will not go unanswered."
t.19: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.
t.22: "And I will turn away from you (all) and from those whom ye invoke besides Allah: I will call on my Lord: perhaps, by my prayer to my Lord, I shall be not unblest."
t.203: "And I shall turn away from you and from those whom you invoke besides Allâh. And I shall call upon my Lord and I hope that I shall not be unblest in my invocation to my Lord."
t.54: میں تو تمہیں بھی اور جن جن کو تم اللہ تعالیٰ کے سوا پکارتے ہو انہیں بھی سب کو چھوڑ رہا ہوں۔ صرف اپنے پروردگار کو پکارتا رہوں گا، مجھے یقین ہے کہ میں اپنے پروردگار سے دعا مانگ کر محروم نہ رہوں گا.

t.149: So when he withdrew from them and what they worshiped apart from Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and each We made a prophet.
t.84: So, when he went away from them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We blessed him with IsHāq (Isaac) and Ya‘qūb (Jacob) and We made each one of them a prophet,
t.85: When he left his people and those they served beside God, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made them both prophets:
t.95: Thereupon Abraham dissociated himself from his people and the deities they worshipped instead of Allah, and We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob and made each of them a Prophet;
t.19: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.
t.22: When he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each one of them We made a prophet.
t.203: So when he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allâh, We gave him Ishâq (Isaac) and Ya‘qûb (Jacob), and each one of them We made a Prophet.
t.54: جب ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) ان سب کو اور اللہ کے سوا ان کے سب معبودوں کو چھوڑ چکے تو ہم نے انہیں اسحاق ویعقوب (علیہما السلام) عطا فرمائے، اور دونوں کو نبی بنا دیا.

t.149: And We granted them of Our mercy and gave them a high and true renown.
t.84: and We bestowed on them (a great deal) of our mercy, and caused them to have a good name at a high level.
t.85: We granted Our grace to all of them, and gave them a noble reputation.
t.95: and We bestowed on them Our mercy, and granted them a truly lofty renown.
t.19: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.
t.22: And We bestowed of Our Mercy on them, and We granted them lofty honour on the tongue of truth.
t.203: And We gave them of Our Mercy (a good provision in plenty), and We granted them honour on the tongues (of all the nations, i.e. everybody remembers them with a good praise).
t.54: اور ان سب کو ہم نے اپنی بہت سی رحمتیں عطا فرمائیں اور ہم نے ان کے ذکر جمیل کو بلند درجے کا کر دیا.

t.149: And mentionin the Scripture Moses. He was indeed a sincere, chosen one , and he was a messenger(and) a prophet.
t.84: And mention in the Book (the story of) Mūsā. Indeed he was a chosen one and was a messenger, a prophet.
t.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Moses. He was specially chosen, a messenger and a prophet:
t.95: And recite in the Book the account of Moses. He was a chosen one, a Messenger, a Prophet.
t.19: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
t.22: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Moses: for he was specially chosen, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
t.203: And mention in the Book (this Qur’ân) Mûsâ (Moses). Verily he was chosen and he was a Messenger (and) a Prophet.
t.54: اس قرآن میں موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کا ذکر بھی کر، جو چنا ہوا اور رسول اور نبی تھا.

t.149: And We called out to him from the right side of Mount Tûr, and brought him near in communion.
t.84: And We called him from the right side of the mount Tūr (Sinai), and We brought him close to communicate in secret.
t.85: We called to him from the right-hand side of the mountain and brought him close to Us in secret communion;
t.95: We called out to him from the right side of the Mount, and We drew him near to Us by communing to him in secret,
t.19: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.
t.22: And we called him from the right side of Mount (Sinai), and made him draw near to Us, for mystic (converse).
t.203: And We called him from the right side of the Mount, and made him draw near to Us for a talk with him [Mûsâ (Moses)].
t.54: ہم نے اسے طور کی دائیں جانب سے ندا کی اور راز گوئی کرتے ہوئے اسے قریب کر لیا.

t.149: And We granted him, of Our mercy, his brother Aaron as a prophet.
t.84: And, out of Our mercy, We granted him his brother Hārūn as a prophet.
t.85: out of Our grace We granted him his brother Aaron as a prophet.
t.95: and out of Our mercy We appointed his brother Aaron, a Prophet (that he may assist him).
t.19: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).
t.22: And, out of Our Mercy, We gave him his brother Aaron, (also) a prophet.
t.203: And We granted him his brother Hârûn (Aaron), (also) a Prophet, out of Our Mercy.
t.54: اور اپنی خاص مہربانی سے اس کے بھائی کو نبی بنا کر عطا فرمایا.

t.149: And mention in the Scripture Ishmael; he was indeed true to his promise, and he was a messenger(and) a prophet.
t.84: And mention in the Book (the story of) Ismā‘īl. He was indeed true to his promise, and was a messenger, a prophet.
t.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Ishmael. He was true to his promise, a messenger and a prophet.
t.95: And recite in the Book the account of Ishmael. He was ever true to his promise, and was a Messenger, a Prophet.
t.19: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
t.22: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Isma'il: He was (strictly) true to what he promised, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
t.203: And mention in the Book (the Qur’ân) Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael). Verily he was true to what he promised, and he was a Messenger, (and) a Prophet.
t.54: اس کتاب میں اسماعیل (علیہ السلام) کا واقعہ بھی بیان کر، وه بڑا ہی وعدے کا سچا تھا اور تھا بھی رسول اور نبی.

t.149: And he used to command his family to prayer and purifying charity, and with his Lord he was always rendered pleased.
t.84: He used to enjoin Salāh and Zakāh upon his family, and was favourite to his Lord.
t.85: He commanded his household to pray and give alms, and his Lord was well pleased with him.
t.95: He enjoined his household to observe Prayer and to give Zakah (purifying alms); and his Lord was well pleased with him.
t.19: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
t.22: He used to enjoin on his people Prayer and Charity, and he was most acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
t.203: And he used to enjoin on his family and his people As-Salât (the prayers) and the Zakât and his Lord was pleased with him.
t.54: وه اپنے گھر والوں کو برابر نماز اور زکوٰة کاحکم دیتا تھا، اور تھا بھی اپنے پروردگار کی بارگاه میں پسندیده اور مقبول.

t.149: And mention in the Scripture Enoch; he was indeed an unwavering believer(and) a prophet.
t.84: And mention in the Book (the story of) Idrīs. He was indeed a Siddīq (man of truth), a prophet.
t.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Idris. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
t.95: And recite in the Book the account of Idris. He was a man of truth, a Prophet;
t.19: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;
t.22: Also mention in the Book the case of Idris: He was a man of truth (and sincerity), (and) a prophet:
t.203: And mention in the Book (the Qur’ân) Idrîs (Enoch).Verily he was a man of truth, (and) a Prophet.
t.54: اور اس کتاب میں ادریس (علیہ السلام) کا بھی ذکر کر، وه بھی نیک کردار پیغمبر تھا.

t.149: And We raised him to a high position.
t.84: We raised him to a high place.
t.85: We raised him to a high position.
t.95: and We exalted him to a lofty position.
t.19: And We raised him to high station.
t.22: And We raised him to a lofty station.
t.203: And We raised him to a high station.
t.54: ہم نےاسے بلند مقام پر اٹھا لیا.

t.149: Those are the ones whom Allahblessed ofthe prophets from the offspring of Adam, and from those Wecarried with Noah, and from the offspring of Abraham and Israel, and from those We guided and selected. Whenever the signsof the All-Mercifulwere recited to them, they would fall down prostrating and weeping.
t.84: Those are the people whom Allah has blessed with bounties, the prophets from the progeny of ’Ādam, and of those whom We caused to board (the Ark) along with NūH, and from the progeny of Ibrāhīm and Isrā’īl (Jacob), and from those whom We guided and selected. When the verses of The RaHmān (The All-Merciful) were recited before them, they used to fall down in Sajdah (prostration), while they were weeping.
t.85: These were the prophets God blessed- from the seed of Adam, of those We carried in the Ark with Noah, from the seed of Abraham and Israel- and those We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Lord of Mercy were recited to them, they fell to their knees and wept,
t.95: These are the Prophets upon whom Allah bestowed His favour from the seed of Adam, and from the seed of those whom We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and from the seed of Abraham and Israel. They were those whom We guided and chose (for an exalted position). They were such that when the words of the Most Compassionate Lord were recited to them, they fell down in prostration, weeping.
t.19: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.
t.22: Those were some of the prophets on whom Allah did bestow His Grace,- of the posterity of Adam, and of those who We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel of those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the Signs of (Allah) Most Gracious were rehearsed to them, they would fall down in prostrate adoration and in tears.
t.203: Those were they unto whom Allâh bestowed His Grace from among the Prophets, of the offspring of Adam, and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Nûh (Noah), and of the offspring of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the Verses of the Most Gracious (Allâh) were recited unto them, they fell down prostrate and weeping.
t.54: یہی وه انبیا ہیں جن پر اللہ تعالیٰ نے فضل وکرم کیا جو اوﻻد آدم میں سے ہیں اور ان لوگوں کی نسل سے ہیں جنہیں ہم نے نوح (علیہ السلام) کے ساتھ کشتی میں چڑھا لیا تھا، اور اوﻻد ابراہیم ویعقوب سے اور ہماری طرف سے راه یافتہ اور ہمارے پسندیده لوگوں میں سے۔ ان کے سامنے جب اللہ رحمان کی آیتوں کی تلاوت کی جاتی تھی یہ سجده کرتے اور روتے گڑگڑاتے گر پڑتے تھے.

t.149: Then they were succeeded by generations who wasted the prayers and followed desires, and thus they will encounter(the sequel of their) delusion—
t.84: Then came after them the successors who neglected Salāh and followed (their selfish) desires. So they will soon face (the outcome of their) deviation,
t.85: but there came after them generations who neglected prayer and were driven by their own desires. These will come face to face with their evil,
t.95: They were succeeded by a people who neglected the Prayers and pursued their lusts. They shall presently meet with their doom,
t.19: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.
t.22: But after them there followed a posterity who missed prayers and followed after lusts soon, then, will they face Destruction,-
t.203: Then, there has succeeded them a posterity who have given up As-Salât (the prayers) [i.e. made their Salât (prayers) to be lost, either by not offering them or by not offering them perfectly or by not offering them in their proper fixed times] and have followed lusts. So they will be thrown in Hell.
t.54: پھر ان کے بعد ایسے ناخلف پیدا ہوئے کہ انہوں نے نماز ضائع کردی اور نفسانی خواہشوں کے پیچھے پڑ گئے، سو ان کا نقصان ان کے آگے آئے گا.

t.149: except for whoever repented and believed and acted righteously, for those shall enter the Garden and shall not be dealt with unjustly in any way—
t.84: except those who repent and believe and do good deeds, and therefore they will enter the Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
t.85: but those who repent, who believe, who do righteous deeds, will enter Paradise. They will not be wronged in the least:
t.95: except those who repent and believe and act righteously. Such shall enter Paradise and shall not be wronged at all.
t.19: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -
t.22: Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness: for these will enter the Garden and will not be wronged in the least,-
t.203: Except those who repent and believe (in the Oneness of Allâh and His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), and work righteousness. Such will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in aught.
t.54: بجز ان کے جو توبہ کر لیں اور ایمان ﻻئیں اور نیک عمل کریں۔ ایسے لوگ جنت میں جائیں گے اور ان کی ذرا سی بھی حق تلفی نہ کی جائے گی.

t.149: the Gardens of Eden which have been promised by the All-Merciful to His servants in the hidden realm; indeed, His promise has ever been coming true.
t.84: (They will enter) the Gardens of eternity, promised by the All-Merciful (Allah) to His servants, in the unseen world. They will surely reach (the places of) His promise.
t.85: they will enter the Gardens of Lasting Bliss, promised by the Lord of Mercy to His servants- it is not yet seen but truly His promise will be fulfilled.
t.95: Theirs shall be everlasting Gardens which the Most Compassionate Lord has promised His servants in a realm which is beyond the ken of perception. Surely His promise shall he fulfilled.
t.19: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -
t.22: Gardens of Eternity, those which (Allah) Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the Unseen: for His promise must (necessarily) come to pass.
t.203: (They will enter) ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), which the Most Gracious (Allâh) has promised to His slaves in the Unseen: Verily His Promise must come to pass.
t.54: ہمیشگی والی جنتوں میں جن کا غائبانہ وعده اللہ مہربان نے اپنے بندوں سے کیا ہے۔ بیشک اس کا وعده پورا ہونے واﻻ ہی ہے.

t.149: Therein they hear no idle talk, but only peace. And therein they have their own provision, morning and evening.
t.84: They will not hear anything absurd therein, but a word of peace, and there they will have their provision at morn and eve.
t.85: There they will hear only peaceful talk, nothing bad; there they will be given provision morning and evening.
t.95: They shall not hear in it anything vain; they shall hear only what is good; and they shall have their provision in it, morning and evening.
t.19: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.
t.22: They will not there hear any vain discourse, but only salutations of Peace: And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and evening.
t.203: They shall not hear therein (in Paradise) any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk), but only Salâm (salutations of peace). And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and afternoon. [See (V.40:55)].
t.54: وه لوگ وہاں کوئی لغو بات نہ سنیں گے صرف سلام ہی سلام سنیں گے، ان کے لئے وہاں صبح شام ان کا رزق ہوگا.

t.149: Such is the Garden(of Paradise) which We give as inheritance to whoever of Our servants who has been mindful(of God) .
t.84: That is the Paradise We will give as inheritance to those of Our servants who have been God-fearing.
t.85: That is the Garden We shall give as their own to those of Our servants who were devout.
t.95: Such is the Paradise which We shall cause those of Our servants who have been God-fearing to inherit.
t.19: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.
t.22: Such is the Garden which We give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who guard against Evil.
t.203: Such is the Paradise which We shall give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who have been Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).
t.54: یہ ہے وه جنت جس کا وارث ہم اپنے بندوں میں سے انہیں بناتے ہیں جو متقی ہوں.

t.149: “And wedo not descend except by the command of yourLord; to Him belongs whatever is before us and whatever is behind us and whatever is between them, and your Lord has never been forgetful.”
t.84: (Jibra’īl X said to the Holy Prophet) “We do not descend but with the command of your Lord. To Him belongs what is in front of us and what is behind us and what is in between; and your Lord is not the One who forgets.
t.85: [Gabriel said],‘We only descend [with revelation] at your Lord’s command––everything before us, everything behind us, everything in between, all belongs to Him––your Lord is never forgetful.
t.95: (The angels will say): "(O Muhammad!) We descend not except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us and all that is behind us, and all that is in between. Your Lord is not forgetful in the least.
t.19: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -
t.22: (The angels say:) "We descend not but by command of thy Lord: to Him belongeth what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between: and thy Lord never doth forget,-
t.203: And we (angels) descend not except by the Command of your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between those two; and your Lord is never forgetful -
t.54: ہم بغیر تیرے رب کے حکم کے اتر نہیں سکتے، ہمارے آگے پیچھے اور ان کے درمیان کی کل چیزیں اسی کی ملکیت میں ہیں، تیرا پروردگار بھولنے واﻻ نہیں.

t.149: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, so worship Him and persevere in worshiping Him. Do you know of anyone similar to Him?
t.84: (He is) the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them. So, worship Him and persevere in His worship. Do you know any one worthy of His name?”
t.85: He is Lord of the heavens and earth and everything in between so worship Him: be steadfast in worshipping Him. Do you know of anyone equal to Him?’
t.95: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in between. Serve Him, then, and be constant in serving Him. Do you know anyone that might be His compeer?"
t.19: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?
t.22: "Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that is between them; so worship Him, and be constant and patient in His worship: knowest thou of any who is worthy of the same Name as He?"
t.203: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, so worship Him (Alone) and be constant and patient in His worship. Do you know of any who is similar to Him? (of course none is similar or co-equal or comparable to Him, and He has none as partner with Him). [There is nothing like Him and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer].
t.54: آسمانوں کا، زمین کا اور جو کچھ ان کے درمیان ہے سب کا رب وہی ہے تو اسی کی بندگی کر اور اس کی عبادت پر جم جا۔ کیا تیرے علم میں اس کا ہمنام ہم پلہ کوئی اور بھی ہے؟

t.149: And man says, “Can it be that when I am dead,I willbe brought out alive?”
t.84: Man says, “Is it that, once I die, I shall be brought forth alive?”
t.85: Man says, ‘What? Once I am dead, will I be brought back to life?’
t.95: Man is prone to say: "Shall I be raised to life after I die?"
t.19: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?
t.22: Man says: "What! When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"
t.203: And man (the disbeliever) says: "When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"
t.54: انسان کہتا ہے کہ جب میں مرجاؤں گا تو کیا پھر زنده کر کے نکالا جاؤں گا؟

t.149: Does man not remember that We created him earlier when he was nothing?
t.84: Does not the man remember that We created him before, when he was nothing?
t.85: but does man not remember that We created him when he was nothing before?
t.95: Does man not remember that We created him before when he was nothing?
t.19: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?
t.22: But does not man call to mind that We created him before out of nothing?
t.203: Does not man remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
t.54: کیا یہ انسان اتنا بھی یاد نہیں رکھتا کہ ہم نے اسے اس سے پہلے پیدا کیا حاﻻنکہ وه کچھ بھی نہ تھا.

t.149: By yourLord, We will surely herd them and the devils, then We will surely bring them around Hell on their knees.
t.84: So, by your Lord, We will definitely gather them together, and the devils as well; then We will definitely make them present around the Jahannam , fallen on their knees.
t.85: By your Lord [Prophet] We shall gather them and the devils together and set them on their knees around Hell;
t.95: By your Lord, We will surely muster them and the devils together. Then We will surely bring them all, on their knees, around Hell,
t.19: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.
t.22: So, by thy Lord, without doubt, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Evil Ones (with them); then shall We bring them forth on their knees round about Hell;
t.203: So by your Lord, surely, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Shayâtîn (devils) (with them), then We shall bring them round Hell on their knees.
t.54: تیرے پروردگار کی قسم! ہم انہیں اور شیطانوں کو جمع کر کے ضرور ضرور جہنم کے اردگرد گھٹنوں کے بل گرے ہوئے حاضر کر دیں گے.

t.149: Then out of every sect We will surely snatch those most defiant to the All-Merciful.
t.84: Then, out of every group, We will certainly draw out those who were more rebellious against the All-Merciful (Allah).
t.85: We shall seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy-
t.95: and then We will draw aside from each party those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate Lord,
t.19: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.
t.22: Then shall We certainly drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against (Allah) Most Gracious.
t.203: Then indeed We shall drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against the Most Gracious (Allâh).
t.54: ہم پھر ہر ہر گروه سے انہیں الگ نکال کھڑا کریں گے جو اللہ رحمنٰ سے بہت اکڑے اکڑے پھرتے تھے.

t.149: Then(they will realize that) We surely know better of those who are most deserving to roast in it.
t.84: Then of course, We are most aware of those who are more deserving to enter it (the Jahannam ).
t.85: We know best who most deserves to burn in Hell-
t.95: and then We shall know well all those most worthy to be cast in Hell.
t.19: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.
t.22: And certainly We know best those who are most worthy of being burned therein.
t.203: Then, verily, We know best those who are most worthy of being burnt therein.
t.54: پھر ہم انہیں بھی خوب جانتے ہیں جو جہنم کے داخلے کے زیاده سزاوار ہیں.

t.149: But every single one of you is bound to approach it; this has been an unavoidable decree of your Lord.
t.84: There is none among you who does not have to arrive at it. This is undertaken by your Lord as an absolute decree, bound to be enforced.
t.85: but every single one of you will approach it, a decree from your Lord which must be fulfilled.
t.95: There is not one of you but shall pass by Hell. This is a decree which your Lord will fulfil.
t.19: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.
t.22: Not one of you but will pass over it: this is, with thy Lord, a Decree which must be accomplished.
t.203: There is not one of you but will pass over it (Hell): this is with your Lord; a Decree which must be accomplished.
t.54: تم میں سے ہر ایک وہاں ضرور وارد ہونے واﻻ ہے، یہ تیرے پروردگار کے ذمے قطعی، فیصل شده امر ہے.

t.149: Then Wedeliver those who were mindful(of God) and leave the unjust in it on their knees.
t.84: Then We will save those who feared Allah, and will leave the wrongdoers in it, fallen on their knees.
t.85: We shall save the devout and leave the evildoers there on their knees.
t.95: Then We shall deliver those that feared Allah and leave the wrong-doers there on their knees.
t.19: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.
t.22: But We shall save those who guarded against evil, and We shall leave the wrong-doers therein, (humbled) to their knees.
t.203: Then We shall save those who used to fear Allâh and were dutiful to Him. And We shall leave the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrongdoers) therein (humbled) to their knees (in Hell).
t.54: پھر ہم پرہیزگاروں کو تو بچالیں گے اور نافرمانوں کو اسی میں گھٹنوں کے بل گرا ہوا چھوڑ دیں گے.

t.149: And when Our signsare read to them, evident, those who have denied say to those who have attained faith, “Which of the two groups is better in position and fairerin company?”
t.84: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Which of the two groups is superior in its place and better in its assembly?”
t.85: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, [all that] the disbelievers say to the believers [is], ‘Which side is better situated? Which side has the better following?’
t.95: When Our clear revelations are recited to those who deny the Truth they are wont to say to those who have faith: "Which of the two groups has a better status and whose assemblies are grander?"
t.19: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?
t.22: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say to those who believe, "Which of the two sides is best in point of position? Which makes the best show in council?"
t.203: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, those who disbelieve (the rich and strong among the pagans of Quraish who live a life of luxury) say to those who believe (the weak, poor companions of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم who have a hard life): "Which of the two groups (i.e. believers or disbelievers) is best in (point of) position and as regards station (place of council for consultation)."
t.54: جب ان کے سامنے ہماری روشن آیتیں تلاوت کی جاتی ہیں تو کافر مسلمانوں سے کہتے ہیں بتاؤ ہم تم دونوں جماعتوں میں سے کس کا مرتبہ زیاده ہے؟ اور کس کی مجلس شاندار ہے؟

t.149: And how many a generation have We annihilated before them who surpassed them in riches and splendor?
t.84: How many a generation We have destroyed before them who were better in assets and outlook!
t.85: We have destroyed many a generation before them who surpassed them in riches and outward glitter!
t.95: How numerous are the peoples We destroyed before them - those that were more resourceful and grander in outward appearance!
t.19: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!
t.22: But how many (countless) generations before them have we destroyed, who were even better in equipment and in glitter to the eye?
t.203: And how many a generation (past nations) have We destroyed before them, who were better in wealth, goods and outward appearance?
t.54: ہم تو ان سے پہلے بہت سی جماعتوں کو غارت کر چکے ہیں جو ساز وسامان اور نام ونمود میں ان سے بڑھ چڑھ کر تھیں.

t.149: Say, “Whoever has been in utter misguidance, may the All-Merciful fully extend for him.” Until, when they see what they were promised—either punishment or the Hour—then they will know who was in a worse position and weaker as an army.
t.84: Say, “Whoever stays straying, let his term be extended by the All-Merciful (Allah) still longer, until when they will see what they are being warned of: either the punishment or the Hour (of Doom), then they will know who was worse in his place and weaker in his forces.
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘The Lord of Mercy lengthens [the lives] of the misguided, until, when they are confronted with what they have been warned about- either the punishment [in this life] or the Hour [of Judgement]- they realize who is worse situated and who has the weakest forces.’
t.95: Say: "The Most Compassionate Lord grants respite to those who stray into error, until they behold what they had been threatened with, either God's chastisement (in the world) or the Hour (of Resurrection)" - then they fully know whose station is worse, and who is weaker in hosts!
t.19: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.
t.22: Say: "If any men go astray, (Allah) Most Gracious extends (the rope) to them, until, when they see the warning of Allah (being fulfilled) - either in punishment or in (the approach of) the Hour,- they will at length realise who is worst in position, and (who) weakest in forces!
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) whoever is in error, the Most Gracious (Allâh) will extend (the rope) to him, until, when they see that which they were promised, either the torment or the Hour, they will come to know who is worst in position, and who is weaker in forces. [This is the answer to the question in Verse No.19:73]
t.54: کہہ دیجئے! جو گمراہی میں ہوتا ہے رحمنٰ اس کو خوب لمبی مہلت دیتا ہے، یہاں تک کہ وه ان چیزوں کو دیکھ لیں جن کا وعده کیے جاتے ہیں یعنی عذاب یا قیامت کو، اس وقت ان کو صحیح طور پر معلوم ہو جائے گا کہ کون برے مرتبے والا اور کس کا جتھا کمزور ہے.

t.149: And Allah increases in guidance those who seek guidance. And abiding deeds of righteousness are more rewardable by your Lord and better in return.
t.84: Allah makes those on the right path excel in guidance. And the everlasting virtues are better with your Lord in respect of reward and better in their return.
t.85: But God gives more guidance to those who are guided, and good deeds of lasting merit are best and most rewarding in your Lord’s sight.
t.95: (On the contrary), Allah increases in guidance those who follow the Right Way. Lasting acts of righteousness are better in the sight of your Lord as reward and conducive to a better end.
t.19: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.
t.22: "And Allah doth advance in guidance those who seek guidance: and the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best in respect of (their) eventual return."
t.203: And Allâh increases in guidance those who walk aright. And the righteous good deeds that last, are better with your Lord, for reward and better for resort.
t.54: اور ہدایت یافتہ لوگوں کو اللہ تعالیٰ ہدایت میں بڑھاتا ہے، اور باقی رہنے والی نیکیاں تیرے رب کے نزدیک ﺛواب کے لحاظ سے اور انجام کے لحاظ سے بہت ہی بہتر ہیں.

t.149: Have youseen the one who denied Our signs and said, “I will most surely be given wealth and children”?
t.84: Have you, then, seen him who rejected Our verses and said, “I shall certainly be given wealth and children”?
t.85: Have you considered the man who rejects Our revelation, who says, ‘I will certainly be given wealth and children’?
t.95: Have you seen him who rejected Our signs and said: "Surely I shall continue to be favoured with riches and children."
t.19: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?
t.22: Hast thou then seen the (sort of) man who rejects Our Signs, yet says: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children?"
t.203: Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Ayât (this Qur’ân and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and said: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children [if I will be alive (again)]."
t.54: کیا تو نے اسے بھی دیکھا جس نے ہماری آیتوں سے کفر کیا اور کہا کہ مجھے تو مال واوﻻد ضرور ہی دی جائے گی.

t.149: Has he viewed the hidden realm, or has he taken with the All-Mercifula covenant?
t.84: Has he peeped into the Unseen or taken a covenant with the All-Merciful (Allah)?
t.85: Has he penetrated the unknown or received a pledge to that effect from the Lord of Mercy?
t.95: Has he obtained knowledge of the Unseen, or has he taken a covenant with the Most Compassionate Lord?
t.19: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?
t.22: Has he penetrated to the Unseen, or has he taken a contract with (Allah) Most Gracious?
t.203: Has he known the Unseen or has he taken a covenant from the Most Gracious (Allâh)?
t.54: کیا وه غیب پر مطلع ہے یا اللہ کا کوئی وعده لے چکا ہے؟

t.149: But no! We will write what he says and keep extending the agony for him exceedingly,
t.84: Never! We will write what he says and extend for him the punishment extensively.
t.85: No! We shall certainly record what he says and prolong his punishment:
t.95: By no means! We shall write down all what he says; and We shall greatly prolong his chastisement,
t.19: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.
t.22: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall add and add to his punishment.
t.203: Nay, We shall record what he says, and We shall increase his torment (in the Hell);
t.54: ہرگز نہیں، یہ جو بھی کہہ رہا ہے ہم اسے ضرور لکھ لیں گے، اور اس کے لئے عذاب بڑھائے چلے جائیں گے.

t.149: and we will inherit from him whatever he says, and he will come to Us solitary.
t.84: And We will inherit from him what he is talking about, and he will come to Us all alone.
t.85: We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of and he will come to Us all alone.
t.95: and We shall inherit all the resources and hosts of which he boasts, and he will come to Us all alone.
t.19: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).
t.22: To Us shall return all that he talks of and he shall appear before Us bare and alone.
t.203: And We shall inherit from him (at his death) all that he talks of (i.e. wealth and children which We have bestowed upon him in this world), and he shall come to Us alone.
t.54: یہ جن چیزوں کو کہہ رہا ہے اسے ہم اس کے بعد لے لیں گے۔ اور یہ تو بالکل اکیلا ہی ہمارے سامنے حاضر ہوگا.

t.149: And they took, apart from Allah, other gods to be a source of might for them.
t.84: They have taken gods other than Allah, so that they may be a source of might for them.
t.85: They have taken other gods beside God to give them strength,
t.95: They have taken other gods instead of Allah that they may be a source of strength for them.
t.19: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.
t.22: And they have taken (for worship) gods other than Allah, to give them power and glory!
t.203: And they have taken (for worship) âlihah (gods) besides Allâh, that they might give them honour, power and glory (and also protect them from Allâh’s punishment).
t.54: انہوں نے اللہ کے سوا دوسرے معبود بنا رکھے ہیں کہ وه ان کے لئے باعﺚ عزت ہوں.

t.149: But no! They will deny their worship of them and become opponents against them.
t.84: Never! They (their fabricated deities) will soon reject their having worshipped them, and they will be just the opposite for them.
t.85: but these gods will reject their worship and will even turn against them.
t.95: By no means! They shall soon deny their worship and shall become their adversaries instead.
t.19: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.
t.22: Instead, they shall reject their worship, and become adversaries against them.
t.203: Nay, but they (the so-called gods) will deny their worship of them, and become opponents to them (on the Day of Resurrection).
t.54: لیکن ایسا ہرگز ہونا نہیں۔ وه تو ان کی پوجا سے منکر ہو جائیں گے، اور الٹے ان کے دشمن بن جائیں گے.

t.149: Have younot seen that We have dispatched the devils against the deniers, exciting them with incitement?
t.84: Have you not seen that We have sent the devils onto the disbelievers inciting them with all their incitements.
t.85: Have you [Prophet] not seen how We send devils to incite the disbelievers to sin?
t.95: Do you not see that We have sent devils upon the unbelievers who greatly incite them (to oppose the Truth)?
t.19: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?
t.22: Seest thou not that We have set the Evil Ones on against the unbelievers, to incite them with fury?
t.203: See you not that We have sent the Shayâtîn (devils) against the disbelievers to push them to do evil.
t.54: کیا تو نے نہیں دیکھا کہ ہم کافروں کے پاس شیطانوں کو بھیجتے ہیں جو انہیں خوب اکساتے ہیں.

t.149: So do not hurry about them; indeed, We are only counting(down) for them precisely.
t.84: So make no hurry about them; We are but counting for them a count down.
t.85: There is no need for you to be impatient concerning them: We are counting down their [allotted] time.
t.95: Therefore, do not hasten (in seeking a scourge against them). We are counting their days.
t.19: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).
t.22: So make no haste against them, for We but count out to them a (limited) number (of days).
t.203: So make no haste against them; We only count out to them a (limited) number (of the days of the life of this world and delay their term so that they may increase in evil and sins).
t.54: تو ان کے بارے میں جلدی نہ کر، ہم تو خود ہی ان کے لئے مدت شماری کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: On a day when We herd the ones who were mindful(of God) to the All-Mercifulas a delegation,
t.84: The day We will assemble the God-fearing before the All-Merciful (Allah) as guests,
t.85: On the Day We gather the righteous as an honoured company before the Lord of Mercy
t.95: The Day shall soon come when We shall bring together the God-fearing to the Most Compassionate Lord, as honoured guests;
t.19: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.
t.22: The day We shall gather the righteous to (Allah) Most Gracious, like a band presented before a king for honours,
t.203: The Day We shall gather the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) unto the Most Gracious (Allâh), like a delegation (presented before a king for honour).
t.54: جس دن ہم پرہیزگاروں کو اللہ رحمان کی طرف بطور مہمان جمع کریں گے.

t.149: and flock the criminals into Hell, thirsty,
t.84: and will drive the sinners towards the Jahannam as herds of cattle (are driven) towards water,
t.85: and drive the sinful like a thirsty herd into Hell,
t.95: and We shall drive the guilty ones to Hell as a thirsty herd.
t.19: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,
t.22: And We shall drive the sinners to Hell, like thirsty cattle driven down to water,-
t.203: And We shall drive the Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) to Hell, in a thirsty state (like a thirsty herd driven down to water).
t.54: اور گناه گاروں کوسخت پیاس کی حالت میں جہنم کی طرف ہانک لے جائیں گے.

t.149: with no power of intercession—except for the one who had taken with the All-Merciful a covenant.
t.84: none will have power to intercede, except the one who has entered into a covenant with the All-Merciful (Allah).
t.85: no one will have power to intercede except for those who have permission from the Lord of Mercy.
t.95: On that Day none will have the power to intercede for them except those who received a sanction from the Most Compassionate Lord.
t.19: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord.
t.22: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from (Allah) Most Gracious.
t.203: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from the Most Gracious (Allâh).
t.54: کسی کو شفاعت کا اختیار نہ ہوگا سوائے ان کے جنہوں نے اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سے کوئی قول قرار لے لیا ہے.

t.149: And they said, “The All-Merciful has taken(for himself) offspring.”
t.84: They say, “The All-Merciful (Allah) has got a son.”
t.85: The disbelievers say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has offspring.’
t.95: They claim: "The Most Compassionate Lord has taken a son to Himself."
t.19: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son.
t.22: They say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
t.203: And they say: "The Most Gracious (Allâh) has begotten a son (or offspring or children) [as the Jews say: ‘Uzair (Ezra) is the son of Allâh, and the Christians say that He has begotten a son [‘Îsâ (Jesus) عليه السلام], and the pagan Arabs say that He has begotten daughters (angels and others.)]."
t.54: ان کا قول تو یہ ہے کہ اللہ رحمٰن نے بھی اوﻻد اختیار کی ہے.

t.149: Youhavecome up with something monstrous!
t.84: Indeed you have come up with such an abominable statement
t.85: How terrible is this thing you assert:
t.95: Surely you have made a monstrous statement.
t.19: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing
t.22: Indeed ye have put forth a thing most monstrous!
t.203: Indeed you have brought forth (said) a terrible evil thing.
t.54: یقیناً تم بہت بری اور بھاری چیز ﻻئے ہو.

t.149: The heavens almost rupture at it, and the earth splits and the mountains fall, crumbling:
t.84: that the heavens are well-nigh to explode at it, and the earth to burst apart, and the mountains to fall down crumbling,
t.85: it almost causes the heavens to be torn apart, the earth to split asunder, the mountains to crumble to pieces,
t.95: It is such a monstrosity that heavens might well-nigh burst forth at it, the earth might be cleaved, and the mountains fall
t.19: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,
t.22: At it the skies are ready to burst, the earth to split asunder, and the mountains to fall down in utter ruin,
t.203: Whereby the heavens are almost torn, and the earth is split asunder, and the mountains fall in ruins,
t.54: قریب ہے کہ اس قول کی وجہ سے آسمان پھٹ جائیں اور زمین شق ہوجائے اور پہاڑ ریزے ریزے ہو جائیں.

t.149: that they have attributed a son to the All-Merciful!
t.84: for they have ascribed a son to the All-Merciful (Allah),
t.85: that they attribute offspring to the Lord of Mercy.
t.95: at their ascribing a son to the Most Compassionate Lord.
t.19: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son,
t.22: That they should invoke a son for (Allah) Most Gracious.
t.203: That they ascribe a son (or offspring or children) to the Most Gracious (Allâh).
t.54: کہ وه رحمان کی اوﻻد ﺛابت کرنے بیٹھے.

t.149: And in no way is it fitting for the All-Merciful to take(for Himself) a son.
t.84: while it does not behove the All-Merciful to have a son.
t.85: It does not befit the Lord of Mercy [to have offspring]:
t.95: It does not befit the Most Compassionate Lord that He should take a son.
t.19: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.
t.22: For it is not consonant with the majesty of (Allah) Most Gracious that He should beget a son.
t.203: But it is not suitable for (the Majesty of) the Most Gracious (Allâh) that He should beget a son (or offspring or children).
t.54: شان رحمٰن کے ﻻئق نہیں کہ وه اوﻻد رکھے.

t.149: There is none in the heavens and the earth but is bound to come to the All-Merciful as a servant.
t.84: There is none in the heavens and the earth, but bound to come to the All-Merciful as a slave.
t.85: there is no one in the heavens or earth who will not come to the Lord of Mercy as a servant-
t.95: There is no one in the heavens and the earth but he shall come to the Most Compassionate Lord as His servant.
t.19: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.
t.22: Not one of the beings in the heavens and the earth but must come to (Allah) Most Gracious as a servant.
t.203: There is none in the heavens and the earth but comes unto the Most Gracious (Allâh) as a slave.
t.54: آسمان وزمین میں جو بھی ہیں سب کے سب اللہ کے غلام بن کر ہی آنے والے ہیں.

t.149: He has enumerated them and counted them precisely.
t.84: He has fully encompassed them and precisely calculated their numbers,
t.85: He has counted them all: He has numbered them exactly-
t.95: Verily He encompasses them and has counted them all.
t.19: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.
t.22: He does take an account of them (all), and hath numbered them (all) exactly.
t.203: Verily He knows each one of them, and has counted them a full counting.
t.54: ان سب کو اس نے گھیر رکھا ہے اور سب کو پوری طرح گن بھی رکھا ہے.

t.149: And each one of them is bound to come to Him on the Day of Resurrection solitary.
t.84: and each one of them is bound to come to Him on the Day of Judgment, all alone.
t.85: and they will each return to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.
t.95: On the Day of Resurrection each one of these will come to Him singly.
t.19: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.
t.22: And everyone of them will come to Him singly on the Day of Judgment.
t.203: And everyone of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection (without any helper, or protector or defender).
t.54: یہ سارے کے سارے قیامت کے دن اکیلے اس کے پاس حاضر ہونے والے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—the All-Merciful will give them love.
t.84: Surely, those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them the All-Merciful (Allah) will create love.
t.85: But the Lord of Mercy will give love to those who believe and do righteous deeds:
t.95: Indeed, the Most Compassionate Lord will soon create enduring love for those who believe and do righteous works.
t.19: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.
t.22: On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.
t.203: Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allâh and in His Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)] and work deeds of righteousness, the Most Gracious (Allâh) will bestow love for them (in the hearts of the believers).
t.54: بیشک جو ایمان لائے ہیں اور جنہوں نے شائستہ اعمال کیے ہیں ان کے لیے اللہ رحمٰن محبت پیدا کردے گا.

t.149: So indeed, We have made it easy in yourtongue, that you may give glad tidings to the ones who were mindful(of God) and warn with it a hostile people.
t.84: So We have made it (the Qur’ān) easy through your tongue, so that you give with it the good news to the God-fearing, and warn with it an obstinate people.
t.85: We have made it easy, in your own language [Prophet], so that you may bring glad news to the righteous and warnings to a stubborn people.
t.95: Therefore, We have revealed the Qur'an in your tongue and made it easy to understand that you may give glad tidings to the God-fearing and warn a contentious people.
t.19: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.
t.22: So have We made the (Qur'an) easy in thine own tongue, that with it thou mayest give Glad Tidings to the righteous, and warnings to people given to contention.
t.203: So We have made this (the Qur’ân) easy in your own tongue (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), only that you may give glad tidings to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2), and warn with it the Ludd (most quarrelsome) people.
t.54: ہم نے اس قرآن کو تیری زبان میں بہت ہی آسان کر دیا ہے کہ تو اس کے ذریعہ سے پرہیزگاروں کو خوشخبری دے اور جھگڑالو لوگوں کو ڈرا دے.

t.149: And how many a generation have We annihilated before them? Can you feel a single one of them or hear from them the slightest whisper?
t.84: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them! Do you sense (the presence of) any one of them, or hear from them even a whisper?
t.85: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you perceive a single one of them now, or hear as much as a whisper?
t.95: How numerous are the peoples that We destroyed before them! Do you now perceive any one of them, or hear even their whisper?
t.19: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound?
t.22: But how many (countless) generations before them have We destroyed? Canst thou find a single one of them (now) or hear (so much as) a whisper of them?
t.203: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Can you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) find a single one of them or hear even a whisper of them?
t.54: ہم نے ان سے پہلے بہت سی جماعتیں تباہ کر دی ہیں، کیا ان میں سے ایک کی بھی آہٹ تو پاتا ہے یا ان کی آواز کی بھنک بھی تیرے کان میں پڑتی ہے؟

t.149: Tâ Ha.
t.84: Tā-Hā
t.85: Ta Ha
t.95: Ta' Ha'
t.19: Ta. Ha.
t.22: Ta-Ha.
t.203: Tâ-Hâ.
t.54: طٰہٰ.

t.149: We have not sent down the Recitalupon youfor you to be wretched,
t.84: We did not reveal the Qur’ān to you to (make you) face hardship
t.85: It was not to distress you [Prophet] that We sent down the Quran to you,
t.95: We did not reveal the Qur'an to you to cause you distress;
t.19: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,
t.22: We have not sent down the Qur'an to thee to be (an occasion) for thy distress,
t.203: We have not sent down the Qur’ân unto you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to cause you distress,
t.54: ہم نے یہ قرآن تجھ پر اس لئے نہیں اتارا کہ تو مشقت میں پڑ جائے.

t.149: but only as a reminding for one who fears.
t.84: rather to remind him who has the fear (of Allah),
t.85: but as a reminder for those who hold God in awe,
t.95: it is only a reminder for him who fears Allah;
t.19: But as a reminder unto him who feareth,
t.22: But only as an admonition to those who fear (Allah),-
t.203: But only as a Reminder to those who fear (Allâh).
t.54: بلکہ اس کی نصیحت کے لئے جو اللہ سے ڈرتا ہے.

t.149: A bestowal from on high by the One Who created the earth and the highest heavens—
t.84: it being a revelation from the One Who created the earth, and high heavens.
t.85: a revelation from the One who created the earth and the high heaven,
t.95: a revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens.
t.19: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens,
t.22: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the heavens on high.
t.203: A revelation from Him (Allâh) Who has created the earth and high heavens.
t.54: اس کا اتارنا اس کی طرف سے ہے جس نے زمین کو اور بلند آسمانوں کو پیدا کیا ہے.

t.149: the All-Merciful; on the Throne He settled.
t.84: The RaHmān (Allah, the All-Merciful) has positioned Himself on the Throne.
t.85: the Lord of Mercy, established on the throne.
t.95: The Most Compassionate Lord is settled on the Throne (of the Universe).
t.19: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne.
t.22: (Allah) Most Gracious is firmly established on the throne (of authority).
t.203: The Most Gracious (Allâh) rose over (Istawâ) the (Mighty) Throne (in a manner that suits His Majesty).
t.54: جو رحمٰن ہے، عرش پر قائم ہے.

t.149: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and whatever is between them and whatever is beneath the ground.
t.84: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens, all that is in the earth and whatever lies between them and whatever lies beneath the soil.
t.85: Everything in the heavens and on earth, everything between them, everything beneath the soil, belongs to Him.
t.95: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and all that is in between, and all that is beneath the soil.
t.19: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod.
t.22: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and on earth, and all between them, and all beneath the soil.
t.203: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth, and all that is between them, and all that is under the soil.
t.54: جس کی ملکیت آسمانوں اور زمین اور ان دونوں کے درمیان اور (کرہٴ خاک) کے نیچے کی ہر ایک چیز پر ہے.

t.149: And if youspeak aloud, indeed, He knows the secret and the most hidden.
t.84: If you pronounce the word aloud, then (it makes no difference, for) He certainly knows the secret and what is even more hidden.
t.85: Whatever you may say aloud, He knows what you keep secret and what is even more hidden.
t.95: Whether you speak out aloud (or in a low voice), He knows what is said secretly, and even that which is most hidden.
t.19: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.
t.22: If thou pronounce the word aloud, (it is no matter): for verily He knoweth what is secret and what is yet more hidden.
t.203: And if you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) speak (the invocation) aloud, then verily, He knows the secret and that which is yet more hidden.
t.54: اگر تو اونچی بات کہے تو وه تو ہر ایک پوشیده، بلکہ پوشیده سے پوشیده تر چیز کو بھی بخوبی جانتا ہے.

t.149: Allah—there is no god but He; to him belong the most beautiful names.
t.84: (Such is) Allah. There is no god but He. For Him are the Beautiful Names.
t.85: God––there is no god but Him––the most excellent names belong to Him.
t.95: Allah - there is no god but He. His are the most excellent names.
t.19: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names.
t.22: Allah! there is no god but He! To Him belong the most Beautiful Names.
t.203: Allâh! Lâ ilâha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He)! To Him belong the Best Names.
t.54: وہی اللہ ہے جس کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں، بہترین نام اسی کے ہیں.

t.149: And has the story of Moses reached you?
t.84: Has there come to you the story of Mūsā?
t.85: Has the story of Moses come to you [Prophet]?
t.95: Has the story of Moses reached you?
t.19: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?
t.22: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
t.203: And has there come to you the story of Mûsâ (Moses)?
t.54: تجھے موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کا قصہ بھی معلوم ہے؟

t.149: When he saw a fire, so he said to his family, “Stay; I have noticed a fire; perhaps I can bring youa torch therefrom or find some guidance by the fire.”
t.84: When he saw a fire and said to his family, “Stay here. I have noticed a fire. Perhaps I can bring you an ember from it, or find some guidance by the fire.”
t.85: He saw a fire and said to his people, ‘Stay here––I can see a fire. Maybe I can bring you a flaming brand from it or find some guidance there.’
t.95: When he saw a fire and said to his family: "Hold on! I have just perceived a fire; perhaps I will bring a brand from it for you, or I will find some guidance at the fire about the way to follow."
t.19: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire.
t.22: Behold, he saw a fire: So he said to his family, "Tarry ye; I perceive a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire."
t.203: When he saw a fire, he said to his family: "Wait! Verily, I have seen a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire."
t.54: جبکہ اس نے آگ دیکھ کر اپنے گھر والوں سے کہا کہ تم ذرا سی دیر ٹھہر جاؤ مجھے آگ دکھائی دی ہے۔ بہت ممکن ہے کہ میں اس کا کوئی انگارا تمہارے پاس ﻻؤں یا آگ کے پاس سے راستے کی اطلاع پاؤں.

t.149: So when he reached it, he was called, “O Moses.
t.84: So when he came to it, he was called, “O Mūsā,
t.85: When he came to the fire, he was summoned, ‘Moses!
t.95: When he came to it, a voice called out: "Moses!
t.19: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses!
t.22: But when he came to the fire, a voice was heard: "O Moses!
t.203: And when he came to it (the fire), he was called by name: "O Mûsâ (Moses)!
t.54: جب وه وہاں پہنچے تو آواز دی گئی اے موسیٰ!

t.149: Indeed, I—I am your Lord. So take off your sandals; you are indeed in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
t.84: it is Me, your Lord, so remove your shoes; you are in the sacred valley of Tuwā.
t.85: I am your Lord. Take off your shoes: you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
t.95: Verily I am your Lord! Take off your shoes. You are in the sacred valley, Tuwa!
t.19: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa.
t.22: "Verily I am thy Lord! therefore (in My presence) put off thy shoes: thou art in the sacred valley Tuwa.
t.203: "Verily I am your Lord! So take off your shoes; you are in the sacred valley, Tuwa.
t.54: یقیناً میں ہی تیرا پروردگار ہوں تو اپنی جوتیاں اتار دے، کیونکہ تو پاک میدان طویٰ میں ہے.

t.149: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed.
t.84: I have chosen you (for prophet-hood), so listen to what is revealed:
t.85: I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.
t.95: I Myself have chosen you; therefore, give ear to what is revealed.
t.19: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.
t.22: "I have chosen thee: listen, then, to the inspiration (sent to thee).
t.203: "And I have chosen you. So listen to that which will be revealed (to you).
t.54: اور میں نے تجھے منتخب کر لیا اب جو وحی کی جائے اسے کان لگا کر سن.

t.149: Indeed I—I alone—am Allah. There is no God but I, so worship Me and establish the prayer for My remembrance.
t.84: Surely, I AM ALLAH. There is no god but Myself, so worship Me, and establish Salāh for My remembrance.
t.85: I am God; there is no god but Me. So worship Me and keep up the prayer so that you remember Me.
t.95: Verily I am Allah. There is no god beside Me. So serve Me and establish Prayers to remember Me.
t.19: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance.
t.22: "Verily, I am Allah: There is no god but I: So serve thou Me (only), and establish regular prayer for celebrating My praise.
t.203: "Verily! I am Allâh! Lâ ilâha illa Ana (none has the right to be worshipped but I), so worship Me, and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) for My Remembrance.
t.54: بیشک میں ہی اللہ ہوں، میرے سوا عبادت کے ﻻئق اور کوئی نہیں پس تو میری ہی عبادت کر، اور میری یاد کے لئے نماز قائم رکھ.

t.149: The Hour is indeed coming—I almost hide it—so that every single self is paid for what it endeavors.
t.84: Surely, the Hour (i.e. the Day of Judgment) has to come. I would keep it secret, so that everyone is given a return for the effort one makes.
t.85: The Hour is coming––though I choose to keep it hidden––for each soul to be rewarded for its labour.
t.95: The Hour of Resurrection is coming. I have willed to keep the time of its coming hidden so that everyone may be recompensed in accordance with his effort.
t.19: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve).
t.22: "Verily the Hour is coming - My design is to keep it hidden - for every soul to receive its reward by the measure of its Endeavour.
t.203: "Verily, the Hour is coming - and I am almost hiding it from Myself - that every person may be rewarded for that which he strives.
t.54: قیامت یقیناً آنے والی ہے جسے میں پوشیده رکھنا چاہتا ہوں تاکہ ہر شخص کو وه بدلہ دیا جائے جو اس نے کوشش کی ہو.

t.149: So let not the one who denies it and has been following his own whim bar you from it, lest you fall(into doom) .
t.84: So the one who does not believe in it and follows his desires must not make you neglectful of it, otherwise you will perish.
t.85: Do not let anyone who does not believe in it and follows his own desires distract you from it, and so bring you to ruin.’
t.95: Let him who does not believe in it and follows his lust not turn your thought away from it, lest you are ruined.
t.19: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.
t.22: "Therefore let not such as believe not therein but follow their own lusts, divert thee therefrom, lest thou perish!"..
t.203: "Therefore, let not the one who believes not therein (i.e. in the Day of Resurrection, Reckoning, Paradise and Hell.), but follows his own lusts, divert you therefrom, lest you perish.
t.54: پس اب اس کے یقین سے تجھے کوئی ایسا شخص روک نہ دے جو اس پر ایمان نہ رکھتا ہو اور اپنی خواہش کے پیچھے پڑا ہو، ورنہ تو ہلاک ہوجائے گا.

t.149: And what is that in your right-hand, O Moses?”
t.84: And what is that in your right hand, O Mūsā?”
t.85: ‘Moses, what is that in your right hand?’
t.95: And what is in your right hand, O Moses?"
t.19: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?
t.22: "And what is that in the right hand, O Moses?"
t.203: "And what is that in your right hand, O Mûsâ (Moses)?"
t.54: اے موسیٰ! تیرے اس دائیں ہاتھ میں کیا ہے؟

t.149: He said, “This is my staff. I lean on it, and I beat down(leaves) for my sheep with it, and I have other uses for it.”
t.84: He said, “It is my staff. I lean on it, and I beat down leaves with it for my sheep, and I have many other uses for it.”
t.85: ‘It is my staff,’ he said, ‘I lean on it; restrain my sheep with it; I also have other uses for it.’
t.95: Moses answered: "This is my staff. I lean on it (when I walk), and with it I beat down leaves for my flock, and I have many other uses for it."
t.19: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses.
t.22: He said, "It is my rod: on it I lean; with it I beat down fodder for my flocks; and in it I find other uses."
t.203: He said: "This is my stick, whereon I lean, and wherewith I beat down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses."
t.54: جواب دیا کہ یہ میری ﻻٹھی ہے، جس پر میں ٹیک لگاتا ہوں اور جس سے میں اپنی بکریوں کے لئے پتے جھاڑ لیا کرتا ہوں اور بھی اس میں مجھے بہت سے فائدے ہیں.

t.149: He said, “Cast it, O Moses.”
t.84: He said, “Throw it down O Mūsā”.
t.85: God said, ‘Throw it down, Moses.’
t.95: He said: "Moses, throw it down."
t.19: He said: Cast it down, O Moses!
t.22: (Allah) said, "Throw it, O Moses!"
t.203: (Allâh) said: "Cast it down, O Mûsâ (Moses)!"
t.54: فرمایا اے موسیٰ! اسے ہاتھ سے نیچے ڈال دے.

t.149: So he cast it, and thereupon it became a moving serpent.
t.84: So, he threw it down, and suddenly it was a snake, running around.
t.85: He threw it down and- lo and behold!- it became a fast-moving snake.
t.95: So he threw it down, and lo! it was a rapidly moving snake.
t.19: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding.
t.22: He threw it, and behold! It was a snake, active in motion.
t.203: He cast it down, and behold! It was a snake, moving quickly.
t.54: ڈالتے ہی وه سانﭗ بن کر دوڑنے لگی

t.149: He said, “Pick it up and be not afraid; We will restore it to its original condition.
t.84: He said, “Pick it up, and be not scared. We shall restore it to its former state.
t.85: He said, ‘Pick it up without fear: We shall turn it back into its former state.
t.95: Then He said: "Seize it and have no fear. We shall restore it to its former state.
t.19: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state.
t.22: (Allah) said, "Seize it, and fear not: We shall return it at once to its former condition"..
t.203: Allâh said: "Grasp it and fear not; We shall return it to its former state,
t.54: فرمایا بے خوف ہو کر اسے پکڑ لے، ہم اسے اسی پہلی سی صورت میں دوباره ﻻ دیں گے.

t.149: And press your hand to your side; it will come out white without any bad affliction—another sign,
t.84: And press your hand under your arm, and it will come out (brightly) white without any disease, as another sign,
t.85: Now place your hand under your armpit and it will come out white, though unharmed: that is another sign.
t.95: And place your hand in your armpit, it will come forth shining white, without blemish. This is another Sign of Allah,
t.19: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token.
t.22: "Now draw thy hand close to thy side: It shall come forth white (and shining), without harm (or stain),- as another Sign,-
t.203: "And press your (right) hand to your (left) side: it will come forth white (and shining), without any disease as another sign,
t.54: اور اپنا ہاتھ اپنی بغل میں ڈال لے تو وه سفید چمکتا ہوا ہو کر نکلے گا، لیکن بغیر کسی عیب (اور روگ) کے یہ دوسرا معجزه ہے.

t.149: that We may show you of Our greatest signs.
t.84: so that We may show you some of Our great signs.
t.85: We do this to show you some of Our greatest signs.
t.95: for We shall show you some of Our greatest Signs.
t.19: That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents,
t.22: "In order that We may show thee (two) of our Greater Signs.
t.203: "That We may show you (some) of Our Greater Signs.
t.54: یہ اس لئے کہ ہم تجھے اپنی بڑی بڑی نشانیاں دکھانا چاہتے ہیں.

t.149: Go to Pharaoh; indeed, he has exceeded all limits.”
t.84: Go to Pharaoh. He has really exceeded all bounds.”
t.85: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly become a tyrant.’
t.95: And go to Pharaoh now for he has transgressed all bounds."
t.19: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
t.22: "Go thou to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds."
t.203: "Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)! Verily, he has transgressed (all bounds in disbelief and disobedience, and has behaved as an arrogant and as a tyrant)."
t.54: اب تو فرعون کی طرف جا اس نے بڑی سرکشی مچا رکھی ہے.

t.149: He said, “My Lord, expand my chest for me,
t.84: He said, “My Lord, put my heart at peace for me,
t.85: Moses said, ‘Lord, lift up my heart
t.95: Moses said: "Lord! Open my breast for me;
t.19: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind
t.22: (Moses) said: "O my Lord! expand me my breast;
t.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "O my Lord! Open for me my chest (grant me self-confidence, contentment, and boldness).
t.54: موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) نے کہا اے میرے پروردگار! میرا سینہ میرے لئے کھول دے.

t.149: and ease my mission for me,
t.84: and make my task easy for me
t.85: and ease my task for me.
t.95: and ease my task for me,
t.19: And ease my task for me;
t.22: "Ease my task for me;
t.203: "And ease my task for me;
t.54: اور میرے کام کو مجھ پر آسان کر دے.

t.149: and untie the knot from my tongue
t.84: and remove the knot from my tongue,
t.85: Untie my tongue,
t.95: and loosen the knot from my tongue
t.19: And loose a knot from my tongue,
t.22: "And remove the impediment from my speech,
t.203: "And loose the knot (the defect) from my tongue, (i.e. remove the incorrectness from my speech) [That occurred as a result of a brand of fire which Mûsâ (Moses) put in his mouth when he was an infant]. (Tafsir At-Tabarî).
t.54: اور میری زبان کی گره بھی کھول دے.

t.149: so that they can comprehend my speech,
t.84: so that they may understand my speech.
t.85: so that they may understand my words,
t.95: so that they may understand my speech;
t.19: That they may understand my saying.
t.22: "So they may understand what I say:
t.203: "That they understand my speech.
t.54: تاکہ لوگ میری بات اچھی طرح سمجھ سکیں.

t.149: and appoint for me an assistant from my family:
t.84: And make for me an assistant from my own family,
t.85: and give me a helper from my family,
t.95: and appoint for me, from my household, someone who will help me bear my burden -
t.19: Appoint for me a henchman from my folk,
t.22: "And give me a Minister from my family,
t.203: "And appoint for me a helper from my family,

t.203: "And indeed We conferred a favour on you another time (before).

t.149: ‘Throw him in the coffer then throw it into the waters, so that the waters will cast it onto the bank where an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his will pick him up.’ For I bestowed upon you love from Me and so that you may be modeled before My eye.
t.84: that is, ‘Put him (the baby) in the chest, then cast it into the river, then let the river throw it by the shore, and it will be picked up by one who is enemy to Me and enemy to him.’ And I had cast love on you from Myself (so that you might be favourite of all), and that you might be brought up under My eye.
t.85: “Put your child into the chest, then place him in the river. Let the river wash him on to its bank, and he will be taken in by an enemy of Mine and his.” I showered you with My love and planned that you should be reared under My watchful eye.
t.95: 'Put the baby into a chest and then throw him in the river. The river will throw him up on the shore, and then an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his will take him.' And I spread My love over you in order that you might be reared in My sight.
t.19: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,
t.22: "'Throw (the child) into the chest, and throw (the chest) into the river: the river will cast him up on the bank, and he will be taken up by one who is an enemy to Me and an enemy to him': But I cast (the garment of) love over thee from Me: and (this) in order that thou mayest be reared under Mine eye.
t.203: "Saying: ‘Put him (the child) into the Tabût (a box or a case or a chest) and put it into the river (Nile); then the river shall cast it up on the bank, and there, an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his shall take him.’ And I endued you with love from Me, in order that you may be brought up under My Eye.
t.54: کہ تو اسے صندوق میں بند کرکے دریا میں چھوڑ دے، پس دریا اسے کنارے ﻻ ڈالے گا اور میرا اور خود اس کا دشمن اسے لے لے گا، اور میں نے اپنی طرف کی خاص محبت ومقبولیت تجھ پر ڈال دی۔ تاکہ تیری پرورش میری آنکھوں کے سامنے کی جائے.

t.149: Recall your sister walking along and saying, ‘Shall I tell you about someone who can foster him?’ So We returned you to your mother, that her eye may be comforted and(that she may) not grieve. And you killed a person, but We delivered you from stress and We tested you thoroughly. Then you stayed for years among the people of Midian. Then you came as ordained, O Moses.
t.84: (Remember) when your sister was going (to the family of Pharaoh) and was saying, ‘Shall I lead you to one who nurses him?’ Thus We brought you back to your mother, so that her eyes might have comfort and she might not grieve. And you had killed a person, then We brought you out of the trouble; and We tested you with a great ordeal. Then you lived a number of years amidst the people of Madyan. After all this, you came O Mūsā, to a destined point of time.
t.85: Your sister went out, saying, “I will tell you someone who will nurse him,” then We returned you to your mother so that she could rejoice and not grieve. Later you killed a man, but We saved you from distress and tried you with other tests. You stayed among the people of Midian for years, then you came here as I ordained.
t.95: Recall, when your sister went along, saying: 'Shall I direct you to one who will take charge of him?' Thus We brought you back to your mother so that her heart might be gladdened and she might not grieve. Moses, recall when you slew a person. We delivered you from distress and made you go through several trials. Then you stayed for several years among the people of Midian, and now you have come at the right moment as ordained.
t.19: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,
t.22: "Behold! thy sister goeth forth and saith, 'shall I show you one who will nurse and rear the (child)?' So We brought thee back to thy mother, that her eye might be cooled and she should not grieve. Then thou didst slay a man, but We saved thee from trouble, and We tried thee in various ways. Then didst thou tarry a number of years with the people of Midian. Then didst thou come hither as ordained, O Moses!
t.203: "When your sister went and said: ‘Shall I show you one who will nurse him?’ So We restored you to your mother, that she might cool her eyes and she should not grieve. Then you did kill a man, but We saved you from great distress and tried you with a heavy trial. Then you stayed a number of years with the people of Madyan (Midian). Then you came here according to the fixed term which I ordained (for you), O Mûsâ (Moses)!
t.54: (یاد کر) جبکہ تیری بہن چل رہی تھی اور کہہ رہی تھی کہ اگر تم کہو تو میں اسے بتا دوں جو اس کی نگہبانی کرے، اس تدبیر سے ہم نے تجھے پھر تیری ماں کے پاس پہنچایا کہ اس کی آنکھیں ٹھنڈی رہیں اور وه غمگین نہ ہو۔ اور تو نے ایک شخص کو مار ڈاﻻ تھا اس پر بھی ہم نے تجھے غم سے بچا لیا، غرض ہم نے تجھے اچھی طرح آزما لیا۔ پھر تو کئی سال تک مدین کے لوگوں میں ٹھہرا رہا، پھر تقدیر الٰہی کے مطابق اے موسیٰ! تو آیا.

t.85: I have chosen you for Myself.

t.19: And I have attached thee to Myself.
t.22: "And I have prepared thee for Myself (for service)"..
t.203: "And I have chosen you, for Myself.

t.149: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and donot slacken in remembering Me.

t.203: They said: "Our Lord! Verily we fear lest he should hasten to punish us or lest he should transgress (all bounds against us)."
t.54: دونوں نے کہا اے ہمارے رب! ہمیں خوف ہے کہ کہیں فرعون ہم پر کوئی زیادتی نہ کرے یا اپنی سرکشی میں بڑھ نہ جائے.

t.149: He said, “Be not afraid; I am indeed with you, hearing and seeing.

t.95: He said: "Have no fear. I am with you, hearing and seeing all.

t.203: He (Allâh) said: "Fear not, verily I am with you both, hearing and seeing.

t.149: So approachhim and say, `Weare the messengers of your Lord, so send the Children of Israel with us and do not punish them; we have surely brought you a sign from your Lord, for peace is upon whoever has followed the guidance.
t.84: So, come to him and say, ‘We are the messengers of your Lord. So, let the children of Isrā’īl go with us, and do not persecute them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord; and peace be upon the one who follows the guidance.
t.85: Go and tell him, “We are your Lord’s mes-sengers, so send the Children of Israel with us and do not oppress them. We have brought you a sign from your Lord. Peace be upon whoever follows the right guidance;
t.95: So, go to him, and say: 'Behold, both of us are the Messengers of your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not chastise them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord; and peace shall be for him who follows the true guidance.
t.19: So go ye unto him and say: Lo! we are two messengers of thy Lord. So let the children of Israel go with us, and torment them not. We bring thee a token from thy Lord. And peace will be for him who followeth right guidance.
t.22: "So go ye both to him, and say, 'Verily we are messengers sent by thy Lord: Send forth, therefore, the Children of Israel with us, and afflict them not: with a Sign, indeed, have we come from thy Lord! and peace to all who follow guidance!
t.203: "So go you both to him, and say: ‘Verily, we are Messengers of your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and torment them not; indeed, we have come with a sign from your Lord! And peace will be upon him who follows the guidance!
t.54: تم اس کے پاس جا کر کہو کہ ہم تیرے پروردگار کے پیغمبر ہیں تو ہمارے ساتھ بنی اسرائیل کو بھیج دے، ان کی سزائیں موقوف کر۔ ہم تو تیرے پاس تیرے رب کی طرف سے نشانی لے کر آئے ہیں اور سلامتی اسی کے لئے ہے جو ہدایت کا پابند ہو جائے.

t.149: It has indeed been revealed to us that punishment falls upon whoever has disbelieved andturned away.’”
t.84: Verily, it has been revealed to us that the punishment is for the one who denies and turns away.’”
t.85: it has been revealed to us that punishment falls on whoever rejects the truth and turns his back on it.”’
t.95: It has been revealed to us that chastisement awaits those who called the lie to the truth and turned away from it.' "
t.19: Lo! it hath been revealed unto us that the doom will be for him who denieth and turneth away.
t.22: "'Verily it has been revealed to us that the Penalty (awaits) those who reject and turn away.'"
t.203: "Truly, it has been revealed to us that the torment will be for him who denies [believes not in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messengers.], and turns away (from the truth and obedience of Allâh)."
t.54: ہماری طرف وحی کی گئی ہے کہ جو جھٹلائے اور روگردانی کرے اس کے لئے عذاب ہے.

t.149: He said, “So who is yourLord, O Moses?”
t.84: He (Pharaoh) said, “Who then is the Lord of you two, O Mūsā?”
t.85: [Pharaoh] said, ‘Moses, who is this Lord of yours?’
t.95: Pharaoh said:" Moses! Who is the Lord of the two of you?"
t.19: (Pharaoh) said: Who then is the Lord of you twain, O Moses?
t.22: (When this message was delivered), (Pharaoh) said: "Who, then, O Moses, is the Lord of you two?"
t.203: Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "Who then, O Mûsâ (Moses), is the Lord of you two?"
t.54: فرعون نے پوچھا کہ اے موسیٰ تم دونوں کا رب کون ہے؟

t.84: He (Mūsā) said, “Our Lord is the One who gave everything its due shape, then guided it.”

t.19: He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright.
t.22: He said: "Our Lord is He Who gave to each (created) thing its form and nature, and further, gave (it) guidance."
t.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Our Lord is He Who gave to each thing its form and nature, then guided it aright."
t.54: جواب دیا کہ ہمارا رب وه ہے جس نے ہر ایک کو اس کی خاص صورت، شکل عنایت فرمائی پھر راه سجھا دی.
