t.85: and he will say, ‘Lord, why did You bring me here blind? I was sighted before!’
t.95: where-upon he will say: "Lord! Why have You raised me blind when I had sight in the world?"
t.19: He will say: My Lord! Wherefor hast Thou gathered me (hither) blind, when I was wont to see?
t.22: He will say: "O my Lord! why hast Thou raised me up blind, while I had sight (before)?"
t.203: He will say: "O my Lord! Why have you raised me up blind, while I had sight (before)."
t.54: وه کہے گا کہ الٰہی! مجھے تو نے اندھا بنا کر کیوں اٹھایا؟ حاﻻنکہ میں تو دیکھتا بھالتا تھا.

t.149: He said, “Just as Our signs came to youand you forgot them, today you will be forgotten.”
t.84: He will say, “In the similar manner as Our signs came to you, and you had ignored them. In the same way you will be ignored today.”
t.85: God will say, ‘This is how it is: You ignored Our revelations when they came to you, so today you will be ignored.’
t.95: He will say: "Even so it is. Our Signs came to you and you ignored them. So shall you be ignored this Day."
t.19: He will say: So (it must be). Our revelations came unto thee but thou didst forget them. In like manner thou art forgotten this Day.
t.22: (Allah) will say: "Thus didst Thou, when Our Signs came unto thee, disregard them: so wilt thou, this day, be disregarded."
t.203: (Allâh) will say: "Like this: Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) came unto you, but you disregarded them (i.e. you left them, did not think deeply in them, and you turned away from them), and so this Day, you will be neglected (in the Hell-fire, away from Allâh’s Mercy)."
t.54: (جواب ملے گا کہ) اسی طرح ہونا چاہئے تھا تو میری آئی ہوئی آیتوں کو بھول گیا تو آج تو بھی بھلا دیا جاتا ہے.

t.149: And thus We repay the one who was an extremist and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And surely the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more lasting.
t.84: Thus We recompense him who exceeds the limits and does not believe in the signs of his Lord. Certainly the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more lasting.
t.85: This is how We reward those who go too far, and who do not believe in their Lord’s revelations. The greatest and most enduring punishment is in the Hereafter.
t.95: Thus do We requite him who transgresses and does not believe in the signs of your Lord (during the life of the world); and surely the punishment of the Hereafter is even more terrible and more enduring.
t.19: Thus do We reward him who is prodigal and believeth not the revelations of his Lord; and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be sterner and more lasting.
t.22: And thus do We recompense him who transgresses beyond bounds and believes not in the Signs of his Lord: and the Penalty of the Hereafter is far more grievous and more enduring.
t.203: And thus do We requite him who transgresses beyond bounds [i.e. commits the great sins and disobeys his Lord (Allâh) and believes not in His Messengers, and His revealed Books, like this Qur’an], and believes not in the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of his Lord; and the torment of the Hereafter is far more severe and more lasting.
t.54: ہم ایسا ہی بدلہ ہر اس شخص کو دیا کرتے ہیں جو حد سے گزر جائے اور اپنے رب کی آیتوں پر ایمان نہ ﻻئے، اور بیشک آخرت کا عذاب نہایت ہی سخت اور باقی رہنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Did it give them no guidance(to learn) how many generations before them We annihilated, amidst whose residences they walk? Indeed, in that are signs for the ones endowed with intelligence.
t.84: Did it give them no guidance (to realize) how many generations We have destroyed prior to them in whose dwellings they (often) walk around? Surely, in this there are signs for the men of reason.
t.85: Do they not draw a lesson from the many generations We destroyed before them, through whose dwelling places they now walk? There truly are signs in this for anyone with understanding!
t.95: Did they not find any guidance in the fact that We destroyed many nations in whose ruined dwelling-places they now walk about? Surely there are many Signs in them for people endowed with wisdom.
t.19: Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many a generation We destroyed before them, amid whose dwellings they walk? Lo! therein verily are signs for men of thought.
t.22: Is it not a warning to such men (to call to mind) how many generations before them We destroyed, in whose haunts they (now) move? Verily, in this are Signs for men endued with understanding.
t.203: Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many generations We have destroyed before them, in whose dwellings they walk? Verily, in this are signs indeed for men of understanding.
t.54: کیا ان کی رہبری اس بات نے بھی نہیں کی کہ ہم نے ان سے پہلے بہت سی بستیاں ہلاک کر دی ہیں جن کے رہنے سہنے کی جگہ یہ چل پھر رہے ہیں۔ یقیناً اس میں عقلمندوں کے لئے بہت سی نشانیاں ہیں.

t.149: And were it not for a word that had preceded from yourLord, the inevitable would have happened, but(there is) a stated term.
t.84: But for a word from your Lord that had passed earlier, and an appointed time that had been fixed, it (the punishment) would have been inevitable (for them).
t.85: If it were not for a preordained Word from your Lord [Prophet], they would already have been destroyed. Their time has been set,
t.95: Were it not for a word already gone from your Lord, the decree (of their destruction) would have come to pass.
t.19: And but for a decree that had already gone forth from thy Lord, and a term already fixed, the judgment would have been inevitable (in this world).
t.22: Had it not been for a Word that went forth before from thy Lord, (their punishment) must necessarily have come; but there is a Term appointed (for respite).
t.203: And had it not been for a Word that went forth before from your Lord, and a term determined, (their punishment) must necessarily have come (in this world).
t.54: اگر تیرے رب کی بات پہلے ہی سے مقرر شده اور وقت معین کرده نہ ہوتا تو اسی وقت عذاب آچمٹتا.

t.149: So bear patiently what they say and exalt yourLord with praise before the rising of the sun and before its setting, and during the hours of the night exalt Him, and at the(two) ends of the day, that you may be well pleased .
t.84: So, (O messenger,) endure with patience what they say, and proclaim the purity and praise of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset. And in some hours of night, proclaim His purity, and at points of the day as well, so that you may be pleased.
t.85: so [Prophet] be patient with what they say- celebrate the praise of your Lord, before the rising and setting of the sun, celebrate His praise during the night, and at the beginning and end of the day, so that you may find contentment-
t.95: So bear patiently with what they say. Glorify your Lord, praising Him before sunrise and before sunset, and in the watches of the night, and glorify Him and at the ends of the day that you may attain to happiness.
t.19: Therefor (O Muhammad), bear with what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere the going down thereof. And glorify Him some hours of the night and at the two ends of the day, that thou mayst find acceptance.
t.22: Therefore be patient with what they say, and celebrate (constantly) the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun, and before its setting; yea, celebrate them for part of the hours of the night, and at the sides of the day: that thou mayest have (spiritual) joy.
t.203: So bear patiently (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) what they say, and glorify the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before its setting, and during some hours of the night, and at the ends of the day (an indication for the five compulsory congregational prayers), that you may become pleased (with the reward which Allâh shall give you).
t.54: پس ان کی باتوں پر صبر کر اور اپنے پروردگار کی تسبیح اور تعریف بیان کرتا ره، سورج نکلنے سے پہلے اور اس کے ڈوبنے سے پہلے، رات کے مختلف وقتوں میں بھی اور دن کے حصوں میں بھی تسبیح کرتا ره، بہت ممکن ہے کہ تو راضی ہو جائے.

t.149: And never extend your eyes towards what We have given some classes of them to enjoy—the splendorof the Earlier Life—that We may test them thereby, for your Lord’sprovision is better and more lasting.
t.84: Never stretch your eyes towards the things We have given to some groups of them to enjoy, so that We put them to test thereby, it being merely glamour of the worldly life. And the bounty of your Lord is much better and more lasting.
t.85: and do not gaze longingly at what We have given some of them to enjoy, the finery of this present life: We test them through this, but the provision of your Lord is better and more lasting.
t.95: Do not turn your eyes covetously towards the embellishments of worldly life that We have bestowed upon various kinds of people to test them. But the clean provision bestowed upon you by your Lord is better and more enduring.
t.19: And strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoy, the flower of the life of the world, that We may try them thereby. The provision of thy Lord is better and more lasting.
t.22: Nor strain thine eyes in longing for the things We have given for enjoyment to parties of them, the splendour of the life of this world, through which We test them: but the provision of thy Lord is better and more enduring.
t.203: And strain not your eyes in longing for the things We have given for enjoyment to various groups of them (polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh), the splendour of the life of this world, that We may test them thereby. But the provision (good reward in the Hereafter) of your Lord is better and more lasting.
t.54: اور اپنی نگاہیں ہرگز ان چیزوں کی طرف نہ دوڑانا جو ہم نے ان میں سے مختلف لوگوں کو آرائش دنیا کی دے رکھی ہیں تاکہ انہیں اس میں آزما لیں تیرے رب کا دیا ہوا ہی (بہت) بہتر اور باقی رہنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And command your people to prayer, and patiently adhere to it; We ask of youno provision; it is We who provide for you. For the future outcome is for mindfulness(of God) .
t.84: Bid your family to perform Salāh, and adhere to it yourself. We ask no provision from you. We give provision to you. And the ultimate end is in favour of Taqwā (God-fearing, and piety).
t.85: Order your people to pray, and pray steadfastly yourself. We are not asking you to give Us provision;We provide for you, and the rewards of the Hereafter belong to the devout.
t.95: Enjoin Prayer on your household, and do keep observing it. We do not ask you for any worldly provision; rather, it is We Who provide you, and ultimately the pious will end up the best.
t.19: And enjoin upon thy people worship, and be constant therein. We ask not of thee a provision: We provided for thee. And the sequel is for righteousness.
t.22: Enjoin prayer on thy people, and be constant therein. We ask thee not to provide sustenance: We provide it for thee. But the (fruit of) the Hereafter is for righteousness.
t.203: And enjoin As-Salât (the prayer) on your family, and be patient in offering them [i.e. the Salât (prayers)]. We ask not of you a provision (i.e. to give Us something: money): We provide for you. And the good end (i.e. Paradise) is for the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).
t.54: اپنے گھرانے کے لوگوں پرنماز کی تاکید رکھ اور خود بھی اس پر جما ره، ہم تجھ سے روزی نہیں مانگتے، بلکہ ہم خود تجھے روزی دیتے ہیں، آخر میں بول باﻻ پرہیزگاری ہی کا ہے.

t.149: And they said, “If only he were to bring us a sign from his Lord!” Were they not given evidence of whatever is in the former scrolls?
t.84: They say, “Why does he not bring to us a sign from his Lord?” Has there not come to them the clear sign of what is contained in the earlier Scriptures?
t.85: The disbelievers say, ‘Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?’ Have they not been given clear proof confirming what was in the earlier scriptures?
t.95: They ask: "Why does he not bring us a (miraculous) sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them a Book containing the teachings of the previous scriptures?
t.19: And they say: If only he would bring us a miracle from his Lord! Hath there not come unto them the proof of what is in the former scriptures?
t.22: They say: "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has not a Clear Sign come to them of all that was in the former Books of revelation?
t.203: They say: "Why does he not bring us a sign (proof) from his Lord?" Has there not come to them the proof of that which is (written) in the former papers [Scriptures, i.e. the Taurât (Torah), and the Injeel (Gospel), about the coming of the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم]?
t.54: انہوں نے کہا کہ یہ نبی ہمارے پاس اپنے پروردگار کی طرف سے کوئی نشانی کیوں نہیں ﻻیا؟ کیا ان کے پاس اگلی کتابوں کی واضح دلیل نہیں پہنچی؟

t.149: Had We annihilated them with a punishment before him, they would have said, “Our Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger so that we would have followed Your signs before we were humiliated and disgraced.”
t.84: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before it, they would have said, “Our Lord, why did you not send a messenger to us, so that we might have followed Your signs before we were humiliated and put to disgrace?”
t.85: If We had destroyed them through punishment before this Messenger came, they would have said, ‘Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we could have followed Your revelations before we suffered humiliation and disgrace!’
t.95: Had We destroyed them through some calamity before his coming, they would have said: "Our Lord! Why did You not send any Messenger to us that we might have followed Your signs before being humbled and disgraced?"
t.19: And if we had destroyed them with some punishment before it, they would assuredly have said: Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent unto us a messenger, so that we might have followed Thy revelations before we were (thus) humbled and disgraced!
t.22: And if We had inflicted on them a penalty before this, they would have said: "Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent us a messenger, we should certainly have followed Thy Signs before we were humbled and put to shame."
t.203: And if We had destroyed them with a torment before this (i.e. Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân), they would surely have said: "Our Lord! If only You had sent us a Messenger, we should certainly have followed Your Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), before we were humiliated and disgraced."
t.54: اور اگر ہم اس سے پہلے ہی انہیں عذاب سے ہلاک کر دیتے تو یقیناً یہ کہہ اٹھتے کہ اے ہمارے پروردگار تو نے ہمارے پاس اپنا رسول کیوں نہ بھیجا؟ کہ ہم تیری آیتوں کی تابعداری کرتے اس سے پہلے کہ ہم ذلیل ورسوا ہوتے.

t.149: Say, “Everybody is waiting, so wait, for you will know who the people of the even path are and who was rightly-guided.
t.84: Say, “Everyone is waiting. So wait, then you will know who the people of the straight path are and who has followed the right guidance.”
t.85: [Prophet], say, ‘We are all waiting, so you carry on waiting: you will come to learn who has followed the even path, and been rightly guided.’
t.95: Tell them, (O Muhammad): "Everyone is waiting for his end. Wait, then, and you will soon know who are the people of the Right Way, and are rightly-guided."
t.19: Say: Each is awaiting; so await ye! Ye will come to know who are the owners of the path of equity, and who is right.
t.22: Say: "Each one (of us) is waiting: wait ye, therefore, and soon shall ye know who it is that is on the straight and even way, and who it is that has received Guidance."
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Each one (believer and disbeliever.) is waiting, so wait you too; and you shall know who are they that are on the Straight and Even Path (i.e. Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism), and who are they that have let themselves be guided (on the Right Path).
t.54: کہہ دیجئے! ہر ایک انجام کا منتظر ہے پس تم بھی انتظار میں رہو۔ عنقريب قطعاً جان لو گے کہ راه راست والے کون ہیں اور کون راه یافتہ ہیں.

t.149: Mankind’s reckoning has drawn near, while they are in oblivion, disregarding(it) .
t.84: The reckoning of the people has drawn near to them, while they are in negligence, turning away (from its signs).
t.85: Ever closer to people draws their reckoning, while they turn away, heedless.
t.95: The time of people's reckoning has drawn near, and yet they turn aside in heedlessness.
t.19: Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness.
t.22: Closer and closer to mankind comes their Reckoning: yet they heed not and they turn away.
t.203: Draws near for mankind their reckoning, while they turn away in heedlessness.
t.54: لوگوں کے حساب کا وقت قریب آگیا پھر بھی وه بے خبری میں منھ پھیرے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: No fresh reminder comes to them from their Lord but they listen to it playfully,
t.84: No fresh message of advice comes to them from their Lord, but they listen to it as if they were playing,
t.85: Whenever any fresh revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it playfully
t.95: Whenever any fresh admonition comes to them from their Lord they barely heed it and remain immersed in play,
t.19: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play,
t.22: Never comes (aught) to them of a renewed Message from their Lord, but they listen to it as in jest,-
t.203: Comes not unto them an admonition (a chapter of the Qur’ân) from their Lord as a recent revelation but they listen to it while they play
t.54: ان کے پاس ان کے رب کی طرف سے جو بھی نئی نئی نصیحت آتی ہے اسے وه کھیل کود میں ہی سنتے ہیں.

t.149: their hearts distracted. And secretly did the unjust converse, “Is this anything but a human being like you? Will you go along with sorcery while you see?”
t.84: their hearts paying no heed. And the wrongdoers whisper in secret, “This one is nothing but a mortal like you. Would you then go along with sorcery while you can see (the reality)?”
t.85: with frivolous hearts. The evildoers conferred in secret: ‘Is this man anything but a mortal like yourselves? Are you going to fall under his spell with your eyes wide open?’
t.95: their hearts being set on other concerns. The wrong-doers whisper to one another: "This person is no more than a mortal like yourselves. Will you, then, be enchanted by sorcery while you see?"
t.19: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?
t.22: Their hearts toying as with trifles. The wrong-doers conceal their private counsels, (saying), "Is this (one) more than a man like yourselves? Will ye go to witchcraft with your eyes open?"
t.203: With their hearts occupied (with evil things). Those who do wrong, conceal their private counsels, (saying): "Is this (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) more than a human being like you? Will you submit to magic while you see it?"
t.54: ان کے دل بالکل غافل ہیں اور ان ﻇالموں نے چپکے چپکے سرگوشیاں کیں کہ وه تم ہی جیسا انسان ہے، پھر کیا وجہ ہے جو تم آنکھوں دیکھتے جادو میں آجاتے ہو.

t.149: He said , “My Lord knows what is said in the heaven and the earth, for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”
t.84: He (the prophet) said, “My Lord knows all that is spoken in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.”
t.85: He said, ‘My Lord knows everything that is said in the heavens and the earth: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.’
t.95: He said: "My Lord knows well all that is spoken in the heavens and the earth. He is All-Hearing, All- Knowing."
t.19: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
t.22: Say: "My Lord knoweth (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth: He is the One that heareth and knoweth (all things)."
t.203: He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: "My Lord knows (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower."
t.54: پیغمبر نے کہا میرا پروردگار ہر اس بات کو جو زمین وآسمان میں ہے بخوبی جانتا ہے، وه بہت ہی سننے واﻻ اور جاننے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: But they said, “A jumble of dreams; rather, he fabricated it; rather, he is a poet, so let him bring us a sign like those sent to the ancients.”
t.84: Further they said, “(The Qur’ān is) a mixture of jumble dreams. Rather, he (the prophet) has fabricated it. Rather, he is a poet. So, let him bring a sign to us, as the earlier ones were sent with.”
t.85: Some say, ‘Muddled dreams’; others, ‘He made it up’; yet others, ‘He is just a poet, let him show us a sign as previous messengers did.’
t.95: They say: "Nay, these are confused dreams; nay, he has forged it; nay, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign, even as the Messengers of the past were sent with signs."
t.19: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).
t.22: "Nay," they say, "(these are) medleys of dream! - Nay, He forged it! - Nay, He is (but) a poet! Let him then bring us a Sign like the ones that were sent to (Prophets) of old!"
t.203: Nay, they say: "These (revelations of the Qur’ân which are revealed to Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are mixed up false dreams! Nay, he has invented them! - Nay, he is a poet! Let him then bring us an Ayâh (sign as a proof) like the ones (Prophets) the former were sent (with)!"
t.54: اتنا ہی نہیں بلکہ یہ تو کہتے ہیں کہ یہ قرآن پراگنده خوابوں کا مجموعہ ہے بلکہ اس نے از خود اسے گھڑ لیا ہے بلکہ یہ شاعر ہے، ورنہ ہمارے سامنے یہ کوئی ایسی نشانی ﻻتے جیسے کہ اگلے پیغمبر بھیجے گئے تھے.

t.149: None of the towns We annihilated before them had believed. Will they, then, believe?
t.84: Not a single town from those whom We destroyed came to believe before them. So, will they believe?
t.85: But of the communities We destroyed before them not a single one believed. Will these now believe?
t.95: Not one township that We destroyed before them believed. Would they, then, believe?
t.19: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe?
t.22: (As to those) before them, not one of the populations which We destroyed believed: will these believe?
t.203: Not one of the towns (populations), of those which We destroyed, believed before them (though We sent them signs): will they then believe?
t.54: ان سے پہلے جتنی بستیاں ہم نے اجاڑیں سب ایمان سے خالی تھیں۔ تو کیا اب یہ ایمان ﻻئیں گے.

t.149: And never did We send before youbut men to whom We reveal , so ask the people of the Reminder if youdo not know.
t.84: And We did not send before you messengers except men whom We inspired with revelation. So, ask the people (having the knowledge) of the Message, if you do not know.
t.85: And even before your time [Prophet], all the messengers We sent were only men We inspired–– if you [disbelievers] do not know, ask people who know the Scripture––
t.95: (O Muhammad), even before you We never sent any other than human beings as Messengers, and to them We sent revelation. Ask the People of the Book if you do not know.
t.19: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not?
t.22: Before thee, also, the messengers We sent were but men, to whom We granted inspiration: If ye realise this not, ask of those who possess the Message.
t.203: And We sent not before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) but men to whom We revealed. So ask the people of the Reminder [Scriptures - the Taurât (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel)] if you do not know.
t.54: تجھ سے پہلے جتنے پیغمبر ہم نے بھیجے سبھی مرد تھے جن کی طرف ہم وحی اتارتے تھے پس تم اہل کتاب سے پوچھ لو اگر خود تمہیں علم نہ ہو.

t.149: And never did We make them a mere body,(ones) who eatno food, for never were they immortal.
t.84: We did not make them such bodies as ate no food, nor were they immortal.
t.85: We did not give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal.
t.95: We did not endow the Messengers with bodies that would need no food; nor were they immortals.
t.19: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals.
t.22: Nor did We give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they exempt from death.
t.203: And We did not create them (the Messengers, with) bodies that ate not food, nor were they immortals.
t.54: ہم نے ان کے ایسے جسم نہیں بنائے تھے کہ وه کھانا نہ کھائیں اور نہ وه ہمیشہ رہنے والے تھے.

t.149: Then We fulfilled the promise to them, so We saved them together with whomever We will, and We annihilated the extremists.
t.84: Then We caused the promise to come true for them, so We saved them and those whom We willed, and destroyed the transgressors.
t.85: We fulfilled Our promise to them in the end: We saved them and those We wished to save, and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
t.95: Then We fulfilled the promise We had made to them: We rescued them and those whom We wished, and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
t.19: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals.
t.22: In the end We fulfilled to them Our Promise, and We saved them and those whom We pleased, but We destroyed those who transgressed beyond bounds.
t.203: Then We fulfilled to them the promise. So We saved them and those whom We willed, but We destroyed Al-Musrifûn (i.e. disbelievers in Allah, in His Messengers, extravagants, transgressors of Allâh’s limits by committing crimes, oppressions, polytheism and sins).
t.54: پھر ہم نے ان سے کیے ہوئے سب وعدے سچے کیے انہیں اور جن جن کو ہم نے چاہا نجات عطا فرمائی اور حد سے نکل جانے والوں کو غارت کر دیا.

t.149: Most surely, We have sent down to youa Scripture containing your reminder. Do you not reason?
t.84: Surely, We have sent down to you (O people of Arabia) a book having a good counsel for you. So, do you not understand?
t.85: And now We have sent down to you [people] a Scripture to remind you. Will you not use your reason?
t.95: We have bestowed upon you a Book that mentions you. Do you not understand?
t.19: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense?
t.22: We have revealed for you (O men!) a book in which is a Message for you: will ye not then understand?
t.203: Indeed, We have sent down for you (O mankind) a Book (the Qur’ân) in which there is Dhikrukum,(your Reminder or an honour for you i.e. honour for the one who follows the teaching of the Qur’ân and acts on its teachings). Will you not then understand?
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے تمہاری جانب کتاب نازل فرمائی ہے جس میں تمہارے لئے ذکر ہے، کیا پھر بھی تم عقل نہیں رکھتے؟

t.149: And how many an unjust town have We crushed and established thereafter another people?
t.84: How many a town, that were unjust, have We crushed and raised up after them another people!
t.85: How many communities of evildoers We have destroyed! How many others We have raised up in their places!
t.95: How many a wrong-doing town did We shatter and then raise up another people.
t.19: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk!
t.22: How many were the populations We utterly destroyed because of their iniquities, setting up in their places other peoples?
t.203: How many a town (community) given to wrong-doing, have We destroyed, and raised up after them another people!
t.54: اور بہت سی بستیاں ہم نے تباه کر دیں جو ﻇالم تھیں اور ان کے بعد ہم نے دوسری قوم کو پیدا کر دیا.

t.149: Thus when they sensed Our force, they immediately ran away from it.
t.84: So, as soon as they sensed Our punishment (approaching them), they started fleeing from it.
t.85: When they felt Our might coming upon them, see how they tried to escape it!
t.95: Then, when they perceived Our chastisement they took to their heels and fled.
t.19: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it!
t.22: Yet, when they felt Our Punishment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.
t.203: Then, when they perceived (saw) Our Torment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.
t.54: جب انہوں نے ہمارے عذاب کا احساس کر لیا، تو لگے اس سے بھاگنے.

t.149: Do not run, but come back to the luxuries youwere immersed in, and your residences, that you may be questioned.
t.84: (It was said to them,) “Do not flee, and go back to the luxuries you were made to enjoy, and to your dwellings. May be you are asked questions.”
t.85: ‘Do not try to escape. Go back to your homes and the pleasure you revelled in: you may be questioned.’
t.95: (They were told): "Flee not, but return to your comforts and to your dwellings. You are likely to be questioned."
t.19: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned.
t.22: Flee not, but return to the good things of this life which were given you, and to your homes in order that ye may be called to account.
t.203: Flee not, but return to that wherein you lived a luxurious life, and to your homes, in order that you may be questioned.
t.54: بھاگ دوڑ نہ کرو اور جہاں تمہیں آسودگی دی گئی تھی وہیں واپس لوٹو اور اپنے مکانات کی طرف جاؤ تاکہ تم سے سوال تو کر لیا جائے.

t.149: They said, “Woe to us; indeed, we have been unjust.”
t.84: They said, “Alas for us! We were wrongdoers indeed.”
t.85: They said, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
t.95: They said: "Woe to us; surely we were wrong-doers."
t.19: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers.
t.22: They said: "Ah! woe to us! We were indeed wrong-doers!"
t.203: They cried: "Woe to us! Certainly we have been Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh)."
t.54: کہنے لگے ہائے ہماری خرابی! بیشک ہم ﻇالم تھے.

t.149: Thus this continued to be their cry until We made them extinguished ashes.
t.84: Then, this continued to be their cry till We turned them into stubble, totally extinguished.
t.85: and that cry of theirs did not cease until We made them burnt-offstubble.
t.95: They did not cease to cry this until We reduced them to stubble, still and silent.
t.19: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct.
t.22: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is mown, as ashes silent and quenched.
t.203: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is reaped, extinct (dead).
t.54: پھر تو ان کا یہی قول تھا یہاں تک کہ ہم نے انہیں جڑ سے کٹی ہوئی کھیتی اور بجھی پڑی آگ (کی طرح) کر دیا.

t.149: And in no way did We create the sky and the earth and what is between them playfully.
t.84: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what lies between them for play.
t.85: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them playfully.
t.95: We did not create in sport the heavens and the earth and all that lies between the two.
t.19: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play.
t.22: Not for (idle) sport did We create the heavens and the earth and all that is between!
t.203: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them for a (mere) play.
t.54: ہم نے آسمان وزمین اور ان کے درمیان کی چیزوں کو کھیلتے ہوئے نہیں بنایا.

t.149: If We wanted amusement, We could have obtained it from very close to Us, were We to do so.
t.84: Had We intended to have a pastime, We would have had it from Our own, if We were ever to do so.
t.85: If We had wished for a pastime, We could have found it within Us- if We had wished for any such thing.
t.95: Had it been Our will to find a pastime, We would have found one near at hand; if at all We were inclined to do so.
t.19: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did.
t.22: If it had been Our wish to take (just) a pastime, We should surely have taken it from the things nearest to Us, if We would do (such a thing)!
t.203: Had We intended to take a pastime (i.e. a wife or a son), We could surely have taken it from Us, if We were going to do (that).
t.54: اگر ہم یوں ہی کھیل تماشے کا اراده کرتے تو اسے اپنے پاس سے ہی بنا لیتے، اگر ہم کرنے والے ہی ہوتے.

t.149: Rather, We hurl the truth against falsehood so that it crushes it, and thus it vanishes. And woe unto youfor what you describe.
t.84: Instead, We launch the truth against falsehood, which gets it smashed, and in no time it is gone. Alas to you for what you describe!
t.85: No! We hurl the truth against falsehood, and truth obliterates it- see how falsehood vanishes away! Woe to you [people] for the way you describe God!
t.95: Nay, We hurl the Truth at falsehood so that the Truth crushes falsehood, and lo! it vanishes. Woe to you for what you utter!
t.19: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
t.22: Nay, We hurl the Truth against falsehood, and it knocks out its brain, and behold, falsehood doth perish! Ah! woe be to you for the (false) things ye ascribe (to Us).
t.203: Nay, We fling (send down) the truth (this Qur’ân) against the falsehood (disbelief), so it destroys it, and behold, it (falsehood) is vanished. And woe to you for that (lie) which you ascribe (to Allâh by uttering that Allâh has a wife and a son).
t.54: بلکہ ہم سچ کو جھوٹ پر پھینک مارتے ہیں پس سچ جھوٹ کا سر توڑ دیتا ہے اور وه اسی وقت نابود ہو جاتا ہے، تم جو باتیں بناتے ہو وه تمہاری لئے باعﺚ خرابی ہیں.

t.149: For to Him belongs whomever is in the heavens and the earth. And those in His presence are not too arrogant to worship Him, nor do they grow weary.
t.84: To Him belong all those in the heavens and the earth. And those who are near to Him are not arrogant against His worship, nor are they sluggish.
t.85: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and those that are with Him are never too proud to worship Him, nor do they grow weary;
t.95: To Him belongs whosoever dwells in the heavens and on earth. Those (angels) that are with Him neither disdain to serve Him out of pride, nor do they weary of it.
t.19: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary;
t.22: To Him belong all (creatures) in the heavens and on earth: Even those who are in His (very) Presence are not too proud to serve Him, nor are they (ever) weary (of His service):
t.203: To Him belongs whosoever is in the heavens and on earth. And those who are near Him (i.e. the angels) are not too proud to worship Him, nor are they weary (of His worship).
t.54: آسمانوں اور زمین میں جو ہے اسی اللہ کا ہے اور جو اس کے پاس ہیں وه اس کی عبادت سے نہ سرکشی کرتے ہیں اور نہ تھکتے ہیں.

t.149: They give due exaltation(to Him) night and day, never tiring.
t.84: They proclaim His purity night and day, never slackening.
t.85: they glorify Him tirelessly night and day.
t.95: They glorify Him night and day, without flagging.
t.19: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not.
t.22: They celebrate His praises night and day, nor do they ever flag or intermit.
t.203: They (i.e. the angels) glorify His Praises night and day, (and) they never slacken (to do so).
t.54: وه دن رات تسبیح بیان کرتے ہیں اور ذرا سی بھی سستی نہیں کرتے.

t.149: Or have they taken to themselves gods from the earth who(can) resurrect?
t.84: Or have they adopted gods from the earth, who raise the dead?
t.85: Have they chosen any gods from the earth who can give life to the dead?
t.95: Have they taken earthly gods who are such that they raise up the dead to life?
t.19: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead?
t.22: Or have they taken (for worship) gods from the earth who can raise (the dead)?
t.203: Or have they taken (for worship) âlihah (gods) from the earth who raise the dead?
t.54: کیا ان لوگوں نے زمین (کی مخلوقات میں) سے جنہیں معبود بنا رکھا ہے وه زنده کردیتے ہیں.

t.149: If there were in them gods other than Allah, they would have surely become corrupted. So Highly Exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, far above what they describe.
t.84: Had there been gods beside Allah, in the heavens and the earth, both of them would have fallen in disorder. So pure is Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from what they describe.
t.85: If there had been in the heavens or earth any gods but Him, both heavens and earth would be in ruins: God, Lord of the Throne, is far above the things they say:
t.95: Had there been any gods in the heavens and the earth apart from Allah, the order of both the heavens and the earth would have gone to ruins. Glory be to Allah, the Lord of the Throne, Who is far above their false descriptions of Him.
t.19: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him).
t.22: If there were, in the heavens and the earth, other gods besides Allah, there would have been confusion in both! but glory to Allah, the Lord of the Throne: (High is He) above what they attribute to Him!
t.203: Had there been therein (in the heavens and the earth) âlihah (gods) besides Allâh, then verily both would have been ruined. Glorified be Allâh, the Lord of the Throne, (High is He) above all that (evil) they associate with Him!
t.54: اگر آسمان وزمین میں سوائے اللہ تعالیٰ کے اور بھی معبود ہوتے تو یہ دونوں درہم برہم ہوجاتے پس اللہ تعالیٰ عرش کا رب ہر اس وصف سے پاک ہے جو یہ مشرک بیان کرتے ہیں.

t.149: He is not asked about what He does, but they shall be asked.
t.84: He is not questioned of what He does, and they are questioned.
t.85: He cannot be called to account for anything He does, whereas they will be called to account.
t.95: None shall question Him about what He does, but they shall be questioned.
t.19: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned.
t.22: He cannot be questioned for His acts, but they will be questioned (for theirs).
t.203: He cannot be questioned as to what He does, while they will be questioned.
t.54: وه اپنے کاموں کے لئے (کسی کےآگے) جواب ده نہیں اور سب (اس کےآگے) جواب ده ہیں.

t.149: Or have they taken apart from Him other gods? Say, “Bring yourproof; thisis the reminder of those with me and the reminder of those before me.” Rather, most of them do not know the truth, so they disregard(it) .
t.84: Is it that they have adopted gods besides Him? Say, “Bring your proof.” Here is the (book carrying) advice for those with me, and the (books carrying) advice for those before me. Yet most of them do not know the truth, and therefore they are averse.
t.85: Have they chosen to worship other gods instead of Him? Say, ‘Bring your proof. This is the Scripture for those who are with me and the Scripture for those who went before me.’ But most of them do not recognize the truth, so they pay no heed.
t.95: Have they taken gods other than Him? Say, (O Muhammad): "Bring forth your proof! Here is the Book with admonition for those of my time and there are also scriptures with admonition for people before me." But most people do not know the Truth, and have, therefore, turned away from it.
t.19: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse.
t.22: Or have they taken for worship (other) gods besides him? Say, "Bring your convincing proof: this is the Message of those with me and the Message of those before me." But most of them know not the Truth, and so turn away.
t.203: Or have they taken for worship (other) âlihah (gods) besides Him? Say: "Bring your proof." This (the Qur’ân) is the Reminder for those with me and the Reminder for those before me. But most of them know not the Truth, so they are averse.
t.54: کیا ان لوگوں نے اللہ کے سوا اور معبود بنا رکھے ہیں، ان سے کہہ دو ﻻؤ اپنی دلیل پیش کرو۔ یہ ہے میرے ساتھ والوں کی کتاب اور مجھ سے اگلوں کی دلیل۔ بات یہ ہے کہ ان میں کے اکثر لوگ حق کو نہیں جانتے اسی وجہ سے منھ موڑے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: And never did We send any messenger before youbut We revealto him that: “There is no god but I, so worshipMe.”
t.84: We did not send before you any messenger but We revealed to him that there is no god but I, so worship Me.”
t.85: We never sent any messenger before you [Muhammad] without revealing to him: ‘There is no god but Me, so serve Me.’
t.95: Never did We send any Messenger before you to whom We did not reveal: "There is no god but Me. So serve Me alone."
t.19: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me.
t.22: Not a messenger did We send before thee without this inspiration sent by Us to him: that there is no god but I; therefore worship and serve Me.
t.203: And We did not send any Messenger before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) but We revealed to him (saying): Lâ ilâha illa Ana [none has the right to be worshipped but I (Allâh)], so worship Me (Alone and none else)."
t.54: تجھ سے پہلے بھی جو رسول ہم نے بھیجا اس کی طرف یہی وحی نازل فرمائی کہ میرے سوا کوئی معبود برحق نہیں پس تم سب میری ہی عبادت کرو.*

t.149: Yet they said, “The All-Merciful has taken to himself offspring.” Highly Exalted is He; rather, they are honored servants
t.84: They said, “The RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah) has taken children for Himself.” Pure is He (from having children). They are but (His) honored servants.
t.85: And they say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has taken offspring for Himself.’ May He be exalted! No! They are only His honoured servants:
t.95: They say: "The Most Compassionate Lord has taken to Himself a son." Glory be to Him! Those whom they so designate are only His honoured servants.
t.19: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves;
t.22: And they say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten offspring." Glory to Him! they are (but) servants raised to honour.
t.203: And they say: "The Most Gracious (Allâh) has begotten a son (or children)." Glory to Him! They [whom they call children of Allâh i.e. the angels, ‘Îsâ (Jesus) - son of Maryam (Mary), ‘Uzair (Ezra)], are but honoured slaves.
t.54: (مشرک لوگ) کہتے ہیں کہ رحمٰن اوﻻد واﻻ ہے (غلط ہے) اس کی ذات پاک ہے، بلکہ وه سب اس کے باعزت بندے ہیں.

t.149: who never speak before Him, and they only act on His command.
t.84: They do not precede Him in speech, and only under His command they act.
t.85: they do not speak before He speaks and they act by His command.
t.95: They do not outstrip Him in speech and only act as He commands.
t.19: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command.
t.22: They speak not before He speaks, and they act (in all things) by His Command.
t.203: They speak not until He has spoken, and they act on His Command.
t.54: کسی بات میں اللہ پر پیش دستی نہیں کرتے بلکہ اس کے فرمان پر کاربند ہیں.

t.149: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they do not intercede except for those whom He approves, and they tremble in awe of Him.
t.84: He knows what is in front of them and what is behind them, and they make recommendation for none but for whom He likes, and in awe of Him they are fearful.
t.85: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede without His permission––indeed they themselves stand in awe of Him.
t.95: He knows whatever is before them and whatsoever is remote from them and they do not intercede except for him, intercession on whose behalf pleases Him, and they stand constantly in awe of Him.
t.19: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him.
t.22: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they offer no intercession except for those who are acceptable, and they stand in awe and reverence of His (Glory).
t.203: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him with whom He is pleased. And they stand in awe for fear of Him.
t.54: وه ان کے آگے پیچھے تمام امور سے واقف ہے وه کسی کی بھی سفارش نہیں کرتے بجز ان کے جن سے اللہ خوش ہو وه تو خود ہیبت الٰہی سے لرزاں وترساں ہیں.

t.149: And whoever of them says, “I am a god apart from Him,” We will repay him with Hell; thus We repay the unjust.
t.84: Should any one of them say, “I am god besides Him”, We will recompense him with Jahannam (Hell). This is how We recompense the transgressors.
t.85: If any of them were to claim, ‘I am a god beside Him,’ We would reward them with Hell: this is how We reward evildoers.
t.95: And if anyone of them were to claim: "Indeed I am a god apart from Him," We shall recompense both with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrong-doers.
t.19: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers.
t.22: If any of them should say, "I am a god besides Him", such a one We should reward with Hell: thus do We reward those who do wrong.
t.203: And if any of them should say: "Verily, I am an ilâh (a god) besides Him (Allâh)," such a one We should recompense with Hell. Thus We recompense the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers).
t.54: ان میں سے اگر کوئی بھی کہہ دے کہ اللہ کے سوا میں ﻻئق عبادت ہوں تو ہم اسے دوزخ کی سزا دیں ہم ﻇالموں کو اسی طرح سزا دیتے ہیں.

t.149: Do the deniers not see that the heavens and the earth were one mass, and then We tore them apart? And We made from water every living thing; will they not believe?
t.84: Did the disbelievers not observe that the heavens and the earth were closed, then We opened them? And We created from water every living thing. Would they still not believe?
t.85: Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and the earth used to be joined together and that We ripped them apart, that We made every living thing from water? Will they not believe?
t.95: Did the unbelievers (who do not accept the teaching of the Prophet) not realize that the heavens and the earth were one solid mass, then We tore them apart, and We made every living being out of water? Will they, then, not believe (that We created all this)?
t.19: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?
t.22: Do not the Unbelievers see that the heavens and the earth were joined together (as one unit of creation), before we clove them asunder? We made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
t.203: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were joined together as one united piece, then We parted them? And We have made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
t.54: کیا کافر لوگوں نے یہ نہیں دیکھا کہ آسمان وزمین باہم ملے جلے تھے پھر ہم نے انہیں جدا کیا اور ہر زنده چیز کو ہم نے پانی سے پیدا کیا، کیا یہ لوگ پھر بھی ایمان نہیں ﻻتے.

t.149: And We put firm mountains on the earth, lest it sway with them; and We set broad pathways on it, that they might be guided.
t.84: And We created mountains on the earth, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein paths and ways, so that they are guided.
t.85: And We put firm mountains on the earth, lest it should sway under them, and set broad paths on it, so that they might follow the right direction,
t.95: And We placed firm mountains on earth lest it should sway with them, and We made wide paths in them that they may find their way;
t.19: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way.
t.22: And We have set on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein broad highways (between mountains) for them to pass through: that they may receive Guidance.
t.203: And We have placed on the earth firm mountains, lest it should shake with them, and We placed therein broad highways for them to pass through, that they may be guided.
t.54: اور ہم نے زمین میں پہاڑ بنا دیئے تاکہ وه مخلوق کو ہلا نہ سکے، اور ہم نے اس میں کشاده راہیں بنا دیں تاکہ وه راستہ حاصل کریں.

t.149: And We made the sky a preserved ceiling, yet they disregard its signs.
t.84: We made the sky a protected roof; and they are averse to its signs.
t.85: and We made the sky a well-secured canopy- yet from its wonders they turn away.
t.95: and We made the sky a secure canopy; and yet they turn away from these Signs.
t.19: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents.
t.22: And We have made the heavens as a canopy well guarded: yet do they turn away from the Signs which these things (point to)!
t.203: And We have made the heaven a roof, safe and well guarded. Yet they turn away from its signs (i.e. sun, moon, winds, clouds, etc.).
t.54: آسمان کو محفوظ چھت بھی ہم نے ہی بنایا ہے۔ لیکن لوگ اس کی قدرت کے نمونوں پر دھیان نہیں دھرتے.

t.149: And it is He Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each floating in an orbit.
t.84: He is the One who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each floating in an orbit.
t.85: It is He who created night and day, the sun and the moon, each floating in its orbit.
t.95: It is He Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Each of them is floating in its orbit.
t.19: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit.
t.22: It is He Who created the Night and the Day, and the sun and the moon: all (the celestial bodies) swim along, each in its rounded course.
t.203: And He it is Who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each in an orbit floating.
t.54: وہی اللہ ہے جس نے رات اور دن اور سورج اور چاند کو پیدا کیا ہے۔ ان میں سے ہر ایک اپنے اپنے مدار میں تیرتے پھرتے ہیں.

t.149: And never did We grant immortality to any human being before you. Should you die, are they then the immortal?
t.84: We did not assign immortality to any human (even) before you. So, if you die, will they live for ever?
t.85: We have not granted everlasting life to any other human being before you either [Muhammad]- if you die, will [the disbelievers] live for ever?
t.95: (O Muhammad), We did not grant everlasting life to any human being even before you. If you were to die, will they live for ever?
t.19: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal!
t.22: We granted not to any man before thee permanent life (here): if then thou shouldst die, would they live permanently?
t.203: And We granted not to any human being immortality before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): then if you die, would they live forever?
t.54: آپ سے پہلے کسی انسان کو بھی ہم نے ہمیشگی نہیں دی، کیا اگر آپ مرگئے تو وه ہمیشہ کے لئے ره جائیں گے.

t.149: Every single self is bound to taste death, for We test youwith evil and good as a means of trial, and to Us you are returned .
t.84: Every one has to taste death, and We test you through bad and good (situations) with a trial, and to Us you are to be returned.
t.85: Every soul is certain to taste death: We test you all through the bad and the good, and to Us you will all return.
t.95: Every living being shall taste death and We shall subject you to ill and good by way of trial, and to Us shall all of you be eventually sent back.
t.19: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.
t.22: Every soul shall have a taste of death: and We test you by evil and by good by way of trial. to Us must ye return.
t.203: Everyone is going to taste death, and We shall make a trial of you with evil and with good. And to Us you will be returned.
t.54: ہر جان دار موت کا مزه چکھنے واﻻ ہے۔ ہم بطریق امتحان تم میں سے ہر ایک کو برائی بھلائی میں مبتلا کرتے ہیں اور تم سب ہماری ہی طرف لوٹائے جاؤ گے.

t.149: And when those who have denied see you, they treat you only with ridicule: “Is this the one who mentions your gods?” For of the reminder of the All-Merciful they themselves are deniers.
t.84: When disbelievers see you, they do nothing but take you in jest (saying to one another,) “Is this the one who talks of your gods?” - while they themselves reject even talking of the RaHmān (All-Merciful).
t.85: When the disbelievers see you, they laugh at you: ‘Is this the one who talks about your gods?’ They reject any talk of the Lord of Mercy.
t.95: When the unbelievers see you they make you an object of fun, saying: "Is he the one who mentions your gods?" They say so, and yet they reject with disdain the very mention of the Most Compassionate Lord.
t.19: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent.
t.22: When the Unbelievers see thee, they treat thee not except with ridicule. "Is this," (they say), "the one who talks of your gods?" and they blaspheme at the mention of (Allah) Most Gracious!
t.203: And when those who disbelieved (in the Oneness of Allâh) see you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), they take you not except for mockery (saying): "Is this the one who talks (badly) about your gods?" While they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Gracious (Allâh). [Tafsir Al-Qurtubî].
t.54: یہ منکرین تجھے جب بھی دیکھتے ہیں تو تمہارا مذاق ہی اڑاتے ہیں کہ کیا یہی وه ہے جو تمہارے معبودوں کا ذکر برائی سے کرتا ہے، اور وه خود ہی رحمٰن کی یاد کے بالکل ہی منکر ہیں.

t.149: Man was created of haste. I will show youMy signs, so do not ask Me to hasten.
t.84: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My signs, so do not seek haste from Me.
t.85: Man was created hasty: I will show you My signs soon, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
t.95: Man is hasty by nature. I shall certainly show you My Signs. Do not ask Me to be hasty.
t.19: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten.
t.22: Man is a creature of haste: soon (enough) will I show you My Signs; then ye will not ask Me to hasten them!
t.203: Man is created of haste. I will show you My Ayât (torments, proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.). So ask Me not to hasten (them).
t.54: انسان جلد باز مخلوق ہے۔ میں تمہیں اپنی نشانیاں ابھی ابھی دکھاؤں گا تم مجھ سے جلد بازی نہ کرو.

t.149: And they say, “When will this promise come true, if you are truthful?”
t.84: They say, “When will this promise be (fulfilled), if you are true?”
t.85: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
t.95: They say: "(Tell us) when will the threat of punishment come to pass if you are truthful?"
t.19: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
t.22: They say: "When will this promise come to pass, if ye are telling the truth?"
t.203: And they say: "When will this promise (come to pass), if you are truthful."
t.54: کہتے ہیں کہ اگر سچے ہو تو بتا دو کہ یہ وعده کب ہے.

t.149: If those who have denied only knew the time when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces nor off their backs, nor will they be supported!
t.84: Only if the disbelievers were to know the time when they will not (be able to) keep off the fire from their faces or from their backs, nor will they be helped.
t.85: If the disbelievers only knew, the time will arrive when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces or their backs, and they will get no help.
t.95: If only the unbelievers knew of the Hour when they shall not be able to keep off the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs; nor shall they be helped.
t.19: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped!
t.22: If only the Unbelievers knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the fire from their faces, nor yet from their backs, and (when) no help can reach them!
t.203: If only those who disbelieved knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs, and they will not be helped.
t.54: کاش! یہ کافر جانتے کہ اس وقت نہ تو یہ کافر آگ کو اپنے چہروں سے ہٹا سکیں گے اور نہ اپنی پیٹھوں سے اور نہ ان کی مدد کی جائے گی.

t.149: Rather, it will come upon them suddenly and bewilder them, so they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be given respite.
t.84: Rather, it will come upon them suddenly and will baffle them. So they will not be able to turn it back, nor will they be given respite.
t.85: It will come upon them suddenly and stupefy them; they will be powerless to push it away; they will not be reprieved.
t.95: That will suddenly come upon them and stupefy them. They shall not be able to ward it off, nor shall they be granted any respite.
t.19: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved.
t.22: Nay, it may come to them all of a sudden and confound them: no power will they have then to avert it, nor will they (then) get respite.
t.203: Nay, it (the Fire or the Day of Resurrection) will come upon them all of a sudden and will perplex them, and they will have no power to avert it nor will they get respite.
t.54: (ہاں ہاں!) وعدے کی گھڑی ان کے پاس اچانک آجائے گی اور انہیں ہکا بکا کر دے گی، پھر نہ تو یہ لوگ اسے ٹال سکیں گے اور نہ ذرا سی بھی مہلت دیئے جائیں گے.

t.149: And most surely(other) messengers before youwere ridiculed, but those who mocked were surrounded by what they used to ridicule.
t.84: In fact, messengers have been mocked at prior to you. So those who laughed at them were besieged by what they used to ridicule.
t.85: Messengers before you [Muhammad] were also ridiculed, but those who mocked them were overwhelmed in the end by the very thing they had mocked.
t.95: Other Messengers before you were also mocked, but those who scoffed at the Messengers were overtaken by the same scourge that they had scoffed at.
t.19: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.
t.22: Mocked were (many) messenger before thee; But their scoffers were hemmed in by the thing that they mocked.
t.203: Indeed, (many) Messengers were mocked before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), but the scoffers were surrounded by that, whereat they used to mock.
t.54: اور تجھ سے پہلے رسولوں کے ساتھ بھی ہنسی مذاق کیا گیا پس ہنسی کرنے والوں کو ہی اس چیز نے گھیر لیا جس کی وه ہنسی اڑاتے تھے.

t.149: Say, “Who guards you by night and day from the All-Merciful?” But they disregard the reminder of their Lord.
t.84: Say, “Who will guard you, during night and day, against the RaHmān (All-Merciful, Allah)?” Rather, to the remembrance of their Lord they are averse.
t.85: Say, ‘Who could protect you night and day from the Lord of Mercy?’ Yet they turn away when their Lord is mentioned.
t.95: Tell them, (O Muhammad): "Who protects you, during the night or the day from the Most Compassionate Lord?" And yet they turn away from the Admonition of their Lord.
t.19: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!
t.22: Say: "Who can keep you safe by night and by day from (the Wrath of) (Allah) Most Gracious?" Yet they turn away from the mention of their Lord.
t.203: Say: "Who can guard and protect you in the night or in the day from the (punishment of the) Most Gracious (Allâh)?" Nay, but they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord.
t.54: ان سے پوچھئے کہ رحمٰن سے، دن اور رات تمہاری حفاﻇت کون کر سکتا ہے؟ بات یہ ہے کہ یہ لوگ اپنے رب کے ذکر سے پھرے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: Or do they have gods that can defend them against Us? They cannot support themselves, nor will they find anyone to side with them against Us.
t.84: Or do they have gods who protect them besides Us? They are not able to help even themselves, nor will they have anyone to side with them against Us.
t.85: Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? Their gods have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
t.95: Do they have any gods who would protect them against Us? They have no power even to help themselves; nor do they enjoy Our support.
t.19: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us.
t.22: Or have they gods that can guard them from Us? They have no power to aid themselves, nor can they be defended from Us.
t.203: Or have they âlihah (gods) who can guard them from Us? They have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us (i.e. from Our Torment).
t.54: کیا ہمارے سوا ان کے اور معبود ہیں جو انہیں مصیبتوں سے بچا لیں۔ کوئی بھی خود اپنی مدد کی طاقت نہیں رکھتا اور نہ کوئی ہماری طرف سے رفاقت دیا جاتا ہے.

t.149: Rather, We gave these people and their forefathers enjoyments until time grew long upon them. Do they not see how We gradually reduce the land from its extremities? Are they then the overcomers?
t.84: But We have given benefits to these and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. So do they not see that We are coming to the land narrowing it down from all its sides? Then, are they the ones to prevail?
t.85: We have allowed these sinners and their forefathers to enjoy life for a long time. But do they not see how We are shrinking their borders? Is it they who will prevail?
t.95: Nay, We generously provided them and their fathers, and they enjoyed Our provision for long. Do they not see that We are now advancing into their territory, diminishing it from different sides? Is it they, then, who will triumph?"
t.19: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors?
t.22: Nay, We gave the good things of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them; See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will win?
t.203: Nay, We gave the luxuries of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them. See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will overcome?
t.54: بلکہ ہم نے انہیں اور ان کے باپ دادوں کو زندگی کے سروسامان دیے یہاں تک کہ ان کی مدت عمر گزر گئی۔ کیا وه نہیں دیکھتے کہ ہم زمین کو اس کے کناروں سے گھٹاتے چلے آرہے ہیں، اب کیا وہی غالب ہیں؟

t.149: Say, “Indeed, I am only warning youthrough revelation.” But the deafcannot hear the call when they are being warned.
t.84: Say, “I warn you only by revelation, but the deaf do not listen to the call when they are warned.”
t.85: Say, ‘I warn you only through the Revelation.’ The deaf will not hear the warning call,
t.95: Tell them: "I only warn you by the Revelation." But the deaf do not hear the cry when they are warned.
t.19: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned.
t.22: Say, "I do but warn you according to revelation": But the deaf will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned!
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I warn you only by the revelation (from Allâh and not by the opinion of the religious scholars and others). But the deaf (who follow the religious scholars and others blindly) will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned [i.e. one should follow only the Qur’ân and the Sunnah (legal ways, orders, acts of worship, and the statements of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, as the companions of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم did)].
t.54: کہہ دیجئے! میں تو تمہیں اللہ کی وحی کے ذریعہ آگاه کر رہا ہوں مگر بہرے لوگ بات نہیں سنتے جبکہ انہیں آگاه کیا جائے.

t.149: And if a whiff of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they say, “Woe to us, We have truly been unjust.”
t.84: If a whiff of your Lord’s torment were to touch them, they would certainly say, “Alas to us! We were wrongdoers indeed.”
t.85: yet if a mere breath of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they will be sure to cry, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
t.95: Were only the slightest whiff from your Lord's punishment to touch them, they would cry out: "Woe to us; we were indeed wrong-doers."
t.19: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.
t.22: If but a breath of the Wrath of thy Lord do touch them, they will then say, "Woe to us! we did wrong indeed!"
t.203: And if a breath (minor calamity) of the Torment of your Lord touches them, they will surely cry: "Woe unto us! Indeed we have been Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."
t.54: اگر انہیں تیرے رب کے کسی عذاب کا جھونکا بھی لگ جائے تو پکار اٹھیں کہ ہائے ہماری بدبختی! یقیناً ہم گنہگار تھے.

t.149: And We set up the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection so that not a single self suffers the least injustice, and even if it be the weight of a mustard seed, We bring it forth. For sufficient are We as reckoners.
t.84: We shall place scales to do justice on the Day of Judgment. So no one shall be wronged in the least. Even if it (a deed) is to the measure of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth, and We are enough to take account.
t.85: We will set up scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection so that no one can be wronged in the least, and if there should be even the weight of a mustard seed, We shall bring it out- We take excellent account.
t.95: We shall set up just scales on the Day of Resurrection so that none will be wronged in the least. (We shall bring forth the acts of everyone), even if it be the weight of a grain of mustard seed. We shall suffice as Reckoners.
t.19: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.
t.22: We shall set up scales of justice for the Day of Judgment, so that not a soul will be dealt with unjustly in the least, and if there be (no more than) the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it (to account): and enough are We to take account.
t.203: And We shall set up balances of justice on the Day of Resurrection, then none will be dealt with unjustly in anything. And if there be the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it. And Sufficient are We to take account.
t.54: قیامت کے دن ہم درمیان میں ﻻ رکھیں گے ٹھیک ٹھیک تولنے والی ترازو کو۔ پھر کسی پر کچھ بھی ﻇلم نہ کیا جائے گا۔ اور اگر ایک رائی کے دانے کے برابر بھی عمل ہوگا ہم اسے ﻻ حاضر کریں گے، اور ہم کافی ہیں حساب کرنے والے.

t.149: And very truly, We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion and illumination and a reminder for the ones who were mindful(of God) :
t.84: And We gave Mūsā and Hārūn the Criterion, and a light and an advice for the God-fearing,
t.85: We gave Moses and Aaron [the Scripture] that distinguishes right from wrong, a light and a reminder for those who are mindful of God,
t.95: Surely We had granted to Moses and Aaron the Criterion (between right and wrong), and Light and Admonition for the good of the God-fearing,
t.19: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,
t.22: In the past We granted to Moses and Aaron the criterion (for judgment), and a Light and a Message for those who would do right,-
t.203: And indeed We granted to Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron) the criterion (of right and wrong), and a shining light [i.e. the Taurât (Torah)] and a Reminder for Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).
t.54: یہ بالکل سچ ہے کہ ہم نے موسیٰ وہارون کو فیصلے کرنے والی نورانی اور پرہیزگاروں کے لئے وعﻆ ونصیحت والی کتاب عطا فرمائی.

t.149: those who fear their Lord, though Unseen, and are apprehensive of theHour.
t.84: - those who have awe of their Lord without having seen Him, and are fearful of the Hour (of Judgment).
t.85: those who stand in awe of their Lord, though He is unseen, and who fear the Hour.
t.95: for those who fear their Lord without seeing Him and dread the Hour (of Reckoning).
t.19: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom).
t.22: Those who fear their Lord in their most secret thoughts, and who hold the Hour (of Judgment) in awe.
t.203: Those who fear their Lord without seeing Him, and they are afraid of the Hour.
t.54: وه لوگ جو اپنے رب سے بن دیکھے خوف کھاتے ہیں اور قیامت (کے تصور) سے کانپتے رہتے ہیں.

t.149: And this(too) is a blessed Reminder that We have sent down. Are yougoing to reject it?
t.84: And this is a blessed advice We have sent down. Are you still rejecting it?
t.85: This [Quran] too is a blessed message We have sent down- are you [people] going to deny it?
t.95: This is a Blessed Admonition that We have revealed. Are you, then, going to reject it?
t.19: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?
t.22: And this is a blessed Message which We have sent down: will ye then reject it?
t.203: And this is a blessed Reminder (the Qur’ân) which We have sent down: will you then (dare to) deny it?
t.54: اور یہ نصیحت وبرکت واﻻ قرآن بھی ہم ہی نے نازل فرمایا ہے کیا پھر بھی تم اس کے منکر ہو.

t.149: And most surely, We brought Abraham his prudence before, and We well knew of him
t.84: Even earlier We had given Ibrāhīm his right course, and We knew him well
t.85: Long ago We bestowed right judgement on Abraham and We knew him well.
t.95: Surely We had bestowed wisdom upon Abraham even earlier, and We knew him well.
t.19: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,
t.22: We bestowed aforetime on Abraham his rectitude of conduct, and well were We acquainted with him.
t.203: And indeed We bestowed aforetime on Ibrâhîm (Abraham) his (portion of) guidance, and We were Well-Acquainted with him (as to his Belief in the Oneness of Allâh).
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے اس سے پہلے ابراہیم کو اس کی سمجھ بوجھ بخشی تھی اور ہم اس کے احوال سے بخوبی واقف تھے.

t.149: when he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are devoted?”
t.84: when he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues you are devoted to?”
t.85: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are these images to which you are so devoted?’
t.95: Recall, when he said to his father and his people: "What are these images to which you are devoutly clinging?"
t.19: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?
t.22: Behold! he said to his father and his people, "What are these images, to which ye are (so assiduously) devoted?"
t.203: When he said to his father and his people: "What are these images, to which you are devoted?"
t.54: جبکہ اس نے اپنے باپ سے اور اپنی قوم سے کہا کہ یہ مورتیاں جن کے تم مجاور بنے بیٹھے ہو کیا ہیں؟

t.149: They said, “We found our forefathers worshiping them.”
t.84: They said, “We found our fathers worshipping them,”
t.85: They replied, ‘We found our fathers worshipping them.’
t.95: They answered: "We found our fathers worshipping them."
t.19: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them.
t.22: They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them."
t.203: They said: "We found our fathers worshipping them."
t.54: سب نے جواب دیا کہ ہم نے اپنے باپ دادا کو انہی کی عبادت کرتے ہوئے پایا.

t.149: He said, “Youand your forefathers have been in evident misguidance.”
t.84: He said, “Surely you and your fathers have been in open error.”
t.85: He said, ‘You and your fathers have clearly gone astray.’
t.95: He said: "Certainly you and your fathers have all been in manifest error."
t.19: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.
t.22: He said, "Indeed ye have been in manifest error - ye and your fathers."
t.203: He said: "Indeed, you and your fathers have been in manifest error."
t.54: آپ نے فرمایا! پھر تو تم اور تمہارے باپ دادا سبھی یقیناً کھلی گمراہی میں مبتلا رہے.

t.149: They said, “Have you come to us with the truth, or are you one of the jesters?”
t.84: They said, “Did you come to us with truth or are you one of the triflers?”
t.85: They asked, ‘Have you brought us the truth or are you just playing about?’
t.95: They said: "Are you expressing your true ideas before us or are you jesting?"
t.19: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester?
t.22: They said, "Have you brought us the Truth, or are you one of those who jest?"
t.203: They said: "Have you brought us the truth, or are you one of those who play about?"
t.54: کہنے لگے کیا آپ ہمارے پاس سچ مچ حق ﻻئے ہیں یا یوں ہی مذاق کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: He said, “Rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the One who originated them, and to that, I am one of those who bear witness.
t.84: He said, “No, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who has created them, and I am one of those who bear witness to it.
t.85: He said, ‘Listen! Your true Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He who created them, and I am a witness to this.
t.95: He said: "Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth which He created and to that I bear witness before you.
t.19: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.
t.22: He said, "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He Who created them (from nothing): and I am a witness to this (Truth).
t.203: He said: "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them and to that I am one of the witnesses.
t.54: آپ نے فرمایا نہیں درحقیقت تم سب کا پروردگار تو وه ہے جو آسمانوں اور زمین کا مالک ہے جس نے انہیں پیدا کیا ہے، میں تو اسی بات کا گواه اور قائل ہوں.

t.149: And by Allah, I shall certainly plot against your human-shaped idols after you have turned away, fleeing.”
t.84: And I swear by Allah that I will devise something against your idols after you have gone away turning your backs.”
t.85: By God I shall certainly plot against your idols as soon as you have turned your backs!’
t.95: By Allah, I shall certainly carry out my plan against your gods after you are gone."
t.19: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.
t.22: "And by Allah, I have a plan for your idols - after ye go away and turn your backs"..
t.203: "And by Allâh, I shall plot a plan (to destroy) your idols after you have gone away and turned your backs."
t.54: اور اللہ کی قسم! میں تمہارے ان معبودوں کے ساتھ جب تم علیحده پیٹھ پھیر کر چل دو گے ایک چال چلوں گا.

t.149: So he reduced them into pieces, except for their biggest, that they may return to it.
t.84: Then, he turned all of them into pieces, except the big one of them, so that they may come back to it.
t.85: He broke them all into pieces, but left the biggest one for them to return to.
t.95: Then he broke them all into pieces, sparing only the supreme one among them that they may possibly return to him.
t.19: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it.
t.22: So he broke them to pieces, (all) but the biggest of them, that they might turn (and address themselves) to it.
t.203: So he broke them to pieces, (all) except the biggest of them, that they might turn to it.
t.54: پس اس نے ان سب کے ٹکڑے ٹکڑے کر دیئے ہاں صرف بڑے بت کو چھوڑ دیا یہ بھی اس لئے کہ وه سب اس کی طرف ہی لوٹیں.

t.149: They said, “Who did this to our gods? Indeed, he is certainly one of the unjust.”
t.84: They said, “Who has done this to our gods? He is one of the wrongdoers indeed.”
t.85: They said, ‘Who has done this to our gods? How wicked he must be!’
t.95: (When they saw the idols in this state) they said: "Who has done this to our gods? Surely he is one of the wrong-doers."
t.19: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer.
t.22: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? He must indeed be some man of impiety!"
t.203: They said: "Who has done this to our âlihah (gods)? He must indeed be one of the Zâlimun (wrong-doers)."
t.54: کہنے لگے کہ ہمارے خداؤں کے ساتھ یہ کس نے کیا؟ ایسا شخص تو یقیناً ﻇالموں میں سے ہے.

t.149: They said, “We heard a young man mentioning them; he is called Abraham.”
t.84: Some of them said, “We have heard a youth talking about them. He is called Ibrāhīm.”
t.85: Some said, ‘We heard a youth called Abraham talking about them.’
t.95: Some of them said: "We heard a youth called Abraham speak (ill) of them."
t.19: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham.
t.22: They said, "We heard a youth talk of them: He is called Abraham."
t.203: They said: "We heard a young man talking against them, who is called Ibrâhîm (Abraham)."
t.54: بولے ہم نے ایک نوجوان کو ان کا تذکره کرتے ہوئے سنا تھا جسے ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) کہا جاتا ہے.

t.149: They said, “So bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may witness.”
t.84: They said, “Then, bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may see”.
t.85: They said, ‘Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial].’
t.95: The others said: "Bring him, then, before the eyes of the people that they may see (what will be done to him)."
t.19: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify.
t.22: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may bear witness."
t.203: They said: "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may testify."
t.54: سب نے کہا اچھا اسے مجمع میں لوگوں کی نگاہوں کے سامنے ﻻؤ تاکہ سب دیکھیں.

t.149: They said, “Are you the one who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”
t.84: They said, “Is it you O Ibrāhīm who has done this to our gods?”
t.85: They asked, ‘Was it you, Abraham, who did this to our gods?’
t.95: (On Abraham's arrival) they said: "Abraham, are you he who has done this to our gods?"
t.19: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?
t.22: They said, "Art thou the one that did this with our gods, O Abraham?"
t.203: They said: "Are you the one who has done this to our gods, O Ibrâhîm (Abraham)?"
t.54: کہنے لگے! اے ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) کیا تو نے ہی ہمارے خداؤں کے ساتھ یہ حرکت کی ہے.

t.149: He said, “Rather, it was this biggest of them that did it, so ask them, if they can talk.”
t.84: He said, “Rather, this is done by this chief of theirs. So, ask them if they can speak.”
t.85: He said, ‘No, it was done by the biggest of them- this one. Ask them, if they can talk.’
t.95: He answered: "Rather it was this supreme one who has done it. So ask them, if they can speak."
t.19: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.
t.22: He said: "Nay, this was done by - this is their biggest one! ask them, if they can speak intelligently!"
t.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Nay, this one, the biggest of them (idols) did it. Ask them, if they can speak!"
t.54: آپ نے جواب دیا بلکہ اس کام کو ان کے بڑے نے کیا ہے تم اپنے خداؤں سے ہی پوچھ لو اگر یہ بولتے چالتے ہوں.

t.149: So they turned to one another and said, “Indeed, you yourselves are the unjust.”
t.84: So they turned to one another and said, “In fact, you yourselves are the wrongdoers.”
t.85: They turned to one another, saying, ‘It is you who are in the wrong,’
t.95: Thereupon they turned to their (inner) selves and said (to themselves): "Surely it is you who are the wrong-doers."
t.19: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers.
t.22: So they turned to themselves and said, "Surely ye are the ones in the wrong!"
t.203: So they turned to themselves and said: "Verily, you are the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."
t.54: پس یہ لوگ اپنے دلوں میں قائل ہوگئے اور کہنے لگے واقعی ﻇالم تو تم ہی ہو.

t.149: But they reverted to their old ideas: “Youcertainly know well that these do not talk.”
