t.84: Then, hanging their heads they reversed their position (and replied to Ibrāhīm,) “You already knew that they do not speak.”
t.85: but then they lapsed again and said, ‘You know very well these gods cannot speak.’
t.95: Then their minds were turned upside down, and they said: "You know well that they do not speak."
t.19: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.
t.22: Then were they confounded with shame: (they said), "Thou knowest full well that these (idols) do not speak!"
t.203: Then they turned to themselves (their first thought and said): "Indeed you [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] know well that these (idols) speak not!"
t.54: پھر اپنے سروں کے بل اوندھے ہوگئے (اور کہنے لگے کہ) یہ تو تجھے بھی معلوم ہے کہ یہ بولنے چالنے والے نہیں.

t.149: He said, “Do you worship, apart from Allah, what can neither benefit you in anything nor harm you?
t.84: He said, “Do you then worship, beside Allah, what does neither benefit you in the least nor harm you?
t.85: Abraham said, ‘How can you worship what can neither benefit nor harm you, instead of God?
t.95: Abraham said: "Do you, then, worship beside Allah a thing that can neither benefit you nor hurt you?
t.19: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you?
t.22: (Abraham) said, "Do ye then worship, besides Allah, things that can neither be of any good to you nor do you harm?
t.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Do you then worship besides Allâh, things that can neither profit you, nor harm you?
t.54: اللہ کے خلیل نے اسی وقت فرمایا افسوس! کیا تم اللہ کے علاوه ان کی عبادت کرتے ہو جو نہ تمہیں کچھ بھی نفع پہنچا سکیں نہ نقصان.

t.149: Fie on you and on what you worship apart from Allah. Do you not reason?”
t.84: Fie upon you and upon what you worship other than Allah. Do you then not understand?”
t.85: Shame on you and on the things you worship instead of God. Have you no sense?’
t.95: Fie upon you and upon all that you worship beside Allah. Do you have no sense?"
t.19: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?
t.22: "Fie upon you, and upon the things that ye worship besides Allah! Have ye no sense?"..
t.203: "Fie upon you, and upon that which you worship besides Allâh! Have you then no sense?"
t.54: تف ہے تم پر اور ان پر جن کی تم اللہ کے سوا عبادت کرتے ہو۔ کیا تمہیں اتنی سی عقل بھی نہیں؟

t.149: They said, “Burn him and support your gods, if you are going to act.”
t.84: They said, “(O people) burn him and help your gods, if you are to take action.”
t.85: They said, ‘Burn him and avenge your gods, if you are going to do the right thing.’
t.95: They said: "Burn him, and come to the support of your gods, if you are going to do anything."
t.19: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing.
t.22: They said, "Burn him and protect your gods, If ye do (anything at all)!"
t.203: They said: "Burn him and help your âlihah (gods), if you will be doing."
t.54: کہنے لگے کہ اسے جلا دو اور اپنے خداؤں کی مدد کرو اگر تمہیں کچھ کرنا ہی ہے.

t.149: We said, “O fire, be cool and peaceful upon Abraham.”
t.84: We said, “O fire, be cold and safe for Ibrāhīm.”
t.85: But We said, ‘Fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.’
t.95: We said: "O fire, become coolness and safety for Abraham."
t.19: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,
t.22: We said, "O Fire! be thou cool, and (a means of) safety for Abraham!"
t.203: We (Allâh) said: "O fire! Be you coolness and safety for Ibrâhîm (Abraham)!"
t.54: ہم نے فرما دیا اے آگ! تو ٹھنڈی پڑ جا اور ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) کے لئے سلامتی (اور آرام کی چیز) بن جا!

t.149: For they wanted to plot against him, so We made them the biggest losers.
t.84: And they intended to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.
t.85: They planned to harm him, but We made them suffer the greatest loss.
t.95: They had sought to do evil to him, but We caused them to be the worst losers,
t.19: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.
t.22: Then they sought a stratagem against him: but We made them the ones that lost most!
t.203: And they wanted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.
t.54: گو انہوں نے ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) کا برا چاہا، لیکن ہم نے انہیں ناکام بنا دیا.

t.149: And We delivered him and Lot to the land that We blessed for all(people of all) realms.
t.84: And We rescued him and LūT towards the land we blessed for all the worlds.
t.85: We saved him and Lot [and sent them] to the land We blessed for all people,
t.95: and We saved him and Lot and brought him to the land upon which We had bestowed Our blessings for all the people of the world.
t.19: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.
t.22: But We delivered him and (his nephew) Lut (and directed them) to the land which We have blessed for the nations.
t.203: And We rescued him and Lût (Lot) to the land which We have blessed for the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn).
t.54: اور ہم ابراہیم اور لوط کو بچاکر اس زمین کی طرف لے چلے جس میں ہم نے تمام جہان والوں کے لئے برکت رکھی تھی.

t.149: And We granted him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, and each We made righteous.
t.84: And We blessed him with IsHāq and Ya‘qūb as gift, and each one of them We made righteous.
t.85: and We gave him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, and made each of them righteous.
t.95: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, making each of them righteous.
t.19: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous.
t.22: And We bestowed on him Isaac and, as an additional gift, (a grandson), Jacob, and We made righteous men of every one (of them).
t.203: And We bestowed upon him Ishâq (Isaac), and (a grandson) Ya‘qûb (Jacob). Each one We made righteous.
t.54: اور ہم نے اسےاسحاق عطا فرمایااور یعقوب اس پر مزید۔ اور ہرایک کو ہم نے صالح بنایا.

t.149: And We made them leaders, guiding by Our command, and We revealed to them(the command of) performing good works and establishing the prayer and bringingthe purifying charity, for of Us they were worshipers.
t.84: And We made them the Imams who guided (people) under Our command, and We inspired them to do good deeds and to establish Salāh and pay Zakāh, and Us alone they worshipped.
t.85: We made all of them leaders, guiding others by Our command, and We inspired them to do good works, to keep up the prayer, and to give alms: they were Our true worshippers.
t.95: And We made them into leaders to guide people in accordance with Our command, and We inspired them to good works, and to establish Prayers and to give Zakah. They worshipped Us alone.
t.19: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone).
t.22: And We made them leaders, guiding (men) by Our Command, and We sent them inspiration to do good deeds, to establish regular prayers, and to practise regular charity; and they constantly served Us (and Us only).
t.203: And We made them leaders, guiding (mankind) by Our Command, and We revealed to them the doing of good deeds, performing Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât), and the giving of Zakât and of Us (Alone) they were the worshippers.
t.54: اور ہم نے انہیں پیشوا بنا دیا کہ ہمارے حکم سے لوگوں کی رہبری کریں اور ہم نے ان کی طرف نیک کاموں کے کرنے اور نمازوں کے قائم رکھنے اور زکوٰة دینے کی وحی (تلقین) کی، اور وه سب کے سب ہمارے عبادت گزار بندے تھے.

t.149: And Lot—We gave him wise judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the town that used to practice nasty things. They were indeed a wicked, defiantly disobedient people.
t.84: As for LūT, We gave him wisdom and knowledge, and We delivered him from the town that used to do dirty deeds. Indeed, they were the people of evil, the sinners.
t.85: We gave Lot sound judgement and knowledge and saved him from the community who practised obscenities- they were shameless people who broke God’s law!
t.95: We bestowed upon Lot sound judgement and knowledge, and We delivered him from the city that was immersed in foul deeds. They were indeed a wicked people, exceedingly disobedient.
t.19: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd.
t.22: And to Lut, too, We gave Judgment and Knowledge, and We saved him from the town which practised abominations: truly they were a people given to Evil, a rebellious people.
t.203: And (remember) Lût (Lot), We gave him Hukm (right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) and (religious) knowledge, and We saved him from the town (folk) who practised Al-Khabâ’ith (evil, wicked and filthy deeds). Verily, they were a people given to evil, and were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).
t.54: ہم نے لوط (علیہ السلام) کو بھی حکم اور علم دیا اور اسے اسی بستی سے نجات دی جہاں کے لوگ گندے کاموں میں مبتلا تھے۔ اور تھے بھی بدترین گنہگار.

t.149: And We entered him into Our mercy; He isindeed one of the righteous.
t.84: And We admitted him to Our mercy. Indeed, He was of the righteous.
t.85: We admitted him to Our mercy; he was a righteous man.
t.95: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Verily he was of the righteous.
t.19: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous.
t.22: And We admitted him to Our Mercy: for he was one of the Righteous.
t.203: And We admitted him to Our Mercy; truly, he was of the righteous.
t.54: اور ہم نے لوط (علیہ السلام) کو اپنی رحمت میں داخل کر لیا بے شک وه نیکو کار لوگوں میں سے تھا.

t.149: And Noah, when he called before, so We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great calamity.
t.84: And (remember) NūH, when he called (for help) earlier, so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the terrible agony,
t.85: Long before that, We answered Noah when he cried out to Us: We saved him and his family from the great calamity
t.95: We bestowed the same favour upon Noah. Recall, when he cried to Us before; We accepted his prayer and delivered him and his household from the great distress
t.19: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.
t.22: (Remember) Noah, when he cried (to Us) aforetime: We listened to his (prayer) and delivered him and his family from great distress.
t.203: And (remember) Nûh (Noah), when he cried (to Us) aforetime. We answered his invocation and saved him and his family from the great distress.
t.54: نوح کے اس وقت کو یاد کیجئے جبکہ اس نے اس سے پہلے دعا کی ہم نے اس کی دعا قبول فرمائی اور اسے اور اس کے گھر والوں کو بڑے کرب سے نجات دی.

t.149: And We supported him against the people who disbelieved Our signs; indeed, they were a wicked people, so We drowned them all.
t.84: and helped him against the people who gave the lie to Our verses. Indeed, they were the people of evil, therefore, We drowned them all.
t.85: and We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs- they were evil people, so We drowned them all.
t.95: and We helped him against a people who rejected Our signs as false. They were indeed an evil people and so We drowned them all.
t.19: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.
t.22: We helped him against people who rejected Our Signs: truly they were a people given to Evil: so We drowned them (in the Flood) all together.
t.203: We helped him against the people who denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.). Verily, they were a people given to evil. So We drowned them all.
t.54: اور جو لوگ ہماری آیتوں کو جھٹلا رہے تھے ان کے مقابلے میں ہم نے اس کی مدد کی، یقیناً وه برے لوگ تھے پس ہم نےان سب کو ڈبو دیا.

t.149: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the case of the field, when some people’s sheep wandered therein by night. And to their judgment We were witnesses.
t.84: And (remember) Dawūd (David) and Sulaimān (Solomon), when they were adjudicating about the tillage in which the goats of other people wandered at night (and trampled it), and We were witness to their judgment.
t.85: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgement regarding the field into which sheep strayed by night and grazed. We witnessed their judgement
t.95: We bestowed the same favour upon David and Solomon. Recall, when they gave judgement regarding a tillage into which the sheep of some people had strayed at night, and We were witnesses to their judgement.
t.19: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.
t.22: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the matter of the field into which the sheep of certain people had strayed by night: We did witness their judgment.
t.203: And (remember) Dâwûd (David) and Sulaimân (Solomon), when they gave judgement in the case of the field in which the sheep of certain people had pastured at night; and We were witness to their judgement.
t.54: اور داؤد اور سلیمان (علیہما السلام) کو یاد کیجئے جبکہ وه کھیت کے معاملہ میں فیصلہ کر رہے تھے کہ کچھ لوگوں کی بکریاں رات کو اس میں چر چگ گئی تھیں، اور ان کے فیصلے میں ہم موجود تھے.

t.149: Yet We made Solomon understand it, and to each We gave wise judgment and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to give(God) due exaltation along with David, and the birds as well—surely We did.
t.84: So, We enabled Sulaimān to understand it. And to each one of them We gave wisdom and knowledge. And with Dawūd We subjugated the mountains that pronounced tasbīH (Allah’s purity), and the birds as well. And We were the One who did (it).
t.85: and made Solomon understand the case [better], though We gave sound judgement and knowledge to both of them. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate Our praises with David- We did all these things-
t.95: We guided Solomon to the right verdict, and We had granted each of them judgement and knowledge. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate the praise of Allah with David. It was We Who did all this.
t.19: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof).
t.22: To Solomon We inspired the (right) understanding of the matter: to each (of them) We gave Judgment and Knowledge; it was Our power that made the hills and the birds celebrate Our praises, with David: it was We Who did (all these things).
t.203: And We made Sulaimân (Solomon) to understand (the case); and to each of them We gave Hukm (right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains and the birds to glorify Our Praises along with Dâwûd (David). And it was We Who were the doer (of all these things).
t.54: ہم نے اس کا صحیح فیصلہ سلیمان کو سمجھا دیا۔ ہاں ہر ایک کو ہم نے حکم وعلم دے رکھا تھا اور داؤد کے تابع ہم نے پہاڑ کر دیئے تھے جو تسبیح کرتے تھے اور پرند بھی۔ ہم کرنے والے ہی تھے.

t.149: And We taught him the making of shields for you, so that they may secure youfrom your violence, so are you then appreciative?
t.84: We taught him the skill of making armor as dress for you to protect you from what may harm you (in combat). So are you grateful?
t.85: We taught him how to make coats of mail for the benefit of you [people], to protect you in your wars, but are you grateful for this?
t.95: It was We Who taught him the art of making coats of mail for your benefit so that it may protect you from each other's violence. Do you, then, give thanks?
t.19: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful?
t.22: It was We Who taught him the making of coats of mail for your benefit, to guard you from each other's violence: will ye then be grateful?
t.203: And We taught him the making of metal coats of mail (for battles), to protect you in your fighting. Are you then grateful?
t.54: اور ہم نے اسے تمہارے لئے لباس بنانے کی کاریگری سکھائی تاکہ لڑائی کے ضرر سے تمہارا بچاؤ ہو۔ کیا تم شکر گزار بنو گے؟

t.149: And to Solomon the stormy wind , blowing at his command towards the land that We had blessed. And We well knew of everything.
t.84: And for Sulaimān, (We subjugated) the violent wind that blew under his command to the land in which We placed Our blessings. And We were the One who knew everything.
t.85: We harnessed the stormy wind for Solomon, so that it sped by his command to the land We had blessed- We have knowledge of all things-
t.95: And We subdued the strongly raging wind to Solomon which blew at his bidding towards the land We blessed. We know everything.
t.19: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware.
t.22: (It was Our power that made) the violent (unruly) wind flow (tamely) for Solomon, to his order, to the land which We had blessed: for We do know all things.
t.203: And to Sulaimân (Solomon) (We subjected) the wind strongly raging, running by his command towards the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are the All-Knower.
t.54: ہم نے تند وتیز ہوا کو سلیمان (علیہ السلام) کے تابع کر دیا جو اس کے فرمان کے مطابق اس زمین کی طرف چلتی تھی جہاں ہم نے برکت دے رکھی تھی، اور ہم ہر چیز سے باخبر اور دانا ہیں.

t.149: And of the devils were some that would dive for him and perform other, lesser tasks, but We were preserving of them.
t.84: And from the devils, (We subjugated for him) those who dived in water for him and did jobs other than that. And We were the One who kept watch over them.
t.85: and We made some of the jinn subservient to him, to dive for him and do other works besides. We were watching over them.
t.95: And We subdued many devils who dived (into the sea) for him and carried out other jobs besides that. We kept watch over all of them.
t.19: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them.
t.22: And of the evil ones, were some who dived for him, and did other work besides; and it was We Who guarded them.
t.203: And of the Shayâtîn (devils from the jinn) were some who dived for him, and did other work besides that; and it was We Who guarded them.
t.54: اسی طرح سے بہت سے شیاطین بھی ہم نے اس کے تابع کیے تھے جو اس کے فرمان سے غوطے لگاتے تھے اور اس کے سوا بھی بہت سے کام کرتے تھے، ان کے نگہبان ہم ہی تھے.

t.149: And Job, when he called upon his Lord: “Great harm has touched me, yet You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”
t.84: And (remember) Ayyūb (Job), when he called his Lord saying, “Here I am, afflicted by pain and You are the most merciful of all the merciful.”
t.85: Remember Job, when he cried to his Lord, ‘Suffering has truly afflicted me, but you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.’
t.95: We bestowed (the same wisdom, judgement and knowledge) upon Job. Recall, when he cried to his Lord: "Behold, disease has struck me and You are the Most Merciful of those that are merciful."
t.19: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
t.22: And (remember) Job, when He cried to his Lord, "Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful."
t.203: And (remember) Ayyûb (Job), when he cried to his Lord: "Verily, distress has seized me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy."
t.54: ایوب (علیہ السلام) کی اس حالت کو یاد کرو جبکہ اس نے اپنے پروردگار کو پکارا کہ مجھے یہ بیماری لگ گئی ہے اور تو رحم کرنے والوں سے زیاده رحم کرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: So We responded to him and lifted the harm which had afflicted him, and We brought him his family and their like with them—a mercy from Us, and a reminding for the worshipers.
t.84: So, We answered his prayer and removed whatever pain he had, and gave him (back) his family and the like thereof along with them, as a mercy from Our own Self and as a lesson for the worshippers.
t.85: We answered him, removed his suffering, and restored his family to him, along with more like them, as an act of grace from Us and a reminder for all who serve Us.
t.95: We accepted his prayer and removed the affliction from him, and We not only restored to him his family but as many more with them as a mercy from Us and as a lesson to the worshippers.
t.19: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers;
t.22: So We listened to him: We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his people to him, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who serve Us.
t.203: So We answered his call, and We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his family to him (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them as a mercy from Ourselves and a Reminder for all those who worship Us.
t.54: تو ہم نے اس کی سن لی اور جو دکھ انہیں تھا اسے دور کر دیا اور اس کو اہل وعیال عطا فرمائے بلکہ ان کے ساتھ ویسے ہی اور اپنی خاص مہربانی سے تاکہ سچے بندوں کے لئے سبب نصیحت ہو.

t.149: And Ishmael and Enoch and Ezekiel; each isone of the steadfast.
t.84: And (remember) Ismā‘īl and Idrīs and Dhul-Kifl. Each one of them was of those who observed patience.
t.85: And remember Ishmael, Idris, and Dhu’l-Kifl: they were all steadfast.
t.95: And (We bestowed the same favour) upon Ishmael, Idris and Dhu al-Kifl, for they were all steadfast.
t.19: And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast.
t.22: And (remember) Isma'il, Idris, and Zul-kifl, all (men) of constancy and patience;
t.203: And (remember) Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael), and Idrîs (Enoch) and Dhul-Kifl (Isaiah): all were from among As-Sâbirûn (the patient).
t.54: اور اسماعیل اور ادریس اور ذوالکفل، (علیہم السلام) یہ سب صابر لوگ تھے.

t.149: And We entered them into Our mercy; indeed, they areof the righteous.
t.84: And We admitted them to Our mercy. Surely, they were of the righteous.
t.85: We admitted them to Our mercy; they were truly righteous.
t.95: And We admitted them into Our mercy, for they were of the righteous.
t.19: And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous.
t.22: We admitted them to Our mercy: for they were of the righteous ones.
t.203: And We admitted them to Our Mercy. Verily, they were of the righteous.
t.54: ہم نے انہیں اپنی رحمت میں داخل کر لیا۔ یہ سب لوگ نیک تھے.

t.149: And Jonah, when he went off angrily and he thought that We would not restrain him . But then He cried out in the darkness(es) , “There is no god but You! Highly Exalted are You! Indeed, I have been one of the unjust!”
t.84: And (remember) Dhunnūn (the man of the fish, namely Yūnus X), when he walked away in anger and thought that We would never put him to trouble. Then, he called (Us) in depths of darkness saying, “There is no god but You. Pure are You. Indeed I was among the wrongdoers”.
t.85: And remember the man with the whale,when he went off angrily, thinking We could not restrict him, but then he cried out in the deep darkness, ‘There is no God but You, glory be to You, I was wrong.’
t.95: And We bestowed Our favour upon Dhu al-Nun. Recall, when he went forth enraged, thinking We have no power to take him to task. Eventually he cried out in the darkness:" There is no god but You. Glory be to You! I have done wrong."
t.19: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.
t.22: And remember Zun-nun, when he departed in wrath: He imagined that We had no power over him! But he cried through the deptHs of darkness, "There is no god but thou: glory to thee: I was indeed wrong!"
t.203: And (remember) Dhun-Nûn (Jonah), when he went off in anger, and imagined that We shall not punish him (i.e. the calamities which had befallen him)! But he cried through the darkness (saying): Lâ ilâha illâ Anta [none has the right to be worshipped but You (O, Allâh)], Glorified (and Exalted) be You [above all that (evil) they associate with You]! Truly, I have been of the wrong-doers."
t.54: مچھلی والے (حضرت یونس علیہ السلام) کو یاد کرو! جبکہ وه غصہ سے چل دیا اور خیال کیا کہ ہم اسے نہ پکڑ سکیں گے۔ بالﺂخر وه اندھیروں کے اندر سے پکار اٹھا کہ الٰہی تیرے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں تو پاک ہے، بیشک میں ﻇالموں میں ہو گیا.

t.149: So We responded to him and delivered him from stress, for thus We save the believers .
t.84: So We responded to him and rescued him from the distress. And this is how We rescue the believers.
t.85: We answered him and saved him from distress: this is how We save the faithful.
t.95: Thereupon We accepted his prayer, and rescued him from grief. Thus do We rescue the believers.
t.19: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.
t.22: So We listened to him: and delivered him from distress: and thus do We deliver those who have faith.
t.203: So We answered his call, and delivered him from the distress. And thus We do deliver the believers (who believe in the Oneness of Allâh, abstain from evil and work righteousness).
t.54: تو ہم نے اس کی پکار سن لی اور اسے غم سے نجات دے دی اور ہم ایمان والوں کو اسی طرح بچا لیا کرتے ہیں.

t.149: And Zechariah, when he called out to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me solitary, while You are the best of inheritors.”
t.84: And (remember) Zakariyyā when he called his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me alone and You are the best of inheritors.”
t.85: Remember Zachariah, when he cried to his Lord, ‘My Lord, do not leave me childless, though You are the best of heirs.’
t.95: And We bestowed favour upon Zechariah, when he cried to his Lord: "Lord! Leave me not solitary (without any issue). You are the Best Inheritor."
t.19: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors.
t.22: And (remember) Zakariya, when he cried to his Lord: "O my Lord! leave me not without offspring, though thou art the best of inheritors."
t.203: And (remember) Zakariyyâ (Zachariah), when he cried to his Lord: "O My Lord! Leave me not single (childless), though You are the Best of the inheritors."
t.54: اور زکریا (علیہ السلام) کو یاد کرو جب اس نے اپنے رب سے دعا کی کہ اے میرے پروردگار! مجھے تنہا نہ چھوڑ، تو سب سے بہتر وارث ہے.

t.149: So We responded to him and granted him John, and We rehabilitated his spouse for him. Indeed, they used to hasten towards good works and call upon Us wishfully and in awe, for they used to be reverent towards Us.
t.84: So, We responded to him and gave him YaHyā and made his wife good for him. They used to race towards the good deeds and call Us with hope and fear; and they were humble to Us.
t.85: We answered him––We gave him John, and cured his wife of barrenness- they were always keen to do good deeds. They called upon Us out of longing and awe, and humbled themselves before Us.
t.95: So We accepted his prayer and bestowed upon him John, and We made his wife fit (to bear a child). Verily they hastened in doing good works and called upon Us with longing and fear, and humbled themselves to Us.
t.19: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us.
t.22: So We listened to him: and We granted him Yahya: We cured his wife's (Barrenness) for him. These (three) were ever quick in emulation in good works; they used to call on Us with love and reverence, and humble themselves before Us.
t.203: So We answered his call, and We bestowed upon him Yahyâ (John), and cured his wife (to bear a child) for him. Verily, they used to hasten on to do good deeds, and they used to call on Us with hope and fear, and used to humble themselves before Us.
t.54: ہم نے اس کی دعا کو قبول فرما کر اسے یحيٰ (علیہ السلام) عطا فرمایا اور ان کی بیوی کو ان کے لئے درست کر دیا۔ یہ بزرگ لوگ نیک کاموں کی طرف جلدی کرتے تھے اور ہمیں ﻻلچ طمع اور ڈر خوف سے پکارتے تھے۔ اور ہمارے سامنے عاجزی کرنے والے تھے.

t.149: And she who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her of Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign to(all people of) all realms.
t.84: And (remember) her who protected her private part (that is, Maryam). So, We blew in her (a life) through Our Spirit, and made her and her son (‘Īsā X) a sign for all the worlds.
t.85: Remember the one who guarded her chastity. We breathed into her from Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign for all people.
t.95: And also recall the woman who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit, and made her and her son a Sign to the whole world.
t.19: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.
t.22: And (remember) her who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit, and We made her and her son a sign for all peoples.
t.203: And she who guarded her chastity [Virgin Maryam (Mary)]: We breathed into (the sleeves of) her (shirt or garment) [through Our Rûh - Jibrîl (Gabriel)], and We made her and her son [‘Îsâ (Jesus)] a sign for Al-‘Âlamîn (the mankind and jinn).
t.54: اور وه پاک دامن بی بی جس نے اپنی عصمت کی حفاﻇت کی ہم نے اس کے اندر روح سے پھونک دی اور خود انہیں اور ان کے لڑکے کو تمام جہان کے لئے نشانی بنا دیا.

t.149: Indeed, this community of yoursis one community and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
t.84: Surely, this is the fraternity of your Faith, a single Faith, and I am your Lord; so worship Me.
t.85: [Messengers], this community of yours is one single community and I am your Lord, so serve Me.
t.95: Verily this community of yours is a single community, and I am your Lord; so worship Me.
t.19: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
t.22: Verily, this brotherhood of yours is a single brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore serve Me (and no other).
t.203: Truly! This, your Ummah [Shari‘ah or religion (Islâmic Monotheism)] is one religion, and I am your Lord, therefore worship Me (Alone). [Tafsîr Ibn Kathîr]
t.54: یہ تمہاری امت ہے جو حقیقت میں ایک ہی امت ہے، اور میں تم سب کا پروردگار ہوں پس تم میری ہی عبادت کرو.

t.149: But they tore themselves into sects; they are all returning to Us.
t.84: But they have separated their ways from one another. All of them have to return to Us.
t.85: They have torn their unity apart, but they will all return to Us.
t.95: But they tore asunder their faith into many parts. But to Us they are bound to return.
t.19: And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us.
t.22: But (later generations) cut off their affair (of unity), one from another: (yet) will they all return to Us.
t.203: But they have broken up and differed as regards their religion among themselves. (And) they all shall return to Us.
t.54: مگر لوگوں نےآپس میں اپنے دین میں فرقہ بندیاں کر لیں، سب کے سب ہماری ہی طرف لوٹنے والے ہیں.

t.149: So whoever does righteous deeds and is a believer—his endeavor will never be denied. And indeed, We are writing it down for him.
t.84: So, whoever does righteous deeds, while he is a believer, his effort will not be rejected, and We are to put it on record.
t.85: If anyone does good deeds and is a believer, his efforts will not be ignored: We record them for him.
t.95: Then whosoever does righteous works, while believing, his striving will not go unappreciated. We record them all for him.
t.19: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him.
t.22: Whoever works any act of righteousness and has faith,- His endeavour will not be rejected: We shall record it in his favour.
t.203: So whoever does righteous good deeds while he is a believer (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism), his efforts will not be rejected. Verily We record it for him (in his Book of deeds).
t.54: پھر جو بھی نیک عمل کرے اور وه مومن (بھی) ہو تو اس کی کوشش کی بے قدری نہیں کی جائے گی۔ ہم تو اس کے لکھنے والے ہیں.

t.149: And there is a ban on any town that We have annihilated—that they do not return,
t.84: It is banned for (the people of) a town that We destroyed that they come back
t.85: No community destroyed by Us can escape its return,
t.95: It has been ordained against every town that We ever destroyed that they shall not return (to enjoy a new lease of life)
t.19: And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return.
t.22: But there is a ban on any population which We have destroyed: that they shall not return,
t.203: And a ban is laid on every town (population) which We have destroyed that they shall not return (to this world again, nor repent to Us).
t.54: اور جس بستی کو ہم نے ہلاک کر دیا اس پر ﻻزم ہے کہ وہاں کے لوگ پلٹ کر نہیں آئیں گے.

t.149: until, when Gog and Magog are opened , and they swarm down from every mound,
t.84: until when the Ya’jūj and Ma’jūj (Gog and Magog) are released, while they run down from every height,
t.85: and when the peoples of Gog and Magog are let loose and swarm swiftly from every highland,
t.95: until Gog and Magog are let loose, and begin swooping from every mound,
t.19: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound,
t.22: Until the Gog and Magog (people) are let through (their barrier), and they swiftly swarm from every hill.
t.203: Until, when Ya’jûj and Ma’jûj (Gog and Magog) are let loose (from their barrier), and they swoop down from every mound.
t.54: یہاں تک کہ یاجوج اور ماجوج کھول دیئے جائیں گے اور وه ہر بلندی سے دوڑتے ہوئے آئیں گے.

t.149: and the true promise has drawn near— then, the sight(s) of those who denied glaze over: “Woe to us. We have been oblivious to this. Rather, we were unjust.”
t.84: and the True Promise draws near, then it will so happen that the eyes of the disbelievers shall remain upraised (in terror, and they will say,) “Alas to us! We were in negligence about this; rather we were transgressors.”
t.85: when the True Promise draws near, the disbelievers’ eyes will stare in terror, and they will say, ‘Woe to us! We were not aware of this at all. We were wrong.’
t.95: and the time for the fulfilment of the true promise of Allah draws near, whereupon the eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in fear, and they will say: "Woe to us, we were indeed heedless of this; nay, we were wrongdoers."
t.19: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers!
t.22: Then will the true promise draw nigh (of fulfilment): then behold! the eyes of the Unbelievers will fixedly stare in horror: "Ah! Woe to us! we were indeed heedless of this; nay, we truly did wrong!"
t.203: And the true promise (Day of Resurrection) shall draw near (of fulfillment). Then (when mankind is resurrected from their graves), you shall see the eyes of the disbelievers fixedly staring in horror. (They will say): "Woe to us! We were indeed heedless of this - nay, but we were Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."
t.54: اور سچا وعده قریب آلگے گا اس وقت کافروں کی نگاہیں پھٹی کی پھٹی ره جائیں گی، کہ ہائے افسوس! ہم اس حال سے غافل تھے بلکہ فی الواقع ہم قصور وار تھے.

t.149: Youand what you worship apart from Allah are indeed fuel for Hell. You are bound to approach it.
t.84: Surely, you and whatever you worship other than Allah are the fuel of Jahannam.. There you will have to arrive.
t.85: You [disbelievers] and what you worship instead of God will be fuel for Hell: that is where you will go-
t.95: (They will be told): "Verily you and the gods you worshipped beside Allah are the fuel of Hell. All of you are bound to arrive there.
t.19: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come.
t.22: Verily ye, (unbelievers), and the (false) gods that ye worship besides Allah, are (but) fuel for Hell! to it will ye (surely) come!
t.203: Certainly you (disbelievers) and that which you are worshipping now besides Allâh, are (but) fuel for Hell! (Surely), you will enter it.
t.54: تم اور اللہ کے سوا جن جن کی تم عبادت کرتے ہو، سب دوزخ کا ایندھن بنو گے، تم سب دوزخ میں جانے والے ہو.

t.149: Had these been gods, they would not have approached it. And all will abide in it.
t.84: Had they been gods, they would not have arrived at it, and all of them will remain there forever.
t.85: if these [idols] had been real gods they would not have gone there- you will all stay there.
t.95: Had these indeed been gods they would not have gone there. But (as it is), all of you shall ever abide in it."
t.19: If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein.
t.22: If these had been gods, they would not have got there! but each one will abide therein.
t.203: Had these (idols) been âlihah (gods), they would not have entered there (Hell), and all of them will abide therein.
t.54: اگر یہ (سچے) معبود ہوتے تو جہنم میں داخل نہ ہوتے، اور سب کے سب اسی میں ہمیشہ رہنے والے ہیں.

t.149: In it they wail, and in it they do not hear.
t.84: For them, there will be screams in it and they will not hear.
t.85: There the disbelievers will be groaning piteously, but the [idols] will hear nothing.
t.95: There they shall groan with anguish and the din and noise in Hell will not let them hear anything.
t.19: Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not.
t.22: There, sobbing will be their lot, nor will they there hear (aught else).
t.203: Therein they will be breathing out with deep sighs and roaring and therein they will hear not.
t.54: وه وہاں چلا رہے ہوں گے اور وہاں کچھ بھی نہ سن سکیں گے.

t.149: Indeed, those who deserved goodness from Us—those are kept away from it.
t.84: As for those for whom the good (news) from Us has come earlier, they will be kept far away from it.
t.85: But those for whom We have decreed Paradise will be kept far from Hell-
t.95: But for those whom We had decided to favour with good reward, they shall be kept far removed from Hell.
t.19: Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence.
t.22: Those for whom the good (record) from Us has gone before, will be removed far therefrom.
t.203: Verily, those for whom the good has preceded from Us, they will be removed far therefrom (Hell) [e.g. ‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary); ‘Uzair (Ezra)].
t.54: البتہ بے شک جن کے لئے ہماری طرف سے نیکی پہلے ہی ٹھہر چکی ہے۔ وه سب جہنم سے دور ہی رکھے جائیں گے.

t.149: They do not hear its hissing, and in what their hearts have desired they abide.
t.84: They will not hear the slightest of its sound, and they will remain forever in what their souls desire.
t.85: they will not hear a murmur from it- and endlessly they will enjoy everything their souls desire.
t.95: They shall not hear even a whisper of it, and they shall live for ever in the delights which they had desired.
t.19: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire.
t.22: Not the slightest sound will they hear of Hell: what their souls desired, in that will they dwell.
t.203: They shall not hear the slightest sound of it (Hell), while they abide in that which their ownselves desire.
t.54: وه تو دوزخ کی آہٹ تک نہ سنیں گے اور اپنی من بھاتی چیزوں میں ہمیشہ رہنے والے ہوں گے.

t.149: The most supreme fear does not worry them, for the angels receive them: “This is yourday which you were promised.”
t.84: They shall not be grieved by the Biggest Panic, and the angels shall receive them (saying), “This is your day that you had been promised”
t.85: They will have no fear of the great Terror: the angels will receive them with the words, ‘This is the Day you were promised!’
t.95: The Hour of the Great Terror shall not grieve them, and the angels shall receive them saying: "This is your Day which you had been promised."
t.19: The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised;
t.22: The Great Terror will bring them no grief: but the angels will meet them (with mutual greetings): "This is your Day,- (the Day) that ye were promised."
t.203: The greatest terror (on the Day of Resurrection) will not grieve them, and the angels will meet them, (with the greeting): "This is your Day which you were promised."
t.54: وه بڑی گھبراہٹ (بھی) انہیں غمگین نہ کر سکے گی اور فرشتے انہیں ہاتھوں ہاتھ لیں گے، کہ یہی تمہارا وه دن ہے جس کا تم وعده دیئے جاتے رہے.

t.149: On the day when We fold the heaven as the scribe rolls up scriptures . Just as We began the first creation, We restore it—a promise from Us. We will indeed act.
t.84: - the Day when We roll up the sky like a scroll rolls up the writings. Just as We originated the first creation, so We shall bring it back again - a promise (undertaken to be binding) on Us. We are sure to do it.
t.85: On that Day, We shall roll up the skies as a writer rolls up [his] scrolls. We shall reproduce creation just as We produced it the first time: this is Our binding promise. We shall certainly do all these things.
t.95: On that Day We shall roll up the heavens like a scroll for writing. Even as We originated the creation first so We shall repeat it. This is a promise binding on Us; and so We shall do.
t.19: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it.
t.22: The Day that We roll up the heavens like a scroll rolled up for books (completed),- even as We produced the first creation, so shall We produce a new one: a promise We have undertaken: truly shall We fulfil it.
t.203: And (remember) the Day when We shall roll up the heaven like a scroll rolled up for books. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise binding upon Us. Truly, We shall do it.
t.54: جس دن ہم آسمان کو یوں لپیٹ لیں گے جیسے طومار میں اوراق لپیٹ دیئے جاتے ہیں، جیسے کہ ہم نے اول دفعہ پیدائش کی تھی اسی طرح دوباره کریں گے۔ یہ ہمارے ذمے وعده ہے اور ہم اسے ضرور کر کے (ہی) رہیں گے.

t.149: And most surely We have written in the Book, after the Reminder, that the land will be inherited by My righteous servants.
t.84: And We have written in Zabūr (Psalms) after the advice that the land will be inherited by My righteous slaves.
t.85: We wrote in the Psalms, as We did in [earlier] Scripture: ‘My righteous servants will inherit the earth.’
t.95: Surely We wrote in the Psalms, after the exhortation, that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous servants.
t.19: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth:
t.22: Before this We wrote in the Psalms, after the Message (given to Moses): My servants the righteous, shall inherit the earth."
t.203: And indeed We have written in Az-Zabûr [i.e. all the revealed Holy Books - the Taurât (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel), the Psalms, the Qur’ân,] after (We have already written in) Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz (the Book that is in the heaven with Allâh), that My righteous slaves shall inherit the land (i.e. the land of Paradise).
t.54: ہم زبور میں پند ونصیحت کے بعد یہ لکھ چکے ہیں کہ زمین کے وارث میرے نیک بندے (ہی) ہوں گے.

t.149: Indeed, in this is a proclamation for people who are worshipers(of Allah) .
t.84: Surely, in this (Qur’ān) there is a message conveyed to a people who worship (Allah).
t.85: There truly is a message in this for the servants of God!
t.95: Herein, surely, is a message for those devoted to worship.
t.19: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout.
t.22: Verily in this (Qur'an) is a Message for people who would (truly) worship Allah.
t.203: Verily, in this (the Qur’ân) there is a plain Message for people who worship Allâh (i.e. the true, real believers of Islâmic Monotheism who act practically on the Qur’ân and the Sunnah - legal ways of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم).
t.54: عبادت گزار بندوں کے لئے تو اس میں ایک بڑا پیغام ہے.

t.149: For We have not sent you but as a mercy to all realms.
t.84: And We have not sent you but as mercy for all the worlds.
t.85: It was only as a mercy that We sent you [Prophet] to all people.
t.95: We have sent you forth as nothing but mercy to people of the whole world.
t.19: We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples.
t.22: We sent thee not, but as a Mercy for all creatures.
t.203: And We have sent you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): not but as a mercy for the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: اور ہم نے آپ کو تمام جہان والوں کے لئے رحمت بنا کر ہی بھیجا ہے.

t.149: Say, “It is revealed to me that yourGod is but One God, so are you going to submit?”
t.84: Say, “What is revealed to me is simply that your God is One God. So do you submit?”
t.85: Say, ‘What is revealed to me is that your God is one God- will you submit to Him?’
t.95: Say: "It is revealed to me that your God is only One God. Will you, then, submit to Him?"
t.19: Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)?
t.22: Say: "What has come to me by inspiration is that your Allah is One Allah: will ye therefore bow to His Will (in Islam)?"
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "It is revealed to me that your Ilâh (God) is only one Ilâh (God - Allâh). Will you then submit to His Will (become Muslims and stop worshipping others besides Allâh)?"
t.54: کہہ دیجئے! میرے پاس تو پس وحی کی جاتی ہے کہ تم سب کا معبود ایک ہی ہے، تو کیا تم بھی اس کی فرمانبرداری کرنے والے ہو؟

t.149: But if they turn away, say, “I have informed you sufficiently, although I do not know whether what youare promised is near or far.
t.84: But, if they turn away, then say (to them), “I have warned you all alike, and I do not know whether what you have been warned of is near or far.
t.85: But if they turn away, say, ‘I have proclaimed the message fairly to you all. I do not know whether the judgement you are promised is near or far,
t.95: If they turn away, say to them: "I have warned you all alike; and I cannot say whether what you have been promised is near or distant.
t.19: But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised.
t.22: But if they turn back, Say: "I have proclaimed the Message to you all alike and in truth; but I know not whether that which ye are promised is near or far.
t.203: But if they (disbelievers, idolaters, Jews, Christians, polytheists) turn away (from Islâmic Monotheism) say (to them O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I give you a notice (of war as) to be known to us all alike. And I know not whether that which you are promised (i.e. the torment or the Day of Resurrection) is near or far."
t.54: پھر اگر یہ منھ موڑ لیں تو کہہ دیجئے کہ میں نے تمہیں یکساں طور پر خبردار کر دیا ہے۔ مجھے علم نہیں کہ جس کا وعده تم سے کیا جا رہا ہے وه قریب ہے یا دور.

t.149: Indeed, He knows whatever is said aloud of speech, and He knows whatever youconceal.
t.84: Surely, He knows what is spoken openly and He knows what you conceal.
t.85: but He knows what you reveal and conceal.
t.95: Indeed He knows what you say loudly and what you hide.
t.19: Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal.
t.22: "It is He Who knows what is open in speech and what ye hide (in your hearts).
t.203: (Say O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): Verily, He (Allâh) knows that which is spoken aloud (openly) and that which you conceal.
t.54: البتہ اللہ تعالیٰ تو کھلی اور ﻇاہر بات کو بھی جانتا ہے اور جو تم چھپاتے ہو اسے بھی جانتا ہے.

t.149: And I do not know whether it is perhaps a means of trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.”
t.84: And I do not know; perhaps it is a trial for you and an enjoyment for a while.”
t.85: I do not know: this [time] may well be a test for you, and enjoyment for a while.’
t.95: I think that this [reprieve] is possibly a trial for you, an opportunity to enjoy yourselves until an appointed time."
t.19: And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while.
t.22: "I know not but that it may be a trial for you, and a grant of (worldly) livelihood (to you) for a time."
t.203: And I know not, perhaps it may be a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.
t.54: مجھے اس کا بھی علم نہیں، ممکن ہے یہ تمہاری آزمائش ہو اور ایک مقرره وقت تک کا فائده (پہنچانا) ہے.

t.149: He said , “My Lord, judge with justice.” “For our Lord is the All-Merciful, Whose help is sought against what you allege.”
t.84: He (Our Messenger) said, “My Lord, judge with truth. And Our Lord is the RaHmān (All-Merciful), the One whose help is sought against what you describe.
t.85: He said,‘My Lord, pass the true judgement.’ And, ‘Our Lord is the Lord of Mercy. We seek His assistance against what you [disbelievers] say.’
t.95: The Messenger said: "My Lord! Judge with truth. Our Compassionate Lord alone is our support against your (blasphemous) utterances."
t.19: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
t.22: Say: "O my Lord! judge Thou in truth!" "Our Lord Most Gracious is the One Whose assistance should be sought against the blasphemies ye utter!"
t.203: He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: "My Lord! Judge You in truth! Our Lord is the Most Gracious, Whose Help is to be sought against that which you attribute (unto Allâh that He has offspring, and unto Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم that he is a sorcerer, and unto the Qur’ân that it is poetry)!"
t.54: خود نبی نے کہا اے رب! انصاف کے ساتھ فیصلہ فرما اور ہمارا رب بڑا مہربان ہے جس سے مدد طلب کی جاتی ہے ان باتوں پر جو تم بیان کرتے ہو.

t.149: O mankind, be mindful of your Lord. Indeed, the quaking of the Hour is something great.
t.84: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed the quake of the (destined) Hour is something terrible.
t.85: People, be mindful of your Lord, for the earthquake of the Last Hour will be a mighty thing:
t.95: O mankind, fear the (wrath of) your Lord! Indeed, the earthquake of the Hour (of Judgement) will be an awesome thing.
t.19: O mankind! Fear your Lord. Lo! the earthquake of the Hour (of Doom) is a tremendous thing.
t.22: O mankind! fear your Lord! for the convulsion of the Hour (of Judgment) will be a thing terrible!
t.203: O mankind! Fear your Lord and be dutiful to Him! Verily, the earthquake of the Hour (of Judgement) is a terrible thing.
t.54: لوگو! اپنے پروردگار سے ڈرو! بلاشبہ قیامت کا زلزلہ بہت ہی بڑی چیز ہے.

t.149: On the day when yousee it: every nursing female discards whatever she has nursed, and every pregnant female aborts her pregnancy, and yousee mankind drunk, even though they are not drunk—but the punishment of Allah is severe.
t.84: The day you will see it, every suckling female will forget that which she suckles, and every female having pregnancy shall abort her fetus, and you will see people as if they are drunk, while they are not drunk, but Allah’s torment is (so) severe.
t.85: on the Day you see it, every nursing mother will think no more of her baby, every pregnant female will miscarry, you will think people are drunk when they are not, so severe will be God’s torment.
t.95: On the Day when you witness it, the suckling woman shall utterly neglect the infant she suckles, and every pregnant woman shall cast her burden, and you will see people as though they are drunk, when they are not drunk; but dreadful shall be Allah's chastisement.
t.19: On the day when ye behold it, every nursing mother will forget her nursling and every pregnant one will be delivered of her burden, and thou (Muhammad) wilt see mankind as drunken, yet they will not be drunken, but the Doom of Allah will be strong (upon them).
t.22: The Day ye shall see it, every mother giving suck shall forget her suckling-babe, and every pregnant female shall drop her load (unformed): thou shalt see mankind as in a drunken riot, yet not drunk: but dreadful will be the Wrath of Allah.
t.203: The Day you shall see it, every nursing mother will forget her nursling, and every pregnant one will drop her load, and you shall see mankind as in a drunken state, yet they will not be drunken, but severe will be the Torment of Allâh.
t.54: جس دن تم اسے دیکھ لو گے ہر دودھ پلانے والی اپنے دودھ پیتے بچے کو بھول جائے گی اور تمام حمل والیوں کے حمل گر جائیں گے اور تو دیکھے گا کہ لوگ مدہوش دکھائی دیں گے، حاﻻنکہ درحقیقت وه متوالے نہ ہوں گے لیکن اللہ کا عذاب بڑا ہی سخت ہے.

t.149: And of mankind is one who argues about Allah without knowledge and follows every defiant Satan.
t.84: Among the people there is one who debates about Allah without knowledge, and follows every rebellious Satan,
t.85: Yet still there are some who, with no knowledge, argue about God, who follow every devilish rebel
t.95: Among people there are some who wrangle about Allah without knowledge and follow every rebellious devil,
t.19: Among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge, and followeth each froward devil;
t.22: And yet among men there are such as dispute about Allah, without knowledge, and follow every evil one obstinate in rebellion!
t.203: And among mankind is he who disputes concerning Allâh, without knowledge, and follows every rebellious (disobedient to Allâh) Shaitân (devil) (devoid of every kind of good).
t.54: بعض لوگ اللہ کے بارے میں باتیں بناتے ہیں اور وه بھی بے علمی کے ساتھ اور ہر سرکش شیطان کی پیروی کرتے ہیں.

t.149: It was destined for him that whoever takes him as a guardian—he surely leads him astray and leads him to the punishment of the Blaze.
t.84: about whom it is destined that if someone takes him for friend, he will misguide him and lead him to the torment of the Fire.
t.85: fated to lead astray those who take his side, and guide them to the suffering of the blazing flame.
t.95: although it is decreed about him that he shall lead into error whosoever takes him for a friend, and will direct him to the torment of the Fire.
t.19: For him it is decreed that whoso taketh him for friend, he verily will mislead him and will guide him to the punishment of the Flame.
t.22: About the (Evil One) it is decreed that whoever turns to him for friendship, him will he lead astray, and he will guide him to the Penalty of the Fire.
t.203: For him (the devil) it is decreed that whosoever follows him, he will mislead him, and will drive him to the torment of the Fire. [Tafsir At-Tabarî]
t.54: جس پر (قضائے الٰہی) لکھ دی گئی ہے کہ جو کوئی اس کی رفاقت کرے گا وه اسے گمراه کر دے گا اور اسے آگ کے عذاب کی طرف لے جائے گا.

t.149: O mankind, if you are in doubt about the Resurrection—We have indeed created you from dust, then from a drop of semen, then from a clinging form, then from a lump of flesh,(partly) differentiated and(partly) undifferentiated, in order to clarify things for you. And We settle in the wombs whatever We will for a stated term, and then We bring youout as infants until you attain your full strength. And of you is one who is taken(at death) , and of you is one who is returned to the most abject age, so that he may not know anything after having known. And yousee the land still, but when We send down water on it, it shakes and swells and germinates all kinds of lovely plant.
t.84: O mankind, if you are in doubt about Resurrection, then (recall that) We created you from dust, then from a drop of semen, then from a clot, then from a piece of flesh, either shaped or unshaped, so that We manifest (Our power) to you.We retain in the wombs whatever We will to a specified term. Then We bring you out as babies, then (We nourish you) so that you reach your maturity. And among you there is one who dies, and among you there is one who is carried to the worst part of the age, so that he knows nothing even after having knowledge.And you see the land dry. Then once We send down water on it, it stirs and swells and puts forth every pleasant pair (of vegetation).
t.85: People, [remember,] if you doubt the Resurrection, that We created you from dust, then a drop of fluid, then a clinging form, then a lump of flesh, both shaped and unshaped: We mean to make Our power clear to you. Whatever We choose We cause to remain in the womb for an appointed time, then We bring you forth as infants and then you grow and reach maturity. Some die young and some are left to live on to such an age that they forget all they once knew. You sometimes see the earth lifeless, yet when We send down water it stirs and swells and produces every kind of joyous growth:
t.95: O mankind! If you have any doubt concerning Resurrection, then know that it is surely We Who created you from dust, then from a drop of sperm, then from a clot of blood, then from a little lump of flesh, some of it shapely and other shapeless. (We are rehearsing this) that We may make the reality clear to you. We cause (the drop of sperm) that We please to remain in the wombs till an appointed time. We bring you forth as infants (and nurture you) that you may come of age. Among you is he that dies (at a young age) and he who is kept back to the most abject age so that after once having known, he reaches a stage when he knows nothing. You see the earth dry and barren and then no sooner than We send down water upon it, it begins to quiver and swell and brings forth every kind of beauteous vegetation.
t.19: O mankind! if ye are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then lo! We have created you from dust, then from a drop of seed, then from a clot, then from a little lump of flesh shapely and shapeless, that We may make (it) clear for you. And We cause what We will to remain in the wombs for an appointed time, and afterward We bring you forth as infants, then (give you growth) that ye attain your full strength. And among you there is he who dieth (young), and among you there is he who is brought back to the most abject time of life, so that, after knowledge, he knoweth naught. And thou (Muhammad) seest the earth barren, but when We send down water thereon, it doth thrill and swell and put forth every lovely kind (of growth).
t.22: O mankind! if ye have a doubt about the Resurrection, (consider) that We created you out of dust, then out of sperm, then out of a leech-like clot, then out of a morsel of flesh, partly formed and partly unformed, in order that We may manifest (our power) to you; and We cause whom We will to rest in the wombs for an appointed term, then do We bring you out as babes, then (foster you) that ye may reach your age of full strength; and some of you are called to die, and some are sent back to the feeblest old age, so that they know nothing after having known (much), and (further), thou seest the earth barren and lifeless, but when We pour down rain on it, it is stirred (to life), it swells, and it puts forth every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs).
t.203: O mankind! If you are in doubt about the Resurrection, then verily We have created you (i.e. Adam) from dust, then from a Nutfah (mixed drops of male and female sexual discharge i.e. the offspring of Adam), then from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood) then from a little lump of flesh - some formed and some unformed (as in the case of miscarriage) - that We may make (it) clear to you (i.e. to show you Our Power and Ability to do what We will). And We cause whom We will to remain in the wombs for an appointed term, then We bring you out as infants, then (give you growth) that you may reach your age of full strength. And among you there is he who dies (young), and among you there is he who is brought back to the miserable old age, so that he knows nothing after having known. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down water (rain) on it, it is stirred (to life), and it swells and puts forth every lovely kind (of growth).
t.54: لوگو! اگر تمہیں مرنے کے بعد جی اٹھنے میں شک ہے تو سوچو ہم نے تمہیں مٹی سے پیدا کیا پھر نطفہ سے پھر خون بستہ سے پھر گوشت کے لوتھڑے سے جو صورت دیا گیا تھا اور بے نقشہ تھا۔ یہ ہم تم پر ﻇاہر کر دیتے ہیں، اور ہم جسے چاہیں ایک ٹھہرائے ہوئے وقت تک رحم مادر میں رکھتے ہیں پھر تمہیں بچپن کی حالت میں دنیا میں ﻻتے ہیں پھر تاکہ تم اپنی پوری جوانی کو پہنچو، تم میں سے بعض تو وه ہیں جو فوت کر لئے جاتے ہیں اور بعض بے غرض عمر کی طرف پھر سے لوٹا دیئے جاتے ہیں کہ وه ایک چیز سے باخبر ہونے کے بعد پھر بے خبر ہو جائے۔ تو دیکھتا ہے کہ زمین (بنجر اور) خشک ہے پھر ہم اس پر بارشیں برساتے ہیں تو وه ابھرتی ہے اور پھولتی ہے اور ہر قسم کی رونق دار نباتات اگاتی ہے.

t.149: That is because indeed Allah is the Truth, and because indeed He gives life to the dead, and because indeed He is Powerful over everything.
t.84: That is because Allah is the truth, and that He gives life to the dead, and that He is powerful to do everything,
t.85: this is because God is the Truth; He brings the dead back to life; He has power over everything.
t.95: All this is because Allah, He is the Truth, and because He resurrects the dead, and because He has power over everything,
t.19: That is because Allah, He is the Truth and because He quickeneth the dead, and because He is Able to do all things;
t.22: This is so, because Allah is the Reality: it is He Who gives life to the dead, and it is He Who has power over all things.
t.203: That is because Allâh: He is the Truth, and it is He Who gives life to the dead, and it is He Who is Able to do all things.
t.54: یہ اس لئے کہ اللہ ہی حق ہے اور وہی مردوں کو جِلاتا ہے اور وه ہر چیز پر قدرت رکھنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And because the Hour is indeed coming—there is no doubt about it—and because indeed Allah resurrects those in the graves.
t.84: and that the Hour (of Doom) has to come, in which there is no doubt, and that Allah will raise again all those in the graves.
t.85: There is no doubt that the Last Hour is bound to come, nor that God will raise the dead from their graves,
t.95: (all of which shows that) the Hour shall surely come to pass - in this there is no doubt - and Allah shall surely resurrect those that are in graves.
t.19: And because the Hour will come, there is no doubt thereof; and because Allah will raise those who are in the graves.
t.22: And verily the Hour will come: there can be no doubt about it, or about (the fact) that Allah will raise up all who are in the graves.
t.203: And surely, the Hour is coming, there is no doubt about it; and certainly, Allâh will resurrect those who are in the graves.
t.54: اور یہ کہ قیامت قطعاً آنے والی ہے جس میں کوئی شک وشبہ نہیں اور یقیناً اللہ تعالیٰ قبروں والوں کو دوباره زنده فرمائے گا.

t.149: And of mankind is one who argues about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an illuminating scripture,
t.84: Among men there is one who debates about Allah with no knowledge, no guidance and no enlightening book,
t.85: yet still there are some who, with no knowledge or guidance or any book of enlightenment, argue about God,
t.95: And among people are those that wrangle about Allah without knowledge, without any true guidance, and without any scripture to enlighten them.
t.19: And among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge or guidance or a scripture giving light,
t.22: Yet there is among men such a one as disputes about Allah, without Knowledge, without Guidance, and without a Book of Enlightenment,-
t.203: And among men is he who disputes about Allâh, without knowledge or guidance, or a Book giving light (from Allâh),
t.54: بعض لوگ اللہ کے بارے میں بغیر علم کے اور بغیر ہدایت کے اور بغیر روشن کتاب کے جھگڑتے ہیں.

t.149: turning aside in contempt, to make(others) stray from the way of Allah; for him in the Earlier(Life) is disgrace, and on the Day of Resurrection We make him taste the punishment of burning:
t.84: turning his side away to lead (people) astray from the way of Allah. For him there is disgrace in this world, and We will have him taste the punishment of Fire on the Day of Judgment
t.85: turning scornfully aside to lead others away from God’s path. Disgrace in this world awaits such a person and, on the Day of Resurrection, We shall make him taste the suffering of the Fire.
t.95: They wrangle arrogantly, intent on leading people astray from the Way of Allah. Such shall suffer disgrace in this world and We shall cause them to taste the chastisement of burning (in the Next).
t.19: Turning away in pride to beguile (men) from the way of Allah. For him in this world is ignominy, and on the Day of Resurrection We make him taste the doom of burning.
t.22: (Disdainfully) bending his side, in order to lead (men) astray from the Path of Allah: for him there is disgrace in this life, and on the Day of Judgment We shall make him taste the Penalty of burning (Fire).
t.203: Bending his neck in pride (far astray from the Path of Allâh), and leading (others) too (far) astray from the Path of Allâh. For him there is disgrace in this worldly life, and on the Day of Resurrection We shall make him taste the torment of burning (Fire).
t.54: جو اپنی پہلو موڑنے واﻻ بن کر اس لئے کہ اللہ کی راه سے بہکادے، اسے دنیا میں بھی رسوائی ہوگی اور قیامت کے دن بھی ہم اسے جہنم میں جلنے کا عذاب چکھائیں گے.

t.149: “That is for what yourhandshave put forth, and because Allah is not a tyrant unto the servants.”
t.84: (and will say to him) “All this is due to what your hands sent ahead, and that Allah is not unjust to His servants.”
t.85: [It will be said], ‘This is for what you have stored up with your own hands: God is never unjust to His creatures.’
t.95: That is the outcome of what your own hands have wrought, for Allah never wrongs His creatures.
t.19: (And unto him it will be said): This is for that which thy two hands have sent before, and because Allah is no oppressor of His slaves.
t.22: (It will be said): "This is because of the deeds which thy hands sent forth, for verily Allah is not unjust to His servants.
t.203: That is because of what your hands have sent forth, and verily, Allâh is not unjust to (His) slaves.
t.54: یہ ان اعمال کی وجہ سے جو تیرے ہاتھوں نے آگے بھیج رکھے تھے۔ یقین مانو کہ اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں پر ﻇلم کرنے واﻻ نہیں.

t.149: And of mankind is one who worships Allah on edge, so that if something good befalls him, he is reassured by it; but if a trial befalls him, he turns about-face, losing the Earlier(Life) and the hereafter; that is the evident loss.
t.84: And among men there is one who worships Allah (standing) on the verge: so if some good thing happens to him, he is satisfied with it, and if a trial befalls him, he turns his face back. He loses both this world and the Hereafter. That is the manifest loss.
t.85: There are also some who serve God with unsteady faith: if something good comes their way, they are satisfied, but if they are tested, they revert to their old ways, losing both this world and the next- that is the clearest loss.
t.95: And among people is he who worships Allah on the borderline; if any good befalls him, he is satisfied; but if a trial afflicts him, he utterly turns away. He will incur the loss of this world and the Hereafter. That indeed is a clear loss.
t.19: And among mankind is he who worshippeth Allah upon a narrow marge so that if good befalleth him he is content therewith, but if a trial befalleth him, he falleth away utterly. He loseth both the world and the Hereafter. That is the sheer loss.
t.22: There are among men some who serve Allah, as it were, on the verge: if good befalls them, they are, therewith, well content; but if a trial comes to them, they turn on their faces: they lose both this world and the Hereafter: that is loss for all to see!
t.203: And among mankind is he who worships Allâh as it were, upon the edge (i.e. in doubt): if good befalls him, he is content therewith; but if a trial befalls him, he turns back on his face (i.e. reverts to disbelief after embracing Islâm). He loses both this world and the Hereafter. That is the evident loss.
t.54: بعض لوگ ایسے بھی ہیں کہ ایک کنارے پر (کھڑے) ہو کر اللہ کی عبادت کرتے ہیں۔ اگر کوئی نفع مل گیا تو دلچسپی لینے لگتے ہیں اور اگر کوئی آفت آگئی تو اسی وقت منھ پھیر لیتے ہیں، انہوں نے دونوں جہان کانقصان اٹھا لیا۔ واقعی یہ کھلا نقصان ہے.

t.149: Apart from Allah, he calls upon what can neither harm him nor benefit him; that is the extreme misguidance.
t.84: He prays to someone, instead of Allah, who can neither harm him nor benefit him. That is the error that takes him too far from the right path.
t.85: Instead of God, they call upon what can neither harm nor help them- that is straying far away-
t.95: He invokes, instead of Allah, those who can neither harm nor benefit him. That indeed is straying far away.
t.19: He calleth, beside Allah, unto that which hurteth him not nor benefiteth him. That is the far error.
t.22: They call on such deities, besides Allah, as can neither hurt nor profit them: that is straying far indeed (from the Way)!
t.203: He calls besides Allâh unto that which can neither harm him, nor profit him. That is a straying far away.
t.54: اللہ کے سوا انہیں پکارتے ہیں جو نہ انہیں نقصان پہنچا سکیں نہ نفع۔ یہی تو دور دراز کی گمراہی ہے.

t.149: He calls upon one whose harm is closer than his benefit; truly, what a miserable patron, and truly, what a miserable consort.
t.84: He, rather, prays to someone whose harm is more likely than his benefit. Wretched is such a patron and wretched is such a companion.
t.85: or invoke one whose harm is closer than his help: an evil master and an evil companion.
t.95: He invokes those that are more likely to cause him harm than benefit. Such is surely an evil patron, and an evil associate.
t.19: He calleth unto him whose harm is nearer than his benefit; verily an evil patron and verily an evil friend!
t.22: (Perhaps) they call on one whose hurt is nearer than his profit: evil, indeed, is the patron, and evil the companion (or help)!
t.203: He calls unto him whose harm is nearer than his profit: certainly, an evil Maulâ (patron) and certainly an evil friend!
t.54: اسے پکارتے ہیں جس کا نقصان اس کے نفع سے زیاده قریب ہے، یقیناً برے والی ہیں اور برے ساتھی.

t.149: Indeed, Allah enters those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds into Gardens beneath which rivers flow; indeed, Allah does whatever He wants.
t.84: Surely, Allah will admit those who believe and do good deeds into gardens beneath which rivers flow. Surely Allah does what He intends.
t.85: But God will admit those who believe and do good deeds to Gardens graced with flowing streams. God does whatever He wishes.
t.95: (In contrast) Allah will assuredly cause those who believe and act righteously to enter Gardens beneath which rivers flow. For, most certainly, Allah does whatever He pleases.
t.19: Lo! Allah causeth those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow. Lo! Allah doth what He intendeth.
t.22: Verily Allah will admit those who believe and work righteous deeds, to Gardens, beneath which rivers flow: for Allah carries out all that He plans.
t.203: Truly, Allâh will admit those who believe (in Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds (according to the Qur’ân and the Sunnah) to Gardens underneath which rivers flow (in Paradise). Verily, Allâh does what He wills.
t.54: ایمان اور نیک اعمال والوں کو اللہ تعالیٰ بہتی ہوئی نہروں والی جنتوں میں داخل کرے گا۔ اللہ جو اراده کرے اسے کر کے رہتا ہے.

t.149: Whoever has been thinking that Allah will not support himin the Earlier(Life) and the Hereafter—let him extend a meansto the sky, then cut(it) off, and see whether his plotting eliminates what enrages(him) .
t.84: If someone thinks that Allah will never help him (the prophet) in this world and in the Hereafter, he should stretch a rope to the sky, then cut (Allah’s communication) off (from the prophet) and see whether his effort can really remove what irritates (him).
t.85: Anyone who thinks that God will not support him in this world and the next should stretch a rope up to the sky, climb all the way up it, and see whether this strategy removes the cause of his anger.
t.95: Anyone who fancies that Allah will not support him in this world and in the Hereafter, let him reach out to heaven through a rope, and then make a hole in the sky and see whether his device can avert that which enrages him.
t.19: Whoso is wont to think (through envy) that Allah will not give him (Muhammad) victory in the world and the Hereafter (and is enraged at the thought of his victory), let him stretch a rope up to the roof (of his dwelling), and let him hang himself. Then let him see whether his strategy dispelleth that whereat he rageth!.
t.22: If any think that Allah will not help him (His Messenger) in this world and the Hereafter, let him stretch out a rope to the ceiling and cut (himself) off: then let him see whether his plan will remove that which enrages (him)!
t.203: Whoever thinks that Allâh will not help him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) in this world and in the Hereafter, let him stretch out a rope to the ceiling and let him strangle himself. Then let him see whether his plan will remove that whereat he rages!
t.54: جس کا یہ خیال ہو کہ اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے رسول کی مدد دونوں جہان میں نہ کرے گا وه اونچائی پر ایک رسہ باندھ کر (اپنے حلق میں پھنده ڈال کر اپنا گلا گھونٹ لے) پھر دیکھ لے کہ اس کی چاﻻکیوں سے وه بات ہٹ جاتی ہے جو اسے تڑپا رہی ہے؟

t.149: And thus We sent it down as evident signs, for Allah guides whomever He wants.
t.84: And this is how We have sent it (the Qur’ān) down as clear signs, and the fact is that Allah leads whom He wills to the right path.
t.85: In this way, We send the Quran down as clear messages, and God guides whoever He will.
t.95: Even so We have revealed the Qur'an with Clear Signs. Verily Allah guides whomsoever He wills.
t.19: Thus We reveal it as plain revelations, and verily Allah guideth whom He will.
t.22: Thus have We sent down Clear Signs; and verily Allah doth guide whom He will!
t.203: Thus have We sent it (this Qur’ân) down (to Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) as clear signs, evidence and proofs, and surely, Allâh guides whom He wills.
t.54: ہم نے اسی طرح اس قرآن کو واضح آیتوں میں اتارا ہے جسے اللہ چاہے ہدایت نصیب فرماتا ہے.

t.149: Indeed, those who have attained faith and those who have Judaized, and the Sabiansand the Christians and the Zoroastriansand the Polytheists—indeed, Allah judges between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, Allah is witness to everything.
t.84: As for those who believe and the Jews and the Sabians and the Christians and the Magians and those who ascribe partners to Allah, Allah will judge between them on the Day of Judgment. Surely Allah is witness to every thing.
t.85: As for the believers, those who follow the Jewish faith, the Sabians, the Christians, the Magians, and the idolaters, God will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection; God witnesses all things.
t.95: On the Day of Resurrection Allah will most certainly judge among those who believe, and those who became Jews, and Sabaeans, and Christians, and Magians, and those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely Allah watches over everything.
t.19: Lo! those who believe (this revelation), and those who are Jews, and the Sabaeans and the Christians and the Magians and the idolaters - Lo! Allah will decide between them on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! Allah is Witness over all things.
t.22: Those who believe (in the Qur'an), those who follow the Jewish (scriptures), and the Sabians, Christians, Magians, and Polytheists,- Allah will judge between them on the Day of Judgment: for Allah is witness of all things.
t.203: Verily, those who believe (in Allâh and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), and those who are Jews, and the Sabians, and the Christians, and the Majûs, and those who worship others besides Allâh, truly, Allâh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Verily! Allâh is over all things a Witness.
t.54: بیشک اہل ایمان اور یہودی اور صابی اور نصرانی اور مجوسی اور مشرکین ان سب کے درمیان قیامت کے دن خود اللہ تعالیٰ فیصلے کر دے گا، اللہ تعالیٰ ہر چیز پر گواه ہے.

t.149: Have younot seen that to Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is in the earth, and the sun and the moon and the stars and the mountains and the trees and the treading creatures and many of mankind? But many others deserved the punishment. And whomever Allah shames, there is none to honor him. Indeed, Allah does whatever He wills.
t.84: Have you not seen that to Allah prostrate all those in the skies and all those on the earth, and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the animals and many from mankind? And there are many on whom punishment has become due. And the one whom Allah puts to disgrace, there is none to give him respect. Surely Allah does what He wills.
t.85: Do you not realize [Prophet] that everything in the heavens and earth submits to God: the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, and the animals? So do many human beings, though for many others punishment is well deserved. Anyone disgraced by God will have no one to honour him: God does whatever He will.
t.95: Have you not seen that all those who are in the heavens and all those who are in the earth prostrate themselves before Allah; and so do the sun and the moon, and the stars and the mountains, and the trees, and the beasts, and so do many human beings, and even many of those who are condemned to chastisement? And he whom Allah humiliates, none can give him honour. Allah does whatever He wills.
t.19: Hast thou not seen that unto Allah payeth adoration whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the hills, and the trees, and the beasts, and many of mankind, while there are many unto whom the doom is justly due. He whom Allah scorneth, there is none to give him honour. Lo! Allah doeth what He will.
t.22: Seest thou not that to Allah bow down in worship all things that are in the heavens and on earth,- the sun, the moon, the stars; the hills, the trees, the animals; and a great number among mankind? But a great number are (also) such as are fit for Punishment: and such as Allah shall disgrace,- None can raise to honour: for Allah carries out all that He wills.
t.203: See you not that whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the mountains, and the trees, and Ad-Dawâbb [moving (living) creatures, beasts], and many of mankind prostrate themselves to Allah. But there are many (men) on whom the punishment is justified. And whomsoever Allâh disgraces, none can honour him. Verily, Allâh does what He wills.
t.54: کیا تو نہیں دیکھ رہا کہ اللہ کے سامنے سجده میں ہیں سب آسمانوں والے اور سب زمینوں والے اور سورج اور چاند اور ستارے اور پہاڑ اور درخت اور جانور اور بہت سے انسان بھی۔ ہاں بہت سے وه بھی ہیں جن پر عذاب کا مقولہ ﺛابت ہو چکا ہے، جسے رب ذلیل کردے اسے کوئی عزت دینے واﻻ نہیں، اللہ جو چاہتا ہے کرتا ہے.

t.149: Here are two adversaries who have disputed regarding their Lord, so those who denied—garments of fire were tailoredfor them, with scalding water pouring over their heads,
t.84: These are two opponents who have disputed about their Lord. As for those who disbelieve, garments from fire shall be tailored for them, and boiling water shall be poured from over their heads
t.85: These two kinds of people disagree about their Lord. Garments of fire will be tailored for those who disbelieve; scalding water will be poured over their heads,
t.95: These two groups (the believers and unbelievers) are in dispute about their Lord. As for those that disbelieve, garments of fire have been cut out for them; boiling water shall be poured down over their heads,
