t.22: O men! Here is a parable set forth! listen to it! Those on whom, besides Allah, ye call, cannot create (even) a fly, if they all met together for the purpose! and if the fly should snatch away anything from them, they would have no power to release it from the fly. Feeble are those who petition and those whom they petition!
t.203: O mankind! A similitude has been coined, so listen to it (carefully): Verily those on whom you call besides Allâh, cannot create (even) a fly, even though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly snatches away a thing from them, they will have no power to release it from the fly. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought.
t.54: لوگو! ایک مثال بیان کی جا رہی ہے، ذرا کان لگا کر سن لو! اللہ کے سوا جن جن کو تم پکارتے رہے ہو وه ایک مکھی بھی تو پیدا نہیں کر سکتے، گو سارے کے سارے ہی جمع ہو جائیں، بلکہ اگر مکھی ان سے کوئی چیز لے بھاگے تو یہ تو اسے بھی اس سے چھین نہیں سکتے، بڑا بودا ہے طلب کرنے واﻻ اور بڑا بودا ہے وه جس سے طلب کیا جا رہا ہے.

t.149: They have not respected Allah with the respect due to Him. Indeed, Allah is certainly All-Powerful, Almighty.
t.84: They did not recognize Allah in His true esteem. Indeed Allah is Powerful, Mighty.
t.85: They have no grasp of God’s true measure: God is truly most strong and mighty.
t.95: They have not formed a true estimate of Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, All-Mighty.
t.19: They measure not Allah His rightful measure. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
t.22: No just estimate have they made of Allah: for Allah is He Who is strong and able to Carry out His Will.
t.203: They have not estimated Allâh His Rightful Estimate. Verily, Allâh is All-Strong, All-Mighty.
t.54: انہوں نے اللہ کے مرتبہ کے مطابق اس کی قدر جانی ہی نہیں، اللہ تعالیٰ بڑا ہی زور وقوت واﻻ اور غالب وزبردست ہے.

t.149: Allah elects messengers from among the angels and from among mankind; indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
t.84: Allah chooses messengers from angels and from men. Surely, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
t.85: God chooses messengers from among the angels and from among men. God is all hearing, all seeing:
t.95: Allah chooses Messengers from among angels and from among human beings (to convey His command). Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
t.19: Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer.
t.22: Allah chooses messengers from angels and from men for Allah is He Who hears and sees (all things).
t.203: Allâh chooses Messengers from angels and from men. Verily, Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Seer.
t.54: فرشتوں میں سے اور انسانوں میں سے پیغام پہونچانے والوں کو اللہ ہی چھانٹ لیتا ہے، بیشک اللہ تعالیٰ سننے واﻻ دیکھنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: He knows what is before them and what is behind them. For to Allah all matters are returned .
t.84: He knows what is in front of them and what is behind them, and to Allah all matters are to be returned.
t.85: He knows what lies before and behind them. All matters return to Him.
t.95: He knows all that is before them and that which is hidden from them. And it is to Allah that all affairs are returned.
t.19: He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned. $$A
t.22: He knows what is before them and what is behind them: and to Allah go back all questions (for decision).
t.203: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them. And to Allâh return all matters (for decision).
t.54: وه بخوبی جانتا ہے جو کچھ ان کے آگے ہے اور جو کچھ ان کے پیچھے ہے، اور اللہ ہی کی طرف سب کام لوٹائے جاتے ہیں.

t.149: O you who have attained faith, kneel and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good(deeds), that you may succeed.
t.84: O you who believe, bow down in Rukū‘ and bow down in Sajdah, and worship your Lord and do good deeds, so that you achieve success.
t.85: Believers, bow down, prostrate yourselves, worship your Lord, and do good so that you may succeed.
t.95: Believers, bow down and prostrate yourselves before Your Lord and serve Your Lord and do good that you may prosper.
t.19: O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper.
t.22: O ye who believe! bow down, prostrate yourselves, and adore your Lord; and do good; that ye may prosper.
t.203: O you who have believed! Bow down, and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord and do good that you may be successful.
t.54: اے ایمان والو! رکوع سجده کرتے رہو اور اپنے پروردگار کی عبادت میں لگے رہو اور نیک کام کرتے رہو تاکہ تم کامیاب ہو جاؤ.

t.149: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not imposed upon you any discomfort in religion—the creed of your father Abraham. It is He Who named you Muslims before and in this(Scripture) , so that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over mankind. So establish the prayer and bringthe purifying charityand hold fast to Allah. He is your Patron, so what an excellent Patron and what an excellent Supporter!
t.84: Struggle for (seeking the pleasure of) Allah, a struggle that is owed to Him. He has chosen you and did not impose any hardship on you in the religion, the faith of your father Ibrāhīm. He (Allah) named you as Muslims earlier and also in this (Qur’ān), so that the Messenger becomes a witness to you, and you become witnesses to (other) people. So establish Salāh, pay Zakāh and hold fast to Allah. He is your patron. So, how excellent He is as a patron, and how excellent as a supporter!
t.85: Strive hard for God as is His due: He has chosen you and placed no hardship in your religion, the faith of your forefather Abraham. God has called you Muslims––both in the past and in this [message]––so that the Messenger can bear witness about you and so that you can bear witness about other people. So keep up the prayer, give the prescribed alms, and seek refuge in God: He is your protector––an excellent protector and an excellent helper.
t.95: Strive in the cause of Allah in a manner worthy of that striving. He has chosen you (for His task), and He has not laid upon you any hardship in religion. Keep to the faith of your father Abraham. Allah named you Muslims earlier and even in this (Book), that the Messenger may be a witness over you, and that you may be witnesses over all mankind. So establish Prayer, and pay Zakah, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protector. What an excellent Protector; what an excellent Helper!
t.19: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!
t.22: And strive in His cause as ye ought to strive, (with sincerity and under discipline). He has chosen you, and has imposed no difficulties on you in religion; it is the cult of your father Abraham. It is He Who has named you Muslims, both before and in this (Revelation); that the Messenger may be a witness for you, and ye be witnesses for mankind! So establish regular Prayer, give regular Charity, and hold fast to Allah! He is your Protector - the Best to protect and the Best to help!
t.203: And strive hard in Allâh’s Cause as you ought to strive (with sincerity and with all your efforts that His Name should be superior). He has chosen you (to convey His Message of Islâmic Monotheism to mankind by inviting them to His religion of Islâm), and has not laid upon you in religion any hardship: it is the religion of your father Ibrâhîm (Abraham) (Islâmic Monotheism). It is He (Allâh) Who has named you Muslims both before and in this (the Qur’ân), that the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) may be a witness over you and you be witnesses over mankind! So perform As-Salât (Iqamat-as-Salât), give Zakât and hold fast to Allâh [i.e. have confidence in Allâh, and depend upon Him in all your affairs]. He is your Maulâ (Patron, Lord), what an Excellent Maulâ (Patron, Lord) and what an Excellent Helper!
t.54: اور اللہ کی راه میں ویسا ہی جہاد کرو جیسا جہاد کا حق ہے۔ اسی نے تمہیں برگزیده بنایا ہے اور تم پر دین کے بارے میں کوئی تنگی نہیں ڈالی، دین اپنے باپ ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) کا قائم رکھو، اسی اللہ نے تمہارا نام مسلمان رکھا ہے۔ اس قرآن سے پہلے اور اس میں بھی تاکہ پیغمبر تم پر گواه ہو جائے اور تم تمام لوگوں کے گواه بن جاؤ۔ پس تمہیں چاہئے کہ نمازیں قائم رکھو اور زکوٰة ادا کرتے رہو اور اللہ کو مضبوط تھام لو، وہی تمہارا ولی اور مالک ہے۔ پس کیا ہی اچھا مالک ہے اور کتنا ہی بہتر مددگار ہے.

t.149: Surely the believers have attained success:
t.84: Success is really attained by the believers
t.85: [How] prosperous are the believers!
t.95: The believers have indeed attained true success:
t.19: Successful indeed are the believers
t.22: The believers must (eventually) win through,-
t.203: Successful indeed are the believers.
t.54: یقیناً ایمان والوں نے فلاح حاصل کرلی.

t.149: those who are reverent in their prayers;
t.84: who concentrate their attention in humbleness when offering Salāh (prayers)
t.85: Those who pray humbly,
t.95: those who, in their Prayers, humble themselves;
t.19: Who are humble in their prayers,
t.22: Those who humble themselves in their prayers;
t.203: Those who offer their Salât (prayers) with all solemnity and full submissiveness.
t.54: جو اپنی نماز میں خشوع کرتے ہیں.

t.149: and those who disregard idle talk;
t.84: and who keep themselves away from vain things,
t.85: who shun idle talk,
t.95: who avoid whatever is vain and frivolous;
t.19: And who shun vain conversation,
t.22: Who avoid vain talk;
t.203: And those who turn away from Al-Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk, falsehood, and all that Allâh has forbidden).
t.54: جو لغویات سے منھ موڑ لیتے ہیں.

t.149: and those who are observant of the purifying charity;
t.84: and who are performers of Zakāh ,
t.85: who pay the prescribed alms,
t.95: who observe Zakah;
t.19: And who are payers of the poor-due;
t.22: Who are active in deeds of charity;
t.203: And those who pay the Zakât.
t.54: جو زکوٰة ادا کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: and those who preserve their private parts,
t.84: and who guard their private parts
t.85: who guard their chastity
t.95: who strictly guard their private parts
t.19: And who guard their modesty -
t.22: Who abstain from sex,
t.203: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts, from illegal sexual acts)
t.54: جو اپنی شرمگاہوں کی حفاﻇت کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: except from their spouses or those whom they rightfully possess—for then they are free from blame.
t.84: except from their wives or from those (bondwomen who are) owned by their hands, as they are not to be blamed.
t.85: except with their spouses or their slaves––with these they are not to blame,
t.95: save from their wives, or those whom their right hands possess; for with regard to them they are free from blame "
t.19: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy,
t.22: Except with those joined to them in the marriage bond, or (the captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (in their case) they are free from blame,
t.203: Except from their wives or (the slaves) that their right hands possess, - for then, they are free from blame;
t.54: بجز اپنی بیویوں اور ملکیت کی لونڈیوں کے یقیناً یہ ملامتیوں میں سے نہیں ہیں.

t.149: But whoever seeks anything beyond that—those are the transgressors.
t.84: However, those who seek (sexual pleasure) beyond that are the transgressors
t.85: but anyone who seeks more than this is exceeding the limits––
t.95: As for those who seek beyond that, they are transgressors"
t.19: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors -
t.22: But those whose desires exceed those limits are transgressors;-
t.203: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors;
t.54: جو اس کے سوا کچھ اور چاہیں وہی حد سے تجاوز کرجانے والے ہیں.

t.149: And those who to their trusts and their covenant are faithful,
t.84: - and (success is attained) by those who honestly look after their trusts and covenant,
t.85: who are faithful to their trusts and pledges
t.95: who are true to their trusts and their covenants,
t.19: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,
t.22: Those who faithfully observe their trusts and their covenants;
t.203: Those who are faithfully true to their Amanât (all the duties which Allâh has ordained, honesty, moral responsibility and trusts) and to their covenants;
t.54: جو اپنی امانتوں اور وعدے کی حفاﻇت کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: and those who preserve their prayers —
t.84: and who consistently observe their prayers.
t.85: and who keep up their prayers,
t.95: and who guard their Prayers.
t.19: And who pay heed to their prayers.
t.22: And who (strictly) guard their prayers;-
t.203: And those who strictly guard their (five compulsory congregational) Salawât (prayers) (at their fixed stated hours).
t.54: جو اپنی نمازوں کی نگہبانی کرتے ہیں.

t.149: those are the ones who are the(true) inheritors
t.84: Those are the inheritors
t.85: will rightly be given
t.95: Such are the inheritors
t.19: These are the heirs
t.22: These will be the heirs,
t.203: These are indeed the inheritors
t.54: یہی وارث ہیں.

t.149: who inherit Paradise; therein they abide.
t.84: who will inherit Firdaus (the Paradise). They will be there forever.
t.85: Paradise as their own, there to remain.
t.95: that shall inherit Paradise; and in it they shall abide for ever.
t.19: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.
t.22: Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever).
t.203: Who shall inherit the Firdaus (Paradise). They shall dwell therein forever.
t.54: جو فردوس کے وارث ہوں گے جہاں وه ہمیشہ رہیں گے.

t.149: And most surely, We created man from an extract of clay;
t.84: We have created man from an extract of clay.
t.85: We created man from an essence of clay,
t.95: We created man out of the extract of clay,
t.19: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;
t.22: Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay);
t.203: And indeed We created man (Adam) out of an extract of clay (water and earth).
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے انسان کو مٹی کے جوہر سے پیدا کیا.

t.149: then We made him a sperm-drop, lodged in a secure place;
t.84: Then We made him a sperm-drop in a firm resting place.
t.85: then We placed him as a drop of fluid in a safe place,
t.95: then We made him into a drop of life-germ, then We placed it in a safe depository,
t.19: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging;
t.22: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed;
t.203: Thereafter We made him (the offspring of Adam) as a Nutfah (mixed drops of the male and female sexual discharge and lodged it) in a safe lodging (womb of the woman).
t.54: پھر اسے نطفہ بنا کر محفوظ جگہ میں قرار دے دیا.

t.149: then We developed the sperm-drop into a clinging form, and We developed the clinging form into a morsel-like lump, and We developed the morsel-like lump into bones , and We clothed the boneswith flesh, then We produced him into another creation. So supremely blessed be Allah, the Best of creators.
t.84: Then We turned the sperm-drop into a clot, then We turned the clot into a fetus-lump, then We turned the fetus-lump into bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh; thereafter We developed it into another creature. So, glorious is Allah, the Best of the creators.
t.85: then We made that drop into a clinging form, and We made that form into a lump of flesh, and We made that lump into bones, and We clothed those bones with flesh, and later We made him into other forms––glory be to God, the best of creators!––
t.95: then We made this drop into a clot, then We made the clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We caused it to grow into another creation. Thus Most Blessed is Allah, the Best of all those that create.
t.19: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!
t.22: Then We made the sperm into a clot of congealed blood; then of that clot We made a (foetus) lump; then we made out of that lump bones and clothed the bones with flesh; then we developed out of it another creature. So blessed be Allah, the best to create!
t.203: Then We made the Nutfah into a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood), then We made the clot into a little lump of flesh, then We made out of that little lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We brought it forth as another creation. So Blessed is Allâh, the Best of creators.
t.54: پھر نطفہ کو ہم نے جما ہوا خون بنا دیا، پھر اس خون کے لوتھڑے کو گوشت کا ٹکڑا کردیا۔ پھر گوشت کے ٹکڑے کو ہڈیاں بنا دیں، پھر ہڈیوں کو ہم نے گوشت پہنا دیا، پھر دوسری بناوٹ میں اس کو پیدا کردیا۔ برکتوں واﻻ ہے وه اللہ جو سب سے بہترین پیدا کرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Then after that youare surely bound to die.
t.84: Then, after all this, you are to die.
t.85: then you will die
t.95: Thereafter you are destined to die,
t.19: Then lo! after that ye surely die.
t.22: After that, at length ye will die
t.203: After that, surely, you will die.
t.54: اس کے بعد پھر تم سب یقیناً مر جانے والے ہو.

t.149: Then on the Day of Resurrection youare bound to be raised.
t.84: Then you are to be raised again on the Day of Judgment.
t.85: and then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be raised up again.
t.95: and then on the Day of Resurrection you shall certainly be raised up.
t.19: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).
t.22: Again, on the Day of Judgment, will ye be raised up.
t.203: Then (again), surely, you will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection.
t.54: پھر قیامت کے دن بلا شبہ تم سب اٹھائے جاؤ گے.

t.149: And surely We created above youseven(heavenly) roads, and never have We been oblivious of the creation.
t.84: And We created above you seven paths (heavens), and We were never neglectful of the creation.
t.85: We created seven levels above you: We are never unmindful of Our creation.
t.95: We have indeed fashioned above you seven paths. Never were We unaware of the task of creation.
t.19: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.
t.22: And We have made, above you, seven tracts; and We are never unmindful of (our) Creation.
t.203: And indeed We have created above you seven heavens (one over the other), and We are never unaware of the creation.
t.54: ہم نے تمہارے اوپر سات آسمان بنائے ہیں اور ہم مخلوقات سے غافل نہیں ہیں.

t.149: And We sent down water from the sky in due measure and settled it in the earth, and We are certainly able to take it away.
t.84: And We sent down water from the sky in due measure, then We lodged it in the earth, and of course, We are able to take it away.
t.85: We sent water down from the sky in due measure and lodged it in the earth––We have the power to take it all away if We so wish––
t.95: We sent down water from the sky in right measure, and caused it to stay in the earth, and We have the power to cause it to vanish (in the manner We please).
t.19: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.
t.22: And We send down water from the sky according to (due) measure, and We cause it to soak in the soil; and We certainly are able to drain it off (with ease).
t.203: And We sent down from the sky water (rain) in (due) measure, and We gave it lodging in the earth, and verily, We are Able to take it away.
t.54: ہم ایک صحیح انداز سے آسمان سے پانی برساتے ہیں، پھر اسے زمین میں ٹھہرا دیتے ہیں، اور ہم اس کے لے جانے پر یقیناً قادر ہیں.

t.149: And with it We produced for yougardens of palms and grapevines; in them you have abundant fruits, and of them you eat.
t.84: Then We produced with it gardens of date-palms and vines for your benefit. For you there are many fruits in them, and of them you eat
t.85: with it We produced for you gardens of date palms and vines, with many fruits there for you to eat,
t.95: Then through water We caused gardens of date-palms and vines to grow for you wherein you have an abundance of delicious fruits and from them you derive your livelihood.
t.19: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;
t.22: With it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and vines: in them have ye abundant fruits: and of them ye eat (and have enjoyment),-
t.203: Then We brought forth for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you, and whereof you eat.
t.54: اسی پانی کے ذریعہ سے ہم تمہارے لئے کھجوروں اور انگوروں کے باغات پیدا کردیتے ہیں، کہ تمہارے لئے ان میں بہت سے میوے ہوتے ہیں ان ہی میں سے تم کھاتے بھی ہو.

t.149: And a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, germinating oil and seasoning for the eaters.
t.84: - and (We produced) a tree (of olive) that comes forth from the (mount) Tūr of Sinai, which grows with oil and with a dressing for those who eat.
t.85: and a tree, growing out of Mount Sinai, that produces oil and seasoning for your food.
t.95: And We also produced the tree which springs forth from Mount Sinai, containing oil and sauce for those that eat.
t.19: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.
t.22: Also a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, which produces oil, and relish for those who use it for food.
t.203: And a tree (olive) that springs forth from Mount Sinai, that grows (produces) oil, and (it is a) relish for the eaters.
t.54: اور وه درخت جو طور سینا پہاڑ سے نکلتا ہے جو تیل نکالتا ہے اور کھانے والے کے لئے سالن ہے.

t.149: And there is indeed a lesson for youin livestock: We give you to drinkfrom what is in their bellies, and you have many benefits in them, and from them you eat,
t.84: And indeed there is a sure lesson in the cattle for you. We give you a drink from that which lies in their bellies, and for you there are many benefits in them, and of them you eat,
t.85: There is a lesson for you in livestock: We produce milk for you to drink from their bellies. And they have many other benefits: you eat them
t.95: And indeed there is also a lesson for you in cattle. We provide you with drink out of what they have in their bellies; and you have many other benefits in them: you eat of them,
t.19: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;
t.22: And in cattle (too) ye have an instructive example: from within their bodies We produce (milk) for you to drink; there are, in them, (besides), numerous (other) benefits for you; and of their (meat) ye eat;
t.203: And verily in the cattle there is indeed a lesson for you. We give you to drink (milk) of that which is in their bellies. And there are, in them, numerous (other) benefits for you, and of them you eat.
t.54: تمہارے لئے چوپایوں میں بھی بڑی بھاری عبرت ہے۔ ان کے پیٹوں میں سے ہم تمہیں دودھ پلاتے ہیں اور بھی بہت سے نفع تمہارے لئے ان میں ہیں ان میں سے بعض بعض کو تم کھاتے بھی ہو.

t.149: and on them and on ships you are carried.
t.84: and on them and on the boats you are transported.
t.85: and you ride on them, as you do in ships.
t.95: and are carried on them and also on ships.
t.19: And on them and on the ship ye are carried.
t.22: And on them, as well as in ships, ye ride.
t.203: And on them, and on ships you are carried.
t.54: اور ان پر اور کشتیوں پر تم سوار کرائے جاتے ہو.

t.149: And most surely We sent Noah to his people, so he said, “O my people, worship Allah; you have no god other than Him. Will you not be mindful(of God) ?”
t.84: Surely, We sent NūH to his nation. So he said, “My people, worship Allah. You have no god whatsoever other than Him. So, do you not fear Allah?”
t.85: We sent Noah to his people. He said, ‘My people, serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
t.95: We sent Noah to his people, and he said: "My people! Serve Allah; you have no deity other than He. Do you have no fear?"
t.19: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t.22: (Further, We sent a long line of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people: He said, "O my people! worship Allah! Ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
t.203: And indeed We sent Nûh (Noah) to his people, and he said: "O my people! Worship Allâh! You have no other Ilâh (God) but Him (Islâmic Monotheism). Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?"
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے نوح (علیہ السلام) کو اس کی قوم کی طرف رسول بنا کر بھیجا، اس نے کہا کہ اے میری قوم کے لوگو! اللہ کی عبادت کرو اور اس کے سوا تمہارا کوئی معبود نہیں، کیا تم (اس سے) نہیں ڈرتے.

t.149: So the chiefs of his people, who denied, said, “This is nothing but a human being like you, who wants to gain superiority over you. And had Allah willed, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of this among our forefathers of old;
t.84: So, said the disbelieving chiefs from among his nation, “This (man) is nothing but a human being like you. He wishes to impose his superiority over you. Had Allah willed, He would have sent down angels (instead of him). We have not heard of such a thing among our forefathers.
t.85: But the leading disbelievers among his people said, ‘He is merely a mortal like you, trying to gain some superiority over you. God would have sent down angels if He had wished; besides, we never heard of anything like this from our forefathers.
t.95: But the notables among his people had refused to believe, and said: "This is none other than a mortal like yourselves who desires to attain superiority over you. Had Allah wanted (to send any Messengers) He would have sent down angels. We have heard nothing like this in the time of our forebears of old (that humans were sent as Messengers).
t.19: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.
t.22: The chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: his wish is to assert his superiority over you: if Allah had wished (to send messengers), He could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing (as he says), among our ancestors of old."
t.203: But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he seeks to make himself superior to you. Had Allâh willed, He surely could have sent down angels. Never did we hear such a thing among our fathers of old.
t.54: اس کی قوم کے کافر سرداروں نے صاف کہہ دیا کہ یہ تو تم جیسا ہی انسان ہے، یہ تم پر فضیلت اور بڑائی حاصل کرنا چاہتا ہے۔ اگر اللہ ہی کو منظور ہوتا تو کسی فرشتے کو اتارتا، ہم نے تو اسے اپنے اگلے باپ دادوں کے زمانے میں سنا ہی نہیں.

t.149: he is nothing but a man in whom is madness, so wait for a while and see what happens to him.”
t.84: He is none but a man suffering from madness; so wait for (what happens to) him until some time”
t.85: He is just a madman, so let’s wait and see what happens to him.’
t.95: He is a person who has been seized with a little madness; so wait for a while (perhaps he will improve)."
t.19: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.
t.22: (And some said): "He is only a man possessed: wait (and have patience) with him for a time."
t.203: "He is only a man in whom is madness, so wait for him a while."
t.54: یقیناً اس شخص کو جنون ہے، پس تم اسے ایک وقت مقرر تک ڈھیل دو.

t.149: He said, “My Lord, support me with what they have disbelieved me about.”
t.84: He said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”
t.85: Noah said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
t.95: Noah said: "My Lord! Come to my help at their accusation that I am lying."
t.19: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
t.22: (Noah) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood!"
t.203: [Nûh (Noah)] said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."
t.54: نوح (علیہ السلام) نے دعا کی اے میرے رب! ان کے جھٹلانے پر تو میری مدد کر.

t.149: So We revealed to him: “Build the ship under Our eyes and according to Our revelation. And when Our command comes and the oven overflows, carry in it ofeach kind, a(male and female) couple, and your family except those of them against whom the word has already been pronounced. And do not speak to me concerning those who have done injustice; they will surely be drowned.
t.84: So, We sent Our revelation to him, saying, “Make the ship under Our eyes and Our revelation. So, when Our command will come, and the oven will gush forth, take on its board a pair of two from each (species) along with your family, except those of them against whom the word has already come to pass. And do not speak to Me (in favor) of those who have done wrong. They are sure to be drowned.
t.85: and so We revealed to him: ‘Build the Ark under Our watchful eye and according to Our revelation. When Our command comes and water gushes up out of the earth,take pairs of every species on board, and your family, except for those on whom the sentence has already been passed- do not plead with me for the evildoers: they will be drowned-
t.95: Thereupon We revealed to him, saying: "Build the Ark under Our eyes and according to Our revelation. And when Our command comes to pass and the oven boils over, take on board a pair each from every species, and also take your household except those of them against whom sentence has already been passed and do not plead to Me on behalf of the wrong-doers. They are doomed to be drowned.
t.19: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.
t.22: So We inspired him (with this message): "Construct the Ark within Our sight and under Our guidance: then when comes Our Command, and the fountains of the earth gush forth, take thou on board pairs of every species, male and female, and thy family- except those of them against whom the Word has already gone forth: And address Me not in favour of the wrong-doers; for they shall be drowned (in the Flood).
t.203: So We revealed to him (saying): "Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our Revelation (guidance). Then, when Our Command comes, and water gushes forth from the oven, take on board of each kind two (male and female), and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favour of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned.
t.54: تو ہم نے ان کی طرف وحی بھیجی کہ تو ہماری آنکھوں کے سامنے ہماری وحی کے مطابق ایک کشتی بنا۔ جب ہمارا حکم آجائے اور تنور ابل پڑے تو، تو ہر قسم کا ایک ایک جوڑا اس میں رکھ لے اور اپنے اہل کو بھی، مگر ان میں سے جن کی بابت ہماری بات پہلے گزر چکی ہے۔ خبردار جن لوگوں نے ﻇلم کیا ہے ان کے بارے میں مجھ سے کچھ کلام نہ کرنا وه تو سب ڈبوئے جائیں گے.

t.149: Then, when you and those with you are settled on the ship, say, ‘Praise be to Allah who has delivered us from the unjust people.’
t.84: So, when you and those with you are well seated in the ship, say, ‘Praise is for Allah who saved us from the wrongdoing people.’
t.85: and when you and your companions are settled on the Ark, say, “Praise be to God, who delivered us from the wicked people,”
t.95: And then when you and those accompanying you are firmly seated in the Ark, say: "Thanks be to Allah Who has delivered us from the wrong-doing people."
t.19: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!
t.22: And when thou hast embarked on the Ark - thou and those with thee,- say: "Praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who do wrong."
t.203: And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has saved us from the people who are Zâlimûn (i.e. oppressors, wrong-doers, polytheists, those who join others in worship with Allâh).
t.54: جب تو اور تیرے ساتھی کشتی پر باطمینان بیٹھ جاؤ تو کہنا کہ سب تعریف اللہ کے لئے ہی ہے جس نے ہمیں ﻇالم لوگوں سے نجات عطا فرمائی.

t.149: And say, ‘My Lord, land me at a blessed landing-place, for You are the best of those who bring(people) to land.’”
t.84: And say, ‘My Lord, make me land a blessed landing, and You are the best of those who bring (someone) to land’”.
t.85: and say, “My Lord, let me land with Your blessing: it is You who provide the best landings”.’
t.95: And say: "My Lord! Make my landing a blessed landing, for You are the Best of those Who can cause people to land in safety."
t.19: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
t.22: And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark."
t.203: And say: "My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land."
t.54: اور کہنا کہ اے میرے رب! مجھے بابرکت اتارنا اتار اور تو ہی بہتر ہے اتارنے والوں میں.

t.149: Indeed, in that are surely signs, and surely We have always been testing(mankind) .
t.84: Surely, there are signs in it, and We do always test (people).
t.85: There are signs in all this: We have always put [people] to the test.
t.95: There are great Signs in this story; and surely We do put people to test.
t.19: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.
t.22: Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand); (thus) do We try (men).
t.203: Verily, in this [what We did as regards drowning of the people of Nûh (Noah)], there are indeed Ayât (proofs, evidence, lessons, signs, etc. for men to understand), for sure We are ever putting (men) to the test.
t.54: یقیناً اس میں بڑی بڑی نشانیاں ہیں اور ہم بےشک آزمائش کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: Then after them We brought forth another generation,
t.84: Then after them We created another generation,
t.85: Then We raised another generation after them,
t.95: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;
t.19: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;
t.22: Then We raised after them another generation.
t.203: Then, after them, We created another generation.
t.54: ان کے بعد ہم نے اور بھی امت پیدا کی.

t.149: and We sent among them a messenger from themselves: “Worship Allah; youhave no god other than Him; will you not be mindful(of God) ?”
t.84: and sent among them a messenger from themselves (to convey the message): “Worship Allah; you have no god whatsoever other than Him. So do you not fear Allah?”
t.85: and sent one of their own as a messenger: ‘Serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
t.95: and We sent among them a Messenger from among themselves, saying: "Serve Allah; you have no god other than He. Do you have no fear?"
t.19: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t.22: And We sent to them a messenger from among themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah! ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
t.203: And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): "Worship Allâh! You have no other Ilâh (God) but Him. Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?"
t.54: پھر ان میں خود ان میں سے (ہی) رسول بھی بھیجا کہ تم سب اللہ کی عبادت کرو اس کے سوا تمہارا کوئی معبود نہیں، تم کیوں نہیں ڈرتے؟

t.149: And said the chiefs of his people who denied and disbelieved in the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had indulged in the Earlier Life, “This is nothing but a human being like you, who eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.
t.84: Then said the chiefs of his nation who were disbelievers and who denied facing the Hereafter and whom We made affluent in the worldly life, “This (man) is nothing but a human being. He eats from what you eat from, and drinks from what you drink.
t.85: But the leading disbelievers among his people, who denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, to whom We had granted ease and plenty in this life, said, ‘He is just a mortal like you- he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink-
t.95: The notables among his people who had refused to believe and who denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and those whom We had endowed with ease and comfort in this life, cried out: "This is no other than a mortal like yourselves who eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.
t.19: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.
t.22: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things of this life, said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: he eats of that of which ye eat, and drinks of what ye drink.
t.203: And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of this life, said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink.
t.54: اور سرداران قوم نے جواب دیا، جو کفر کرتے تھے اور آخرت کی ملاقات کو جھٹلاتے تھے اور ہم نے انہیں دنیوی زندگی میں خوشحال کر رکھا تھا، کہ یہ تو تم جیسا ہی انسان ہے، تمہاری ہی خوراک یہ بھی کھاتا ہے اور تمہارے پینے کا پانی ہی یہ پیتا ہے.

t.149: And if you obey a human being like yourselves, then you are bound to lose.
t.84: If you obey a human like yourselves, then you will be absolute losers.
t.85: and you will really be losers if you obey a mortal like yourselves.
t.95: If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, you will certainly be losers.
t.19: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.
t.22: "If ye obey a man like yourselves, behold, it is certain ye will be lost.
t.203: "If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily you indeed would be losers.
t.54: اگر تم نے اپنے جیسے ہی انسان کی تابعداری کر لی ہے تو بےشک تم سخت خسارے والے ہو.

t.149: Does he promise youthat when you have died and have become dust and bones you will be brought out?
t.84: Does he promise you that, when you die and are turned into dust and bones, you are to be brought forth?
t.85: How can he promise you that after you die and become dust and bones you will be brought out alive?
t.95: Does he promise you that when you are dead and are reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth to life?
t.19: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth?
t.22: "Does he promise that when ye die and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth (again)?
t.203: "Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive (resurrected)?
t.54: کیا یہ تمہیں اس بات کا وعده کرتا ہے کہ جب تم مرکر صرف خاک اور ہڈی ره جاؤ گے تو تم پھر زنده کئے جاؤ گے.

t.149: Farfetched, farfetched is what you are promised.
t.84: Far too improbable is what you are being promised.
t.85: What you are promised is very farfetched.
t.95: Far-fetched, utterly far-fetched is what you are being promised.
t.19: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!
t.22: "Far, very far is that which ye are promised!
t.203: "Far, very far is that which you are promised!
t.54: نہیں نہیں دور اور بہت دور ہے وه جس کا تم وعده دیئے جاتے ہو.

t.149: There is nothing but our Earlier Life—we die and we live, and we will never be raised.
t.84: There is nothing but our worldly life. We die and we live, and we are not to be raised again.
t.85: There is only the life of this world: we die, we live, but we will never be resurrected.
t.95: There is no other life than the life of the world. We shall live here and here shall we die; and we are not going to be raised again.
t.19: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).
t.22: "There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again!
t.203: "There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!
t.54: (زندگی) تو صرف دنیا کی زندگی ہے ہم مرتے جیتے رہتے ہیں اور یہ نہیں کہ ہم پھر اٹھائے جائیں گے.

t.149: He is nothing but a man who has fabricated lies against Allah, and never will we believe him.”
t.84: He is nothing but a man who has forged a lie against Allah, and we are not going to believe in him.”
t.85: He is just a man making lies up about God. We will never believe in him.’
t.95: This man has forged a mere lie in the name of Allah and we shall never believe what he says."
t.19: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.
t.22: "He is only a man who invents a lie against Allah, but we are not the ones to believe in him!"
t.203: "He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allâh, and we are not going to believe in him."
t.54: یہ تو بس ایسا شخص ہے جس نے اللہ پر جھوٹ (بہتان) باندھ لیا ہے، ہم تو اس پر ایمان ﻻنے والے نہیں ہیں.

t.149: He said, “My Lord, support me with what they have disbelieved me about.”
t.84: He said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”
t.85: The prophet said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
t.95: The Messenger said: "My Lord! Come to my help at their accusing me of lying."
t.19: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
t.22: (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood."
t.203: He said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."
t.54: نبی نے دعا کی کہ پروردگار! ان کے جھٹلانے پر تو میری مدد کر.

t.149: He said, “Soon they will definitely become remorseful.”
t.84: He (Allah) said, “In a little while they will have to be remorseful.”
t.85: and so God said, ‘Soon they will be filled with regret.’
t.95: He answered: "A short while, and they shall be repenting."
t.19: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.
t.22: (Allah) said: "In but a little while, they are sure to be sorry!"
t.203: (Allâh) said: "In a little while, they are sure to be regretful."
t.54: جواب ملا کہ یہ تو بہت ہی جلد اپنے کئے پر پچھتانے لگیں گے.

t.149: So the Shout took them away, according to the true(promise) , and We turned them into scum. So away with the unjust people.
t.84: So the Cry seized them according to the true (promise), and We turned them in to scum. So, away with the wrongdoing people.
t.85: The blast justly struck them and We swept them away like scum. Away with the evildoers!
t.95: Then a mighty blast quite justly overtook them, and We reduced them to a rubble. So away with the wrong-doing folk!
t.19: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!
t.22: Then the Blast overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead leaves (floating on the stream of Time)! So away with the people who do wrong!
t.203: So As-Saihah (torment - awful cry) overtook them in truth (with justice), and We made them as rubbish of dead plants. So away with the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, disobedient to His Messengers).
t.54: بالﺂخر عدل کے تقاضے کے مطابق چیﺦ نے پکڑ لیا اور ہم نے انہیں کوڑا کرکٹ کر ڈاﻻ، پس ﻇالموں کے لئے دوری ہو.

t.149: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
t.84: Then, after them, We created another generation.
t.85: We raised other generations after them-
t.95: Then, after them, We brought forth other generations.
t.19: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
t.22: Then We raised after them other generations.
t.203: Then, after them, We created other generations.
t.54: ان کے بعد ہم نے اور بھی بہت سی امتیں پیدا کیں.

t.149: No community can advance its time, nor can they delay it.
t.84: No community can go ahead of its appointed time, nor can they become late.
t.85: no community can advance or delay its time-
t.95: No nation can outstrip its term, nor can it put it back.
t.19: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.
t.22: No people can hasten their term, nor can they delay (it).
t.203: No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it.
t.54: نہ تو کوئی امت اپنے وقت مقرره سے آگے بڑھی اور نہ پیچھے رہی.

t.149: Then We sent Our messengers in succession; every time a messenger came to his community, they disbelieved him. So We made them follow one anotherand made them history. So away with a people who do not believe.
t.84: Thereafter, We sent Our messengers successively. Whenever its messenger came to a community, they rejected him. Then We made some of them follow others (in destruction) and turned them into tales (of history). So, away with a people who do not believe.
t.85: and We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to a community they invariably called him a liar, so We destroyed them one after the other and made them into cautionary tales. Away with the disbelievers!
t.95: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Whenever a Messenger came to his people they rejected him, calling him a liar. Thereupon, We made each people to follow the other (to its doom), reducing them to mere tales (of the past). Scourged be the people who do not believe!
t.19: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!
t.22: Then sent We our messengers in succession: every time there came to a people their messenger, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other (in punishment): We made them as a tale (that is told): So away with a people that will not believe!
t.203: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him; so We made them follow one another (to destruction), and We made them as Ahadîth (the true stories for mankind to learn a lesson from them). So away with a people who believe not!
t.54: پھر ہم نے لگاتار رسول بھیجے، جب جب اس امت کے پاس اس کا رسول آیا اس نے جھٹلایا، پس ہم نے ایک دوسرے کے پیچھے لگا دیا اور انہیں افسانہ بنا دیا۔ ان لوگوں کو دوری ہے جو ایمان قبول نہیں کرتے.

t.149: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and an evident manifestation
t.84: Thereafter, We sent Mūsā and his brother Hārūn with Our signs and a clear proof
t.85: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our signs and clear authority,
t.95: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our Signs and a clear authority
t.19: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant
t.22: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest,
t.203: Then We sent Mûsa (Moses) and his brother Hârûn‎‎ (Aaron), with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and manifest authority,
t.54: پھر ہم نے موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کو اور ان کے بھائی ہارون (علیہ السلام) کو اپنی آیتوں اور کھلی دلیل کے ساتھ بھیجا.

t.149: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they acted arrogantly and they were a haughty people.
t.84: towards Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his advisors. But they showed arrogance and they were haughty people.
t.85: to Pharaoh and his prominent leaders, but they responded with arrogance: they were a haughty people.
t.95: to Pharaoh and to his chiefs, but they behaved superciliously and they were haughty.
t.19: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.
t.22: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people.
t.203: To Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord, and exalting themselves over and above the Messenger of Allâh).
t.54: فرعون اور اس کے لشکروں کی طرف، پس انہوں نے تکبر کیا اور تھے ہی وه سرکش لوگ.

t.149: So they said, “Are we to believe in two human beings like us while their people are servants to us?”
t.84: So they said, “shall we believe in two humans who are like ourselves and whose people are serving us as slaves?”
t.85: They said, ‘Are we to believe in two mortals like us? And their people are our servants?’
t.95: They said: "Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves when their people are slaves to us?"
t.19: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?
t.22: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us!"
t.203: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility (and we use them to serve us as we like)."
t.54: کہنے لگے کہ کیا ہم اپنے جیسے دو شخصوں پر ایمان ﻻئیں؟ حاﻻنکہ خود ان کی قوم (بھی) ہمارے ماتحت ہے.

t.149: So they disbelieved them both, and thus they became of those who were annihilated.
t.84: Thus they rejected both of them and were among the destroyed.
t.85: and so they called them both liars: they became another ruined people.
t.95: So they rejected them, calling them liars, and they too eventually became of those that were destroyed.
t.19: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.
t.22: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed.
t.203: So they denied them both [Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)] and became of those who were destroyed.
t.54: پس انہوں نے ان دونوں کو جھٹلایا آخر وه بھی ہلاک شده لوگوں میں مل گئے.

t.149: And indeed We gave Moses the Scripture, that they may be guided.
t.84: And, of course, We gave Mūsā the Book, so that they may take the right path.
t.85: We gave Moses the Scripture, so that they might be rightly guided.
t.95: And We gave Moses the Book that people might be guided by it.
t.19: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.
t.22: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance.
t.203: And indeed We gave Mûsâ (Moses) the Scripture, that they may be guided.
t.54: ہم نے تو موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کو کتاب (بھی) دی کہ لوگ راه راست پر آجائیں.

t.149: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and We sheltered them in a secure place on a hilltop with a spring.
t.84: And We made the son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother a sign, and gave them shelter on a height, having a place of rest and running springs.
t.85: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign; We gave them shelter on a peaceful hillside with flowing water.
t.95: And We made Mary's son, and his mother, a Sign, and We gave them refuge on a lofty ground, a peaceful site with springs flowing in it.
t.19: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.
t.22: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs.
t.203: And We made the son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother as a sign, and We gave them refuge on high ground, a place of rest, security and flowing streams.
t.54: ہم نے ابن مریم اور اس کی والده کو ایک نشانی بنایا اور ان دونوں کو بلند صاف قرار والی اور جاری پانی والی جگہ میں پناه دی.

t.149: “O messengers, eat of the good foods and do righteousness; indeed, I am All-Knowing of what you do .
t.84: O messengers, eat from the good things, and act righteously. Of whatever you do, I am fully aware.
t.85: Messengers, eat good things and do good deeds: I am well aware of what you do.
t.95: Messengers! Partake of the things that are clean, and act righteously. I know well all that you do.
t.19: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.
t.22: O ye messengers! enjoy (all) things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with (all) that ye do.
t.203: O (you) Messengers! Eat of the Tayyibât [all kinds of Halâl foods which Allâh has made lawful (meat of slaughtered eatable animals, milk products, fats, vegetables, fruits, etc.] and do righteous deeds. Verily! I am Well-Acquainted with what you do.
t.54: اے پیغمبرو! حلال چیزیں کھاؤ اور نیک عمل کرو تم جو کچھ کر رہے ہو اس سے میں بخوبی واقف ہوں.

t.149: For indeed, this community of yours is one community and I am your Lord, so be mindful of Me.”
t.84: Surely, this is your creed, a single creed, and I am your Lord. So fear Me.
t.85: This community of yours is one- and I am your Lord: be mindful of Me-
t.95: This community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord; so hold Me alone in fear.
t.19: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.
t.22: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me (and no other).
t.203: And verily this your religion (of Islâmic Monotheism) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear (keep your duty to) Me.
t.54: یقیناً تمہارا یہ دین ایک ہی دین ہے اور میں ہی تم سب کا رب ہوں، پس تم مجھ سے ڈرتے رہو.

t.149: But they tore themselves into sects, each party rejoicing in what they had.
t.84: But they split up ways from one another (dividing themselves) into factions, each faction happy with what lies before it.
t.85: but they have split their community into sects, each rejoicing in their own.
t.95: But people later cut up their religion into bits, each group rejoicing in what they have.
t.19: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.
t.22: But people have cut off their affair (of unity), between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself.
t.203: But they (men) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in what is with it (as its beliefs).
t.54: پھر انہوں نے خود (ہی) اپنے امر (دین) کے آپس میں ٹکڑے ٹکڑے کر لیئے، ہر گروه جو کچھ اس کے پاس ہے اسی پر اترا رہا ہے.

t.149: So leavethem in their perplexity for a while.
t.84: So leave them in their negligence for some time.
t.85: So [Muhammad] leave them for a while steeped [in their ignorance].
t.95: So leave them immersed in their heedlessness till an appointed time.
t.19: So leave them in their error till a time.
t.22: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time.
t.203: So leave them in their error for a time.
t.54: پس آپ (بھی) انہیں ان کی غفلت میں ہی کچھ مدت پڑا رہنے دیں.

t.149: Do they assume that, in supplying them with wealth and children,
t.84: Do they think that by consistently providing them with wealth and children,
t.85: Do they reckon that, by giving them wealth and sons,
t.95: Do they fancy that Our continuing to give them wealth and children (means) that
t.19: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them
t.22: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons,
t.203: Do they think that in wealth and children with which We enlarge them
t.54: کیا یہ (یوں) سمجھ بیٹھے ہیں؟ کہ ہم جو بھی ان کے مال و اوﻻد بڑھا رہے ہیں.

t.149: We hasten to give them the good things? In fact, they are unaware.
t.84: We are accelerating the (real) good things to them? The fact, however, is that they do not understand (the reality).
t.85: We race to give them good things? They really have no idea!
t.95: We are busy lavishing on them all kinds of good? Nay, they do not perceive the reality of the matter.
t.19: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not.
t.22: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand.
t.203: We hasten unto them with good things. Nay, [it is a Fitnah (trial) in this worldly life so that they will have no share of good things in the Hereafter] but they perceive not. [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi].
t.54: وه ان کے لئے بھلائیوں میں جلدی کر رہے ہیں (نہیں نہیں) بلکہ یہ سمجھتے ہی نہیں.

t.149: Indeed, those who, out of awe for their Lord, are fearful,
t.84: (Contrarily) those who are anxious out of awe of their Lord,
t.85: Those who stand in awe of their Lord,
t.95: Surely those who stand in awe for fear of their Lord,
t.19: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.
t.22: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
t.203: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
t.54: یقیناً جو لوگ اپنے رب کی ہیبت سے ڈرتے ہیں.

t.149: and those who believe in their Lord’s signs,
t.84: and those who believe in the verses of their Lord
t.85: who believe in His messages,
t.95: who have full faith in the Signs of their Lord;
t.19: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
t.22: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord;
t.203: And those who believe in the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord;
t.54: اور جو اپنے رب کی آیتوں پر ایمان رکھتے ہیں.

t.149: and those who associate none with their Lord,
t.84: and those who do not associate any partner to their Lord,
t.85: who do not ascribe partners to Him,
t.95: who associate none with their Lord in His Divinity,
t.19: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,
t.22: Those who join not (in worship) partners with their Lord;
t.203: And those who join not anyone (in worship) as partners with their Lord;
t.54: اور جو اپنے رب کے ساتھ کسی کو شریک نہیں کرتے.

t.149: and those who bring whatever they bring while their hearts tremble, knowing that to their Lord they are returning—
t.84: And those who give whatever they give, with their hearts full of fear that to their Lord they are to return
t.85: who always give with hearts that tremble at the thought that they must return to Him,
t.95: who give, whatever they give in charity, with their hearts trembling at the thought that they are destined to return to their Lord;
t.19: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,
t.22: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord;-
t.203: And those who give that (their charity) which they give (and also do other good deeds) with their hearts full of fear (whether their alms and charities have been accepted or not), because they are sure to return to their Lord (for reckoning).
t.54: اور جو لوگ دیتے ہیں جو کچھ دیتے ہیں اور ان کے دل کپکپاتے ہیں کہ وه اپنے رب کی طرف لوٹنے والے ہیں.

t.149: those are the ones who hasten towards good works, and it is they who will reach it first.
t.84: - those people are accelerating towards the (real) good things, and they are the foremost to attain them.
t.85: are the ones who race toward good things, and they will be the first to get them.
t.95: it is these who hasten to do good works and vie in so doing with one another.
t.19: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.
t.22: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them.
t.203: It is these who hasten in the good deeds, and they are foremost in them [e.g. offering the compulsory Salât (prayers) in their (early) stated, fixed times and so on].
t.54: یہی ہیں جو جلدی جلدی بھلائیاں حاصل کر رہے ہیں اور یہی ہیں جو ان کی طرف دوڑ جانے والے ہیں.

t.149: And We never task any self beyond its capacity, and with Us is a recordthat tells the truth, and they will not be dealt with unjustly.
t.84: We do not place a burden on anyone except according to his ability. With Us there is a book which speaks with truth, and they shall not be wronged.
t.85: We do not burden any soul with more than it can bear- We have a Record that tells the truth- they will not be wronged.
t.95: We do not lay a burden on anyone beyond his capacity. We have a Book with Us that speaks the truth(about everyone); and they shall in no wise be wronged.
t.19: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.
t.22: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged.
t.203: And We task not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.
t.54: ہم کسی نفس کو اس کی طاقت سے زیاده تکلیف نہیں دیتے، اور ہمارے پاس ایسی کتاب ہے جو حق کے ساتھ بولتی ہے، ان کے اوپر کچھ ﻇلم نہ کیا جائے گا.

t.149: But their hearts are in perplexity as to this, and they have deeds other than that which they are doing,
t.84: But their hearts are in ignorance about this, and they have deeds, other than that, which they are continuously doing.
t.85: But the disbelievers’ hearts are steeped [in ignorance of ] all this; and there are other things besides this that they do.
t.95: Nay, their hearts are lost in ignorance of all this; and their deeds too vary from the way (mentioned above). They will persist in these deeds
t.19: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;
t.22: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will (continue) to do,-
t.203: Nay, but their hearts are covered from (understanding) this (the Qur’ân), and they have other (evil) deeds, besides, which they are doing.
t.54: بلکہ ان کے دل اس طرف سے غفلت میں ہیں اور ان کے لئے اس کے سوا بھی بہت سے اعمال ہیں جنہیں وه کرنے والے. ہیں

t.149: until when We seize the affluent ones among them with punishment, they promptly begin to groan.
t.84: Until when We will seize their affluent ones with punishment, they will suddenly start crying.
t.85: When We bring Our punishment on those corrupted with wealth, they will cry for help:
t.95: until We seize with Our chastisement those of them that are given to luxuriant ways. They will then begin to groan.
t.19: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.
t.22: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication!
t.203: Until when We seize those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment: behold they make humble invocation with a loud voice.
t.54: یہاں تک کہ جب ہم نے ان کے آسوده حال لوگوں کو عذاب میں پکڑ لیا تو وه بلبلانے لگے.

t.149: “Do not groan today; indeed, youwill not be supported by Us.
t.84: (Then it will be said to them,) “Do not cry today. You will not be helped by Us.
t.85: ‘Do not cry out today: you will get no help from Us.
t.95: "Put a stop to your groaning now! Surely no help shall be provided to you from Us.
t.19: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.
t.22: (It will be said): "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us.
t.203: Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly you shall not be helped by Us.
t.54: آج مت بلبلاؤ یقیناً تم ہمارے مقابلہ پر مدد نہ کئے جاؤ گے.

t.149: Surely, My signsused to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels
t.84: My verses used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels
t.85: Time and time again My messages were recited to you, but you turned arrogantly on your heels,
t.95: My Signs were rehearsed to you and you turned back on your heels and took to flight,
t.19: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,
t.22: "My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels-
t.203: Indeed My Verses used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels (denying them, and refusing with hatred to listen to them).
t.54: میری آیتیں تو تمہارے سامنے پڑھی جاتی تھیں پھر بھی تم اپنی ایڑیوں کے بل الٹے بھاگتے تھے.

t.149: in arrogance regarding it, conversing by night(about it) ,(yet) deserting it .”
t.84: in arrogance, making it a subject of tales at night, talking nonsense (about it).”
t.85: and spent the evening making fun of [the Quran].’
t.95: behaving arrogantly, and making fun, and talking nonsense (about the Book in your nightly chats)."
t.19: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.
t.22: "In arrogance: talking nonsense about the (Qur'an), like one telling fables by night."
t.203: In pride (they - Quraish pagans and polytheists of Makkah used to feel proud that they are the dwellers of Makkah sanctuary - Haram), talking evil about it (the Qur’ân) by night.
t.54: اکڑتے اینٹھتے افسانہ گوئی کرتے اسے چھوڑ دیتے تھے.

t.149: Have they not pondered the Word? Or has there come to them what came not to their forefathers of old?
t.84: Then, is it that they did not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or there has come to them something that did not come to their forefathers?
t.85: Have they not contemplated the Word of God? Has something come to them that did not come to their forefathers?
t.95: Did they never ponder over this Word (of God)? Or has he (to wit, the Messenger) brought something the like of which did not come to their forefathers of yore?
t.19: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?
t.22: Do they not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old?
t.203: Have they not pondered over the Word (of Allâh, i.e. what is sent down to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم), or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old?
t.54: کیا انہوں نے اس بات میں غور وفکر ہی نہیں کیا؟ بلکہ ان کے پاس وه آیا جو ان کے اگلے باپ دادوں کے پاس نہیں آیا تھا؟

t.149: Or is it that they did not recognize their messenger so they disacknowledge him?
t.84: Or did they not recognize their messenger and therefore they denied him?
t.85: Do they not recognize their Messenger? So why do they reject him?
t.95: Or is it that they were unaware of their Messenger and were therefore repelled by him for he was a stranger to them?
t.19: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him?
t.22: Or do they not recognise their Messenger, that they deny him?
t.203: Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) so they deny him?
t.54: یا انہوں نے اپنے پیغمبر کو پہچانا نہیں کہ اس کے منکر ہو رہے ہیں؟

t.149: Or do they say, “He is possessed?” Rather, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are hateful of the truth.
t.84: Or do they say, “He is suffering from madness?” No, but he has come to them with truth, but it is the truth that most of them dislike.
t.85: Why do they say he is possessed? He has brought them the truth and most of them hate it,
t.95: Or do they say that there is madness in him? Nay, he has brought them the Truth and it is the Truth that most of them disdain.
t.19: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.
t.22: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth.
t.203: Or say they: There is madness in him? Nay, but he brought them the truth [i.e. Tauhîd: Worshipping Allâh Alone in all aspects, the Qur’ân and the religion of Islâm], but most of them (the disbelievers) are averse to the truth.
t.54: یا یہ کہتے ہیں کہ اسے جنون ہے؟ بلکہ وه تو ان کے پاس حق ﻻیا ہے۔ ہاں ان میں اکثر حق سے چڑنے والے ہیں.

t.149: Yet were the Truth to follow their whims, the heavens and the earth and everyone in them would have become corrupted. Rather, We have come up to them with their Reminder, but they keep disregarding their Reminder.
t.84: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens and the earth and all those therein would have fallen in total disorder. However, We have brought to them their advice, but it is their advice that they are averse to.
t.85: but if the truth were in accordance with their desires, the heavens, the earth, and everyone in them would disintegrate. We have brought them their Reminder and they turn away from it.
t.95: Were the Truth to follow their desires, the order of the heavens and the earth and those who dwell in them would have been ruined. Nay, the fact is that We have brought to them their own remembrance; and yet it is from their own remembrance that they are turning away.
t.19: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.
t.22: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition.
t.203: And if the truth had been in accordance with their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder, but they turn away from their reminder.
t.54: اگر حق ہی ان کی خواہشوں کا پیرو ہوجائے تو زمین وآسمان اور ان کے درمیان کی ہر چیز درہم برہم ہو جائے۔ حق تو یہ ہے کہ ہم نے انہیں ان کی نصیحت پہنچا دی ہے لیکن وه اپنی نصیحت سے منھ موڑنے والے ہیں.

t.149: Or are youasking them for a payment? Rather, your Lord’s payment is better, for He is the best of providers.
t.84: Or is it that you (O Prophet) demand remuneration from them? But the remuneration from your Lord is best, and He is the best of all givers.
t.85: Do you [Prophet] ask them for any payment? Your Lord’s is the best payment: He is the Best of Providers.
t.95: Are you asking them for something? What Allah has given you is the best. He is the Best of providers.
t.19: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.
t.22: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
t.203: Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask them for some wages? But the recompense of your Lord is better, and He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
t.54: کیا آپ ان سے کوئی اجرت چاہتے ہیں؟ یاد رکھیئے کہ آپ کے رب کی اجرت بہت ہی بہتر ہے اور وه سب سے بہتر روزی رساں ہے.

t.149: And indeed, youare surely calling them to a straight path,
t.84: Surely you are inviting them to a straight path,
t.85: You call them to a straight path
t.95: You are calling them to a Straight Way,
t.19: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.
t.22: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way;
t.203: And certainly, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) call them to the Straight Path (true religion - Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: یقیناً آپ تو انہیں راه راست کی طرف بلا رہے ہیں.

t.149: for those who do not believe in the Hereafter are most surely swerving from the path.
t.84: and those who do not believe in the Hereafter are surely the deviators from the Path.
t.85: and those who do not believe in the Hereafter turn away from that path.
t.95: but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are ever prone to deviate from the Right Way.
t.19: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.
t.22: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way.
t.203: And verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed deviating far astray from the Path (true religion - Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: بےشک جو لوگ آخرت پر یقین نہیں رکھتے وه سیدھے راستے سے مڑ جانے والے ہیں.

t.149: And were We to have mercy upon them and remove whatever harm is upon them, surely they would continue to wander aimlessly while exceeding all limits.
t.84: And if We have mercy on them and remove whatever distress they have, they would still persist obstinately in their rebellion, wandering blindly (in disbelief).
t.85: Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve them of distress, they would blindly persist in their transgression.
t.95: Were We to be merciful to them and remove from them their present afflictions, they would persist in their transgression, blindly wandering on.
t.19: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.
t.22: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro.
t.203: And though We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, still they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
t.54: اور اگر ہم ان پر رحم فرمائیں اور ان کی تکلیفیں دور کردیں تو یہ تو اپنی اپنی سرکشی میں جم کر اور بہکنے لگیں.

t.149: And most surely We gripped them with punishment, but they did not surrender to their Lord, nor do they supplicate(Him)
t.84: We have already seized them with punishment, but they did not turn humble to their Lord, nor do they supplicate in humility,
t.85: We have already afflicted them, yet they did not submit to their Lord: they will not humble themselves
t.95: (They are such) that We seized them with chastisement (and yet) they did not humble themselves before their Lord, nor do they entreat
t.19: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,
t.22: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat (Him)!-
t.203: And indeed We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke (Allâh) with submission to Him.
t.54: اور ہم نے انہیں عذاب میں بھی پکڑا تاہم یہ لوگ نہ تو اپنے پروردگار کے سامنے جھکے اور نہ ہی عاجزی اختیار کی.

t.149: until, when We have opened before them a gate of intense punishment, they suddenly despair.
t.84: until when We will open against them the door of a severe punishment, they will be taken aback in despair.
t.85: until We open a gate to severe torment for them- then they will be plunged into utter despair.
t.95: until We opened upon them the door of a severe chastisement. Then lo, in this state they become utterly despaired of any good.
t.19: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.
t.22: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein!
t.203: Until, when We open for them the gate of severe punishment, then lo! they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair.
t.54: یہاں تک کہ جب ہم نے ان پر سخت عذاب کا دروازه کھول دیا تو اسی وقت فوراً مایوس ہوگئے.

t.149: And it is He Who initiated for youthe hearing and the sight(s) and the burning hearts; scarcely do you give thanks!
t.84: He is the One who created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Little you are grateful.
t.85: It is God who endowed you with hearing, sight, and hearts- how seldom you are grateful!
t.95: It is He Who has endowed you with the faculties of hearing and sight and has given you hearts (to think). Scarcely do you give thanks.
t.19: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
t.22: It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give!
t.203: It is He Who has created for you (the sense of) hearing (ears), eyes (sight), and hearts (understanding). Little thanks you give.
t.54: وه اللہ ہے جس نے تمہارے لئے کان اور آنکھیں اور دل پیدا کئے، مگر تم بہت (ہی) کم شکر کرتے ہو.

t.149: And it is He Who scattered youon earth, and to Him you will be herded.
t.84: And He is the One who created you on the earth, and it is He unto whom you will be gathered together.
t.85: It is He who made you multiply on earth. It is to Him that you will be gathered:
t.95: It is He Who has dispersed you all around the earth, and it is unto Him that you shall all be mustered.
t.19: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.
t.22: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back.
t.203: And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back.
t.54: اور وہی ہے جس نے تمہیں پیدا کرکے زمین میں پھیلا دیا اور اسی کی طرف تم جمع کئے جاؤ گے.

t.149: And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and to Him is the alternation of night and day. Do younot reason?
t.84: And He is the One who gives life and brings death, and it is He who controls the alternation of night and day. So, do you not understand?
t.85: it is He who gives life and death; the alternation of night and day depends on Him; will you not use your minds?
t.95: It is He Who gives life and causes death, and He holds mastery over the alternation of night and day. Do you not understand this?
t.19: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense?
t.22: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him (is due) the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand?
t.203: And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand?
t.54: اور یہ وہی ہے جو جلاتا اور مارتا ہے اور رات دن کے ردوبدل کا مختار بھی وہی ہے۔ کیا تم کو سمجھ بوجھ نہیں؟

t.149: Rather, they said the like of what the ancients had said.
t.84: But they say as the earlier people had said.
t.85: But, like others before them,
t.95: Nay, but they say the like of what their predecessors of yore had said.
t.19: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;
t.22: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said.
t.203: Nay, but they say the like of what the men of old said.
t.54: بلکہ ان لوگوں نے بھی ویسی ہی بات کہی جو اگلے کہتے چلے آئے.

t.149: They said, “Can it be thatwhen we have died and become dust and bones, can it be that we will really be resurrected?
t.84: They said, “Is it that, when we will die and become dust and bones - is it that we will be raised again?
t.85: they say, ‘What? When we die and turn to dust and bones, shall we really be resurrected?
t.95: They say: "Is it that when we are dead and have been reduced to dust and bones, shall we then be raised up again?
t.19: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?
t.22: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again?
t.203: They said: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed?
t.54: کہ کیا جب ہم مر کر مٹی اور ہڈی ہوجائیں گے کیا پھر بھی ہم ضرور اٹھائے جائیں گے؟

t.149: Most surely, we were promised this before, we and our forefathers—these are nothing but legends of the ancients.”
t.84: This is what has been promised to us and to our fathers before. It is nothing but the tales of the ancients.”
t.85: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
t.95: We were promised such things and so were our forefathers before us. All these are no more than tales of the past."
t.19: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.
t.22: "Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients!"
t.203: "Verily, this we have been promised - we and our fathers before (us)! This is only the tales of the ancients!"
t.54: ہم سے اور ہمارے باپ دادوں سے پہلے ہی یہ وعده ہوتا چلا آیا ہے کچھ نہیں یہ تو صرف اگلے لوگوں کے افسانے ہیں.
