t.95: Why was a treasure not bestowed upon him, or a garden whereof he might obtain his sustenance?" The evil-doers say: "You are simply following a bewitched man."
t.19: Or (why is not) treasure thrown down unto him, or why hath he not a paradise from whence to eat? And the evil-doers say: Ye are but following a man bewitched.
t.22: "Or (Why) has not a treasure been bestowed on him, or why has he (not) a garden for enjoyment?" The wicked say: "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched."
t.203: "Or (why) has not a treasure been granted to him, or why has he not a garden whereof he may eat?" And the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) say: "You follow none but a man bewitched."
t.54: یا اس کے پاس کوئی خزانہ ہی ڈال دیا جاتا یا اس کا کوئی باغ ہی ہوتا جس میں سے یہ کھاتا۔ اور ان ﻇالموں نے کہا کہ تم ایسے آدمی کے پیچھے ہو لئے ہو جس پر جادو کر دیا گیا ہے.

t.149: Lookhow they have set forth parables for you and gone astray, so they cannot find a way.
t.84: See how they coined similes for you, so they have gone astray and cannot find a way.
t.85: See what they think you are like! They have gone astray and cannot find the right way.
t.95: See what specious arguments they put forth before you: they are so strayed that they will not find their way to anything sound.
t.19: See how they coin similitudes for thee, so that they are all astray and cannot find a road!
t.22: See what kinds of comparisons they make for thee! But they have gone astray, and never a way will they be able to find!
t.203: See how they coin similitudes for you, so they have gone astray, and they cannot find a (Right) Path.
t.54: خیال تو کیجیئے! کہ یہ لوگ آپ کی نسبت کیسی کیسی باتیں بناتے ہیں۔ پس جس سے وه خود ہی بہک رہے ہیں اور کسی طرح راه پر نہیں آسکتے.

t.149: Supremely Blessed be the One Who, if He so willed, would provide youwith better than that—Gardens beneath which rivers flow—and make for you palaces.
t.84: Glorious is the One who, if He so wills, would give you better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow, and would give you palaces.
t.85: Exalted is He who can, if He wishes, give you better things than these: Gardens graced with flowing streams, and palaces too.
t.95: Most blessed is He Who, if He wills, can grant you even better than what they propose: Gardens beneath which rivers flow, and stately mansions.
t.19: Blessed is He Who, if He will, will assign thee better than (all) that - Gardens underneath which rivers flow - and will assign thee mansions.
t.22: Blessed is He who, if that were His will, could give thee better (things) than those,- Gardens beneath which rivers flow; and He could give thee palaces (secure to dwell in).
t.203: Blessed be He Who, if He wills will assign you better than (all) that - Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise) and will assign you palaces (i.e. in Paradise).
t.54: اللہ تعالیٰ تو ایسا بابرکت ہے کہ اگر چاہے تو آپ کو بہت سے ایسے باغات عنایت فرما دے جو ان کے کہے ہوئے باغ سے بہت ہی بہتر ہوں جن کے نیچے نہریں لہریں لے رہی ہوں اور آپ کو بہت سے (پختہ) محل بھی دے دے.

t.149: Rather, they have considered the Hour to be a lie, and We have prepared a blaze for those who have disbelieved in the Hour.
t.84: But they have disbelieved the Hour (the Day of Judgment) and for those who disbelieve the Hour, We have prepared a flaming fire.
t.85: It is actually the coming of the Hour that they reject: We have prepared a blazing fire for those who reject the Hour.
t.95: Nay, the truth is that it is the Hour to which they give the lie.; We have kept a Blazing Fire ready for him who denies the Hour.
t.19: Nay, but they deny (the coming of) the Hour, and for those who deny (the coming of) the Hour We have prepared a flame.
t.22: Nay they deny the hour (of the judgment to come): but We have prepared a blazing fire for such as deny the hour:
t.203: Nay, they deny the Hour (the Day of Resurrection), and for those who deny the Hour, We have prepared a flaming Fire (i.e. Hell).
t.54: بات یہ ہے کہ یہ لوگ قیامت کو جھوٹ سمجھتے ہیں اور قیامت کے جھٹلانے والوں کے لئے ہم نے بھڑکتی ہوئی آگ تیار کر رکھی ہے.

t.149: When it sees them from a distant place, they hear its raging and roaring.
t.84: When it will see them from a distant place, they will hear (the sounds of) its raging and breathing,
t.85: When it sees them from a distance, they will hear it raging and roaring,
t.95: When it sees them from a place afar, they will hear its raging and roaring,
t.19: When it seeth them from afar, they hear the crackling and the roar thereof.
t.22: When it sees them from a place far off, they will hear its fury and its ranging sigh.
t.203: When it (Hell) sees them from a far place, they will hear its raging and its roaring.
t.54: جب وه انہیں دور سے دیکھے گی تو یہ اس کا غصے سے بپھرنا اور دھاڑنا سنیں گے.

t.149: And when they are cast, shackled, into a tight place therein, there they plead for demise.
t.84: and when they will be thrown into a narrow place therein, while they will be chained together, they will call for death.
t.85: and when they are hurled into a narrow part of it, chained together, they will cry out for death.
t.95: and when they are flung, chained together, into a narrow place in it, they will fervently call there for annihilation.
t.19: And when they are flung into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they pray for destruction there.
t.22: And when they are cast, bound together into a constricted place therein, they will plead for destruction there and then!
t.203: And when they shall be thrown into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they will exclaim therein for destruction.
t.54: اور جب یہ جہنم کی کسی تنگ جگہ میں مشکیں کس کر پھینک دیئے جائیں گے تو وہاں اپنے لئے موت ہی موت پکاریں گے.

t.149: “Do not callfor one demise today, but call for many demises.”
t.84: (Then it will be said to them,) “Do not call for one death today, but call for many a death.”
t.85: ‘Do not cry out this day for one death, but for many.’
t.95: (They will then be told): "Do not call for a single annihilation, but for many an annihilation."
t.19: Pray not that day for one destruction, but pray for many destructions!
t.22: "This day plead not for a single destruction: plead for destruction oft-repeated!"
t.203: Exclaim not today for one destruction, but exclaim for many destructions.
t.54: (ان سے کہا جائے گا) آج ایک ہی موت کو نہ پکارو بلکہ بہت سی اموات کو پکارو.

t.149: Say, “Is that better or the Garden of Eternity promised to the ones who were mindful(of God) ? For them it has always been a repayment anda destiny.
t.84: Say, “Is that better or the eternal paradise the God-fearing are promised?” It will be a reward for them and a final abode.
t.85: Say, ‘Which is better, this or the lasting Garden that those who are mindful of God have been promised as their reward and journey’s end?’
t.95: Ask them: "Is this state better or the Garden of Eternity which the God-fearing have been promised?" It shall be their recompense and the end-point of their journey;
t.19: Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end.
t.22: Say: "Is that best, or the eternal garden, promised to the righteous? for them, that is a reward as well as a goal (of attainment).
t.203: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "Is that (torment) better or the Paradise of Eternity which is promised to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2)?" It will be theirs as a reward and as a final destination.
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجیئے کہ کیا یہ بہتر ہے یا وه ہمیشگی والی جنت جس کا وعده پرہیزگاروں سے کیا گیا ہے، جو ان کا بدلہ ہے اور ان کے لوٹنے کی اصلی جگہ ہے.

t.149: They have therein whatever they desire, as they abide. That has always been yourLord’s promise,(worthy) to be requested.
t.84: For them there will be whatever they wish, while they will be eternal. This is a promise undertaken by your Lord, (the fulfillment of) which is worth praying for.
t.85: There they will find everything they wish for, and there they will stay. [Prophet], this is a binding promise from your Lord.
t.95: the Garden wherein whatever they desire will be fulfilled. In it they shall abide for ever. This is a promise whose fulfilment Your Lord has made incumbent on Himself.
t.19: Therein abiding, they have all that they desire. It is for thy Lord a promise that must be fulfilled.
t.22: "For them there will be therein all that they wish for: they will dwell (there) for aye: A promise to be prayed for from thy Lord."
t.203: For them there will be therein all that they desire, and they will abide (there forever). It is a promise binding upon your Lord that must be fulfilled.
t.54: وه جو چاہیں گے ان کے لئے وہاں موجود ہوگا، ہمیشہ رہنے والے۔ یہ تو آپ کے رب کے ذمے وعده ہے جو قابل طلب ہے.

t.149: And on the day when He herdsthemand what they worship apart from Allah, then Hesays , “Was it youwho misguided these servants of Mine, or was it they who strayed from the way?”
t.84: (Remember) the Day when He will gather them and what they used to worship beside Allah and will say (to the latter ones), “Did you mislead these My servants, or did they themselves lose the way?”
t.85: On the Day He gathers them all together with those they worship beside Him, He will say, ‘Was it you [false gods] who led these creatures of Mine astray, or did they stray from the path by themselves?’
t.95: On the Day when He will muster together all the unbelievers as well as the deities that they worship beside Allah, and He will ask them: "Was it you who caused these servants of Mine to stray away, or did they themselves stray away from the Right Path?"
t.19: And on the day when He will assemble them and that which they worship instead of Allah and will say: Was it ye who misled these my slaves or did they (themselves) wander from the way?
t.22: The day He will gather them together as well as those whom they worship besides Allah, He will ask: "Was it ye who let these My servants astray, or did they stray from the Path themselves?"
t.203: And on the Day when He will gather them together and that which they worship besides Allâh [idols, angels, pious men, saints]. He will say: "Was it you who misled these My slaves or did they (themselves) stray from the (Right) Path?"
t.54: اور جس دن اللہ تعالیٰ انہیں اور سوائے اللہ کے جنہیں یہ پوجتے رہے، انہیں جمع کرکے پوچھے گا کہ کیا میرے ان بندوں کو تم نے گمراه کیا یا یہ خود ہی راه سے گم ہوگئے.

t.149: They said, “Highly Exalted are You. We should not have taken any masters apart from You. But you allowed them to enjoy, as well as their fathers, until they forgot the Reminder and became a ruined people.”
t.84: They will say, “Pure are You. It was not for us to adopt other guardians than You. Instead, You gave them and their fathers (worldly) benefits till they forgot the advice, and became a ruined people.”
t.85: They will say, ‘May You be exalted! We ourselves would never take masters other than You! But You granted them and their forefathers pleasures in this life, until they forgot Your Reminder and were ruined.’
t.95: They will say: "Glory be to You! It did not behove us to take any other than You as our guardians, but You lavished the pleasures of life upon them and their forefathers until they forgot the Admonition and became doomed to destruction."
t.19: They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk.
t.22: They will say: "Glory to Thee! not meet was it for us that we should take for protectors others besides Thee: But Thou didst bestow, on them and their fathers, good things (in life), until they forgot the Message: for they were a people (worthless and) lost."
t.203: They will say: "Glorified be You! It was not for us to take any Auliyâ’ (Protectors, Helpers) besides You, but You gave them and their fathers comfort till they forgot the warning, and became a lost people (doomed to total loss).
t.54: وه جواب دیں گے کہ تو پاک ذات ہے خود ہمیں ہی یہ زیبا نہ تھا کہ تیرے سوا اوروں کو اپنا کارساز بناتے بات یہ ہے کہ تو نے انہیں اور ان کے باپ دادوں کو آسودگیاں عطا فرمائیں یہاں تک کہ وه نصیحت بھلا بیٹھے، یہ لوگ تھے ہی ہلاک ہونے والے.

t.149: Thus theyhave certainly disbelieved youregarding what you say, so you can neither avoid(punishment) nor get any support. And whoever of you commits injustice, We will make him taste a supreme punishment.
t.84: Thus they will refute you in what you say, and you will not be able to repulse (the punishment,) or to receive help. Whoever commits injustice from among you, We will make him taste a painful punishment.
t.85: [God will say], ‘Now your gods have denounced what you say as lies: you cannot avoid the punishment; you will not get any help.’ If any of you commits such evil, We shall make him taste agonizing torment.
t.95: Thus will those deities give the lie to all what you now say, and you will not be able to avert your doom, nor obtain any succour. We shall cause whoever of you commits wrong to taste an enormous chastisement.
t.19: Thus they will give you the lie regarding what ye say, then ye can neither avert (the doom) nor obtain help. And whoso among you doeth wrong, We shall make him taste great torment.
t.22: (Allah will say): "Now have they proved you liars in what ye say: so ye cannot avert (your penalty) nor (get) help." And whoever among you does wrong, him shall We cause to taste of a grievous Penalty.
t.203: Thus they (false gods - all deities other than Allâh) will belie you (polytheists) regarding what you say (that they are gods besides Allâh): then you can neither avert (the punishment), nor get help. And whoever among you does wrong (i.e. sets up rivals to Allâh), We shall make him taste a great torment.
t.54: تو انہوں نے تو تمہیں تمہاری تمام باتوں میں جھٹلایا، اب نہ تو تم میں عذابوں کے پھیرنے کی طاقت ہے، نہ مدد کرنے کی، تم میں سے جس جس نے ﻇلم کیا ہے ہم اسے بڑا عذاب چکھائیں گے.

t.149: And never did We send any emissaries before youbut they used to eat food and walk in the marketplaces. And We made some of you a means of trial for others—will you be patient? And your Lord has always been All-Seeing.
t.84: We did not send any messengers before you (O prophet,) but all of them used to eat food and walk in the markets. And We have made some of you a test for some others. Would you observe patience? And your Lord is Ever-seeing.
t.85: No messenger have We sent before you [Muhammad] who did not eat food and walk about in the marketplace. But We have made some of you a means of testing others- will you stand fast? Your Lord is always watching.
t.95: (O Muhammad), We never sent any Messengers before you but they ate food and walked about in the markets. We made some of you a means to test each by the other to see whether you remain patient. Your Lord is All-Seeing.
t.19: We never sent before thee any messengers but lo! they verily ate food and walked in the markets. And We have appointed some of you a test for others: Will ye be steadfast? And thy Lord is ever Seer.
t.22: And the messengers whom We sent before thee were all (men) who ate food and walked through the streets: We have made some of you as a trial for others: will ye have patience? for Allah is One Who sees (all things).
t.203: And We never sent before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) any of the Messengers but verily, they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you as a trial for others: will you have patience? And your Lord is Ever All-Seer (of everything).
t.54: ہم نے آپ سے پہلے جتنے رسول بھیجے سب کے سب کھانا بھی کھاتے تھے اور بازاروں میں بھی چلتے پھرتے تھے اور ہم نے تم میں سے ہر ایک کو دوسرے کی آزمائش کا ذریعہ بنا دیا۔ کیا تم صبر کرو گے؟ تیرا رب سب کچھ دیکھنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And those who do not expect to meet Us said, “If only the angels were sent down to us or we could see our Lord.” They have acted arrogantly regarding themselves and have become excessively defiant.
t.84: Said those who do not even expect to meet Us, “Why the angels are not sent down to us or why do we not see our Lord?” Indeed they think too highly of themselves, and have gone too far in rebellion.
t.85: Those who do not fear to meet Us say, ‘Why are the angels not sent down to us?’ or ‘Why can we not see our Lord?’ They are too proud of themselves and too insolent.
t.95: Those who do not look forward to meet Us say: "Why should angels not be sent to us, or why do we ourselves not observe our Lord?" Surely they are too proud of themselves and have gone beyond all limits in their rebellion.
t.19: And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride.
t.22: Such as fear not the meeting with Us (for Judgment) say: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or (why) do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they have an arrogant conceit of themselves, and mighty is the insolence of their impiety!
t.203: And those who expect not a Meeting with Us (i.e. those who deny the Day of Resurrection and the life of the Hereafter) said: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or why do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they think too highly of themselves, and are scornful with great pride.
t.54: اور جنہیں ہماری ملاقات کی توقع نہیں انہوں نے کہا کہ ہم پر فرشتے کیوں نہیں اتارے جاتے؟ یا ہم اپنی آنکھوں سے اپنے رب کو دیکھ لیتے؟ ان لوگوں نے اپنے آپ کو ہی بہت بڑا سمجھ رکھا ہے اور سخت سرکشی کرلی ہے.

t.149: On the day when they see the angels—no glad tidings for the criminals on that day, and theysay, “an insurmountable separator.”
t.84: The Day they will see the angels, there will be no good news for the sinners that day, and they will say, “(We need) a shelter, fully protected!”
t.85: There will be no good news for the guilty on the Day they see the angels. The angels will say, ‘You cannot cross the forbidden barrier,’
t.95: On that Day - the Day when they will behold angels - there will be no good news for those immersed in evil, and they will cry out: "We seek refuge (in Allah)."
t.19: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban!
t.22: The Day they see the angels,- no joy will there be to the sinners that Day: The (angels) will say: "There is a barrier forbidden (to you) altogether!"
t.203: On the Day they will see the angels - no glad tidings will there be for the Mujrimûn (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners) that day. And they (angels) will say: "All kinds of glad tidings are forbidden to you," [none will be allowed to enter Paradise except the one who said: Lâ ilâha illallâh, "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh) and acted practically on its legal orders and obligations. See the footnote of V.2:193)].
t.54: جس دن یہ فرشتوں کو دیکھ لیں گے اس دن ان گناه گاروں کو کوئی خوشی نہ ہوگی اور کہیں گے یہ محروم ہی محروم کیے گئے.

t.149: And We proceededto the work they had done and turned them into scattered dust.
t.84: And We will proceed to whatever deeds they did, and will turn them into scattered dust.
t.85: and We shall turn to the deeds they have done and scatter them like dust.
t.95: And We shall turn to their deeds and shall reduce them to scattered dust.
t.19: And We shall turn unto the work they did and make it scattered motes.
t.22: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they did (in this life), and We shall make such deeds as floating dust scattered about.
t.203: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners) did, and We shall make such deeds as scattered floating particles of dust.
t.54: اور انہوں نے جو جو اعمال کیے تھے ہم نےان کی طرف بڑھ کر انہیں پراگنده ذروں کی طرح کردیا.

t.149: The fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) on that day have a better residence and are more fairly accommodated.
t.84: The people of Paradise, on that day, will be the best in (terms of their) abode and best in (terms of their) resting-place.
t.85: But the companions in the Garden will have a better home on that Day, and a fairer place to rest.
t.95: On that Day it is the inmates of Paradise that will be graced with a better abode and a fairer resting place.
t.19: Those who have earned the Garden on that day will be better in their home and happier in their place of noonday rest;
t.22: The Companions of the Garden will be well, that Day, in their abode, and have the fairest of places for repose.
t.203: The dwellers of Paradise (i.e. those who deserved it through their Islamic Monotheistic Faith and their deeds of righteousness) will, on that Day, have the best abode, and have the fairest of places for repose.
t.54: البتہ اس دن جنتیوں کا ٹھکانا بہتر ہوگا اور خواب گاه بھی عمده ہوگی.

t.149: And it is the day when the sky is cleft with clouds and the angels weresent down in streams.
t.84: The Day the sky will break open with a cloud, and the angels will be sent down in a majestic descent,
t.85: On the Day when the sky and its clouds are split apart and the angels sent down in streams,
t.95: On that Day the sky shall be rent asunder by a cloud and a whole cavalcade of angels will be made to descend.
t.19: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent.
t.22: The Day the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and angels shall be sent down, descending (in ranks),-
t.203: And (remember) the Day when the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and the angels will be sent down, with a grand descending.
t.54: اور جس دن آسمان بادل سمیت پھٹ جائے گا اور فرشتے لگاتار اتارے جائیں گے.

t.149: Dominion on that day belongs to the All-Merciful, and it has been a difficult day for the deniers.
t.84: the Kingdom on that day will be for the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah), and it will be a difficult day for the disbelievers.
t.85: on that Day, true authority belongs to the Lord of Mercy. It will be a grievous Day for the disbelievers.
t.95: On that Day the true kingdom will belong only to the Merciful Lord. That will be a hard day for those that deny the Truth;
t.19: The Sovereignty on that day will be the True (Sovereignty) belonging to the Beneficent One, and it will be a hard day for disbelievers.
t.22: That Day, the dominion as of right and truth, shall be (wholly) for (Allah) Most Merciful: it will be a Day of dire difficulty for the misbelievers.
t.203: The sovereignty on that Day will be the true (sovereignty), belonging to the Most Gracious (Allâh), and it will be a hard Day for the disbelievers (those who disbelieve in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: اس دن صحیح طور پر ملک صرف رحمٰن کا ہی ہوگا اور یہ دن کافروں پر بڑا بھاری ہوگا.

t.149: And it is the day when the unjust bites his hands, saying, “If only I had followed the way with the Messenger.
t.84: And (Be mindful of) the Day the wrongdoer will bite his hands saying, “Would that I had taken a path along with the messenger!
t.85: On that Day the evildoer will bite his own hand and say, ‘If only I had taken the same path as the Messenger.
t.95: a Day when the wrong-doer will bite his hands, saying: "Would that I had stood by the Messenger!
t.19: On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)!
t.22: The Day that the wrong-doer will bite at his hands, he will say, "Oh! would that I had taken a (straight) path with the Messenger!
t.203: And (remember) the Day when the Zâlim (wrong-doer, oppressor, polytheist) will bite at his hands, he will say: "Oh! Would that I had taken a path with the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).
t.54: اور اس دن ﻇالم شخص اپنے ہاتھوں کو چبا چبا کر کہے گا ہائے کاش کہ میں نے رسول (صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) کی راه اختیار کی ہوتی.

t.149: Woe to me! I wish I had not taken so-and-so for a close friend;
t.84: Woe to me! Would that I had not taken so-and-so for my friend!
t.85: Woe is me! If only I had not taken so and so as a friend-
t.95: Woe is me! Would that I had not taken such a one for a friend!
t.19: Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend!
t.22: "Ah! woe is me! Would that I had never taken such a one for a friend!
t.203: "Ah! Woe to me! Would that I had never taken so-and-so as a Khalîl (an intimate friend)!
t.54: ہائے افسوس کاش کہ میں نے فلاں کو دوست نہ بنایا ہوتا.

t.149: he definitely made me stray away from the Reminder after it had come to me.” And Satan has always been a betrayer of man.”
t.84: Indeed he led me astray from the advice after it had come to me.” And the Satan is man’s betrayer.
t.85: he led me away from the Revelation after it reached me. Satan has always betrayed mankind.’
t.95: He led me astray from the Admonition that had come to me. Satan proved to be a great betrayer of man."
t.19: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need.
t.22: "He did lead me astray from the Message (of Allah) after it had come to me! Ah! the Evil One is but a traitor to man!"
t.203: "He indeed led me astray from the Reminder (this Qur’ân) after it had come to me. And Shaitân (Satan) is to man ever a deserter in the hour of need." [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]
t.54: اس نے تو مجھے اس کے بعد گمراه کردیا کہ نصیحت میرے پاس آپہنچی تھی اور شیطان تو انسان کو (وقت پر) دغا دینے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And the Messenger said, “O My Lord, my people have dealt with this Recitalby deserting it.”
t.84: And the messenger will say, “O my Lord, my people had taken this Qur’ān as deserted.”
t.85: The Messenger has said, ‘Lord, my people treat this Quran as something to be shunned,’
t.95: And the Messenger will say: "My Lord! My own people had made this Qur'an an object of laughter."
t.19: And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account.
t.22: Then the Messenger will say: "O my Lord! Truly my people took this Qur'an for just foolish nonsense."
t.203: And the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) will say: "O my Lord! Verily, my people deserted this Qur’ân (neither listened to it, nor acted on its laws and teachings).
t.54: اور رسول کہے گا کہ اے میرے پروردگار! بےشک میری امت نے اس قرآن کو چھوڑ رکھا تھا.

t.149: Likewise, to every prophet We assigned enemies from among the criminals. But sufficient is yourLord as a Guide and Supporter.
t.84: In a similar way We made for every prophet an enemy from among the sinners, but your Lord suffices as a guide and as a supporter.
t.85: but We have always appointed adversaries from the wicked, for every prophet: Your Lord is sufficient guide and helper.
t.95: (O Muhammad), thus did We make for every Prophet enemies from among those immersed in evil. Your Lord suffices you as a Guide and a Helper.
t.19: Even so have We appointed unto every prophet an opponent from among the guilty; but Allah sufficeth for a Guide and Helper.
t.22: Thus have We made for every prophet an enemy among the sinners: but enough is thy Lord to guide and to help.
t.203: Thus have We made for every Prophet an enemy among the Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, criminals). But Sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper.
t.54: اور اسی طرح ہم نے ہر نبی کے دشمن بعض گناه گاروں کو بنادیا ہے اور تیرا رب ہی ہدایت کرنے واﻻ اور مدد کرنے واﻻ کافی ہے.

t.149: And those who denied said, “If only the Recitalhad been sent down upon him as one complete whole!” Yet(it is sent in this way) in order to strengthen your heart thereby, and We(revealed it to be) chanted slowly and distinctly.
t.84: Said those who disbelieved, “Why has the Qur’ān not been revealed to him all at once?” (It has been sent down) in this way (i.e. in parts) so that We make your heart firm, and We revealed it little by little.
t.85: The disbelievers also say, ‘Why was the Quran not sent down to him all at once?’ We sent it in this way to strengthen your heart [Prophet]; We gave it to you in gradual revelation.
t.95: Those who disbelieve say: "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" It was revealed thus that We may fully impress it on your mind; (and for the same end) We have revealed it gradually (according to a scheme) in fragments.
t.19: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order.
t.22: Those who reject Faith say: "Why is not the Qur'an revealed to him all at once? Thus (is it revealed), that We may strengthen thy heart thereby, and We have rehearsed it to thee in slow, well-arranged stages, gradually.
t.203: And those who disbelieve say: "Why is not the Qur’ân revealed to him all at once?" Thus (it is sent down in parts), that We may strengthen your heart thereby. And We have revealed it to you gradually, in stages. (It was revealed to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم in 23 years.).
t.54: اور کافروں نے کہا کہ اس پر قرآن سارا کا سارا ایک ساتھ ہی کیوں نہ اتارا گیا اسی طرح ہم نے (تھوڑا تھوڑا کرکے) اتارا تاکہ اس سے ہم آپ کا دل قوی رکھیں، ہم نے اسے ٹھہر ٹھہر کر ہی پڑھ سنایا ہے.

t.149: And whatever similitude they come to youwith, We provide you with the truth and a better exposition.
t.84: They bring to you no hypothesis, but We bring to you the correct position and (an answer) better explained.
t.85: They cannot put any argument to you without Our bringing you the truth and the best explanation.
t.95: (This was also done so that) whenever they put any strange question to you, We sent its right answer and explained the matter in the best manner.
t.19: And they bring thee no similitude but We bring thee the Truth (as against it), and better (than their similitude) as argument.
t.22: And no question do they bring to thee but We reveal to thee the truth and the best explanation (thereof).
t.203: And no example or similitude do they bring (to oppose or to find fault in you or in this Qur’ân), but We reveal to you the truth (against that similitude or example), and the better explanation thereof.
t.54: یہ آپ کے پاس جو کوئی مثال ﻻئیں گے ہم اس کا سچا جواب اور عمده توجیہ آپ کو بتادیں گے.

t.149: Those who are herded to Hell on their faces—those are in a worse position and further astray from the way.
t.84: Those who will be driven on their faces to Hell - they are the worst in situation and far more astray from the path.
t.85: It is those driven [falling], on their faces,to Hell who will be in the worst place- they are the furthest from the right path.
t.95: Those who shall be mustered in the Hell upon their faces, their stand is the worst and their way most erroneous.
t.19: Those who will be gathered on their faces unto hell: such are worse in plight and further from the right road.
t.22: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces,- they will be in an evil plight, and, as to Path, most astray.
t.203: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces, such will be in an evil state, and most astray from the (Straight) Path.
t.54: جو لوگ اپنے منھ کے بل جہنم کی طرف جمع کیے جائیں گے۔ وہی بدتر مکان والے اور گمراه تر راستے والے ہیں.

t.149: And surely We gave Moses the Scripture and appointed his brother Aaron as an assistant,
t.84: Surely We gave Mūsā the Book, and appointed his brother Hārūn as a minister with him.
t.85: We gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron to help him.
t.95: Verily We granted Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron with him as his helper
t.19: We verily gave Moses the Scripture and placed with him his brother Aaron as henchman.
t.22: (Before this,) We sent Moses The Book, and appointed his brother Aaron with him as minister;
t.203: And indeed We gave Mûsâ (Moses) the Scripture [the Taurât (Torah)], and placed his brother Hârûn (Aaron) with him as a helper;
t.54: اور بلاشبہ ہم نے موسیٰ کو کتاب دی اور ان کے ہمراه ان کے بھائی ہارون کو ان کا وزیر بنادیا.

t.149: then We said, “Goto the people who have disbelieved Our signs,” then We destroyed them completely.
t.84: So we said, “Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs” Then We annihilated them totally.
t.85: We said, ‘Go, both of you, to the people who have rejected Our signs.’ Later We destroyed those people utterly.
t.95: and said to him: "Go the two of you to the people who have given the lie to Our Signs." Thereafter We utterly destroyed them.
t.19: Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction.
t.22: And We command: "Go ye both, to the people who have rejected our Signs:" And those (people) We destroyed with utter destruction.
t.203: And We said: "Go you both to the people who have denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)." Then We destroyed them with utter destruction.
t.54: اور کہہ دیا کہ تم دونوں ان لوگوں کی طرف جاؤ جو ہماری آیتوں کو جھٹلا رہے ہیں۔ پھر ہم نے انہیں بالکل ہی پامال کردیا.

t.149: And when the people of Noah disbelieved the messengers, We drowned them and made them a sign for mankind. And We have prepared a painful punishment for the unjust,
t.84: As for the people of NūH, when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them and made them an example for mankind, and We have prepared a painful punishment for the transgressors.
t.85: The people of Noah, too: when they rejected their messengers, We drowned them and made them an example to all people. We have prepared a painful torment for the evildoers,
t.95: (The same happened with) the people of Noah: when they gave the lie to the Messengers We drowned them and made of them a Sign of warning for all mankind. We have kept ready a painful chastisement for the wrong-doers.
t.19: And Noah's folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers.
t.22: And the people of Noah,- when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a Sign for mankind; and We have prepared for (all) wrong-doers a grievous Penalty;-
t.203: And Nûh’s (Noah) people, when they denied the Messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a sign for mankind. And We have prepared a painful torment for the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers).
t.54: اور قوم نوح نے بھی جب رسولوں کو جھوٹا کہا تو ہم نے انہیں غرق کردیا اور لوگوں کے لیے انہیں نشان عبرت بنا دیا۔ اور ہم نے ﻇالموں کے لیے دردناک عذاب مہیا کر رکھا ہے.

t.149: and(for) ʻĀdand Thamûdand the fellows of Al-Russand many generations in between.
t.84: And (We annihilated also the peoples of) ‘Ād and Thamūd and the people of Rass, and many generations in between them.
t.85: as We did for the people of Ad, Thamud, and al-Rass, and many generations in between.
t.95: And in like manner were the 'Ad and the Thamud destroyed and the people of al-Rass and many a nation in the centuries in between.
t.19: And (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, and the dwellers in Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.
t.22: As also 'Ad and Thamud, and the Companions of the Rass, and many a generation between them.
t.203: And (also) ‘Âd and Thamûd, and the Dwellers of Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.
t.54: اور عادیوں اور ﺛمودیوں اور کنوئیں والوں کو اور ان کے درمیان کی بہت سی امتوں کو (ہلاک کردیا).

t.149: Thus to each We set forth parables, and each We devastated utterly.
t.84: To each (of them) We cited examples, and each of them We brought to utter ruin.
t.85: To each of them We gave warnings, and each of them We destroyed completely.
t.95: We warned each (of them) by examples (of the nations so destroyed in the past), and We totally annihilated each of them.
t.19: Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin.
t.22: To each one We set forth Parables and examples; and each one We broke to utter annihilation (for their sins).
t.203: And for each (of them) We put forward examples (as proofs and lessons), and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin (because of their disbelief and evil deeds).
t.54: اور ہم نے ان کے سامنے مثالیں بیان کیں پھر ہر ایک کو بالکل ہی تباه و برباد کردیا.

t.149: And indeed they have already come across the cityupon which was rained the woeful rain. Have they not seen it then? Rather, they did not expect any resurrection.
t.84: Indeed they (the pagans of Makkah) have passed by the town that was afflicted by an evil rain sent down to it. So, have they not been seeing it? Rather, they do not believe in Resurrection.
t.85: These disbelievers must have passed by the town that was destroyed by the terrible rain––did they not see it? Yet they do not expect to be raised from the dead.
t.95: They have surely passed by the town which was rained upon by an evil rain. Have they not seen it? Nay; but they do not believe in being raised up after death.
t.19: And indeed they have passed by the township whereon was rained the fatal rain. Can it be that they have not seen it? Nay, but they hope for no resurrection.
t.22: And the (Unbelievers) must indeed have passed by the town on which was rained a shower of evil: did they not then see it (with their own eyes)? But they fear not the Resurrection.
t.203: And indeed they have passed by the town [of Prophet Lût (Lot)] on which was rained the evil rain. Did they (disbelievers) not then see it (with their own eyes)? Nay! But they used not to expect any resurrection.
t.54: یہ لوگ اس بستی کے پاس سے بھی آتے جاتے ہیں جن پر بری طرح کی بارش برسائی گئی۔ کیا یہ پھر بھی اسے دیکھتے نہیں؟ حقیقت یہ ہے کہ انہیں مرکر جی اٹھنے کی امید ہی نہیں.

t.149: And when they see you, they take you not except in ridicule: “Is this the one Allah has sent as a messenger?
t.84: When they see you, they take you only as a laughing stock, (saying) “Is this the man whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
t.85: Whenever they see you [Prophet] they ridicule you: ‘Is this the one God has sent as a messenger?
t.95: Whenever they see you they take you for nothing else but an object of jest, saying: "Is this whom Allah has sent as a Messenger?
t.19: And when they see thee (O Muhammad) they treat thee only as a jest (saying): Is this he whom Allah sendeth as a messenger?
t.22: When they see thee, they treat thee no otherwise than in mockery: "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?"
t.203: And when they see you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), they treat you only in mockery (saying): "Is this the one whom Allâh has sent as a Messenger?
t.54: اور تمہیں جب کبھی دیکھتے ہیں تو تم سے مسخرا پن کرنے لگتے ہیں۔ کہ کیا یہی وه شخص ہیں جنہیں اللہ تعالیٰ نے رسول بنا کر بھیجا ہے.

t.149: He was about to make us stray away from our gods, had we not patiently adhered to them.” And they will eventually know, when they witness the punishment, who is further astray from the way.
t.84: He would have almost led us astray from our gods, had we not been so firm towards them.” They will know when they will see the punishment, who is farther astray in his way.
t.85: He might almost have led us astray from our gods if we had not stood so firmly by them.’ When they see the punishment, they will know who is furthest from the path.
t.95: Had we not firmly persevered in our devotion to them (he had almost) led us astray from our gods." But soon, when they see the chastisement, they will come to know who had strayed too far from the Right Way.
t.19: He would have led us far away from our gods if we had not been staunch to them. They will know, when they behold the doom, who is more astray as to the road.
t.22: "He indeed would well-nigh have misled us from our gods, had it not been that we were constant to them!" - Soon will they know, when they see the Penalty, who it is that is most misled in Path!
t.203: "He would have nearly misled us from our âlihah (gods), had it not been that we were patient and constant in their worship!" And they will know when they see the torment, who it is that is most astray from the (Right) Path!
t.54: (وه تو کہیئے) کہ ہم اس پر جمے رہے ورنہ انہوں نے تو ہمیں ہمارے معبودوں سے بہکادینے میں کوئی کسر نہیں چھوڑی تھی۔ اور یہ جب عذابوں کو دیکھیں گے تو انہیں صاف معلوم ہوجائے گا کہ پوری طرح راه سے بھٹکا ہوا کون تھا؟

t.149: Have youseen the one who took his own whim as his god? Would you be a trustee for him?
t.84: Tell me about the one who has taken his desire as his god, would you then, become a guardian for him?
t.85: Think [Prophet] of the man who has taken his own passion as a god: are you to be his guardian?
t.95: Have you ever considered the case of him who has taken his carnal desire for his god? Can you take responsibility for guiding him to the Right Way?
t.19: Hast thou seen him who chooseth for his god his own lust? Wouldst thou then be guardian over him?
t.22: Seest thou such a one as taketh for his god his own passion (or impulse)? Couldst thou be a disposer of affairs for him?
t.203: Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) seen him who has taken as his ilâh (god) his own vain desire? Would you then be a Wakîl (a disposer of his affairs or a watcher) over him?
t.54: کیا آپ نے اسے بھی دیکھا جو اپنی خواہش نفس کو اپنا معبود بنائے ہوئے ہے کیا آپ اس کے ذمہدار ہوسکتے ہیں؟

t.149: Or do youassume that most of them hear or reason? They are but like livestock; rather, they are even further astray from the way.
t.84: Or do you think that most of them listen or understand? They are but like cattle. Rather, they are even farther astray from the (right) way.
t.85: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are just like cattle- no, they are further from the path.
t.95: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? For they are merely like cattle; nay, even worse than them.
t.19: Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand? They are but as the cattle - nay, but they are farther astray?
t.22: Or thinkest thou that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle;- nay, they are worse astray in Path.
t.203: Or do you think that most of them hear or understand? They are only like cattle - nay, they are even farther astray from the Path (i.e. even worse than cattle).
t.54: کیا آپ اسی خیال میں ہیں کہ ان میں سے اکثر سنتے یا سمجھتے ہیں۔ وه تو نرے چوپایوں جیسے ہیں بلکہ ان سے بھی زیاده بھٹکے ہوئے.

t.149: Have younot seen how your Lord extended the shade? And had He willed, He could have made it still. Then We made the sun a guide to it.
t.84: Have you not observed how your Lord stretched out the shadow (of the sun)? If He so willed, He would have made it stand still. Then We made the sun an indicator for it.
t.85: Do you not see how your Lord lengthens the shade? If He had willed, He could have made it stand still- We made the sun its indicator-
t.95: Have you not seen how your Lord spreads the shade? If He will, He could have made it stationary; instead, We have made the sun its pilot.
t.19: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade - And if He willed He could have made it still - then We have made the sun its pilot;
t.22: Hast thou not turned thy vision to thy Lord?- How He doth prolong the shadow! If He willed, He could make it stationary! then do We make the sun its guide;
t.203: Have you not seen how your Lord spread the shadow. If He willed, He could have made it still - But We have made the sun its guide (i.e. after the sunrise, the shadow shrinks and vanishes at midnoon and then again appears in the afternoon with the decline of the sun, and had there been no sunlight, there would have been no shadow).
t.54: کیا آپ نے نہیں دیکھا کہ آپ کے رب نے سائے کو کس طرح پھیلا دیا ہے؟ اگر چاہتا تو اسے ٹھہرا ہوا ہی کر دیتا۔ پھر ہم نے آفتاب کو اس پر دلیل بنایا.

t.149: Then We drew it to Us easily.
t.84: Then We pulled it toward Us in a gradual manner.
t.85: but We gradually draw it towards Us, little by little.
t.95: So (as the sun rises), We gradually roll up that shade unto Us.
t.19: Then We withdraw it unto Us, a gradual withdrawal?
t.22: Then We draw it in towards Ourselves,- a contraction by easy stages.
t.203: Then We withdraw it to Us a gradual concealed withdrawal.
t.54: پھر ہم نے اسے آہستہ آہستہ اپنی طرف کھینچ لیا.

t.149: And it is He Who made the night for youas a garment and sleep for repose, and made the day a(time of) resurrection.
t.84: He is the One who has made the night an apparel for you, and the sleep a means of rest, and has made the day a means of revival.
t.85: It is He who made the night a garment for you, and sleep a rest, and made the day like a resurrection.
t.95: It is Allah Who has made night a garment for you, and sleep the repose (of death), and has made day the time of rising to life.
t.19: And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection.
t.22: And He it is Who makes the Night as a Robe for you, and Sleep as Repose, and makes the Day (as it were) a Resurrection.
t.203: And it is He Who makes the night a covering for you, and the sleep (as) a repose, and makes the day Nushûr (i.e. getting up and going about here and there for daily work, after one’s sleep at night, or like resurrection after one’s death).
t.54: اور وہی ہے جس نے رات کو تمہارے لیے پرده بنایا۔ اور نیند کو راحت بنائی۔ اور دن کو اٹھ کھڑے ہونے کا وقت.

t.149: And it is He Who sent the winds as heralds of glad tidings ahead of His mercy. And Wesent down from the sky pure water
t.84: And He is the One who has sent the winds conveying good news before His mercy, and We have sent down purifying water from the heavens,
t.85: It is He who sends the winds as heralds of good news before His Mercy. We send down pure water from the sky,
t.95: And He it is Who sends forth the winds as glad tidings, heralding His Mercy. Then We send down pure water from the sky
t.19: And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy, and We send down purifying water from the sky,
t.22: And He it is Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy, and We send down pure water from the sky,-
t.203: And it is He Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy (rain); and We send down pure water from the sky.
t.54: اور وہی ہے جو باران رحمت سے پہلے خوش خبری دینے والی ہواؤں کو بھیجتا ہے اور ہم آسمان سے پاک پانی برساتے ہیں.

t.149: to revive a lifeless land thereby, and to provide drink for a multitude of animals and humans We have created.
t.84: so that We revive a dead land therewith, and give drink to the many cattle and humans created by Us.
t.85: so that We can revive a dead land with it, and We give it as a drink to many animals and people We have created.
t.95: that We may revive through it a dead land and give it for drink to many cattle and human beings from among Our creation.
t.19: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof.
t.22: That with it We may give life to a dead land, and slake the thirst of things We have created,- cattle and men in great numbers.
t.203: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give to drink thereof many of the cattle and men that We had created.
t.54: تاکہ اس کے ذریعے سے مرده شہر کو زنده کردیں اوراسے ہم اپنی مخلوقات میں سے بہت سے چوپایوں اور انسانوں کو پلاتے ہیں.

t.149: And most surely We have circulated it among them, that they may constantly remember , yet most of mankind refused anything but constant denial.
t.84: And We have distributed it (the water) among them, so that they may take lesson. Yet most of the people refused all but ungratefulness.
t.85: Many times We have repeated this to people so that they might take heed, but most persist in their ingratitude.
t.95: We present this wondrous phenomenon to them over and over again that they may learn a lesson from it. But most people simply decline everything except disbelief and ingratitude.
t.19: And verily We have repeated it among them that they may remember, but most of mankind begrudge aught save ingratitude.
t.22: And We have distributed the (water) amongst them, in order that they may celebrate (our) praises, but most men are averse (to aught) but (rank) ingratitude.
t.203: And indeed We have distributed it (rain or water) amongst them in order that they may remember (the Grace of Allâh,) but most men (refuse to accept the Truth or Faith and) accept nothing but disbelief or ingratitude.
t.54: اور بے شک ہم نے اسےان کے درمیان طرح طرح سے بیان کیا تاکہ وه نصیحت حاصل کریں، مگر پھر بھی اکثر لوگوں نے سوائے ناشکری کے مانا نہیں.

t.149: And had We willed, We could have sent to every town a warner.
t.84: Had We so willed, We would have sent a (separate) warner for every town, (but, according to Our wisdom, We have sent Muhammad as a prophet for all these towns)
t.85: If it had been Our will, We would have sent a warner to every town,
t.95: Had We so willed, We would have raised up in every town a warner.
t.19: If We willed, We could raise up a warner in every village.
t.22: Had it been Our Will, We could have sent a warner to every centre of population.
t.203: And had We willed, We would have raised a warner in every town.
t.54: اگر ہم چاہتے تو ہر بستی میں ایک ڈرانے واﻻ بھیج دیتے.

t.149: So do not obeythe deniers, but strive against them with ita supreme striving.
t.84: So, (O Prophet,) do not obey the infidels, and strive against them with it (the Qur’ān), in utmost endeavor.
t.85: so do not give in to the disbelievers: strive hard against them with this Quran.
t.95: So, (O Prophet), do not follow the unbelievers but engage in a mighty striving against them with this Qur'an.
t.19: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them herewith with a great endeavour.
t.22: Therefore listen not to the Unbelievers, but strive against them with the utmost strenuousness, with the (Qur'an).
t.203: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them (by preaching) with the utmost endeavour with it (the Qur’ân).
t.54: پس آپ کافروں کا کہنا نہ مانیں اور قرآن کے ذریعے ان سے پوری طاقت سے بڑا جہاد کریں.

t.149: And it is He Who merged the two seas, this one fresh and sweet and this one salty and bitter, and He made between them a barrier and an insurmountable separator.
t.84: He is the One who joined the two seas, so as this is sweet, very sweet, and this is bitter, very bitter, and made between them a buffer and an insurmountable barrier.
t.85: It is He who released the two bodies of flowing water, one sweet and fresh and the other salty and bitter, and put an insurmountable barrier between them.
t.95: And He it is Who has joined the two seas: one sweet and palatable and the other saltish and bitter; and He has set a barrier and an insurmountable obstruction between the two that keeps them apart.
t.19: And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them.
t.22: It is He Who has let free the two bodies of flowing water: One palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter; yet has He made a barrier between them, a partition that is forbidden to be passed.
t.203: And it is He Who has let free the two seas (kinds of water): this is palatable and sweet, and that is salt and bitter; and He has set a barrier and a complete partition between them.
t.54: اور وہی ہے جس نے دو سمندر آپس میں ملا رکھے ہیں، یہ ہے میٹھا اور مزیدار اور یہ ہے کھاری کڑوا، اور ان دونوں کے درمیان ایک حجاب اور مضبوط اوٹ کردی.

t.149: And it is He Who created of water a human being, then made him related by lineage and marriage. And yourLord has always been All-Able.
t.84: And He is the One who created man from water, then made of him relations created by lineage and relations created by marriage. Your Lord is All-Powerful.
t.85: It is He who creates human beings from fluid, then makes them kin by blood and marriage: your Lord is all powerful!
t.95: And He it is Who has created man from water and then produced from him two sorts of kindred: by descent and by marriage. Your Lord is All-Powerful.
t.19: And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful.
t.22: It is He Who has created man from water: then has He established relationships of lineage and marriage: for thy Lord has power (over all things).
t.203: And it is He Who has created man from water, and has appointed for him kindred by blood, and kindred by marriage. And your Lord is Ever All-Powerful to do what He wills.
t.54: وه ہے جس نے پانی سے انسان کو پیدا کیا، پھر اسے نسب واﻻ اور سسرالی رشتوں واﻻ کردیا۔ بلاشبہ آپ کا پروردگار (ہر چیز پر) قادر ہے.

t.149: Yet they worship, apart from Allah, what neither benefits them nor harms them. And the denier has always been a backup against his Lord.
t.84: They worship, instead of Allah, what can neither give them any benefit nor can cause them any harm. The disbeliever is always a supporter (of Satan) against his Lord.
t.85: Yet instead of God they worship things that can neither benefit nor harm them: the disbeliever has always turned his back on his Lord.
t.95: And yet people worship deities other than Allah that can neither benefit them nor hurt them. Besides, the unbeliever is ever prone to come to the support of everyone who rebels against his Lord.
t.19: Yet they worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them nor hurt them. The disbeliever was ever a partisan against his Lord.
t.22: Yet do they worship, besides Allah, things that can neither profit them nor harm them: and the Misbeliever is a helper (of Evil), against his own Lord!
t.203: And they (disbelievers, polytheists) worship besides Allâh that which can neither profit them nor harm them; and the disbeliever is ever a helper (of the Satan) against his Lord.
t.54: یہ اللہ کو چھوڑ کر ان کی عبادت کرتے ہیں جو نہ تو انہیں کوئی نفع دے سکیں نہ کوئی نقصان پہنچاسکیں، اور کافر تو ہے ہی اپنے رب کے خلاف (شیطان کی) مدد کرنے واﻻ.

t.149: And We have not sent you but as a bearer of glad tidings and as a warner.
t.84: We did not send you but as a bearer of good news and as a warner.
t.85: We sent you only to give good news and warning.
t.95: We have not sent you, (O Muhammad), except as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
t.19: And We have sent thee (O Muhammad) only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
t.22: But thee We only sent to give glad tidings and admonition.
t.203: And We have sent you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) only as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.
t.54: ہم نے تو آپ کو خوشخبری اور ڈر سنانے واﻻ (نبی) بنا کر بھیجا ہے.

t.149: Say, “I ask of you no reward for this—only that whoever wills may take a way to his Lord.”
t.84: Say, “I do not demand from you any return, except that one should adopt the (proper) way to his Lord, if he so wills.
t.85: Say, ‘I am not asking for any reward for it, but anyone who wishes should take a path to his Lord.’
t.95: Say to them: "I ask of you no reward for my work. My only reward is that whoever so wills may follow the way leading to His Lord."71a
t.19: Say: I ask of you no reward for this, save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord.
t.22: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for it but this: that each one who will may take a (straight) Path to his Lord."
t.203: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this (that which I have brought from my Lord and its preaching), save that whosoever wills may take a Path to his Lord.
t.54: کہہ دیجئے کہ میں قرآن کے پہنچانے پر تم سے کوئی بدلہ نہیں چاہتا مگر جو شخص اپنے رب کی طرف راه پکڑنا چاہے.

t.149: And place yourtrust in the Ever-Living One Who never dies, and exalt Him with praise. And sufficient is He as the All-Aware of the misdeeds of His servants.
t.84: And place your trust in the Ever-Living who cannot die, and proclaim His purity along with His praise. Enough is He to be aware of the sins of His servants,
t.85: Put your trust in the Living [God] who never dies, and celebrate His praise. He knows the sins of His servants well enough:
t.95: (O Muhammad), put your trust in Him Who is Ever-Living, Who will never die, and glorify Him with His praise. He suffices as the Knower of the sins of His servants,
t.19: And trust thou in the Living One Who dieth not, and hymn His praise. He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen's sins,
t.22: And put thy trust in Him Who lives and dies not; and celebrate his praise; and enough is He to be acquainted with the faults of His servants;-
t.203: And put your trust (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) in the Ever Living One Who dies not, and glorify His Praises, and Sufficient is He as the All-Knower of the sins of His slaves,
t.54: اس ہمیشہ زنده رہنے والے اللہ تعالیٰ پر توکل کریں جسے کبھی موت نہیں اور اس کی تعریف کے ساتھ پاکیزگی بیان کرتے رہیں، وه اپنے بندوں کے گناہوں سے کافی خبردار ہے.

t.149: The One Who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six daysthen settled on the Throne. The All-Merciful. So ask about Him one(who is) well aware.
t.84: the One who created in six days the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them, then He positioned Himself on the Throne. (He is) the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah). So ask about Him someone who knows.
t.85: it is He who created the heavens and earth and what is between them in six Days, and then established Himself on the throne- He is the Lord of Mercy; He is the Best Informed.
t.95: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them in six days, and then ascended the Throne; the Merciful One. Ask concerning Him the one who knows.
t.19: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days, then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask anyone informed concerning Him!
t.22: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between, in six days, and is firmly established on the Throne (of Authority): Allah Most Gracious: ask thou, then, about Him of any acquainted (with such things).
t.203: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days. Then He (Istawâ ) rose over the Throne (in a manner that suits His Majesty). The Most Gracious (Allâh)! Ask Him (O Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , concerning His Qualities: His rising over His Throne, His creations, etc.), as He is Al-Khabîr (The All-Knower of everything i.e. Allâh).
t.54: وہی ہے جس نے آسمانوں اور زمین اوران کے درمیان کی سب چیزوں کو چھ دن میں پیدا کردیا ہے، پھر عرش پر مستوی ہوا، وه رحمٰن ہے، آپ اس کے بارے میں کسی خبردار سے پوچھ لیں.

t.149: And when it is said to them, “Prostrate yourselves to the All-Merciful,” they say, “And what is the All-Merciful? Shall we prostrate ourselves to what you command us?” And it increases their aversion.
t.84: And when it is said to them, “Prostrate yourselves to the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah),” they say “What is RaHmān? Shall we prostrate ourselves to the one to whom you direct us?” And it increases nothing in them except aversion.
t.85: Yet when they are told, ‘Bow down before the Lord of Mercy,’ they say, ‘What is the Lord of Mercy? Should we bow down before anything you command?’ and they turn even further away.
t.95: When they are told: "Prostrate yourselves before the Merciful One," they say: "What is the Merciful One? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whomsoever you command us to prostrate?" This even further increases their aversion.
t.19: And when it is said unto them: Prostrate to the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent? Are we to prostrate to whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us? And it increaseth aversion in them.
t.22: When it is said to them, "Prostrate to (Allah) Most Gracious!", they say, "And what is (Allah) Most Gracious? Shall we prostrate to that which thou commandest us?" And it increases their flight (from the Truth).
t.203: And when it is said to them: "Prostrate yourselves to the Most Gracious (Allâh)! they say: "And what is the Most Gracious? Shall we fall down in prostration to that which you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) command us?" And it increases in them only aversion.
t.54: ان سے جب بھی کہا جاتا ہے کہ رحمٰن کو سجده کرو تو جواب دیتے ہیں رحمٰن ہے کیا؟ کیا ہم اسے سجده کریں جس کا تو ہمیں حکم دے رہا ہے اور اس (تبلیﻎ) نےان کی نفرت میں مزید اضافہ کردیا.

t.149: Supremely Blessed be the One Who placed constellations in the sky and placed in it a lamp and an illuminating moon.
t.84: Glorious is the One who made stellar formations in the sky, and placed therein a lamp (i.e. the sun) and a bright moon.
t.85: Exalted is He who put constellations in the heavens, a radiant light, and an illuminating moon-
t.95: Most blessed is He Who set a constellation in the heavens, and placed in it a great lamp and a shining moon.
t.19: Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light!
t.22: Blessed is He Who made constellations in the skies, and placed therein a Lamp and a Moon giving light;
t.203: Blessed be He Who has placed in the heaven big stars, and has placed therein a great lamp (sun), and a moon giving light.
t.54: بابرکت ہے وه جس نے آسمان میں برج بنائے اور اس میں آفتاب بنایا اور منور مہتاب بھی.

t.149: And it is He Who made the night and the day alternate—for whoever wants to constantly remember or wants to give constant thanks.
t.84: And He is the One who made the day and the night following each other, for the one who wishes to be mindful or wishes to show gratitude.
t.85: it is He who made the night and day follow each other- so anyone who wishes may be mindful or show gratitude.
t.95: He it is Who has appointed night and day to succeed one another (as a Sign) for him who desires to take heed, or desires to be thankful.
t.19: And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness.
t.22: And it is He Who made the Night and the Day to follow each other: for such as have the will to celebrate His praises or to show their gratitude.
t.203: And He it is Who has put the night and the day in succession, for such who desires to remember or desires to show his gratitude.
t.54: اور اسی نے رات اور دن کو ایک دوسرے کے پیچھے آنے جانے واﻻ بنایا۔ اس شخص کی نصیحت کے لیے جو نصیحت حاصل کرنے یا شکر گزاری کرنے کا اراده رکھتا ہو.

t.149: And the servants of the All-Merciful are those who walk the earth gently, and when the ignorant harassers address them, they say, “Peace.”
t.84: The servants of the RaHmān (the All-Merciful, Allah) are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the ignorant people speak to them, they reply peacefully,
t.85: The servants of the Lord of Mercy are those who walk humbly on the earth, and who, when the foolish address them, reply, ‘Peace’;
t.95: The true servants of the Merciful One are those who walk on the earth gently and when the foolish ones address them, they simply say: "Peace to you";
t.19: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;
t.22: And the servants of (Allah) Most Gracious are those who walk on the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, "Peace!";
t.203: And the (faithful) slaves of the Most Gracious (Allâh) are those who walk on the earth in humility and sedateness, and when the foolish address them (with bad words) they reply back with mild words of gentleness.
t.54: رحمٰن کے (سچے) بندے وه ہیں جو زمین پر فروتنی کے ساتھ چلتے ہیں اور جب بے علم لوگ ان سے باتیں کرنے لگتے ہیں تو وه کہہ دیتے ہیں کہ سلام ہے.

t.149: And they are those who spend the night prostrating themselves to their Lord and standing(in prayer) .
t.84: and those who pass the night prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord,
t.85: those who spend the night bowed down or standing, worshipping their Lord,
t.95: who spend the night prostrating themselves before their Lord and standing;
t.19: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing,
t.22: Those who spend the night in adoration of their Lord prostrate and standing;
t.203: And those who spend the night in worship of their Lord, prostrate and standing.
t.54: اور جو اپنے رب کے سامنے سجدے اور قیام کرتے ہوئے راتیں گزار دیتے ہیں.

t.149: And they are those who say, ‘‘Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell; indeed, its suffering has been ever adhering;
t.84: and those who say, “Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Jahannam (the Hell); indeed, its punishment is a persisting affliction.”
t.85: who plead, ‘Our Lord, turn away from us the suffering of Hell, for it is a dreadful torment to suffer!
t.95: who entreat: "Our Lord! Ward off from us the chastisement of Hell, for its chastisement is one that clings.
t.19: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;
t.22: Those who say, "Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous,-
t.203: And those who say: "Our Lord! Avert from us the torment of Hell. Verily its torment is ever an inseparable, permanent punishment."
t.54: اور جو یہ دعا کرتے ہیں کہ اے ہمارے پروردگار! ہم سے دوزخ کا عذاب پرے ہی پرے رکھ، کیونکہ اس کا عذاب چمٹ جانے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: it is indeed bad as a residence and dwelling place.”
t.84: Indeed, it is evil as an abode and a place to dwell in
t.85: It is an evil home, a foul resting place!’
t.95: Verily it is a wretched abode and restingplace."
t.19: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;
t.22: "Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in";
t.203: Evil indeed it (Hell) is as an abode and as a place to rest in.
t.54: بے شک وه ٹھہرنے اور رہنے کے لحاظ سے بدترین جگہ ہے.

t.149: And they are those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor stingy, for the upright method has always been between both.
t.84: - and those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor miserly, and it (i.e. their spending) is moderate in between (the two extremes,)
t.85: They are those who are neither wasteful nor niggardly when they spend, but keep to a just balance;
t.95: (The true servants of the Merciful One are) those who are neither extravagant nor niggardly in their spending but keep the golden mean between the two;
t.19: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;
t.22: Those who, when they spend, are not extravagant and not niggardly, but hold a just (balance) between those (extremes);
t.203: And those who, when they spend, are neither extravagant nor niggardly, but hold a medium (way) between those (extremes).
t.54: اور جو خرچ کرتے وقت بھی نہ تو اسراف کرتے ہیں نہ بخیلی، بلکہ ان دونوں کے درمیان معتدل طریقے پر خرچ کرتے ہیں.

t.149: And they are those who do not call upon any other god with Allah and do not kill the self which Allah has made inviolable—except in the pursuit of justice—and do not fornicate. And whoever does that encounters penalties.
t.84: - and those who do not invoke any other god along with Allah, and do not kill a person whom Allah has given sanctity, except rightfully, nor do they fornicate; and whoever does it, shall face the recompense of his sin,
t.85: those who never invoke any other deity beside God, nor take a life, which God has made sacred, except in the pursuit of justice, nor commit adultery. (Whoever does these things will face the penalties:
t.95: who invoke no other deity along with Allah, nor take any life - which Allah has forbidden - save justly; who do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse - and whoso does that shall meet its penalty;
t.19: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;
t.22: Those who invoke not, with Allah, any other god, nor slay such life as Allah has made sacred except for just cause, nor commit fornication; - and any that does this (not only) meets punishment.
t.203: And those who invoke not any other ilâh (god) along with Allâh, nor kill such person as Allâh has forbidden, except for just cause, nor commit illegal sexual intercourse - and whoever does this shall receive the punishment.
t.54: اور اللہ کے ساتھ کسی دوسرے معبود کو نہیں پکارتے اور کسی ایسے شخص کو جسے قتل کرنا اللہ تعالیٰ نے منع کردیا ہو وه بجز حق کے قتل نہیں کرتے، نہ وه زنا کے مرتکب ہوتے ہیں اور جو کوئی یہ کام کرے وه اپنے اوپر سخت وبال ﻻئے گا.

t.149: The punishment is doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he abides therein humiliated—
t.84: the punishment will be doubled for him, and he will remain there disdained, for ever,
t.85: their torment will be doubled on the Day of Resurrection, and they will remain in torment, disgraced,
t.95: his torment shall be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide in it in ignominy -
t.19: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;
t.22: (But) the Penalty on the Day of Judgment will be doubled to him, and he will dwell therein in ignominy,-
t.203: The torment will be doubled to him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein in disgrace;
t.54: اسے قیامت کے دن دوہرا عذاب کیا جائے گا اور وه ذلت و خواری کے ساتھ ہمیشہ اسی میں رہے گا.

t.149: except for whoever has repented and has attained faith and has done righteous work, for those—Allah replaces their evil deeds with good deeds. And Allah has always been Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
t.84: except the one who repents and believes and does good deeds, then Allah will replace the evils of such people by good deeds, and Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
t.85: except those who repent, believe, and do good deeds: God will change the evil deeds of such people into good ones. He is most forgiving, most merciful.
t.95: unless he repents and believes and does righteous works. For such, Allah will change their evil deeds into good deeds. Allah is Ever Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
t.19: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
t.22: Unless he repents, believes, and works righteous deeds, for Allah will change the evil of such persons into good, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful,
t.203: Except those who repent and believe (in Islâmic Monotheism), and do righteous deeds; for those, Allâh will change their sins into good deeds, and Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.54: سوائے ان لوگوں کے جو توبہ کریں اور ایمان ﻻئیں اور نیک کام کریں، ایسے لوگوں کے گناہوں کو اللہ تعالیٰ نیکیوں سے بدل دیتا ہے، اللہ بخشنے واﻻ مہربانی کرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And whoever has repented and has acted righteously, then surely he repents to Allah a true repentance.
t.84: Whoever repents and does righteous deeds turns to Allah truly
t.85: People who repent and do good deeds truly return to God.)
t.95: Whosoever repents and does good, he returns to Allah in the manner that he should.
t.19: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -
t.22: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah with an (acceptable) conversion;-
t.203: And whosoever repents and does righteous good deeds; then verily, he repents towards Allâh with true repentance.
t.54: اور جو شخص توبہ کرے اور نیک عمل کرے وه تو (حقیقتاً) اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف سچا رجوع کرتا ہے.

t.149: And they are those who do not bear false witness, and when they come across idle talk, they pass by with dignity.
t.84: - and those who do not witness falsehood, and when they pass by the absurd things, Pass by them with dignity,
t.85: [The servants of the Lord of Mercy are] those who do not give false testimony, and who, when they see some frivolity, pass by with dignity;
t.95: (The true servants of the Merciful One) are those who do not bear witness to any falsehood and who, when they pass by frivolity, pass by it with dignity;
t.19: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.
t.22: Those who witness no falsehood, and, if they pass by futility, they pass by it with honourable (avoidance);
t.203: And those who do not bear witness to falsehood, and if they pass by some evil play or evil talk, they pass by it with dignity.
t.54: اور جو لوگ جھوٹی گواہی نہیں دیتے اور جب کسی لغو چیز پر ان کا گزر ہوتا ہے تو شرافت سے گزر جاتے ہیں.

t.149: And they are those who, when reminded of the signsof their Lord, do not fall before them deaf and blind.
t.84: and those who, when they are reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall at them as deaf and blind ones,
t.85: who, when reminded of their Lord’s signs, do not turn a deaf ear and a blind eye to them;
t.95: who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, do not fall at them deaf and blind;
t.19: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
t.22: Those who, when they are admonished with the Signs of their Lord, droop not down at them as if they were deaf or blind;
t.203: And those who, when they are reminded of the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
t.54: اور جب انہیں ان کے رب کے کلام کی آیتیں سنائی جاتی ہیں تو وه اندھے بہرے ہو کر ان پر نہیں گرتے۔.

t.149: And they are those who say, “Our Lord, grant us in our spouses and our offspring(s) a comfort to the eyes, and make us a good example of the ones who were mindful(of God) .”
t.84: - and those who say, “Our Lord, Give us, from our spouses and our children, comfort of eyes, and make us heads of the God-fearing.”
t.85: those who pray, ‘Our Lord, give us joy in our spouses and offspring. Make us good examples to those who are aware of You’.
t.95: who are prone to pray: "Our Lord! Grant us that our spouses and our offspring be a joy to our eyes, and do make us the leaders of the God-fearing."
t.19: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).
t.22: And those who pray, "Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous."
t.203: And those who say: "Our Lord! Bestow on us from our wives and our offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders of the Muttaqûn(the pious. See V.2:2)."
t.54: اور یہ دعا کرتے ہیں کہ اے ہمارے پروردگار! تو ہمیں ہماری بیویوں اور اوﻻد سے آنکھوں کی ٹھنڈک عطا فرما اور ہمیں پرہیزگاروں کا پیشوا بنا.

t.149: Those are awarded the Chamber(in Heaven) for their patience, and are received therein with greetings and peace,
t.84: Such people will be rewarded with the high place - because they observed patience - and will be received therein with prayers of their eternal life and peace,
t.85: These servants will be rewarded with the highest place in Paradise for their steadfastness. There they will be met with greetings and peace.
t.95: They are the ones who will be rewarded for their patience: lofty palaces will be granted to them, and they will be received with greeting and salutation.
t.19: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,
t.22: Those are the ones who will be rewarded with the highest place in heaven, because of their patient constancy: therein shall they be met with salutations and peace,
t.203: Those will be rewarded with the highest place (in Paradise) because of their patience. Therein they shall be met with greetings and the word of peace and respect.
t.54: یہی وه لوگ ہیں جنہیں ان کے صبر کے بدلے جنت کے بلند و باﻻخانے دیئے جائیں گے جہاں انہیں دعا سلام پہنچایا جائے گا.

t.149: abiding therein—an excellent residence and dwelling place.
t.84: living in it (the Paradise) for ever. It is best as an abode and as a place to dwell in.
t.85: There they will stay- a happy home and resting place!
t.95: Therein they shall abide for ever: how good an abode, and how good a resting-place!
t.19: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!
t.22: Dwelling therein;- how beautiful an abode and place of rest!
t.203: Abiding therein - excellent it is as an abode, and as a place to rest in.
t.54: اس میں یہ ہمیشہ رہیں گے، وه بہت ہی اچھی جگہ اور عمده مقام ہے.

t.149: Say, “What are youto my Lord without your calling upon Him? But you have certainly disbelieved, so the inevitable is bound to come.”
t.84: Say (O Prophet), “My Lord will never care about you, if you will not invoke Him. Now since you rejected (the truth), the punishment will be inseparable from you.”
t.85: [Prophet, tell the disbelievers], ‘What are you to my Lord without your supplication? But since you have written offthe truth as lies, the inevitable will happen.’
t.95: Say to them (O Muhammad): "My Lord would not care for you were it not for your prayer. But now that you have given the lie to (the Message of Allah), an inextricable punishment shall soon come upon you."
t.19: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.
t.22: Say (to the Rejecters): "My Lord is not uneasy because of you if ye call not on Him: But ye have indeed rejected (Him), and soon will come the inevitable (punishment)!"
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to the disbelievers): "My Lord pays attention to you only because of your invocation to Him. But now you have indeed denied (Him). So the torment will be yours for ever (inseparable, permanent punishment)."
t.54: کہہ دیجئے! اگر تمہاری دعا التجا (پکارنا) نہ ہوتی تو میرا رب تمہاری مطلق پروا نہ کرتا، تم تو جھٹلا چکے اب عنقریب اس کی سزا تمہیں چمٹ جانے والی ہوگی.

t.149: Tâ Sîn Mīm.
t.84: Tā sīn mīm.
t.85: Ta Sin Mim
t.95: Ta'. Sin. Mim.
t.19: Ta. Sin. Mim.
t.22: Ta. Sin. Mim.
t.203: Tâ-Sîn-Mîm.
t.54: طٰسم.

t.149: Those are the signs of the Evident Scripture.
t.84: These are the verses of the manifest Book.
t.85: These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear:
t.95: These are the verses of the Clear Book.
t.19: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
t.22: These are verses of the Book that makes (things) clear.
t.203: These are the Verses of the manifest Book [(this Qur’ân), which was promised by Allâh in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), makes things clear].
t.54: یہ آیتیں روشن کتاب کی ہیں.*

t.149: Perhaps youare going to destroy yourself with sorrow because they do not believe?
t.84: (O Prophet,) perhaps you are going to let yourself collapse in grief because they do not believe.
t.85: [Prophet], are you going to worry yourself to death because they will not believe?
t.95: (O Muhammad), you will perhaps grieve yourself to death because these people do not believe.
t.19: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.
t.22: It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers.
t.203: It may be that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are going to kill yourself with grief, that they do not become believers [in your Risalah (Messengership) i.e. in your Message of Islâmic Monotheism].
t.54: ان کے ایمان نہ ﻻنے پر شاید آپ تو اپنی جان کھودیں گے.

t.149: If We will, We can bestow upon them a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay bent in humility.
t.84: If We so will, We can send down to them a sign from the sky, for which their necks will stay bent in submission.
t.85: If We had wished, We could have sent them down a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in utter humility.
t.95: If We will, We can send down a Sign to them from heaven, so their necks will be humbled to it.
t.19: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
t.22: If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them from the sky a Sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
t.203: If We will, We could send down to them from the heaven a sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
t.54: اگر ہم چاہتے تو ان پر آسمان سے کوئی ایسی نشانی اتارتے کہ جس کے سامنے ان کی گردنیں خم ہو جاتیں.
