t.149: But no fresh reminder comes to them from the All-Merciful but they disregard it.
t.84: Never a new message comes to them from the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah), but they become averse to it.
t.85: Whenever they are brought a new revelation from the Lord of Mercy, they turn away:
t.95: Never does there come to them an admonition from the Merciful Lord but they turn away from it.
t.19: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.
t.22: But there comes not to them a newly-revealed Message from (Allah) Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom.
t.203: And never comes there unto them a Reminder as a recent revelation from the Most Gracious (Allâh), but they turn away therefrom.
t.54: اور ان کے پاس رحمٰن کی طرف سے جو بھی نئی نصیحت آئی یہ اس سے روگردانی کرنے والے بن گئے.

t.149: Thus they have certainly disbelieved, but soon will come to them the tidings of what they used to ridicule.
t.84: Thus they rejected (the Truth); well, soon will come to them the real descriptions of what they used to ridicule.
t.85: they deny it, but the truth of what they scorned will soon hit them.
t.95: They will soon come to know the truth of that which they have been scoffing at.
t.19: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.
t.22: They have indeed rejected (the Message): so they will know soon (enough) the truth of what they mocked at!
t.203: So they have indeed denied (the truth - this Qur’ân), then the news of what they mocked at will come to them.
t.54: ان لوگوں نے جھٹلایا ہے اب ان کے پاس جلدی سے اس کی خبریں آجائیں گی جس کے ساتھ وه مسخرا پن کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: Have they not seen the land— how many noble kinds of plants We have germinated therein?
t.84: Have they not looked at the earth, how many of the noble pairs (of vegetation) We have caused to grow in it?
t.85: Do they not see the earth, and what noble kinds of thing We grow in it?
t.95: Do they not look at the earth, how We caused a variety of fine vegetation to grow from it (in abundance)?
t.19: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?
t.22: Do they not look at the earth,- how many noble things of all kinds We have produced therein?
t.203: Do they not observe the earth - how much of every good kind We cause to grow therein?
t.54: کیا انہوں نے زمین پر نظریں نہیں ڈالیں؟ کہ ہم نے اس میں ہر طرح کے نفیس جوڑے کس قدر اگائے ہیں؟

t.149: Indeed, in that is a sign, and in no way were most of them believers.
t.84: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,
t.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
t.95: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.
t.19: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
t.22: Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
t.203: Verily, in this is an Ayâh (proof or sign), yet most of them (polytheists, pagans who do not believe in Resurrection) are not believers.
t.54: بے شک اس میں یقیناً نشانی ہے اور ان میں کے اکثر لوگ مومن نہیں ہیں.

t.149: And indeed, it is yourLord who is surely the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
t.84: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.
t.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
t.95: Verily Your Lord is Infinitely Mighty, Most Compassionate.
t.19: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t.22: And verily, thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
t.203: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
t.54: اور تیرا رب یقیناً وہی غالب اور مہربان ہے.

t.149: And recall when Your Lord called to Moses, “Go to the unjust people—
t.84: (Remember) when your Lord called Mūsā saying, “Go to the transgressing people,
t.85: Your Lord called to Moses: ‘Go to those wrongdoers,
t.95: (Recount to them about the time) when Your Lord called Moses: "Go to the wrong-doing people,
t.19: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,
t.22: Behold, thy Lord called Moses: "Go to the people of iniquity,-
t.203: And (remember) when your Lord called Mûsâ (Moses) (saying): "Go to the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) -
t.54: اور جب آپ کے رب نے موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کو آواز دی کہ تو ﻇالم قوم کے پاس جا.

t.149: the people of Pharaoh. Will they never be mindful?”
t.84: the people of Pharaoh. Do they not fear Allah?”
t.85: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not take heed?’
t.95: the people of Pharaoh: do they have no fear?"
t.19: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?
t.22: "The people of the Pharaoh: will they not fear Allah?"
t.203: "The people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh): Will they not fear Allâh and become righteous?"
t.54: قوم فرعون کے پاس، کیا وه پرہیزگاری نہ کریں گے.

t.149: He said, “My Lord, I fear that they will disbelieve me.
t.84: He (Mūsā) said, “My Lord, I fear that they will reject me.
t.85: Moses said, ‘My Lord, I fear they will call me a liar,
t.95: He said: "My Lord! I fear that they will brand me a liar.
t.19: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
t.22: He said: "O my Lord! I do fear that they will charge me with falsehood:
t.203: He said: "My Lord! Verily, I fear that they will belie me,
t.54: موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) نے کہا میرے پروردگار! مجھے تو خوف ہے کہ کہیں وه مجھے جھٹلا (نہ) دیں.

t.149: And my chest tightens and my tongue is not fluent, so send for Aaron(too) .
t.84: My heart gets straitened, and my tongue is not fluent; so send for Hārūn.
t.85: and I will feel stressed and tongue-tied, so send Aaron too;
t.95: My breast is constricted and my tongue is not fluent, so endow Messengership on Aaron.
t.19: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).
t.22: "My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (smoothly): so send unto Aaron.
t.203: "And my breast straitens, and my tongue expresses not well. So send for Hârûn (Aaron) (to come along with me).
t.54: اور میرا سینہ تنگ ہو رہا ہے میری زبان چل نہیں رہی پس تو ہارون کی طرف بھی وحی بھیج.

t.149: And they hold(a charge of) a misdeed against me, so I fear they will kill me.”
t.84: Moreover, they have (leveled) a charge of offence against me, and I fear they will kill me;”
t.85: besides, they have a chargeagainst me, and I fear they may kill me.’
t.95: As for me, they hold the charge of a crime against me. I fear they will put me to death."
t.19: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.
t.22: "And (further), they have a charge of crime against me; and I fear they may slay me."
t.203: "And they have a charge of crime against me, and I fear they will kill me."
t.54: اور ان کا مجھ پر میرے ایک قصور کا (دعویٰ) بھی ہے مجھے ڈر ہے کہ کہیں وه مجھے مار نہ ڈالیں.

t.149: He said, “By no means! So go, with Our signs; We are with you, listening.
t.84: He (Allah) said, “Never! (They will not be able to kill you.) So go, both of you, with Our signs. We are with you, listening (to the conversation you will have with him.)
t.85: God said, ‘No [they will not]. Go, both of you, with Our signs––We shall be with you, listen-ing.
t.95: He said: "Certainly not! So go both of you with Our Signs. We shall be with you listening to everything.
t.19: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.
t.22: Allah said: "By no means! proceed then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you, and will listen (to your call).
t.203: (Allâh) said: "Nay! Go you both with Our Signs. Verily We shall be with you, listening.
t.54: جناب باری نے فرمایا! ہرگز ایسا نہ ہوگا، تم دونوں ہماری نشانیاں لے کر جاؤ ہم خود سننے والے تمہارے ساتھ ہیں.

t.149: So goto Pharaoh and say, ‘We are indeed the Messenger of the Lord of all realms:
t.84: So go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, ‘We both are messengers of the Lord of all the worlds,
t.85: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, “We bring a message from the Lord of the Worlds:
t.95: Go, then, to Pharaoh and say to him: 'The Lord of the Universe has sent us
t.19: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,
t.22: "So go forth, both of you, to Pharaoh, and say: 'We have been sent by the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds;
t.203: "And go both of you to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and say: ‘We are the Messengers of the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),
t.54: تم دونوں فرعون کے پاس جاکر کہو کہ بلاشبہ ہم رب العالمین کے بھیجے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: send the Children of Israel with us.’”
t.84: (sent with the message) that you must send the children of Isrā’īl with us’”.
t.85: let the Children of Israel leave with us.” ’
t.95: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.'"
t.19: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.
t.22: "'Send thou with us the Children of Israel.'"
t.203: "So allow the Children of Israel to go with us.’ "
t.54: کہ تو ہمارے ساتھ بنی اسرائیل کو روانہ کردے.

t.149: He said, “Did we not raise youamong us as a child, and you stayed among us for many years of your life?
t.84: He (Pharaoh) said, “Did we not nourish you among us as a child? And you remained amidst us for years,
t.85: Pharaoh said, ‘Did we not bring you up as a child among us? Did you not stay with us for many years?
t.95: Pharaoh said: "Did we not bring you up among us when you were a child?
t.19: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,
t.22: (Pharaoh) said: "Did we not cherish thee as a child among us, and didst thou not stay in our midst many years of thy life?
t.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said [to Mûsâ (Moses)]: "Did we not bring you up among us as a child? And you did dwell many years of your life with us.
t.54: فرعون نے کہا کہ کیا ہم نے تجھے تیرے بچپن کے زمانہ میں اپنے ہاں نہیں پاﻻ تھا؟ اور تو نے اپنی عمر کے بہت سے سال ہم میں نہیں گزارے؟

t.149: And youcommitted that base deed of yours that you committed while you were one of the deniers.”
t.84: and you did the blunder you did; still you are ungrateful.”
t.85: And then you committed that crime of yours: you were so ungrateful.’
t.95: You spent many years of your life among us and then you committed that deed of yours. You are very ungrateful indeed."
t.19: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.
t.22: "And thou didst a deed of thine which (thou knowest) thou didst, and thou art an ungrateful (wretch)!"
t.203: "And you did your deed, which you did (i.e. the crime of killing a man) while you were one of the ingrates."
t.54: پھر تو اپنا وه کام کر گیا جو کر گیا اور تو ناشکروں میں ہے.

t.149: He said, “I did it then while I was one of those astray.
t.84: He said, “I did that at a time when I was mistaken.
t.85: Moses replied, ‘I was misguided when I did it
t.95: Moses replied: "I committed that act erringly.
t.19: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.
t.22: Moses said: "I did it then, when I was in error.
t.203: Mûsâ (Moses) said: "I did it then, when I was ignorant (as regards my Lord and His Message).
t.54: (حضرت) موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) نے جواب دیا کہ میں نے اس کام کو اس وقت کیا تھا جبکہ میں راه بھولے ہوئے لوگوں میں سے تھا.

t.149: And I fled from youwhen I feared you, then my Lord gave me wise judgment and made me one of the emissaries.
t.84: Then I fled away from you when I feared you. Thereafter my Lord granted wisdom to me, and made me one of the messengers.
t.85: and I fled from you in fear; later my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of His messengers.
t.95: Then I fled for fear of you. Then my Lord bestowed wisdom and authority on me and made me one of the Messengers.
t.19: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).
t.22: "So I fled from you (all) when I feared you; but my Lord has (since) invested me with judgment (and wisdom) and appointed me as one of the messengers.
t.203: "So I fled from you when I feared you. But my Lord has granted me Hukm (i.e. religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood), and made me one of the Messengers.
t.54: پھر تم سے خوف کھا کر میں تم میں سے بھاگ گیا، پھر مجھے میرے رب نے حکم و علم عطا فرمایا اور مجھے اپنے پیغمبروں میں سے کر دیا.

t.149: And is that a favor youremind me of: that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?”
t.84: As for the favor with which you are obliging me, it is that you have enslaved the children of Isrā’īl.”
t.85: And is this- that you have enslaved the Children of Israel- the favour with which you reproach me?’
t.95: Now this is the favour that you tauntingly remind me of: that you enslaved the Children of Israel!"
t.19: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.
t.22: "And this is the favour with which thou dost reproach me,- that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel!"
t.203: "And this is the past favour with which you reproach me: that you have enslaved the Children of Israel."
t.54: مجھ پر تیرا کیا یہی وه احسان ہے؟ جسے تو جتا رہا ہے جبکہ تو نے بنی اسرائیل کو غلام بنا رکھا ہے.

t.149: Pharaoh said, “And what is the Lord of all realms?”
t.84: Pharaoh said, “What is the Lord of the worlds?”
t.85: Pharaoh asked, ‘What is this “Lord of the Worlds”?’
t.95: Pharaoh said: "And who is this Lord of the Universe?"
t.19: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?
t.22: Pharaoh said: "And what is the 'Lord and Cherisher of the worlds'?"
t.203: Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) said: "And what is the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?"
t.54: فرعون نے کہا رب العالمین کیا (چیز) ہے؟

t.149: He said, “The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, if you(can ever) believe with certitude.”
t.84: He (Mūsā) said, “Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever there is between them, if you are to believe”
t.85: Moses replied, ‘He is the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them. If you would only have faith!’
t.95: Moses answered: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them, if you were only to believe."
t.19: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.
t.22: (Moses) said: "The Lord and Cherisher of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- if ye want to be quite sure."
t.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, if you seek to be convinced with certainty."
t.54: (حضرت) موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) نے فرمایا وه آسمانوں اور زمین اور ان کے درمیان کی تمام چیزوں کا رب ہے، اگر تم یقین رکھنے والے ہو.

t.149: He said to those around him, “Are you listening?”
t.84: He (The Pharaoh) said to those around him, “Are you not hearing?”
t.85: Pharaoh said to those present, ‘Do you hear what he says?’
t.95: Pharaoh said to those around him: "Do you hear (what he says)?"
t.19: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?
t.22: (Pharaoh) said to those around: "Did ye not listen (to what he says)?"
t.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said to those around: "Do you not hear (what he says)?"
t.54: فرعون نے اپنے اردگرد والوں سے کہا کہ کیا تم سن نہیں رہے؟

t.149: He said, “YourLord and the Lord of your ancient fathers.”
t.84: He (Mūsā) said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your early forefathers”
t.85: Moses said, ‘He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.’
t.95: Moses said: "(He is) Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore."
t.19: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.
t.22: (Moses) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers from the beginning!"
t.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your ancient fathers!"
t.54: (حضرت) موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) نے فرمایا وه تمہارا اور تمہارے اگلے باپ دادوں کا پروردگار ہے.

t.149: He said, “This messenger of yours who has been sent to you is certainly a madman.”
t.84: He (Pharaoh) said, “Your messenger who is sent to you is a mad man indeed.”
t.85: Pharaoh said, ‘This messenger who has been sent to you is truly possessed.’
t.95: Pharaoh said to the audience: "This Messenger of yours who has been sent to you is simply mad."
t.19: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!
t.22: (Pharaoh) said: "Truly your messenger who has been sent to you is a veritable madman!"
t.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "Verily, your Messenger who has been sent to you is a madman!"
t.54: فرعون نے کہا (لوگو!) تمہارا یہ رسول جو تمہاری طرف بھیجا گیا ہے یہ تو یقیناً دیوانہ ہے.

t.149: He said, “The Lord of the east and the west and whatever is between them, if youcan(ever) reason.”
t.84: He (Mūsā) said, “Lord of the East and the West and whatever lies between them, if you are to understand.”
t.85: Moses continued, ‘Lord of the East and West and everything between them. If you would only use your reason!’
t.95: Moses continued: "(He is) the Lord of the east and the west, and all between them. If you only had any understanding!"
t.19: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.
t.22: (Moses) said: "Lord of the East and the West, and all between! if ye only had sense!"
t.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Lord of the east and the west, and all that is between them, if you did but understand!"
t.54: حضرت موسیٰ علیہ السلام نے فرمایا! وہی مشرق ومغرب کا اور ان کے درمیان کی تمام چیزوں کا رب ہے، اگر تم عقل رکھتے ہو.

t.149: He said, “If youaccept any god other than me, I will surely make you of the imprisoned.”
t.84: He (Pharaoh) said, “If you adopt a God other than me, I will certainly put you to prison.”
t.85: But Pharaoh said [to him], ‘If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison,’
t.95: Pharaoh said: "If you take any god other than me, I will certainly make you one of those (who are rotting) in prison."
t.19: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.
t.22: (Pharaoh) said: "If thou dost put forward any god other than me, I will certainly put thee in prison!"
t.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "If you choose an ilâh (god) other than me, I will certainly put you among the prisoners."
t.54: فرعون کہنے لگا سن لے! اگر تو نے میرے سوا کسی اور کو معبود بنایا تو میں تجھے قیدیوں میں ڈال دوں گا.

t.149: He said, “What if I bring yousomething evident?”
t.84: He (Mūsā) said “Will you (do this) even if I bring to you something evident?”
t.85: and Moses asked, ‘Even if I show you something convincing?’
t.95: Moses said: "Even if I were to bring a Clear Sign to you?"
t.19: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?
t.22: (Moses) said: "Even if I showed you something clear (and) convincing?"
t.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Even if I bring you something manifest (and convincing)?"
t.54: موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) نے کہا اگرچہ میں تیرے پاس کوئی کھلی چیز لے آؤں؟

t.149: He said, “Bring it, if youare of the truthful.”
t.84: He said, “Then bring it, if you are truthful.”
t.85: ‘Show it then,’ said Pharaoh, ‘if you are telling the truth.’
t.95: Pharaoh said: "Then bring it if you are truthful at all."
t.19: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!
t.22: (Pharaoh) said: "Show it then, if thou tellest the truth!"
t.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "Bring it forth then, if you are of the truthful!"
t.54: فرعون نے کہا اگر تو سچوں میں سے ہے تو اسے پیش کر.

t.149: So he cast his staff and thereupon it was an evident serpent.
t.84: So, he threw down his staff, and in no time it was a serpent, clearly visible,
t.85: So Moses threw down his staff and- lo and behold!- it became a snake for everyone to see.
t.95: (No sooner had he said this than) Moses threw down his rod and behold, it was a veritable serpent,
t.19: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,
t.22: So (Moses) threw his rod, and behold, it was a serpent, plain (for all to see)!
t.203: So [Mûsâ (Moses)] threw his stick, and behold, it was a serpent, manifest.
t.54: آپ نے (اسی وقت) اپنی ﻻٹھی ڈال دی جو اچانک کھلم کھلا (زبردست) اﮊدہا بن گئی.

t.149: And he pulled his hand and thereupon it was white for the beholders.
t.84: and he drew out his hand, and right then it was a white light to the onlookers.
t.85: Then he drew out his hand and- lo and behold!- it was white for the onlookers to see.
t.95: and he drew his hand (out of his armpit) and lo! it had become a shining object to the beholders.
t.19: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.
t.22: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!
t.203: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!
t.54: اور اپنا ہاتھ کھینچ نکالا تو وه بھی اسی وقت ہر دیکھنے والے کو سفید چمکیلا نظر آنے لگا.

t.149: He said to the chiefs around him, “This is indeed a knowledgeable sorcerer
t.84: He (Pharaoh) said to the chiefs around him “This man is certainly an expert sorcerer”.
t.85: Pharaoh said to the counsellors around him, ‘This man is a learned sorcerer!
t.95: Pharaoh said to the nobles around him: "Surely this man is a skilled magician
t.19: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,
t.22: (Pharaoh) said to the Chiefs around him: "This is indeed a sorcerer well-versed:
t.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said to the chiefs around him: "Verily! This is indeed a well-versed sorcerer.
t.54: فرعون اپنے آس پاس کے سرداروں سے کہنے لگا بھئی یہ تو کوئی بڑا دانا جادوگر ہے.

t.149: who wants to evict you from your land with his sorcery, so what do you command?”
t.84: He wants to expel you from your land with his sorcery. So what do you suggest?”
t.85: He means to use his sorcery to drive you out of your land! What do you suggest?’
t.95: who wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. Tell us, what do you advise us?"
t.19: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?
t.22: "His plan is to get you out of your land by his sorcery; then what is it ye counsel?"
t.203: "He wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery: what is it then that you command?"
t.54: یہ تو چاہتا ہے کہ اپنے جادو کے زور سے تمہیں تمہاری سر زمین سے ہی نکال دے، بتاؤ اب تم کیا حکم دیتے ہو.

t.149: They said, “Put him off, and his brother, and send summoners to the cities
t.84: They said, “Leave him and his brother alone for some time, and send heralds to the cities,
t.85: They answered, ‘Delay him and his brother for a while, and send messengers to all the cities
t.95: They said: "Detain him and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to the cities
t.19: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners
t.22: They said: "Keep him and his brother in suspense (for a while), and dispatch to the Cities heralds to collect-
t.203: They said: "Put him off and his brother (for a while), and send callers to the cities;
t.54: ان سب نے کہا آپ اسے اور اس کے بھائی کو مہلت دیجئے اور تمام شہروں میں ہرکارے بھیج دیجئے.

t.149: to bring youevery knowledgeable magician.”
t.84: so that they bring to you every highly expert sorcerer.”
t.85: to bring every accomplished sorcerer to you.’
t.95: to mobilise all skilled magicians."
t.19: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.
t.22: "And bring up to thee all (our) sorcerers well-versed."
t.203: "To bring up to you every well-versed sorcerer."
t.54: جو آپ کے پاس ذی علم جادو گروں کو لے آئیں.

t.149: So the sorcerers were assembled for the appointment on a specified day.
t.84: So the sorcerers were assembled for the appointed time of a known day,
t.85: The sorcerers were [to be] assembled at the appointed time on a certain day
t.95: So the magicians were brought together on a particular day at a set time
t.19: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.
t.22: So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known,
t.203: So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time on a day appointed.
t.54: پھر ایک مقرر دن کے وعدے پر تمام جادوگر جمع کیے گئے.

t.149: And people were told, “Are you going to assemble,
t.84: and it was said to the people, “Would you assemble,
t.85: and the people were asked, "Are you all coming?
t.95: and the people were told: "Will you join the assembly?
t.19: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?
t.22: And the people were told: "Are ye (now) assembled?-
t.203: And it was said to the people: "Are you (too) going to assemble?
t.54: اور عام لوگوں سے بھی کہہ دیا گیا کہ تم بھی مجمع میں حاضر ہوجاؤ گے؟

t.149: that we may follow the sorcerers if they are the overcomers?”
t.84: so that we may follow the sorcerers if they are victorious?”
t.85: We may follow the sorcerers if they win!"
t.95: We may perhaps follow the religion of the magicians if they triumph."
t.19: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.
t.22: "That we may follow the sorcerers (in religion) if they win?"
t.203: "That we may follow the sorcerers [who were on Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) religion of disbelief] if they are the winners."
t.54: تاکہ اگر جادوگر غالب آجائیں تو ہم ان ہی کی پیروی کریں.

t.149: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Pharaoh, “Is there a reward for us if we are the overcomers?”
t.84: So, when the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, “Will there be a sure reward for us, if we are the victorious?”
t.85: When the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we be rewarded if we win?’
t.95: When the magicians came forth (for the encounter) they said to Pharaoh: "Is there a reward for us if we triumph?"
t.19: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?
t.22: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Pharaoh: "Of course - shall we have a (suitable) reward if we win?

t.19: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
t.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
t.54: اور یقیناً تیرا پروردگار البتہ وہی ہے غلبے واﻻ مہربانی واﻻ.

t.149: And most surely, it is a bestowal from on high from the Lord of all realms.
t.84: This (Qur’ān) is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
t.85: Truly, this Quran has been sent down by the Lord of the Worlds:
t.95: Indeed this is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe;
t.19: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,
t.22: Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds:
t.203: And truly, this (the Qur’ân) is a revelation from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),
t.54: اور بیشک و شبہ یہ (قرآن) رب العالمین کا نازل فرمایا ہوا ہے.

t.149: The Trustworthy Spiritcame down with it
t.84: The Trusted Spirit has brought it down
t.85: the Trustworthy Spirit brought it down
t.95: which the truthful spirit has carried down
t.19: Which the True Spirit hath brought down
t.22: With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth-
t.203: Which the trustworthy Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] has brought down
t.54: اسے امانت دار فرشتہ لے کر آیا ہے.

t.149: upon yourheart, that you may be of the forewarners,
t.84: upon your heart, so that you become one of the warners
t.85: to your heart [Prophet], so that you could bring warning
t.95: to your heart that you might become one of those who warn (others on behalf of Allah),
t.19: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,
t.22: To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish.
t.203: Upon your heart (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that you may be (one) of the warners,
t.54: آپ کے دل پر اترا ہے کہ آپ آگاه کر دینے والوں میں سے ہو جائیں.

t.149: in an evident Arabic tongue.
t.84: in plain Arabic language.
t.85: in a clear Arabic tongue.
t.95: (a revelation) in clear Arabic language,
t.19: In plain Arabic speech.
t.22: In the perspicuous Arabic tongue.
t.203: In the plain Arabic language.
t.54: صاف عربی زبان میں ہے.

t.149: And it is in the books of the ancients.
t.84: And of course, it is (mentioned) in the Scriptures of the former people.
t.85: This was foretold in the scriptures of earlier religions.
t.95: (a revelation embodied) in the scriptures of the ancients.
t.19: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.
t.22: Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples.
t.203: And verily, it (the Qur’ân, and its revelation to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is (announced) in the Scriptures [i.e. the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] of former people.
t.54: اگلے نبیوں کی کتابوں میں بھی اس قرآن کا تذکره ہے.

t.149: Is it not a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel recognized it?
t.84: Is it not a proof for them that the knowledgeable of the children of Isrā’īl recognize him (the prophet)?
t.85: Is it not proof enough for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel have recognized it?
t.95: Is it not a Sign to them � (to wit, the Makkans) � that the learned men of the Children of Israel know that?
t.19: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?
t.22: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
t.203: Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars (like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm رضي الله عنه who embraced Islâm) of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
t.54: کیا انہیں یہ نشانی کافی نہیں کہ حقانیت قرآن کو تو بنی اسرائیل کے علماء بھی جانتے ہیں.

t.149: And had We bestowed it from on high upon some non-Arabs
t.84: Even if We had revealed it to a Non-Arab,
t.85: If We had sent it down to someone who was not an Arab,
t.95: (But such is their adamance) that had We revealed it to one of the non-Arabs and even if he had recited(this clear Arabic discourse) to them
t.19: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,
t.22: Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs,
t.203: And if We had revealed it (this Qur’ân) unto any of the non-Arabs,
t.54: اور اگر ہم اسے کسی عجمی شخص پر نازل فرماتے.

t.149: and he had recited it to them, they would still not have believed in it.
t.84: and he had recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
t.85: and he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.
t.95: they would still not have believed in it.
t.19: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
t.22: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
t.203: And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
t.54: پس وه ان کے سامنے اس کی تلاوت کرتا تو یہ اسے باور کرنے والے نہ ہوتے.

t.149: Thus We inserted it into the hearts of the criminals.
t.84: This is how We have made it pass through the hearts of the sinners.
t.85: So We make it pass straight through the hearts of the guilty:
t.95: Thus have We caused this (Admonition) to penetrate the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod).
t.19: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
t.22: Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners.
t.203: Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Qur’ân) to enter the hearts of the Mûjrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners).
t.54: اسی طرح ہم نے گناہگاروں کے دلوں میں اس انکار کو داخل کر دیا ہے.

t.149: They will not believe in it until they witness the painful punishment
t.84: They will not believe in it until they will see the painful punishment
t.85: they will not believe in it until they see the grievous torment,
t.95: They will not believe in it until they clearly see the grievous chastisement.
t.19: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,
t.22: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty;
t.203: They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment.
t.54: وه جب تک دردناک عذابوں کو ملاحظہ نہ کرلیں ایمان نہ ﻻئیں گے.

t.149: which will come to them suddenly while they are unaware.
t.84: and it will come to them suddenly while they will not be anticipating (it),
t.85: which will suddenly hit them when they are not expecting it,
t.95: But when it comes upon them suddenly, taking them unawares,
t.19: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.
t.22: But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
t.203: It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not.
t.54: پس وه عذاب ان کو ناگہاں آجائے گا انہیں اس کا شعور بھی نہ ہو گا.

t.149: Then they will say, “Will we be reprieved?”
t.84: and (then) they will say, “Is it (possible) that we are given some respite?”
t.85: and then they will say, ‘Can we have more time?’
t.95: they say: "Can we be granted some respite?"
t.19: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?
t.22: Then they will say: "Shall we be respited?"
t.203: Then they will say: "Can we be respited?"
t.54: اس وقت کہیں گے کہ کیا ہمیں کچھ مہلت دی جائے گی؟

t.149: So do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
t.84: Is it then Our punishment that they are trying to hasten up?
t.85: How can they ask that Our punishment be brought to them sooner?
t.95: Do they really want Our chastisement to be expedited?
t.19: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?
t.22: Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on?
t.203: Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?
t.54: پس کیا یہ ہمارے عذاب کی جلدی مچا رہے ہیں؟

t.149: So have youseen if We let them enjoy(life) for(many) years,
t.84: So tell me, if We give them enjoyment for years,
t.85: Think, if we let them enjoy this life for some years
t.95: Did you consider that if We were to let them enjoy life for many years
t.19: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,
t.22: Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years,
t.203: Tell Me, (even) if We do let them enjoy for years,
t.54: اچھا یہ بھی بتاؤ کہ اگر ہم نے انہیں کئی سال بھی فائده اٹھانے دیا.

t.149: then there comes to them what they were promised,
t.84: then comes to them what they are warned of,
t.85: and then the promised torment came upon them,
t.95: and then the chastisement of which they were being warned were to come upon them,
t.19: And then cometh that which they were promised,
t.22: Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised!
t.203: And afterwards comes to them that (punishment) which they had been promised,
t.54: پھر انہیں وه عذاب آ لگا جن سے یہ دھمکائے جاتے تھے.

t.149: of what avail to them will their past enjoyments be?
t.84: what help can they receive from the comforts they were given to enjoy?
t.85: what good would their past enjoyment be to them?
t.95: of what avail will be the provisions of life which they have been granted to enjoy?
t.19: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?
t.22: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)!
t.203: All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them.
t.54: تو جو کچھ بھی یہ برتتے رہے اس میں سے کچھ بھی فائده نہ پہنچا سکے گا.

t.149: And never did We destroy a town but it had forewarners—
t.84: We did not destroy any town unless it has had warners
t.85: Never have We destroyed a town without sending down messengers to warn it,
t.95: We never destroyed any habitation but that it had warners
t.19: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
t.22: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners -
t.203: And never did We destroy a township but it had its warners
t.54: ہم نے کسی بستی کو ہلاک نہیں کیا ہے مگر اسی حال میں کہ اس کے لیے ڈرانے والے تھے.

t.149: a reminding, and in no way have We been unjust.
t.84: to give advice, and We have never been unjust.
t.85: as a reminder from Us: We are never unjust.
t.95: to admonish them. We have never been unjust.
t.19: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.
t.22: By way of reminder; and We never are unjust.
t.203: By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust.
t.54: نصیحت کے طور پر اور ہم ﻇلم کرنے والے نہیں ہیں.

t.149: And in no way have the devils been descending with it,
t.84: And this (Qur’ān) is not brought down by devils.
t.85: It was not the jinn who brought down this Quran:
t.95: The satans did not bring down this (Clear Book),
t.19: The devils did not bring it down.
t.22: No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation):
t.203: And it is not the Shayâtîn (devils) who have brought it (this Qur’ân) down.
t.54: اس قرآن کو شیطان نہیں ﻻئے.

t.149: for it neither suits them nor is it in their power.
t.84: It neither suits them, nor are they able to (do this).
t.85: it is neither in their interests nor in their power,
t.95: nor does it behove them, nor does it lie in their power.
t.19: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,
t.22: It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it).
t.203: Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it).
t.54: نہ وه اس کے قابل ہیں، نہ انہیں اس کی طاقت ہے.

t.149: They are indeed barred from hearing(it) .
t.84: In fact, they are kept far away from hearing (it at the time of revelation).
t.85: indeed they are prevented from overhearing it.
t.95: Indeed they are debarred from even hearing it.
t.19: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.
t.22: Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it.
t.203: Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it.
t.54: بلکہ وه تو سننے سے بھی محروم کردیے گئے ہیں.

t.149: So do not call upon any other god with Allah, lest yoube of those punished.
t.84: So do not invoke any other god along with Allah, otherwise you will be among those who are to be punished.
t.85: So [Prophet] do not invoke any gods beside God, or you will incur punishment.
t.95: So do not call any other god beside Allah lest you become of those who will be punished,
t.19: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.
t.22: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty.
t.203: So invoke not with Allâh another ilâh (god) lest you should be among those who receive punishment.
t.54: پس تو اللہ کے ساتھ کسی اور معبود کو نہ پکار کہ تو بھی سزا پانے والوں میں سے ہوجائے.

t.149: And warn yourclose kinsfolk,
t.84: And warn the nearest people of your clan,
t.85: Warn your nearest kinsfolk
t.95: and warn your nearest kinsmen;
t.19: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,
t.22: And admonish thy nearest kinsmen,
t.203: And warn your tribe (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of near kindred.
t.54: اپنے قریبی رشتہ والوں کو ڈرا دے.

t.149: and lower your wingfor those of the believers who have followed you.
t.84: and be kind with humbleness to the believers who followed you.
t.85: and lower your wing tenderly over the believers who follow you.
t.95: and be meek to the believers who follow you.
t.19: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.
t.22: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee.
t.203: And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you.
t.54: اس کے ساتھ فروتنی سے پیش آ، جو بھی ایمان ﻻنے واﻻ ہو کر تیری تابعداری کرے.

t.149: But if they disobey you, say, “I am indeed innocent of what you do.”
t.84: So if they disobey you, then say, “I disown what you do,”
t.85: If they disobey you, say, ‘I bear no responsibility for your actions.’
t.95: Then if they disobey you say to them: "I am quit of what you do."
t.19: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
t.22: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do!"
t.203: Then if they disobey you, say: "I am innocent of what you do."
t.54: اگر یہ لوگ تیری نافرمانی کریں تو تو اعلان کردے کہ میں ان کاموں سے بیزار ہوں جو تم کر رہے ہو.

t.149: And place your trust in the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy,
t.84: and place your trust in the Mighty, the Merciful,
t.85: Put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful,
t.95: And put your trust in Him Who is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate,
t.19: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
t.22: And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,-
t.203: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,
t.54: اپنا پورا بھروسہ غالب مہربان اللہ پر رکھ.

t.149: Who sees you when you rise,
t.84: Who sees you when you stand (in prayer,)
t.85: who sees you when you stand up [for prayer]
t.95: Who observes you when you rise (to pray)
t.19: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
t.22: Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer),
t.203: Who sees you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when you stand up (alone at night for Tahajjud prayers).
t.54: جو تجھے دیکھتا رہتا ہے جبکہ تو کھڑا ہوتا ہے.

t.149: as well as your movement among those who prostrate;
t.84: and (sees) your movement among those who prostrate themselves.
t.85: and sees your movements among the worshippers:
t.95: and observes your movements among those who prostrate themselves.
t.19: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).
t.22: And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves,
t.203: And your movements among those who fall prostrate (to Allâh in the five compulsory congregational prayers).
t.54: اور سجده کرنے والوں کے درمیان تیرا گھومنا پھرنا بھی.

t.149: indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
t.84: Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
t.85: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
t.95: He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
t.19: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.
t.22: For it is He Who heareth and knoweth all things.
t.203: Verily He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.
t.54: وه بڑا ہی سننے واﻻ اور خوب ہی جاننے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Shall I inform youupon whom the devils keep descending?
t.84: Shall I tell you on whom the devils descend?
t.85: Shall I tell you who the jinn come down to?
t.95: O people, shall I tell you on whom it is that satans descend?
t.19: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
t.22: Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend?
t.203: Shall I inform you (O people!) upon whom the Shayâtîn (devils) descend?
t.54: کیا میں تمہیں بتاؤں کہ شیطان کس پر اترتے ہیں.

t.149: They keep descending upon every sinful fabricator.
t.84: They descend on every sinful liar.
t.85: They come down to every lying sinner
t.95: They descend on every forgerer steeped in sin,
t.19: They descend on every sinful, false one.
t.22: They descend on every lying, wicked person,
t.203: They descend on every lying, sinful person.
t.54: وه ہر ایک جھوٹے گنہگار پر اترتے ہیں.

t.149: They give ear, and most of them are liars.
t.84: They give ear to hear (secretly,) and most of them tell lies.
t.85: who readily lends an ear to them, and most of them are liars:
t.95: on those who whisper hearsay in the ears of people; and most of them are liars.
t.19: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.
t.22: (Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars.
t.203: Who gives ear (to the devils and they pour what they may have heard of the Unseen from the angels), and most of them are liars.
t.54: (اچٹتی) ہوئی سنی سنائی پہنچا دیتے ہیں اور ان میں سے اکثر جھوٹے ہیں.

t.149: And as for the poets—the deluded ones follow them.
t.84: As for the poets, they are followed by the straying people.
t.85: only those who are lost in error follow the poets.
t.95: As for poets, only the wayward follow them.
t.19: As for poets, the erring follow them.
t.22: And the Poets,- It is those straying in Evil, who follow them:
t.203: As for the poets, the erring ones follow them,
t.54: شاعروں کی پیروی وه کرتے ہیں جو بہکے ہوئے ہوں.

t.149: Have younot seen that they aimlessly roam in every valley?
t.84: Did you not see that they wander in every valley,
t.85: Do you not see how they rove aimlessly in every valley;
t.95: Do you not see that they wander about in every valley
t.19: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,
t.22: Seest thou not that they wander distracted in every valley?-
t.203: See you not that they speak about every subject (praising people - right or wrong) in their poetry?
t.54: کیا آپ نے نہیں دیکھا کہ شاعر ایک ایک بیابان میں سر ٹکراتے پھرتے ہیں.

t.149: And that they say what they do not do?
t.84: and that they say what they do not?
t.85: how they say what they do not do?
t.95: and say things which they do not act upon,
t.19: And how they say that which they do not?
t.22: And that they say what they practise not?-
t.203: And that they say what they do not do.
t.54: اور وه کہتے ہیں جو کرتے نہیں.

t.149: Except for those who attained faith and did righteous deeds and remembered Allah frequently and defended themselves after they had been dealt with unjustly. And those who have been unjust will know the place of return to which they are bound to return.
t.84: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah very much, and defend themselves after they are wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know to which place they are going to return.
t.85: Not so those [poets] who believe, do good deeds, remember God often, and defend themselves after they have been wronged. The evildoers will find out what they will return to.
t.95: except those who believed and acted righteously and remembered Allah much, and when they themselves were subjected to wrong, they exacted retribution no more than to the extent of the wrong? Soon will the wrong-doers know the end that they shall reach.
t.19: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!
t.22: Except those who believe, work righteousness, engage much in the remembrance of Allah, and defend themselves only after they are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust assailants know what vicissitudes their affairs will take!
t.203: Except those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, and remember Allâh much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged [by replying back in poetry to the unjust poetry (which the pagan poets utter against the Muslims)]. And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned.
t.54: سوائے ان کے جو ایمان ﻻئے اور نیک عمل کیے اور بکثرت اللہ تعالیٰ کا ذکر کیا اور اپنی مظلومی کے بعد انتقام لیا، جنہوں نے ﻇلم کیا ہے وه بھی عنقریب جان لیں گے کہ کس کروٹ الٹتے ہیں.

t.149: Tâ Sîn. Those are the signsof the Recitaland an Evident Scripture—
t.84: Tā Sīn . These are the verses of the Qur’ān and an enlightening book,
t.85: Ta Sin These are the verses of the Quran––a scripture that makes things clear;
t.95: Ta'. Sin. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a Clear Book;
t.19: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain;
t.22: These are verses of the Qur'an,-a book that makes (things) clear;
t.203: Tâ-Sîn. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings].
t.54: طٰس، یہ آیتیں ہیں قرآن کی (یعنی واضح) اور روشن کتاب کی.

t.149: guidance and glad tidings for the believers
t.84: a guidance and good news to the believers
t.85: a guide and joyful news for the believers
t.95: a guidance and good tidings for the believers
t.19: A guidance and good tidings for believers
t.22: A guide: and glad tidings for the believers,-
t.203: A guide (to the Right Path) and glad tidings for the believers [who believe in the Oneness of Allâh (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism)].
t.54: ہدایت اور خوشخبری ایمان والوں کے لیے.

t.149: who establish the prayer and bringthe purifying charityand, of the Hereafter, they are certain.
t.84: who establish Salāh and pay Zakāh and who have faith in the Hereafter.
t.85: who keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and believe firmly in the life to come.
t.95: who establish Prayer and give Zakah, and have firm faith in the Hereafter.
t.19: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter.
t.22: Those who establish regular prayers and give in regular charity, and also have (full) assurance of the hereafter.
t.203: Those who perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) and give Zakât and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter (resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell).
t.54: جو نماز قائم کرتے ہیں اور زکوٰة ادا کرتے ہیں اور آخرت پر یقین رکھتے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter—We have adorned their deeds for them, so they wander aimlessly;
t.84: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds look beautiful to them. So they are wandering astray.
t.85: As for those who do not believe in the life to come, We have made their deeds seem alluring to them, so they wander blindly:
t.95: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds seem attractive to them so they stumble around in perplexity.
t.19: Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray.
t.22: As to those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds pleasing in their eyes; and so they wander about in distraction.
t.203: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds fair-seeming to them, so that they wander about blindly.
t.54: جو لوگ قیامت پر ایمان نہیں ﻻتے ہم نے انہیں ان کے کرتوت زینت دار کر دکھائے ہیں، پس وه بھٹکتے پھرتے ہیں.

t.149: those are the ones for whom is the worst punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the biggest losers.
t.84: Those are the people who deserve the worst punishment and who are the worst losers in the Hereafter.
t.85: it is they who will have the worst suffering, and will be the ones to lose most in the life to come.
t.95: It is they for whom a grievous chastisement lies in store; it is they who shall be the greatest losers in the Hereafter.
t.19: Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.
t.22: Such are they for whom a grievous Penalty is (waiting); and in the Hereafter theirs will be the greatest loss.
t.203: They are those for whom there will be an evil torment (in this world). And in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.
t.54: یہی لوگ ہیں جن کے لیے برا عذاب ہے اور آخرت میں بھی وه سخت نقصان یافتہ ہیں.

t.149: And indeed, youare surely receiving the Recitalfrom One who is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
t.84: Indeed you are being given the Qur’ān by a Wise, Knowledgeable Being.
t.85: You [Prophet] receive the Quran from One who is all wise, all knowing.
t.95: As for you, (O Muhammad), you are receiving the Qur'an from the Most Wise, the All-Knowing.
t.19: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware.
t.22: As to thee, the Qur'an is bestowed upon thee from the presence of one who is wise and all-knowing.
t.203: And verily, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are being taught the Qur’ân from One, All-Wise, All-Knowing.
t.54: بیشک آپ کو اللہ حکیم وعلیم کی طرف سے قرآن سکھایا جارہا ہے.

t.149: Recall when Moses said to his family, “I have surely glimpsed a fire. I will bring you some news from it, or bring you a firebrand, a borrowed flame , that you may warm yourselves.”
t.84: (Remember) when Mūsā said to his family, “I have noticed a fire. I shall bring to you some news from it, or bring to you a live ember, so that you may warm yourselves.”
t.85: Moses said to his family, ‘I have seen a fire. I will bring you news from there, or a burning stick for you to warm yourselves.’
t.95: (Recount to them) when Moses said to his family: "I perceive something like fire: soon will I bring to you some information from there, or I will bring you a burning brand that you may warm yourselves."
t.19: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.
t.22: Behold! Moses said to his family: "I perceive a fire; soon will I bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand to light our fuel, that ye may warm yourselves.
t.203: (Remember) when Mûsâ (Moses) said to his household: "Verily I have seen a fire; I will bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand, that you may warm yourselves."
t.54: (یاد ہوگا) جبکہ موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) نے اپنے گھر والوں سے کہا کہ میں نے آگ دیکھی ہے، میں وہاں سے یا تو کوئی خبر لے کر یا آگ کا کوئی سلگتا ہوا انگارا لے کر ابھی تمہارے پاس آ جاؤں گا تاکہ تم سینک تاپ کر لو.

t.149: Then when he reached it, he was called: “Blessed is whoever is in the fire and whoever is around it, and Highly Exalted is Allah, Lord of all realms.
t.84: So when he came to it, he was called: “Blessed is the one who is in the fire and the one who is around it. And pure is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
t.85: When he reached the fire, a voice called: ‘Blessed is the person near this fireand those around it; may God be exalted, the Lord of the Worlds.
t.95: But when Moses came to the fire, a call was sounded: "Blessed is He Who is in the fire and whatever is around it. Glory be to Allah, the Sustainer of all in the Universe.
t.19: But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
t.22: But when he came to the (fire), a voice was heard: "Blessed are those in the fire and those around: and glory to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
t.203: But when he came to it, he was called: "Blessed is whosoever is in the fire, and whosoever is round about it! And glorified be Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: جب وہاں پہنچے تو آواز دی گئی کہ بابرکت ہے وه جو اس آگ میں ہے اور برکت دیاگیا ہے وه جس کے آس پاس ہے اور پاک ہے اللہ جو تمام جہانوں کا پالنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: O Moses, it is indeed I, Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
t.84: O Mūsā, the fact is that I AM ALLAH, the Mighty, the Wise.
t.85: Moses, I am God, the Mighty, the Wise.
t.95: O Moses, verily this is Me, Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise!
t.19: O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
t.22: "O Moses! verily, I am Allah, the exalted in might, the wise!....
t.203: "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Verily it is I, Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
t.54: موسیٰ! سن بات یہ ہے کہ میں ہی اللہ ہوں غالب با حکمت.

t.149: Now, cast your staff.” So when he saw it shaking as though it were a snake, he turned away, fleeing, and did not look back. “O Moses, fear not! Truly, in My presence emissaries have nothing to fear,
t.84: And cast your staff down.” So when he saw it moving, as if it was a snake, he retreated turning his back, and did not look behind. “O Mūsā, be not scared. I am such that the messengers are not scared before Me,
t.85: Throw down your staff,’ but when he saw it moving like a snake, he turned and fled. ‘Moses, do not be afraid! The messengers need have no fear in My presence,
t.95: Now cast your rod!" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent, he turned his back in retreat and did not even look behind. "O Moses, have no fear. Messengers have no fear in My presence,
t.19: And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence,
t.22: "Now do thou throw thy rod!" But when he saw it moving (of its own accord) as if it had been a snake, he turned back in retreat, and retraced not his steps: "O Moses!" (it was said), "Fear not: truly, in My presence, those called as messengers have no fear,-
t.203: "And throw down your stick!" But when he saw it moving as if it were a snake, he turned in flight, and did not look back. (It was said:) "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Fear not: verily the Messengers fear not in front of Me.
t.54: تو اپنی ﻻٹھی ڈال دے، موسیٰ نے جب اسے ہلتا جلتا دیکھا اس طرح کہ گویا وه ایک سانﭗ ہے تو منھ موڑے ہوئے پیٹھ پھیر کر بھاگے اور پلٹ کر بھی نہ دیکھا، اے موسیٰ! خوف نہ کھا، میرے حضور میں پیغمبر ڈرا نہیں کرتے.

t.149: except for one who did an injustice then substituted kindness for evil—then I am surely Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
t.84: except him who did wrong, then after (having done) evil, replaced (it) with good, then I am Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
t.85: I am truly most forgiving and merciful to those who do wrong,and then replace their evil with good.
t.95: except he who has committed some wrong. But if he substitutes good in place of evil, I am Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
t.19: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful.
t.22: "But if any have done wrong and have thereafter substituted good to take the place of evil, truly, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.203: "Except him who has done wrong and afterwards has changed evil for good; then surely, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.54: لیکن جو لوگ ﻇلم کریں پھر اس کے عوض نیکی کریں اس برائی کے پیچھے تو میں بھی بخشنے واﻻ مہربان ہوں.

t.149: And put your hand inside the opening of your garment(and) it will come out white, without any evil affliction—among nine signs to Pharaoh and his people; they have indeed been a defiantly disobedient people.”
t.84: And put your hand into your bosom, and it will come out white, without any evil, as one of the nine signs (sent) to Pharaoh and his people. Surely they have been a sinful people.
t.85: Put your hand inside your cloak and it will come out white, but unharmed. These are among the nine signs that you will show Pharaoh and his people; they have really gone too far.’
t.95: Now put your hand into your bosom, and it will come forth shining without any blemish. (These are two of the) nine Signs to be carried to Pharaoh and his people. They are surely a wicked people."
t.19: And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe, it will come forth white but unhurt. (This will be one) among nine tokens unto Pharaoh and his people Lo! they were ever evil-living folk.
t.22: "Now put thy hand into thy bosom, and it will come forth white without stain (or harm): (these are) among the nine Signs (thou wilt take) to Pharaoh and his people: for they are a people rebellious in transgression."
t.203: "And put your hand into your bosom, it will come forth white without hurt. (These are) among the nine signs (you will take) to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his people. Verily they are a people who are Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).
t.54: اور اپنا ہاتھ اپنے گریبان میں ڈال، وه سفید چمکیلا ہو کر نکلے گا بغیر کسی عیب کے، تو نو نشانیاں لے کر فرعون اور اس کی قوم کی طرف جا، یقیناً وه بدکاروں کا گروه ہے.

t.149: So when Our signs came to them as an eye-opener, they said, “This is evident sorcery.”
t.84: So when Our signs came to them as eye-openers, they said, “This is a clear magic.”
t.85: But when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, ‘This is clearly [just] sorcery!’
t.95: But when Our Clear Signs came to them, they said: "This is plain magic."
t.19: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,
t.22: But when Our Signs came to them, that should have opened their eyes, they said: "This is sorcery manifest!"
t.203: But when Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) came to them, clear to see, they said: "This is a manifest magic."
t.54: پس جب ان کے پاس آنکھیں کھول دینے والے ہمارے معجزے پہنچے تو وه کہنے لگے یہ تو صریح جادو ہے.

t.149: And they repudiated them, though their(inner) selves were certain of them—out of injustice and haughtiness; so lookwhat the outcome was for the corrupters.
t.84: And they denied them out of sheer injustice and arrogance, though their hearts believed them (to be true). See, then, how was the fate of the mischief-makers.
t.85: They denied them, in their wickedness and their pride, even though their souls acknowledged them as true. See how those who spread corruption met their end!
t.95: They denied those Signs out of iniquity and arrogance although their hearts were convinced of their truth. So see how evil was the end of those mischief-makers!
t.19: And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers!
t.22: And they rejected those Signs in iniquity and arrogance, though their souls were convinced thereof: so see what was the end of those who acted corruptly!
t.203: And they belied them (those Ayât) wrongfully and arrogantly, though their ownselves were convinced thereof [i.e. those (Ayât ) are from Allâh, and Mûsâ (Moses) is the Messenger of Allâh in truth, but they disliked to obey Mûsâ (Moses), and hated to believe in his Message of Monotheism]. So see what was the end of the Mufsidûn (disbelievers, disobedient to Allâh, evil-doers and liars.).
t.54: انہوں نے انکار کردیا حاﻻنکہ ان کے دل یقین کر چکے تھے صرف ﻇلم اور تکبر کی بنا پر۔ پس دیکھ لیجئے کہ ان فتنہ پرداز لوگوں کا انجام کیسا کچھ ہوا.

t.149: And indeed, We brought David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, “Praise be to Allah, Who has favored us over many of His believing servants.”
t.84: Surely We gave knowledge to Dāwūd and Sulaimān, and they said, “Praise belongs to Allah who made us excel many of His believing servants.
t.85: We gave knowledge to David and Solomon, and they both said, ‘Praise be to God, who has favoured us over many of His believing servants.’
t.95: (On the other hand), We granted knowledge to David and Solomon and they said: "All praise be to Allah Who has exalted us above many of His believing servants!"
t.19: And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves!
t.22: We gave (in the past) knowledge to David and Solomon: And they both said: "Praise be to Allah, Who has favoured us above many of his servants who believe!"
t.203: And indeed We gave knowledge to Dâwûd (David) and Sulaimân (Solomon), and they both said: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has preferred us above many of His believing slaves!"
t.54: اور ہم نے یقیناً داؤد اور سلیمان کو علم دے رکھا تھا۔ اور دونوں نے کہا، تعریف اس اللہ کے لیے ہے جس نے ہمیں اپنے بہت سے ایماندار بندوں پر فضیلت عطا فرمائی ہے.

t.149: And Solomon succeeded David, and he said, “O mankind, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given of everything; this is most surely the evident grace.”
t.84: And Sulaimān inherited (the traits of) Dāwūd and said, “O people we have been taught the speech of birds, and all sorts of things are given to us. Indeed, this is the evident grace (of Allah).”
t.85: Solomon succeeded David. He said, ‘People, we have been taught the speech of birds, and we have been given a share of everything: this is a clearly a great favour.’
t.95: And Solomon succeeded David and said: "O people, we have been taught the speech of birds and we have been endowed with all kinds of things. Surely this is a conspicuous favour (from Allah)."
t.19: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour.
t.22: And Solomon was David's heir. He said: "O ye people! We have been taught the speech of birds, and on us has been bestowed (a little) of all things: this is indeed Grace manifest (from Allah.)"
t.203: And Sulaimân (Solomon) inherited (the knowledge of) Dâwûd (David). He said: "O mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and on us have been bestowed all things. This, verily, is an evident grace (from Allâh)."
t.54: اور داؤد کے وارث سلیمان ہوئے اور کہنے لگے لوگو! ہمیں پرندوں کی بولی سکھائی گئی ہے اور ہم سب کچھ میں سے دیئے گئے ہیں۔ بیشک یہ بالکل کھلا ہوا فضل الٰہی ہے.

t.149: And to the service of Solomon were herded his troops of unseen beingsand men and birds, all held in strict order,
t.84: And mustered for Sulaimān were his forces from among the Jinns and the humans and the birds. So all of them were kept under (his) control,
t.85: Solomon’s hosts of jinn, men, and birds were marshalled in ordered ranks before him,
t.95: Hosts of jinn and humans and birds were marshalled for Solomon and were kept under full control.
t.19: And there were gathered together unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order;
t.22: And before Solomon were marshalled his hosts,- of Jinns and men and birds, and they were all kept in order and ranks.
t.203: And there were gathered before Sulaimân (Solomon) his hosts of jinn and men, and birds, and they all were set in battle order (marching forward).
t.54: سلیمان کے سامنے ان کے تمام لشکر جنات اور انسان اور پرند میں سے جمع کیے گئے (ہر ہر قسم کی) الگ الگ درجہ بندی کردی گئی.

t.149: until, when they came upon the valley of ants, an ant said, “O you ants! Enter into your homes, lest Solomon and his troops crush you while they are unaware.”
t.84: until when they reached the valley of the ants, one of the ants said, “O ants, enter your dwelling places, lest Sulaimān and his armies crush you unknowingly.”
t.85: and when they came to the Valley of the Ants, one ant said, ‘Ants! Go into your homes, in case Solomon and his hosts unwittingly crush you.’
t.95: (Solomon was once on the move with them) until when they reached a valley of ants one of the ants said: "O ants, get into your holes, lest Solomon and his hosts crush you (under their feet) without even knowing."
t.19: Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving.
t.22: At length, when they came to a (lowly) valley of ants, one of the ants said: "O ye ants, get into your habitations, lest Solomon and his hosts crush you (under foot) without knowing it."
t.203: Till, when they came to the valley of the ants, one of the ants said: "O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Sulaimân (Solomon) and his hosts should crush you, while they perceive not."
t.54: جب وه چینوٹیوں کے میدان میں پہنچے تو ایک چیونٹی نے کہا اے چیونٹیو! اپنے اپنے گھروں میں گھس جاؤ، ایسا نہ ہو کہ بیخبری میں سلیمان اور اس کا لشکر تمہیں روند ڈالے.

t.149: So he smiled, laughing at her speech, and said, “My Lord, direct me to be thankful for Your blessings which you have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteousness that well pleases You. And include me, by Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.”
t.84: So he (Sulaimān) smiled, laughing on her speech and said, “My Lord, enable me to become grateful to Your favor that you have bestowed on me and on my parents, and to do good deeds that You like, and admit me, with Your mercy, among Your righteous servants.”
t.85: Solomon smiled broadly at her words and said, ‘Lord, inspire me to be thankful for the blessings You have granted me and my parents, and to do good deeds that please You; admit me by Your grace into the ranks of Your righteous servants.’
t.95: Smiling at the ant's utterance, Solomon burst into laughter and said: "My Lord! Hold me under (Your) control that I may render thanks for the favour which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may act righteously in a manner that would please You. Include me, out of Your Mercy, among Your righteous servants."
t.19: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.
t.22: So he smiled, amused at her speech; and he said: "O my Lord! so order me that I may be grateful for Thy favours, which thou hast bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may work the righteousness that will please Thee: And admit me, by Thy Grace, to the ranks of Thy righteous Servants."
t.203: So he [Sulaimân (Solomon)] smiled, amused at her speech and said: "My Lord! Grant me the power and ability that I may be grateful for Your Favours which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may do righteous good deeds that will please You, and admit me by Your Mercy among Your righteous slaves."
t.54: اس کی اس بات سے حضرت سلیمان مسکرا کر ہنس دیئے اور دعا کرنے لگے کہ اے پروردگار! تو مجھے توفیق دے کہ میں تیری ان نعمتوں کا شکر بجا ﻻؤں جو تو نے مجھ پر انعام کی ہیں اور میرے ماں باپ پر اور میں ایسے نیک اعمال کرتا رہوں جن سے تو خوش رہے مجھے اپنی رحمت سے نیک بندوں میں شامل کر لے.

t.149: Then he inspected the birds and said, “What is it with me? Can I not see the hoopoe, or is he among the absentees?
t.84: And (once) he (Sulaimān) checked the birds and said, “How is it with me that I do not see the hudhud (hoopoe)? Rather he has disappeared.
t.85: Solomon inspected the birds and said, ‘Why do I not see the hoopoe? Is he absent?
t.95: (On another occasion) Solomon inspected the birds and said: "Why is it that I do not see the hoopoe? Is he among the absentees?
t.19: And he sought among the birds and said: How is it that I see not the hoopoe, or is he among the absent?
t.22: And he took a muster of the Birds; and he said: "Why is it I see not the Hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?
t.203: He inspected the birds, and said: "What is the matter that I see not the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?
t.54: آپ نے پرندوں کی دیکھ بھال کی اور فرمانے لگے یہ کیا بات ہے کہ میں ہدہد کو نہیں دیکھتا؟ کیا واقعی وه غیر حاضر ہے؟

t.149: Most surely, I will either punish him severely or slay him, unless he brings me an evident excuse.”
t.84: I will punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings to me a clear plea.”
t.85: I will punish him severely, or kill him, unless he brings me a convincing excuse for his absence.’
t.95: I will inflict a severe punishment on him or maybe even slaughter him unless he comes forth with a convincing reason (for his absence)."
t.19: I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse.
t.22: "I will certainly punish him with a severe penalty, or execute him, unless he bring me a clear reason (for absence)."
t.203: "I will surely punish him with a severe torment, or slaughter him, unless he brings me a clear reason."
t.54: یقیناً میں اسے سخت سزا دوں گا، یا اسے ذبح کر ڈالوں گا، یا میرے سامنے کوئی صریح دلیل بیان کرے.

t.149: But he did not stay away for long and he said, “I have encompassed that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with sure tidings.
t.84: Then the hoopoe did not take long and said (to Sulaimān), “I have discovered what you did not, and have brought to you a sure information from Saba’ (Sheba).
t.85: But the hoopoe did not stay away long: he came and said, ‘I have learned something you did not know: I come to you from Sheba with firm news.
t.95: Not before long the hoopoe came up and said: "I have obtained a knowledge which you could not. I have brought for you sure news about Sheba.
t.19: But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings.
t.22: But the Hoopoe tarried not far: he (came up and) said: "I have compassed (territory) which thou hast not compassed, and I have come to thee from Saba with tidings true.
t.203: But the hoopoe stayed not long: he (came up and) said: "I have grasped (the knowledge of a thing) which you have not grasped and I have come to you from Saba’ (Sheba) with true news.
t.54: کچھ زیاده دیر نہ گزری تھی کہ آ کر اس نے کہا میں ایک ایسی چیز کی خبر ﻻیا ہوں کہ تجھے اس کی خبر ہی نہیں، میں سبا کی ایک سچی خبر تیرے پاس ﻻیا. ہوں.

t.149: I found a woman reigning over them, and she has been given of everything, and she has a great throne.
t.84: I have found a woman ruling over them, and all sorts of things are given to her, and she has a great throne.
t.85: I found a woman ruling over the people, who has been given a share of everything- she has a magnificent throne-
t.95: I found there a woman ruling over them, one who has been endowed with all things and has a mighty throne.
t.19: Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne.
t.22: "I found (there) a woman ruling over them and provided with every requisite; and she has a magnificent throne.
t.203: "I found a woman ruling over them: she has been given all things that could be possessed by any ruler of the earth, and she has a great throne.
t.54: میں نے دیکھا کہ ان کی بادشاہت ایک عورت کر رہی ہے جسے ہر قسم کی چیز سے کچھ نہ کچھ دیا گیا ہے اور اس کا تخت بھی بڑی عظمت واﻻ ہے.

t.149: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun apart from Allah, for Satan has adorned their deeds for them and has thus barred them from the way, so that they are not guided—
t.84: I have found her and her people prostrating themselves to the sun, instead of Allah, and the Satan has beautified their deeds for them, and has prevented them from the way, so they do not take the right path,
t.85: [but] I found that she and her people worshipped the sun instead of God. Satan has made their deeds seem alluring to them, and diverted them from the right path: they cannot find the right path.
t.95: I found that she and her people prostrate themselves before the sun rather than Allah." Satan has made their deeds appear attractive to them and has, thus, debarred them from the Right Path so they do not find true guidance
t.19: I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works fairseeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth), so that they go not aright;
t.22: "I found her and her people worshipping the sun besides Allah: Satan has made their deeds seem pleasing in their eyes, and has kept them away from the Path,- so they receive no guidance,-
t.203: "I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allâh, and Shaitân (Satan) has made their deeds fair-seeming to them, and has barred them from (Allâh’s) Way: so they have no guidance."
t.54: میں نے اسے اور اس کی قوم کو، اللہ تعالیٰ کو چھوڑ کر سورج کو سجده کرتے ہوئے پایا، شیطان نے ان کے کام انہیں بھلے کرکے دکھلا کر صحیح راه سے روک دیا ہے۔ پس وه ہدایت پر نہیں آتے.

t.149: that they do not prostrate themselvesto Allah, Who brings out what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows whatever you hide and whatever youmake public.
t.84: that is, they do not prostrate to Allah who brings forth what is hidden in the heavens and the earth,-and who knows whatever you conceal and whatever you reveal.”
t.85: Should they not worship God, who brings forth what is hidden in the heavens and earth and knows both what you people conceal and what you declare?
t.95: that they would prostrate themselves before Allah Who brings to light all that is hidden in the heavens and the earth and knows all that you conceal and all that you reveal.
t.19: So that they worship not Allah, Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knoweth what ye hide and what ye proclaim,
t.22: "(Kept them away from the Path), that they should not worship Allah, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what ye hide and what ye reveal.
t.203: [As Shaitân (Satan) has barred them from Allâh’s Way] so they do not worship (prostrate themselves before) Allâh, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal. [Tafsir At-Tabarî]
t.54: کہ اسی اللہ کے لیے سجدے کریں جو آسمانوں اور زمینوں کے پوشیده چیزوں کو باہر نکالتا ہے، اور جو کچھ تم چھپاتے ہو اور ﻇاہر کرتے ہو وه سب کچھ جانتا ہے.

t.149: Allah—there is no god but He, Lord of the Great Throne.”
t.84: Allah! There is no god but He, the Lord of the Great Throne.
t.85: He is God, there is no god but Him, the Lord of the mighty throne.’
t.95: Allah - none is worthy of worship save He; He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
t.19: Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Tremendous Throne.
t.22: "Allah!- there is no god but He!- Lord of the Throne Supreme!"
t.203: Allâh, Lâ ilâha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!
t.54: اس کے سوا کوئی معبود برحق نہیں وہی عظمت والے عرش کا مالک ہے.

t.149: He said, “We will see whether you have spoken the truth or have been one of the liars.
t.84: He (Sulaimān) said, “We shall see whether you have told the truth or you are one of the liars.
t.85: Solomon said, ‘We shall see whether you are telling the truth or lying.
t.95: Solomon said: "Soon shall we see whether you have spoken the truth or are one of those that lie.
t.19: (Solomon) said: We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars.
t.22: (Solomon) said: "Soon shall we see whether thou hast told the truth or lied!
t.203: [Sulaimân (Solomon)] said: "We shall see whether you speak the truth or you are (one) of the liars.
t.54: سلیمان نے کہا، اب ہم دیکھیں گے کہ تو نے سچ کہا ہے یا تو جھوٹا ہے.

t.149: Go with this letter of mine and cast it to them, then turn away from them and wait to see what they say to each other.”
t.84: Go with this letter of mine, and deliver it down to them, then turn back from them, and see how they react.”
t.85: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them, then withdraw and see what answer they send back.’
t.95: Take this letter of mine, deliver it to them, and then draw back from them, and observe what they do."
t.19: Go with this my letter and throw it down unto them; then turn away and see what (answer) they return,
t.22: "Go thou, with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them: then draw back from them, and (wait to) see what answer they return"...
t.203: "Go you with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them, then draw back from them, and see what (answer) they return."
t.54: میرے اس خط کو لے جاکر انہیں دے دے پھر ان کے پاس سے ہٹ آ اور دیکھ کہ وه کیا جواب دیتے ہیں.

t.149: She said, “O chiefs, a noble letter has indeed been cast down to me;
t.84: She (the queen) said (to her officials after receiving the letter), “O chieftains, there has been delivered to me an esteemed letter.
t.85: The Queen of Sheba said, ‘Counsellors, a gracious letter has been delivered to me.
t.95: The Queen said:" Know my nobles that a gracious letter has been delivered to me.
t.19: (The Queen of Sheba) said (when she received the letter): O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter.
t.22: (The queen) said: "Ye chiefs! here is delivered to me - a letter worthy of respect.
t.203: She said: "O chiefs! Verily! Here is delivered to me a noble letter,
t.54: وه کہنے لگی اے سردارو! میری طرف ایک باوقعت خط ڈاﻻ گیا ہے.

t.149: it is indeed from Solomon, and it is indeed, ‘In the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Bestower of mercy:
t.84: It is from Sulaimān, and it is (in the following words :) With the name of Allah, the All-Merciful, the Very-Merciful.
t.85: It is from Solomon, and it says, “In the name of God, the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy,
t.95: It is from Solomon, and it is: "In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate."
t.19: Lo! it is from Solomon, and lo! it is: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful;
t.22: "It is from Solomon, and is (as follows): 'In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful:
t.203: "Verily it is from Sulaimân (Solomon), and verily, it (reads): In the Name of Allâh, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful:
t.54: جو سلیمان کی طرف سے ہے اور جو بخشش کرنے والے مہربان اللہ کے نام سے شروع ہے.

t.149: You must not exalt yourselves above me and must come to me as Muslims.’”
t.84: Do not rebel against me, and come to me in submission.”
t.85: do not put yourselves above me, and come to me in submission to God.”’
t.95: (It says): "Do not act towards me with defiance, but come to me in submission."
t.19: Exalt not yourselves against me, but come unto me as those who surrender.
t.22: "'Be ye not arrogant against me, but come to me in submission (to the true Religion).'"
t.203: "Be you not exalted against me, but come to me as Muslims (true believers who submit to Allâh with full submission).’ "
t.54: یہ کہ تم میرے سامنے سرکشی نہ کرو اور مسلمان بن کر میرے پاس آجاؤ.
