t.149: She said, “O chiefs, give me your opinion in this matter of mine. I never take a decision on any matter except in your presence.”
t.84: She said, “O chieftains, advise me in the matter I have (before me). I am not the one who decides a matter absolutely unless you are present with me.”
t.85: She said, ‘Counsellors, give me your counsel in the matter I now face: I only ever decide on matters in your presence.’
t.95: (After reading the letter) the Queen said: "Nobles, let me have your counsel in this matter for I make no firm decision without you."
t.19: She said: O chieftains! Pronounce for me in my case. I decide no case till ye are present with me.
t.22: She said: "Ye chiefs! advise me in (this) my affair: no affair have I decided except in your presence."
t.203: She said: "O chiefs! Advise me in (this) case of mine. I decide no case till you are present with me (and give me your opinions)."
t.54: اس نے کہا اے میرے سردارو! تم میرے اس معاملہ میں مجھے مشوره دو۔ میں کسی امر کا قطعی فیصلہ جب تک تمہاری موجودگی اور رائے نہ ہو نہیں کیا کرتی.

t.149: They said, “We are a people of power and of intense force, and you are in command, so see what you wish to command.”
t.84: They said, “We are powerful and tough fighters, and the decision lies with you; so consider what command you should give.”
t.85: They replied, ‘We possess great force and power in war, but you are in command, so consider what orders to give us.’
t.95: They said: "We are strong and are given to vehement fighting. But the decision is yours. Therefore, consider what you would like to command."
t.19: They said: We are lords of might and lords of great prowess, but it is for thee to command; so consider what thou wilt command.
t.22: They said: "We are endued with strength, and given to vehement war: but the command is with thee; so consider what thou wilt command."
t.203: They said: "We have great strength, and great ability for war, but it is for you to command: so think over what you will command."
t.54: ان سب نے جواب دیا کہ ہم طاقت اور قوت والے سخت لڑنے بھڑنے والے ہیں۔ آگے آپ کو اختیار ہے آپ خود ہی سوچ لیجئے کہ ہمیں آپ کیا کچھ حکم فرماتی ہیں.

t.149: She said, “Indeed, when kings enter a town, they corrupt it and humiliate its dignified people, and this is what they(always) do.
t.84: She said, “In fact when the kings enter a town, they put it to disorder, and put its honorable citizens to disgrace, and this is how they normally do.
t.85: She said, ‘Whenever kings go into a city, they ruin it and humiliate its leaders- that is what they do-
t.95: The Queen said: "When the kings enter a country they cause corruption in it and abase those of its people who are held in honour. This is what they are wont to do.
t.19: She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do.
t.22: She said: "Kings, when they enter a country, despoil it, and make the noblest of its people its meanest thus do they behave.
t.203: She said: "Verily kings, when they enter a town (country), they despoil it and make the most honourable amongst its people the lowest. And thus they do.
t.54: اس نے کہا کہ بادشاه جب کسی بستی میں گھستے ہیں تو اسے اجاڑ دیتے ہیں اور وہاں کے باعزت لوگوں کو ذلیل کر دیتے ہیں اور یہ لوگ بھی ایسا ہی کریں گے.

t.149: Thus I am sending them a gift and will see what the emissaries return with.”
t.84: And I am going to send a gift to them, then see, what response the envoys will bring back.”
t.85: but I am going to send them a gift, then see what answer my envoys bring back.’
t.95: I will send them a gift and then see with what answer my envoys return."
t.19: But lo! I am going to send a present unto them, and to see with what (answer) the messengers return.
t.22: "But I am going to send him a present, and (wait) to see with what (answer) return (my) ambassadors."
t.203: "But verily! I am going to send him a present, and see with what (answer) the messengers return."
t.54: میں انہیں ایک ہدیہ بھیجنے والی ہوں، پھر دیکھ لوں گی کہ قاصد کیا جواب لے کر لوٹتے ہیں.

t.149: So when he came to Solomon, he said, “Are yousupplying me with wealth? What Allah has brought me is better than what He has brought you. Rather, it is you who rejoice when given gifts.
t.84: So when he (the envoy) came to Sulaimān, he said, “Are you extending a financial aid to me? So what Allah has given me is much better than what He has given to you. But you yourselves are proud of your gift.
t.85: When her envoy came to Solomon, Solomon said, ‘What! Are you offering me wealth? What God has given me is better than what He has given you, though you rejoice in this gift of yours.
t.95: Now, when (the envoy of the Queen) came to Solomon, he said: "Do you want to aid me with wealth? Whatever Allah has granted me is much more than what He has given you. (Keep for yourselves) your gift in which you are exulting.
t.19: So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon, (the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth? But that which Allah hath given me is better than that which He hath given you. Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift.
t.22: Now when (the embassy) came to Solomon, he said: "Will ye give me abundance in wealth? But that which Allah has given me is better than that which He has given you! Nay it is ye who rejoice in your gift!
t.203: So when (the messengers with the present) came to Sulaimân (Solomon), he said: "Will you help me in wealth? What Allâh has given me is better than that which He has given you! Nay, you rejoice in your gift!"
t.54: پس جب قاصد حضرت سلیمان کے پاس پہنچا تو آپ نے فرمایا کیا تم مال سے مجھے مدد دینا چاہتے ہو؟ مجھے تو میرے رب نے اس سے بہت بہتر دے رکھا ہے جو اس نے تمہیں دیا ہے پس تم ہی اپنے تحفے سے خوش رہو.

t.149: Returnback to them. Indeed, we will come upon them with troops they cannot resist, and indeed, we will evict them from it, humiliated and dishonored.”
t.84: Go back to them, and we will bring to them forces they have no power to face, and we will certainly drive them out from there in humiliation while they are disgraced.”
t.85: Go back to your people: we shall certainly come upon them with irresistible forces, and drive them, disgraced and humbled, from their land.’
t.95: Envoy, go back to those who sent you and we shall certainly come upon them with hosts whom they will be unable to resist. We shall drive them out from there, and they will suffer humiliation and disgrace."
t.19: Return unto them. We verily shall come unto them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from thence with shame, and they will be abased.
t.22: "Go back to them, and be sure we shall come to them with such hosts as they will never be able to meet: We shall expel them from there in disgrace, and they will feel humbled (indeed)."
t.203: [Then Sulaimân (Solomon) said to the chief of her messengers who brought the present]: "Go back to them. We verily shall come to them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from there in disgrace, and they will be abased."
t.54: جا ان کی طرف واپس لوٹ جا، ہم ان (کے مقابلہ) پر وه لشکر ﻻئیں گے جن کے سامنے پڑنے کی ان میں طاقت نہیں اور ہم انہیں ذلیل و پست کر کے وہاں سے نکال باہر کریں گے.

t.149: He said, “O chiefs, which one of you can bring me her throne before they come to me as Muslims?”
t.84: He said, “O chieftains, which one of you will bring her throne to me before they come to me submissively?”
t.85: Then he said, ‘Counsellors, which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?’
t.95: Solomon said: "My nobles, which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
t.19: He said: O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering?
t.22: He said (to his own men): "Ye chiefs! which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
t.203: He said: "O chiefs! Which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me surrendering themselves in obedience?"
t.54: آپ نے فرمایا اے سردارو! تم میں سے کوئی ہے جو ان کے مسلمان ہو کر پہنچنے سے پہلے ہی اس کا تخت مجھے ﻻدے.

t.149: A powerful one of the unseen beingssaid, “I will bring it to youbefore you rise from your seat, and indeed, I am certainly strong and trustworthy enough to do it.”
t.84: A stalwart of the Jinn said, “I will bring it to you before you rise up from your place, and for this (task) I am powerful, reliable.”
t.85: A powerful and crafty jinn replied, ‘I will bring it to you before you can even rise from your place. I am strong and trustworthy enough,’
t.95: A stalwart of the jinn said: "I will bring it to you before you rise from your council. Surely I have the power to do so and I am trustworthy."
t.19: A stalwart of the jinn said: I will bring it thee before thou canst rise from thy place. Lo! I verily am strong and trusty for such work.
t.22: Said an 'Ifrit, of the Jinns: "I will bring it to thee before thou rise from thy council: indeed I have full strength for the purpose, and may be trusted."
t.203: A ‘Ifrît (strong one) from the jinn said: "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place (council). And verily, I am indeed strong, and trustworthy for such work."
t.54: ایک قوی ہیکل جن کہنے لگا آپ اپنی اس مجلس سے اٹھیں اس سے پہلے ہی پہلے میں اسے آپ کے پاس ﻻدیتا ہوں، یقین مانیے کہ میں اس پر قادر ہوں اور ہوں بھی امانت دار.

t.149: The one who had knowledge of the Scripture said, “I will bring it to you before you blink your eye.” So when he saw it settled before him, he said, “This is of my Lord’s grace, to test me: whether I will thank or will deny. For whoever is thankful is only thankful to his own benefit, and whoever has denied—my Lord is, indeed, Self-Sufficient, Noble.”
t.84: Said the one who had the knowledge of the book, “I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.” So when he saw it (the throne) well placed before him, he said, “This is by the grace of my Lord, so that He may test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful. Whoever is grateful is grateful for his own benefit, and whoever is ungrateful, then my Lord is Need-Free, Bountiful”.
t.85: but one of them who had some knowledge of the Scripture said, ‘I will bring it to you in the twinkling of an eye.’ When Solomon saw it set before him, he said, ‘This is a favour from my Lord, to test whether I am grateful or not: if anyone is grateful, it is for his own good, if anyone is ungrateful, then my Lord is self-sufficient and most generous.’
t.95: And he who had some knowledge of the Book said: "I will bring it before the twinkling of your eye." When Solomon saw the throne placed firmly beside him, he cried out: "This is by the grace of my Lord so that He may test me whether I give thanks for (His Bounty) or act with ingratitude. Whoever is grateful is so to his own good; and whoever is ungrateful, let him know that my Lord is Immensely Resourceful, Most Bountiful."
t.19: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: I will bring it thee before thy gaze returneth unto thee. And when he saw it set in his presence, (Solomon) said: This is of the bounty of my Lord, that He may try me whether I give thanks or am ungrateful. Whosoever giveth thanks he only giveth thanks for (the good of) his own soul; and whosoever is ungrateful (is ungrateful only to his own soul's hurt). For lo! my Lord is Absolute in independence, Bountiful.
t.22: Said one who had knowledge of the Book: "I will bring it to thee within the twinkling of an eye!" Then when (Solomon) saw it placed firmly before him, he said: "This is by the Grace of my Lord!- to test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful! and if any is grateful, truly his gratitude is (a gain) for his own soul; but if any is ungrateful, truly my Lord is Free of all Needs, Supreme in Honour!"
t.203: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: "I will bring it to you within the twinkling of an eye!" Then when he [Sulaimân (Solomon)] saw it placed before him, he said: "This is by the Grace of my Lord - to test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful! And whoever is grateful, truly, his gratitude is for (the good of) his ownself; and whoever is ungrateful, (he is ungrateful only for the loss of his ownself). Certainly my Lord is Rich (Free of all needs), Bountiful."
t.54: جس کے پاس کتاب کا علم تھا وه بول اٹھا کہ آپ پلک جھپکائیں اس سے بھی پہلے میں اسے آپ کے پاس پہنچا سکتا ہوں۔ جب آپ نے اسے اپنے پاس موجود پایا تو فرمانے لگے یہی میرے رب کا فضل ہے، تاکہ وه مجھے آزمائے کہ میں شکر گزاری کرتا ہوں یا ناشکری، شکر گزار اپنے ہی نفع کے لیے شکر گزاری کرتا ہے اور جو ناشکری کرے تو میرا پروردگار (بے پروا اور بزرگ) غنی اور کریم ہے.

t.149: He said, “Disguise her throne for her, and we shall see whether she will be guided or be one of those who are never guided.”
t.84: He said, “Disguise the throne for her, and we will see whether she discovers the truth, or she does not recognize it.”
t.85: Then he said, ‘Disguise her throne, and we shall see whether or not she recognizes it.’
t.95: Solomon said:" Set the throne before her casually, and let us see whether she gets to the Truth or is one of those who are not guided to what is right."
t.19: He said: Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will go aright or be of those not rightly guided.
t.22: He said: "Transform her throne out of all recognition by her: let us see whether she is guided (to the truth) or is one of those who receive no guidance."
t.203: He said: "Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will be guided (to recognise her throne), or she will be one of those not guided."
t.54: حکم دیا کہ اس کے تخت میں کچھ پھیر بدل کر دو تاکہ معلوم ہو جائے کہ یہ راه پالیتی ہے یا ان میں سے ہوتی ہے جو راه نہیں پاتے.

t.149: So when she arrived, it was said, “Is your throne like this?” She said, “As if this is it.”(Solomon said,) “And We were given knowledge before her and we have always been Muslims.”
t.84: So when she came, it was said (to her), “Is your throne like this?” She said, “It seems to be the same. We have been made to recognize the truth even before this, and we have already submitted.”
t.85: When she arrived, she was asked, ‘Is this your throne?’ She replied, ‘It looks like it.’ [Solomon said], ‘We were given knowledge before her, and we devoted ourselves to God;
t.95: When the Queen arrived, she was asked: "Is your throne like this one?" She said: "It seems as if it is the same. We had already come to know this and we had submitted ourselves."
t.19: So, when she came, it was said (unto her): Is thy throne like this? She said: (It is) as though it were the very one. And (Solomon said): We were given the knowledge before her and we had surrendered (to Allah).
t.22: So when she arrived, she was asked, "Is this thy throne?" She said, "It was just like this; and knowledge was bestowed on us in advance of this, and we have submitted to Allah (in Islam)."
t.203: So when she came, it was said (to her): "Is your throne like this?" She said: "(It is) as though it were the very same." And [Sulaimân (Solomon) said]: "Knowledge was bestowed on us before her, and we were submitted to Allâh (in Islâm as Muslims before her)."
t.54: پھر جب وه آگئی تو اس سے کہا (دریافت کیا) گیا کہ ایسا ہی تیرا (بھی) تخت ہے؟ اس نے جواب دیا کہ یہ گویا وہی ہے، ہمیں اس سے پہلے ہی علم دیا گیا تھا اور ہم مسلمان تھے.

t.149: But she was barred by whatever she used to worship apart from Allah; indeed, she was of a denying people.
t.84: And she was prevented (from submitting before this) by that which she used to worship instead of Allah. Indeed she was from a disbelieving people.
t.85: she was prevented by what she worshipped instead of God, for she came from a disbelieving people.’
t.95: What prevented her (from accepting the True Faith) was her worshipping deities other than Allah, for she belonged to an unbelieving people.
t.19: And (all) that she was wont to worship instead of Allah hindered her, for she came of disbelieving folk.
t.22: And he diverted her from the worship of others besides Allah: for she was (sprung) of a people that had no faith.
t.203: And that which she used to worship besides Allâh has prevented her (from Islâm), for she was of a disbelieving people.
t.54: اسے انہوں نے روک رکھا تھا جن کی وه اللہ کے سوا پرستش کرتی رہی تھی، یقیناً وه کافر لوگوں میں سے تھی.

t.149: She was told, “Enter the tower.” And when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pond and she bared her legs. He said, “It is a tower paved with glass.” She said, “My Lord, I have indeed been unjust to myself, and I have submitted with Solomon to Allah, Lord of all realms.”
t.84: It was said to her, “Enter the palace.” Then once she saw it, she thought it was flowing water, and uncovered her legs. He (Sulaimān) said, “This is a palace made of glasses.” She said, “My Lord, I had surely wronged myself, and now I submit, along with Sulaimān, to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.”
t.85: Then it was said to her, ‘Enter the hall,’ but when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pool of water, and bared her legs. Solomon explained, ‘It is just a hall paved with glass,’ and she said, ‘My Lord, I have wronged myself: I devote myself, with Solomon, to God, the Lord of the Worlds.’
t.95: She was told: "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a pool of water and she bared both her calves (to enter into it). Solomon said: "This is a slippery floor of crystal." Thereupon she cried out: "My Lord, I have been inflicting much wrong on myself. Now I submit myself with Solomon to Allah, the Lord of the whole Universe."
t.19: It was said unto her: Enter the hall. And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs. (Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass. She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself, and I surrender with Solomon unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
t.22: She was asked to enter the lofty Palace: but when she saw it, she thought it was a lake of water, and she (tucked up her skirts), uncovering her legs. He said: "This is but a palace paved smooth with slabs of glass." She said: "O my Lord! I have indeed wronged my soul: I do (now) submit (in Islam), with Solomon, to the Lord of the Worlds."
t.203: It was said to her: "Enter As-Sarh" (a glass surface with water underneath it or a palace): but when she saw it, she thought it was a pool, and she (tucked up her clothes) uncovering her legs. (Sulaimân (Solomon)) said: "Verily, it is a Sarh (a glass surface with water underneath it or a palace)." She said: "My Lord! Verily, I have wronged myself, and I submit [in Islâm, together with Sulaimân (Solomon)] to Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)."
t.54: اس سے کہا گیا کہ محل میں چلی چلو، جسے دیکھ کر یہ سمجھ کر کہ یہ حوض ہے اس نے اپنی پنڈلیاں کھول دیں، فرمایا یہ توشیشے سے منڈھی ہوئی عمارت ہے، کہنے لگی میرے پروردگار! میں نے اپنے آپ پر ﻇلم کیا۔ اب میں سلیمان کے ساتھ اللہ رب العالمین کی مطیع اور فرمانبردار بنتی ہوں.

t.149: And indeed, We sent to Thamûd their brother Saleh(saying) , “Worship Allah.” But they promptly became two disputing groups.
t.84: And We sent to Thamūd their brother SāliH saying (to them), “Worship Allah”. Then suddenly they became two groups quarrelling with each other.
t.85: To the people of Thamud We sent their brother, Salih, saying, ‘Worship God alone,’ but they split into two rival factions.
t.95: And We sent to Thamud their brother Salih (with the Message): "Serve Allah," but all of a sudden they became split into two quarrelling factions.
t.19: And We verily sent unto Thamud their brother Salih, saying: Worship Allah. And lo! they (then became two parties quarrelling.
t.22: We sent (aforetime), to the Thamud, their brother Salih, saying, "Serve Allah": But behold, they became two factions quarrelling with each other.
t.203: And indeed We sent to Thamûd their brother Sâlih, saying: "Worship Allâh (Alone and none else). Then look! They became two parties (believers and disbelievers) quarreling with each other."
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے ﺛمود کی طرف ان کے بھائی صالح کو بھیجا کہ تم سب اللہ کی عبادت کرو پھر بھی وه دو فریق بن کر آپس میں لڑنے جھگڑنے لگے.

t.149: He said, “O my people, why do you ask that the bad be hastened before the good? If only you would ask Allah’s forgiveness so that you may be shown mercy.”
t.84: He said, “My people, why do you seek evil to come sooner before good? Why do you not seek forgiveness from Allah, so that you are treated with mercy?”
t.85: Salih said, ‘My people, why do you rush to bring [forward] what is bad rather than good? Why do you not ask forgiveness of God, so that you may be given mercy?’
t.95: Salih said: "My people, why do you wish to hasten that evil rather than good should come upon you? Why should you not seek pardon from Allah so that mercy be shown to you?"
t.19: He said: O my people! Why will ye hasten on the evil rather than the good? Why will ye not ask pardon of Allah, that ye may receive mercy.
t.22: He said: "O my people! why ask ye to hasten on the evil in preference to the good? If only ye ask Allah for forgiveness, ye may hope to receive mercy.
t.203: He said: "O my people! Why do you seek to hasten the evil (torment) before the good (Allâh’s Mercy)? Why seek you not the Forgiveness of Allâh, that you may receive mercy?"
t.54: آپ نے فرمایا اے میری قوم کے لوگو! تم نیکی سے پہلے برائی کی جلدی کیوں مچا رہے ہو؟ تم اللہ تعالیٰ سےاستغفار کیوں نہیں کرتے تاکہ تم پر رحم کیا جائے.

t.149: They said, “We consider youa bad omen, and those with you(too) .” He said, “Your omen is with Allah. In fact, you are a people being tried.”
t.84: They said, “We regard you and those with you as a sign of bad omen.” He said, “Your omen is with Allah, but you are a people put to a test.”
t.85: They said, ‘We see you and your fol-lowers as an evil omen.’ He replied, ‘God will decide on any omen you may see: you people are being put to the test.’
t.95: They said: "We augur ill of you and those who are with you." Salih replied: "Your augury is with Allah. The truth is that you are a people who are being tried."
t.19: They said: We augur evil of thee and those with thee. He said: Your evil augury is with Allah. Nay, but ye are folk that are being tested.
t.22: They said: "Ill omen do we augur from thee and those that are with thee". He said: "Your ill omen is with Allah; yea, ye are a people under trial."
t.203: They said: "We augur ill omen from you and those with you." He said: "Your ill omen is with Allâh; nay, but you are a people that are being tested."
t.54: وه کہنے لگے ہم تو تیری اور تیرے ساتھیوں کی بدشگونی لے رہے ہیں؟ آپ نے فرمایا تمہاری بدشگونی اللہ کے ہاں ہے، بلکہ تم فتنے میں پڑے ہوئے لوگ ہو.

t.149: And there were nine persons in the city who were spreading corruption in the land and would not reform.
t.84: And there were nine persons in the city who used to make mischief on the earth and did not put things right.
t.85: There were nine men in the city who spread corruption in the land without making amends.
t.95: Now there were nine ring-leaders in the city who created corruption in the land and never worked to set things right.
t.19: And there were in the city nine persons who made mischief in the land and reformed not.
t.22: There were in the city nine men of a family, who made mischief in the land, and would not reform.
t.203: And there were in the city nine men (from the sons of their chiefs), who made mischief in the land, and would not reform.
t.54: اس شہر میں نو سردار تھے جو زمین میں فساد پھیلاتے رہتے تھے اور اصلاح نہیں کرتے تھے.

t.149: They said, “Swear by Allah to one another that we will surely attack himand his family at night, and then wewill emphatically tellhis kinsman seeking retribution, ‘We did not witness the murder of his family, and we are indeed truthful.’”
t.84: They said, “Let us swear a mutual oath by Allah that we shall attack him (SāliH) and his family at night, then will say to his heir, ‘We did not witness the destruction of his family, and we are really truthful.’”
t.85: They said, ‘Swear by God: we shall attack this man and his household in the night, then say to his next of kin, “We did not witness the destruction of his household. We are telling the truth.”’
t.95: They said: "Swear to one another in the name of Allah that we shall make a sudden night swoop on Salih and his family and will then tell their heirs that we did not witness the destruction of his family. We are indeed truthful."
t.19: They said: Swear one to another by Allah that we verily will attack him and his household by night, and afterward we will surely say unto his friend: We witnessed not the destruction of his household. And lo! we are truthtellers.
t.22: They said: "Swear a mutual oath by Allah that we shall make a secret night attack on him and his people, and that we shall then say to his heir (when he seeks vengeance): 'We were not present at the slaughter of his people, and we are positively telling the truth.'"
t.203: They said: "Swear one to another by Allâh that we shall make a secret night attack on him and his household, and thereafter we will surely say to his near relatives: ‘We witnessed not the destruction of his household, and verily we are telling the truth.’"
t.54: انہوں نے آپس میں بڑی قسمیں کھا کھا کر عہد کیا کہ رات ہی کو صالح اور اس کے گھر والوں پر ہم چھاپہ ماریں گے، اور اس کے وارﺛوں سے صاف کہہ دیں گے کہ ہم اس کے اہل کی ہلاکت کے وقت موجود نہ تھے اور ہم بالکل سچے ہیں.

t.149: And they schemed a scheme, and We schemed a scheme while they were unaware.
t.84: Thus they devised a plan, and We devised a plan, while they were not aware.
t.85: So they devised their evil plan, but We too made a plan of which they were unaware.
t.95: Thus they planned and We too planned, the while they did not know.
t.19: So they plotted a plot: and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not.
t.22: They plotted and planned, but We too planned, even while they perceived it not.
t.203: So they plotted a plot, and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not.
t.54: انہوں نے مکر (خفیہ تدبیر) کیا اور ہم نے بھی اور وه اسے سمجھتے ہی نہ تھے.

t.149: So lookat how the outcome of their scheming was that We did destroy them and their people, all of them.
t.84: So, look how was the fate of their plan, that We annihilated them and their people altogether.
t.85: See how their scheming ended: We destroyed them utterly, along with all their people.
t.95: So see what was the outcome of the plan they made: We utterly destroyed them and their people, all of them.
t.19: Then see the nature of the consequence of their plotting, for lo! We destroyed them and their people, every one.
t.22: Then see what was the end of their plot!- this, that We destroyed them and their people, all (of them).
t.203: Then see how was the end of their plot! Verily! We destroyed them and their nation, all together.
t.54: (اب) دیکھ لے ان کے مکر کا انجام کیسا کچھ ہوا؟ کہ ہم نے ان کو اور ان کی قوم کو سب کو غارت کردیا.

t.149: So here are their houses, vacant, on account of their injustice. Indeed, in this is surely a sign for people who know.
t.84: Now those are their houses, lying empty because of their transgression. Surely, in this there are signs for a people who have knowledge.
t.85: As a result of their evil deeds, their homes are desolate ruins- there truly is a sign in this for those who know-
t.95: Now behold their houses that lie in utter ruins because of their wrong-doing. Verily there is a Sign in this for the people who know.
t.19: See, yonder are their dwellings empty and in ruins because they did wrong. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a people who have knowledge.
t.22: Now such were their houses, - in utter ruin, - because they practised wrong-doing. Verily in this is a Sign for people of knowledge.
t.203: These are their houses in utter ruin, for they did wrong. Verily, in this is indeed an Ayâh (a lesson or a sign) for people who know.
t.54: یہ ہیں ان کے مکانات جو ان کے ﻇلم کی وجہ سے اجڑے پڑے ہیں، جو لوگ علم رکھتے ہیں ان کے لیےاس میں بڑی نشانی ہے.

t.149: And We saved those who believed and were mindful(of God) .
t.84: And We saved those who believed and who used to be God-fearing.
t.85: but We saved those who believed and were mindful of God.
t.95: And We delivered those who believed and were wont to avoid disobeying (Allah).
t.19: And we saved those who believed and used to ward off (evil).
t.22: And We saved those who believed and practised righteousness.
t.203: And We saved those who believed, and used to fear Allâh, and keep their duty to Him.
t.54: ہم نے ان کو جو ایمان ﻻئے تھے اور پرہیزگار تھے بال بال بچالیا.

t.149: And Lot(too) , when he said to his people, “Do you commit obscenity while you can see(its shamefulness) ?
t.84: And (We sent) LūT when he said to his people, “Do you commit the shameful act while you can see (its shamefulness)?
t.85: We also sent Lot to his people. He said to them, ‘How can you commit this outrage with your eyes wide open?
t.95: We also sent Lot, and recall when he told his people: "Do you commit shameless acts with your eyes open?
t.19: And Lot! when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination knowingly?
t.22: (We also sent) Lut (as a messenger): behold, He said to his people, "Do ye do what is shameful though ye see (its iniquity)?
t.203: And (remember) Lût (Lot)! When he said to his people. Do you commit Al-Fâhishah (evil, great sin, every kind of unlawful sexual intercourse, sodomy) while you see (one another doing evil without any screen)?"
t.54: اور لوط کا (ذکر کر) جبکہ اس نے اپنی قوم سے کہاکہ کیا باوجود دیکھنے بھالنے کے پھر بھی تم بدکاری کر رہے ہو؟

t.149: Do you approach men with lust instead of women? Rather you are an ignorant people.”
t.84: Is it that you really come to men lustfully instead of women? No, you are a people committing acts of ignorance.”
t.85: How can you lust after men instead of women? What fools you are!’
t.95: Do you lustfully approach men instead of women? Nay, you engage in acts of sheer ignorance."
t.19: Must ye needs lust after men instead of women? Nay, but ye are folk who act senselessly.
t.22: Would ye really approach men in your lusts rather than women? Nay, ye are a people (grossly) ignorant!
t.203: "Do you practise your lusts on men instead of women? Nay, but you are a people who behave senselessly."
t.54: یہ کیا بات ہے کہ تم عورتوں کو چھوڑ کر مردوں کے پاس شہوت سے آتے ہو حق یہ ہے کہ تم بڑی ہی نادانی کر رہے ہو.

t.149: But the only response of his people was to say, “Evict Lot’s folk from your town; indeed, they are a few people who always keep themselves clean.”
t.84: So, the answer of his people was not else but that they said, “Expel the family of LūT from your town. They are a people who over-indulge in purity.”
t.85: The only answer his people gave was to say, ‘Expel Lot’s followers from your town! These men mean to stay chaste!’
t.95: But this had only one answer from his people. They said: "Expel Lot's folk from your city. They pretend to be absolutely clean."
t.19: But the answer of his folk was naught save that they said: Expel the household of Lot from your township, for they (forsooth) are folk who would keep clean!
t.22: But his people gave no other answer but this: they said, "Drive out the followers of Lut from your city: these are indeed men who want to be clean and pure!"
t.203: There was no other answer given by his people except that they said: "Drive out the family of Lût (Lot) from your city Verily, these are men who want to be clean and pure!"
t.54: قوم کا جواب بجز اس کہنے کے اور کچھ نہ تھا کہ آل لوط کو اپنے شہر سے شہر بدر کر دو، یہ تو بڑے پاک باز بن رہے ہیں.

t.149: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife, whom We destined to be of those who lingered behind.
t.84: So, We saved him and his family, except his wife. We destined her to remain among those who stayed behind.
t.85: We saved him and his family- except for his wife: We made her stay behind-
t.95: Eventually We saved (Lot) and his family, except his wife. We had decreed that she should be among those who would remain behind.
t.19: Then We saved him and his household save his wife; We destined her to be of those who stayed behind.
t.22: But We saved him and his family, except his wife; her We destined to be of those who lagged behind.
t.203: So We saved him and his family, except his wife. We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
t.54: پس ہم نے اسے اور اس کے اہل کو بجز اس کی بیوی کے سب کو بچالیا، اس کا اندازه تو باقی ره جانے والوں میں ہم لگا ہی چکے تھے.

t.149: And We rained upon them a rain, and so evil was the rain of the forewarned.
t.84: And We rained on them a rain. So evil was the rain of those who were warned.
t.85: and We brought rain down on them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been warned!
t.95: And We rained down upon them a rain. It was an evil rain for those who had already been warned.
t.19: And We rained a rain upon them. Dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.
t.22: And We rained down on them a shower (of brimstone): and evil was the shower on those who were admonished (but heeded not)!
t.203: And We rained down on them a rain (of stones). So evil was the rain of those who were warned.
t.54: اور ان پر ایک (خاص قسم) کی بارش برسادی، پس ان دھمکائے ہوئے لوگوں پر بری بارش ہوئی.

t.149: Say, “Praise be to Allah and peace be upon His servants whom He has elected. Is Allah better or what they associate?”
t.84: Say, “Praise belongs to Allah, and peace be on those of His servants whom He has chosen.” Is Allah better or that which they associate (with Him as His partners)?
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Praise be to God and peace on the servants He has chosen. Who is better: God, or those they set up as partners with Him?
t.95: Say, (O Muhammad): "All praise be to Allah, and peace be on those of His servants whom He has chosen." (Ask them): "Who is better: Allah or the false gods that they associate with Him as His partners?
t.19: Say (O Muhammad): Praise be to Allah, and peace be on His slaves whom He hath chosen! Is Allah best, or (all) that ye ascribe as partners (unto Him)?
t.22: Say: Praise be to Allah, and Peace on his servants whom He has chosen (for his Message). (Who) is better?- Allah or the false gods they associate (with Him)?
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Praise and thanks be to Allâh, and peace be on His slaves whom He has chosen (for His Message)! Is Allâh better, or (all) that you ascribe as partners (to Him)?" (Of course, Allâh is Better).
t.54: تو کہہ دے کہ تمام تعریف اللہ ہی کے لیے ہے اور اس کے برگزیده بندوں پر سلام ہے۔ کیا اللہ تعالیٰ بہتر ہے یا وه جنہیں یہ لوگ شریک ٹھہرا رہے ہیں.

t.149: Or who(else then) is the one who created the heavens and the earth, and sent down to youfrom the sky water with which Wegerminated gardens full of beauty, whose trees you could not have germinated? Is there any other god with Allah? Rather, they are a people who equate.
t.84: Or the One who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you water from the sky? Then We caused to grow with it gardens, full of glamour. It was not within your ability to grow their trees. Is there any god along with Allah? No, but they are a people who equate (others with Allah).
t.85: Who created the heavens and earth? Who sends down water from the sky for you- with which We cause gardens of delight to grow: you have no power to make the trees grow in them- is it another god beside God? No! But they are people who take others to be equal with God.
t.95: Who is it that has created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you water from the sky and then We caused to grow therewith orchards full of beauty whose trees you could never grow. Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)?" Nay, they are a people who are veering away from the Right Path.
t.19: Is not He (best) Who created the heavens and the earth, and sendeth down for you water from the sky wherewith We cause to spring forth joyous orchards, whose trees it never hath been yours to cause to grow. Is there any Allah beside Allah? Nay, but they are folk who ascribe equals (unto Him)!
t.22: Or, Who has created the heavens and the earth, and Who sends you down rain from the sky? Yea, with it We cause to grow well-planted orchards full of beauty of delight: it is not in your power to cause the growth of the trees in them. (Can there be another) god besides Allah? Nay, they are a people who swerve from justice.
t.203: Is not He (better than your gods) Who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you water (rain) from the sky, whereby We cause to grow wonderful gardens full of beauty and delight? It is not in your ability to cause the growth of their trees. Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Nay, but they are a people who ascribe equals (to Him)!
t.54: بھلا بتاؤ تو؟ کہ آسمانوں کو اور زمین کو کس نے پیدا کیا؟ کس نے آسمان سے بارش برسائی؟ پھر اس سے ہرے بھرے بارونق باغات اگا دیئے؟ ان باغوں کے درختوں کو تم ہر گز نہ اگا سکتے، کیا اللہ کے ساتھ اور کوئی معبود بھی ہے؟ بلکہ یہ لوگ ہٹ جاتے ہیں (سیدھی راه سے).

t.149: Or who(else then) is the one who made the earth habitable and made rivers flow through it and set firm mountains for it and placed a partition between the two seas? Is there any other god with Allah? Rather, most of them do not know.
t.84: Or the One who made the earth a place to settle and made rivers amidst it and made mountains for (making) it (firm), and made a barrier between two seas? Is there any god along with Allah? No, but most of them do not have knowledge.
t.85: Who is it that made the earth a stable place to live? Who made rivers flow through it? Who set immovable mountains on it and created a barrier between the fresh and salt water? Is it another god beside God? No! But most of them do not know.
t.95: Who is it Who has made the earth a place of resort, and has caused rivers to flow in its midst, and has placed upon it firm mountains, and has placed a barrier between two masses of water? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Nay; but most of them do not know.
t.19: Is not He (best) Who made the earth a fixed abode, and placed rivers in the folds thereof, and placed firm hills therein, and hath set a barrier between the two seas? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Nay, but most of them know not!
t.22: Or, Who has made the earth firm to live in; made rivers in its midst; set thereon mountains immovable; and made a separating bar between the two bodies of flowing water? (can there be another) god besides Allah? Nay, most of them know not.
t.203: Is not He (better than your gods) Who has made the earth as a fixed abode, and has placed rivers in its midst, and has placed firm mountains therein, and has set a barrier between the two seas (of salt and sweet water)? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Nay, but most of them know not!
t.54: کیا وه جس نے زمین کو قرار گاه بنایا اور اس کے درمیان نہریں جاری کر دیں اور اس کے لیے پہاڑ بنائے اور دو سمندروں کے درمیان روک بنا دی کیا اللہ کے ساتھ اور کوئی معبود بھی ہے؟ بلکہ ان میں سے اکثر کچھ جانتے ہی نہیں.

t.149: Or who(else then) is the one who responds to someone in need when he calls upon Him and relieves evil and makes you successors on earth? Is there any other god with Allah? Little do you remind yourselves.
t.84: Or the One who responds to a helpless person when he prays to Him and removes distress, and who makes you vicegerents of the earth? Is there any god along with Allah? No, but little you heed to advice.
t.85: Who is it that answers the distressed when they call upon Him? Who removes their suffering? Who makes you successors in the earth? Is it another god beside God? Little notice you take!
t.95: Who is it Who heeds the prayers of the distressed when he calls out to Him and Who removes his affliction? And who is it Who makes you vicegerents of the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? How little do you reflect!
t.19: Is not He (best) Who answereth the wronged one when he crieth unto Him and removeth the evil, and hath made you viceroys of the earth? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Little do they reflect!
t.22: Or, Who listens to the (soul) distressed when it calls on Him, and Who relieves its suffering, and makes you (mankind) inheritors of the earth? (Can there be another) god besides Allah? Little it is that ye heed!
t.203: Is not He (better than your gods) Who responds to the distressed one, when he calls on Him, and Who removes the evil, and makes you inheritors of the earth, generations after generations? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Little is that you remember!
t.54: بے کس کی پکار کو جب کہ وه پکارے، کون قبول کرکے سختی کو دور کر دیتا ہے؟ اور تمہیں زمین کا خلیفہ بناتا ہے، کیا اللہ تعالیٰ کے ساتھ اور معبود ہے؟ تم بہت کم نصیحت وعبرت حاصل کرتے ہو.

t.149: Or who(else then) is the one who guides youthrough the darkness(es) of the land and the sea, and who sends the winds as heraldsof glad tidings before His mercy? Is there any other god with Allah? Most High is Allah above what they associate.
t.84: Or the One who guides you in depths of darkness on land and sea, and who sends the winds bearing good news before His mercy? Is there any god along with Allah? Allah is far higher than the partners they ascribe to Him.
t.85: Who is it that guides you through the darkness on land and sea? Who sends the winds as heralds of good news before His mercy? Is it another god beside God? God is far above the partners they put beside him!
t.95: Who is it Who guides you through the darkness on land and sea? And Who sends winds as heralds of good tidings ahead of His Mercy? Is there any god associated with Allah (in this task)? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate with Him in His Divinity!
t.19: Is not He (best) Who guideth you in the darkness of the land and the sea, He Who sendeth the winds as heralds of His mercy? Is there any Allah beside Allah? High Exalted be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!
t.22: Or, Who guides you through the depths of darkness on land and sea, and Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy? (Can there be another) god besides Allah?- High is Allah above what they associate with Him!
t.203: Is not He (better than your gods) Who guides you in the darkness of the land and the sea, and Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His Mercy (rain)? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? High Exalted be Allâh above all that they associate as partners (to Him)!
t.54: کیا وه جو تمہیں خشکی اور تری کی تاریکیوں میں راه دکھاتا ہے اور جو اپنی رحمت سے پہلے ہی خوشخبریاں دینے والی ہوائیں چلاتا ہے، کیا اللہ کے ساتھ کوئی اور معبود بھی ہے جنہیں یہ شریک کرتے ہیں ان سب سے اللہ بلند وباﻻتر ہے.

t.149: Or who(else then) is the one who originates creation and then restores it, and Who provides for youfrom the sky and the land? Is there any other god with Allah? Say, “Produce yourproof, if you are truthful.”
t.84: Or the One who originated creation, then will reproduce it, and who gives you provision from the sky and the earth? Is there any god along with Allah? Say, “Bring your proof if you are true.”
t.85: Who is it that creates life and reproduces it? Who is it that gives you provision from the heavens and earth? Is it another god beside God?’ Say, ‘Show me your evidence then, if what you say is true.’
t.95: Who is it Who creates in the first instance and then repeats it? Who is it Who provides you with sustenance from the heavens and the earth? Is there any god associated with Allah (in these tasks)? Say: "Bring forth your evidence, if you are truthful."
t.19: Is not He (best) Who produceth creation, then reproduceth it, and Who provideth for you from the heaven and the earth? Is there any Allah beside Allah? Say: Bring your proof, if ye are truthful!
t.22: Or, Who originates creation, then repeats it, and who gives you sustenance from heaven and earth? (Can there be another) god besides Allah? Say, "Bring forth your argument, if ye are telling the truth!"
t.203: Is not He (better than your so-called gods) Who originates creation, and shall thereafter repeat it, and Who provides for you from heaven and earth? Is there any ilâh (god) with Allâh? Say: "Bring forth your proofs, if you are truthful."
t.54: کیا وه جو مخلوق کی اول دفعہ پیدائش کرتا ہے پھر اسے لوٹائے گا اور جو تمہیں آسمان اور زمین سے روزیاں دے رہا ہے، کیا اللہ کے ساتھ کوئی اور معبود ہے کہہ دیجئے کہ اگر سچے ہو تو اپنی دلیل ﻻؤ.

t.149: Say, “No one in the heavens or the earth knows what is hidden except Allah.” For they are unaware of when they will be resurrected;
t.84: Say, “No one in the heavens and the earth has the knowledge of the Unseen except Allah.” And they do not know when they will be raised again.
t.85: Say, ‘No one in the heavens or on earth knows the unseen except God.’ They do not know when they will be raised from the dead:
t.95: Say: "None in the heavens or on the earth has knowledge of the Unseen save Allah. They do not know when they will be raised to life."
t.19: Say (O Muhammad): None in the heavens and the earth knoweth the Unseen save Allah; and they know not when they will be raised (again).
t.22: Say: None in the heavens or on earth, except Allah, knows what is hidden: nor can they perceive when they shall be raised up (for Judgment).
t.203: Say: "None in the heavens and the earth knows the Ghaib (Unseen) except Allâh, nor can they perceive when they shall be resurrected."
t.54: کہہ دیجئے کہ آسمانوں والوں میں سے زمین والوں میں سے سوائے اللہ کے کوئی غیب نہیں جانتا، انہیں تو یہ بھی نہیں معلوم کہ کب اٹھا کھڑے کیے جائیں گے؟

t.149: rather, their knowledge has been reached in the Hereafter; rather, they are in doubt about it; rather, they are completely blind to it.
t.84: Rather, their knowledge has failed in respect of the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are blind to it.
t.85: their knowledge cannot comprehend the Hereafter; they are in doubt about it; they are blind to it.
t.95: Nay, but they have lost their knowledge of the Hereafter. They are steeped in doubt and uncertainty about it: rather they are blind to it.
t.19: Nay, but doth their knowledge reach to the Hereafter? Nay, for they are in doubt concerning it. Nay, for they cannot see it.
t.22: Still less can their knowledge comprehend the Hereafter: Nay, they are in doubt and uncertainty thereanent; nay, they are blind thereunto!
t.203: Nay, they have no knowledge of the Hereafter. Nay, they are in doubt about it. Nay, they are in complete blindness about it.
t.54: بلکہ آخرت کے بارے میں ان کا علم ختم ہوچکا ہے، بلکہ یہ اس کی طرف سے شک میں ہیں۔ بلکہ یہ اس سے اندھے ہیں.

t.149: And those who denied said, “Can it be that when we have become dust, and our forefathers—can it be thatwe will really be brought out?
t.84: And said those who disbelieved, “Is it that, when we and our fathers become dust,-is it that we shall really be brought forth?
t.85: So the disbelievers say, ‘What! When we and our forefathers have become dust, shall we be brought back to life again?
t.95: The unbelievers say: "When we become dust, we and our forefathers, shall we really be brought out (from our graves)?
t.19: Yet those who disbelieve say: When we have become dust like our fathers, shall we verily be brought forth (again)?
t.22: The Unbelievers say: "What! when we become dust,- we and our fathers,- shall we really be raised (from the dead)?
t.203: And those who disbelieve say: "When we have become dust - we and our fathers - shall we really be brought forth (again)?
t.54: کافروں نے کہا کہ کیا جب ہم مٹی ہو جائیں گے اور ہمارے باپ دادا بھی کیا ہم پھر نکالے جائیں گے.

t.149: Most surely, we were promised this before, we and our forefathers; this is nothing but the legends of the ancients.”
t.84: Indeed, it was promised to us and to our fathers even before this. This is nothing but the tales of the ancients.”
t.85: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
t.95: We were told about this and so were our forefathers before us. But these are no more than fairy tales that have been recounted from ancient times."
t.19: We were promised this, forsooth, we and our fathers. (All) this is naught but fables of the men of old.
t.22: "It is true we were promised this,- we and our fathers before (us): these are nothing but tales of the ancients."
t.203: "Indeed we were promised this - we and our forefathers before (us), verily, these are nothing but tales of ancients."
t.54: ہم اور ہمارے باپ دادوں کو بہت پہلے سے یہ وعدے دیے جاتے رہے۔ کچھ نہیں یہ تو صرف اگلوں کے افسانے ہیں.

t.149: Say, “Journey through the earth and look what the outcome was for the criminals.”
t.84: Say, “Travel in the land and see how was the fate of the sinners.”
t.85: [Prophet], say, ‘Travel through the earth and see how the evildoers ended up.’
t.95: Say: "Go about through the earth and see what has been the end of the evil-doers."
t.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Travel in the land and see the nature of the sequel for the guilty!
t.22: Say: "Go ye through the earth and see what has been the end of those guilty (of sin)."
t.203: Say to them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "Travel in the land and see how has been the end of the Mujrimûn (criminals, those who denied Allâh’s Messengers and disobeyed Allâh)."
t.54: کہہ دیجئے کہ زمین میں چل پھر کر ذرا دیکھو تو سہی کہ گنہگاروں کا کیسا انجام ہوا؟

t.149: But donot grieve over them and do not be troubled by what they scheme.
t.84: And do not grieve for them, nor should your heart be straitened because of what they plan.
t.85: [Prophet], do not grieve over them; do not be distressed by their schemes.
t.95: (O Prophet), do not grieve over them, nor be distressed at their designs.
t.19: And grieve thou not for them, nor be in distress because of what they plot (against thee).
t.22: But grieve not over them, nor distress thyself because of their plots.
t.203: And grieve you not over them, nor be straitened (in distress) because of what they plot.
t.54: آپ ان کے بارے میں غم نہ کریں اور ان کے داؤں گھات سے تنگ دل نہ ہوں.

t.149: And they say, “When is this promise, if you are truthful?”
t.84: They say, “When shall this promise come to pass if you are true?”
t.85: They also say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled if what you say is true?’
t.95: They also say: "Tell us when this threat will come to pass, if you are truthful."
t.19: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
t.22: They also say: "When will this promise (come to pass)? (Say) if ye are truthful."
t.203: And they (the disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) say: "When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if you are truthful?"
t.54: کہتے ہیں کہ یہ وعده کب ہے اگر سچے ہو تو بتلا دو.

t.149: Say, “Perhaps some of what you are asking to be hastened has drawn near.”
t.84: Say, “It is not unlikely that some part of that (punishment) which you are asking to come soon is already following you closely.”
t.85: Say, ‘Maybe some of what you seek to hasten is near at hand.’
t.95: Say: "The chastisement whose hastening you have been asking for, maybe a part of it has drawn quite near to you."
t.19: Say: It may be that a part of that which ye would hasten on is close behind you.
t.22: Say: "It may be that some of the events which ye wish to hasten on may be (close) in your pursuit!"
t.203: Say: "Perhaps that which you wish to hasten on, may be close behind you.
t.54: جواب دیجئے! کہ شاید بعض وه چیزیں جن کی تم جلدی مچا رہے ہو تم سے بہت ہی قریب ہوگئی ہوں.

t.149: And indeed, yourLord is surely the Possessor of grace towards mankind, but most of them are not thankful.
t.84: And surely, your Lord is graceful for the mankind, but most of the people are not grateful.
t.85: Your Lord is bountiful to people, though most of them are ungrateful.
t.95: Indeed Your Lord is exceedingly bountiful to mankind. Yet most of them do not give thanks.
t.19: Lo! thy Lord is full of bounty for mankind, but most of them do not give thanks.
t.22: But verily thy Lord is full of grace to mankind: Yet most of them are ungrateful.
t.203: "Verily, your Lord is full of Grace for mankind, yet most of them do not give thanks."
t.54: یقیناً آپ کا پروردگار تمام لوگوں پر بڑے ہی فضل واﻻ ہے لیکن اکثر لوگ ناشکری کرتے ہیں.

t.149: And indeed, yourLord knows whatever their chests harbor and whatever they make public.
t.84: Of course, your Lord knows for sure what their hearts conceal and what they reveal.
t.85: He knows everything their hearts conceal and everything they reveal:
t.95: Verily your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal as well as all that they reveal.
t.19: Lo! thy Lord knoweth surely all that their bosoms hide, and all that they proclaim.
t.22: And verily thy Lord knoweth all that their hearts do hide. As well as all that they reveal.
t.203: And verily, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they reveal.
t.54: بیشک آپ کا رب ان چیزوں کو بھی جانتا ہے جنہیں ان کے سینے چھپا رہے ہیں اور جنہیں ﻇاہر کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: And never is there anything hidden in the heaven or the earth but it is in an evident record.
t.84: There is nothing hidden in the heavens and the earth that is not (recorded) in a manifest book.
t.85: there is nothing hidden in the heavens or on earth that is not in a clear Record.
t.95: There is nothing that is hidden - be it in the heaven or the earth - but is recorded in a Clear Book.
t.19: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven or the earth but it is in a clear Record.
t.22: Nor is there aught of the unseen, in heaven or earth, but is (recorded) in a clear record.
t.203: And there is nothing hidden in the heaven and the earth but it is in a Clear Book (i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz).
t.54: آسمان وزمین کی کوئی پوشیده چیز بھی ایسی نہیں جو روشن اور کھلی کتاب میں نہ ہو.

t.149: This Recitalindeed narrates to the Children of Israel most of what they differ over,
t.84: Surely this Qur’ān mentions to the children of Isrā’īl most of the matters in which they dispute.
t.85: Truly, this Quran explains to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about,
t.95: Surely this Qur'an explains to the Children of Israel most of the matters concerning which they have disagreements
t.19: Lo! this Qur'an narrateth unto the Children of Israel most of that concerning which they differ.
t.22: Verily this Qur'an doth explain to the Children of Israel most of the matters in which they disagree.
t.203: Verily, this Qur’ân narrates to the Children of Israel most of that in which they differ.
t.54: یقیناً یہ قرآن بنی اسرائیل کے سامنے ان اکثر چیزوں کا بیان کر رہا ہے جن میں یہ اختلاف کرتے ہیں.

t.149: and most surely it is a guidance and a mercy to the believers.
t.84: It is guidance and mercy for the believers.
t.85: and it is guidance and grace for those who believe.
t.95: and it is a guidance and mercy for the believers.
t.19: And lo! it is a guidance and a mercy for believers.
t.22: And it certainly is a Guide and a Mercy to those who believe.
t.203: And truly, it (this Qur’ân) is a guide and a mercy for the believers.
t.54: اور یہ قرآن ایمان والوں کے لیے یقیناً ہدایت اور رحمت ہے.

t.149: Indeed, yourLord decrees between them by His wise judgment, and He is the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
t.84: And surely your Lord will decide between them by His judgment, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
t.85: Truly, your Lord will judge between them in His wisdom- He is the Almighty, the All Knowing-
t.95: Indeed your Lord will decide between them by His judgement. He is All-Mighty, All-Knowing.
t.19: Lo! thy Lord will judge between them of His wisdom, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
t.22: Verily thy Lord will decide between them by His Decree: and He is Exalted in Might, All-Knowing.
t.203: Verily, your Lord will decide between them (various sects) by His Judgement. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
t.54: آپ کا رب ان کے درمیان اپنے حکم سے سب فیصلے کر دے گا، وه بڑا ہی غالب اور دانا ہے.

t.149: So place yourtrust in Allah; you are indeed upon the evident truth.
t.84: So trust in Allah. Surely you are on the clear truth.
t.85: so [Prophet], put your trust in God, you are on the path of clear truth.
t.95: So put your trust in Allah for you are on the manifest truth.
t.19: Therefor (O Muhammad) put thy trust in Allah, for thou (standest) on the plain Truth.
t.22: So put thy trust in Allah: for thou art on (the path of) manifest Truth.
t.203: So put your trust in Allâh; surely, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are on manifest truth.
t.54: پس آپ یقیناً اللہ ہی پر بھروسہ رکھیے، یقیناً آپ سچے اور کھلے دین پر ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, youcannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hearthe call if they withdraw and turn their backs.
t.84: Surely, you cannot make the dead to hear, nor can you make the deaf to hear your call when they turn their backs in retreat,
t.85: You cannot make the dead hear, you cannot make the deaf listen to your call when they turn their backs and leave,
t.95: Surely you cannot make the dead hear you, nor can you make the deaf hear your call if they turn back in flight,
t.19: Lo! thou canst not make the dead to hear, nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call when they have turned to flee;
t.22: Truly thou canst not cause the dead to listen, nor canst thou cause the deaf to hear the call, (especially) when they turn back in retreat.
t.203: Verily, you cannot make the dead to hear nor can you make the deaf to hear the call (i.e. benefit them and similarly the disbelievers), when they flee, turning their backs.
t.54: بیشک آپ نہ مُردوں کو سنا سکتے ہیں اور نہ بہروں کو اپنی پکار سنا سکتے ہیں، جبکہ وه پیٹھ پھیرے روگرداں جا رہے ہوں.

t.149: Nor can youguide the blind out of their utter misguidance; you can make no one hear except those who believe in Our signs, and are(thus) Muslims.
t.84: nor can you show the right path to the blind against their wandering astray. You can make no one to listen (to you) except those who believe in Our verses, then submit themselves (to Allah).
t.85: you cannot guide the blind out of their error: you cannot make anyone hear you except those who believe in Our signs and submit [to Us].
t.95: nor can you direct the blind to the Right Way, preventing them from falling into error. You can make only those who believe in Our verses to hear the call and then submit.
t.19: Nor canst thou lead the blind out of their error. Thou canst make none to hear, save those who believe Our revelations and who have surrendered.
t.22: Nor canst thou be a guide to the blind, (to prevent them) from straying: only those wilt thou get to listen who believe in Our Signs, and they will bow in Islam.
t.203: Nor can you lead the blind out of their error. You can only make to hear those who believe in Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and who have submitted (themselves to Allâh in Islâm as Muslims).
t.54: اور نہ آپ اندھوں کو ان کی گمراہی سے ہٹا کر رہنمائی کر سکتے ہیں آپ تو صرف انہیں سنا سکتے ہیں جو ہماری آیتوں پر ایمان ﻻئے ہیں پھر وه فرمانبردار ہوجاتے ہیں.

t.149: And when the decree is fulfilled against them, We will bring out for them—from the earth—a treading creature that will tell them that mankindused to have no certitude in Our signs.
t.84: When the word will come to fall upon them, We will bring forth for them a beast from the earth who will speak to them that the human beings (i.e the infidels) did not believe in Our signs.
t.85: When the verdict is given against them, We shall bring a creature out of the earth, which will tell them that people had no faith in Our revelations.
t.95: And when the time for the fulfilment of Our Word against them will come, We shall bring forth for them a beast from the earth who will speak to them because people did not believe in Our Signs.
t.19: And when the word is fulfilled concerning them, We shall bring forth a beast of the earth to speak unto them because mankind had not faith in Our revelations.
t.22: And when the Word is fulfilled against them (the unjust), we shall produce from the earth a beast to (face) them: He will speak to them, for that mankind did not believe with assurance in Our Signs.
t.203: And when the Word (of torment) is fulfilled against them, We shall bring out from the earth a beast for them, to speak to them because mankind believed not with certainty in Our Ayât (Verses of the Qur’ân and Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).
t.54: جب ان کے اوپر عذاب کا وعده ﺛابت ہو جائے گا، ہم زمین سے ان کے لیے ایک جانور نکالیں گے جو ان سے باتیں کرتا ہوگا کہ لوگ ہماری آیتوں پر یقین نہیں کرتے تھے.

t.149: On the day when We herd from every community a crowd of those who disbelieve our signs, so that they are held in strict order.
t.84: And (remember) the day when We will gather from every nation a host of those who used to reject Our verses, and they will be kept under control.
t.85: The Day will come when We gather from every community a crowd of those who disbelieved in Our signs and they will be led in separate groups
t.95: Just imagine the Day when We shall muster from every nation a large group of those who gave the lie to Our Signs, and they shall be duly arranged in ranks
t.19: And (remind them of) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a host of those who denied Our revelations, and they will be set in array;
t.22: One day We shall gather together from every people a troop of those who reject our Signs, and they shall be kept in ranks,-
t.203: And (remember) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a troop of those who denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and (then) they (all) shall be driven (to the place of reckoning),
t.54: اور جس دن ہم ہر امت میں سے ان لوگوں کے گروه کو جو ہماری آیتوں کو جھٹلاتے تھے گھیر گھار کر ﻻئیں گے پھر وه سب کے سب الگ کر دیئے جائیں گے.

t.149: Until, when they come(before their Lord) , He will say, “Did you deny My signs and did you not encompass them in knowledge, or what were you doing?”
t.84: Until when they will come, He (Allah) will say, “Did you reject My verses while you did not comprehend them with knowledge, or what was it that you used to do?
t.85: until, when they come before Him, He will say, ‘Did you deny My messages without even taking them in? Or what were you doing?’
t.95: until, when all of them have arrived, Allah will say: "Did you give the lie to My Signs even without encompassing them with your knowledge? If that is not so, what did you do?"
t.19: Till, when they come (before their Lord), He will say: Did ye deny My revelations when ye could not compass them in knowledge, or what was it that ye did?
t.22: Until, when they come (before the Judgment-seat), (Allah) will say: "Did ye reject My Signs, though ye comprehended them not in knowledge, or what was it ye did?"
t.203: Till, when they come (before their Lord at the place of reckoning), He will say: "Did you deny My Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) whereas you comprehended them not by knowledge (of their truth or falsehood), or what (else) was it that you used to do?"
t.54: جب سب کے سب آپہنچیں گے تو اللہ تعالیٰ فرمائے گا کہ تم نے میری آیتوں کو باوجودیکہ تمہیں ان کا پورا علم نہ تھا کیوں جھٹلایا؟ اور یہ بھی بتلاؤ کہ تم کیا کچھ کرتے رہے؟

t.149: And the decree shall be fulfilled against them for the injustices they did, and they shall be speechless.
t.84: And the Word will come to fall on them because of their transgression, so they will not (be able to) speak.
t.85: The verdict will be given against them because of their wrongdoing: they will not speak.
t.95: And the Word will come to pass against them because of their wrong-doing: they will then be able to utter nothing.
t.19: And the Word will be fulfilled concerning them because they have done wrong, and they will not speak.
t.22: And the Word will be fulfilled against them, because of their wrong-doing, and they will be unable to speak (in plea).
t.203: And the Word (of torment) will be fulfilled against them, because they have done wrong, and they will be unable to speak (in order to defend themselves).
t.54: بسبب اس کے کہ انہوں نے ﻇلم کیا تھا ان پر بات جم جائے گی اور وه کچھ بول نہ سکیں گے.

t.149: Have they not seen that We have made the night for them to rest therein and the day allowing sight? Indeed, in that are signs for people who believe.
t.84: Did they not see that We made the night, so that they may have rest in it, and (made) the day to make them see? Surely, in this there are signs for a people who believe.
t.85: Did they not see that We gave them the night for rest, and the day for light? There truly are signs in this for those who believe.
t.95: Did they not perceive that We had made the night so that they may repose in it and made the day clear and shining. Surely there are Signs in this for those who believe.
t.19: Have they not seen how We have appointed the night that they may rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Lo! therein verily are portents for a people who believe.
t.22: See they not that We have made the Night for them to rest in and the Day to give them light? Verily in this are Signs for any people that believe!
t.203: See they not that We have made the night for them to rest therein, and the day sight-giving? Verily, in this are Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) for the people who believe.
t.54: کیا وه دیکھ نہیں رہے ہیں کہ ہم نے رات کو اس لیے بنایا ہے کہ وه اس میں آرام حاصل کرلیں اور دن کو ہم نے دکھلانے واﻻ بنایا ہے، یقیناً اس میں ان لوگوں کے لیے نشانیاں ہیں جو ایمان ویقین رکھتے ہیں.

t.149: And on the day when the Trumpet is blown, and everyone in the heavens and the earth washorrified, except whomever Allah willed, and everyone came before Him in humility.
t.84: And (remember) the day when the Horn will be blown; so all those in the heavens and the earth will be in panic, except those whom Allah wills. And All (of them) will come to Him in humility.
t.85: On the Day the Trumpet sounds, everyone in heaven and on earth will be terrified- except such as God wills- and all will come to Him in utter humility.
t.95: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown all those who are in the heavens and on the earth shall be terror stricken - all except those whom Allah wills - and everyone shall come to Him utterly abject.
t.19: And (remind them of) the Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and all who are in the heavens and the earth will start in fear, save him whom Allah willeth. And all come unto Him, humbled.
t.22: And the Day that the Trumpet will be sounded - then will be smitten with terror those who are in the heavens, and those who are on earth, except such as Allah will please (to exempt): and all shall come to His (Presence) as beings conscious of their lowliness.
t.203: And (remember) the Day on which the Trumpet will be blown - and all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth, will be terrified except him whom Allâh will (exempt). And all shall come to Him, humbled.
t.54: جس دن صور پھونکا جائے گا تو سب کے سب آسمانوں والے اور زمین والے گھبرا اٹھیں گے مگر جسے اللہ تعالیٰ چاہے، اور سارے کے سارے عاجز وپست ہو کر اس کے سامنے حاضر ہوں گے.

t.149: And yousee the mountains, thinking them fixed, yet they pass as the passing of the clouds—the making of Allah Who has perfected everything; He is indeed All-Aware of what you do.
t.84: And you see the mountains (at present) supposing them as fixed (forever), while (on that Day) they will fly like the flight of clouds - an act of Allah who has perfected every thing. Surely, He is All-Aware of what you do.
t.85: You will see the mountains and think they are firmly fixed, but they will float away like clouds: this is the handiwork of God who has perfected all things. He is fully aware of what you do:
t.95: You now see the mountains and consider them firmly fixed, but then they shall pass away even as clouds pass away. That will be the handiwork of Allah Who has created everything with perfect wisdom. He is well aware of what you do.
t.19: And thou seest the hills thou deemest solid flying with the flight of clouds: the doing of Allah Who perfecteth all things. Lo! He is Informed of what ye do.
t.22: Thou seest the mountains and thinkest them firmly fixed: but they shall pass away as the clouds pass away: (such is) the artistry of Allah, who disposes of all things in perfect order: for he is well acquainted with all that ye do.
t.203: And you will see the mountains and think them solid, but they shall pass away as the passing away of the clouds. The Work of Allâh, Who perfected all things, verily He is Well-Acquainted with what you do.
t.54: اور آپ پہاڑوں کو دیکھ کر اپنی جگہ جمے ہوئے خیال کرتے ہیں لیکن وه بھی بادل کی طرح اڑتے پھریں گے، یہ ہے صنعت اللہ کی جس نے ہر چیز کو مضبوط بنایا ہے، جو کچھ تم کرتے ہو اس سے وه باخبر ہے.

t.149: Whoever comes with a good deed—for him is one better than it and they are safe from horror onthat day,
t.84: Whoever will come with the good deed will have (a reward) better than that, and such people will be immune on that day from any panic.
t.85: whoever comes with a good deed will be rewarded with something better, and be secure from the terrors of that Day,
t.95: Whosoever comes with good will receive a reward better than his deed, and they will be made secure from the terror of that Day.
t.19: Whoso bringeth a good deed will have better than its worth; and such are safe from fear that Day.
t.22: If any do good, good will (accrue) to them therefrom; and they will be secure from terror that Day.
t.203: Whoever brings a good deed (i.e. Belief in the Oneness of Allâh along with every deed of righteousness), will have better than its worth; and they will be safe from the terror on that Day.
t.54: جو لوگ نیک عمل ﻻئیں گے انھیں اس سے بہتر بدلہ ملے گا اور وه اس دن کی گھبراہٹ سے بےخوف ہوں گے.

t.149: while whoever comes with an evil deed—their faces are tumbled into the Fire. “Are youbeing repaid except for what you used to do?”
t.84: And whoever will come with evil deed, the faces of such people will be thrown down into the Fire. You will not be recompensed but for what you used to do.
t.85: but whoever comes with evil deeds will be cast face downwards into the Fire. ‘Are you rewarded for anything except what you have done?’
t.95: And whosoever comes with evil, they will be flung upon their faces into the Fire. Will you be recompensed for aught other than what you do?
t.19: And whoso bringeth an ill-deed, such will be flung down on their faces in the Fire. Are ye rewarded aught save what ye did?
t.22: And if any do evil, their faces will be thrown headlong into the Fire: "Do ye receive a reward other than that which ye have earned by your deeds?"
t.203: And whoever brings an evil deed (i.e. Shirk - polytheism, disbelief in the Oneness of Allâh and every evil sinful deed), they will be cast down (prone) on their faces in the Fire. (And it will be said to them) "Are you being recompensed anything except what you used to do?"
t.54: اور جو برائی لے کر آئیں گے وه اوندھے منھ آگ میں جھونک دیئے جائیں گے۔ صرف وہی بدلہ دیئے جاؤ گے جو تم کرتے رہے.

t.149: (Say ) “Indeed, I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this township, Who has made it inviolable and to Whom everything belongs, and I have been commanded to be of the Muslims
t.84: I am but ordered to worship the Lord of this city, which is sanctified by Him. And to Him belongs every thing, and I am ordered to be one of the Muslims (who submit themselves to Allah),
t.85: [Say Prophet], ‘What I am commanded to do is to serve the Sustainer of this town, which He has made inviolable. Everything belongs to Him; I am commanded to be one of those devoted to Him;
t.95: (Tell them, O Muhammad): "I have been commanded only to serve the Lord of this city that He has made inviolable, to serve Him to Whom all things belong. I have been commanded to be of those that submit to Allah,
t.19: (Say): I (Muhammad) am commanded only to serve the Lord of this land which He hath hallowed, and unto Whom all things belong. And I am commanded to be of those who surrender (unto Him),
t.22: For me, I have been commanded to serve the Lord of this city, Him Who has sanctified it and to Whom (belong) all things: and I am commanded to be of those who bow in Islam to Allah's Will,-
t.203: I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) have been commanded only to worship the Lord of this city (Makkah), Who has sanctified it and to Whom belongs everything. And I am commanded to be from among the Muslims (those who submit to Allâh in Islâm).
t.54: مجھے تو بس یہی حکم دیا گیا ہے کہ میں اس شہر کے پروردگار کی عبادت کرتا رہوں جس نے اسے حرمت واﻻ بنایا ہے، جس کی ملکیت ہر چیز ہے اور مجھے یہ بھی فرمایا گیا ہے کہ میں فرماں برداروں میں ہو جاؤں.

t.149: and to read the Recital; so whoever is guided, then he is surely guided to his own benefit. And whoever goes astray, then say, “Indeed, I am only one of the forewarners.”
t.84: and to recite the Qur’ān; so whoever takes the right path, takes it for his own benefit. As for the one who goes astray, say (to him), “I am only one of the warners.”
t.85: I am commanded to recite the Quran.’ Whoever chooses to follow the right path does so for his own good. Say to whoever deviates from it, ‘I am only here to warn.’
t.95: and to recite the Qur'an." So, whosoever is guided, his guidance will be to his own good. As for those who stray, tell them: "I am none but a warner."
t.19: And to recite the Qur'an. And whoso goeth right, goeth right only for (the good of) his own soul; and as for him who goeth astray - (Unto him) say: Lo! I am only a warner.
t.22: And to rehearse the Qur'an: and if any accept guidance, they do it for the good of their own souls, and if any stray, say: "I am only a Warner".
t.203: And that I should recite the Qur’ân, then whosoever receives guidance, receives it for the good of his ownself; and whosoever goes astray, say (to him): "I am only one of the warners."
t.54: اور میں قرآن کی تلاوت کرتا رہوں، جو راه راست پر آجائے وه اپنے نفع کے لیے راه راست پر آئے گا۔ اور جو بہک جائے تو کہہ دیجئے! کہ میں تو صرف ہوشیار کرنے والوں میں سے ہوں.

t.149: And say, “Praise be to Allah; He will show youHis signs and you will recognize them. For in no way is yourLord oblivious of what youdo .”
t.84: And say, “Praise belongs to Allah. He will show you His signs, then you will recognize them.” And your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
t.85: Say, ‘Praise belongs to God: He will show you His signs so that you will recognize them.’ Your Lord is never unmindful of what you all do.
t.95: And say: "All praise be to Allah, Who will soon show you His Signs that you will recognize." Your Lord is not unaware of what you do.
t.19: And say: Praise be to Allah Who will show you His portents so that ye shall know them. And thy Lord is not unaware of what ye (mortals) do.
t.22: And say: "Praise be to Allah, Who will soon show you His Signs, so that ye shall know them"; and thy Lord is not unmindful of all that ye do.
t.203: And say [(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to these polytheists and pagans.]: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh. He will show you His Ayât (signs, in yourselves, and in the universe or punishments), and you shall recognise them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
t.54: کہہ دیجئے، کہ تمام تعریفیں اللہ ہی کو سزاوار ہیں وه عنقریب اپنی نشانیاں دکھائے گا جنہیں تم (خود) پہچان لو گے۔ اور جو کچھ تم کرتے ہو اس سے آپ کا رب غافل نہیں.

t.149: Tâ Sîn Mīm.
t.84: Tā Sīn Mīm.
t.85: Ta Sin Mim
t.95: Ta'. Sin. Mim
t.19: Ta. Sin. Mim.
t.22: Ta. Sin. Mim.
t.203: Tâ-Sîn-Mîm
t.54: طٰسم.

t.149: Those are the signsof the Evident Scripture.
t.84: These are verses of the clear Book.
t.85: These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear:
t.95: These are the verses of the Clear Book.
t.19: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
t.22: These are Verses of the Book that makes (things) clear.
t.203: These are the Verses of the manifest Book (that makes clear truth from falsehood, good from evil).
t.54: یہ آیتیں ہیں روشن کتاب کی.*

t.149: We read to youfrom the tiding of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for people who believe.
t.84: We recite to you a part of the story of Mūsā and Pharaoh with truth for a people who believe.
t.85: We recount to you [Prophet] part of the story of Moses and Pharaoh, setting out the truth for people who believe.
t.95: We recount to you with truth some parts of the story of Moses and Pharaoh for the benefit of those who believe.
t.19: We narrate unto thee (somewhat) of the story of Moses and Pharaoh with truth, for folk who believe.
t.22: We rehearse to thee some of the story of Moses and Pharaoh in Truth, for people who believe.
t.203: We recite to you some of the news of Mûsâ (Moses) and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) in truth, for a people who believe (in this Qur’ân, and in the Oneness of Allâh).
t.54: ہم آپ کے سامنے موسیٰ اور فرعون کا صحیح واقعہ بیان کرتے ہیں ان لوگوں کے لیے جو ایمان رکھتے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, Pharaoh became exalted in the land and divided its people into sects, deeming a faction of them weak and oppressed: slaughtering their sons while keeping their women alive(in bondage) . Indeed, he was one of the corrupters.
t.84: Indeed, Pharaoh had become high-handed in the land, and had divided its people into different groups; he used to persecute a group of them, slaughtering their sons and keeping their women alive. Indeed he was one of the mischief-makers,
t.85: Pharaoh made himself high and mighty in the land and divided the people into different groups: one group he oppressed, slaughtering their sons and sparing their women––he was one of those who spread corruption––
t.95: Indeed Pharaoh transgressed in the land and divided its people into sections. One group of them he humiliated, and slew their sons and spared their daughters. Truly he was among the mischief-makers.
t.19: Lo! Pharaoh exalted himself in the earth and made its people castes. A tribe among them he oppressed, killing their sons and sparing their women. Lo! he was of those who work corruption.
t.22: Truly Pharaoh elated himself in the land and broke up its people into sections, depressing a small group among them: their sons he slew, but he kept alive their females: for he was indeed a maker of mischief.
t.203: Verily, Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) exalted himself in the land and made its people sects, weakening (oppressing) a group (i.e. Children of Israel) among them: killing their sons, and letting their females live. Verily, he was of the Mufsidûn(i.e. those who commit great sins and crimes, oppressors, tyrants).
t.54: یقیناً فرعون نے زمین میں سرکشی کر رکھی تھی اور وہاں کے لوگوں کو گروه گروه بنا رکھا تھا اور ان میں سے ایک فرقہ کو کمزور کر رکھا تھا اور ان کے لڑکوں کو تو ذبح کر ڈالتا تھا اور ان کی لڑکیوں کو زنده چھوڑ دیتا تھا۔ بیشک وشبہ وه تھا ہی مفسدوں میں سے.

t.149: Thus We are willing to favor those who were deemed weak and oppressed in the land and to make them leaders and to make them the inheritors
t.84: while We intended to favor those who were held as weak in the land, and to make them leaders and make them inheritors,
t.85: but We wished to favour those who were oppressed in that land, to make them leaders, the ones to survive,
t.95: We wanted to bestow favour on those who were oppressed in the land. We wanted to make them leaders and heirs
t.19: And We desired to show favour unto those who were oppressed in the earth, and to make them examples and to make them the inheritors,
t.22: And We wished to be Gracious to those who were being depressed in the land, to make them leaders (in Faith) and make them heirs,
t.203: And We wished to do a favour to those who were weak (and oppressed) in the land, and to make them rulers and to make them the inheritors,
t.54: پھر ہماری چاہت ہوئی کہ ہم ان پر کرم فرمائیں جنہیں زمین میں بےحد کمزور کر دیا گیا تھا، اور ہم انہیں کو پیشوا اور (زمین) کا وارث بنائیں.

t.149: and to establish them in the land and to show Pharaoh and Hamān and their troops from them the very thing they used to fear .
t.84: and give them power in the land, and to show Pharaoh, Hāmān and their armies the very thing they were fearing from them.
