t.54: بےشک اللہ تعالیٰ جاننے واﻻ ہے آسمانوں اور زمین کی پوشیده چیزوں کا، بےشک وہی جاننے واﻻ ہے سینوں کی باتوں کا.

t.149: It is He who made yousuccessors on earth. So whoever denies—his denial is upon him, and the denial of the deniers adds only to their Lord’s loathing of them, and the denial of the deniers adds only to their perdition.
t.84: He is the One who has made you successors (of the past generations) on the earth. So the one who becomes infidel, his infidelity will go against himself. Their infidelity adds nothing to the infidels but anger from their Lord, and their infidelity adds nothing to the infidels but loss.
t.85: it is He who made you [people] successors to the land. Those who deny the truth will bear the consequences: their denial will only make them more odious to their Lord, and add only to their loss.
t.95: It is He Who made you vicegerents in the earth. So whoever disbelieves will bear the burden of his unbelief. The unbelievers' unbelief adds nothing but Allah's wrath against them. The unbelievers' unbelief adds nothing but their own loss.
t.19: He it is Who hath made you regents in the earth; so he who disbelieveth, his disbelief be on his own head. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers, in their Lord's sight, naught save abhorrence. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers naught save loss.
t.22: He it is That has made you inheritors in the earth: if, then, any do reject (Allah), their rejection (works) against themselves: their rejection but adds to the odium for the Unbelievers in the sight of their Lord: their rejection but adds to (their own) undoing.
t.203: He it is Who has made you successors generations after generations in the earth, so whosoever disbelieves (in Islâmic Monotheism) on him will be his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers adds nothing but hatred of their Lord. And the disbelief of the disbelievers adds nothing but loss.
t.54: وہی ایسا ہے جس نے تم کو زمین میں آباد کیا، سو جو شخص کفر کرے گا اس کے کفر کا وبال اسی پر پڑے گا۔ اور کافروں کے لئے ان کا کفر ان کے پروردگار کے نزدیک ناراضی ہی بڑھنے کا باعﺚ ہوتا ہے، اور کافروں کے لئے ان کا کفر خساره ہی بڑھنے کا باعﺚ ہوتا ہے.

t.149: Say, “Have you regarded those associates of yours that you worship apart from Allah? Show me what they have created on earth.” Or do they have any share in the heavens? Or have We given them a scripture such that they rely on an evident proof from it? Rather, the unjust promise one another nothing but a deception.
t.84: Say, “Tell me about your (presumed) co-gods whom you invoke beside Allah. Show me that part of the earth that they have created. Or do they have a share in the (creation) of the heavens?” Or have We given them a book so that they are upon a clear proof from it? No, but the wrongdoers promise one another nothing but delusion.
t.85: Say, ‘Consider those “partners” of yours that you call upon beside God. Show me! What part of the earth did they create? What share of the heavens do they possess?’ Have We given them a book that contains clear evidence? No indeed! The idolaters promise each other only delusion.
t.95: Say to them (O Prophet): “Have you ever seen those of your associates upon whom you call apart from Allah? Show me what have they created in the earth? Or do they have any partnership (with Allah) in the heavens? Or have We given them a Book so that they have a clear proof (for associating others with Allah in His Divinity)?” Nay, what these wrong-doers promise each other is nothing but delusion.
t.19: Say: Have ye seen your partner-gods to whom ye pray beside Allah? Show me what they created of the earth! Or have they any portion in the heavens? Or have We given them a scripture so they act on clear proof therefrom? Nay, the evil-doers promise one another only to deceive.
t.22: Say: "Have ye seen (these) 'Partners' of yours whom ye call upon besides Allah? Show Me what it is they have created in the (wide) earth. Or have they a share in the heavens? Or have We given them a Book from which they (can derive) clear (evidence)?- Nay, the wrong-doers promise each other nothing but delusions.
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me or inform me (what) do you think about your (so-called) partner-gods to whom you call upon besides Allâh? Show me, what they have created of the earth. Or have they any share in the heavens? Or have We given them a Book, so that they act on clear proof therefrom? Nay, the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) promise one another nothing but delusions."
t.54: آپ کہیئے! کہ تم اپنے قرارداد شریکوں کا حال تو بتلاؤ جن کو تم اللہ کے سوا پوجا کرتے ہو۔ یعنی مجھ کو یہ بتلاؤ کہ انہوں نے زمین میں سے کون سا (جزو) بنایا ہے یا ان کا آسمانوں میں کچھ ساجھا ہے یا ہم نے ان کو کوئی کتاب دی ہے کہ یہ اس کی دلیل پر قائم ہوں، بلکہ یہ ﻇالم ایک دوسرے سے نرے دھوکے کی باتوں کا وعده کرتے آتے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. And were they to vanish, there is none to hold them both except He; indeed, He has always been Forbearing, Oft-Forgiving.
t.84: Undoubtedly, Allah holds back the heavens and the earth from leaving their existing state, and if they were to leave, there is none who can hold them back, except Him. Surely He is Forbearing, Most-Forgiving.
t.85: God keeps the heavens and earth from vanishing; if they did vanish, no one else could stop them. God is most forbearing, most forgiving.
t.95: Surely Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they should be displaced there, for if they were displaced none would be able to hold them after Him.Surely He is Most Forbearing, Most Forgiving.
t.19: Lo! Allah graspeth the heavens and the earth that they deviate not, and if they were to deviate there is not one that could grasp them after Him. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.
t.22: It is Allah Who sustains the heavens and the earth, lest they cease (to function): and if they should fail, there is none - not one - can sustain them thereafter: Verily He is Most Forbearing, Oft-Forgiving.
t.203: Verily! Allâh grasps the heavens and the earth lest they should move away from their places, and if they were to move away from their places, there is not one that could grasp them after Him. Truly, He is Ever Most Forbearing, Oft-Forgiving.
t.54: یقینی بات ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ آسمانوں اور زمین کو تھامے ہوئے ہے کہ وه ٹل نہ جائیں اور اگر وه ٹل جائیں تو پھر اللہ کے سوا اور کوئی ان کو تھام بھی نہیں سکتا۔ وه حلیم غفور ہے.

t.149: And they swore by Allah their most solemn oaths: that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any of the other communities. Yet when a warner came to them, it only increased them in aversion—
t.84: They had sworn forceful oaths that if a warner would come to them, they would be more receptive to guidance than any other community. But when a warner came to them, it added nothing to them but aversion,
t.85: [The idolaters] swore their most solemn oath that, if someone came to warn them, they would be more rightly guided than any [other] community, but when someone did come they turned yet further away,
t.95: Swearing by Allah their strongest oaths they claimed that if a warner came to them they would be better-guided than any other people. But when a warner did come to them, his coming only increased their aversion (to the Truth).
t.19: And they swore by Allah, their most binding oath, that if a warner came unto them they would be more tractable than any of the nations; yet, when a warner came unto them it aroused in them naught save repugnance,
t.22: They swore their strongest oaths by Allah that if a warner came to them, they would follow his guidance better than any (other) of the Peoples: But when a warner came to them, it has only increased their flight (from righteousness),-
t.203: And they swore by Allâh their most binding oath that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any of the nations (before them); yet when a warner (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) came to them, it increased in them nothing but flight (from the truth)
t.54: اور ان کفار نے بڑی زوردار قسم کھائی تھی کہ اگر ان کے پاس کوئی ڈرانے واﻻ آئے تو وه ہر ایک امت سے زیاده ہدایت قبول کرنے والے ہوں۔ پھر جب ان کے پاس ایک پیغمبر آ پہنچے تو بس ان کی نفرت ہی میں اضافہ ہوا.

t.149: behaving arrogantly in the land and scheming evil. But evil scheming surrounds none but its people. So do they expect anything but the precedent of the ancients? For youwill never find any change in Allah’s rule, and you will never find any deviation in Allah’s rule.
t.84: because of their showing arrogance in the land and plotting of evil. And the evil plot engulfs none but its own people (who make it). So, they are looking for nothing but the (divine) practice with the earlier people. So you will never find in Allah’s practice any change, and you will never find in Allah’s practice any diversion.
t.85: became more arrogant in the land, and intensified their plotting of evil- the plotting of evil only rebounds on those who plot. Do they expect anything but what happened to earlier people? You will never find any change in God’s practice; you will never find any deviation there.
t.95: They began to wax even more proud on earth and contrived evil designs although the contriving of evil designs only overtakes their authors. Are they waiting, then, for anything except what happened to the nations before them? You shall not find any change in the Way of Allah; and you shall not find anything that can ever alter the Way of Allah.
t.19: (Shown in their) behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil; and the evil plot encloseth but the men who make it. Then, can they expect aught save the treatment of the folk of old? Thou wilt not find for Allah's way of treatment any substitute, nor wilt thou find for Allah's way of treatment aught of power to change.
t.22: On account of their arrogance in the land and their plotting of Evil, but the plotting of Evil will hem in only the authors thereof. Now are they but looking for the way the ancients were dealt with? But no change wilt thou find in Allah's way (of dealing): no turning off wilt thou find in Allah's way (of dealing).
t.203: (They took to flight because of their) arrogance in the land and their plotting of evil. But the evil plot encompasses only him who makes it. Then, can they expect anything (else) but the Sunnah (way of dealing) of the peoples of old? So no change will you find in Allâh’s Sunnah (way of dealing), and no turning off will you find in Allâh’s Sunnah (way of dealing).
t.54: دنیا میں اپنے کو بڑا سمجھنے کی وجہ سے، اور ان کی بری تدبیروں کی وجہ سے اور بری تدبیروں کا وبال ان تدبیر والوں ہی پر پڑتا ہے، سو کیا یہ اسی دستور کے منتظر ہیں جو اگلے لوگوں کے ساتھ ہوتا رہا ہے۔ سو آپ اللہ کے دستور کو کبھی بدلتا ہوا نہ پائیں گے، اور آپ اللہ کے دستور کو کبھی منتقل ہوتا ہوا نہ پائیں گے.

t.149: And have they not journeyed through the earth and observed the consequences for those before them, though they were superior to them in strength? But in no way could Allah be thwarted by anything in the heavens or in the earth. Indeed, He has always been All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
t.84: Did they not travel in the land and see how was the end of those before them? They were stronger than these in power. Allah is not such that something in the heavens or the earth can frustrate Him. Surely He is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
t.85: Have they not travelled in the land and seen how those before them met their end, although they were superior to them in strength? God is not to be frustrated by anything in the heavens or on the earth: He is all knowing, all powerful.
t.95: Have they not journeyed in the earth to behold the end of those who went before them though they were stronger than them in might? Nothing in the heavens nor on earth can frustrate Him in the least. He is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.
t.19: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them, and they were mightier than these in power? Allah is not such that aught in the heavens or in the earth escapeth Him. Lo! He is the Wise, the Mighty.
t.22: Do they not travel through the earth, and see what was the End of those before them,- though they were superior to them in strength? Nor is Allah to be frustrated by anything whatever in the heavens or on earth: for He is All-Knowing. All-Powerful.
t.203: Have they not travelled in the land, and seen what was the end of those before them - though they were superior to them in power? Allâh is not such that anything in the heavens or in the earth escapes Him. Verily, He is All-Knowing, All-Omnipotent.
t.54: اور کیا یہ لوگ زمین میں چلے پھرے نہیں جس میں دیکھتے بھالتے کہ جو لوگ ان سے پہلے ہو گزرے ہیں ان کا انجام کیا ہوا؟ حاﻻنکہ وه قوت میں ان سے بڑھے ہوئے تھے، اور اللہ ایسا نہیں ہے کہ کوئی چیز اس کو ہرا دے نہ آسمانوں میں اور نہ زمین میں۔ وه بڑے علم واﻻ، بڑی قدرت واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And if Allah were to hold mankind accountable for what they have earned, He would not leave a single treading creature on its surface. But He defers them for a stated term, and then when their term is due—indeed, Allah has always been All-Seeing of His servants.
t.84: If Allah were to take mankind to task for what they did, He would have not left a living creature on its back, but He delays them upto an appointed time. So when their time will come, then Allah is the One who will see His slaves.
t.85: If God were to punish people [at once] for the wrong they have done, there would not be a single creature left on the surface of the earth. He gives them respite for a stated time and, whenever their time comes, God has been watching His servants.
t.95: If Allah were to take people to task for their deeds, He would not leave any living creature on earth, but He grants them respite to an appointed time. When their appointed time comes to an end, surely Allah fully observes His servants.
t.19: If Allah took mankind to task by that which they deserve, He would not leave a living creature on the surface of the earth; but He reprieveth them unto an appointed term, and when their term cometh - then verily (they will know that) Allah is ever Seer of His slaves.
t.22: If Allah were to punish men according to what they deserve. He would not leave on the back of the (earth) a single living creature: but He gives them respite for a stated Term: when their Term expires, verily Allah has in His sight all His Servants.
t.203: And if Allâh were to punish men for that which they earned, He would not leave a moving (living) creature on the surface of the earth; but He gives them respite to an appointed term: and when their term comes, then verily, Allâh is Ever All-Seer of His slaves.
t.54: اور اگر اللہ تعالیٰ لوگوں پر ان کے اعمال کے سبب داروگیر فرمانے لگتا تو روئے زمین پر ایک جاندار کو نہ چھوڑتا، لیکن اللہ تعالیٰ ان کو ایک میعاد معین تک مہلت دے رہا ہے، سو جب ان کی وه میعاد آپہنچے گی اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کو آپ دیکھ لے گا.

t.149: Ya-Sîn.
t.84: Yā Sīn
t.85: Ya Sin
t.95: Ya'. Sin.
t.19: Ya Sin.
t.22: Ya Sin.
t.203: Yâ-Sîn.
t.54: یٰس.

t.149: By the all-wise Recital.
t.84: By the Qur’ān, that is full of wisdom,
t.85: By the wise Quran,
t.95: By the Wise Qur'an,
t.19: By the wise Qur'an,
t.22: By the Qur'an, full of Wisdom,-
t.203: By the Qur’ân, full of wisdom (i.e. full of laws, evidence, and proofs),
t.54: قسم ہے قرآن باحکمت کی.

t.149: Youare indeed of the emissaries
t.84: You are truly one of the messengers of Allah,
t.85: you [Muhammad] are truly one of the mes-sengers sent
t.95: you are truly among the Messengers,
t.19: Lo! thou art of those sent
t.22: Thou art indeed one of the messengers,
t.203: Truly, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are one of the Messengers,
t.54: کہ بے شک آپ پیغمبروں میں سے ہیں.

t.149: on a straight path.
t.84: (and you are) on a straight path,
t.85: on a straight path,
t.95: on a Straight Way,
t.19: On a straight path,
t.22: On a Straight Way.
t.203: On the Straight Path (i.e. on Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: سیدھے راستے پر ہیں.

t.149: (God bestowed it as) a bestowal from on high by the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy,
t.84: (this Qur’ān being) a revelation from the All- Mighty, the Very-Merciful,
t.85: with a revelation from the Almighty, the Lord of Mercy,
t.95: (and this Qur'an) is a revelation from the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate
t.19: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,
t.22: It is a Revelation sent down by (Him), the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
t.203: (This is a Revelation) sent down by the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,
t.54: یہ قرآن اللہ زبردست مہربان کی طرف سے نازل کیا گیا ہے.

t.149: to warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are oblivious.
t.84: so that you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, and hence, they are unaware.
t.85: to warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so they are unaware.
t.95: so that you may warn a people whose ancestors were not warned before wherefore they are heedless.
t.19: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
t.22: In order that thou mayest admonish a people, whose fathers had received no admonition, and who therefore remain heedless (of the Signs of Allah).
t.203: In order that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
t.54: تاکہ آپ ایسے لوگوں کو ڈرائیں جن کے باپ دادے نہیں ڈرائے گئے تھے، سو (اسی وجہ سے) یہ غافل ہیں.

t.149: Certainly, most of them deserved the decree on them, for they refuse to believe.
t.84: The word has indeed come true about most of them, so they will not believe.
t.85: The verdict has been passed against most of them, for they refuse to believe.
t.95: Surely most of them merit the decree of chastisement; so they do not believe.
t.19: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.
t.22: The Word is proved true against the greater part of them: for they do not believe.
t.203: Indeed the Word (of punishment) has proved true against most of them, so they will not believe.
t.54: ان میں سے اکثر لوگوں پر بات ﺛابت ہوچکی ہے سو یہ لوگ ایمان نہ ﻻئیں گے.

t.149: Indeed, We placed shackles around their necks up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up.
t.84: We have placed iron collars on their necks, so they are reaching up to their chins, and their heads are forced to remain upwards.
t.85: [It is as if] We had placed [iron] collars around their necks, right up to their chins so that their heads are forced up
t.95: We have put fetters around their necks which reach up to their chins so that they are standing with their heads upright,
t.19: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.
t.22: We have put yokes round their necks right up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up (and they cannot see).
t.203: Verily We have put on their necks iron collars reaching to the chins, so that their heads are raised up.
t.54: ہم نے ان کی گردنوں میں طوق ڈال دیئے ہیں پھر وه ٹھوڑیوں تک ہیں، جس سے ان کے سر اوپر کو الٹ گئے ہیں.

t.149: And We placed a barrier in front of them and a barrier behind them, and thus We blocked their vision so they cannot see.
t.84: And We have placed a barrier in front of them and a barrier behind them, and (thus) they are encircled by Us; so they do not see.
t.85: and set barriers before and behind them, blocking their vision: they cannot see.
t.95: and We have put a barrier before them and a barrier behind them, and have covered them up, so they are unable to see.
t.19: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.
t.22: And We have put a bar in front of them and a bar behind them, and further, We have covered them up; so that they cannot see.
t.203: And We have put a barrier before them, and a barrier behind them, and We have covered them up, so that they cannot see.
t.54: اور ہم نے ایک آڑ ان کے سامنے کردی اورایک آڑ ان کے پیچھے کردی، جس سے ہم نے ان کو ڈھانک دیا سو وه نہیں دیکھ سکتے.

t.149: And it is the same for them whether youwarn them or do not warn them—they believe not.
t.84: It is all equal for them whether you warn them or do not warn them, they will not believe.
t.85: It is all the same to them whether you warn them or not: they will not believe.
t.95: It is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them for they shall not believe.
t.19: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.
t.22: The same is it to them whether thou admonish them or thou do not admonish them: they will not believe.
t.203: It is the same to them whether you warn them or you warn them not, they will not believe.
t.54: اور آپ ان کو ڈرائیں یا نہ ڈرائیں دونوں برابر ہیں، یہ ایمان نہیں ﻻئیں گے.

t.149: Indeed, youcan only warn one who has followed the Reminder and has feared the All-Merciful though unseen—so give him glad tidings of forgiveness and a noble reward.
t.84: You can (usefully) warn only the one who follows the advice and fears the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) without seeing (Him). So give him the good news of forgiveness and of a noble reward.
t.85: You can warn only those who will follow the Quran and hold the Merciful One in awe, though they cannot see Him: give such people the glad news of forgiveness and a noble reward.
t.95: You can warn only him who follows the Admonition and fears the Merciful Lord without seeing Him. Give such a one good tidings of forgiveness and a generous reward.
t.19: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward.
t.22: Thou canst but admonish such a one as follows the Message and fears the (Lord) Most Gracious, unseen: give such a one, therefore, good tidings, of Forgiveness and a Reward most generous.
t.203: You can only warn him who follows the Reminder (the Qur’ân), and fears the Most Gracious (Allâh) unseen. Bear you to such one the glad tidings of forgiveness, and a generous reward (i.e. Paradise).
t.54: بس آپ تو صرف ایسے شخص کو ڈرا سکتے ہیں جو نصیحت پر چلے اور رحمٰن سے بےدیکھے ڈرے، سو آپ اس کو مغفرت اور باوقار اجر کی خوش خبریاں سنا دیجیئے.

t.149: Indeed, We—We alone—revive the dead and write down what they have put forth and their traces. And everything have We tallied in an evident archive.
t.84: Surely We will give new life to the dead, and We are recording whatever (deeds) they send before them and whatever effects they leave behind. Every thing is fully computed by Us in a manifest book of record.
t.85: We shall certainly bring the dead back to life, and We record what they send ahead of them as well as what they leave behind: We keep an account of everything in a clear Record.
t.95: We shall surely raise the dead to life and We record what they did and the traces of their deeds that they have left behind. We have encompassed that in a Clear Book.
t.19: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register.
t.22: Verily We shall give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before and that which they leave behind, and of all things have We taken account in a clear Book (of evidence).
t.203: Verily, We give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before (them), and their traces and all things We have recorded with numbers (as a record) in a Clear Book.
t.54: بےشک ہم مُردوں کو زنده کریں گے، اور ہم لکھتے جاتے ہیں وه اعمال بھی جن کو لوگ آگے بھیجتے ہیں اور ان کے وه اعمال بھی جن کو پیچھے چھوڑ جاتے ہیں، اور ہم نے ہر چیز کو ایک واضح کتاب میں ضبط کر رکھا ہے.

t.149: And setforth for them the parable of the fellows of the town when the Emissaries came to it—
t.84: Cite to them the example of the People of the Town, when the messengers came to it,
t.85: Give them the example of the people to whose town messengers came.
t.95: Recite to them, as a case in point, the story of the people of the town when the Messengers came to them.
t.19: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;
t.22: Set forth to them, by way of a parable, the (story of) the Companions of the City. Behold!, there came messengers to it.
t.203: And put forward to them a similitude: the (story of the) dwellers of the town, [it is said that the town was Antioch (Antâkiya)], when there came Messengers to them.
t.54: اور آپ ان کے سامنے ایک مثال (یعنی ایک) بستی والوں کی مثال (اس وقت کا) بیان کیجیئے جب کہ اس بستی میں (کئی) رسول آئے.

t.149: when We sent them two persons but they disbelieved them, so We reinforced (them) with a third. Then they said, “Truly, We are emissaries sent to you.”
t.84: when We sent to them two (apostles), and they rejected both of them, so We confirmed them with a third one. So they said, “We are sent to you.”
t.85: We sent two messengers but they rejected both. Then We reinforced them with a third. They said, ‘Truly, we are messengers to you,’
t.95: We sent to them two Messengers and they rejected both of them as liars. Then We strengthened them with a third (Messenger).
t.19: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
t.22: When We (first) sent to them two messengers, they rejected them: But We strengthened them with a third: they said, "Truly, we have been sent on a mission to you."
t.203: When We sent to them two Messengers, they belied them both; so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: "Verily we have been sent to you as Messengers."
t.54: جب ہم نے ان کے پاس دو کو بھیجا سو ان لوگوں نے (اول) دونوں کو جھٹلایا پھر ہم نے تیسرے سے تائید کی سو ان تینوں نے کہا کہ ہم تمہارے پاس بھیجے گئے ہیں.

t.149: They said, “You are nothing but human beings like us, and the All-Merciful did not send down anything; you are only lying.”
t.84: They (the people of the Town) said, “You are no more than human beings like us, and the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) has not sent down any thing. You are but telling a lie.”
t.85: but they answered, ‘You are only men like ourselves. The Lord of Mercy has sent nothing; you are just lying.'
t.95: They said: “We have been sent to you as Messengers.” The people of the town said: “You are only human beings like ourselves, and the Merciful Lord has revealed nothing. You are simply lying.”
t.19: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!
t.22: The (people) said: "Ye are only men like ourselves; and (Allah) Most Gracious sends no sort of revelation: ye do nothing but lie."
t.203: They (people of the town) said: "You are only human beings like ourselves, and the Most Gracious (Allâh) has revealed nothing. You are only telling lies."
t.54: ان لوگوں نے کہا کہ تم تو ہماری طرح معمولی آدمی ہو اور رحمٰن نے کوئی چیز نازل نہیں کی۔ تم نرا جھوٹ بولتے ہو.

t.149: They said, “Our Lord knows that we are indeed emissaries sent to you,
t.84: They (the messengers) said, “Our Lord knows that we are undoubtedly sent to you.
t.85: They said, ‘Our Lord knows that we have been sent to you.
t.95: The Messengers said: “Our Lord knows that we have indeed been sent to you
t.19: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,
t.22: They said: "Our Lord doth know that we have been sent on a mission to you:
t.203: The Messengers said: "Our Lord knows that we have been sent as Messengers to you,
t.54: ان (رسولوں) نے کہا ہمارا پروردگار جانتا ہے کہ بےشک ہم تمہارے پاس بھیجے گئے ہیں.

t.149: and our only duty is evident proclamation.”
t.84: Our obligation is no more than to convey the message clearly.”
t.85: Our duty is only to deliver the message to you,’
t.95: and our duty is no more than to clearly convey the Message.”
t.19: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).
t.22: "And our duty is only to proclaim the clear Message."
t.203: "And our duty is only to convey plainly (the Message)."
t.54: اور ہمارے ذمہ تو صرف واضح طور پر پہنچا دینا ہے.

t.149: They said, “We see an evil omen in you; if you do not give up, we will most surely stone you, and a painful punishment from us will most surely afflict you.”
t.84: They (the People of the Town) said, “We take you as a bad omen for us. If you do not desist, we will certainly stone you and you will be afflicted by a painful punishment from us.”
t.85: but they answered, ‘We think you are an evil omen. If you do not stop, we shall stone you, and inflict a painful torment on you.’
t.95: The people of the town said: “We believe you are an evil omen for us. If you do not desist, we will stone you or you will receive a grievous chastisement from us.”
t.19: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.
t.22: The (people) said: "for us, we augur an evil omen from you: if ye desist not, we will certainly stone you. And a grievous punishment indeed will be inflicted on you by us."
t.203: They (people) said: "For us, we see an evil omen from you: if you cease not, we will surely stone you, and a painful torment will touch you from us."
t.54: انہوں نے کہا کہ ہم تو تم کو منحوس سمجھتے ہیں۔ اگر تم باز نہ آئے تو ہم پتھروں سے تمہارا کام تمام کردیں گے اور تم کو ہماری طرف سے سخت تکلیف پہنچے گی.

t.149: They said, “Your evil omen is within yourselves. Can it be that it is becauseyou were reminded ? Rather, you are an extremist people!”
t.84: They said, “Your bad omen is with yourselves. (Do you take it as bad omen) if you are given a good counsel? Rather, you are a people who cross all limits.”
t.85: The messengers said, ‘The evil omen is within yourselves. Why do you take it as an evil omen when you are reminded of the Truth? You are going too far!’
t.95: The Messengers replied: “Your evil omen is with you. (Are you saying this) because you were asked to take heed? The truth is that you are a people who have exceeded all bounds.”
t.19: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk!
t.22: They said: "Your evil omens are with yourselves: (deem ye this an evil omen). If ye are admonished? Nay, but ye are a people transgressing all bounds!"
t.203: They (Messengers) said: "Your evil omens be with you! (Do you call it "evil omen") because you are admonished? Nay, but you are a people Musrifûn (transgressing all bounds by committing all kinds of great sins, and by disobeying Allâh).
t.54: ان رسولوں نے کہا کہ تمہاری نحوست تمہارے ساتھ ہی لگی ہوئی ہے، کیا اس کو نحوست سمجھتے ہو کہ تم کو نصیحت کی جائے بلکہ تم حد سے نکل جانے والے لوگ ہو.

t.149: And there came a man rushing from the farthest end of the city. He said, “O my people, follow the emissaries.
t.84: And there came a man rushing from the farthest part of the city. He said, “O my people, follow the messengers.
t.85: Then, from the furthest part of the city, a man came running. He said, ‘My people, follow the messengers.
t.95: In the meantime a man came running from the far end of the town, saying: “My people, follow the Messengers;
t.19: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!
t.22: Then there came running, from the farthest part of the City, a man, saying, "O my people! Obey the messengers:
t.203: And there came a man running from the farthest part of the town. He said: "O my people! Obey the Messengers.
t.54: اور ایک شخص (اس) شہر کے آخری حصے سے دوڑتا ہوا آیا کہنے لگا کہ اے میری قوم! ان رسولوں کی راه پر چلو.

t.149: Follow those who do not ask youany reward, and are themselves guided.
t.84: Follow those who do not claim any reward from you, and who are on the right path.
t.85: Follow them: they are not asking you to reward them and they are rightly guided.
t.95: follow those who do not ask any recompense from you and are rightly-guided.
t.19: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.
t.22: "Obey those who ask no reward of you (for themselves), and who have themselves received Guidance.
t.203: "Obey those who ask no wages of you (for themselves), and who are rightly guided.
t.54: ایسے لوگوں کی راه پر چلو جو تم سے کوئی معاوضہ نہیں مانگتے اور وه راه راست پر ہیں.

t.149: And why should I not worship the One Who originated me, and to Whom youare returned ?
t.84: What excuse do I have if I do not worship the One who has created me and to whom you will be returned?
t.85: Why should I not worship the One who created me? It is to Him that you will be returned.
t.95: Why should I not serve the One Who created me and to Whom all of you shall be sent back?
t.19: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?
t.22: "It would not be reasonable in me if I did not serve Him Who created me, and to Whom ye shall (all) be brought back.
t.203: "And why should I not worship Him (Allâh Alone) Who has created me and to Whom you shall be returned.
t.54: اور مجھے کیا ہو گیا ہے کہ میں اس کی عبادت نہ کروں جس نے مجھے پیدا کیا اور تم سب اسی کی طرف لوٹائے جاؤگے.

t.149: Shall I take other gods apart from Him? If the All-Merciful wants harm for me, their intercession does not avail me at all, nor can they rescue me.
t.84: Shall I adopt those gods besides Him whose intercession, if RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) intends to do harm to me, cannot help me in the least, nor can they come to my rescue?
t.85: How could I take besides Him any other gods, whose intercession will not help me and who would not be able to save me if the Lord of Mercy wished to harm me?
t.95: What! Shall I take any deities apart from Him whose intercession will not avail me the least were the Merciful One to bring any adversity upon me, nor will they be able to rescue me?
t.19: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save?
t.22: "Shall I take (other) gods besides Him? If (Allah) Most Gracious should intend some adversity for me, of no use whatever will be their intercession for me, nor can they deliver me.
t.203: "Shall I take besides Him âlihah (gods)? If the Most Gracious (Allâh) intends me any harm, their intercession will be of no use for me whatsoever, nor can they save me?
t.54: کیا میں اسے چھوڑ کر ایسوں کو معبود بناؤں کہ اگر (اللہ) رحمٰن مجھے کوئی نقصان پہنچانا چاہے تو ان کی سفارش مجھے کچھ بھی نفع نہ پہنچا سکے اور نہ وه مجھے بچا سکیں.

t.149: In that case, I should indeed be in evident misguidance.
t.84: In that case, I will be in open error indeed.
t.85: Then I would clearly be in the wrong.
t.95: Surely in that case I should indeed be in evident error.
t.19: Then truly I should be in error manifest.
t.22: "I would indeed, if I were to do so, be in manifest Error.
t.203: "Then verily, I should be in plain error.
t.54: پھر تو میں یقیناً کھلی گمراہی میں ہوں.

t.149: Indeed, I have attained faith in yourLord, so listen to me.”
t.84: Undoubtedly I have believed in your Lord; so listen to me.”
t.85: I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.’
t.95: I believe in your Lord; so listen to me.”
t.19: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!
t.22: "For me, I have faith in the Lord of you (all): listen, then, to me!"
t.203: "Verily! I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me!"
t.54: میری سنو! میں تو (سچے دل سے) تم سب کے رب پر ایمان ﻻ چکا.

t.149: It was said, “Enter the Garden(of Paradise) .” He said, “Oh if only my people could know
t.84: (Thereafter when his people killed him,) it was said to him, “Enter the Paradise”. He said, “Would that my people knew
t.85: He was told, ‘Enter the Garden,’ so he said, ‘If only my people knew
t.95: (Eventually they killed him and he was told): “Enter Paradise.” The man exclaimed: “Would that my people knew
t.19: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew
t.22: It was said: "Enter thou the Garden." He said: "Ah me! Would that my People knew (what I know)!-
t.203: It was said (to him when the disbelievers killed him): "Enter Paradise." He said: "Would that my people knew
t.54: (اس سے) کہا گیا کہ جنت میں چلا جا، کہنے لگا کاش! میری قوم کو بھی علم ہو جاتا.

t.149: how my Lord has forgiven me and made me one of the honored!”
t.84: how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honoured ones!”
t.85: how my Lord has forgiven me and set me among the highly honoured.’
t.95: for what reason Allah has forgiven me and placed me among the honoured ones.”
t.19: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!
t.22: "For that my Lord has granted me Forgiveness and has enrolled me among those held in honour!"
t.203: "That my Lord (Allâh) has forgiven me, and made me of the honoured ones!"
t.54: کہ مجھے میرے رب نے بخش دیا اور مجھے باعزت لوگوں میں سے کر دیا.

t.149: And after him, We sent down no soldiers from heaven to his people, nor would We ever send any down.
t.84: And We did not send down to his people any army from the heavens after him, nor were We (in need) to send down.
t.85: After him We did not send any army from heaven against his people, nor were We about to:
t.95: After him, We did not send down any hosts from the heaven; We stood in no need to send down any host.
t.19: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.
t.22: And We sent not down against his People, after him, any hosts from heaven, nor was it needful for Us so to do.
t.203: And We sent not against his people after him a host from the heaven, nor was it needful for Us to send (such a thing).
t.54: اس کے بعد ہم نے اس کی قوم پر آسمان سے کوئی لشکر نہ اتارا، اور نہ اس طرح ہم اتارا کرتے ہیں.

t.149: It was just a single Shout, and suddenly they were extinct.
t.84: It was no more than a single Cry, and in no time they were extinguished.
t.85: there was just one blast, and they fell down lifeless.
t.95: There was but a single Blast and suddenly they became silent and still.
t.19: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.
t.22: It was no more than a single mighty Blast, and behold! they were (like ashes) quenched and silent.
t.203: It was but one Saihah (shout) and lo! they (all) were still (silent,dead,destroyed).
t.54: وه تو صرف ایک زور کی چیﺦ تھی کہ یکایک وه سب کے سب بجھ بجھا گئے.

t.149: Alas for the servants! No messenger comes to them but they ridicule him.
t.84: Alas for the slaves (of Allah)! No messenger came to them, but they have been mocking at him.
t.85: Alas for human beings! Whenever a messenger comes to them they ridicule him.
t.95: Alas for My servants! Never does a Messenger come to them but they mock him.
t.19: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him!
t.22: Ah! Alas for (My) Servants! There comes not a messenger to them but they mock him!
t.203: Alas for mankind! There never came a Messenger to them but they used to mock at him.
t.54: (ایسے) بندوں پر افسوس! کبھی بھی کوئی رسول ان کے پاس نہیں آیا جس کی ہنسی انہوں نے نہ اڑائی ہو.

t.149: Have they not seen how many generations We annihilated before them—that they will not return to them?
t.84: Did they not see how many generations We have destroyed before them who will not come back to them?
t.85: Do they not see how many generations We have destroyed before them, none of whom will ever come back to them?
t.95: Have they not seen how many nations before them did We destroy? Thereafter they never came back to them.
t.19: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them;
t.22: See they not how many generations before them we destroyed? Not to them will they return:
t.203: Do they not see how many of the generations We have destroyed before them? Verily, they will not return to them.
t.54: کیا انہوں نے نہیں دیکھا کہ ان کے پہلے بہت سی قوموں کو ہم نے غارت کر دیا کہ وه ان کی طرف لوٹ کر نہیں آئیں گے.

t.149: And none of them but will be arraigned before Us, all together.
t.84: All of them are but to be assembled together (and) to be arraigned before Us.
t.85: [Yet] all of them will be brought before Us.
t.95: All of them shall (one day) be gathered before Us.
t.19: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.
t.22: But each one of them all - will be brought before Us (for judgment).
t.203: And surely, all - everyone of them will be brought before Us.
t.54: اور نہیں ہے کوئی جماعت مگر یہ کہ وه جمع ہو کر ہمارے سامنے حاضر کی جائے گی.

t.149: And there is a sign for them in the lifeless land: We have revived it and have brought out from it grains, so from it they eat.
t.84: And a sign for them is the dead land. We gave it life and brought forth grain from it; so from it they eat.
t.85: There is a sign for them in the lifeless earth: We give it life and We produce grain from it for them to eat;
t.95: Let the dead earth be a Sign for them. We gave it life and produced from it grain whereof they eat.
t.19: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;
t.22: A Sign for them is the earth that is dead: We do give it life, and produce grain therefrom, of which ye do eat.
t.203: And a sign for them is the dead land. We give it life, and We bring forth from it grains, so that they eat thereof.
t.54: اور ان کے لئے ایک نشانی (خشک) زمین ہے جس کو ہم نے زنده کر دیا اور اس سے غلہ نکالا جس میں سے وه کھاتے ہیں.

t.149: And We have made in it gardens of palm-trees and grapevines, and have caused springs to burst forth in it,
t.84: And We have placed gardens of date-palms and grapes, and caused springs to gush forth therein,
t.85: We have put gardens of date palms and grapes in the earth, and We have made springs of water gush out of it
t.95: We made in it gardens of date-palms and vines, and We caused springs to gush forth
t.19: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein,
t.22: And We produce therein orchard with date-palms and vines, and We cause springs to gush forth therein:
t.203: And We have made therein gardens of date-palms and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein.
t.54: اور ہم نے اس میں کھجوروں کے اور انگور کے باغات پیدا کر دیئے، اور جن میں ہم نے چشمے بھی جاری کر دیئے ہیں.

t.149: that they may eat from its produce and(from) whattheir hands have made . So will they not give thanks?
t.84: so that they may eat fruits thereof, while it was not made by their hands. Would they not then offer gratitude?
t.85: so that they could eat its fruit. It was not their own hands that made all this. How can they not give thanks?
t.95: that they might eat of its fruits. It was not their hands that made them. Will they not, then, give thanks?
t.19: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?
t.22: That they may enjoy the fruits of this (artistry): It was not their hands that made this: will they not then give thanks?
t.203: So that they may eat of the fruit thereof - and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?
t.54: تاکہ (لوگ) اس کے پھل کھائیں، اور اس کو ان کے ہاتھوں نے نہیں بنایا۔ پھر کیوں شکر گزاری نہیں کرتے.

t.149: Highly Exalted is He Who created all pairs—of what the earth germinates and of their own selvesand of what they do not know.
t.84: Pure (from every fault) is the One who has created all the pairs of whatever the earth grows and of the humans themselves and of that which they do not know.
t.85: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs of things that the earth produces, as well as themselves and other things they do not know about.
t.95: Holy is He Who created all things in pairs, whether it be of what the earth produces, and of themselves, and of what they do not know.
t.19: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!
t.22: Glory to Allah, Who created in pairs all things that the earth produces, as well as their own (human) kind and (other) things of which they have no knowledge.
t.203: Glory be to Him Who has created all the pairs of that which the earth produces, as well as of their own (human) kind (male and female), and of that which they know not.
t.54: وه پاک ذات ہے جس نے ہر چیز کے جوڑے پیدا کیے خواه وه زمین کی اگائی ہوئی چیزیں ہوں، خواه خود ان کے نفوس ہوں خواه وه (چیزیں) ہوں جنہیں یہ جانتے بھی نہیں.

t.149: And a sign for them is the night: We strip the day out of it—and they are suddenly in darkness.
t.84: And a sign for them is the night. We strip (the cover of) the day from it, and they are suddenly in darkness.
t.85: The night is also a sign for them: We strip the daylight from it, and- lo and behold!- they are in darkness.
t.95: And the night is another Sign for them. We strip the day from it and they become plunged in darkness.
t.19: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.
t.22: And a Sign for them is the Night: We withdraw therefrom the Day, and behold they are plunged in darkness;
t.203: And a sign for them is the night. We withdraw therefrom the day, and behold, they are in darkness.
t.54: اور ان کے لئے ایک نشانی رات ہے جس سے ہم دن کو کھینچ دیتے ہیں تو وه یکایک اندھیرے میں ره جاتے ہیں.

t.149: And the sun runs towards its destination; such is the determining of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
t.84: And the sun is quickly proceeding towards its destination. That is the designing of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
t.85: The sun, too, runs its determined course laid down for it by the Almighty, the All Knowing.
t.95: The sun is running its course to its appointed place. That is the ordaining of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
t.19: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
t.22: And the sun runs his course for a period determined for him: that is the decree of (Him), the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing.
t.203: And the sun runs on its fixed course for a term (appointed). That is the Decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
t.54: اور سورج کے لئے جو مقرره راه ہے وه اسی پر چلتا رہتا ہے۔ یہ ہے مقرر کرده غالب، باعلم اللہ تعالیٰ کا.

t.149: And We have determined the moon in phases until it returned like an old palm-branch.
t.84: And for the moon We have appointed measured phases, until it turned (pale, curved and fine) like an old branch of date palm.
t.85: We have determined phases for the moon until finally it becomes like an old date-stalk.
t.95: We have appointed stages for the moon till it returns in the shape of a dry old branch of palm-tree.
t.19: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
t.22: And the Moon,- We have measured for her mansions (to traverse) till she returns like the old (and withered) lower part of a date-stalk.
t.203: And the moon, We have measured for it mansions (to traverse) till it returns like the old dried curved date stalk.
t.54: اور چاند کی ہم نے منزلیں مقررکر رکھی ہیں، یہاں تک کہ وه لوٹ کر پرانی ٹہنی کی طرح ہو جاتا ہے.

t.149: The sun is not to overtake the moon, nor is the night to outpace the day, and each floats in an orbit.
t.84: Neither it is for the sun to overtake the moon, nor can the night outpace the day. Each one is floating in an orbit.
t.85: The sun cannot overtake the moon, nor can the night outrun the day: each floats in [its own] orbit.
t.95: Neither does it lie in the sun's power to overtake the moon nor can the night outstrip the day. All glide along, each in its own orbit.
t.19: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
t.22: It is not permitted to the Sun to catch up the Moon, nor can the Night outstrip the Day: Each (just) swims along in (its own) orbit (according to Law).
t.203: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day. They all float, each in an orbit.
t.54: نہ آفتاب کی یہ مجال ہے کہ چاند کو پکڑے اور نہ رات دن پرآگے بڑھ جانے والی ہے، اور سب کے سب آسمان میں تیرتے پھرتے ہیں.

t.149: And a sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden ship,
t.84: And it is a sign for them that We boarded their children in the loaded ship,
t.85: Another sign for them is that We carried their seed in the laden Ark,
t.95: Another Sign for them is that We carried all their offspring in the laden vessel
t.19: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,
t.22: And a Sign for them is that We bore their race (through the Flood) in the loaded Ark;
t.203: And an Ayâh (sign) for them is that We bore their offspring in the laden ship [of Nûh (Noah)].
t.54: اور ان کے لئے ایک نشانی (یہ بھی) ہے کہ ہم نے ان کی نسل کو بھری ہوئی کشتی میں سوار کیا.

t.149: and We created for them the like of it in which they ride.
t.84: and created for them things similar to it on which they ride.
t.85: and We have made similar things for them to ride in.
t.95: and then created for them other vessels like those on which they ride.
t.19: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.
t.22: And We have created for them similar (vessels) on which they ride.
t.203: And We have created for them of the like thereunto, on which they ride.
t.54: اور ان کے لئے اسی جیسی اور چیزیں پیدا کیں جن پر یہ سوار ہوتے ہیں.

t.149: And if We will, We can drown them—with no screaming to be heard from them, nor will they be rescued,
t.84: And if We so will, We can drown them; then no one will respond to their cry, nor will they be rescued,
t.85: If We wished, We could drown them, and there would be no one to help them: they could not be saved.
t.95: Should We so wish, We can drown them, and there will be none to heed their cries of distress, nor will they be rescued.
t.19: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;
t.22: If it were Our Will, We could drown them: then would there be no helper (to hear their cry), nor could they be delivered,
t.203: And if We will, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout (or helper) for them (to hear their cry for help), nor will they be saved.
t.54: اور اگر ہم چاہتے تو انہیں ڈبو دیتے۔ پھر نہ تو کوئی ان کا فریاد رس ہوتا نہ وه بچائے جائیں.

t.149: except by a mercy from Us and enjoyment for a while.
t.84: unless there be mercy from Us, and (unless) We let them enjoy for a while.
t.85: Only by Our mercy could they be reprieved to enjoy life for a while.
t.95: It is only Our Mercy (that rescues them) and enables enjoyment of life for a while.
t.19: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.
t.22: Except by way of Mercy from Us, and by way of (world) convenience (to serve them) for a time.
t.203: Unless it be a mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a while.
t.54: لیکن ہم اپنی طرف سے رحمت کرتے ہیں اور ایک مدت تک کے لئے انہیں فائدے دے رہے ہیں.

t.149: And when it is said to them, “Be mindful of what lies before you and what lies behind you, that you may receive mercy” . . .
t.84: And (they pay no heed) when it is said to them, “Save yourselves from that (punishment) which is before you (in this world) and that which will come after you (die), so that you may receive mercy”.
t.85: Yet when they are told, ‘Beware of what lies before and behind you, so that you may be given mercy,’
t.95: When it is said to such people: “Guard yourselves against what is ahead of you and what has preceded you that mercy be shown to you” (they pay scant heed to it).
t.19: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).
t.22: When they are told, "Fear ye that which is before you and that which will be after you, in order that ye may receive Mercy," (they turn back).
t.203: And when it is said to them: "Fear of that which is before you (worldly torments), and that which is behind you (torments in the Hereafter), in order that you may receive Mercy (i.e. if you believe in Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism, and avoid polytheism, and obey Allâh with righteous deeds)."
t.54: اور ان سے جب (کبھی) کہا جاتا ہے کہ اگلے پچھلے (گناہوں) سے بچو تاکہ تم پر رحم کیا جائے.

t.149: Yet never does a sign of their Lord’s signs come to them, but they disregard it.
t.84: There comes to them no sign from the signs of your Lord, but they turn averse to it.
t.85: they ignore every single sign that comes to them from their Lord,
t.95: Never does any Sign of their Lord come to them, but they turn away from it.
t.19: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!
t.22: Not a Sign comes to them from among the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away therefrom.
t.203: And never came an Ayâh from among the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it.
t.54: اور ان کے پاس تو ان کے رب کی نشانیوں میں سے کوئی نشانی ایسی نہیں آئی جس سے یہ بے رخی نہ برتتے ہوں.

t.149: And when it is said to them, “Spend of what Allah has provided for you,” those who deny say to those who have attained faith, “Shall we feed someone whom Allah could feed, if He so wills? You are but in evident misguidance.”
t.84: And when it is said to them, “Spend (to the needy) from the provision Allah has given to you”, the disbelievers say to the believers, “Shall we feed those whom Allah could have fed, if Allah so willed? You are but in open error.”
t.85: and when they are told, ‘Give to others out of what God has provided for you,’ the disbelievers say to the believers, ‘Why should we feed those that God could feed if He wanted? You must be deeply misguided.’
t.95: And when it is said to them: “Spend (in the Way of Allah) out of the sustenance that Allah has provided you,” the unbelievers say to the believers: “Shall we feed him whom, Allah would have fed, had He so wished?” Say: “You are in evident error.”
t.19: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
t.22: And when they are told, "Spend ye of (the bounties) with which Allah has provided you," the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Shall we then feed those whom, if Allah had so willed, He would have fed, (Himself)?- Ye are in nothing but manifest error."
t.203: And when it is said to them: "Spend of that with which Allâh has provided you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Shall we feed those whom, if Allâh willed, He (Himself) would have fed? You are only in a plain error."
t.54: اور ان سے جب کہا جاتا ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کے دیئے ہوئے میں سے کچھ خرچ کرو، تو یہ کفار ایمان والوں کو جواب دیتے ہیں کہ ہم انہیں کیوں کھلائیں؟ جنہیں اگر اللہ تعالیٰ چاہتا تو خود کھلا پلا دیتا، تم تو ہو ہی کھلی گمراہی میں.

t.149: And they say, “When will this promise be, if youare truthful?”
t.84: And they say, “When will this promise come true, if you are truthful?”
t.85: And they say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
t.95: They say: “When will this threat (of Resurrection) come to pass? Tell us if indeed you are truthful.”
t.19: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?
t.22: Further, they say, "When will this promise (come to pass), if what ye say is true?"
t.203: And they say: "When will this promise (i.e. Resurrection) be fulfilled, if you are truthful?"
t.54: وه کہتے ہیں کہ یہ وعده کب ہوگا، سچے ہو تو بتلاؤ.

t.149: All they can expect is a single Shout, which will take them away while they feud,
t.84: They are looking for nothing but for a single Cry that will seize them when they will be quarrelling.
t.85: But all they are waiting for is a single blast that will overtake them while they are still arguing with each other.
t.95: The Truth is that they are waiting for nothing but a mighty Blast to seize them the while they are disputing (in their worldly affairs),
t.19: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.
t.22: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves!
t.203: They await only but a single Saihah (shout), which will seize them while they are disputing!
t.54: انہیں صرف ایک سخت چیﺦ کاانتظار ہے جو انہیں آپکڑے گی اور یہ باہم لڑائی جھگڑے میں ہی ہوں گے.

t.149: so that they will neither be able to make a will nor return to their own people.
t.84: So they will not be able to make a bequest, nor will they return to their household.
t.85: They will have no time to make bequests, nor will they have the chance to return to their own people.
t.95: and they will not even be able to make a testament, nor to return to their households.
t.19: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.
t.22: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people!
t.203: Then they will not be able to make bequest, nor they will return to their family.
t.54: اس وقت نہ تو یہ وصیت کر سکیں گے اور نہ اپنے اہل کی طرف لوٹ سکیں گے.

t.149: And the trumpet was blown, whereupon they walked quickly out from the tombs to their Lord.
t.84: And the Horn will be blown, and suddenly they will be rushing from their graves towards their Lord.
t.85: The Trumpet will be sounded and- lo and behold!- they will rush out to their Lord from their graves.
t.95: Then the Trumpet shall be blown and lo! they will come out of their graves and be on the move towards their Lord,
t.19: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,
t.22: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!
t.203: And the Trumpet will be blown (i.e. the second blowing) and behold from the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord.
t.54: تو صور کے پھونکے جاتے ہی سب کے سب اپنی قبروں سے اپنے پروردگار کی طرف (تیز تیز) چلنے لگیں گے.

t.149: They said, “Woe to us! Who has resurrected us from our resting place?” This is what the All-Merciful has promised, and the emissaries have spoken the truth.”
t.84: They will say, “Woe to us! Who has raised us from our sleeping place? “This is what RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) had promised, and the messengers had told the truth.
t.85: They will say, ‘Alas for us! Who has resurrected us from our resting places?’ [They will be told], ‘This is what the Lord of Mercy promised, and the messengers told the truth.’
t.95: (nervously) exclaiming. “Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping-place?” “This is what the Merciful One had promised, and what (His) Messengers had said was true.”
t.19: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
t.22: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers!"
t.203: They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep." (It will be said to them): "This is what the Most Gracious (Allâh) had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth!"
t.54: کہیں گے ہائے ہائے! ہمیں ہماری خواب گاہوں سے کس نے اٹھا دیا۔ یہی ہے جس کا وعده رحمٰن نے دیا تھا اور رسولوں نے سچ سچ کہہ دیا تھا.

t.149: It was just a single Shout, and suddenly they were all arraigned before Us.
t.84: It will be no more than a single Cry, and in no time they will all be arraigned before Us.
t.85: It was just one single blast and then- lo and behold!- they were all brought before Us.
t.95: Then there will simply be one single Blast, and all will have gathered before Us.
t.19: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!
t.22: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us!
t.203: It will be but a single Saihah (shout), so behold they will all be brought up before Us!
t.54: یہ نہیں ہے مگر ایک چیﺦ کہ یکایک سارے کے سارے ہمارے سامنے حاضر کر دیئے جائیں گے.

t.149: So today no soul is dealt with unjustly in the least, and youare not repaid except for what you used to do.
t.84: Then, nobody will be subjected to injustice in the least, and you will not be recompensed but for what you used to do.
t.85: ‘Today, no soul will be wronged in the least: you will only be repaid for your deeds.
t.95: Today no one shall suffer the least injustice, and you shall not be recompensed except according to your deeds.
t.19: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.
t.22: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds.
t.203: This Day (Day of Resurrection), none will be wronged in anything, nor will you be requited anything except that which you used to do.
t.54: پس آج کسی شخص پر کچھ بھی ﻇلم نہ کیا جائے گا اور تمہیں نہیں بدلہ دیا جائے گا، مگر صرف ان ہی کاموں کا جو تم کیا کرتے تھے.

t.149: Indeed, today the fellows of the Garden(of Paradise) are happily busy,
t.84: The people of the Paradise are engaged today in (their) activities, happily enjoying (them).
t.85: The people of Paradise today are happily occupied-
t.95: Indeed, the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves:
t.19: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,
t.22: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;
t.203: Verily, the dwellers of the Paradise, that Day, will be busy with joyful things.
t.54: جنتی لوگ آج کے دن اپنے (دلچسﭗ) مشغلوں میں ہشاش بشاش ہیں.

t.149: they and their spouses, in shades , reclining on couches.
t.84: They and their spouses are in pleasant shades, reclining on couches.
t.85: they and their spouses- seated on couches in the shade.
t.95: they and their spouses shall be reclining on their couches in shady groves;
t.19: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;
t.22: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity);
t.203: They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones.
t.54: وه اور ان کی بیویاں سایوں میں مسہریوں پر تکیہ لگائے بیٹھے ہوں گے.

t.149: For them are fruits therein, and for them is whatever they call for.
t.84: For them there are fruits, and for them there is whatever they ask for.
t.85: There they have fruit and whatever they ask for.
t.95: therein there will be all kinds of fruits to eat, and they shall have all that they desire.
t.19: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;
t.22: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for;
t.203: They will have therein fruits (of all kinds) and all that they ask for.
t.54: ان کے لئے جنت میں ہر قسم کے میوے ہوں گے اور بھی جو کچھ وه طلب کریں.

t.149: “Peace”—a word from a Lord Bestowing of mercy.
t.84: “Salām ”(Peace upon you) is the word (they receive) from Merciful Lord.
t.85: “Peace,” a word from the Lord of Mercy.
t.95: “Peace” shall be the word conveyed to them from their Merciful Lord.
t.19: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
t.22: "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!
t.203: (It will be said to them): Salâm (peace be on you) - a Word from the Lord (Allâh), Most Merciful.
t.54: مہربان پروردگار کی طرف سے انہیں سلام کہا جائے گا.

t.149: But step aside today, you criminals.
t.84: And (it will be said to the infidels,) “Get apart (from the believers) today O the guilty ones.
t.85: But step aside today, you guilty ones.
t.95: “Criminals, separate yourselves from others today!
t.19: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!
t.22: "And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day!
t.203: (It will be said): "And O you Mujrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Islâmic Monotheism, wicked evil ones)! Get you apart this Day (from the believers).
t.54: اے گناهگارو! آج تم الگ ہو جاؤ.

t.149: Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not worship the devil—indeed, for you he is an evident enemy—
t.84: Did I not direct you, O children of ’Ādam (Adam), that you must not worship the Satan, (because) he is an open enemy for you,
t.85: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan, for he was your sworn enemy,
t.95: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan � he is to you an open enemy
t.19: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -
t.22: "Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed?-
t.203: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitân (Satan). Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.
t.54: اے اوﻻد آدم! کیا میں نے تم سے قول قرار نہیں لیا تھا کہ تم شیطان کی عبادت نہ کرنا، وه تو تمہارا کھلا دشمن ہے.

t.149: and that you shall worship Me? This is a straight path.
t.84: and that you must worship Me, (because) this is the straight path?
t.85: but to serve Me? This is the straight path.
t.95: and serve Me alone: this is the Straight Way?
t.19: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.
t.22: "And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way?
t.203: And that you should worship Me [Alone - Islâmic Monotheism, and set up not rivals, associate-gods with Me]. That is the Straight Path.
t.54: اور میری ہی عبادت کرنا۔ سیدھی راه یہی ہے.

t.149: Yet he has certainly led a great multitude of you astray. Did you not use reason?
t.84: He had misguided lot many people from among you. So, did you not have sense?
t.85: He has led great numbers of you astray. Did you not use your reason?
t.95: Still, he misguided a whole throng of you. Did you have no sense?
t.19: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?
t.22: "But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand?
t.203: And indeed he (Satan) did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not, then, understand?
t.54: شیطان نے تو تم میں سے بہت ساری مخلوق کو بہکا دیا۔ کیا تم عقل نہیں رکھتے.

t.149: This is Hell which youwere promised.
t.84: (Now) this is the Jahannam of which you were consistently warned.
t.85: So this is the Fire that you were warned against.
t.95: Now this is the Hell of which you were warned.
t.19: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).
t.22: "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!
t.203: This is Hell which you were promised!
t.54: یہی وه دوزخ ہے جس کا تمہیں وعده دیا جاتا تھا.

t.149: Roast in it today on account of how you used to deny.
t.84: Enter it today, because you have been persistently denying (the truth).”
t.85: Enter it today, because you went on ignoring [my commands].’
t.95: Burn in it on account of your disbelieving.
t.19: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
t.22: "Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)."
t.203: Burn therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve.
t.54: اپنے کفر کا بدلہ پانے کے لئے آج اس میں داخل ہوجاؤ.

t.149: Today, We put a seal upon their mouths, and their hands speak to Us, and their feet testify to whatever they used to earn.
t.84: Today We will set a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness about what they used to do.
t.85: On that Day We shall seal up their mouths, but their hands will speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to everything they have done.
t.95: Today We shall put a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us and their feet shall bear witness to what they had been doing.
t.19: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.
t.22: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.
t.203: This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn. (It is said that one’s left thigh will be the first to bear the witness). [Tafsir At-Tabarî,]
t.54: ہم آج کے دن ان کے منھ پر مہریں لگا دیں گے اور ان کے ہاتھ ہم سے باتیں کریں گے اور ان کے پاؤں گواہیاں دیں گے، ان کاموں کی جو وه کرتے تھے.

t.149: And if We will, We can obliterate their eyes, then they race with each other to(find) the Path—but how will they see?
t.84: If We so will, We would wipe out their eyes (right here in this world), and they would be racing towards the way, but how would they see?
t.85: If it had been Our will, We could have taken away their sight. They would have struggled to find the way, but how could they have seen it?
t.95: If We so willed, We would have put out their eyes, then they would rush to see the Way, but how would they be able to see?
t.19: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?
t.22: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen?
t.203: And if it had been Our Will, We would surely have wiped out (blinded) their eyes, so that they would struggle for the Path, how then would they see?
t.54: اگر ہم چاہتے تو ان کی آنکھیں بے نور کر دیتے پھر یہ رستے کی طرف دوڑتے پھرتے لیکن انہیں کیسے دکھائی دیتا؟

t.149: And if We will, We can disfigure them right in their place , so that they can neither move forward nor go back.
t.84: And If We so will, We would disfigure them at their places, and they would not be able to move, nor would they return.
t.85: If it had been Our will, We could have paralysed them where they stood, so that they could not move forward or backward.
t.95: If We so willed, We would have transformed them where they were so that they would not go forward or backward.
t.19: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.
t.22: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error).
t.203: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (into animals or lifeless objects) in their places. Then they would have been unable to go forward (move about) nor they could have turned back.
t.54: اور اگر ہم چاہتے تو ان کی جگہ ہی پر ان کی صورتیں مسﺦ کر دیتے پھر نہ وه چل پھر سکتے اور نہ لوٹ سکتے.

t.149: And to whomever We give long life, We reverse his development—so will they not reason?
t.84: And whomsoever We give long life, we reverse him in creation. Then, do they have no sense?
t.85: If We extend anyone’s life, We reverse his development. Do they not use their reason?
t.95: Whomsoever We grant a long life, We reverse him in his constitution. Do they still not understand?
t.19: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?
t.22: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?
t.203: And he whom We grant long life - We reverse him in creation (weakness after strength). Will they not then understand?
t.54: اور جسے ہم بوڑھا کرتے ہیں اسے پیدائشی حالت کی طرف پھر الٹ دیتے ہیں کیا پھر بھی وه نہیں سمجھتے.

t.149: And never did We teach himpoetry, nor is it proper for him; it is but a Reminder and an Evident Recital—
t.84: We did not teach him (the Holy Prophet) poetry, and it is not proper for him. It is nothing (of that sort,) but (it is) an advice and a readable book that explains (the Truth),
t.85: We have not taught the Prophet poetry, nor could he everhave been a poet.
t.95: We did not teach him (to wit, the Messenger) poetry and it does not behove him. This is none but an Admonition, and a Clear Book
t.19: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
t.22: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur'an making things clear:
t.203: And We have not taught him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) poetry, nor is it suitable for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Qur’ân.
t.54: نہ تو ہم نے اس پیغمبر کو شعر سکھائے اور نہ یہ اس کے ﻻئق ہے۔ وه تو صرف نصیحت اور واضح قرآن ہے.

t.149: so that it may forewarn whoever is alive, and so that God’s decree may be deserved by the deniers.
t.84: so that it may warn him who is alive (to listen to the truth), and so that the word may prove true against the disbelievers.
t.85: This is a revelation, an illuminating Quran to warn anyone who is truly alive, so that God’s verdict may be passed against the disbelievers.
t.95: that he may warn him who is alive and establish an argument against those that deny the Truth.
t.19: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.
t.22: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth).
t.203: That he or it (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم or the Qur’ân) may give warning to him who is living (a healthy minded - the believer), and that Word (charge) may be justified against the disbelievers (dead, as they reject the warnings).
t.54: تاکہ وه ہر اس شخص کو آگاه کر دے جو زنده ہے، اور کافروں پر حجت ﺛابت ہو جائے.

t.149: Have they not seen that We have created for them, of Our Handiwork, livestock, so that they are their owners?
t.84: Did they not see that We have created for them cattle, among things made (directly) by Our hands, and then they become their owners?
t.85: Can they not see how, among the things made by Our hands, We have created livestock they control,
t.95: Do they not see Our handiwork: We created for them cattle which they own?
t.19: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,
t.22: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion?-
t.203: Do they not see that We have created for them of what Our Hands have created the cattle, so that they are their owners.
t.54: کیا وه نہیں دیکھتے کہ ہم نے اپنے ہاتھوں سے بنائی ہوئی چیزوں میں سے ان کے لئے چوپائے (بھی) پیدا کر دیئے، جن کے یہ مالک ہوگئے ہیں.

t.149: And We made them manageable by them, so some they ride and some they eat.
t.84: And We have brought them under their control, so as some of them are their means of transport, and some of them they eat.
t.85: and made them obedient, so that some can be used for riding, some for food,
t.95: We have subjected the cattle to them so that some of them they ride and eat the flesh of others.
t.19: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?
t.22: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat:
t.203: And We have subdued them unto them so that some of them they have for riding and some they eat.
t.54: اور ان مویشیوں کو ہم نے ان کا تابع فرمان بنا دیا ہے جن میں سے بعض تو ان کی سواریاں ہیں اور بعض کا گوشت کھاتے ہیں.

t.149: And they have in them other benefits and drinks, so will they not give thanks?
t.84: And for them there are (other) benefits in them and things to drink. So, would they not be grateful?
t.85: some for other benefits, and some for drink? Will they not give thanks?
t.95: They derive a variety of benefits and drinks from them. Will they, then, not give thanks?
t.19: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?
t.22: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
t.203: And they have (other) benefits from them, and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
t.54: انہیں ان سے اور بھی بہت سے فائدے ہیں، اور پینے کی چیزیں۔ کیا پھر (بھی) یہ شکر ادا نہیں کریں گے؟

t.149: Yet they have taken to themselves gods other than Allah, that perhaps they may be supported.
t.84: They have adopted gods other than Allah, so that they may be helped (by them).
t.85: Yet they have taken other gods besides God to help them,
t.95: They set up deities apart from Allah, hoping that they will receive help from them.
t.19: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.
t.22: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than Allah, (hoping) that they might be helped!
t.203: And they have taken besides Allâh âlihah (gods), hoping that they might be helped (by those so-called gods).
t.54: اور وه اللہ کے سوا دوسروں کو معبود بناتے ہیں تاکہ وه مدد کئے جائیں.

t.149: They cannot support them, even if they are arraigned for them as an army.
t.84: They cannot help them, rather they (the disbelievers themselves) are (like) an army brought forth for (protecting) them (the so-called co-gods)
t.85: though these could not do so even if they called a whole army of them together!
t.95: Those deities can render them no help. Yet these devotees act as though they were an army in waiting for them.
t.19: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.
t.22: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned).
t.203: They cannot help them, but they will be brought forward as a troop against those who worshipped them (at the time of Reckoning).
t.54: (حاﻻنکہ) ان میں ان کی مدد کی طاقت ہی نہیں، (لیکن) پھر بھی (مشرکین) ان کے لئے حاضر باش لشکری ہیں.

t.149: So let not their words sadden you. Indeed, We know whatever they keep secret and whatever they make public.
t.84: So, their remarks must not grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they disclose.
t.85: So [Prophet] do not be distressed at what they say: We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
t.95: Let not their words grieve you. Surely We know all things about them, what they conceal and what they reveal.
t.19: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.
t.22: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose.
t.203: So let not their speech, then, grieve you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). Verily, We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
t.54: پس آپ کو ان کی بات غمناک نہ کرے، ہم ان کی پوشیده اور علانیہ سب باتوں کو (بخوبی) جانتے ہیں.

t.149: Has man not regarded that We created him from a sperm-drop? Yet he became an evident adversary,
t.84: Did man not see that We have created him from a drop of semen? Then suddenly he stood as an open adversary (to Us).
t.85: Can man not see that We created him from a drop of fluid? Yet- lo and behold!- he disputes openly,
t.95: Does man not see that We created him of a sperm drop, and lo! he is flagrantly contentious?
t.19: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
t.22: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary!
t.203: Does not man see that We have created him from Nutfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge - semen drops). Yet behold he (stands forth) as an open opponent.
t.54: کیا انسان کو اتنا بھی معلوم نہیں کہ ہم نے اسے نطفے سے پیدا کیا ہے؟ پھر یکایک وہ صریح جھگڑالو بن بیٹھا.

t.149: and he set forth a parable for Us and forgot his own creation. He said, “Who can revive the bones when they have decayed?”
t.84: He has set up an argument about Us and forgot his creation. He said, “Who will give life to the bones when they are decayed?”
t.85: producing arguments against Us, forgetting his own creation. He says, ‘Who can give life back to bones after they have decayed?’
