t.95: He strikes for Us a similitude and forgot his own creation. He says: “Who will quicken the bones when they have decayed?”
t.19: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?
t.22: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)?"
t.203: And he puts forth for Us a parable, and forgets his own creation. He says: "Who will give life to these bones after they are rotten and have become dust?"
t.54: اور اس نے ہمارے لئے مثال بیان کی اور اپنی (اصل) پیدائش کو بھول گیا، کہنے لگا ان گلی سڑی ہڈیوں کو کون زنده کر سکتا ہے؟

t.149: Say, “He who initiated them the first time revives them, for He is All-Knowing of every creation.”
t.84: Say, “These will be revived by the same One who had created them for the first time, and who is fully aware of every creation,
t.85: Say, ‘He who created them in the first place will give them life again: He has full knowledge of every act of creation.
t.95: Say: “He Who first brought them into being will quicken them; He knows well about every kind of creation;
t.19: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,
t.22: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation!-
t.203: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "He will give life to them Who created them for the first time! And He is the All-Knower of every creation!"
t.54: آپ جواب دیجئے! کہ انہیں وه زنده کرے گا جس نے انہیں اول مرتبہ پیدا کیا ہے، جو سب طرح کی پیدائش کا بخوبی جاننے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: He who made fire for youout of green trees, so that with them you kindle.
t.84: - the One who created for you fire from the green tree, and in no time you kindle from it.”
t.85: It is He who produces fire for you out of the green tree- lo and behold!- and from this you kindle fire.
t.95: He Who created from a green tree a fire for you, a fire to light your stoves with.”
t.19: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.
t.22: "The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)!
t.203: He Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold you kindle therewith.
t.54: وہی جس نے تمہارے لئے سبز درخت سے آگ پیدا کر دی جس سے تم یکایک آگ سلگاتے ہو.

t.149: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth capable of creatingthe like of them? Yes indeed, and He is the All-Creating, the All-Knowing.
t.84: Is it that the One who has created the heavens and the earth has no power to create ones like them? Why not? He is the Supreme Creator, the All-Knowing.
t.85: Is He who created the heavens and earth not able to create the likes of these people? Of course He is! He is the All Knowing Creator:
t.95: Has He Who created the heavens and the earth no power to create the likes of them? Yes, indeed, He is the Superb Creator.
t.19: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,
t.22: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)!
t.203: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, Able to create the like of them? Yes, indeed! He is the All-Knowing Supreme Creator.
t.54: جس نے آسمانوں اور زمین کو پیدا کیا ہے کیا وه ان جیسوں کے پیدا کرنے پرقادر نہیں، بےشک قادر ہے۔ اور وہی تو پیدا کرنے واﻻ دانا (بینا) ہے.

t.149: Indeed, His only command once He has desired anything is to say to it, “Be,” and so it is .
t.84: His practice, when He intends to do something, is no more than He says, “Be”, and it comes to be.
t.85: when He wills something to be, His way is to say, “Be”- and it is!
t.95: Whenever He wills a thing, He just commands it “Be” and it is.
t.19: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
t.22: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is!
t.203: Verily, His Command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, "Be!" - and it is!
t.54: وه جب کبھی کسی چیز کا اراده کرتا ہے اسے اتنا فرما دینا (کافی ہے) کہ ہو جا، وه اسی وقت ہو جاتی ہے.

t.149: So Highly Exalted is the One in Whose hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him youare returned .
t.84: So, pure (from every fault) is the One in whose hand is the dominion of all things. And towards Him you are to be returned.
t.85: So glory be to Him in whose Hand lies control over all things. It is to Him that you will all be brought back.’
t.95: Holy is He Who has full control over everything, and to Him you shall all be recalled.
t.19: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.
t.22: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back.
t.203: So glorified be He and exalted above all that they associate with Him, and in Whose Hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him you shall be returned.
t.54: پس پاک ہے وه اللہ جس کے ہاتھ میں ہر چیز کی بادشاہت ہے اور جس کی طرف تم سب لوٹائے جاؤ گے.

t.149: By those aligned, lined up in ranks.
t.84: (I swear) by those who stand in rows,
t.85: By those [angels] ranged in rows,
t.95: By those who range themselves in rows;
t.19: By those who set the ranks in battle order
t.22: By those who range themselves in ranks,
t.203: By those (angels) ranged in ranks (or rows).
t.54: قسم ہے صف باندھنے والے (فرشتوں) کی.

t.149: Then by the propellers propelling firmly.
t.84: then by those who prevent firmly,
t.85: who rebuke reproachfully
t.95: by those who reprove severely,
t.19: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
t.22: And so are strong in repelling (evil),
t.203: By those (angels) who drive the clouds in a good way.
t.54: پھر پوری طرح ڈانٹنے والوں کی.

t.149: Then by the readers of a Reminder—
t.84: then by those who recite the dhikr,
t.85: and recite God’s word,
t.95: and those who recite the Exhortation;
t.19: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
t.22: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!
t.203: By those (angels) who bring the Book and the Qur’ân from Allâh to mankind [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].
t.54: پھر ذکر اللہ کی تلاوت کرنے والوں کی.

t.149: indeed, yourGod is surely One,
t.84: surely your God is but One,
t.85: truly your God is One,
t.95: surely your God is One,
t.19: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;
t.22: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-
t.203: Verily your Ilâh (God) is indeed One (i.e. Allâh):
t.54: یقیناً تم سب کا معبود ایک ہی ہے.

t.149: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and Lord of the Easts.
t.84: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.
t.85: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them, Lord of every sunrise.
t.95: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever lies between the two, the Lord of the Easts.
t.19: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.
t.22: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!
t.203: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun’s risings.
t.54: آسمانوں اور زمین اور ان کے درمیان کی تمام چیزوں اور مَشرقوں کا رب وہی ہے.

t.149: Indeed, We have adorned the lowestheaven withan adornment, the planets ,
t.84: Verily, We have decorated the nearest sky with an adornment, the stars,
t.85: We have adorned the lowest heaven with stars,
t.95: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars
t.19: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;
t.22: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-
t.203: Verily We have adorned the near heaven with the stars (for beauty).
t.54: ہم نے آسمان دنیا کو ستاروں کی زینت سے آراستہ کیا.

t.149: and as a protection against every defiant devil.
t.84: and (have made them) a security against every rebellious devil.
t.85: and made them a safeguard against every rebellious devil:
t.95: and have protected it from every rebellious satan.
t.19: With security from every froward devil.
t.22: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,
t.203: And to guard against every rebellious devil.
t.54: اور حفاﻇت کی سرکش شیطان سے.

t.149: They cannot eavesdrop onthe Higher Assembly, for they get bombarded from every side—
t.84: They cannot listen to the Upper Realm and are hit from every side
t.85: they cannot eavesdrop on the Higher Assembly––pelted from every side,
t.95: These satans cannot listen to what transpires in the High Council for they are pelted away from every side
t.19: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
t.22: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
t.203: They cannot listen to the higher group (angels) for they are pelted from every side.
t.54: عالم باﻻ کے فرشتوں (کی باتوں) کو سننے کے لئے وه کان بھی نہیں لگا سکتے، بلکہ ہر طرف سے وه مارے جاتے ہیں.

t.149: repelled, and they will have an unremitting punishment,
t.84: to be driven off, and for them there is a lasting punishment;
t.85: driven away, they will have perpetual torment––
t.95: and are repelled. Theirs is an unceasing chastisement.
t.19: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
t.22: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,
t.203: Outcast, and theirs is a constant (or painful) torment.
t.54: بھگانے کے لئے اور ان کے لئے دائمی عذاب ہے.

t.149: except for one who snatched a fragment and was then pursued by a piercing meteor.
t.84: however, if one snatches a little bit, he is pursued by a bright flame.
t.85: if any [of them] stealthily snatches away a fragment, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.
t.95: And if any is able to snatch a fragment, he is pursued by a piercing flame.
t.19: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
t.22: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.
t.203: Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.
t.54: مگر جو کوئی ایک آدھ بات اچک لے بھاگے تو (فوراً ہی) اس کے پیچھے دہکتا ہوا شعلہ لگ جاتا ہے.

t.149: So inquireof them, “Are they more difficult to create, or the others We created?” Indeed, We created them from sticky clay.
t.84: Now ask them, “Are they stronger in the formation of their bodies, or those (other beings) that We have created?” Certainly, We did create them from sticky clay.
t.85: So [Prophet], ask the disbelievers: is it harder to create them than other beings We have created? We created them from sticky clay.
t.95: So ask them (that is, human beings): “Were they harder to create than the objects We created?” We created them from sticky clay.
t.19: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.
t.22: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!
t.203: Then ask them (i.e. these polytheists, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are they stronger as creation, or those (others like the heavens and the earth and the mountains) whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.
t.54: ان کافروں سے پوچھو تو کہ آیا ان کا پیدا کرنا زیاده دشوار ہے یا (ان کا) جنہیں ہم نے (ان کے علاوه) پیدا کیا؟ ہم نے (انسانوں) کو لیس دار مٹی سے پیدا کیا ہے.

t.149: Rather, youwere amazed asthey ridicule.
t.84: But you wonder (at their denial), and they mock (at the idea of an Hereafter).
t.85: You marvel as they scoff,
t.95: You marvel (at the wondrous creations of Allah) and they scoff at it,
t.19: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
t.22: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,
t.203: Nay, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) wondered (at their insolence) while they mock (at you and at the Qur’ân).
t.54: بلکہ تو تعجب کر رہا ہے اور یہ مسخرا پن کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: And when reminded, they remember not.
t.84: And when any advice is given to them, they pay no heed to it.
t.85: take no heed when they are warned,
t.95: and when they are admonished, they pay no heed;
t.19: And heed not when they are reminded,
t.22: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-
t.203: And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.
t.54: اور جب انہیں نصیحت کی جاتی ہے یہ نہیں مانتے.

t.149: And when they see a sign, they exaggerate in ridiculing
t.84: And when they see a sign, they make fun of it,
t.85: and resort to ridicule when they see a sign,
t.95: and if they see any Sign, they laugh it away
t.19: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.
t.22: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,
t.203: And when they see an Ayâh (a sign, or an evidence) from Allâh, they mock at it.
t.54: اور جب کسی معجزے کو دیکھتے ہیں تو مذاق اڑاتے ہیں.

t.149: and say, “This is nothing but evident sorcery.
t.84: and say, “This is nothing but an open magic.
t.85: saying, ‘This is no more than blatant sorcery.’
t.95: and say: “This is nothing but plain sorcery.
t.19: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
t.22: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!
t.203: And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!
t.54: اور کہتے ہیں کہ یہ تو بالکل کھلم کھلا جادو ہی ہے.

t.149: Can it be thatwhen we have died and become dust and bones, can it be that we will really be resurrected?
t.84: Is it when we have died and become dust and bones, that we shall be raised again,
t.85: ‘What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we really be raised up again,
t.95: Is it ever possible that after we die and are reduced to dust and (a skeleton of) bones, we will be raised to life?
t.19: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?
t.22: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)
t.203: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we (then) verily be resurrected?
t.54: کیا جب ہم مر جائیں گے اور خاک اور ہڈی ہو جائیں گے پھر کیا (سچ مچ) ہم اٹھائے جائیں گے؟

t.149: And our ancient forefathers?”
t.84: and even our fathers of aforetime?”
t.85: along with our forefathers?’
t.95: And so also shall our forefathers of yore be raised to life?”
t.19: And our forefathers?
t.22: "And also our fathers of old?"
t.203: "And also our fathers of old?"
t.54: کیا ہم سے پہلے کے ہمارے باپ دادا بھی؟

t.149: Say, “Yes indeed, and you will be totally subdued.”
t.84: Say, “Yes, and you shall be disgraced (too)!”
t.85: Say, ‘Yes indeed, and you will be humiliated.’
t.95: Tell them: “Yes; and you are utterly helpless (against Allah).”
t.19: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
t.22: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."
t.54: آپ جواب دیجئے! کہ ہاں ہاں اور تم ذلیل (بھی) ہوں گے.

t.149: It is but a single nudge, and there they are looking on(in bewilderment) !
t.84: So, it will be only a single castigating call, and all of a sudden they will begin to see.
t.85: Just one blast and––lo and behold!––they will look
t.95: There will be a single stern rebuff and lo, they will be observing with their own eyes (all that they had been warned against).
t.19: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,
t.22: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!
t.203: It will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e. the second blowing of the Trumpet)], and behold, they will be staring!
t.54: وه تو صرف ایک زور کی جھڑکی ہے کہ یکایک یہ دیکھنے لگیں گے.

t.149: And they said, “Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense.”
t.84: And they will be saying, “Woe to us; this is the Day of Retribution.”
t.85: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgement.’
t.95: They will then say: “Woe for us. This is the Day of Judgement.”
t.19: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
t.22: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"
t.203: They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"
t.54: اور کہیں گے کہ ہائے ہماری خرابی یہی جزا (سزا) کا دن ہے.

t.149: “This is the Day of Decision which youused to deny.
t.84: (It will be said to them,) “This is the Day of Judgment that you used to deny.”
t.85: [It will be said], ‘This is the Day of Decision, which you used to deny.
t.95: “Yes, this is the Day of Final Decision that you used to deny as a lie.”
t.19: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
t.22: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"
t.203: (It will be said): "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
t.54: یہی فیصلہ کا دن ہے جسے تم جھٹلاتے رہے.

t.149: Herdthose who were unjust and their spouses, and what they used to worship
t.84: (It will be said to the angels,) “Muster all those who were unjust, and their fellows, and whatever they used to worship
t.85: [Angels], gather together those who did wrong, and others like them, as well as whatever they worshipped
t.95: (Then will the command be given): “Muster all the wrong-doers and their spouses and the deities whom they used to serve
t.19: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship
t.22: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-
t.203: (It will be said to the angels): "Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions (from the devils) and what they used to worship,
t.54: ﻇالموں کو اور ان کے ہمراہیوں کو اور (جن) جن کی وه اللہ کے علاوه پرستش کرتے تھے.

t.149: apart from Allah, and guide them to the path to purgatory.
t.84: other than Allah, and show them the way to Jahannam ,
t.85: beside God, lead them all to the path of Hell,
t.95: apart from Allah, and direct them to the path of Hell,
t.19: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
t.22: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!
t.203: "Instead of Allâh, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell);
t.54: (ان سب کو) جمع کرکے انہیں دوزخ کی راه دکھا دو.

t.149: And stop them—indeed, they are to be questioned.”
t.84: and stop them (for a while,) for they are to be asked some questions.”
t.85: and halt them for questioning:
t.95: and detain them there; they will be called to account.
t.19: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
t.22: "But stop them, for they must be asked:
t.203: "But stop them, verily they are to be questioned.
t.54: اور انہیں ٹھہرا لو، (اس لئے) کہ ان سے (ضروری) سوال کیے جانے والے ہیں.

t.149: “What is the matter with youthat you do not help one another?”
t.84: (Then they will be asked, “What is wrong with you that you do not help each other?”
t.85: “Why do you not support each other now?” ’––
t.95: How is it that you are not helping one another?
t.19: What aileth you that ye help not one another?
t.22: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"
t.203: "What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another (as you used to do in the world)?"
t.54: تمہیں کیا ہو گیا ہے کہ (اس وقت) تم ایک دوسرے کی مدد نہیں کرتے.

t.149: Rather, on this day, they are submissive.
t.84: On the contrary, that day all of them will have totally surrendered.
t.85: no indeed! They will be in complete submission on that Day––
t.95: Indeed, today they are surrendering themselves completely.”
t.19: Nay, but this day they make full submission.
t.22: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);
t.203: Nay, but that Day they shall surrender.
t.54: بلکہ وه (سب کے سب) آج فرمانبردار بن گئے.

t.149: And they cameto one another, asking one another.
t.84: And some of them (the followers of their chiefs) will turn to others (the chiefs), asking questions from one another.
t.85: and they will turn on one another accusingly.
t.95: They will then turn towards each other (and start wrangling).
t.19: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
t.22: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
t.203: And they will turn to one another and question one another.
t.54: وه ایک دوسرے کی طرف متوجہ ہو کر سوال وجواب کرنے لگیں گے.

t.149: Theysaid, “Indeed, youused to come at us from the right”
t.84: They (the followers) will say, “You were the ones who used to come to (mislead) us forcefully.”
t.85: They will say, ‘You came to us from a position of power.’
t.95: (The followers will say to their leaders): “You used to come to us from the right hand.”
t.19: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
t.22: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"
t.203: They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side [i.e. from the right side of one of us and beautify for us every evil, enjoin on us polytheism, and stop us from the truth i.e. Islâmic Monotheism and from every good deed]."
t.54: کہیں گے کہ تم تو ہمارے پاس ہماری دائیں طرف سے آتے تھے.

t.149: Theysaid, “Rather, youyourselves were not believers,
t.84: They (the chiefs) will say, “On the contrary, you yourselves were not believers.
t.85: They will say, ‘No! It was you who would not believe-
t.95: They will say: “Nay, you yourselves were not the ones who would believe.
t.19: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
t.22: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!
t.203: They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers.
t.54: وه جواب دیں گے کہ نہیں بلکہ تم ہی ایمان والے نہ تھے.

t.149: and we had no authority over you; rather, you yourselves were a people who exceeded all limits.
t.84: We had no authority over you at all, but you yourselves were a transgressing people.
t.85: we had no power over you- and you were already exceeding all limits.
t.95: We had no power over you. You were a rebellious people,
t.19: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.
t.22: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
t.203: "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were Tâghûn (transgressing) people (polytheists, and disbelievers).
t.54: اور کچھ ہمارا زور تو تم پر تھا (ہی) نہیں۔ بلکہ تم (خود) سرکش لوگ تھے.

t.149: And therefore we deserved our Lord’s decree on us. Most surely we will all get a taste,
t.84: So, the word of our Lord has come true against us. Indeed, we have to taste (the punishment).
t.85: Our Lord’s sentence on us is just and we must all taste the punishment.
t.95: and so we became deserving of the Word of our Lord that we shall be made to suffer chastisement.
t.19: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).
t.22: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).
t.203: "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly (have to) taste (the torment).
t.54: اب تو ہم (سب) پر ہمارے رب کی یہ بات ﺛابت ہو چکی کہ ہم (عذاب) چکھنے والے ہیں.

t.149: for we deluded you; indeed, we were deluded.”
t.84: We did misguide you, (because) we were ourselves erroneous”.
t.85: We led you astray as we ourselves were astray.’
t.95: So we led you astray; we ourselves were strayed.”
t.19: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
t.22: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."
t.203: "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray."
t.54: پس ہم نے تمہیں گمراه کیا ہم تو خود بھی گمراه ہی تھے.

t.149: So on that day, they are indeed partners in the punishment.
t.84: So, that day, they will share each other in punishment.
t.85: On that Day they will all share the torment:
t.95: On that Day, they will all share the chastisement.
t.19: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
t.22: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
t.203: Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.
t.54: سو اب آج کے دن تو (سب کے سب) عذاب میں شریک ہیں.

t.149: This is what We do with the criminals.
t.84: This is how We deal with the criminals.
t.85: this is how We deal with the guilty.
t.95: Thus do We treat the culprits.
t.19: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
t.22: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
t.203: Certainly, that is how We deal with Al-Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, disbelievers, criminals, the disobedient to Allâh).
t.54: ہم گناه گاروں کے ساتھ اسی طرح کیا کرتے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, when it was said to them, “There is no god except Allah,” they would act arrogantly
t.84: They were those to whom when it was said: “There is no god but Allah”, they waxed proud,
t.85: Whenever it was said to them, ‘There is no deity but God,’ they became arrogant,
t.95: Whenever it was said to them: “There is no true deity apart from Allah,” they waxed proud
t.19: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful
t.22: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,
t.203: Truly, when it was said to them: Lâ ilâha illallâh "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh)," they puffed themselves up with pride (i.e. denied it).
t.54: یہ وه (لوگ) ہیں کہ جب ان سے کہا جاتا ہے کہ اللہ کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں تو یہ سرکشی کرتے تھے.

t.149: and say, “Are we really to abandon our gods for a mad poet?”
t.84: and used to say, “Are we really to leave our gods because of an insane poet?”
t.85: and said, ‘Are we to forsake our gods for a mad poet?’
t.95: and said: “Shall we forsake our deities for the sake of a distracted poet?”
t.19: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
t.22: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
t.203: And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our âlihah (gods) for the sake of a mad poet?"
t.54: اور کہتے تھے کہ کیا ہم اپنے معبودوں کو ایک دیوانے شاعر کی بات پر چھوڑ دیں؟

t.149: In fact, he came with the truth, and he confirmed the emissaries.
t.84: No, he has come with Truth and has confirmed all the messengers (of Allah).
t.85: ‘No: he brought the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers;
t.95: (They say so although) he brought the Truth and confirmed the veracity of the Messengers.
t.19: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
t.22: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).
t.203: Nay! he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come with the truth (i.e. Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism and this Qur’ân) and he confirms the Messengers (before him who brought Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: (نہیں نہیں) بلکہ (نبی) تو حق (سچا دین) ﻻئے ہیں اور سب رسولوں کو سچا جانتے ہیں.

t.149: Most surely, youwill taste the painful punishment,
t.84: Surely you have to taste the painful punishment,-
t.85: you will taste the painful torment,
t.95: (They will be told): “You shall taste the grievous chastisement.
t.19: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -
t.22: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-
t.203: Verily, you (pagans of Makkah) are going to taste the painful torment;
t.54: یقیناً تم دردناک عذاب (کا مزه) چکھنے والے ہو.

t.149: and in no way will you be repaid except for what you used to do,
t.84: And you will be recompensed for nothing but for what you used to do-
t.85: and be repaid only according to your deeds.’
t.95: You will only be recompensed according to your deeds.”
t.19: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -
t.22: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-
t.203: And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do (evil deeds, sins, and Allâh’s disobedience which you used to do in this world)
t.54: تمہیں اسی کا بدلہ دیا جائے گا جو تم کرتے تھے.

t.149: except for Allah’s sincere chosen servants.
t.84: unlike Allah’s chosen servants.
t.85: Not so God’s true servants.
t.95: But Allah's chosen servants (shall be spared this woeful end).
t.19: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;
t.22: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-
t.203: Save the chosen slaves of Allâh (i.e. the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: مگر اللہ تعالیٰ کے خالص برگزیده بندے.

t.149: For those, there is a known provision:
t.84: Those are the people for whom there is a known provision,
t.85: They will have familiar provisions––
t.95: For them awaits a known provision,
t.19: For them there is a known provision,
t.22: For them is a Sustenance determined,
t.203: For them there will be a known provision (in Paradise),
t.54: انہیں کے لئے مقرره روزی ہے.

t.149: fruits, and they are honored
t.84: the fruits; and they will be honored
t.85: fruits- and will be honoured
t.95: a variety of delicious fruits; and they shall be honoured
t.19: Fruits. And they will be honoured
t.22: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,
t.203: Fruits; and they shall be honoured,
t.54: (ہر طرح کے) میوے، اور وه باعزت واکرام ہوں گے.

t.149: in the Gardens of Bliss,
t.84: in Gardens of Bliss
t.85: in gardens of delight;
t.95: in the Gardens of Bliss.
t.19: In the Gardens of delight,
t.22: In Gardens of Felicity,
t.203: In the Gardens of delight (Paradise),
t.54: نعمتوں والی جنتوں میں.

t.149: on couches facing one another.
t.84: facing each other on couches.
t.85: seated on couches, facing one another.
t.95: They will be seated upon couches set face to face;
t.19: On couches facing one another;
t.22: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):
t.203: Facing one another on thrones.
t.54: تختوں پر ایک دوسرے کے سامنے (بیٹھے) ہوں گے.

t.149: A drink is passed round among them from a flowing spring:
t.84: They will be served with a cup from a flowing drink,
t.85: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring:
t.95: a cup filled with wine from its springs, will be passed around to them;
t.19: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
t.22: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,
t.203: Round them will be passed a cup of pure wine -
t.54: جاری شراب کے جام کا ان پر دور چل رہا ہوگا.

t.149: white, a delight to those who drink,
t.84: (that will be) white (and) delicious for those who drink.
t.85: white, delicious to those who taste it,
t.95: white, sparkling (wine), a delight to the drinkers.
t.19: White, delicious to the drinkers,
t.22: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),
t.203: White, delicious to the drinkers.
t.54: جو صاف شفاف اور پینے میں لذیذ ہوگی.

t.149: no headiness in it, nor by it are they drained.
t.84: There will be no headache therein, nor will they be intoxicated with it,
t.85: causing no headiness or intoxication.
t.95: There will neither be any harm in it for their body nor will it intoxicate their mind.
t.19: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.
t.22: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
t.203: Neither will they have Ghoul (any kind of hurt, abdominal pain, headache, a sin) from that, nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
t.54: نہ اس سے درد سر ہو اور نہ اس کے پینے سے بہکیں.

t.149: And with them are bashful maidens with lovely eyes,
t.84: and by their side there will be females restricting their gazes (to their husbands), having pretty big eyes,
t.85: With them will be spouses- modest of gaze and beautiful of eye-
t.95: Theirs shall be wide-eyed maidens with bashful, restrained glances,
t.19: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,
t.22: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).
t.203: And beside them will be Qâsirât-at-Tarf [chaste females (wives), restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands)], with wide and beautiful eyes.
t.54: اور ان کے پاس نیچی نظروں، بڑی بڑی آنکھوں والی (حوریں) ہوں گی.

t.149: as if they were closely guarded eggs.
t.84: as if they were eggs hidden (under feathers, protected from pollution).
t.85: like protected eggs.
t.95: so delicate as the hidden peel under an egg's shell.
t.19: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).
t.22: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.
t.203: (Delicate and pure) as if they were (hidden) eggs (well) preserved.
t.54: ایسی جیسے چھپائے ہوئے انڈے.

t.149: So they cameto one another, asking one another.
t.84: Then they will turn to each other asking questions mutually.
t.85: They will turn to one another with questions:
t.95: Then some of them will turn to others, and will ask each other.
t.19: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
t.22: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.
t.203: Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning.
t.54: (جنتی) ایک دوسرے کی طرف رخ کرکے پوچھیں گے.

t.149: One of them said, “Indeed, I did have a comrade
t.84: A speaker from them will say, “I had a companion (in the worldly life)
t.85: one will say, ‘I had a close companion on earth
t.95: One of them will say: “I had a companion in the world
t.19: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
t.22: One of them will start the talk and say: "I had an intimate companion (on the earth),
t.203: A speaker of them will say: "Verily, I had a companion (in the world),
t.54: ان میں سے ایک کہنے واﻻ کہے گا کہ میرا ایک ساتھی تھا.

t.149: who would say, ‘Can it be that youare really of those who believe?
t.84: who used to say (to me), “Are you one of those who believe?
t.85: who used to ask me, “Do you really believe that
t.95: who used to say: �Are you also one of those who confirm the Truth (of life after death)?
t.19: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?
t.22: "Who used to say, 'what! art thou amongst those who bear witness to the Truth (of the Message)?
t.203: Who used to say: "Are you among those who believe (in resurrection after death).
t.54: جو (مجھ سے) کہا کرتا تھا کہ کیا تو (قیامت کے آنے کا) یقین کرنے والوں میں سے ہے؟

t.149: Can it be thatwhen we have died and become dust and bones, can it be that we will really be called to account?’”
t.84: Is it when we have died and become dust and bones? Is it true that we are going to be recompensed (for our deeds)?”
t.85: after we die and become dust and bone, we shall be brought for judgement?”’
t.95: After we are dead and have become all dust and bones shall we still be requited?'
t.19: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?
t.22: "'When we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed receive rewards and punishments?'"
t.203: "(That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed (be raised up) to receive reward or punishment (according to our deeds)?"
t.54: کیا جب کہ ہم مر کر مٹی اور ہڈی ہو جائیں گے کیا اس وقت ہم جزا دیئے جانے والے ہیں؟

t.149: He said(to his companions in Paradise) , “Can youview(him) ?”
t.84: He (the speaker) will say (to other people in Paradise) “Would you like to have a look (at Jahannam to find out what happened to that companion of mine)?”
t.85: Then he will say, ‘Shall we look for him?’
t.95: He will say: �Do you wish to know where he is now?'
t.19: He saith: Will ye look?
t.22: (A voice) said: "Would ye like to look down?"
t.203: (The speaker) said: "Will you look down?"
t.54: کہے گا تم چاہتے ہو کہ جھانک کر دیکھ لو؟

t.149: Then he viewed(him) and saw him in the midst of purgatory.
t.84: So he will look and will see him in the middle of Jahannam.
t.85: He will look down and see him in the midst of the Fire,
t.95: Then he will look downwards, and will see him in the depths of Hell.
t.19: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
t.22: He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
t.203: So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
t.54: جھانکتے ہی اسے بیچوں بیچ جہنم میں (جلتا ہوا) دیکھے گا.

t.149: He said,“(I swear) by Allah, youalmost ruined me.
t.84: He (the speaker) will say (to his companion seen in Jahannam ), “By Allah, you were going almost to ruin me.
t.85: and say to him, ‘By God, you almost brought me to ruin!
t.95: He will say to him: �By Allah, you almost ruined me.
t.19: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,
t.22: He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!
t.203: He said: "By Allâh! You have nearly ruined me.
t.54: کہے گا واللہ! قریب تھا کہ تو مجھے (بھی) برباد کر دے.

t.149: And were it not for the blessing of my Lord, I would have been of the arraigned.”
t.84: But for the favor of my Lord, I would have been among those produced for punishment.”
t.85: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I too would have been taken to Hell.’
t.95: But for Allah's favour, I should be one of those who have been mustered here.
t.19: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).
t.22: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been among those brought (there)!
t.203: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell)."
t.54: اگر میرے رب کا احسان نہ ہوتا تو میں بھی دوزخ میں حاضر کئے جانے والوں میں ہوتا.

t.149: “Are we(then) not to die
t.84: (Then the speaker will address other people of Paradise in delight and wonder, saying,) “Are we not then to die anymore
t.85: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], ‘Are we never to die again after our earlier death?
t.95: So, are we not going to die,
t.19: Are we then not to die
t.22: "Is it (the case) that we shall not die,
t.203: (The dwellers of Paradise will say) "Are we then not to die (any more)?
t.54: کیا (یہ صحیح ہے) کہ ہم مرنے والے ہی نہیں؟

t.149: except for our first death? And are we never to be punished?”
t.84: beyond our first death, nor are we going to be punished?”
t.85: Shall we never suffer?
t.95: except for our first death? And shall we suffer no chastisement?'”
t.19: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?
t.22: "Except our first death, and that we shall not be punished?"
t.203: Except our first death, and we shall not be punished? (after we have entered Paradise)."
t.54: بجز پہلی ایک موت کے، اور نہ ہم عذاب کیے جانے والے ہیں.

t.149: It is most surely this which is the great triumph.
t.84: This is, indeed, the great achievement.
t.85: This truly is the supreme triumph!’
t.95: Surely this is the supreme triumph.
t.19: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.
t.22: Verily this is the supreme achievement!
t.203: Truly, this is the supreme success!
t.54: پھر تو (ﻇاہر بات ہے کہ) یہ بڑی کامیابی ہے.

t.149: For the like of this let the workers work.
t.84: For this kind (of achievement), all workers must work.
t.85: Everyone should strive to attain this.
t.95: For the like of it should the workers work.
t.19: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.
t.22: For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.
t.203: For the like of this let the workers work.
t.54: ایسی (کامیابی) کے لئے عمل کرنے والوں کو عمل کرنا چاہئے.

t.149: Is this a better hospitality or the Tree of Zaqqum?
t.84: Is that (blissful Paradise) better for hospitality or the tree of zaqqūm ?
t.85: Is this the better welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum,
t.95: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of al-Zaqqum?
t.19: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?
t.22: Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?
t.203: Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqûm (a horrible tree in Hell)?
t.54: کیا یہ مہمانی اچھی ہے یا سینڈھ (زقوم) کا درخت؟

t.149: Indeed, We have made it a means of trial for the unjust.
t.84: We have made it a test for the unjust.
t.85: which we have made a test for the evildoers?
t.95: We have made this tree a trial for the wrong-doers.
t.19: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.
t.22: For We have truly made it (as) a trial for the wrong-doers.
t.203: Truly We have made it (as) a trail for the Zâlimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, wrong-doers).
t.54: جسے ہم نے ﻇالموں کے لئے سخت آزمائش بنا رکھا ہے.

t.149: Indeed, it is a tree that comes out from the very origin of purgatory.
t.84: It is a tree that comes forth in the bottom of Jahannam.
t.85: This tree grows in the heart of the blazing Fire,
t.95: It is a tree that grows in the nethermost part of Hell.
t.19: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.
t.22: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-Fire:
t.203: Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire,
t.54: بے شک وه درخت جہنم کی جڑ میں سے نکلتا ہے.

t.149: Its yield is as if it were devils’ heads.
t.84: Its fruits are like the heads of devils.
t.85: and its fruits are like devils’ heads.
t.95: Its spathes are like the heads of satans.
t.19: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils
t.22: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of devils:
t.203: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of Shayâtîn (devils);
t.54: جس کے خوشے شیطانوں کے سروں جیسے ہوتے ہیں.

t.149: So they are sure to eat from it and fill their bellies with it.
t.84: So, they have to eat from it and have to fill their bellies with it.
t.85: They will fill their bellies eating from it;
t.95: (The people of Hell) will surely eat of it, filling their bellies with it.
t.19: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.
t.22: Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
t.203: Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
t.54: (جہنمی) اسی درخت سے کھائیں گے اور اسی سے پیٹ بھریں گے.

t.149: Then, on top of it, they will have a brew of scalding water.
t.84: Then they will have, on top of it, a mixture made of boiling water.
t.85: then drink scalding water on top of it;
t.95: Then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water.
t.19: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
t.22: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture made of boiling water.
t.203: Then on the top of that they will be given boiling water to drink so that it becomes a mixture (of boiling water and Zaqqûm in their bellies).
t.54: پھر اس پر گرم جلتے جلتے پانی کی ملونی ہوگی.

t.149: Then their return is sure to be to purgatory.
t.84: Then, their final return is to the Fire.
t.85: then return to the blazing Fire.
t.95: Then their return will be to the same blazing Hell.
t.19: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.
t.22: Then shall their return be to the (Blazing) Fire.
t.203: Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell.
t.54: پھر ان سب کا لوٹنا جہنم کی (آگ کے ڈھیرکی) طرف ہوگا.

t.149: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray,
t.84: They found their fathers on the wrong path.
t.85: They found their forefathers astray,
t.95: These are the ones who found their fathers steeped in error,
t.19: They indeed found their fathers astray,
t.22: Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;
t.203: Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path;
t.54: یقین مانو! کہ انہوں نے اپنے باپ دادا کو بہکا ہوا پایا.

t.149: so they rush along in their footsteps.
t.84: So, they used to run in their footsteps.
t.85: and rushed to follow in their footsteps- before the disbelievers [of Mecca],
t.95: and they are running in their footsteps.
t.19: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.
t.22: So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!
t.203: So they (too) hastened in their footsteps!
t.54: اور یہ انہی کے نشان قدم پر دوڑتے رہے.

t.149: And certainly, most of the ancients before them went astray.
t.84: Most of the earlier ones (too) had gone astray before them.
t.85: most men in the past went astray,
t.95: Before them a multitude of people of olden times had erred,
t.19: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,
t.22: And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-
t.203: And indeed most of the men of old went astray before them;
t.54: ان سے پہلے بھی بہت سے اگلے بہک چکے ہیں.

t.149: And certainly, We sent among them forewarners.
t.84: We did send warners among them.
t.85: even though We sent messengers to warn them.
t.95: and We had sent among them Messengers to warn them.
t.19: And verily We sent among them warners.
t.22: But We sent aforetime, among them, (messengers) to admonish them;-
t.203: And indeed We sent among them warners (Messengers);
t.54: جن میں ہم نے ڈرانے والے (رسول) بھیجے تھے.

t.149: So lookat what the outcome was for those who were warned,
t.84: So look, how was the end of those warned -
t.85: See how those who were warned met their end!
t.95: Observe, then, what was the end of those that had been warned,
t.19: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,
t.22: Then see what was the end of those who were admonished (but heeded not),-
t.203: Then see what was the end of those who were warned (but heeded not).
t.54: اب تو دیکھ لے کہ جنہیں دھمکایا گیا تھا ان کا انجام کیسا کچھ ہوا.

t.149: except for Allah’s sincere chosen servants.
t.84: except Allah’s chosen servants.
t.85: Not so the true servants of God.
t.95: except for the chosen servants of Allah?
t.19: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
t.22: Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah.
t.203: Except the chosen slaves of Allâh (faithful, obedient, and true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: سوائے اللہ کے برگزیده بندوں کے.

t.149: And certainly, Noah called out to Us, so the very excellent of responders are We!
t.84: And NūH did call Us (for help after he was disappointed with his people), so (We accepted his prayer, as) We are the best to respond.
t.85: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response!
t.95: Noah had called upon Us (earlier). See, how excellent We were in answering him!
t.19: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
t.22: (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, and We are the best to hear prayer.
t.203: And indeed Nûh (Noah) invoked Us, and We are the Best of those who answer (the request).
t.54: اور ہمیں نوح (علیہ السلام) نے پکارا تو (دیکھ لو) ہم کیسے اچھے دعا قبول کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: Thus We delivered him and his family from the great calamity,
t.84: And We delivered him and his family from the great agony,
t.85: We saved him and his people from great distress,
t.95: We delivered him and his household from the great calamity;
t.19: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,
t.22: And We delivered him and his people from the Great Calamity,
t.203: And We rescued him and his family from the great distress (i.e. drowning),
t.54: ہم نے اسے اور اس کے گھر والوں کو اس زبردست مصیبت سے بچا لیا.

t.149: and We made his offspring the sole survivors,
t.84: and made his progeny the sole survivors (from the Deluge).
t.85: We let his offspring remain on the earth,
t.95: and made his offspring the only ones to survive,
t.19: And made his seed the survivors,
t.22: And made his progeny to endure (on this earth);
t.203: And, his progeny, them We made the survivors (i.e. Shem, Ham and Japheth).
t.54: اور اس کی اوﻻد کو ہم نے باقی رہنے والی بنا دی.

t.149: and We left him thus to be remembered among later generations.
t.84: And We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people, (that is):
t.85: We let him be praised by later generations:
t.95: and We established for him a good name among posterity.
t.19: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
t.22: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations to come in later times:
t.203: And left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations:
t.54: اور ہم نے اس کا (ذکر خیر) پچھلوں میں باقی رکھا.

t.149: Peace be upon Noah among(all creatures of) all realms.
t.84: Salām be on NūH among (the people of) all the worlds.
t.85: ‘Peace be upon Noah among all the nations!’
t.95: Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.
t.19: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!
t.22: "Peace and salutation to Noah among the nations!"
t.203: "Salâm (peace) be upon Nûh (Noah) (from Us) among the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)!"
t.54: نوح (علیہ السلام) پر تمام جہانوں میں سلام ہو

t.149: Indeed, thus do We repay those who excel in doing good.
t.84: Certainly, this is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.
t.85: This is how We reward those who do good:
t.95: Thus do We reward all those who do good.
t.19: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
t.22: Thus indeed do we reward those who do right.
t.203: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).
t.54: ہم نیکی کرنے والوں کو اسی طرح بدلہ دیتے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, he is one of Our believing servants.
t.84: He was one of Our believing servants.
t.85: he was truly one of Our faithful servants.
t.95: Surely he was one of Our truly believing servants.
t.19: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
t.22: For he was one of our believing Servants.
t.203: Verily, he [Nûh (Noah)] was one of Our believing slaves.
t.54: وه ہمارے ایمان والے بندوں میں سے تھا.

t.149: Then We drowned the others.
t.84: Then, we drowned others.
t.85: We drowned the rest.
t.95: Thereafter We caused the others to be drowned.
t.19: Then We did drown the others.
t.22: Then the rest we overwhelmed in the Flood.
t.203: Then We drowned the others (disbelievers and polytheists).
t.54: پھر ہم نے دوسروں کو ڈبو دیا.

t.149: And, indeed, of his kind is Abraham.
t.84: And certainly one of his adherents was Ibrāhīm.
t.85: Abraham was of the same faith:
t.95: Abraham was on the self-same way (as Noah).
t.19: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
t.22: Verily among those who followed his Way was Abraham.
t.203: And, verily, among those who followed his [Nûh’s (Noah)] way (Islâmic Monotheism) was Ibrâhîm (Abraham).
t.54: اور اس (نوح علیہ السلام کی) تابعداری کرنے والوں میں سے (ہی) ابراہیم (علیہ السلام بھی) تھے.

t.149: Recall when he came to his Lord with a sound heart.
t.84: (Remember) when he came to his Lord with a pure heart,
t.85: he came to his Lord with a devoted heart.
t.95: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart,
t.19: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;
t.22: Behold! he approached his Lord with a sound heart.
t.203: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart [attached to Allâh Alone and none else, worshipping none but Allâh Alone - true Islâmic Monotheism, pure from the filth of polytheism].
t.54: جبکہ اپنے رب کے پاس بے عیب دل ﻻئے.

t.149: He said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?
t.84: when he said to his father and his people, “What is that which you worship?
t.85: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are you worshipping?
t.95: and said to his father and his people: “Whom do you worship?
t.19: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?
t.22: Behold! he said to his father and to his people, "What is that which ye worship?
t.203: When he said to his father and to his people: "What is it that which you worship?
t.54: انہوں نے اپنے باپ اور اپنی قوم سے کہا کہ تم کیا پوج رہے ہو؟

t.149: Is it false gods, instead of Allah, that youwant?
t.84: Do you wish (to have) fallacious gods other than Allah?
t.85: How can you choose false gods instead of the true God?
t.95: Is it false deities that you want to serve rather than Allah?
t.19: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?
t.22: "Is it a falsehood- gods other than Allah- that ye desire?
t.203: "Is it a falsehood - âlihah (gods) other than Allâh - that you desire?
t.54: کیا تم اللہ کے سوا گھڑے ہوئے معبود چاہتے ہو؟

t.149: So what is youropinion about the Lord of all realms?”
t.84: Then, what do you think about the Lord of the worlds?”
t.85: So what is your opinion about the Lord of all the Worlds?’
t.95: What do you think of the Lord of the whole Universe?”
t.19: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?
t.22: "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"
t.203: "Then what think you about the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists)?"
t.54: تو یہ (بتلاؤ کہ) تم نے رب العالمین کو کیا سمجھ رکھا ہے؟

t.149: Then he took one look at the stars
t.84: Then, he cast a look at the stars,
t.85: then he looked up to the stars.
t.95: Then he looked carefully at the stars
t.19: And he glanced a glance at the stars
t.22: Then did he cast a glance at the Stars.
t.203: Then he cast a glance at the stars,
t.54: اب ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) نے ایک نگاه ستاروں کی طرف اٹھائی.

t.149: and said, “I am sick.”
t.84: and then said, “I feel indisposed”
t.85: He said, ‘I am sick,’
t.95: and said: “I am sick.”
t.19: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
t.22: And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"
t.203: And he said: "Verily, I am sick (with plague). [He did this trick to remain in their temple of idols to destroy them and not to accompany them to the pagan feast)]."
t.54: اور کہا میں تو بیمار ہوں.

t.149: So they turned away from him, fleeing,
t.84: So they went away from him, turning their backs.
t.85: so [his people] turned away from him and left.
t.95: So turning their backs, they went away from him.
t.19: And they turned their backs and went away from him.
t.22: So they turned away from him, and departed.
t.203: So they turned away from him, and departed (for fear of the disease).
t.54: اس پر وه سب اس سے منھ موڑے ہوئے واپس چلے گئے.

t.149: whereupon he turned to their gods and said, “Will younot eat?
t.84: And he made his way to their ‘gods’ and said to them, “Why would you not eat?
t.85: He turned to their gods and said, ‘Do you not eat?
t.95: Then he went quietly to the (temple of the deities) and said: “What is the matter with you, why do you not eat?
t.19: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?
t.22: Then did he turn to their gods and said, "will ye not eat (of the offerings before you)?...
t.203: Then he turned to their âlihah (gods) and said: "Will you not eat (of the offering before you)?
t.54: آپ (چﭗ چپاتے) ان کے معبودوں کے پاس گئے اور فرمانے لگے تم کھاتے کیوں نہیں؟

t.149: What is it with you? Do you not speak?”
t.84: What is wrong with you that you do not speak?”
t.85: Why do you not speak?’
t.95: What is the matter with you, why do you not speak?”
t.19: What aileth you that ye speak not?
t.22: "What is the matter with you that ye speak not (intelligently)?"
t.203: "What is the matter with you that you speak not?"
t.54: تمہیں کیا ہو گیا کہ بات تک نہیں کرتے ہو.

t.149: Then he turned on them, striking with his right hand.
t.84: Then he attacked them striking with his right hand.
t.85: then he turned and struck them with his right arm.
t.95: Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand,
t.19: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.
t.22: Then did he turn upon them, striking (them) with the right hand.
t.203: Then he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand.
t.54: پھر تو (پوری قوت کے ساتھ) دائیں ہاتھ سے انہیں مارنے پر پل پڑے.

t.149: So they came towards him, dashing .
t.84: Then, they (the idolaters) came to him rushing.
t.85: His people hurried towards him,
t.95: whereupon people came to him running.
t.19: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
t.22: Then came (the worshippers) with hurried steps, and faced (him).
t.203: Then they (the worshippers of idols) came, towards him, hastening.
t.54: وه (بت پرست) دوڑے بھاگے آپ کی طرف متوجہ ہوئے.

t.149: He said, “Do you worship what you carve,
t.84: He said, “Do you worship what is carved by yourselves,
t.85: but he said, ‘How can you worship things you carve with your own hands,
t.95: Abraham said to them: “Do you worship what you yourselves have carved with your own hands
t.19: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
t.22: He said: "Worship ye that which ye have (yourselves) carved?
t.203: He said: "Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve?
t.54: تو آپ نے فرمایا تم انہیں پوجتے ہو جنہیں (خود) تم تراشتے ہو.

t.149: when Allah has created youand all that you do?”
t.84: while Allah has created you and what you make?”
t.85: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?’
t.95: while it is Allah Who has created you and all that you make?”
t.19: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?
t.22: "But Allah has created you and your handwork!"
t.203: "While Allâh has created you and what you make!"
t.54: حاﻻنکہ تمہیں اور تمہاری بنائی ہوئی چیزوں کو اللہ ہی نے پیدا کیا ہے.

t.149: They said, “Build a structure for him and throw him into purgatory.”
t.84: They said, “Build for him a structure, and throw him into the blazing fire.”
t.85: They said, ‘Build a pyre and throw him into the blazing fire.’
t.95: They spoke among themselves: “Build him a pyre and then throw him into the furnace.”
t.19: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
t.22: They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"
t.203: They said: "Build for him a building (it is said that the building was like a furnace) and throw him into the blazing fire!"
t.54: وه کہنے لگے اس کے لئے ایک مکان بناؤ اور اس (دہکتی ہوئی) آگ میں اسے ڈال دو.

t.149: So they desired to plot against him, but We made them the lowest.
t.84: So, they intended to bring harm to him, but We made them the lowest (by frustrating their plan).
t.85: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them.
t.95: They had contrived an evil plan against him, but We abased them all.
t.19: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.
t.22: (This failing), they then sought a stratagem against him, but We made them the ones most humiliated!
t.203: So they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest.
t.54: انہوں نے تو اس (ابراہیم علیہ السلام) کے ساتھ مکر کرنا چاہا لیکن ہم نے انہی کو نیچا کر دیا.

t.149: And then he said, “I am going to my Lord—He will guide me.”
t.84: And he said, “I am going to my Lord. He will show me the way.
t.85: He said, ‘I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me.
t.95: Abraham said: “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.
t.19: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.
t.22: He said: "I will go to my Lord! He will surely guide me!
t.203: And he said (after his rescue from the fire): "Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!"
t.54: اور اس (ابراہیم علیہ السلام) نے کہا میں تو ہجرت کر کے اپنے پروردگار کی طرف جانے واﻻ ہوں۔ وه ضرور میری رہنمائی کرے گا.

t.149: “My Lord, give me one of the righteous.”
t.84: O my Lord, bless me with a righteous son.”
t.85: Lord, grant me a righteous son,’
t.95: Lord, grant me a righteous son.”
t.19: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.
t.22: "O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!"
t.203: "My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous."
t.54: اے میرے رب! مجھے نیک بخت اوﻻد عطا فرما.

t.149: So We gave him glad tidings of a forbearing boy.
t.84: So, We gave him the good news of a forbearing boy.
t.85: so We gave him the good news that he would have a patient son.
t.95: (In response to this prayer) We gave him the good news of a prudent boy;
t.19: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.
t.22: So We gave him the good news of a boy ready to suffer and forbear.

t.22: When he ran away (like a slave from captivity) to the ship (fully) laden,
t.203: When he ran to the laden ship:
t.54: جب بھاگ کر پہنچے بھری کشتی پر.

t.149: and he drew lots and was of those who lost.
t.84: Then he participated in drawing lots (to offload one of the passengers) and was the one who was defeated.
t.85: They cast lots, he suffered defeat,
t.95: cast lots, and was among the losers.
t.19: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;
t.22: He (agreed to) cast lots, and he was condemned:
t.203: Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers.
t.54: پھر قرعہ اندازی ہوئی تو یہ مغلوب ہوگئے.

t.149: Then the whale took him into its mouth, and he was to blame.
t.84: Then the fish swallowed him while he was reproaching his own self.
t.85: and a great fish swallowed him, for he had committed blameworthy acts.
t.95: Then a fish swallowed him, and he was blameworthy.
t.19: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;
t.22: Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.
t.203: Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame.
t.54: تو پھر انہیں مچھلی نے نگل لیا اور وه خود اپنے آپ کو ملامت کرنے لگ گئے.

t.149: And had he not been one of those who highly exalt God,
t.84: Had he not been of those who proclaim Allah’s purity,
t.85: If he had not been one of those who glorified God,
t.95: Had he not been one of those who glorify Allah,
t.19: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)
t.22: Had it not been that he (repented and) glorified Allah,
t.203: Had he not been of them who glorify Allâh,
t.54: پس اگر یہ پاکی بیان کرنے والوں میں سے نہ ہوتے.

t.149: he would have stayed in its belly until the day they are resurrected.
t.84: he would have definitely lived in its belly till the day when the dead will be raised.
t.85: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day when all are raised up,
t.95: he would certainly have remained in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.
t.19: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;
t.22: He would certainly have remained inside the Fish till the Day of Resurrection.
t.203: He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection.
t.54: تو لوگوں کے اٹھائے جانے کے دن تک اس کے پیٹ میں ہی رہتے.

t.149: Then We threw him into the wilderness while he was sick,
t.84: Then We cast him ashore in the open while he was ill,
t.85: but We cast him out, sick, on to a barren shore,
t.95: But We threw him on a wide bare tract of land while he was ill;
t.19: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;
t.22: But We cast him forth on the naked shore in a state of sickness,
t.203: But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,
t.54: پس انہیں ہم نے چٹیل میدان میں ڈال دیا اور وه اس وقت بیمار تھے.

t.149: and We germinated a gourd tree over him.
t.84: and We caused a tree of ourds to grow over him.
t.85: and made a gourd tree grow above him.
t.95: and caused a gourd tree to grow over him,
t.19: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;
t.22: And We caused to grow, over him, a spreading plant of the gourd kind.
t.203: And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him.
t.54: اور ان پر سایہ کرنے واﻻ ایک بیل دار درخت ہم نے اگا دیا.

t.149: Then We sent him to a hundred thousand or more.
t.84: And We had sent him (as messenger) to one hundred thousand, or more.
t.85: We sent him to a hundred thousand people or more.
t.95: and We sent him forth to a nation of a hundred thousand or more,
t.19: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more
t.22: And We sent him (on a mission) to a hundred thousand (men) or more.
t.203: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more.
t.54: اور ہم نے انہیں ایک لاکھ بلکہ اور زیاده آدمیوں کی طرف بھیجا.

t.149: And they attained faith, so We gave them enjoyment for some time.
t.84: So, they believed, then, We let them enjoy for a time.
t.85: They believed, so We let them live out their lives.
t.95: and they believed. So We let them enjoy life for a while.
t.19: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.
t.22: And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.
t.203: And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.
t.54: پس وه ایمان ﻻئے، اور ہم نے انہیں ایک زمانہ تک عیش وعشرت دی.

t.149: So inquireof them, “Are the daughters for yourLord while for them are the sons?”
t.84: So ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?”
t.85: Now [Muhammad], ask the disbelievers: is it true that your Lord has daughters, while they choose sons for themselves?
t.95: So ask their opinion: “(Are you convinced) that your Lord should have daughters and you should have sons?
t.19: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?
t.22: Now ask them their opinion: Is it that thy Lord has (only) daughters, and they have sons?-
t.203: Now ask them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them?"
t.54: ان سے دریافت کیجئے! کہ کیا آپ کے رب کی تو بیٹیاں ہیں اور ان کے بیٹے ہیں؟

t.149: Or did We create the angels as females while they witnessed?”
t.84: Or, had We created angels as females while they were witnessing?
t.85: Did We create the angels as females while they were watching?
t.95: Did We create the angels as females the while they witnessed?”
t.19: Or created We the angels females while they were present?
t.22: Or that We created the angels female, and they are witnesses (thereto)?
t.203: Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses?
t.54: یا یہ اس وقت موجود تھے جبکہ ہم نے فرشتوں کو مؤنﺚ پیدا کیا.

t.149: Undoubtedly, it is out of their utter falsehood that they do indeed say,
t.84: Beware! They are the ones who, by way of a lie of theirs, (have the audacity to) say,
t.85: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say,
t.95: Behold, it is one of their fabrications that they say:
t.19: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:
t.22: Is it not that they say, from their own invention,
t.203: Verily, it is of their falsehood that they (Quraish pagans) say:
t.54: آگاه رہو! کہ یہ لوگ صرف اپنی افترا پردازی سے کہہ رہے ہیں.

t.149: “Allah has begotten.” But they are most surely liars.
t.84: “Allah has children” - and they are absolute liars.
t.85: ‘God has begotten.’ How they lie!
t.95: “Allah has begotten.” They are liars!
t.19: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.
t.22: "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!
t.203: "Allâh has begotten [offspring - the angels being the daughters of Allâh)?" And, verily, they are liars!
t.54: کہ اللہ تعالی کی اوﻻد ہے۔ یقیناً یہ محض جھوٹے ہیں.

t.149: Has He selected daughters over sons?
t.84: Is it that Allah has chosen daughters (for Himself) instead of sons?
t.85: Did He truly choose daughters in preference to sons?
t.95: Did He choose daughters rather than sons?
t.19: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.
t.22: Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?
t.203: Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons?
t.54: کیا اللہ تعالی نے اپنے لیے بیٹیوں کو بیٹوں پر ترجیح دی.

t.149: What is it with you? How do you judge?
t.84: What is the matter with you? How (arbitrarily) do you judge?
t.85: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgements?
t.95: What is the matter with you that you make such strange judgements?
t.19: What aileth you? How judge ye?
t.22: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
t.203: What is the matter with you? How do you decide?
t.54: تمہیں کیا ہو گیا ہے کیسے حکم لگاتے پھرتے ہو؟

t.149: Will you not remind yourselves?
t.84: Then, is it that you do not think about it?
t.85: Do you not reflect?
t.95: Will you then not take heed?
t.19: Will ye not then reflect?
t.22: Will ye not then receive admonition?
t.203: Will you not then remember?
t.54: کیا تم اس قدر بھی نہیں سمجھتے؟

t.149: Or do youhave an evident manifestation?
t.84: Or, is it that there is some open authority with you?
t.85: Do you perhaps have clear authority?
t.95: Do you have any clear authority for such claims?
t.19: Or have ye a clear warrant?
t.22: Or have ye an authority manifest?
t.203: Or is there for you a plain authority?
t.54: یا تمہارے پاس اس کی کوئی صاف دلیل ہے.

t.149: Then bring yourscripture, if you have been truthful.
t.84: Then bring your book, if you are truthful.
t.85: Bring your scriptures, if you are telling the truth.
t.95: Bring your Book, if you are truthful.
t.19: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.
t.22: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!
t.203: Then bring your Book if you are truthful!
t.54: تو جاؤ اگر سچے ہو تو اپنی ہی کتاب لے آؤ.

t.149: And they invented a relationship between Him and(the race of) unseen beings. And certainly,(the race of) unseen beings knew that they(who made the claims) would surely be arraigned—
t.84: And they have made up between Him (Allah) and the Jinns some kinship, while the Jinns already know that they are bound to be seized.-
t.85: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be brought before Him.
t.95: They have established a kinship between Allah and the angels; and the angels know well that these people will be arraigned (as culprits).
t.19: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).
t.22: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!
t.203: And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinn, but the jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be called to account).
t.54: اور ان لوگوں نے تو اللہ کے اور جنات کے درمیان بھی قرابت داری ٹھہرائی ہے، اور حاﻻنکہ خود جنات کو معلوم ہے کہ وه (اس عقیده کے لوگ عذاب کے سامنے) پیش کیے جائیں گے.

t.149: Highly Exalted is Allah far above what they describe—
t.84: -Pure is Allah from what they describe-
t.85: God is far above what they attribute to Him-
t.95: (They say): “Exalted be Allah above what they attribute to Him,
t.19: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),
t.22: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!
t.203: Glorified be Allâh! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!
t.54: جو کچھ یہ (اللہ کے بارے میں) بیان کر رہے ہیں اس سے اللہ تعالیٰ بالکل پاک ہے.

t.149: except for Allah’s sincere chosen servants.
t.84: except Allah’s chosen servants.
t.85: the true servants of God do not do such things-
t.95: all of them except the chosen servants of Allah.
t.19: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
t.22: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.
t.203: Except the slaves of Allâh, whom He chooses (for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islâmic Monotheism who do not attribute false things unto Allâh).
t.54: سوائے! اللہ کے مخلص بندوں کے.

t.149: Thus surely, youand what you worship
t.84: So, you and those whom you worship,
t.85: and neither you nor what you worship
t.95: So you and your deities
t.19: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,
t.22: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-
t.203: So, verily you (pagans) and those whom you worship (idols)
t.54: یقین مانو کہ تم سب اور تمہارے معبودان (باطل).

t.149: can never seduce(anyone) away from Him,
t.84: none of you can make anyone turn away from Him (Allah),
t.85: can lure away from God any
t.95: shall not be able to tempt anyone away from Allah
t.19: Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.
t.22: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,
t.203: Cannot lead astray [turn away from Him (Allâh) anyone of the believers],
t.54: کسی ایک کو بھی بہکا نہیں سکتے.

t.149: except for one who is to roast in purgatory.
t.84: except him who is to burn in Jahannam.
t.85: except those who will burn in Hell.
t.95: except him who shall roast in the Blazing Fire.
t.19: Save him who is to burn in hell.
t.22: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!
t.203: Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!
t.54: بجز اس کے جو جہنمی ہی ہے.

t.149: “And there is not one of usbut has an assigned position.
t.84: And (the angels say,) “There is no one among us who does not have a known station,
t.85: [The angels say], ‘Every single one of us has his appointed place:
t.95: As for us, there is none but has an appointed station.
t.19: There is not one of us but hath his known position.
t.22: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;
t.203: And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place (or position);
t.54: (فرشتوں کا قول ہے کہ) ہم میں سے تو ہر ایک کی جگہ مقرر ہے.

t.149: And we are indeed the aligned.
t.84: and We, surely We, are those who stand in rows
t.85: we are ranged in ranks.
t.95: Verily we range ourselves in rows (as humble servants)
t.19: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,
t.22: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);
t.203: And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows (for the prayers as you Muslims stand in rows for your prayers);
t.54: اور ہم تو (بندگیٴ الٰہی میں) صف بستہ کھڑے ہیں.

t.149: And we are indeed those who exalt God.”
t.84: and We, surely We, are those who proclaim Allah’s purity.”
t.85: We glorify God.’
t.95: and we are of those who glorify Allah.”
t.19: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
t.22: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"
t.203: And verily, we (angels), indeed are those who glorify (Allâh’s Praises i.e. perform prayers).
t.54: اور اس کی تسبیح بیان کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: Even though theyused to say,
t.84: And they (the pagans) used to say,
t.85: [The disbelievers] used to say,
t.95: They used to say before:
t.19: And indeed they used to say:
t.22: And there were those who said,
t.203: And indeed they (Arab pagans) used to say:
t.54: کفار تو کہا کرتے تھے.

t.149: “Had we received a Reminder from the ancients,
t.84: “Had there been a scripture with us like that of the former people,
t.85: ‘If only we had a scripture like previous people,
t.95: “If only we had the Reminder which had been granted to the people of yore
t.19: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
t.22: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,
t.203: "If we had a reminder as had the men of old (before the coming of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم as a Messenger of Allâh),
t.54: کہ اگر ہمارے سامنے اگلے لوگوں کا ذکر ہوتا.

t.149: we would have been Allah’s sincere chosen servants.”
t.84: we would have certainly been Allah’s chosen servants.”
t.85: we would be true servants of God,’
t.95: we would surely have been Allah's chosen servants.”
t.19: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.
t.22: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"
t.203: "We would have indeed been the chosen slaves of Allâh (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)!"
t.54: تو ہم بھی اللہ کے چیده بندے بن جاتے.

t.149: But they denied it, so they will find out.
t.84: Then (once the divine book came to them,) they disbelieved in it. So, very soon they will come to know.
t.85: yet now they reject [the Quran]. They will soon realize.
t.95: But when it came to them, they rejected it. They shall soon come to know (the end of such an attitude).
t.19: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.
t.22: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!
t.203: But (now that the Qur’ân has come) they disbelieve therein (i.e. in the Qur’ân and in Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , and all that he brought, - the Divine Revelation), so they will come to know!
t.54: لیکن پھر اس قرآن کے ساتھ کفر کر گئے، پس اب عنقریب جان لیں گے.

t.149: And most surely Our Word has already gone out to our servant emissaries:
t.84: And Our Word has already come to pass in favor of Our servants, the messengers
t.85: Our word has already been given to Our servants the messengers:
t.95: We have already given Our promise to Our Messengers
t.19: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
t.22: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),
t.203: And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our slaves, the Messengers,
t.54: اور البتہ ہمارا وعده پہلے ہی اپنے رسولوں کے لئے صادر ہو چکا ہے.

t.149: indeed, it is they who shall surely be supported,
t.84: (that) they are the ones who will be supported,
t.85: it is they who will be helped,
t.95: that they shall certainly be succoured,
t.19: That they verily would be helped,
t.22: That they would certainly be assisted,
t.203: That they verily would be made triumphant,
t.54: کہ یقیناً وه ہی مدد کیے جائیں گے.

t.149: and indeed it is Our soldiers who shall surely be the overcomers.
t.84: and verily it is Our army (of chosen servants) that prevails.
t.85: and the ones who support Our cause will be the winners.
t.95: and that Our hosts shall triumph.
t.19: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.
t.22: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.
t.203: And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors.
t.54: اور ہمارا ہی لشکر غالب (اور برتر) رہے گا.

t.149: So turnaway from them for some time,
t.84: So, withdraw your attention from them for some time.
t.85: So [Prophet] turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
t.95: So, (O Prophet), leave them alone for a while,
t.19: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,
t.22: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
t.203: So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them for a while,
t.54: اب آپ کچھ دنوں تک ان سے منھ پھیر لیجئے.

t.149: and watch them—for they will soon see.
t.84: But, watch them. They shall soon see (the reality).
t.85: Watch them: they will soon see.
t.95: and see, and soon they too shall see.
t.19: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
t.22: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
t.203: And watch them and they shall see (the punishment)!
t.54: اور انہیں دیکھتے رہیئے، اور یہ بھی آگے چل کر دیکھ لیں گے.

t.149: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
t.84: Are they asking for Our punishment to come sooner?
t.85: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment?
t.95: Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?
t.19: Would they hasten on Our doom?
t.22: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?
t.203: Do they seek to hasten on Our Torment?
t.54: کیا یہ ہمارے عذاب کی جلدی مچا رہے ہیں؟

t.149: Yet, when it descends into their courtyard, miserable shall be the morning of those forewarned.
t.84: So, when it will descend in their courtyard, then, evil will be the morning of those warned.
t.85: When it descends on their courtyards, how ter-rible that morning will be for those who were warned!
t.95: When that chastisement will descend upon their courtyard, evil shall that Day be for those who had been warned.
t.19: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.
t.22: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!
t.203: Then, when it descends in their courtyard (i.e. near to them), evil will be the morning for those who had been warned!
t.54: سنو! جب ہمارا عذاب ان کے میدان میں اتر آئے گا اس وقت ان کی جن کو متنبہ کر دیا گیا تھا بڑی بری صبح ہوگی.

t.149: And turnaway from them for a while,
t.84: So, withdraw your attention from them for some time,
t.85: [Prophet], turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
t.95: Leave them alone for a while,
t.19: Withdraw from them awhile
t.22: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
t.203: So turn (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) away from them for a while,
t.54: آپ کچھ وقت تک ان کا خیال چھوڑ دیجئے.

t.149: and watch—they will soon see.
t.84: and watch. They shall soon see (the reality).
t.85: Watch them: they will soon see.
t.95: and see; and they too shall soon see.
t.19: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
t.22: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
t.203: And watch and they shall see (the torment)!
t.54: اور دیکھتے رہئیے یہ بھی ابھی ابھی دیکھ لیں گے.

t.149: Highly Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of Might, far above what they describe.
t.84: Pure is your Lord, the Lord of all might and honor, from what they describe
t.85: Your Lord, the Lord of Glory, is far above what they attribute to Him.
t.95: Exalted be your Lord, the Lord of Glory, above what they attribute to Him,
t.19: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
t.22: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!
t.203: Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!
t.54: پاک ہے آپ کا رب جو بہت بڑی عزت واﻻ ہے ہر اس چیز سے (جو مشرک) بیان کرتے ہیں.
