t.149: And peace be upon the emissaries.
t.84: and Salām be on the messengers
t.85: Peace be upon the messengers
t.95: and peace be upon the Messengers,
t.19: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
t.22: And Peace on the messengers!
t.203: And peace be on the Messengers!
t.54: پیغمبروں پر سلام ہے.

t.149: And all praise be to Allah, Lord of all realms.
t.84: and praised is Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.
t.85: and praise be to God the Lord of all the Worlds.
t.95: and all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe.
t.19: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
t.22: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.
t.203: And all the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: اور سب طرح کی تعریف اللہ کے لئے ہے جو سارے جہان کا رب ہے.

t.149: Sād. By the Recitalcontaining the Reminder.
t.84: Sād . I swear by the Qur’ān, (the book) containing advice, (this is true,)
t.85: Sad By the Quran with its reminding . . .!
t.95: Sad, and by the Qur'an full of exhortation!
t.19: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,
t.22: Sad: By the Qur'an, Full of Admonition: (This is the Truth).
t.203: Sâd. [These letters (Sâd etc.) are one of the miracles of the Quran and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the Quran full of reminding.
t.54: ص! اس نصیحت والے قرآن کی قسم.

t.149: Yet those who denied are in a state of mightand opposition.
t.84: but those who disbelieve are (involved) in false pride and opposition.
t.85: Yet the disbelievers are steeped in arrogance and hostility.
t.95: Nay, but the unbelievers are steeped in arrogance and stubborn defiance.
t.19: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.
t.22: But the Unbelievers (are steeped) in self-glory and Separatism.
t.203: Nay, those who disbelieve are in false pride and opposition.
t.54: بلکہ کفار غرور ومخالفت میں پڑے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: How many generations have We caused to perish before them, so they called out when it was too late to escape!
t.84: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, so they cried out (for mercy), while no time was left for having any refuge.
t.85: How many generations We have destroyed before them! They all cried out, once it was too late, for escape.
t.95: How many a nation did We destroy before them! (When they approached their doom) they cried out (for deliverance), but the time for deliverance was already past.
t.19: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!
t.22: How many generations before them did We destroy? In the end they cried (for mercy)- when there was no longer time for being saved!
t.203: How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape.
t.54: ہم نے ان سے پہلے بھی بہت سی امتوں کو تباه کر ڈاﻻ انہوں نے ہر چند چیﺦ وپکار کی لیکن وه وقت چھٹکارے کا نہ تھا.

t.149: And they marveled that a forewarner had come to them from among them, and the deniers said, “This is a sorcerer, a sheer liar.
t.84: They (the pagans) wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a sheer liar.
t.85: The disbelievers think it strange that a prophet of their own people has come to warn them: they say, ‘He is just a lying sorcerer.
t.95: They wondered that a warner had come to them from among themselves,and the deniers of the Truth said: “This is a sorcerer, and a big liar.
t.19: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.
t.22: So they wonder that a Warner has come to them from among themselves! and the Unbelievers say, "This is a sorcerer telling lies!
t.203: And they (Arab pagans) wonder that a warner (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a sorcerer, a liar.
t.54: اور کافروں کو اس بات پر تعجب ہوا کہ ان ہی میں سے ایک انہیں ڈرانے واﻻ آگیا اور کہنے لگے کہ یہ تو جادوگر اور جھوٹا ہے.

t.149: Did he make all the gods into one God? Surely this is indeed something strange.”
t.84: Has he (not) turned all the gods into a single God? It is a very strange thing indeed.”
t.85: How can he claim that all the gods are but one God? What an astonishing thing [to claim]!’
t.95: Has he made the gods one single God? This is truly astounding.”
t.19: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.
t.22: "Has he made the gods (all) into one Allah? Truly this is a wonderful thing!"
t.203: "Has he made the âlihah (gods) (all) into One Ilâh (God - Allâh). Verily, this is a curious thing!"
t.54: کیا اس نےاتنے سارے معبودوں کا ایک ہی معبود کر دیا واقعی یہ بہت ہی عجیب بات ہے.

t.149: And the chiefs among them proceeded,(saying) , “Walk away(from the Prophet) and hold fast to yourgods; indeed this is certainly something planned.
t.84: And the leaders among them walked out saying (to their followers), “Walk away (from the Prophet,) and stay firm on (adhering to) your gods. This (call of the Prophet) is surely something designed (for his personal benefit).
t.85: Their leaders depart, saying, ‘Walk away! Stay faithful to your gods! That is what you must do.
t.95: And the elders among them went forth saying: “Go ahead and be steadfast in adhering to your deities. What is being said is with a design.”
t.19: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.
t.22: And the leader among them go away (impatiently), (saying), "Walk ye away, and remain constant to your gods! For this is truly a thing designed (against you)!
t.203: And the leaders among them went about (saying): "Go on, and remain constant to your âlihah (gods)! Verily, this is a thing designed (against you)!
t.54: ان کے سردار یہ کہتے ہوئے چلے کہ چلو جی اور اپنے معبودوں پر جمے رہو، یقیناً اس بات میں تو کوئی غرض ہے.

t.149: Never have we heard of this in the former creed. This is nothing but an invention.
t.84: We never heard of it in the classical faith (of ours). This is nothing but a false invention.
t.85: We did not hear any such claim in the last religion: it is all an invention.
t.95: We have not heard this in the religious community close to our time. This is nothing but a fabrication.
t.19: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.
t.22: "We never heard (the like) of this among the people of these latter days: this is nothing but a made-up tale!"
t.203: "We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days (i.e. Christianity). This is nothing but an invention! [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]
t.54: ہم نے تو یہ بات پچھلے دین میں بھی نہیں سنی، کچھ نہیں یہ تو صرف گھڑنت ہے.

t.149: Was the Reminder sent down to him out of all of us?” Rather, they are doubtful about My Reminder; rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
t.84: Is it (believable) that the message of advice has been sent down to him (alone) from among all of us?” The fact is that they are in doubt about My message; rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
t.85: Was the message sent only to him out of all of us?’ In fact they doubt My warning; in fact they have not tasted My punishment yet.
t.95: Has this Exhortation been sent down among us only to him, to the exclusion of all others?” Nay, they are in doubt regarding My Exhortation, and are saying all this because they have not yet had any taste of My chastisement.
t.19: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.
t.22: "What! has the Message been sent to him - (Of all persons) among us?"... but they are in doubt concerning My (Own) Message! Nay, they have not yet tasted My Punishment!
t.203: "Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us?" Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder (this Qur’ân)! Nay, but they have not tasted (My) Torment!
t.54: کیا ہم سب میں سے اسی پر کلام الٰہی نازل کیا گیا ہے؟ دراصل یہ لوگ میری وحی کی طرف سے شک میں ہیں، بلکہ (صحیح یہ ہے کہ) انہوں نے اب تک میرا عذاب چکھا ہی نہیں.

t.149: Or do they possess the treasuries of yourLord’s mercy, the Almighty, the Giver?
t.84: Do they have the treasures of the mercy of your Lord, the Mighty, the Bountiful?
t.85: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord’s bounty, the Mighty, the All Giving?
t.95: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord, the Most Mighty, the Great Bestower?
t.19: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?
t.22: Or have they the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord,- the Exalted in Power, the Grantor of Bounties without measure?
t.203: Or have they the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Real Bestower?
t.54: یا کیا ان کے پاس تیرے زبردست فیاض رب کی رحمت کے خزانے ہیں.

t.149: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend by any means.
t.84: Or do they have the ownership of the heavens and the earth and what lies between them? Then let them ascend (to the sky) by ropes.
t.85: Do they control the heavens and earth and everything between? Let them climb their ropes:
t.95: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and of all that is in between them? If so, let them ascend the heights of the realm of causation and see!
t.19: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!
t.22: Or have they the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all between? If so, let them mount up with the ropes and means (to reach that end)!
t.203: Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? If so, let them ascend up with means (to the heavens)!
t.54: یا کیا آسمان وزمین اور ان کے درمیان کی ہر چیز کی بادشاہت ان ہی کی ہے، تو پھر یہ رسیاں تان کر چڑھ جائیں.

t.149: An army of confederates will be defeated there.
t.84: What is there (in Makkah) is just a host of the (opposing) groups that has to be defeated.
t.85: their armed alliance is weak and will be crushed.
t.95: This is only a small army out of the several armies that will suffer defeat here.
t.19: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.
t.22: But there - will be put to flight even a host of confederates.
t.203: (As they denied Allâh’s Message) they will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times (who were defeated).
t.54: یہ بھی (بڑے بڑے) لشکروں میں سے شکست پایا ہوا (چھوٹا سا) لشکر ہے.

t.149: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved, as did ʻĀd, and Pharaoh of the stakes,
t.84: Even before them, the people of NūH and ‘Ād and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), the man of stakes,
t.85: The people of Noah, Ad, and firmly-supported Pharaoh rejected their prophets before them.
t.95: Before them the people of Noah, Ad, and Pharaoh of the tent-pegs gave the lie (to the Messengers)
t.19: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,
t.22: Before them (were many who) rejected messengers,- the people of Noah, and 'Ad, and Pharaoh, the Lord of Stakes,
t.203: Before them (were many who) belied (Messengers) - the people of Nûh (Noah); and ‘Âd; and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) the man of stakes (with which he used to punish the people),
t.54: ان سے پہلے بھی قوم نوح اور عاد اور میخوں والے فرعون نے جھٹلایا تھا.

t.149: and Thamûdand the people of Lot and the fellows of the thicket. Those were the parties.
t.84: and Thamūd and the people of LūT and the people of Aaikah have rejected (the messengers). They were the (strong) groups.
t.85: Thamud, the people of Lot, and the Forest-Dwellers each formed opposition [against theirs].
t.95: and so did Thamud and the people of Lot and the people of Aykah. These were all leagued together.
t.19: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.
t.22: And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Companions of the Wood; - such were the Confederates.
t.203: And Thamûd, and the people of Lût (Lot), and the Dwellers of the Wood: such were the Confederates.
t.54: اور ﺛمود نے اور قوم لوط نے اور ایکہ کے رہنے والوں نے بھی، یہی (بڑے) لشکر تھے.

t.149: None of them but disbelieved the messengers, so My punishment was deserved.
t.84: All of them did nothing but declare the messengers as liars; hence, My punishment became due.
t.85: They all rejected the mes-sengers and they were deservedly struck by My punishment:
t.95: Each of them gave the lie to Messengers and My decree of chastisement came upon them.
t.19: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,
t.22: Not one (of them) but rejected the messengers, but My punishment came justly and inevitably (on them).
t.203: Not one of them but belied the Messengers; therefore My Torment was justified,
t.54: ان میں سے ایک بھی ایسا نہ تھا جس نے رسولوں کی تکذیب نہ کی ہو پس میری سزا ان پر ﺛابت ہوگئی.

t.149: For these await nothing but a single shout, from which there is no recovery.
t.84: And these people are waiting for nothing but for a single Cry (the sound of the Trumpet to be blown on Doomsday) that will have no pause.
t.85: all the disbelievers here are waiting for is a single blast that cannot be postponed.
t.95: They are waiting for nothing except a single Cry, after which there will be no second Cry.
t.19: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.
t.22: These (today) only wait for a single mighty Blast, which (when it comes) will brook no delay.
t.203: And these only wait for a single Saihah [shout (i.e. the blowing of the Trumpet by the angel Isrâfil -)] there will be no pause or ending thereto [till everything will perish except Allâh (the only God full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour)].
t.54: انہیں صرف ایک چیﺦ کا انتظار ہے جس میں کوئی توقف (اور ڈھیل) نہیں ہے.

t.149: Yet they said, “Our Lord, hasten for us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning.”
t.84: And they say, “O our Lord, give us our share (of the punishment) sooner, before the Day of Reckoning.”
t.85: They say, ‘Our Lord! Advance us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning!’
t.95: They say: “Our Lord, hasten to us our share (of chastisement) before the Day of Reckoning.”
t.19: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.
t.22: They say: "Our Lord! hasten to us our sentence (even) before the Day of Account!"
t.203: They say: "Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittanâ (i.e. our Record of good and bad deeds so that we may see it) before the Day of Reckoning!"
t.54: اور انہوں نے کہا کہ اے ہمارے رب! ہماری سرنوشت تو ہمیں روز حساب سے پہلے ہی دے دے.

t.149: Endurepatiently what they say and remember Our servant David who was endowed with strong faith; indeed, he often turnsto Us.
t.84: Bear patiently with what they say, and remember Our servant Dawūd, the man of might. Surely he was ever-turning to Allah.
t.85: Bear their words patiently [Prophet]. Remember Our servant David, a man of strength who always turned to Us:
t.95: (O Prophet), bear with patience what they say, and call to mind Our servant David, who was endowed with great strength and who constantly turned (to Allah).
t.19: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
t.22: Have patience at what they say, and remember our servant David, the man of strength: for he ever turned (to Allah).
t.203: Be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of what they say, and remember Our slave Dâwûd (David), endued with power. Verily, he was ever oft-returning in all matters and in repentance (toward Allâh).
t.54: آپ ان کی باتوں پر صبر کریں اور ہمارے بندے داؤد (علیہ السلام) کو یاد کریں جو بڑی قوت واﻻ تھا، یقیناً وه بہت رجوع کرنے واﻻ تھا.

t.149: Indeed, We subjected the mountains to give due exaltations(to God) with him in the evening and at daybreak,
t.84: We had subjugated the mountains to join him (in) making tasbīH (i.e. pronouncing Allah’s purity) at evening and sunrise,
t.85: We made the mountains join him in glorifying Us at sunset and sunrise;
t.95: With him We had subjected the mountains that they join him in celebrating Allah's glory, evening and morning,
t.19: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,
t.22: It was We that made the hills declare, in unison with him, Our Praises, at eventide and at break of day,
t.203: Verily, We made the mountains to glorify Our Praises with him [Dâwûd (David)] in the ‘Ashî (i.e. after the mid-day till sunset) and Ishrâq (i.e. after the sunrise till mid-day).
t.54: ہم نے پہاڑوں کو اس کے تابع کر رکھا تھا کہ اس کے ساتھ شام کو اور صبح کو تسبیح خوانی کریں.

t.149: with the birds made to flock, each often turning to Him.
t.84: and the birds as well, mustered together. All were turning to Allah with him.
t.85: and the birds, too, in flocks, all echoed his praise.
t.95: and the birds, too, in their flocks, and turn again and again to celebrating Allah's glory.
t.19: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.
t.22: And the birds gathered (in assemblies): all with him did turn (to Allah).
t.203: And (so did) the birds assembled: all obedient to him [Dâwûd (David)] [i.e. they came and glorified Allâh’s Praises along with him]. (Tafsir Al-Qurtubi ).
t.54: اور پرندوں کو بھی جمع ہو کر سب کے سب اس کے زیر فرمان رہتے.

t.149: Thus We strengthened his dominion and brought him wisdom and decisive speech.
t.84: And We made his kingdom strong, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
t.85: We strengthened his kingdom; We gave him wisdom and a decisive way of speaking.
t.95: And We strengthened his kingdom and endowed him with wisdom and decisive judgement.
t.19: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
t.22: We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment in speech and decision.
t.203: We made his kingdom strong and gave him Al-Hikmah (Prophethood) and sound judgement in speech and decision.
t.54: اور ہم نے اس کی سلطنت کو مضبوط کر دیا تھا اور اسے حکمت دی تھی اور بات کا فیصلہ کرنا.

t.149: And has the tiding of the disputants reached you, as they climbed the sanctuary—
t.84: Has there come to you the story of the litigants, when they entered the sanctuary by climbing over the wall?
t.85: Have you heard the story of the two litigants who climbed into his private quarters?
t.95: Has the story of the litigants reached you � of those who entered his private chambers by climbing over the wall?
t.19: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber;
t.22: Has the Story of the Disputants reached thee? Behold, they climbed over the wall of the private chamber;
t.203: And has the news of the litigants reached you? When they climbed over the wall into (his) Mihrâb (a praying place or a private room);
t.54: اور کیا تجھے جھگڑا کرنے والوں کی (بھی) خبر ملی؟ جبکہ وه دیوار پھاند کر محراب میں آگئے.

t.149: as they entered upon David, and he was startled by them? They said, “Do not fear; two disputants, one of whom has oppressed the other. So judge between us with the truth and do not be untrue, and guide us to the right path.”
t.84: When they entered upon Dawūd, and he was scared of them, they said, “Be not scared. We are two litigants; one of us has wronged the other, so decide between us with truth, and do not cross the limits, and guide us to the right path.
t.85: When they reached David, he took fright, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid. We are two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other: judge between us fairly- do not be unjust- and guide us to the right path.
t.95: As they came upon David � and he was frightened of them � they said: “Be not afraid. We are just two litigants: one of us has committed excess against the other. So judge rightly between us, and be not unjust; and guide us to the Right Way.
t.19: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.
t.22: When they entered the presence of David, and he was terrified of them, they said: "Fear not: we are two disputants, one of whom has wronged the other: Decide now between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, but guide us to the even Path..
t.203: When they entered in upon Dâwûd (David), he was terrified of them. They said: "Fear not! (We are) two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other, therefore judge between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, and guide us to the Right Way.
t.54: جب یہ (حضرت) داؤد (علیہ السلام) کے پاس پہنچے، پس یہ ان سے ڈر گئے، انہوں نے کہا خوف نہ کیجئے! ہم دو فریق مقدمہ ہیں، ہم میں سے ایک نے دوسرے پر زیادتی کی ہے، پس آپ ہمارے درمیان حق کے ساتھ فیصلہ کر دیجئے اور ناانصافی نہ کیجئے اور ہمیں سیدھی راه بتا دیجئے.

t.149: “Indeed, this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have just one ewe, and he said, ‘Entrust it to me,’ and he pressured me with words.”
t.84: This is my brother; he has ninety nine ewes, and I have a single ewe; still he said, ‘Give it into my charge.’ And he overpowered me in speech.”
t.85: This is my brother. He had ninety-nine ewes and I just the one, and he said, “Let me take charge of her,” and overpowered me with his words.’
t.95: Behold, this is my brother; he has ninety-nine ewes and I have only one ewe.” And yet he said: “Give her into my charge,” and he got the better of me in argument.
t.19: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.
t.22: "This man is my brother: He has nine and ninety ewes, and I have (but) one: Yet he says, 'commit her to my care,' and is (moreover) harsh to me in speech."
t.203: Verily, this my brother (in religion) has ninety-nine ewes, while I have (only) one ewe, and he says: "Hand it over to me, and he overpowered me in speech."
t.54: (سنیے) یہ میرا بھائی ہے اس کے پاس نناوے دنبیاں ہیں اور میرے پاس ایک ہی دنبی ہے لیکن یہ مجھ سے کہہ رہا ہے کہ اپنی یہ ایک بھی مجھ ہی کو دے دے اور مجھ پر بات میں بڑی سختی برتتا ہے.

t.149: He said, “He has done youwrong by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes, and indeed many partners do oppress one another— except those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds, but these are so few.” And David realized that We were testing him, so he sought forgiveness from his Lord and fell down to his knees and turned penitent.
t.84: He (Dawūd) said, “He has certainly wronged you by demanding your ewe to be added to his ewe. Many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds, and very few they are.” And Dawūd realized that We had put him to a test, so he prayed to his Lord for forgiveness, and bowing down, he fell in prostration, and turned (to Allah).
t.85: David said, ‘He has done you wrong by demanding to add your ewe to his flock. Many partners treat each other unfairly. Those who sincerely believe and do good deeds do not do this, but these are very few.’ [Then] David realized that We had been testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness, fell down on his knees, and repented:
t.95: David said: “He has certainly wronged you in seeking to add your ewe to his ewes; and indeed many who live together commit excesses, one to the other, except those that believe and act righteously; and they are but few.” (While so saying) David realized that it is We Who have put him to test; therefore, he sought the forgiveness of his Lord, and fell down, bowing and penitently turning (to Him).
t.19: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.
t.22: (David) said: "He has undoubtedly wronged thee in demanding thy (single) ewe to be added to his (flock of) ewes: truly many are the partners (in business) who wrong each other: Not so do those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, and how few are they?"... and David gathered that We had tried him: he asked forgiveness of his Lord, fell down, bowing (in prostration), and turned (to Allah in repentance).
t.203: [Dâwûd (David)] said (immediately without listening to the opponent): "He has wronged you in demanding your ewe in addition to his ewes. And, verily, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and they are few." And Dâwûd (David) guessed that We have tried him and he sought Forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down prostrate and turned (to Allâh) in repentance.
t.54: آپ نے فرمایا! اس کا اپنی دنبیوں کے ساتھ تیری ایک دنبی ملا لینے کا سوال بیشک تیرے اوپر ایک ﻇلم ہے اور اکثر حصہ دار اور شریک (ایسے ہی ہوتے ہیں کہ) ایک دوسرے پر ﻇلم کرتے ہیں، سوائے ان کے جو ایمان ﻻئے اور جنہوں نے نیک عمل کیے اور ایسے لوگ بہت ہی کم ہیں اور (حضرت) داؤد (علیہ السلام) سمجھ گئے کہ ہم نے انہیں آزمایا ہے، پھر تو اپنے رب سے استغفار کرنے لگے اور عاجزی کرتے ہوئے گر پڑے اور (پوری طرح) رجوع کیا.

t.149: So We forgave him that, and indeed there is most surely for him nearness to Us and a beautiful place to return to.
t.84: So we forgave him that (lapse), and surely he has a place of nearness in Our presence, and an excellent resort.
t.85: We forgave him [his misdeed]. His reward will be nearness to Us, a good place to return to.
t.95: Thereupon We forgave him his shortcoming and indeed (an exalted position of) nearness awaits him, and an excellent resort.
t.19: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end.
t.22: So We forgave him this (lapse): he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful place of (Final) Return.
t.203: So We forgave him that, and verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good place of (final) return (Paradise).
t.54: پس ہم نے بھی ان کا وه (قصور) معاف کر دیا، یقیناً وه ہمارے نزدیک بڑے مرتبہ والے اور بہت اچھے ٹھکانے والے ہیں.

t.149: “O David, We have appointed you as a viceroy in the land, so judge between mankind with the truth and do not follow the whim, lest it misguide you from the way of Allah. Indeed, for those who stray from the way of Allah there is a severe punishment for their having forgotten the Day of Reckoning.”
t.84: O Dawūd, We have made you a vicegerent on earth, so judge between people with truth, and do not follow the selfish desire, lest it should lead you astray from Allah’s path. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s path will have a severe punishment, because they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.
t.85: ‘David, We have given you mastery over the land. Judge fairly between people. Do not follow your desires, lest they divert you from God’s path: those who wander from His path will have a painful torment because they ignore the Day of Reckoning.’
t.95: (We said to him): “O David, We have appointed you vicegerent on earth. Therefore, rule among people with justice and do not follow (your) desire lest it should lead you astray from Allah's Path. Allah's severe chastisement awaits those who stray away from Allah's Path, for they had forgotten the Day of Reckoning.
t.19: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning.
t.22: O David! We did indeed make thee a vicegerent on earth: so judge thou between men in truth (and justice): Nor follow thou the lusts (of thy heart), for they will mislead thee from the Path of Allah: for those who wander astray from the Path of Allah, is a Penalty Grievous, for that they forget the Day of Account.
t.203: O Dâwûd (David)! Verily! We have placed you as a successor on the earth; so judge you between men in truth (and justice) and follow not your desire - for it will mislead you from the Path of Allâh. Verily, those who wander astray from the Path of Allâh (shall) have a severe torment, because they forgot the Day of Reckoning.
t.54: اے داؤد! ہم نے تمہیں زمین میں خلیفہ بنا دیا تم لوگوں کے درمیان حق کے ساتھ فیصلے کرو اور اپنی نفسانی خواہش کی پیروی نہ کرو ورنہ وه تمہیں اللہ کی راه سے بھٹکا دے گی، یقیناً جو لوگ اللہ کی راه سے بھٹک جاتے ہیں ان کے لئے سخت عذاب ہے اس لئے کہ انہوں نے حساب کے دن کو بھلا دیا ہے.

t.149: And in no way have We created the heaven and the earth and whatever is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who have denied. So woe to those who have denied from the Fire!
t.84: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them in vain. That is the thinking of those who disbelieve. So, woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire (they have to face).
t.85: It was not without purpose that We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between. That may be what the disbelievers assume- how they will suffer from the Fire!-
t.95: We did not create this heaven and earth and all that lies between them in vain. That is the fancy of those who denied the Truth. So woe from the Fire to all who deny the Truth.
t.19: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire!
t.22: Not without purpose did We create heaven and earth and all between! that were the thought of Unbelievers! but woe to the Unbelievers because of the Fire (of Hell)!
t.203: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them without purpose! That is the consideration of those who disbelieve! Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Islâmic Monotheism) from the Fire!
t.54: اور ہم نے آسمان وزمین اور ان کے درمیان کی چیزوں کو ناحق پیدا نہیں کیا، یہ گمان تو کافروں کا ہے سو کافروں کے لئے خرابی ہے آگ کی.

t.149: Or are We to make those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds equal to those who spread corruption in the earth? Or are We to make the people who are mindful(of God) equal to the wicked?
t.84: Shall We make those who believe and do righteous deeds equal to those who commit mischief on the earth? Or shall We make the God-fearing equal to the sinners?
t.85: but would We treat those who believe and do good deeds and those who spread corruption on earth as equal? Would We treat those who are aware of God and those who recklessly break all bounds in the same way?
t.95: Shall We then treat alike those that believe and act righteously and those that create mischief on earth? Or treat alike the God-fearing and the wicked?
t.19: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked?
t.22: Shall We treat those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, the same as those who do mischief on earth? Shall We treat those who guard against evil, the same as those who turn aside from the right?
t.203: Shall We treat those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds as Mufsidûn (those who associate partners in worship with Allâh and commit crimes) on earth? Or shall We treat the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) as the Fujjâr (criminals, disbelievers, the wicked)?
t.54: کیا ہم ان لوگوں کو جو ایمان ﻻئے اور نیک عمل کیے ان کے برابر کر دیں گے جو (ہمیشہ) زمین میں فساد مچاتے رہے، یا پرہیزگاروں کو بدکاروں جیسا کر دینگے؟

t.149: A Scripture that We sent down to you, blessed, that they may ponderits signsand that those endowed with understanding may remind themselves.
t.84: This is a blessed Book We have revealed to you, so that they deliberate in its verses, and so that the men of understanding may heed to advice.
t.85: This is a blessed Scripture which We sent down to you [Muhammad], for people to think about its messages, and for those with understanding to take heed.
t.95: This is the Blessed Book that We have revealed to you, (O Muhammad), that people with understanding may reflect over its verses and those with understanding derive a lesson.
t.19: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.
t.22: (Here is) a Book which We have sent down unto thee, full of blessings, that they may mediate on its Signs, and that men of understanding may receive admonition.
t.203: (This is) a Book (the Qur’ân) which We have sent down to you, full of blessings, that they may ponder over its Verses, and that men of understanding may remember.
t.54: یہ بابرکت کتاب ہے جسے ہم نے آپ کی طرف اس لئے نازل فرمایا ہے کہ لوگ اس کی آیتوں پر غور وفکر کریں اور عقلمند اس سے نصیحت حاصل کریں.

t.149: And to David We gave Solomon, an excellent servant; indeed, he often turnsto Us.
t.84: And We blessed Dawūd with Sulaimān. He was an excellent servant (of Allah). Surely, he was great in turning (to Us, in penitence and praise).
t.85: We gave David Solomon. He was an excellent servant who always turned to God.
t.95: We bestowed upon David (an illustrious son), Solomon. How excellent a servant (of Ours he was)! Indeed he constantly turned to Us in devotion.
t.19: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
t.22: To David We gave Solomon (for a son),- How excellent in Our service! Ever did he turn (to Us)!
t.203: And to Dâwûd (David) We gave Sulaimân (Solomon). How excellent a slave! Verily, he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us)!
t.54: اور ہم نے داؤد کو سلیمان (نامی فرزند) عطا فرمایا، جو بڑا اچھا بنده تھا اور بے حد رجوع کرنے واﻻ تھا.

t.149: Recall when the beautiful horses were paraded before him in the evening,
t.84: (Worth remembering is the incident) when the swift horses of high breeding were presented before him in the evening.
t.85: When well-bred light-footed horses were paraded before him near the close of day,
t.95: And when one evening well-trained and running horses of noble breed were brought to him
t.19: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers
t.22: Behold, there were brought before him, at eventide coursers of the highest breeding, and swift of foot;
t.203: When there were displayed before him, in the afternoon, well trained horses of the highest breed [for Jihâd (holy fighting in Allâh’s Cause)].
t.54: جب ان کے سامنے شام کے وقت تیز رو خاصے گھوڑے پیش کیے گئے.

t.149: so he said, “Indeed, I have loved the good things with a love more than the remembrance of my Lord, until itdisappeared behind the veil(of night) .
t.84: He said, “I held the love of the good things (i.e. these horses) because of the remembrance of my Lord.” until it went behind the veil.
t.85: he kept saying, ‘My love of fine things is part of my remembering my Lord!’ until [the horses] disappeared from sight-
t.95: he said: “Lo! I have come to love this wealth on account of the remembrance of my Lord.” And when the horses disappeared,
t.19: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.
t.22: And he said, "Truly do I love the love of good, with a view to the glory of my Lord,"- until (the sun) was hidden in the veil (of night):
t.203: He said: "I did love the good (these horses) instead of remembering my Lord (in my ‘Asr prayer)" till the time was over, and (the sun) had hidden in the veil (of night).
t.54: تو کہنے لگے میں نے اپنے پروردگار کی یاد پر ان گھوڑوں کی محبت کو ترجیح دی، یہاں تک کہ (آفتاب) چھﭗ گیا.

t.149: Bringthem back to me.” And he started to stroke their legs and necks.
t.84: (Then he said,) “Bring them back to me” - and he started passing his hands over the shanks and the necks (of the horses).
t.85: ‘Bring them back!’ [he said] and started to stroke their legs and necks.
t.95: (he ordered): “Bring these horses back to me,” and then he began to gently stroke their shanks and necks.
t.19: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.
t.22: "Bring them back to me." then began he to pass his hand over (their) legs and their necks.
t.203: Then he said "Bring them (horses) back to me." Then he began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks (till the end of the display).
t.54: ان (گھوڑوں) کو دوباره میرے سامنے ﻻؤ! پھر تو پنڈلیوں اور گردنوں پر ہاتھ پھیرنا شروع کر دیا.

t.149: And surely, We tested Solomon and cast a body on his throne, then he turned penitent.
t.84: And indeed We tested Sulaimān while We threw on his throne a body after which he turned (to Us).
t.85: We certainly tested Solomon, reducing him to a mere skeleton on his throne.
t.95: Surely We put Solomon to the test and cast upon his throne a mere body. Thereupon he penitently turned (to Us).
t.19: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent.
t.22: And We did try Solomon: We placed on his throne a body (without life); but he did turn (to Us in true devotion):
t.203: And indeed, We did try Sulaimân (Solomon) and We placed on his throne Jasad (a devil, so he lost his kingdom for a while) and he did return (to Allâh with obedience and in repentance, and to his throne and kingdom by the Grace of Allâh).
t.54: اور ہم نے سلیمان (علیہ السلام) کی آزمائش کی اور ان کے تخت پر ایک جسم ڈال دیا پھر اس نے رجوع کیا.

t.149: He said, “My Lord, forgive me and grant me a dominion never to be attained by anyone after me; indeed, You— only You—are the Giver.”
t.84: He said, “O my Lord, forgive me, and bless me with a kingdom that will not be available to anyone after me. Surely, You are the Bountiful.”
t.85: He turned to Us and prayed: ‘Lord forgive me! Grant me such power as no one after me will have- You are the Most Generous Provider.’
t.95: He said: “My Lord, forgive me and bestow upon me a kingdom such as none other after me will deserve. Surely You are the Bounteous Giver.”
t.19: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.
t.22: He said, "O my Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom which, (it may be), suits not another after me: for Thou art the Grantor of Bounties (without measure).
t.203: He said: "My Lord! Forgive me, and bestow upon me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me: Verily, You are the Bestower."
t.54: کہا کہ اے میرے رب! مجھے بخش دے اور مجھے ایسا ملک عطا فرما جو میرے سوا کسی (شخص) کے ﻻئق نہ ہو، تو بڑا ہی دینے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: So We subjected to him the wind , flowing gently by his command wherever he directed;
t.84: Then We subjugated the wind for him that blew smoothly on his command to wherever he wished,
t.85: So We gave him power over the wind, which at his request ran gently wherever he willed,
t.95: We subjected the wind to him, so that it blew gently at his bidding, wherever he directed it,
t.19: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended.
t.22: Then We subjected the wind to his power, to flow gently to his order, Whithersoever he willed,-
t.203: So, We subjected to him the wind; it blew gently by his order whithersoever he willed,
t.54: پس ہم نے ہوا کو ان کے ماتحت کر دیا اور آپ کے حکم سے جہاں آپ چاہتے نرمی سے پہنچا دیا کرتی تھی.

t.149: and the demons—every builder and diver;
t.84: and (We subjugated to him) the devils (among Jinns), all builders and divers,
t.85: and the jinn––every kind of builder and diver
t.95: and We also subjected the devils to him � all kinds of builders and divers;
t.19: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient),
t.22: As also the evil ones, (including) every kind of builder and diver,-
t.203: And also the Shayâtîn (devils) from the jinn (including) every kind of builder and diver,
t.54: اور (طاقت ور) جنات کو بھی (ان کا ماتحت کر دیا) ہر عمارت بنانے والے کو اور غوطہ خور کو.

t.149: and others bound together in fetters.
t.84: and many others held in chains.
t.85: and others chained in fetters.
t.95: and others that were bound with chains.
t.19: And others linked together in chains,
t.22: As also others bound together in fetters.
t.203: And also others bound in fetters.
t.54: اور دوسرے جنات کو بھی جو زنجیروں میں جکڑے رہتے.

t.149: “This is Our gift, so givegenerously or withhold, without measure.”
t.84: This is Our gift. So, do favor (to someone) or withhold (it), with no (requirement to give) account.
t.85: ‘This is Our gift, so give or withhold as you wish without account.’
t.95: “This is Our bestowal. So give or withhold as you wish without account.”
t.19: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning.
t.22: "Such are Our Bounties: whether thou bestow them (on others) or withhold them, no account will be asked."
t.203: [Allâh said to Sulaimân (Solomon)]: "This is Our gift: so spend you or withhold, no account will be asked (of you)."
t.54: یہ ہے ہمارا عطیہ اب تو احسان کر یا روک رکھ، کچھ حساب نہیں.

t.149: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a beautiful place to return to.
t.84: He has a place of nearness in Our presence, and an excellent end.
t.85: His reward will be nearness to Us, and a good place to return to.
t.95: Indeed an exalted position of nearness awaits him and an excellent resort.
t.19: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end.
t.22: And he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful Place of (Final) Return.
t.203: And verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good (final) return (Paradise).
t.54: ان کے لئے ہمارے پاس بڑا تقرب ہے اور بہت اچھا ٹھکانا ہے.

t.149: And recall Our servant Job, when he called out to his Lord, “Satan has touched me with toil and suffering.”
t.84: And remember Our servant, Ayyūb - when he called his Lord saying, “The ShaiTān (Satan) has inflicted weariness and pain upon me.”
t.85: Bring to mind Our servant Job who cried to his Lord, ‘Satan has afflicted me with weariness and suffering.’
t.95: And remember Our servant Job: when he cried to his Lord: “Behold, Satan has afflicted me with much hardship and suffering.”
t.19: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment.
t.22: Commemorate Our Servant Job. Behold he cried to his Lord: "The Evil One has afflicted me with distress and suffering!"
t.203: And remember Our slave Ayyûb (Job), when he invoked his Lord (saying): "Verily Shaitân (Satan) has touched me with distress (by ruining my health) and torment (by ruining my wealth)!
t.54: اور ہمارے بندے ایوب (علیہ السلام) کا (بھی) ذکر کر، جبکہ اس نے اپنے رب کو پکارا کہ مجھے شیطان نے رنج اور دکھ پہنچایا ہے.

t.149: “Stamp your foot—this is a cool washing-place and drinking-place.”
t.84: (Allah said to him,) “Strike (the ground) with your foot: Here is a cool water to bathe, and a drink!”
t.85: ‘Stamp your foot! Here is cool water for you to wash in and drink,’
t.95: (We commanded him): “Stamp your foot on earth, and here is cool water to wash with and to drink.”
t.19: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink.
t.22: (The command was given:) "Strike with thy foot: here is (water) wherein to wash, cool and refreshing, and (water) to drink."
t.203: (Allâh said to him): "Strike the ground with your foot: This is (a spring of) water to wash in, cool and a (refreshing) drink."
t.54: اپنا پاؤں مارو، یہ نہانے کا ٹھنڈا اور پینے کا پانی ہے.

t.149: And We gave him back his family and doubled them—a mercy from Us and a reminding for those endowed with understanding.
t.84: And We let him have his family and the like of them besides, as a mercy from Us, and a reminder for the people of understanding.
t.85: and We restored his family to him, with many more like them: a sign of Our mercy and a lesson to all who understand.
t.95: And We granted to him his family and also the like of them, as a mercy from Us, and as a reminder to people of understanding,
t.19: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding.
t.22: And We gave him (back) his people, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who have Understanding.
t.203: And We gave him (back) his family, and along with them the like thereof, as a Mercy from Us, and a Reminder for those who understand.
t.54: اور ہم نے اسے اس کا پورا کنبہ عطا فرمایا بلکہ اتنا ہی اور بھی اسی کے ساتھ اپنی (خاص) رحمت سے، اور عقلمندوں کی نصیحت کے لئے.

t.149: “And take with yourhand a bundle of grass, and strike with it so as not to breach(your oath) .” Indeed, We found him patient. What an excellent servant; indeed, he often turnsunto Us.
t.84: And (We said to him,) “Take (a bundle of) thin twigs in your hand, and strike with it, and do not violate your oath. Surely, We found him very enduring. He was really an excellent servant. Surely, he was great in turning (to Us, in penitence and praise).
t.85: ‘Take a small bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [her] with that so as not to break your oath.’ We found him patient in adversity; an excellent servant! He, too, always turned to God.
t.95: (and We said to him): “Take in your hand a bundle of rushes and strike with it, and do not break your oath.” Indeed We found him steadfast. How excellent a servant (of Ours) he was. Indeed he constantly turned (to his Lord).
t.19: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord).
t.22: "And take in thy hand a little grass, and strike therewith: and break not (thy oath)." Truly We found him full of patience and constancy. How excellent in Our service! ever did he turn (to Us)!
t.203: "And take in your hand a bundle of thin grass and strike therewith (your wife), and break not your oath. Truly! We found him patient. How excellent a slave! Verily he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us)!
t.54: اور اپنے ہاتھوں میں تنکوں کا ایک مٹھا (جھاڑو) لے کر مار دے اور قسم کے خلاف نہ کر، سچ تو یہ ہے کہ ہم نے اسے بڑا صابر بنده پایا، وه بڑا نیک بنده تھا اور بڑی ہی رغبت رکھنے واﻻ.

t.149: And recallOurservants Abraham and Isaac and Jacob—those endowed with strong faith and with sight(s) .
t.84: And remember Our servants - Ibrāhīm and IsHāq and Ya‘qūb - the men of strength and the men of vision.
t.85: Remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, all men of strength and vision.
t.95: And remember Our servants � Abraham, Isaac and Jacob � they were endowed with great strength and vision.
t.19: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision.
t.22: And commemorate Our Servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, possessors of Power and Vision.
t.203: And remember Our slaves, Ibrâhîm (Abraham), Ishâq (Isaac), and Ya‘qûb (Jacob), (all) owners of strength (in worshipping Us) and (also) of religious understanding.
t.54: ہمارے بندوں ابراہیم، اسحاق اور یعقوب (علیہم السلام) کا بھی لوگوں سے ذکر کرو جو ہاتھوں اور آنکھوں والے تھے.

t.149: Surely We distinguished them with a distinct quality —the remembranceof the(final) Home.
t.84: We chose them for a trait of remembering the (eternal) Home (in the Hereafter).
t.85: We caused them to be devoted to Us through their sincere remembrance of the Final Home:
t.95: Verily We exalted them in consideration of a sterling quality: their remembrance of the Abode of the Hereafter.
t.19: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter).
t.22: Verily We did choose them for a special (purpose)- proclaiming the Message of the Hereafter.
t.203: Verily, We did choose them by granting them (a good thing, - i.e.) the remembrance of the Home [in the Hereafter and they used to make the people remember it, and also they used to invite the people to obey Allâh and to do good deeds for the Hereafter].
t.54: ہم نے انہیں ایک خاص بات یعنی آخرت کی یاد کے ساتھ مخصوص کر دیا تھا.

t.149: And indeed, to Us they are of the elect, the outstanding.
t.84: And surely they are, in Our sight, among the chosen, the best of the righteous.
t.85: with Us they will be among the elect, the truly good.
t.95: In Our sight they are among the chosen and excellent ones.
t.19: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent.
t.22: They were, in Our sight, truly, of the company of the Elect and the Good.
t.203: And they are with Us, verily, of the chosen and the best!
t.54: یہ سب ہمارے نزدیک برگزیده اور بہترین لوگ تھے.

t.149: And recallIshmael and Elisha and Ezekiel—and all are of the outstanding.
t.84: And remember Ismā‘īl and Al-Yasa‘ and Dhul-Kifl. Each one of them was among the best of the righteous.
t.85: And remember Our servants Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu ’l-Kifl, each of them truly good.
t.95: And remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu al-Kifl.All were of the best.
t.19: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen.
t.22: And commemorate Isma'il, Elisha, and Zul-Kifl: Each of them was of the Company of the Good.
t.203: And remember Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael), Alyasa‘ (Elisha), and Dhul-Kifl (Isaiah), all are among the best.
t.54: اسماعیل، یسع اور ذوالکفل (علیہم السلام) کا بھی ذکر کر دیجئے۔ یہ سب بہترین لوگ تھے.

t.149: This is a Reminder. For indeed, for the mindful(of God) is a beautiful place to return to:
t.84: This is a reminder (of what has passed). And surely the God-fearing will have the best place to return:
t.85: This is a lesson. The devout will have a good place to return to:
t.95: This was a remembrance. An excellent retreat awaits the God-fearing
t.19: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end,
t.22: This is a Message (of admonition): and verily, for the righteous, is a beautiful Place of (Final) Return,-
t.203: This is a Reminder. And verily, for the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) is a good final return (Paradise),
t.54: یہ نصیحت ہے اور یقین مانو کہ پرہیزگاروں کی بڑی اچھی جگہ ہے.

t.149: the Gardens of Eden, with their doors wide-open for them,
t.84: - everlasting gardens, with (their) doors opened for them.
t.85: Gardens of lasting bliss with gates wide open.
t.95: � everlasting Gardens with gates wide open for them
t.19: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them,
t.22: Gardens of Eternity, whose doors will (ever) be open to them;
t.203: ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), whose doors will be opened for them.
t.54: (یعنی ہمیشگی والی) جنتیں جن کے دروازے ان کے لئے کھلے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: relaxing therein and calling for abundant fruit and beverage.
t.84: They will be relaxing in it, calling there for plenteous fruits and drinks;
t.85: They will be comfortably seated; they will call for abundant fruit and drink;
t.95: wherein they shall recline, wherein they shall ask for abundant fruit and drinks,
t.19: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein.
t.22: Therein will they recline (at ease): Therein can they call (at pleasure) for fruit in abundance, and (delicious) drink;
t.203: Therein they will recline; therein they will call for fruits in abundance and drinks;
t.54: جن میں بافراغت تکیے لگائے بیٹھے ہوئے طرح طرح کے میوے اور قسم قسم کی شرابوں کی فرمائشیں کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: And with them are bashful maidens of equal age.
t.84: and in their company there will be females restricting their glances (to their husbands, and) of matching ages.
t.85: they will have well-matched [wives] with modest gaze.
t.95: and wherein there shall be with them well-matched, bashful mates.
t.19: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions.
t.22: And beside them will be chaste women restraining their glances, (companions) of equal age.
t.203: And beside them will be Qâsirât-at-Tarf [chaste females (wives) restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands)], (and) of equal ages.
t.54: اور ان کے پاس نیچی نظروں والی ہم عمر حوریں ہوں گی.

t.149: This is what you are promisedfor the Day of Reckoning.
t.84: This is what you are being promised for the Day of Reckoning.
t.85: ‘This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning:
t.95: All this is what you are promised for the Day of Judgement.
t.19: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning.
t.22: Such is the Promise made, to you for the Day of Account!
t.203: This it is what you (Al-Muttaqûn - the pious - see V.2:2) are promised for the Day of Reckoning!
t.54: یہ ہے جس کا وعده تم سے حساب کے دن کے لئے کیا جاتا تھا.

t.149: Indeed, such is Our provision, inexhaustible.
t.84: Surely, that is provision provided by Us, to which there is no end.
t.85: Our provision for you will never end.’
t.95: This is Our provision for you, never to end.
t.19: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away.
t.22: Truly such will be Our Bounty (to you); it will never fail;-
t.203: (It will be said to them)! Verily, this is Our Provision which will never finish.
t.54: بیشک روزیاں (خاص) ہمارا عطیہ ہیں جن کا کبھی خاتمہ ہی نہیں.

t.149: All this. But indeed, for those who exceed all limits is a miserable place to return to:
t.84: Having said this, the transgressors will surely have the most evil place to return:
t.85: But the evildoers will have the worst place to return to:
t.95: All this (is for the God-fearing). But for the transgressors, an evil resort awaits them �
t.19: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end,
t.22: Yea, such! but - for the wrong-doers will be an evil place of (Final) Return!-
t.203: This is so! And for the Tâghûn (transgressors, the disobedient to Allâh and His Messenger - disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, criminals) will be an evil final return (Fire).
t.54: یہ تو ہوئی جزا، (یاد رکھو کہ) سرکشوں کے لئے بڑی بری جگہ ہے.

t.149: Hell, in which they roast—so what a miserable resting place!
t.84: the Jahannam , in which they will enter. So, how evil is that place to rest?
t.85: Hell to burn in, an evil place to stay-
t.95: Hell, where they will be roasted. An evil place to dwell!
t.19: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place.
t.22: Hell!- they will burn therein, - an evil bed (indeed, to lie on)!-
t.203: Hell! Where they will burn, and worst (indeed) is that place to rest!
t.54: دوزخ ہے جس میں وه جائیں گے (آه) کیا ہی برا بچھونا ہے.

t.149: All this, so let them taste it—scalding water and purulence.
t.84: Let them taste this: hot water and pus,
t.85: all this will be theirs: let them taste it- a scalding, dark, foul fluid,
t.95: All this (is for them); so let them taste boiling water and pus,
t.19: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it,
t.22: Yea, such! - then shall they taste it,- a boiling fluid, and a fluid dark, murky, intensely cold!-
t.203: This is so! Then let them taste it - a boiling fluid and dirty wound discharges.
t.54: یہ ہے، پس اسے چکھیں، گرم پانی اور پیﭗ.

t.149: And another (torment) similar to it, of diverse kinds.
t.84: and other things similar to it of various kinds.
t.85: and other such torments.
t.95: and other sufferings of the kind.
t.19: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)!
t.22: And other Penalties of a similar kind, to match them!
t.203: And other (torments) of similar kind - all together!
t.54: اس کے علاوه اور طرح طرح کے عذاب.

t.149: “This is a crowd rushing headlong with you.” They are not welcome; indeed, they are to be roasted in the Fire.
t.84: (When the leaders of the infidels will see their followers entering the Hell after them, they will say to each other,) “This is a multitude rushing into (the Hell) with you - they are not welcome - they are to burn in the Fire.”
t.85: [It will be said], ‘Here is another crowd of people rushing headlong to join you.’ [The response will be], ‘They are not welcome! They will burn in the Fire.’
t.95: (Observing their followers advancing to Hell they will say, among themselves: “This is a troop rushing in to you. There is no welcome for them. They are destined to roast in the Fire.”
t.19: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire.
t.22: Here is a troop rushing headlong with you! No welcome for them! truly, they shall burn in the Fire!
t.203: This is a troop entering with you (in Hell), no welcome for them! Verily, they shall burn in the Fire!
t.54: یہ ایک قوم ہے جو تمہارے ساتھ (آگ میں) جانے والی ہے، کوئی خوش آمدید ان کے لئے نہیں ہے یہی تو جہنم میں جانے والے ہیں.

t.149: They said, “But it is youwho are not welcome! It is you who brought it upon us! So what a miserable end!”
t.84: They (the followers) will say (to their leaders) “No, it is you who are not welcome; you are the ones who brought this upon us.” So, how evil is the place to stay (for ever)!”
t.85: They will say to them, ‘You are not welcome! It was you who brought this on us, an evil place to stay,’
t.95: They will reply: “Rather, no welcome to you. (You will roast in Hell.) It is you who led us to this end. What an evil resort!”
t.19: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight.
t.22: (The followers shall cry to the misleaders:) "Nay, ye (too)! No welcome for you! It is ye who have brought this upon us! Now evil is (this) place to stay in!"
t.203: (The followers of the misleaders will say): "Nay, you (too)! No welcome for you! It is you (misleaders) who brought this upon us (because you misled us in the world), so evil is this place to stay in!"
t.54: وه کہیں گے بلکہ تم ہی ہو جن کے لئے کوئی خوش آمدید نہیں ہے تم ہی نے تو اسے پہلے ہی سے ہمارے سامنے ﻻ رکھا تھا، پس رہنے کی بڑی بری جگہ ہے.

t.149: They said, “Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us, give him double punishment in the Fire.”
t.84: They (the followers) will say, “Our Lord, whoever has brought this on us, do increase his punishment twofold in the Fire.”
t.85: adding, ‘Our Lord, give double punishment to those who brought this upon us.’
t.95: They will say: “Our Lord, give twofold punishment in the Fire to him who has led us to this.”
t.19: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire!
t.22: They will say: "Our Lord! whoever brought this upon us,- Add to him a double Penalty in the Fire!"
t.203: They will say: "Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, add to him a double torment in the Fire!"
t.54: وه کہیں گے اے ہمارے رب! جس نے (کفر کی رسم) ہمارے لئے پہلے سے نکالی ہو اس کے حق میں جہنم کی دگنی سزا کر دے.

t.149: And they said, “What is it with us that we do not see men whom we used to count among the villains?
t.84: And they (the infidels) will say, “What is the matter with us that we do not see those men (here in Hell) whom we used to count amongst the worst? (i.e the Muslims whom the infidels used to treat as the worst people among them)
t.85: They will say, ‘Why do we not see those we thought were bad
t.95: They will say to one another: “But why do we not see those whom we considered him among the wicked?
t.19: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?
t.22: And they will say: "What has happened to us that we see not men whom we used to number among the bad ones?
t.203: And they will say: "What is the matter with us that we see not men whom we used to count among the bad ones?"
t.54: اور جہنمی کہیں گے کیا بات ہے کہ وه لوگ ہمیں دکھائی نہیں دیتے جنہیں ہم برے لوگوں میں شمار کرتے تھے.

t.149: Did we take them with mockery , or have our sight(s) swerved from them?
t.84: Had we taken them as a laughing-stock (unjustly), or have our eyes missed them?”
t.85: and took as a laughing-stock? Have our eyes missed them?’
t.95: Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them; or have they disappeared from our sight?”
t.19: Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them?
t.22: "Did we treat them (as such) in ridicule, or have (our) eyes failed to perceive them?"
t.203: Did we take them as an object of mockery, or have (our) eyes failed to perceive them?"
t.54: کیا ہم نے ہی ان کا مذاق بنا رکھا تھا یا ہماری نگاہیں ان سے ہٹ گئی ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, that is certainly true: the disputing among the inhabitants of the Fire.
t.84: That is going to happen definitely, that is, the mutual quarrel of the people of the Fire.
t.85: This is how it will really be: the inhabitants of the Fire will blame one another in this way.
t.95: Verily all this is true. This is how the inmates of the Fire will dispute among themselves.
t.19: Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire.
t.22: Truly that is just and fitting,- the mutual recriminations of the People of the Fire!
t.203: Verily, that is the very truth - the mutual dispute of the people of the Fire!
t.54: یقین جانو کہ دوزخیوں کا یہ جھگڑا ضرور ہی ہوگا.

t.149: Say, “Indeed, I am only a forewarner, for there is no god except Allah—the One, the Subduer,
t.84: Say, “I am only a warner, and there is no god but Allah, the One, the All-Dominant,
t.85: [Prophet] say, ‘I am only here to give warning. There is no god but God the One, the All Powerful,
t.95: Tell them, (O Prophet): “I am nothing but a warner. There is no deity but Allah, the One, the Supreme,
t.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute,
t.22: Say: "Truly am I a Warner: no god is there but the one Allah, Supreme and Irresistible,-
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I am only a warner and there is no Ilâh (God) except Allâh (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh) the One, the Irresistible,
t.54: کہہ دیجئے! کہ میں تو صرف خبردار کرنے واﻻ ہوں اور بجز اللہ واحد غالب کے اور کوئی ﻻئق عبادت نہیں.

t.149: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Almighty, the Forgiver.”
t.84: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the Mighty, the Very-Forgiving.”
t.85: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Almighty, the Most Forgiving.’
t.95: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in between them, the Most Mighty, the Most Forgiving.”
t.19: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning.
t.22: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- Exalted in Might, able to enforce His Will, forgiving again and again."
t.203: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving."
t.54: جو پروردگار ہے آسمانوں کا اور زمین کا اور جو کچھ ان کے درمیان ہے، وه زبردست اور بڑا بخشنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Say, “It is a great tiding
t.84: Say, “It is a great news
t.85: Say, ‘This message is a mighty one,
t.95: Say: “This is a tiding of tremendous import
t.19: Say: It is tremendous tidings
t.22: Say: "That is a Message Supreme (above all),-
t.203: Say: "That (this Qur’ân) is a great news,
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ یہ بہت بڑی خبر ہے.

t.149: which youdisregard.
t.84: to which you are averse.
t.85: yet you ignore it.
t.95: from which you are turning away.”
t.19: Whence ye turn away!
t.22: "From which ye do turn away!
t.203: "From which you turn away!
t.54: جس سے تم بے پرواه ہو رہے ہو.

t.149: I have had no knowledge of the Highest Assembly as they disputed.
t.84: I had no knowledge of the Heavenly Beings when they were debating (about the creation of ’Ādam).
t.85: I have no knowledge of what those on high discuss:
t.95: (Tell them): “I had no knowledge of the High Council when they were disputing.
t.19: I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed;
t.22: "No knowledge have I of the Chiefs on high, when they discuss (matters) among themselves.
t.203: "I had no knowledge of the chiefs (angels) on high when they were disputing and discussing (about the creation of Adam).
t.54: مجھے ان بلند قدر فرشتوں کی (بات چیت کا) کوئی علم ہی نہیں جبکہ وه تکرار کر رہے تھے.

t.149: It is only revealed to methat I am an evident warner.”
t.84: Revelation is sent to me only because I am a plain warner.
t.85: it is only revealed to me that I am here to give clear warning.’
t.95: I am told (about matters) by means of revelation only because I am a clear warner.”
t.19: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner.
t.22: 'Only this has been revealed to me: that I am to give warning plainly and publicly."
t.203: "Only this has been revealed to me, that I am a plain warner."
t.54: میری طرف فقط یہی وحی کی جاتی ہے کہ میں تو صاف صاف آگاه کر دینے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: Recall when YourLord said to the angels, “Indeed, I am creating a human being from clay.
t.84: When your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create man from clay.
t.85: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a man from clay.
t.95: When your Lord said to the angels: “Verily I am creating a human being from clay.
t.19: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire,
t.22: Behold, thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man from clay:
t.203: (Remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "Truly I am going to create man from clay".
t.54: جبکہ آپ کے رب نے فرشتوں سے ارشاد فرمایا کہ میں مٹی سے انسان کو پیدا کرنے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: So when I have formed him and breathed into him of My spirit, fall prostrate before him.
t.84: So, once I make him perfectly and breath My spirit into him, you must fall down in prostration before him.”
t.85: When I have shaped him and breathed from My Spirit into him, bow down before him.’
t.95: After I have created him and breathed into him of My spirit, fall you down, prostrating yourselves to him.”
t.19: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate,
t.22: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
t.203: So when I have fashioned him and breathed into him (his) soul created by Me, then you fall down prostrate to him."
t.54: سو جب میں اسے ٹھیک ٹھاک کر لوں اور اس میں اپنی روح پھونک دوں، تو تم سب اس کے سامنے سجدے میں گر پڑنا.

t.149: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them, entirely—
t.84: Then, the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together -
t.85: The angels all bowed down together,
t.95: Then the angels, all of them, prostrated themselves before Adam
t.19: The angels fell down prostrate, every one,
t.22: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
t.203: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them:
t.54: چنانچہ تمام فرشتوں نے سجده کیا.

t.149: but not Iblis; he acted arrogantly and became one of the deniers.
t.84: except Iblīs (Satan). He waxed proud, and became one of the disbelievers.
t.85: but not Iblis, who was too proud. He became a rebel.
t.95: except Iblis. He waxed proud and became one of the unbelievers.
t.19: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers.
t.22: Not so Iblis: he was haughty, and became one of those who reject Faith.
t.203: Except Iblîs (Satan): he was proud and was one of the disbelievers.
t.54: مگر ابلیس نے (نہ کیا)، اس نے تکبر کیا اور وه تھا کافروں میں سے.

t.149: He said, “O Iblis, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My Own hands? Have you acted arrogantly, or have you become one of the exalted?”
t.84: He (Allah) said, “O Iblīs, what did prevent you from prostrating yourself before what I created with My hands? Did you wax proud or were you among the lofty ones?”
t.85: God said, ‘Iblis, what prevents you from bowing down to the man I have made with My own hands? Are you too high and mighty?’
t.95: The Lord said: “O Iblis, what prevented you from prostrating yourself before him whom I created of My Two Hands. Are you waxing proud, or fancy yourself to be too exalted?”
t.19: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted?
t.22: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! What prevents thee from prostrating thyself to one whom I have created with my hands? Art thou haughty? Or art thou one of the high (and mighty) ones?"
t.203: (Allâh) said: "O Iblîs (Satan)! What prevents you from prostrating yourself to one whom I have created with Both My Hands. Are you too proud (to fall prostrate to Adam) or are you one of the high exalted?"
t.54: (اللہ تعالیٰ نے) فرمایا اے ابلیس! تجھے اسے سجده کرنے سے کس چیز نے روکا جسے میں نے اپنے ہاتھوں سے پیدا کیا۔ کیا تو کچھ گھمنڈ میں آگیا ہے؟ یا تو بڑے درجے والوں میں سے ہے.

t.149: He said, “I am better than him; You created me from fire and created him from clay.”
t.84: He said, “I am better than him. You created me from fire, and created him from clay.”
t.85: Iblis said, ‘I am better than him: You made me from fire, and him from clay.’
t.95: He replied: “I am nobler than he. You created me from fire and created him from clay.”
t.19: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay.
t.22: (Iblis) said: "I am better than he: thou createdst me from fire, and him thou createdst from clay."
t.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "I am better than he. You created me from fire, and You created him from clay."
t.54: اس نے جواب دیا کہ میں اس سے بہتر ہوں، تو نے مجھے آگ سے بنایا، اور اسے مٹی سے بنایا ہے.

t.149: He said, “Then get out of it, for you are indeed an outcast!
t.84: He said, “Then, get out from here, for you are accursed,
t.85: ‘Get out of here! You are rejected:
t.95: He said: “Get out of here; surely you are accursed,
t.19: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast,
t.22: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here: for thou art rejected, accursed.
t.203: (Allâh) said: "Then get out from here; for verily you are outcast.
t.54: ارشاد ہوا کہ تو یہاں سے نکل جا تو مردود ہوا.

t.149: And indeed, My curse is upon you until the Day of Recompense.”
t.84: and on you shall remain My curse till the Day of Judgment.”
t.85: My rejection will follow you till the Day of Judgement!’
t.95: and My curse shall remain upon you till the Day of Resurrection.”
t.19: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment.
t.22: "And My curse shall be on thee till the Day of Judgment."
t.203: "And verily My Curse is on you till the Day of Recompense."
t.54: اور تجھ پر قیامت کے دن تک میری لعنت وپھٹکار ہے.

t.149: He said, “My Lord, then reprieve me until the day they are resurrected.”
t.84: He said, “O my Lord, then give me respite till the day they are raised again.”
t.85: but Iblis said, ‘My Lord, grant me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead,’
t.95: Satan said: “My Lord, then grant me respite till the Day that they are raised up.”
t.19: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
t.22: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
t.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "My Lord! Give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are resurrected."
t.54: کہنے لگا میرے رب مجھے لوگوں کے اٹھ کھڑے ہونے کے دن تک مہلت دے.

t.149: He said, “Then indeed, you are of those reprieved
t.84: He said, “Then, you have been given respite,
t.85: so He said, ‘You have respite
t.95: He said: “You are of those who have been granted respite
t.19: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved
t.22: (Allah) said: "Respite then is granted thee-
t.203: (Allâh) said: "Verily! You are of those allowed respite."
t.54: (اللہ تعالیٰ نے) فرمایا تو مہلت والوں میں سے ہے.

t.149: until the Day of the Time Appointed.”
t.84: until the Day of the Appointed Time.”
t.85: till the Appointed Day.’
t.95: till the Day whose Hour I know.”
t.19: Until the day of the time appointed.
t.22: "Till the Day of the Time Appointed."
t.203: "Till the Day of the time appointed."
t.54: متعین وقت کے دن تک.

t.149: He said, “Then, by Your majesty, I will most surely delude them all,
t.84: He said, “Then, I swear by Your Might, that I will definitely lead them astray, all of them -
t.85: Iblis said, ‘I swear by Your might! I will tempt all
t.95: (Iblis) said: “By Your glory, I shall mislead them all
t.19: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,
t.22: (Iblis) said: "Then, by Thy power, I will put them all in the wrong,-
t.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "By Your Might, then I will surely mislead them all,
t.54: کہنے لگا پھر تو تیری عزت کی قسم! میں ان سب کو یقیناً بہکا دوں گا.

t.149: except for your sincere chosen servants among them.”
t.84: except Your chosen servants among them.”
t.85: but Your true servants.’
t.95: except those of Your servants, the chosen ones from amongst them.”
t.19: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them.
t.22: "Except Thy Servants amongst them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
t.203: "Except Your chosen slaves amongst them (i.e. faithful, obedient, true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)."
t.54: بجز تیرے ان بندوں کے جو چیده اور پسندیده ہوں.

t.149: He said, “So the truth is—and only the truth I say—
t.84: He (Allah) said, “Then, the truth is-and it is (always) the truth that I speak-
t.85: God said, ‘This is the truth- I speak only the truth-
t.95: He (i.e. Allah) said: “This is the Truth � and I only speak the Truth �
t.19: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak,
t.22: (Allah) said: "Then it is just and fitting- and I say what is just and fitting-
t.203: (Allâh) said: "The Truth is - and the Truth I say -
t.54: فرمایا سچ تو یہ ہے، اور میں سچ ہی کہا کرتا ہوں.

t.149: I will surely fill Hell with youand with whoever of them who follows you, all together.”
t.84: that I will definitely fill the Jahannam with you and with those who will follow you from among them, all together.”
t.85: I will fill Hell with you and all those that follow you.’
t.95: I will certainly fill the Gehenna with you and with all those among them who follow you.”
t.19: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together.
t.22: "That I will certainly fill Hell with thee and those that follow thee,- every one."
t.203: That I will fill Hell with you [Iblîs (Satan)] and those of them (mankind) that follow you, together."
t.54: کہ تجھ سے اور تیرے تمام ماننے والوں سے میں (بھی) جہنم کو بھر دوں گا.

t.149: Say, “I ask of you no reward for this, and I am not a pretender.
t.84: Say (O Prophet to the unbelievers,) “I do not demand from you any fee for it, nor am I from among those who make up things artificially.
t.85: [Prophet], say, ‘I ask no reward from you for this, nor do I claim to be what I am not:
t.95: (O Prophet), tell them: “I do not ask you for any recompense for the performance of this task; nor am I given to affectation.
t.19: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating.
t.22: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor am I a pretender.
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "No wage do I ask of you for this (the Qur’ân), nor am I one of the Mutakallifûn (those who pretend and fabricate things which do not exist).
t.54: کہہ دیجئے کہ میں تم سے اس پر کوئی بدلہ طلب نہیں کرتا اور نہ میں تکلف کرنے والوں میں سے ہوں.

t.149: It is but a Reminder to(all creatures of) all realms.
t.84: It is nothing but an advice for all the worlds.
t.85: this is only a warning for all people.
t.95: This is nothing but an Admonition for all people the world over.
t.19: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples
t.22: "This is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds.
t.203: "It (this Qur’ân) is only a Reminder for all the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn).
t.54: یہ تو تمام جہان والوں کے لئے سراسر نصیحت (وعبرت) ہے.

t.149: And youwill certainly know its tiding after a while.”
t.84: And you will come to know its reality after a while.”
t.85: In time you will certainly come to know its truth.’
t.95: You will know the truth of the matter after a while.”
t.19: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof.
t.22: "And ye shall certainly know the truth of it (all) after a while."
t.203: "And you shall certainly know the truth of it after a while".
t.54: یقیناً تم اس کی حقیقت کو کچھ ہی وقت کے بعد (صحیح طور پر) جان لو گے.

t.149: The bestowal of the Scripture from on high is by Allah the Almighty, the All-Wise.
t.84: This is the revelation of the Book from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
t.85: This Scripture is sent down from God the Mighty, the Wise.
t.95: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
t.19: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
t.22: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Power, full of Wisdom.
t.203: The revelation of this Book (the Qur’ân) is from Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
t.54: اس کتاب کا اتارنا اللہ تعالیٰ غالب باحکمت کی طرف سے ہے.

t.149: Indeed, We have sent down to youthe Scripture with the truth, so worship Allah, devoting religion to Him.
t.84: Surely We have revealed the Book to you with truth; so worship Allah making your submission exclusive for Him.
t.85: It is We who sent down the Scripture to you [Prophet] with the Truth, so worship God with your total devotion:
t.95: (O Prophet), it is We Who have revealed this Book to you with Truth. So serve only Allah, consecrating your devotion to Him.
t.19: Lo! We have revealed the Scripture unto thee (Muhammad) with truth; so worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).
t.22: Verily it is We Who have revealed the Book to thee in Truth: so serve Allah, offering Him sincere devotion.
t.203: Verily We have sent down the Book to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) in truth: So worship Allâh (Alone) by doing religious deeds sincerely for Allâh’s sake only.
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے اس کتاب کو آپ کی طرف حق کے ساتھ نازل فرمایا ہے پس آپ اللہ ہی کی عبادت کریں، اسی کے لئے دین کو خالص کرتے ہوئے.

t.149: Undoubtedly, faithful religion is due to Allah! And those who take guardians apart from Him—(they say,) “We only worship them so that they may bring us closer to Allah.” Indeed, Allah will judge between them regarding whatever they used to differ over. Indeed, Allah does not guide one who is a liar, a relentless denier.
t.84: Remember, Allah alone deserves the exclusive submission. As for those who have adopted guardians other than Him (saying), “We worship them for no other reason but because they would bring us near to Allah closely”, Allah will judge between them in the matters in which they are differing. Surely, Allah does not guide anyone who is liar, highly infidel.
t.85: true devotion is due to God alone. [As for] those who choose other protectors beside Him, saying, ‘We only worship them because they bring us nearer to God,’ God Himself will judge between them regarding their differences. God does not guide any ungrateful liar.
t.95: Lo, religion is exclusively devoted to Allah. Your religion is entirely consecrated to Him. As for those who have taken others than Allah for their guardians, (they say): “We worship them only that they may bring us nearer to Allah.” Allah will judge between them concerning what they differ about. Verily Allah does not guide anyone who is given to sheer lying, is an utter unbeliever.
t.19: Surely pure religion is for Allah only. And those who choose protecting friends beside Him (say): We worship them only that they may bring us near unto Allah. Lo! Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Lo! Allah guideth not him who is a liar, an ingrate.
t.22: Is it not to Allah that sincere devotion is due? But those who take for protectors other than Allah (say): "We only serve them in order that they may bring us nearer to Allah." Truly Allah will judge between them in that wherein they differ. But Allah guides not such as are false and ungrateful.
t.203: Surely the religion (i.e. the worship and the obedience) is for Allâh only.
