t.54: (ان) دروازوں تک پہنچ جاؤں اور موسیٰ کے معبود کو جھانک لوں اور بیشک میں سمجھتا ہوں وه جھوٹا ہے اور اسی طرح فرعون کی بدکرداریاں اسے بھلی دکھائی گئیں اور راه سے روک دیا گیا اور فرعون کی (ہر) حیلہ سازی تباہی میں ہی رہی.

t.149: And the one who had attained faith said, “O my people, follow me and I will guide you to the way of prudence.
t.84: And said he who had believed, “O my people, follow me, I will show you the path of guidance.
t.85: The believer said, ‘My people, follow me! I will guide you to the right path.
t.95: The person endowed with faith said: “My people, follow me; I shall direct you to the Path of Rectitude.
t.19: And he who believed said: O my people! Follow me. I will show you the way of right conduct.
t.22: The man who believed said further: "O my people! Follow me: I will lead you to the Path of Right.
t.203: And the man who believed said: "O my people! Follow me, I will guide you to the way of right conduct [i.e. guide you to Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism with which Mûsâ (Moses) has been sent].
t.54: اور اس مومن شخص نے کہا کہ اے میری قوم! (کے لوگو) تم (سب) میری پیروی کرو میں نیک راه کی طرف تمہاری رہبری کروں گا.

t.149: O my people, this Earlier Life is nothing but(fleeting) enjoyment, while the Hereafter is indeed the Home of Permanence.
t.84: O my people, this life of the world is only a (momentary) benefit, while the Hereafter is, indeed, the place of permanent living.
t.85: My people, the life of this world is only a brief enjoyment; it is the Hereafter that is the lasting home.
t.95: My people, the life of this world is ephemeral, whereas the Hereafter, that is the permanent abode.
t.19: O my people! Lo! this life of the world is but a passing comfort, and lo! the Hereafter, that is the enduring home.
t.22: "O my people! This life of the present is nothing but (temporary) convenience: It is the Hereafter that is the Home that will last.
t.203: "O my people! Truly, this life of the world is nothing but a (quick passing) enjoyment, and verily, the Hereafter that is the home that will remain forever."
t.54: اے میری قوم! یہ حیات دنیا متاع فانی ہے، (یقین مانو کہ قرار) اور ہمیشگی کا گھر تو آخرت ہی ہے.

t.149: Whoever has committed an evil deed will not be repaid except with its like, but whoever has acted righteously, whether male or female, while a believer—then those shall enter the Garden(of Paradise) where they shall be provided for without measure.
t.84: The one who does something evil will not be punished but in its equal proportion, but the one who does a righteous deed, be he male or female, while he is a believer, then, such people will enter the Jannah (Paradise) where they will be provided with bounties beyond reckoning.
t.85: Whoever does evil will be repaid with its like; whoever does good and believes, be it a man or a woman, will enter Paradise and be provided for without measure.
t.95: Whosoever does an evil deed will be requited only with the like of it; and whosoever acts righteously and has attained to faith � be he a male or a female � they shall enter Paradise and be provided sustenance beyond all reckoning.
t.19: Whoso doeth an ill-deed, he will be repaid the like thereof, while whoso doeth right, whether male or female, and is a believer, (all) such will enter the Garden, where they will be nourished without stint.
t.22: "He that works evil will not be requited but by the like thereof: and he that works a righteous deed - whether man or woman - and is a Believer- such will enter the Garden (of Bliss): Therein will they have abundance without measure.
t.203: "Whosoever does an evil deed, will not be requited except the like thereof; and whosoever does a righteous deed, whether male or female and is a true believer (in the Oneness of Allâh), such will enter Paradise, where they will be provided therein (with all things in abundance) without limit.
t.54: جس نے گناه کیا ہے اسے تو برابر برابر کا بدلہ ہی ہے اور جس نے نیکی کی ہے خواه وه مرد ہو یا عورت اور وه ایمان واﻻ ہو تو یہ لوگ جنت میں جائیں گے اور وہاں بےشمار روزی پائیں گے.

t.149: And O my people, how is it that I call you to salvation and you call me to the Fire?
t.84: And O my people, what is wrong with me that I call you to salvation and you call me to the Fire?
t.85: My people, why do I call you to salvation when you call me to the Fire?
t.95: My people, how is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire;
t.19: And, O my people! What aileth me that I call you unto deliverance when ye call me unto the Fire?
t.22: "And O my people! How (strange) it is for me to call you to Salvation while ye call me to the Fire!
t.203: "And O my people! How is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire!
t.54: اے میری قوم! یہ کیا بات ہے کہ میں تمہیں نجات کی طرف بلا رہا ہوں اور تم مجھے دوزخ کی طرف بلا رہے ہو.

t.149: Youcall me to deny Allah and associate with Him what I have no knowledge of, while I call you to the Almighty, the Forgiver.
t.84: You invite me to reject my belief in Allah and ascribe to Him partners about whom I have no knowledge, while I invite you to (Him who is) the Mighty, the Most-Forgiving.
t.85: You call me to disbelieve in God and to associate with Him things of which I have no knowledge; I call you to the Mighty, the Forgiving One.
t.95: you call me to deny Allah and to associate with Him as His partners those regarding whom I have no knowledge (that they are Allah's partners in His Divinity), whereas I call you to the Most Mighty, the Most Forgiving?
t.19: Ye call me to disbelieve in Allah and ascribe unto Him as partners that whereof I have no knowledge, while I call you unto the Mighty, the Forgiver.
t.22: "Ye do call upon me to blaspheme against Allah, and to join with Him partners of whom I have no knowledge; and I call you to the Exalted in Power, Who forgives again and again!"
t.203: "You invite me to disbelieve in Allâh (and in His Oneness), and to join partners in worship with Him of which I have no knowledge; and I invite you to the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving!
t.54: تم مجھے یہ دعوت دے رہے ہوکہ میں اللہ کے ساتھ کفر کروں اور اس کے ساتھ شرک کروں جس کا کوئی علم مجھے نہیں اور میں تمہیں غالب بخشنے والے (معبود) کی طرف دعوت دے رہا ہوں.

t.149: Without doubt, what youcall me to has no say in the Earlier(Life) or in the Hereafter, and that our turning back is to Allah, and that it is the extremists who are the fellows of the Fire.
t.84: It is obvious that those (gods) to whom you are inviting me are not worth calling, neither in this world nor in the world to come, and that we have to return back to Allah, and that the transgressors are indeed the people of the Fire.
t.85: There is no doubt that what you call me to serve is not fit to be invoked either in this world or the Hereafter: our return is to God alone, and it will be the rebels who will inhabit the Fire.
t.95: There is no doubt that those whom you call me to have no claim to be called upon in this world and in the Hereafter. Certainly to Allah shall be our return, and those who exceed the limits are destined to the Fire.
t.19: Assuredly that whereunto ye call me hath no claim in the world or in the Hereafter, and our return will be unto Allah, and the prodigals will be owners of the Fire.
t.22: "Without doubt ye do call me to one who is not fit to be called to, whether in this world, or in the Hereafter; our return will be to Allah; and the Transgressors will be Companions of the Fire!
t.203: "No doubt you call me to (worship) one who cannot grant (me) my request (or respond to my invocation) in this world or in the Hereafter. And our return will be to Allâh, and Al-Musrifûn (i.e. polytheists and arrogants, those who commit great sins, the transgressors of Allâh’s set limits): they shall be the dwellers of the Fire!
t.54: یہ یقینی امر ہے کہ تم مجھے جس کی طرف بلا رہے ہو وه تو نہ دنیا میں پکارے جانے کے قابل ہے نہ آخرت میں، اور یہ (بھی یقینی بات ہے) کہ ہم سب کا لوٹنا اللہ کی طرف ہے اور حد سے گزر جانے والے ہی (یقیناً) اہل دوزخ ہیں.

t.149: Youwill remember what I am telling you. So I entrust my affairs to Allah; indeed, Allah is All-Seeing of the servants.”
t.84: Soon you will remember what I am saying to you. And I entrust my matter with Allah. Surely, Allah has all (His) servants in sight.”
t.85: [One Day] you will remember what I am saying to you now, so I commit my case to God: God is well aware of His servants.’
t.95: Soon you shall remember what I say to you. I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is watchful over His servants.”
t.19: And ye will remember what I say unto you. I confide my cause unto Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of (His) slaves.
t.22: "Soon will ye remember what I say to you (now), My (own) affair I commit to Allah: for Allah (ever) watches over His Servants."
t.203: "And you will remember what I am telling you, and my affair I leave it to Allâh. Verily, Allâh is the All-Seer of (His) slaves."
t.54: پس آگے چل کر تم میری باتوں کو یاد کرو گے میں اپنا معاملہ اللہ کے سپرد کرتا ہوں، یقیناً اللہ تعالیٰ بندوں کا نگراں ہے.

t.149: So Allah shielded him from the evils of their scheming, while an awful punishment surrounded Pharaoh’s folk:
t.84: Then Allah saved him from the evils of what they designed, and the House of Pharaoh was encircled by an evil punishment.
t.85: So God saved him from the harm they planned. A terrible punishment engulfed Pharaoh’s people;
t.95: Eventually Allah saved the person endowed with faith from all the evils of their guile, and a woeful chastisement encompassed the Pharaonites.
t.19: So Allah warded off from him the evils which they plotted, while a dreadful doom encompassed Pharaoh's folk,
t.22: Then Allah saved him from (every) ill that they plotted (against him), but the brunt of the Penalty encompassed on all sides the People of Pharaoh.
t.203: So Allâh saved him from the evils that they plotted (against him), while an evil torment encompassed Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people.
t.54: پس اسے اللہ تعالیٰ نے تمام بدیوں سے محفوظ رکھ لیا جو انہوں نے سوچ رکھی تھیں اور فرعون والوں پر بری طرح کا عذاب الٹ پڑا.

t.149: the Fire—they are exposed to it in the early morning and at nightfall, and on the day the Hour takes place(it is said) : “EnterPharaoh’s folk into the most intense punishment.”
t.84: It is the Fire before which they are presented morning and evening. And on the day when the Hour (of final judgment) will take place, (the order will be released,): “Admit the family of Pharaoh into the most severe punishment.”
t.85: they will be brought before the Fire morning and evening. On the Day the Hour comes, it will be said, ‘Throw Pharaoh’s people into the worst torment.’
t.95: They are exposed to the Fire every morning and evening; and when the Last Hour will come to pass, a command shall be given: “Admit the Pharaonites to an even more severe chastisement.”
t.19: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening; and on the day when the Hour upriseth (it is said): Cause Pharaoh's folk to enter the most awful doom.
t.22: In front of the Fire will they be brought, morning and evening: And (the sentence will be) on the Day that Judgment will be established: "Cast ye the People of Pharaoh into the severest Penalty!"
t.203: The Fire, they are exposed to it, morning and afternoon. And on the Day when the Hour will be established (it will be said to the angels): "Cause Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people to enter the severest torment!"
t.54: آگ ہے جس کے سامنے یہ ہر صبح شام ﻻئے جاتے ہیں اور جس دن قیامت قائم ہوگی (فرمان ہوگا کہ) فرعونیوں کو سخت ترین عذاب میں ڈالو.

t.149: And as they debate in the Fire, the weak say to the arrogant leaders, “Indeed, we were followers of yours, so will you now spare us a portion of the Fire?”
t.84: And (worth remembering is the time) when they (the infidels) will argue with each other in the Fire. So, the weak will say to those who were arrogant, “Surely, we used to be your followers, would you, then, stand for us in (suffering at least a) part of the (punishment of) Fire?”
t.85: In the Fire they will quarrel with one another: the weak will say to the haughty, ‘We were your followers, so can you now relieve us from some share of the Fire?’
t.95: Just imagine when they will remonstrate with one another in Hell. The weak ones will say to those who waxed proud: “We were your followers. Will you, then, lighten for us a part of our suffering of the Fire?”
t.19: And when they wrangle in the Fire, the weak say unto those who were proud: Lo! we were a following unto you; will ye therefor rid us of a portion of the Fire?
t.22: Behold, they will dispute with each other in the Fire! The weak ones (who followed) will say to those who had been arrogant, "We but followed you: Can ye then take (on yourselves) from us some share of the Fire?
t.203: And, when they will dispute in the Fire, the weak will say to those who were arrogant: "Verily, we followed you: can you then take from us some portion of the Fire?"
t.54: اور جب کہ دوزخ میں ایک دوسرے سے جھگڑیں گے تو کمزور لوگ تکبر والوں سے (جن کے یہ تابع تھے) کہیں گے کہ ہم تو تمہارے پیرو تھے تو کیا اب تم ہم سے اس آگ کا کوئی حصہ ہٹا سکتے ہو؟

t.149: The arrogant leaders said, “We are all in it; indeed, Allah has judged between the servants.”
t.84: Those who were arrogant will say, “We all are in it. Allah has already passed the judgment between (His) servants.
t.85: but they will say, ‘We are all in this together. God has judged between His creatures.’
t.95: Those who had waxed proud will reply: “All of us are in it. Allah has already passed His judgement among His servants.”
t.19: Those who were proud say: Lo! we are all (together) herein. Lo! Allah hath judged between (His) slaves.
t.22: Those who had been arrogant will say: "We are all in this (Fire)! Truly, Allah has judged between (his) Servants!"
t.203: Those who were arrogant will say: "We are all (together) in this (Fire)! Verily, Allâh has judged between (His) slaves!"
t.54: وه بڑے لوگ جواب دیں گے ہم تو سبھی اس آگ میں ہیں، اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کے درمیان فیصلے کر چکا ہے.

t.149: And those in the Fire said to the keepers of Hell, “Call upon your Lord to lighten one day of the punishment for us.”
t.84: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Jahannam (Hell), “Pray to your Lord to lighten the punishment for us some day.”
t.85: Those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, ‘Ask your Lord to lessen our suffering for one day,’
t.95: Those suffering in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell: “Call upon your Lord to lighten the chastisement for us just for a day.”
t.19: And those in the Fire say unto the guards of hell: Entreat your Lord that He relieve us of a day of the torment.
t.22: Those in the Fire will say to the Keepers of Hell: "Pray to your Lord to lighten us the Penalty for a day (at least)!"
t.203: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers (angels) of Hell: "Call upon your Lord to lighten for us the torment for a day!"
t.54: اور (تمام) جہنمی مل کر جہنم کے داروغوں سے کہیں گے کہ تم ہی اپنے پروردگار سے دعا کرو کہ وه کسی دن تو ہمارے عذاب میں کمی کردے.

t.149: They said, “Did not your messengers come to you with evident proofs?” They said, “Yes.” They said, “Then call.” But the calling of the deniers is but in vain.
t.84: They will say, “Had your messengers not been coming to you with open signs?” They will say, “Of course, (they had come).” They (the keepers) will say, “Then, keep praying” - but praying of disbelievers (in the Hereafter) is only in vain.
t.85: but they will say, ‘Did your messengers not come to you with clear evidence of the truth?’ They will say, ‘Yes they did,’ and the keeper will say, ‘You can plead, then, but the pleas of disbelievers will always be in vain.’
t.95: The keepers of Hell will ask: “Did your Messengers not come to you with Clear Signs?” They will say: “Yes (they did).” The keepers of Hell will say: “Then you yourselves should call (upon the Lord). And the call of the unbelievers will end in vain.”
t.19: They say: Came not your messengers unto you with clear proofs? They say: Yea, verily. They say: Then do ye pray, although the prayer of disbelievers is in vain.
t.22: They will say: "Did there not come to you your messengers with Clear Signs?" They will say, "Yes". They will reply, "Then pray (as ye like)! But the prayer of those without Faith is nothing but (futile wandering) in (mazes of) error!"
t.203: They will say: "Did there not come to you, your Messengers with (clear) evidence (and signs)?" They will say: "Yes." They will reply: "Then call (as you like)! And the invocation of the disbelievers is nothing but in vain (as it will not be answered by Allâh)!"
t.54: وه جواب دیں گے کہ کیا تمہارے پاس تمہارے رسول معجزے لے کر نہیں آئے تھے؟ وه کہیں گے کیوں نہیں، وه کہیں گے کہ پھر تم ہی دعا کرو اور کافروں کی دعا محض بے اﺛر اور بےراه ہے.

t.149: Most surely, We support Our messengers and those who have attained faith in the Earlier Life and on the day when all sorts of witnesses arise—
t.84: Surely, We do help Our messengers and the believers, in the worldly life, as well as (we will help them) on the day in which witnesses will stand (to give their testimony)-
t.85: We support Our messengers and the believers, in the present life and on the Day when witnesses arise.
t.95: Surely We shall help Our Messengers and the believers in the life of this world and on the Day when witnesses will rise to testify,
t.19: Lo! We verily do help Our messengers, and those who believe, in the life of the world and on the day when the witnesses arise,
t.22: We will, without doubt, help our messengers and those who believe, (both) in this world's life and on the Day when the Witnesses will stand forth,-
t.203: Verily, We will indeed make victorious Our Messengers and those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) in this world’s life and on the Day when the witnesses will stand forth, (i.e. Day of Resurrection) -
t.54: یقیناً ہم اپنے رسولوں کی اور ایمان والوں کی مدد زندگانیٴ دنیا میں بھی کریں گے اور اس دن بھی جب گواہی دینے والے کھڑے ہوں گے.

t.149: the day when the excuses of the unjust do them no benefit, and for them is the curse, and for them is the worst(final) Home.
t.84: a day when apology of the unjust will bring them no benefit, and on them shall be the curse, and for them will be the evil abode.
t.85: On the Day when excuses will not profit the evildoers, their fate will be rejection and they will have the worst of homes.
t.95: the Day when the excuses offered by the wrong-doers shall not avail them. They shall be victims of the curse and a woeful abode.
t.19: The day when their excuse availeth not the evil-doers, and theirs is the curse, and theirs the ill abode.
t.22: The Day when no profit will it be to Wrong-doers to present their excuses, but they will (only) have the Curse and the Home of Misery.
t.203: The Day when their excuses will be of no profit to Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh). Theirs will be the curse, and theirs will be the evil abode (i.e. painful torment in Hell-fire).
t.54: جس دن ﻇالموں کو ان کی (عذر) معذرت کچھ نفع نہ دے گی ان کے لیے لعنت ہی ہوگی اور ان کے لیے برا گھر ہو گا.

t.149: And certainly We gave Moses the guidance and made the children of Israel inherit the Scripture,
t.84: We gave Guidance to Mūsā, while We made the children of Isrā’īl inherit the Book -
t.85: We gave Moses guidance and passed down the Scripture to the Children of Israel,
t.95: We surely guided Moses and made the Children of Israel the heirs of the Book
t.19: And We verily gave Moses the guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture,
t.22: We did aforetime give Moses the (Book of) Guidance, and We gave the book in inheritance to the Children of Israel,-
t.203: And, indeed We gave Mûsâ (Moses) the guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture [i.e. the Taurât (Torah)] -
t.54: ہم نے موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کو ہدایت نامہ عطا فرمایا اور بنو اسرائیل کو اس کتاب کا وارث بنایا.

t.149: as guidance and a reminding for those endowed with understanding.
t.84: as a guide and advice for people of understanding.
t.85: as a guide and a reminder to people of understanding.
t.95: which was a guidance and good counsel to people endowed with understanding and wisdom.
t.19: A guide and a reminder for men of understanding.
t.22: A Guide and a Message to men of Understanding.
t.203: A guide and a reminder for men of understanding.
t.54: کہ وه ہدایت و نصیحت تھی عقل مندوں کے لیے.

t.149: So be patient; indeed the promise of Allah is true. And ask forgiveness for yourmisdeed and exalt your Lord with praise evening and morning.
t.84: So, be patient - surely the promise of Allah is true - and seek forgiveness for your sins, and proclaim the purity and praise of your Lord in the afternoon and at dawn.
t.85: So be patient, Prophet, for what God has promised is sure to come. Ask forgiveness for your sins; praise your Lord morning and evening.
t.95: Be steadfast, then, (O Prophet), Allah's promise is true. Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings, and celebrate the praise of your Lord, evening and morning.
t.19: Then have patience (O Muhammad). Lo! the promise of Allah is true. And ask forgiveness of thy sin, and hymn the praise of thy Lord at fall of night and in the early hours.
t.22: Patiently, then, persevere: for the Promise of Allah is true: and ask forgiveness for thy fault, and celebrate the Praises of thy Lord in the evening and in the morning.
t.203: So be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). Verily, the Promise of Allâh is true, and ask forgiveness for your fault and glorify the praises of your Lord in the ‘Ashî (i.e. the time period after the midnoon till sunset) and in the Ibkâr (i.e. the time period from early morning or sunrise till before midnoon) [it is said that, that means the five compulsory congregational Salât (prayers) or the ‘Asr and Fajr prayers].
t.54: پس اے نبی! تو صبر کر اللہ کا وعده بلاشک (وشبہ) سچا ہی ہے تو اپنے گناه کی معافی مانگتا ره اور صبح شام اپنے پروردگار کی تسبیح اور حمد بیان کرتا ره.

t.149: Indeed, those who argue against Allah’s signs without any manifestation having come to them—there is nothing in their chests but a feeling of greatness which they will never attain. So seekrefuge in Allah; indeed, it is He who is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
t.84: Surely, those who quarrel in Allah’s verses without any authority having reached them, there is nothing in their hearts but pride of greatness that they are not (able) to reach. So, seek refuge with Allah. Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
t.85: As for those who, with no authority to do so, dispute God’s messages, there is nothing in their hearts but a thirst for a greatness they will never attain. Seek refuge in God, for He is the All Hearing, the All Seeing.
t.95: Verily those who dispute regarding the Signs of Allah without any evidence that might have come to them, nothing but vain pride fills their hearts. Yet they shall never be able to satisfy the pride with which they are puffed up. So seek refuge with Allah. Verily He is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
t.19: Lo! those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without a warrant having come unto them, there is naught else in their breasts save pride which they will never attain. So take thou refuge in Allah. Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Seer.
t.22: Those who dispute about the signs of Allah without any authority bestowed on them,- there is nothing in their breasts but (the quest of) greatness, which they shall never attain to: seek refuge, then, in Allah: It is He Who hears and sees (all things).
t.203: Verily those who dispute about the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh, without any authority having come to them, there is nothing else in their breasts except pride [to accept you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) as a Messenger of Allâh and to obey you]. They will never have it (i.e. Prophethood which Allâh has bestowed upon you). So seek refuge in Allâh (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم from the arrogants). Verily, it is He Who is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer.
t.54: جو لوگ باوجود اپنے پاس کسی سند کے نہ ہونے کے آیات الٰہی میں جھگڑا کرتے ہیں ان کے دلوں میں بجز نری بڑائی کے اور کچھ نہیں وه اس تک پہنچنے والے ہی نہیں، سو تو اللہ کی پناه مانگتا ره بیشک وه پورا سننے واﻻ اور سب سے زیاده دیکھنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: The creation of the heavens and the earth is certainly greater than the creation of humanity, but the majority of mankind does not know.
t.84: Certainly, the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of human beings, but most human beings do not know.
t.85: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater by far than the creation of mankind, though most people do not know it.
t.95: Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is a greater act than the creation of human beings. But most people do not know.
t.19: Assuredly the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of mankind; but most of mankind know not.
t.22: Assuredly the creation of the heavens and the earth is a greater (matter) than the creation of men: Yet most men understand not.
t.203: The creation of the heavens and the earth is indeed greater than the creation of mankind; yet, most of mankind know not.
t.54: آسمان و زمین کی پیدائش یقیناً انسان کی پیدائش سے بہت بڑا کام ہے، لیکن (یہ اور بات ہے کہ) اکثر لوگ بےعلم ہیں.

t.149: And in no way are the blind and the seeing equal, nor are those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds(equal) to the evildoer. How little you remind yourselves!
t.84: The blind one and the sighted one are not equal, and those who believed and did good deeds and the evil ones are not (equal) either. Little you heed to the advice!
t.85: The blind and the sighted are not equal, just as those who believe and do good works and those who do evil are not equal: how seldom you reflect!
t.95: Never can the blind and the seeing be equal; nor those that believe and act righteously and those that do evil. Little do you understand.
t.19: And the blind man and the seer are not equal, neither are those who believe and do good works (equal with) the evil-doer. Little do ye reflect!
t.22: Not equal are the blind and those who (clearly) see: Nor are (equal) those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, and those who do evil. Little do ye learn by admonition!
t.203: And not equal are the blind and those who see; nor are (equal) those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism), and do righteous good deeds, and those who do evil. Little do you remember!
t.54: اندھا اور بینا برابر نہیں نہ وه لوگ جو ایمان ﻻئے اور بھلے کام کیے بدکاروں کے (برابر ہیں)، تم (بہت) کم نصیحت حاصل کر رہے ہو.

t.149: Indeed, the Hour is coming—no doubt about it—but the majority of mankind does not believe.
t.84: Certainly, the Hour is bound to come. There is no doubt in it, but most of the people do not believe.
t.85: The Final Hour is sure to come, without doubt, but most people do not believe.
t.95: The Hour will indeed come; there is no doubt about that. Yet most people do not believe.
t.19: Lo! the Hour is surely coming, there is no doubt thereof; yet most of mankind believe not.
t.22: The Hour will certainly come: Therein is no doubt: Yet most men believe not.
t.203: Verily, the Hour (Day of Judgement) is surely coming, there is no doubt about it, yet most men believe not.
t.54: قیامت بالیقین اور بےشبہ آنے والی ہے، لیکن (یہ اور بات ہے کہ) بہت سے لوگ ایمان نہیں ﻻتے.

t.149: Yet your Lord has said, “Call upon Me(and) I will respond to you. Indeed, those who are too arrogant to serve Me will enter Hell in humiliation.”
t.84: Your Lord has said, “Call Me, I will respond to you. Definitely those who show arrogance against worshipping Me shall enter Jahannam (Hell) with disgrace.
t.85: Your Lord says, ‘Call on Me and I will answer you; those who are too proud to serve Me will enter Hell humiliated.’
t.95: Your Lord said: “Pray to Me, and I will accept your prayers. Surely those who wax too proud to worship Me shall enter Hell, utterly abased.”
t.19: And your Lord hath said: Pray unto Me and I will hear your prayer. Lo! those who scorn My service, they will enter hell, disgraced.
t.22: And your Lord says: "Call on Me; I will answer your (Prayer): but those who are too arrogant to serve Me will surely find themselves in Hell - in humiliation!"
t.203: And your Lord said: "Invoke Me, [i.e. believe in My Oneness (Islâmic Monotheism) and ask Me for anything] I will respond to your (invocation). Verily! Those who scorn My worship [i.e. do not invoke Me, and do not believe in My Oneness, (Islâmic Monotheism)] they will surely enter Hell in humiliation!"
t.54: اور تمہارے رب کا فرمان (سرزد ہوچکا ہے) کہ مجھ سے دعا کرو میں تمہاری دعاؤں کو قبول کروں گا یقین مانو کہ جو لوگ میری عبادت سے خودسری کرتے ہیں وه عنقريب ذلیل ہوکر جہنم میں پہنچ جائیں گے.

t.149: It is Allah Who made the night for you, that you may rest therein, and the day allowing sight; indeed, Allah is certainly Gracious towards mankind, but the majority of mankind does not give thanks.
t.84: Allah is the One who made for you the night, so that you may have rest in it, and the day to let you see. Surely, Allah is most kind to people, but most of the people do not offer gratitude.
t.85: It is God who has given you the night in which to rest and the day in which to see. God is truly bountiful to people, but most people do not give thanks.
t.95: Allah it is Who made the night so that you may seek repose in it, and made the day radiant. Surely Allah is Most Bounteous to people; but most people do not give thanks.
t.19: Allah it is Who hath appointed for you night that ye may rest therein, and day for seeing. Lo! Allah is a Lord of bounty for mankind, yet most of mankind give not thanks.
t.22: It is Allah Who has made the Night for you, that ye may rest therein, and the days as that which helps (you) to see. Verily Allah is full of Grace and Bounty to men: yet most men give no thanks.
t.203: Allâh, it is He Who has made the night for you that you may rest therein and the day for you to see. Truly, Allâh is full of Bounty to mankind; yet, most of mankind give no thanks.
t.54: اللہ تعالیٰ نے تمھارے لیے رات بنادی کہ تم اس میں آرام حاصل کرو اور دن کو دیکھنے واﻻ بنا دیا، بیشک اللہ تعالیٰ لوگوں پر فضل وکرم واﻻ ہے لیکن اکثر لوگ شکر گزاری نہیں کرتے.

t.149: Such is Allah, yourLord, Creator of everything; there is no god except Him, so how can you be averted(from the truth) ?
t.84: This is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. Then, from where are you being reversed (by your selfish desires)?
t.85: Such is God your Lord, the Creator of all things: there is no god but Him. How can you be so deluded?
t.95: Allah (Who bestowed all these favours upon you) is your Lord, the Creator of everything. There is no god but He. Whence are you, then, being led astray?
t.19: Such is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye perverted?
t.22: Such is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, there is no god but He: Then how ye are deluded away from the Truth!
t.203: That is Allâh, your Lord, the Creator of all things: Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). How then are you turning away (from Allâh, by worshipping others instead of Him)?
t.54: یہی اللہ ہے تم سب کا رب ہر چیز کا خالق اس کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں پھر کہاں تم پھرے جاتے ہو.

t.149: Thus are averted those who used to repudiate the signs of Allah.
t.84: Similarly reversed were those who used to deny Our verses.
t.85: This is how deluded those who deny God’s messages are.
t.95: Thus it is only those who had denied Allah's Signs that were led astray.
t.19: Thus are they perverted who deny the revelations of Allah.
t.22: Thus are deluded those who are wont to reject the Signs of Allah.
t.203: Thus were turned away those who used to deny the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh.
t.54: اسی طرح وه لوگ بھی پھیرے جاتے رہے جو اللہ کی آیتوں کا انکار کرتے تھے.

t.149: It is Allah who made the earth a habitat for you, and the sky a structure, and He designed you and perfected your designs, and He provided you with the good things. Such is Allah, your Lord, so supremely blessed be Allah, Lord of all realms.
t.84: Allah is the One who made for you the earth a place to live, and the sky a roof, and shaped you, and made your shapes so good - and provided you with a lot of good things. That is Allah, your Lord. So, Glorious is Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
t.85: It is God who has given you the earth for a dwelling place and the heavens for a canopy. He shaped you, formed you well, and provided you with good things. Such is God your Lord, so glory be to Him, the Lord of the Worlds.
t.95: Allah it is Who made the earth a dwelling place for you and made the sky a canopy, Who shaped you � and shaped you exceedingly well � and gave you good things as sustenance. That is Allah, your Lord; blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Universe.
t.19: Allah it is Who appointed for you the earth for a dwelling-place and the sky for a canopy, and fashioned you and perfected your shapes, and hath provided you with good things. Such is Allah, your Lord. Then blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
t.22: It is Allah Who has made for you the earth as a resting place, and the sky as a canopy, and has given you shape- and made your shapes beautiful,- and has provided for you Sustenance, of things pure and good;- such is Allah your Lord. So Glory to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
t.203: Allâh, it is He Who has made for you the earth as a dwelling place and the sky as a canopy, and has given you shape and made your shapes good (looking) and has provided you with good things. That is Allâh, your Lord: so Blessed be Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: اللہ ہی ہے جس نے تمہارے لیے زمین کو ٹھہرنے کی جگہ اور آسمان کو چھت بنا دیا اور تمہاری صورتیں بنائیں اور بہت اچھی بنائیں اور تمہیں عمده عمده چیزیں کھانے کو عطا فرمائیں، یہی اللہ تمہارا پروردگار ہے، پس بہت ہی برکتوں واﻻ اللہ ہے سارے جہان کا پرورش کرنے واﻻ.

t.149: He is the Living One; there is no god except He, so callupon Him, devoting religion to Him. All praise be to Allah, Lord of all realms.
t.84: He is Ever-living. There is no god but He. So worship Him making your submission exclusive for Him. All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.
t.85: He is the Living One and there is no god but Him, so call on Him, and dedicate your religion entirely to Him. Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.
t.95: He is the Ever-Living: there is no god but He. So call upon Him, consecrating to Him all your devotion. All praise and thanks be to Allah, the Lord of the whole Universe.
t.19: He is the Living One. There is no Allah save Him. So pray unto Him, making religion pure for Him (only). Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
t.22: He is the Living (One): There is no god but He: Call upon Him, giving Him sincere devotion. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
t.203: He is the Ever Living, Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He); so invoke Him making your worship pure for Him Alone (by worshipping Him Alone, and none else, and by doing righteous deeds sincerely for Allâh’s sake only, and not to show off, and not setting up rivals with Him in worship). All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: وه زنده ہے جس کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں پس تم خالص اس کی عبادت کرتے ہوئے اسے پکارو، تمام خوبیاں اللہ ہی کے لیے ہیں جو تمام جہانوں کا رب ہے.

t.149: Say, “Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those whom youcall upon apart from Allah, now that the evident proofs have come to me from my Lord. And I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of all realms.”
t.84: Say, “I have been ordered not to worship those whom you invoke beside Allah when clear signs from my Lord have (already) come to me, and I have been ordered that I should submit to the Lord of the worlds.”
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Since clear evidence has come to me from my Lord I am forbidden to serve those you call upon besides God: I am commanded to submit to the Lord of the Worlds.’
t.95: Say, (O Prophet): “I have been forbidden to worship those beside Allah whom you call upon. (How can I worship any beside Allah) when clear Signs have come to me from my Lord and I have been commanded to surrender to Allah, the Lord of the Universe?”
t.19: Say (O Muhammad): I am forbidden to worship those unto whom ye cry beside Allah since there have come unto me clear proofs from my Lord, and I am commanded to surrender to the Lord of the Worlds.
t.22: Say: "I have been forbidden to invoke those whom ye invoke besides Allah,- seeing that the Clear Signs have come to me from my Lord; and I have been commanded to bow (in Islam) to the Lord of the Worlds."
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I have been forbidden to worship those whom you worship besides Allâh, since there have come to me evidence from my Lord; and I am commanded to submit (in Islâm) to the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! کہ مجھے ان کی عبادت سے روک دیا گیا ہے جنہیں تم اللہ کے سوا پکار رہے ہو اس بنا پر کہ میرے پاس میرے رب کی دلیلیں پہنچ چکی ہیں، مجھے یہ حکم دیا گیا ہے کہ میں تمام جہانوں کے رب کا تابع فرمان ہو جاؤں.

t.149: It is He Who created youfrom dust, then from a drop of semen, then from a clinging form, then He brings you out as infants, then He lets you attain your full strength, then you become elderly—although some of you are taken(at death) sooner—and that you may reach a predetermined age, and so that you may reason.
t.84: He is the One who created you from dust, then from a drop of semen, then from a clot. After that, He takes you out as an infant. Then, (He makes you grow) so that you reach your full maturity, and, thereafter, become old - and some of you die earlier - and so that you reach the appointed term, and so that you understand.
t.85: It is He who created you from dust, then from a drop of fluid, then from a tiny, clinging form, then He brought you forth as infants, then He allowed you to reach maturity, then He let you grow old- though some of you die sooner- and reach your appointed term so that you may reflect.
t.95: He it is Who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clot; then He brings you out as an infant, then causes you to grow into full maturity, and then causes you to grow further so that you may reach old age, while some of you He recalls earlier. All this is in order that you may reach an appointed term and that you may understand (the Truth).
t.19: He it is Who created you from dust, then from a drop (of seed) then from a clot, then bringeth you forth as a child, then (ordaineth) that ye attain full strength and afterward that ye become old men - though some among you die before - and that ye reach an appointed term, that haply ye may understand.
t.22: It is He Who has created you from dust then from a sperm-drop, then from a leech-like clot; then does he get you out (into the light) as a child: then lets you (grow and) reach your age of full strength; then lets you become old,- though of you there are some who die before;- and lets you reach a Term appointed; in order that ye may learn wisdom.
t.203: It is He, Who has created you (Adam) from dust, then from a Nutfah [mixed semen drops of male and female sexual discharge (i.e. Adam’s offspring)] then from a clot (a piece of coagulated blood), then brings you forth as an infant, then (makes you grow) to reach the age of full strength, and afterwards to be old (men and women)- though some among you die before,- and that you reach an appointed term in order that you may understand.
t.54: وه وہی ہے جس نے تمہیں مٹی سے پھر نطفے سے پھر خون کے لوتھڑے سے پیدا کیا پھر تمہیں بچہ کی صورت میں نکالتا ہے، پھر (تمہیں بڑھاتا ہے کہ) تم اپنی پوری قوت کو پہنچ جاؤ پھر بوڑھے ہو جاؤ، تم میں سے بعض اس سے پہلے ہی فوت ہو جاتے ہیں، (وه تمہیں چھوڑ دیتا ہے) تاکہ تم مدت معین تک پہنچ جاؤ اور تاکہ تم سوچ سمجھ لو.

t.149: It is He who gives life and death, so whenever He decrees a matter, He only says to it, “Be,” and so it is .
t.84: He is the One who gives life and brings death, and when He decides to do something, He only says to it: “Be” and it comes to be.
t.85: It is He who gives life and death, and when He ordains a thing, He says only ‘Be’ and it is.
t.95: He it is Who gives life and causes death. Whenever He decrees a thing, He only commands to it “Be”, and it is.
t.19: He it is Who quickeneth and giveth death. When He ordaineth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
t.22: It is He Who gives Life and Death; and when He decides upon an affair, He says to it, "Be", and it is.
t.203: It is He Who gives life and causes death. And when He decides upon a thing He says to it only: "Be!" - and it is.
t.54: وہی ہے جو جلاتا ہے اور مار ڈالتا ہے، پھر جب وه کسی کام کا کرنا مقرر کرتا ہے تو اسے صرف یہ کہتا ہے کہ ہو جا پس وه ہو جاتا ہے.

t.149: Have younot seen those who argue regarding Allah’s signs? How are they turned away?
t.84: Have you not seen those who quarrel in Allah’s verses? From where are they being turned away (by their selfish desires?)
t.85: [Prophet], do you see how deluded those who dispute God’s messages are-
t.95: Did you not see those who dispute concerning Allah's Signs? Whence are they, then, being turned astray?
t.19: Hast thou not seen those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah, how they are turned away? -
t.22: Seest thou not those that dispute concerning the Signs of Allah? How are they turned away (from Reality)?-
t.203: See you not those who dispute about the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allâh? How are they turning away [from the truth, (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism to the falsehood (i.e. polytheism)]?
t.54: کیا تو نے انہیں دیکھا جو اللہ کی آیتوں میں جھگڑتے ہیں، وه کہاں پھیر دیے جاتے ہیں.

t.149: Those who disbelieved the Scripture and what We sent Our messengers with, for they will come to know
t.84: - those who rejected the Book and what We sent with Our messengers. So, they will soon come to know,
t.85: those who reject the Scripture and the messages We have sent through Our messengers? They will find out
t.95: Those who gave the lie to this Book and all the Books which We had sent with Our Messengers shall soon come to know the Truth
t.19: Those who deny the Scripture and that wherewith We send Our messengers. But they will come to know,
t.22: Those who reject the Book and the (revelations) with which We sent our messengers: but soon shall they know,-
t.203: Those who deny the Book (this Qur’ân), and that with which We sent Our Messengers (i.e. to worship none but Allâh Alone sincerely, and to reject all false deities and to confess resurrection after the death for recompense) they will come to know (when they will be cast into the Fire of Hell).
t.54: جن لوگوں نے کتاب کو جھٹلایا اور اسے بھی جو ہم نے اپنے رسولوں کے ساتھ بھیجا انہیں ابھی ابھی حقیقت حال معلوم ہو جائے گی.

t.149: when the yokes are around their necks, as well as the chains, as they are dragged
t.84: when shackles will be round their necks, and chains. They will be dragged
t.85: when, with iron collars and chains around their necks, they are dragged
t.95: when fetters and chains shall be on their necks, and they shall be dragged into
t.19: When carcans are about their necks and chains. They are dragged
t.22: When the yokes (shall be) round their necks, and the chains; they shall be dragged along-
t.203: When iron collars will be rounded over their necks, and the chains, they shall be dragged along,
t.54: جب کہ ان کی گردنوں میں طوق ہوں گے اور زنجیریں ہوں گی گھسیٹے جائیں گے.

t.149: into the scalding water, then in the Fire they are seethed.
t.84: into the hot water after which they will be thrown into the Fire as a fuel.
t.85: into scalding water, and then burned in the Fire,
t.95: boiling water, and cast into the Fire.
t.19: Through boiling waters; then they are thrust into the Fire.
t.22: In the boiling fetid fluid: then in the Fire shall they be burned;
t.203: In the boiling water, then they will be burned in the Fire.
t.54: کھولتے ہوئے پانی میں اور پھر جہنم کی آگ میں جلائے جائیں گے.

t.149: Then it was saidto them, “Where are those you used to associate
t.84: Then, it will be said to them, “Where are those whom you used to associate (in worship)
t.85: and asked, ‘Where now are those you called upon
t.95: It will then be said to them: “Where are those whom you
t.19: Then it is said unto them: Where are (all) that ye used to make partners (in the Sovereignty)
t.22: Then shall it be said to them: "Where are the (deities) to which ye gave part-worship-
t.203: Then it will be said to them: "Where are (all) those whom you used to join in worship as partners
t.54: پھر ان سے پوچھا جائے گا کہ جنہیں تم شریک کرتے تھے وه کہاں ہیں.

t.149: apart from Allah?” They said, “They have strayed from us. In fact, we were calling upon nothing before.” Thus Allah misguides the deniers.
t.84: beside Allah?” They will say, “They are lost to us, rather, we used to invoke nothing at all.” This is how Allah makes disbelievers get lost.
t.85: besides God?’ They will say, ‘They have abandoned us: those we called upon before were really nothing at all.’ ‘This is how God lets disbelievers go astray,
t.95: associated with Allah in His Divinity?” They will say: “We have lost them; rather, we never used to call upon anyone before.” Thus will Allah cause them to stumble in error.
t.19: Beside Allah? They say: They have failed us; but we used not to pray to anything before. Thus doth Allah send astray the disbelievers (in His guidance).
t.22: "In derogation of Allah?" They will reply: "They have left us in the lurch: Nay, we invoked not, of old, anything (that had real existence)." Thus does Allah leave the Unbelievers to stray.
t.203: "Besides Allâh"? They will say: "They have vanished from us: Nay, we did not invoke (worship) anything before." Thus Allâh leads astray the disbelievers.
t.54: جو اللہ کے سوا تھے وه کہیں گے کہ وه تو ہم سے بہک گئے بلکہ ہم تو اس سے پہلے کسی کو بھی پکارتے ہی نہ تھے۔ اللہ تعالیٰ کافروں کو اسی طرح گمراه کرتا ہے.

t.149: “That is on account of how youused to rejoice on earth in untruth and on account of how you used to behave with vanity.
t.84: (It will be said to them,) “This is because you used to rejoice on the earth wrongfully, and because you used to show arrogance.
t.85: all because on earth you revelled in untruth and ran wild.
t.95: (They will be told): “This is because while you were on earth you took delight in untruth and exulted in it.
t.19: (And it is said unto them): This is because ye exulted in the earth without right, and because ye were petulant.
t.22: "That was because ye were wont to rejoice on the earth in things other than the Truth, and that ye were wont to be insolent.
t.203: That was because you had been exulting in the earth without any right (by worshipping others instead of Allâh and by committing crimes), and that you used to rejoice extremely (in your error).
t.54: یہ بدلہ ہے اس چیز کا جو تم زمین میں ناحق پھولے نہ سماتے تھے۔ اور (بےجا) اتراتے پھرتے تھے.

t.149: Enterthe gates of Hell, abiding therein. So how miserable is the dwelling of the arrogant!”
t.84: Enter the gates of Jahannam to live in it forever. So, how evil is the abode of the arrogant.
t.85: Enter the gates of Hell, there to remain- an evil home for the arrogant.’
t.95: Enter Hell now to abide in it. How woeful is the abode of those who wax proud!
t.19: Enter ye the gates of hell, to dwell therein. Evil is the habitation of the scornful.
t.22: "Enter ye the gates of Hell, to dwell therein: and evil is (this) abode of the arrogant!"
t.203: Enter the gates of Hell to abide therein: and (indeed) what an evil abode of the arrogant!
t.54: (اب آؤ) جہنم میں ہمیشہ رہنے کے لیے (اس کے) دروازوں میں داخل ہو جاؤ، کیا ہی بری جگہ ہے تکبر کرنے والے کی.

t.149: So be patient; indeed, the promise of Allah is true. So whether We show you some of what We have promised them or take you up to Us, to Us they are returned .
t.84: Therefore, be patient. Surely, Allah’s promise is true. Then, (O Prophet,) whether We show you (in your life) a part of the promise We are making to them, or make you die (before they are punished), in any case they have to be returned to Us.
t.85: So be patient [Prophet], for God’s promise is sure: whether We show you part of what We have promised them in this life or whether We take your soul back to Us first, it is to Us that they will be returned.
t.95: So be patient, (O Prophet). Surely Allah's promise is true. Whether We show them a part of the woeful consequences against which We warn them (while you are still in their midst) or We recall you (from this world) before that, eventually it is to Us that they shall be brought back.
t.19: Then have patience (O Muhammad). Lo! the promise of Allah is true. And whether we let thee see a part of that which We promise them, or (whether) We cause thee to die, still unto Us they will be brought back.
t.22: So persevere in patience; for the Promise of Allah is true: and whether We show thee (in this life) some part of what We promise them,- or We take thy soul (to Our Mercy) (before that),-(in any case) it is to Us that they shall (all) return.
t.203: So be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم); verily, the Promise of Allâh is true and whether We show you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم in this world) some part of what We have promised them, or We cause you to die then still it is to Us they all shall be returned.
t.54: پس آپ صبر کریں اللہ کا وعده قطعاً سچا ہے، انہیں ہم نے جو وعدے دے رکھے ہیں ان میں سے کچھ ہم آپ کو دکھائیں یا (اس سے پہلے) ہم آپ کو وفات دے دیں، ان کا لوٹایا جانا تو ہماری ہی طرف ہے.

t.149: And surely We sent messengers before you, some of whose stories We related to you, and some We did not. And it was never for any messenger to bring about a sign except by Allah’s leave. So when the command of Allah comes, matters are decreed between them with fairness, and there and then the advocates of falsehood will lose.
t.84: We had sent messengers before you. Among them there are those whose history We have narrated to you, and of them there are those whose history We did not narrate to you. And it is not up to a messenger that he could come up with a sign without permission from Allah. So, when the command of Allah will come, matters will stand decided justly, and on that occasion all adherents of falsehood will turn into losers.
t.85: We have sent other messengers before you- some We have mentioned to you and some We have not- and no messenger could bring about a sign except with God’s permission. When [the Day] God ordained comes, just judgement will be passed between them: there and then, those who followed falsehood will be lost.
t.95: Indeed We sent many Messengers before you: of them there are some whose account We have narrated to you and there are others whose account We have not narrated to you. It did not lie in any Messenger's power to bring any Sign except with Allah's leave. So when Allah's decree came, the matter was decided with justice, and those steeped in error courted utter loss, then and there.
t.19: Verily We sent messengers before thee, among them those of whom We have told thee, and some of whom We have not told thee; and it was not given to any messenger that he should bring a portent save by Allah's leave, but when Allah's commandment cometh (the cause) is judged aright, and the followers of vanity will then be lost.
t.22: We did aforetime send messengers before thee: of them there are some whose story We have related to thee, and some whose story We have not related to thee. It was not (possible) for any messenger to bring a sign except by the leave of Allah: but when the Command of Allah issued, the matter was decided in truth and justice, and there perished, there and then those who stood on Falsehoods.
t.203: And, indeed We have sent Messengers before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): of some of them We have related to you their story. And of some We have not related to you their story, and it was not given to any Messenger that he should bring a sign except by the Leave of Allâh. But, when comes the Commandment of Allâh, the matter will be decided with truth, and the followers of falsehood will then be lost.
t.54: یقیناً ہم آپ سے پہلے بھی بہت سے رسول بھیج چکے ہیں جن میں سے بعض کے (واقعات) ہم آپ کو بیان کر چکے ہیں اور ان میں سے بعض کے (قصے) تو ہم نے آپ کو بیان ہی نہیں کیے اور کسی رسول کا یہ (مقدور) نہ تھا کہ کوئی معجزه اللہ کی اجازت کے بغیر ﻻ سکے پھر جس وقت اللہ کا حکم آئےگا حق کے ساتھ فیصلہ کر دیا جائے گا اور اس جگہ اہل باطل خسارے میں ره جائیں گے.

t.149: It is Allah who made livestock for you, that you may ride some of them and of some you eat.
t.84: Allah is the One who made for you the cattle, so that you may ride some of them,- and of them you eat;
t.85: It is God who provides livestock for you, some for riding and some for your food;
t.95: Allah it is Who has made cattle for you so that you ride some of them and from some of them you derive food.
t.19: Allah it is Who hath appointed for you cattle, that ye may ride on some of them, and eat of some -
t.22: It is Allah Who made cattle for you, that ye may use some for riding and some for food;
t.203: Allâh, it is He Who has made cattle for you, that you may ride on some of them, and of some you eat.
t.54: اللہ وه ہے جس نے تمہارے لیے چوپائے پیدا کیے جن میں سے بعض پر تم سوار ہوتے ہو اور بعض کو تم کھاتے ہو.

t.149: And in them you have benefits, and through them you satisfy a need within your chests, and on them and on ships you are carried.
t.84: and for you there are (other) benefits in them- and so that, (by riding) on them, you meet any need you have in your hearts; and on them and on boats you are carried.
t.85: you have other benefits in them too. You can reach any destination you wish on them: they carry you, as ships carry you [on the sea].
t.95: In them there are also other benefits for you, and through them you fulfil your heartfelt need (to reach places), and you are borne along upon them as upon the ships.
t.19: (Many) benefits ye have from them - and that ye may satisfy by their means a need that is in your breasts, and may be borne upon them as upon the ship.
t.22: And there are (other) advantages in them for you (besides); that ye may through them attain to any need (there may be) in your hearts; and on them and on ships ye are carried.
t.203: And you have (many other) benefits from them, and that you may reach by their means a desire that is in your breasts (i.e. carry your goods, loads, etc.), and on them and on ships you are carried.
t.54: اور بھی تمہارے لیے ان میں بہت سے نفع ہیں اور تاکہ اپنے سینوں میں چھپی ہوئی حاجتوں کو انہی پر سواری کر کے تم حاصل کر لو اور ان چوپایوں پر اور کشتیوں پر سوار کیے جاتے ہو.

t.149: And He shows youHis signs, so which of Allah’s signs do you deny?
t.84: He shows you His signs. Then, which of the signs of Allah would you (still) deny?
t.85: He shows you His signs: which of God’s signs do you still ignore?
t.95: Allah shows His Signs to you; then which of Allah's Signs will you deny?
t.19: And He showeth you His tokens. Which, then, of the tokens of Allah do ye deny?
t.22: And He shows you (always) His Signs: then which of the Signs of Allah will ye deny?
t.203: And He shows you His Ayât (signs and proofs) (of His Oneness in all the above-mentioned things). Which, then of the Ayât (signs and proofs) of Allâh do you deny?
t.54: اللہ تمہیں اپنی نشانیاں دکھاتا جارہا ہے، پس تم اللہ کی کن کن نشانیوں کے منکر بنتے رہو گے.

t.149: Have they not journeyed through the earth and looked at how the outcome was for those before them? They were superior to them in strength and in the traces which they left in the land, but what they had achieved availed them nothing.
t.84: Have they not traveled through the earth and seen how was the fate of those before them? Most of them were more in numbers than these, and superior in vigor and vestiges left on the earth. So then, whatever they used to earn did not work for them at all.
t.85: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how those who lived before them met their end? They were more numerous than them, stronger than them, and made a more impressive mark on the land, yet what they achieved was of no use to them at all.
t.95: Did they not journey in the land that they may behold the end of those who had gone before them? They were more numerous and greater in strength and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Yet their attainments did not avail them.
t.19: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those before them? They were more numerous than these, and mightier in power and (in the) traces (which they left behind them) in the earth. But all that they used to earn availed them not.
t.22: Do they not travel through the earth and see what was the End of those before them? They were more numerous than these and superior in strength and in the traces (they have left) in the land: Yet all that they accomplished was of no profit to them.
t.203: Have they not travelled through the earth and seen what was the end of those before them? They were more in number than them and mightier in strength, and in the traces (they have left behind them) in the land; yet all that they used to earn availed them not.
t.54: کیا انہوں نے زمین میں چل پھر کر اپنے سے پہلوں کا انجام نہیں دیکھا؟ جو ان سے تعداد میں زیاده تھے قوت میں سخت اور زمین میں بہت ساری یادگاریں چھوڑی تھیں، ان کے کیے کاموں نے انہیں کچھ بھی فائده نہیں پہنچایا.

t.149: When their messengers came to them with evident proofs they rejoiced in the knowledge they had, so they became surrounded by what they used to ridicule.
t.84: When their messengers came to them with manifest signs, they exulted because of whatever knowledge they had, and they were encircled by what they used to ridicule.
t.85: When messengers came to them with clear signs, they revelled in the knowledge they had, and so they were engulfed by the very punishment they mocked:
t.95: When their Messengers came to them with Clear Signs, they arrogantly exulted in whatever knowledge they had. They were then encompassed by what they had mocked.
t.19: And when their messengers brought them clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) they exulted in the knowledge they (themselves) possessed. And that which they were wont to mock befell them.
t.22: For when their messengers came to them with Clear Signs, they exulted in such knowledge (and skill) as they had; but that very (Wrath) at which they were wont to scoff hemmed them in.
t.203: Then when their Messengers came to them with clear proofs, they were glad (and proud) with that which they had of the knowledge (of worldly things). And that at which they used to mock, surrounded them (i.e. the punishment).
t.54: پس جب بھی ان کے پاس ان کے رسول کھلی نشانیاں لے کر آئے تو یہ اپنے پاس کے علم پر اترانے لگے، بالﺂخر جس چیز کو مذاق میں اڑا رہے تھے وه ان پر الٹ پڑی.

t.149: Then when they witnessed Our chastisement they said, “We believe in Allah alone and we deny what we used to associate with Him.”
t.84: When they saw Our punishment, they said, “We have (now) come to believe in Allah alone, and We have rejected everything we used to ascribe (to Him) as partners.”
t.85: when they saw Our punishment, they said, ‘We believe in God alone; we reject any partner we ascribed to Him,’
t.95: When they saw Our chastisement, they said: “We have come to believe in Allah, the Only One, and we reject all what we had associated (with Allah in His Divinity).”
t.19: Then, when they saw Our doom, they said: We believe in Allah only and reject (all) that we used to associate (with Him).
t.22: But when they saw Our Punishment, they said: "We believe in Allah,- the one Allah - and we reject the partners we used to join with Him."
t.203: So when they saw Our punishment, they said: "We believe in Allâh Alone and reject (all) that we used to associate with Him as (His) partners.
t.54: ہمارا عذاب دیکھتے ہی کہنے لگے کہ اللہ واحد پر ہم ایمان ﻻئے اور جن جن کو ہم اس کا شریک بنا رہے تھے ہم نے ان سب سے انکار کیا.

t.149: But their faith could not help them once they witnessed Our chastisement; such has been Allah’s rule in(dealing with) His servants, and there and then did the deniers lose.
t.84: But, their profession of faith was not (competent) to benefit them, once they had seen Our punishment - a customary practice of Allah that has been there all along in the matter of His servants - and hence, the disbelievers became the losers.
t.85: but believing after seeing Our punishment did not benefit them at all- this has always been God’s way of dealing with His creatures- there and then the disbelievers were lost.
t.95: But their believing after they had seen Our chastisement did not avail them. That has been Allah's Way concerning His servants. And the unbelievers courted utter loss, then and there.
t.19: But their faith could not avail them when they saw Our doom. This is Allah's law which hath ever taken course for His bondmen. And then the disbelievers will be ruined.
t.22: But their professing the Faith when they (actually) saw Our Punishment was not going to profit them. (Such has been) Allah's Way of dealing with His Servants (from the most ancient times). And even thus did the Rejecters of Allah perish (utterly)!
t.203: Then their Faith (in Islâmic Monotheism) could not avail them when they saw Our punishment. (Like) this has been the way of Allâh in dealing with His slaves. And there the disbelievers lost utterly (when Our Torment covered them).
t.54: لیکن ہمارے عذاب کو دیکھ لینے کے بعد ان کے ایمان نے انہیں نفع نہ دیا۔ اللہ نے اپنا معمول یہی مقرر کر رکھا ہے جو اس کے بندوں میں برابر چلا آ رہا ہے۔ اور اس جگہ کافر خراب وخستہ ہوئے.

t.149: Ha Mīm.
t.84: Hā Mīm
t.85: Ha Mim
t.95: Ha'. Mim.
t.19: Ha. Mim.
t.22: Ha Mim:
t.203: Hâ-Mîm.
t.54: حٰم.

t.149: A bestowal from on high by the All-Merciful, the Bestower of mercy—
t.84: This is a revelation from the All-Merciful, the Very-Merciful-
t.85: A revelation from the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy;
t.95: This is a revelation from the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate,
t.19: A revelation from the Beneficent, the Merciful,
t.22: A Revelation from (Allah), Most Gracious, Most Merciful;-
t.203: A revelation from (Allâh), the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
t.54: اتاری ہوئی ہے بڑے مہربان بہت رحم والے کی طرف سے.*

t.149: a Scripture whose signswere detailed as an Arabic Recitalfor people who know.
t.84: - a book whose verses are elaborated in the form of an Arabic Qur’ān for a people who understand,
t.85: a Scripture whose verses are made distinct as a Quran in Arabic for people who understand,
t.95: a Book whose verses have been well-expounded; an Arabic Qur'an for those who have knowledge,
t.19: A Scripture whereof the verses are expounded, a Lecture in Arabic for people who have knowledge,
t.22: A Book, whereof the verses are explained in detail;- a Qur'an in Arabic, for people who understand;-
t.203: A Book whereof the Verses are explained in detail - a Qur’ân in Arabic for people who know.
t.54: (ایسی) کتاب ہے جس کی آیتوں کی واضح تفصیل کی گئی ہے، (اس حال میں کہ) قرآن عربی زبان میں ہے اس قوم کے لیے جو جانتی ہے.

t.149: A herald of glad tidings and a warner, but most of them disregard(it), so they do not hear.
t.84: as a bearer of good news and warning. Yet most of them turned away, so they do not listen.
t.85: giving good news and warning. Yet most of them turn away and so do not hear.
t.95: one bearing good news and warning. Yet most of them turned away and are not wont to give heed.
t.19: Good tidings and a warning. But most of them turn away so that they hear not.
t.22: Giving good news and admonition: yet most of them turn away, and so they hear not.
t.203: Giving glad tidings [of Paradise to the one who believes in the Oneness of Allâh (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism) and fears Allâh much (abstains from all kinds of sins and evil deeds) and loves Allâh much (performing all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained)], and warning (of punishment in the Hell-Fire to the one who disbelieves in the Oneness of Allâh), but most of them turn away, so they hear not.
t.54: خوش خبری سنانے واﻻ اور ڈرانے واﻻ ہے، پھر بھی ان کی اکثریت نے منھ پھیر لیا اور وه سنتے ہی نہیں.

t.149: And they said, “Our hearts are screened from what youcall us to, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a barrier. So do what you want, and so will we.”
t.84: And they say, “Our hearts are (wrapped) in covers against that (faith) to which you invite us, and there is deafness in our ears, and there is a barrier between you and us. So, do (in your way). We too are doing (in our own way)”.
t.85: They say, ‘Our hearts are encased against [the faith] you call us to; our ears are heavy; there is a barrier between us and you. So you do whatever you want, and so shall we.’
t.95: They say: “Our hearts are securely wrapped up against what you call us to, and in our ears is a heaviness, and between you and us there is a veil. So act; we too are acting.”
t.19: And they say: Our hearts are protected from that unto which thou (O Muhammad) callest us, and in our ears there is a deafness, and between us and thee there is a veil. Act, then. Lo! we also shall be acting.
t.22: They say: "Our hearts are under veils, (concealed) from that to which thou dost invite us, and in our ears in a deafness, and between us and thee is a screen: so do thou (what thou wilt); for us, we shall do (what we will!)"
t.203: And they say: "Our hearts are under coverings (screened) from that to which you invite us; and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a screen: so work you (on your way); verily, we are working (on our way)."
t.54: اور انہوں نے کہا کہ تو جس کی طرف ہمیں بلا رہا ہے ہمارے دل تو اس سے پردے میں ہیں اور ہمارے کانوں میں گرانی ہے اور ہم میں اور تجھ میں ایک حجاب ہے، اچھا تو اب اپنا کام کیے جا ہم بھی یقیناً کام کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: Say, “I am only a human being like you. To me it is revealed that your god is One God. So be upright towards Him and seek forgiveness from Him.” And woe to the polytheists—
t.84: Say, “I am but a human being like you; it is revealed to me that your god is only One God. So, turn straight towards Him, and seek forgiveness from Him, and woe to the Mushriks (those who ascribe partners to Allah)
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘I am only a mortal like you, [but] it has been revealed to me that your God is One. Take the straight path to Him and seek His forgiveness. Woe to the idolaters,
t.95: Tell them, (O Prophet): “I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God is One God; so direct yourselves straight to Him, and seek His forgiveness. Woe to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity,
t.19: Say (unto them O Muhammad): I am only a mortal like you. It is inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah, therefor take the straight path unto Him and seek forgiveness of Him. And woe unto the idolaters,
t.22: Say thou: "I am but a man like you: It is revealed to me by Inspiration, that your Allah is one Allah: so stand true to Him, and ask for His Forgiveness." And woe to those who join gods with Allah,-
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your Ilâh (God) is One Ilâh (God - Allâh), therefore take Straight Path to Him (with true Faith - Islâmic Monotheism) and obedience to Him, and seek forgiveness of Him. And woe to Al-Mushrikûn (the polytheists, idolaters, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh).
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجیئے! کہ میں تو تم ہی جیسا انسان ہوں مجھ پر وحی نازل کی جاتی ہے کہ تم سب کا معبود ایک اللہ ہی ہے سو تم اس کی طرف متوجہ ہو جاؤ اور اس سے گناہوں کی معافی چاہو، اور ان مشرکوں کے لیے (بڑی ہی) خرابی ہے.

t.149: those who do not bring about the purifying act, and regarding the Hereafter they are deniers.
t.84: who do not pay Zakāh ; and of the life of the Hereafter, they are deniers.”
t.85: who do not pay the prescribed alms and refuse to believe in the world to come!
t.95: who do not pay Zakah, and who deny the Hereafter.
t.19: Who give not the poor-due, and who are disbelievers in the Hereafter.
t.22: Those who practise not regular Charity, and who even deny the Hereafter.
t.203: Those who give not the Zakât and they are disbelievers in the Hereafter.
t.54: جو زکوٰة نہیں دیتے اورآخرت کے بھی منکر ہی رہتے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—for them is an unfailing reward.
t.84: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them there is a reward that will never be interrupted.
t.85: Those who believe and do good deeds will have a reward that never fails.’
t.95: As to those who have faith and do good works, surely theirs shall be a never-ending reward.
t.19: Lo! as for those who believe and do good works, for them is a reward enduring.
t.22: For those who believe and work deeds of righteousness is a reward that will never fail.
t.203: Truly, those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, for them will be an endless reward that will never stop (i.e. Paradise).
t.54: بیشک جو لوگ ایمان ﻻئیں اور بھلے کام کریں ان کے لیے نہ ختم ہونے واﻻ اجر ہے.

t.149: Say, “Can it be that youreally deny the One Who created the earth in two(heavenly) days and attribute rivals to Him? That is the Lord of all realms.”
t.84: Say, “Do you really disbelieve in the One who has created the earth in two days, and ascribe to Him partners? That is the Lord of the worlds.
t.85: Say, ‘How can you disregard the One who created the earth in two Days? How can you set up other gods as His equals? He is the Lord of all the worlds!’
t.95: Tell them, (O Prophet): “Do you indeed disbelieve in Him and assign compeers to Him Who created the earth in two days? He is the Lord of all beings of the Universe.
t.19: Say (O Muhammad, unto the idolaters): Disbelieve ye verily in Him Who created the earth in two Days, and ascribe ye unto Him rivals? He (and none else) is the Lord of the Worlds.
t.22: Say: Is it that ye deny Him Who created the earth in two Days? And do ye join equals with Him? He is the Lord of (all) the Worlds.
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Do you verily disbelieve in Him Who created the earth in two Days? And you set up rivals (in worship) with Him? That is the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! کہ کیا تم اس (اللہ) کا انکار کرتے ہو اور تم اس کے شریک مقرر کرتے ہو جس نے دو دن میں زمین پیدا کردی، سارے جہانوں کا پروردگار وہی ہے.

t.149: And He made therein firm mountains on top of it, and He blessed it and determined its sustenance in four days, equal, for those who ask.
t.84: He has placed firm mountains in it (the earth) towering above it, and put blessings in it, and proportioned its foods therein, in four days, equal for those who ask.
t.85: He placed solid mountains on it, blessed it, measured out its varied provisions for all who seek them––all in four Days.
t.95: (After creating the earth) He set up firm mountains on it, blessed it, and provided it with sustenance in proportion to the needs of all who seek (sustenance). All this was done in four days.
t.19: He placed therein firm hills rising above it, and blessed it and measured therein its sustenance in four Days, alike for (all) who ask;
t.22: He set on the (earth), mountains standing firm, high above it, and bestowed blessings on the earth, and measure therein all things to give them nourishment in due proportion, in four Days, in accordance with (the needs of) those who seek (Sustenance).
t.203: He placed therein (i.e. the earth) firm mountains from above it, and He blessed it, and measured therein its sustenance (for its dwellers) in four Days equal (i.e. all these four days were equal in the length of time) for all those who ask (about its creation).
t.54: اور اس نے زمین میں اس کے اوپر سے پہاڑ گاڑ دیے اوراس میں برکت رکھ دی اوراس میں (رہنے والوں کی) غذاؤں کی تجویز بھی اسی میں کر دی (صرف) چار دن میں، ضرورت مندوں کے لیے یکساں طور پر.

t.149: Then He settledto the heaven while it was smoke, and said to it and to the earth, “Come, willingly or reluctantly.” They said, “We have come willingly.”
t.84: Then He turned straight to the sky, while it was a smoke, and said to it and to the earth, “Come (to My obedience), both of you, willingly or unwillingly.” Both said, “We come willingly.”
t.85: Then He turned to the sky, which was smoke––He said to it and the earth, ‘Come into being, willingly or not,’ and they said, ‘We come willingly’––
t.95: Then He turned to the heaven while it was all smoke. He said to the heaven and the earth: “Come (into being), willingly or unwillingly.” They said: “Here we come (into being) in willing obeisance.”
t.19: Then turned He to the heaven when it was smoke, and said unto it and unto the earth: Come both of you, willingly or loth. They said: We come, obedient.
t.22: Moreover He comprehended in His design the sky, and it had been (as) smoke: He said to it and to the earth: "Come ye together, willingly or unwillingly." They said: "We do come (together), in willing obedience."
t.203: Then He rose over (Istawâ) towards the heaven when it was smoke, and said to it and to the earth: "Come both of you willingly or unwillingly." They both said: "We come willingly."
t.54: پھر آسمان کی طرف متوجہ ہوا اور وه دھواں (سا) تھا پس اس سے اور زمین سے فرمایا کہ تم دونوں خوشی سے آؤ یا ناخوشی سے دونوں نے عرض کیا ہم بخوشی حاضر ہیں.

t.149: So He decreed them as seven heavens in two days, and He revealed within each heaven its command. And We adorned the lowestheaven with lamps, and for preservation; that is the determining of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
t.84: So He accomplished them as seven skies in two days, and settled in every sky its (due) thing. And We have decorated the closest sky with lamps, and protected it properly. All this is the determination of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
t.85: and in two Days He formed seven heavens, and assigned an order to each. We have made the nearest one beautifully illuminated and secure. Such is the design of the Almighty, the All Knowing.
t.95: Then He made them seven heavens in two days and revealed to each heaven its law. And We adorned the lower heaven with lamps, and firmly secured it. All this is the firm plan of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
t.19: Then He ordained them seven heavens in two Days and inspired in each heaven its mandate; and We decked the nether heaven with lamps, and rendered it inviolable. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Knower.
t.22: So He completed them as seven firmaments in two Days, and He assigned to each heaven its duty and command. And We adorned the lower heaven with lights, and (provided it) with guard. Such is the Decree of (Him) the Exalted in Might, Full of Knowledge.
t.203: Then He completed and finished from their creation (as) seven heavens in two Days and He made in each heaven its affair. And We adorned the nearest (lowest) heaven with lamps (stars) to be an adornment as well as to guard (from the devils by using them as missiles against the devils). Such is the Decree of Him the All-Mighty, the All-Knower.
t.54: پس دو دن میں سات آسمان بنا دیئے اور ہر آسمان میں اس کے مناسب احکام کی وحی بھیج دی اور ہم نے آسمان دنیا کو چراغوں سے زینت دی اور نگہبانی کی، یہ تدبیر اللہ غالب و دانا کی ہے.

t.149: But if they disregard(you) , then say, “I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt of ʻĀdand Thamûd.”
t.84: So, if they turn away, then say, “I have warned you of a calamity like the calamity of ‘Ād and Thamūd,
t.85: If they turn away, say, ‘I have warned you about a blast like the one which struck 'Ad and Thamud:
t.95: But if they turn away, tell them: “I warn you against a sudden scourge like that which struck Ad and Thamud.”
t.19: But if they turn away, then say: I warn you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt (which fell of old upon the tribes) of A'ad and Thamud;
t.22: But if they turn away, say thou: "I have warned you of a stunning Punishment (as of thunder and lightning) like that which (overtook) the 'Ad and the Thamud!"
t.203: But if they turn away, then say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I have warned you of a Sâ‘iqah (a destructive awful cry, torment, hit, a thunderbolt) like the Sâ‘iqah which overtook ‘Âd and Thamûd (people)."
t.54: اب بھی یہ روگرداں ہوں تو کہہ دیجئے! کہ میں تمہیں اس کڑک (عذاب آسمانی) سے ڈراتا ہوں جو مثل عادیوں اور ﺛمودیوں کی کڑک ہوگی.

t.149: Recall when their messengers came to them from before them and from behind them, saying, “Do not worship anyone but Allah.” They said, “Had our Lord willed, He would have sent down angels; therefore, of what you are sent with, we are deniers.”
t.84: when the messengers came to them from their front and from their rear, saying, “Do not worship anyone but Allah.” They said, “Had our Lord (really) willed (to send someone as messenger), He would have sent down angels. So, we are deniers of what you have been sent with.”
t.85: when their messengers came to them, from all angles, saying, “Serve no one but God,” they said, “If our Lord had wished, He would have sent down angels. We do not believe in the message with which you have been sent.”
t.95: When the Messengers (of Allah) came to them from the front and from the rear, saying: “Do not serve any but Allah”; they said: “Had our Lord so willed, He would have sent down angels. So we deny the Message you have brought.”
t.19: When their messengers came unto them from before them and behind them, saying: Worship none but Allah! they said: If our Lord had willed, He surely would have sent down angels (unto us), so lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent.
t.22: Behold, the messengers came to them, from before them and behind them, (preaching): "Serve none but Allah." They said, "If our Lord had so pleased, He would certainly have sent down angels (to preach). Now we reject your mission (altogether)."
t.203: When the Messengers came to them, from before them and behind them (saying): "Worship none but Allâh", they said: "If our Lord had so willed, He would surely have sent down the angels. So indeed we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent."
t.54: ان کے پاس جب ان کے آگے پیچھے سے پیغمبر آئے کہ تم اللہ کے سوا کسی کی عبادت نہ کرو تو انہوں نے جواب دیا کہ اگر ہمارا پروردگار چاہتا تو فرشتوں کو بھیجتا۔ ہم تو تمہاری رسالت کے بالکل منکر ہیں.

t.149: So, as for ʻĀd, they turned unjustifiably arrogant in the land andsaid, “Who is more powerful than us?” Had they not seen that Allah, who created them, is more powerful than them? And they used to repudiate Our signs,
t.84: As for ‘Ād, they showed arrogance in the land with no right (to do so), and said, “Who is stronger than us in power?” Did they not see that Allah, who created them, is stronger than them in power? And they used to reject Our signs.
t.85: The people of 'Ad behaved arrogantly throughout the land without any right, saying, “Who could be stronger than us?” Did they not realize that God, who created them, was stronger than them?’ They continued to reject Our message,
t.95: As for Ad, they waxed proud in the land without justification and said: “Who is greater than we in strength?” Did they not see that Allah, Who created them, is greater in strength than they? They continued to deny Our Signs,
t.19: As for A'ad, they were arrogant in the land without right, and they said: Who is mightier than us in power? Could they not see that Allah Who created them, He was mightier than them in power? And they denied Our revelations.
