t.19: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers.
t.22: He said: "What! Even if I brought you better guidance than that which ye found your fathers following?" They said: "For us, we deny that ye (prophets) are sent (on a mission at all)."
t.203: (The warner) said: "Even if I bring you better guidance than that which you found your fathers following?" They said: "Verily, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent."
t.54: (نبی نے) کہا بھی کہ اگرچہ میں تمہارے پاس اس سے بہت بہتر (مقصود تک پہنچانے واﻻ) طریقہ لے آیا ہوں جس پر تم نے اپنے باپ دادوں کو پایا، تو انہوں نے جواب دیا کہ ہم اس کے منکر ہیں جسے دے کر تمہیں بھیجا گیا ہے.

t.149: Thus We took retribution on them, so lookat what the outcome was for the disbelievers.
t.84: So, We took revenge from them. Now look, how was the end of those who rejected (Our messengers).
t.85: We punished them: think about how those who rejected the Truth met their end.
t.95: Then We exacted retribution from them. So do consider the end of those who gave the lie (to the Prophets).
t.19: So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!
t.22: So We exacted retribution from them: now see what was the end of those who rejected (Truth)!
t.203: So We took revenge on them, then see what was the end of those who denied (Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: پس ہم نے ان سے انتقام لیا اور دیکھ لے جھٹلانے والوں کا کیسا انجام ہوا؟

t.149: And recall when Abraham said to his father and his people, “I am innocent of what you worship
t.84: (Recall) when Ibrāhīm said to his father and to his people, “I disown that which you worship,
t.85: Abraham said to his father and his people, ‘I renounce what you worship.
t.95: Call to mind when Abraham said to his father and his people: “I totally disown all whom you serve
t.19: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship
t.22: Behold! Abraham said to his father and his people: "I do indeed clear myself of what ye worship:
t.203: And (remember) when Ibrâhîm (Abraham) said to his father and his people: "Verily, I am innocent of what you worship,
t.54: اور جبکہ ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) نے اپنے والد سے اور اپنی قوم سے فرمایا کہ میں ان چیزوں سے بیزار ہوں جن کی تم عبادت کرتے ہو.

t.149: except for the One Who originated me, for He will guide me.”
t.84: except the One who has originated me; so He will guide me.”
t.85: I worship only Him who created me, and it is He who will guide me,’
t.95: except the One Who created me; and, behold, it is He Who will direct me to the Right Way.”
t.19: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me.
t.22: "(I worship) only Him Who made me, and He will certainly guide me."
t.203: "Except Him (i.e. I worship none but Allâh Alone) Who did create me; and verily He will guide me."
t.54: بجز اس ذات کے جس نے مجھے پیدا کیا ہے اور وہی مجھے ہدایت بھی کرے گا.

t.149: And he made it an enduring word in his posterity, so that they may return.
t.84: He made it a word lasting among his posterity, so that they may return.
t.85: and he bequeathed these words to his descendants so that they might return [to God].
t.95: And Abraham left behind this word to endure among his posterity so that they may return to it.
t.19: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return.
t.22: And he left it as a Word to endure among those who came after him, that they may turn back (to Allah).
t.203: And he made it [i.e. Lâ ilâha illallâh (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh Alone)] a Word lasting among his offspring, (True Monotheism), that they may turn back (i.e. to repent to Allâh or receive admonition).
t.54: اور (ابراہیم علیہ السلام) اسی کو اپنی اوﻻد میں بھی باقی رہنے والی بات قائم کر گئے تاکہ لوگ (شرک سے) باز آتے رہیں.

t.149: Yet I let these and their forefathers enjoy(life) until the truth and an evident messenger came to them.
t.84: But, I gave these and their fathers enjoyment, until the truth came to them, and a messenger as well who explains (it).
t.85: I have let these people and their fathers enjoy long lives, and now I have given them the Truth and a messenger to make things clear-
t.95: (Even when they began worshipping others than Allah We did not destroy them) but bestowed sustenance on them and on their forefathers until there came to them the Truth and a Messenger who clearly expounded things to them.
t.19: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.
t.22: Yea, I have given the good things of this life to these (men) and their fathers, until the Truth has come to them, and a messenger making things clear.
t.203: Nay, but I gave (the good things of this life) to these (polytheists) and their fathers to enjoy, till there came to them the truth (the Qur’ân), and a Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) making things clear.
t.54: بلکہ میں نے ان لوگوں کو اور ان کے باپ دادوں کو سامان (اور اسباب) دیا، یہاں تک کہ ان کے پاس حق اور صاف صاف سنانے واﻻ رسول آگیا.

t.149: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is sorcery, and indeed we are deniers of it.”
t.84: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally disbelieve in it.”
t.85: yet when the Truth came to them, they said, ‘This is sorcery. We do not believe in it,’
t.95: And when the Truth came to them they said: “This is just sorcery and we reject it.”
t.19: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.
t.22: But when the Truth came to them, they said: "This is sorcery, and we do reject it."
t.203: And when the truth (this Qur’ân) came to them, they (the disbelievers in this Qur’ân) said: "This is magic, and we disbelieve therein."
t.54: اور حق کے پہنچتے ہی یہ بول پڑے کہ یہ تو جادو ہے اور ہم اس کے منکر ہیں.

t.149: They also said, “If only this Recitalhad been sent down to any great man from the two towns.”
t.84: They say, “Why was this Qur’ān not revealed on a great man from (either of) the two towns?”
t.85: and they said, ‘Why was this Quran not sent down to a distinguished man, from either of the two cities?’
t.95: They say: “Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon some great man from the two (main) cities?”
t.19: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?
t.22: Also, they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down to some leading man in either of the two (chief) cities?"
t.203: And they say: "Why is not this Qur’ân sent down to some great man of the two towns (Makkah and Tâ’if)?"
t.54: اور کہنے لگے، یہ قرآن ان دونوں بستیوں میں سے کسی بڑے آدمی پر کیوں نہ نازل کیا گیا.

t.149: Is it they who allocate the mercy of yourLord? It is We who have allocated their livelihood in the Earlier Life. And We elevated some of them by degrees above others, that some of them may employ one another in service. But your Lord’s mercy is better than what they hoard.
t.84: Is it they who allocate the mercy of your Lord? We have allocated among them their livelihood in the worldly life, and have raised some of them over others in ranks, so that some of them may put some others to work. And the mercy of your Lord is much better than what they accumulate.
t.85: Are they the ones who share out your Lord’s grace? We are the ones who give them their share of livelihood in this world and We have raised some of them above others in rank, so that some may take others into service: your Lord’s grace is better than anything they accumulate.
t.95: Is it they who distribute the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who have distributed their livelihood among them in the life of this world, and have raised some above others in rank that some of them may harness others to their service. Your Lord's Mercy is better than all the treasures that they hoard.
t.19: Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass.
t.22: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of thy Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in the life of this world: and We raise some of them above others in ranks, so that some may command work from others. But the Mercy of thy Lord is better than the (wealth) which they amass.
t.203: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in this world, and We raised some of them above others in ranks, so that some may employ others in their work. But the Mercy (Paradise) of your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) is better than the (wealth of this world) which they amass.
t.54: کیا آپ کے رب کی رحمت کو یہ تقسیم کرتے ہیں؟ ہم نے ہی ان کی زندگانیٴ دنیا کی روزی ان میں تقسیم کی ہے اور ایک کو دوسرے سے بلند کیا ہے تاکہ ایک دوسرے کو ماتحت کر لے جسے یہ لوگ سمیٹتے پھرتے ہیں اس سے آپ کے رب کی رحمت بہت ہی بہتر ہے.

t.149: Were it not that humanity would become a single(ungodly) community, We would have provided those who deny the All-Merciful with roofs of silver to their houses, and stairways(of silver) by which they ascend,
t.84: Were it not that all people would become of a single creed (i.e. disbelief), We would have caused, for those who disbelieve in RaHmān, roofs of their houses to be made of silver, and the stairs as well, on which they would climb,
t.85: If it were not that all mankind might have become a single nation [of disbelievers], We could have given all those who disbelieve in the Lord of Mercy houses with roofs of silver, sweeping staircases to ascend,
t.95: Were it not that all mankind would become a single community (and follow the same way), We would have provided for all those who disbelieve in the Merciful One silver roofs for their houses, and (silver) stairs on which to go up,
t.19: And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount,
t.22: And were it not that (all) men might become of one (evil) way of life, We would provide, for everyone that blasphemes against (Allah) Most Gracious, silver roofs for their houses and (silver) stair-ways on which to go up,
t.203: And were it not that mankind would have become of one community (all disbelievers, desiring worldly life only), We would have provided for those who disbelieve in the Most Gracious (Allâh), silver roofs for their houses, and elevators whereby they ascend,
t.54: اور اگر یہ بات نہ ہوتی کہ تمام لوگ ایک ہی طریقہ پر ہو جائیں گے تو رحمٰن کے ساتھ کفر کرنے والوں کے گھروں کی چھتوں کو ہم چاندی کی بنادیتے۔ اور زینوں کو (بھی) جن پر چڑھا کرتے.

t.149: and doors(of silver) to their houses, and furnishings on which they recline,
t.84: and doors of their homes, and the coaches on which they would recline,
t.85: massive gates, couches to sit on,
t.95: and (silver) doors to their houses, and couches (of silver) upon which they would recline;
t.19: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline,
t.22: And (silver) doors to their houses, and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
t.203: And for their houses, doors (of silver), and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
t.54: اور ان کے گھروں کے دروازے اور تخت بھی جن پر وه تکیہ لگا لگا کر بیٹھتے.

t.149: and(golden) decorations. Yet all that is nothing butthe enjoyment of the Earlier Life, whereas the Hereafter with yourLord is for the ones who are mindful(of God) .
t.84: and (would have made some of these things) of gold-ornaments. And all this is nothing but an enjoyment of the worldly life. And the Hereafter, with your Lord, is (destined) for the God-fearing.
t.85: and golden ornaments. All of these are mere enjoyments of this life; your Lord reserves the next life for those who take heed of Him.
t.95: or that they be made of gold. Surely all this is only the enjoyment of the life of the world. But (true prosperity) in the Hereafter with Your Lord is only for the God-fearing.
t.19: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.
t.22: And also adornments of gold. But all this were nothing but conveniences of the present life: The Hereafter, in the sight of thy Lord is for the Righteous.
t.203: And adornments of gold. Yet all this (i.e. the roofs, doors, stairs, elevators, thrones of their houses) would have been nothing but an enjoyment of this world. And the Hereafter with your Lord is (only) for the Muttaqûn.
t.54: اور سونے کے بھی، اور یہ سب کچھ یونہی سا دنیا کی زندگی کا فائده ہے اور آخرت تو آپ کے رب کے نزدیک (صرف) پرہیزگاروں کے لیے (ہی) ہے.

t.149: And whoever shuns the remembrance of the All-Merciful, We assign for him a Satan who then becomes his comrade.
t.84: Whoever makes himself blind against the advice of RaHmān, We assign for him a devil who accompanies him all the time.
t.85: We assign an evil one as a comrade for whoever turns away from the revelations of the Lord of Mercy:
t.95: He who is negligent to remember the Merciful One, to him We assign a satan as his boon companion,
t.19: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;
t.22: If anyone withdraws himself from remembrance of (Allah) Most Gracious, We appoint for him an evil one, to be an intimate companion to him.
t.203: And whosoever turns away blindly from the remembrance of the Most Gracious (Allâh) (i.e. this Qur’ân and worship of Allâh), We appoint for him Shaitan (Satan - devil) to be a Qarîn (a companion) to him.
t.54: اور جو شخص رحمٰن کی یاد سے غفلت کرے ہم اس پر ایک شیطان مقرر کردیتے ہیں وہی اس کا ساتھی رہتا ہے.

t.149: And indeed, they certainly bar them from the way, though they think they are guided.
t.84: And they (the devils) prevent such people from the (right) way, while they deem themselves to be on the right path,
t.85: evil ones bar people from the right path, even though they may think they are well guided.
t.95: and these satans hinder them from the Right Path, while he still reckons himself to be rightly-guided.
t.19: And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided;
t.22: Such (evil ones) really hinder them from the Path, but they think that they are being guided aright!
t.203: And verily, they (Satans / devils) hinder them from the Path (of Allâh), but they think that they are guided aright!
t.54: اور وه انہیں راه سے روکتے ہیں اور یہ اسی خیال میں رہتے ہیں کہ یہ ہدایت یافتہ ہیں.

t.149: Until, when he comes to Us, he says, “If only there were between me and youthe distance of the two easts.” What a miserable comrade!
t.84: until when such a person will come to us, he will say (to the devil), “Would that there were the distance of East and West between me and you, because you were the worst companion.”
t.85: When such a person comes to Us, he will say [to his comrade], ‘If only you had been as far away from me as east is from west. What an evil comrade!’
t.95: But when he comes to Us, he will say (to his satan): “Would that there had been between me and you the distance as between the East and the West. How evil a companion you were!”
t.19: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!
t.22: At length, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says (to his evil companion): "Would that between me and thee were the distance of East and West!" Ah! evil is the companion (indeed)!
t.203: Till, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says [to his Qarîn (Satan / devil companion)] "Would that between me and you were the distance of the two easts (or the east and west)" - a worst (type of) companion (indeed)!
t.54: یہاں تک کہ جب وه ہمارے پاس آئے گا کہے گا کاش! میرے اور تیرے درمیان مشرق اور مغرب کی دوری ہوتی (تو) بڑا برا ساتھی ہے.

t.149: Yet never will it benefit youon that day, since you have committed injustices, that you are partners in the punishment.
t.84: And (it will be said to such people,) “Since you were wrongdoers, it will never benefit you today that you are sharing the punishment with each other.”
t.85: [It will be said to them], ‘You have done wrong. Having partners in punishment will not console you today.’
t.95: (He will then be told): “Today it will not benefit you the least that after your wrong-doing you and your satans now share the chastisement.”
t.19: And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom.
t.22: When ye have done wrong, it will avail you nothing, that Day, that ye shall be partners in Punishment!
t.203: It will profit you not this Day (O you who turn away from Allâh’s remembrance and His worship) as you did wrong, (and) that you will be sharers (you and your Qarîn ) in the punishment.
t.54: اور جب کہ تم ﻇالم ٹھہر چکے تو تمہیں آج ہرگز تم سب کا عذاب میں شریک ہونا کوئی نفع نہ دے گا.

t.149: Can youmake the deaf hear, or guide the blind and one who has been in evident misguidance?
t.84: So, can you (O prophet) make the deaf to hear, or can you show the way to the blind and the one who is in open error?
t.85: Can you [Prophet] make the deaf hear? Or guide either the blind or those who are in gross error?
t.95: Can you, (O Prophet), then make the deaf hear, or direct to the Right Way the blind or one lost in manifest error?
t.19: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest?
t.22: Canst thou then make the deaf to hear, or give direction to the blind or to such as (wander) in manifest error?
t.203: Can you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) make the deaf to hear, or can you guide the blind or him who is in manifest error?
t.54: کیا پس تو بہرے کو سنا سکتا ہے یا اندھے کو راه دکھا سکتا ہے اور اسے جو کھلی گمراہی میں ہو.

t.149: So We will either take youaway, then surely wreak vengeance upon them,
t.84: So, even if We take you away, We will surely take vengeance on them.
t.85: Either We shall take you away and punish them- indeed We will-
t.95: We shall inflict retribution on them, whether We take you away from the world (before We do that),
t.19: And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them,
t.22: Even if We take thee away, We shall be sure to exact retribution from them,
t.203: And even if We take you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) away, We shall indeed take vengeance on them.
t.54: پس اگر ہم تجھے یہاں سے لے بھی جائیں تو بھی ہم ان سے بدلہ لینے والے ہیں.

t.149: or We will surely show you what We have promised them, for indeed We have absolute power over them.
t.84: Or (if) We show you (in your life) that (punishment) with which We have threatened them, then We have full control over them.
t.85: or We shall let you witness the punishment We threatened them with; We have full power over them.
t.95: or make you see the end that We had promised them, for We have full power over them.
t.19: Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them.
t.22: Or We shall show thee that (accomplished) which We have promised them: for verily We shall prevail over them.
t.203: Or (if) We show you that wherewith We threaten them: then verily We have perfect command over them.
t.54: یا جو کچھ ان سے وعده کیا ہے وه تجھے دکھا دیں ہم ان پر بھی قدرت رکھتے ہیں.

t.149: So adhereto what has been revealed to you; indeed you are upon a straight path.
t.84: So, hold fast to that which has been revealed to you. Surely, you are on the straight path.
t.85: Hold fast to what has been revealed to you- you truly are on the right path-
t.95: So hold fast to what has been revealed to you. Surely you are on the Straight Way.
t.19: So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path.
t.22: So hold thou fast to the Revelation sent down to thee; verily thou art on a Straight Way.
t.203: So hold you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) fast to that which is revealed to you. Verily you are on the Straight Path.
t.54: پس جو وحی آپ کی طرف کی گئی ہے اسے مضبوط تھامے رہیں بیشک آپ راه راست پر ہیں.

t.149: And indeed it is surely a message for youand for your people, and youwill be asked.
t.84: And certainly this (Qur’ān) is a word of honour for you and your people, and you will be questioned.
t.85: for it is a reminder for you and your people: you will all be questioned.
t.95: Verily it is a great source of eminence for you and your people, and soon you will be called to account concerning that.
t.19: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.
t.22: The (Qur'an) is indeed the message, for thee and for thy people; and soon shall ye (all) be brought to account.
t.203: And verily this (the Qur’ân) is indeed a Reminder for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) and your people (Quraish people, or your followers), and you will be questioned (about it).
t.54: اور یقیناً یہ (خود) آپ کے لیے اور آپ کی قوم کے لیے نصیحت ہے اور عنقریب تم لوگ پوچھے جاؤ گے.

t.149: And ask those of Our messengers We sent before you: “Did We appoint gods apart from the All-Merciful to be worshiped?”
t.84: Ask Our messengers whom We sent before you whether We had appointed gods to be worshipped besides RaHmān.
t.85: Ask the prophets We sent before you: ‘Did We ever appoint any gods to be worshipped besides the Lord of Mercy?’
t.95: Ask all Our Messengers whom We sent before you whether We had appointed any deities beside the Merciful One to be worshipped.
t.19: And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent?
t.22: And question thou our messengers whom We sent before thee; did We appoint any deities other than (Allah) Most Gracious, to be worshipped?
t.203: And ask (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) those of Our Messengers whom We sent before you: "Did We ever appoint âlihâh (gods) to be worshipped besides the Most Gracious (Allâh)?"
t.54: اور ہمارے ان نبیوں سے پوچھو! جنہیں ہم نے آپ سے پہلے بھیجا تھا کہ کیا ہم نے سوائے رحمٰن کے اور معبود مقرر کیے تھے جن کی عبادت کی جائے؟

t.149: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, so He said, “Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of all realms.”
t.84: We sent Mūsā with Our signs to Fir’aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs; so he said, “I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds.”
t.85: We sent Moses to Pharaoh and his courtiers and he said, ‘I am truly a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds,’
t.95: Indeed We sent Moses with Our Signs to Pharaoh and his nobles. He told them: “I am a Messenger of the Lord of the Universe.”
t.19: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.
t.22: We did send Moses aforetime, with Our Signs, to Pharaoh and his Chiefs: He said, "I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds."
t.203: And indeed We did send Mûsâ (Moses) with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs (inviting them to Allâh’s religion of Islâm) He said: "Verily, I am a Messenger of the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)."
t.54: اور ہم نے موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کو اپنی نشانیاں دے کر فرعون اور اس کے امراء کے پاس بھیجا تو (موسیٰ علیہ السلام نے جاکر) کہا کہ میں تمام جہانوں کے رب کا رسول ہوں.

t.149: Yet, as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they promptly started laughing at them,
t.84: So, when he came to them with Our signs, they at once started laughing at them.
t.85: but when he presented Our signs to them, they laughed,
t.95: Yet when he brought forth Clear Signs from Us, then lo, they burst into laughter.
t.19: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them.
t.22: But when he came to them with Our Signs, behold they ridiculed them.
t.203: But when he came to them with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations) behold, they laughed at them.
t.54: پس جب وه ہماری نشانیاں لے کر ان کے پاس آئے تو وه بےساختہ ان پر ہنسنے لگے.

t.149: even though each sign We showed them was more supreme than its counterpart, and We took hold of them with the punishment, that possibly they would return.
t.84: And We did not show them a sign, but it used to be greater than the one that preceded it. And We seized them with punishment, so that they may return.
t.85: even though each sign We showed them was greater than the previous one. We inflicted torment on them so that they might return to the right path.
t.95: Every Sign that We showed them was greater than its predecessor; and then We seized them with Our chastisement so that they may return (to the Right Way).
t.19: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again.
t.22: We showed them Sign after Sign, each greater than its fellow, and We seized them with Punishment, in order that they might turn (to Us).
t.203: And not an Ayâh (sign, etc.) We showed them but it was greater than its fellow , and We seized them with torment, in order that they might turn [from their polytheism to Allâh’s religion (Islâmic Monotheism)].
t.54: اور ہم انہیں جو نشانی دکھاتے تھے وه دوسری سے بڑھی چڑھی ہوتی تھی اور ہم نے انہیں عذاب میں پکڑا تاکہ وه باز آجائیں.

t.149: And they said(to Moses) , “O sorcerer, pray to your Lord for us according to His covenant with you, and then we will surely be guided.”
t.84: And they said, “O magician, pray for us to your Lord by the covenant He has made with you; we will certainly come to guidance.”
t.85: They said, ‘Sorcerer, call on your Lord for us, by virtue of His pledge to you: we shall certainly accept guidance,’
t.95: (Whenever they faced an affliction) they would say: “O magician, pray for us to your Lord according to your station with Him. We shall certainly be guided to the Right Way.”
t.19: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.
t.22: And they said, "O thou sorcerer! Invoke thy Lord for us according to His covenant with thee; for we shall truly accept guidance."
t.203: And they said [to Mûsâ (Moses)]: "O you sorcerer! Invoke your Lord for us according to what He has covenanted with you. Verily, We shall guide ourselves (aright)."
t.54: اور انہوں نے کہا اے جادوگر! ہمارے لیے اپنے رب سے اس کی دعا کر جس کا اس نے تجھ سے وعده کر رکھا ہے، یقین مان کہ ہم راه پر لگ جائیں گے.

t.149: But when We lifted the punishment from them, they promptly broke their promise.
t.84: Then, once We removed the punishment from them, in no time they broke their promise.
t.85: but as soon as We relieved their torment they broke their word.
t.95: But lo, each time We removed Our affliction from them, they would go back on their word.
t.19: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word.
t.22: But when We removed the Penalty from them, behold, they broke their word.
t.203: But when We removed the torment from them, behold, they broke their covenant (that they will believe if We remove the torment from them).
t.54: پھر جب ہم نے وه عذاب ان سے ہٹالیا انہوں نے اسی وقت اپنا قول وقرار توڑ دیا.

t.149: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, “O my people, do I not have the dominion over Egypt, and are these rivers not flowing beneath me? Do you not see?
t.84: And Fir’aun (Pharaoh) proclaimed among his people, saying, “Does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers are flowing right underneath me? Do you, then, not discern?
t.85: Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, ‘My people, is the Kingdom of Egypt not mine? And these rivers that flow at my feet, are they not mine? Do you not see?
t.95: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people: “My people, do I not have dominion over Egypt, and are these streams not flowing beneath me? Can't you see?
t.19: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?
t.22: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying: "O my people! Does not the dominion of Egypt belong to me, (witness) these streams flowing underneath my (palace)? What! see ye not then?
t.203: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) proclaimed among his people (saying): "O my people! Is not mine the dominion of Egypt, and these rivers flowing underneath me. See you not then?
t.54: اور فرعون نے اپنی قوم میں منادی کرائی اور کہا اے میری قوم! کیا مصر کا ملک میرا نہیں؟ اور میرے (محلوں کے) نیچے یہ نہریں بہہ رہی ہیں، کیا تم دیکھتے نہیں؟

t.149: Or am I not better than this one who is despicable and can barely express himself?
t.84: Or (do you not see that) I am much better than this one (Mūsā) who is worthless and can hardly express himself?
t.85: Am I not better than this contemptible wretch who can scarcely express himself?
t.95: Am I better or this contemptible man who is scarcely able to express himself?
t.19: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain!
t.22: "Am I not better than this (Moses), who is a contemptible wretch and can scarcely express himself clearly?
t.203: "Am I not better than this one [Mûsâ (Moses)] who is despicable and can scarcely express himself clearly?
t.54: بلکہ میں بہتر ہوں بہ نسبت اس کے جو بےتوقیر ہے اور صاف بول بھی نہیں سکتا.

t.149: So, if only some bracelets of gold had been cast on him, or if angels had come with him in comradeship!”
t.84: So why were the bracelets of gold not sent down to him, or (why) did the angels not come along with him as companions?”
t.85: Why has he not been given any gold bracelets? Why have no angels come to accompany him?’
t.95: Why were bracelets of gold not bestowed upon him? Why did a retinue of angels not accompany him as attendants?”
t.19: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him?
t.22: "Then why are not gold bracelets bestowed on him, or (why) come (not) with him angels accompanying him in procession?"
t.203: "Why then are not golden bracelets bestowed on him, or angels sent along with him?"
t.54: اچھا اس پر سونے کے کنگن کیوں نہیں آپڑے یا اس کے ساتھ پر باندھ کر فرشتے ہی آجاتے.

t.149: Thus he fooled his people, and they obeyed him; indeed they were a defiantly disobedient people.
t.84: Thus he made fool of his people, and they obeyed him. Surely they were a sinful people.
t.85: In this way he moved his people to accept and they obeyed him- they were perverse people.
t.95: He incited his people to levity and they obeyed him. Surely they were an iniquitous people.
t.19: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.
t.22: Thus did he make fools of his people, and they obeyed him: truly were they a people rebellious (against Allah).
t.203: Thus he [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] befooled (and misled) his people, and they obeyed him. Verily, they were ever a people who were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).
t.54: اس نے اپنی قوم کو بہلایا پھسلایا اور انہوں نے اسی کی مان لی، یقیناً یہ سارے ہی نافرمان لوگ تھے.

t.149: So when they displeased Us, We took vengeance on them and We drowned them all.
t.84: So, when they provoked Our anger, We took vengeance on them, and drowned them all together,
t.85: When they provoked Us, We punished and drowned them all:
t.95: So when they incurred Our wrath, We exacted retribution from them, and drowned them all,
t.19: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.
t.22: When at length they provoked Us, We exacted retribution from them, and We drowned them all.
t.203: So when they angered Us, We punished them, and drowned them all.
t.54: پھر جب انہوں نے ہمیں غصہ دﻻیا تو ہم نے ان سے انتقام لیا اور سب کو ڈبو دیا.

t.149: So We made them aprecedent and an example for later people.
t.84: and made them a people of the past, and an example for the later generations.
t.85: We made them a lesson and an example for later people.
t.95: and made them a thing of the past and an example for those who would come after them.
t.19: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).
t.22: And We made them (a people) of the Past and an Example to later ages.
t.203: And We made them a precedent (as a lesson for those coming after them), and an example to later generations.
t.54: پس ہم نے انہیں گیا گزرا کردیا اور پچھلوں کے لیے مثال بنادی.

t.149: And when the son of Mary was set forth as an example, yourpeople promptly clapped him
t.84: When the example of the son of Maryam was cited, your people started at once shouting at it (in joy),
t.85: When the son of Mary is cited as an example, your people [Prophet] laugh and jeer,
t.95: No sooner the example of the son of Mary was mentioned than, lo and behold, your people raised a clamour
t.19: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out,
t.22: When (Jesus) the son of Mary is held up as an example, behold, thy people raise a clamour thereat (in ridicule)!
t.203: And when the son of Maryam (Mary) is quoted as an example [i.e. ‘Îsâ (Jesus) is worshipped like their idols], behold, your people cry aloud (laugh out at the example).
t.54: اور جب ابن مریم کی مثال بیان کی گئی تو اس سے تیری قوم (خوشی سے) چیخنے لگی ہے.

t.149: and said, “Are our gods better, or he?” They cited him only for argument; in fact, they are a quarrelsome people.
t.84: and said, “Are Our gods better or is he?” They did not cite it (the example) but for the sake of disputation. Rather, they are a quarrelsome people.
t.85: saying, ‘Are our gods better or him?’- they cite him only to challenge you: they are a contentious people-
t.95: and said: “Who is better, our deities or he?” They said so only out of contentiousness. They are a disputatious people.
t.19: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.
t.22: And they say, "Are our gods best, or he?" This they set forth to thee, only by way of disputation: yea, they are a contentious people.
t.203: And say: "Are our âlihah (gods) better or is he [‘Îsâ (Jesus)]?" They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people. (See V. 21:98-101)
t.54: اور انہوں نے کہا کہ ہمارے معبود اچھے ہیں یا وه؟ تجھ سے ان کا یہ کہنا محض جھگڑے کی غرض سے ہے، بلکہ یہ لوگ ہیں ہی جھگڑالو.

t.149: He is but a servant whom We blessed, and We made him an example for the children of Israel.
t.84: He (‘Īsā) is no more than a servant (of Allah) whom We favoured and made an example for the children of Isrā’īl.
t.85: but he is only a servant We favoured and made an example for the Children of Israel:
t.95: He was no more than a servant (of Ours), one upon whom We bestowed Our favours and whom We made an example (of Our infinite power) for the Children of Israel.
t.19: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel.
t.22: He was no more than a servant: We granted Our favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel.
t.203: He [‘Îsâ (Jesus)] was not more than a slave. We granted Our Favour to him, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel (i.e. his creation without a father).
t.54: عیسیٰ (علیہ السلام) بھی صرف بنده ہی ہے جس پر ہم نے احسان کیا اور اسے بنی اسرائیل کے لیے نشان قدرت بنایا.

t.149: And had We willed, We would have made from among youangels to be successors on earth.
t.84: And if We will, We may create angels from you who succeed you on the earth.
t.85: if it had been Our will, We could have made you angels, succeeding one another on earth.
t.95: If We had so willed We could have made some of you into angels to become your successors on earth.
t.19: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth.
t.22: And if it were Our Will, We could make angels from amongst you, succeeding each other on the earth.
t.203: And if it were Our Will, We would have [destroyed you (mankind) all, and] made angels to replace you on the earth. [Tafsir At-Tabarî].
t.54: اگر ہم چاہتے تو تمہارے عوض فرشتے کردیتے جو زمین میں جانشینی کرتے.

t.149: And indeed heis a portent of the Hour, so never beskeptical about it and follow Me; this is a straight path.
t.84: And he (‘Īsā) is a source of knowledge of the Hour (the Day of Judgment); so do not be in doubt about it, and follow me. This is the straight way.
t.85: This [Quran] gives knowledge of the Hour: do not doubt it. Follow Me for this is the right path;
t.95: Verily he [i.e., Jesus) is a portent of the Hour. So be in no doubt concerning it and follow Me. This is the Straight Way.
t.19: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.
t.22: And (Jesus) shall be a Sign (for the coming of) the Hour (of Judgment): therefore have no doubt about the (Hour), but follow ye Me: this is a Straight Way.
t.203: And he [‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary)] shall be a known sign for (the coming of) the Hour (Day of Resurrection) [i.e. ‘Isâ’s (Jesus) descent on the earth]. Therefore have no doubt concerning it (i.e. the Day of Resurrection). And follow Me (Allâh) (i.e. be obedient to Allâh and do what He orders you to do, O mankind)! This is the Straight Path (of Islâmic Monotheism, leading to Allâh and to His Paradise).
t.54: اور یقیناً عیسیٰ (علیہ السلام) قیامت کی علامت ہے پس تم (قیامت) کے بارے میں شک نہ کرو اور میری تابعداری کرو، یہی سیدھی راه ہے.

t.149: And let not Satan bar you; indeed, he is an evident enemy to you.
t.84: And let not the ShaiTān (Satan) prevent you (from following this way). He is surely an open enemy for you.
t.85: do not let Satan hinder you, for he is your sworn enemy.
t.95: Let not Satan hinder you (from believing in the Hour), for surely he is your open enemy.
t.19: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
t.22: Let not the Evil One hinder you: for he is to you an enemy avowed.
t.203: And let not Shaitân (Satan) hinder you (from the right religion, i.e. Islâmic Monotheism). Verily, he (Satan) to you is a plain enemy.
t.54: اور شیطان تمہیں روک نہ دے، یقیناً وه تمہارا صریح دشمن ہے.

t.149: And when Jesus came with the evident proofs, he said, “I have come to youwith wisdom, and to clarify for you some of what you differ over, so be mindful of Allah and obey me.
t.84: When ‘Īsā came with clear proofs, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to explain to you some of those matters in which you differ. So, fear Allah, and obey me.
t.85: When Jesus came with clear signs he said, ‘I have brought you wisdom; I have come to clear up some of your differences for you. Be mindful of God and obey me:
t.95: When Jesus came with Clear Signs and said: “I have brought wisdom to you that I may make plain to you some of the things you differ about. So fear Allah and follow me.
t.19: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
t.22: When Jesus came with Clear Signs, he said: "Now have I come to you with Wisdom, and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which ye dispute: therefore fear Allah and obey me.
t.203: And when ‘Îsâ (Jesus) came with (Our) clear Proofs, he said: "I have come to you with Al-Hikmah (Prophethood), and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) in which you differ. Therefore fear Allâh and obey me.
t.54: اور جب عیسیٰ (علیہ السلام) معجزے کو ﻻئے تو کہا۔ کہ میں تمہارے پاس حکمت ﻻیا ہوں اور اس لیے آیا ہوں کہ جن بعض چیزوں میں تم مختلف ہو، انہیں واضح کردوں، پس تم اللہ تعالیٰ سے ڈرو اور میرا کہا مانو.

t.149: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him; this is a straight path.”
t.84: Surely, it is Allah who is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him. This is the straight way.”
t.85: God is my Lord and your Lord. Serve Him: this is the straight path.’
t.95: Allah is my Lord and your Lord; therefore, serve Him. That is the Straight Way.”
t.19: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.
t.22: "For Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord: so worship ye Him: this is a Straight Way."
t.203: "Verily, Allâh! He is my Lord (God) and your Lord (God). So worship Him (Alone). This is the (only) Straight Path (i.e. Allâh’s religion of true Islâmic Monotheism)."
t.54: میرا اور تمہارا رب فقط اللہ تعالیٰ ہی ہے۔ پس تم سب اس کی عبادت کرو۔ راه راست (یہی) ہے.

t.149: But the parties differed among themselves, so woe to those who committed injustices from the punishment of a painful day.
t.84: Then different groups, out of them, fell into disagreement. Woe to the wrongdoers because of the punishment of a painful day!
t.85: Yet still the different factions among them disagreed- woe to the evildoers: they will suffer the torment of a grievous day!-
t.95: Then the factions fell apart among themselves. So woe to the wrong-doers from the chastisement of a grievous Day.
t.19: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.
t.22: But sects from among themselves fell into disagreement: then woe to the wrong-doers, from the Penalty of a Grievous Day!
t.203: But the sects from among themselves differed. So woe to those who do wrong [by ascribing things to ‘Îsâ (Jesus) that are not true] from the torment of a painful Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: پھر (بنی اسرائیل کی) جماعتوں نے آپس میں اختلاف کیا، پس ﻇالموں کے لیے خرابی ہے دکھ والے دن کی آفت سے.

t.149: Are they only waiting for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware?
t.84: They are waiting for nothing but for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they would not even imagine (it).
t.85: what are they waiting for but the Hour, which will come upon them suddenly and take them unawares?
t.95: Are they awaiting anything other than the Last Hour that it should suddenly come upon them without their even perceiving it?
t.19: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not?
t.22: Do they only wait for the Hour - that it should come on them all of a sudden, while they perceive not?
t.203: Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly, while they perceive not?
t.54: یہ لوگ صرف قیامت کے منتظر ہیں کہ وه اچانک ان پر آپڑے اور انہیں خبر بھی نہ ہو.

t.149: On that day, close friends will be enemies to one another, except for the ones who were mindful(of God) .
t.84: Friends, on that day, will become enemies to one another, except the God-fearing,
t.85: On that Day, friends will become each other’s enemies. Not so the righteous-
t.95: On that Day even bosom friends shall become enemies to one another, all except the God-fearing.
t.19: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).
t.22: Friends on that day will be foes, one to another,- except the Righteous.
t.203: Friends on that Day will be foes one to another except Al-Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).
t.54: اس دن (گہرے) دوست بھی ایک دوسرے کے دشمن بن جائیں گے سوائے پرہیزگاروں کے.

t.149: O My servants, no fear shall be upon you today, nor shall you grieve.
t.84: (to whom it will be said) “O my servants, there is no fear for you today, nor will you grieve-
t.85: ‘My servants, there is no fear for you today, nor shall you grieve’––
t.95: (It will be said to them): “My servants, today you have nothing to fear or regret,
t.19: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;
t.22: My devotees! no fear shall be on you that Day, nor shall ye grieve,-
t.203: (It will be said to the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism): My worshippers! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve,
t.54: میرے بندو! آج تو تم پر کوئی خوف (و ہراس) ہے اور نہ تم (بد دل اور) غمزده ہوگے.

t.149: Those who believed in Our signsand were Muslims:
t.84: -O those (servants) who believed in Our signs, and remained obedient.
t.85: those who believed in Our revelations and devoted themselves to Us.
t.95: you who believed in Our Signs and had surrendered yourselves (to Us)!
t.19: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,
t.22: (Being) those who have believed in Our Signs and bowed (their wills to Ours) in Islam.
t.203: (You) who believed in Our Ayât (proofs, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and were Muslims (i.e. who submit totally to Allâh’s Will, and believe in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: جو ہماری آیتوں پر ایمان ﻻئے اور تھے بھی وه (فرماں بردار) مسلمان.

t.149: enter the Garden(of Paradise) , you and your spouses, filled up with joy.
t.84: - Enter the Paradise, you and your spouses, showered with bliss.”
t.85: ‘Enter Paradise, you and your spouses: you will be filled with joy.’
t.95: Enter Paradise joyfully, both you and your spouses.”
t.19: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.
t.22: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing.
t.203: Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness.
t.54: تم اور تمہاری بیویاں ہشاش بشاش (راضی خوشی) جنت میں چلے جاؤ.

t.149: They are served around with trays of gold and cups, and therein is whatever is desired by the selvesand delights the eyes, and therein youabide.
t.84: Circulated among them will be the bowls of gold, and glasses. And there will be whatever souls desire and that which eyes enjoy. “And you will be living in it for ever.
t.85: Dishes and goblets of gold will be passed around them with all that their souls desire and their eyes delight in. ‘There you will remain:
t.95: Platters and cups of gold shall be passed around them, and there shall be all that they might desire and all that their eyes might delight in. (They shall be told): “Herein shall you abide for ever.
t.19: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
t.22: To them will be passed round, dishes and goblets of gold: there will be there all that the souls could desire, all that their eyes could delight in: and ye shall abide therein (for eye).
t.203: Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them; (there will be) therein all that inner-selves could desire, and all that eyes could delight in and you will abide therein forever.
t.54: ان کے چاروں طرف سے سونے کی رکابیاں اور سونے کے گلاسوں کا دور چلایا جائے گا، ان کے جی جس چیز کی خواہش کریں اور جس سے ان کی آنکھیں لذت پائیں، سب وہاں ہوگا اور تم اس میں ہمیشہ رہو گے.

t.149: And that is the Garden(of Paradise) youwere madeto inherit on account of what you used to do.
t.84: That is the Paradise you are made to inherit because of what you used to do.
t.85: this is the Garden you are given as your own, because of what you used to do,
t.95: Such is the Paradise that you shall inherit by virtue of your good deeds in the life of the world.
t.19: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.
t.22: Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life).
t.203: This is the Paradise which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds which you used to do (in the life of the world).
t.54: یہی وه بہشت ہے کہ تم اپنے اعمال کے بدلے اس کے وارث بنائے گئے ہو.

t.149: For youtherein is abundant fruit from which you eat.
t.84: For you there are fruits in abundance from which you will eat.”
t.85: and there is abundant fruit in it for you to eat.’
t.95: Herein you will have abundant fruits of which you will eat.”
t.19: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.
t.22: Ye shall have therein abundance of fruit, from which ye shall have satisfaction.
t.203: Therein for you will be fruits in plenty, of which you will eat (as you desire).
t.54: یہاں تمہارے لیے بکثرت میوے ہیں جنہیں تم کھاتے رہو گے.

t.149: Indeed, the criminals abide in the punishment of Hell
t.84: The sinners (on the other hand) will be in the punishment of Jahannam (Hell), living there forever.
t.85: But the evildoers will remain in Hell’s punishment,
t.95: But the evil-doers shall abide in the torment of Hell.
t.19: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.
t.22: The sinners will be in the Punishment of Hell, to dwell therein (for aye):
t.203: Verily, the Mujrimûn (criminals, sinners, disbelievers) will be in the torment of Hell to abide therein forever.
t.54: بیشک گنہگار لوگ عذاب دوزخ میں ہمیشہ رہیں گے.

t.149: which is never palliated for them, and in it they are devastated.
t.84: It will not be lightened for them, and they will be there, devoid of all hopes.
t.85: from which there is no relief: they will remain in utter despair.
t.95: Never will their torment be lightened for them. They shall remain in utter despair.
t.19: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.
t.22: Nowise will the (Punishment) be lightened for them, and in despair will they be there overwhelmed.
t.203: (The torment) will not be lightened for them, and they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair therein.
t.54: یہ عذاب کبھی بھی ان سے ہلکا نہ کیا جائے گا اور وه اسی میں مایوس پڑے رہیں گے.

t.149: Yet in no way did We do them injustice, but it was they who were the unjust.
t.84: We did not do injustice to them, rather, they themselves were the unjust.
t.85: We never wronged them; they were the ones who did wrong.
t.95: It is not We Who wronged them; rather, it is they who wronged themselves.
t.19: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.
t.22: Nowise shall We be unjust to them: but it is they who have been unjust themselves.
t.203: We wronged them not, but they were the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers).
t.54: اور ہم نے ان پر ﻇلم نہیں کیا بلکہ یہ خود ہی ﻇالم تھے.

t.149: And they cried, “O Malek, let your Lord finish us off.” He said, “You are staying.
t.84: And they will call (Mālik, the keeper of the Hell,) “O Mālik, let your Lord do away with us.” He will say, “You have to stay on.”
t.85: They will cry, ‘Malik, if only your Lord would finish us off,’ but he will answer, ‘No! You are here to stay.’
t.95: They shall call out: “O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us.” He will reply: “You must stay on in it.
t.19: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.
t.22: They will cry: "O Malik! would that thy Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Nay, but ye shall abide!"
t.203: And they will cry: "O Malik (Keeper of Hell)! Let your Lord make an end of us." He will say: "Verily, you shall abide forever."
t.54: اور پکار پکار کر کہیں گے کہ اے مالک! تیرا رب ہمارا کام ہی تمام کردے، وه کہے گا کہ تمہیں تو (ہمیشہ) رہنا ہے.

t.149: We certainly came to you with the truth, but most of youare hateful of the truth.”
t.84: (O disbelievers,) indeed We have brought to you the truth, but it is the truth that most of you detest.
t.85: We have brought you the Truth but most of you despise it.
t.95: We brought you the Truth; but to the truth most of you were averse.”
t.19: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.
t.22: Verily We have brought the Truth to you: but most of you have a hatred for Truth.
t.203: Indeed We have brought the truth (Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم with the Qur’ân) to you, but most of you have a hatred for the truth.
t.54: ہم تو تمہارے پاس حق لے آئے لیکن تم میں سے اکثر لوگ حق سے نفرت رکھنے والے تھے؟

t.149: Or have they contrived to do something? So indeed, We too are contriving.
t.84: Is it that they have firmly resolved to do something (harmful to Our messenger)? Then, We have firmly resolved (to frustrate their plan.)
t.85: Have these disbelievers thought up some scheme? We too have been scheming.
t.95: Have they contrived some scheme? If so, We too will contrive a scheme.
t.19: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining.
t.22: What! have they settled some plan (among themselves)? But it is We Who settle things.
t.203: Or have they plotted some plan? Then We too are planning.
t.54: کیا انہوں نے کسی کام کا پختہ اراده کرلیا ہے تو یقین مانو کہ ہم بھی پختہ کام کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: Or do they think that We cannot hear their secret and their private conversations? Yes indeed, Our messengers are by them, writing down.
t.84: Do they think that We do not hear their secrets and their whispers? Yes of course, Our messengers (angels) are with them who record (whatever they plan).
t.85: Do they think We cannot hear their secret talk and their private counsel? Yes we can: Our messengers are at their sides, recording everything.
t.95: Or do they think that We do not hear their secret talks and their whispering counsels? Yes, indeed We do and Our messengers [i.e., angels) are with them, writing.
t.19: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.
t.22: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsels? Indeed (We do), and Our messengers are by them, to record.
t.203: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsel? (Yes We do) and Our messengers (appointed angels in charge of mankind) are by them, to record.
t.54: کیا ان کا یہ خیال ہے کہ ہم ان کی پوشیده باتوں کو اور ان کی سرگوشیوں کو نہیں سنتے، (یقیناً ہم برابر سن رہے ہیں) بلکہ ہمارے بھیجے ہوئے ان کے پاس ہی لکھ رہے ہیں.

t.149: Say, “If the All-Merciful had a child , I would be the first of(his) worshipers.”
t.84: Say, “Had there been a son for the RaHmān, I would have been the first to worship.”
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘If the Lord of Mercy [truly] had offspring I would be the first to worship [them], but-
t.95: Say: “If the Merciful One had a son, I would have been the first one to worship him.”
t.19: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).
t.22: Say: "If (Allah) Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship."
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم): "If the Most Gracious (Allâh) had a son (or children as you pretend), then I am the first of Allâh’s worshippers [who deny and refute this claim of yours (and the first to believe in Allâh Alone and testify that He has no children)]." [Tafsir At-Tabarî].
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! کہ اگر بالفرض رحمٰن کی اوﻻد ہو تو میں سب سے پہلے عبادت کرنے واﻻ ہوتا.

t.149: Highly Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, beyond what they describe.
t.84: Pure is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from what they attribute (to Him).
t.85: exalted be the Lord of the heavens and earth, the Lord of the Throne- He is far above their false descriptions.’
t.95: Exalted be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, above what they attribute to Him.
t.19: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
t.22: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)!
t.203: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted be He from all that they ascribe (to Him).
t.54: آسمانوں اور زمین اور عرش کا رب جو کچھ یہ بیان کرتے ہیں اس سے (بہت) پاک ہے.

t.149: So leavethem to blunder and play until they meet their day which they are promised.
t.84: So, let them indulge (in their fallacy) and play, until they face their Day that they are promised.
t.85: Leave them to wade in deeper and play about, until they face the Day they have been promised.
t.95: So leave them alone to indulge in their vanities and to frolic about until they encounter that Day of theirs against which they have been warned.
t.19: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.
t.22: So leave them to babble and play (with vanities) until they meet that Day of theirs, which they have been promised.
t.203: So leave them (alone) to speak nonsense and play until they meet the Day of theirs which they have been promised.
t.54: اب آپ انہیں اسی بحﺚ مباحثہ اور کھیل کود میں چھوڑ دیجئے، یہاں تک کہ انہیں اس دن سے سابقہ پڑجائے جن کا یہ وعده دیے جاتے ہیں.

t.149: And it is He who in the heaven is God, and in the earth is God, and He is the All-Wise, the All-Knowing.
t.84: He is the One who is God to be worshipped in the sky, and God to be worshipped on the earth. And He is the Wise, the All-Knowing.
t.85: It is He who is God in heaven and God on earth; He is the All Wise, the All Knowing;
t.95: He it is Who is God in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Wise, the All-Knowing.
t.19: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.
t.22: It is He Who is Allah in heaven and Allah on earth; and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge.
t.203: It is He (Allâh) Who is the only Ilâh (God to be worshipped) in the heaven and the only Ilâh (God to be worshipped) on the earth. And He be the All-Wise, the All-Knower.
t.54: وہی آسمانوں میں معبود ہے اور زمین میں بھی وہی قابل عبادت ہے اور وه بڑی حکمت واﻻ اور پورے علم واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And supremely blessed be the One to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and Who alone has knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom youare returned .
t.84: Glorious is the One to whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever lies between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and towards Him you are to be returned.
t.85: Exalted is He who has control of the heavens and earth and everything between them; He has knowledge of the Hour; you will all be returned to Him.
t.95: Blessed is He Who has dominion over the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. With Him is the knowledge of the Hour; and to Him you shall all be sent back.
t.19: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.
t.22: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all between them: with Him is the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment): and to Him shall ye be brought back.
t.203: And Blessed be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, and with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom you (all) will be returned.
t.54: اور وه بہت برکتوں واﻻ ہے جس کے پاس آسمان وزمین اور ان کے درمیان کی بادشاہت ہے، اور قیامت کا علم بھی اسی کے پاس ہے اور اسی کی جانب تم سب لوٹائے جاؤ گے.

t.149: And those they call upon apart from Him are incapable of intercession, except those who testify to the truth knowingly.
t.84: And those whom they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede; but those who bear witness to the truth, while they have knowledge (may intercede for the believers with Allah’s permission).
t.85: Those gods they invoke besides Him have no power of intercession, unlike those who bore witness to the truth and recognized it.
t.95: Those whom they call upon, instead of Allah have no power of intercession, except such that testify to the truth based on knowledge.
t.19: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.
t.22: And those whom they invoke besides Allah have no power of intercession;- only he who bears witness to the Truth, and they know (him).
t.203: And those whom they invoke instead of Him have no power of intercession - except for those who bear witness to the truth knowingly (i.e. believed in the Oneness of Allâh, and obeyed His Orders), and they know (the facts about the Oneness of Allâh).
t.54: جنہیں یہ لوگ اللہ کے سوا پکارتے ہیں وه شفاعت کرنے کا اختیار نہیں رکھتے، ہاں (مستحق شفاعت وه ہیں) جو حق بات کا اقرار کریں اور انہیں علم بھی ہو.

t.149: And surely if you asked them, “Who created them?” they would certainly say, “Allah.” So how can they be averted(from the truth) ?
t.84: And if you ask them as to who has created them, they will certainly say, “Allah”. Then, to where are they driven back (by their false desires)?
t.85: If you [Prophet] ask them who created them they are sure to say, ‘God,’ so why are they so deluded?
t.95: If you were to ask them: “Who created them?” they will surely say: “Allah.” Whence are they, then, being led astray?
t.19: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?
t.22: If thou ask them, who created them, they will certainly say, Allah: How then are they deluded away (from the Truth)?
t.203: And if you ask them who created them, they will surely say: "Allâh." How then are they turned away (from the worship of Allâh, Who created them)?
t.54: اگر آپ ان سے دریافت کریں کہ انہیں کس نے پیدا کیا ہے؟ تو یقیناً یہ جواب دیں گے کہ اللہ نے، پھر یہ کہاں الٹے جاتے ہیں؟

t.149: And(God hears) hisstatement: “My Lord, indeed, these are people who do not believe.”
t.84: And (Allah has the knowledge) of his (prophet’s) saying, “O my Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”
t.85: The Prophet has said, ‘My Lord, truly these are people who do not believe,’
t.95: We call to witness the cry of the Messenger: “O Lord, these are a people not wont to believe!”
t.19: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.
t.22: (Allah has knowledge) of the (Prophet's) cry, "O my Lord! Truly these are people who will not believe!"
t.203: (And Allâh has the knowledge) of (Prophet Muhammad’s) saying: "O my Lord! Verily, these are a people who believe not!"
t.54: اور ان کا (پیغمبر کا اکثر) یہ کہنا کہ اے میرے رب! یقیناً یہ وه لوگ ہیں جو ایمان نہیں ﻻتے.

t.149: Then grantthem amnesty and say, “Peace.” For they shall come to know.
t.84: So, turn away from them, and say, “Salām !” (good-bye!). Then, soon they will come to know (the end of their attitude).
t.85: but turn away from them and say, ‘Peace’: they will come to know.
t.95: Indulge them, (O Prophet), and say to them: “Peace to you.” For soon they shall come to know.
t.19: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.
t.22: But turn away from them, and say "Peace!" But soon shall they know!
t.203: So turn away from them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم), and say: Salâm (peace)! But they will come to know.
t.54: پس آپ ان سے منھ پھیر لیں اور کہہ دیں۔ (اچھا بھائی) سلام! انہیں عنقریب (خود ہی) معلوم ہوجائے گا.

t.149: Ha Mīm.
t.84: Hā Mīm .
t.85: Ha Mim
t.95: Ha'. Mim.
t.19: Ha. Mim.
t.22: Ha-Mim.
t.203: Hâ.-Mîm.
t.54: حٰم.

t.149: By the Evident Scripture,
t.84: By the manifest Book,
t.85: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
t.95: By the Clear Book.
t.19: By the Scripture that maketh plain
t.22: By the Book that makes things clear;-
t.203: By the manifest Book (this Qur’ân) that makes things clear.
t.54: قسم ہے اس وضاحت والی کتاب کی.

t.149: We have indeed sent it down on a blessed night. Indeed, We have always been warning.
t.84: We have sent it down in a blessed night, (because) We had to warn (people).
t.85: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––
t.95: We revealed it on a Blessed Night, for We were intent on warning;
t.19: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -
t.22: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).
t.203: We sent it (this Qur’ân) down on a blessed night [(i.e. night of Al-Qadr, Sûrah No. 97) in the month of Ramadân - the 9th month of the Islâmic calendar]. Verily, We are ever warning [mankind that Our Torment will reach those who disbelieve in Our Oneness of Lordship and in Our Oneness of worship].
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے اسے بابرکت رات میں اتارا ہے بیشک ہم ڈرانے والے ہیں.

t.149: Onit, every wise command is distinguished—
t.84: In that (night), every wise matter is allocated
t.85: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct
t.95: (We revealed it on the Night) wherein every matter is wisely determined
t.19: Whereon every wise command is made clear
t.22: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,
t.203: Therein (that night) is decreed every matter of ordainments.
t.54: اسی رات میں ہر ایک مضبوط کام کا فیصلہ کیا جاتا ہے.

t.149: a command from Us; indeed, We have always been sending
t.84: through a command from Us. We were to send the Messenger
t.85: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––
t.95: by Our command. Verily, We were set to send a Messenger
t.19: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -
t.22: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),
t.203: As a Command (or this Qur’ân or the Decree of every matter) from Us. Verily, We are ever sending (the Messengers),
t.54: ہمارے پاس سے حکم ہوکر، ہم ہی ہیں رسول بناکر بھیجنے والے.

t.149: mercy from yourLord—indeed, it is He who is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing—
t.84: as a mercy from your Lord, -Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing-
t.85: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,
t.95: as a Mercy from your Lord. Surely He is All-Hearing, All-Seeing,
t.19: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,
t.22: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);
t.203: (As) a Mercy from your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.
t.54: آپ کے رب کی مہربانی سے۔ وه ہی ہے سننے واﻻ جاننے واﻻ.

t.149: (from the) Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, if you(can ever) believe with certitude.
t.84: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever there is between them, if you are to believe.
t.85: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––
t.95: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them: if you would only have sure faith.
t.19: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.
t.22: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.
t.203: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you (but) have a faith with certainty.
t.54: جو رب ہے آسمانوں کا اور زمین کا اور جو کچھ ان کے درمیان ہے۔ اگر تم یقین کرنے والے ہو.

t.149: There is no god but He; He gives life and causes death—yourLord and the Lord of your ancient fathers.
t.84: There is no god, but He. He gives life and brings death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.
t.85: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––
t.95: There is no god but He: He gives life and causes death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.
t.19: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
t.22: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.
t.203: Lâ ilaha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). It is He Who gives life and causes death - your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.
t.54: کوئی معبود نہیں اس کے سوا وہی جلاتا ہے اور مارتا ہے، وہی تمہارا رب ہے اور تمہارے اگلے باپ دادوں کا.

t.149: Yet they play around in doubt.
t.84: But they, being in doubt, are playing around.
t.85: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.
t.95: (But the fact is, they lack certainty) and frolic about in doubt.
t.19: Nay, but they play in doubt.
t.22: Yet they play about in doubt.
t.203: Nay! They play about in doubt.
t.54: بلکہ وه شک میں پڑے کھیل رہے ہیں.

t.149: So waitand watch out for the day when the sky produces evident smoke
t.84: So, wait for a day when the sky will come up with a visible smoke
t.85: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.
t.95: So watch for the Day when the sky will come down with a pall of smoke,
t.19: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
t.22: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,
t.203: Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,
t.54: آپ اس دن کے منتظر رہیں جب کہ آسمان ﻇاہر دھواں ﻻئے گا.

t.149: that overwhelms mankind; this is a painful punishment.
t.84: that will envelop people. This is a painful punishment.
t.85: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!
t.95: enveloping people. That will be a grievous scourge.
t.19: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.
t.22: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.
t.203: Covering the people: this is a painful torment.
t.54: جو لوگوں کو گھیر لے گا، یہ دردناک عذاب ہے.

t.149: “Our Lord, lift the punishment from us; we are truly believers.”
t.84: (Then they will say,) “O our Lord, remove from us the punishment; we will truly believe.”
t.85: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’
t.95: (People will then say): “Our Lord, remove this scourge from us; we shall believe.”
t.19: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.
t.22: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"
t.203: (They will say): "Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!"
t.54: کہیں گے کہ اے ہمارے رب! یہ آفت ہم سے دور کر ہم ایمان قبول کرتے ہیں.

t.149: But how can the reminding benefit them when an evident messenger had already come to them,
t.84: How will they take lesson, while there has already come to them a messenger making things clear?
t.85: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,
t.95: But how will they take heed? Such are they that a Messenger came to them clearly expounding the Truth,
t.19: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,
t.22: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Messenger explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-
t.203: How can there be for them an admonition (at the time when the torment has reached them), when a Messenger explaining things clearly has already come to them.
t.54: ان کے لیے نصیحت کہاں ہے؟ کھول کھول کر بیان کرنے والے پیغمبران کے پاس آچکے.

t.149: then they turned away from him and said, “(He is) taught(by others) , a madman!”
t.84: Then they turned away from him, and said, “(He is) tutored, crazy.”
t.85: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’
t.95: yet they turned away from him and said: “This is a well-tutored madman.”
t.19: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?
t.22: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"
t.203: Then they had turned away from him (Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) and said: (He is) one taught (by a human being), a madman!"
t.54: پھر بھی انہوں نے ان سے منھ پھیرا اور کہہ دیا کہ سکھایا پڑھایا ہوا باؤﻻ ہے.

t.149: Indeed, if We lift off the punishment a little, youwill revert.
t.84: (Well,) We are going to remove the punishment for a while, (but) you will certainly go back (to your original position).
t.85: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––
t.95: Yet We will hold the scourge back for a while, (but no sooner than We will do so) you will revert to your old ways.
t.19: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).
t.22: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).
t.203: Verily, We shall remove the torment for a while. Verily you will revert (to disbelief).
t.54: ہم عذاب کو تھوڑا دور کردیں گے تو تم پھر اپنی اسی حالت پر آجاؤ گے.

t.149: On the day when We assault with the biggest onslaught, We will indeed wreak vengeance upon them.
t.84: (Then,) the day We will seize (you) with the greatest seizure, We will take vengeance.
t.85: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.
t.95: The Day when We shall seize them with a mighty seizing, that will be the Day on which We shall inflict upon you full retribution.
t.19: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.
t.22: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!
t.203: On the Day when We shall seize you with the greatest seizure (punishment). Verily, We will exact retribution.
t.54: جس دن ہم بڑی سخت پکڑ پکڑیں گے، بالیقین ہم بدلہ لینے والے ہیں.

t.149: And surely before them We tested the people of Pharaoh when a noble messengercame to them,
t.84: And We tested the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) prior to them, and a noble messenger came to them
t.85: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,
t.95: Indeed before that We subjected the Pharaonites to the same test. A noble Messenger came to them
t.19: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,
t.22: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them a messenger most honourable,
t.203: And indeed We tried before them Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people, when there came to them a noble Messenger [i.e. Mûsâ (Moses) عليه السلام],
t.54: یقیناً ان سے پہلے ہم قوم فرعون کو (بھی) آزما چکے ہیں جن کے پاس (اللہ) کا باعزت رسول آیا.

t.149: saying, “Hand over Allah’s servants to me; indeed, I am to youa trustworthy messenger.
t.84: saying, “Deliver to me the servants of Allah. I am an honest messenger to you,”
t.85: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.
t.95: (and said): “Deliver to me Allah's servants. I am a trustworthy Messenger to you,
t.19: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.
t.22: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of Allah: I am to you an messenger worthy of all trust;
t.203: Saying: "Deliver to me the slaves of Allâh (i.e. the Children of Israel). Verily, I am to you a Messenger worthy of all trust.
t.54: کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کے بندوں کو میرے حوالے کر دو، یقین مانو کہ میں تمہارے لیے امانت دار رسول ہوں.

t.149: And do not consider yourselves to be above Allah; indeed, I come to you with an evident manifestation.
t.84: and saying, “Do not be haughty against Allah. I bring to you a clear proof.
t.85: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.
t.95: and do not exalt yourselves in defiance of Allah. I have come to you with a clear authority (as a Messenger).
t.19: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.
t.22: "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.
t.203: "And exalt not yourselves against Allâh. Truly, I have come to you with a manifest authority.
t.54: اور تم اللہ تعالیٰ کے سامنے سرکشی نہ کرو، میں تمہارے پاس کھلی دلیل ﻻنے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: And I have indeed sought refuge with my Lord and yourLord lest you stone me.
t.84: And I have sought refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death.
t.85: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!
t.95: I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you should attack me with stones.
t.19: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
t.22: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.
t.203: "And truly, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me (or call me a sorcerer or kill me).
t.54: اور میں اپنے اور تمہارے رب کی پناه میں آتا ہوں اس سے کہ تم مجھے سنگسار کردو.

t.149: Thus if youdo not believe in me, just keep away from me.”
t.84: And if you do not believe in me, then keep away from me.”
t.85: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’
t.95: But if you do not believe what I say, leave me alone (and desist from laying hands on me).”
t.19: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.
t.22: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."
t.203: "But if you believe me not, then keep away from me and leave me alone."
t.54: اور اگر تم مجھ پر ایمان نہیں ﻻتے تو مجھ سے الگ ہی رہو.

t.149: Then he called upon his Lord—that these people are criminals.
t.84: Then he prayed to his Lord saying, “These are a guilty people.”
t.85: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’
t.95: Then he called upon his Lord: “These are a criminal people.”
t.19: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.
t.22: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."
t.203: (But they were aggressive), so he [Mûsâ (Moses)] called upon his Lord (saying): "These are indeed the people who are Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals)."
t.54: پھر انہوں نے اپنے رب سے دعا کی کہ یہ سب گنہگار لوگ ہیں.

t.149: (Then His Lord commanded,) “Journey with My servants by night; indeed, youwill be followed.
t.84: (So, Allah answered his prayer saying,) “Now, take away my servants at night. You will certainly be chased,
t.85: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.
t.95: (He was told): “Set out with My servants by night for you will certainly be pursued.
t.19: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,
t.22: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.
t.203: (Allâh said): "Depart you with My slaves by night. Surely, you will be pursued.
t.54: (ہم نے کہہ دیا) کہ راتوں رات تو میرے بندوں کو لے کر نکل، یقیناً تمہارا پیچھا کیا جائے گا.

t.149: And leavethe sea parted(behind you) ; indeed, they are an army to be drowned.”
t.84: and leave the sea in the state of stillness; they are an army that is sure to be drowned.”
t.85: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’
t.95: And leave the sea behind you as calm as ever. Surely they are an army that is doomed to be drowned.”
t.19: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.
t.22: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."
t.203: "And leave the sea as it is (quiet and divided). Verily, they are a host to be drowned."
t.54: تو دریا کو ساکن چھوڑ کر چلا جا، بلاشبہ یہ لشکر غرق کردیا جائے گا.

t.149: How many gardens and springs did they leave behind,
t.84: How many gardens and fountains have they left behind-
t.85: Many a garden and spring they left behind,
t.95: How many gardens did they leave behind, and how many fountains
t.19: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,
t.22: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,
t.203: How many of gardens and springs that they [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people] left behind,
t.54: وه بہت سے باغات اور چشمے چھوڑ گئے.

t.149: as well as vegetation(s) and a noble domicile
t.84: - and how many fields and noble sites,
t.85: many a cornfield and noble building,
t.95: and sown fields and splendid mansions,
t.19: And the cornlands and the goodly sites
t.22: And corn-fields and noble buildings,
t.203: And green crops (fields) and goodly places,
t.54: اور کھیتیاں اور راحت بخش ٹھکانے.

t.149: and a blessing they used to enjoy?
t.84: and how many a luxury they used to rejoice in!
t.85: many a thing in which they had delighted:
t.95: and the life of ease in which they took delight!
t.19: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!
t.22: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!
t.203: And comforts of life wherein they used to take delight!
t.54: اور وه آرام کی چیزیں جن میں عیش کررہے تھے.

t.149: So it was. And We made another people inherit it.
