t.84: This is how it happened. And We made other people inherit all this.
t.85: We gave these to another people to inherit.
t.95: Thus it was; and We made another people inherit all that.
t.19: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;
t.22: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!
t.203: Thus (it was)! And We made other people inherit them (i.e. We made the Children of Israel to inherit the kingdom of Egypt).
t.54: اسی طرح ہوگیا اور ہم نے ان سب کا وارث دوسری قوم کو بنادیا.

t.149: So neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor were they reprieved.
t.84: So, neither the sky and earth wept over them, nor were they given a respite.
t.85: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.
t.95: Then neither the sky shed tears over them nor the earth. They were granted no respite.
t.19: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
t.22: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).
t.203: And the heavens and the earth wept not for them, nor were they given a respite.
t.54: سو ان پر نہ تو آسمان وزمین روئے اور نہ انہیں مہلت ملی.

t.149: And surely, We delivered the Children of Israel from the demeaning punishment—
t.84: And We delivered the children of Isrā’īl from the humiliating punishment,
t.85: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering
t.95: Thus did We deliver the Children of Israel from the humiliating chastisement,
t.19: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;
t.22: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,
t.203: And indeed We saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment:
t.54: اور بےشک ہم نے (ہی) بنی اسرائیل کو (سخت) رسوا کن سزا سے نجات دی.

t.149: from Pharaoh; indeed, he was of the extremists.
t.84: from Fir‘aun. Indeed, he was haughty, one of the transgressors.
t.85: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.
t.95: from Pharaoh who was most prominent among the prodigals.
t.19: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.
t.22: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.
t.203: From Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he was arrogant and was of the Musrifûn (those who transgress beyond bound in spending and other things and commit great sins).
t.54: (جو) فرعون کی طرف سے (ہو رہی) تھی۔ فیالواقع وه سرکش اور حد سے گزر جانے والوں میں سے تھا.

t.149: And We chose them knowingly over all communities,
t.84: And We chose them, with knowledge, above all the worlds.
t.85: We chose them knowingly above others:
t.95: We knowingly exalted them (i.e., the Children of Israel) above other peoples of the world
t.19: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.
t.22: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,
t.203: And We chose them (the Children of Israel) above the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn) [during the time of Mûsâ (Moses)] with knowledge,
t.54: اور ہم نے دانستہ طور پر بنی اسرائیل کو دنیا جہان والوں پر فوقیت دی.

t.149: and gave them of the signs that which was an evident test.
t.84: And We gave them the clear signs in which there was a manifest blessing.
t.85: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.
t.95: and bestowed upon them the Signs wherein lay an evident test for them.
t.19: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.
t.22: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial
t.203: And granted them signs in which there was a plain trial.
t.54: اور ہم نے انہیں ایسی نشانیاں دیں جن میں صریح آزمائش تھی.

t.149: Indeed, these people surely say,
t.84: These people say,
t.85: These people here assert,
t.95: Indeed these people say:
t.19: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:
t.22: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:
t.203: Verily, these (Quraish) people are saying:
t.54: یہ لوگ تو یہی کہتے ہیں.

t.149: “There is nothing but our first death, for we will not be resurrected.
t.84: “There is nothing more than our first death, and we are not going to be resurrected.
t.85: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.
t.95: “This is our first and only death, and we shall never be raised again.
t.19: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
t.22: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
t.203: "There is nothing but our first death, and we shall not be resurrected.
t.54: کہ (آخری چیز) یہی ہماری پہلی بار (دنیا سے) مرجانا ہے اور ہم دوباره اٹھائے نہیں جائیں گے.

t.149: So bringback our forefathers, if you are truthful!”
t.84: So, (O believers,) bring our fathers, if you are true (in your belief in resurrection.)”
t.85: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’
t.95: Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.”
t.19: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!
t.22: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
t.203: "Then bring back our forefathers, if you speak the truth!"
t.54: اگر تم سچے ہو تو ہمارے باپ دادوں کو لے آؤ.

t.149: Are they better, or the people of Tubbaʻand those before them? We annihilated them; indeed, they were criminals.
t.84: Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those who were before them? We have destroyed them. They were guilty indeed.
t.85: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.
t.95: Are these better or the people of Tubba and those who went before them? We destroyed them for they were a criminal people.
t.19: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.
t.22: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.
t.203: Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those before them? We destroyed them because they were indeed Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals).
t.54: کیا یہ لوگ بہتر ہیں یا تبع کی قوم کے لوگ اور جو ان سے بھی پہلے تھے۔ ہم نے ان سب کو ہلاک کردیا یقیناً وه گنہ گار تھے.

t.149: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them to play.
t.84: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them just as players.
t.85: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;
t.95: It was not in idle sport that We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.
t.19: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.
t.22: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:
t.203: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, for mere play.
t.54: ہم نے زمین اور آسمانوں اور ان کے درمیان کی چیزوں کو کھیل کے طور پر پیدا نہیں کیا.

t.149: We did not create them except with truth, but most of them do not know.
t.84: We did not create them but with true purpose, but most of them do not know.
t.85: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.
t.95: We did not create them except in Truth. But most of them do not know.
t.19: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.
t.22: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.
t.203: We created them not except with truth (i.e. to examine and test those who are obedient and those who are disobedient and then reward the obedient ones and punish the disobedient ones), but most of them know not.
t.54: بلکہ ہم نے انہیں درست تدبیر کے ساتھ ہی پیدا کیا ہے، لیکن ان میں سے اکثر لوگ نہیں جانتے.

t.149: Indeed, the Day of Decision is the appointed time for them all—
t.84: The Day of Decision is the appointed time for all of them-
t.85: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;
t.95: The Day of Final Decision is the appointed time for all;
t.19: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,
t.22: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-
t.203: Verily, the Day of Judgement (when Allâh will judge between the creatures) is the time appointed for all of them -
t.54: یقیناً فیصلے کا دن ان سب کا طے شده وقت ہے.

t.149: a day when no patron will avail a protégé in any way, and they cannot be supported,
t.84: the day when no close relation will be of any use to any close relation, nor will they be helped,
t.85: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.
t.95: the Day when a friend shall be of no avail to his friend nor shall they be helped,
t.19: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,
t.22: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,
t.203: The Day when a Maulâ (a near relative) cannot avail a Maulâ (a near relative) in aught, and no help can they receive,
t.54: اس دن کوئی دوست کسی دوست کے کچھ بھی کام نہ آئے گا اور نہ ان کی امداد کی جائے گی.

t.149: except for one upon whom Allah has hadmercy; indeed, He is the Almighty, the Bestower of mercy.
t.84: except the One on whom Allah has mercy. Of course, He is the All-Mighty, the Very-Merciful.
t.85: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.
t.95: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate.
t.19: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
t.22: Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
t.203: Except him on whom Allâh has Mercy. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
t.54: مگر جس پر اللہ کی مہربانی ہوجائے وه زبردست اور رحم کرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Indeed, the Tree of Zaqqum
t.84: Indeed the tree of zaqqūm
t.85: The tree of Zaqqum
t.95: The tree of al-Zaqqum
t.19: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,
t.22: Verily the tree of Zaqqum
t.203: Verily, the tree of Zaqqûm
t.54: بیشک زقوم (تھوہر) کا درخت.

t.149: is the food of the sinful one,
t.84: is the food of the sinful,
t.85: will be food for the sinners:
t.95: shall be the food of the sinful.
t.19: The food of the sinner!
t.22: Will be the food of the Sinful,-
t.203: Will be the food of the sinners.
t.54: گناه گار کا کھانا ہے.

t.149: like molten brass boiling in the bellies
t.84: like dregs of oil. It will boil in the bellies
t.85: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies
t.95: Like dregs of oil, it will boil in their bellies
t.19: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies
t.22: Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.
t.203: Like boiling oil, it will boil in the bellies,
t.54: جو مثل تلچھٹ کے ہے اور پیٹ میں کھولتا رہتا ہے.

t.149: like the boiling of scalding water.
t.84: like the boiling of hot water.
t.85: like seething water.
t.95: like boiling water.
t.19: As the seething of boiling water.
t.22: Like the boiling of scalding water.
t.203: Like the boiling of scalding water.
t.54: مثل تیز گرم پانی کے.

t.149: “Takehim and drag him into the midst of Hell,
t.84: (It will be said to angels,) “Seize him, and drag him into the midst of the Hell.
t.85: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!
t.95: “Seize him and drag him to the middle of the Blazing Fire,
t.19: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,
t.22: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!
t.203: (It will be said) "Seize him and drag him into the midst of blazing Fire,
t.54: اسے پکڑ لو پھر گھسیٹتے ہوئے بیچ جہنم تک پہنچاؤ.

t.149: then pour over his head some of the punishment of scalding water!”
t.84: Then pour on his head some torment of boiling water.”
t.85: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’
t.95: then pour boiling water over his head as chastisement.
t.19: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.
t.22: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,
t.203: "Then pour over his head the torment of boiling water.
t.54: پھر اس کے سر پر سخت گرم پانی کا عذاب بہاؤ.

t.149: “Taste! You —indeed you—are the mighty, the noble.
t.84: “Have a taste! You are the ‘man of might’, the ‘man of honour’.
t.85: ‘Taste this, you powerful, respected man!
t.95: Taste this, you are a person mighty and noble!
t.19: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!
t.22: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!
t.203: "Taste you (this)! Verily, you were (pretending to be) the mighty, the generous!
t.54: (اس سے کہا جائے گا) چکھتا جا تو تو بڑا ذی عزت اور بڑے اکرام واﻻ تھا.

t.149: Indeed, this is what youwereskeptical about.”
t.84: This is the thing about which you used to be skeptic.”
t.85: This is what you doubted.’
t.95: This is what you used to doubt.”
t.19: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.
t.22: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"
t.203: "Verily, this is that whereof you used to doubt!"
t.54: یہی وه چیز ہے جس میں تم شک کیا کرتے تھے.

t.149: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are in a safe domicile,
t.84: Indeed the God-fearing will be in a place free from fear,
t.85: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place
t.95: Verily the God-fearing shall be in a secure place
t.19: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.
t.22: As to the Righteous (they will be) in a position of Security,
t.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2), will be in place of Security (Paradise).
t.54: بیشک (اللہ سے) ڈرنے والے امن چین کی جگہ میں ہوں گے.

t.149: amidst Gardens and springs,
t.84: in gardens and fountains.
t.85: amid Gardens and springs,
t.95: amidst gardens and springs.
t.19: Amid gardens and watersprings,
t.22: Among Gardens and Springs;
t.203: Among Gardens and Springs,
t.54: باغوں اور چشموں میں.

t.149: dressed in silk and brocade, facing one another.
t.84: They will be dressed in fine silk and thick silk, facing each other.
t.85: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:
t.95: Attired in silk and brocade, they shall be arrayed face to face.
t.19: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.
t.22: Dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, they will face each other;
t.203: Dressed in fine silk and (also) in thick silk, facing each other,
t.54: باریک اور دبیز ریشم کے لباس پہنے ہوئے آمنے سامنے بیٹھے ہوں گے.

t.149: So it is. And We marriedthem to spouses with lovely wide eyes.
t.84: Thus (it will happen,) and We will marry them with houris having big dark eyes.
t.85: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.
t.95: Thus shall it be: and We shall espouse them to fair, wide-eyed maidens.
t.19: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
t.22: So; and We shall join them to fair women with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes.
t.203: So (it will be). And We shall marry them to Hûr (fair female) with wide, lovely eyes.
t.54: یہ اسی طرح ہے اور ہم بڑی بڑی آنکھوں والی حوروں سے ان کا نکاح کردیں گے.

t.149: They call therein for every kind of fruit, feeling safe.
t.84: They will call therein for every fruit peacefully.
t.85: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.
t.95: While resting in security, they shall call for all kinds of fruit.
t.19: They call therein for every fruit in safety.
t.22: There can they call for every kind of fruit in peace and security;
t.203: They will call therein for every kind of fruit in peace and security;
t.54: دل جمعی کے ساتھ وہاں ہر طرح کے میوؤں کی فرمائشیں کرتے ہوں گے.

t.149: Therein they do not taste death beyond the first death, and Heshielded them from the punishment of Hell—
t.84: They will not taste death therein beyond the first death (they faced in the world). And He (Allah) will save them from the torment of Hell,
t.85: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,
t.95: They shall not taste death except the death in this world. And Allah will save them from the chastisement of Hell
t.19: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,
t.22: Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-
t.203: They will never taste death therein except the first death (of this world), and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire,
t.54: وہاں وه موت چکھنے کے نہیں ہاں پہلی موت (جو وه مر چکے)، انہیں اللہ تعالیٰ نے دوزخ کی سزا سے بچا دیا.

t.149: a grace from yourLord; that is the great triumph.
t.84: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great achievement.
t.85: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
t.95: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great triumph.
t.19: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
t.22: As a Bounty from thy Lord! that will be the supreme achievement!
t.203: As a Bounty from your Lord! That will be the supreme success!
t.54: یہ صرف تیرے رب کا فضل ہے، یہی ہے بڑی کامیابی.

t.149: Thus have We made iteasy through yourtongue, that they may remind themselves.
t.84: So, We had made it (the Qur’ān) easy in your tongue, so that they may take lesson.
t.85: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.
t.95: (O Prophet), We have made this Book easy in your tongue so that they may take heed.
t.19: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.
t.22: Verily, We have made this (Qur'an) easy, in thy tongue, in order that they may give heed.
t.203: Certainly, We have made this (Qur’an) easy in your tongue, in order that they may remember.
t.54: ہم نے اس (قرآن) کو تیری زبان میں آسان کردیا تاکہ وه نصیحت حاصل کریں.

t.149: So wait and watch. Indeed, they too are waiting and watching.
t.84: Now wait. They too are waiting.
t.85: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.
t.95: Wait, then; they too are waiting.
t.19: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
t.22: So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.
t.203: Wait then (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم); verily, they (too) are waiting.
t.54: اب تو منتظر ره یہ بھی منتظر ہیں.

t.149: Ha, Mîm.
t.84: Hā Mīm .
t.85: Ha Mim
t.95: Ha'. Mim.
t.19: Ha. Mim.
t.22: Ha-Mim.
t.203: Hâ-Mîm.
t.54: حٰم

t.149: The bestowal of the Scripture from on high is by Allah the Almighty, the All-Wise.
t.84: This is revelation of the Book from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
t.85: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Mighty, the Wise.
t.95: This Book is a revelation from the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
t.19: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
t.22: The revelation of the Book is from Allah the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.
t.203: The revelation of the Book (this Qur’ân) is from Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
t.54: یہ کتاب اللہ غالب حکمت والے کی طرف سے نازل کی ہوئی ہے.

t.149: Indeed, in the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers.
t.84: Surely in the heavens and the earth, there are signs for those who have faith.
t.85: There are signs in the heavens and the earth for those who believe:
t.95: Behold, for those who believe there are (myriad) Signs in the heavens and the earth
t.19: Lo! in the heavens and the earth are portents for believers.
t.22: Verily in the heavens and the earth, are Signs for those who believe.
t.203: Verily, in the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers.
t.54: آسمانوں اور زمین میں ایمان داروں کے لیے یقیناً بہت سی نشانیاں ہیں.

t.149: And in yourown creation, and in the treading creatures He scatters, are signs for people who believe with certitude.
t.84: And in your creation and in the living beings that He scatters on the earth, there are signs for a people who believe.
t.85: in the creation of you, in the creatures God scattered on earth, there are signs for people of sure faith;
t.95: and in your own creation; and in the animals which He spreads out over the earth too there are Signs for those endowed with sure faith;
t.19: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.
t.22: And in the creation of yourselves and the fact that animals are scattered (through the earth), are Signs for those of assured Faith.
t.203: And in your creation, and what He scattered (through the earth) of moving (living) creatures are signs for people who have Faith with certainty.
t.54: اور خود تمہاری پیدائش میں اور ان جانوروں کی پیدائش میں جنہیں وه پھیلاتا ہے یقین رکھنے والی قوم کے لیے بہت سی نشانیاں ہیں.

t.149: And the alternation of night and day, and the provision Allah has sent down from the sky, with which He has revived the earth after its death, and the shifting of the winds are signs for people who reason.
t.84: And in the alternation of the day and the night, and in the provision He has sent down from the sky, then has revived the earth after its death, and in changing of the winds, there are signs for a people who understand.
t.85: in the alternation of night and day, in the rain God provides, sending it down from the sky and reviving the dead earth with it, and in His shifting of the winds there are signs for those who use their reason.
t.95: and in the succession of night and day, and in the provision that Allah sends down from the sky wherewith He gives life to the earth after it had been lifeless, and in the change of the winds: (in all these) there are Signs for people who use reason.
t.19: And the difference of night and day and the provision that Allah sendeth down from the sky and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death, and the ordering of the winds, are portents for a people who have sense.
t.22: And in the alternation of Night and Day, and the fact that Allah sends down Sustenance from the sky, and revives therewith the earth after its death, and in the change of the winds,- are Signs for those that are wise.
t.203: And in the alternation of night and day, and the provision (rain) that Allâh sends down from the sky, and revives therewith the earth after its death, and in the turning about of the winds (i.e. sometimes towards the east or north, and sometimes towards the south or west sometimes bringing glad tidings of rain etc., and sometimes bringing the torment), are signs for a people who understand.
t.54: اور رات دن کے بدلنے میں اور جو کچھ روزی اللہ تعالیٰ آسمان سے نازل فرما کر زمین کو اس کی موت کے بعد زنده کر دیتا ہے، (اس میں) اور ہواؤں کے بدلنے میں بھی ان لوگوں کے لیے جو عقل رکھتے ہیں نشانیاں ہیں.

t.149: Those are Allah’s signswhich We read to youin truth. So in which discourse, after Allah and His signs, will they believe?
t.84: These are Allah’s verses that We recite to you rightly. Then, in which discourse, after Allah and His verses, will they believe?
t.85: These are God’s signs that We recount to you [Prophet, to show] the Truth. If they deny God and His revelations, what message will they believe in?
t.95: These are Allah's Signs that We rehearse to you in Truth. In what kind of discourse after Allah and His Signs will they, then, believe?
t.19: These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth. Then in what fact, after Allah and His portents, will they believe?
t.22: Such are the Signs of Allah, which We rehearse to thee in Truth; then in what exposition will they believe after (rejecting) Allah and His Signs?
t.203: These are the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, revelations, etc.) of Allâh, which We recite to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) with truth. Then in which speech after Allâh and His Ayât will they believe?
t.54: یہ ہیں اللہ کی آیتیں جنہیں ہم آپ کو راستی سے سنا رہے ہیں، پس اللہ تعالیٰ اور اس کی آیتوں کے بعد یہ کس بات پر ایمان ﻻئیں گے.

t.149: Woe to every sinful liar
t.84: Woe to every sinful liar,
t.85: Woe to every lying sinful person
t.95: Woe to every guilty impostor
t.19: Woe unto each sinful liar,
t.22: Woe to each sinful dealer in Falsehoods:
t.203: Woe to every sinful liar
t.54: ویل اور افسوس ہے ہر ایک جھوٹے گنہگار پر.

t.149: who hears Allah’s signsbeing read to him, yet he persists arrogantly, as though he did not hear them. So givehim glad tidingsof a painful punishment.
t.84: who hears Allah’s verses being recited to him, then he remains adamant out of arrogance, as if he never heard them. So give him the ‘good news’ of a painful punishment.
t.85: who hears God’s revelations being recited to him, yet persists in his arrogance as if he had never heard them––[Prophet] bring him news of a painful torment!––
t.95: who hears Allah's Signs being rehearsed to him, and yet persists in his pride, as though he had not heard it. Announce to him, then, the tidings of a grievous chastisement.
t.19: Who heareth the revelations of Allah recited unto him, and then continueth in pride as though he heard them not. Give him tidings of a painful doom.
t.22: He hears the Signs of Allah rehearsed to him, yet is obstinate and lofty, as if he had not heard them: then announce to him a Penalty Grievous!
t.203: Who hears the Verses of Allâh (being) recited to him, yet persists with pride as if he heard them not. So announce to him a painful torment!
t.54: جو آیتیں اللہ کی اپنے سامنے پڑھی جاتی ہوئی سنے پھر بھی غرور کرتا ہوا اس طرح اڑا رہے کہ گویا سنی ہی نہیں، تو ایسے لوگوں کو دردناک عذاب کی خبر (پہنچا) دیجئے.

t.149: And when he learns something of Our signs, he takes them in mockery; for thoseis a demeaning punishment.
t.84: When he learns about something of Our verses, he takes it as a laughing stock. For such people, there is a humiliating punishment.
t.85: who, if he knows anything about Our revelations, ridicules it! Such people will have a humiliating torment:
t.95: Whenever he comes to know anything of Our Signs, he makes them an object of jest. For such there awaits a humiliating chastisement.
t.19: And when he knoweth aught of Our revelations he maketh it a jest. For such there is a shameful doom.
t.22: And when he learns something of Our Signs, he takes them in jest: for such there will be a humiliating Penalty.
t.203: And when he learns something of Our Verses (this Qur’ân), he makes them a jest. For such there will be a humiliating torment.
t.54: وه جب ہماری آیتوں میں سے کسی آیت کی خبر پالیتا ہے تو اس کی ہنسی اڑاتا ہے، یہی لوگ ہیں جن کے لیے رسوائی کی مار ہے.

t.149: Beyond them lies Hell, and what they have earned will not benefit them at all, nor will those whom they took as guardians apart from Allah, and for them is a great punishment.
t.84: In front of them, there is Jahannam (Hell). And whatever they have earned will not be of any use to them, nor the patrons they have adopted instead of Allah. And for them, there is a horrible punishment.
t.85: Hell lurks behind them and their gains will not benefit them, nor will those beings they took as protectors beside God––a tremendous torment awaits them.
t.95: Hell is behind them. Their worldly earnings shall not avail them, nor those whom they took as protectors instead of Allah. An awesome chastisement lies in store for them.
t.19: Beyond them there is hell, and that which they have earned will naught avail them, nor those whom they have chosen for protecting friends beside Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom.
t.22: In front of them is Hell: and of no profit to them is anything they may have earned, nor any protectors they may have taken to themselves besides Allah: for them is a tremendous Penalty.
t.203: In front of them there is Hell. And that which they have earned will be of no profit to them, nor (will be of any profit to them) those whom they have taken as Auliyâ’ (protectors, helpers) besides Allâh. And theirs will be a great torment.
t.54: ان کے پیچھے دوزخ ہے، جو کچھ انہوں نے حاصل کیا تھا وه انہیں کچھ بھی نفع نہ دے گا اور نہ وه (کچھ کام آئیں گے) جن کو انہوں نے اللہ کے سوا کارساز بنا رکھا تھا، ان کے لیے تو بہت بڑا عذاب ہے.

t.149: This is guidance, but those who have denied their Lord’s signs—for them is a painful punishment of torment .
t.84: This is guidance, and those who reject the verses of their Lord, for them there is a painful punishment of the divine scourge.
t.85: This is true guidance; those who reject their Lord’s revelations will have a woeful torment.
t.95: This (Qur'an) is the true guidance. Those who deny the Signs of their Lord shall suffer the torment of a woeful scourge.
t.19: This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath.
t.22: This is (true) Guidance and for those who reject the Signs of their Lord, is a grievous Penalty of abomination.
t.203: This (Qur’an) is a guidance. And those who disbelieve in the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations) of their Lord, for them there is a painful torment of Rijz (a severe kind of punishment).
t.54: یہ (سر تاپا) ہدایت ہے اور جن لوگوں نے اپنے رب کی آیتوں کو نہ مانا ان کے لیے بہت سخت دردناک عذاب ہے.

t.149: Allah is the One Who has subjected to youthe sea, that ships may run in it by His Command, and that you may seek of His grace, and that you may give thanks.
t.84: Allah is the One who has subjugated for you the sea, so that the ships may sail in it with His command, and so that you may seek His grace, and so that you offer gratitude.
t.85: It is God who subjected the sea for you––ships sail on it by His command so that you can seek His bounty and give Him thanks––
t.95: Allah it is Who has subjected the sea to you so that ships may sail upon it at His bidding and you may seek of His Bounty and give thanks to Him.
t.19: Allah it is Who hath made the sea of service unto you that the ships may run thereon by His command, and that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful;
t.22: It is Allah Who has subjected the sea to you, that ships may sail through it by His command, that ye may seek of his Bounty, and that ye may be grateful.
t.203: Allâh, it is He Who has subjected to you the sea, that ships may sail through it by His Command, and that you may seek of His Bounty, and that you may be thankful.
t.54: اللہ ہی ہے جس نے تمہارے لیے دریا کو تابع بنادیا تاکہ اس کے حکم سے اس میں کشتیاں چلیں اور تم اس کا فضل تلاش کرو اور تاکہ تم شکر بجاﻻؤ.

t.149: And He has subjected to youwhatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth—all is from Him. Indeed, in that are signs for people who reflect.
t.84: He has subjugated for you whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, all on His own. Surely in this there are signs for a people who reflect.
t.85: He has subjected all that is in the heavens and the earth for your benefit, as a gift from Him. There truly are signs in this for those who reflect.
t.95: He has subjected to you all that is in the heavens and the earth, all being from Him. Verily there are Signs in this for those who reflect.
t.19: And hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect.
t.22: And He has subjected to you, as from Him, all that is in the heavens and on earth: Behold, in that are Signs indeed for those who reflect.
t.203: And has subjected to you all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth; it is all as a favour and kindness from Him. Verily, in it are signs for a people who think deeply.
t.54: اور آسمان وزمین کی ہر ہر چیز کو بھی اس نے اپنی طرف سے تمہارے لیے تابع کر دیا ہے۔ جو غور کریں یقیناً وه اس میں بہت سی نشانیاں پالیں گے.

t.149: Tellthose who have attained faith to forgive those who do not expect the Days of Allah, that He may repay peoplefor what they used to earn.
t.84: Tell those who believe that they should forgive those who do not believe in Allah’s days, so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
t.85: Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear God’s days [of punishment]––He will requite people for what they have done.
t.95: (O Prophet), tell the believers to indulge those who have no fear of any evil days coming upon them from Allah so that Allah may Himself requite them for their deeds.
t.19: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn.
t.22: Tell those who believe, to forgive those who do not look forward to the Days of Allah: It is for Him to recompense (for good or ill) each People according to what they have earned.
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) to the believers to forgive those who (harm them and) hope not for the Days of Allâh (i.e. His Recompense), that He may recompense people, according to what they have earned (i.e. to punish these disbelievers who harm the believers).
t.54: آپ ایمان والوں سے کہہ دیں کہ وه ان لوگوں سے درگزر کریں جو اللہ کے دنوں کی توقع نہیں رکھتے، تاکہ اللہ تعالیٰ ایک قوم کو ان کے کرتوتوں کا بدلہ دے.

t.149: Whoever acts righteously does so to his own benefit, while whoever commits evil does so to his own detriment, then to yourLord you are returned .
t.84: Whoever acts righteously, it is for his own benefit, and who does evil, it is against his own soul. Then towards your Lord, you will be returned.
t.85: Whoever does good benefits himself, and whoever does evil harms himself: you will all be returned to your Lord.
t.95: Whoever acts righteously, does so to his own good; and whoever commits an evil will suffer its consequence. All of you will then be sent back to your Lord.
t.19: Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back.
t.22: If any one does a righteous deed, it ensures to the benefit of his own soul; if he does evil, it works against (his own soul). In the end will ye (all) be brought back to your Lord.
t.203: Whosoever does a good deed, it is for his ownself, and whosoever does evil, it is against (his ownself). Then to your Lord you will be made to return.
t.54: جو نیکی کرے گا وه اپنے ذاتی بھلے کے لیے اور جو برائی کرے گا اس کا وبال اسی پر ہے، پھر تم سب اپنے پروردگار کی طرف لوٹائے جاؤ گے.

t.149: And surely We had given the Children of Israel the Scripture and wise judgment and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and favored them above all communities
t.84: We gave the children of Isrā’īl the book and the wisdom and the prophet-hood, and provided them with good things, and preferred them above all (people of) the world,
t.85: We gave scripture, wisdom, and prophethood to the Children of Israel; We provided them with good things and favoured them above others;
t.95: Indeed We endowed the Children of Israel with the Book and Wisdom and Prophethood, and provided them with good things as sustenance, and exalted them above the peoples of the whole world.
t.19: And verily we gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and the Command and the Prophethood, and provided them with good things and favoured them above (all) peoples;
t.22: We did aforetime grant to the Children of Israel the Book the Power of Command, and Prophethood; We gave them, for Sustenance, things good and pure; and We favoured them above the nations.
t.203: And indeed We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, and the understanding of the Scripture and its laws, and the Prophethood; and provided them with good things, and preferred them above the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn of their time, during that period),
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے بنی اسرائیل کو کتاب، حکومت اور نبوت دی تھی، اور ہم نے انہیں پاکیزه (اور نفیس) روزیاں دی تھیں اور انہیں دنیا والوں پر فضیلت دی تھی.

t.149: and gave them evident explanations regarding matters. Thus they differed not except after knowledge had come to them, thereby oppressing one another. Indeed, yourLord judges between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding whatever they used to differ over.
t.84: and We gave them clear proofs of the Matter (i.e. the religion). So they did not fall into disagreement out of mutual jealousy, but after the knowledge had come to them. Surely your Lord will judge between them, on the Day of Judgment, in the matters in which they used to differ.
t.85: We gave them clear proof in matters [of religion]. They differed among themselves out of mutual rivalry, only after knowledge came to them: on the Day of Resurrection your Lord will judge between them regarding their differences.
t.95: We gave them clear directions in matters pertaining to religion. Yet they differed among themselves (not out of ignorance but) after knowledge had come to them; and they did so out of the desire to commit excesses against one another. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will judge among them regarding what they had differed.
t.19: And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.
t.22: And We granted them Clear Signs in affairs (of Religion): it was only after knowledge had been granted to them that they fell into schisms, through insolent envy among themselves. Verily thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment as to those matters in which they set up differences.
t.203: And gave them clear proofs in matters [by revealing to them the Taurât (Torah)]. And they differed not until after the knowledge came to them, through envy among themselves. Verily, Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection about that wherein they used to differ.
t.54: اور ہم نے انہیں دین کی صاف صاف دلیلیں دیں، پھر انہوں نے اپنے پاس علم کے پہنچ جانے کے بعد آپس کی ضد بحﺚ سے ہی اختلاف برپا کر ڈاﻻ، یہ جن جن چیزوں میں اختلاف کر رہے ہیں ان کا فیصلہ قیامت والے دن ان کے درمیان (خود) تیرا رب کرے گا.

t.149: Then We set youupon a(path of) legislation regarding matters, so follow it and do not follow the whims of those who do not know.
t.84: Then We have put you on a certain way of the Matter (i.e. the religion); so follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.
t.85: Now We have set you [Muhammad] on a clear religious path, so follow it. Do not follow the desires of those who lack [true] knowledge-
t.95: And then We set you, (O Prophet), on a clear high road in religious matters. So follow that and do not follow the desires of those who do not know.
t.19: And now have We set thee (O Muhammad) on a clear road of (Our) commandment; so follow it, and follow not the whims of those who know not.
t.22: Then We put thee on the (right) Way of Religion: so follow thou that (Way), and follow not the desires of those who know not.
t.203: Then We have put you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) on a (plain) way of (Our) commandment [like the one which We commanded Our Messengers before you (i.e. legal ways and laws of the Islâmic Monotheism)]. So follow you that (Islâmic Monotheism and its laws), and follow not the desires of those who know not. (Tafsir At-Tabarî).
t.54: پھر ہم نے آپ کو دین کی (ﻇاہر) راه پر قائم کردیا، سو آپ اسی پر لگے رہیں اور نادانوں کی خواہشوں کی پیروی میں نہ پڑیں.

t.149: Indeed, they will never avail youagainst Allah in any way, for indeed, the unjust are guardians of one another, while Allah is the Ultimate Guardian of the ones mindful(of Him) .
t.84: They will never help you against Allah in the least. The wrongdoers are friends to one another, and Allah is the friend of the God-fearing.
t.85: they cannot help you against God in any way. Wrongdoers only have each other to protect them; the righteous have God Himself as their protector.
t.95: Surely they will be of no avail to you against Allah. Indeed the wrong-doers are friends of each other, whereas Allah is the friend of the God-fearing.
t.19: Lo! they can avail thee naught against Allah. And lo! as for the wrong-doers, some of them are friends of others; and Allah is the Friend of those who ward off (evil).
t.22: They will be of no use to thee in the sight of Allah: it is only Wrong-doers (that stand as) protectors, one to another: but Allah is the Protector of the Righteous.
t.203: Verily, they can avail you nothing against Allâh (if He wants to punish you). Verily, the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers) are Auliyâ’ (protectors, helpers) of one another, but Allâh is the Walî (Helper, Protector) of the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).
t.54: (یاد رکھیں) کہ یہ لوگ ہرگز اللہ کے سامنے آپ کے کچھ کام نہیں آسکتے۔ (سمجھ لیں کہ) ﻇالم لوگ آپس میں ایک دوسرے کے رفیق ہوتے ہیں اور پرہیزگاروں کا کارساز اللہ تعالیٰ ہے.

t.149: This provides insights for mankind, and guidance and mercy for people who believe with certitude.
t.84: These are insights for the people, and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
t.85: This [revelation] is a means of insight for people, a source of guidance and mercy for those of sure faith.
t.95: These are the lights of discernment for people and guidance and mercy for those endowed with sure faith.
t.19: This is clear indication for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a folk whose faith is sure.
t.22: These are clear evidences to men and a Guidance and Mercy to those of assured Faith.
t.203: This (Qur’an) is a clear insight and evidence for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for people who have Faith with certainty.
t.54: یہ (قرآن) لوگوں کے لیے بصیرت کی باتیں اور ہدایت ورحمت ہے اس قوم کے لیے جو یقین رکھتی ہے.

t.149: Or do those who have perpetrated evil deeds assume that We will make them asequal to those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds, whether in their life or their death? Miserableis their judgment!
t.84: Do those who have committed evils assume that We will make them like those who believe and do righteous deeds, so as their life and death becomes equal? Evil is what they judge.
t.85: Do those who commit evil deeds really think that We will deal with them in the same way as those who believe and do righteous deeds, that they will be alike in their living and their dying? How badly they judge!
t.95: Do the evil-doers imagine that We shall make them equal to those who believe and do good, making their lives and deaths alike? How vile is their judgement!
t.19: Or do those who commit ill-deeds suppose that We shall make them as those who believe and do good works, the same in life and death? Bad is their judgment!
t.22: What! Do those who seek after evil ways think that We shall hold them equal with those who believe and do righteous deeds,- that equal will be their life and their death? Ill is the judgment that they make.
t.203: Or do those who earn evil deeds think that We shall hold them equal with those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, in their present life and after their death? Worst is the judgement that they make.
t.54: کیا ان لوگوں کا جو برے کام کرتے ہیں یہ گمان ہے کہ ہم انہیں ان لوگوں جیسا کردیں گے جو ایمان ﻻئے اور نیک کام کیے کہ ان کا مرنا جینا یکساں ہوجائے، برا ہے وه فیصلہ جو وه کررہے ہیں.

t.149: And Allah created the heavens and the earth with truth, and so that every soul will be repaid for what it has earned, for they will not be dealt with unjustly.
t.84: Allah has created the heavens and the earth with just purpose, and so that everybody is recompensed for what he (or she) earned, and they will not be wronged.
t.85: God created the heavens and earth for a true purpose: to reward each soul according to its deeds. They will not be wronged.
t.95: Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth that each person may be requited for his deeds. They shall not be wronged.
t.19: And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged.
t.22: Allah created the heavens and the earth for just ends, and in order that each soul may find the recompense of what it has earned, and none of them be wronged.
t.203: And Allâh has created the heavens and the earth with truth, in order that each person may be recompensed what he has earned, and they will not be wronged.
t.54: اور آسمانوں اور زمین کو اللہ نے بہت ہی عدل کے ساتھ پیدا کیا ہے اور تاکہ ہر شخص کو اس کے کیے ہوئے کام کا پورا بدلہ دیا جائے اور ان پر ﻇلم نہ کیا جائے گا.

t.149: Have youseen the one who has taken his own whim as his god, and Allah has misguided him despite his knowledge, and has sealed his hearing and his heart, and has placed a veil over his sight? Who will guide him after Allah? Will you not remind yourselves?
t.84: So, have you seen him who has taken his desires as his god, and Allah has let him go astray, despite having knowledge, and has sealed his ear and his heart, and put a cover on his eye? Now who will guide him after Allah? Still, do you not take lesson?
t.85: [Prophet], consider the one who has taken his own desire as a god, whom God allows to stray in the face of knowledge, sealing his ears and heart and covering his eyes- who can guide such a person after God [has done this]? Will you [people] not take heed?
t.95: Did you ever consider the case of him who took his desire as his god, and then Allah caused him to go astray despite knowledge, and sealed his hearing and his heart, and cast a veil over his sight? Who, after Allah, can direct him to the Right Way? Will you not take heed?
t.19: Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed?
t.22: Then seest thou such a one as takes as his god his own vain desire? Allah has, knowing (him as such), left him astray, and sealed his hearing and his heart (and understanding), and put a cover on his sight. Who, then, will guide him after Allah (has withdrawn Guidance)? Will ye not then receive admonition?
t.203: Have you seen him who takes his own lust (vain desires) as his ilâh (god)? And Allâh knowing (him as such), left him astray, and sealed his hearing and his heart, and put a cover on his sight. Who then will guide him after Allâh? Will you not then remember?
t.54: کیا آپ نے اسے بھی دیکھا؟ جس نے اپنی خواہش نفس کو اپنا معبود بنا رکھا ہے اور باوجود سمجھ بوجھ کے اللہ نے اسے گمراه کردیا ہے اور اس کے کان اور دل پر مہر لگادی ہے اور اس کی آنکھ پر بھی پرده ڈال دیا ہے، اب ایسے شخص کو اللہ کے بعد کون ہدایت دے سکتا ہے.

t.149: And they said, “There is nothing but our Earlier Life; we die and we live, for nothing annihilates us except time.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are only guessing.
t.84: And they say, “There is no life but our worldly life. We die and live, and nothing destroys us except time.” They have no knowledge about that; they do nothing but make conjectures.
t.85: They say, ‘There is only our life in this world: we die, we live, nothing but time destroys us.’ They have no knowledge of this; they only follow guesswork. Their only argument,
t.95: They say: “There is no life other than our present worldly life: herein we live and we die, and it is only (the passage of) time that destroys us. Yet the fact is that they know nothing about this and are only conjecturing.
t.19: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess.
t.22: And they say: "What is there but our life in this world? We shall die and we live, and nothing but time can destroy us." But of that they have no knowledge: they merely conjecture:
t.203: And they say: "There is nothing but our life of this world, we die and we live and nothing destroys us except Ad-Dahr (time). And they have no knowledge of it: they only conjecture.
t.54: کیا اب بھی تم نصیحت نہیں پکڑتے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ ہماری زندگی تو صرف دنیا کی زندگی ہی ہے۔ ہم مرتے ہیں اور جیتے ہیں اور ہمیں صرف زمانہ ہی مار ڈالتا ہے، (دراصل) انہیں اس کا کچھ علم ہی نہیں۔ یہ تو صرف (قیاس اور) اٹکل سے ہی کام لے رہے ہیں.

t.149: And when Our signsare recited to them, evident, their only argument is to say, “Bring back our forefathers, if youare truthful.”
t.84: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, their argument is none but that they say, “Bring our fathers, if you are truthful.”
t.85: when Our clear revelations are recited to them, is to say, ‘Bring back our forefathers if what you say is true.’
t.95: And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, their only contention is: “Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.”
t.19: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them their only argument is that they say: Bring (back) our fathers. then, if ye are truthful.
t.22: And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them their argument is nothing but this: They say, "Bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
t.203: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, their argument is no other than that they say: "Bring back our (dead) fathers, if you are truthful!"
t.54: اور جب ان کے سامنے ہماری واضح اور روشن آیتوں کی تلاوت کی جاتی ہے، تو ان کے پاس اس قول کے سوا کوئی دلیل نہیں ہوتی کہ اگر تم سچے ہو تو ہمارے باپ دادوں کو ﻻؤ.

t.149: Say, “Allah gives you life, then He makes you die, then He gathers you for the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt; but most of mankind does not know.”
t.84: Say, “Allah gives you life, then makes you die, then He will assemble you on the Day of Judgement in which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know.
t.85: [Prophet], say, ‘It is God who gives you life, then causes you to die, and then He gathers you all to the Day of Resurrection of which there is no doubt, though most people do not comprehend.’
t.95: Tell them, (O Prophet): “It is Allah Who gives you life and then causes you to die, and He it is Who will then bring all of you together on the Day of Resurrection, a Day regarding which there can be no doubt. Yet most people do not know.
t.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not.
t.22: Say: "It is Allah Who gives you life, then gives you death; then He will gather you together for the Day of Judgment about which there is no doubt": But most men do not understand.
t.203: Say (to them): "Allâh gives you life, then causes you to die, then He will assemble you on the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not."
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! اللہ ہی تمہیں زنده کرتا ہے پھر تمہیں مار ڈالتا ہے پھر تمہیں قیامت کے دن جمع کرے گا جس میں کوئی شک نہیں لیکن اکثر لوگ نہیں سمجھتے.

t.149: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Thus on the day when the Hour takes place—on that day the advocates of falsehood lose.
t.84: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. The day the Hour will take place, it will be the day in which the adherents of falsehood shall lose,
t.85: Control of everything in the heavens and the earth belongs to God. When the Hour comes, those who follow falsehood will be the losers on that Day.
t.95: Allah's is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and on the Day when the Hour (of Resurrection) shall come to pass, the followers of falsehood shall be in utter loss.
t.19: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost.
t.22: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and the Day that the Hour of Judgment is established,- that Day will the dealers in Falsehood perish!
t.203: And to Allâh belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And on the Day that the Hour will be established - on that Day the followers of falsehood (polytheists, disbelievers, worshippers of false deities) shall lose (everything).
t.54: اور آسمانوں اور زمین کی بادشاہی اللہ ہی کی ہے اور جس دن قیامت قائم ہوگی اس دن اہل باطل بڑے نقصان میں پڑیں گے.

t.149: And yousee every community kneeling; every community iscalled to its Scripture: “Today youare being repaid for what you used to do:
t.84: and you will see every community kneeling down. Every community will be called to its book (of record). Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
t.85: You will see every community kneeling. Every community will be summoned to its record: ‘Today you will be repaid for what you did.
t.95: On that Day you shall see every people fallen on their knees. Every people will be summoned to come forth and see its Record and will be told: “Today you shall be requited for your deeds.
t.19: And thou wilt see each nation crouching, each nation summoned to its record. (And it will be said unto them): This day ye are requited what ye used to do.
t.22: And thou wilt see every sect bowing the knee: Every sect will be called to its Record: "This Day shall ye be recompensed for all that ye did!
t.203: And you will see each nation humbled to their knees (kneeling): each nation will be called to its Record (of deeds). This Day you shall be recompensed for what you used to do.
t.54: اور آپ دیکھیں گے کہ ہر امت گھٹنوں کے بل گری ہوئی ہوگی۔ ہر گروه اپنے نامہٴ اعمال کی طرف بلایا جائے گا، آج تمہیں اپنے کیے کا بدلہ دیا جائے گا.

t.149: here is Our Scripture speaking about youin truth. Surely, We have been transcribing what youhave been doing.”
t.84: This is Our book that speaks against you with truth. We used to get recorded all that you used to do.
t.85: Here is Our record that tells the truth about you: We have been recording everything you do.’
t.95: This is Our Record which bears witness against you with truth; We used to record all what you did.”
t.19: This Our Book pronounceth against you with truth. Lo! We have caused (all) that ye did to be recorded.
t.22: "This Our Record speaks about you with truth: For We were wont to put on Record all that ye did."
t.203: This Our Record speaks about you with truth. Verily, We were recording what you used to do (i.e. Our angels used to record your deeds).
t.54: یہ ہے ہماری کتاب جو تمہارے بارے میں سچ سچ بول رہی ہے، ہم تمہارے اعمال لکھواتے جاتے تھے.

t.149: As for those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—their Lord enters them into His mercy; that is the evident triumph.
t.84: Then, as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them to His mercy. That is indeed the achievement, visible to all.
t.85: Those who believed and did good deeds will be admitted by their Lord into His mercy- that is the clearest triumph-
t.95: As for those who believe and act righteously, their Lord shall admit them to His Mercy. That indeed is the manifest triumph.
t.19: Then, as for those who believed and did good works, their Lord will bring them in unto His mercy. That is the evident triumph.
t.22: Then, as to those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them to His Mercy that will be the achievement for all to see.
t.203: Then, as for those who believed (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and did righteous good deeds, their Lord will admit them to His Mercy. That will be the evident success.
t.54: پس لیکن جو لوگ ایمان ﻻئے اور انہوں نے نیک کام کیے تو ان کو ان کا رب اپنی رحمت تلے لے لے گا، یہی صریح کامیابی ہے.

t.149: But as for those who have denied(it will be said to them) : “Were My signs not read to you, yet you acted arrogantly and were a criminal people?”
t.84: And as to those who disbelieved, (it will be said to them,) “Had My verses not been recited to you? But you showed arrogance, and you were a guilty people;
t.85: but those who disbelieved [will be asked]: ‘When My revelations were recited to you, were you not arrogant and persistent in wicked deeds?
t.95: But those who denied the Truth, they shall be told: “Were My Signs not rehearsed to you? But you waxed proud and became a guilty people.”
t.19: And as for those who disbelieved (it will be said unto them): Were not Our revelations recited unto you? But ye were scornful and became a guilty folk.
t.22: But as to those who rejected Allah, (to them will be said): "Were not Our Signs rehearsed to you? But ye were arrogant, and were a people given to sin!
t.203: But as for those who disbelieved (it will be said to them): "Were not Our Verses recited to you? But you were proud, and you were a people who were Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals)."
t.54: لیکن جن لوگوں نے کفر کیا تو (میں ان سے کہوں گا) کیا میری آیتیں تمہیں سنائی نہیں جاتی تھیں؟ پھر بھی تم تکبر کرتے رہے اور تم تھے ہی گنہ گار لوگ.

t.149: And when it is said, “Indeed, the promise of Allah is true”—while of the Hour there is no doubt—yousay, “We do not know what the Hour is; we are only making a guess; we are not certain.”
t.84: and when it was said to you that Allah’s promise is true and there is no doubt in the (arrival of the) Hour, you used to say, ‘We do not know what the Hour is. We do not think (about it) but as an assumption, and we are not sure.’”
t.85: When it was said to you, “God’s promise is true: there is no doubt about the Hour,” did you not reply, “We know nothing of the Hour. This is only conjecture in our opinion. We are not convinced”?’
t.95: And when it was said to them: “Surely Allah's promise is true, and there is no doubt regarding the Hour of Resurrection,” you were wont to say: “We do not know what the Hour (of Resurrection) is. We are simply making conjectures and are not at all certain.”
t.19: And when it was said: Lo! Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming, ye said: We know not what the Hour is. We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced.
t.22: "And when it was said that the promise of Allah was true, and that the Hour- there was no doubt about its (coming), ye used to say, 'We know not what is the hour: we only think it is an idea, and we have no firm assurance.'"
t.203: And when it was said: "Verily, Allâh’s Promise is the truth, and there is no doubt about the coming of the Hour," you said: "We know not what is the Hour: we do not think it but as a conjecture, and we have no firm convincing belief (therein)."
t.54: اور جب کبھی کہا جاتا کہ اللہ کا وعده یقیناً سچا ہے اور قیامت کے آنے میں کوئی شک نہیں تو تم جواب دیتے تھے کہ ہم نہیں جانتے قیامت کیا چیز ہے؟ ہمیں کچھ یوں ہی سا خیال ہوجاتا ہے لیکن ہمیں یقین نہیں.

t.149: And the evils of what they had done became evident to them, and they became surrounded by what they used to ridicule.
t.84: And revealed to them will be the evils of what they did, and encircled they will be by what they used to ridicule.
t.85: The evil of their actions will [then] become clear to them. The punishment they mocked will engulf them.
t.95: (On that Day) the evil of their deeds will become apparent to them and what they had mocked at will encompass them,
t.19: And the evils of what they did will appear unto them, and that which they used to deride will befall them.
t.22: Then will appear to them the evil (fruits) of what they did, and they will be completely encircled by that which they used to mock at!
t.203: And the evil of what they did will appear to them, and that which they used to mock at will completely encircle them.
t.54: اور ان پر اپنے اعمال کی برائیاں کھل گئیں اور جس کا وه مذاق اڑا رہے تھے اس نے انہیں گھیر لیا.

t.149: And it was said, “Today We forget youas you forgot the meeting of this day of yours. Thus your shelter is the Fire, and there are no helpers for you.
t.84: It will be said, “Today We will forget you, as you forgot facing this your day, and your abode is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers at all.
t.85: It will be said, ‘Today We shall ignore you just as you ignored your appointment with this Day. The Fire will be your home and no one will help you,
t.95: and it will be said: “We will forget you today as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours. The Fire shall now be your abode, and you shall have none to come to your aid.
t.19: And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you.
t.22: It will also be said: "This Day We will forget you as ye forgot the meeting of this Day of yours! and your abode is the Fire, and no helpers have ye!
t.203: And it will be said: "This Day We will forget you as you forgot the Meeting of this Day of yours. And your abode is the Fire, and there is none to help you."
t.54: اور کہہ دیا گیا کہ آج ہم تمہیں بھلا دیں گے جیسے کہ تم نے اپنے اس دن سے ملنے کو بھلا دیا تھا تمہارا ٹھکانا جہنم ہے اور تمہارا مددگار کوئی نہیں.

t.149: That is because youdealt with Allah’s signswith ridicule, and the Earlier Life deceived you.” So today they are not brought outof it, and they are not allowed to make amends.
t.84: That is because you took Allah’s verses as a laughing stock, and the worldly life deceived you.” So today they will neither be brought out of it, nor will they be asked to repent.
t.85: because you received God’s revelations with ridicule and were deceived by worldly life.’ They will not be brought out of the Fire on that Day, nor will they be given the chance to make amends.
t.95: You reached this end because you made Allah's Signs an object of jest and the life of the world deluded you.” So they shall not be taken out of the Fire nor shall they be asked to make amends (and thus please their Lord).
t.19: This, forasmuch as ye made the revelations of Allah a jest, and the life of the world beguiled you. Therefor this day they come not forth from thence, nor can they make amends.
t.22: "This, because ye used to take the Signs of Allah in jest, and the life of the world deceived you:" (From) that Day, therefore, they shall not be taken out thence, nor shall they be received into Grace.
t.203: This, because you took the revelations of Allâh (this Qur’ân) in mockery, and the life of the world deceived you. So this Day, they shall not be taken out from there (Hell), nor shall they be returned to the worldly life, (so that they repent to Allâh, and beg His Pardon for their sins).
t.54: یہ اس لیے ہے کہ تم نے اللہ تعالیٰ کی آیتوں کی ہنسی اڑائی تھی اور دنیا کی زندگی نے تمہیں دھوکے میں ڈال رکھا تھا، پس آج کے دن نہ تو یہ (دوزخ) سے نکالے جائیں گے اور نہ ان سے عذر و معذرت قبول کیا جائے گا.

t.149: So praise be to Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all realms.
t.84: So, to Allah belongs all praise, who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the worlds.
t.85: So praise be to God, Lord of the heavens and earth, Lord of the worlds.
t.95: So all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the heavens, the Lord of the earth, the Lord of the whole Universe.
t.19: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.
t.22: Then Praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth,- Lord and Cherisher of all the Worlds!
t.203: So all the praises and thanks be to Allâh, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, and the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: پس اللہ کی تعریف ہے جو آسمانوں اور زمین اور تمام جہان کا پالنہار ہے.

t.149: And to Him belongs all supremacy in the heavens and the earth, for He is the Almighty, the All-Wise.
t.84: And to Him belongs majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.
t.85: True greatness in the heavens and the earth is rightfully His: He is the Mighty, the Wise.
t.95: His is the glory in the heavens and the earth. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
t.19: And unto Him (alone) belongeth Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
t.22: To Him be glory throughout the heavens and the earth: and He is Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom!
t.203: And His (Alone) is the Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
t.54: تمام (بزرگی اور) بڑائی آسمانوں اور زمین میں اسی کی ہے اور وہی غالب اور حکمت واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Ha Mīm.
t.84: Hā Mīm .
t.85: Ha Mim
t.95: Ha'. Mim.
t.19: Ha. Mim.
t.22: Ha-Mim.
t.203: Hâ-Mîm.
t.54: حٰم.

t.149: The bestowal of the Scripture from on high is by Allah, the Almighty, the All-Wise.
t.84: This is revelation of the book from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
t.85: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Almighty, the Wise.
t.95: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
t.19: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah the Mighty, the Wise.
t.22: The Revelation of the Book is from Allah the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.
t.203: The revelation of the Book (this Qur’ân) is from Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
t.54: اس کتاب کا اتارنا اللہ تعالیٰ غالب حکمت والے کی طرف سے ہے.

t.149: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what lies between them except in accordance with truth and for a stated term. But the deniers continue to disregard the warnings which they have received.
t.84: We did not create the heavens and the earth but with true purpose and for a specified term. But those who disbelieve are averse to what they are warned of.
t.85: It was for a true purpose and a specific term that We created heaven and earth and everything in between, yet those who deny the truth ignore the warning they have been given.
t.95: We have created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in Truth and for an appointed term. But those who disbelieve have turned away from what they were warned against.
t.19: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.
t.22: We created not the heavens and the earth and all between them but for just ends, and for a Term Appointed: But those who reject Faith turn away from that whereof they are warned.
t.203: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with truth, and for an appointed term. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.
t.54: ہم نے آسمانوں اور زمین اور ان دونوں کے درمیان کی تمام چیزوں کو بہترین تدبیر کے ساتھ ہی ایک مدت معین کے لئے پیدا کیا ہے، اور کافر لوگ جس چیز سے ڈرائے جاتے ہیں منھ موڑ لیتے ہیں.

t.149: Say, “Have youseen what you call upon apart from Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth, or do they own a share of the heavens? Bring me a scripture prior to this one, or some trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.”
t.84: Say, “Tell me about those whom you invoke instead of Allah, (and) show me what they have created from the earth; Or have they a share in (the creation of) the heavens? Bring to me a book (revealed) before this one, or a trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.”
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Consider those you pray to other than God: show me which part of the earth they created or which share of the heavens they own; bring me a previous scripture or some vestige of divine knowledge––if what you say is true.’
t.95: Tell them, (O Prophet): “Did you consider those whom you call upon beside Allah? Show me, which part of the earth they created? Or do they have any share in creating the heavens? Bring to me any Scripture earlier than this one, or any vestige of knowledge (in support of your belief) if you are truthful.
t.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful.
t.22: Say: "Do ye see what it is ye invoke besides Allah? Show me what it is they have created on earth, or have they a share in the heavens bring me a book (revealed) before this, or any remnant of knowledge (ye may have), if ye are telling the truth!
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to these pagans): "Think you about all that you invoke besides Allâh? Show me. What have they created of the earth? Or have they a share in (the creation of) the heavens? Bring me a Book (revealed before this), or some trace of knowledge (in support of your claims), if you are truthful!"
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! بھلا دیکھو تو جنہیں تم اللہ کے سوا پکارتے ہو مجھے بھی تو دکھاؤ کہ انہوں نے زمین کا کون سا ٹکڑا بنایا ہے یا آسمانوں میں ان کا کون سا حصہ ہے؟ اگر تم سچے ہو تو اس سے پہلے ہی کی کوئی کتاب یا کوئی علم ہی جو نقل کیا جاتا ہو، میرے پاس ﻻؤ.

t.149: And who is more misguided than one who calls upon, apart from Allah, those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection and who are oblivious to their invocation?
t.84: Who is more astray than him who invokes, instead of Allah, those who will not respond to him up to the Day of Judgement; and they are totally unaware of their prayers,
t.85: Who could be more wrong than a person who calls on those other than God, those who will not answer him till the Day of Resurrection, those who are unaware of his prayers,
t.95: Who is farther strayed from the Right Path than he who calls upon others than Allah that cannot answer his call till the Day of Resurrection, the while they are not even conscious that callers are calling upon them?
t.19: And who is further astray than those who, instead of Allah, pray unto such as hear not their prayer until the Day of Resurrection, and are unconscious of their prayer,
t.22: And who is more astray than one who invokes besides Allah, such as will not answer him to the Day of Judgment, and who (in fact) are unconscious of their call (to them)?
t.203: And who is more astray than one who calls on (invokes) besides Allâh, such as will not answer him till the Day of Resurrection, and who are (even) unaware of their calls (invocations) to them?
t.54: اور اس سے بڑھ کر گمراه اور کون ہوگا؟ جو اللہ کے سوا ایسوں کو پکارتا ہے جو قیامت تک اس کی دعا قبول نہ کر سکیں بلکہ ان کے پکارنے سے محض بےخبر ہوں.

t.149: And when mankind is herded, those(false gods) become enemies to them and deny their worship of them.
t.84: and when people will be assembled (on the Day of Judgment), they will be enemies to them, and will refuse even their having worshipped them.
t.85: those who, when all mankind is gathered, will become his enemies and disown his worship?
t.95: When all human beings will be gathered together those who had been called upon will become the enemies to their votaries and will disown their worship.
t.19: And when mankind are gathered (to the Judgment) will become enemies for them, and will become deniers of having been worshipped.
t.22: And when mankind are gathered together (at the Resurrection), they will be hostile to them and reject their worship (altogether)!
t.203: And when mankind are gathered (on the Day of Resurrection), they (false deities) will become their enemies and will deny their worshipping.
t.54: اور جب لوگوں کو جمع کیا جائے گا تو یہ ان کے دشمن ہو جائیں گے اور ان کی پرستش سے صاف انکار کر جائیں گے.

t.149: And when Our signsare read to them, evident, those who deny say of the truth when it has come to them, “This is evident sorcery.”
t.84: When Our verses are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say about the truth when it comes to them, “This is an open magic.”
t.85: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, the disbelievers say of the Truth that has reached them, ‘This is clearly sorcery,’
t.95: When Our Clear Messages are rehearsed to them, the unbelievers exclaim about the Truth when it came to them: “This is plain sorcery.”
t.19: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say of the Truth when it reacheth them: This is mere magic.
t.22: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say, of the Truth when it comes to them: "This is evident sorcery!"
t.203: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, the disbelievers say of the truth (this Qur’ân) when it reaches them: "This is plain magic!"
t.54: اور انہیں جب ہماری واضح آیتیں پڑھ کر سنائی جاتی ہیں تو منکر لوگ سچی بات کو جب کہ ان کے پاس آچکی، کہہ دیتے ہیں کہ یہ تو صریح جادو ہے.

t.149: Or do they say, “He has fabricated it!” Say, “If I have fabricated it myself, there is nothing youcan do to protect me from Allah. He knows better what you are engaged in; sufficient is He as a witness between me and you, and He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Bestower of mercy.”
t.84: Is it that they say, “He has forged it (the Qur’ān)”? Say, “If I have forged it, then you do not have any power to help me against Allah. He is well aware of what you are engaged in. He is enough as a witness between me and you, and He is the Most-Forgiving, the Very-Merciful.”
t.85: or they say, ‘He has invented it himself.’ Say [Prophet], ‘If I have really invented it, there is nothing you can do to save me from God. He knows best what you say amongst yourselves about it; He is sufficient as a witness between me and you; He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.’
t.95: Do they claim that the Messenger himself has fabricated it? (If so), tell them: “If I have fabricated it, then you have no power to protect me from Allah's chastisement. He knows well the idle talk in which you indulge. He suffices as a witness between me and you. He is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
t.19: Or say they: He hath invented it? Say (O Muhammad): If I have invented it, still ye have no power to support me against Allah. He is Best Aware of what ye say among yourselves concerning it. He sufficeth for a witness between me and you. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
t.22: Or do they say, "He has forged it"? Say: "Had I forged it, then can ye obtain no single (blessing) for me from Allah. He knows best of that whereof ye talk (so glibly)! Enough is He for a witness between me and you! And he is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
t.203: Or say they: "He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has fabricated it." Say: "If I have fabricated it? still you have no power to support me against Allâh. He knows best of what you say among yourselves concerning it (i.e. this Qur’ân)! Sufficient is He as a witness between me and you! And He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful."
t.54: کیا وه کہتے ہیں کہ اسے تو اس نے خود گھڑ لیا ہے آپ کہہ دیجئے! کہ اگر میں ہی اسے بنا ﻻیا ہوں تو تم میرے لئے اللہ کی طرف سے کسی چیز کا اختیار نہیں رکھتے، تم اس (قرآن) کے بارے میں جو کچھ کہہ سن رہے ہو اسے اللہ خوب جانتا ہے، میرے اور تمہارے درمیان گواہی کے لئے وہی کافی ہے، اور وه بخشنے واﻻ مہربان ہے.

t.149: Say, “I am not different from the other messengers, and I do not know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow what is revealed to me, and I am only an evident warner.”
t.84: Say, “I am not something unprecedented among the messengers, and I do not know what will be done to me or to you. I do not follow anything but what is revealed to me, and I am only a clear warner.”
t.85: Say, ‘I am nothing new among God’s messengers. I do not know what will be done with me or you; I only follow what is revealed to me; I only warn plainly.’
t.95: Tell them: “I am not the first of the Messengers; and I do not know what shall be done with me or with you. I follow only what is revealed to me, and I am nothing but a plain warner.”
t.19: Say: I am no new thing among the messengers (of Allah), nor know I what will be done with me or with you. I do but follow that which is inspired in me, and I am but a plain warner.
t.22: Say: "I am no bringer of new-fangled doctrine among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I follow but that which is revealed to me by inspiration; I am but a Warner open and clear."
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I am not a new thing among the Messengers (of Allâh i.e. I am not the first Messenger) nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am but a plain warner."
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! کہ میں کوئی بالکل انوکھا پیغمبر تو نہیں نہ مجھے یہ معلوم ہے کہ میرے ساتھ اور تمہارے ساتھ کیا کیا جائے گا۔ میں تو صرف اسی کی پیروی کرتا ہوں جو میری طرف وحی بھیجی جاتی ہے اور میں تو صرف علیاﻻعلان آگاه کر دینے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: Say, “Have youseen: if it is truly from Allah and you deny it? And a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to its like and has attained faith, while you have acted arrogantly. Indeed, Allah does not guide the unjust people.”
t.84: Say, “Tell me, If it (the Qur’ān) is from Allah and you reject it, and a witness from the children of Isrā’īl testifies about something similar to it and comes to believe (in it), while you persist in your arrogance, (then, how unjust you are!) Surely, Allah does not give guidance to the unjust people.
t.85: Say, ‘Have you thought: what if this Quran really is from God and you reject it? What if one of the Children of Israel testifies to its similarity [to earlier scripture] and believes in it, and yet you are too proud to [do the same]? God certainly does not guide evildoers.’
t.95: Tell them, (O Prophet): “Did you consider (what would be your end) if this Qur'an were indeed from Allah and yet you rejected it? And this even though a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to the like of it. But he believed, while you waxed arrogant. Verily Allah does not guide such wrong-doers to the Right Way.
t.19: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye disbelieve therein, and a witness of the Children of Israel hath already testified to the like thereof and hath believed, and ye are too proud (what plight is yours)? Lo! Allah guideth not wrong-doing folk.
t.22: Say: "See ye? If (this teaching) be from Allah, and ye reject it, and a witness from among the Children of Israel testifies to its similarity (with earlier scripture), and has believed while ye are arrogant, (how unjust ye are!) truly, Allah guides not a people unjust."
t.203: Say: "Tell me! If this (Qur’ân) is from Allâh and you deny it, and a witness from among the Children of Israel (‘Abdullâh bin Salâm رضي الله عنه) testifies that [this Qur’ân is from Allâh (like the Taurât (Torah)], and he believed (embraced Islâm) while you are too proud (to believe)." Verily, Allâh guides not the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists, disbelievers and wrong-doers).
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! اگر یہ (قرآن) اللہ ہی کی طرف سے ہو اور تم نے اسے نہ مانا ہو اور بنی اسرائیل کا ایک گواه اس جیسی کی گواہی بھی دے چکا ہو اور وه ایمان بھی ﻻچکا ہو اور تم نے سرکشی کی ہو، تو بیشک اللہ تعالیٰ ﻇالموں کو راه نہیں دکھاتا.

t.149: Those who denied said of those who had attained faith, “If it were anything good, they would not have preceded us to it.” And since they were not guided by it, they will say, “This is an ancient lie.”
t.84: The disbelievers say about the believers, “Had it (Islamic faith) been a good thing, these (weak and poor) people would not have preceded us (in proceeding) towards it.” Since they did not accept guidance through it (the Qur’ān), they will say, “This is a classical lie.”
t.85: Those who disbelieve say of the believers, ‘If there were any good in this Quran, they would not have believed in it before we did,’and, since they refuse to be guided by it, they say, ‘This is an ancient fabrication.’
t.95: The unbelievers say to the believers: If there was any good in this Book, others would not have beaten us to its acceptance.” But since they have not been guided to it, they will certainly say: “This is an old fabrication.”
t.19: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe: If it had been (any) good, they would not have been before us in attaining it. And since they will not be guided by it, they say: This is an ancient lie;
t.22: The Unbelievers say of those who believe: "If (this Message) were a good thing, (such men) would not have gone to it first, before us!" And seeing that they guide not themselves thereby, they will say, "this is an (old,) falsehood!"
t.203: And those who disbelieve (the strong and wealthy) say of those who believe (the weak and poor): "Had it (Islâmic Monotheism to which Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم is inviting mankind) been a good thing, they (the weak and poor) would not have preceded us thereto!" And when they have not let themselves be guided by it (this Qur’ân), they say: "This is an ancient lie!"
