t.22: And know that among you is Allah's Messenger: were he, in many matters, to follow your (wishes), ye would certainly fall into misfortune: But Allah has endeared the Faith to you, and has made it beautiful in your hearts, and He has made hateful to you Unbelief, wickedness, and rebellion: such indeed are those who walk in righteousness;-
t.203: And know that among you there is the Messenger of Allâh (صلى الله عليه وسلم). If he were to obey you (i.e. follow your opinions and desires) in much of the matter, you would surely be in trouble. But Allâh has endeared the Faith to you and has beautified it in your hearts, and has made disbelief, wickedness and disobedience (to Allâh and His Messenger صلى الله عليه وسلم) hateful to you. Such are they who are the rightly guided.
t.54: اور جان رکھو کہ تم میں اللہ کے رسول موجود ہیں، اگر وه تمہارا کہا کرتے رہے بہت امور میں، تو تم مشکل میں پڑجاؤ لیکن اللہ تعالیٰ نے ایمان کو تمہارے لئے محبوب بنا دیا ہے اور اسے تمہارے دلوں میں زینت دے رکھی ہے اور کفر کو اور گناه کو اور نافرمانی کو تمہارے نگاہوں میں ناپسندیده بنا دیا ہے، یہی لوگ راه یافتہ ہیں.

t.149: A grace from Allah and a blessing, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
t.84: as a grace from Allah, and as a blessing. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
t.85: through God’s favour and blessing: God is all knowing and all wise.
t.95: by Allah's favour and bounty. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
t.19: (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise.
t.22: A Grace and Favour from Allah; and Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
t.203: (This is) a Grace from Allâh and His Favour. And Allâh is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
t.54: اللہ کے احسان وانعام سے اور اللہ دانا اور باحکمت ہے.

t.149: And if two factions of believers fall to fighting each other, reconcilebetween them. But if one group oppresses the other, then combat the one which oppresses until it complies with the command of Allah. But once it has complied, reconcile between them with justice and be equitable; indeed, Allah loves the equitable.
t.84: If two groups of the believers fight each other, seek reconciliation between them. And if one of them commits aggression against the other, fight the one that commits aggression until it comes back to Allah’s command. So if it comes back, seek reconciliation between them with fairness, and maintain justice. Surely Allah loves those who maintain justice.
t.85: If two groups of the believers fight, you [believers] should try to reconcile them; if one of them is [clearly] oppressing the other, fight the oppressors until they submit to God’s command, then make a just and even-handed reconciliation between the two of them: God loves those who are even-handed.
t.95: If two parties of the believers happen to fight, make peace between them. But then, if one of them transgresses against the other, fight the one that transgresses until it reverts to Allah's command. And if it does revert, make peace between them with justice, and be equitable for Allah loves the equitable.
t.19: And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.
t.22: If two parties among the Believers fall into a quarrel, make ye peace between them: but if one of them transgresses beyond bounds against the other, then fight ye (all) against the one that transgresses until it complies with the command of Allah; but if it complies, then make peace between them with justice, and be fair: for Allah loves those who are fair (and just).
t.203: And if two parties or groups among the believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them both. But if one of them outrages against the other, then fight you (all) against the one that which outrages till it complies with the Command of Allâh. Then if it complies, then make reconciliation between them justly, and be equitable. Verily! Allâh loves those who are the equitable.
t.54: اور اگر مسلمانوں کی دو جماعتیں آپس میں لڑ پڑیں تو ان میں میل ملاپ کرا دیا کرو۔ پھر اگر ان دونوں میں سے ایک جماعت دوسری جماعت پر زیادتی کرے تو تم (سب) اس گروه سے جو زیادتی کرتا ہے لڑو۔ یہاں تک کہ وه اللہ کے حکم کی طرف لوٹ آئے، اگر لوٹ آئے تو پھر انصاف کے ساتھ صلح کرا دو اور عدل کرو بیشک اللہ تعالیٰ انصاف کرنے والوں سے محبت کرتا ہے.

t.149: Indeed, all the believers are but brothers, so reconcile between yourtwo brothers and be mindful of Allah, that you may receive mercy.
t.84: All believers are but brothers, therefore seek reconciliation between your two brothers, and fear Allah, so that you may be blessed with mercy.
t.85: The believers are brothers, so make peace between your two brothers and be mindful of God, so that you may be given mercy.
t.95: Surely the believers are none but brothers unto one another, so set things right between your brothers, and have fear of Allah that you may be shown mercy.
t.19: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.
t.22: The Believers are but a single Brotherhood: So make peace and reconciliation between your two (contending) brothers; and fear Allah, that ye may receive Mercy.
t.203: The believers are nothing else than brothers (in Islâmic religion). So make reconciliation between your brothers, and fear Allâh, that you may receive mercy.
t.54: (یاد رکھو) سارے مسلمان بھائی بھائی ہیں پس اپنے دو بھائیوں میں ملاپ کرا دیا کرو، اور اللہ سے ڈرتے رہو تاکہ تم پر رحم کیا جائے.

t.149: O you who have attained faith, no people shall ridicule other people, for they may be better than them. Nor shall any women ridicule other women, for they may be better than them. Nor shall you defame yourselves, nor shall you insult one another by nicknames. What a miserable label ungodliness is after attaining faith! And whoever has not repented—then thoseare the unjust.
t.84: O you who believe, no men should ever scoff at other men. May be, the latter are better than the former. Nor should women (ever scoff) at other women. May be, the latter women are better than the former ones. And do not find fault with one another, nor call one another with bad nicknames. Bad is the name of sinfulness after embracing Faith. If anyone does not repent, then such people are the wrongdoers.
t.85: Believers, no one group of men should jeer at another, who may after all be better than them; no one group of women should jeer at another, who may after all be better than them; do not speak ill of one another; do not use offensive nicknames for one another. How bad it is to be called a mischief-maker after accepting faith! Those who do not repent of this behaviour are evildoers.
t.95: Believers, let not a group (of men) scoff at another group, it may well be that the latter (at whom they scoff) are better than they; nor let a group of women scoff at another group, it may well be that the latter are better than they. And do not taunt one another, nor revile one another by nicknames. It is an evil thing to gain notoriety for ungodliness after belief. Those who do not repent are indeed the wrong-doers.
t.19: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.
t.22: O ye who believe! Let not some men among you laugh at others: It may be that the (latter) are better than the (former): Nor let some women laugh at others: It may be that the (latter are better than the (former): Nor defame nor be sarcastic to each other, nor call each other by (offensive) nicknames: Ill-seeming is a name connoting wickedness, (to be used of one) after he has believed: And those who do not desist are (indeed) doing wrong.
t.203: O you who believe! Let not a group scoff at another group, it may be that the latter are better than the former. Nor let (some) women scoff at other women, it may be that the latter are better than the former. Nor defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. How bad is it to insult one’s brother after having Faith [i.e. to call your Muslim brother (a faithful believer) as: "O sinner", or "O wicked"]. And whosoever does not repent, then such are indeed Zâlimûn (wrong-doers, etc.).
t.54: اے ایمان والو! مرد دوسرے مردوں کا مذاق نہ اڑائیں ممکن ہے کہ یہ ان سے بہتر ہو اور نہ عورتیں عورتوں کا مذاق اڑائیں ممکن ہے یہ ان سے بہتر ہوں، اور آپس میں ایک دوسرے کو عیب نہ لگاؤ اور نہ کسی کو برے لقب دو۔ ایمان کے بعد فسق برا نام ہے، اور جو توبہ نہ کریں وہی ﻇالم لوگ ہیں.

t.149: O you who have attained faith, avoid making too many assumptions—indeed, some assumptions are sinful. And do not spy on one another nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would detest it. So be mindful of Allah; indeed, Allah is Granting and Accepting of repentance, Bestowing of mercy.
t.84: O you who believe, abstain from many of the suspicions. Some suspicions are sins. And do not be curious (to find out faults of others), and do not backbite one another. Does one of you like that he eats the flesh of his dead brother? You would abhor it. And fear Allah. Surely Allah is Most-Relenting, Very-Merciful.
t.85: Believers, avoid making too many assumptions- some assumptions are sinful- and do not spy on one another or speak ill of people behind their backs: would any of you like to eat the flesh of your dead brother? No, you would hate it. So be mindful of God: God is ever relenting, most merciful.
t.95: Believers, avoid being excessively suspicious, for some suspicion is a sin. Do not spy, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would surely detest it. Have fear of Allah. Surely Allah is much prone to accept repentance, is Most Compassionate.
t.19: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.
t.22: O ye who believe! Avoid suspicion as much (as possible): for suspicion in some cases is a sin: And spy not on each other behind their backs. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Nay, ye would abhor it... But fear Allah: For Allah is Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.
t.203: O you who believe! Avoid much suspicion; indeed some suspicions are sins. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would hate it (so hate backbiting). And fear Allâh. Verily, Allâh is the One Who forgives and accepts repentance, Most Merciful.
t.54: اے ایمان والو! بہت بدگمانیوں سے بچو یقین مانو کہ بعض بدگمانیاں گناه ہیں۔ اور بھید نہ ٹٹوﻻ کرو اور نہ تم میں سے کوئی کسی کی غیبت کرے۔ کیا تم میں سے کوئی بھی اپنے مرده بھائی کا گوشت کھانا پسند کرتا ہے؟ تم کو اس سے گھن آئے گی، اور اللہ سے ڈرتے رہو، بیشک اللہ توبہ قبول کرنے واﻻ مہربان ہے.

t.149: O mankind, We have created you from a male and a female and made you into races and tribes, that you may know one another; indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah are the most mindful(of Him) among you; indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
t.84: O mankind, We have created you from a male and a female, and made you into races and tribes, so that you may identify one another. Surely the noblest of you, in Allah’s sight, is the one who is most pious of you. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
t.85: People, We created you all from a single man and a single woman, and made you into races and tribes so that you should recognize one another. In God’s eyes, the most honoured of you are the ones most mindful of Him: God is all knowing, all aware.
t.95: Human beings, We created you all from a male and a female, and made you into nations and tribes so that you may know one another. Verily the noblest of you in the sight of Allah is the most God-fearing of you. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
t.19: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.
t.22: O mankind! We created you from a single (pair) of a male and a female, and made you into nations and tribes, that ye may know each other (not that ye may despise (each other). Verily the most honoured of you in the sight of Allah is (he who is) the most righteous of you. And Allah has full knowledge and is well acquainted (with all things).
t.203: O mankind! We have created you from a male and a female, and made you into nations and tribes, that you may know one another. Verily, the most honourable of you with Allâh is that (believer) who has At-Taqwâ [i.e. he is one of the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2)]. Verily, Allâh is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
t.54: اے لوگو! ہم نے تم سب کو ایک (ہی) مرد وعورت سے پیدا کیا ہے اور اس لئے کہ تم آپس میں ایک دوسرے کو پہچانو کنبے اور قبیلے بنا دیئے ہیں، اللہ کے نزدیک تم سب میں باعزت وه ہے جو سب سے زیاده ڈرنے واﻻ ہے۔ یقین مانو کہ اللہ دانا اور باخبر ہے.

t.149: The nomadic Arabs said, “We have attained faith.” Say, “You have not attained faith; rather say, ‘We have become Muslims,’ for faith has not yet entered into your hearts. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not diminish any of your deeds; indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.”
t.84: The Bedouins say, “We have come to believe.” Say, “You have not come to believe; instead, you (should) say, ‘We have surrendered’ and the belief has not entered your hearts so far. If you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not curtail (the reward of) any of your deeds in the least. Surely Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.”
t.85: The desert Arabs say, ‘We have faith.’ [Prophet], tell them, ‘You do not have faith. What you should say instead is, “We have submitted,” for faith has not yet entered your hearts.’ If you obey God and His Messenger, He will not diminish any of your deeds: He is most forgiving and most merciful.
t.95: The Bedouins say: “We believe.”(O Prophet), say to them: “You do not believe; you should rather say: 'We have submitted'”; for belief has not yet entered your hearts. If you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not diminish anything from the reward of any of your deeds. Surely Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
t.19: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
t.22: The desert Arabs say, "We believe." Say, "Ye have no faith; but ye (only) say, 'We have submitted our wills to Allah,' For not yet has Faith entered your hearts. But if ye obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not belittle aught of your deeds: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
t.203: The bedouins say: "We believe." Say: "You believe not but you only say, ‘We have surrendered (in Islâm),’ for Faith has not yet entered your hearts. But if you obey Allâh and His Messenger (صلى الله عليه وسلم), He will not decrease anything in reward for your deeds. Verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
t.54: دیہاتی لوگ کہتے ہیں کہ ہم ایمان ﻻئے۔ آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ درحقیقت تم ایمان نہیں ﻻئے لیکن تم یوں کہو کہ ہم اسلام ﻻئے (مخالفت چھوڑ کر مطیع ہوگئے) حاﻻنکہ ابھی تک تمہارے دلوں میں ایمان داخل ہی نہیں ہوا۔ تم اگر اللہ کی اور اس کے رسول کی فرمانبرداری کرنے لگو گے تو اللہ تمہارے اعمال میں سے کچھ بھی کم نہ کرے گا۔ بیشک اللہ بخشنے واﻻ مہربان ہے.

t.149: The believers are those who have attained faith in Allah and His Messenger, and then have not doubted and have striven with their wealth and their lives in the way of Allah; those are the truthful.
t.84: Believers, in fact, are those who believe in Allah and His Messenger, then have no doubt, and struggle, with their riches and their lives, in the way of Allah. Those are the truthful.
t.85: The true believers are the ones who have faith in God and His Messenger and leave all doubt behind, the ones who have struggled with their possessions and their persons in God’s way: they are the ones who are true.
t.95: Indeed the ones possessed of true faith are those who believed in Allah and His Messenger and then they did not entertain any doubt and strove hard in the Way of Allah with their lives and their possessions. These are the truthful ones.
t.19: The (true) believers are those only who believe in Allah and His messenger and afterward doubt not, but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Such are the sincere.
t.22: Only those are Believers who have believed in Allah and His Messenger, and have never since doubted, but have striven with their belongings and their persons in the Cause of Allah: Such are the sincere ones.
t.203: Only those are the believers who have believed in Allâh and His Messenger, and afterward doubt not but strive with their wealth and their lives for the Cause of Allâh. Those! They are the truthful.
t.54: مومن تو وه ہیں جو اللہ اور اس کے رسول پر (پکا) ایمان ﻻئیں پھر شک وشبہ نہ کریں اور اپنے مالوں سے اور اپنی جانوں سے اللہ کی راه میں جہاد کرتے رہیں، (اپنے دعوائے ایمان میں) یہی سچے اور راست گو ہیں.

t.149: Say, “Are yougoing to teach Allah about your religion, when Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, for Allah is All-Knowing of everything?”
t.84: Say, “Would you apprise Allah of your religion, while Allah knows all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is All-Knowing about every thing?”
t.85: Say, ‘Do you presume to teach God about your religion, when God knows everything in the heavens and earth, and He has full knowledge of all things?’
t.95: Say, (O Prophet), (to these pretenders to faith): “Are you apprising Allah of your faith? Allah knows all that is in the heavens and the earth. Allah has full knowledge of everything.”
t.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things?
t.22: Say: "What! Will ye instruct Allah about your religion? But Allah knows all that is in the heavens and on earth: He has full knowledge of all things.
t.203: Say: "Will you inform Allâh of your religion while Allâh knows all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allâh is All-Aware of everything.
t.54: کہہ دیجئے! کہ کیا تم اللہ تعالیٰ کو اپنی دینداری سے آگاه کر رہے ہو، اللہ ہر اس چیز سے جو آسمانوں میں اور زمین میں ہے بخوبی آگاه ہے۔ اور اللہ ہر چیز کا جاننے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: They keep reminding youof the favor they did you by becoming Muslims. Say, “Do not consider your submission(to Allah) a favor to me; it is Allah who does you a favor by guiding you to the faith, if you are truthful.”
t.84: They oblige you that they have accepted Islam, (as if it was a favour shown to you). Say, “Do not oblige me for your accepting Islam. Rather, Allah makes you obliged for His having guided you to the Faith, if you are truthful.
t.85: They think they have done you [Prophet] a favour by submitting. Say, ‘Do not consider your submission a favour to me; it is God who has done you a favour, by guiding you to faith, if you are truly sincere.’
t.95: They count it as a favour to you that they accepted Islam. Say: “Do not regard your (accepting) Islam as a favour to me; rather, Allah has bestowed a favour on you by guiding you to faith, if you are truthful (in your claim to be believers).
t.19: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.
t.22: They impress on thee as a favour that they have embraced Islam. Say, "Count not your Islam as a favour upon me: Nay, Allah has conferred a favour upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if ye be true and sincere.
t.203: They regard as favour to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that they have embraced Islâm. Say: "Count not your Islâm as a favour to me. Nay, but Allâh has conferred a favour upon you that He has guided you to the Faith if you indeed are true.
t.54: اپنے مسلمان ہونے کا آپ پر احسان جتاتے ہیں۔ آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ اپنے مسلمان ہونے کا احسان مجھ پر نہ رکھو، بلکہ دراصل اللہ کا تم پر احسان ہے کہ اس نے تمہیں ایمان کی ہدایت کی اگر تم راست گو ہو.

t.149: Allah knows the hidden realm of the heavens and the earth, for Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.
t.84: Surely Allah knows the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and Allah keeps in sight whatever you do.”
t.85: God knows the secrets of the heavens and earth: He sees everything you do.
t.95: Surely Allah knows every hidden thing of the heavens and the earth. Allah sees all that you do.
t.19: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
t.22: "Verily Allah knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth: and Allah Sees well all that ye do."
t.203: Verily, Allâh knows the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allâh is the All-Seer of what you do.
t.54: یقین مانو کہ آسمانوں اور زمین کی پوشیده باتیں اللہ خوب جانتا ہے۔ اور جو کچھ تم کر رہے ہو اسے اللہ خوب دیکھ رہا ہے.

t.149: Qāf. By the Glorious Recital. . .
t.84: Qāf . (I swear) by the glorious Qur’ān, (you are sent as a messenger.)
t.85: Qaf By the glorious Quran!
t.95: Qaf. By the glorious Qur'an.
t.19: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,
t.22: Qaf: By the Glorious Qur'an (Thou art Allah's Messenger).
t.203: Qâf. [These letters (Qâf, etc.) are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the Glorious Qur’ân.
t.54: ق! بہت بڑی شان والے اس قرآن کی قسم ہے.

t.149: But they marveled that a forewarner had come to them from among them, so the deniers said, “How strange!
t.84: But they wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves; so the disbelievers said, “This is something strange.
t.85: But the disbelievers are amazed that a warner has come from among them and they say, ‘How strange!
t.95: Nay; they wondered that a warner should have come to them from among themselves. The unbelievers said: “This indeed is a strange thing.
t.19: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:
t.22: But they wonder that there has come to them a Warner from among themselves. So the Unbelievers say: "This is a wonderful thing!
t.203: Nay, they wonder that there has come to them a warner (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from among themselves. So the disbelievers say: "This is a strange thing!
t.54: بلکہ انہیں تعجب معلوم ہوا کہ ان کے پاس انہی میں سے ایک آگاه کرنے واﻻ آیا تو کافروں نے کہا کہ یہ ایک عجیب چیز ہے.

t.149: Can it be that when we have died and become dust . . .? This is a far-fetched return.”
t.84: Is it when we die and become dust (that we will be brought to life again?) That is a return, far (from understanding).”
t.85: To come back [to life] after we have died and become dust? That is too farfetched.’
t.95: What! When we are dead and reduced to mere dust, (shall we be raised to life)? Such a return is far-fetched.”
t.19: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!
t.22: "What! When we die and become dust, (shall we live again?) That is a (sort of) return far (from our understanding)."
t.203: "When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be resurrected?) That is a far return."
t.54: کیا جب ہم مر کر مٹی ہو جائیں گے۔ پھر یہ واپسی دور (از عقل) ہے.

t.149: We have already known what the earth consumes of them, and with Us is a constantly preserving record.
t.84: We know very well how much of them is diminished by the earth, and We have a Book that Preserves every thing.
t.85: We know very well what the earth takes away from them: We keep a comprehensive record.
t.95: (Thus do they imagine, although) We know well what the earth takes away from them. With Us is a Record that preserves everything.
t.19: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.
t.22: We already know how much of them the earth takes away: With Us is a record guarding (the full account).
t.203: We know that which the earth takes of them (their dead bodies), and with Us is a Book preserved (i.e. the Book of Decrees).
t.54: زمین جو کچھ ان سے گھٹاتی ہے وه ہمیں معلوم ہے اور ہمارے پاس سب یاد رکھنے والی کتاب ہے.

t.149: But they rejected the truth when it came to them, so they are in a state of confusion.
t.84: Rather, they rejected the truth when it came to them; so they are in a confused state.
t.85: But the disbelievers deny the truth when it comes to them; they are in a state of confusion.
t.95: They gave the lie to the Truth when it came to them. So they are now in a state of great perplexity.
t.19: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.
t.22: But they deny the Truth when it comes to them: so they are in a confused state.
t.203: Nay, but they have denied the truth (this Qur’ân) when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state (cannot differentiate between right and wrong).
t.54: بلکہ انہوں نے سچی بات کو جھوٹ کہا ہے جبکہ وه ان کے پاس پہنچ چکی پس وه ایک الجھاؤ میں پڑ گئے ہیں.

t.149: Have they not looked at the sky above them—how We constructed it and decoratedit and how it has no fractures?
t.84: Did they not, then, look to the sky above them, how We have built it and beautified it, and it has no cracks?
t.85: Do they not see the sky above them––how We have built and adorned it, with no rifts in it;
t.95: Did they never observe the sky above them: how We built it and beautified it; and it has no cracks;
t.19: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?
t.22: Do they not look at the sky above them?- How We have made it and adorned it, and there are no flaws in it?
t.203: Have they not looked at the heaven above them, how We have made it and adorned it, and there are no rifts in it?
t.54: کیا انہوں نے آسمان کو اپنے اوپر نہیں دیکھا؟ کہ ہم نے اسے کس طرح بنایا ہے اور زینت دی ہے اس میں کوئی شگاف نہیں.

t.149: And the earth—how We spread it out and set on it firm mountains and germinated therein all kinds of lovely plants,
t.84: As for the earth, We have spread it out, and cast on it firm hills, and caused to grow therein every kind of delightful things,
t.85: how We spread out the earth and put solid mountains on it, and caused every kind of joyous plant to grow in it,
t.95: and We have spread out the earth, and have set upon it firm mountains, and have caused it to bring out plants of all beauteous kinds?
t.19: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,
t.22: And the earth- We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and produced therein every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs)-
t.203: And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and have produced therein every kind of lovely growth (plants).
t.54: اور زمین کو ہم نے بچھا دیا اور اس میں ہم نے پہاڑ ڈال دیئے ہیں اور اس میں ہم نے قسم قسم کی خوشنما چیزیں اگا دی ہیں.

t.149: an eye-opener and a reminder for every penitent servant?
t.84: as a source of vision and as a lesson to every servant (of Allah) who turns (to Him for guidance).
t.85: as a lesson and reminder for every servant who turns to God;
t.95: All these are to serve as eye openers and as a lesson to every being who is prone to turn (to the Truth).
t.19: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.
t.22: To be observed and commemorated by every devotee turning (to Allah).
t.203: An insight and a Reminder for every slave who turns to Allâh in repentance (i.e. the one who believes in the Oneness of Allâh and performs deeds of His obedience, and always begs His pardon).
t.54: تاکہ ہر رجوع کرنے والے بندے کے لئے بینائی اور دانائی کا ذریعہ ہو.

t.149: And We brought down from the sky blessed water and germinated with it gardens and grain to harvest,
t.84: And We sent down blessed water from the sky, and caused to grow therewith gardens and grain of harvest,
t.85: and how We send blessed water down from the sky and grow with it gardens, the harvest grain,
t.95: We also sent down blessed water from the heaven, wherewith We caused gardens and harvest-grain to grow,
t.19: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,
t.22: And We send down from the sky rain charted with blessing, and We produce therewith gardens and Grain for harvests;
t.203: And We send down blessed water (rain) from the sky, then We produce therewith gardens and grain (every kind of harvests) that are reaped.
t.54: اور ہم نے آسمان سے بابرکت پانی برسایا اور اس سے باغات اور کٹنے والے کھیت کے غلے پیدا کیے.

t.149: and the soaring palm trees with clustered dates—
t.84: and towering date palms that have spadices, put one upon another,
t.85: and tall palm trees laden with clusters of dates,
t.95: and tall palm-trees with their thickly-clustered spathes;
t.19: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,
t.22: And tall (and stately) palm-trees, with shoots of fruit-stalks, piled one over another;-
t.203: And tall date-palms, with ranged clusters.
t.54: اور کھجوروں کے بلند وباﻻ درخت جن کے خوشے تہ بہ تہ ہیں.

t.149: provision for the servants. And We revived thereby a lifeless land; likewise is the emergence.
t.84: as a provision to the servants (of Allah). And We gave life with it to a dead land. Similar will be the exit (of the dead from their graves).
t.85: as a provision for everyone; how with water We give [new] life to a land that is dead? This is how the dead will emerge [from their graves].
t.95: all this as sustenance for Our servants. And thus We do bring the dead land back to life with water. Such shall be the coming forth (of human beings from the earth).
t.19: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.
t.22: As sustenance for (Allah's) Servants;- and We give (new) life therewith to land that is dead: Thus will be the Resurrection.
t.203: A provision for (Allâh’s) slaves. And We give life therewith to a dead land. Thus will be the resurrection (of the dead).
t.54: بندوں کی روزی کے لئے اور ہم نے پانی سے مرده شہر کو زنده کر دیا۔ اسی طرح (قبروں سے) نکلنا ہے.

t.149: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved, and(so did) the fellows of Al-Russ and Thamûd
t.84: It (resurrection) was rejected before them by the people of NūH, and the people of Rass and Thamūd,
t.85: The people of Noah disbelieved long before these disbelievers, as did the people of Rass, Thamud,
t.95: In the past Noah's people, and the people of Rass and Thamud gave the lie (to Messengers),
t.19: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,
t.22: Before them was denied (the Hereafter) by the People of Noah, the Companions of the Rass, the Thamud,
t.203: Denied before them (i.e. these pagans of Makkah) the people of Nûh (Noah), and the dwellers of Rass, and Thamûd;
t.54: ان سے پہلے نوح کی قوم نے اور رس والوں نے اور ﺛمود نے.

t.149: and ʻĀd and Pharaoh and the brethren of Lot
t.84: and ‘Ād, and Fir’aun (Pharaoh), and the brothers of LūT,
t.85: Ad, Pharaoh, Lot,
t.95: and so did 'Ad, and Pharaoh and Lot's brethren,
t.19: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
t.22: The 'Ad, Pharaoh, the brethren of Lut,
t.203: And ‘Âd, and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and the brethren of Lût (Lot);
t.54: اور عاد نے فرعون نے اور برادران لوط نے.

t.149: and the fellows of the Thicket and the people of Tubbaʻ; they all disbelieved the messengers, so My threat came true.
t.84: and dwellers of Aaikah, and the people of Tubba’. Each one of them rejected the messengers; so My threat came true.
t.85: the Forest-Dwellers, Tubba: all of these people disbelieved their messengers, and so My warning was realized.
t.95: and the people of Aykah, and the people of Tubba'. They all gave the lie to the Messengers. Thereafter My threat of chastisement against them was fulfilled.
t.19: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.
t.22: The Companions of the Wood, and the People of Tubba'; each one (of them) rejected the messengers, and My warning was duly fulfilled (in them).
t.203: And the Dwellers of the Wood, and the people of Tubba‘. Everyone of them denied (their) Messengers, so My Threat took effect.
t.54: اور ایکہ والوں نے تبع کی قوم نے بھی تکذیب کی تھی۔ سب نے پیغمبروں کو جھٹلایا پس میرا وعدہٴ عذاب ان پر صادق آگیا.

t.149: Were We fatigued by the first creation? Rather, they are in doubt of a new creation.
t.84: Is it, then, that We were worn out by the first creation? No, but they are still in confusion about the new creation.
t.85: So were We incapable of the first creation? No indeed! Yet they doubt a second creation.
t.95: Did We, then, become worn out by the first creation? Not at all; but they are in doubt about a fresh creation.
t.19: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
t.22: Were We then weary with the first Creation, that they should be in confused doubt about a new Creation?
t.203: Were We then tired with the first creation? Nay, they are in confused doubt about a new creation (i.e. Resurrection).
t.54: کیا ہم پہلی بار کے پیدا کرنے سے تھک گئے؟ بلکہ یہ لوگ نئی پیدائش کی طرف سے شک میں ہیں.

t.149: And surely We created man and know what his(inner) self whispers to him, for We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
t.84: Indeed We have created man, and We know whatever thoughts his inner self develops, and We are closer to him than (his) jugular vein,
t.85: We created man––We know what his soul whispers to him: We are closer to him than his jugular vein––
t.95: Surely We have created man, and We know the promptings of his heart, and We are nearer to him than even his jugular vein.
t.19: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
t.22: It was We Who created man, and We know what dark suggestions his soul makes to him: for We are nearer to him than (his) jugular vein.
t.203: And indeed We have created man, and We know what his ownself whispers to him. And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein (by Our Knowledge).
t.54: ہم نے انسان کو پیدا کیا ہے اور اس کے دل میں جو خیاﻻت اٹھتے ہیں ان سے ہم واقف ہیں اور ہم اس کی رگ جان سے بھی زیاده اس سے قریب ہیں.

t.149: As the two receptorsreceive(him) , one on the right and one on the left, constantly seated.
t.84: when the two receiving angels receive (every human act to record it), seated (one) on the right and (one) on the left.
t.85: with two receptors set to record, one on his right side and one on his left:
t.95: Moreover, there are two scribes, one each sitting on the right and the left, recording everything.
t.19: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,
t.22: Behold, two (guardian angels) appointed to learn (his doings) learn (and noted them), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
t.203: (Remember) that the two receivers (recording angels) receive (each human being), one sitting on the right and one on the left (to note his or her actions).
t.54: جس وقت دو لینے والے جا لیتے ہیں ایک دائیں طرف اور ایک بائیں طرف بیٹھا ہوا.

t.149: Not a word does he utter, but close to him is a watcher, constantly ready.
t.84: Not a single word is uttered by one but there is a watcher near him, ready (to record).
t.85: he does not utter a single word without an ever-present watcher.
t.95: He utters not a word, but there is a vigilant watcher at hand.
t.19: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.
t.22: Not a word does he utter but there is a sentinel by him, ready (to note it).
t.203: Not a word does he (or she) utter but there is a watcher by him ready (to record it).
t.54: (انسان) منھ سے کوئی لفﻆ نکال نہیں پاتا مگر کہ اس کے پاس نگہبان تیار ہے.

t.149: Then came the daze of death with the truth: “That is what youwere trying to avoid.”
t.84: The daze of death has (to) come with truth. That is what you tried to escape.
t.85: The trance of death will bring the Truth with it: ‘This is what you tried to escape.’
t.95: Lo, the agony of death has indeed come with the Truth. That is what you had sought to avoid.
t.19: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.
t.22: And the stupor of death will bring Truth (before his eyes): "This was the thing which thou wast trying to escape!"
t.203: And the stupor of death will come in truth: "This is what you have been avoiding!"
t.54: اور موت کی بے ہوشی حق لے کر آ پہنچی، یہی ہے جس سے تو بدکتا پھرتا تھا.

t.149: And the Trumpet was blown: “That is the Day of the Threat.”
t.84: And the Horn will be blown. That will be the day of (which) threat (was given).
t.85: The Trumpet will be sounded: ‘This is the Day [you were] warned of.’
t.95: And then the Trumpet was blown. This is the day of the promised chastisement.
t.19: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.
t.22: And the Trumpet shall be blown: that will be the Day whereof Warning (had been given).
t.203: And the Trumpet will be blown - that will be the Day whereof warning (had been given) (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).
t.54: اور صور پھونک دیا جائے گا۔ وعدہٴ عذاب کا دن یہی ہے.

t.149: And every soul came forward, accompanied by a driver and a witness.
t.84: And everybody will come, along with one (angel) to drive (him to the field of reckoning) and one (angel) to testify (about his deeds).
t.85: Each person will arrive attended by an [angel] to drive him on and another to bear witness:
t.95: Everyone has come, each attended by one who will drive him on, and another who will bear witness.
t.19: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.
t.22: And there will come forth every soul: with each will be an (angel) to drive, and an (angel) to bear witness.
t.203: And every person will come forth along with an (angel) to drive (him) and an (angel) to bear witness.
t.54: اور ہر شخص اس طرح آئے گا کہ اس کے ساتھ ایک ﻻنے واﻻ ہوگا اور ایک گواہی دینے واﻻ.

t.149: “Indeed, youwere oblivious to this, so We removed your veil and your sight today is(as sharp as) iron.”
t.84: “You were heedless of this. Now We have removed your veil from you; so your sight today is sharp.”
t.85: ‘You paid no attention to this [Day]; but today We have removed your veil and your sight is sharp.’
t.95: You were heedless of this. Now We have removed your veil and so your vision today is sharp.
t.19: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.
t.22: (It will be said:) "Thou wast heedless of this; now have We removed thy veil, and sharp is thy sight this Day!"
t.203: (It will be said to the sinners): "Indeed you were heedless of this. Now We have removed from you your covering, and sharp is your sight this Day!"
t.54: یقیناً تو اس سے غفلت میں تھا لیکن ہم نے تیرے سامنے سے پرده ہٹا دیا پس آج تیری نگاه بہت تیز ہے.

t.149: And His comradesaid, “This is what I have ready with me.”
t.84: And his companion (i.e. the angel who recorded his deeds) will say, “This is what I have with me, ready (to be presented as his record of deeds).”
t.85: The person’s attendant will say, ‘Here is what I have prepared’-
t.95: His companion said:“ Here is he who was in my charge.”
t.19: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).
t.22: And his Companion will say: "Here is (his Record) ready with me!"
t.203: And his companion (angel) will say: "Here is (this Record) ready with me!"
t.54: اس کا ہم نشین (فرشتہ) کہے گا یہ حاضر ہے جو کہ میرے پاس تھا.

t.149: “Castinto Hell, every stubborn relentless denier,
t.84: (Then it will be said,) “Cast, (O two angels,) into Jahannam (Hell) every obstinate disbeliever
t.85: ‘Hurl every obstinate disbeliever into Hell,
t.95: The command was given: “Cast into Hell every hardened, stubborn unbeliever,
t.19: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,
t.22: (The sentence will be:) "Throw, throw into Hell every contumacious Rejecter (of Allah)!-
t.203: (Allah will say to the angels): "Both of you throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever (in the Oneness of Allâh, in His Messengers).
t.54: ڈال دو جہنم میں ہر کافر سرکش کو.

t.149: preventer of good, transgressor, doubter,
t.84: who used to prevent (others) from good (behavior), who transgressed all bounds, who cast doubts (in true faith),
t.85: everyone who hindered good, was aggressive, caused others to doubt,
t.95: who hinders good, exceeds the limits, is immersed in doubts,
t.19: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,
t.22: "Who forbade what was good, transgressed all bounds, cast doubts and suspicions;
t.203: "Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,
t.54: جو نیک کام سے روکنے واﻻ حد سے گزر جانے واﻻ اور شک کرنے واﻻ تھا.

t.149: who has set up another deity with Allah. So casthim into the severe punishment.”
t.84: who set up another god along with Allah. So cast him (O angels) in the painful punishment.”
t.85: and set up other gods alongside God. Hurl him into severe punishment!’-
t.95: and has set up another deity with Allah. Hurl him into the grievous torment.”
t.19: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.
t.22: "Who set up another god beside Allah: Throw him into a severe penalty."
t.203: "Who set up another ilâh (god) with Allâh. Then both of you cast him in the severe torment."
t.54: جس نے اللہ کے ساتھ دوسرا معبود بنا لیا تھا پس اسے سخت عذاب میں ڈال دو.

t.149: His comrade said, “Our Lord, I did not make him exceed all limits, but he was in extreme misguidance.”
t.84: His (evil) companion (i.e. the Satan) will say, “O our Lord, I did not cause him to rebel, but he was himself (involved) in straying far from the track.”
t.85: and his [evil] companion will say, ‘Lord, I did not make him transgress; he had already gone far astray himself.’
t.95: His companion said:“ I did not incite him to rebel; he was far gone into error of his own accord.”
t.19: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
t.22: His Companion will say: "Our Lord! I did not make him transgress, but he was (himself) far astray."
t.203: His companion (Satan - devil)] will say: "Our Lord! I did not push him to transgression, (in disbelief, oppression, and evil deeds) but he was himself in error far astray."
t.54: اس کا ہمنشین (شیطان) کہے گا اے ہمارے رب! میں نے اسے گمراه نہیں کیا تھا بلکہ یہ خود ہی دور دراز کی گمراہی میں تھا.

t.149: He said, “Do not dispute in My presence, for I have warned youin advance.
t.84: He (Allah) will say, “Do not quarrel before Me, while I had sent to you My threat well in advance.
t.85: God will say, ‘Do not argue in My presence. I sent you a warning
t.95: (It was said): “Do not remonstrate in My presence. I had warned you.
t.19: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.
t.22: He will say: "Dispute not with each other in My Presence: I had already in advance sent you Warning.
t.203: Allâh will say: "Dispute not in front of Me, I had already in advance sent you the threat.
t.54: حق تعالیٰ فرمائے گا بس میرے سامنے جھگڑنے کی بات مت کرو میں تو پہلے ہی تمہاری طرف وعید (وعدہٴ عذاب) بھیج چکا تھا.

t.149: The decree from Me cannot be changed, and I am not a tyrant unto the servants.”
t.84: The Word is not changed with Me, and I Am not so unjust to My servants.”
t.85: and My word cannot be changed: I am not unjust to any creature.’
t.95: My Word is not changed; and never do I inflict the least wrong upon My servants.”
t.19: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.
t.22: "The Word changes not before Me, and I do not the least injustice to My Servants."
t.203: The Sentence that comes from Me cannot be changed, and I am not unjust to the slaves."
t.54: میرے ہاں بات بدلتی نہیں اور نہ میں اپنے بندوں پر ذرا بھی ﻇلم کرنے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: On the day when We say to Hell, “Are you full?” And it says, “Are there any more?”
t.84: (Remind them of) the Day when We will say to Jahannam (Hell), “Are you filled up?” and it will say, “Are there some more?”
t.85: We shall say to Hell on that day, ‘Are you full?’ and it will reply, ‘Are there no more?’
t.95: On that Day We shall ask Hell: “Are you full?” And it will reply: “Are there any more?”
t.19: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
t.22: One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
t.203: On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled?" It will say: "Are there any more (to come)?"
t.54: جس دن ہم دوزخ سے پوچھیں گے کیا تو بھر چکی؟ وه جواب دے گی کیا کچھ اور زیاده بھی ہے؟

t.149: And the Garden(of Paradise) was brought closer to those mindful(of God) , not far away.
t.84: And the Jannah (Paradise) will be brought close for the God-fearing, no longer distant.
t.85: But Paradise will be brought close to the righteous and will no longer be distant:
t.95: And when Paradise shall be brought close to the God-fearing, and will no longer be far away,
t.19: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.
t.22: And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
t.203: And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2), not far off.
t.54: اور جنت پرہیزگاروں کے لئے بالکل قریب کر دی جائے گی ذرا بھی دور نہ ہوگی.

t.149: This is what youare promised —for every constant preserver who often turns to God,
t.84: (And it will be said,) “This is what you were promised for everyone who was oft-returning to Allah, vigilant (against sins),
t.85: ‘This is what you were promised––this is for everyone who turned often to God and kept Him in mind,
t.95: it will be said: “This is what you were promised, a promise made to everyone who turned much (to Allah) and was watchful of his conduct,
t.19: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,
t.22: (A voice will say:) "This is what was promised for you,- for every one who turned (to Allah) in sincere repentance, who kept (His Law),
t.203: (It will be said): "This is what you were promised - (it is) for those oft-returning (to Allâh) in sincere repentance, and those who preserve their covenant with Allâh (by obeying Him in all what He has ordered, and worshipping none but Allâh Alone, i.e. follow Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: یہ ہے جس کا تم سے وعده کیا جاتا تھا ہر اس شخص کے لئے جو رجوع کرنے واﻻ اور پابندی کرنے واﻻ ہو.

t.149: the one who inwardly feared the All-Merciful and came with a penitent heart.
t.84: the one who feared the RaHmān (The All-Merciful Allah), without seeing Him, and came up with a heart oriented towards Him.
t.85: who held the Most Gracious in awe, though He is unseen, who comes before Him with a heart turned to Him in devotion-
t.95: to everyone who feared the Merciful One though He is beyond the reach of perception, to everyone who has come with a heart ever wont to turn (to Him).
t.19: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.
t.22: "Who feared (Allah) Most Gracious Unseen, and brought a heart turned in devotion (to Him):
t.203: "Who feared the Most Gracious (Allâh) in the Ghaib (Unseen) and brought a heart turned in repentance (to Him and absolutely free from each and every kind of polytheism).
t.54: جو رحمٰن کا غائبانہ خوف رکھتا ہو اور توجہ واﻻ دل ﻻیا ہو.

t.149: “Enterit in peace; that is the Day of Eternity.”
t.84: Enter it in peace. That is the Day of Eternity.”
t.85: so enter it in peace. This is the Day of everlasting Life.’
t.95: Enter this Paradise in peace.” That will be the Day of Eternity.
t.19: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
t.22: "Enter ye therein in Peace and Security; this is a Day of Eternal Life!"
t.203: "Enter you therein in peace and security - this is a Day of eternal life!"
t.54: تم اس جنت میں سلامتی کے ساتھ داخل ہو جاؤ۔ یہ ہمیشہ رہنے کا دن ہے

t.149: Therein they have whatever they desire, and We have even more.
t.84: They will have in it whatever they wish, and with Us there are things even more than that.
t.85: They will have all that they wish for there, and We have more for them.
t.95: Therein they shall get whatever they desire; and with Us there is even more.
t.19: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.
t.22: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.
t.203: There they will have all that they desire - and We have more (for them, i.e. a glance at the All-Mighty, All-Majestic جل جلاله).
t.54: یہ وہاں جو چاہیں انھیں ملے گا (بلکہ) ہمارے پاس اور بھی زیاده ہے.

t.149: And how many generations before them who were more powerful than they did We destroy! And they explored the lands—was there any escape?
t.84: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger than these in their grip on power, and they searched out the cities. Was there any place (for them) to escape?
t.85: We have destroyed even mightier generations before these disbelievers, who travelled through [many] lands- was there any escape?
t.95: How many a nation did We destroy before them that were stronger in prowess than these. They searched about the lands of the world. But could they find a refuge?
t.19: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?
t.22: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?
t.203: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And (when Our Torment came), they ran for a refuge in the land! Could they find any place of refuge (for them to save themselves from destruction)?
t.54: اور ان سے پہلے بھی ہم بہت سی امتوں کو ہلاک کر چکے ہیں جو ان سے طاقت میں بہت زیاده تھیں وه شہروں میں ڈھونڈھتے ہی ره گئے، کہ کوئی بھاگنے کا ٹھکانہ ہے؟

t.149: Indeed, in that is a reminder for whoever possesses a heart or cares to listen and witness.
t.84: Indeed, there is a lesson in all this for him who has a heart and gives ear (to the truth) attentively.
t.85: There truly is a reminder in this for whoever has a heart, whoever listens attentively.
t.95: Verily there is a lesson in this for everyone who has a (sound) heart and who listens with an attentive mind.
t.19: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.
t.22: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).
t.203: Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful.
t.54: اس میں ہر صاحب دل کے لئے عبرت ہے اور اس کے لئے جو دل سے متوجہ ہو کر کان لگائے اور وه حاضر ہو.

t.149: And surely We created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, and never were We touched by any fatigue.
t.84: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, and no weariness even touched Us.
t.85: We created the heavens, the earth, and everything between, in six Days without tiring.
t.95: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, and weariness did not even touch Us.
t.19: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
t.22: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.
t.203: And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us.
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے آسمانوں اور زمین اور جو کچھ اس کے درمیان ہے سب کو (صرف) چھ دن میں پیدا کر دیا اور ہمیں تکان نے چھوا تک نہیں.

t.149: So endurewhat they say, and highly exalt your Lord with praise before the rising of the sun and before sunset.
t.84: So, (O Prophet,) endure with patience what they say, and proclaim His purity, along with your Lord’s praise, before sunrise and before sunset.
t.85: So [Prophet], bear everything they say with patience; celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising and setting of the sun;
t.95: Hence bear with patience whatever they say, and celebrate your Lord's glory before the rising of the sun and before its setting;
t.19: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
t.22: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
t.203: So bear with patience (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) all that they say, and glorify the Praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting (i.e. the Fajr, Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers).
t.54: پس یہ جو کچھ کہتے ہیں آپ اس پر صبر کریں اور اپنے رب کی تسبیح تعریف کے ساتھ بیان کریں سورج نکلنے سے پہلے بھی اور سورج غروب ہونے سے پہلے بھی.

t.149: And highly exaltHim with praise in the night and after prostrations.
t.84: And in hours of night, proclaim His purity, and at the ends of prostration.
t.85: proclaim His praise in the night and at the end of every prayer;
t.95: and in the night, too, celebrate His glory, in the wake of prostration.
t.19: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.
t.22: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.
t.203: And during a part of the night (also) glorify His praises (i.e. Maghrib and ‘Isha prayers) and (so likewise) after the prayers [As-Sunnah, Nawâfil - optional and additional prayers. And also glorify, praise and magnify Allâh - Subhân Allâh, Alhamdu lillâh, Allâhu-Akbar].
t.54: اور رات کے وقت بھی تسبیح کریں اور نماز کے بعد بھی.

t.149: And listenon the day when the caller calls from a nearby place.
t.84: And listen: The Day when the caller will call out from a near place,
t.85: listen out for the Day when the caller will call from a nearby place.
t.95: Hearken on the Day when the caller will call from a place nearby,
t.19: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
t.22: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-
t.203: And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place.
t.54: اور سن رکھیں کہ جس دن ایک پکارنے واﻻ قریب ہی کی جگہ سے پکارے گا.

t.149: The day when they hear the Shout in all truth; that is the Day of Emergence.
t.84: the Day they will hear the Cry in reality- that will be the Day of Resurrection.
t.85: They will come out [from their graves] on that Day, the Day when they hear the mighty blast in reality.
t.95: the Day when they shall hear the Blast in truth. That will be the Day (for the dead) to come forth.
t.19: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
t.22: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.
t.203: The Day when they will hear As-Saihah (shout) in truth: that will be the Day of coming out (from the graves, i.e. the Day of Resurrection).
t.54: جس روز اس تند وتیز چیﺦ کو یقین کے ساتھ سن لیں گے، یہ دن ہوگا نکلنے کا.

t.149: Indeed, We—We alone—give life and cause death, and to Us is the destiny.
t.84: Surely We alone give life and bring death, and to Us is the final return
t.85: It is We who give life and death; the final return will be to Us
t.95: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death, and to Us shall all return
t.19: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.
t.22: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-
t.203: Verily, We it is Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return.
t.54: ہم ہی جلاتے ہیں اور ہم ہی مارتے ہیں اور ہماری ہی طرف لوٹ پھر کر آنا ہے.

t.149: The day the earth ruptures open from above them, letting them rush out; that is an easy exodus for Us.
t.84: on the Day when the earth will burst apart exposing them, while they will be hurrying up (to come out). That is an assembly, so easy for Us (to muster).
t.85: on the Day when the earth will be torn apart, letting them rush out- that gathering will be easy for Us.
t.95: on the Day when the earth will be rent asunder and people, rising from it, will hasten forth. To assemble them all will be easy for Us.
t.19: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).
t.22: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.
t.203: On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them, (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us.
t.54: جس دن زمین پھٹ جائے گی اور یہ دوڑتے ہوئے (نکل پڑیں گے) یہ جمع کر لینا ہم پر بہت ہی آسان ہے.

t.149: We know better what they say, and youare not a compeller over them, so remind by the Recitalwhoever fears My warning.
t.84: We know well what they say, and you are not (sent) as one who compels them. So exhort, through the Qur’ān, the one who fears My warning.
t.85: We know best what the disbelievers say. You [Prophet] are not there to force them, so remind, with this Quran, those who fear My warning.
t.95: (O Prophet), We are well aware of what they say; and you are not required to force things on them. So exhort with the Qur'an all those who fear My warning.
t.19: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
t.22: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur'an such as fear My Warning!
t.203: We know best what they say. And you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are not the one to force them (to Belief). But warn by the Qur’an; him who fears My Threat.
t.54: یہ جو کچھ کہہ رہے ہیں ہم بخوبی جانتے ہیں اور آپ ان پر جبر کرنے والے نہیں، تو آپ قرآن کے ذریعے انہیں سمجھاتے رہیں جو میرے وعید (ڈرانے کے وعدوں) سے ڈرتے ہیں.

t.149: By the spreaders spreading,
t.84: By those (winds) that scatter dust,
t.85: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,
t.95: By the winds which scatter dust,
t.19: By those that winnow with a winnowing
t.22: By the (Winds) that scatter broadcast;
t.203: By (the winds) that scatter dust.
t.54: قسم ہے بکھیرنے والیوں کی اڑا کر.

t.149: and by those bearers of loads,
t.84: then those that bear load (of clouds),
t.85: and those that are heavily laden,
t.95: which carry clouds laden with water,
t.19: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)
t.22: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;
t.203: And (the clouds) that bear heavy weight of water.
t.54: پھر اٹھانے والیاں بوجھ کو.

t.149: and by those moving gently,
t.84: then those that float with ease,
t.85: that speed freely,
t.95: which then smoothly speed along,
t.19: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)
t.22: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;
t.203: And (the ships) that float with ease and gentleness.
t.54: پھر چلنے والیاں نرمی سے.

t.149: and by those distributing as commanded—
t.84: then those who distribute things,
t.85: that distribute [rain] as ordained!
t.95: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):
t.19: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,
t.22: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-
t.203: And those (angels) who distribute (provisions, rain, and other blessings) by (Allâh’s) Command.
t.54: پھر کام کو تقسیم کرنے والیاں.

t.149: what youare promised is true.
t.84: whatever you are being promised is surely true,
t.85: What you [people] are promised is true:
t.95: surely what you are being warned against is true,
t.19: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,
t.22: Verily that which ye are promised is true;
t.203: Verily, that which you are promised (i.e. Resurrection in the Hereafter and receiving the reward or punishment of good or bad deeds) is surely true.
t.54: یقین مانو کہ تم سے جو وعدے کیے جاتے ہیں (سب) سچے ہیں.

t.149: And, indeed, the Recompense is sure to come.
t.84: and Recompense (of deeds) is sure to happen.
t.85: the Judgement will come––
t.95: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.
t.19: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.
t.22: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.
t.203: And verily, the Recompense is sure to happen.
t.54: اور بیشک انصاف ہونے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: By the heaven comprising interwoven tracks,
t.84: By the sky, having paths,
t.85: by the sky with its pathways,
t.95: By the heaven with its numerous forms:
t.19: By the heaven full of paths,
t.22: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,
t.203: By the heaven full of paths,
t.54: قسم ہے راہوں والے آسمان کی.

t.149: indeed, youare of different opinions.
t.84: you are (involved) in a contradictory discussion.
t.85: you differ in what you say––
t.95: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);
t.19: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).
t.22: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,
t.203: Certainly, you have different ideas (about Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân).
t.54: یقیناً تم مختلف بات میں پڑے ہوئے ہو.

t.149: Averted from it is he who is averted.
t.84: Turned away from this (Qur’ān) is the one who is turned away (totally from the truth.)
t.85: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.
t.95: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).
t.19: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.
t.22: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.
t.203: Turned aside therefrom (i.e. from Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân) is he who is turned aside (by the Decree and Preordainment القضاء والقدر of Allâh).
t.54: اس سے وہی باز رکھا جاتا ہے جو پھیر دیا گیا ہو.

t.149: May the conjecturers perish!
t.84: Death upon those who make conjectures (against the true faith),
t.85: Perish the liars,
t.95: Doomed are the conjecturers
t.19: Accursed be the conjecturers
t.22: Woe to the falsehood-mongers,-
t.203: Cursed be the liars
t.54: بے سند باتیں کرنے والے غارت کر دیئے گئے.

t.149: Those who are unmindful and in perplexity,
t.84: - those who are drowned in ignorance, forgetful!
t.85: those steeped in error and unaware!
t.95: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.
t.19: Who are careless in an abyss!
t.22: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:
t.203: Who are under a cover of heedlessness (think not about the gravity of the Hereafter),
t.54: جو غفلت میں ہیں اور بھولے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: asking, “When is the Day of Recompense?”
t.84: They ask, “When shall be the Day of Recompense?”
t.85: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’
t.95: They ask: “When will the Day of Judgement be?”
t.19: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?
t.22: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"
t.203: They ask: "When will be the Day of Recompense?"
t.54: پوچھتے ہیں کہ یوم جزا کب ہوگا؟

t.149: The day they are heated on the Fire:
t.84: (It will be) the Day when they will be heated on the Fire,
t.85: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,
t.95: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire
t.19: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
t.22: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!
t.203: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (punished i.e. burnt) over the Fire!
t.54: ہاں یہ وه دن ہے کہ یہ آگ پر تپائے جائیں گے.

t.149: “Taste your trial; this is what you,(challengingly) have been asking to be hastened.”
t.84: (and it will be said to them,) “Taste (the punishment of) your mischief. This is what you have been asking to be brought sooner.”
t.85: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’
t.95: (and be told): “Taste your ordeal! This is what you were seeking to hasten.”
t.19: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
t.22: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
t.203: "Taste you your trial (punishment i.e. burning)! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"
t.54: اپنی فتنہ پردازی کا مزه چکھو، یہی ہے جس کی تم جلدی مچا رہے تھے.

t.149: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are amidst Gardens(of Paradise) and springs,
t.84: The God-fearing (on the other hand) will be in gardens and springs,
t.85: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.
t.95: As for the God-fearing, they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains,
t.19: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
t.22: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
t.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs (in the Paradise),
t.54: بیشک تقویٰ والے لوگ بہشتوں اور چشموں میں ہوں گے.

t.149: taking what their Lord has given them. Indeed, before that, they used to excel in doing good:
t.84: receiving what their Lord will have given to them. Indeed, prior to this, they were good in their deeds.
t.85: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:
t.95: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them. Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):
t.19: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
t.22: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
t.203: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112).
t.54: ان کے رب نے جو کچھ انہیں عطا فرمایا ہے اسے لے رہے ہوں گے وه تو اس سے پہلے ہی نیکوکار تھے.

t.149: they used to lie down but little of the night,
t.84: They used to sleep little in the night;
t.85: sleeping only little at night,
t.95: they used to sleep but little by night,
t.19: They used to sleep but little of the night,
t.22: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
t.203: They used to sleep but little by night [invoking their Lord (Allâh) and praying, with fear and hope].
t.54: وه رات کو بہت کم سویا کرتے تھے.

t.149: and at dawn they would seek forgiveness,
t.84: and in the hours before dawn they used to pray for forgiveness,
t.85: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,
t.95: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn,
t.19: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
t.22: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
t.203: And in the hours before dawn, they were (found) asking (Allâh) for forgiveness.
t.54: اور وقت سحر استغفار کیا کرتے تھے.

t.149: and in their wealth was a share for the asker and the deprived.
t.84: and in their wealth, there was a right for one who asks and for one who is deprived.
t.85: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.
t.95: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.
t.19: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
t.22: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
t.203: And in their properties there was the right of the Sâ’il (the beggar who asks) and the Mahrûm (the poor who does not ask others).
t.54: اور ان کے مال میں مانگنے والوں کا اور سوال سے بچنے والوں کا حق تھا.

t.149: And on earth are signs for those who believe with certitude,
t.84: In the earth, there are signs for those who (seek truth to) believe,
t.85: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––
t.95: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith,
t.19: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
t.22: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
t.203: And on the earth are signs for those who have Faith with certainty.
t.54: اور یقین والوں کے لئے تو زمین میں بہت سی نشانیاں ہیں.

t.149: and within yourselves; do you not see?
t.84: and in your own selves! So, do you not perceive?
t.85: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––
t.95: and also in your own selves. Do you not see?
t.19: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
t.22: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
t.203: And also in your ownselves. Will you not then see?
t.54: اور خود تمہاری ذات میں بھی، تو کیا تم دیکھتے نہیں ہو.

t.149: And in the heaven is your provision and what you are promised.
t.84: And in the heavens, there is your sustenance and all that you have been promised.
t.85: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.
t.95: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.
t.19: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
t.22: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
t.203: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.
t.54: اور تمہاری روزی اور جو تم سے وعده کیا جاتا ہے سب آسمان میں ہے.

t.149: So by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, indeed, it is as true as the fact that you(can) pronounce.
t.84: So, by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it (the Day of Recompense) is a reality, as sure as the fact that you (can) speak.
t.85: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.
t.95: So, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is certainly true, as true as the fact of your speaking.
t.19: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
t.22: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
t.203: Then by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth (i.e. what has been promised to you), just as it is the truth that you can speak.
t.54: آسمان وزمین کے پروردگار کی قسم! کہ یہ بالکل برحق ہے ایسا ہی جیسے کہ تم باتیں کرتے ہو.

t.149: Has the story of Abraham’s honored guests reached you?
t.84: Has there come to you the story of the honoured guests of Ibrāhīm?
t.85: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?
t.95: (O Prophet), did the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reach you?
t.19: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
t.22: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
t.203: Has the story reached you, of the honoured guests [three angels; Jibrîl (Gabriel) along with another two] of Ibrâhîm (Abraham)?
t.54: کیا تجھے ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) کے معزز مہمانوں کی خبر بھی پہنچی ہے؟

t.149: When they entered upon him they said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace, strangers.”
t.84: When they (the angels in human form) entered unto him and said, “We greet you with Salām .” He said, “Salām on you.” (And he said to himself,) “(They are) unknown people.”
t.85: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’
t.95: When they came to him, they said: “Peace”; he said: “Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.”
t.19: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
t.22: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."
t.203: When they came in to him and said: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)!" He answered: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)," and said: "You are a people unknown to me."
t.54: وه جب ان کے ہاں آئے تو سلام کیا، ابراہیم نے جواب سلام دیا (اور کہا یہ تو) اجنبی لوگ ہیں.

t.149: And he slipped away to his family and brought a fatted calf
t.84: Then he slipped off to his home and fetched a fattened calf.
t.85: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,
t.95: Then he went back to his family and brought a fat roasted calf
t.19: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;
t.22: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,
t.203: Then he turned to his household, and brought out a roasted calf [as the property of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) was mainly cows].
t.54: پھر (چﭗ چاپ جلدی جلدی) اپنے گھر والوں کی طرف گئے اور ایک فربہ بچھڑے (کا گوشت) ﻻئے.

t.149: and set it before them. He said, “Will you not eat?”
t.84: So he presented it before them (to eat, but being angels, they refrained.) He said, “Would you not eat?”
t.85: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,
t.95: and laid it before them, saying: “Will you not eat?”
t.19: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?
t.22: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"
t.203: And placed it before them, (saying): "Will you not eat?"
t.54: اور اسے ان کے پاس رکھا اور کہا آپ کھاتے کیوں نہیں.

t.149: And he was filled with apprehension towards them. They said, “Do not be afraid,” and they announced to him the glad tidings of a knowledgeable boy.
t.84: So he felt some fear in his heart. They said, “Be not scared.” And they gave him the good news of (the birth of) a knowledgeable boy.
t.85: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.
t.95: Then he became afraid of them. They said: “Fear not,” and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.
t.19: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
t.22: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
t.203: Then he conceived fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not." And they gave him glad tidings of a son having knowledge (about Allâh and His religion of True Monotheism).
t.54: پھر تو دل ہی دل میں ان سے خوفزده ہوگئے انہوں نے کہا آپ خوف نہ کیجئے۔ اور انہوں نے اس (حضرت ابراہیم) کو ایک علم والے لڑکے کی بشارت دی.

t.149: So his wife came forward with a shriek, then clasped her face and said, “A barren old woman!”
t.84: So his wife came forward with a clamor, and slapped her own face and said, “(How can I have a child when I am) a barren old woman?”
t.85: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’
t.95: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed: “A barren old woman am I.”
t.19: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
t.22: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"
t.203: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice: she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"
t.54: پس ان کی بیوی آگے بڑھی اور حیرت میں آکر اپنے منھ پر ہاتھ مار کر کہا کہ میں تو بوڑھیا ہوں اور ساتھ ہی بانجھ.

t.149: They said, “Thus your Lord has said; He is the All-Wise, the All- Knowing.”
t.84: They said, “This is how your Lord has said. Surely, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.”
t.85: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’
t.95: They said: “So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.”
t.19: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
t.22: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."
t.203: They said: "Even so says your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."
t.54: انہوں نے کہا ہاں تیرے پروردگار نے اسی طرح فرمایا ہے، بیشک وه حکیم وعلیم ہے.

t.149: He said, “So what is your business, O emissaries?”
t.84: He (Ibrāhīm) said (to the angels), “Then, what is your mission O messengers?”
t.85: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’
t.95: Abraham said: “Envoys (of Allah), what is your errand?”
t.19: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
t.22: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"
t.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O Messengers?"
t.54: (حضرت ابرہیم علیہ السلام) نے کہا کہ اللہ کے بھیجے ہوئے (فرشتو!) تمہارا کیا مقصد ہے؟

t.149: They said, “We have been sent to a criminal people,
t.84: They said, “We are sent to a guilty people, (i.e. the people of Sodom)
t.85: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,
t.95: They replied: “Behold, we have been sent to a wicked people
t.19: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
t.22: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-
t.203: They said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in Allâh)
t.54: انہوں نے جواب دیا کہ ہم گناه گار قوم کی طرف بھیجے گئے ہیں.

t.149: to unleash upon them rocks of clay,
t.84: so that we may send down upon them stones of clay,
t.85: to bring down rocks of clay,
t.95: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones
t.19: That we may send upon them stones of clay,
t.22: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),
t.203: To send down upon them stones of baked clay.
t.54: تاکہ ہم ان پر مٹی کے کنکر برسائیں.

t.149: marked by yourLord for the extremists.”
t.84: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”
t.85: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’
t.95: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.”
t.19: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
t.22: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."
t.203: Marked by your Lord for the Musrifûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners - those who trespass Allâh’s set limits in evil-doings by committing great sins).
t.54: جو تیرے رب کی طرف سے نشان زده ہیں، ان حد سے گزر جانے والوں کے لیے.

t.149: Then We brought out all the believers who were in it.
t.84: So, We let the believers who were there to come out (from danger),
t.85: We brought out such believers as were there-
t.95: Then We evacuated there from all the believers
t.19: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.
t.22: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,
t.203: So We brought out from therein the believers.
t.54: پس جتنے ایمان والے وہاں تھے ہم نے انہیں نکال لیا.

t.149: Yet We found in it only one household of Muslims,
t.84: but We did not find in it any Muslims, except one house.
t.85: We found only one household devoted to God-
t.95: – and We did not find there any, apart from a single house of Muslims –
t.19: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).
t.22: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:
t.203: But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one [of Lût (Lot) and his two daughters].
t.54: اور ہم نے وہاں مسلمانوں کا صرف ایک ہی گھر پایا.

t.149: and We left in it a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
t.84: And We left in this (event) a sign (of deterrence) for those who fear the painful punishment.
t.85: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
