t.95: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.
t.19: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.
t.22: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.
t.203: And We have left there a sign (i.e. the place of the Dead Sea in Palestine) for those who fear the painful torment.
t.54: اور وہاں ہم نے ان کے لیے جو درد ناک عذاب کا ڈر رکھتے ہیں ایک (کامل) علامت چھوڑی.

t.149: And in Moses(there is also a sign) —when We sent him to Pharaoh with an evident manifestation.
t.84: And (We left a similar sign) in (the story of) Mūsā, when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a clear proof.
t.85: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
t.95: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.
t.19: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
t.22: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.
t.203: And in Mûsâ (Moses) (too, there is a sign), when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a manifest authority.
t.54: موسیٰ (علیہ السلام کے قصے) میں (بھی ہماری طرف سے تنبیہ ہے) کہ ہم نے اسے فرعون کی طرف کھلی دلیل دے کر بھیجا.

t.149: But he turned away with his warlords and said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
t.84: So he turned away along with his chiefs and said, “ (Mūsā is) a magician or a madman!”
t.85: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’
t.95: But Pharaoh turned away, showing arrogance on account of his power, and said (about Moses): “He is either a sorcerer or a madman.”
t.19: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
t.22: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"
t.203: But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] turned away (from Belief in might) along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer, or a madman."
t.54: پس اس نےاپنے بل بوتے پر منھ موڑا اور کہنے لگا یہ جادوگر ہے یا دیوانہ ہے.

t.149: So We seized him and his troops and flung them into the waters, and he was to blame.
t.84: So We seized him and his army, and cast them into the sea, as he was of culpable behaviour.
t.85: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.
t.95: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.
t.19: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
t.22: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
t.203: So We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, for he was blameworthy.
t.54: بالﺂخر ہم نے اسے اور اس کے لشکروں کو اپنے عذاب میں پکڑ کر دریا میں ڈال دیا وه تھا ہی ملامت کے قابل.

t.149: And(likewise) in(the people of) ʻĀd—We sent against them the Barren Wind,
t.84: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) ‘Ād, when We sent upon them the wind that was barren (from any benefit);
t.85: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them
t.95: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad, when We let loose upon them an ominous wind
t.19: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.
t.22: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:
t.203: And in ‘Âd (there is also a sign) when We sent against them the barren wind;
t.54: اسی طرح عادیوں میں بھی (ہماری طرف سے تنبیہ ہے) جب کہ ہم نے ان پر خیر وبرکت سے خالی آندھی بھیجی.

t.149: sparing nothing it came upon without rendering it like decayed ruins.
t.84: it spared nothing it came upon, but rendered it like a stuff smashed by decay.
t.85: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.
t.95: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.
t.19: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
t.22: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
t.203: It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.
t.54: وه جس جس چیز پر گرتی تھی اسے بوسیده ہدی کی طرح (چورا چورا) کردیتی تھی.

t.149: And(likewise) in(the people of) Thamûd—they were told, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
t.84: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) Thamūd, when it was said to them, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
t.85: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’
t.95: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told: “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
t.19: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
t.22: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"
t.203: And in Thamûd (there is also a sign), when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"
t.54: اور ﺛمود (کے قصے) میں بھی (عبرت) ہے جب ان سے کہا گیا کہ تم کچھ دنوں تک فائده اٹھا لو.

t.149: But they defied the command of their Lord, so the Lightningstruckthem as they looked on,
t.84: Then they rebelled against the command of your Lord; so the thunderbolt (of divine punishment) seized them, while they were looking on.
t.85: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:
t.95: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord’s command, and then a sudden chastisement overtook them while they looked on.
t.19: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
t.22: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.
t.203: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Sâ‘iqah overtook them while they were looking.
t.54: لیکن انہوں نے اپنے رب کے حکم سے سرتابی کی جس پر انہیں ان کے دیکھتے دیکھتے (تیز وتند) کڑاکے نے ہلاک کر دیا.

t.149: and they could not rise up, nor could they help themselves.
t.84: Then they were neither able to stand (before the punishment), nor could they defend themselves.
t.85: they could not even remain standing, let alone defend themselves.
t.95: They were unable even to stand up or protect themselves.
t.19: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
t.22: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
t.203: Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
t.54: پس نہ تو وه کھڑے ہو سکے اور نہ بدلہ لے سکے.

t.149: And(recall) before that, the people of Noah—indeed, they were a defiantly disobedient people.
t.84: And (We have destroyed) the people of NūH even before; indeed they were a sinful people.
t.85: Before that We destroyed the people of Noah. They were a truly sinful people!
t.95: Before all these We destroyed the people of Noah: they were a wicked people.
t.19: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.
t.22: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.
t.203: (So were) the people of Nûh (Noah) before them. Verily, they were a people who were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).
t.54: اور نوح (علیہ السلام) کی قوم کا بھی اس سے پہلے (یہی حال ہو چکا تھا) وه بھی بڑے نافرمان لوگ تھے.

t.149: And the universe—We constructed it with power, and We are surely expanding it.
t.84: And the sky was built by Us with might; and indeed We are the expanders.
t.85: We built the heavens with Our power and made them vast,
t.95: And heaven – We made it with Our Own Power and We have the Power to do so.
t.19: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
t.22: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of space.
t.203: With power did We construct the heaven. Verily, We are Able to extend the vastness of space thereof.
t.54: آسمان کو ہم نے (اپنے) ہاتھوں سے بنایا ہے اور یقیناً ہم کشادگی کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: And the earth—We spread it out. So how excellent are We who prepared it!
t.84: And the earth was spread out by Us as a floor; so how well have We spread it out!
t.85: We spread out the earth- how well We smoothed it out!-
t.95: And the earth – We spread it out, and how well have We smoothed it!
t.19: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
t.22: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!
t.203: And We have spread out the earth: how Excellent Spreader (thereof) are We!
t.54: اور زمین کو ہم نے فرش بنا دیاہے پس ہم بہت ہی اچھے بچھانے والے ہیں.

t.149: And We created all things in pairs, that you may remind yourselves.
t.84: And from every thing We have created pairs of twos, so that you may heed.
t.85: and We created pairs of all things so that you [people] might take note.
t.95: And of everything We have created pairs; perhaps you will take heed.
t.19: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
t.22: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.
t.203: And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember (the Grace of Allâh).
t.54: اور ہر چیز کو ہم نے جوڑا جوڑا پیداکیا ہے تاکہ تم نصیحت حاصل کرو.

t.149: “So flee to Allah; I am to youfrom Him an evident warner.
t.84: So, flee to Allah. Indeed I am a plain warner sent by Him for you.
t.85: [So, say to them, Prophet], ‘Quickly, turn to God- I am sent by Him to give you clear warning-
t.95: Flee, therefore, to Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him;
t.19: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
t.22: Hasten ye then (at once) to Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
t.203: So flee to Allâh (from His Torment to His Mercy - Islâmic Monotheism). Verily, I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) am a plain warner to you from Him.
t.54: پس تم اللہ کی طرف دوڑ بھاگ (یعنی رجوع) کرو، یقیناً میں تمہیں اس کی طرف سے صاف صاف تنبیہ کرنے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: And do not set up any other god with Allah; I am to you from Him an evident warner.”
t.84: And do not make up any other god along with Allah. Indeed I am a plain warner sent by Him for you.
t.85: and do not set up any other god alongside Him. I am sent by Him to give you clear warning!’
t.95: and do not set up any deity with Allah. Surely I am a clear warner to you from Him.
t.19: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
t.22: And make not another an object of worship with Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
t.203: And set not up (or worship not) any other ilâh (god) along with Allâh [Glorified be He (Alone), Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him]. Verily, I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) am a plain warner to you from Him.
t.54: اور اللہ کے ساتھ کسی اور کو معبود نہ ٹھراؤ۔ بیشک میں تمہیں اس کی طرف سے کھلا ڈرانے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them but they said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
t.84: In similar way, no messenger came to those before them, but they said, “(He is) a magician or a madman.”
t.85: Every previous people to whom a messenger was sent also said, ‘A sor-cerer, or maybe a madman!’
t.95: Thus has it been (in the past): never did a Messenger come to the nations that preceded them but they said: “(He is) a sorcerer, or a mad-man.”
t.19: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
t.22: Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
t.203: Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"
t.54: اسی طرح جو لوگ ان سے پہلے گزرے ہیں ان کے پاس جو بھی رسول آیا انہوں نے کہہ دیا کہ یا تو یہ جادوگر ہے یا دیوانہ ہے.

t.149: Did they recommend it to one another? In fact, they are a people who exceed all limits.
t.84: Have they handed down (this saying) to each other as a legacy? Rather they are a rebellious people.
t.85: Did they tell one another to do this? No! They are a people who exceed all bounds,
t.95: Have they arrived at a common understanding concerning this? No; but they are a people given to transgression.
t.19: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.
t.22: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
t.203: Have they (the people of the past) transmitted this saying to these (Quraish pagans)? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds (in disbelief)!
t.54: کیایہ اس بات کی ایک دوسرے کو وصیت کرتے گئے ہیں.

t.149: So turn away from them, for youare not to blame.
t.84: So, turn away from them, for you are not blamed.
t.85: so ignore them [Prophet]- you are not to blame-
t.95: So turn your attention away from them; you shall incur no blame.
t.19: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,
t.22: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.
t.203: So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them (Quraish pagans), you are not blame-worthy (as you have conveyed Allâh’s Message).
t.54: (نہیں) بلکہ یہ سب کے سب سرکش ہیں۔ تو آپ ان سے منھ پھیر لیں آپ پر کوئی ملامت نہیں.

t.149: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers.
t.84: And keep reminding, because reminding benefits the believers.
t.85: and go on reminding [people], it is good for those who believe to be reminded.
t.95: Do, however, keep exhorting them; for exhortation benefits those endowed with faith.
t.19: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
t.22: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
t.203: And remind (by preaching the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), for verily, the reminding profits the believers.
t.54: اور نصیحت کرتے رہیں یقیناً یہ نصیحت ایمان والوں کو نفع دے گی.

t.149: And I did not create the unseen beingsand humans but to worship Me.
t.84: I did not create the Jinns and the human beings except for the purpose that they should worship Me.
t.85: I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me:
t.95: I created the jinn and humans for nothing else but that they may serve Me;
t.19: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
t.22: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.
t.203: And I (Allâh) created not the jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me (Alone).
t.54: میں نے جنات اورانسانوں کو محض اسی لیے پیدا کیا ہے کہ وه صرف میری عبادت کریں.

t.149: I need no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.
t.84: I do not want any sustenance from them, nor do I want them to feed Me.
t.85: I want no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me-
t.95: I desire from them no provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
t.19: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
t.22: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
t.203: I seek not any provision from them (i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures) nor do I ask that they should feed Me (i.e. feed themselves or My creatures).
t.54: نہ میں ان سے روزی چاہتا ہوں نہ میری یہ چاہت ہے کہ یہ مجھے کھلائیں.

t.149: Allah is the All-Providing, the Possessor of power, the All-Firm.
t.84: In fact, Allah is the All-Sustainer, Possessor of power, the Strong.
t.85: God is the Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever Mighty.
t.95: Surely Allah is the Bestower of all provision, the Lord of all power, the Strong.
t.19: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
t.22: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
t.203: Verily, Allâh is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.
t.54: اللہ تعالیٰ تو خود ہی سب کا روزی رساں توانائی واﻻ اور زور آور ہے.

t.149: So, indeed, those who do injustice will have their lot like the lot of their fellows, so let them not hasten Me.
t.84: So, those who did wrong will have their turn like the turn of their counterparts. So, they should not ask Me to hasten on.
t.85: The evildoers, like their predecessors, will have a share of punishment- they need not ask Me to hasten it-
t.95: The wrong-doers shall receive a portion of the chastisements as their fellows (of yore). So let them not rush Me.
t.19: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
t.22: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
t.203: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on!
t.54: پس جن لوگوں نے ﻇلم کیا ہے انہیں بھی ان کے ساتھیوں کے حصہ کے مثل حصہ ملے گا، لہٰذا وه مجھ سے جلدی طلب نہ کریں.

t.149: So woe to those who have denied from that day of theirs which they are promised.
t.84: Woe, then, to those who disbelieve because of the Day of theirs that they are promised (for punishment).
t.85: and woe betide those who deny the truth on the Day they have been promised.
t.95: Woe, then, betide those who disbelieved in that Day of theirs which they are being asked to hold in dread.
t.19: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
t.22: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
t.203: Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Allâh and His Oneness - Islâmic Monotheism) from their Day which they have been promised (for their punishment).
t.54: پس خرابی ہے منکروں کو ان کے اس دن کی جس کا وعده دیئے جاتے ہیں.

t.149: By Mount Tûr.
t.84: By the mount of Tūr,
t.85: By the mountain,
t.95: By the Mount,
t.19: By the Mount,
t.22: By the Mount (of Revelation);
t.203: By the Tûr (Mount)
t.54: قسم ہے طور کی.

t.149: By a scripture inscribed
t.84: and by a book, written
t.85: by a Scripture inscribed
t.95: and the Book inscribed
t.19: And a Scripture inscribed
t.22: By a Decree inscribed
t.203: And by a Book Inscribed
t.54: اور لکھی ہوئی کتاب کی.

t.149: in an unrolled parchment.
t.84: on an unrolled scroll,
t.85: in unrolled parch-ment,
t.95: on fine parchment;
t.19: On fine parchment unrolled,
t.22: In a Scroll unfolded;
t.203: In parchment unrolled.
t.54: جو جھلی کے کھلے ہوئے ورق میں ہے.

t.149: By the frequented House(of God) .
t.84: and by the Populated House (Al-Bait-ul-Ma‘mūr) ,
t.85: by the much-visited House,
t.95: by the much-frequented House,
t.19: And the House frequented,
t.22: By the much-frequented Fane;
t.203: And by Al-Bait-ul-Ma‘mûr (the house over the heavens parallel to the Ka‘bah at Makkah, continuously visited by the angels).
t.54: اورآباد گھر کی.

t.149: By the raised canopy.
t.84: and by the roof, raised high,
t.85: by the raised canopy,
t.95: by the elevated canopy;
t.19: And the roof exalted,
t.22: By the Canopy Raised High;
t.203: And by the roof raised high (i.e. the heaven).
t.54: اور اونچی چھت کی.

t.149: By the sea flared up with fire—
t.84: and by the sea, flared up (with fire),
t.85: by the ocean ever filled,
t.95: and by the swelling sea:
t.19: And the sea kept filled,
t.22: And by the Ocean filled with Swell;-
t.203: And by the sea kept filled (or it will be fire kindled on the Day of Resurrection).
t.54: اور بھڑکائے ہوئے سمندر کی.

t.149: the punishment of yourLord is sure to come;
t.84: the punishment of your Lord is sure to fall.
t.85: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is coming––
t.95: verily your Lord's chastisement shall come to pass,
t.19: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;
t.22: Verily, the Doom of thy Lord will indeed come to pass;-
t.203: Verily, the Torment of your Lord will surely come to pass.
t.54: بیشک آپ کے رب کا عذاب ہو کر رہنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: there is nothing to avert it
t.84: There is nothing to push it back,
t.85: it cannot be put off––
t.95: none can avert that.
t.19: There is none that can ward it off.
t.22: There is none can avert it;-
t.203: There is none that can avert it.
t.54: اسے کوئی روکنے واﻻ نہیں.

t.149: on the day when the sky sways in agitation
t.84: the Day when the sky will tremble, a horrible trembling,
t.85: on the Day when the sky sways back and forth
t.95: (It shall come to pass) on the Day when the heaven will convulse in a great convulsion,
t.19: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
t.22: On the Day when the firmament will be in dreadful commotion.
t.203: On the Day when the heaven will shake with a dreadful shaking,
t.54: جس دن آسمان تھرتھرانے لگے گا.

t.149: and the mountains go into motion.
t.84: and the mountains will move about, a terrible movement.
t.85: and the mountains float away.
t.95: and the mountains shall violently fly about.
t.19: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,
t.22: And the mountains will fly hither and thither.
t.203: And the mountains will move away with a (horrible) movement.
t.54: اور پہاڑ چلنے پھرنے لگیں گے.

t.149: So woe on that day to the disbelievers
t.84: So, woe to those who reject (the true faith),
t.85: Woe on that Day to those who deny the Truth,
t.95: Woe, then, on that Day to those who give the lie (to this Message)
t.19: Then woe that day unto the deniers
t.22: Then woe that Day to those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood;-
t.203: Then woe that Day to the beliers.
t.54: اس دن جھٹلانے والوں کو (پوری) خرابی ہے.

t.149: who are indulged in vain talk, playing.
t.84: who are indulged in vain talk, playing (with truth),
t.85: who amuse themselves with idle chatter:
t.95: and amuse themselves with vain argumentation.
t.19: Who play in talk of grave matters;
t.22: That play (and paddle) in shallow trifles.
t.203: Who are playing in falsehood.
t.54: جو اپنی بیہوده گوئی میں اچھل کود کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: The day when they are shoved into the Fire of Hell forcefully.
t.84: the Day they will be pushed to the Fire forcefully,
t.85: on that Day they will be thrust into the Fire of Hell.
t.95: On the Day when they shall be thrust into Hell with a violent thrust (and shall be told):
t.19: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell
t.22: That Day shall they be thrust down to the Fire of Hell, irresistibly.
t.203: The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the Fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing.
t.54: جس دن وه دھکے دے دے کر آتش جہنم کی طرف ﻻئیں جائیں گے.

t.149: “This is the Fire in which youused to disbelieve.
t.84: (and it will be said to them,) “This is the Fire you used to deny.
t.85: ‘This is the Fire you used to deny.
t.95: “This is the Hell which you used to give the lie to.”
t.19: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.
t.22: "This:, it will be said, "Is the Fire,- which ye were wont to deny!
t.203: This is the Fire which you used to belie.
t.54: یہی وه آتش دوزخ ہے جسے تم جھوٹ بتلاتے تھے.

t.149: Is this magic, or do younot see?
t.84: Is it then magic, or do you not see?
t.85: So is this sorcery? Do you still not see it?
t.95: Is this, then, any feat of magic or are you unable to see?
t.19: Is this magic, or do ye not see?
t.22: "Is this then a fake, or is it ye that do not see?
t.203: Is this magic, or do you not see?
t.54: (اب بتاؤ) کیا یہ جادو ہے؟ یا تم دیکھتے ہی نہیں ہو.

t.149: Roast in it, and be patient or be impatient—it is the same for you; indeed, you are only being repaid for what you used to do.”
t.84: Enter it. Now, whether you endure (it) patiently or impatiently, it is all the same for you; you are merely rewarded for what you used to do.”
t.85: Burn in it––it makes no difference whether you bear it patiently or not–– you are only being repaid for what you have done.’
t.95: Go now and burn in it. It is all the same whether you bear it patiently or do not bear it with patience. You are only being recompensed for your deeds.”
t.19: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
t.22: "Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds."
t.203: Taste you therein its heat and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do.
t.54: جاؤ دوزخ میں اب تمہارا صبر کرنا اور نہ کرنا تمہارے لیے یکساں ہے تمہیں فقط تمہارے کیے کا بدلہ دیا جائے گا.

t.149: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are in Gardens and bliss,
t.84: Of course, the God-fearing will be in gardens and bliss,
t.85: Those who were mindful of God are in Gardens and in bliss,
t.95: Surely the God-fearing shall be in Gardens and bliss,
t.19: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,
t.22: As to the Righteous, they will be in Gardens, and in Happiness,-
t.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) will be in Gardens (Paradise), and Delight.
t.54: یقیناً پرہیزگار لوگ جنتوں میں اور نعمتوں میں ہیں.

t.149: enjoying what their Lord has brought them, and their Lord has shielded them from the punishment of purgatory.
t.84: enjoying what their Lord will have given to them, and their Lord will have saved them from the punishment of Hell.
t.85: rejoicing in their Lord’s gifts: He has saved them from the torment of the Blaze,
t.95: enjoying what Allah will have endowed them with; and their Lord will have saved them from the torment of the Blazing Fire.
t.19: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
t.22: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire.
t.203: Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire.
t.54: جو انہیں ان کے رب نے دے رکھی ہیں اس پر خوش خوش ہیں، اوران کے پروردگار نے انہیں جہنم کے عذاب سے بھی بچا لیا ہے.

t.149: “Eat and drink pleasantly on account of what youused to do.”
t.84: (It will be said to them,) “Eat and drink pleasantly because of what you used to do,
t.85: ‘Eat and drink with healthy enjoyment as a reward for what you have done.’
t.95: (They will be told): “Eat and drink to your hearts' content as a reward for your deeds.”
t.19: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,
t.22: (To them will be said:) "Eat and drink ye, with profit and health, because of your (good) deeds."
t.203: "Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do."
t.54: تم مزے سے کھاتے پیتے رہو ان اعمال کے بدلے جو تم کرتے تھے.

t.149: Relaxing on luxurious furnishings, and We coupled them with spouses with lovely wide eyes.
t.84: relaxing on lined up couches”. And We will marry them with big-eyed houris.
t.85: They are comfortably seated on couches arranged in rows; We pair them with beautiful-eyed maidens;
t.95: The God-fearing shall be reclining on couches facing each other, and We shall wed them to maidens with large, beautiful eyes.
t.19: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
t.22: They will recline (with ease) on Thrones (of dignity) arranged in ranks; and We shall join them to Companions, with beautiful big and lustrous eyes.
t.203: They will recline (with ease) on thrones arranged in ranks. And We shall marry them to Hûr: (female, fair ones) with wide lovely eyes.
t.54: برابر بچھے ہوئے شاندار تختے پر تکیے لگائے ہوئے۔ اور ہم نے ان کے نکاح بڑی بڑی آنکھوں والی (حوروں) سے کر دیئے ہیں.

t.149: And those who attained faith and whose offspring followed themin faith—We have unitedthem with theiroffspring , and We have not deprived them of anything of their work; every person is in pledge for what(deeds) he has earned.
t.84: And those who believed and their children followed them in belief, We will join their children with them, and will not curtail (the reward of) any of their deeds at all. Every person will be pledged for what he earned.
t.85: We unite the believers with their offspring who followed them in faith–– We do not deny them any of the rewards for their deeds: each person is in pledge for his own deeds––
t.95: We shall unite the believers with those descendants of theirs who followed them in their faith, and shall not deny them any part of the reward for their good deeds. Every person is pledged to what he did.
t.19: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.
t.22: And those who believe and whose families follow them in Faith,- to them shall We join their families: Nor shall We deprive them (of the fruit) of aught of their works: (Yet) is each individual in pledge for his deeds.
t.203: And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in Faith: to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned.
t.54: اور جو لوگ ایمان ﻻئے اور ان کی اوﻻد نے بھی ایمان میں ان کی پیروی کی ہم ان کی اوﻻد کو ان تک پہنچا دیں گے اور ان کے عمل سے ہم کچھ کم نہ کریں گے، ہر شخص اپنے اپنے اعمال کا گروی ہے.

t.149: And We have supplied them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
t.84: And We will go on giving them whatever they desire of fruits and meat.
t.85: We provide them with any fruit or meat they desire.
t.95: We shall provide them in abundance with all kinds of fruit and meat, whatever they may desire.
t.19: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
t.22: And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire.
t.203: And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
t.54: ہم ان کے لیے میوے اورمرغوب گوشت کی ریل پیل کردیں گے.

t.149: They exchange therein a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or recrimination.
t.84: They will snatch from one another (in a friendly manner) a glass (of wine) carrying neither absurd talk, nor something leading to sin.
t.85: They pass around a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin.
t.95: They shall pass on to one another a cup that will incite neither levity nor sin.
t.19: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
t.22: They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill.
t.203: There they shall pass from hand to hand a (wine) cup, free from any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk between them), and free from sin (because it will be lawful for them to drink).
t.54: (خوش طبعی کے ساتھ) ایک دوسرے سے جام (شراب) کی چھینا جھپٹی کریں گے جس شراب کے سرور میں تو بیہوده گوئی ہوگی نہ گناه.

t.149: And serving them are youths like nestled pearls.
t.84: And their own serving boys will rotate around them, (who will be as neat and clean) as if they were hidden pearls.
t.85: Devoted youths like hidden pearls wait on them.
t.95: Youths as fair as hidden pearls will be set apart to wait upon them; they will be running to and fro to serve them.
t.19: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
t.22: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
t.203: And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls.
t.54: اور ان کے اردگرد ان کے نو عمر غلام چل پھر رہے ہوں گے، گویا کہ وه موتی تھے جو ڈھکے رکھے تھے.

t.149: And they approached one another, inquiring.
t.84: And they will advance to one another, asking (about each other’s welfare).
t.85: They turn to one another and say,
t.95: They will turn to one another and ask (regarding the past events).
t.19: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
t.22: They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry.
t.203: And some of them draw near to others, questioning.
t.54: اور آپس میں ایک دوسرے کی طرف متوجہ ہو کر سوال کریں گے.

t.149: They said, “When we were still with our familieswe used to live in fear,
t.84: They will say, “Indeed we were afraid (of Allah’s punishment) when we were amidst our family,
t.85: ‘When we were still with our families [on earth] we used to live in fear––
t.95: They will say: “When we were living before among our kinsfolk we lived in constant fear (of Allah's displeasure).
t.19: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;
t.22: They will say: "Aforetime, we were not without fear for the sake of our people.
t.203: Saying: "Aforetime, we were afraid (of the punishment of Allâh) in the midst of our families.
t.54: کہیں گے کہ اس سے پہلے ہم اپنے گھر والوں کے درمیان بہت ڈرا کرتے تھے.

t.149: so Allah has conferred favor upon us and has shielded us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
t.84: but Allah did favour to us and saved us from the torment of Fire’s scorching breath.
t.85: God has been gracious to us and saved us from the torment of intense heat-
t.95: Then Allah graced us with His favour and saved us from the chastisement of the scorching wind.
t.19: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.
t.22: "But Allah has been good to us, and has delivered us from the Penalty of the Scorching Wind.
t.203: "So Allâh has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire.
t.54: پس اللہ تعالیٰ نے ہم پر بڑا احسان کیا اور ہمیں تیز وتند گرم ہواؤں کے عذاب سے بچا لیا.

t.149: Indeed, before this we used to pray to Him; indeed , He is the Fulfiller of promises, the Bestower of mercy.”
t.84: We used to pray to Him before. He is surely the Most-Kind, the Very-Merciful.
t.85: We used to pray to Him: He is the Good, the Merciful One.’
t.95: Formerly we had always prayed to Him. Surely He is Most Benign, Most Compassionate.”
t.19: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.
t.22: "Truly, we did call unto Him from of old: truly it is He, the Beneficent, the Merciful!"
t.203: "Verily, We used to invoke Him (Alone and none else) before. Verily, He is Al-Barr (the Most Subtle, Kind, Courteous, and Generous), the Most Merciful."
t.54: ہم اس سے پہلے ہی اس کی عبادت کیا کرتے تھے، بیشک وه محسن اور مہربان ہے.

t.149: So remind, for youare neither a soothsayer nor a madman.
t.84: So keep reminding (them), because by the grace of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a mad man.
t.85: So [Prophet] remind [people]. By the grace of your Lord [Prophet], you are neither oracle nor madman.
t.95: So exhort (them, O Prophet), for by your Lord's Grace, you are neither a soothsayer nor a madman.
t.19: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
t.22: Therefore proclaim thou the praises (of thy Lord): for by the Grace of thy Lord, thou art no (vulgar) soothsayer, nor art thou one possessed.
t.203: Therefore, remind (mankind of Islâmic Monotheism, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). By the Grace of Allâh, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.
t.54: تو آپ سمجھاتے رہیں کیونکہ آپ اپنے رب کے فضل سے نہ تو کاہن ہیں نہ دیوانہ.

t.149: Or do they say, “A poetfor whom we await a calamity of time”?
t.84: Do they rather say, “He is a poet for whom we are awaiting the accident of death?”
t.85: If they say, ‘He is only a poet: we shall await his fate,’
t.95: Or do they say: “He is a poet for whom we await an adverse turn of fortune.”
t.19: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?
t.22: Or do they say:- "A Poet! we await for him some calamity (hatched) by Time!"
t.203: Or do they say: "(Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a poet! We await for him some calamity by time!"
t.54: کیا کافر یوں کہتے ہیں کہ یہ شاعر ہے ہم اس پر زمانے کے حوادث (یعنی موت) کا انتظار کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: Say, “Go on awaiting, for I am with youamong those awaiting.”
t.84: Say, “Wait! I am waiting with you, too.”
t.85: say, ‘Wait if you wish; I too am waiting’-
t.95: Tell them: “Wait; I too am waiting with you.”
t.19: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.
t.22: Say thou: "Await ye!- I too will wait along with you!"
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to them): "Wait! I am with you among the waiters!"
t.54: کہہ دیجئے! تم منتظر رہو میں بھی تمہارے ساتھ انتظار کرنے والوں میں ہوں.

t.149: Or is it that their discerning minds command them to this? Or are they a people who exceed all limits?
t.84: Is it their intellects that direct them to (say) this, or are they a rebellious people?
t.85: does their reason really tell them to do this, or are they simply insolent people?
t.95: Do their minds prompt them to say such things, or are they a people immersed in transgression?”
t.19: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?
t.22: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds?
t.203: Do their minds command them this [i.e. to tell a lie against you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)] or are they people transgressing all bounds?
t.54: کیا ان کی عقلیں انہیں یہی سکھاتی ہیں؟ یا یہ لوگ ہی سرکش ہیں.

t.149: Or do they say, “He made it up”? In fact, they do not believe.
t.84: Do they rather say, “He has forged it (the Qur’ān.)”? No, but they do not believe.
t.85: If they say, ‘He has made it up himself’- they certainly do not believe-
t.95: Do they say: “He has himself fabricated the Qur'an?” No; the truth is that they are altogether averse to believing.
t.19: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!
t.22: Or do they say, "He fabricated the (Message)"? Nay, they have no faith!
t.203: Or do they say: "He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has forged it (this Qur’ân)?" Nay! They believe not!
t.54: کیا یہ کہتے ہیں کہ اس نبی نے (قرآن) خود گھڑ لیا ہے، واقعہ یہ ہے کہ وه ایمان نہیں ﻻتے.

t.149: So let them produce a discourse like it if they are truthful.
t.84: So, let them bring a discourse like this, if they are truthful.
t.85: let them produce one like it, if what they say is true.
t.95: (If they are truthful in this), then let them produce a discourse of similar splendour.
t.19: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.
t.22: Let them then produce a recital like unto it,- If (it be) they speak the truth!
t.203: Let them then produce a recital like unto it (the Qur’ân) if they are truthful.
t.54: اچھا اگر یہ سچے ہیں تو بھلا اس جیسی ایک (ہی) بات یہ (بھی) تو لے آئیں.

t.149: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?
t.84: Is it that they are created by none, or are they themselves the creators?
t.85: Were they created without any agent? Were they the creators?
t.95: Did they come into being without any creator? Or were they their own creators?
t.19: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?
t.22: Were they created of nothing, or were they themselves the creators?
t.203: Were they created by nothing? Or were they themselves the creators?
t.54: کیا یہ بغیر کسی (پیدا کرنے والے) کے خود بخود پیدا ہوگئے ہیں؟ یا یہ خود پیدا کرنے والے ہیں؟

t.149: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they are not certain.
t.84: Or have they created the heavens and the earth? No, but they are sure of nothing.
t.85: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They do not have faith.
t.95: Or is it they who created the heavens and the earth? No; the truth is that they lack sure faith.
t.19: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
t.22: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, they have no firm belief.
t.203: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm Belief.
t.54: کیا انہوں نے ہی آسمانوں اور زمین کو پیدا کیا ہے؟ بلکہ یہ یقین نہ کرنے والے لوگ ہیں.

t.149: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers?
t.84: Or do they have the treasures of your Lord, or have they acquired control (over them)?
t.85: Do they possess your Lord’s treasures or have control over them?
t.95: Or do they have your Lord's treasures in their keeping? Or have absolute authority over them?
t.19: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?
t.22: Or are the Treasures of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (of affairs)?
t.203: Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like?
t.54: یا کیا ان کے پاس تیرے رب کے خزانے ہیں؟ یا (ان خزانوں کے) یہ داروغہ ہیں.

t.149: Or do they have a stairway(to heaven) by means of which they listen? Then let their listener bring an evident manifestation.
t.84: Or have they a stairway (to the heavens) by means of which they listen (to the divine decrees)? If so, their listener must bring a clear proof.
t.85: Do they have a ladder to climb, in order to eavesdrop [on Heaven’s secrets]? Let their eavesdropper produce clear proof.
t.95: Or do they have a ladder whereon they can climb and attempt to listen (to what is transpiring in the Higher Realm)? Then, let any of them who has listened to it produce a clear proof of it.
t.19: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
t.22: Or have they a ladder, by which they can (climb up to heaven and) listen (to its secrets)? Then let (such a) listener of theirs produce a manifest proof.
t.203: Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen (to the talks of the angels)? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof.
t.54: یا کیا ان کے پاس کوئی سیڑھی ہے جس پر چڑھ کر سنتے ہیں؟ (اگر ایسا ہے) تو ان کا سننے واﻻ کوئی روشن دلیل پیش کرے.

t.149: Or is He to have the daughters and youthe sons?
t.84: Is it that He has daughters and you have sons?
t.85: Does God have daughters while you have sons?
t.95: Or does Allah have daughters whereas you have sons?
t.19: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?
t.22: Or has He only daughters and ye have sons?
t.203: Or has He (Allâh) only daughters and you have sons?
t.54: کیا اللہ کی تو سب لڑکیاں ہیں اور تمہارے ہاں لڑکے ہیں؟

t.149: Or do youask them for a reward so that they are weighed down by debt?
t.84: Or is it that you (O prophet) ask them for a fee, and therefore they are burdened with a liability?
t.85: Do you [Prophet] demand a payment from them that would burden them with debt?
t.95: Or is it that you ask of them any recompense so that they should fear to be weighed down under the burden of debt?
t.19: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?
t.22: Or is it that thou dost ask for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
t.203: Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask a wage from them (for your preaching of Islâmic Monotheism) so that they are burdened with a load of debt?
t.54: کیا تو ان سے کوئی اجرت طلب کرتا ہے کہ یہ اس کے تاوان سے بوجھل ہو رہے ہیں.

t.149: Or do they have(knowledge of) the hidden realm and they are writing it down?
t.84: Or have they the knowledge of the Unseen, and they are recording it?
t.85: Do they have [access to] the unseen? Could they write it down?
t.95: Or is it that they have access to (the Truths in) the realm beyond sense-perception which they are writing down?
t.19: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?
t.22: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down?
t.203: Or that the Ghaib (Unseen) is with them, and they write it down?
t.54: کیا ان کے پاس علم غیب ہے جسے یہ لکھ لیتے ہیں؟

t.149: Or do they want a plot? Rather, the plot will only befall the deniers.
t.84: Or do they intend to plan to do harm (to the prophet)? Then the disbelievers themselves shall be harmed by the plan.
t.85: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared.
t.95: Or are they contriving a stratagem against you? If so, that stratagem will rebound against the unbelievers.
t.19: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!
t.22: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy Allah are themselves involved in a Plot!
t.203: Or do they intend a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)? But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) are themselves plotted against!
t.54: کیا یہ لوگ کوئی فریب کرنا چاہتے ہیں؟ تو یقین کرلیں کہ فریب خورده کافر ہی ہیں.

t.149: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Highly Exalted is Allah above what they associate.
t.84: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Pure is Allah from what they associate with Him.
t.85: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him.
t.95: Do they have any god other than Allah? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate (with Him in His Divinity).
t.19: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!
t.22: Or have they a god other than Allah? Exalted is Allah far above the things they associate with Him!
t.203: Or have they an ilâh (a god) other than Allâh? Glorified be Allâh from all that they ascribe as partners (to Him)
t.54: کیا اللہ کے سوا ان کا کوئی معبود ہے؟ (ہرگز نہیں) اللہ تعالیٰ ان کے شرک سے پاک ہے.

t.149: And if they were to see lumps of sky falling, they would say, “A mass of clouds.”
t.84: Even if they see a piece falling down from the sky, they would say, “It is a cumulated cloud.”
t.85: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’
t.95: (So obstinate are they that) even if they were to see some fragments of the sky falling down they would still say: “It is only a mass of cloud.”
t.19: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
t.22: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
t.203: And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
t.54: اگر یہ لوگ آسمان کے کسی ٹکڑے کو گرتا ہوا دیکھ لیں تب بھی کہہ دیں کہ یہ تہ بہ تہ بادل ہے.

t.149: So leavethem until they meet their day in which they are stunned—
t.84: So, leave them alone until they face their Day, in which they will be turned unconscious,
t.85: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck,
t.95: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs when they shall be struck down,
t.19: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,
t.22: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror),-
t.203: So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror).
t.54: تو انہیں چھوڑ دے یہاں تک کہ انہیں اس دن سے سابقہ پڑے جس میں یہ بے ہوش کر دیئے جائیں گے.

t.149: the day when their plots avail them nothing, nor are they supported.
t.84: the Day their planning will not benefit them in the least, nor will they be helped.
t.85: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help.
t.95: when their stratagem shall be of no avail to them, nor shall they be succoured.
t.19: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
t.22: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them.
t.203: The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all nor will they be helped (i.e. they will receive their torment in Hell).
t.54: جس دن انہیں ان کا مکر کچھ کام نہ دے گا اور نہ وه مدد کیے جائیں گے.

t.149: And indeed, for those who did injustice there is a punishment apart from that, but most of them do not know.
t.84: And for those who did wrong there is another punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
t.85: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it.
t.95: Surely a chastisement awaits the wrong-doers even before the coming of that Day; but most of them do not know.
t.19: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.
t.22: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.
t.203: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment (i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves) before this; but most of them know not. (Tafsir At-Tabarî).
t.54: بیشک ﻇالموں کے لیے اس کے علاوه اور عذاب بھی ہیں۔ لیکن ان لوگوں میں سے اکثر بےعلم ہیں.

t.149: So wait patiently for the decree of yourLord, for you are before Our Eyes. And highly exalt your Lord with praise when you arise,
t.84: And (O Prophet) be patient about the decision of your Lord, because you are in front of Our Eyes. And proclaim the purity of your Lord along with His praise when you stand (in Prayer),
t.85: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise.
t.95: Be patient, then, (O Prophet), until the judgement of your Lord comes. For surely you are before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise,
t.19: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
t.22: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
t.203: So wait patiently (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes; and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep.
t.54: تو اپنے رب کے حکم کے انتظار میں صبر سے کام لے، بیشک تو ہماری آنکھوں کے سامنے ہے۔ صبح کو جب تو اٹھے اپنے رب کی پاکی اور حمد بیان کر.

t.149: and highly exalt Him during the night and at the receding of the stars.
t.84: And, in parts of night too, proclaim His purity, and at the time of setting of the stars.
t.85: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars.
t.95: and also celebrate His praise at night, and at the retreat of the stars.
t.19: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.
t.22: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars!
t.203: And in the nighttime also glorify His Praises - and at the setting of the stars.
t.54: اور رات کو بھی اس کی تسبیح پڑھ اور ستاروں کے ڈوبتے وقت بھی.

t.149: By the star as it goes down,
t.84: By the star when it goes down to set,
t.85: By the star when it sets!
t.95: By the star when it sets:
t.19: By the Star when it setteth,
t.22: By the Star when it goes down,-
t.203: By the star when it goes down (or vanishes).
t.54: قسم ہے ستارے کی جب وه گرے.

t.149: yourfellow has not gone astray, nor has he been deluded,
t.84: your fellow (the Holy Prophet) has neither missed the way, nor did he deviate.
t.85: Your companion has not strayed; he is not deluded;
t.95: your companion has neither strayed nor is he deluded;
t.19: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;
t.22: Your Companion is neither astray nor being misled.
t.203: Your companion (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has neither gone astray nor has erred.
t.54: کہ تمہارے ساتھی نے نہ راه گم کی ہے نہ وه ٹیڑھی راه پر ہے.

t.149: nor does he speak out of whim.
t.84: He does not speak out of (his own) desire.
t.85: he does not speak from his own desire.
t.95: nor does he speak out of his desire.
t.19: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.
t.22: Nor does he say (aught) of (his own) Desire.
t.203: Nor does he speak of (his own) desire.
t.54: اور نہ وه اپنی خواہش سے کوئی بات کہتے ہیں.

t.149: It is but a revelation being revealed,
t.84: It is but revelation revealed (to him).
t.85: The Quran is nothing less than a revelation that is sent to him.
t.95: This is nothing but a revelation that is conveyed to him,
t.19: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,
t.22: It is no less than inspiration sent down to him:
t.203: It is only a Revelation revealed.
t.54: وه تو صرف وحی ہے جو اتاری جاتی ہے.

t.149: taught to him by the extremely powerful,
t.84: It is taught to him by one (angel) of strong faculties,
t.85: It was taught to him by [an angel] with mighty powers
t.95: something that a very powerful one has imparted to him,
t.19: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,
t.22: He was taught by one Mighty in Power,
t.203: He has been taught (this Qur’ân) by one mighty in power [Jibrîl (Gabriel)]
t.54: اسے پوری طاقت والے فرشتے نے سکھایا ہے.

t.149: the one of vigor. He settled
t.84: the one of vigour. So he stood poised,
t.85: and great strength, who stood
t.95: one endowed with immense wisdom. He came forth and stood poised,
t.19: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view
t.22: Endued with Wisdom: for he appeared (in stately form);
t.203: One free from any defect in body and mind then he (Jibrîl - Gabriel in his real shape as created by Allah) rose and became stable.
t.54: جو زور آور ہے پھر وه سیدھا کھڑا ہو گیا.

t.149: while he was at the highest horizon,
t.84: while he was on the upper horizon.
t.85: on the highest horizon
t.95: being on the higher horizon.
t.19: When he was on the uppermost horizon.
t.22: While he was in the highest part of the horizon:
t.203: While he [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] was in the highest part of the horizon, (Tafsir Ibn Kathir)
t.54: اور وه بلند آسمان کے کناروں پر تھا.

t.149: then he came near and descended
t.84: Then he drew near, and came down,
t.85: and then approached––coming down
t.95: Then he drew near and hung above suspended,
t.19: Then he drew nigh and came down
t.22: Then he approached and came closer,
t.203: Then he [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] approached and came closer,
t.54: پھر نزدیک ہوا اور اتر آیا.

t.149: so that he was within two bows’ length or closer.
t.84: so as he was at a distance like that of two bows (joined together), rather even nearer.
t.85: until he was two bow-lengths away or even closer––
t.95: until he was two bows' length away, or nearer.
t.19: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,
t.22: And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer;
t.203: And was at a distance of two bows’ length or (even) nearer.
t.54: پس وه دو کمانوں کے بقدر فاصلہ ره گیا بلکہ اس سے بھی کم.

t.149: Then He revealed to His servant that which He revealed.
t.84: Thus He (Allah) revealed to His slave what He revealed.
t.85: and revealed to God’s servant what He revealed.
t.95: Then he revealed to Allah's servant whatever he had to reveal.
t.19: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.
t.22: So did (Allah) convey the inspiration to His Servant- (conveyed) what He (meant) to convey.
t.203: So (Allâh) revealed to His slave [Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم through Jibrîl (Gabriel) عليه السلام] whatever He revealed.
t.54: پس اس نے اللہ کے بندے کو وحی پہنچائی جو بھی پہنچائی.

t.149: The burning heart did not lie aboutwhat it saw.
t.84: The heart did not err in what he saw.
t.85: [The Prophet’s] own heart did not distort what he saw.
t.95: His heart added no untruth to what he saw.
t.19: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.
t.22: The (Prophet's) (mind and) heart in no way falsified that which he saw.
t.203: The (Prophet’s) heart lied not in what he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw.
t.54: دل نے جھوٹ نہیں کہا جسے (پیغمبر نے) دیکھا.

t.149: Will youenter into controversies with himdespitewhat he sees?
t.84: Do you quarrel with him in what he sees?
t.85: Are you going to dispute with him what he saw with his own eyes?
t.95: Are you, then, going to contend with him regarding what he sees with his eyes?
t.19: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?
t.22: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he saw?
t.203: Will you then dispute with him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about what he saw [during the Mi‘râj: (Ascent of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم to the seven heavens)]
t.54: کیا تم جھگڑا کرتے ہو اس پر جو (پیغمبر) دیکھتے ہیں.

t.149: And he saw him on another descent,
t.84: Indeed he saw him another time
t.85: A second time he saw him:
t.95: Indeed he saw him a second time,
t.19: And verily he saw him yet another time
t.22: For indeed he saw him at a second descent,
t.203: And indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw him [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] at a second descent (i.e. another time).
t.54: اسے تو ایک مرتبہ اور بھی دیکھا تھا.

t.149: at the Lote-tree of the Extremity,
t.84: by Sidrat-ul-Muntahā (the lote-tree in the upper realm),
t.85: by the lote tree beyond which none may pass
t.95: by the lote-tree at the farthest boundary,
t.19: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,
t.22: Near the Lote-tree beyond which none may pass:
t.203: Near Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (a lote-tree of the utmost boundary over the seventh heaven beyond which none can pass).
t.54: سدرةالمنتہیٰ کے پاس.

t.149: near which is the Garden of Shelter,
t.84: near which there is Jannat-ul-Ma’wā (the Paradise of Abode),
t.85: near the Garden of Restfulness,
t.95: near which is the Garden of Abode.
t.19: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.
t.22: Near it is the Garden of Abode.
t.203: Near it is the Paradise of Abode.
t.54: اسی کے پاس جنہ الماویٰ ہے.

t.149: when there covered the Lote-tree what covered it.
t.84: when the lote-tree was covered by that which covered it.
t.85: when the tree was covered in nameless [splendour].
t.95: (This was) when the lote-tree was covered with that which covered it.
t.19: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,
t.22: Behold, the Lote-tree was shrouded (in mystery unspeakable!)
t.203: When that covered the lote-tree which did cover it!
t.54: جب کہ سدره کو چھپائے لیتی تھی وه چیز جو اس پر چھا رہی تھی.

t.149: The sight(of the Prophet) did not swerve, nor did it exceed.
t.84: The eye neither went wrong, nor did exceed the limit.
t.85: His sight never wavered, nor was it too bold,
t.95: His eye did not waver, nor did it stray,
t.19: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.
t.22: (His) sight never swerved, nor did it go wrong!
t.203: The sight (of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) turned not aside (right or left), nor it transgressed beyond the limit (ordained for it).
t.54: نہ تو نگاه بہکی نہ حد سے بڑھی.

t.149: He certainly saw some of the great signs of his Lord.
t.84: He has indeed seen a part of the biggest signs of your Lord.
t.85: and he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.
t.95: and he certainly saw some of the greatest Signs of His Lord.
t.19: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.
t.22: For truly did he see, of the Signs of his Lord, the Greatest!
t.203: Indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) did see of the Greatest Signs, of his Lord (Allâh).
t.54: یقیناً اس نے اپنے رب کی بڑی بڑی نشانیوں میں سے بعض نشانیاں دیکھ لیں.

t.149: Have youseen Al-Lāt and Al-ʻUzza?
t.84: Have you ever considered about the (idols of) Lāt and ‘Uzzā,
t.85: [Disbelievers], consider al-Lat and al-Uzza,
t.95: Have you ever thought about al-Lat and al-Uzza,
t.19: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza
t.22: Have ye seen Lat. and 'Uzza,
t.203: Have you then considered Al-Lât, and Al-‘Uzzâ (two idols of the pagan Arabs)
t.54: کیا تم نے ﻻت اور عزیٰ کو دیکھا.

t.149: And Manāt, the third one, the other?
t.84: and about the other, the third (idol), namely, Manāt,?
t.85: and the third one, Manat––
t.95: and about the third deity, al-Manat?
t.19: And Manat, the third, the other?
t.22: And another, the third (goddess), Manat?
t.203: And Manât (another idol of the pagan Arabs), the other third?
t.54: اور منات تیسرے پچھلے کو.

t.149: Are youto have the males and He the females?
t.84: Is it that you have males and He (Allah) has females?
t.85: are you to have the male and He the female?
t.95: Shall you have the male issues, and He the female issues?
t.19: Are yours the males and His the females?
t.22: What! for you the male sex, and for Him, the female?
t.203: Is it for you the males and for Him the females?
t.54: کیا تمہارے لیے لڑکے اور اللہ کے لیے لڑکیاں ہیں؟

t.149: What a bizarre distribution!
t.84: If so, it is a bizarre division.
t.85: That would be a most unjust distribution!––
t.95: That is indeed an unfair division!
t.19: That indeed were an unfair division!
t.22: Behold, such would be indeed a division most unfair!
t.203: That indeed is a division most unfair!
t.54: یہ تو اب بڑی بےانصافی کی تقسیم ہے.

t.149: These are nothing but names which youhave named, you and your forefathers, for which Allah sent down no manifestation. They follow nothing but assumptions and what the(inner) selves desire, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.
t.84: These are nothing but names you and your fathers have invented; Allah has sent down no authority attached to them. They are following nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire, while guidance from their Lord has surely reached them.
t.85: these are nothing but names you have invented yourselves, you and your forefathers. God has sent no authority for them. These people merely follow guesswork and the whims of their souls, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.
t.95: These are nothing but names that you and your forefathers have invented, for which Allah has sent down no authority. They are merely following their conjectures and their carnal desires although guidance has come to them from their Lord.
t.19: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
t.22: These are nothing but names which ye have devised,- ye and your fathers,- for which Allah has sent down no authority (whatever). They follow nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire!- Even though there has already come to them Guidance from their Lord!
t.203: They are but names which you have named - you and your fathers - for which Allâh has sent down no authority. They follow but a guess and that which they themselves desire, whereas there has surely come to them the Guidance from their Lord!
t.54: دراصل یہ صرف نام ہیں جو تم نے اور تمہارے باپ دادوں نے ان کے رکھ لیے ہیں اللہ نے ان کی کوئی دلیل نہیں اتاری۔ یہ لوگ تو صرف اٹکل کے اور اپنی نفسانی خواہشوں کے پیچھے پڑے ہوئے ہیں۔ اور یقیناً ان کے رب کی طرف سے ان کے پاس ہدایت آ چکی ہے.

t.149: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
t.84: Is it that man can get whatever he wishes?
t.85: Is man to have everything he wishes for,
t.95: Does man imagine that whatever he wishes for is right for him?
t.19: Or shall man have what he coveteth?
t.22: Nay, shall man have (just) anything he hankers after?
t.203: Or shall man have what he wishes?
t.54: کیا ہر شخص جو آرزو کرے اسے میسر ہے؟

t.149: To Allah belong the Hereafter and the first(life) .
t.84: (No,) because to Allah alone belongs the (good of) the Hereafter and the former life (of this world).
t.85: when the present life and the life to come belong only to God?
t.95: To Allah belong both the Next World and the present.
t.19: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.
t.22: But it is to Allah that the End and the Beginning (of all things) belong.
t.203: But to Allâh belongs the last (Hereafter) and the first (the world).
t.54: اللہ ہی کے ہاتھ ہے یہ جہان اور وه جہان.

t.149: And how many an angel is there in the heavens whose intercession avails nothing except after Allah gives permission to whomever He wills and is well pleased with.
t.84: How many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession cannot benefit (any one) at all, but after Allah allows (it) for whomsoever He wills and pleases.
t.85: There are many angels in heaven whose intercession will be of no use until God gives permission to those He will, whose words He will accept.
t.95: Numerous are the angels in the heavens; yet their intercession shall be of no avail, except in regard to those whom He grants the leave of intercession and whose plea He is pleased to accept.
t.19: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.
t.22: How many-so-ever be the angels in the heavens, their intercession will avail nothing except after Allah has given leave for whom He pleases and that he is acceptable to Him.
t.203: And there are many angels in the heavens, whose intercession will avail nothing except after Allâh has given leave for whom He wills and is pleased with.
t.54: اور بہت سے فرشتے آسمانوں میں ہیں جن کی سفارش کچھ بھی نفع نہیں دے سکتی مگر یہ اور بات ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ اپنی خوشی اور اپنی چاہت سے جس کے لیے چاہے اجازت دے دے.

t.149: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels with female names,
t.84: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter call the angels by names of females.
t.85: Those who deny the life to come give the angels female names.
t.95: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give angels the names of females,
t.19: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.
t.22: Those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.
t.203: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.
t.54: بیشک جو لوگ آخرت پر ایمان نہیں رکھتے وه فرشتوں کا زنانہ نام مقرر کرتے ہیں.

t.149: though they have no knowledge of that. They only follow assumptions, yet surely assumptions do not substitute for the truth.
t.84: They do not have knowledge about it. They follow nothing but conjecture, and conjecture is of no avail in (the matter of) Truth.
t.85: They have no knowledge to base this on: they merely follow guesswork. Guesswork is of no value against the Truth.
t.95: although they have no knowledge regarding that. They only follow their conjecture and conjecture can never take the place of the Truth.
t.19: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.
t.22: But they have no knowledge therein. They follow nothing but conjecture; and conjecture avails nothing against Truth.
t.203: But they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and verily, guess is no substitute for the truth.
t.54: حاﻻنکہ انہیں اس کا کوئی علم نہیں وه صرف اپنے گمان کے پیچھے پڑے ہوئے ہیں اور بیشک وہم (و گمان) حق کے مقابلے میں کچھ کام نہیں دیتا.

t.149: So disregardthe one who has turned away from Our Reminder and has wanted nothing but the Earlier Life.
t.84: So, turn away from him who turns away from Our advice, and seeks nothing but (pleasure of) the worldly life.
t.85: So [Prophet] ignore those who turn away from Our revelation, who want only the life of this world.
t.95: So leave alone those who turn away from the remembrance of Us and who seek nothing but the life of the world –
t.19: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
t.22: Therefore shun those who turn away from Our Message and desire nothing but the life of this world.
t.203: Therefore withdraw (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from him who turns away from Our Reminder (this Qur’ân) and desires nothing but the life of this world.
t.54: تو آپ اس سے منھ موڑ لیں جو ہماری یاد سے منھ موڑے اور جن کا اراده بجز زندگانیٴ دنیا کے اور کچھ نہ ہو.

t.149: That is the extent of their knowledge. Indeed, yourLord is the One Who knows better who has strayed from His way and He is the One Who knows better who has accepted guidance.
t.84: That is the limit of their access to knowledge. Indeed only your Lord knows well about the one who has gone astray from his way, and He knows well about the one who has adopted the right path.
t.85: Their knowledge does not go beyond that. Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who follows guidance.
t.95: that being the utmost of their knowledge. Surely your Lord fully knows those who have strayed away from His Path and He also fully knows those who are rightly guided.
t.19: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.
t.22: That is as far as knowledge will reach them. Verily thy Lord knoweth best those who stray from His Path, and He knoweth best those who receive guidance.
t.203: That is what they could reach of knowledge. Verily, your Lord it is He Who knows best him who goes astray from His Path, and He knows best him who receives guidance.
t.54: یہی ان کے علم کی انتہا ہے۔ آپ کا رب اس سے خوب واقف ہے جو اس کی راه سے بھٹک گیا ہے اور وہی خوب واقف ہےاس سے بھی جو راه یافتہ ہے.

t.149: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may repay those who have done evil according to what they have done and repay those who have excelled in doing good with the best.
t.84: To Allah belongs whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, so that He gives punishment to evildoers for what they did, and gives good reward to those who did good
t.85: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and reward, with what is best, those who do good.
t.95: To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. He will requite the evil-doers for their deeds and bestow a goodly reward on those who have done good,
t.19: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.
t.22: Yea, to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: so that He rewards those who do evil, according to their deeds, and He rewards those who do good, with what is best.
t.203: And to Allâh belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil with that which they have done (i.e. punish them in Hell), and reward those who do good, with what is best (i.e. Paradise).
t.54: اور اللہ ہی کا ہے جو کچھ آسمانوں میں ہے اور جو کچھ زمین میں ہے تاکہ اللہ تعالیٰ برے عمل کرنے والوں کو ان کے اعمال کا بدلہ دے اور نیک کام کرنے والوں کو اچھا بدلہ عنایت فرمائے.

t.149: Those who avoid the gravest of sinsand obscenities—except for minor lapses—yourLord is of vast forgiveness. He knows better about you, ever since He initiated you from the earth, and ever since you were fetuses in your mothers’ bellies. So do not acclaim your own purity—He knows better who is mindful(of Him) .
t.84: -those who abstain from the major sins and from shameful acts, except minor involvements. Indeed your Lord is extensive in forgiveness. He knows you more than anyone else (from a time) when He created you from the earth and when you were embryos in the wombs of your mothers. So, do not claim purity (from faults) for your selves. He knows best who is God-fearing.
t.85: As for those who avoid grave sins and foul acts, though they may commit small sins, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. He has been aware of you from the time He produced you from the earth and from your hiding places in your mothers’ wombs, so do not assert your own goodness:He knows best who is mindful of Him.
t.95: on those who avoid grave sins and shameful deeds, even if they may sometimes stumble into lesser offences. Surely your Lord is abounding in His Forgiveness. Very well is He aware of you since He produced you from the earth, and while you were still in your mothers' wombs and not yet born. So do not boastfully claim yourselves to be purified. He fully knows those that are truly Godfearing.
t.19: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).
t.22: Those who avoid great sins and shameful deeds, only (falling into) small faults,- verily thy Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you well when He brings you out of the earth, And when ye are hidden in your mothers' wombs. Therefore justify not yourselves: He knows best who it is that guards against evil.
t.203: Those who avoid great sins (See the Qur’ân, Verses: 6:152,153) and Al-Fawâhish (illegal sexual intercourse) except the small faults, - verily, your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well when He created you from the earth (Adam), and when you were fetuses in your mothers’ wombs. So ascribe not purity to yourselves. He knows best him who fears Allâh and keeps his duty to Him [i.e. those who are Al-Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2)].
t.54: ان لوگوں کو جو بڑے گناہوں سے بچتے ہیں اور بے حیائی سے بھی۔ سوائے کسی چھوٹے سے گناه کے۔ بیشک تیرا رب بہت کشاده مغفرت واﻻ ہے، وه تمہیں بخوبی جانتا ہے جبکہ اس نے تمہیں زمین سے پیدا کیا اور جبکہ تم اپنی ماؤں کے پیٹ میں بچے تھے۔ پس تم اپنی پاکیزگی آپ بیان نہ کرو، وہی پرہیزگاروں کو خوب جانتا ہے.

t.149: Have youseen the one who turned away
t.84: Did you see the one who turned away,
t.85: [Prophet], consider that man who turned away:
t.95: (O Prophet), did you see him who turned away (from the Path of Allah),
t.19: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,
t.22: Seest thou one who turns back,
t.203: Did you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) observe him who turned away (from Islâm).
t.54: کیا آپ نے اسے دیکھا جس نے منھ موڑ لیا.

t.149: and gave a little, then held back?
t.84: and gave a little, and stopped?
t.85: he only gave a little and then he stopped.
t.95: who gave a little, and then stopped?
t.19: And gave a little, then was grudging?
t.22: Gives a little, then hardens (his heart)?
t.203: And gave a little, then stopped (giving)?
t.54: اور بہت کم دیا اور ہاتھ روک لیا.

t.149: Does he possess knowledge of the hidden realm and can therefore foresee?
t.84: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen whereby he sees (what he believes)?
t.85: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen? Can he see [the Hereafter]?
t.95: Does he have any knowledge of the world beyond the ken of sense-perception, and therefore, clearly sees (the Truth)?
t.19: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?
t.22: What! Has he knowledge of the Unseen so that he can see?
t.203: Is with him the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees?
t.54: کیا اسے علم غیب ہے کہ وه (سب کچھ) دیکھ رہا ہے؟

t.149: Or was he not informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses,
t.84: Has he not been told of what was (revealed) in the scriptures of Mūsā
t.85: Has he not been told what was written in the Scriptures of Moses
t.95: Has he not been informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses,
t.19: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses
t.22: Nay, is he not acquainted with what is in the Books of Moses-
t.203: Or is he not informed with what is in the Pages (Scripture) of Mûsâ (Moses),
t.54: کیا اسے اس چیز کی خبر نہیں دی گئی جو موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کے.

t.149: and of Abraham who fulfilled(conveying the commandments) :
t.84: and of Ibrāhīm who fulfilled (his duties)?
t.85: and of Abraham, who fulfilled his duty:
t.95: and of Abraham, who lived up to the trust?
t.19: And Abraham who paid his debt:
t.22: And of Abraham who fulfilled his engagements?-
t.203: And of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) who fulfilled (or conveyed) all that (Allâh ordered him to do or convey):
t.54: اور وفادار ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) کے صحیفوں میں تھا.

t.149: that no bearer of burden bears the burden of another;
t.84: (It was) that no bearer of burden shall bear the burden of the other,
t.85: that no soul shall bear the burden of another;
t.95: “That no bearer of a burden shall bear the burden of another,
t.19: That no laden one shall bear another's load,
t.22: Namely, that no bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another;
t.203: That no burdened person (with sins) shall bear the burden (sins) of another.
t.54: کہ کوئی شخص کسی دوسرے کا بوجھ نہ اٹھائے گا.

t.149: and that man attains only what he has striven for;
t.84: and that a man shall not deserve but (the reward of) his own effort,
t.85: that man will only have what he has worked towards;
t.95: and that man shall have nothing but what he has striven for,
t.19: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,
t.22: That man can have nothing but what he strives for;
t.203: And that man can have nothing but what he does (good or bad).
t.54: اور یہ کہ ہر انسان کے لیے صرف وہی ہے جس کی کوشش خود اس نے کی.

t.149: and that surely his pursuit will eventually be seen,
t.84: and that his effort will soon be seen,
t.85: that his labour will be seen
t.95: and that (the result of) his striving shall soon be seen,
t.19: And that his effort will be seen.
t.22: That (the fruit of) his striving will soon come in sight:
t.203: And that his deeds will be seen.
t.54: اور یہ کہ بیشک اس کی کوشش عنقریب دیکھی جائے گی.

t.149: then he is repaid for it with the fullest repayment;
t.84: then he will be recompensed for it in full,
t.85: and that in the end he will be repaid in full for it;
t.95: and that he shall then be fully recompensed,
t.19: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;
t.22: Then will he be rewarded with a reward complete;
t.203: Then he will be recompensed with a full and the best recompense.
t.54: پھر اسے پورا پورا بدلہ دیا جائے گا.

t.149: and that to yourLord is the finality;
t.84: and that to your Lord is the end (of every one),
t.85: that the final goal is your Lord;
t.95: and that the final end is with your Lord,
t.19: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;
t.22: That to thy Lord is the final Goal;
t.203: And that to your Lord (Allâh) is the End (Return of everything).
t.54: اور یہ کہ آپ کے رب ہی کی طرف پہنچنا ہے.

t.149: and that it is He Who caused laughter and weeping;
t.84: and that He is the One who makes (one) laugh and makes (him) weep,
t.85: that it is He who makes people laugh and weep;
t.95: and that He it is Who causes people to laugh and to cry,
t.19: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,
t.22: That it is He Who granteth Laughter and Tears;
t.203: And that it is He (Allâh) Who makes (whom He wills) laugh, and makes (whom He wills) weep.
t.54: اور یہ کہ وہی ہنساتا ہے اور وہی رﻻتا ہے.

t.149: and that it is He Who caused death and gave life;
t.84: and that He is the One who gives death and gives life,
t.85: that it is He who gives death and life;
t.95: and that He it is Who causes death and grants life,
t.19: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;
t.22: That it is He Who granteth Death and Life;
t.203: And that it is He (Allâh) Who causes death and gives life.
t.54: اور یہ کہ وہی مارتا ہے اور جلاتا ہے.

t.149: and that He created the two spouses—the male and the female,
t.84: and that He creates the pairs, male and female,
t.85: that He Himself created the two sexes, male and female,
t.95: and He it is Who created the two kinds, the male and the female,
t.19: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,
t.22: That He did create in pairs,- male and female,
t.203: And that He (Allâh) creates the pairs, male and female,
t.54: اور یہ کہ اسی نے جوڑا یعنی نر ماده پیدا کیا ہے.

t.149: from a sperm drop when emitted;
t.84: from a sperm-drop when it is poured (into a womb),
t.85: from an ejected drop of sperm;
t.95: from a drop of sperm when it was emitted,
t.19: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;
t.22: From a seed when lodged (in its place);
t.203: From Nutfah (drops of semen - male and female discharges) when it is emitted.
t.54: نطفہ سے جبکہ وه ٹپکایا جاتا ہے.

t.149: and that upon Him is the next creation;
t.84: and that the second creation is undertaken by Him,
t.85: that He will undertake the second Creation;
t.95: and that it is for Him to grant the second life,
t.19: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;
t.22: That He hath promised a Second Creation (Raising of the Dead);
