t.203: And that upon Him (Allâh) is another bringing forth (Resurrection).
t.54: اور یہ کہ اسی کے ذمہ دوباره پیدا کرنا ہے.

t.149: and that it is He Who enriched and impoverished;
t.84: and that He is the One who gives wealth and preserves (it),
t.85: that it is He who gives wealth and possessions;
t.95: that He it is Who bestowed wealth and riches,
t.19: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;
t.22: That it is He Who giveth wealth and satisfaction;
t.203: And that it is He (Allâh) Who gives much or a little (of wealth and contentment)
t.54: اور یہ کہ وہی مالدار بناتا ہے اور سرمایہ دیتا ہے.

t.149: and that it is He Who is the Lord of Sirius;
t.84: and that He is the One who is the Lord of Sirius (the star worshipped by pagans),
t.85: that He is the Lord of Sirius;
t.95: that He is the Lord of Sirius,
t.19: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;
t.22: That He is the Lord of Sirius (the Mighty Star);
t.203: And that He (Allâh) is the Lord of Sirius (the star which the pagan Arabs used to worship).
t.54: اور یہ کہ وہی شعریٰ (ستارے) کا رب ہے.

t.149: and that He annihilated ancient ʻĀd
t.84: and that He has destroyed the earlier ‘Ād,
t.85: that it was He who destroyed, in their entirety, ancient 'Ad
t.95: that He it is Who destroyed the ancient 'Ad,
t.19: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,
t.22: And that it is He Who destroyed the (powerful) ancient 'Ad (people),
t.203: And that it is He (Allâh) Who destroyed the former ‘Âd (people),
t.54: اور یہ کہ اس نے عاد اول کو ہلاک کیا ہے.

t.149: and Thamûd, sparing no one;
t.84: and Thamūd, so spared none,
t.85: and Thamud,
t.95: and Thamud, leaving no trace of them,
t.19: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;
t.22: And the Thamud nor gave them a lease of perpetual life.
t.203: And Thamûd (people): He spared none of them.
t.54: اور ﺛمود کو بھی (جن میں سے) ایک کو بھی باقی نہ رکھا.

t.149: and the people of Noah before that; indeed, they were more unjust and more exceeding of all limits.
t.84: and (destroyed) the people of NūH even earlier. Surely they were more unjust and more rebellious.
t.85: and before them the people of Noah who were even more unjust and insolent;
t.95: and that He it is Who destroyed the people of Noah before for they were much given to iniquity and transgression.
t.19: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;
t.22: And before them, the people of Noah, for that they were (all) most unjust and most insolent transgressors,
t.203: And the people of Nûh (Noah) aforetime. Verily, they were more unjust and more rebellious and transgressing [in disobeying Allâh and His Messenger Nûh (Noah) عليه السلام].
t.54: اور اس سے پہلے قوم نوح کو، یقیناً وه بڑے ﻇالم اور سرکش تھے.

t.149: And He brought down the Ruined Cities
t.84: And He destroyed the overturned towns (of the people of LūT) also,
t.85: that it was He who brought down the ruined cities
t.95: And He brought perdition upon the subverted cities
t.19: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed
t.22: And He destroyed the Overthrown Cities (of Sodom and Gomorrah).
t.203: And He destroyed the overthrown cities [of Sodom to which Prophet Lût (Lot) was sent].
t.54: اور مؤتفکہ (شہر یا الٹی ہوئی بستیوں کو) اسی نے الٹ دیا.

t.149: and covered them by that which He covered.
t.84: so enveloped they were by that which enveloped.
t.85: and enveloped them in the punishment He ordained for them?
t.95: and caused them to be covered with that which He covered them with.
t.19: So that there covered them that which did cover.
t.22: So that (ruins unknown) have covered them up.
t.203: So there covered them that which did cover (i.e. torment with stones).
t.54: پھر اس پر چھا دیا جو چھایا.

t.149: So which of yourLord’s marvels do you enter into controversies about?
t.84: Then concerning which of your Lord’s bounties would you remain in doubt?
t.85: Which then of your Lord’s blessings do you deny?
t.95: So, which of your Lord's bounties will you doubt?”
t.19: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?
t.22: Then which of the gifts of thy Lord, (O man,) wilt thou dispute about?
t.203: Then which of the Graces of your Lord (O man!) will you doubt?
t.54: پس اے انسان تو اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کے بارے میں جھگڑے گا؟

t.149: This is a warning just like the first warnings.
t.84: This (Prophet) is a warner from the (genus of the) previous warners.
t.85: This is a warning just like the warnings sent in former times.
t.95: This is a warning among the warnings of yore.
t.19: This is a warner of the warners of old.
t.22: This is a Warner, of the (series of) Warners of old!
t.203: This (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a warner (Messenger) of the (series of) warners (Messengers) of old.
t.54: یہ (نبی) ڈرانے والے ہیں پہلے ڈرانے والوں میں سے.

t.149: The inevitable is imminent;
t.84: The Imminent (Hour of Judgment) has approached.
t.85: The imminent Hour draws near
t.95: The imminent Hour has drawn near,
t.19: The threatened Hour is nigh.
t.22: The (Judgment) ever approaching draws nigh:
t.203: The Day of Resurrection draws near.
t.54: آنے والی گھڑی قریب آ گئی ہے.

t.149: none apart from Allah can unveil it.
t.84: There is no one, beside Allah, to remove it.
t.85: and only God can disclose it.
t.95: and none but Allah can avert it.
t.19: None beside Allah can disclose it.
t.22: No (soul) but Allah can lay it bare.
t.203: None besides Allâh can avert it (or advance it or delay it).
t.54: اللہ کے سوا اس کا (وقت معین پر کھول) دکھانے واﻻ اور کوئی نہیں.

t.149: Do youmarvel at this discourse,
t.84: Do you then wonder at this discourse,
t.85: Do you [people] marvel at this?
t.95: Will you, then, wonder at this?
t.19: Marvel ye then at this statement,
t.22: Do ye then wonder at this recital?
t.203: Do you then wonder at this recitation (the Qur’ân)?
t.54: پس کیا تم اس بات سے تعجب کرتے ہو.

t.149: and laugh and do not weep,
t.84: and laugh (at it), and not weep,
t.85: Why do you laugh instead of weeping?
t.95: Will you laugh at it rather than weep?
t.19: And laugh and not weep,
t.22: And will ye laugh and not weep,-
t.203: And you laugh at it and weep not,
t.54: اور ہنس رہے ہو؟ روتے نہیں؟

t.149: lost in your frivolity?
t.84: while you are engaged in vain play?
t.85: Why do you pay no heed?
t.95: Will you occupy yourselves simply in merriment?
t.19: While ye amuse yourselves?
t.22: Wasting your time in vanities?
t.203: Wasting your (precious) lifetime in pastime and amusements (singing, etc.).
t.54: (بلکہ) تم کھیل رہے ہو.

t.149: So prostrate yourselves to Allah and worship!
t.84: Now, fall down in prostration and worship (Allah).
t.85: Bow down before God and worship.
t.95: Prostrate yourselves before Allah, and serve Him.
t.19: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.
t.22: But fall ye down in prostration to Allah, and adore (Him)!
t.203: So fall you down in prostration to Allâh and worship Him (Alone).
t.54: اب اللہ کے سامنے سجدے کرو اور (اسی) کی عبادت کرو.

t.149: The Hour has drawn near and the moon has ruptured.
t.84: The Hour (of doom) has drawn near, and the moon has split asunder.
t.85: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.
t.95: The Hour of Resurrection drew near and the moon split asunder.
t.19: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
t.22: The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.
t.203: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been cleft asunder (the people of Makkah requested Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to show them a miracle, so he showed them the splitting of the moon).
t.54: قیامت قریب آ گئی اور چاند پھٹ گیا.

t.149: Yet whenever they see a miracle, they disregard(it) and say, “Continuous magic!”
t.84: When these people see a sign, they turn away and say, “(This is) a transient magic.”
t.85: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’
t.95: (Regardless of any Signs these people see), they turn away and say: “This is an ongoing sorcery.”
t.19: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
t.22: But if they see a Sign, they turn away, and say, "This is (but) transient magic."
t.203: And if they see a sign, they turn away, and say: "This is continuous magic."
t.54: یہ اگر کوئی معجزه دیکھتے ہیں تو منھ پھیر لیتے ہیں اور کہہ دیتے ہیں کہ یہ پہلے سے چلا آتا ہوا جادو ہے.

t.149: And they disbelieved and followed their whims. And every matter is bound to settle[1666]
t.84: They have rejected (the Truth) and followed their desires, while every matter has to settle (at some time).
t.85: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––
t.95: They also gave the lie to (the splitting asunder of the moon) and only followed their desires. Yet everything is destined to reach an end.
t.19: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
t.22: They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.
t.203: They belied (the Verses of Allâh - this Qur’ân), and followed their own lusts. And every matter will be settled (according to the kind of deeds: good deeds will take their doers to Paradise, and similarly evil deeds will take their doers to Hell).
t.54: انہوں نے جھٹلایا اور اپنی خواہشوں کی پیروی کی اور ہر کام ٹھہرے ہوئے وقت پر مقرر ہے.

t.149: And most surely there have come to them tidings containing a deterrent—
t.84: And there has come to them as much news (of the earlier communities) as it is enough to deter,
t.85: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––
t.95: Surely there came to them narratives (of the ancient nations) that should suffice to deter (them from transgression),
t.19: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,
t.22: There have already come to them Recitals wherein there is (enough) to check (them),
t.203: And indeed there has come to them news (in this Qur’ân) wherein there is (enough warning) to check (them from evil),
t.54: یقیناً ان کے پاس وه خبریں آچکی ہیں جن میں ڈانٹ ڈپٹ (کی نصیحت) ہے.

t.149: profound wisdom, but warnings are of no avail.
t.84: (containing) a perfect wisdom. But the warnings are of no avail (to them).
t.85: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:
t.95: narratives that are full of consummate wisdom. But warnings do not avail them.
t.19: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.
t.22: Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.
t.203: Perfect wisdom (this Qur’ân), but (the preaching of) warners benefit them not.
t.54: اور کامل عقل کی بات ہے لیکن ان ڈراؤنی باتوں نے بھی کچھ فائده نہ دیا.

t.149: So turn awayfrom them. On the day when the Summoner summons to something terrible,
t.84: Therefore, turn aside (O Prophet,) from them. (They will see the reality) on the day in which the caller will call (them) to a gruesome object.
t.85: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,
t.95: So turn away from them, (O Prophet). On the Day when a caller shall call them to a thing most terrible,
t.19: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.
t.22: Therefore, (O Prophet,) turn away from them. The Day that the Caller will call (them) to a terrible affair,
t.203: So (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withdraw from them. The Day that the caller will call (them) to a terrible thing.
t.54: پس (اے نبی) تم ان سے اعراض کرو جس دن ایک پکارنے واﻻ ناگوار چیز کی طرف پکارے گا.

t.149: with their sight(s) (subdued) in reverence they come out of the tombs like swarming locusts,
t.84: With their eyes humbled, they will come out of the graves like locusts spread all over,
t.85: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts
t.95: with down-cast eyes they shall go forth from their graves, as though they were scattered locusts.
t.19: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,
t.22: They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,
t.203: They will come forth, with humbled eyes from (their) graves as if they were locusts spread abroad,
t.54: یہ جھکی آنکھوں قبروں سے اس طرح نکل کھڑے ہوں گے کہ گویا وه پھیلا ہوا ٹڈی دل ہے.

t.149: scrambling towards the Summoner; the deniers say, “This is a hard day.”
t.84: rushing quickly towards the caller. (On that Day) the disbelievers will say, “This is a hard day.”
t.85: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’
t.95: They shall be hurrying forth towards the caller, and the unbelievers (who had once denied this Day), will say: “This is a woeful Day.”
t.19: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
t.22: Hastening, with eyes transfixed, towards the Caller!- "Hard is this Day!", the Unbelievers will say.
t.203: Hastening towards the caller. The disbelievers will say: "This is a hard Day."
t.54: پکارنے والے کی طرف دوڑتے ہوں گے اور کافر کہیں گے یہ دن تو بہت سخت ہے.

t.149: The people of Noah disbelieved before them, so they disbelieved Our servant and said, “A madman!”, and he was rebuked.
t.84: The people of NūH denied (the truth) before them. So they rejected Our servant, and said, “(He is) a madman”, and he was (also) threatened (by them).
t.85: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,
t.95: Before them Noah's people also gave the lie (to his Message). They rejected Our servant as a liar, saying: “He is a madman”; and he was rebuffed.
t.19: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
t.22: Before them the People of Noah rejected (their messenger): they rejected Our servant, and said, "Here is one possessed!", and he was driven out.
t.203: The people of Nûh (Noah) denied (their Messenger) before them. They rejected Our slave, and said: "A madman!" and he was insolently rebuked and threatened.
t.54: ان سے پہلے قوم نوح نے بھی ہمارے بندے کو جھٹلایا تھا اور یہ دیوانہ بتلا کر جھڑک دیا گیا تھا.

t.149: So he called upon his Lord, “I am overcome, so bestow help!”
t.84: So he prayed to his Lord saying, “I am overpowered, so defend (me).”
t.85: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’
t.95: Then he called upon His Lord: “Verily I am vanquished; so come You to my aid.”
t.19: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
t.22: Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"
t.203: Then he invoked his Lord (saying): "I have been overcome, so help (me)!"
t.54: پس اس نے اپنے رب سے دعا کی کہ میں بے بس ہوں تو میری مدد کر.

t.149: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring down,
t.84: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring forth profusely,
t.85: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,
t.95: Thereupon We opened the gates of the sky for water to pour down,
t.19: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water
t.22: So We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring forth.
t.203: So We opened the gates of the heaven with water pouring forth.
t.54: پس ہم نے آسمان کے دروازوں کو زور کے مینہ سے کھول دیا.

t.149: and We made the earth burst with springs, so the waters met for a matter already determined.
t.84: and We caused the earth to gush forth as springs; so the water (of both kinds) met together for a destined event.
t.85: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.
t.95: and We made the earth burst forth with springs, and all this water converged to fulfil that which had been decreed.
t.19: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.
t.22: And We caused the earth to gush forth with springs, so the waters met (and rose) to the extent decreed.
t.203: And We caused springs to gush forth from the earth. So the waters (of the heaven and the earth) met for a matter predestined.
t.54: اور زمین سے چشموں کو جاری کر دیا پس اس کام کے لیے جو مقدر کیا گیا تھا (دونوں) پانی جمع ہو گئے.

t.149: And We carried him on a craft of planks and nails,
t.84: And We caused him (NūH) to board that (ship) which had planks and nails,
t.85: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails
t.95: And We bore Noah on the vessel built of planks and nails,
t.19: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,
t.22: But We bore him on an (Ark) made of broad planks and caulked with palm-fibre:
t.203: And We carried him on a (ship) made of planks and nails,
t.54: اور ہم نے اسے تختوں اور کیلوں والی (کشتی) پر سوار کر لیا.

t.149: sailing before Our eyes—a repayment for the one who had been denied.
t.84: which sailed under Our Eyes, as a reward for the one who was rejected (by the infidels).
t.85: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.
t.95: which sailed on under Our supervision: a reward for him who had been shown ingratitude.
t.19: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.
t.22: She floats under our eyes (and care): a recompense to one who had been rejected (with scorn)!
t.203: Floating under Our Eyes: a reward for him who had been rejected!
t.54: جو ہماری آنکھوں کے سامنے چل رہی تھی۔ بدلہ اس کی طرف سے جس کا کفر کیا گیا تھا.

t.149: And most surely We have left it as a sign, so is there anyone to remind himself?
t.84: And We left it (the ship) as a sign. So, is there one to take lesson?
t.85: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?
t.95: And We left the Ark as a Sign. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
t.19: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?
t.22: And We have left this as a Sign (for all time): then is there any that will receive admonition?
t.203: And indeed, We have left this as a sign. Then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?
t.54: اور بیشک ہم نے اس واقعہ کو نشانی بنا کر باقی رکھا پس کوئی ہے نصیحت حاصل کرنے واﻻ.

t.149: So how were My punishment and My warnings!
t.84: Then how was My torment and My warnings?
t.85: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
t.95: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
t.19: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
t.22: But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning?
t.203: Then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?
t.54: بتاؤ میرا عذاب اور میری ڈرانے والی باتیں کیسی رہیں؟

t.149: And most surely We have made the Recitaleasy for remembrance, so is there anyone to remind himself?
t.84: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?
t.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
t.95: We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
t.19: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
t.22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
t.203: And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any one who will remember (or receive admonition)?
t.54: اور بیشک ہم نے قرآن کو سمجھنے کے لیے آسان کر دیا ہے۔ پس کیا کوئی نصیحت حاصل کرنے واﻻ ہے؟

t.149: ʻĀddisbelieved, so how were My punishment and My warnings!
t.84: (The people of) ‘Ād rejected (their prophet). So how was My torment and My warnings?
t.85: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
t.95: 'Ad also gave the lie (to Hud). So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
t.19: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.
t.22: The 'Ad (people) (too) rejected (Truth): then how terrible was My Penalty and My Warning?
t.203: ‘Âd (people) belied (their Prophet, Hûd); then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?
t.54: قوم عاد نے بھی جھٹلایا پس کیسا ہوا میرا عذاب اور میری ڈرانے والی باتیں.

t.149: Indeed, We sent against them a screaming wind on a day of unrelenting misfortune,
t.84: We did send to them a furious wind in a day of continuous misfortune,
t.85: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;
t.95: We sent a tumultuous wind against them on a day of unremitting misfortune,
t.19: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,
t.22: For We sent against them a furious wind, on a Day of violent Disaster,
t.203: Verily, We sent against them a furious wind of harsh voice on a day of evil omen and continuous calamity.
t.54: ہم نے ان پر تیز وتند مسلسل چلنے والی ہوا، ایک پیہم منحوس دن میں بھیج دی.

t.149: plucking people away as though they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.
t.84: plucking people away, as if they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
t.85: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.
t.95: which tore people away and hurled them as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
t.19: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.
t.22: Plucking out men as if they were roots of palm-trees torn up (from the ground).
t.203: Plucking out men as if they were uprooted stems of date-palms.
t.54: جو لوگوں کو اٹھا اٹھا کر دے پٹختی تھی، گویا کہ وه جڑ سے کٹے ہوئے کھجور کے تنے ہیں.

t.149: So how were My punishment and My warnings!
t.84: So how was My torment and My warnings?
t.85: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
t.95: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
t.19: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
t.22: Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
t.203: Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?
t.54: پس کیسی رہی میری سزا اور میرا ڈرانا؟

t.149: And most surely We made the Recitaleasy for remembrance, so is there anyone to remind himself?
t.84: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?
t.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
t.95: We have made the Qur'an easy to derive lessons from. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
t.19: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
t.22: But We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
t.203: And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے قرآن کو نصیحت کے لیے آسان کر دیا ہے، پس کیا ہے کوئی نصیحت حاصل کرنے واﻻ؟

t.149: Thamûddisbelieved in the warnings
t.84: (The people of) Thamūd rejected the warners.
t.85: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:
t.95: Thamud gave the lie to the warnings,
t.19: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings
t.22: The Thamud (also) rejected (their) Warners.
t.203: Thamûd (people also) belied the warnings.
t.54: قوم ﺛمود نے ڈرانے والوں کو جھٹلایا.

t.149: and said, “Are we to follow a human being from among us? Indeed, we would then be astray and insane!
t.84: So they said, “Shall we follow a single human being from among us? Then we will be in error and insanity.
t.85: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!
t.95: saying: “Are we to follow a single mortal, one from among ourselves? If we do that, we shall surely be in error and folly.
t.19: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.
t.22: For they said: "What! a man! a Solitary one from among ourselves! shall we follow such a one? Truly should we then be straying in mind, and mad!
t.203: And they said: "A man, alone among us - shall we follow him? Truly then we should be in error and distress (or madness)!"
t.54: اور کہنے لگے کیا ہمیں میں سے ایک شخص کی ہم فرمانبرداری کرنے لگیں؟ تب تو ہم یقیناً غلطی اور دیوانگی میں پڑے ہوئے ہوں گے.

t.149: Has the Reminder been cast to him out of all of us? Rather, he is a wicked sheer liar.”
t.84: Is it that the advice has been cast upon him alone out of all of us? No, but he is a bragging liar.”
t.85: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’
t.95: Was there none but he to whom the Reminder could be vouchsafed excluding all others? Nay; he is an insolent liar.”
t.19: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
t.22: "Is it that the Message is sent to him, of all people amongst us? Nay, he is a liar, an insolent one!"
t.203: "Is it that the Reminder is sent to him [Prophet Sâlih عليه السلام] alone from among us? Nay, he is an insolent liar!"
t.54: کیا ہمارے سب کے درمیان صرف اسی پر وحی اتاری گئی؟ نہیں بلکہ وه جھوٹا اور شیخی خور ہے.

t.149: They will knowtomorrow who the wicked sheer liar is.
t.84: Tomorrow they will know who the bragging liar is!
t.85: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,
t.95: (We told Our Messenger): “Tomorrow they shall know who is the insolent liar.
t.19: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.
t.22: Ah! they will know on the morrow, which is the liar, the insolent one!
t.203: Tomorrow they will come to know who is the liar, the insolent one!
t.54: اب سب جان لیں گے کل کو کہ کون جھوٹا اور شیخی خور تھا؟

t.149: We are sending the she-camel as a means of trial for them, so watchthem and be patient.
t.84: We are going to send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch them (O SāliH,) and keep patience,
t.85: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.
t.95: We shall send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch their end with patience.
t.19: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;
t.22: For We will send the she-camel by way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Salih), and possess thyself in patience!
t.203: Verily, We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them [O Sâlih عليه السلام], and be patient!
t.54: بیشک ہم ان کی آزمائش کے لیے اونٹنی بھیجیں گے پس (اے صالح) توان کا منتظر ره اور صبر کر.

t.149: And informthem that the water is to be shared between them; each one should drink in turn.
t.84: and tell them that water (of the well) is to be shared between them (and the she-camel), so as the right of having water shall be attended by each (alternatively).
t.85: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’
t.95: Let them know that the water should be divided between them and the she-camel, each availing their turn.”
t.19: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.
t.22: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them: Each one's right to drink being brought forward (by suitable turns).
t.203: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them, each one’s right to drink being established (by turns).
t.54: ہاں انہیں خبر کر دے کہ پانی ان میں تقسیم شده ہے، ہرایک اپنی باری پر حاضر ہوگا.

t.149: But they called their fellow, and he dared and hamstrung(it) .
t.84: Then they called their man (to kill the she-camel,) so he undertook (the task) and killed (the she-camel).
t.85: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.
t.95: Eventually, they summoned their companion, and he undertook the (outrageous) task and hamstrung the she-camel.
t.19: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).
t.22: But they called to their companion, and he took a sword in hand, and hamstrung (her).
t.203: But they called their comrade and he took (a sword) and killed (her).
t.54: انہوں نے اپنے ساتھی کو آواز دی جس نے (اونٹنی پر) وار کیا اور (اس کی) کوچیں کاٹ دیں.

t.149: So how were My punishment and My warnings!
t.84: So how was My torment and My warnings?
t.85: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
t.95: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!
t.19: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
t.22: Ah! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
t.203: Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?
t.54: پس کیونکر ہوا میرا عذاب اور میرا ڈرانا.

t.149: Indeed, We sent against them a single Shout, and they ended up like a fence-maker’s dry sticks.
t.84: We sent upon them a single Cry, and they were like crushed leafs of a hedge-builder.
t.85: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.
t.95: Behold, We sent a single Blast against them, and they became like the trampled twigs of a sheep pen-builder.
t.19: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.
t.22: For We sent against them a single Mighty Blast, and they became like the dry stubble used by one who pens cattle.
t.203: Verily, We sent against them a single Saihah (torment - awful cry), and they became like the stubble of a fold-builder.
t.54: ہم نے ان پر ایک چیﺦ بھیجی پس ایسے ہو گئے جیسے باڑ بنانے والے کی روندی ہوئی گھاس.

t.149: And most surely We made the Recitaleasy for remembrance, so is there anyone to remind himself?
t.84: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?
t.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
t.95: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
t.19: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
t.22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
t.203: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?
t.54: اور ہم نے نصیحت کے لیے قرآن کو آسان کر دیا ہے پس کیا ہے کوئی جو نصیحت قبول کرے.

t.149: The people of Lot disbelieved in the warnings.
t.84: The people of LūT rejected the warners.
t.85: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
t.95: Lot's people also gave the lie to the warnings,
t.19: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.
t.22: The people of Lut rejected (his) warning.
t.203: The people of Lût (Lot) belied the warnings.
t.54: قوم لوط نے بھی ڈرانے والوں کی تکذیب کی.

t.149: Indeed, We sent against them a shower of stones, except for Lot’s folk–We delivered them at dawn—
t.84: We sent upon them a rain of stones, except the family of LūT whom We saved in the last hours of night,
t.85: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn
t.95: and behold, We let loose upon them a tempest which rained stones upon them, except upon Lot's household whom We rescued in the last hours of the night
t.19: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,
t.22: We sent against them a violent Tornado with showers of stones, (which destroyed them), except Lut's household: them We delivered by early Dawn,-
t.203: Verily, We sent against them a violent storm of stones (which destroyed them all), except the family of Lût (Lot), them We saved in the last hour of the night,
t.54: بیشک ہم نے ان پر پتھر برسانے والی ہوا بھیجی سوائے لوط (علیہ السلام) کے گھر والوں کے، انہیں ہم نے سحر کے وقت نجات دے دی.

t.149: a blessing from Us; thus We repay whoever gives thanks.
t.84: as a grace from Us. This is how We reward the one who offers gratitude.
t.85: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.
t.95: as a favour from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.
t.19: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.
t.22: As a Grace from Us: thus do We reward those who give thanks.
t.203: As a Favour from Us. Thus do We reward him who gives thanks (by obeying Us).
t.54: اپنے احسان سے ہر ہر شکر گزار کو ہم اسی طرح بدلہ دیتے ہیں.

t.149: And most surely hehad warned them of Our onslaught, but they entered into controversies about the warnings.
t.84: And he (LūT) had certainly warned them of Our grasp, but they disputed the warnings.
t.85: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-
t.95: Surely Lot warned his people that We shall seize them (with Our chastisement), but they doubted the warnings.
t.19: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.
t.22: And (Lut) did warn them of Our Punishment, but they disputed about the Warning.
t.203: And he [Lût (Lot)] indeed had warned them of Our Seizure (punishment), but they did doubt the warnings!
t.54: یقیناً (لوط علیہ السلام) نے انہیں ہماری پکڑ سے ڈرایا تھا لیکن انہوں نے ڈرانے والوں کے بارے میں (شک وشبہ اور) جھگڑا کیا.

t.149: And most surely they solicited of him his guests, so We obliterated their eyes— “So taste My punishment and My warnings.”
t.84: And they had even tried to tempt him against his guests (so that they may snatch them away for bad purpose,) but We blinded their eyes: “Now taste My torment and My warnings!”
t.85: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-
t.95: Then they even solicited his guests from him, whereupon We blotted out their eyes, (telling them): “Now have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.”
t.19: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!
t.22: And they even sought to snatch away his guests from him, but We blinded their eyes. (They heard:) "Now taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
t.203: And they indeed sought to shame his guest (by asking to commit sodomy with them). So We blinded their eyes, (saying) "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."
t.54: اور ان (لوط علیہ السلام) کو ان کے مہمانوں کے بارے میں پھسلایا پس ہم نے ان کی آنکھیں اندھی کردیں، (اور کہہ دیا) میرا عذاب اور میرا ڈرانا چکھو.

t.149: And most surely an abiding punishment came upon them in the morning—
t.84: And on the next morning, a lasting torment overtook them:
t.85: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-
t.95: Indeed an abiding chastisement came upon them in the morning.
t.19: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.
t.22: Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
t.203: And verily, an abiding torment seized them early in the morning.
t.54: اور یقینی بات ہے کہ انہیں صبح سویرے ہی ایک جگہ پکڑنے والے مقرره عذاب نے غارت کر دیا.

t.149: “So tasteMy punishment and My warnings.”
t.84: “Now taste My torment and My warnings.”
t.85: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’
t.95: So have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.
t.19: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!
t.22: "So taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
t.203: "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."
t.54: پس میرے عذاب اور میرے ڈراوے کا مزه چکھو.

t.149: And most surely We made the Recitaleasy for remembrance, so is there anyone to remind himself?
t.84: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?
t.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
t.95: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?
t.19: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
t.22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
t.203: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?
t.54: اور یقیناً ہم نے قرآن کو پند ووعﻆ کے لیے آسان کر دیا ہے۔ پس کیا کوئی ہے نصحیت پکڑنے واﻻ.

t.149: And most surely the warnings came to Pharaoh’s folk—
t.84: And the warners came to the family of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).
t.85: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.
t.95: Warnings also came to the Pharaonites,
t.19: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh
t.22: To the People of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, came Warners (from Allah).
t.203: And indeed, warnings came to the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) [through Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)].
t.54: اور فرعونیوں کے پاس بھی ڈرانے والے آئے.

t.149: they disbelieved all Our signs. So We seized them(with) the seizure of an Almighty, Invincible One.
t.84: (But) they rejected all Our signs; so We seized them- a seizure by One Mighty, Powerful.
t.85: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.
t.95: but they gave the lie to Our Signs, to all of them. Thereupon We seized them with the seizing of the Most Mighty, the Most Powerful.
t.19: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.
t.22: The (people) rejected all Our Signs; but We seized them with such Penalty (as comes) from One Exalted in Power, able to carry out His Will.
t.203: (They) belied all Our Signs, so We seized them with a Seizure of the All-Mighty, All-Capable (Omnipotent).
t.54: انہوں نے ہماری تمام نشانیاں جھٹلائیں پس ہم نے انہیں بڑے غالب قوی پکڑنے والے کی طرح پکڑ لیا.

t.149: “Are yourdeniers better than all those? Or do you have immunity in the Books?”
t.84: Are the disbelievers among you in a better position than all of the aforesaid (punished people), or do you have immunity (recorded) in the sacred books?
t.85: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’
t.95: Are your unbelievers (of Makkah) any better than they? Or have you been granted any immunity in the Scriptures?
t.19: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?
t.22: Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they? Or have ye an immunity in the Sacred Books?
t.203: Are your disbelievers (O Quraish!) better than these [nations of Nûh (Noah), Lût (Lot), Sâlih, and the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) who were destroyed)? Or have you an immunity (against Our Torment) in the Divine Scriptures?
t.54: (اے قریشیو!) کیا تمہارے کافر ان کافروں سے کچھ بہتر ہیں؟ یا تمہارے لیے اگلی کتابوں میں چھٹکارا لکھا ہوا ہے؟

t.149: Or do they say, “We, all together, will be victorious”?
t.84: Or do they say, “We are a large group, well-defended.”?
t.85: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?
t.95: Or do they say: “We are a strong legion, strong enough for victory?”
t.19: Or say they: We are a host victorious?
t.22: Or do they say: "We acting together can defend ourselves"?
t.203: Or say they: "We are a great multitude, victorious?"
t.54: یا یہ کہتے ہیں کہ ہم غلبہ پانے والی جماعت ہیں.

t.149: The multitude will be defeated, and they will turn their backs.
t.84: Soon this ‘large group’ shall be defeated, and all of them will turn their backs.
t.85: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.
t.95: Soon shall this legion be routed and shall turn their backs and flee.
t.19: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.
t.22: Soon will their multitude be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
t.203: Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
t.54: عنقریب یہ جماعت شکست دی جائےگی اور پیٹھ دے کر بھاگے گی.

t.149: Nay, the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
t.84: Rather the Hour (of judgment) is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour is more calamitous and much more bitter.
t.85: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:
t.95: Nay; the Hour of Doom is their appointed time, and the Hour shall be more calamitous and bitter.
t.19: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).
t.22: Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) is the time promised them (for their full recompense): And that Hour will be most grievous and most bitter.
t.203: Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.
t.54: بلکہ قیامت کی گھڑی ان کے وعدے کے وقت ہے اور قیامت بڑی سخت اور کڑوی چیز ہے.

t.149: Indeed, the criminals are in confusion and insanity.
t.84: Surely the guilty ones are in error and madness.
t.85: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––
t.95: The evil-doers are victims of error and madness.
t.19: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.
t.22: Truly those in sin are the ones straying in mind, and mad.
t.203: Verily the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals) are in error (in this world) and will burn (in the Hell-fire in the Hereafter).
t.54: بیشک گناه گار گمراہی میں اور عذاب میں ہیں.

t.149: The day when they are dragged upon their faces into the Fire: “Taste the touch of Saqar.”
t.84: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, (it will be said to them,) “Taste the touch of Hell.”
t.85: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’
t.95: There shall come a Day when they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire and will be told: “Now taste the flame of Hell.”
t.19: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.
t.22: The Day they will be dragged through the Fire on their faces, (they will hear:) "Taste ye the touch of Hell!"
t.203: The Day they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire (it will be said to them): "Taste you the touch of Hell!"
t.54: جس دن وه اپنے منھ کے بل آگ میں گھسیٹے جائیں گے (اوران سے کہا جائے گا) دوزخ کی آگ لگنے کے مزے چکھو.

t.149: Indeed, We have created everything in due measure.
t.84: Verily, We have created every thing according to (Our) predestination.
t.85: We have created all things in due measure;
t.95: We have created everything in a determined measure.
t.19: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.
t.22: Verily, all things have We created in proportion and measure.
t.203: Verily, We have created all things with Qadar (Divine Preordainments of all things before their creation as written in the Book of Decrees Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz).
t.54: بیشک ہم نے ہر چیز کو ایک (مقرره) اندازے پر پیدا کیا ہے.

t.149: And Our command is but once, like the twinkling of an eye.
t.84: And (implementation of) Our command is no more than a single act like the twinkling of an eye.
t.85: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;
t.95: Our command consists of only one Word which is carried out in the twinkling of an eye.
t.19: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.
t.22: And Our Command is but a single (Act),- like the twinkling of an eye.
t.203: And Our Commandment is but one as the twinkling of an eye.
t.54: اور ہمارا حکم صرف ایک دفعہ (کا ایک کلمہ) ہی ہوتا ہے جیسے آنکھ کا جھپکنا.

t.149: And most surely We have annihilated yourlikes, so is there anyone to remind himself?
t.84: We have destroyed people like you; so, is there one to take lesson?
t.85: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?
t.95: We did indeed destroy many like you. Is there, then, any who will heed?
t.19: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?
t.22: And (oft) in the past, have We destroyed gangs like unto you: then is there any that will receive admonition?
t.203: And indeed, We have destroyed your likes; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?
t.54: اور ہم نے تم جیسے بہتیروں کو ہلاک کر دیا ہے، پس کوئی ہے نصیحت لینے واﻻ.

t.149: And everything they have done is in the Books—
t.84: And every thing they have done is recorded in the books (of deeds).
t.85: Everything they do is noted in their records:
t.95: All their deeds are recorded in the Scrolls;
t.19: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,
t.22: All that they do is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds):
t.203: And everything they have done is noted in (their) Records (of deeds).
t.54: جوکچھ انہوں نے (اعمال) کیے ہیں سب نامہٴ اعمال میں لکھے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: for everything, small or large, is written down.
t.84: And every thing, small and big, is written down.
t.85: every action, great or small, is recorded.
t.95: everything large or small, is duly inscribed.
t.19: And every small and great thing is recorded.
t.22: Every matter, small and great, is on record.
t.203: And everything, small and big, is written down (in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz already beforehand i.e. before it befalls, or is done by its doer: الإيمان بالقدر) (See the Qur’ân V.57:22 and its footnote).
t.54: (اسی طرح) ہر چھوٹی بڑی بات بھی لکھی ہوئی ہے.

t.149: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are amidst Gardens and rivers,
t.84: Of course, the God-fearing will be in gardens and rivers,
t.85: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,
t.95: Surely those who shun disobedience will dwell amidst Gardens and running streams
t.19: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,
t.22: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,
t.203: Verily, The Muttaqûn (the pious - see V.2:2), will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers (Paradise).
t.54: یقیناً ہمارا ڈر رکھنے والے جنتوں اور نہروں میں ہوں گے.

t.149: in a seat of truth, in the presence of an Invincible King.
t.84: in a seat of Truth, near to the Omnipotent Sovereign.
t.85: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.
t.95: where they will be honourably seated in the presence of a King, Mighty in Power.
t.19: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
t.22: In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.
t.203: In a seat of truth (i.e. Paradise), near the Omnipotent King (Allâh, the One, the All-Blessed, the Most High, the Owner of Majesty and Honour).
t.54: راستی اور عزت کی بیٹھک میں قدرت والے بادشاه کے پاس.

t.149: The All-Merciful
t.84: The RaHmān (The All-Merciful Allah)
t.85: It is the Lord of Mercy
t.95: The Merciful One
t.19: The Beneficent
t.22: (Allah) Most Gracious!
t.203: The Most Gracious (Allâh)!
t.54: رحمٰن نے.

t.149: taught the Recital
t.84: has taught the Qur’ān.
t.85: who taught the Quran.
t.95: has taught the Qur'an,
t.19: Hath made known the Qur'an.
t.22: It is He Who has taught the Qur'an.
t.203: He has taught (you mankind) the Qur’ân (by His Mercy).
t.54: قرآن سکھایا.

t.149: created man,
t.84: He has created man.
t.85: He created man
t.95: has created man,
t.19: He hath created man.
t.22: He has created man:
t.203: He created man.
t.54: اسی نے انسان کو پیدا کیا.

t.149: and taught him clear expression.
t.84: He has taught him (how) to express himself.
t.85: and taught him to communicate.
t.95: and has taught him articulate speech.
t.19: He hath taught him utterance.
t.22: He has taught him speech (and intelligence).
t.203: He taught him eloquent speech.
t.54: اور اسے بولنا سکھایا.

t.149: The sun and the moon move according to plan,
t.84: The sun and the moon are (bound) by a (fixed) calculation.
t.85: The sun and the moon follow their calculated courses;
t.95: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning,
t.19: The sun and the moon are made punctual.
t.22: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed;
t.203: The sun and the moon run on their fixed courses (exactly) calculated with measured out stages for each (for reckoning).
t.54: آفتاب اور ماہتاب (مقرره) حساب سے ہیں.

t.149: and the plantsand the trees prostrate themselves.
t.84: And the vine and the tree both prostrate (to Allah).
t.85: the plants and the trees submit to His designs;
t.95: and the stars and the trees all prostrate themselves,
t.19: The stars and the trees prostrate.
t.22: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) prostrate in adoration.
t.203: And the herbs (or stars) and the trees both prostrate themselves (to Allah - See V.22:18) (Tafsir Ibn Kathir)
t.54: اور ستارے اور درخت دونوں سجده کرتے ہیں.

t.149: And the sky—He raised it and set up the balance,
t.84: He raised the sky high, and has placed the scale,
t.85: He has raised up the sky. He has set the balance
t.95: and He has raised up the heaven and has set a balance
t.19: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
t.22: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice),
t.203: And the heaven: He has raised it high, and He has set up the Balance.
t.54: اسی نے آسمان کو بلند کیا اور اسی نے ترازو رکھی.

t.149: so donot exceed in the balance,
t.84: so that you should not be wrongful in weighing.
t.85: so that you may not exceed in the balance:
t.95: that you may not transgress in the balance,
t.19: That ye exceed not the measure,
t.22: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance.
t.203: In order that you may not transgress (due) balance.
t.54: تاکہ تم تولنے میں تجاوز نہ کرو.

t.149: but maintain the weights justly and do not fall short in the balance.
t.84: Observe the correct weight with fairness, and do not make weighing deficient.
t.85: weigh with justice and do not fall short in the balance.
t.95: but weigh things equitably and skimp not in the balance.
t.19: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
t.22: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.
t.203: And observe the weight with equity and do not make the balance deficient.
t.54: انصاف کے ساتھ وزن کو ٹھیک رکھو اور تول میں کم نہ دو.

t.149: And the earth—He set it up for living creatures;
t.84: As for the earth, He has placed it for creatures,
t.85: He set down the Earth for His creatures,
t.95: And He has set up the earth for all beings.
t.19: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,
t.22: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:
t.203: And the earth: He has put down (laid) for the creatures.
t.54: اور اسی نے مخلوق کے لیے زمین بچھا دی.

t.149: in it are fruits and sheathed palm trees,
t.84: in which there are fruits and date palms having sheaths,
t.85: with its fruits, its palm trees with sheathed clusters,
t.95: Therein are fruit and palm-trees with their dates in sheaths,
t.19: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,
t.22: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates);
t.203: Therein are fruits and date-palms producing sheathed fruit-stalks (enclosing dates).
t.54: جس میں میوے ہیں اور خوشے والے کھجور کے درخت ہیں.

t.149: and grains in the blades, and fragrant plants.
t.84: and the grain having chaff, and fragrant flowers.
t.85: its husked grain, its fragrant plants.
t.95: and a variety of corn with both husk and grain.
t.19: Husked grain and scented herb.
t.22: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.
t.203: And also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-scented plants.
t.54: اور بھس واﻻ اناج ہے۔ اور خوشبودار پھول ہیں.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, (O mankind and Jinn,) which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of the bounties of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پس (اے انسانو اور جنو!) تم اپنے پروردگار کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: He created man from potter’s clay like pottery
t.84: He has created man from dry clay, ringing like pottery,
t.85: He created mankind out of dried clay, like pottery,
t.95: He has created man from dry, rotten clay like the potter's,
t.19: He created man of clay like the potter's,
t.22: He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery,
t.203: He created man (Adam) from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.
t.54: اس نےانسان کو بجنے والی مٹی سے پیدا کیا جو ٹھیکری کی طرح تھی.

t.149: and created the unseen beingfrom a smokeless flame of fire.
t.84: and created Jann (father of the Jinn) from a smokeless flame of fire.
t.85: the jinn out of smokeless fire.
t.95: and has created the jinn from the flame of fire.
t.19: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.
t.22: And He created Jinns from fire free of smoke:
t.203: And the jinn: He created from a smokeless flame of fire.
t.54: اور جنات کو آگ کے شعلے سے پیدا کیا.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, (O mankind and Jinn,) which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of the wonders of your Lord's power will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پس تم اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests.
t.84: He is the Lord of both points of sunrise and both points of sunset.
t.85: He is Lord of the two risings and Lord of the two settings.
t.95: Lord of the two easts and of the two wests is He.
t.19: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!
t.22: (He is) Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests:
t.203: (He is) the Lord of the two easts (places of sunrise during early summer and early winter) and the Lord of the two wests (places of sunset during early summer and early winter).
t.54: وه رب ہے دونوں مشرقوں اور دونوں مغربوں کا

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of the powers of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: تو (اے جنو اورانسانو!) تم اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: He merged the two waters, converging together;
t.84: He let forth the two seas to meet together,
t.85: He released the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water. They meet,
t.95: He unleashed the two seas so that they merge together,
t.19: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.
t.22: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together:
t.203: He has let loose the two seas (the salt and fresh water) meeting together.
t.54: اس نے دو دریا جاری کر دیے جو ایک دوسرے سے مل جاتے ہیں.

t.149: between them is a barrier which they do not overrun.
t.84: while there is a barrier between them; they do not encroach (upon one another).
t.85: yet there is a barrier between them they do not cross.
t.95: and yet there is a barrier between them which they may not overstep.
t.19: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).
t.22: Between them is a Barrier which they do not transgress:
t.203: Between them is a barrier which none of them can transgress.
t.54: ان دونوں میں ایک آڑ ہے کہ اس سے بڑھ نہیں سکتے.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پس اپنے پروردگار کی کون کون سی نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: From them come out pearls and corals.
t.84: From both of them come forth the pearl and the coral.
t.85: Pearls come forth from them: large ones, and small, brilliant ones.
t.95: From these seas come forth pearls and coral.
t.19: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.
t.22: Out of them come Pearls and Coral:
t.203: Out of them both come out pearl and coral.
t.54: ان دونوں میں سے موتی اور مونگے برآمد ہوتے ہیں.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of the wonders of your Lord's power will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پھر تم اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: His are the running ships, whose sails are raised in the sea like banners.
t.84: And His are the sailing ships raised up in the sea like mountains.
t.85: His are the moving ships that float, high as mountains, on the sea.
t.95: His are the ships, towering on the sea like mountains.
t.19: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.
t.22: And His are the Ships sailing smoothly through the seas, lofty as mountains:
t.203: And His are the ships going and coming in the seas, like mountains.
t.54: اور اللہ ہی کی (ملکیت میں) ہیں وه جہاز جو سمندروں میں پہاڑ کی طرح بلند (چل پھر رہے) ہیں.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پس (اے انسانو اور جنو!) تم اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: Everyone upon itis bound to perish,
t.84: Every one who is on it (the earth) has to perish.
t.85: Everyone on earth perishes;
t.95: All that is on earth will perish,
t.19: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;
t.22: All that is on earth will perish:
t.203: Whatsoever is on it (the earth) will perish.
t.54: زمین پر جو ہیں سب فنا ہونے والے ہیں.

t.149: and all that remains is yourLord’s Countenance, the Possessor of majesty and nobility.
t.84: And your Lord’s Countenance will remain, full of majesty, full of honour.
t.85: all that remains is the Face of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
t.95: only the Person of your Lord, full of majesty and splendour, will endure.
t.19: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.
t.22: But will abide (for ever) the Face of thy Lord,- full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
t.203: And the Face of your Lord full of Majesty and Honour will remain forever.
t.54: صرف تیرے رب کی ذات جو عظمت اور عزت والی ہے باقی ره جائے گی.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: So which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پھرتم اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: Everyone in the heavens and the earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
t.84: All those in the heavens and the earth beseech Him (for their needs.) Every day He is in a state of action.
t.85: Everyone in heaven and earth entreats Him; every day He is at work.
t.95: All in the heavens and the earth entreat Him for their needs; a new, mighty task engages Him each day.
t.19: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
t.22: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)!
t.203: Whosoever is in the heavens and on earth begs of Him (its needs from Him). Every day He is (engaged) in some affair (such as giving honour or disgrace to some, life or death to some, etc.)!
t.54: سب آسمان وزمین والے اسی سے مانگتے ہیں۔ ہر روز وه ایک شان میں ہے.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of your Lord's laudable attributes will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پھر تم اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: We will attendto you, O two huge communities.
t.84: Soon We are going to spare Ourselves for you (to reckon your deeds), O two heavy species (of Jinn and mankind)!
t.85: We shall attend to you two huge armies [of jinn and mankind].
t.95: O you twain, who are a burden (on the earth), We shall attend to you and call you to account.
t.19: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).
t.22: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds!
t.203: We shall attend to you, O you two classes (jinn and men)!
t.54: (جنوں اور انسانوں کے گروہو!) عنقریب ہم تمہاری طرف پوری طرح متوجہ ہو جائیں گے.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: (We shall then see), which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پھر تم اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤگے؟

t.149: O society of unseen beings and humans, if youcan penetrate the bounds of the heavens and the earth then go ahead and penetrate; you will never penetrate except with authority.
t.84: O genera of Jinn and mankind, If you are able to penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate. You cannot penetrate without power.
t.85: Jinn and mankind, if you can pass beyond the regions of heaven and earth, then do so: you will not pass without Our authority.
t.95: O company of jinn and men, if you have the power to go beyond the bounds of the heavens and the earth, go beyond them! Yet you will be unable to go beyond them for that requires infinite power.
t.19: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
t.22: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass!
t.203: O assembly of jinn and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass beyond (them)! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority (from Allâh)!
t.54: اے گروه جنات و انسان! اگر تم میں آسمانوں اور زمین کے کناروں سے باہر نکل جانے کی طاقت ہے تو نکل بھاگو! بغیر غلبہ اور طاقت کے تم نہیں نکل سکتے.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of your Lord's powers will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پھر تم اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: Flares of fire, and brass , will be sent upon you, and you will not find help.
t.84: A flame of fire and a smoke will be loosed against you, and you will not (be able) to defend.
t.85: A flash of fire and smoke will be released upon you and no one will come to your aid.
t.95: (If you so venture) a flame of fire and smoke shall be lashed at you, which you shall be unable to withstand.
t.19: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.
t.22: On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain!) a flame of fire (to burn) and a smoke (to choke): no defence will ye have:
t.203: There will be sent against you both, smokeless flames of fire and (molten) brass, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.

t.22: Whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
t.203: With whom no man or jinni has had tamth before them.
t.54: ان کو ہاتھ نہیں لگایا کسی انسان یا جن نے اس سے قبل.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پس اپنے پروردگار کی کون کون سی نعمت کے ساتھ تم تکذیب کرتے ہو؟

t.149: Reclining on green cushions and exquisite carpets.
t.84: (The people of these gardens will be) reclining on green cushions and marvelously beautiful mattresses.
t.85: They will all sit on green cushions and fine carpets.
t.95: They shall be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets.
t.19: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets.
t.22: Reclining on green Cushions and rich Carpets of beauty.
t.203: Reclining on green cushions and rich beautiful mattresses.
t.54: سبز مسندوں اور عمده فرشوں پر تکیہ لگائے ہوئے ہوں گے.

t.149: So which of your Lord’s marvels do youdisbelieve in?
t.84: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
t.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
t.95: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?
t.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
t.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?
t.54: پس (اے جنو اور انسانو!) تم اپنے رب کی کس کس نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟

t.149: Supremely Blessed be the Name of yourLord,the Possessor ofmajesty and nobility.
t.84: Glorious is the name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty, the Lord of Honour.
t.85: Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
t.95: Blessed be the name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty and Glory.
t.19: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!
t.22: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
t.203: Blessed be the Name of your Lord (Allâh), the Owner of Majesty and Honour.
t.54: تیرے پروردگار کا نام بابرکت ہے جو عزت وجلال واﻻ ہے.

t.149: When the inevitable event befalls,
t.84: When the Imminent Event (of Doom) will occur,
t.85: When that which is coming arrives,
t.95: When the Event will come to pass
t.19: When the event befalleth -
t.22: When the Event inevitable cometh to pass,
t.203: When the Event (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) befalls.
t.54: جب قیامت قائم ہو جائے گی.

t.149: no disbelief will there be about its befalling,
t.84: there will be no one to deny its occurrence.
t.85: no one will be able to deny it has come,
t.95: – and then there will be no one to deny its occurrence –
t.19: There is no denying that it will befall -
t.22: Then will no (soul) entertain falsehood concerning its coming.
t.203: And there can be no denial of its befalling.
t.54: جس کے واقع ہونے میں کوئی جھوٹ نہیں.

t.149: bringing low, raising high.
t.84: It will be abasing (some), exalting (others)
t.85: bringing low and raising high.
t.95: (a calamitous Event) that shall turn things upside down:
t.19: Abasing (some), exalting (others);
t.22: (Many) will it bring low; (many) will it exalt;
t.203: Bringing low (some - those who will enter Hell) Exalting (others - those who will enter Paradise). [Tafsir Ibn Kathir]
t.54: وه پست کرنے والی اور بلند کرنے والی ہوگی.

t.149: When the earth is shaken violently,
t.84: when the earth will be jolted with a terrible jolt,
t.85: When the earth is shaken violently
t.95: when the earth will suddenly shake with a terrible shaking,
t.19: When the earth is shaken with a shock
t.22: When the earth shall be shaken to its depths,
t.203: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.
t.54: جبکہ زمین زلزلہ کے ساتھ ہلا دی جائے گی.

t.149: and mountains are crushed and crumbled
t.84: and the mountains will be crumbled a thorough crumbling,
t.85: and the mountains are ground to powder
t.95: and the mountains will crumble
t.19: And the hills are ground to powder
t.22: And the mountains shall be crumbled to atoms,
t.203: And the mountains will be powdered to dust,
t.54: اور پہاڑ بالکل ریزه ریزه کر دیے جائیں گے.

t.149: and become scattered dust,
t.84: until they will become dust, scattered in the air,
t.85: and turn to scattered dust,
t.95: and will scatter abroad into fine dust.
t.19: So that they become a scattered dust,
t.22: Becoming dust scattered abroad,
t.203: So that they will become floating dust particles.
t.54: پھر وه مثل پراگنده غبار کے ہو جائیں گے.

t.149: and you become three classes:
t.84: and you will be (divided into) three categories.
t.85: then you will be sorted into three classes.
t.95: You shall then become three groups.
t.19: And ye will be three kinds:
t.22: And ye shall be sorted out into three classes.
t.203: And you (all) will be in three groups.
t.54: اور تم تین جماعتوں میں ہو جاؤ گے.

t.149: the fellows of the rightness; what of the fellows of the rightness!
t.84: As for the People of the Right, how (lucky) are the People of the Right!
t.85: Those on the Right––what people they are!
t.95: The People on the Right: and how fortunate will be the People on the Right!
t.19: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
t.22: Then (there will be) the Companions of the Right Hand;- What will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
t.203: So those on the Right Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Records in their right hands) - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand! (As a respect for them, because they will enter Paradise).
t.54: پس داہنے ہاتھ والے کیسے اچھے ہیں داہنے ہاتھ والے.

t.149: And the fellows of the ill-omened; what of the fellows of the ill-omened!
t.84: And the People of the Left ? How (wretched) are the People of the Left!
t.85: Those on the Left––what people they are!
t.95: And the People on the Left: and how miserable will be the People on the Left!
t.19: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?
t.22: And the Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
t.203: And those on the Left Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Record in their left hands) - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand! (As a disgrace for them, because they will enter Hell).
t.54: اور بائیں ہاتھ والے کیا حال ہے بائیں ہاتھ والوں کا.

t.149: And the pioneers, the pioneers:
t.84: And the Foremost are the foremost.
t.85: And those in front––ahead indeed!
t.95: As for the Foremost, they will be the foremost!
t.19: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:
t.22: And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).
t.203: And those foremost [(in Islâmic Faith of Monotheism and in performing righteous deeds) in the life of this world on the very first call for to embrace Islâm] will be foremost (in Paradise).
t.54: اور جو آگے والے ہیں وه تو آگے والے ہی ہیں.

t.149: those are the ones brought near(to God)
t.84: Those are the ones blessed with nearness (to Allah)
t.85: For these will be the ones brought nearest to God
t.95: They shall be near-stationed (to their Lord),
t.19: Those are they who will be brought nigh
t.22: These will be those Nearest to Allah:
t.203: These will be the nearest (to Allâh).
t.54: وه بالکل نزدیکی حاصل کیے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: in the Gardens of Bliss—
t.84: in gardens of bliss,
t.85: in Gardens of Bliss:
t.95: in the Gardens of Bliss.
t.19: In gardens of delight;
t.22: In Gardens of Bliss:
t.203: In the Gardens of Delight (Paradise).
t.54: نعمتوں والی جنتوں میں ہیں.

t.149: a throng from the ancients
t.84: many from the first generations,
t.85: many from the past
t.95: A throng of the ancients,
t.19: A multitude of those of old
t.22: A number of people from those of old,
t.203: A multitude of those (foremost) will be from the first generations (who embraced Islâm).
t.54: (بہت بڑا) گروه تو اگلے لوگوں میں سے ہوگا.

t.149: and a small band from the latecomers,
t.84: and a few from the later ones.
t.85: and a few from later generations.
t.95: and a few from later times.
t.19: And a few of those of later time.
t.22: And a few from those of later times.
t.203: And a few of those (foremost) will be from the later generations.
t.54: اور تھوڑے سے پچھلے لوگوں میں سے.

t.149: on luxurious couches,
t.84: (They will be sitting) on thrones woven with gold,
t.85: On couches of well-woven cloth
t.95: They (will be seated) on gold-encrusted couches,
t.19: On lined couches,
t.22: (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
t.203: (They will be) on thrones woven with gold and precious stones.
t.54: یہ لوگ سونے کے تاروں سے بنے ہوئے تختوں پر.

t.149: leaning on them, facing one another.
t.84: reclining on them, facing each other.
t.85: they will sit facing each other;
t.95: reclining on them, arrayed face to face;
t.19: Reclining therein face to face.
t.22: Reclining on them, facing each other.
t.203: Reclining thereon, face to face.
t.54: ایک دوسرے کےسامنے تکیہ لگائے بیٹھے ہوں گے.

t.149: Serving them will be immortal youths
t.84: Immortal boys will rotate around them
t.85: everlasting youths will go round among them
t.95: immortal youths shall go about them
t.19: There wait on them immortal youths
t.22: Round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness),
t.203: Immortal boys will go around them (serving),
t.54: ان کے پاس ایسے لڑکے جو ہمیشہ (لڑکے ہی) رہیں گے آمدورفت کریں گے.

t.149: with glasses, and pitchers, and a cup from a flowing spring,
t.84: with bowls and jugs and a goblet of pure wine,
t.85: with glasses, flagons, and cups of a pure drink
t.95: with goblets and ewers and a cup filled with a drink drawn from a running spring,
t.19: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
t.22: With goblets, (shining) beakers, and cups (filled) out of clear-flowing fountains:
t.203: With cups, and jugs, and a glass of flowing wine,
t.54: آبخورے اور جگ لے کر اور ایسا جام لے کر جو بہتی ہوئی شراب سے پر ہو.

t.149: causing them neither headache nor intoxication ,
t.84: from which they will neither suffer headache, nor will they be intoxicated,
t.85: that causes no headache or intoxication;
t.95: a drink by which their minds will not be clouded nor will it cause drunkenness;
t.19: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,
t.22: No after-ache will they receive therefrom, nor will they suffer intoxication:
t.203: Wherefrom they will get neither any aching of the head, nor any intoxication.
t.54: جس سے نہ سر میں درد ہو نہ عقل میں فتور آئے.

t.149: and fruit of their choice,
t.84: -and with fruits that they choose,
t.85: [there will be] any fruit they choose;
t.95: they will also go about them with the fruits of which they may choose,
t.19: And fruit that they prefer
t.22: And with fruits, any that they may select:
t.203: And with fruit that they may choose.
t.54: اور ایسے میوے لیے ہوئے جو ان کی پسند کے ہوں.

t.149: and meat of any bird they may desire.
t.84: and the flesh of birds that they desire.
t.85: the meat of any bird they like;
t.95: and with the flesh of any fowl that they may desire to eat;
t.19: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
t.22: And the flesh of fowls, any that they may desire.
t.203: And with the flesh of fowls that they desire.
t.54: اور پرندوں کے گوشت جو انہیں مرغوب ہوں.

t.149: And(in it are) spouses with lovely wide eyes,
t.84: And (for them there will be) houris, having lovely big eyes,
t.85: and beautiful companions
t.95: and there shall be wide-eyed maidens,
t.19: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,
t.22: And (there will be) Companions with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes,-
t.203: And (there will be) Hûr (fair females) with wide, lovely eyes (as wives for "Al-Muttaqûn" - the pious - See V. 2:2),
t.54: اور بڑی بڑی آنکھوں والی حوریں.

t.149: like well-preserved pearls,
t.84: all (neat and clean) like a hidden pearl,
t.85: like hidden pearls:
t.95: beautiful as pearls hidden in their shells.
t.19: Like unto hidden pearls,
t.22: Like unto Pearls well-guarded.
t.203: Like unto preserved pearls.
t.54: جو چھپے ہوئے موتیوں کی طرح ہیں.

t.149: as a repayment on account of what they used to do.
t.84: as a reward for what they used to do.
t.85: a reward for what they used to do.
t.95: All this shall be theirs as a reward for their deeds.
t.19: Reward for what they used to do.
t.22: A Reward for the deeds of their past (life).
t.203: A reward for what they used to do.
t.54: یہ صلہ ہے ان کے اعمال کا.

t.149: Therein they will hear no idle talk and no recrimination
t.84: They will hear neither an absurd talk in it, nor something leading to sin,
t.85: They will hear no idle or sinful talk there,
t.95: There they shall hear no idle talk nor any sinful speech.
t.19: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
t.22: Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
t.203: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech (like backbiting).
t.54: نہ وہاں بکواس سنیں گے اور نہ گناه کی بات.

t.149: except for the saying: “Peace, peace.”
t.84: but (they will hear) the words of Salām , Salām (as greetings).
t.85: only clean and wholesome speech.
t.95: All talk will be sound and upright.
t.19: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
t.22: Only the saying, "Peace! Peace".
t.203: But only the saying of: Salâm! Salâm! (greetings with peace)!
t.54: صرف سلام ہی سلام کی آواز ہوگی.

t.149: And the fellows of the right—what of the fellows of the right?
t.84: And the People of the right? How (lucky) are the People of the Right!
t.85: Those on the Right, what people they are!
t.95: As for the People on the Right, how fortunate shall be the people on the Right!
t.19: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
t.22: The Companions of the Right Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
t.203: And those on the Right Hand - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand?
t.54: اور داہنے ہاتھ والے کیا ہی اچھے ہیں داہنے ہاتھ والے.

t.149: Amid thornless lote-trees
t.84: (They will be) amid lote-trees with no thorns,
t.85: They will dwell amid thornless lote trees
t.95: They shall be in the midst of thornless lote trees,
t.19: Among thornless lote-trees
t.22: (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
t.203: (They will be) among thornless lote-trees,
t.54: وه بغیرکانٹوں کی بیریوں.

t.149: and clustered banana-trees
t.84: and the trees of TalH , (banana, or a fragrant tree) having layers one upon the other,
t.85: and clustered acacia
t.95: and flower-clad acacias,
t.19: And clustered plantains,
t.22: Among Talh trees with flowers (or fruits) piled one above another,-
t.203: And among Talh (banana-trees) with fruits piled one above another,
t.54: اور تہ بہ تہ کیلوں.

t.149: and extended shade
t.84: and a shade, spread all over,
t.85: with spreading shade,
t.95: and extended shade,
t.19: And spreading shade,
t.22: In shade long-extended,
t.203: And in shade long-extended,
t.54: اور لمبے لمبے سایوں.

t.149: and outpouring water
t.84: and water, poured forth,
t.85: constantly flowing water,
t.95: and gushing water,
t.19: And water gushing,
t.22: By water flowing constantly,
t.203: And by water flowing constantly,
t.54: اور بہتے ہوئے پانیوں.

t.149: and abundant fruit,
t.84: and a lot of fruits,
