t.85: abundant fruits,
t.95: and abundant fruit,
t.19: And fruit in plenty
t.22: And fruit in abundance.
t.203: And fruit in plenty,
t.54: اور بکثرت پھلوں میں.

t.149: neither withheld nor forbidden.
t.84: neither interrupted (in any season), nor prohibited,
t.85: unfailing, unforbidden,
t.95: never-ending and unforbidden.
t.19: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,
t.22: Whose season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden,
t.203: Whose supply is not cut off (by change of season), nor are they out of reach,
t.54: جو نہ ختم ہوں نہ روک لیے جائیں.

t.149: And high-class spouses;
t.84: and mattresses of high quality.
t.85: with incomparable companions
t.95: They shall be on upraised couches,
t.19: And raised couches;
t.22: And on Thrones (of Dignity), raised high.
t.203: And on couches or thrones, raised high.
t.54: اور اونچے اونچے فرشوں میں ہوں گے.

t.149: We have created them perfectly
t.84: Surely We have made up those females in a special creation,
t.85: We have specially created––
t.95: and their spouses We shall have brought them into being afresh,
t.19: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
t.22: We have created (their Companions) of special creation.
t.203: Verily, We have created them (maidens) of special creation.
t.54: ہم نے ان کی (بیویوں کو) خاص طور پر بنایا ہے.

t.149: and made them virgins,
t.84: and have made them virgins,
t.85: virginal,
t.95: and shall have made them virgins,
t.19: And made them virgins,
t.22: And made them virgin - pure (and undefiled), -
t.203: And made them virgins.
t.54: اور ہم نے انہیں کنواریاں بنا دیا ہے.

t.149: tender, of matching age,
t.84: amorous to their husbands, matching them in age,
t.85: loving, of matching age––
t.95: intensely loving and of matching age.
t.19: Lovers, friends,
t.22: Beloved (by nature), equal in age,-
t.203: Loving (their husbands only), (and) of equal age.
t.54: محبت والیاں اور ہم عمر ہیں.

t.149: for the fellows of the right—
t.84: for the People of the Right,
t.85: for those on the Right,
t.95: All this will be for the People on the Right;
t.19: For those on the right hand;
t.22: For the Companions of the Right Hand.
t.203: For those on the Right Hand.
t.54: دائیں ہاتھ والوں کے لیے ہیں.

t.149: a throng from the ancients
t.84: (comprising) many from the first generations,
t.85: many from the past
t.95: a large throng from the ancients,
t.19: A multitude of those of old
t.22: A (goodly) number from those of old,
t.203: A multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the first generation (who embraced Islâm).
t.54: جم غفیر ہے اگلوں میں سے.

t.149: and a throng from the latecomers.
t.84: and many from the later ones.
t.85: and many from later generations.
t.95: and also a large throng from those of later times.
t.19: And a multitude of those of later time.
t.22: And a (goodly) number from those of later times.
t.203: And a multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the later generations.
t.54: اور بہت بڑی جماعت ہے پچھلوں میں سے.

t.149: And the fellows of the left—what of the fellows of the left?
t.84: And the People of the Left? How (wretched) are the People of the Left!
t.85: But those on the Left, what people they are!
t.95: As for the People on the Left: how miserable will be the People on the Left!
t.19: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?
t.22: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
t.203: And those on the Left Hand - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand?
t.54: اور بائیں ہاتھ والے کیا ہیں بائیں ہاتھ والے

t.149: Amid searing wind and scalding water
t.84: (They will be) in scorching wind and boiling water,
t.85: They will dwell amid scorching wind and scalding water
t.95: They will be in the midst of scorching wind and boiling water,
t.19: In scorching wind and scalding water
t.22: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,
t.203: In fierce hot wind and boiling water,
t.54: گرم ہوا اور گرم پانی میں (ہوں گے).

t.149: and a shadow of thick smoke,
t.84: and in a shade of black smoke,
t.85: in the shadow of black smoke,
t.95: and a shade of thick, pitch-black smoke,
t.19: And shadow of black smoke,
t.22: And in the shades of Black Smoke:
t.203: And shadow of black smoke,
t.54: اورسیاه دھوئیں کے سائے میں.

t.149: neither cool nor refreshing.
t.84: neither cool nor graceful.
t.85: neither cool nor refreshing.
t.95: which will neither be cool nor soothing.
t.19: Neither cool nor refreshing.
t.22: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:
t.203: (That shadow) neither cool, nor (even) pleasant,
t.54: جو نہ ٹھنڈا ہے نہ فرحت بخش.

t.149: They had lived before that indulging in affluence,
t.84: They were earlier in luxuries,
t.85: Before, they overindulged in luxury
t.95: Surely they had lived before in luxury,
t.19: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
t.22: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
t.203: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,
t.54: بیشک یہ لوگ اس سے پہلے بہت نازوں میں پلے ہوئے تھے.

t.149: and they used to insist on great violation,
t.84: and used to persist in major sins,
t.85: and persisted in great sin,
t.95: and had persisted in the Great Sin.
t.19: And used to persist in the awful sin.
t.22: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!
t.203: And were persisting in great sin (joining partners in worship along with Allâh, committing murder and other crimes)
t.54: اور بڑے بڑے گناہوں پر اصرار کرتے تھے.

t.149: and they used to say, “Can it be that when we have died and become dust and bones—can it be that we will really be resurrected?
t.84: and used to say, “Is it that when we die and become dust-is it that we will be raised again,
t.85: always saying, ‘What? When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up?
t.95: They used to say: “What! Once we are dead and are reduced to dust and bones, shall we still be raised to a new life from the dead?
t.19: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
t.22: And they used to say, "What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised up again?-
t.203: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected?
t.54: اور کہتے تھے کہ کیا جب ہم مر جائیں گے اور مٹی اور ہڈی ہو جائیں گے تو کیا ہم پھر دوباره اٹھا کھڑے کیے جائیں گے.

t.149: And our ancient forefathers, too?”
t.84: and our ancient fathers as well?”
t.85: And our earliest forefathers too?’
t.95: (We) and our fore-fathers of yore?”
t.19: And also our forefathers?
t.22: "(We) and our fathers of old?"
t.203: "And also our forefathers?"
t.54: اور کیا ہمارے اگلے باپ دادا بھی؟

t.149: Say, “Indeed, the ancients and the latecomers
t.84: Say, “All the earlier and the later ones
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘The earliest and latest generations
t.95: Tell them, (O Prophet): “The earlier ones and the later ones
t.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
t.22: Say: "Yea, those of old and those of later times,
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times.
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ یقیناً سب اگلے اور پچھلے.

t.149: will be gathered for the appointment of a well-known day!
t.84: will be gathered together for a fixed time of a specified Day.
t.85: will all be gathered on a predetermined Day
t.95: shall all be brought together on an appointed Day.
t.19: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
t.22: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
t.203: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed Meeting of a known Day.
t.54: ضرور جمع کئے جائیں گے ایک مقرر دن کے وقت.

t.149: Then indeed all of you, O misguided disbelievers,
t.84: Then O you, the erring, the denying people,
t.85: and you who have gone astray and denied the truth
t.95: Then you, the erring ones and those that gave the lie to the Truth,
t.19: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,
t.22: "Then will ye truly,- O ye that go wrong, and treat (Truth) as Falsehood!-
t.203: "Then moreover, verily you the erring-ones, the deniers (of Resurrection)!
t.54: پھر تم اے گمراہو جھٹلانے والو!

t.149: will certainly be eating from the trees of Zaqqum
t.84: you will have to eat from the tree of zaqqūm,
t.85: will eat from the bitter tree of Zaqqum,
t.95: shall all eat from the Tree of al-Zaqqum,
t.19: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
t.22: "Ye will surely taste of the Tree of Zaqqum.
t.203: "You verily will eat of the trees of Zaqqûm.
t.54: البتہ کھانے والے ہو تھوہر کا درخت.

t.149: and filling your bellies with it
t.84: and to fill with it the bellies,
t.85: filling your bellies with it,
t.95: filling your bellies with it;
t.19: And will fill your bellies therewith;
t.22: "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
t.203: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,
t.54: اور اسی سے پیٹ بھرنے والے ہو.

t.149: and will be drinking on top of it scalding water,
t.84: then on top of it you will have to drink boiling water,
t.85: and drink scalding water,
t.95: and thereupon you shall drink boiling water,
t.19: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,
t.22: "And drink Boiling Water on top of it:
t.203: "And drink boiling water on top of it.
t.54: پھر اس پر گرم کھولتا پانی پینے والے ہو.

t.149: thus drinking as a thirst-mad camel drinks.”
t.84: and to drink like camels suffering from the disease of over-thirst.
t.85: lapping it like thirsty camels.’
t.95: drinking it as thirsty camels do.”
t.19: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
t.22: "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
t.203: "And you will drink (that) like thirsty camels!"
t.54: پھر پینے والے بھی پیاسے اونٹوں کی طرح.

t.149: That is their hospitality on the Day of Recompense.
t.84: This will be their welcome entertainment on the Day of Requital.
t.85: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgement.
t.95: Thus shall they be entertained on the Day of Recompense.
t.19: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
t.22: Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
t.203: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!
t.54: قیامت کے دن ان کی مہمانی یہ ہے.

t.149: We have created you; if only you would believe!
t.84: We have created you; then why do you not believe in it?
t.85: It was We who created you: will you not believe?
t.95: We have created you, then why would you not confirm it?
t.19: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
t.22: It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?
t.203: We created you: then why do you believe not?
t.54: ہم ہی نے تم سب کو پیدا کیا ہے پھر تم کیوں باور نہیں کرتے؟

t.149: Have youseen what you ejaculate?
t.84: So, tell Me about the semen you drop (in the wombs):
t.85: Consider [the semen] you eject-
t.95: Did you ever consider the sperm that you emit?
t.19: Have ye seen that which ye emit?
t.22: Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-
t.203: Then tell Me (about) the (human) semen that you emit.
t.54: اچھا پھر یہ تو بتلاؤ کہ جو منی تم ٹپکاتے ہو.

t.149: Is it youwho create it or are We the Creators?
t.84: Is it you who create it, or are We the Creator?
t.85: do you create it yourselves or are We the Creator?
t.95: Do you create a child out of it, or are We its creators?
t.19: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
t.22: Is it ye who create it, or are We the Creators?
t.203: Is it you who create it (i.e. make this semen into a perfect human being), or are We the Creator?
t.54: کیا اس کا (انسان) تم بناتے ہو یا پیدا کرنے والے ہم ہی ہیں؟

t.149: We have decreed death among you, and We will not be outstripped
t.84: We have appointed (the times of) death among you, and We cannot be frustrated
t.85: We ordained death to be among you. Nothing could stop Us
t.95: It is We Who ordained death upon you and We are not to be frustrated.
t.19: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,
t.22: We have decreed Death to be your common lot, and We are not to be frustrated
t.203: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not outstripped,
t.54: ہم ہی نے تم میں موت کو متعین کر دیا ہے اور ہم اس سے ہارے ہوئے نہیں ہیں.

t.149: in replacing you with your likes and transforming you into what you do not know.
t.84: from replacing you with others like you, and creating you (afresh) in that (form) which you do not know.
t.85: if We intended to change you and recreate you in a way unknown to you.
t.95: Had We so wished, nothing could have hindered Us from replacing you by others like yourselves, or transforming you into beings you know nothing about.
t.19: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.
t.22: from changing your Forms and creating you (again) in (forms) that ye know not.
t.203: To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not.
t.54: کہ تمہاری جگہ تم جیسے اور پیدا کر دیں اور تمہیں نئے سرے سے اس عالم میں پیدا کریں جس سے تم (بالکل) بےخبر ہو.

t.149: And youhave certainly known the first formation; if only you would remind yourselves!
t.84: And you certainly know the first creation; then why do you not take lesson?
t.85: You have learned how you were first created: will you not reflect?
t.95: You are well aware of the first creation; then, do you learn no lesson from it?
t.19: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?
t.22: And ye certainly know already the first form of creation: why then do ye not celebrate His praises?
t.203: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation (i.e. the creation of Adam): why then do you not remember (or take heed)?
t.54: تمہیں یقینی طور پر پہلی دفعہ کی پیدائش معلوم ہی ہے پھر کیوں عبرت حاصل نہیں کرتے؟

t.149: Have youseen what you cultivate?
t.84: Well, tell Me about that (seed) which you sow:
t.85: Consider the seeds you sow in the ground-
t.95: Have you considered the seeds you till?
t.19: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?
t.22: See ye the seed that ye sow in the ground?
t.203: Then tell Me about the seed that you sow in the ground.
t.54: اچھا پھر یہ بھی بتلاؤ کہ تم جو کچھ بوتے ہو.

t.149: Is it you who plant it or are We the Planters?
t.84: Is it you who grow it, or are We the One who grows?
t.85: is it you who make them grow or We?
t.95: Is it you or We Who make them grow?
t.19: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?
t.22: Is it ye that cause it to grow, or are We the Cause?
t.203: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower?
t.54: اسے تم ہی اگاتے ہو یا ہم اگانے والے ہیں.

t.149: If We will, We can turn it into rubble, then youwill lament,
t.84: If We so will, We can certainly make it crumbled, and you will remain wondering,
t.85: If We wished, We could turn your harvest into chaff and leave you to wail,
t.95: If We so wished, We could have reduced your harvest to rubble, and you would have been left wonder-struck to exclaim:
t.19: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
t.22: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry powder, and ye would be left in wonderment,
t.203: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be regretful (or left in wonderment) [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].
t.54: اگر ہم چاہیں تواسے ریزه ریزه کر ڈالیں اور تم حیرت کے ساتھ باتیں بناتے ہی ره جاؤ.

t.149: “Indeed, we arein debt;
t.84: (and saying,) “We are laden with debt,
t.85: ‘We are burdened with debt;
t.95: “We have been penalised;
t.19: Lo! we are laden with debt!
t.22: (Saying), "We are indeed left with debts (for nothing):
t.203: (Saying): "We are indeed Mughramûn (i.e. ruined or have lost the money without any profit, or are punished by the loss of all that we spend for cultivation)! (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)
t.54: کہ ہم پر تو تاوان ہی پڑ گیا.

t.149: rather, we are dispossessed!”
t.84: rather we are totally deprived.”
t.85: we are bereft.’
t.95: nay; we have been undone!”
t.19: Nay, but we are deprived!
t.22: "Indeed are we shut out (of the fruits of our labour)"
t.203: "Nay, but we are deprived!"
t.54: بلکہ ہم بالکل محروم ہی ره گئے.

t.149: Have youseen the water you drink?
t.84: Again, tell Me about the water you drink:
t.85: Consider the water you drink-
t.95: Did you cast a good look at the water that you drink?
t.19: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?
t.22: See ye the water which ye drink?
t.203: Then tell Me about the water that you drink.
t.54: اچھا یہ بتاؤ کہ جس پانی کو تم پیتے ہو.

t.149: Is it you who sent it down from the rainclouds or are We the Senders?
t.84: Is it you who have brought it down from the clouds, or are We the One who sends (it) down?
t.85: was it you who brought it down from the rain-cloud or We?
t.95: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds or is it We Who brought it down?
t.19: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?
t.22: Do ye bring it down (in rain) from the cloud or do We?
t.203: Is it you who cause it from the rain-clouds to come down, or are We the Causer of it to come down?
t.54: اسے بادلوں سے بھی تم ہی اتارتے ہو یا ہم برساتے ہیں؟

t.149: If We will, We can make it salty. Will younot be thankful?
t.84: If We so will, We can make it bitter in taste. So why do you not offer gratitude?
t.85: If We wanted, We could make it bitter: will you not be thankful?
t.95: If We had so pleased, We could have made it bitter. So why would you not give thanks?
t.19: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?
t.22: Were it Our Will, We could make it salt (and unpalatable): then why do ye not give thanks?
t.203: If We willed, We verily could make it salt (and undrinkable): why then do you not give thanks (to Allâh)?
t.54: اگر ہماری منشا ہو تو ہم اسے کڑوا زہر کردیں پھر تم ہماری شکرگزاری کیوں نہیں کرتے؟

t.149: Have you seen the fire you kindle?
t.84: Now tell Me about the fire you kindle:
t.85: Consider the fire you kindle-
t.95: Did you consider the fire which you kindle?
t.19: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;
t.22: See ye the Fire which ye kindle?
t.203: Then tell Me about the fire which you kindle.
t.54: اچھا ذرا یہ بھی بتاؤ کہ جو آگ تم سلگاتے ہو.

t.149: Is it you who produced the tree for it, or are We the Producers?
t.84: Is it you who have originated its tree, or are We the Originator?
t.85: is it you who make the wood for it grow or We?
t.95: Did you make its tree grow or was it We Who made it grow?
t.19: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?
t.22: Is it ye who grow the tree which feeds the fire, or do We grow it?
t.203: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower?
t.54: اس کے درخت کو تم نے پیدا کیا ہے یا ہم اس کے پیدا کرنے والے ہیں؟

t.149: We have made it a reminding and a comfort for the travelers.
t.84: We have made it a reminder (of Our infinite power, and of the fire of Hell) and a benefit for travelers in deserts.
t.85: We made it a reminder, and useful to those who kindle it,
t.95: We made it a reminder and a provision for the needy.
t.19: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
t.22: We have made it a memorial (of Our handiwork), and an article of comfort and convenience for the denizens of deserts.
t.203: We have made it a Reminder (of the Hell-fire in the Hereafter), and an article of use for the travellers (and all the others, in this world).
t.54: ہم نے اسے سبب نصیحت اور مسافروں کے فائدے کی چیز بنایا ہے.

t.149: So highly exalt the Name of yourLord, the Great.
t.84: So, proclaim purity of the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.
t.85: so [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Supreme.
t.95: Glorify, then, (O Prophet), the name of your Great Lord.
t.19: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
t.22: Then celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme!
t.203: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
t.54: پس اپنے بہت بڑے رب کے نام کی تسبیح کیا کرو.

t.149: I swear by the locations of the stars—
t.84: So, I swear by the setting places of the stars,
t.85: I swear by the positions of the stars-
t.95: No! I swear by the positions of the stars –
t.19: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -
t.22: Furthermore I call to witness the setting of the Stars,-
t.203: So I swear by the setting of the stars.
t.54: پس میں قسم کھاتا ہوں ستاروں کے گرنے کی.

t.149: and it is certainly a great oath if only youwere to know.
t.84: -and indeed it is a great oath, if you are to appreciate-
t.85: a mighty oath, if you only knew-
t.95: and this is indeed a mighty oath, if only you knew –
t.19: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -
t.22: And that is indeed a mighty adjuration if ye but knew,-
t.203: And verily that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.
t.54: اور اگرتمہیں علم ہو تو یہ بہت بڑی قسم ہے.

t.149: It is indeed a Noble Recital
t.84: it is surely the Noble Qur’ān,
t.85: that this is truly a noble Quran,
t.95: that this indeed is a noble Qur'an,
t.19: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an
t.22: That this is indeed a qur'an Most Honourable,
t.203: That (this) is indeed an honourable recitation (the Noble Qur’ân).
t.54: کہ بیشک یہ قرآن بہت بڑی عزت واﻻ ہے.

t.149: in a well-protected Scripture.
t.84: (recorded already) in a protected book (i.e. the Preserved Tablet)
t.85: in a protected Record
t.95: inscribed in a well-guarded Book,
t.19: In a Book kept hidden
t.22: In Book well-guarded,
t.203: In a Book well-guarded (with Allâh in the heaven i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz ).
t.54: جو ایک محفوظ کتاب میں درج ہے

t.149: None touches it except the cleansed,
t.84: that is not touched except by the purified ones (the angels).
t.85: that only the purified can touch,
t.95: which none but the pure may touch;
t.19: Which none toucheth save the purified,
t.22: Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
t.203: Which (that Book with Allâh) none can touch but the purified (i.e. the angels).
t.54: جسے صرف پاک لوگ ہی چھو سکتے ہیں.

t.149: a bestowal from on high by the Lord of all realms.
t.84: - a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
t.85: sent down from the Lord of all being.
t.95: a revelation from the Lord of the Universe.
t.19: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
t.22: A Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
t.203: A Revelation (this Qur’ân) from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: یہ رب العالمین کی طرف سےاترا ہوا ہے.

t.149: Is it this discourse that youtake so lightly?
t.84: Is it this discourse that you take lightly,
t.85: How can you scorn this statement?
t.95: Do you, then, take this discourse in light esteem,
t.19: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,
t.22: Is it such a Message that ye would hold in light esteem?
t.203: Is it such a talk (this Qur’ân) that you (disbelievers) deny?
t.54: پس کیا تم ایسی بات کو سرسری (اور معمولی) سمجھ رہے ہو؟

t.149: And you render due thanks for being provided with it by disbelieving in it?
t.84: and take your denial as your livelihood?
t.85: And how, in return for the livelihood you are given, can you deny it?
t.95: and your portion in it is simply that you denounce it as false?
t.19: And make denial thereof your livelihood?
t.22: And have ye made it your livelihood that ye should declare it false?
t.203: And instead (of thanking Allâh) for the provision He gives you, you deny (Him by disbelief)!
t.54: اور اپنے حصے میں یہی لیتے ہو کہ جھٹلاتے پھرو.

t.149: So when ithas reached the throat,
t.84: So why (do you) not (intervene) when the soul (of a dying person) reaches the throat,
t.85: When the soul of a dying man comes up to his throat
t.95: Why, then, when the soul leaps up to the throat,
t.19: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
t.22: Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
t.203: Then why do you not (intervene) when (the soul of a dying person) reaches the throat?
t.54: پس جبکہ روح نرخرے تک پہنچ جائے.

t.149: and you are at that moment looking on,
t.84: and you are watching?
t.85: while you gaze on-
t.95: the while you are helplessly watching that he is on the verge of death,
t.19: And ye are at that moment looking
t.22: And ye the while (sit) looking on,-
t.203: And you at the moment are looking on,
t.54: اور تم اس وقت آنکھوں سے دیکھتے رہو.

t.149: and We are nearer to him than you are, but you do not see—
t.84: And We are closer to him than you, but you do not perceive.
t.85: We are nearer to him than you, though you do not see Us-
t.95: – at that moment when We are closer to him than you, although you do not see (Us)
t.19: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
t.22: But We are nearer to him than ye, and yet see not,-
t.203: But We (i.e. Our angels who take the soul) are nearer to him than you, but you see not, (Tafsir At-Tabarî)
t.54: ہم اس شخص سے بہ نسبت تمہارے بہت زیاده قریب ہوتے ہیں لیکن تم نہیں دیکھ سکتے.

t.149: why, if you are not to be held to account,
t.84: So, if you are not going to be recompensed (in the Hereafter for your deeds), then why do you not
t.85: why, if you are not to be judged,
t.95: if you are not subject to anyone's authority,
t.19: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),
t.22: Then why do ye not,- If you are exempt from (future) account,-
t.203: Then why do you not - if you are exempt from the reckoning and recompense (punishment) -
t.54: پس اگر تم کسی کے زیرفرمان نہیں.

t.149: do you not bring itback if you are truthful?
t.84: bring the soul back, if you are truthful?
t.85: do you not restore his soul to him, if what you say is true?
t.95: why are you then not able to bring them back to life if you are truthful?
t.19: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?
t.22: Call back the soul, if ye are true (in the claim of independence)?
t.203: Bring back the soul (to its body), if you are truthful?
t.54: اور اس قول میں سچے ہو تو (ذرا) اس روح کو تو لوٹاؤ.

t.149: Yet, if he is one of those brought near(to God) ,
t.84: So, in case he (the dying person) is from among those blessed with nearness,
t.85: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to God,
t.95: So if he is one of those who are near-stationed (to Allah),
t.19: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,
t.22: Thus, then, if he be of those Nearest to Allah,
t.203: Then, if he (the dying person) be of the Muqarrabûn (those brought near to Allâh),
t.54: پس جو کوئی بارگاه الٰہی سے قریب کیا ہوا ہوگا.

t.149: then serenity andfragrant plants and a Garden of Bliss.
t.84: then (for him) there is comfort and fragrance and garden of bliss.
t.85: he will have rest, ease, and a Garden of Bliss;
t.95: then happiness and delight and Gardens of Bliss are his.
t.19: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
t.22: (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
t.203: (There is for him) rest and provision, and a Garden of Delights (Paradise).
t.54: اسے تو راحت ہے اور غذائیں ہیں اور آرام والی جنت ہے.

t.149: And if he is one of the fellows of the right,
t.84: And in case he is from among the People of the Right,
t.85: if he is one of those on the Right,
t.95: And if he is one of the People on the Right,
t.19: And if he is of those on the right hand,
t.22: And if he be of the Companions of the Right Hand,
t.203: And if he (the dying person) be of those on the Right Hand,
t.54: اور جو شحص داہنے (ہاتھ) والوں میں سے ہے.

t.149: then, “Peace for you,” from the fellows of the right.
t.84: then, (it will be said to him,) “Peace is for you, as you are one of the People of the Right.”
t.85: [he will hear], ‘Peace be on you,’ from his companions on the Right;
t.95: he will be welcomed by the words: “Peace to you” from the People on the Right.
t.19: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
t.22: (For him is the salutation), "Peace be unto thee", from the Companions of the Right Hand.
t.203: Then there is safety and peace (from the Punishment of Allâh) for those on the right Hand.
t.54: تو بھی سلامتی ہے تیرے لیے کہ تو داہنے والوں میں سے ہے.

t.149: But if he is one of the misguided disbelievers,
t.84: But if he is one of the deniers, the astray,
t.85: but if he is one of those who denied the truth and went astray,
t.95: And if he is one of those who give the lie (to this Message) and go astray,
t.19: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,
t.22: And if he be of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, who go wrong,
t.203: But if he (the dying person) be of the denying (of the Resurrection), the erring (away from the Right Path of Islâmic Monotheism),
t.54: لیکن اگر کوئی جھٹلانے والوں گمراہوں میں سے ہے.

t.149: then the welcome will be scalding water
t.84: then (for him) there is entertainment from boiling water,
t.85: he will be welcomed with scalding water.
t.95: then he will be served boiling water,
t.19: Then the welcome will be boiling water
t.22: For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.
t.203: Then for him is an entertainment with boiling water.
t.54: تو کھولتے ہوئے گرم پانی کی مہمانی ہے.

t.149: and roasting in purgatory.
t.84: and burning in the Hell.
t.85: He will burn in Hell.
t.95: and will be scorched by the Fire.
t.19: And roasting at hell-fire.
t.22: And burning in Hell-Fire.
t.203: And burning in Hell-fire.
t.54: اور دوزخ میں جانا ہے.

t.149: Indeed, this is surely the truth of certitude.
t.84: Indeed this is certainty in its true sense.
t.85: This is the certain truth:
t.95: That indeed is the absolute truth.
t.19: Lo! this is certain truth.
t.22: Verily, this is the Very Truth and Certainly.
t.203: Verily, this! This is an absolute Truth with certainty.
t.54: یہ خبر سراسر حق اور قطعاً یقینی ہے.

t.149: So highly exalt the Name of yourLord, the Great.
t.84: So, proclaim purity of the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.
t.85: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Supreme.
t.95: So glorify the name of your Great Lord.
t.19: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
t.22: So celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme.
t.203: So glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
t.54: پس تواپنے عظیم الشان پروردگار کی تسبیح کر.

t.149: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth has been highly exalting Allah, and He is the Almighty, the All-Wise.
t.84: All that is in the heavens and the earth proclaims Allah’s purity, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
t.85: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God––He is the Almighty, the Wise.
t.95: All that is in the heavens and the earth extols the glory of Allah. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.
t.19: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
t.22: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth,- let it declare the Praises and Glory of Allah: for He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
t.203: Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allâh - and He is the All-Mighty, All-Wise.
t.54: آسمانوں اور زمین میں جو ہے (سب) اللہ کی تسبیح کر رہے ہیں، وه زبردست باحکمت ہے.

t.149: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and causes death, for He is All-Powerful over everything.
t.84: To Him belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and brings death, and He is Powerful to do any thing.
t.85: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him; He gives life and death; He has power over all things.
t.95: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over everything.
t.19: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.
t.22: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: It is He Who gives Life and Death; and He has Power over all things.
t.203: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. It is He Who gives life and causes death: and He is Able to do all things.
t.54: آسمانوں اور زمین کی بادشاہت اسی کی ہے، وہی زندگی دیتا ہے اور موت بھی اور وه ہر چیز پر قادر ہے.

t.149: He is the First and the Last and the Manifest and the Innermost, and He is All-Knowing of everything.
t.84: He is the First and the Last, and the Manifest and the Hidden, and He is All-Knowing about every thing.
t.85: He is the First and the Last; the Outer and the Inner; He has knowledge of all things.
t.95: He is the First and the Last, and the Manifest and the Hidden, and He has knowledge of everything.
t.19: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.
t.22: He is the First and the Last, the Evident and the Immanent: and He has full knowledge of all things.
t.203: He is the First (nothing is before Him) and the Last (nothing is after Him), the Most High (nothing is above Him) and the Most Near (nothing is nearer than Him). And He is the All-Knower of every thing.
t.54: وہی پہلے ہے اور وہی پیچھے، وہی ﻇاہر ہے اور وہی مخفی، اور وه ہر چیز کو بخوبی جاننے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: It is He Who created the heavens and the earth in six daysthen settled over the Throne. He knows what penetrates the earth and what comes out of it, and what descends from the sky and what ascends to it, for He is with youwherever you may be. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.
t.84: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then He positioned Himself on the Throne. He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatever comes out from it, and whatever descends from the sky, and whatever ascends thereto. He is with you wherever you are, and Allah is watchful of whatever you do.
t.85: It was He who created the heavens and earth in six Days and then established Himself on the throne. He knows what enters the earth and what comes out of it; what descends from the sky and what ascends to it. He is with you wherever you are; He sees all that you do;
t.95: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself on the Throne. He knows all that enters the earth and all that comes forth from it, and all that comes down from the heaven and all that goes up to it. He is with you wherever you are. Allah sees all that you do.
t.19: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
t.22: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in Six Days, and is moreover firmly established on the Throne (of Authority). He knows what enters within the earth and what comes forth out of it, what comes down from heaven and what mounts up to it. And He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah sees well all that ye do.
t.203: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days and then rose over (Istawâ) the Throne (in a manner that suits His Majesty). He knows what goes into the earth and what comes forth from it, and what descends from the heaven and what ascends thereto. And He is with you (by His Knowledge) wheresoever you may be. And Allâh is the All-Seer of what you do.
t.54: وہی ہے جس نے آسمانوں اور زمین کو چھ دن میں پیدا کیا پھر عرش پر مستوی ہو گیا۔ وه (خوب) جانتا ہےاس چیز کو جو زمین میں جائے اور جو اس سے نکلے اور جو آسمان سے نیچے آئے اور جو کچھ چڑھ کر اس میں جائے، اور جہاں کہیں تم ہو وه تمہارے ساتھ ہے اور جو تم کر رہے ہو اللہ دیکھ رہا ہے.

t.149: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah all matters are returned .
t.84: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah all matters are returned.
t.85: control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him. Everything is brought back to God.
t.95: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Him are all matters referred (for judgement).
t.19: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back.
t.22: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: and all affairs are referred back to Allah.
t.203: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And to Allâh return all the matters (for decision).
t.54: آسمانوں کی اور زمین کی بادشاہی اسی کی ہے۔ اور تمام کام اسی کی طرف لوٹائے جاتے ہیں.

t.149: He causes the night to penetrate the day and He causes the day to penetrate the night, and He is All-Knowing of what lies within the chests.
t.84: He makes the night enter into the day, and makes the day enter into the night, and He is All-Knowing about whatever lies in the hearts.
t.85: He makes night merge into day and day into night. He knows what is in every heart.
t.95: He causes the night to pass into the day, and causes the day to pass into the night, and He fully knows all that is hidden in the breasts of people.
t.19: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts.
t.22: He merges Night into Day, and He merges Day into Night; and He has full knowledge of the secrets of (all) hearts.
t.203: He merges night into day (i.e. the decrease in the hours of the night is added into the hours of the day), and merges day into night (i.e. the decrease in the hours of the day is added into the hours of the night), and He has full knowledge of whatsoever is in the breasts.
t.54: وہی رات کو دن میں لے جاتا ہے اور وہی دن کو رات میں داخل کر دیتا ہے اور سینوں کے بھیدوں کا وه پورا عالم ہے.

t.149: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend of that over which He has made you trustees, for those of you who have attained faith and spent—for them is a supreme reward.
t.84: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and spend out of that (wealth) in which He has appointed you as deputies. So, for those of you who have believed and spent (in Allah’s way), there is a big reward.
t.85: Believe in God and His Messenger, and give out of what He has made pass down to you: those of you who believe and give will have a great reward.
t.95: Believe in Allah and in His Messenger and expend of what He has entrusted to you. A great reward awaits those of you who believe and spend their wealth.
t.19: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward.
t.22: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend (in charity) out of the (substance) whereof He has made you heirs. For, those of you who believe and spend (in charity),- for them is a great Reward.
t.203: Believe in Allâh and His Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), and spend of that whereof He has made you trustees. And such of you as believe and spend (in Allâh’s Way), theirs will be a great reward.
t.54: اللہ پر اور اس کے رسول پر ایمان لے آؤ اور اس مال میں سے خرچ کرو جس میں اللہ نے تمہیں (دوسروں کا) جانشین بنایا ہے پس تم میں سے جو ایمان ﻻئیں اور خیرات کریں انہیں بہت بڑا ﺛواب ملے گا.

t.149: And what is the matter with youthat you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger calls you to believe in your Lord—when He has taken your pledge — if you are believers?
t.84: What is wrong with you that you do not believe in Allah, while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord, and He has taken your covenant, if you are to believe?
t.85: Why should you not believe in God when the Mes-senger calls you to believe in your Lord, and He has already made a pledge with you, if you have faith?
t.95: How is it that you do not believe in Allah when the Messenger calls you to believe in your Lord and although he has taken a covenant from you, if indeed you are believers?
t.19: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers?
t.22: What cause have ye why ye should not believe in Allah?- and the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord, and has indeed taken your Covenant, if ye are men of Faith.
t.203: And what is the matter with you that you believe not in Allâh! While the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) invites you to believe in your Lord (Allâh); and He (Allâh) has indeed taken your covenant, if you are real believers.
t.54: تم اللہ پر ایمان کیوں نہیں ﻻتے؟ حاﻻنکہ خود رسول تمہیں اپنے رب پر ایمان ﻻنےکی دعوت دے رہا ہے اور اگر تم مومن ہو تو وه تو تم سے مضبوط عہد وپیمان بھی لے چکا ہے.

t.149: It is He who bestows upon His servant evident signs from on highto bring youout of darkness(es) into light. And towards you Allah is truly Compassionate, Bestowing of mercy.
t.84: He is the One who reveals clear verses to His servant, so that He brings you out from layers of darkness into the light. And to you, Allah is Very-Kind indeed, Very-Merciful.
t.85: It is He who has sent down clear revelations to His Servant, so that He may bring you from the depths of darkness into light; God is truly kind and merciful to you.
t.95: He it is Who sends down Clear Signs to His servant so as to bring you out from darkness into light. Surely Allah is Most Kind and Most Compassionate to you.
t.19: He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful.
t.22: He is the One Who sends to His Servant Manifest Signs, that He may lead you from the depths of Darkness into the Light and verily Allah is to you most kind and Merciful.
t.203: It is He Who sends down manifest Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) to His slave (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that He may bring you out from darkness into light. And verily, Allâh is to you full of kindness, Most Merciful.
t.54: وه (اللہ) ہی ہے جو اپنے بندے پر واضح آیتیں اتارتا ہے تاکہ وه تمہیں اندھیروں سے نور کی طرف لے جائے یقیناً اللہ تعالیٰ تم پر نرمی کرنے واﻻ رحم کرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: And why is it that youdo not spend in the way of Allah when to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest and combated; those are higher in degrees(of rank) than those who spent afterwards and combated, yet to each Allah has promisedthe best(reward) , and Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
t.84: And what is wrong with you that you should not spend in the way of Allah, while to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent before the Conquest (of Makkah) and fought are not at par (with others). Those are much greater in rank than those who spent later and fought, though Allah has promised the good (reward) for each. Allah is well aware of what you do.
t.85: Why should you not give for God’s cause when God alone will inherit what is in the heavens and earth? Those who gave and fought before the triumph are not like others: they are greater in rank than those who gave and fought afterwards. But God has promised a good reward to all of them: God is fully aware of all that you do.
t.95: How is it that you do not expend in the Way of Allah when to Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting before the Victory cannot be equated (with those who spent their wealth and took part in fighting afterwards). They are higher in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. But to each Allah has promised a good reward. Allah is well aware of all that you do.
t.19: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.
t.22: And what cause have ye why ye should not spend in the cause of Allah?- For to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. Not equal among you are those who spent (freely) and fought, before the Victory, (with those who did so later). Those are higher in rank than those who spent (freely) and fought afterwards. But to all has Allah promised a goodly (reward). And Allah is well acquainted with all that ye do.
t.203: And what is the matter with you that you spend not in the Cause of Allâh? And to Allâh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. Not equal among you are those who spent and fought before the conquering (of Makkah, with those among you who did so later). Such are higher in degree than those who spent and fought afterwards. But to all Allâh has promised the best (reward). And Allâh is All-Aware of what you do.
t.54: تمہیں کیا ہو گیا ہے جو تم اللہ کی راه میں خرچ نہیں کرتے؟ دراصل آسمانوں اور زمینوں کی میراث کا مالک (تنہا) اللہ ہی ہے تم میں سے جن لوگوں نے فتح سے پہلے فی سبیل اللہ دیا ہے اور قتال کیا ہے وه (دوسروں کے) برابر نہیں، بلکہ ان سے بہت بڑے درجے کے ہیں جنہوں نے فتح کے بعد خیراتیں دیں اور جہاد کیے۔ ہاں بھلائی کا وعده تو اللہ تعالیٰ کاان سب سے ہے جو کچھ تم کر رہے ہو اس سے اللہ خبردار ہے.

t.149: Who is it that will lend Allah a good loan, that He may multiply it for him, and for him is a noble reward?
t.84: Who is there to advance a loan, a good loan, to Allah so that He multiplies it for him, and he may have a noble reward?
t.85: Who will make God a good loan? He will double it for him and reward him generously.
t.95: Who is it that will give Allah a beautiful loan? A loan that Allah will repay after increasing it many times and grant him a generous reward.
t.19: Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward?
t.22: Who is he that will Loan to Allah a beautiful loan? for (Allah) will increase it manifold to his credit, and he will have (besides) a liberal Reward.
t.203: Who is he that will lend Allâh a goodly loan: then (Allâh) will increase it manifold to his credit (in repaying), and he will have (besides) a good reward (i.e. Paradise).
t.54: کون ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کو اچھی طرح قرض دے پھر اللہ تعالیٰ اسے اس کے لیے بڑھاتا چلا جائے اور اس کے لیے پسندیده اجر ﺛابت ہو جائے.

t.149: On the day when yousee the believing men and believing women with their light radiating ahead of them and to their right: “Glad tidings for you today: Gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein; it is that which is the great triumph.”
t.84: On the Day when you will see the believing men and the believing women, their light proceeding in front of them and to their right hands, (it will be said to them,) “Good news for you today! Gardens beneath which rivers flow, to live therein forever! That is the great achievement,
t.85: On the Day when you [Prophet] see the believers, both men and women, with their light streaming out ahead of them and to their right, [they will be told], ‘The good news for you today is that there are Gardens graced with flowing streams where you will stay: that is truly the supreme triumph!’
t.95: On that Day you will see believing men and women that their light will be running before them and on their right hands. (They will be told): “A good tiding to you today.” There shall be Gardens beneath which rivers flow; therein they shall abide. That indeed is the great triumph.
t.19: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph.
t.22: One Day shalt thou see the believing men and the believing women- how their Light runs forward before them and by their right hands: (their greeting will be): "Good News for you this Day! Gardens beneath which flow rivers! to dwell therein for aye! This is indeed the highest Achievement!"
t.203: On the Day you shall see the believing men and the believing women: their light running forward before them and by their right hands. Glad tidings for you this Day! Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise), to dwell therein forever! Truly, this is the great success!
t.54: (قیامت کے دن تو دیکھے گا کہ مومن مردوں اور عورتوں کا نور ان کے آگے آگے اور ان کے دائیں دوڑ رہا ہوگا آج تمہیں ان جنتوں کی خوش خبری ہے جن کے نیچے نہریں جاری ہیں جن میں ہمیشہ کی رہائش ہے۔ یہ ہے بڑی کامیابی.

t.149: On the day when the hypocritical men and hypocritical women say to those who believed, “Wait for us so that we may borrow from your light.” They were told: “Go back behind you and seek light.” Then a wall with a door was raised between them: within it is mercy and outside of it is punishment.
t.84: - the Day when the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believe, “Wait for us, so that we may have a share from your light.”It will be said (to them), “Go back to your rear, and search for light.” Then a wall will be placed between them, which will have a gate. In its inner side, there will be the divine mercy, while towards its outer side, there will be the divine punishment.
t.85: On the same Day, the hypocrites, both men and women, will say to the believers, ‘Wait for us! Let us have some of your light!’ They will be told, ‘Go back and look for a light.’ A wall with a door will be erected between them: inside it lies mercy, outside lies torment.
t.95: On that Day the hypocrites, both men and women, shall say to the believers: “Look at us that we may extract some light from your light.” They will be told: “Go back and seek light for yourselves elsewhere.” Then a wall shall be erected between them with a door in it. On the inside of it there will be mercy, and on the outside of it there will be chastisement.
t.19: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.
t.22: One Day will the Hypocrites- men and women - say to the Believers: "Wait for us! Let us borrow (a Light) from your Light!" It will be said: "Turn ye back to your rear! then seek a Light (where ye can)!" So a wall will be put up betwixt them, with a gate therein. Within it will be Mercy throughout, and without it, all alongside, will be (Wrath and) Punishment!
t.203: On the Day when the hypocrites - men and women - will say to the believers: "Wait for us! Let us get something from your light!" It will be said: "Go back to your rear! Then seek a light!" So a wall will be put up between them, with a gate therein. Inside it will be mercy, and outside it will be torment."
t.54: اس دن منافق مرد وعورت ایمان والوں سے کہیں گے کہ ہمارا انتظار تو کرو کہ ہم بھی تمہارے نور سے کچھ روشنی حاصل کر لیں۔ جواب دیا جائے گا کہ تم اپنے پیچھے لوٹ جاؤ اور روشنی تلاش کرو۔ پھر ان کے اور ان کے درمیان ایک دیوار حائل کر دی جائے گی جس میں دروازه بھی ہوگا۔ اس کے اندرونی حصہ میں تو رحمت ہوگی اور باہر کی طرف عذاب ہوگا.

t.149: Theycall to them, “Were we not with you?” They said, “Yes, but you tempted yourselves and waited and doubted and became deceived by fancies until the command of Allah arrived, and the deceiverdeceived you regarding Allah.
t.84: They (the hypocrites) will call out to them (the believers), “Were we not with you?” They will say, “Yes, (you were,) but you led your souls to a wrong way, and kept waiting (for an evil end to the Muslims), and remained in doubt, and were deluded by fancies, until Allah’s command came to pass, and you were deceived about Allah by the Big Deceiver (Iblīs).
t.85: The hypocrites will call out to the believers, ‘Were we not with you?’ They will reply, ‘Yes. But you allowed yourselves to be tempted, you were hesitant, doubtful, deceived by false hopes until God’s command came- the Deceiver tricked you about God.
t.95: The hypocrites will call out to the believers: “Were we not with you?” The believers will reply: “Yes; but you allowed yourselves to succumb to temptations, and you wavered and you remained in doubt and false expectations deluded you until Allah's command came to pass, and the Deluder deluded you concerning Allah.
t.19: They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah;
t.22: (Those without) will call out, "Were we not with you?" (The others) will reply, "True! but ye led yourselves into temptation; ye looked forward (to our ruin); ye doubted (Allah's Promise); and (your false) desires deceived you; until there issued the Command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you in respect of Allah.
t.203: (The hypocrites) will call the believers: "Were we not with you?" The believers will reply: "Yes! But you led yourselves into temptations, you looked forward for our destruction; you doubted (in Faith) and you were deceived by false desires, till the Command of Allâh came to pass. And the chief deceiver (Satan) deceived you in respect of Allâh."
t.54: یہ چلا چلا کر ان سے کہیں گے کہ کیا ہم تمھارے ساتھ نہ تھے وه کہیں گے کہ ہاں تھے تو سہی لیکن تم نے اپنے آپ کو فتنہ میں پھنسا رکھا تھا اور انتظار میں ہی رہے اور شک و شبہ کرتے رہے اور تمہیں تمہاری فضول تمناؤں نے دھوکے میں ہی رکھا یہاں تک کہ اللہ کا حکم آ پہنچا اور تمہیں اللہ کے بارے میں دھوکہ دینے والے نے دھوکے میں ہی رکھا.

t.149: So today no ransom is accepted from younor from those who have denied. The Fire is your shelter; it is your patron—and what a miserable destiny!”
t.84: So, no ransom will be accepted from you today, nor from those who disbelieved (openly). Your abode is the Fire, and it is an evil end.”
t.85: Today no ransom will be accepted from you or from the disbelievers: your home is the Fire- that is where you belong––a miserable destination!’
t.95: So no ransom shall be accepted from you today, nor from those who disbelieved. You are destined for the Fire. That will be your guardian. And that indeed is a grievous destination.
t.19: So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end.
t.22: "This Day shall no ransom be accepted of you, nor of those who rejected Allah." Your abode is the Fire: that is the proper place to claim you: and an evil refuge it is!"
t.203: So this Day no ransom shall be taken from you (hypocrites), nor of those who disbelieved, (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism). Your abode is the Fire. That is your maulâ (friend - proper place), and worst indeed is that destination.
t.54: الغرض، آج تم سے نہ فدیہ (اور نہ بدلہ) قبول کیا جائے گا اور نہ کافروں سے تم (سب) کا ٹھکانا دوزخ ہے۔ وہی تمہاری رفیق ہے اور وه برا ٹھکانا ہے.

t.149: Is it not time for those who have attained faith: that their hearts should become reverent towards Allah’s Reminder and to that which came down of the truth, and not be like those who were given the Scripture previously, but for whom time became prolonged so that their hearts hardened, and many of them are defiantly disobedient?
t.84: Has the time not yet come for those who believe that their hearts should be humble for the remembrance of Allah and for the truth that has descended (through revelation)? They must not be like those to whom the Book was given before, but a long period passed on them (in which they did not repent), therefore their hearts became hard, and (thus) many of them are sinners.
t.85: Is it not time for believers to humble their hearts to the remembrance of God and the Truth that has been revealed, and not to be like those who received the Scripture before them, whose time was extended but whose hearts hardened and many of whom were lawbreakers?
t.95: Is the time not come that the hearts of the believers should be humbled to Allah's remembrance and to the Truth that He has revealed, and that they should not be like those who were vouchsafed the Book and then a long time elapsed so that their hearts were hardened? A great many of them are now evil-doers.
t.19: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers.
t.22: Has not the Time arrived for the Believers that their hearts in all humility should engage in the remembrance of Allah and of the Truth which has been revealed (to them), and that they should not become like those to whom was given Revelation aforetime, but long ages passed over them and their hearts grew hard? For many among them are rebellious transgressors.
t.203: Has not the time come for the hearts of those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) to be affected by Allâh’s Reminder (this Qur’ân), and that which has been revealed of the truth, lest they become as those who received the Scripture [the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] before (i.e. Jews and Christians), and the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened? And many of them were Fâsiqûn (the rebellious, the disobedient to Allâh).
t.54: کیا اب تک ایمان والوں کے لیے وقت نہیں آیا کہ ان کے دل ذکر الٰہی سے اور جو حق اتر چکا ہے اس سے نرم ہو جائیں اور ان کی طرح نہ ہو جائیں جنہیں ان سے پہلے کتاب دی گئی تھی پھر جب ان پر ایک زمانہ دراز گزر گیا تو ان کے دل سخت ہو گئے اور ان میں بہت سے فاسق ہیں.

t.149: Know that Allah revives the earth after its death; We have made the signs evident for you, that you may reason.
t.84: Know well that Allah revives the land after its death. We have made the signs clear for you, so that you may understand.
t.85: Remember that God revives the earth after it dies; We have made Our revelation clear to you so that you may use your reason.
t.95: Know well that Allah revives the earth after it becomes lifeless. We have clearly shown Our Signs to you, perchance you will use your reason.
t.19: Know that Allah quickeneth the earth after its death. We have made clear Our revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.
t.22: Know ye (all) that Allah giveth life to the earth after its death! already have We shown the Signs plainly to you, that ye may learn wisdom.
t.203: Know that Allâh gives life to the earth after its death! Indeed We have made clear the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) to you, if you but understand.
t.54: یقین مانوکہ اللہ ہی زمین کو اس کی موت کے بعد زنده کر دیتا ہے۔ ہم نے تو تمہارے لیے اپنی آیتیں بیان کردیں تاکہ تم سمجھو.

t.149: Indeed, charitable men and charitable women who have loaned Allah a good loan—it will be multiplied for them, and for them is a noble reward.
t.84: Surely those men who give Sadaqah (alms) and those women who give Sadaqah and have advanced a good loan to Allah, for them it will be multiplied, and for them there is a noble reward.
t.85: Charitable men and women who make a good loan to God will have it doubled and have a generous reward.
t.95: Verily those who give alms be they men or women, and give Allah a beautiful loan shall be repaid after increasing it many times; and theirs shall be a generous reward.
t.19: Lo! those who give alms, both men and women, and lend unto Allah a goodly loan, it will be doubled for them, and theirs will be a rich reward.
t.22: For those who give in Charity, men and women, and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan, it shall be increased manifold (to their credit), and they shall have (besides) a liberal reward.
t.203: Verily, those who give Sadaqât (i.e. Zakât and alms), men and women, and lend Allâh a goodly loan, it shall be increased manifold (to their credit), and theirs shall be an honourable good reward (i.e. Paradise).
t.54: بیشک صدقہ دینے والے مرد اور صدقہ دینے والی عورتیں اور جو اللہ کو خلوص کے ساتھ قرض دے رہے ہیں۔ ان کے لیے یہ بڑھایا جائے گا اور ان کے لیے پسندیده اجر وﺛواب ہے.

t.149: And as for those who have attained faith in Allah and His messengers—those are the unwavering believers and the witnesseswho will come as witnesses with their Lord; for them is their reward and their light. But as for those who denied and rejected Our signs—those are the fellows of purgatory.
t.84: And those who believed in Allah and His messengers, - those are the Siddīqs (the most righteous after prophets) and the Shuhadā’ (martyrs) in the sight of your Lord. For them shall be their reward and their light. As for those who disbelieved and rejected Our verses, they are the inmates of Hell.
t.85: Those who believe in God and His messengers are the truthful ones who will bear witness before their Lord: they will have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations are the inhabitants of Hell.
t.95: In Allah's sight only those who truly believe in Allah and His Messengers are utterly truthful and true bearers of witness(for the sake of Allah). For them is their reward and their light. As for those who gave the lie to Our Signs, they are the people of Hell.
t.19: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.
t.22: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers- they are the Sincere (lovers of Truth), and the witnesses (who testify), in the eyes of their Lord: They shall have their Reward and their Light. But those who reject Allah and deny Our Signs,- they are the Companions of Hell-Fire.
t.203: And those who believe in (the Oneness of) Allâh and His Messengers - they are the Siddiqûn (i.e. those followers of the Prophets who were first and foremost to believe in them), and the martyrs with their Lord, they shall have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and deny Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) - they shall be the dwellers of the blazing Fire.
t.54: اللہ اوراس کے رسول پر جو ایمان رکھتے ہیں وہی لوگ اپنے رب کے نزدیک صدیق اور شہید ہیں ان کے لیے ان کا اجر اور ان کا نور ہے، اور جو لوگ کفر کرتے ہیں اور ہماری آیتوں کوجھٹلاتے ہیں وه جہنمی ہیں.

t.149: Knowthat the Earlier Life is only a game and a distraction and an adornment and boasting among you and rivalry in wealth and children: like a rainfall producing plants that delighted the farmers, then it withers and you see it yellowing, then it becomes debris. But in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and(His) good pleasure, for the Earlier Life is nothing but the enjoyment of deception.
t.84: Know well that the worldly life is but a play and an amusement, and a show of beauty, and exchange of boastful claims between you, and a competition of increase in riches and children. (All this is) like a rain, the growth of which attracts the farmers, then it withers, and you see it turning yellow, then it becomes straw. And in the Hereafter there is a severe punishment (for the disbelievers), and forgiveness from Allah and (Allah’s) pleasure (for the believers and the righteous). The worldly life is nothing but a material of delusion.
t.85: Bear in mind that the present life is just a game, a diversion, an attraction, a cause of boasting among you, of rivalry in wealth and children. It is like plants that spring up after the rain: their growth at first delights the sowers, but then you see them wither away, turn yellow, and become stubble. There is terrible punishment in the next life as well as forgiveness and approval from God; the life of this world is only an illusory pleasure.
t.95: Know well that the life of this world is merely sport and diversion and adornment and an object of your boasting with one another, and a rivalry in the multiplication of riches and children. Its likeness is that of rain: when it produces vegetation it delights the tillers. But then it withers and you see it turn yellow, and then it crumbles away. In the Hereafter there is (either) grievous chastisement (or) forgiveness from Allah and (His) good pleasure. The life of this world is nothing but delusion.
t.19: Know that the life of the world is only play, and idle talk, and pageantry, and boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children; as the likeness of vegetation after rain, whereof the growth is pleasing to the husbandman, but afterward it drieth up and thou seest it turning yellow, then it becometh straw. And in the Hereafter there is grievous punishment, and (also) forgiveness from Allah and His good pleasure, whereas the life of the world is but matter of illusion.
t.22: Know ye (all), that the life of this world is but play and amusement, pomp and mutual boasting and multiplying, (in rivalry) among yourselves, riches and children. Here is a similitude: How rain and the growth which it brings forth, delight (the hearts of) the tillers; soon it withers; thou wilt see it grow yellow; then it becomes dry and crumbles away. But in the Hereafter is a Penalty severe (for the devotees of wrong). And Forgiveness from Allah and (His) Good Pleasure (for the devotees of Allah). And what is the life of this world, but goods and chattels of deception?
t.203: Know that the life of this world is only play and amusement, pomp and mutual boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children. (It is) as the likeness of vegetation after rain, thereof the growth is pleasing to the tiller; afterwards it dries up and you see it turning yellow; then it becomes straw. But in the Hereafter (there is) a severe torment (for the disbelievers - evil-doers), and (there is) Forgiveness from Allâh and (His) Good Pleasure (for the believers - good-doers). And the life of this world is only a deceiving enjoyment.
t.54: خوب جان رکھو کہ دنیا کی زندگی صرف کھیل تماشا زینت اور آپس میں فخر (و غرور) اور مال واوﻻد میں ایک کا دوسرے سے اپنے آپ کو زیاده بتلانا ہے، جیسے بارش اور اس کی پیداوار کسانوں کو اچھی معلوم ہوتی ہے پھر جب وه خشک ہو جاتی ہے تو زرد رنگ میں اس کو تم دیکھتے ہو پھر وه بالکل چورا چورا ہو جاتی ہے اور آخرت میں سخت عذاب اور اللہ کی مغفرت اور رضامندی ہے اور دنیا کی زندگی بجز دھوکے کے سامان کے اور کچھ بھی تو نہیں.

t.149: Race towards forgiveness from yourLord and a Garden(of Paradise) whose width is like the width of the heavens and the earth—prepared for those who have attained faith in Allah and His messengers. That is Allah’s grace; He bestows it upon whomever He wills, and Allah is the Possessor of great grace.
t.84: Compete each other in proceeding towards forgiveness from your Lord and to Paradise the width of which is like the width of the sky and the earth. It has been prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah; He gives it to whomsoever He Wills and Allah is the Lord of the great bounty.
t.85: So race for your Lord’s forgiveness and a Garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers: that is God’s bounty, which He bestows on whoever He pleases. God’s bounty is infinite.
t.95: So vie with one another in seeking to attain your Lord's forgiveness and a Garden whose width is as the width of the heaven and the earth, one which has been prepared for those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. That is Allah's bounty which He bestows upon those whom He pleases. Allah is the Lord of abounding bounty.
t.19: Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.
t.22: Be ye foremost (in seeking) Forgiveness from your Lord, and a Garden (of Bliss), the width whereof is as the width of heaven and earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers: that is the Grace of Allah, which He bestows on whom he pleases: and Allah is the Lord of Grace abounding.
t.203: Race with one another in hastening towards forgiveness from your Lord (Allâh), and Paradise the width whereof is as the width of the heaven and the earth, prepared for those who believe in Allâh and His Messengers. That is the Grace of Allâh which He bestows on whom He is pleased with. And Allâh is the Owner of Great Bounty.
t.54: (آؤ) دوڑو اپنے رب کی مغفرت کی طرف اور اس جنت کی طرف جس کی وسعت آسمان وزمین کی وسعت کے برابر ہے یہ ان کے لیے بنائی ہے جو اللہ پر اور اس کے رسولوں پر ایمان رکھتے ہیں۔ یہ اللہ کا فضل ہے جسے چاہے دے اور اللہ بڑے فضل واﻻ ہے.

t.149: No calamity occurs on earth or among yourselves but it is already written in a Recordbefore We make it— indeed, that is easy for Allah—
t.84: No calamity befalls the earth or your own selves, but it is (pre-destined) in a Book before We bring it into being, -Indeed it is easy for Allah.
t.85: No misfortune can happen, either in the earth or in yourselves, that was not set down in writing before We brought it into being- that is easy for God-
t.95: No misfortune ever befalls on earth, nor on yourselves but We have inscribed it in the Book before We make it manifest. Surely that is easy for Allah.
t.19: Naught of disaster befalleth in the earth or in yourselves but it is in a Book before we bring it into being - Lo! that is easy for Allah -
t.22: No misfortune can happen on earth or in your souls but is recorded in a decree before We bring it into existence: That is truly easy for Allah:
t.203: No calamity befalls on the earth or in yourselves but it is inscribed in the Book of Decrees (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz) before We bring it into existence. Verily, that is easy for Allâh.
t.54: نہ کوئی مصیبت دنیا میں آتی ہے نہ (خاص) تمہاری جانوں میں، مگر اس سے پہلے کہ ہم اس کو پیدا کریں وه ایک خاص کتاب میں لکھی ہوئی ہے، یہ (کام) اللہ تعالیٰ پر (بالکل) آسان ہے.

t.149: so that youdo not grieve over what you have missed nor exult over what He has given you. And Allah does not love every self-admiring boaster—
t.84: - so that you may neither grieve on what has escaped you, nor over-exult on what He has given to you. And Allah does not love any self-admirer, over-proud,
t.85: so you need not grieve for what you miss or gloat over what you gain. God does not love the conceited, the boastful,
t.95: (We do so) that you may not grieve over the loss you suffer, nor exult over what He gave you. Allah does not love the vainglorious, the boastful,
t.19: That ye grieve not for the sake of that which hath escaped you, nor yet exult because of that which hath been given. Allah loveth not all prideful boasters,
t.22: In order that ye may not despair over matters that pass you by, nor exult over favours bestowed upon you. For Allah loveth not any vainglorious boaster,-
t.203: In order that you may not grieve at the things that you fail to get, nor rejoice over that which has been given to you. And Allâh likes not prideful boasters.
t.54: تاکہ تم اپنے سے فوت شده کسی چیز پر رنجیده نہ ہو جایا کرو اور نہ عطا کرده چیز پر اترا جاؤ، اور اترانے والے شیخی خوروں کو اللہ پسند نہیں فرماتا.

t.149: those who are miserly and command mankind to miserliness. And whoever turns away—indeed, it is Allah who is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
t.84: -those who are miserly and bid others to be miserly. And whoever turns away, then Allah is the All-Independent, the Ever-Praised.
t.85: those who are miserly, and who tell other people to be miserly. If anyone turns away, remember that God is self-sufficient and worthy of praise.
t.95: those who are niggardly and bid others to be niggardly. And he who turns away, (should know that) Allah is Self-Sufficient, Immensely Praiseworthy.
t.19: Who hoard and who enjoin upon the people avarice. And whosoever turneth away, still Allah is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.
t.22: Such persons as are covetous and commend covetousness to men. And if any turn back (from Allah's Way), verily Allah is Free of all Needs, Worthy of all Praise.
t.203: Those who are misers and enjoin upon people miserliness - (Allâh is not in need of their charity). And whosoever turns away (from Faith - Allâh’s Monotheism), then Allâh is Rich (Free of all needs), Worthy of all praise.
t.54: جو (خود بھی) بخل کریں اور دوسروں کو (بھی) بخل کی تعلیم دیں۔ سنو! جو بھی منھ پھیرے اللہ بےنیاز اور سزاوار حمد وﺛنا ہے.

t.149: And We certainly sent Our messengers with evident proofs, and We sent down with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may uphold justice. And We sent down iron in which there is intense force and benefits for humanity, and that Allah may know who supports Him and His messengers, though unseen. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful, Almighty.
t.84: We have indeed sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and sent down with them the Book and the Balance, so that people may uphold equity. And We sent down iron in which there is strong power, and benefits for the people; and (We did it) so that Allah knows the one who helps Him and His messengers without seeing (Him). Surely Allah is Strong, Mighty.
t.85: We sent Our messengers with clear signs, the Scripture and the Balance, so that people could uphold justice: We also sent iron, with its mighty strength and many uses for mankind, so that God could mark out those who would help Him and His messengers though they cannot see Him. Truly God is powerful, almighty.
t.95: Indeed We sent Our Messengers with Clear Signs, and sent down with them the Book and the Balance that people may uphold justice. And We sent down iron, wherein there is awesome power and many benefits for people, so that Allah may know who, without even having seen Him, helps Him and His Messengers. Surely Allah is Most Strong, Most Mighty.
t.19: We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
t.22: We sent aforetime our messengers with Clear Signs and sent down with them the Book and the Balance (of Right and Wrong), that men may stand forth in justice; and We sent down Iron, in which is (material for) mighty war, as well as many benefits for mankind, that Allah may test who it is that will help, Unseen, Him and His messengers: For Allah is Full of Strength, Exalted in Might (and able to enforce His Will).
t.203: Indeed We have sent Our Messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance (justice) that mankind may keep up justice. And We brought forth iron wherein is mighty power (in matters of war), as well as many benefits for mankind, that Allâh may test who it is that will help Him (His religion) and His Messengers in the unseen. Verily, Allâh is All-Strong, All-Mighty.
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے اپنے پیغمبروں کو کھلی دلیلیں دے کر بھیجا اور ان کے ساتھ کتاب اور میزان (ترازو) نازل فرمایا تاکہ لوگ عدل پر قائم رہیں۔ اور ہم نے لوہے کو اتارا جس میں سخت ہیبت وقوت ہے اور لوگوں کے لیے اور بھی (بہت سے) فائدے ہیں اور اس لیے بھی کہ اللہ جان لے کہ اس کی اور اس کے رسولوں کی مدد بےدیکھے کون کرتا ہے، بیشک اللہ قوت واﻻ اور زبردست ہے.

t.149: And We certainly sent Noah and Abraham and established Prophethood and Scripture among their offspring, so some of them are rightly guided, while many of them are defiantly disobedient.
t.84: Indeed We sent NūH and Ibrāhīm, and kept the Book and prophet-hood (continuing) in their progeny. So, some of those (to whom they were sent) were on the right path, and many of them were sinners.
t.85: We sent Noah and Abraham, and gave prophethood and scripture to their offspring: among them there were some who were rightly guided, but many were lawbreakers.
t.95: Indeed We sent forth Noah and Abraham and established in their line Prophecy and the Book. Then some of them embraced the guidance and many of them are wicked.
t.19: And We verily sent Noah and Abraham and placed the prophethood and the scripture among their seed, and among them there is he who goeth right, but many of them are evil-livers.
t.22: And We sent Noah and Abraham, and established in their line Prophethood and Revelation: and some of them were on right guidance. But many of them became rebellious transgressors.
t.203: And indeed, We sent Nûh (Noah) and Ibrâhîm (Abraham), and placed in their offspring Prophethood and Scripture. And among them there are some who are guided; but many of them are Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).
t.54: بیشک ہم نے نوح اور ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) کو (پیغمبر بنا کر) بھیجا اور ہم نے ان دونوں کی اوﻻد میں پیغمبری اور کتاب جاری رکھی تو ان میں سے کچھ تو راه یافتہ ہوئے اور ان میں سے اکثر بہت نافرمان رہے.

t.149: Then We sent in their wake Our messengers and followed them with Jesus, son of Mary, and We gave him the Gospel and instilled in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy. But the monasticism which they invented was only to seek Allah’s good pleasure—We did not ordain it for them— yet they did not observe it with its due observance. So We gave those of them who attained faith their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
t.84: Then We made Our messengers follow them one after the other, then We sent after them ‘Īsā, the son of Maryam (Jesus, son of Mary), and gave him the Injīl, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of his followers. As for monasticism, it was invented by them; We did not ordain it for them, but (they adopted it) to seek Allah’s pleasure, then could not observe it as was due. So We gave the believers from among them their reward. And many of them are sinners.
t.85: We sent other messengers to follow in their footsteps. After those We sent Jesus, son of Mary: We gave him the Gospel and put compassion and mercy into the hearts of his followers. But monasticism was something they invented- We did not ordain it for them- only to seek God’s pleasure, and even so, they did not observe it properly. So We gave a reward to those of them who believed, but many of them were lawbreakers.
t.95: In their wake, We sent a succession of Our Messengers, and raised Jesus, son of Mary, after all of them, and bestowed upon him the Evangel, and We set tenderness and mercy in the hearts of those that followed him. As for monasticism, it is they who invented it; We did not prescribe it for them. They themselves invented it in pursuit of Allah's good pleasure, and then they did not observe it as it ought to have been observed. So We gave their reward to those of them that believed. But many of them are wicked.
t.19: Then We caused Our messengers to follow in their footsteps; and We caused Jesus, son of Mary, to follow, and gave him the Gospel, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. But monasticism they invented - We ordained it not for them - only seeking Allah's pleasure, and they observed it not with right observance. So We give those of them who believe their reward, but many of them are evil-livers.
t.22: Then, in their wake, We followed them up with (others of) Our messengers: We sent after them Jesus the son of Mary, and bestowed on him the Gospel; and We ordained in the hearts of those who followed him Compassion and Mercy. But the Monasticism which they invented for themselves, We did not prescribe for them: (We commanded) only the seeking for the Good Pleasure of Allah; but that they did not foster as they should have done. Yet We bestowed, on those among them who believed, their (due) reward, but many of them are rebellious transgressors.
t.203: Then, We sent after them Our Messengers, and We sent ‘Îsâ (Jesus) - son of Maryam (Mary), and gave him the Injeel (Gospel). And We ordained in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy. But the monasticism which they invented for themselves, We did not prescribe for them, but (they sought it) only to please Allâh therewith, but they did not observe it with the right observance.
