t.149: O you who have attained faith, repent to Allah with sincere repentance; hopefully your Lord will remit your evil deeds and enter you into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will never disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. With their light streaming before them and to their right, they say, “Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us; You are indeed All-Powerful over everything.”
t.84: O you who believe, turn to Allah with a faithful repentance. It is hoped from your Lord that he will write off your faults, and will admit you to the gardens beneath which rivers flow, on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will run before them and to their right hands. They will say, “Our Lord, perfect for us our light, and forgive us. Indeed you are powerful over every thing.”
t.85: Believers, turn to God in sincere repentance. Your Lord may well cancel your bad deeds for you and admit you into Gardens graced with flowing streams, on a Day when God will not disgrace the Prophet or those who have believed with him. With their lights streaming out ahead of them and to their right, they will say, ‘Lord, perfect our lights for us and forgive us: You have power over everything.’
t.95: Believers, turn to Allah in sincere repentance; maybe your Lord will expunge your evil deeds and admit you to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. This will be on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who have embraced faith and are with him; their light will be running before them and on their right hands, and they will say: “Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Surely You have power over everything.”
t.19: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.
t.22: O ye who believe! Turn to Allah with sincere repentance: In the hope that your Lord will remove from you your ills and admit you to Gardens beneath which Rivers flow,- the Day that Allah will not permit to be humiliated the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their Light will run forward before them and by their right hands, while they say, "Our Lord! Perfect our Light for us, and grant us Forgiveness: for Thou hast power over all things."
t.203: O you who believe! Turn to Allâh with sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will expiate from you your sins, and admit you into Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise) - the Day that Allâh will not disgrace the Prophet (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and those who believe with him. Their Light will run forward before them and (with their Records - Books of deeds) in their right hands. They will say: "Our Lord! Keep perfect our Light for us [and do not put it off till we cross over the Sirât (a slippery bridge over the Hell) safely] and grant us forgiveness. Verily, You are Able to do all things."
t.54: اے ایمان والو! تم اللہ کے سامنے سچی خالص توبہ کرو۔ قریب ہے کہ تمہارا رب تمہارے گناه دور کر دے اور تمہیں ایسی جنتوں میں داخل کرے جن کے نیچے نہریں جاری ہیں۔ جس دن اللہ تعالیٰ نبی کو اور ایمان والوں کو جو ان کے ساتھ ہیں رسوا نہ کرے گا۔ ان کا نور ان کے سامنے اور ان کے دائیں دوڑ رہا ہوگا۔ یہ دعائیں کرتے ہوں گے اے ہمارے رب ہمیں کامل نور عطا فرما اور ہمیں بخش دے یقیناً تو ہر چیز پر قادر ہے.

t.149: O Prophet, strive hard against the deniers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. And their shelter is Hell, and what a miserable destiny!
t.84: O Prophet, carry out Jihād (struggle) against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be harsh with them. Their final abode is Jahannam (Hell), and it is an evil end.
t.85: Prophet, strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Deal with them sternly. Hell will be their home, an evil destination!
t.95: O Prophet, strive against the unbelievers and the hypocrites, and be severe with them. Hell shall be their resort. What a grievous end!
t.19: O Prophet! Strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. Hell will be their home, a hapless journey's end.
t.22: O Prophet! Strive hard against the Unbelievers and the Hypocrites, and be firm against them. Their abode is Hell,- an evil refuge (indeed).
t.203: O Prophet (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)! Strive hard against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be severe against them; their abode will be Hell, and worst indeed is that destination.
t.54: اے نبی! کافروں اور منافقوں سے جہاد کرو اور ان پر سختی کرو ان کا ٹھکانا جہنم ہے اور وه بہت بری جگہ ہے.

t.149: Allah has set forth a parable for those who denied: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot; they were under two servants of Our righteous servants but they betrayed them, so they availed them nothing against Allah, and it was said, “Enter the Fire with those who are entering.”
t.84: Allah has cited for the disbelievers the example of the wife of NūH and the wife of LūT. Both were married with two of Our righteous servants, but betrayed them. So they could not benefit them against Allah at all, and it was said, “Enter the Fire along with those who enter.”
t.85: God has given examples of disbelievers: the wives of Noah and Lot who married two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them. Their husbands could not help them against God: it was said, ‘Both of you enter the Fire with the others.’
t.95: Allah has set forth for the unbelievers the parable of the wives of Noah and Lot. They were wedded to two of Our righteous servants, but each acted treacherously with her husband, and their husbands could be of no avail to them against Allah. The two of them were told: “Enter the Fire with all the others who enter it.”
t.19: Allah citeth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot, who were under two of Our righteous slaves yet betrayed them so that they (the husbands) availed them naught against Allah and it was said (unto them): Enter the Fire along with those who enter.
t.22: Allah sets forth, for an example to the Unbelievers, the wife of Noah and the wife of Lut: they were (respectively) under two of our righteous servants, but they were false to their (husbands), and they profited nothing before Allah on their account, but were told: "Enter ye the Fire along with (others) that enter!"
t.203: Allâh sets forth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Nûh (Noah) and the wife of Lût (Lot). They were under two of our righteous slaves, but they both betrayed them (their husbands by rejecting their doctrine). So they [Nûh (Noah) and Lût (Lot) عليهما السلام] availed them (their respective wives) not against Allâh and it was said: "Enter the Fire along with those who enter!"
t.54: اللہ تعالیٰ نے کافروں کے لیے نوح کی اور لوط کی بیوی کی مثال بیان فرمائی یہ دونوں ہمارے بندوں میں سے دو (شائستہ اور) نیک بندوں کے گھر میں تھیں، پھر ان کی انہوں نے خیانت کی پس وه دونوں (نیک بندے) ان سے اللہ کے (کسی عذاب کو) نہ روک سکے اور حکم دے دیا گیا (اے عورتوں) دوزخ میں جانے والوں کے ساتھ تم دونوں بھی چلی جاؤ.

t.149: And Allah has set forth a parable for those who have attained faith: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, “My Lord, build for me, with you, a house in the Garden(of Paradise) , and deliver me from Pharaoh and his actions, and deliver me from the unjust people.”
t.84: And Allah has cited for the believers the example of the wife of Fir’aun (Pharaoh), when she said, “My Lord, build for me, near You, a house in the Paradise, and deliver me from Fir’aun and his deeds, and deliver me from the unjust people.”
t.85: God has also given examples of believers: Pharaoh’s wife, who said, ‘Lord, build me a house near You in the Garden. Save me from Pharaoh and his actions; save me from the evildoers,’
t.95: Allah has set forth for the believers the parable of Pharaoh's wife. She prayed: “My Lord, build for me a house with You in Paradise and deliver me from Pharaoh and his misdeeds; and deliver me from the iniquitous people.”
t.19: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk;
t.22: And Allah sets forth, as an example to those who believe the wife of Pharaoh: Behold she said: "O my Lord! Build for me, in nearness to Thee, a mansion in the Garden, and save me from Pharaoh and his doings, and save me from those that do wrong";
t.203: And Allâh has set forth an example for those who believe: the wife of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), when she said: "My Lord! Build for me a home with You in Paradise, and save me from Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his work, and save me from the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in Allâh).
t.54: اور اللہ تعالیٰ نے ایمان والوں کے لیے فرعون کی بیوی کی مثال بیان فرمائی جبکہ اس نے دعا کی کہ اے میرے رب! میرے لیے اپنے پاس جنت میں مکان بنا اور مجھے فرعون سے اور اس کے عمل سے بچا اور مجھے ﻇالم لوگوں سے خلاصی دے.

t.149: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, and so We breathed into her of Our Spirit, and she believed in her Lord’s Words and His Scriptures and was one of the devout.
t.84: And (Allah has also cited the example of) Maryam, daughter of ‘Imrān who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her Our spirit, and she testified to the truth of the words of her Lord and His books, and she was one of the devout.
t.85: and Mary, daughter of Imran. She guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her from Our spirit. She accepted the truth of her Lord’s words and Scriptures: she was truly devout.
t.95: Allah has also set forth the parable of Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, and into whom We breathed of Our Spirit, and who testified to the words of her Lord and His Books. She was among the obedient.
t.19: And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, and was of the obedient.
t.22: And Mary the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity; and We breathed into (her body) of Our spirit; and she testified to the truth of the words of her Lord and of His Revelations, and was one of the devout (servants).
t.203: And Maryam (Mary), the daughter of ‘Imrân who guarded her chastity. And We breathed into (the sleeve of her shirt or her garment) through Our Rûh [i.e. Jibrîl (Gabriel)], and she testified to the truth of the Words of her Lord [i.e. believed in the Words of Allâh: "Be!" - and he was; that is ‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary) as a Messenger of Allâh], and (also believed in) His Scriptures, and she was of the Qânitûn (i.e. obedient to Allâh).
t.54: اور (مثال بیان فرمائی) مریم بنت عمران کی جس نے اپنے ناموس کی حفاﻇت کی پھر ہم نے اپنی طرف سے اس میں جان پھونک دی اور (مریم) اس نے اپنے رب کی باتوں اور اس کی کتابوں کی تصدیق کی اور عبادت گزاروں میں سے تھی.

t.149: Supremely Blessed be He in whose hand is the dominion, and He is All- Powerful over everything;
t.84: Glorious is the One in whose hand is the Kingdom (of the whole universe), and He is powerful over every thing,
t.85: Exalted is He who holds all control in His hands; who has power over all things;
t.95: Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion of the Universe, and Who has power over everything;
t.19: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things.
t.22: Blessed be He in Whose hands is Dominion; and He over all things hath Power;-
t.203: Blessed be He in Whose Hand is the dominion; and He is Able to do all things.
t.54: بہت بابرکت ہے وه (اللہ) جس کے ہاتھ میں بادشاہی ہے اور جو ہر چیز پر قدرت رکھنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: the One Who created death and life to test youas to which of you is better in conduct, for He is the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving;
t.84: the One who created death and life, so that He may test you as to which of you is better in his deeds. And He is the All-Mighty, the Most-Forgiving,
t.85: who created death and life to test you [people] and reveal which of you does best––He is the Mighty, the Forgiving;
t.95: Who created death and life that He might try you as to which of you is better in deed. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Forgiving;
t.19: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,
t.22: He Who created Death and Life, that He may try which of you is best in deed: and He is the Exalted in Might, Oft-Forgiving;-
t.203: Who has created death and life that He may test you which of you is best in deed. And He is the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving;
t.54: جس نے موت اور حیات کو اس لیے پیدا کیاکہ تمہیں آزمائے کہ تم میں سے اچھے کام کون کرتا ہے، اور وه غالب (اور) بخشنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: the One Who created seven heavens in layers: yousee no discrepancy in the creation of the All-Merciful. So look again: can you see any splits?
t.84: who has created seven skies, one over the other. You will see nothing out of proportion in the creation of the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah). So, cast your eye again. Do you see any rifts?
t.85: who created the seven heavens, one above the other. You will not see any flaw in what the Lord of Mercy creates. Look again! Can you see any flaw?
t.95: Who created the seven heavens one upon another. You will see no incongruity in the Merciful One's creation. Turn your vision again, can you see any flaw?
t.19: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts?
t.22: He Who created the seven heavens one above another: No want of proportion wilt thou see in the Creation of (Allah) Most Gracious. So turn thy vision again: seest thou any flaw?
t.203: Who has created the seven heavens one above another; you can see no fault in the creation of the Most Gracious. Then look again: "Can you see any rifts?"
t.54: جس نے سات آسمان اوپر تلے بنائے۔ (تو اے دیکھنے والے) اللہ رحمٰن کی پیدائش میں کوئی بے ضابطگی نہ دیکھے گا، دوباره (نظریں ڈال کر) دیکھ لے کیا کوئی شگاف بھی نظر آرہا ہے.

t.149: Then look again and again—yoursight will return to you bedazzled and exhausted.
t.84: Then cast your eye again and again, and the eye will come back to you abased, in a state of weariness.
t.85: Look again! And again! Your sight will turn back to you, weak and defeated.
t.95: Then turn your vision again, and then again; in the end your vision will come back to you, worn out and frustrated.
t.19: Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and made dim.
t.22: Again turn thy vision a second time: (thy) vision will come back to thee dull and discomfited, in a state worn out.
t.203: Then look again and yet again: your sight will return to you in a state of humiliation and worn out.
t.54: پھر دوہرا کر دو دو بار دیکھ لے تیری نگاه تیری طرف ذلیل (و عاجز) ہو کر تھکی ہوئی لوٹ آئے گی.

t.149: And indeed, We have adorned the lowestheaven with lanterns and made them missiles against the Satans, and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
t.84: And We have decorated the nearest sky with lamps, and have made them devices to stone the devils, and We have prepared for them the punishment of Hell.
t.85: We have adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and made them [missiles] for stoning devils for whom We have also prepared the torment of a blazing fire.
t.95: We have adorned the lower heaven with lamps, and have made them a means to drive away the satans. We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.
t.19: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.
t.22: And we have, (from of old), adorned the lowest heaven with Lamps, and We have made such (Lamps) (as) missiles to drive away the Evil Ones, and have prepared for them the Penalty of the Blazing Fire.
t.203: And indeed We have adorned the nearest heaven with lamps, and We have made such lamps (as) missiles to drive away the Shayâtîn (devils), and have prepared for them the torment of the blazing Fire.
t.54: بیشک ہم نے آسمان دنیا کو چراغوں (ستاروں) سے آراستہ کیا اور انہیں شیطانوں کے مارنے کا ذریعہ بنا دیا اور شیطانوں کے لیے ہم نے (دوزخ کا جلانے واﻻ) عذاب تیار کر دیا.

t.149: And for those who have denied their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and what a miserable destiny!
t.84: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord, there is the punishment of Jahannam , and it is an evil end.
t.85: For those who defy their Lord We have prepared the torment of Hell: an evil destination.
t.95: The chastisement of Hell awaits those who disbelieve in their Lord. What a wretched destination!
t.19: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end!
t.22: For those who reject their Lord (and Cherisher) is the Penalty of Hell: and evil is (such), Destination.
t.203: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord (Allâh) is the torment of Hell, and worst indeed is that destination.
t.54: اور اپنے رب کے ساتھ کفر کرنے والوں کے لیے جہنم کا عذاب ہے اور وه کیا ہی بری جگہ ہے.

t.149: When they are thrown into it, they hear it roaring as it seethes—
t.84: When they will be thrown in it, they will hear a terrible sound from it, and it will be boiling,
t.85: They will hear it drawing in its breath when they are thrown in. It blazes forth,
t.95: When they will be cast into it, they will hear it roar as it boils,
t.19: When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up,
t.22: When they are cast therein, they will hear the (terrible) drawing in of its breath even as it blazes forth,
t.203: When they are cast therein, they will hear the (terrible) drawing in of its breath as it blazes forth.
t.54: جب اس میں یہ ڈالے جائیں گے تو اس کی بڑے زور کی آواز سنیں گے اور وه جوش مار رہی ہوگی.

t.149: it almost bursts with rage. Every time a crowd is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, “Did no warner come to you?”
t.84: seeming as if it will burst out of fury. Whenever a group is thrown into it, its keepers will say to them, “Had no warner come to you?”
t.85: almost bursting with rage. Its keepers will ask every group that is thrown in, ‘Did no one come to warn you?’
t.95: as though it will burst with rage. Every time a multitude is cast into it, its keepers will ask them: “Did no warner come to you?”
t.19: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner?
t.22: Almost bursting with fury: Every time a Group is cast therein, its Keepers will ask, "Did no Warner come to you?"
t.203: It almost bursts up with fury. Every time a group is cast therein, its keeper will ask: "Did no warner come to you?"
t.54: قریب ہے کہ (ابھی) غصے کے مارے پھٹ جائے، جب کبھی اس میں کوئی گروه ڈاﻻ جائے گا اس سے جہنم کے داروغے پوچھیں گے کہ کیا تمہارے پاس ڈرانے واﻻ کوئی نہیں آیا تھا؟

t.149: They said, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved and said, ‘Allah did not bestow anything from on high; it is youwho are greatly misguided!’”
t.84: They will say, “Yes, a warner had come to us, but We had rejected, and said, ‘Allah has not revealed anything. You are only in great error.’”
t.85: They will reply, ‘Yes, a warner did come to us, but we did not believe him. We said, “God has revealed nothing: you are greatly misguided”.’
t.95: They will say: “Yes, a warner came to us, but we gave the lie to him and said: 'Allah has revealed nothing. You are surely in huge error.'
t.19: They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error.
t.22: They will say: "Yes indeed; a Warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said, 'Allah never sent down any (Message): ye are nothing but an egregious delusion!'"
t.203: They will say: "Yes, indeed a warner did come to us, but we belied him and said: ‘Allâh never sent down anything (of revelation); you are only in great error.’"
t.54: وه جواب دیں گے کہ بیشک آیا تھا لیکن ہم نے اسے جھٹلایا اور ہم نے کہا کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نےکچھ بھی نازل نہیں فرمایا۔ تم بہت بڑی گمراہی میں ہی ہو.

t.149: And they said, “Had we listened or reasoned, we would not have been among the fellows of the Blaze.”
t.84: And they will say, “Had we been listening or understanding, we would not have been among the people of the Hell.”
t.85: They will say, ‘If only we had listened, or reasoned, we would not be with the inhabitants of the blazing fire,’ and
t.95: They will say: 'If we had only listened and understood, we would not be among the inmates of the Blazing Fire.'”
t.19: And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames.
t.22: They will further say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we should not (now) be among the Companions of the Blazing Fire!"
t.203: And they will say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we would not have been among the dwellers of the blazing Fire!"
t.54: اور کہیں گے اگر ہم سنتے ہوتے یا عقل رکھتے ہوتے تو دوزخیوں میں (شریک) نہ ہوتے.

t.149: Thus they acknowledged their misdeed, so away with the fellows of the Blaze.
t.84: Thus they will confess their sin. So, away with the people of the Hell!
t.85: they will confess their sins. Away with the inhabitants of the blazing fire!
t.95: Thus will they confess their sins. Damned are these inmates of the Blazing Fire.
t.19: So they acknowledge their sins; but far removed (from mercy) are the dwellers in the flames.
t.22: They will then confess their sins: but far will be (Forgiveness) from the Companions of the Blazing Fire!
t.203: Then they will confess their sin. So, away with the dwellers of the blazing Fire!
t.54: پس انہوں نے اپنے جرم کا اقبال کر لیا۔ اب یہ دوزخی دفع ہوں (دور ہوں).

t.149: Indeed, for those who fear their Lord though Unseen, there is forgiveness and a supreme reward.
t.84: Surely, for those who have awe of their Lord without seeing (Him), there is forgiveness and a big reward.
t.85: But there is forgiveness and a great reward for those who fear their Lord though they cannot see Him.
t.95: Surely forgiveness and a mighty reward await those who fear Allah without seeing Him.
t.19: Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.
t.22: As for those who fear their Lord unseen, for them is Forgiveness and a great Reward.
t.203: Verily,, those who fear their Lord unseen (i.e. they do not see Him, nor His punishment in the Hereafter), theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward (i.e. Paradise).
t.54: بیشک جو لوگ اپنے پروردگار سےغائبانہ طور پر ڈرتے رہتے ہیں ان کے لیے بخشش ہے اور بڑا ﺛواب ہے.

t.149: And keep yourwords secret or say them aloud—indeed, He is All-Knowing of what lies within the chests.
t.84: Whether you keep your talk secret or make it aloud, He knows well what lies in the hearts.
t.85: Whether you keep your words secret or state them openly, He knows the contents of every heart.
t.95: Whether you speak in secrecy or aloud, (it is all the same to Allah). He even knows the secrets that lie hidden in the breasts of people.
t.19: And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in the breasts (of men).
t.22: And whether ye hide your word or publish it, He certainly has (full) knowledge, of the secrets of (all) hearts.
t.203: And whether you keep your talk secret or disclose it, Verily, He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts (of men).
t.54: تم اپنی باتوں کو چھپاؤ یا ﻇاہر کرو وه تو سینوں کی پوشیدگی کو بھی بخوبی جانتا ہے.

t.149: Would He not know whomever He has created, while He is the Subtle, the All-Aware?
t.84: Is it (imaginable) that He who has created (them) will not have (such a) knowledge, while He is the Knower of the finest things, the All-Aware?
t.85: How could He who created not know His own creation, when He is the Most Subtle, the All Aware?
t.95: Would He not know, He Who has created, when He is All-Subtle, All-Aware?
t.19: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware.
t.22: Should He not know,- He that created? and He is the One that understands the finest mysteries (and) is well-acquainted (with them).
t.203: Should not He Who has created know? And He is the Most Kind and Courteous (to His slaves), All-Aware (of everything).
t.54: کیا وہی نہ جانے جس نے پیدا کیا؟ پھر وه باریک بین اور باخبر بھی ہو.

t.149: It is He who made the earth manageable for you, so walk through its regions and eat of His provision, and to Him is the Resurrection.
t.84: He is the One who has made the earth subjugated for you, so walk on its shoulders, and eat out of His provision, and to Him is the Resurrection.
t.85: It is He who has made the earth manageable for you––travel its regions; eat His provision- and to Him you will be resurrected.
t.95: He it is Who made the earth subservient to you. So traverse in its tracks and partake of the sustenance He has provided. To Him will you be resurrected.
t.19: He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the dead).
t.22: It is He Who has made the earth manageable for you, so traverse ye through its tracts and enjoy of the Sustenance which He furnishes: but unto Him is the Resurrection.
t.203: He it is Who has made the earth subservient to you (i.e. easy for you to walk, to live and to do agriculture on it); so walk in the path thereof and eat of His provision. And to Him will be the Resurrection.
t.54: وه ذات جس نے تمہارے لیے زمین کو پست ومطیع کردیا تاکہ تم اس کی راہوں میں چلتے پھرتے رہو اور اللہ کی روزیاں کھاؤ (پیو) اسی کی طرف (تمہیں) جی کر اٹھ کھڑا ہونا ہے.

t.149: Are youconfident that the One in heaven will not cause the earth to collapse beneath you as it spins?
t.84: Have you become fearless of Him who is in the sky if He makes you sink into the earth, and it starts trembling at once?
t.85: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not make the earth swallow you up with a violent shudder?
t.95: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not cause the earth to cave in with you, and then suddenly it will begin to rock violently?
t.19: Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed?
t.22: Do ye feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not cause you to be swallowed up by the earth when it shakes (as in an earthquake)?
t.203: Do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven (Allâh), will not cause the earth to sink with you, and then it should quake?
t.54: کیا تم اس بات سے بے خوف ہوگئے ہو کہ آسمانوں واﻻ تمہیں زمین میں دھنسا دے اور اچانک زمین لرزنے لگے.

t.149: Or are you confident that the One in heaven will not unleash against you a violent storm? Then you will know what Mywarning is like.
t.84: Or, have you become fearless of Him who is in the sky if He looses a violent wind with stones against you? So, you will soon come to know how was My warning!
t.85: Are you sure that He who is in Heaven will not send a whirlwind to pelt you with stones? You will come to know what My warning means.
t.95: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not let loose upon you a storm of stones? Then shall you know what My warning is like!
t.19: Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let loose on you a hurricane? But ye shall know the manner of My warning.
t.22: Or do ye feel secure that He Who is in Heaven will not send against you a violent tornado (with showers of stones), so that ye shall know how (terrible) was My warning?
t.203: Or do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven (Allâh), will not send against you a violent whirlwind? Then you shall know how (terrible) has been My Warning.
t.54: یا کیا تم اس بات سے نڈر ہوگئے ہو کہ آسمانوں واﻻ تم پر پتھر برسادے؟ پھر تو تمہیں معلوم ہو ہی جائے گا کہ میرا ڈرانا کیسا تھا.

t.149: And surely those before them disbelieved(as well) , so how terrible was My condemnation!
t.84: And of course, those before them (also) rejected (the truth). So, how was My censure?
t.85: Those who went before them also disbelieved- how terrible was My condemnation!
t.95: Those who came before them also gave the lie (to the Messengers): then how awesome was My chastisement!
t.19: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)!
t.22: But indeed men before them rejected (My warning): then how (terrible) was My rejection (of them)?
t.203: And indeed those before them belied (the Messengers of Allâh), then how terrible was My denial (punishment)?
t.54: اوران سے پہلے لوگوں نے بھی جھٹلایا تھا تو دیکھو ان پر میرا عذاب کیسا کچھ ہوا؟

t.149: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them? None holds them except the All-Merciful; indeed, He is All-Seeing of everything.
t.84: Have they not looked to the birds above them spreading their wings, and (at times) they fold (them) in? No one holds them up except the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah). Surely He is watchful of every thing.
t.85: Do they not see the birds above them spreading and closing their wings? It is only the Lord of Mercy who holds them up: He watches over everything.
t.95: Have they not seen birds above them spreading and closing their wings, with none holding them except the Merciful One? He oversees everything.
t.19: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things.
t.22: Do they not observe the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them in? None can uphold them except (Allah) Most Gracious: truly it is He that watches over all things.
t.203: Do they not see the birds above them, spreading out their wings and folding them in? None upholds them except the Most Gracious (Allâh). Verily, He is the All-Seer of everything.
t.54: کیا یہ اپنے اوپر پر کھولے ہوئے اور (کبھی کبھی) سمیٹے ہوئے (اڑنے والے) پرندوں کو نہیں دیکھتے، انہیں (اللہ) رحمٰن ہی (ہوا وفضا میں) تھامے ہوئے ہے۔ بیشک ہر چیز اس کی نگاه میں ہے.

t.149: Or who is this who is an army for you, supporting you, apart from the All-Merciful? Indeed, the deniers are in nothing but a deception.
t.84: Now, who is there to act as a force for you to help you, except the RaHmān ? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.
t.85: What force can help you if the Lord of Mercy does not? The disbelievers are truly deluded.
t.95: Which is your army that will come to your aid against the Merciful Lord? But the unbelievers are in utter delusion.
t.19: Or who is he that will be an army unto you to help you instead of the Beneficent? The disbelievers are in naught but illusion.
t.22: Nay, who is there that can help you, (even as) an army, besides (Allah) Most Merciful? In nothing but delusion are the Unbelievers.
t.203: Who is he besides the Most Gracious that can be an army to you to help you? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.
t.54: سوائے اللہ کے تمہارا وه کون سا لشکر ہے جو تمہاری مدد کرسکے کافر تو سراسر دھوکے ہی میں ہیں.

t.149: Or who is this that will provide for you if He withholds His provision? Rather, they persist in defiance and aversion.
t.84: Or, who is there to give you sustenance, if He withholds His sustenance? Still, they persist in rebellion and aversion.
t.85: Who can provide for you if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in their insolence and their avoidance of the Truth.
t.95: Who shall provide for you if He withholds His sustenance? Nay; but they persist in rebellion and aversion.
t.19: Or who is he that will provide for you if He should withhold His providence? Nay, but they are set in pride and frowardness.
t.22: Or who is there that can provide you with Sustenance if He were to withhold His provision? Nay, they obstinately persist in insolent impiety and flight (from the Truth).
t.203: Who is he that can provide for you if He should withhold His provision? Nay, but they continue to be in pride, and (they) flee (from the truth).
t.54: اگر اللہ تعالیٰ اپنی روزی روک لے تو بتاؤ کون ہے جو پھر تمہیں روزی دے گا؟ بلکہ (کافر) تو سرکشی اور بدکنے پر اڑگئے ہیں.

t.149: Is one who walks bent on his own face better guided or one who walks upright on a straight path?
t.84: Then, is the one who walks falling down (frequently) on his face more right or the one who walks properly on a straight path?
t.85: Who is better guided: someone who falls on his face, or someone who walks steadily on a straight path?
t.95: Who is better guided: he who walks grovelling on his face, or he who walks upright on a Straight Path?
t.19: Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road?
t.22: Is then one who walks headlong, with his face grovelling, better guided,- or one who walks evenly on a Straight Way?
t.203: Is he who walks prone (without seeing) on his face, more rightly guided, or he who (sees and) walks upright on the Straight Way (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism)?
t.54: اچھا وه شخص زیاده ہدایت واﻻ ہے جو اپنے منھ کے بل اوندھا ہو کر چلے یا وه جو سیدھا (پیروں کے بل) راه راست پر چلا ہو؟

t.149: Say, “It is He Who initiated youand made for you hearing and sight(s) and burning hearts; rarely do you give thanks.”
t.84: Say, “He is the One who has originated you, and made for you ears and eyes and hearts. How little you pay gratitude!”
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘It is He who brought you into being, He who endowed you with hearing, sight, and understanding- what small thanks you give!’
t.95: Say: “He it is Who has brought you into being, and has given you hearing and sight, and has given you hearts to think and understand. How seldom do you give thanks!”
t.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
t.22: Say: "It is He Who has created you (and made you grow), and made for you the faculties of hearing, seeing, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give.
t.203: Say it is He Who has created you, and endowed you with hearing (ears) and seeing (eyes), and hearts. Little thanks you give.
t.54: کہہ دیجئے کہ وہی (اللہ) ہے جس نے تمہیں پیدا کیا اور تمہارے کان آنکھیں اور دل بنائے تم بہت ہی کم شکر گزاری کرتے ہو.

t.149: Say, “It is He Who scattered youon earth, and to Him you will be herded.”
t.84: Say, “He is the One who has scattered you on the earth, and to Him you will be assembled.”
t.85: Say, ‘It is He who scattered you throughout the earth, He to whom you will be gathered.’
t.95: Say: “Allah it is Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you will be mustered.”
t.19: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered.
t.22: Say: "It is He Who has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered together."
t.203: Say: "It is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him shall you be gathered (in the Hereafter)."
t.54: کہہ دیجئے! کہ وہی ہے جس نے تمہیں زمین میں پھیلا دیا اور اس کی طرف سے تم اکٹھے کیے جاؤ گے.

t.149: And they say, “When will this promise be fulfilled if youare truthful?”
t.84: And they say, “When will this promise (of the Day of Judgment) be fulfilled, if you are true?”
t.85: They say, ‘If what you say is true, when will this promise be fulfilled?’
t.95: They say: “If you are truthful, tell us when will this promise (of the Hereafter) be fulfilled?”
t.19: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
t.22: They ask: When will this promise be (fulfilled)? - If ye are telling the truth.
t.203: They say: "When will this promise (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) come to pass if you are telling the truth.?"
t.54: (کافر) پوچھتے ہیں کہ وه وعده کب ﻇاہر ہوگا اگر تم سچے ہو (تو بتاؤ؟)

t.149: Say, “Indeed, knowledge is only with Allah, and indeed, I am only an evident warner.”
t.84: Say, “The knowledge (of that Day) is only with Allah, and I am only a plain warner.
t.85: Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of this: my only duty is to give clear warning.’
t.95: Say: “Allah alone knows about that; and I am no more than a plain warner.”
t.19: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner;
t.22: Say: "As to the knowledge of the time, it is with Allah alone: I am (sent) only to warn plainly in public."
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "The knowledge (of its exact time) is with Allâh only, and I am only a plain warner."
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ اس کا علم تو اللہ ہی کو ہے، میں تو صرف کھلے طور پر آگاه کر دینے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: But when they saw it approaching, the faces of those who had denied turned gloomy, and it was said, “This is what youused to claim (would never happen) .”
t.84: Then, once they will see it approaching, the faces of the disbelievers will be turned awkward, and it will be said, “This is what you were calling for!”
t.85: When they see it close at hand, the disbelievers’ faces will be gloomy, and it will be said, ‘This is what you were calling for.’
t.95: When they will see it near at hand, the faces of all those who had denied it will be distraught, and then they will be told: “This is the doom which you used to ask for.”
t.19: But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call.
t.22: At length, when they see it close at hand, grieved will be the faces of the Unbelievers, and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise fulfilled), which ye were calling for!"
t.203: But when they will see it (the torment on the Day of Resurrection) approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will change and turn black with sadness and in grief and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise) which you were calling for!"
t.54: جب یہ لوگ اس وعدے کو قریب تر پالیں گے اس وقت ان کافروں کے چہرے بگڑ جائیں گے اور کہہ دیا جائے گا کہ یہی ہے جسے تم طلب کیا کرتے تھے.

t.149: Say, “Have you seen: if Allah makes me and those with me perish or has mercy on us, who then will protect the deniers from a painful punishment?”
t.84: Say, “Tell me, if Allah destroys me and those who are with me (as you wish), or has mercy on us (as we wish), who can (in either case) save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”
t.85: Say, ‘Just think- regardless of whether God destroys me and my followers or has mercy on us- who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?’
t.95: Say to them: “Did you ever consider: whether Allah destroys me and those that are with me, or shows mercy to us, who can protect the unbelievers from a grievous chastisement?”
t.19: Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom?
t.22: Say: "See ye?- If Allah were to destroy me, and those with me, or if He bestows His Mercy on us,- yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from a grievous Penalty?"
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If Allâh destroys me, and those with me, or He bestows His Mercy on us - who can save the disbelievers from a painful torment?"
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! اچھا اگر مجھے اور میرے ساتھیوں کو اللہ تعالیٰ ہلاک کردے یا ہم پر رحم کرے (بہر صورت یہ تو بتاؤ) کہ کافروں کو دردناک عذاب سے کون بچائے گا؟

t.149: Say, “He is the All-Merciful; we have attained faith in Him, and in Him alone we have placed our trust, and soon youwill know who is in evident misguidance.”
t.84: Say, “He is the RaHmān; we have believed in Him, and in Him we placed our trust. So, you will soon come to know who is in open error.”
t.85: Say, ‘He is the Lord of Mercy; we believe in Him; we put our trust in Him. You will come to know in time who is in obvious error.’
t.95: Say to them: “He is Merciful, and it is in Him that we believe, and it is in Him that we put all our trust. Soon will you know who is in manifest error.”
t.19: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest.
t.22: Say: "He is (Allah) Most Gracious: We have believed in Him, and on Him have we put our trust: So, soon will ye know which (of us) it is that is in manifest error."
t.203: Say: "He is the Most Gracious (Allâh), in Him we believe, and in Him we put our trust. So you will come to know who it is that is in manifest error."
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! کہ وہی رحمٰن ہے ہم تو اس پر ایمان ﻻچکے اور اسی پر ہمارا بھروسہ ہے۔ تمہیں عنقریب معلوم ہو جائے گا کہ صریح گمراہی میں کون ہے؟

t.149: Say, “Have youseen:if your water drains away, who then will bring you pure running water?”
t.84: Say, “Tell me, Should your water vanish into the earth, who will bring you a flowing (stream of) water?
t.85: Say, ‘Just think: if all your water were to sink deep into the earth who could give you flowing water in its place?’
t.95: Say to them: “Did you even consider: if all the water that you have (in the wells) were to sink down into the depths of the earth, who will produce for you clear, flowing water?”
t.19: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water?
t.22: Say: "See ye?- If your stream be some morning lost (in the underground earth), who then can supply you with clear-flowing water?"
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If (all) your water were to sink away, who then can supply you with flowing (spring) water?"
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! کہ اچھا یہ تو بتاؤ کہ اگر تمہارے (پینے کا) پانی زمین میں اتر جائے تو کون ہے جو تمہارے لیے نتھرا ہوا پانی ﻻئے؟

t.149: Nûn. By the pen and all that they inscribe.
t.84: Nūn , by the pen and what they write,
t.85: Nun By the pen! By all they write!
t.95: Nun. By the pen and what the scribes write.
t.19: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),
t.22: Nun. By the Pen and the (Record) which (men) write,-
t.203: Nûn. [These letters (Nun, etc.) are one of the miracles of the Qur’an, and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the pen and by what they (the angels) write (in the Records of men).
t.54: ن، قسم ہے قلم کی اور اس کی جو کچھ کہ وه (فرشتے) لکھتے ہیں.

t.149: YourLord’s blessing does not make you a madman.
t.84: with the grace of your Lord, you are not insane.
t.85: Your Lord’s grace does not make you [Prophet] a madman:
t.95: By your Lord's Grace, you are not afflicted with madness,
t.19: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.
t.22: Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed.
t.203: You (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), by the Grace of your Lord, are not mad.
t.54: تو اپنے رب کے فضل سے دیوانہ نہیں ہے.

t.149: And most surely, for youis an unfailing reward.
t.84: And you will definitely have a reward that will never end.
t.85: you will have a never-ending reward––
t.95: and surely yours shall be a never-ending reward,
t.19: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.
t.22: Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing:
t.203: And Verily, for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) will be an endless reward.
t.54: اور بے شک تیرے لیے بے انتہا اجر ہے.*

t.149: And very truly, youare of great moral character.
t.84: And you are surely on an excellent standard of character.
t.85: truly you have a strong character––
t.95: and you are certainly on the most exalted standard of moral excellence.
t.19: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.
t.22: And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character.
t.203: And Verily, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are on an exalted (standard of) character.
t.54: اور بیشک تو بہت بڑے (عمده) اخلاق پر ہے.

t.149: Thus youshall see and they shall see
t.84: So, you will see, and they will see
t.85: and soon you will see, as will they,
t.95: So you will soon see, and they too will see,
t.19: And thou wilt see and they will see
t.22: Soon wilt thou see, and they will see,
t.203: You will see, and they will see,
t.54: پس اب تو بھی دیکھ لے گا اور یہ بھی دیکھ لیں گے.

t.149: which of you is the demented.
t.84: which of you is demented.
t.85: which of you is afflicted with madness.
t.95: which of you is afflicted with madness.
t.19: Which of you is the demented.
t.22: Which of you is afflicted with madness.
t.203: Which of you is afflicted with madness.
t.54: کہ تم میں سے کون فتنہ میں پڑا ہوا ہے.

t.149: Indeed, yourLord is He Who knows better who has strayed from His way, and it is He Who knows better of the rightly guided.
t.84: Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from his way, and He is well aware of those who are on the right path.
t.85: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is rightly guided.
t.95: Surely your Lord knows well those who have strayed from His Way just as He knows well those who are on the Right Way.
t.19: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.
t.22: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which (among men) hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive (true) Guidance.
t.203: Verily, your Lord is the Best Knower of him who has gone astray from His Path, and He is the Best Knower of those who are guided.
t.54: بیشک تیرا رب اپنی راه سے بہکنے والوں کو خوب جانتا ہے، اور وه راه یافتہ لوگوں کو بھی بخوبی جانتا ہے.

t.149: So do not obey the disbelievers;
t.84: So, do not obey those who reject (the true faith.)
t.85: So do not yield to those who deny the truth––
t.95: Do not, then, yield to those who reject the Truth, decrying it as false;
t.19: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters
t.22: So hearken not to those who deny (the Truth).
t.203: So (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) obey you not the deniers [(of Islâmic Monotheism - those who belie the Verses of Allâh), the Oneness of Allâh, and the Messengership of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم]
t.54: پس تو جھٹلانے والوں کی نہ مان.

t.149: they would like you to compromise, then they too would compromise.
t.84: They wish that you become flexible (in your faith), so that they should become flexible (in their hostile attitude.)
t.85: they want you to compromise with them and then they will compromise with you––
t.95: they would wish you to be pliant so that they too may be pliant.
t.19: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.
t.22: Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant.
t.203: They wish that you should compromise (in religion out of courtesy) with them: so they (too) would compromise with you.
t.54: وه تو چاہتے ہیں کہ تو ذرا ڈھیلا ہو تو یہ بھی ڈھیلے پڑ جائیں.

t.149: And do not obey any despicable swearer,
t.84: And do not obey any contemptible one who swears much,
t.85: do not yield to any contemptible swearer,
t.95: And do not yield to any contemptible swearer,
t.19: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,
t.22: Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths,
t.203: And (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) obey you not everyone Hallaf Mahîn (the one who swears much and is a liar or is worthless). [Tafsir At-Tabari]
t.54: اور تو کسی ایسے شخص کا بھی کہا نہ ماننا جو زیاده قسمیں کھانے واﻻ.

t.149: backbiter, spreader of malicious gossip,
t.84: a slanderer who goes about with calumnies,
t.85: to any backbiter, slander-monger,
t.95: the fault-finder who goes around slandering,
t.19: Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders,
t.22: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,
t.203: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,
t.54: بے وقار، کمینہ، عیب گو، چغل خور.

t.149: preventer of good, transgressor, sinful,
t.84: one who prevents good, (and who is) transgressor, sinful,
t.85: or hinderer of good, to anyone who is sinful, aggressive,
t.95: the hinderer of good, the transgressor, the sinful;
t.19: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor
t.22: (Habitually) hindering (all) good, transgressing beyond bounds, deep in sin,
t.203: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, sinful,
t.54: بھلائی سے روکنے واﻻ حد سے بڑھ جانے واﻻ گنہگار.

t.149: brutal; moreover, of spurious parentage!
t.84: harsh, (and) after all that, notorious,
t.85: coarse, and on top of all that, an imposter.
t.95: the coarse-grained, and above all mean and ignoble;
t.19: Greedy therewithal, intrusive.
t.22: Violent (and cruel),- with all that, base-born,-
t.203: Cruel, and moreover base-born (of illegitimate birth).
t.54: گردن کش پھر ساتھ ہی بے نسب ہو.

t.149: Just because he has money and sons,
t.84: (do not obey such a person merely) because he is a man of wealth and sons.
t.85: Just because he has wealth and sons,
t.95: (who so acts) simply because he has wealth and sons,
t.19: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children
t.22: Because he possesses wealth and (numerous) sons.
t.203: (He was so) because he had wealth and children.
t.54: اس کی سرکشی صرف اس لیے ہے کہ وه مال واﻻ اور بیٹوں واﻻ ہے.

t.149: when Our signsare read to him, he says, “Legends of the ancients!”
t.84: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “(These are) the tales of the ancient.”
t.85: when our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘These are just ancient fables.’
t.95: and whenever Our verses are rehearsed to him, he says: “These are fairy- tales of times gone by.”
t.19: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.
t.22: When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, "Tales of the ancients", he cries!
t.203: When Our Verses (of the Qur’ân) are recited to him, he says: "Tales of the men of old!"
t.54: جب اس کے سامنے ہماری آیتیں پڑھی جاتی ہیں تو کہہ دیتا ہے کہ یہ تو اگلوں کے قصے ہیں.

t.149: We will brand him on the snout.
t.84: We will soon brand him on the snout.
t.85: We shall brand him on the snout!
t.95: Soon shall We brand him on his snout.
t.19: We shall brand him on the nose.
t.22: Soon shall We brand (the beast) on the snout!
t.203: We shall brand him on the snout (nose)!
t.54: ہم بھی اس کی سونڈ (ناک) پر داغ دیں گے.

t.149: Indeed, We have tested them as We tested the fellows of the garden, when they swore to harvest it in the morning
t.84: We have tested them as We had tested the Owners of the Garden, when they had sworn an oath that they would pluck its fruits on the next morning,
t.85: We have tried them as We tried the owners of a certain garden, who swore that they would harvest its fruits in the morning
t.95: We have put them [i.e., the Makkans] to test even as We put to test the owners of the orchard when they vowed that they would gather the fruit of their orchard in the morning,
t.19: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,
t.22: Verily We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they resolved to gather the fruits of the (garden) in the morning.
t.203: Verily, We have tried them as We tried the people of the garden, when they swore to pluck the fruits of the (garden) in the morning,
t.54: بیشک ہم نے انہیں اسی طرح آزما لیا جس طرح ہم نے باغ والوں کو آزمایا تھا جبکہ انہوں نے قسمیں کھائیں کہ صبح ہوتے ہی اس باغ کے پھل اتار لیں گے.

t.149: without any reservation.
t.84: and did not make any exception (by saying inshā’allāh ).
t.85: and made no allowance [for the Will of God]:
t.95: without making any allowance (for the will of Allah).
t.19: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);
t.22: But made no reservation, ("If it be Allah's Will").
t.203: Without saying: Inshâ’ Allâh (If Allâh wills).
t.54: اور انشاءاللہ نہ کہا.

t.149: Then a sweeping visitation from yourLord swept through it while they were asleep,
t.84: Then, there whirled around it a whirl (of calamity) from your Lord, while they were asleep.
t.85: a disaster from your Lord struck the garden as they slept
t.95: Thereupon a calamity from your Lord passed over it while they were asleep,
t.19: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
t.22: Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep.
t.203: Then there passed by on the (garden) a visitation (fire) from your Lord at night and burnt it while they were asleep.
t.54: پس اس پر تیرے رب کی جانب سے ایک بلا چاروں طرف گھوم گئی اور یہ سو ہی رہے تھے.

t.149: and in the morning it was as though harvested.
t.84: Thus, on the next morning, it was like a harvested field.
t.85: and by morning it was stripped bare, a desolate land.
t.95: and so by morning the orchard lay as though it had been fully harvested.
t.19: And in the morning it was as if plucked.
t.22: So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered).
t.203: So the (garden) became black by the morning, like a pitch dark night (in complete ruins).
t.54: پس وه باغ ایسا ہو گیا جیسے کٹی ہوئی کھیتی.

t.149: So they called to each other in the early morning:
t.84: So, they called out each other as the morning broke,
t.85: Still they called each other at daybreak,
t.95: At daybreak they called out to one another:
t.19: And they cried out one unto another in the morning,
t.22: As the morning broke, they called out, one to another,-
t.203: Then they called out one to another as soon as the morning broke.
t.54: اب صبح ہوتے ہی انہوں نے ایک دوسرے کو آوازیں دیں.

t.149: “Go early to yourfield if you are going to harvest.”
t.84: saying, “Set out early, if you are going to pluck (the fruits).”
t.85: ‘Go early to your field if you wish to gather all its fruits,’
t.95: “Hurry to your orchard if you would gather its fruit.”
t.19: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).
t.22: "Go ye to your tilth (betimes) in the morning, if ye would gather the fruits."
t.203: Saying: "Go to your tilth in the morning, if you would pluck the fruits."
t.54: کہ اگر تمہیں پھل اتارنے ہیں تو اپنی کھیتی پر سویرے ہی سویرے چل پڑو.

t.149: So they set out, murmuring to one another,
t.84: So they set out while they were whispering to each other,
t.85: and went off, whispering,
t.95: So off they went, whispering to one another:
t.19: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:
t.22: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones, (saying)-
t.203: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones (saying):
t.54: پھر یہ سب چپکے چپکے یہ باتیں کرتے ہوئے چلے.

t.149: “Not one destitute person is to enter it upon youtoday.”
t.84: saying, “Let no poor man enter into it upon you today.”
t.85: ‘Make sure no poor person enters the garden today!’––
t.95: “No destitute person shall enter it today.”
t.19: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.
t.22: "Let not a single indigent person break in upon you into the (garden) this day."
t.203: "No Miskîn (poor man) shall enter upon you into it today."
t.54: کہ آج کے دن کوئی مسکین تمہارے پاس نہ آنے پائے.*

t.149: And early they went, resolved in intent.
t.84: And in early hours they rushed quickly, while they were (assuming themselves) powerful (to pluck the fruits and prevent the poor.)
t.85: they left early, bent on their purpose-
t.95: They went forth early, believing that they had the power (to gather the fruit).
t.19: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.
t.22: And they opened the morning, strong in an (unjust) resolve.
t.203: And they went in the morning with strong intention, thinking that they have power (to prevent the poor taking anything of the fruits therefrom).
t.54: اور لپکے ہوئے صبح صبح گئے۔ (سمجھ رہے تھے) کہ ہم قابو پاگئے.

t.149: But when they saw it, they said, “Indeed, we are surely misguided;
t.84: But when they saw it (the place of the ruined garden), they said, “We have missed the way.”
t.85: but when they saw the garden, they said, ‘We must have lost our way!
t.95: But as soon as they beheld the orchard, (they cried out): “We have certainly lost the way;
t.19: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!
t.22: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "We have surely lost our way:
t.203: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "Verily, we have gone astray."
t.54: جب انہوں نے باغ دیکھا تو کہنے لگے یقیناً ہم راستہ بھول گئے.

t.149: rather, we are deprived.”
t.84: (Then, once they realized that the garden is the same, but it has been destroyed, they said,) “No, but we are deprived (of the fruits).”
t.85: No- we are ruined!’
t.95: rather, we are utterly ruined.”
t.19: Nay, but we are desolate!
t.22: "Indeed we are shut out (of the fruits of our labour)!"
t.203: (Then they said): "Nay! Indeed we are deprived of (the fruits)!"
t.54: نہیں نہیں بلکہ ہماری قسمت پھوٹ گئی.

t.149: The most reasonable of them said, “Did I not tell you, ‘if only you would highly exalt(God) ?’”
t.84: Said he who was the best among them, “Did I not say to you, ‘Why do you not pronounce tasbīH (Allah’s purity)?”
t.85: The wisest of them said, ‘Did I not say to you, “Will you not glorify God?”’-
t.95: The best among them said: “Did I not say to you: why do you not give glory to (your Lord)?”
t.19: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?
t.22: Said one of them, more just (than the rest): "Did I not say to you, 'Why not glorify (Allah)?'"
t.203: The best among them said: "Did I not tell you: why say you not: Inshâ’ Allâh (If Allâh wills)."
t.54: ان سب میں جو بہتر تھا اس نے کہا کہ میں تم سے نہ کہتا تھا کہ تم اللہ کی پاکیزگی کیوں نہیں بیان کرتے؟

t.149: They said, “Highly Exalted is our Lord; indeed, we were unjust.”
t.84: They said, “We pronounce the purity of our Lord. No doubt, we were wrongdoers.”
t.85: they said, ‘Glory be to God, Our Lord! Truly, we were doing wrong!’-
t.95: They cried out: “Glory be to our Lord! Certainly we were sinners.”
t.19: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.
t.22: They said: "Glory to our Lord! Verily we have been doing wrong!"
t.203: They said: "Glory to Our Lord! Verily, we have been Zâlimûn (wrong-doers)."
t.54: تو سب کہنے لگے ہمارا رب پاک ہے بیشک ہم ہی ﻇالم تھے.

t.149: Then they turned to each other, blaming one another.
t.84: Then, (at the beginning,) they started reproaching one another;
t.85: and then they turned to each other in mutual reproach.
t.95: Then they began to reproach one another.
t.19: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.
t.22: Then they turned, one against another, in reproach.
t.203: Then they turned one against another, blaming.
t.54: پھر وه ایک دوسرے کی طرف رخ کر کے آپس میں ملامت کرنے لگے.

t.149: They said, “Woe to us; indeed, we have exceeded all limits.
t.84: (and at last,) they said, “Woe to us! In fact, we (all) were outrageous.
t.85: They said, ‘Alas for us! We have done terrible wrong,
t.95: They said: “Woe to us! We had indeed transgressed.
t.19: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.
t.22: They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed!
t.203: They said: "Woe to us! Verily, we were Tâghûn (transgressors and disobedient)
t.54: کہنے لگے ہائے افسوس! یقیناً ہم سرکش تھے.

t.149: Perhaps our Lord will give us a better substitute for it. Indeed, to our Lord we turn wishfully.”
t.84: We hope that our Lord will give us in exchange something better than this. Truly we turn to Allah.”
t.85: but maybe our Lord will give us something better in its place: we truly turn to Him in hope.’
t.95: Maybe our Lord will give us a better orchard in its place; to our Lord do we penitently turn.”
t.19: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.
t.22: "It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this: for we do turn to Him (in repentance)!"
t.203: We hope that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this. Truly, we turn to our Lord (wishing for good that He may forgive our sins and reward us in the Hereafter).
t.54: کیا عجب ہے کہ ہمارا رب ہمیں اس سے بہتر بدلہ دے دے ہم تو اب اپنے رب سے ہی آرزو رکھتے ہیں.

t.149: Such is the punishment(of this world) ; but the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
t.84: In this way the punishment comes. And, of course, the punishment of the Hereafter is even greater, if they but realize!
t.85: Such is the punishment [in this life], but greater still is the punishment in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
t.95: Such is the chastisement; and the chastisement of the Hereafter is assuredly even greater, if only they knew.
t.19: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.
t.22: Such is the Punishment (in this life); but greater is the Punishment in the Hereafter,- if only they knew!
t.203: Such is the punishment (in this life), but truly, the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they but knew.
t.54: یوں ہی آفت آتی ہے اور آخرت کی آفت بہت بڑی ہے۔ کاش انہیں سمجھ ہوتی.

t.149: Indeed, for the people who are mindful(of God) are Gardens of Bliss, with their Lord.
t.84: Surely, for the God-fearing there are gardens of bliss.
t.85: There will be Gardens of bliss for those who are mindful of God.
t.95: Surely the God-fearing shall have Gardens of bliss with their Lord.
t.19: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.
t.22: Verily, for the Righteous, are Gardens of Delight, in the Presence of their Lord.
t.203: Verily, for the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) are Gardens of delight (Paradise) with their Lord.
t.54: پرہیزگاروں کے لیے ان کے رب کے پاس نعمتوں والی جنتیں ہیں.

t.149: Shall We treat the Muslimslike the criminals?
t.84: Otherwise, shall We make the obedient like the sinners?
t.85: Should We treat those who submit to Us as We treat those who do evil?
t.95: What! Shall We treat those who have submitted (to Our command) like those who have acted as criminals?
t.19: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?
t.22: Shall We then treat the People of Faith like the People of Sin?
t.203: Shall We then treat the Muslims (believers of Islamic Monotheism, doers of righteous deeds) like the Mujrimûn (criminals, polytheists and disbelievers, etc.)?
t.54: کیا ہم مسلمانوں کو مثل گناه گاروں کے کردیں گے.

t.149: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
t.84: What has happened to you? How do you judge?
t.85: What is the matter with you? On what basis do you judge?
t.95: What is the matter with you? How ill do you judge!
t.19: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!
t.22: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
t.203: What is the matter with you? How judge you?
t.54: تمہیں کیا ہوگیا، کیسے فیصلے کر رہے ہو؟

t.149: Or do you have a scripture in which you study,
t.84: Do you have a book in which you read
t.85: Do you have a Scripture that tells you
t.95: Or do you have a Book wherein you read
t.19: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn
t.22: Or have ye a book through which ye learn-
t.203: Or have you a Book wherein you learn,
t.54: کیا تمہارے پاس کوئی کتاب ہے جس میں تم پڑھتے ہو؟

t.149: wherein there is whatever you choose?
t.84: that for you there is what you choose?
t.85: that you will be granted whatever you choose?
t.95: that (in the Hereafter) you shall have all that you choose for yourselves?
t.19: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?
t.22: That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose?
t.203: That you shall therein have all that you choose?
t.54: کہ اس میں تمہاری من مانی باتیں ہوں؟

t.149: Or do you have oaths from Us, binding until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you demand?
t.84: Or do you have oaths sworn by Us, remaining effective up to the Day of Judgment, that you will get what you decide?
t.85: Have you received from Us solemn oaths, binding to the Day of Resurrection, that you will get whatever you yourselves decide?
t.95: Or have We sworn a covenant with you which We are bound to keep till the Day of Resurrection, (a covenant requiring that whatever you ordain for yourselves shall be yours)?
t.19: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?
t.22: Or have ye Covenants with Us to oath, reaching to the Day of Judgment, (providing) that ye shall have whatever ye shall demand?
t.203: Or have you oaths from Us, reaching to the Day of Resurrection, that yours will be what you judge?
t.54: یا تم نے ہم سے کچھ قسمیں لی ہیں؟ جو قیامت تک باقی رہیں کہ تمہارے لیے وه سب ہے جو تم اپنی طرف سے مقرر کر لو.

t.149: Askthem which of them guarantees that.
t.84: Ask them which of them stands surety for that.
t.85: Ask them [Prophet] which of them will guarantee this.
t.95: Ask them: “Which of them can guarantee that?
t.19: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!
t.22: Ask thou of them, which of them will stand surety for that!
t.203: Ask them, which of them will stand surety for that!
t.54: ان سے پوچھو تو کہ ان میں سے کون اس بات کا ذمہدار (اور دعویدار) ہے؟

t.149: Or do they have associates? Then let them bring their associates if they are truthful.
t.84: Or do they have associate-gods (who have guaranteed safety for them)? Then, let them bring their associate-gods, if they are true.
t.85: Do they have ‘partners’ [besides God]? Let them produce their ‘partners’, if what they say is true.
t.95: Or has something been guaranteed by any of those whom they associate with Allah in His Divinity?” If so, let them bring forth their associates, if they are truthful.
t.19: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful
t.22: Or have they some “ Partners ” (in Godhead)? Then let them produce Their “ partners ”, If they are truthful !
t.203: Or have they "partners"? Then let them bring their "partners" if they are truthful!
t.54: کیا ان کے کوئی شریک ہیں؟ تو چاہئے کہ اپنے اپنے شریکوں کو لے آئیں اگر یہ سچے ہیں.

t.149: On the day when the shin is exposedand they are called to prostrate themselves, but theyare unable to.
t.84: On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called upon to prostrate themselves, they will not be able to.
t.85: On the Day when matters become dire, they will be invited to prostrate themselves but will be prevented from doing so,
t.95: On the Day when the dreadful calamity will unfold, when people will be summoned to prostrate themselves, and yet they will not be able to prostrate.
t.19: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,
t.22: The Day that the shin shall be laid bare, and they shall be summoned to bow in adoration, but they shall not be able,-
t.203: (Remember) the Day when the Shin shall be laid bare (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) and they shall be called to prostrate themselves (to Allâh), but they (hypocrites) shall not be able to do so.
t.54: جس دن پنڈلی کھول دی جائے گی اور سجدے کے لیے بلائے جائیں گے تو (سجده) نہ کر سکیں گے.

t.149: Their sight(s) (subdued) in reverence, humiliation overwhelms them, for they had been called to prostrate themselves when they were sound.
t.84: With their eyes downcast, they will be enveloped by ignominy. They used to be called upon to prostrate when they were healthy (but they did not.)
t.85: and their eyes will be downcast and they will be overwhelmed with shame: they were invited to prostrate themselves when they were safe [but refused].
t.95: Their eyes shall be downcast and ignominy shall overwhelm them. For when they were safe and sound, they were summoned to prostrate themselves, (and they refused).
t.19: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.
t.22: Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused).
t.203: Their eyes will be cast down and ignominy will cover them; they used to be called to prostrate themselves (offer prayers), while they were healthy and good (in the life of the world, but they did not).
t.54: نگاہیں نیچی ہوں گی اور ان پر ذلت و خواری چھارہی ہوگی، حاﻻنکہ یہ سجدے کے لیے (اس وقت بھی) بلائے جاتے تھے جب کہ صحیح سالم تھے.

t.149: So leaveMe to those who reject this discourse; We will draw them forth gradually(to punishment) from where they do not know.
t.84: So, leave Me alone with those who reject this discourse. We will draw them on little by little (towards Hell) from a way they do not know.
t.85: So [Prophet] leave those who reject this revelation to Me: We shall lead them on, step by step, in ways beyond their knowledge;
t.95: So leave Me, (O Prophet), to deal with him who gives the lie to this Discourse. We shall draw them little by little (to their undoing) in a way that they will not know.
t.19: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.
t.22: Then leave Me alone with such as reject this Message: by degrees shall We punish them from directions they perceive not.
t.203: Then leave Me Alone with such as belie this Qur’ân. We shall punish them gradually from directions they perceive not.
t.54: پس مجھے اور اس کلام کو جھٹلانے والے کو چھوڑ دے ہم انہیں اس طرح آہستہ آہستہ کھینچیں گے کہ انہیں معلوم بھی نہ ہوگا.

t.149: And I will give them respite. Indeed, My plot is firm.
t.84: And I give them respite. Indeed, My plan is firm.
t.85: I will allow them more time, for My plan is powerful.
t.95: I am giving them a respite. Great is My scheme!
t.19: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.
t.22: A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan.
t.203: And I will grant them a respite. Verily, My Plan is strong.
t.54: اور میں انہیں ڈھیل دوں گا، بیشک میری تدبیر بڑی مضبوط ہے.

t.149: Or do youask them for a reward, so they are burdened with debt?
t.84: Is it that you ask them for a fee, due to which they are burdened with debt?
t.85: Do you demand some reward from them that would burden them with debt?
t.95: Or are you asking them for some compensation so that they feel burdened with debt?
t.19: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?
t.22: Or is it that thou dost ask them for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
t.203: Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask them a wage, so that they are heavily burdened with debt?
t.54: کیا تو ان سے کوئی اجرت چاہتا ہے جس کے تاوان سے یہ دبے جاتے ہیں.

t.149: Or do they have(knowledge of) the hidden realm and they are writing it down?
t.84: Or do they have the (knowledge of the) Unseen, and they write it down?
t.85: Do they have knowledge of the unseen that enables them to write it down?
t.95: Or do they have any knowledge of the Unseen which they are now writing down?
t.19: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?
t.22: Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down?
t.203: Or that the Ghaib (the Unseen - here in this Verse it means Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz) is in their hands, so that they can write it down?
t.54: یا کیا ان کے پاس علم غیب ہے جسے وه لکھتے ہوں.

t.149: So wait patiently for the Decree of yourLord, and do not be like the Fellow of the Whale, who cried out in despair.
t.84: So, remain patient with your Lord’s judgment, and be not like the Man of the Fish, he cried out while he was in anguish.
t.85: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: do not be like the man in the whale who called out in distress:
t.95: So bear with patience until the Judgement of your Lord comes, and do not belike the man in the fish (i.e., Jonah) who called out, choking with grief:
t.19: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.
t.22: So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony.
t.203: So wait with patience for the Decision of your Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish - when he cried out (to Us) while he was in deep sorrow. (See the Qur’ân, Verse 21:87).
t.54: پس تو اپنے رب کے حکم کا صبر سے (انتظار کر) اور مچھلی والے کی طرح نہ ہو جا جب کہ اس نے غم کی حالت میں دعا کی.

t.149: Were it not for his Lord’s favor that reached him, he would have been thrown into the wilderness, fully despised.
t.84: Had not a favour from His Lord come to his help, he would have been cast in the wilderness in a reproachable state.
t.85: if his Lord’s grace had not reached him, he would have been left, abandoned and blameworthy, on the barren shore,
t.95: had his Lord not bestowed His favour upon him, he would have been cast upon that barren shore (and would have remained there) in disgrace.
t.19: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.
t.22: Had not Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been cast off on the naked shore, in disgrace.
t.203: Had not a Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been (left in the stomach of the fish, but We forgave him): so he was cast off on the naked shore, while he was to be blamed.
t.54: اگر اسے اس کے رب کی نعمت نہ پالیتی تو یقیناً وه برے حالوں میں چٹیل میدان میں ڈال دیا جاتا.

t.149: But his Lord chose him and made him one of the righteous.
t.84: Then his Lord chose him, and made him one of the righteous.
t.85: but his Lord chose him and made him one of the Righteous.
t.95: But his Lord exalted him, and included him among His righteous servants.
t.19: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.
t.22: Thus did his Lord choose him and make him of the Company of the Righteous.
t.203: Then his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
t.54: اسے اس کے رب نے پھر نوازا اور اسے نیک کاروں میں کر دیا.

t.149: Those who have denied almost stab youwith their sight(s) when they hear the Reminder, and say, “He is indeed a madman!”
t.84: And indeed the disbelievers seem to trip you up with their glances when they hear the Reminder, and say, “He is a madman indeed.”
t.85: The disbelievers almost strike you down with their looks when they hear the Quran. They say, ‘He must be mad!’
t.95: When the unbelievers hear this Exhortation, they look at you as though they would knock you off your feet with their (hostile) glances. They say: “Surely he is afflicted with madness”;
t.19: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;
t.22: And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed!"
t.203: And verily, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes (through hatred) when they hear the Reminder (the Qur’ân), and they say: "Verily, he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a madman!"
t.54: اور قریب ہے کہ کافر اپنی تیز نگاہوں سے آپ کو پھسلا دیں، جب کبھی قرآن سنتے ہیں اور کہہ دیتے ہیں یہ تو ضرور دیوانہ ہے.

t.149: But it is nothing other than a Reminder to(all creatures of) all realms.
t.84: And it is nothing else but a Reminder for all the worlds.
t.85: but truly it is nothing other than a Reminder for all peoples.
t.95: although this is nothing but an Exhortation (to goodness) for everyone in the world.
t.19: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.
t.22: But it is nothing less than a Message to all the worlds.
t.203: But it is nothing else than a Reminder to all the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, and jinn).
t.54: در حقیقت یہ (قرآن) تو تمام جہان والوں کے لیے سراسر نصیحت ہی ہے.

t.149: The Reality.
t.84: The Imminent Happening!
t.85: The Inevitable Hour!
t.95: The indubitable event!
t.19: The Reality!
t.22: The Sure Reality!
t.203: The Inevitable (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: ﺛابت ہونے والی.

t.149: What is the Reality?
t.84: What is the Imminent Happening?
t.85: What is the Inevitable Hour?
t.95: And what is that indubitable event?
t.19: What is the Reality?
t.22: What is the Sure Reality?
t.203: What is the Inevitable?
t.54: ﺛابت ہونے والی کیا ہے؟

t.149: And what can make yourealize what the Reality is?
t.84: And what can let you know what the Imminent happening is?
t.85: What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is?
t.95: And what do you know what that indubitable event is?
t.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!
t.22: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?
t.203: And what will make you know what the Inevitable is?
t.54: اور تجھے کیا معلوم ہے کہ وه ﺛابت شده کیا ہے؟

t.149: Thamûd and ʻĀd disbelieved in the Shocking Event.
t.84: Thamūd and ‘Ād had denied (the happening of) the Shocking Event (the Day of Judgment).
t.85: The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blowwould come:
t.95: The Thamud and the Ad denied the (possibility of a) sudden calamity, calling it false.
t.19: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.
t.22: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!
t.203: Thamûd and ‘Âd people denied the Qâri‘ah (the striking Hour of Judgement)!
t.54: اس کھڑکا دینے والی کو ﺛمود اور عاد نے جھٹلا دیا تھا

t.149: So as for Thamûd, they were annihilated by the Overwhelming.
t.84: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by that (dreadful cry), which exceeded all limits.
t.85: Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast;
t.95: Then the Thamud were destroyed by an awesome upheaval;
t.19: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.
t.22: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!
t.203: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by the awful cry!
t.54: (جس کے نتیجہ میں) ﺛمود تو بے حد خوفناک (اور اونچی) آواز سے ہلاک کردیئے گئے.

t.149: And as for ʻĀd, they were annihilated by a furious, roaring wind
t.84: And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a violent windstorm
t.85: Ad was destroyed by a furious wind
t.95: and the Ad were destroyed by a furiously raging wind-storm
t.19: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,
t.22: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;
t.203: And as for ‘Âd, they were destroyed by a furious violent wind!
t.54: اور عاد بیحد تیز وتند ہوا سے غارت کردیئے گئے.

t.149: which He unleashed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so youcould see the people tossed around as though they were stumps of hollow palm trees.
t.84: that He imposed on them for seven nights and eight consecutive days; so you could see them thrown on the ground, as if they were trunks of hollow palm-trees.
t.85: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks.
t.95: which He let loose upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession; so that (if you had been there) you might have seen people lying prostrate, as though they were uprooted trunks of hollowed palm trees.
t.19: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
t.22: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!
t.203: Which Allâh imposed on them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so that you could see men lying overthrown (destroyed), as if they were hollow trunks of date-palms!
t.54: جسے ان پر لگاتار سات رات اور آٹھ دن تک (اللہ نے) مسلط رکھا پس تم دیکھتے کہ یہ لوگ زمین پر اس طرح گر گئے جیسے کہ کھجور کے کھوکھلے تنے ہوں.

t.149: So can yousee any remnant of them?
t.84: Now, do you see any remnant of them?
t.85: Can you see any trace of them now?
t.95: Do you now see any trace of them?
t.19: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?
t.22: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?
t.203: Do you see any remnants of them?
t.54: کیا ان میں سے کوئی بھی تجھے باقی نظر آرہا ہے؟

t.149: Then Pharaoh and whoever was before him and the Overturned Citiescame up with grave offenses
t.84: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and those before him and the overthrown towns came up with evil,
