t.85: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
t.95: Pharaoh and those before him and the people of the overturned habitations all engaged in the same great sin.
t.19: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,
t.22: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.
t.203: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and those before him, and the cities overthrown [the towns of the people of [Lût (Lot)] committed sin.
t.54: فرعون اور اس سے پہلے کے لوگ اور جن کی بستیاں الٹ دی گئی، انہوں نے بھی خطائیں کیں.

t.149: and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an overpowering grip.
t.84: and they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an extremely severe seizure.
t.85: these people committed grave sins and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip.
t.95: They did not follow the Messenger of their Lord, and so He seized them with a severe grip.
t.19: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.
t.22: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.
t.203: And they disobeyed their Lord’s Messenger, so He seized them with a strong punishment.
t.54: اور اپنے رب کے رسول کی نافرمانی کی (بالﺂخر) اللہ نے انہیں (بھی) زبردست گرفت میں لے لیا.

t.149: Indeed, when the waters overflowed We carried youin the running ship,
t.84: When the water overflowed (in the Deluge of NūH), We let you (O mankind,) board the floating ship,
t.85: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship,
t.95: Verily when the water rose to great heights, We bore you upon a floating vessel (i.e. the Ark)
t.19: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship
t.22: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),
t.203: Verily, when the water rose beyond its limits [Nûh’s (Noah) Flood], We carried you (mankind) in the floating [ship that was constructed by Nûh (Noah)]
t.54: جب پانی میں طغیانی آگئی تو اس وقت ہم نے تمہیں کشتی میں چڑھا لیا.

t.149: making it a lesson for you—so that an attentive ear may take heed.
t.84: so that We make it a reminder for you, and so that a preserving ear (that hears their story) may preserve it.
t.85: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed.
t.95: so that We might make it an instructive event for you, and retentive ears might preserve its memory.
t.19: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.
t.22: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.
t.203: That We might make it (Noah’s ship) an admonition for you and that it might be retained by the retaining ears.
t.54: تاکہ اسے تمہارے لیے نصیحت اور یادگار بنادیں، اور (تاکہ) یاد رکھنے والے کان اسے یاد رکھیں.

t.149: Then, when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast,
t.84: Then, once the Trumpet will be blown for the first time,
t.85: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time,
t.95: So when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast
t.19: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast
t.22: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,
t.203: Then when the Trumpet will be blown with one blowing (the first one).
t.54: پس جب کہ صور میں ایک پھونک پھونکی جائے گی.

t.149: and the earth and the mountains are lifted up and crushed with a single crush—
t.84: and the earth and the mountains will be lifted and crushed into pieces with a single blow,
t.85: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow,
t.95: and the earth and the mountains are carried aloft and are crushed to bits at one stroke,
t.19: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,
t.22: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-
t.203: And the earth and the mountains shall be removed from their places, and crushed with a single crushing.
t.54: اور زمین اور پہاڑ اٹھا لیے جائیں گے اور ایک ہی چوٹ میں ریزه ریزه کر دیے جائیں گے.

t.149: on that day, the Inevitable Event shall come to pass
t.84: then on that Day the Happening will happen,
t.85: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass.
t.95: on that Day shall that indubitable event come to pass;
t.19: Then, on that day will the Event befall.
t.22: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.
t.203: Then on that Day shall the (Great) Event befall.
t.54: اس دن ہو پڑنے والی (قیامت) ہو پڑے گی.

t.149: and the heaven shall crack, for on that day it shall be frail.
t.84: and the sky will burst apart, while it will have become frail on that day.
t.85: The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail.
t.95: when the sky will be rent asunder, the grip holding it together having loosened on that Day,
t.19: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.
t.22: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,
t.203: And the heaven will be rent asunder, for that Day it (the heaven) will be frail and torn up.
t.54: اور آسمان پھٹ جائے گا اور اس دن بالکل بودا ہوجائے گا.

t.149: And the angels are ranged around its borders, while eight carry the Throne of yourLord above them on that day.
t.84: And the angels will be on its borders. And on that Day, the Throne of your Lord will be carried above them by eight (angels).
t.85: The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them.
t.95: and the angels will stand on the sides, with eight of them bearing aloft the Throne of your Lord on that Day.
t.19: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.
t.22: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.
t.203: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight angels will, that Day, bear the Throne of your Lord above them.
t.54: اس کے کناروں پر فرشتے ہوں گے، اور تیرے پروردگار کا عرش اس دن آٹھ (فرشتے) اپنے اوپر اٹھائے ہوئے ہوں گے.

t.149: On that day youare presented, and no hidden secret of yours remains hidden.
t.84: On that day, you will be brought forward in a way that no secret of yours will remain secret.
t.85: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden.
t.95: That will be the Day when you shall be brought forth (before Allah) and no secret of yours shall remain hidden.
t.19: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.
t.22: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.
t.203: That Day shall you be brought to Judgement, not a secret of you will be hidden.
t.54: اس دن تم سب سامنے پیش کیے جاؤ گے، تمہارا کوئی بھید پوشیده نہ رہے گا.

t.149: So as for the one who was given his recordin his right hand, he says, “Here, take my record and read it.
t.84: Now, as for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say (to his colleagues), “Come here, read my book.
t.85: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it.
t.95: On that Day, he whose Record is given to him in his right hand will say: “Lo! Read my Record!
t.19: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
t.22: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!
t.203: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Here! read my Record!
t.54: سو جسے اس کا نامہٴ اعمال اس کے دائیں ہاتھ میں دیا جائے گا تو وه کہنے لگے گا کہ لو میرا نامہٴ اعمال پڑھو.

t.149: Indeed, I was certain that I would meet my reckoning.”
t.84: I was sure that I would encounter my reckoning.”
t.85: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’
t.95: Verily I was sure that I would be handed over my account.”
t.19: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.
t.22: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"
t.203: "Surely, I did believe that I shall meet my Account!"
t.54: مجھے تو کامل یقین تھا کہ مجھے اپنا حساب ملنا ہے.

t.149: So he will be in a well-pleasing living,
t.84: So he will be in a well-pleasing life
t.85: and so he will have a pleasant life
t.95: Then he shall find himself in a life of bliss;
t.19: Then he will be in blissful state
t.22: And he will be in a life of Bliss,
t.203: So he shall be in a life, well-pleasing.
t.54: پس وه ایک دل پسند زندگی میں ہوگا.

t.149: in a lofty Garden(of Paradise) ,
t.84: in a lofty garden,
t.85: in a lofty Garden,
t.95: in a lofty Garden
t.19: In a high garden
t.22: In a Garden on high,
t.203: In a lofty Paradise,
t.54: بلند وباﻻ جنت میں.

t.149: its clusters(of fruit) within reach—
t.84: the fruits of which will be close at hand.
t.85: with clustered fruit within his reach.
t.95: the clusters of whose fruit will be hanging low to be within reach (of the inmates of Paradise).
t.19: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.
t.22: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.
t.203: The fruits in bunches whereof will be low and near at hand.
t.54: جس کے میوے جھکے پڑے ہوں گے.

t.149: “Eat and drink with satisfaction on account of what youdidin the days gone by.”
t.84: (It will be said to such people,) “Eat and drink with pleasure, as a reward for what you did in advance during past days.”
t.85: It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’
t.95: (They will be told): “Eat and drink with good cheer as a reward for the good deeds you did in the days that have passed by.”
t.19: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.
t.22: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"
t.203: Eat and drink at ease for that which you have sent on before you in days past!
t.54: (ان سے کہا جائے گا) کہ مزے سے کھاؤ، پیو اپنے ان اعمال کے بدلے جو تم نے گزشتہ زمانے میں کیے.

t.149: But as for the one who was given his recordin his left hand, he says, “I wish I was never given my record
t.84: As for him who will be given his book in his left hand, he will say, “ Oh, would that I had not been given my book,
t.85: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record
t.95: As for him whose Record will be given to him in his left hand, he will exclaim: “Would that I had never been given my Record,
t.19: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
t.22: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!
t.203: But as for him who will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "I wish that I had not been given my Record!
t.54: لیکن جسے اس (کے اعمال) کی کتاب اس کے بائیں ہاتھ میں دی جائے گی، وه تو کہے گا کہ کاش کہ مجھے میری کتاب دی ہی نہ جاتی.

t.149: and never knew what my reckoning was.
t.84: and I had never known what my account is!
t.85: and knew nothing of my Reckoning.
t.95: and had not known my account.
t.19: And knew not what my reckoning!
t.22: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!
t.203: "And that I had never known how my Account is!
t.54: اور میں جانتا ہی نہ کہ حساب کیا ہے.

t.149: If only it was the end!
t.84: Oh, would that it (death) had been the end of the matter!
t.85: How I wish death had been the end of me.
t.95: Oh! Would that the death that came to me in the world had made an end of me!
t.19: Oh, would that it had been death!
t.22: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!
t.203: "Would that it had been my end (death)!
t.54: کاش! کہ موت (میرا) کام ہی تمام کر دیتی.

t.149: My money cannot avail me;
t.84: My wealth has not been of any use to me.
t.85: My wealth has been no use to me,
t.95: My riches have not availed me,
t.19: My wealth hath not availed me,
t.22: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!
t.203: "My wealth has not availed me;
t.54: میرے مال نے بھی مجھے کچھ نفع نہ دیا.

t.149: my power has vanished from me.”
t.84: My power has gone from me for good.”
t.85: and my power has vanished.’
t.95: and my authority has vanished.”
t.19: My power hath gone from me.
t.22: "My power has perished from me!"...
t.203: "My power (and arguments to defend myself) have gone from me!"
t.54: میرا غلبہ بھی مجھ سے جاتا رہا.

t.149: “Takehim and shackle him,
t.84: (Then it will be said to angels,) “Seize him, then put a collar around his neck,
t.85: ‘Take him, put a collar on him,
t.95: (A command will be issued): “Seize him and shackle him,
t.19: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him
t.22: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,
t.203: (It will be said): "Seize him and fetter him;
t.54: (حکم ہوگا) اسے پکڑ لو پھر اسے طوق پہنادو.

t.149: then scorch him in purgatory,
t.84: and then, let him burn in the blazing fire.
t.85: lead him to burn in the blazing Fire,
t.95: then cast him in the Fire,
t.19: And then expose him to hell-fire
t.22: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.
t.203: Then throw him in the blazing Fire.
t.54: پھر اسے دوزخ میں ڈال دو.

t.149: then in a chain whose length is seventy cubits tie him up.
t.84: Thereafter, fasten him with a chain the measure of which is seventy hands.”
t.85: and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long:
t.95: then fasten him with a chain, seventy cubits long.
t.19: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.
t.22: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!
t.203: "Then fasten him with a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits!"
t.54: پھر اسے ایسی زنجیر میں جس کی پیمائش ستر ہاتھ کی ہے جکڑ دو.

t.149: For he would not believe in Allah, the Great,
t.84: Indeed, he did not believe in Allah, the Almighty,
t.85: he would not believe in Almighty God,
t.95: He would not believe in Allah, the Most Great;
t.19: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,
t.22: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.
t.203: Verily, he used not to believe in Allâh, the Most Great,
t.54: بیشک یہ اللہ عظمت والے پرایمان نہ رکھتا تھا.

t.149: nor would he urge(others to serve) food to the destitute.
t.84: and did not persuade (others) to feed the needy.
t.85: he never encouraged feeding the hungry,
t.95: nor would he urge the feeding of the poor.
t.19: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.
t.22: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!
t.203: And urged not on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor).
t.54: اور مسکین کے کھلانے پر رغبت نہ دﻻتا تھا.

t.149: So he has no intimate(friend) here today,
t.84: So, he has no friend here today,
t.85: so today he has no real friend here,
t.95: Today he has been left here friendless;
t.19: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,
t.22: "So no friend hath he here this Day.
t.203: So no friend has he here this Day,
t.54: پس آج اس کا نہ کوئی دوست ہے.

t.149: nor any food except scum,
t.84: nor any food except that which comes out from wounds when washing,
t.85: and the only food he has is the filth
t.95: and has no food except the filth from the washing of wounds,
t.19: Nor any food save filth
t.22: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,
t.203: Nor any food except filth from the washing of wounds.
t.54: اور نہ سوائے پیﭗ کے اس کی کوئی غذا ہے.

t.149: which none eats except the wrongdoers.”
t.84: which is eaten by none but the sinners.
t.85: that only sinners eat.’
t.95: which only the sinners will eat.”
t.19: Which none but sinners eat.
t.22: "Which none do eat but those in sin."
t.203: None will eat it except the Khâti’ûn (sinners, disbelievers, polytheists).
t.54: جسے گناه گاروں کے سوا کوئی نہیں کھائے گا.

t.149: So I swear by what yousee
t.84: I swear by what you see,
t.85: So I swear by what you can see
t.95: But no; I swear by what you see,
t.19: But nay! I swear by all that ye see
t.22: So I do call to witness what ye see,
t.203: So I swear by whatsoever you see,
t.54: پس مجھے قسم ہے ان چیزوں کی جنہیں تم دیکھتے ہو.

t.149: and what you do not see:
t.84: and what you do not see,
t.85: and by what you cannot see:
t.95: and by what you do not see,
t.19: And all that ye see not
t.22: And what ye see not,
t.203: And by whatsoever you see not,
t.54: اور ان چیزوں کی جنہیں تم نہیں دیکھتے.

t.149: it is indeed the wordof a noble messenger
t.84: it is surely the speech of a noble Messenger, (that he conveys from Allah).
t.85: this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger,
t.95: that this is the speech of an honourable Messenger,
t.19: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.
t.22: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;
t.203: That this is verily, the word of an honoured Messenger [i.e. Jibrîl (Gabriel) or Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم which he has brought from Allâh].
t.54: کہ بیشک یہ (قرآن) بزرگ رسول کا قول ہے.

t.149: and in no way is it the word of a poet—little do youbelieve ,
t.84: and it is not the speech of a poet, (but) little you believe,
t.85: not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-
t.95: not the speech of a poet. Little do you believe!
t.19: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!
t.22: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!
t.203: It is not the word of a poet: little is that you believe!
t.54: یہ کسی شاعر کا قول نہیں (افسوس) تمہیں بہت کم یقین ہے.

t.149: nor is it the speech of a soothsayer—little do you remind yourselves .
t.84: nor is it the speech of a soothsayer, (but) little you heed to the advice.
t.85: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!
t.95: Nor is this the speech of a soothsayer. Little do you reflect!
t.19: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!
t.22: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.
t.203: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer (or a foreteller): little is that you remember!
t.54: اور نہ کسی کاہن کا قول ہے، (افسوس) بہت کم نصیحت لے رہے ہو.

t.149: (It is) a bestowal from on high by the Lord of all realms.
t.84: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
t.85: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds:
t.95: It has been revealed by the Lord of the Universe.
t.19: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
t.22: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
t.203: This is the Revelation sent down from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: (یہ تو) رب العالمین کا اتارا ہوا ہے.

t.149: And had he falsely attributed some statements to Us,
t.84: Had he (the prophet) forged some statements in Our name,
t.85: if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us,
t.95: And if he [i.e., the Prophets] had forged this Discourse and thereafter ascribed it to Us,
t.19: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,
t.22: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,
t.203: And if he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) had forged a false saying concerning Us (Allâh جل جلاله),
t.54: اور اگر یہ ہم پر کوئی بھی بات بنا لیتا.

t.149: We would certainly have seized him strongly,
t.84: We would have certainly seized him by the right hand,
t.85: We would certainly have seized his right hand
t.95: We would surely have seized him by the right hand,
t.19: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
t.22: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,
t.203: We surely would have seized him by his right hand (or with power and might),
t.54: تو البتہ ہم اس کا داہنا ہاتھ پکڑ لیتے.

t.149: then We would certainly have slashed his aorta,
t.84: and then severed his life-artery,
t.85: and cut off his lifeblood,
t.95: and then severed his life vein;
t.19: And then severed his life-artery,
t.22: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:
t.203: And then We certainly would have cut off his life artery (aorta),
t.54: پھر اس کی شہ رگ کاٹ دیتے.

t.149: and in no way could any of you have defended him.
t.84: and none of you could have saved him from it.
t.85: and none of you could have defended him.
t.95: and not one of you would have been able to withhold Us from doing so.
t.19: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.
t.22: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).
t.203: And none of you could have withheld Us from (punishing) him.
t.54: پھر تم میں سے کوئی بھی مجھے اس سے روکنے واﻻ نہ ہوتا.

t.149: And indeed, it is a reminding for the mindful(of God) .
t.84: It is infact a Reminder for the God-fearing.
t.85: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God.
t.95: Surely it is a Good Counsel for the God-fearing.
t.19: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).
t.22: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.
t.203: And verily, this (Qur’an) is a Reminder for the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).
t.54: یقیناً یہ قرآن پرہیزگاروں کے لیے نصیحت ہے.

t.149: And indeed, We do know that some of you are disbelievers.
t.84: And, of course, We know that among you there are deniers.
t.85: We know that some of you consider it to be lies-
t.95: We certainly know that some among you will give the lie to it,
t.19: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).
t.22: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).
t.203: And verily, We know that there are some among you that belie (this Qur’ân). (Tafsir At-Tabarî)
t.54: ہمیں پوری طرح معلوم ہے کہ تم میں سے بعض اس کے جھٹلانے والے ہیں.

t.149: And indeed, it is surely a source of grief for the deniers.
t.84: And surely, it is a cause of remorse for the disbelievers.
t.85: this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers-
t.95: and surely it will be a cause of regret for the unbelievers.
t.19: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.
t.22: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.
t.203: And indeed it (this Qur’ân) will be an anguish for the disbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection).
t.54: بیشک (یہ جھٹلانا) کافروں پر حسرت ہے.

t.149: And indeed, it is surely the truth of certitude.
t.84: And it is surely an absolute truth.
t.85: but it is in fact the certain Truth.
t.95: Certainly it is a Truth of absolute certainty.
t.19: And lo! it is absolute truth.
t.22: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.
t.203: And verily, it (this Qur’ân) is an absolute truth with certainty.
t.54: اور بیشک (و شبہ) یہ یقینی حق ہے.

t.149: So highly exalt the name of yourLord, the Great.
t.84: So, pronounce the purity of the name of your magnificent Lord.
t.85: So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty.
t.95: So glorify the name of your Lord Most Great.
t.19: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
t.22: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.
t.203: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
t.54: پس تو اپنے رب عظیم کی پاکی بیان کر.

t.149: An asker asked abouta punishment sure to come
t.84: A demanding person has asked for the punishment that is going to befall
t.85: A man [mockingly] demanded the punishment.
t.95: A beseecher besought the visitation of chastisement,
t.19: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall
t.22: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-
t.203: A questioner asked concerning a torment about to befall
t.54: ایک سوال کرنے والے نے اس عذاب کا سوال کیا جو واضح ہونے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: for the deniers, that none can repel—
t.84: the disbelievers; there is no one to avert it,
t.85: It will fall on the disbelievers––none can deflect it––
t.95: (a chastisement meant) for the unbelievers, one which none can avert;
t.19: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,
t.22: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-
t.203: Upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,
t.54: کافروں پر، جسے کوئی ہٹانے واﻻ نہیں.

t.149: from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
t.84: (and it will come) from Allah, the Lord of the stairways,
t.85: from God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent,
t.95: a chastisement from Allah, the Lord of the ascending steps,
t.19: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways
t.22: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
t.203: From Allâh, the Lord of the ways of ascent.
t.54: اس اللہ کی طرف سے جو سیڑھیوں واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Unto Him the angels and the Spirit ascend on a day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.
t.84: to whom ascend the angels and the Spirit in a day the length of which is fifty thousand years.
t.85: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him, on a Day whose length is fifty thousand years.
t.95: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in one Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.
t.19: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.
t.22: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:
t.203: The angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] ascend to Him in a Day the measure whereof is fifty thousand years.
t.54: جس کی طرف فرشتے اور روح چڑھتے ہیں ایک دن میں جس کی مقدار پچاس ہزار سال کی ہے.

t.149: So bepatient with beautiful patience.
t.84: So, observe patience, a good patience.
t.85: So be patient, [Prophet], as befits you.
t.95: So, (O Prophet), persevere with gracious perseverance.
t.19: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.
t.22: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).
t.203: So be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), with a good patience.
t.54: پس تو اچھی طرح صبر کر.

t.149: Indeed, they see it distant,
t.84: They see it far off,
t.85: The disbelievers think it is distant,
t.95: Verily they think that the chastisement is far off,
t.19: Lo! they behold it afar off
t.22: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):
t.203: Verily, they see it (the torment) afar off.
t.54: بیشک یہ اس (عذاب) کو دور سمجھ رہے ہیں.

t.149: but We see it near—
t.84: and We see it near.
t.85: but We know it to be close.
t.95: while We think that it is near at hand.
t.19: While we behold it nigh:
t.22: But We see it (quite) near.
t.203: But We see it (quite) near.
t.54: اور ہم اسے قریب ہی دیکھتے ہیں.

t.149: on the day when the sky is like molten brass,
t.84: (This punishment will befall) on the Day when the sky will be like dregs of oil,
t.85: On a Day when the heavens will be like molten brass
t.95: It shall befall on a Day whereon the sky will become like molten brass,
t.19: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,
t.22: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,
t.203: The Day that the sky will be like the boiling filth of oil, (or molten copper or silver or lead).
t.54: جس دن آسمان مثل تیل کی تلچھٹ کے ہو جائے گا.*

t.149: and the mountains are like tufted wool,
t.84: and the mountains will be like dyed wool,
t.85: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
t.95: and the mountains will become like dyed tufts of wool,
t.19: And the hills become as flakes of wool,
t.22: And the mountains will be like wool,
t.203: And the mountains will be like flakes of wool.
t.54: اور پہاڑ مثل رنگین اون کے ہو جائیں گے.

t.149: and no intimate(friend) asks his intimate(friend) —
t.84: and no friend will ask about any friend,
t.85: when no friend will ask about his friend,
t.95: and no bosom friend will enquire about any of his bosom friends
t.19: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend
t.22: And no friend will ask after a friend,
t.203: And no friend will ask a friend (about his condition),
t.54: اور کوئی دوست کسی دوست کو نہ پوچھے گا.

t.149: though they are shown each other. The criminal wishes he could be redeemed from the punishment of that day by sacrificing his children
t.84: (though) they will be made to see each other. A guilty person will desire that he may be able to ransom himself from the torment of that day even by his sons,
t.85: even when they are within sight of one another. The guilty person will wish he could save himself from the suffering of that Day by sacrificing his sons,
t.95: although they shall be within sight of one another. The guilty one would fain ransom himself from the torment of that Day by offering his children,
t.19: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children
t.22: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,
t.203: Though they shall be made to see one another [(i.e. on the Day of Resurrection), there will be none but see his father, children and relatives, but he will neither speak to them nor will ask them for any help]. The Mujrim, (criminal, sinner, disbeliever) would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children,
t.54: (حاﻻنکہ) ایک دوسرے کو دکھا دیئے جائیں گے، گناهگار اس دن کے عذاب کے بدلے فدیے میں اپنے بیٹوں کو.

t.149: and his female companion and his brother
t.84: and his wife and his brother,
t.85: his spouse, his brother,
t.95: and his spouse and his brother,
t.19: And his spouse and his brother
t.22: His wife and his brother,
t.203: And his wife and his brother,
t.54: اپنی بیوی کو اور اپنے بھائی کو.

t.149: and his kinsfolk who shelter him
t.84: and his kindred that sheltered him,
t.85: the kinsfolk who gave him shelter,
t.95: and his kinsfolk who had stood by him,
t.19: And his kin that harboured him
t.22: His kindred who sheltered him,
t.203: And his kindred who sheltered him,
t.54: اور اپنے کنبے کو جو اسے پناه دیتا تھا.

t.149: and everyone on earth, so it would then save him.
t.84: and all those on earth, then he may redeem himself.
t.85: and everyone on earth, if it could save him.
t.95: and all persons of the earth, if only he could thus save himself.
t.19: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.
t.22: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:
t.203: And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him.
t.54: اور روئے زمین کے سب لوگوں کو دینا چاہے گا تاکہ یہ اسے نجات دﻻ دے.

t.149: But no! It is a raging fire
t.84: By no means! It is the flaming fire
t.85: But no! There is a raging flame
t.95: By no means! It will be the fierce flame
t.19: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell
t.22: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-
t.203: By no means! Verily, it will be the Fire of Hell,
t.54: (مگر) ہرگز یہ نہ ہوگا، یقیناً وه شعلہ والی (آگ) ہے.

t.149: that strips away the scalps,
t.84: that will pull out the skin of the scalp.
t.85: that strips away the skin,
t.95: that will strip off the scalp.
t.19: Eager to roast;
t.22: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-
t.203: Taking away (burning completely) the head skin!
t.54: جو منھ اور سر کی کھال کھینچ ﻻنے والی ہے.

t.149: inviting the one who had retreated and turned away
t.84: It will call him who had turned his back and fled away (from the truth)
t.85: and it will claim everyone who rejects the truth, turns away,
t.95: It shall insistently summon him who turned his back and retreated,
t.19: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),
t.22: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).
t.203: Calling (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from Faith) [picking and swallowing them up from that great gathering of mankind on the Day of Resurrection just as a bird picks up a food-grain from the earth with its beak and swallows it up] (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)
t.54: وه ہر اس شخص کو پکارے گی جو پیچھے ہٹتا اور منھ موڑتا ہے.

t.149: and accumulated(wealth) and hoarded.
t.84: and accumulated (wealth) and hoarded (it).
t.85: amasses wealth and hoards it.
t.95: and amassed wealth and covetously hoarded it.
t.19: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.
t.22: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!
t.203: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from spending it in the Cause of Allâh).
t.54: اور جمع کرکے سنبھال رکھتا ہے.

t.149: Indeed, man was created fretful:
t.84: Indeed man is created weak in courage,
t.85: Man was truly created anxious:
t.95: Verily man is impatient by nature:
t.19: Lo! man was created anxious,
t.22: Truly man was created very impatient;-
t.203: Verily, man (disbeliever) was created very impatient;
t.54: بیشک انسان بڑے کچے دل واﻻ بنایا گیا ہے.

t.149: when touched by adversity he is impatient,
t.84: very upset when touched by evil,
t.85: he is fretful when misfortune touches him,
t.95: bewailing when evil befalls him,
t.19: Fretful when evil befalleth him
t.22: Fretful when evil touches him;
t.203: Irritable (discontented) when evil touches him;
t.54: جب اسے مصیبت پہنچتی ہے تو ہڑبڑا اٹھتا ہے.

t.149: and when touched by good he is ungenerous;
t.84: and very niggard when visited by good (fortune),
t.85: but tight-fisted when good fortune comes his way.
t.95: and tight-fisted when good fortune visits him,
t.19: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;
t.22: And niggardly when good reaches him;-
t.203: And niggardly when good touches him.
t.54: اور جب راحت ملتی ہے تو بخل کرنے لگتا ہے.

t.149: except the prayerful
t.84: except the performers of Salāh,
t.85: Not so those who pray
t.95: except those that pray,
t.19: Save worshippers.
t.22: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-
t.203: Except those who are devoted to Salât (prayers).
t.54: مگر وه نمازی.

t.149: who areconstant at their prayers;
t.84: who are regular in their Salāh,
t.85: and are constant in their prayers;
t.95: and are constant in their Prayer;
t.19: Who are constant at their worship
t.22: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;
t.203: Those who remain constant in their Salât (prayers);
t.54: جو اپنی نماز پر ہمیشگی کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: and those in whose wealth is a rightfully acknowledged share
t.84: and those in whose riches there is a specified right
t.85: who give a due share of their wealth
t.95: and those in whose wealth there is a known right
t.19: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged
t.22: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
t.203: And those in whose wealth there is a recognised right
t.54: اور جن کے مالوں میں مقرره حصہ ہے.

t.149: for the asker and the deprived;
t.84: for the one who asks and the one who is deprived,
t.85: to beggars and the deprived;
t.95: for those that ask and those that are dispossessed,
t.19: For the beggar and the destitute;
t.22: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);
t.203: For the beggar who asks, and for the unlucky who has lost his property and wealth, (and his means of living has been straitened).
t.54: مانگنے والوں کا بھی اور سوال سے بچنے والوں کا بھی.

t.149: and those who believe in the Day of Recompense;
t.84: and those who believe in the Day of Judgment as true,
t.85: who believe in the Day of Judgement
t.95: those who firmly believe in the Day of Recompense,
t.19: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,
t.22: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;
t.203: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense.
t.54: اور جو انصاف کے دن پر یقین رکھتے ہیں.

t.149: and those who fear their Lord’s punishment—
t.84: and those who are fearful of the torment of their Lord-
t.85: and fear the punishment of their Lord––
t.95: and fear the chastisement of their Lord–
t.19: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -
t.22: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-
t.203: And those who fear the torment of their Lord.
t.54: اور جو اپنے رب کے عذاب سے ڈرتے رہتے ہیں.

t.149: indeed, none can feel secure from their Lord’s punishment;
t.84: -Indeed the torment of their Lord is not something to be fearless from.-
t.85: none may feel wholly secure from it––
t.95: surely the chastisement of their Lord is a thing none can feel secure from –
t.19: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -
t.22: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
t.203: Verily, the torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure. -
t.54: بیشک ان کے رب کا عذاب بے خوف ہونے کی چیز نہیں.

t.149: and those who preserve their private parts,
t.84: and those who guard their private parts,
t.85: who guard their chastity
t.95: and those who guard their private parts,
t.19: And those who preserve their chastity
t.22: And those who guard their chastity,
t.203: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts from illegal sexual acts).
t.54: اور جو لوگ اپنی شرم گاہوں کی (حرام سے) حفاﻇت کرتے ہیں.

t.149: except from their spouses or those whom they rightfully possess—for then they are indeed not blameworthy.
t.84: except from their wives and those (slave-girls) owned by their hands,- because they are not to be blamed,
t.85: from all but their spouses or their slave-girls––there is no blame attached to [relations with] these,
t.95: except in regard to their spouses and those whom their right hands possess, for in regard to them they are not reproachable,
t.19: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;
t.22: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,
t.203: Except from their wives or the (women slaves) whom their right hands possess - for (then) they are not blameworthy.
t.54: ہاں ان کی بیویوں اور لونڈیوں کے بارے میں جن کے وه مالک ہیں انہیں کوئی ملامت نہیں.

t.149: But whoever seeks to go beyond that, then those are the transgressors;
t.84: but the one who seeks (sexual gratification) beyond that, then such people are the transgressors,-
t.85: but those whose desires exceed this limit are truly transgressors––
t.95: but any who seeks to go beyond that, it is indeed they who are the transgressors,
t.19: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;
t.22: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-
t.203: But whosoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are trespassers.
t.54: اب جو کوئی اس کے علاوه (راه) ڈھونڈے گا توایسے لوگ حد سے گزر جانے والے ہوں گے.

t.149: and those who are faithful to their trusts and their covenant;
t.84: and those who are careful about their trusts and covenants,
t.85: who are faithful to their trusts and their pledges;
t.95: and those who fulfil their trusts and their covenants,
t.19: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,
t.22: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;
t.203: And those who keep their trusts and covenants.
t.54: اور جو اپنی امانتوں کا اور اپنے قول و قرار کا پاس رکھتے ہیں.

t.149: and those who stand by their testimonies ;
t.84: and those who are upright in their testimonies,
t.85: who give honest testimony
t.95: and those who are upright in their testimonies;
t.19: And those who stand by their testimony
t.22: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;
t.203: And those who stand firm in their testimonies.
t.54: اور جو اپنی گواہیوں پر سیدھے اور قائم رہتے ہیں.

t.149: and those who preserve their prayers—
t.84: and those who take due care of their Salāh .
t.85: and are steadfast in their prayers.
t.95: and who take due care of their Prayer:
t.19: And those who are attentive at their worship.
t.22: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-
t.203: And those who guard their Salât (prayers) well.
t.54: اور جو اپنی نمازوں کی حفاﻇت کرتے ہیں.

t.149: those are honored in Gardens(of Paradise) .
t.84: Those will be honoured in gardens (of Jannah ).
t.85: They will be honoured in Gardens of bliss.
t.95: all these shall live honourably in the Gardens.
t.19: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.
t.22: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).
t.203: Such shall dwell in the Gardens (i.e. Paradise), honoured.
t.54: یہی لوگ جنتوں میں عزت والے ہوں گے.

t.149: So what is with those who have denied, craning their necks towards you,
t.84: So what has happened to those who disbelieve that they are rushing towards you
t.85: What is wrong with the disbelievers? Why do they rush to peer at you [Prophet],
t.95: But what is the matter with the unbelievers who are hurrying towards you
t.19: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,
t.22: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-
t.203: So what is the matter with those who disbelieve that they hasten to listen from you [O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), in order to belie you and to mock at you, and at Allâh’s Book (this Qur’ân)].
t.54: پس کافروں کو کیاہو گیا ہے کہ وه تیری طرف دوڑتے آتے ہیں.

t.149: from the right and from the left, banding together?
t.84: from the right and from the left, in groups?
t.85: from right and left, in crowds?
t.95: in crowds, both on the right and on the left?
t.19: On the right and on the left, in groups?
t.22: From the right and from the left, in crowds?
t.203: (Sitting) in groups on the right and on the left (of you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)?
t.54: دائیں اور بائیں سے گروه کے گروه..

t.149: Does every one of them ardently hope to be entered into a Garden of Bliss?
t.84: Does every one of them aspire to be admitted to the garden of bliss?
t.85: Does every one of them expect to enter a Garden of bliss?
t.95: Does everyone of them wish to enter the Garden of Bliss?
t.19: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
t.22: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
t.203: Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight?
t.54: کیا ان میں سے ہر ایک کی توقع یہ ہے کہ وه نعمتوں والی جنت میں داخل کیا جائے گا؟

t.149: But no! Indeed, We created them from what they know.
t.84: By no means! We have created them from what they know.
t.85: No! We created them from the substance they know,
t.95: By no means! They know that which We have created them from.
t.19: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.
t.22: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!
t.203: No, that is not like that! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know!
t.54: (ایسا) ہرگز نہ ہوگا۔ ہم نے انہیں اس (چیز) سے پیدا کیا ہے جسے وه جانتے ہیں.

t.149: So I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests that We are surely able
t.84: So, I swear by the Lord of the points of sunrise and those of sunset, We are powerful
t.85: and, by the Lord of every sunrise and sunset, We have the power
t.95: I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We have the power
t.19: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able
t.22: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-
t.203: So I swear by the Lord of all the [three hundred and sixty-five (365)] points of sunrise and sunset in the east and the west that surely We are Able
t.54: پس مجھے قسم ہے مشرقوں اور مغربوں کے رب کی (کہ) ہم یقیناً قادر ہیں.

t.149: to replace them with better than them, and We cannot be outstripped.
t.84: to bring those better than them in their place, and We are not to be frustrated.
t.85: to substitute for them others better than they are- nothing can prevent Us from doing this.
t.95: to replace them by others who would be better than they; and We shall certainly not be overpowered.
t.19: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.
t.22: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).
t.203: To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun.
t.54: اس پر کہ ان کے عوض ان سے اچھے لوگ لے آئیں اور ہم عاجز نہیں ہیں.

t.149: So letthem blunder and play until they meet their day which they are promised—
t.84: So, leave them involved in pastime and play until they encounter their Day, which they are promised,
t.85: So leave them to wallow in idle talk, until they come face to face with their promised Day,
t.95: So leave them to engage in vain talk and to amuse themselves until they come face to face with the Day which they are promised,
t.19: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,
t.22: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-
t.203: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised -
t.54: پس تو انہیں جھگڑتا کھیلتا چھوڑ دے یہاں تک کہ یہ اپنے اس دن سے جاملیں جس کا ان سے وعده کیا جاتا ہے.

t.149: the day when they come out of the tombs in a rush, as though they are hurrying towards some statues ,
t.84: the Day they will come out of the graves quickly, as if they were rushing toward idols,
t.85: the Day they will rush out of their graves as if rallying to a flag,
t.95: the Day on which they will hastily come forth from their graves, as though they were hurrying on to the altars of their deities.
t.19: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,
t.22: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-
t.203: The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a goal,
t.54: جس دن یہ قبروں سے دوڑتے ہوئے نکلیں گے، گویا کہ وه کسی جگہ کی طرف تیز تیز جا رہے ہیں.

t.149: their sight(s) (subdued) in reverence, humiliation overwhelming them. That is the day which they were promised.
t.84: with their eyes downcast, enveloped by ignominy. That is the Day, which they were being promised.
t.85: eyes downcast and covered in shame: that is the Day of which they were warned.
t.95: Their eyes will be downcast and disgrace will overwhelm them. Such is the Day that they were promised.
t.19: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.
t.22: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
t.203: With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!
t.54: ان کی آنکھیں جھکی ہوئی ہوں گی، ان پر ذلت چھا رہی ہوگی، یہ ہے وه دن جس کا ان سے وعده کیا جاتا تھا.

t.149: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people: “Warn your people before there comes upon them a painful punishment.”
t.84: We sent NūH to his people (and said to him): “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”
t.85: We sent Noah to his people: ‘Warn your people, before a painful punishment comes to them.’
t.95: We sent Noah to his people (and directed him): “Warn your people before a grievous chastisement comes upon them.”
t.19: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.
t.22: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."
t.203: Verily, We sent Nûh (Noah) to his people (saying): "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment."
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے نوح (علیہ السلام) کو ان کی قوم کی طرف بھیجا کہ اپنی قوم کو ڈرا دو (اور خبردار کردو) اس سے پہلے کہ ان کے پاس دردناک عذاب آجائے.

t.149: He said, “O my people, indeed, I am an evident warner to you:
t.84: He said, “O my people, I openly warn you
t.85: And so he said, ‘My people, I am here to warn you plainly.
t.95: Noah said: “My people, I have certainly been sent as a clear warner to you,
t.19: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you
t.22: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:
t.203: He said: "O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,
t.54: (نوح علیہ السلام نے) کہا اے میری قوم! میں تمہیں صاف صاف ڈرانے واﻻ ہوں.

t.149: that you should worship Allah and be mindful of Him, and obey me.
t.84: that you must worship Allah, and fear Him, and obey me,
t.85: Serve God, be mindful of Him and obey me.
t.95: that you serve Allah and fear Him, and follow me;
t.19: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,
t.22: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:
t.203: "That you should worship Allâh (Alone), fear (be dutiful to) Him, and obey me,
t.54: کہ تم اللہ کی عبادت کرو اور اسی سے ڈرو اور میرا کہا مانو.

t.149: He will then forgive youyour misdeeds and reprieve you until(you fulfill) a stated term; indeed, Allah’s term cannot be deferred once it has come, if you only knew.”
t.84: and Allah will forgive you your sins, and will respite you to an appointed term. Indeed when Allah’s term comes, it is not deferred, if you only know!”
t.85: He will forgive you your sins and spare you until your appointed time––when God’s appointed time arrives it cannot be postponed. If only you understood!’
t.95: He will forgive your sins and will grant you respite until an appointed term. Indeed when Allah's appointed term comes, it cannot be deferred; if you only knew!”
t.19: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.
t.22: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."
t.203: "He (Allâh) will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allâh when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew."
t.54: تو وه تمہارے گناه بخش دے گا اور تمہیں ایک وقت مقرره تک چھوڑ دے گا۔ یقیناً اللہ کا وعده جب آجاتا ہے تو مؤخر نہیں ہوتا۔ کاش کہ تمہیں سمجھ ہوتی.

t.149: He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
t.84: He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
t.85: He said, ‘My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
t.95: He said: “My Lord, I called my people by night and by day,
t.19: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
t.22: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:
t.203: He said: "O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day (i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islâmic Monotheism),
t.54: (نوح علیہ السلام نے) کہا اے میرے پرورگار! میں نے اپنی قوم کو رات دن تیری طرف بلایا ہے.

t.149: but my call has only made them flee the more.
t.84: but my call added only to their flight (from the truth).
t.85: but the more I call them, the further they run away:
t.95: but the more I called, the farther they fled.
t.19: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;
t.22: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).
t.203: "But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (from the truth).
t.54: مگر میرے بلانے سے یہ لوگ اور زیاده بھاگنے لگے.

t.149: And indeed, every time I called them, that You may forgive them, they put their fingers into their ears and wrapped themselves in their garments and insisted and became extremely arrogant.
t.84: Whenever I called them, so that You might forgive them, they put their fingers into their ears, and wrapped their clothes around themselves, and grew obstinate, and waxed proud in extreme arrogance.
t.85: every time I call them, so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, cover their heads with their garments, persist in their rejection, and grow more insolent and arrogant.
t.95: And every time I called them so that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears and wrapped up their faces with their garments and obstinately clung to their attitude, and waxed very proud.
t.19: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.
t.22: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.
t.203: And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted (in their refusal), and magnified themselves in pride.
t.54: میں نے جب کبھی انہیں تیری بخشش کے لیے بلایا انہوں نے اپنی انگلیاں اپنے کانوں میں ڈال لیں اور اپنے کپڑوں کو اوڑھ لیا اور اڑ گئے اور بڑا تکبر کیا.

t.149: Then I called them openly,
t.84: Then I called them loudly,
t.85: I have tried calling them openly.
t.95: Then I summoned them openly,
t.19: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,
t.22: "So I have called to them aloud;
t.203: "Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud).
t.54: پھر میں نے انہیں بﺂواز بلند بلایا.

t.149: then I spoke to them publicly and I spoke to them privately,
t.84: and then I spoke to them in public and spoke to them in private.
t.85: I have tried preaching to them in public and speaking to them in private.
t.95: and preached to them in public, and also addressed them in secret.
t.19: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.
t.22: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,
t.203: "Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private.
t.54: اور بیشک میں نےان سے علانیہ بھی کہا اور چپکے چپکے بھی.

t.149: and I said, ‘Ask your Lord for forgiveness–indeed, He has always been Forgiving.
t.84: So I said, ‘Pray to your Lord for your forgiveness,- Indeed He is Very-Forgiving, -
t.85: I said, “Ask forgiveness of your Lord: He is ever forgiving.
t.95: I said to them: “Ask forgiveness from your Lord; surely He is Most Forgiving.
t.19: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
t.22: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
t.203: "I said (to them): ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;
t.54: اور میں نے کہا کہ اپنے رب سے اپنے گناه بخشواؤ (اور معافی مانگو) وه یقیناً بڑا بخشنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: He will send(rain from) the sky upon youin showers
t.84: and He will cause the heavens to rain upon you in abundance,
t.85: He will send down abundant rain from the sky for you;
t.95: He will shower upon you torrents from heaven,
t.19: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
t.22: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;
t.203: ‘He will send rain to you in abundance,
t.54: وه تم پر آسمان کو خوب برستا ہوا چھوڑ دے گا.

t.149: and supply you with wealth and children and allot for you Gardens(of Paradise) and allot for you rivers.
t.84: and will help you with riches and sons, and will cause gardens to grow for you, and cause rivers to flow for you.
t.85: He will give you wealth and sons; He will provide you with gardens and rivers.
t.95: and will provide you with wealth and children, and will bestow upon you gardens and rivers.
t.19: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
t.22: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).
t.203: ‘And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.’"
t.54: اور تمہیں خوب پے درپے مال اور اوﻻد میں ترقی دے گا اور تمہیں باغات دے گا اور تمہارے لیے نہریں نکال دے گا.

t.149: What is the matter with youthat you do not expect(a reward for having) reverence towards Allah
t.84: What has happened to you that you do not appreciate the Majesty of Allah,
t.85: What is the matter with you? Why will you not fear God’s majesty,
t.95: What is amiss with you that you do not look forward to the majesty of Allah
t.19: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity
t.22: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-
t.203: What is the matter with you, that [you fear not Allâh (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allâh or you believe not in His Oneness).
t.54: تمہیں کیا ہوگیا ہے کہ تم اللہ کی برتری کا عقیده نہیں رکھتے.

t.149: although He created you in stages?
t.84: while He has created you in different phases?
t.85: when He has created you stage by stage?
t.95: when He has created you in stages?
t.19: When He created you by (divers) stages?
t.22: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?
t.203: While He has created you in (different) stages [i.e. first Nutfah, then ‘Alaqah and then Mudghah, see (V.23:13,14)].
t.54: حاﻻنکہ اس نے تمہیں طرح طرح سے پیدا کیا ہے.

t.149: Have younot seen how Allah has created seven heavens in layers?
t.84: Did you not see how Allah has created seven heavens one upon another,
t.85: Have you ever wondered how God created seven heavens, one above the other,
t.95: Do you not see how Allah has created seven heavens, one upon the other,
t.19: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
t.22: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,
t.203: See you not how Allâh has created the seven heavens one above another?
t.54: کیا تم نہیں دیکھتے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے اوپر تلے کس طرح سات آسمان پیدا کر دیئے ہیں.

t.149: And He has made the moon therein a light, and He has made the sun a lamp.
t.84: and has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
t.85: placed the moon as a light in them and the sun as a lamp,
t.95: and has placed the moon in them as a light, and the sun as a radiant lamp?
t.19: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
t.22: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?
t.203: And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
t.54: اور ان میں چاند کو جگمگاتا بنایا ہے اور سورج کو روشن چراغ بنایا ہے.

t.149: And Allah has germinated youfrom the(dust of the) land,
t.84: And Allah has caused you to grow well out of the earth,
t.85: how God made you spring forth from the earth like a plant,
t.95: And Allah has caused you to grow out of the earth so wondrously,
t.19: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,
t.22: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),
t.203: And Allâh has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth? (Tafsir At-Tabarî)
t.54: اور تم کو زمین سے ایک (خاص اہتمام سے) اگایا ہے (اور پیدا کیا ہے).

t.149: then He will return you into it and will bring you out again.
t.84: then He will send you back into it, and will bring you forth once again.
t.85: how He will return you into it and then bring you out again,
t.95: and He will later cause you to return to it and will then again bring you out of it.
t.19: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.
t.22: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?
t.203: Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth (again on the Day of Resurrection)?
t.54: پھر تمہیں اسی میں لوٹا لے جائے گا اور (ایک خاص طریقہ) سے پھر نکالے گا.

t.149: And Allah has made the land a spread for you,
t.84: And Allah has made the earth a spread for you,
t.85: and how He has spread the Earth out for you
t.95: Allah has made the earth a wide expanse for you
t.19: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you
t.22: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),
t.203: And Allâh has made for you the earth a wide expanse.
t.54: اور تمہارے لیے زمین کو اللہ تعالیٰ نے فرش بنادیا ہے.

t.149: that you may travel its pathways made broad.’”
t.84: so that you may go about its broad ways.’”
t.85: to walk along its spacious paths?” ’
t.95: so that you may tread its spacious paths.”
t.19: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.
t.22: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"
t.203: That you may go about therein in broad roads.
t.54: تاکہ تم اس کی کشاده راہوں میں چلو پھرو.

t.149: Noah said, “My Lord, indeed, they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increased him in nothing but in loss.
t.84: And said NūH, “My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed him whose wealth and children added nothing to him but loss,
t.85: Noah said, ‘My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose riches and children only increase their ruin;
t.95: Noah said: “My Lord, they did not pay heed to what I said, and followed those (nobles) whose possession of wealth and children has led them to an even greater loss.
t.19: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
t.22: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.
t.203: Nûh (Noah) said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss.
t.54: نوح (علیہ السلام) نے کہا اے میرے پروردگار! ان لوگوں نے میری تو نافرمانی کی اور ایسوں کی فرمانبرداری کی جن کے مال واوﻻد نے ان کو (یقیناً) نقصان ہی میں بڑھایا ہے.

t.149: And they schemed outrageous schemes,
t.84: and they devised a mighty plot,
t.85: who have made a grand plan,
t.95: They contrived a plot of great magnitude.
t.19: And they have plotted a mighty plot,
t.22: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.
t.203: "And they have plotted a mighty plot.
t.54: اور ان لوگوں نے بڑا سخت فریب کیا.

t.149: saying, ‘Do not abandon yourgods, and do not abandon Wadd, nor Souwaʻ, nor Yaghooth and Yaʻooq and Nasra.
t.84: and said (to their people), “Never forsake your gods, and never forsake Wadd, nor Suwā‘, nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr.
t.85: saying, “Do not renounce your gods! Do not renounce Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, or Nasr!”
t.95: They said: “Do not abandon your deities; do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth, nor Yauq, nor Nasr.
t.19: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
t.22: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-
t.203: "And they have said: ‘You shall not leave your gods: nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwâ‘, nor Yaghûth, nor Ya‘ûq nor Nasr’ (these are the names of their idols).
t.54: اور کہا انہوں نے کہ ہرگز اپنے معبودوں کو نہ چھوڑنا اور نہ ود اور سواع اور یغوث اور یعوق اور نسر کو (چھوڑنا).

t.149: And truly, they have misguided many, so do not increase the unjust except in misguidance.”
t.84: And they have led many astray. And (O my Lord,) let not the wrongdoers progress in anything but deviation from the right path.”
t.85: They have led many astray. Lord, bring nothing but destruction down on the evildoers!’
t.95: They have misled many. So do not enable these evildoers to increase in anything except straying (from the Right Way).”
t.19: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.
t.22: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)."
t.203: "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allâh): ‘Grant no increase to the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) save error.’"
t.54: اور انہوں نے بہت سے لوگوں کو گمراه کیا (الٰہی) تو ان ﻇالموں کی گمراہی اور بڑھا.

t.149: For their offenses, they were drowned then hurled into a fire, and they did not find any supporters apart from Allah.
t.84: Because of their sins they were drowned, and then admitted into the Fire. So they found no helpers for them besides Allah.
t.85: They were drowned and sent to Hell for their evildoings: they found no one to help them against God.
t.95: And so they were drowned on account of their sins, and then cast into the Fire, and did not find any other than Allah, to come forth to their help.
t.19: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.
t.22: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them.
t.203: Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allâh.
t.54: یہ لوگ بہ سبب اپنے گناہوں کے ڈبو دیئے گئے اور جہنم میں پہنچا دیئے گئے اور اللہ کے سوا اپنا کوئی مددگار انہوں نے نہ پایا.

t.149: And Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave of the deniers a single dweller in the land.
t.84: And said NūH, “My Lord, do not leave on earth even a single inhabitant (surviving) out of the disbelievers.
t.85: And Noah said, ‘Lord, do not leave any of the disbelievers on the earth-
t.95: Noah said: “My Lord, do not leave out of these unbelievers even a single dweller on earth,
t.19: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
t.22: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!
t.203: And Nûh (Noah) said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth!
t.54: اور (حضرت) نوح (علیہ السلام) نے کہا کہ اے میرے پالنے والے! تو روئے زمین پر کسی کافر کو رہنے سہنے واﻻ نہ چھوڑ.

t.149: Indeed, if You leave them, they will misguide your servants and beget none but wicked relentless deniers.
t.84: If You leave them (surviving), they will lead Your servants astray, and will beget none but a sinful disbeliever.
t.85: if you leave them they will lead Your servants astray and beget only sinners and disbelievers-
t.95: for certainly if You should leave them (alive), they will mislead Your servants, and will beget none but sinners and utter unbelievers.
t.19: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.
t.22: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.
t.203: "If You leave them, they will mislead Your slaves, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers.
t.54: اگر تو انہیں چھوڑ دے گا تو (یقیناً) یہ تیرے (اور) بندوں کو (بھی) گمراه کر دیں گے اور یہ فاجروں اور ڈھیٹ کافروں ہی کو جنم دیں گے.

t.149: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and anyone who enters my house as a believer, and all the believing men and believing women, and do not increase the unjust except in perdition.”
t.84: My Lord, grant pardon to me, and to my parents, and to everyone who enters my home as a believer, and to all the believing men and believing women, and do not increase the wrongdoers but in ruin.
t.85: Lord, forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer. Forgive believing men and women but bring nothing but ruin down on the evildoers!’
t.95: My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer, and forgive all believers, both men and women, and do not increase the wrong-doers in anything except perdition.”
t.19: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
t.22: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"
t.203: "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) grant You no increase but destruction!"
t.54: اے میرے پروردگار! تو مجھے اور میرے ماں باپ اور جو بھی ایمان کی حالت میں میرے گھر میں آئے اور تمام مومن مردوں اور عورتوں کو بخش دے اور کافروں کو سوائے بربادی کے اور کسی بات میں نہ بڑھا.

t.149: Say, “It was revealed to me that a band of unseen beingslistened in and said, ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous Recital
t.84: Say, “It has been revealed to me that a group from Jinn has listened (to the Qur’ān), and said (to their people), ‘Indeed we have heard an amazing Recital (Qur’ān)
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn once listened in and said, “We have heard a wondrous Quran,
t.95: Say, (O Prophet), it was revealed to me that a band of jinn attentively listened to (the recitation of the Qur'an) and then (went back to their people) and said:
t.19: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,
t.22: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital!
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "It has been revealed to me that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinn listened (to this Qur’ân). They said: ‘Verily, we have heard a wonderful Recitation (this Qur’ân)!
t.54: (اے محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم) آپ کہہ دیں کہ مجھے وحی کی گئی ہے کہ جنوں کی ایک جماعت نے (قرآن) سنا اور کہا کہ ہم نے عجیب قرآن سنا ہے.

t.149: that guides to prudence, so we have come to believe in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.
t.84: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate a partner with our Lord.’
t.85: that gives guidance to the right path, and we have come to believe it––We shall never set up partners with our Lord––
t.95: “We have indeed heard a wonderful Qur'an which guides to the Right Way; so we have come to believe in it, and we will not associate aught with Our Lord in His Divinity”;
t.19: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.
t.22: 'It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord.
t.203: ‘It guides to the Right Path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join (in worship) anything with our Lord (Allâh).
t.54: جو راه راست کے طرف رہنمائی کرتا ہے۔ ہم اس پر ایمان ﻻ چکے (اب) ہم ہرگز کسی کو بھی اپنے رب کا شریک نہ بنائیں گے.

t.149: And that most high is the Grandeur of our Lord—He never took a female companion nor a child.
t.84: and (then the Jinns started talking to each other) that exalted is the Glory of our Lord; He has taken neither a wife, nor a son,
t.85: and that He––exalted be the glory of our Lord!––has neither spouse nor child.
t.95: and that “He – exalted be His Majesty – has not taken to Himself either a wife or a son”;
t.19: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,
t.22: 'And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son.
t.203: ‘And He, exalted be the Majesty of our Lord, has taken neither a wife nor a son (or offspring or children).
t.54: اور بیشک ہمارے رب کی شان بڑی بلند ہے نہ اس نے کسی کو (اپنی) بیوی بنایا ہے نہ بیٹا.

t.149: And thatour fool used to speak untruthfully about Allah.
t.84: and that the fools among us used to attribute to Allah extremely absurd things,
t.85: Outrageous things have been said about God by the foolish among us,
t.95: and that “the foolish among us have been wont to say outrageous things about Allah”;
t.19: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.
t.22: 'There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against Allah;
t.203: ‘And that the foolish among us [i.e. Iblîs (Satan) or the polytheists amongst the jinn] used to utter against Allâh that which was an enormity in falsehood.
t.54: اور یہ کہ ہم میں سے بیوقوف [یعنی ابلیس] اللہ کے بارے میں خلاف حق باتیں کہا کرتا تھا.

t.149: And that we thought that humans and unseen beings would never say a lie aboutAllah.
t.84: and that we thought that the humans and the Jinn would never tell a lie about Allah, (therefore, we had followed them in shirk under this impression),
t.85: although we had thought that no man or jinn would [dare to] tell a lie about Him.
t.95: and that “we had thought that men and jinn would never speak a lie about Allah”,
t.19: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -
t.22: 'But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against Allah.
t.203: ‘And verily, we thought that men and jinn would not utter a lie against Allâh.
t.54: اور ہم تو یہی سمجھتے رہے کہ ناممکن ہے کہ انسانوں اور جنات اللہ پر جھوٹی باتیں لگائیں.

t.149: And thatcertain men among humans used to seek refuge in certain men among the unseen beings, but they only increased them in confusion.
t.84: and that some guys from human beings used to seek refuge with some guys of the Jinn, and thus they increased them (the Jinns) in arrogance,
t.85: Men have sought refuge with the jinn in the past, but they only misguided them further.
t.95: and that “some from among the humans used to seek protection of some among the jinn, and thus they increased the arrogance of the jinn”;
t.19: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);
t.22: 'True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly.
t.203: ‘And verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the males among the jinn, but they (jinn) increased them (mankind) in sin and transgression.
t.54: بات یہ ہے کہ چند انسان بعض جنات سے پناه طلب کیا کرتے تھے جس سے جنات اپنی سرکشی میں اور بڑھ گئے.

t.149: And thatthey thought, as youthought, that Allah would never resurrect anyone.
t.84: and that they (humans) thought as you (O Jinns) thought that Allah will never resurrect anyone,
t.85: They thought, as you did, that God would never raise anyone from the dead.
t.95: and that “they thought, even as you thought, that Allah would never raise anyone (as a Messenger)”;
t.19: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -
t.22: 'And they (came to) think as ye thought, that Allah would not raise up any one (to Judgment).
t.203: ‘And they thought as you thought, that Allâh will not send any Messenger (to mankind or jinn).
t.54: اور (انسانوں) نے بھی تم جنوں کی طرح گمان کر لیا تھا کہ اللہ کسی کو نہ بھیجے گا (یا کسی کو دوباره زنده نہ کرے گا).

t.149: And thatwe sought to reach the heaven and found it filled with stern guards and meteors.
t.84: and that we sought (to reach) the sky, but we found it filled with stern guards and flames,
t.85: We tried to reach heaven, but discovered it to be full of stern guards and shooting stars––
t.95: and that “we tried to pry (the secrets of) the heaven, but we found it full of terrible guards and shooting meteors”;
t.19: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.
t.22: 'And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
t.203: ‘And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
t.54: اور ہم نے آسمان کو ٹٹول کر دیکھا تو اسے سخت چوکیداروں اور سخت شعلوں سے پر پایا.

t.149: And thatwe used to take up positions to listen in, but whoever listens now finds a meteor in wait for him.
t.84: and that we used to sit at places therein to listen; but if one will (try to) listen now, he will find a flame in ambush for him,
t.85: we used to sit in places there, listening, but anyone trying to listen now will find a shooting star lying in wait for him––
t.95: and that “we would take up stations in the heaven to try to hear but anyone who now attempts to listen finds a shooting meteor in wait for him”;
t.19: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
t.22: 'We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
t.203: ‘And verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) a hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
t.54: اس سے پہلے ہم باتیں سننے کے لیے آسمان میں جگہ جگہ بیٹھ جایا کرتے تھے۔ اب جو بھی کان لگاتا ہے وه ایک شعلے کو اپنی تاک میں پاتا ہے.

t.149: And thatwe do not know whether ill has been desired for those on earth, or if their Lord has desired prudence for them.
t.84: and that we do not know whether it is a bad end that is intended for those on earth, or their Lord has intended for them a right thing,
t.85: [so now] we do not know whether those who live on earth are due for misfortune, or whether their Lord intends to guide them.
t.95: and that “we do not know whether evil is intended for those on the earth, or whether their Lord intends to direct them to the Right Way”;
t.19: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.
t.22: 'And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct.
t.203: ‘And we know not whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends for them a Right Path.
t.54: ہم نہیں جانتے کہ زمین والوں کے ساتھ کسی برائی کا اراده کیا گیا ہے یا ان کے رب کا اراده ان کے ساتھ بھلائی کا ہے.

t.149: And thatsome of us are righteous, but some of us are less than that: we have been following divergent roads.
t.84: and that some of us are (already) righteous, and some of us are otherwise, and we were on different ways;
t.85: Some of us are righteous and others less so: we follow different paths.
t.95: and that “some of us are upright and some of us are otherwise for we follow widely divergent paths”;
t.19: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.
t.22: 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths.
t.203: ‘There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups having different ways (religious sects).
t.54: اور یہ کہ (بیشک) بعض تو ہم میں نیکو کار ہیں اور بعض اس کے برعکس بھی ہیں، ہم مختلف طریقوں سے بٹے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: And that we realized that we cannot thwart Allah on earth, nor can we thwart Him by fleeing.
t.84: and that we have now believed that we can never frustrate Allah on the earth, nor can we baffle Him by escape,
t.85: We know we can never frustrate God on earth; we can never escape Him.
t.95: and that “we thought that we will neither be able to frustrate Allah on earth, nor frustrate Him by flight”;
t.19: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
t.22: 'But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
t.203: ‘And we think that we cannot escape (the punishment of) Allâh in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
t.54: اور ہم نے سمجھ لیا کہ ہم اللہ تعالیٰ کو زمین میں ہرگز عاجز نہیں کرسکتے اور نہ ہم بھاگ کر اسے ہرا سکتے ہیں.

t.149: And thatwhen we heard the guidance we believed in it, for whoever believes in his Lord fears neither loss nor confusion.
t.84: and that when we heard the Guiding Discourse, we believed in it; so if one believes in his Lord, he will have no fear of either any curtailment (in his reward) or any excess (in his punishment),
t.85: When we heard the guidance we came to believe: whoever believes in his Lord need fear no loss nor injustice.
t.95: and that “when we heard the teaching of the Right Way we came to believe in it; he who believes in His Lord shall have no fear of suffering loss or being subjected to any injustice”;
t.19: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.
t.22: 'And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice.
t.203: ‘And indeed when we heard the Guidance (this Qur’ân), we believed therein (Islâmic Monotheism), and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in the punishment for his sins.
t.54: ہم تو ہدایت کی بات سنتے ہی اس پر ایمان ﻻئے چکے اور جو بھی اپنے رب پر ایمان ﻻئے گا اسے نہ کسی نقصان کا اندیشہ ہے نہ ﻇلم وستم کا.
