t.149: And thatamong us are Muslimsand among us are those who swerve from justice, so whoever has become Muslim—it is they who have pursued prudence.
t.84: and that some of us are Muslims, and some of us are unjust. Now, those who submitted to Islam have found out the right path,
t.85: Some of us submit to Him and others go the wrong way: those who submit to God have found wise guidance,
t.95: and that “among us some are Muslims (Those who have submitted to Allah), and some of us are deviant. So those who became Muslims found the Right Course;
t.19: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.
t.22: 'Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:
t.203: ‘And of us some are Muslims (who have submitted to Allâh, after listening to this Qur’ân), and of us some are Al-Qâsitûn (disbelievers - those who have deviated from the Right Path)’. And whosoever has embraced Islâm (i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to Allâh), then such have sought the Right Path."
t.54: ہاں ہم میں بعض تو مسلمان ہیں اور بعض بےانصاف ہیں پس جو فرماں بردار ہوگئے انہوں نے تو راه راست کا قصد کیا.

t.149: But as for those who swerve from justice—they have become firewood for Hell.’”
t.84: As for the unjust, they have become firewood for Hell.”
t.85: but those who go wrong will be fuel for Hellfire.” ’
t.95: but those who deviated from the Truth, will be the fuel for Hell.”
t.19: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.
t.22: 'But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire'-
t.203: And as for the Qâsitûn (disbelievers who deviated from the Right Path), they shall be firewood for Hell,
t.54: اور جو ﻇالم ہیں وه جہنم کا ایندھن بن گئے.

t.149: But had they gone straight on the right mode(of life) , We would have given them plenty of water to drink,
t.84: “(And it is also revealed to me) that if they (the people of Makkah) had stood firm on the (right) way, We would have supplied water to them in abundance,
t.85: If they had taken to the right way, We would have given them abundant water to drink-
t.95: If people were to keep firmly to the Right Way, We would have vouchsafed them abundant rain
t.19: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance
t.22: (And Allah's Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance.
t.203: If they (non-Muslims) had believed in Allâh, and went on the Right Way (i.e. Islâm) We would surely have bestowed on them water (rain) in abundance.
t.54: اور (اے نبی یہ بھی کہہ دو) کہ اگر لوگ راه راست پر سیدھے رہتے تو یقیناً ہم انہیں بہت وافر پانی پلاتے.

t.149: so as to test them with it. And whoever disregards the remembrance of his Lord—He will insert himinto a mounting punishment.
t.84: so that We test them thereby; and if one turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will thrust him into a severe torment,
t.85: a test for them––but anyone who turns away from his Lord’s Revelation will be sent by Him to spiralling torment.
t.95: so that We might try them through this bounty. Whoso turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to suffer a grievous chastisement;
t.19: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
t.22: "That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty.
t.203: That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord (i.e. this Qur’ân, - and practise not its laws and orders), He will cause him to enter in a severe torment (i.e. Hell).
t.54: تاکہ ہم اس میں انہیں آزمالیں، اور جو شخص اپنے پروردگار کے ذکر سے منھ پھیر لے گا تو اللہ تعالیٰ اسے سخت عذاب میں مبتلا کردے گا.

t.149: And(say) that mosques belong to Allah, so do not call upon anyone along with Allah.
t.84: and that masājid (mosques) belong to Allah; so, do not invoke anyone along with Allah,
t.85: Places of worship are for God alone- so do not pray to anyone other than God-
t.95: and that “mosques belong to Allah, so do not invoke anyone with Him”;
t.19: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.
t.22: "And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah;
t.203: And the mosques are for Allâh (Alone): so invoke not anyone along with Allâh.
t.54: اور یہ کہ مسجدیں صرف اللہ ہی کے لئے خاص ہیں پس اللہ تعالیٰ کے ساتھ کسی اور کو نہ پکارو.

t.149: Andthat when the servant of Allah got up, calling upon Him(in prayers) , they almost fell on him in a mass .
t.84: and that when Allah’s servant stood invoking Him, they almost rushed on him in crowds.”
t.85: yet when God’s Servant stood up to pray to Him, they pressed in on him.
t.95: and when Allah's servant stood up to call on Him, they well-nigh swarmed him.
t.19: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.
t.22: "Yet when the Devotee of Allah stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd."
t.203: And when the slave of Allâh (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) stood up invoking Him (his Lord - Allâh) in prayer they (the jinn) just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other (in order to listen to the Prophet’s recitation).
t.54: اور جب اللہ کا بنده اس کی عبادت کے لیے کھڑا ہوا تو قریب تھا کہ وه بھیڑ کی بھیڑ بن کر اس پر پل پڑیں.

t.149: Say , “Indeed, I pray only to my Lord, and I never associate anyone with Him.”
t.84: Say, “I invoke my Lord, and do not associate anyone with Him.”
t.85: Say, ‘I pray to my Lord alone; I set up no partner with Him.’
t.95: Say, (O Prophet): “I call on my Lord alone, and I do not associate aught with Him in His Divinity.”
t.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.
t.22: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)."
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I invoke only my Lord (Allâh Alone), and I associate none as partners along with Him."
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ میں تو صرف اپنے رب ہی کو پکارتا ہوں اور اس کے ساتھ کسی کو شریک نہیں کرتا.

t.149: Say, “Indeed, I possess for youneither harm nor prudence.”
t.84: Say, “I possess no power to cause you any harm or bring you to a right way.”
t.85: Say, ‘I have no control over any harm or good that may befall you.’
t.95: Say: “Surely neither it is in my power to hurt you nor to bring you to the Right Way.”
t.19: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.
t.22: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct."
t.203: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the Right Path."
t.54: کہہ دیجئے کہ مجھے تمہارے کسی نقصان نفع کا اختیار نہیں.

t.149: Say, “Indeed, no one can protect me from Allah, and I will not find any refuge except with Him.
t.84: Say, “No one can ever save me from Allah, and I can never find a refuge save with Him.
t.85: Say, ‘No one can protect me from God: I have no refuge except in Him.
t.95: Say: “None can protect me from Allah, nor can I find a refuge apart from Him.
t.19: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him
t.22: Say: "No one can deliver me from Allah (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him,
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "None can protect me from Allâh’s punishment (if I were to disobey Him), nor can I find refuge except in Him.
t.54: کہہ دیجئے کہ مجھے ہرگز کوئی اللہ سے بچا نہیں سکتا اور میں ہرگز اس کے سوا کوئی جائے پناه بھی پا نہیں سکتا.

t.149: (I have nothing) except for a proclamation from Allah and His messages, and whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger—for him is the fire of Hell, abiding therein forever.
t.84: However, (I have been given power) of conveying (commands) from Allah, and His messages. The one who disobeys Allah and His Messenger, for him there is the fire of Hell, wherein such people will live forever.
t.85: I only deliver [what I receive] from God- only His messages.’ Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger will have Hell’s Fire as his permanent home:
t.95: (My task is no more than) to deliver Allah's proclamation and His messages. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, surely the Fire of Hell awaits him; therein he will abide in perpetuity.”
t.19: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.
t.22: "Unless I proclaim what I receive from Allah and His Messages: for any that disobey Allah and His Messenger,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever."
t.203: "(Mine is) but conveyance (of the truth) from Allâh and His Messages (of Islâmic Monotheism), and whosoever disobeys Allâh and His Messenger, then Verily, for him is the Fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever."
t.54: البتہ (میرا کام) اللہ کی بات اور اس کے پیغامات (لوگوں کو) پہنچا دینا ہے، (اب) جو بھی اللہ اور اس کے رسول کی نہ مانے گا اس کے لیے جہنم کی آگ ہے جس میں ایسے لوگ ہمیشہ رہیں گے.

t.149: Only when they see what they are promised, will they then know who has weaker helpers and is fewer in numbers.
t.84: (The disbelievers will continue denying the truth and mock at it) until when they will see what they are promised, they will know whose supporters are weaker, and whose numbers are less.
t.85: when they are confronted by what they have been warned about, they will realize who has the weaker protector and the smaller number.
t.95: (They shall not change their ways) until they see that against which they had been warned, and then they will know whose helpers are weaker and whose supporters are fewer in number.
t.19: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.
t.22: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.
t.203: Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning numbers.
t.54: (ان کی آنکھ نہ کھلے گی) یہاں تک کہ اسے دیکھ لیں جس کا ان کو وعده دیا جاتا ہے پس عنقریب جان لیں گے کہ کس کا مددگار کمزور اور کس کی جماعت کم ہے.

t.149: Say, “I do not know whether what youare promised is near, or whether my Lord will extend it for a period.
t.84: Say, “I do not know whether that which you are promised is near, or my Lord has appointed for it a distant term.
t.85: Say, ‘I do not know whether what you have been warned about is near, or whether a distant time has been appointed for it by my Lord.’
t.95: Say: “I know not whether what you are promised is near or whether my Lord will prolong its term.
t.19: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.
t.22: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I know not whether (the punishment) which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
t.54: کہہ دیجئے کہ مجھے معلوم نہیں کہ جس کا وعده تم سے کیا جاتا ہے وه قریب ہے یا میرا رب اس کے لیے دور کی مدت مقرر کرے گا.

t.149: The Knower of the hidden realm—so He does not disclose His hidden realm to anyone
t.84: (He is the) Knower of the Unseen. So He does not let anyone know the Unseen created by Him,
t.85: He is the One who knows what is hidden.
t.95: He is the Knower of the Unseen, and He does not disclose His Unseen to anyone
t.19: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,
t.22: "He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries,-
t.203: "(He Alone is) the All-Knower of the Ghaib (Unseen), and He reveals to none His Ghaib (Unseen)."
t.54: وه غیب کا جاننے واﻻ ہے اور اپنے غیب پر کسی کو مطلع نہیں کرتا.

t.149: except to a Messenger of His choosing, for He then dispatches guards before him and behind him,
t.84: except a messenger whom He chooses (to inform through revelation), and then He appoints (angels as) watching guards before him and behind him, (so that devils may not tamper with the divine revelation,)
t.85: He does not disclose it except to a messenger of His choosing. He sends watchers to go in front and behind
t.95: other than to a Messenger whom He chooses (for the bestowal of any part of the knowledge of the Unseen), whereafter He appoints guards who go before him and behind him,
t.19: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him
t.22: "Except a messenger whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him,
t.203: Except to a Messenger (from mankind) whom He has chosen (He informs him of unseen as much as He likes), and then He makes a band of watching guards (angels) to march before him and behind him.
t.54: سوائے اس پیغمبر کے جسے وه پسند کرلے لیکن اس کے بھی آگے پیچھے پہرے دار مقرر کردیتا ہے.

t.149: that He may know that they have compiled and proclaimed the messages of their Lord. But He has encompassed what they have, and has tallied everything by number.”
t.84: so that He knows that they (angels) have conveyed the messages of their Lord. And He has encompassed all that is with them, and has comprehensive knowledge of every thing by numbers.
t.85: to ensure that each of His messengers delivers his Lord’s message: He knows all about them, and He takes account of everything.
t.95: so that He may know that they have delivered the messages of their Lord. He encompasses in His knowledge their surroundings and keeps a count of all things.”
t.19: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
t.22: "That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing."
t.203: [He (Allâh) protects them (the Messengers)], till He sees that they (the Messengers) have conveyed the Messages of their Lord (Allâh). And He (Allâh) surrounds all that which is with them, and He (Allâh) keeps count of all things (i.e. He knows the exact number of everything).
t.54: تاکہ ان کے اپنے رب کے پیغام پہنچا دینے کا علم ہو جائے اللہ تعالیٰ نے ان کے آس پاس (کی تمام چیزوں) کا احاطہ کر رکھا ہے اور ہر چیز کی گنتی شمار کر رکھا ہے.

t.149: O you enwrapped one,
t.84: O you, wrapped up in clothes,
t.85: You [Prophet], enfolded in your cloak!
t.95: O you the (sleeping) enwrapped one!
t.19: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!
t.22: O thou folded in garments!
t.203: O you wrapped in garments (i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)!
t.54: اے کپڑے میں لپٹنے والے.

t.149: stand upduring the night except a little–
t.84: stand at night (for prayer) except a little-
t.85: Stay up throughout the night, all but a small part of it,
t.95: Stand up in Prayer by night, all but a small part of it;
t.19: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -
t.22: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night,-
t.203: Stand (to pray) all night, except a little -
t.54: رات (کے وقت نماز) میں کھڑے ہوجاؤ مگر کم.

t.149: for half of it or reduce it a little
t.84: -half of it, or make it a little less,
t.85: half, or a little less,
t.95: half of it, or reduce it a little;
t.19: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof
t.22: Half of it,- or a little less,
t.203: Half of it or a little less than that,
t.54: آدھی رات یا اس سے بھی کچھ کم کرلے.

t.149: or add to it, and chant the Recitalslowly and distinctly.
t.84: or make it a little more; and recite the Qur’ān clearly with tartīl (in a distinct and measured tone).
t.85: or a little more; recite the Quran slowly and distinctly:
t.95: or add to it a little; and recite the Qur'an slowly and distinctly.
t.19: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,
t.22: Or a little more; and recite the Qur'an in slow, measured rhythmic tones.
t.203: Or a little more. And recite the Qur’ân (aloud) in a slow, (pleasant tone and) style.
t.54: یا اس پر بڑھا دے اور قرآن کو ٹھہر ٹھہر کر (صاف) پڑھا کر.

t.149: Indeed, We are about to cast upon youa heavy word.
t.84: We are going to send down to you a weighty discourse.
t.85: We shall send a momentous message down to you.
t.95: Behold, We shall cast upon you a Weighty Word.
t.19: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.
t.22: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message.
t.203: Verily, We shall send down to you a weighty Word (i.e. obligations, laws).
t.54: یقیناً ہم تجھ پر بہت بھاری بات عنقریب نازل کریں گے.

t.149: The vigil of the night is indeed more intense and more upright for articulation.
t.84: Truly, rising by night (for prayer of tahajjud) is the most effective way to subdue (one’s base self) and to make speech more upright.
t.85: Night prayer makes a deeper impression and sharpens words––
t.95: Surely getting up at night is the best means of subduing the self and is more suitable for uprightness in speech.
t.19: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.
t.22: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).
t.203: Verily, the rising by night (for Tahajjud prayer) is very hard and most potent and good for governing oneself, and most suitable for (understanding) the Word (of Allâh).
t.54: بیشک رات کا اٹھنا دل جمعی کے لیے انتہائی مناسب ہے اور بات کو بہت درست کر دینے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Indeed, in the daytime youhave lengthy work to do.
t.84: Surely, in daytime, you have a lengthy work to do.
t.85: you are kept busy for long periods of the day––
t.95: You are indeed much occupied during the day with the affairs of the world.
t.19: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.
t.22: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
t.203: Verily, there is for you by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties.
t.54: یقیناً تجھے دن میں بہت شغل رہتا ہے.

t.149: So remember the Name of yourLord and devote yourself to Him with(solemn) devotion.
t.84: And remember the name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him with exclusive devotion.
t.85: so celebrate the name of your Lord and devote yourself wholeheart-edly to Him.
t.95: So remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with exclusive devotion.
t.19: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
t.22: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
t.203: And remember the Name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with a complete devotion.
t.54: تو اپنے رب کے نام کا ذکر کیا کر اور تمام خلائق سے کٹ کر اس کی طرف متوجہ ہوجا.

t.149: (He is) the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He, so take Him as a Trustee.
t.84: He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He; so take Him for (your) Guardian.
t.85: He is Lord of the east and west, there is no god but Him, so take Him as your Protector,
t.95: He is the Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He. So take Him alone for your Guardian,
t.19: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -
t.22: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.
t.203: (He Alone is) the Lord of the east and the west; Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). So take Him Alone as Wakîl (Disposer of your affairs).
t.54: مشرق ومغرب کا پروردگار جس کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں، تو اسی کو اپنا کار ساز بنالے.

t.149: And endure patiently what they say, and withdraw from them politely.
t.84: And bear patiently what they (the opponents) say, and part with them in a beautiful manner.
t.85: patiently endure what they say, ignore them politely,
t.95: And bear patiently the vain things they utter, and gracefully forsake them.
t.19: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.
t.22: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).
t.203: And be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) with what they say, and keep away from them in a good way.
t.54: اور جو کچھ وه کہیں تو سہتا ره اور وضعداری کے ساتھ ان سے الگ تھلگ ره.

t.149: And leave to Me the disbelievers, those of luxury, and give them a brief respite.
t.84: And leave Me alone (to deal) with the deniers, the people of luxury, and give them respite for a while.
t.85: and leave to Me those who deny the truth and live in luxury. Bear with them for a little while;
t.95: Leave it to Me to deal with the affluent ones who give the lie (to the Truth), and bear with them for a while.
t.19: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
t.22: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
t.203: And leave Me Alone to deal with the beliers (those who deny My Verses), those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little while.
t.54: اور مجھے اور ان جھٹلانے والے آسوده حال لوگوں کو چھوڑ دے اور انہیں ذرا سی مہلت دے.

t.149: Indeed, We have shackles and a purgatory
t.84: Surely with Us are fetters and flaming fire,
t.85: We have fetters, a blazing fire,
t.95: We have heavy fetters and a blazing Fire in store for them;
t.19: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,
t.22: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),
t.203: Verily, with Us are fetters (to bind them), and a raging Fire.
t.54: یقیناً ہمارے ہاں سخت بیڑیاں ہیں اور سلگتی ہوئی جہنم ہے.

t.149: and food that chokes and a painful punishment
t.84: and food that chokes, and a painful punishment
t.85: food that chokes, and agonizing torment in store for them
t.95: and a food that chokes, and a grievous chastisement.
t.19: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom
t.22: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.
t.203: And a food that chokes, and a painful torment.
t.54: اور حلق میں اٹکنے واﻻ کھانا ہے اور درد دینے واﻻ عذاب ہے.

t.149: on the day when the earth and the mountains tremble and the mountains becameheaps of sand.
t.84: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will quake, and the mountains will turn into a slipping heap of sand.
t.85: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will shake. The mountains will become a heap of loose sand.
t.95: (They will come across all this) on the Day when the earth and the mountains shall tremble violently and the mountains shall crumble into heaps of scattered sand.
t.19: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.
t.22: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
t.203: On the Day when the earth and the mountains will be in violent shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out.
t.54: جس دن زمین اور پہاڑ تھرتھرا جائیں گے اور پہاڑ مثل بھربھری ریت کے ٹیلوں کے ہوجائیں گے.

t.149: Indeed, We have sent to youa messenger as a witness over you, as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
t.84: (O people,) We have sent to you a messenger, as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).
t.85: We have sent a messenger to you [people] to be your witness, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh,
t.95: Surely We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness over you, just as We had sent a Messenger to Pharaoh.
t.19: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.
t.22: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
t.203: Verily, We have sent to you (O men) a Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)] to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).
t.54: بیشک ہم نے تمہاری طرف بھی تم پر گواہی دینے واﻻ رسول بھیج دیا ہے جیسے کہ ہم نے فرعون کے پاس رسول بھیجا تھا.

t.149: But Pharaoh disobeyed the Messenger, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.
t.84: Then, Fir‘aun disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a severe seizure.
t.85: but Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger and so We inflicted a heavy punishment on him.
t.95: But Pharaoh disobeyed Our Messenger, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.
t.19: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.
t.22: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.
t.203: But Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) disobeyed the Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)]; so We seized him with a severe punishment.
t.54: تو فرعون نے اس رسول کی نافرمانی کی تو ہم نے اسے سخت (وبال کی) پکڑ میں پکڑ لیا.

t.149: So how, if youdeny, will you guard yourselves from a day which turns children gray-haired?
t.84: So, if you disbelieve, how will you save yourself from a day that will turn the small boys into grey-headed old men,
t.85: So if you disbelieve, how can you guard yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair grey,
t.95: If you persist in disbelieving, how will you guard yourself against the (woe of the) Day that will turn children grey-haired,
t.19: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,
t.22: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-
t.203: Then how can you avoid the punishment, if you disbelieve, on a Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) that will make the children grey-headed?
t.54: تم اگر کافر رہے تو اس دن کیسے پناه پاؤ گے جو دن بچوں کو بوڑھا کردے گا.

t.149: The heaven shatters thereby; His promise has always been fulfilled.
t.84: whereby the sky will burst apart. His promise has to be fulfilled.
t.85: a Day when the sky will be torn apart? God’s promise will certainly be fulfilled.
t.95: the Day whose severity shall cause the heaven to split asunder? Allah's promise is ever bound to be fulfilled.
t.19: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.
t.22: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.
t.203: Whereon the heaven will be cleft asunder? His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.
t.54: جس دن آسمان پھٹ جائے گا اللہ تعالیٰ کا یہ وعده ہو کر ہی رہنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Indeed, this is a reminding, so whoever wills, let him take a way to his Lord.
t.84: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.
t.85: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes take the way to his Lord.
t.95: Indeed this is nothing but a Good Counsel; so let him who will take a way leading to his Lord.
t.19: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.
t.22: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!
t.203: Verily, this is an admonition: therefore whosoever will, let him take a Path to His Lord!
t.54: بیشک یہ نصیحت ہے پس جو چاہے اپنے رب کی طرف راه اختیار کرے.

t.149: Indeed, yourLord knows that you stand up nearly two-thirds of the night, and(sometimes you stand up) half of it , and(sometimes you stand up) one-third of it,along with a faction of those with you. And Allah determines the night and the day. He has known that youwill be unable to sustain it, so He has pardoned you. So recite of the Recitalwhatever is easy(for you) . He knew that some of you will be ill, and others traveling through the land seeking a share of Allah’s grace, and others combating in the way of Allah, so read of it what is possible for you, and establish the prayer, and bringthe purifying charity, and lend Allah a good loan. And whatever good you advance for yourselves, you will find it with Allah; it will be better and greater in reward. And seek Allah’s forgiveness; indeed, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Bestowing of mercy.
t.84: Your Lord knows that you stand (in prayer) for nearly two thirds of the night, and (at times) for half of it, and (at times) for one third of it, and (so do) a group of those who are with you. And Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you (O Muslims,) cannot do it in regular way; therefore He turned to you in mercy.Now, recite as much of the Qur’ān as is easy (for you). He knows that some of you may be sick, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and yet others fighting in Allah’s way. Therefore, recite as much of it as is easy. And establish Salāh, and pay Zakāh, and advance to Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you will send ahead for your own-selves, you will find it with Allah much better in condition, and much greater in reward. And seek forgiveness from Allah. Indeed Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.
t.85: [Prophet], your Lord is well aware that you sometimes spend nearly two-thirds of the night at prayer––sometimes half, sometimes a third––as do some of your followers. God determines the division of night and day. He knows that you will not be able to keep a measure of it and He has relented towards all of you, so recite as much of the Quran as is easy for you. He knows that some of you will be sick, some of you travelling through the land seeking God’s bounty, some of you fighting in God’s way: recite as much as is easy for you, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and make God a good loan. Whatever good you store up for yourselves will be improved and increased for you. Ask God for His forgiveness, He is most forgiving, most merciful.
t.95: (O Prophet), your Lord knows that you sometimes stand up in Prayer nearly two-thirds of the night, and sometimes half or one-third of it, and so does a party of those with you; Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He has shown mercy to you. So now recite as much of the Qur'an as you can. He knows that there are among you those who are sick and others who are journeying in the land in quest of Allah's bounty, and still others who are fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite as much of the Qur'an as you easily can, and establish Prayer, and pay Zakah, and give Allah a goodly loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you shall find it with Allah. That is better and its reward is greater. And ask for Allah's forgiveness; surely He is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.
t.19: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
t.22: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
t.203: Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand (to pray at night) a little less than two thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and also a party of those with you. And Allâh measures the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to pray the whole night, so He has turned to you (in mercy). So, recite you of the Qur’ân as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there will be some among you sick, others travelling through the land, seeking of Allâh’s Bounty, yet others fighting in Allâh’s Cause. So recite as much of the Qur’ân as may be easy (for you), and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât ) and give Zakât, and lend to Allâh a goodly loan. And whatever good you send before you for yourselves (i.e. Nawâfil non-obligatory acts of worship: prayers, charity, fasting, Hajj and ‘Umrah), you will certainly find it with Allâh, better and greater in reward. And seek Forgiveness of Allâh. Verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.
t.54: آپ کا رب بخوبی جانتا ہے کہ آپ اور آپ کے ساتھ کے لوگوں کی ایک جماعت قریب دو تہائی رات کے اور آدھی رات کے اور ایک تہائی رات کے تہجد پڑھتی ہے اور رات دن کا پورا اندازه اللہ تعالیٰ کو ہی ہے، وه (خوب) جانتا ہے کہ تم اسے ہرگز نہ نبھا سکو گے پس اس نے تم پر مہربانی کی لہٰذا جتنا قرآن پڑھنا تمہارے لیے آسان ہو اتنا ہی پڑھو، وه جانتا ہے کہ تم میں بعض بیمار بھی ہوں گے، بعض دوسرے زمین میں چل پھر کر اللہ تعالیٰ کا فضل (یعنی روزی بھی) تلاش کریں گے اور کچھ لوگ اللہ تعالیٰ کی راه میں جہاد بھی کریں گے، سو تم بہ آسانی جتنا قرآن پڑھ سکو پڑھو اور نماز کی پابندی رکھو اور زکوٰة دیتے رہا کرو اور اللہ تعالیٰ کو اچھا قرض دو۔ اور جو نیکی تم اپنے لیے آگے بھیجو گے اسے اللہ تعالیٰ کے ہاں بہتر سے بہتر اور ﺛواب میں بہت زیاده پاؤ گے اللہ تعالیٰ سے معافی مانگتے رہو۔ یقیناً اللہ تعالیٰ بخشنے واﻻ. مہربان ہے

t.149: O you shrouded(in your mantle) —
t.84: O you, enveloped in a mantle,
t.85: You, wrapped in your cloak,
t.95: O you enveloped in your cloak!
t.19: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,
t.22: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!
t.203: O you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) enveloped in garments!
t.54: اے کپڑا اوڑھنے والے.

t.149: stand up and warn!
t.84: stand up and warn,
t.85: arise and give warning!
t.95: Arise, and warn,
t.19: Arise and warn!
t.22: Arise and deliver thy warning!
t.203: Arise and warn!
t.54: کھڑا ہوجا اور آگاه کردے.

t.149: And yourLord glorify!
t.84: and pronounce the greatness of your Lord,
t.85: Proclaim the greatness of your Lord;
t.95: and magnify the glory of your Lord,
t.19: Thy Lord magnify,
t.22: And thy Lord do thou magnify!
t.203: And magnify your Lord (Allâh)!
t.54: اور اپنے رب ہی کی بڑائیاں بیان کر.

t.149: And yourclothes purify!
t.84: and purify your clothes,
t.85: cleanse yourself;
t.95: and purify your robes,
t.19: Thy raiment purify,
t.22: And thy garments keep free from stain!
t.203: And purify your garments!
t.54: اپنے کپڑوں کو پاک رکھا کر.

t.149: And abominations forsake!
t.84: and keep away from filth,
t.85: keep away from all filth;
t.95: and shun uncleanness,
t.19: Pollution shun!
t.22: And all abomination shun!
t.203: And keep away from Ar-Rujz (the idols)!
t.54: ناپاکی کو چھوڑ دے.

t.149: And showno favor, seeking self-gain!
t.84: and do not do a favour (to anyone merely) to seek more (in return).
t.85: do not be overwhelmed and weaken;
t.95: and bestow not favour in order to seek from others a greater return,
t.19: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!
t.22: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!
t.203: And give not a thing in order to have more (or consider not your deeds of obedience to Allâh as a favour to Him).
t.54: اور احسان کرکے زیاده لینے کی خواہش نہ کر.

t.149: And to yourLord endure patiently!
t.84: And for the sake of your Lord, observe patience.
t.85: be steadfast in your Lord’s cause.
t.95: and persevere for your Lord's sake.
t.19: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!
t.22: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!
t.203: And be patient for the sake of your Lord (i.e. perform your duty to Allâh)!
t.54: اور اپنے رب کی راه میں صبر کر.

t.149: So when the Trumpet is blown,
t.84: For when the trumpet will be blown,
t.85: When the Trumpet sounds,
t.95: When the Trumpet shall be sounded,
t.19: For when the trumpet shall sound,
t.22: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
t.203: Then, when the Trumpet is sounded (i.e. the second blowing of the horn).
t.54: پس جب کہ صور میں پھونک ماری جائے گی.

t.149: that day will be a difficult day
t.84: that day will be a difficult day,
t.85: that will be a Day of anguish for the disbelievers.
t.95: that will surely be a hard day,
t.19: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,
t.22: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-
t.203: Truly, that Day will be a Hard Day -
t.54: تو وه دن بڑا سخت دن ہوگا.

t.149: for the deniers—not easy.
t.84: not easy for the disbelievers.
t.85: They will have no ease.
t.95: not an easy day for the unbelievers.
t.19: Not of ease, for disbelievers.
t.22: Far from easy for those without Faith.
t.203: Far from easy for the disbelievers.
t.54: جو کافروں پر آسان نہ ہوگا.

t.149: Leaveto Me the one whom I created alone,
t.84: Leave me alone (to deal) with the one whom I created lonely,
t.85: [Prophet], leave Me to deal with the one I created helpless,
t.95: Leave Me with him whom I alone have created,
t.19: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,
t.22: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-
t.203: Leave Me Alone (to deal) with whom I created lonely (without any wealth or children etc, i.e. Al-Walîd bin Al-Mughîrah Al-Makhzûmî)!
t.54: مجھے اور اسے چھوڑ دے جسے میں نے اکیلا پیدا کیا ہے.

t.149: and to whom I gave vast wealth
t.84: and gave him extensive wealth,
t.85: then gave vast wealth,
t.95: whom I have endowed with abundant riches,
t.19: And then bestowed upon him ample means,
t.22: To whom I granted resources in abundance,
t.203: And then granted him resources in abundance.
t.54: اور اسے بہت سا مال دے رکھا ہے.

t.149: and children by his side,
t.84: and sons present before (his) eyes,
t.85: and sons by his side,
t.95: and sons ever present with him,
t.19: And sons abiding in his presence
t.22: And sons to be by his side!-
t.203: And children to be by his side.
t.54: اور حاضر باش فرزند بھی.

t.149: and smoothed things for him—
t.84: and extended (power and honour) to him pretty well.
t.85: making everything easy for him––
t.95: and for whom I have smoothed the way (to power and riches),
t.19: And made (life) smooth for him.
t.22: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
t.203: And made life smooth and comfortable for him.
t.54: اور میں نے اسے بہت کچھ کشادگی دے رکھی ہے.

t.149: yet he ardently hopes that I give more!
t.84: Still, he aspires that I should give him more.
t.85: yet he still hopes I will give him more.
t.95: and who still greedily desires that I should bestow upon him more.
t.19: Yet he desireth that I should give more.
t.22: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-
t.203: After all that he desires that I should give more;
t.54: پھر بھی اس کی چاہت ہے کہ میں اسے اور زیاده دوں.

t.149: But no! He was stubborn towards Our signs
t.84: Never! He is inimical towards Our verses.
t.85: No! He has been stubbornly hostile to Our revelation:
t.95: By no means; he is stubbornly opposed to Our Signs.
t.19: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.
t.22: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
t.203: Nay! Verily, he has been opposing Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations).
t.54: نہیں نہیں، وه ہماری آیتوں کا مخالف ہے.

t.149: I will exhaust him increasingly.
t.84: I will force him to climb the mountain Sa‘ūd.
t.85: I will inflict a spiralling torment on him.
t.95: I shall soon constrain him to a hard ascent.
t.19: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.
t.22: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!
t.203: I shall oblige him to (climb a slippery mountain in the Hell-fire called As-Sa‘ûd, or) face a severe torment!
t.54: عنقریب میں اسے ایک سخت چڑھائی چڑھاؤں گا.

t.149: He thought and determined.
t.84: He pondered and surmised.
t.85: He planned and plotted––
t.95: He reflected and then hatched a scheme.
t.19: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -
t.22: For he thought and he plotted;-
t.203: Verily, he thought and plotted.
t.54: اس نے غور کرکے تجویز کی.

t.149: May he perish—how he determined!
t.84: Death onto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!
t.85: devilishly he plotted!
t.95: Ruin seize him, how did he hatch a scheme?
t.19: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!
t.22: And woe to him! How he plotted!-
t.203: So let him be cursed: how he plotted!
t.54: اسے ہلاکت ہو کیسی (تجویز) سوچی؟

t.149: Again: may he perish—how he determined!
t.84: Again, death unto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!
t.85: ferociously he plotted!––
t.95: Again, ruin seize him, how did he hatch a scheme?
t.19: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -
t.22: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-
t.203: And once more let him be cursed: how he plotted!
t.54: وه پھر غارت ہو کس طرح اندازه کیا.

t.149: Then he looked,
t.84: Then he looked (to those around him,)
t.85: and looked
t.95: He looked (at others);
t.19: Then looked he,
t.22: Then he looked round;
t.203: Then he thought.
t.54: اس نے پھر دیکھا.

t.149: then he frowned and scowled,
t.84: then he frowned and scowled,
t.85: and frowned and scowled
t.95: then frowned and scowled;
t.19: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.
t.22: Then he frowned and he scowled;
t.203: Then he frowned and he looked in a bad tempered way;
t.54: پھر تیوری چڑھائی اور منھ بنایا.

t.149: then he retreated and acted arrogantly
t.84: then turned his back, and waxed proud,
t.85: and turned away and behaved arrogantly
t.95: then he retreated and waxed proud,
t.19: Then turned he away in pride
t.22: Then he turned back and was haughty;
t.203: Then he turned back, and was proud.
t.54: پھر پیچھے ہٹ گیا اور غرور کیا.

t.149: and said, “This is nothing but sorcery from the past.
t.84: then said, “This is nothing but traditional magic;
t.85: and said, ‘This is just old sorcery,
t.95: and said: “This (Qur'an) is merely a sorcery of yore;
t.19: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;
t.22: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;
t.203: Then he said: "This is nothing but magic from that of old,
t.54: اور کہنے لگا تو یہ صرف جادو ہے جو نقل کیا جاتا ہے.

t.149: This is nothing but the word of a human being.”
t.84: this is nothing but saying of a mortal.”
t.85: just the talk of a mortal!’
t.95: this is nothing but the word of a mere mortal!”
t.19: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.
t.22: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"
t.203: "This is nothing but the word of a human being!"
t.54: سوائے انسانی کلام کے کچھ بھی نہیں ہے.

t.149: I will roast him in Saqar.
t.84: I will put him into Saqar (Hell).
t.85: I will throw him into the scorching Fire.
t.95: Him shall I soon roast in Hell.
t.19: Him shall I fling unto the burning.
t.22: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!
t.203: I will cast him into Hell-fire.
t.54: میں عنقریب اسے دوزخ میں ڈالوں گا.

t.149: But what can make yourealize what Saqar is?
t.84: And what can let you know what Saqar is?
t.85: What will explain to you what the scorching Fire is?
t.95: And what do you know what Hell is?
t.19: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -
t.22: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
t.203: And what will make you know (exactly) what Hell-fire is?
t.54: اور تجھے کیا خبر کہ دوزخ کیا چیز ہے؟

t.149: It neither leaves nor spares;
t.84: It neither spares (anything inside it from burning) nor leaves (any disbeliever outside).
t.85: It spares nothing and leaves nothing;
t.95: It spares nothing; it leaves nothing intact;
t.19: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught
t.22: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-
t.203: It spares not (any sinner), nor does it leave (anything unburnt)!
t.54: نہ وه باقی رکھتی ہے نہ چھوڑتی ہے.

t.149: it scorches the flesh;
t.84: It will disfigure the skins.
t.85: it scorches the flesh of humans;
t.95: it scorches (even) the skin.
t.19: It shrivelleth the man.
t.22: Darkening and changing the colour of man!
t.203: Burning and blackening the skins!
t.54: کھال کو جھلسا دیتی ہے.

t.149: over it are nineteen.
t.84: Appointed on it are nineteen (wardens).
t.85: there are nineteen in charge of it––
t.95: Over it are nineteen keepers.
t.19: Above it are nineteen.
t.22: Over it are Nineteen.
t.203: Over it are nineteen (angels as guardians and keepers of Hell).
t.54: اور اس میں انیس (فرشتے مقرر) ہیں.

t.149: And We have not appointed except angels to be wardens of the Fire and have made their number nothing but a means of trial for the deniers—so that those given the Scripture may attain certitude, and those who have attained belief may increase in faith, and those given the Scripture and the believers may not doubt, and so that those in whose hearts is sickness and the deniers may say, “What did Allah desire by this parable?” Thus Allah misguides whomever He wills and guides whomever He wills, and none knows the soldiers of yourLord except He, and this is nothing but a reminder to human beings.
t.84: And We did not make wardens of the Fire but (from) angels, and did not fix their number but as a test for those who disbelieve, so that those who are given the Book may come to believe, and those who believe may improve in belief, and so that those who are given the Book and those who believe may not doubt (its correctness), and so that those having malady in their hearts and the disbelievers say, “What has Allah meant by this strange statement?” Thus Allah lets go astray whomever He wills, and leads to the right path whomever He wills. And no one knows the hosts of your Lord but He. And this is nothing else but a reminder for mankind.
t.85: none other than angels appointed by Us to guard Hellfire- and We have made their number a test for the disbelievers. So those who have been given the Scripture will be certain and those who believe will have their faith increased: neither those who have been given the Scripture nor the believers will have any doubts, but the sick at heart and the disbelievers will say, ‘What could God mean by this description?’ God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will- no one knows your Lord’s forces except Him- this [description] is a warning to mortals.
t.95: We have appointed none but angels as the keepers of the Fire, and We have not made their number but as a trial for the unbelievers so that those who have been endowed with the Book will be convinced and the believers' faith will increase, and neither those who have been endowed with the Book nor the believers will fall into any doubt. As for those in whose hearts there is a sickness as well as the unbelievers, they will say: “What did Allah aim at by this strange parable?” Thus does Allah let whomsoever He pleases to go astray, and directs whomsoever He pleases to the Right Way. And none knows the hosts of your Lord but He. (And Hell has only been mentioned here) that people may take heed.
t.19: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
t.22: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.
t.203: And We have set none but angels as guardians of the Fire. And We have fixed their number (19) only as a trial for the disbelievers, in order that the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) may arrive at a certainty [that this Qur’ân is the truth as it agrees with their Books regarding the number (19) which is written in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] and that the believers may increase in Faith (as this Qur’ân is the truth), and that no doubt may be left for the people of the Scripture and the believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease (of hypocrisy) and the disbelievers may say: "What Allâh intends by this (curious) example ?" Thus Allâh leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none can know the hosts of your Lord but He. And this (Hell) is nothing else than a (warning) reminder to mankind.
t.54: ہم نے دوزخ کے داروغے صرف فرشتے رکھے ہیں۔ اور ہم نے ان کی تعداد صرف کافروں کی آزمائش کے لیے مقرر کی ہے تاکہ اہل کتاب یقین کرلیں، اوراہل ایمان کے ایمان میں اضافہ ہو جائے اور اہل کتاب اور اہل ایمان شک نہ کریں اور جن کے دلوں میں بیماری ہے وه اور کافر کہیں کہ اس بیان سے اللہ تعالیٰ کی کیا مراد ہے؟ اسی طرح اللہ تعالیٰ جسے چاہتا ہے گمراه کرتا ہے اور جسے چاہتا ہے ہدایت دیتا ہے۔ تیرے رب کے لشکروں کو اس کے سوا کوئی نہیں جانتا، یہ تو کل بنی آدم کے لیے سراسر پند ونصیحت ہے.

t.149: But no! By the moon.
t.84: Truly, I swear by the moon,
t.85: Yes––by the moon!
t.95: Nay, by the moon,
t.19: Nay, by the Moon
t.22: Nay, verily: By the Moon,
t.203: Nay! And by the moon
t.54: سچ کہتا ہوں قسم ہے چاند کی.

t.149: By the night as it retreated.
t.84: and by the night when it goes back,
t.85: By the departing night!
t.95: and by the night when it recedes,
t.19: And the night when it withdraweth
t.22: And by the Night as it retreateth,
t.203: And by the night when it withdraws.
t.54: اور رات کی جب وه پیچھے ہٹے.

t.149: By the morning when it lights up—
t.84: and by the morning when it becomes bright,
t.85: By the shining dawn!
t.95: and by the day when it dawns (with its radiance),
t.19: And the dawn when it shineth forth,
t.22: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
t.203: And by the dawn when it brightens.
t.54: اور صبح کی جب کہ روشن ہو جائے.

t.149: indeed, it is one of the greatest things:
t.84: it (Saqar : Hell) is one of the greatest things
t.85: It is one of the mightiest things,
t.95: surely (Hell) is one of the greatest Signs,
t.19: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)
t.22: This is but one of the mighty (portents),
t.203: Verily, it (Hell, or their denial of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, or the Day of Resurrection) is but one of the greatest (signs).
t.54: کہ (یقیناً وه جہنم) بڑی چیزوں میں سے ایک ہے.

t.149: a warning to human beings,
t.84: as a warning to the mankind,
t.85: a warning to all mortals,
t.95: a warning to humankind,
t.19: As a warning unto men,
t.22: A warning to mankind,-
t.203: A warning to mankind -
t.54: بنی آدم کو ڈرانے والی.

t.149: to whomever of you who wishes to advance or regress.
t.84: to the one from among you who wishes to come forward (towards good deeds) or to go back (from them).
t.85: to those of you who choose to go ahead and those who lag behind.
t.95: a warning to everyone of you whether he would like to come forward or lag behind.
t.19: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.
t.22: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-
t.203: To any of you that chooses to go forward (by working righteous deeds), or to remain behind (by committing sins).
t.54: (یعنی) اسے جو تم میں سے آگے بڑھنا چاہے یا پیچھے ہٹنا چاہے.

t.149: Every single self is held in pledge for what it has earned,
t.84: Everyone will be detained (in the Hell) because of what he did,
t.85: Every soul is held in pledge for its deeds,
t.95: Each one is a hostage to one's deeds,
t.19: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;
t.22: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.
t.203: Every person is a pledge for what he has earned,
t.54: ہر شخص اپنے اعمال کے بدلے میں گروی ہے.

t.149: except for those on the Right—
t.84: except the People of the Right, (i.e. those who will be given their Book of Deeds in their right hands)
t.85: but the Companions of the Right will stay
t.95: save the People of the Right Hand
t.19: Save those who will stand on the right hand.
t.22: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.
t.203: Except those on the Right, (i.e. the pious true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: مگر دائیں ہاتھ والے.

t.149: in Gardens(of Paradise) , inquiring
t.84: who will be in gardens, asking
t.85: in Gardens and ask
t.95: who shall be in the Gardens, and shall ask
t.19: In gardens they will ask one another
t.22: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,
t.203: In Gardens (Paradise) they will ask one another,
t.54: کہ وه بہشتوں میں (بیٹھے ہوئے) گناه گاروں سے.

t.149: about the criminals:
t.84: about the guilty persons,
t.85: about the guilty.
t.95: about the guilty ones:
t.19: Concerning the guilty:
t.22: And (ask) of the Sinners:
t.203: About Al-Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, disbelievers), (And they will say to them):
t.54: سوال کرتے ہوں گے.

t.149: “What drove youinto Saqar?”
t.84: “What has brought you to Saqar? (Hell)”
t.85: ‘What drove you to the Scorching Fire?’ [they will ask]
t.95: “What drove you to Hell?”
t.19: What hath brought you to this burning?
t.22: "What led you into Hell Fire?"
t.203: "What has caused you to enter Hell?"
t.54: تمہیں دوزخ میں کس چیز نے ڈاﻻ.

t.149: They said, “We were not of those who prayed,
t.84: They will say, “We were not among those who offered Salāh , (obligatory prayer)
t.85: and they will answer, ‘We did not pray;
t.95: They will answer: “We were not among those who observed Prayer,
t.19: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed
t.22: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;
t.203: They will say: "We were not of those who used to offer the Salât (prayers),
t.54: وه جواب دیں گے کہ ہم نمازی نہ تھے.

t.149: nor did we feed the destitute,
t.84: and we did not give food to the needy,
t.85: we did not feed the poor;
t.95: and we did not feed the poor,
t.19: Nor did we feed the wretched.
t.22: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;
t.203: "Nor we used to feed Al-Miskîn (the poor);
t.54: نہ مسکینوں کو کھانا کھلاتے تھے.

t.149: and we used to indulge(in falsehood) with those who indulged,
t.84: and we indulged (in mocking at the truth) along with those who indulged,
t.85: we indulged with others [in mocking the believers];
t.95: and we indulged in vain talk with those who indulged in vain talk,
t.19: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,
t.22: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;
t.203: "And we used to talk falsehood (all that which Allâh hated) with vain talkers.
t.54: اور ہم بحﺚ کرنے والے (انکاریوں) کا ساتھ دے کر بحﺚ مباحثہ میں مشغول رہا کرتے تھے.

t.149: and we used to deny the Day of Recompense,
t.84: and we used to deny the Day of Requital,
t.85: we denied the Day of Judgement
t.95: and we gave the lie to the Day of Judgement
t.19: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
t.22: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
t.203: And we used to belie the Day of Recompense,
t.54: اور روز جزا کو جھٹلاتے تھے.

t.149: until the certitude(of death) came to us.”
t.84: until when we were overtaken by that which is certain.”
t.85: until the Certain End came upon us.’
t.95: until the inevitable event overtook us.”
t.19: Till the Inevitable came unto us.
t.22: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."
t.203: "Until there came to us (the death) that is certain."
t.54: یہاں تک کہ ہمیں موت آگئی.

t.149: So in no way can the intercession of intercessors help them.
t.84: Then intercession of intercessors will not benefit them.
t.85: No intercessor’s plea will benefit them now.
t.95: The intercession of the intercessors shall then be of no avail to them.
t.19: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.
t.22: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
t.203: So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them.
t.54: پس انہیں سفارش کرنے والوں کی سفارش نفع نہ دے گی.

t.149: So why are they disregarding the Reminder,
t.84: So what has happened to them that they are turning away from the Reminder,
t.85: What is the matter with them? Why do they turn away from the warning,
t.95: What is the matter with people that they are turning away from this Exhortation,
t.19: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,
t.22: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-
t.203: Then what is wrong with them (i.e. the polytheists, the disbelievers) that they turn away from (receiving) admonition?
t.54: انہیں کیا ہو گیا ہے؟ کہ نصیحت سے منھ موڑ رہے ہیں.

t.149: as though they were panicked donkeys ,
t.84: as if they were wild donkeys,
t.85: like frightened asses
t.95: as though they were frightened wild asses,
t.19: As they were frightened asses
t.22: As if they were affrighted asses,
t.203: As if they were (frightened) wild donkeys.
t.54: گویا کہ وه بِدکے ہوئے گدھے ہیں.

t.149: having fled from a lion?
t.84: fleeing from a lion?
t.85: fleeing from a lion?
t.95: fleeing from a lion?
t.19: Fleeing from a lion?
t.22: Fleeing from a lion!
t.203: Fleeing from a hunter, or a lion, or a beast of prey.
t.54: جو شیر سے بھاگے ہوں.

t.149: Yet every one of them wants to be given scrolls unrolled.
t.84: Rather, every one of them wishes that he should be given unrolled (divine) scriptures.
t.85: Each one of them demands that a scripture be sent down to him and unrolled before his very eyes-
t.95: No indeed; each one of them desires that open letters be sent to each of them.
t.19: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).
t.22: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!
t.203: Nay, everyone of them desires that he should be given pages spread out (coming from Allâh with a writing that Islâm is the right religion, and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم has come with the truth from Allâh, the Lord of the heavens and earth).
t.54: بلکہ ان میں سے ہر شخص چاہتا ہے کہ اسے کھلی ہوئی کتابیں دی جائیں.

t.149: But no! Rather, they do not fear the Hereafter.
t.84: Never! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
t.85: No! Truly they have no fear of the life to come-
t.95: No indeed; the truth is that they have no fear of the Hereafter.
t.19: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.
t.22: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,
t.203: Nay! But they fear not the Hereafter (from Allâh’s punishment).
t.54: ہرگز ایسا نہیں (ہوسکتا بلکہ) یہ قیامت سے بے خوف ہیں.

t.149: But no! It is a Reminder.
t.84: Never! Indeed, this is a Reminder.
t.85: but truly this is a reminder.
t.95: Nay; this is an Exhortation.
t.19: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.
t.22: Nay, this surely is an admonition:
t.203: Nay, verily, this (Qur’an) is an admonition,
t.54: سچی بات تو یہ ہے کہ یہ (قرآن) ایک نصیحت ہے.

t.149: So whoever wills shall remember it.
t.84: So, whoever so wishes may take advice from it.
t.85: Let whoever wishes to take heed do so:
t.95: So, whoever wills may benefit from it.
t.19: So whosoever will may heed.
t.22: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!
t.203: So whosoever will (let him read it), and receive admonition (from it)!
t.54: اب جو چاہے اس سے نصیحت حاصل کرے.

t.149: Yet they will not rememberunless Allah wills; He is Worthy of mindfulness and Worthy of(bestowing) forgiveness.
t.84: And they will not take advice unless Allah so wills. He is worthy to be feared, and worthy to forgive.
t.85: they will only take heed if God so wishes. He is the Lord who should be heeded, the Lord of forgiveness.
t.95: But they will not benefit from it unless Allah Himself so wills. He is worthy to be feared; and He is worthy to forgive (those that fear Him).
t.19: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.
t.22: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
t.203: And they will not receive admonition unless Allâh wills; He (Allâh) is the One, deserving that mankind should be afraid of, and should be dutiful to Him, and should not take any Ilâh (god) along with Him, and He is the One Who forgives (sins).
t.54: اور وه اس وقت نصیحت حاصل کریں گے جب اللہ تعالیٰ چاہے، وه اسی ﻻئق ہے کہ اس سے ڈریں اور اس ﻻئق بھی کہ وه بخشے.

t.149: No!I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
t.84: I swear by the Day of Resurrection,
t.85: By the Day of Resurrection
t.95: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
t.19: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
t.22: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;
t.203: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
t.54: میں قسم کھاتا ہوں قیامت کے دن کی.

t.149: And, no! I swear by the reproaching(inner) self.
t.84: and I swear by the self-reproaching conscience, (that Resurrection is a reality.)
t.85: and by the self-reproaching soul!
t.95: and nay, I swear by the self-reproaching soul!
t.19: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).
t.22: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).
t.203: And I swear by the self-reproaching person (a believer).
t.54: اور قسم کھاتا ہوں اس نفس کی جو ملامت کرنے واﻻ ہو.

t.149: Does man think that We will not reassemble his bones?
t.84: Does man think that We will never reassemble his bones?
t.85: Does man think We shall not put his bones back together?
t.95: Does man imagine that We will not be able to bring his bones together again?
t.19: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?
t.22: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?
t.203: Does man (a disbeliever) think that We shall not assemble his bones?
t.54: کیا انسان یہ خیال کرتا ہے کہ ہم اس کی ہڈیاں جمع کریں گے ہی نہیں.

t.149: Yes indeed; We are Able to form his very fingertips.
t.84: Why (can We) not (do so), while We are able to reset (even) his fingertips perfectly?
t.85: In fact, We can reshape his very fingertips.
t.95: Yes indeed; We have the power to remould even his finger-tips.
t.19: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!
t.22: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.
t.203: Yes, We are Able to put together in perfect order the tips of his fingers.
t.54: ہاں ضرور کریں گے ہم تو قادر ہیں کہ اس کی پور پور تک درست کردیں.

t.149: Rather, man wants to commit vice ever onward.
t.84: But man wishes to go on violating Allah’s injunctions (even in future) ahead of him.
t.85: Yet man wants to deny what is ahead of him:
t.95: But man desires to persist in his evil ways.
t.19: But man would fain deny what is before him.
t.22: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.
t.203: Nay! Man (denies Resurrection and Reckoning. So he) desires to continue committing sins.
t.54: بلکہ انسان تو چاہتا ہے کہ آگے آگے نافرمانیاں کرتا جائے.

t.149: He asks, “When is the Day of Resurrection?”
t.84: He asks, “When will be this Day of Resurrection?”
t.85: he says, ‘So, when will this Day of Resurrection be?’
t.95: He asks: “When will the Day of Resurrection be?”
t.19: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
t.22: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
t.203: He asks: "When will be this Day of Resurrection?"
t.54: پوچھتا ہے کہ قیامت کا دن کب آئے گا.

t.149: So, when the sight is dazzled ,
t.84: So, when the eyes will be dazzled,
t.85: When eyes are dazzled
t.95: When the sight is dazed,
t.19: But when sight is confounded
t.22: At length, when the sight is dazed,
t.203: So, when the sight shall be dazed.
t.54: پس جس وقت کہ نگاه پتھرا جائے گی.

t.149: and the moon is eclipsed,
t.84: and the moon will lose its light,
t.85: and the moon eclipsed,
t.95: and the moon is eclipsed,
t.19: And the moon is eclipsed
t.22: And the moon is buried in darkness.
t.203: And the moon will be eclipsed.
t.54: اور چاند بے نور ہو جائے گا.

t.149: and the sun and the moon are joined together—
t.84: and the sun and the moon will be joined together,
t.85: when the sun and the moon are brought together,
t.95: and the sun and the moon are joined together,
t.19: And sun and moon are united,
t.22: And the sun and moon are joined together,-
t.203: And the sun and moon will be joined together (by going one into the other or folded up or deprived of their light).
t.54: اور سورج اور چاند جمع کردیئے جائیں گے.

t.149: man says on that day, “Where is the escape?”
t.84: on that day man will say, “Where to escape?”
t.85: on that Day man will say, ‘Where can I escape?’
t.95: on that Day will man say: “Whither the refuge?”
t.19: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
t.22: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"
t.203: On that Day man will say: "Where (is the refuge) to flee?"
t.54: اس دن انسان کہے گا کہ آج بھاگنے کی جگہ کہاں ہے؟

t.149: But no! There is no refuge.
t.84: Never! There will be no refuge at all.
t.85: Truly, there is no refuge:
t.95: No, there is no refuge.
t.19: Alas! No refuge!
t.22: By no means! No place of safety!
t.203: No! There is no refuge!
t.54: نہیں نہیں کوئی پناہ گاه نہیں.

t.149: To yourLord on that day everything comes to reside.
t.84: On that day, towards your Lord will be the destination (of everyone.)
t.85: they will all return to your Lord on that Day.
t.95: With your Lord alone will be the retreat that Day.
t.19: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.
t.22: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.
t.203: Unto your Lord (Alone) will be the place of rest that Day.
t.54: آج تو تیرے پروردگار کی طرف ہی قرار گاه ہے.

t.149: Man is informed on that day of whatever he put forth and whatever he left behind.
t.84: Man will be informed of what he sent ahead and what he left behind.
t.85: On that Day, man will be told what he put first and what he put last.
t.95: On that Day will man be apprised of his deeds, both the earlier and the later.
t.19: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.
t.22: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.
t.203: On that Day man will be informed of what he sent forward (of his evil good deeds), and what he left behind (of his good or evil traditions).
t.54: آج انسان کو اس کے آگے بھیجے ہوئے اور پیچھے چھوڑے ہوئے سے آگاه کیا جائے گا.

t.149: Rather, man is an eyewitness against himself,
t.84: Rather, man will be a witness against himself,
t.85: Truly, man is a clear witness against himself,
t.95: But lo, man is well aware of himself,
t.19: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
t.22: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,
t.203: Nay! Man will be a witness against himself [as his body parts (skin, hands, legs, etc.) will speak about his deeds],
t.54: بلکہ انسان خود اپنے اوپر آپ حجت ہے.

t.149: even as he presents his excuses.
t.84: even though he may offer his excuses.
t.85: despite all the excuses he may put forward.
t.95: even though he might make up excuses.
t.19: Although he tender his excuses.
t.22: Even though he were to put up his excuses.
t.203: Though he may put forth his excuses (to cover his evil deeds).
t.54: اگر چہ کتنے ہی بہانے پیش کرے.

t.149: Do not rush yourtongue with itto hurry on with it.
t.84: (O Prophet,) do not move your tongue (during revelation) for (reciting) it (the Qur’ān) to receive it in hurry.
t.85: [Prophet], do not rush your tongue in an attempt to hasten [your memorization of] the Revelation:
t.95: (O Prophet), do not stir your tongue hastily (to commit the Revelation to memory).
t.19: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.
t.22: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.
t.203: Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to make haste therewith.
t.54: (اے نبی) آپ قرآن کو جلدی (یاد کرنے) کے لیے اپنی زبان کو حرکت نہ دیں.

t.149: Indeed, upon Us is its collection and its recitation.
t.84: It is surely undertaken by Us to store it (in your heart), and to let it be recited (by you after revelation is completed).
t.85: We shall make sure of its safe collection and recitation.
t.95: Surely it is for Us to have you commit it to memory and to recite it.
t.19: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.
t.22: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:
t.203: It is for Us to collect it and to give you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the ability to recite it (the Qur’ân).
t.54: اس کا جمع کرنا اور (آپ کی زبان سے) پڑھنا ہمارے ذمہ ہے.

t.149: So, when We have recited it, followits recitation;
t.84: Therefore, when it is recited by Us (through the angel), follow its recitation (by concentration of your heart).
t.85: When We have recited it, repeat the recitation
t.95: And so when We recite it, follow its recitation attentively;
t.19: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;
t.22: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):
t.203: And when We have recited it to you [O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم through Jibrîl (Gabriel)], then follow its (the Qur’an’s) recital.
t.54: ہم جب اسے پڑھ لیں تو آپ اس کے پڑھنے کی پیروی کریں.

t.149: then upon Us is its explanation.
t.84: Then, it is undertaken by Us to explain it.
t.85: and We shall make it clear.
t.95: then it will be for Us to explain it.
t.19: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.
t.22: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):
t.203: Then it is for Us (Allâh) to make it clear (to you).
t.54: پھر اس کا واضح کر دینا ہمارے ذمہ ہے.

t.149: But no! Rather, youlove the fleeting life
t.84: Never, (your denial of Resurrection is never based on any sound reason!) Instead, you love that which is immediate,
t.85: Truly you [people] love this fleeting world
t.95: Nay; the truth is that you love ardently (the good of this world) that can be obtained hastily,
t.19: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
t.22: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,
t.203: Not [as you think, that you (mankind) will not be resurrected and recompensed for your deeds], but you (men) love the present life of this world,
t.54: نہیں نہیں تم جلدی ملنے والی (دنیا) کی محبت رکھتے ہو.

t.149: and you leave asidethe Hereafter.
t.84: and neglect the Hereafter.
t.85: and neglect the life to come.
t.95: and are oblivious of the Hereafter.
t.19: And neglect the Hereafter.
t.22: And leave alone the Hereafter.
t.203: And neglect the Hereafter.
t.54: اور آخرت کو چھوڑ بیٹھے ہو.

t.149: Some faces on that day are radiant,
t.84: Many faces, that day, will be glowing,
t.85: On that Day there will be radiant faces,
t.95: Some faces on that Day will be fresh and resplendent,
t.19: That day will faces be resplendent,
t.22: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-
t.203: Some faces that Day shall be Nâdirah (shining and radiant).
t.54: اس روز بہت سے چہرے تروتازه اور بارونق ہوں گے.

t.149: looking towards their Lord.
t.84: looking towards their Lord,
t.85: looking towards their Lord,
t.95: and will be looking towards their Lord;
t.19: Looking toward their Lord;
t.22: Looking towards their Lord;
t.203: Looking at their Lord (Allâh).
t.54: اپنے رب کی طرف دیکھتے ہوں گے.

t.149: And some faces on that day are gloomy,
t.84: and many faces, that day, will be gloomy,
t.85: and on that Day there will be the sad and despairing faces
t.95: and some faces on that Day will be gloomy,
t.19: And that day will other faces be despondent,
t.22: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,
t.203: And some faces, that Day, will be Bâsirah (dark, gloomy, frowning, and sad),
t.54: اور کتنے چہرے اس دن (بد رونق اور) اداس ہوں گے.

t.149: expecting that a back-breaking blow will be dealt them.
t.84: realizing that a back-breaking calamity is going to be afflicted on them.
t.85: of those who realize that a great calamity is about to befall them.
t.95: believing that a crushing calamity is about to strike them.
t.19: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.
t.22: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;
t.203: Thinking that some calamity is about to fall on them.
t.54: سمجھتے ہوں گے کہ ان کے ساتھ کمر توڑ دینے واﻻ معاملہ کیا جائے گا.

t.149: But no! Rather, when ithas reached the collarbone,
t.84: Never, (you will never remain in this world forever!) When the soul (of a patient) reaches the clavicles,
t.85: Truly, when the soul reaches the collarbone;
t.95: Nay; when a man's soul reaches up to the throat,
t.19: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
t.22: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),
t.203: Nay, when (the soul) reaches to the collar bone (i.e. up to the throat in its exit),
t.54: نہیں نہیں جب روح ہنسلی تک پہنچے گی.

t.149: and it is said, “Who is the healer?”
t.84: and it is said, “Who is an enchanter (that can save him?)”
t.85: when it is said, ‘Could any charm-healer save him now?’;
t.95: and it is said: “Is there any enchanter who can step forward and help (by his chanting)?”
t.19: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?
t.22: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"
t.203: And it will be said: "Who can cure him (and save him from death)?"
t.54: اور کہا جائے گا کہ کوئی جھاڑ پھونک کرنے واﻻ ہے؟

t.149: And one realizes that it is the final departure,
t.84: and he realizes that it is (the time of) departure (from the world,)
t.85: when he knows it is the final parting;
t.95: and he realises that the hour of parting is come,
t.19: And he knoweth that it is the parting;
t.22: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;
t.203: And he (the dying person) will conclude that it was (the time) of parting (death);
t.54: اور جان لیا اس نے کہ یہ وقت جدائی ہے.

t.149: and leg is entwined with leg—
t.84: and one shank is intertwined with the other shank,
t.85: when his legs are brought together:
t.95: and calf is inter-twined with calf.
t.19: And agony is heaped on agony;
t.22: And one leg will be joined with another:
t.203: And one leg will be joined with another leg (shrouded).
t.54: اور پنڈلی سے پنڈلی لپٹ جائے گی.

t.149: to yourLord on that day is the driving(of people) .
t.84: then on that day, it is to your Lord that one has to be driven.
t.85: on that day he will be driven towards your Lord.
t.95: On that Day you will be driven to your Lord.
t.19: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.
t.22: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!
t.203: The drive will be, on that Day, to your Lord (Allâh)!
t.54: آج تیرے پروردگار کی طرف چلنا ہے.

t.149: Then,(as for) one who neither believed nor prayed,
t.84: So (the denier of the Hereafter) neither believed, nor prayed,
t.85: He neither believed nor prayed,
t.95: But he did not verify the Truth, nor did he observe Prayer;
t.19: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.
t.22: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-
t.203: So he (the disbeliever) neither believed (in this Qur’ân and in the Message of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) nor prayed!
t.54: اس نے نہ تو تصدیق کی نہ نماز ادا کی.

t.149: but disbelieved and turned away,
t.84: but rejected the truth and turned away (from it),
t.85: but denied the truth and turned away,
t.95: on the contrary, he gave the lie to the Truth and turned his back upon it,
t.19: But he denied and flouted.
t.22: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!
t.203: But on the contrary, he belied (this Qur’ân and the Message of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and turned away!
t.54: بلکہ جھٹلایا اور روگردانی کی.

t.149: then went to his family, strutting—
t.84: then he went to his home, puffed up with pride.
t.85: walking back to his people with a conceited swagger.
t.95: then he went back to his kinsfolk, elated with pride.
t.19: Then went he to his folk with glee.
t.22: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!
t.203: Then he walked in conceit (full pride) to his family admiring himself!
t.54: پھر اپنے گھر والوں کے پاس اتراتا ہوا گیا.

t.149: (this punishment is) more and more suitable for you.
t.84: (It will be said to such a man,) Woe to you, then woe to you!
t.85: Closer and closer it comes to you.
t.95: This (attitude) is worthy of you, altogether worthy;
t.19: Nearer unto thee and nearer,
t.22: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
t.203: Woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!
t.54: افسوس ہے تجھ پر حسرت ہے تجھ پر.

t.149: Then again, more and more suitable for you.
t.84: Again, woe to you, then woe to you!
t.85: Closer and closer still.
t.95: again, it is worthy of you, altogether worthy.
t.19: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).
t.22: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
t.203: Again, woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!
t.54: وائے ہے اور خرابی ہے تیرے لیے.

t.149: Does man think that he will be left without purpose?
t.84: Does man presume that he will be left unchecked?
t.85: Does man think he will be left alone?
t.95: Does man think that he will be left alone, unquestioned?
t.19: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?
t.22: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?
t.203: Does man think that he will be left neglected (without being punished or rewarded for the obligatory duties enjoined by his Lord Allâh on him)?
t.54: کیا انسان یہ سمجھتا ہے کہ اسے بیکار چھوڑ دیا جائے گا.

t.149: Was he not a drop of emittedsemen?
t.84: Was he not an ejaculated drop of semen?
t.85: Was he not just a drop of spilt-out sperm,
t.95: Was he not a drop of ejaculated semen,
t.19: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?
t.22: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?
t.203: Was he not a Nutfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge) of semen emitted (poured forth)?
t.54: کیا وه ایک گاڑھے پانی کا قطره نہ تھا جو ٹپکایا گیا تھا؟

t.149: Then he became a clinging form, which He then created and formed?
t.84: Then he became a clot of blood, then He created (him) and made (him) perfect,
t.85: which became a clinging form, which God shaped in due proportion,
t.95: then he became a clot, and then Allah made it into a living body and proportioned its parts,
t.19: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
t.22: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.
t.203: Then he became an ‘Alaqah (a clot); then (Allâh) shaped and fashioned (him) in due proportion.
t.54: پھر وه لہو کا لوتھڑا ہوگیا پھر اللہ نے اسے پیدا کیا اور درست بنا دیا.

t.149: And made of him the two spouses, the male and the female?
t.84: and made from him two kinds, male and female.
t.85: fashioning from it the two sexes, male and female?
t.95: and then He made of him a pair, male and female?
t.19: And made of him a pair, the male and female.
t.22: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.
t.203: And made of him two sexes, male and female.
t.54: پھر اس سے جوڑے یعنی نر وماده بنائے.

t.149: Is not that One Able to revive the dead?
