t.84: Has He no power to give life to the dead?
t.85: Does He who can do this not have the power to bring the dead back to life?
t.95: Does He, then, not have the power to bring back the dead to life?
t.19: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?
t.22: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
t.203: Is not He (Allâh Who does that) Able to give life to the dead? (Yes! He is Able to do all things).
t.54: کیا (اللہ تعالیٰ) اس (امر) پر قادر نہیں کہ مردے کو زنده کردے.

t.149: Has there come upon man a period of time when he was nothing to be mentioned?
t.84: There has come upon man a period of time in which he was nothing worth mentioning.
t.85: Was there not a period of time when man was nothing to speak of ?
t.95: Was there a period of time when man was not even worthy of a mention?
t.19: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
t.22: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?
t.203: Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was not a thing worth mentioning?
t.54: یقیناً گزرا ہے انسان پر ایک وقت زمانے میں جب کہ یہ کوئی قابل ذکر چیز نہ تھا.

t.149: Indeed, We created man from a mingled sperm drop to try him, and We made him hearing and seeing.
t.84: We have created man from a mixed sperm-drop to put him to a test; then We made him able to hear, able to see.
t.85: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid to put him to the test; We gave him hearing and sight;
t.95: Verily We created man out of a drop of intermingled sperm so that We might try him, and We therefore endowed him with hearing and sight.
t.19: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
t.22: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
t.203: Verily, We have created man from Nutfah (drops) of mixed semen (sexual discharge of man and woman), in order to try him: so We made him hearer and seer.
t.54: بیشک ہم نے انسان کو ملے جلے نطفے سے امتحان کے لیے پیدا کیا اور اس کو سنتا دیکھتا بنایا.

t.149: Indeed, We have guided him to the way, be he thankful or a staunch denier.
t.84: We have shown him the way to be either grateful or ungrateful.
t.85: We guided him to the right path, whether he was grateful or not.
t.95: Surely We showed him the Right Path, regardless of whether he chooses to be thankful or unthankful (to his Lord).
t.19: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
t.22: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).
t.203: Verily, We showed him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.
t.54: ہم نے اسے راه دکھائی اب خواه وه شکر گزار بنے خواه ناشکرا.

t.149: Indeed, We have prepared for the deniers chains and yokes and a blaze.
t.84: We have prepared, for the disbelievers, shackles and iron-collars and a blazing Fire.
t.85: We have prepared chains, iron collars, and blazing Fire for the disbelievers, but
t.95: For the unbelievers, We have kept ready chains and fetters and a Blazing Fire.
t.19: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.
t.22: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.
t.203: Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and a blazing Fire.
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے کافروں کے لیے زنجیریں اور طوق اور شعلوں والی آگ تیار کر رکھی ہے.

t.149: Indeed, the virtuous drink from a cup whose mixture is camphor—
t.84: Indeed, the righteous will have a drink from a goblet, blended with (a drink from) Camphor
t.85: the righteous will have a drink mixed with kafur,
t.95: The virtuous shall drink from a cup tempered with camphor water.
t.19: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,
t.22: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-
t.203: Verily,, the Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism), shall drink of a cup (of wine) mixed with (water from a spring in Paradise called) Kâfûr
t.54: بیشک نیک لوگ وه جام پئیں گے جس کی آمیزش کافور کی ہے.

t.149: a spring from which Allah’s servants drink, making it gush abundantly.
t.84: that will be a spring from which Allah’s servants will drink, making it flow (wherever they wish) profusely.
t.85: a spring for God’s servants, which flows abundantly at their wish.
t.95: This will be a gushing spring wherefrom Allah's servants shall drink wine, a spring from which they will take out channels wherever they wish.
t.19: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,
t.22: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.
t.203: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allâh will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly.
t.54: جو ایک چشمہ ہے۔ جس سے اللہ کے بندے پئیں گے اس کی نہریں نکال لے جائیں گے (جدھر چاہیں).

t.149: They fulfill(their) vows and fear a day of widespread evil,
t.84: They (are the ones who) fulfill their vows, and fear a day whose evil (events) will spread far and wide,
t.85: They fulfil their vows; they fear a day of widespread woes;
t.95: These will be the ones who fulfil their vows and dread the Day whose woe shall be spread far and wide;
t.19: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
t.22: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.
t.203: They (are those who) fulfil (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading.
t.54: جو نذر پوری کرتے ہیں اور اس دن سے ڈرتے ہیں جس کی برائی چاروں طرف پھیل جانے والی ہے.

t.149: and they feed—for the love of Him—(any) destitute person and(any) orphan and(any) captive.
t.84: and they give food, out of their love for Him (Allah), to the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,
t.85: they give food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive, though they love it themselves,
t.95: those who, for the love of Him, feed the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,
t.19: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,
t.22: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-
t.203: And they give food, inspite of their love for it (or for the love of Him), to the Miskîn (the poor), the orphan, and the captive
t.54: اور اللہ تعالیٰ کی محبت میں کھانا کھلاتے ہیں مسکین، یتیم اور قیدیوں کو.

t.149: “Indeed, we only feed youfor the sake of Allah; We want from you neither repayment nor thankfulness.
t.84: (saying to them,) “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we have no intention of (receiving) either a return from you or thanks.
t.85: saying, ‘We feed you for the sake of God alone: We seek neither recompense nor thanks from you.
t.95: (saying): “We feed you only for Allah's sake; we do not seek of you any recompense or thanks,
t.19: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
t.22: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.
t.203: (Saying): "We feed you seeking Allâh’s Countenance only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you.
t.54: ہم تو تمہیں صرف اللہ تعالیٰ کی رضامندی کے لیے کھلاتے ہیں نہ تم سے بدلہ چاہتے ہیں نہ شکر گزاری.

t.149: Indeed, we fear from our Lord a frowning, grim day.”
t.84: In fact, we are fearful of a day, from the side of our Lord, that will be frowning, extremely malignant.”
t.85: We fear the Day of our Lord––a woefully grim Day.’
t.95: we fear from our Lord a Day that shall be long and distressful.”
t.19: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
t.22: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."
t.203: "Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day, hard and distressful, that will make the faces look horrible (from extreme dislike to it)."
t.54: بیشک ہم اپنے پروردگار سے اس دن کا خوف کرتے ہیں جو اداسی اور سختی واﻻ ہوگا.

t.149: So Allah shielded them from the ills of that day and made them receive radiance and joy
t.84: So Allah will save them from the evil of that day, and will grant them bloom and delight,
t.85: So God will save them from the woes of that Day, give them radiance and gladness,
t.95: So Allah shall guard them against the woe of that Day, and will procure them freshness and joy,
t.19: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
t.22: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.
t.203: So Allâh saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them Nadrah (a light of beauty) and joy.
t.54: پس انہیں اللہ تعالیٰ نے اس دن کی برائی سے بچا لیا اور انہیں تازگی اور خوشی پہنچائی.

t.149: and repaid them for their patience with a Garden(in paradise) and silk(garments) ;
t.84: and will give them, in return for their patience, Paradise and (garments of) silk,
t.85: and reward them, for their steadfastness, with a Garden and silken robes.
t.95: and will reward them for their steadfastness with Paradise and robes of silk.
t.19: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;
t.22: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.
t.203: And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient.
t.54: اور انہیں ان کے صبر کے بدلے جنت اور ریشمی لباس عطا فرمائے.

t.149: reclining therein on couches, they see therein neither(the heat of a) sun nor freezing cold.
t.84: wherein they will be reclining on couches, feeling neither heat of the sun nor intense cold.
t.85: They will sit on couches, feeling neither scorching heat nor biting cold,
t.95: There they will recline on elevated couches and will be subjected neither to the burning heat of the sun nor to bitter cold.
t.19: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
t.22: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.
t.203: Reclining therein on raised thrones, they will see there neither the excessive heat of the sun, nor the excessive bitter cold, (as in Paradise there is no sun and no moon).
t.54: یہ وہاں تختوں پر تکیے لگائے ہوئے بیٹھیں گے۔ نہ وہاں آفتاب کی گرمی دیکھیں گے نہ جاڑے کی سختی.

t.149: And its shades hover over them, and its clusters(of fruit) are brought low within reach.
t.84: And shades of gardens will be hanging low on them, and their fruits will be placed totally under their command.
t.85: with shady [branches] spread above them and clusters of fruit hanging close at hand.
t.95: The shades of Paradise will bend over them, and its fruits will be brought within their easy reach;
t.19: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.
t.22: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.
t.203: And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach.
t.54: ان جنتوں کے سائے ان پر جھکے ہوئے ہوں گے اور ان کے (میوے اور) گچھے نیچے لٹکائے ہوئے ہوں گے.

t.149: And passing around them are vessels of silver and cups of crystal—
t.84: Circulated among them will be vessels of silver, and cups that will be (as transparent as) crystals,
t.85: They will be served with silver plates
t.95: and there shall be passed around them vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,
t.19: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
t.22: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-
t.203: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal -
t.54: اور ان پر چاندی کے برتنوں اور ان جاموں کا دور کرایا جائے گا جو شیشے کے ہوں گے.

t.149: crystalline silver cups—that they measured out with perfect measure.
t.84: -crystals (as shining as if made) of silver, measured by those (who filled them) with due measure.
t.85: and gleaming silver goblets according to their fancy,
t.95: goblets bright as crystal but made of silver, filled to exact measure.
t.19: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).
t.22: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
t.203: Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
t.54: شیشے بھی چاندی کے جن کو (ساقی نے) اندازے سے ناپ رکھا ہوگا.

t.149: And they are served in it with a cup whose flavor is a mixture of ginger,
t.84: And they will be served with goblet of a drink blended with ginger,
t.85: and they will be given a drink infused with ginger
t.95: Therein they shall be served a cup flavoured with ginger,
t.19: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
t.22: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-
t.203: And they will be given to drink there of a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabîl (ginger),
t.54: اور انہیں وہاں وه جام پلائے جائیں گے جن کی آمیزش زنجبیل کی ہوگی.

t.149: (from) a spring therein named Salsabeel.
t.84: (acquired from) a spring therein called Salsabīl.
t.85: from a spring called Salsabil.
t.95: drawn from a spring (in Paradise) called Salsabil.
t.19: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
t.22: A fountain there, called Salsabil.
t.203: A spring there, called Salsabîl.
t.54: جنت کی ایک نہر سے جس کا نام سلسبیل ہے.

t.149: And passing among them are immortal youths; when yousee them, you think them sprinkled pearls.
t.84: And circling around them will be serving boys, blessed with eternal youth; when you would see them, you would take them as scattered pearls.
t.85: Everlasting youths will attend them––if you could see them, you would think they were scattered pearls––
t.95: There boys of everlasting youth shall go about attending them: when you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.
t.19: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
t.22: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.
t.203: And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.
t.54: اور ان کے ارد گرد گھومتے پھرتے ہوں گے وه کم سن بچے جو ہمیشہ رہنے والے ہیں جب تو انہیں دیکھے تو سمجھے کہ وه بکھرے ہوئے سچے موتی ہیں.

t.149: And when yousee, you see there bliss and a vast Dominion.
t.84: When you will look around there, you will see the Bliss and a magnificent realm.
t.85: and if you were to look around, you would see bliss and great wealth:
t.95: Whitherto you look around, you will see an abundance of bliss and the glories of a great kingdom.
t.19: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
t.22: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.
t.203: And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion.
t.54: تو وہاں جہاں کہیں بھی نظر ڈالے گا سراسر نعمتیں اور عظیم الشان سلطنت ہی دیکھے گا.

t.149: Upon them are green garments of silk, and(upon them is) brocade ,and they have been adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord has offered them a pure drink.
t.84: Upon them will be garments of green sundus (a kind of fine silk), and of istabraq (a kind of thick silk), and they will be adorned by bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them a pure beverage to drink:
t.85: they will wear garments of green silk and brocade; they will be adorned with silver bracelets; their Lord will give them a pure drink.
t.95: They [i.e., the virtuous] shall be attired in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade and will be adorned with bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them a pure wine to drink.
t.19: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.
t.22: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.
t.203: Their garments will be of fine green silk, and gold embroidery. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.
t.54: ان کے جسموں پر سبز باریک اور موٹے ریشمی کپڑے ہوں گے اور انہیں چاندی کے کنگن کا زیور پہنایا جائے گا۔ اور انہیں ان کا رب پاک صاف شراب پلائے گا.

t.149: “Indeed, this is a repayment for you, and your efforts have been well thanked.”
t.84: “This is a reward for you, and your effort has been appreciated.”
t.85: [It will be said], ‘This is your reward. Your endeavours are appreciated.’
t.95: Behold, this is your recompense and your endeavour has been appreciated.
t.19: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
t.22: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."
t.203: (And it will be said to them): "Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been accepted."
t.54: (کہا جائے گا) کہ یہ ہے تمہارے اعمال کا بدلہ اور تمہاری کوشش کی قدر کی گئی.

t.149: Indeed, We—We alone—have surely bestowed the Recitalupon youfrom on high.
t.84: Indeed we have revealed to you the Qur’ān through a gradual process.
t.85: We Ourself have sent down this Quran to you [Prophet] in gradual revelation.
t.95: (O Prophet), indeed We have revealed the Qur'an to you in portions.
t.19: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;
t.22: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.
t.203: Verily, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’ân to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) by stages.
t.54: بیشک ہم نے تجھ پر بتدریج قرآن نازل کیا ہے.

t.149: So wait patiently for the judgment of yourLord, and do not obey any sinner or any staunch denier among them.
t.84: So, be steadfast patiently in (obeying) your Lord’s command, and do not obey any one of them who is sinner or ungrateful.
t.85: Await your Lord’s Judgement with patience; do not yield to any of these sinners or disbelievers;
t.95: So persevere with the command of your Lord and do not pay any heed to the wicked and the unbelieving,
t.19: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.
t.22: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.
t.203: Therefore be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) with constancy to the Command of your Lord (Allâh, by doing your duty to Him and by conveying His Message to mankind), and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them.
t.54: پس تو اپنے رب کے حکم پر قائم ره اور ان میں سے کسی گنہگار یا ناشکرے کا کہا نہ مان.

t.149: And rememberthe Name of yourLord morning and evening,
t.84: And pronounce the name of Allah morning and evening.
t.85: remember the name of your Lord at dawn and in the evening;
t.95: and remember the name of your Lord, morning and evening;
t.19: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
t.22: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,
t.203: And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon [i.e. offering of the Morning (Fajr), Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers].
t.54: اور اپنے رب کے نام کا صبح وشام ذکر کیا کر.

t.149: and for part of the night prostrate yourself to Him, and highly exalt Him long into the night.
t.84: And in some parts of night prostrate yourself before Him, and pronounce His purity for long times at night.
t.85: bow down before Him, and glorify Him at length by night.
t.95: and prostrate yourself before Him at night, and extol His Glory during the long watches of the night.
t.19: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.
t.22: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.
t.203: And during night, prostrate yourself to Him (i.e. the offering of Maghrib and ‘Ishâ’ prayers), and glorify Him a long night through (i.e. Tahajjud prayer).
t.54: اور رات کے وقت اس کے سامنے سجدے کر اور بہت رات تک اس کی تسبیح کیا کر.

t.149: Indeed, theselove the fleeting life and leave behind them a heavy day.
t.84: In fact these people love that which is immediate, and neglect a Heavy Day ahead of them.
t.85: These people love the fleeting life. They put aside [all thoughts of] a Heavy Day.
t.95: Verily they love (the good of this world) that is hastily obtainable and are oblivious of the burdensome Day ahead of them.
t.19: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
t.22: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.
t.203: Verily, these (disbelievers) love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day (that will be hard).
t.54: بیشک یہ لوگ جلدی ملنے والی (دنیا) کو چاہتے ہیں اور اپنے پیچھے ایک بڑے بھاری دن کو چھوڑے دیتے ہیں.

t.149: We have created them and have strengthened their frame, and whenever We will, We can replace them entirely with others like them.
t.84: We have created them and have made their joints strong. And whenever We will, We would replace them with others like them, a total replacement.
t.85: Yet We created them; We strengthened their constitution; if We please, We can replace such people completely.
t.95: We created them and strengthened their joints; and whenever We wish, We can change their faces entirely.
t.19: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
t.22: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.
t.203: It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong built. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement.
t.54: ہم نے انہیں پیدا کیا اور ہم نے ہی ان کے جوڑ اور بندھن مضبوط کیے اور ہم جب چاہیں ان کے عوض ان جیسے اوروں کو بدل ﻻئیں.

t.149: Indeed, this is a Reminder. So whoever wills, let him take a way to his Lord.
t.84: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.
t.85: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes, take the way to his Lord.
t.95: Verily this is an Exhortation; so let him who so will take a way to his Lord.
t.19: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
t.22: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.
t.203: Verily, this (Verse of the Qur’ân) is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord (Allâh).
t.54: یقیناً یہ تو ایک نصیحت ہے پس جو چاہے اپنے رب کی راه لے لے.

t.149: Yet youcannot will, unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah has always been All-Knowing, All- Wise.
t.84: And you will not so wish unless Allah so wills. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
t.85: But you will only wish to do so if God wills- God is all knowing, all wise-
t.95: But your willing shall be of no avail until Allah Himself so wills. Surely Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.
t.19: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.
t.22: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
t.203: But you cannot will, unless Allâh wills. Verily, Allâh is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.
t.54: اور تم نہ چاہو گے مگر یہ کہ اللہ تعالیٰ ہی چاہے بیشک اللہ تعالیٰ علم واﻻ باحکمت ہے.

t.149: He enters into His mercy whomever He wills, and the unjust— He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
t.84: He admits whomsoever He wills to His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
t.85: He admits whoever He will into His Mercy and has prepared a painful torment for the disbelievers.
t.95: He admits to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. As for the wrong-doers, He has prepared for them a grievous chastisement.
t.19: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.
t.22: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
t.203: He will admit to His Mercy whom He wills and as for the Zâlimûn - (polytheists, wrong-doers) He has prepared a painful torment.
t.54: جسے چاہے اپنی رحمت میں داخل کرلے، اور ﻇالموں کے لیے اس نے دردناک عذاب تیار کر رکھا ہے.*

t.149: By those unleashed in succession,
t.84: (I swear) by those (winds) that are sent one after the other,
t.85: By the [winds] sent forth in swift succession,
t.95: By the (winds) sent forth in quick succession,
t.19: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another
t.22: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);
t.203: By the winds (or angels or the Messengers of Allâh) sent forth one after another.
t.54: دل خوش کن چلتی ہواؤں کی قسم.

t.149: and by those storming turbulently.
t.84: and by those that blow violently,
t.85: violently storming,
t.95: which then blow tempestuously
t.19: By the raging hurricanes,
t.22: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
t.203: And by the winds that blow violently.
t.54: پھر زور سے جھونکا دینے والیوں کی قسم.*

t.149: By those scattering far and wide,
t.84: and by those that spread (clouds) all over,
t.85: scattering far and wide,
t.95: and raise (clouds) and scatter them around,
t.19: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;
t.22: And scatter (things) far and wide;
t.203: And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain.
t.54: پھر (ابر کو) ابھار کر پراگنده کرنے والیوں کی قسم.

t.149: and by those separating decisively,
t.84: and by those (angels) who differentiate (between right and wrong) distinctly,
t.85: separating forcefully,
t.95: then winnow them thoroughly,
t.19: By those who winnow with a winnowing,
t.22: Then separate them, one from another,
t.203: And by the Verses (of the Qur’ân) that separate the right from the wrong.
t.54: پھر حق وباطل کو جدا جدا کر دینے والے.

t.149: and by those casting a Reminder,
t.84: then bring down the advice,
t.85: delivering a reminder,
t.95: and then cast (Allah's) remembrance (in people's hearts),
t.19: By those who bring down the Reminder,
t.22: Then spread abroad a Message,
t.203: And by the angels that bring the revelations to the Messengers,
t.54: اور وحی ﻻنے والے فرشتوں کی قسم.

t.149: excusing or warning––
t.84: leaving no excuse (for the disbelievers) or giving warnings,
t.85: as a proof or a warning:
t.95: to serve as an excuse or a warning.
t.19: To excuse or to warn,
t.22: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-
t.203: To cut off all excuses or to warn.
t.54: جو (وحی) الزام اتارنے یا آگاه کردینے کے لیے ہوتی ہے.

t.149: indeed, what youare promised is sure to come.
t.84: that which you are promised is sure to happen.
t.85: what you are promised will come to pass.
t.95: Surely what you are promised shall come to pass.
t.19: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.
t.22: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.
t.203: Surely, what you are promised must come to pass.
t.54: جس چیز کا تم سے وعده کیا جاتا ہے وہ یقیناً ہونے والی ہے.

t.149: So when the stars are obliterated,
t.84: So, when the stars will be extinguished,
t.85: When the stars are dimmed
t.95: So when the stars are extinguished,
t.19: So when the stars are put out,
t.22: Then when the stars become dim;
t.203: Then when the stars lose their lights.
t.54: پس جب ستارے بے نور کردئے جائیں گے.

t.149: and when the sky is fractured,
t.84: and when the sky will be split,
t.85: and the sky is torn apart,
t.95: and the sky is rent asunder,
t.19: And when the sky is riven asunder,
t.22: When the heaven is cleft asunder;
t.203: And when the heaven is cleft asunder.
t.54: اور جب آسمان توڑ پھوڑ دیا جائے گا.

t.149: and when the mountains are blown away,
t.84: and when the mountains will be blown away as dust,
t.85: when the mountains are turned to dust
t.95: and the mountains are blown away,
t.19: And when the mountains are blown away,
t.22: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;
t.203: And when the mountains are blown away.
t.54: اور جب پہاڑ ٹکڑے ٹکڑے کر کے اڑا دیئے جائیں گے.

t.149: and when the messengers are gathered to their appointed time––
t.84: and when the messengers will be assembled at the appointed time, (then all matters will be decided.)
t.85: and the messengers given their appointed time––
t.95: and the appointed time to bring the Messengers together arrives,(then shall the promised event come to pass).
t.19: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -
t.22: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-
t.203: And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed.
t.54: اور جب رسولوں کو وقت مقرره پر ﻻیا جائے گا.

t.149: to which day is it deferred?
t.84: (Do you know) for which day has all this been delayed?
t.85: for what Day has all this been set?
t.95: To which Day has this task been deferred?
t.19: For what day is the time appointed?
t.22: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?
t.203: For what Day are these signs postponed?
t.54: کس دن کے لیے (ان سب کو) مؤخر کیا گیا ہے؟

t.149: To the Day of Decision.
t.84: For the Day of Decision!
t.85: The Day of Decision.
t.95: To the Day of Judgement.
t.19: For the Day of Decision.
t.22: For the Day of Sorting out.
t.203: For the Day of Sorting Out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell).
t.54: فیصلے کے دن کے لیے.

t.149: And what can make yourealize what the Day of Decision is?
t.84: And what may let you know what the Day of Decision is?
t.85: What will explain to you what the Day of Decision is?
t.95: What do you know what the Day of Judgement is?
t.19: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
t.22: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
t.203: And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out?
t.54: اور تجھے کیا معلوم کہ فیصلے کا دن کیا ہے؟

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers.
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: اس دن جھٹلانے والوں کی خرابی ہے.

t.149: Did We not destroy the ancients,
t.84: Did We not destroy the earlier people?
t.85: Did We not destroy the first [of them]?
t.95: Did We not destroy many a nation of the earlier times?
t.19: Destroyed We not the former folk,
t.22: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?
t.203: Did We not destroy the ancients?
t.54: کیا ہم نے اگلوں کو ہلاک نہیں کیا؟

t.149: then follow them up with the later ones?
t.84: Then We will cause the later ones to follow them.
t.85: We shall make the last follow them:
t.95: And We shall cause those of later times to follow them.
t.19: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?
t.22: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.
t.203: So shall We make later generations to follow them.
t.54: پھر ہم ان کے بعد پچھلوں کو ﻻئے.

t.149: This is how We deal with the criminals.
t.84: Thus We deal with the guilty people.
t.85: this is how We deal with the guilty.
t.95: Thus do We deal with the guilty.
t.19: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.
t.22: Thus do We deal with men of sin.
t.203: Thus do We deal with the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals).
t.54: ہم گنہگاروں کے ساتھ اسی طرح کرتے ہیں.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers.
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: اس دن جھٹلانے والوں کے لیے ویل (افسوس) ہے.

t.149: Did We not create youfrom a despicable fluid,
t.84: Did We not create you from a worthless fluid?
t.85: Did We not make you from an underrated fluid
t.95: Did We not create you of a mean fluid,
t.19: Did We not create you from a base fluid
t.22: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-
t.203: Did We not create you from a despised water (semen)?
t.54: کیا ہم نے تمہیں حقیر پانی سے (منی سے) پیدا نہیں کیا.

t.149: then lodged it in a secure place
t.84: Then We put it in a firm place of rest
t.85: which We housed in a safe lodging
t.95: which We then placed in a secure repository
t.19: Which We laid up in a safe abode
t.22: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
t.203: Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb),
t.54: پھر ہم نے اسے مضبوط ومحفوظ جگہ میں رکھا.

t.149: for a known term?
t.84: for a known period.
t.85: for a determined period?
t.95: until an appointed time?
t.19: For a known term?
t.22: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
t.203: For a known period (determined by gestation)?
t.54: ایک مقرره وقت تک.

t.149: And We have determined, so what excellent determiners are We!
t.84: Thus We did (all this with perfect) measure; so We are the best to measure.
t.85: We determine [it]: how excellently We determine!
t.95: See that We had the power to do so. Great indeed is Our power to do what We will.
t.19: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!
t.22: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).
t.203: So We did measure; and We are the Best to measure (the things).
t.54: پھر ہم نے اندازه کیا اور ہم کیا خوب اندازه کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers.
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: اس دن تکذیب کرنے والوں کی خرابی ہے.

t.149: Did We not make the earth a homestead
t.84: Did We not make the earth a container that collects
t.85: Did We not make the earth a home
t.95: Did We not make the earth a receptacle,
t.19: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
t.22: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.
t.203: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
t.54: کیا ہم نے زمین کو سمیٹنے والی نہیں بنایا؟

t.149: for the living and the dead,
t.84: the living and the dead?
t.85: for the living and the dead?
t.95: for the living and the dead,
t.19: Both for the living and the dead,
t.22: The living and the dead,
t.203: For the living and the dead?
t.54: زندوں کو بھی اور مردوں کو بھی.

t.149: and set on it lofty, firm mountains, and gave you pure water to drink?
t.84: And We placed towering mountains therein, and provided you with sweet water to drink.
t.85: Did We not place firm, lofty mountains on it and provide you with sweet water?
t.95: and did We not firmly fix towering mountains on it and give you sweet water to drink?
t.19: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?
t.22: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?
t.203: And have placed therein firm, and tall mountains, and have given you to drink sweet water?
t.54: اور ہم نے اس میں بلند وبھاری پہاڑ بنادیے اور تمہیں سیراب کرنے واﻻ میٹھا پانی پلایا.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers.
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: اس دن جھٹلانے والوں کے لیے وائے اور افسوس ہے.

t.149: “Proceed to what youused to disbelieve in.
t.84: (It will be said to them on that day,) “Push on to what you used to deny.
t.85: They will be told, ‘Go to that which you used to deny!
t.95: Proceed now towards that which you were wont to deny as false;
t.19: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;
t.22: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!
t.203: (It will be said to the disbelievers): "Depart you to that which you used to deny!
t.54: اس دوزخ کی طرف جاؤ جسے تم جھٹلاتے رہے تھے.

t.149: Proceed to a shadow that rises in three different columns,
t.84: Push on to a canopy (of Hell’s smoke) having three branches,
t.85: Go to a shadow of smoke!’ It rises in three columns;
t.95: proceed towards the three-pronged shadow,
t.19: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,
t.22: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,
t.203: "Depart you to a shadow (of Hell-Fire smoke ascending) in three columns,
t.54: چلو تین شاخوں والے سائے کی طرف.

t.149: offering no shade and unavailing against the flames.”
t.84: that neither has a comfortable shade, nor is it of any use against the scorching heat.
t.85: no shade does it give, nor relief from the flame;
t.95: which neither provides (cooling) shade nor protection against the flames;
t.19: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.
t.22: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
t.203: Neither shady, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire."
t.54: جو در اصل نہ سایہ دینے واﻻ ہے اور نہ شعلے سے بچاسکتا ہے.

t.149: It shoots sparks like huge buildings,
t.84: It emits sparks (as huge) as castles,
t.85: it shoots out sparks as large as treetrunks
t.95: it indeed throws up sparks like castles,
t.19: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,
t.22: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,
t.203: Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr (a fort or a huge log of wood),
t.54: یقیناً دوزخ چنگاریاں پھینکتی ہے جو مثل محل کے ہیں.

t.149: as if they are yellow camels.
t.84: as if they were yellowish camels.”
t.85: and as bright as copper.
t.95: which seem as though they are yellow-coloured camels.
t.19: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.
t.22: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."
t.203: As if they were yellow camels or bundles of ropes.
t.54: گویا کہ وه زرد اونٹ ہیں.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: آج ان جھٹلانے والوں کی درگت ہے.

t.149: This is a day when they do not speak,
t.84: This is the day when they will not speak,
t.85: On that Day they will be speechless,
t.95: That will be the Day on which they will not (be able to) utter a word,
t.19: This is a day wherein they speak not,
t.22: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
t.203: That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),
t.54: آج (کا دن) وه دن ہے کہ یہ بول بھی نہ سکیں گے.

t.149: nor are they allowed to apologize.
t.84: nor will they be allowed to offer excuses.
t.85: and they will be given no chance to offer any excuses.
t.95: nor will they be allowed to proffer excuses.
t.19: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.
t.22: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.
t.203: And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse.
t.54: نہ انہیں معذرت کی اجازت دی جائے گی.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers.
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: اس دن جھٹلانے والوں کی خرابی ہے.*

t.149: This is the Day of Decision; We have gathered you, together with the ancients.
t.84: (It will be said to them,) “This is the Day of Decision. We have assembled you and the earlier ones together.
t.85: [They will be told], ‘This is the Day of Decision: We have gathered you and earlier generations.
t.95: That is the Day of Judgement on which We have assembled you as well as all those who went before you.
t.19: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
t.22: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!
t.203: That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!
t.54: یہ ہے فیصلے کا دن ہم نے تمہیں اور اگلوں کو سب کو جمع کرلیا ہے.

t.149: So if you have a plot, then plot against Me.
t.84: Now, if you have a trick, use the trick against Me.”
t.85: If you have any plots against Me, try them now.’
t.95: So if you have any ploy, try it against Me!
t.19: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
t.22: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!
t.203: So if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allâh جل جلاله)!
t.54: پس اگر تم مجھ سے کوئی چال چل سکتے ہو تو چل لو.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers.
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: وائے ہے اس دن جھٹلانے والوں کے لیے.

t.149: Indeed, the mindful(of God) are amidst shades and springs
t.84: Of course, the God-fearing will be amid shades and streams,
t.85: But those who took heed of God will enjoy cool shade, springs,
t.95: Behold, today the God-fearing will be amidst shades and springs,
t.19: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,
t.22: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
t.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) shall be amidst shades and springs.
t.54: بیشک پرہیزگار لوگ سایوں میں ہیں اور بہتے چشموں میں.

t.149: and fruits as they desire.
t.84: and fruits of their desire.
t.85: and any fruit they desire;
t.95: and the fruits that they desire (will be ready at hand).
t.19: And fruits such as they desire.
t.22: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
t.203: And fruits, such as they desire.
t.54: اور ان میووں میں جن کی وه خواہش کریں.

t.149: “Eat and drink pleasantly on account of what youused to do.”
t.84: It will be said to them, “Eat and drink with pleasure because of what you used to do.”
t.85: [they will be told], ‘Eat and drink to your hearts’ content as a reward for your deeds:
t.95: Eat and drink and may every joy attend you as a reward for your deeds.
t.19: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.
t.22: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).
t.203: "Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do."
t.54: (اے جنتیو!) کھاؤ پیو مزے سےاپنے کیے ہوئے اعمال کے بدلے.

t.149: Indeed, this is how We repay those who excel in doing good.
t.84: This is how We reward those who do good deeds.
t.85: this is how We reward those who do good.’
t.95: Thus do We reward those that do good.
t.19: Thus do We reward the good.
t.22: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.
t.203: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112).
t.54: یقیناً ہم نیکی کرنے والوں کو اسی طرح جزا دیتے ہیں.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers.
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: اس دن سچا نہ جاننے والوں کے لیے ویل (افسوس) ہے.

t.149: “Eat and enjoy yourselves a little; youare indeed criminals.”
t.84: “(O disbelievers,) eat and drink for a while! You are guilty ones.”
t.85: [You may] eat and enjoy yourselves for a short while, evildoers that you are.
t.95: Eat and enjoy yourselves for a while. Surely you are evil-doers.
t.19: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.
t.22: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.
t.203: (O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals).
t.54: (اے جھٹلانے والو) تم دنیا میں تھوڑا سا کھا لو اور فائده اٹھا لو بیشک تم گنہگار ہو.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers.
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: اس دن جھٹلانے والوں کے لیے سخت ہلاکت ہے.

t.149: And when it is said to them, “Bow down”, they do not bow down.
t.84: And when it is said to them, “Bow down (i.e. submit to Allah’s commands)”, they do not bow down.
t.85: When they are told, ‘Bow down in prayer,’ they do not do so.
t.95: When it is said to them: “Bow down (before Allah),” they do not bow down.
t.19: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!
t.22: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.
t.203: And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself (in prayer)!" They bow not down (offer not their prayers).
t.54: ان سے جب کہا جاتا ہے کہ رکوع کر لو تو نہیں کرتے.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers.
t.84: Woe that Day to the deniers!
t.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
t.95: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
t.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
t.54: اس دن جھٹلانے والوں کی تباہی ہے.

t.149: So in what discourse, beyond this, will they believe?
t.84: Now, in which discourse, after this, will they believe?
t.85: In what revelation, after this, will they believe?
t.95: In what discourse after this (Qur'an) will they, then, believe?
t.19: In what statement, after this, will they believe?
t.22: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
t.203: Then in what statement after this (the Qur’ân) will they believe?
t.54: اب اس قرآن کے بعد کس بات پر ایمان ﻻئیں گے؟

t.149: What are they asking one another about?
t.84: About what are they asking each other?
t.85: What are they asking about?
t.95: About what are they asking one another?
t.19: Whereof do they question one another?
t.22: Concerning what are they disputing?
t.203: What are they asking (one another) about?
t.54: یہ لوگ کس چیز کے بارے میں پوچھ گچھ کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: About the Great Tiding,
t.84: About the Great Event
t.85: The momentous announcement
t.95: Is it about the awesome tiding
t.19: (It is) of the awful tidings,
t.22: Concerning the Great News,
t.203: About the great news, (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism, the Qur’ân, which Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم brought and the Day of Resurrection)
t.54: اس بڑی خبر کے متعلق.

t.149: over which they differ.
t.84: in which they dispute!
t.85: about which they differ.
t.95: that they are in utter disagreement?
t.19: Concerning which they are in disagreement.
t.22: About which they cannot agree.
t.203: About which they are in disagreement.
t.54: جس کے بارے میں یہ اختلاف کر رہے ہیں.

t.149: But no, surely they will find out!
t.84: Indeed they will soon know.
t.85: They will find out.
t.95: No indeed; soon will they come to know;
t.19: Nay, but they will come to know!
t.22: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know!
t.203: Nay, they will come to know!
t.54: یقیناً یہ عنقریب جان لیں گے.*

t.149: Once again, no, surely they will find out!
t.84: Again, indeed they will soon know.
t.85: In the end they will find out.
t.95: again, no indeed; soon will they come to know.
t.19: Nay, again, but they will come to know!
t.22: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know!
t.203: Nay, again, they will come to know!
t.54: پھر بالیقین انہیں بہت جلد معلوم ہو جائے گا.

t.149: Did We not make the earth a resting place,
t.84: Did We not make the earth a floor,
t.85: Did We not make the earth smooth,
t.95: Have We not spread the earth like a bed,
t.19: Have We not made the earth an expanse,
t.22: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse,
t.203: Have We not made the earth as a bed,
t.54: کیا ہم نے زمین کو فرش نہیں بنایا؟

t.149: and the mountains as pegs?
t.84: and the mountains bulwarks?
t.85: and make the mountains to keep it stable?
t.95: and fixed the mountains like pegs,
t.19: And the high hills bulwarks?
t.22: And the mountains as pegs?
t.203: And the mountains as pegs?
t.54: اور پہاڑوں کو میخیں (نہیں بنایا؟)

t.149: And created youin pairs?
t.84: And We have created you in pairs,
t.85: Did We not create you in pairs,
t.95: and created you in pairs (as men and women),
t.19: And We have created you in pairs,
t.22: And (have We not) created you in pairs,
t.203: And We have created you in pairs (male and female, tall and short, good and bad, etc.).
t.54: اور ہم نے تمہیں جوڑا جوڑا پیدا کیا.

t.149: And made your sleep for rest,
t.84: and made your sleep a source of rest,
t.85: give you sleep for rest,
t.95: and made your sleep a means of repose,
t.19: And have appointed your sleep for repose,
t.22: And made your sleep for rest,
t.203: And We have made your sleep as a thing for rest.
t.54: اور ہم نے تمہاری نیند کو آرام کا سبب بنایا.

t.149: and made the night a garment,
t.84: and made the night a covering,
t.85: the night as a cover,
t.95: and made the night a covering,
t.19: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
t.22: And made the night as a covering,
t.203: And We have made the night as a covering (through its darkness),
t.54: اور رات کو ہم نے پرده بنایا.

t.149: and made the day for livelihood?
t.84: and made the day a source of livelihood.
t.85: and the day for your livelihood?
t.95: and made the day to seek livelihood,
t.19: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
t.22: And made the day as a means of subsistence?
t.203: And We have made the day for livelihood.
t.54: اور دن کو ہم نے وقت روزگار بنایا.

t.149: And built above you seven strong ones,
t.84: And We have built seven strong (skies),
t.85: Did We not build seven strong [heavens] above you,
t.95: and built above you seven strong firmaments,
t.19: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
t.22: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,
t.203: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
t.54: اور تمہارے اوپر ہم نے سات مضبوط آسمان بنائے.

t.149: and made a glowing lamp?
t.84: and created a luminous lamp (the sun).
t.85: and make a blazing lamp?
t.95: and placed therein a hot, shining lamp,
t.19: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
t.22: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?
t.203: And We have made (therein) a shining lamp (sun).
t.54: اور ایک روشن چراغ (سورج) بنایا.

t.149: And brought down from the clouds pouring water,
t.84: And We have sent down abundant water from the rain-laden clouds,
t.85: Did We not send water pouring down from the clouds
t.95: and sent down abundant water from the clouds
t.19: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
t.22: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,
t.203: And We have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water.
t.54: اور بدلیوں سے ہم نے بکثرت بہتا ہوا پانی برسایا.

t.149: to bring out with it grains and plants
t.84: so that We bring out therewith grain and vegetation,
t.85: to bring forth with it grain, plants,
t.95: so that We may thereby bring forth grain and vegetation,
t.19: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
t.22: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,
t.203: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetations,
t.54: تاکہ اس سے اناج اور سبزه اگائیں.

t.149: and luxuriant gardens?
t.84: and thick gardens.
t.85: and luxuriant gardens?
t.95: and gardens dense with foliage?
t.19: And gardens of thick foliage.
t.22: And gardens of luxurious growth?
t.203: And gardens of thick growth.
t.54: اور گھنے باغ (بھی اگائیں).

t.149: Indeed, the Day of Decision has been appointed:
t.84: Surely the Day of Decision is an appointed time,
t.85: A time has been appointed for the Day of Decision:
t.95: Surely the Day of Judgement has an appointed time;
t.19: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
t.22: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,
t.203: Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
t.54: بیشک فیصلہ کے دن کا وقت مقرر ہے.

t.149: the day when the Trumpet is blown, and you come in crowds,
t.84: a day when the trumpet will be blown, so you will come in multitudes,
t.85: a Day when the Trumpet will sound and you will come forward in crowds,
t.95: the Day when the Trumpet shall be blown, and you will come forth in multitudes;
t.19: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
t.22: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;
t.203: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds (groups after groups). [Tafsir At-Tabari]
t.54: جس دن کہ صور میں پھونکا جائے گا۔ پھر تم فوج در فوج چلے آؤ گے.

t.149: and the sky wasopened upand became gateways,
t.84: and the sky will be opened, so it will become as gates,
t.85: when the sky will open up like wide portals,
t.95: and when the sky shall be opened up and will become all doors;
t.19: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
t.22: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
t.203: And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates,
t.54: اور آسمان کھول دیا جائے گا تو اس میں دروازے ہی دروازے ہو جائیں گے.

t.149: and the mountains were set in motion and became a mirage.
t.84: and the mountains will be set in motion, so they will be as mirage.
t.85: when the mountains will vanish like a mirage.
t.95: and the mountains will be set in motion and become a mirage.
t.19: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
t.22: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.
t.203: And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage.
t.54: اور پہاڑ چلائے جائیں گے پس وه سراب ہو جائیں گے.

t.149: Indeed, Hell has been lying in ambush—
t.84: Surely Jahannam (the Hell) lurks in ambush.
t.85: Hell lies in wait,
t.95: Surely the Hell is an ambush,
t.19: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,
t.22: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,
t.203: Truly, Hell is a place of ambush -
t.54: بیشک دوزخ گھات میں ہے.

t.149: a destination for those who exceed all limits,
t.84: (It is) abode for the rebellious people
t.85: a home for oppressors
t.95: a resort for the rebellious;
t.19: A home for the rebellious.
t.22: For the transgressors a place of destination:
t.203: A dwelling place for the Tâghûn (those who transgress the boundary limits set by Allâh like polytheists, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, hyprocrites, sinners, criminals),
t.54: سرکشوں کا ٹھکانہ وہی ہے.

t.149: where they remain for eons,
t.84: who will be abiding in it for ages.
t.85: to stay in for a long, long time,
t.95: therein they shall abide for ages,
t.19: They will abide therein for ages.
t.22: They will dwell therein for ages.
t.203: They will abide therein for ages.
t.54: اس میں وه مدتوں تک پڑے رہیں گے.

t.149: tasting therein neither coolness nordrink,
t.84: They will taste nothing cool in it, nor a drink,
t.85: where they will taste no coolness nor drink
t.95: they shall taste in it no coolness, nor any pleasant drink
t.19: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
t.22: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,
t.203: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink.
t.54: نہ کبھی اس میں خنکی کا مزه چکھیں گے، نہ پانی کا.

t.149: except scalding water and purulence—
t.84: except boiling water and pus,
t.85: except one that is scalding and dark––
t.95: save boiling water and wash of the wounds;
t.19: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
t.22: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,
t.203: Except boiling water, and dirty wound discharges -
t.54: سوائے گرم پانی اور (بہتی) پیپ کے.

t.149: a fitting repayment,
t.84: this being a punishment, fully commensurate (with their deeds).
t.85: a fitting requital,
t.95: a befitting recompense for their deeds.
t.19: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).
t.22: A fitting recompense (for them).
t.203: An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes).
t.54: (ان کو) پورا پورا بدلہ ملے گا.

t.149: for they were not expecting any reckoning,
t.84: They did not expect (to face) accounting (of their deeds),
t.85: for they did not fear a reckoning,
t.95: For indeed they did not look forward to any reckoning,
t.19: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
t.22: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
t.203: For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.
t.54: انہیں تو حساب کی توقع ہی نہ تھی.

t.149: and they disbelieved Our signs with utter disbelief.
t.84: and they rejected Our signs totally.
t.85: and they rejected Our messages as lies.
t.95: and roundly denied Our Signs as false.
t.19: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
t.22: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.
t.203: But they belied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, and that which Our Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم brought) completely.
t.54: اور بے باکی سے ہماری آیتوں کی تکذیب کرتے تھے.

t.149: But We have enumerated everything in writing.
t.84: And everything (from their deeds) is thoroughly recorded by Us in writing.
t.85: We have recorded everything in a Record.
t.95: And everything have We recorded in a Book.
t.19: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
t.22: And all things have We preserved on record.
t.203: And all things We have recorded in a Book.
t.54: ہم نے ہر ایک چیز کو لکھ کر شمار کر رکھا ہے.

t.149: So taste, for We will not increase youexcept in punishment!
t.84: “So now taste! We will add nothing to you but torment.”
t.85: ‘Taste this: all you will get from Us is more torment.’
t.95: So taste (the fruit of your deeds). We shall only increase your torment.
t.19: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
t.22: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
t.203: So taste you (the results of your evil actions). No increase shall We give you, except in torment.
t.54: اب تم (اپنے کیے کا) مزه چکھو ہم تمہارا عذاب ہی بڑھاتے رہیں گے.

t.149: Indeed, for the mindful(of God) there is triumph:
t.84: Of course, the God-fearing will have great achievement,
t.85: For those who were aware of God there is supreme fulfilment:
t.95: Surely the state of triumph awaits the God-fearing:
t.19: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
t.22: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;
t.203: Verily, for the Muttaqûn, there will be a success (Paradise);
t.54: یقیناً پرہیزگار لوگوں کے لئے کامیابی ہے.

t.149: Gardens(of Paradise) and vineyards;
t.84: -gardens and grapes,
t.85: private gardens, vineyards,
t.95: gardens and vineyards,
t.19: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,
t.22: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;
t.203: Gardens and vineyards,
t.54: باغات ہیں اور انگور ہیں.

t.149: and high-class spouses, well-matched;
t.84: and buxom maidens of matching age,
t.85: nubile, well-matched companions,
t.95: and youthful maidens of like age,
t.19: And voluptuous women of equal age;
t.22: And voluptuous women of equal age;
t.203: And young full-breasted (mature) maidens of equal age,
t.54: اور نوجوان کنواری ہم عمر عورتیں ہیں.

t.149: and overflowing cups.
t.84: and goblets filled up to the brim.
t.85: and an overflowing cup.
t.95: and an overflowing cup.
t.19: And a full cup.
t.22: And a cup full (to the brim).
t.203: And a full cup (of wine).
t.54: اور چھلکتے ہوئے جام ہیں.

t.149: They hear therein neither idle talk nor lies—
t.84: They will not hear any vain talk therein, nor lies,
t.85: There they will hear no vain or lying talk:
t.95: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, nor any falsehood;
t.19: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
t.22: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-
t.203: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil talk) shall they hear therein, nor lying;
t.54: وہاں نہ تو وه بیہوده باتیں سنیں گے اور نہ جھوٹی باتیں سنیں گے.

t.149: a repayment from yourLord, a measured gift,
t.84: this being a reward from their Lord, a well calculated grant,
t.85: a reward from your Lord, a fitting gift
t.95: a recompense from your Lord and an ample reward
t.19: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
t.22: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,
t.203: A reward from your Lord, an ample calculated gift (according to the best of their good deeds),
t.54: (ان کو) تیرے رب کی طرف سے (ان کے نیک اعمال کا)یہ بدلہ ملے گا جو کافی انعام ہوگا.

t.149: (from)the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between them,(from) the All-Merciful. They have no authority from Him to speak
t.84: (from) the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the All-Merciful. No one will have power to address Him,
t.85: from the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Lord of Mercy. They will have no authority from Him to speak.
t.95: from the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of that which is between them; the Most Merciful Lord before Whom none dare utter a word.
t.19: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
t.22: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.
t.203: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Gracious, with Whom they cannot dare to speak (on the Day of Resurrection except by His Leave).
t.54: (اس رب کی طرف سے ملے گا جو کہ) آسمانوں کا اور زمین کا اور جو کچھ ان کے درمیان ہے ان کا پروردگار ہے اور بڑی بخشش کرنے واﻻ ہے۔ کسی کو اس سے بات چیت کرنے کا اختیار نہیں ہوگا.

t.149: on the day when the Spirit and the angels line up in ranks, not speaking—except whomever the All-Merciful has permitted and who has said what is right.
t.84: on the Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows. They will not speak, except the one who is permitted by the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) and speaks aright.
t.85: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in rows, they will not speak except for those to whom the Lord of Mercy gives permission, who will say only what is right.
t.95: The Day when the Spirit and the angels are ranged row on row. None shall speak save he whom the Merciful Lord will permit; and he too will speak what is right.
t.19: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
t.22: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.
t.203: The Day that Ar-Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel) or another angel] and the angels will stand forth in rows, they will not speak except him whom the Most Gracious (Allâh) allows, and he will speak what is right.
t.54: جس دن روح اور فرشتے صفیں باندھ کر کھڑے ہوں گے تو کوئی کلام نہ کر سکے گا مگر جسے رحمٰن اجازت دے دے اور وه ٹھیک بات زبان سے نکالے.

t.149: That is the True Day. So whoever wills, let him take a route to return to his Lord.
t.84: That is the Day that is sure to come. So whoever so wishes may take refuge with his Lord.
t.85: That is the Day of Truth. So whoever wishes to do so should take the path that leads to his Lord.
t.95: That Day is sure to come. So let him who will seek a resort with his Lord.
t.19: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
t.22: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
t.203: That is (without doubt) the True Day. So, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)!
t.54: یہ دن حق ہے اب جو چاہے اپنے رب کے پاس (نیک اعمال کر کے) ٹھکانا بنالے.

t.149: Indeed, We have warned youof a near punishment—the day when a person looks at what his hands have put forth, and the denier says, “If only I were dust!”
t.84: We have warned you of an approaching torment (that will be inflicted) on a day when one will see what his hands have sent ahead, and the disbeliever will say, “O would that I had turned into dust.”
t.85: We have warned you of imminent torment, on the Day when every person will see what their own hands have sent ahead for them, when the disbeliever will say, ‘If only I were dust!’
t.95: Lo! We warn you of a chastisement near at hand; the Day when a man will look on what his own hands have sent forth, and the unbelievers shall say: “Oh would that I were utter dust.”
t.19: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
t.22: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (mere) dust!"
t.203: Verily, We have warned you of a near torment - the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: "Woe to me! Would that I were dust!"
t.54: ہم نے تمہیں عنقریب آنے والے عذاب سے ڈرا دیا (اور چوکنا کر دیا) ہے۔ جس دن انسان اپنے ہاتھوں کی کمائی کو دیکھ لے گا اور کافر کہے گا کہ کاش! میں مٹی ہو جاتا.

t.149: By those who snatch violently.
t.84: I swear by those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the infidels) with extreme force,
t.85: By the forceful chargers
t.95: By those (angels) that pluck out the soul from depths,
t.19: By those who drag forth to destruction,
t.22: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
t.203: By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence.
t.54: ڈوب کر سختی سے کھینچنے والوں کی قسم!

t.149: By those who remove gently.
t.84: and by those (angels) who untie the knot (of the souls of the believers) smoothly,
t.85: raring to go,
t.95: and gently take it away;
t.19: By the meteors rushing,
t.22: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);
t.203: By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers).
t.54: بند کھول کر چھڑا دینے والوں کی قسم!

t.149: By those who glide smoothly,
t.84: and by those who float (in the atmosphere) swiftly,
t.85: sweeping ahead at full stretch,
t.95: and by those that speedily glide along (the cosmos),
t.19: By the lone stars floating,
t.22: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
t.203: And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits).
t.54: اور تیرنے پھرنے والوں کی قسم!

t.149: and by those who race swiftly,
t.84: then proceed forward quickly,
t.85: overtaking swiftly
t.95: and vie with the others(in carrying out their Lord's behests);
t.19: By the angels hastening,
t.22: Then press forward as in a race,
t.203: And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses).
t.54: پھر دوڑ کر آگے بڑھنے والوں کی قسم!

t.149: and by those who regulate matters—
t.84: then manage (to do) everything (they are ordered to do,)
t.85: to bring the matter to an end,
t.95: and then manage the affairs of the Universe(according to their Lord's commands).
t.19: And those who govern the event,
t.22: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),
t.203: And by those angels who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbelievers will be called to account).
t.54: پھر کام کی تدبیر کرنے والوں کی قسم!

t.149: on the day when the Quake quakes
t.84: (you will be resurrected) on the Day when the shocking event (i.e. the first blowing of the trumpet) will shock (everything),
t.85: on the Day when the blast reverberates
t.95: The Day when the quaking will cause a violent convulsion,
t.19: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
t.22: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
t.203: On the Day (when the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the mountains will shake violently (and everybody will die).
t.54: جس دن کانپنے والی کانپے گی.

t.149: and is followed by the Successor,
t.84: followed by the next one (i.e. the second blowing of the trumpet.)
t.85: and the second blast follows,
t.95: and will be followed by another quaking.
t.19: And the second followeth it,
t.22: Followed by oft-repeated (commotions):
t.203: The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be resurrected).
t.54: اس کے بعد ایک پیچھے آنے والی (پیچھے پیچھے) آئے گی.

t.149: hearts on that day are pounding,
t.84: On that day, hearts (of people) will be throbbing,
t.85: hearts will tremble
t.95: On that Day some hearts shall tremble (with fright),
t.19: On that day hearts beat painfully
t.22: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
t.203: (Some) hearts that Day will shake with fear and anxiety.
t.54: (بہت سے) دل اس دن دھڑکتے ہوں گے.

t.149: their sight(s) (subdued) in reverence.
t.84: with their eyes downcast.
t.85: and eyes will be downcast.
t.95: and their eyes shall be downcast with dread.
t.19: While eyes are downcast
t.22: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.
t.203: Their eyes will be downcast.
t.54: جن کی نگاہیں نیچی ہوں گی.

t.149: They say, “Can it be that we will reallybe restored to the original condition?
t.84: They (the infidels) say, “Are we going to be brought back to our former state (of Life)?
t.85: They say, ‘What? shall we be brought back to life,
t.95: They say: “Shall we indeed be restored to life,
t.19: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
t.22: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?
t.203: They say: "Shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state of life?
t.54: کہتے ہیں کہ کیا ہم پہلی کی سی حالت کی طرف پھر لوٹائے جائیں گے؟

t.149: Can that be when we havebecome wornout bones?”
t.84: Is it when we are turned into decayed bones?”
t.85: after we have turned into decayed bones?’ and they say,
t.95: even after we have been reduced to bones, hollow and rotten?”
t.19: Even after we are crumbled bones?
t.22: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"
t.203: "Even after we are crumbled bones?"
t.54: کیا اس وقت جب کہ ہم بوسیده ہڈیاں ہو جائیں گے؟

t.149: They said, “This is a losing return.”
t.84: They say, “If so, that will be a harmful homecoming.”
t.85: ‘Such a return is impossible!’
t.95: They say: “That will then be a return with a great loss!”
t.19: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
t.22: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
t.203: They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!"
t.54: کہتے ہیں کہ پھر تو یہ لوٹنا نقصان ده ہے

t.149: Yet, indeed, it is nothing but a single nudge,
t.84: In fact, it will be only a single harsh voice,
t.85: But all it will take is a single blast,
t.95: Surely they will need no more than a single stern blast,
t.19: Surely it will need but one shout,
t.22: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
t.203: But it will be only a single Zajrah [shout (i.e., the second blowing of the Trumpet)], (See Verse 37:19).
t.54: (معلوم ہونا چاہئے) وه تو صرف ایک (خوفناک) ڈانٹ ہے.

t.149: and they are all awake.
t.84: and in no time they will be (brought) into the plain (of Hashr).
t.85: and they will be back above ground.
t.95: and lo, they will all be in the open plain.
t.19: And lo! they will be awakened.
t.22: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).
t.203: When behold, they find themselves on the surface of the earth alive after their death,
t.54: کہ (جس کے ظاہر ہوتے ہی) وه ایک دم میدان میں جمع ہو جائیں گے.

t.149: Has the story of Moses reached you?
t.84: Has there come to you the narrative about Mūsā?
t.85: Have you [Prophet] heard the story of Moses?
t.95: Has Moses' story reached you?
t.19: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?
t.22: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
t.203: Has there come to you the story of Mûsâ (Moses)?
t.54: کیا موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کی خبر تمہیں پہنچی ہے؟

t.149: When His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
t.84: (Recall) when his Lord called to him in the blessed valley of Tuwā:
t.85: His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:
t.95: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
t.19: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,
t.22: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-
t.203: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tûwâ,
t.54: جب کہ انہیں ان کے رب نے پاک میدان طویٰ میں پکارا.

t.149: “Go to Pharaoh—indeed, he has exceeded all limits—
t.84: “Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh). Indeed, he has crossed all bounds.
t.85: ‘Go to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds,
t.95: and directed him: “Go to Pharaoh, he has rebelled,
t.19: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -
t.22: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:
t.203: Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he has transgressed all bounds (in crimes, sins, polytheism, disbelief).
t.54: (کہ) تم فرعون کے پاس جاؤ اس نے سرکشی اختیار کر لی ہے.

t.149: and say, ‘Do youcare to be purified?
t.84: And say (to him,) ‘Would you like to purify yourself,
t.85: and ask him, “Do you want to purify yourself [of sin]?
t.95: and say to him: 'Are you willing to be purified,
t.19: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
t.22: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-
t.203: And say to him: "Would you purify yourself (from the sin of disbelief by becoming a believer)?"
t.54: اس سے کہو کہ کیا تو اپنی درستگی اور اصلاح چاہتا ہے.

t.149: And I will guide you to your Lord, so you will be in awe.’”
t.84: and that I should guide you to your Lord, so that you fear (Him)?’”
t.85: Do you want me to guide you to your Lord, so that you may hold Him in awe?” ’
t.95: that I may direct you to your Lord and then you hold Him in awe?' ”
t.19: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).
t.22: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"
t.203: "And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him?"
t.54: اور یہ کہ میں تجھے تیرے رب کی راه دکھاؤں تاکہ تو (اس سے) ڈرنے لگے.

t.149: So he showed him the biggest sign,
t.84: So, he (Mūsā) showed him the biggest sign.
t.85: Moses showed him the great sign,
t.95: Then Moses (went to Pharaoh and) showed him the Great Sign;
t.19: And he showed him the tremendous token.
t.22: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
t.203: Then [Mûsâ (Moses)] showed him the great sign (miracles).
t.54: پس اسے بڑی نشانی دکھائی.

t.149: but he disbelieved and disobeyed,
t.84: But he rejected and disobeyed,
t.85: but he denied it and refused [the faith].
t.95: but he denied it as false and disobeyed,
t.19: But he denied and disobeyed,
t.22: But (Pharaoh) rejected it and disobeyed (guidance);
t.203: But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] belied and disobeyed.
t.54: تو اس نے جھٹلایا اور نافرمانی کی.

t.149: then retreated in haste
t.84: then he turned back, and tried hard (to refute the Messenger),
t.85: He turned away and hastily
t.95: and then he turned back to have recourse to his craftiness,
t.19: Then turned he away in haste,
t.22: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
t.203: Then he turned his back, striving (against Allâh).
t.54: پھر پلٹا دوڑ دھوپ کرتے ہوئے.

t.149: and gathered and proclaimed.
t.84: then he gathered (his people) and shouted
t.85: gathered his people, proclaiming,
t.95: and gathered his people and declared:
t.19: Then gathered he and summoned
t.22: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
t.203: Then he gathered (his people) and cried aloud,
t.54: پھر سب کو جمع کرکے پکارا.

t.149: He said, “I am yourLord, the most high.”
t.84: and said, “I am your supreme lord.”
t.85: ‘I am your supreme lord,’
t.95: “I am the supreme lord of you all.”
t.19: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
t.22: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
t.203: Saying: "I am your lord, most high."
t.54: تم سب کا رب میں ہی ہوں.

t.149: So Allah seized him with an exemplary punishment, in the Last(life) and in the First.
t.84: So, Allah seized him for an exemplary punishment in the Hereafter and the present world.
t.85: so God condemned him to punishment in the life to come as well as in this life:
t.95: Thereupon Allah seized him for the chastisement of the World to Come as well as of the present.
t.19: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
t.22: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.
t.203: So Allâh, seized him with punishment for his last and first transgression. [Tafsir At-Tabari]
t.54: تو (سب سے بلند وباﻻ) اللہ نے بھی اسے آخرت کے اور دنیا کے عذاب میں گرفتار کرلیا.

t.149: Indeed, in this is a lesson for whoever fears.
t.84: Indeed, there is a lesson for him who fears (Allah).
t.85: there truly is a lesson in this for anyone who stands in awe of God.
t.95: Surely there is a great lesson in it for whoever would fear (Allah).
t.19: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.
t.22: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).
t.203: Verily, in this is an instructive admonition for whosoever fears Allâh.
t.54: بیشک اس میں اس شخص کے لئے عبرت ہے جو ڈرے.

t.149: Are youmore difficult to create or the heaven? He constructed it:
t.84: Is your creation more difficult or that of the sky? He has built it,
t.85: Which is harder to create: you people or the sky that He built,
t.95: Is it harder to create you or the heaven? But Allah built it,
t.19: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
t.22: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:
t.203: Are you more difficult to create or is the heaven that He constructed?
t.54: کیا تمہارا پیدا کرنا زیاده دشوار ہے یا آسمان کا؟ اللہ تعالیٰ نے اسے بنایا.

t.149: He raised its masses and proportioned it,
t.84: He has raised its height, then made it proper,
t.85: raising it high and perfecting it,
t.95: and raised its vault high and proportioned it;
t.19: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;
t.22: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.
t.203: He raised its height, and has perfected it.
t.54: اس کی بلندی اونچی کی پھر اسے ٹھیک ٹھاک کر دیا.

t.149: and He dimmed its night and brought out its daylight.
t.84: and darkened its night, and brought forth its daylight,
t.85: giving darkness to its night and bringing out its morning brightness,
t.95: and covered its night with darkness and brought forth from it its day;
t.19: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
t.22: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).
t.203: Its night He covers with darkness and its forenoon He brings out (with light)
t.54: اسکی رات کو تاریک بنایا اور اس کے دن کو نکالا.

t.149: And the earth, after that—He spread it out;
t.84: and, after that, He spread out the earth.
t.85: and the earth, too, He spread out,
t.95: and thereafter spread out the earth,
t.19: And after that He spread the earth,
t.22: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);
t.203: And after that He spread the earth,
t.54: اور اس کے بعد زمین کو (ہموار) بچھا دیا.

t.149: from it He brought out its water and its pasture,
