t.84: From it, He brought out its water and its meadows,
t.85: bringing waters and pastures out of it,
t.95: and brought out of it its water and its pasture,
t.19: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
t.22: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;
t.203: And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture.
t.54: اس میں سے پانی اور چاره نکالا.

t.149: and the mountains He anchored—
t.84: and firmly fixed the mountains,
t.85: and setting firm mountains [in it]
t.95: and firmly fixed in it mountains;
t.19: And He made fast the hills,
t.22: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
t.203: And the mountains He has fixed firmly,
t.54: اور پہاڑوں کو (مضبوط) گاڑ دیا.

t.149: a source of enjoyment for youand for your livestock.
t.84: (all this) as a benefit to you and your cattle.
t.85: for you and your animals to enjoy?
t.95: all this as provision for you and your cattle.
t.19: A provision for you and for your cattle.
t.22: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
t.203: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.
t.54: یہ سب تمہارے اور تمہارے جانوروں کے فائدے کے لئے (ہیں).

t.149: So when the Biggest Catastrophe arrives—
t.84: So when the Greatest Havoc will take place
t.85: When the great overwhelming event arrives
t.95: But when the great calamity will come about
t.19: But when the great disaster cometh,
t.22: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-
t.203: But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense) -
t.54: پس جب وه بڑی آفت (قیامت) آجائے گی.

t.149: on the day when man reminds himself of what he has endeavored,
t.84: on the day when man will recall what he did,
t.85: on the Day that man remembers what he has done
t.95: on the Day when man will recall all his strivings,
t.19: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
t.22: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,
t.203: The Day when man shall remember what he strove for.
t.54: جس دن کہ انسان اپنے کیے ہوئے کاموں کو یاد کرے گا.

t.149: and purgatory is displayed to whoever sees.
t.84: and the Hell will be exposed for all who see,
t.85: and Hell is there for all to see,
t.95: and Hell will be brought in sight for anyone to see:
t.19: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
t.22: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-
t.203: And Hell-fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees.
t.54: اور (ہر) دیکھنے والے کے سامنے جہنم ظاہر کی جائے گی.

t.149: So as for the one who exceeded all
t.84: then for the one who had rebelled,
t.85: for anyone who has transgressed
t.95: then he who transgressed
t.19: Then, as for him who rebelled
t.22: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,
t.203: Then for him who transgressed all bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allâh).
t.54: تو جس (شخص) نے سرکشی کی (ہوگی).

t.149: limits and preferred the Earlier Life,
t.84: and preferred the worldly life (to the Hereafter),
t.85: and preferred the present life
t.95: and preferred the life of this world,
t.19: And chose the life of the world,
t.22: And had preferred the life of this world,
t.203: And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts),
t.54: اور دنیوی زندگی کو ترجیح دی (ہوگی).

t.149: then indeed, purgatory is the shelter.
t.84: the Hell will be the abode,
t.85: Hell will be home;
t.95: most surely his abode shall be Hell.
t.19: Lo! hell will be his home.
t.22: The Abode will be Hell-Fire;
t.203: Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire;
t.54: اس کا ٹھکانا جہنم ہی ہے.

t.149: But as for the one who feared standing before his Lord and forbade the self(its) whim,
t.84: whereas for the one who feared to stand before his Lord, and restrained his self from the (evil) desire,
t.85: for anyone who feared the meeting with his Lord and restrained himself from base desires,
t.95: But he who feared to stand before his Lord, and restrained himself from evil desires,
t.19: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
t.22: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
t.203: But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires and lusts.
t.54: ہاں جو شخص اپنے رب کے سامنے کھڑے ہونے سے ڈرتا رہا ہوگا اور اپنے نفس کو خواہش سے روکا ہوگا.

t.149: then indeed, the Garden(of Paradise) is the shelter.
t.84: the Paradise will be the abode.
t.85: Paradise will be home.
t.95: most surely his abode shall be Paradise.
t.19: Lo! the Garden will be his home.
t.22: Their abode will be the Garden.
t.203: Verily, Paradise will be his abode.
t.54: تو اس کا ٹھکانا جنت ہی ہے.

t.149: They ask youabout the Hour: “When will it take place?”
t.84: They ask you (O Prophet,) about the Hour (the Day of Judgment) as to when it will take place.
t.85: They ask you [Prophet] about the Hour,
t.95: They ask you about the Hour: “When will it be?”
t.19: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?
t.22: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?
t.203: They ask you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about the Hour - when will be its appointed time?
t.54: لوگ آپ سے قیامت کے واقع ہونے کا وقت دریافت کرتے ہیں.

t.149: What have youto do with mentioning it?
t.84: In which capacity are you to tell this?
t.85: saying, ‘When will it arrive?’, but how can you tell [them that]?
t.95: What concern do you have to speak about that?
t.19: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
t.22: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
t.203: You have no knowledge to say anything about it.
t.54: آپ کو اس کے بیان کرنے سے کیا تعلق؟

t.149: To yourLord is its finality.
t.84: With your Lord is the final word about it.
t.85: Its time is known only to your Lord;
t.95: Its knowledge rests with your Lord.
t.19: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
t.22: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
t.203: To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?
t.54: اس کے علم کی انتہا تو اللہ کی جانب ہے.

t.149: You are just a forewarner for whoever fears it.
t.84: You are only a warner for anyone who fears it.
t.85: you are only sent to warn those who fear it.
t.95: You are only a warner to him who has a fear of it.
t.19: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
t.22: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
t.203: You (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are only a warner for those who fear it,
t.54: آپ تو صرف اس سے ڈرتے رہنے والوں کو آگاه کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: On the day when they witness it, it will be as though they tarried(in the world) but the evening of one day or its morning.
t.84: The day they will see it, it will seem to them as if they did not live (in the world) but only for one afternoon or for the morning thereof.
t.85: On the Day they see it, it will seem they lingered [in this life] an evening [at most,] or its morning.
t.95: On the Day they see it, they will feel as though they had stayed (in the grave) no more than one evening or one morning.
t.19: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
t.22: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
t.203: The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning.
t.54: جس روز یہ اسے دیکھ لیں گے تو ایسا معلوم ہوگا کہ صرف دن کا آخری حصہ یا اول حصہ ہی (دنیا میں) رہے ہیں.

t.149: He frowned and turned away
t.84: He (the Prophet) frowned and turned his face,
t.85: He frowned and turned away
t.95: He frowned and turned away
t.19: He frowned and turned away
t.22: (The Prophet) frowned and turned away,
t.203: (The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم) frowned and turned away.
t.54: وه ترش رو ہوا اور منھ موڑ لیا.

t.149: when the blind man approached him.
t.84: because the blind man came to him!
t.85: when the blind man came to him––
t.95: that the blind man came to him.
t.19: Because the blind man came unto him.
t.22: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).
t.203: Because there came to him the blind man (i.e. ‘Abdullâh bin Umm-Maktûm, who came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم while he was preaching to one or some of the Quraish chiefs).
t.54: (صرف اس لئے) کہ اس کے پاس ایک نابینا آیا.

t.149: But what could make yourealize that perhaps he was seeking to purify himself,
t.84: What could tell you (O prophet about the prospects of the blind man?) May be, (if you had attended him properly,) he would have attained purity,
t.85: for all you know, he might have grown in spirit,
t.95: How could you know? Perhaps he would cleanse himself,
t.19: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
t.22: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
t.203: And how can you know that he might become pure (from sins)?
t.54: تجھے کیا خبر شاید وه سنور جاتا.

t.149: or to be reminded so that the reminder would benefit him?
t.84: or have received the advice, and the advice would have benefited him.
t.85: or taken note of something useful to him.
t.95: or he might be mindful and good counsel might avail him.
t.19: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
t.22: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?
t.203: Or he might receive admonition, and the admonition might profit him?
t.54: یا نصیحت سنتا اور اسے نصیحت فائده پہنچاتی.

t.149: But as for the one who thought himself self-sufficient,
t.84: As for the one who does not care (about faith),
t.85: For the self-satisfied one
t.95: Now he who waxes indifferent,
t.19: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
t.22: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,
t.203: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,
t.54: جو بے پرواہی کرتا ہے.

t.149: yougive him your attention,
t.84: you are anxious to pursue him,
t.85: you go out of your way––
t.95: you attend to him,
t.19: Unto him thou payest regard.
t.22: To him dost thou attend;
t.203: To him you attend;
t.54: اس کی طرف تو تو پوری توجہ کرتا ہے.

t.149: though you are not liable if he never purifies himself.
t.84: while there is no blame on you, if he does not attain purity.
t.85: though you are not to be blamed for his lack of spiritual growth––
t.95: though you are not to blame if he would not cleanse himself.
t.19: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
t.22: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).
t.203: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure (from disbelief: you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allâh).
t.54: حاﻻنکہ اس کے نہ سنورنے سے تجھ پر کوئی الزام نہیں.

t.149: Yet, as for the one who came to you rushing
t.84: As regards the one who has come to you rushing eagerly,
t.85: but from the one who has come to you full of eagerness
t.95: But he who comes to you running,
t.19: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
t.22: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,
t.203: But as to him who came to you running,
t.54: اور جو شخص تیرے پاس دوڑتا ہوا آتا ہے.

t.149: with fear(of Allah) ,
t.84: while he fears (Allah),
t.85: and awe
t.95: and fears (Allah),
t.19: And hath fear,
t.22: And with fear (in his heart),
t.203: And is afraid (of Allâh and His punishment).
t.54: اور وه ڈر (بھی) رہا ہے.

t.149: to him you are inattentive.
t.84: to him you pay no heed!
t.85: you allow yourself to be distracted.
t.95: you pay no heed to him.
t.19: From him thou art distracted.
t.22: Of him wast thou unmindful.
t.203: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,
t.54: تو اس سے بےرخی برتتا ہے.

t.149: But no, indeed this is a Reminder.
t.84: Never! (you should never act in this way,) Indeed this (Qur’ān) is an advice.
t.85: No indeed! This [Quran] is a lesson
t.95: No indeed; this is only a Reminder.
t.19: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
t.22: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
t.203: Nay, (do not do like this); indeed it (this Qur’ân) is an admonition.
t.54: یہ ٹھیک نہیں قرآن تو نصیحت (کی چیز) ہے.

t.149: So whoever wills shall remember it.
t.84: So, whoever so wills may pay heed to it.
t.85: from which those who wish to be taught should learn,
t.95: So whoso wills may give heed to it.
t.19: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
t.22: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.
t.203: So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it.
t.54: جو چاہے اس سے نصیحت لے.

t.149: (It is) in honorable Scrolls,
t.84: It is (recorded) in those scripts (of the Preserved Tablet) that are honoured,
t.85: [written] on honoured,
t.95: It is contained in scrolls highly honoured,
t.19: On honoured leaves
t.22: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,
t.203: (It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz),
t.54: (یہ تو) پر عظمت صحیفوں میں (ہے).

t.149: exalted and purified,
t.84: exalted, purified,
t.85: exalted, pure pages,
t.95: most exalted and purified,
t.19: Exalted, purified,
t.22: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,
t.203: Exalted (in dignity), purified,
t.54: جو بلند وباﻻ اور پاک صاف ہے.

t.149: borne by the hands of scribes,
t.84: in the hands of those scribes
t.85: by the hands of
t.95: borne by the hands of scribes,
t.19: (Set down) by scribes
t.22: (Written) by the hands of scribes-
t.203: In the hands of scribes (angels).
t.54: ایسے لکھنے والوں کے ہاتھوں میں ہے.

t.149: noble and devoted.
t.84: who are honorable, righteous.
t.85: noble and virtuous scribes.
t.95: noble and purified.
t.19: Noble and righteous.
t.22: Honourable and Pious and Just.
t.203: Honourable and obedient.
t.54: جو بزرگ اور پاکباز ہیں.

t.149: May man perish! What a denier he is!
t.84: Damned is the man! How ungrateful he is!
t.85: Woe to man! How ungrateful he is!
t.95: Accursed be man! How stubbornly he denies the Truth.
t.19: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!
t.22: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;
t.203: Be cursed (the disbelieving) man! How ungrateful he is!
t.54: اللہ کی مار انسان پر کیسا ناشکرا ہے.

t.149: From what did He create him?
t.84: From which stuff did He (Allah) create him?
t.85: From what thing does God create him?
t.95: Out of what did Allah create him?
t.19: From what thing doth He create him?
t.22: From what stuff hath He created him?
t.203: From what thing did He create him?
t.54: اسے اللہ نے کس چیز سے پیدا کیا.

t.149: From a sperm drop He created him and enabled him,
t.84: from a drop of semen! He created him, and designed him in due proportion,
t.85: He creates him from a droplet, He proportions him,
t.95: Out of a sperm-drop did He create him and then determined a measure for him,
t.19: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
t.22: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
t.203: From Nutfah (male and female semen drops) He created him and then set him in due proportion.
t.54: اسے) ایک نطفہ سے پیدا کیا،پھراس کا اندازہ مقررکیا .

t.149: then He eased the way for him,
t.84: then He made the way easy for him,
t.85: He makes the way easy for him,
t.95: and then made the course of life easy for him,
t.19: Then maketh the way easy for him,
t.22: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;
t.203: Then He makes the Path easy for him.
t.54: پھر اس کے لئے راستہ آسان کیا.

t.149: then He put him to death and buried him,
t.84: Later, he made him die, and put him into grave,
t.85: then He causes him to die and be buried.
t.95: then He caused him to die and brought him to the grave,
t.19: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
t.22: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;
t.203: Then He causes him to die and puts him in his grave.
t.54: پھر اسے موت دی اور پھر قبر میں دفن کیا.

t.149: then, when He wills, He will resurrect him.
t.84: Thereafter, when He will intend, He will raise him up.
t.85: When He wills, He will raise him up again.
t.95: and then, whenever He wishes, He will raise him back to life.
t.19: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
t.22: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).
t.203: Then when it is His Will, He will resurrect him (again).
t.54: پھر جب چاہے گا اسے زنده کر دے گا.

t.149: But no, he did not fulfill what He commanded him.
t.84: No! He has not yet fulfilled what He (Allah) had commanded him.
t.85: Yet man does not fulfil God’s commands.
t.95: Nay, but man did not fulfil what Allah had enjoined upon him.
t.19: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
t.22: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.
t.203: Nay, but (man) has not done what He commanded him.
t.54: ہرگز نہیں*۔ اس نے اب تک اللہ کے حکم کی بجا آوری نہیں کی.

t.149: Let man look at his food:
t.84: So, the man should consider his food,
t.85: Let man consider the food he eats!
t.95: So let man just consider his food:
t.19: Let man consider his food:
t.22: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
t.203: Then let man look at his food:
t.54: انسان کو چاہئے کہ اپنے کھانے کو دیکھے.

t.149: that We poured down water in abundance,
t.84: how well We poured water,
t.85: We pour down abundant water
t.95: We poured water, pouring it in great abundance,
t.19: How We pour water in showers
t.22: For that We pour forth water in abundance,
t.203: We pour forth water in abundance.
t.54: کہ ہم نے خوب پانی برسایا.

t.149: then We made the land vigorously rupture
t.84: then how nicely We split the earth,
t.85: and cause the soil to split open.
t.95: and cleaved the earth, cleaving it asunder;
t.19: Then split the earth in clefts
t.22: And We split the earth in fragments,
t.203: And We split the earth in clefts.
t.54: پھر پھاڑا زمین کو اچھی طرح.

t.149: and germinated therein grains
t.84: then We grew in it grain,
t.85: We make grain grow,
t.95: then caused the grain to grow out of it,
t.19: And cause the grain to grow therein
t.22: And produce therein corn,
t.203: And We cause therein the grain to grow,
t.54: پھر اس میں سے اناج اگائے.

t.149: and grapes and herbs,
t.84: and grapes and greens,
t.85: and vines, fresh vegetation,
t.95: together with grapes and vegetables,
t.19: And grapes and green fodder
t.22: And Grapes and nutritious plants,
t.203: And grapes and clover plants (i.e. green fodder for the cattle),
t.54: اور انگور اور ترکاری.

t.149: and olives and dates,
t.84: and olive and date-palms,
t.85: olive trees, date palms,
t.95: and olives and palms,
t.19: And olive-trees and palm-trees
t.22: And Olives and Dates,
t.203: And olives and date-palms,
t.54: اور زیتون اور کھجور.

t.149: and luscious orchards,
t.84: and gardens, full of thick trees,
t.85: luscious gardens,
t.95: and dense orchards,
t.19: And garden-closes of thick foliage
t.22: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
t.203: And gardens dense with many trees,
t.54: اور گنجان باغات.

t.149: and fruit and fodder—
t.84: and fruits and fodder,
t.85: fruits, and fodder:
t.95: and fruits and pastures –
t.19: And fruits and grasses:
t.22: And fruits and fodder,-
t.203: And fruits and herbage
t.54: اور میوه اور (گھاس) چاره (بھی اگایا).

t.149: an enjoyment for you and for yourlivestock.
t.84: as a benefit for you and your cattle.
t.85: all for you and your livestock to enjoy.
t.95: all this as a provision for you and your cattle.
t.19: Provision for you and your cattle.
t.22: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
t.203: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.
t.54: تمہارے استعمال وفائدے کے لئے اور تمہارے چوپایوں کے لئے.

t.149: But when the Deafening Noise comes to pass,
t.84: So when the Deafening Noise will occur,
t.85: When the Deafening Blast comes––
t.95: But when the deafening cry shall be sounded
t.19: But when the Shout cometh
t.22: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-
t.203: Then when there comes As-Sâkhkhah (the second blowing of the Trumpet on the Day of Resurrection)
t.54: پس جب کہ کان بہرے کر دینے والی (قیامت) آجائے گی.

t.149: on a day when a person flees from his brother
t.84: the Day when one will flee from his brother,
t.85: the Day man will flee from his own brother,
t.95: on the Day when each man shall flee from his brother,
t.19: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
t.22: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
t.203: That Day shall a man flee from his brother,
t.54: اس دن آدمی اپنے بھائی سے بھاگے گا.

t.149: and his mother and his father
t.84: and from his mother and father,
t.85: his mother, his father,
t.95: and his mother and his father;
t.19: And his mother and his father
t.22: And from his mother and his father,
t.203: And from his mother and his father,
t.54: اور اپنی ماں اور اپنے باپ سے.

t.149: and his female companion and his children—
t.84: and from his wife and sons,
t.85: his wife, his children:
t.95: and his consort and his children;
t.19: And his wife and his children,
t.22: And from his wife and his children.
t.203: And from his wife and his children.
t.54: اور اپنی بیوی اور اپنی اوﻻد سے بھاگے گا.

t.149: every one of them on that day has enough to preoccupy him.
t.84: every one of them will be too engaged in his own affairs to care for others.
t.85: each of them will be absorbed in concerns of their own on that Day-
t.95: on that Day each will be occupied with his own business, making him oblivious of all save himself.
t.19: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
t.22: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.
t.203: Everyman that Day will have enough to make him careless of others.
t.54: ان میں سے ہر ایک کو اس دن ایسی فکر (دامن گیر) ہوگی جو اس کے لئے کافی ہوگی.

t.149: Some faces on that day are radiant,
t.84: Many faces, on that day, will be bright,
t.85: on that Day some faces will be beaming,
t.95: Some faces on that Day shall be beaming with happiness,
t.19: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
t.22: Some faces that Day will be beaming,
t.203: Some faces that Day will be bright (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism),
t.54: اس دن بہت سے چہرے روشن ہوں گے.

t.149: laughing and glad.
t.84: laughing, rejoicing,
t.85: laughing, and rejoicing,
t.95: and be cheerful and joyous.
t.19: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;
t.22: Laughing, rejoicing.
t.203: Laughing, rejoicing at good news (of Paradise).
t.54: (جو) ہنستے ہوئے اور ہشاش بشاش ہوں گے.

t.149: And some faces on that day are covered with dust,
t.84: and many faces, on that day, will be stained with dust,
t.85: but some faces will be dust-stained
t.95: Some faces on that Day shall be dust-ridden,
t.19: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
t.22: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
t.203: And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained.
t.54: اور بہت سے چہرے اس دن غبار آلود ہوں گے.

t.149: covered in darkness:
t.84: covered by darkness.
t.85: and covered in darkness:
t.95: enveloped by darkness.
t.19: Veiled in darkness,
t.22: Blackness will cover them:
t.203: Darkness will cover them.
t.54: جن پر سیاہی چڑھی ہوئی ہوگی.

t.149: those are the deniers, the vicious.
t.84: Those are the disbelievers, the nefarious.
t.85: those are the disbelievers, the licentious.
t.95: These will be the unbelievers, the wicked.
t.19: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
t.22: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
t.203: Such will be the Kafarah (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, etc.), the Fajarah (wicked evil doers).
t.54: وه یہی کافر بدکردار لوگ ہوں گے.

t.149: When the sun is rolled up,
t.84: When the sun will be folded up,
t.85: When the sun is shrouded in darkness,
t.95: When the sun shall be folded up,
t.19: When the sun is overthrown,
t.22: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;
t.203: When the sun is wound round and its light is lost and is overthrown.
t.54: جب سورج لپیٹ لیا جائے گا.

t.149: and when the stars are dimmed,
t.84: and when the stars will swoop down,
t.85: when the stars are dimmed,
t.95: when the stars shall scatter away,
t.19: And when the stars fall,
t.22: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;
t.203: And when the stars fall.
t.54: اور جب ستارے بے نور ہو جائیں گی.

t.149: and when the mountains are set in motion,
t.84: and when the mountains will be set in motion,
t.85: when the mountains are set in motion,
t.95: when the mountains shall be set in motion,
t.19: And when the hills are moved,
t.22: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);
t.203: And when the mountains are made to pass away;
t.54: اور جب پہاڑ چلائے جائیں گے.

t.149: and when pregnant camels are abandoned,
t.84: and when the ten-months pregnant she-camels will be abandoned,
t.85: when pregnant camels are abandoned,
t.95: when the ten-months pregnant camels shall be abandoned,
t.19: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
t.22: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;
t.203: And when the pregnant she-camels are neglected;
t.54: اور جب دس ماه کی حاملہ اونٹنیاں چھوڑ دی جائیں.

t.149: and when the beasts are herded,
t.84: and when the wild beasts will be gathered together,
t.85: when wild beasts are herded together,
t.95: when the savage beasts shall be brought together,
t.19: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
t.22: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);
t.203: And when the wild beasts are gathered together.
t.54: اور جب وحشی جانور اکھٹے کیے جائیں گے.

t.149: and when the oceans are set aflame,
t.84: and when the seas will be flared up,
t.85: when the seas boil over,
t.95: when the seas shall be set boiling,
t.19: And when the seas rise,
t.22: When the oceans boil over with a swell;
t.203: And when the seas become as blazing Fire or overflow.
t.54: اور جب سمندر بھڑکائے جائیں گے.

t.149: and when the souls are paired,
t.84: and when the people will be arranged in categories,
t.85: when souls are sorted into classes,
t.95: when the souls shall be rejoined (with their bodies),
t.19: And when souls are reunited,
t.22: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);
t.203: And when the souls are joined with their bodies, (the good with the good and the bad with the bad).
t.54: اور جب جانیں (جسموں سے) ملا دی جائیں گی.

t.149: and when the baby girl that was buried alive is asked
t.84: and when the girl-child that was buried alive will be asked,
t.85: when the baby girl buried alive is asked
t.95: and when the girl-child buried alive shall be asked:
t.19: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
t.22: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -
t.203: And when the female (infant) buried alive (as the pagan Arabs used to do) is questioned:
t.54: اور جب زنده گاڑی ہوئی لڑکی سے سوال کیا جائے گا.

t.149: for what misdeed she was killed ,
t.84: for what sin she was killed,
t.85: for what sin she was killed,
t.95: for what offence was she killed?
t.19: For what sin she was slain,
t.22: For what crime she was killed;
t.203: For what sin, was she killed?
t.54: کہ کس گناه کی وجہ سے وه قتل کی گئی؟

t.149: and when the scrolls are made public ,
t.84: and when the scrolls (of deeds) will be unrolled,
t.85: when the records of deeds are spread open,
t.95: and when the scrolls of (men's) deeds shall be unfolded,
t.19: And when the pages are laid open,
t.22: When the scrolls are laid open;
t.203: And when the (written) pages [of deeds (good and bad) of every person] are laid open.
t.54: اور جب نامہٴ اعمال کھول دیئے جائیں گے.

t.149: and when the sky is peeled away,
t.84: and when the sky will be stripped off,
t.85: when the sky is stripped away,
t.95: and when Heaven is laid bare;
t.19: And when the sky is torn away,
t.22: When the world on High is unveiled;
t.203: And when the heaven is stripped off and taken away from its place;
t.54: اور جب آسمان کی کھال اتار لی جائے گی.

t.149: and when purgatory is setfully ablaze ,
t.84: and when the Hell will be set ablaze,
t.85: when Hell is made to blaze
t.95: and Hell is stoked,
t.19: And when hell is lighted,
t.22: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
t.203: And when Hell-fire is set ablaze.
t.54: اور جب جہنم بھڑکائی جائے گی.

t.149: and when the Garden(of Paradise) is brought near—
t.84: and when the Paradise will be brought close,
t.85: and Paradise brought near:
t.95: and Paradise brought nigh:
t.19: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
t.22: And when the Garden is brought near;-
t.203: And when Paradise is brought near.
t.54: اور جب جنت نزدیک کر دی جائے گی.

t.149: each soul will know what it has brought forth.
t.84: then everyone will know what he (or she) has put forward.
t.85: then every soul will know what it has brought about.
t.95: then shall each person know what he has brought along.
t.19: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
t.22: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
t.203: (Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil).
t.54: تو اس دن ہر شخص جان لے گا جو کچھ لے کر آیا ہوگا.

t.149: So, no! I swear by those(stars) receding,
t.84: So, I swear by those (stars) that recede,
t.85: I swear by the planets
t.95: No indeed; I swear by the alternating stars
t.19: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
t.22: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,
t.203: So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night).
t.54: میں قسم کھاتا ہوں پیچھے ہٹنے والے.

t.149: running, sweeping.
t.84: that proceed, that withdraw from the scene,
t.85: that recede, move, and hide,
t.95: that hide,
t.19: The stars which rise and set,
t.22: Go straight, or hide;
t.203: And by the planets that move swiftly and hide themselves.
t.54: چلنے پھرنے والے چھپنے والے ستاروں کی.

t.149: By the night as its darkness comes and goes.
t.84: and by the night when it departs,
t.85: by the night that descends,
t.95: and by the night as it recedes,
t.19: And the close of night,
t.22: And the Night as it dissipates;
t.203: And by the night as it departs.
t.54: اور رات کی جب جانے لگے.

t.149: By the morn as it breathes—
t.84: and the morning when it starts breathing,
t.85: by the dawn that softly breathes:
t.95: and the morn as it breathes.
t.19: And the breath of morning
t.22: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
t.203: And by the dawn as it brightens.
t.54: اور صبح کی جب چمکنے لگے.

t.149: indeed, it is the word of a noble messenger,
t.84: it (the Qur’ān) is surely the word of a noble messenger (Jibra’īl X),
t.85: this is the speech of a noble messenger,
t.95: Verily this is the word of a noble message-bearer;
t.19: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
t.22: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,
t.203: Verily, this is the Word (this Qur’ân brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrîl (Gabrîl), from Allâh to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم].
t.54: یقیناً یہ ایک بزرگ رسول کا کہا ہوا ہے.

t.149: endowed with power, eminent with the Lord of the Throne,
t.84: the one possessing power and a high status with the Lord of the Throne,
t.85: who possesses great strength and is held in honour by the Lord of the Throne––
t.95: one mighty and held in honour with the Lord of the Throne;
t.19: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
t.22: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
t.203: Owner of power, (and high rank) with (Allâh), the Lord of the Throne,
t.54: جو قوت واﻻ ہے، عرش والے (اللہ) کے نزدیک بلند مرتبہ ہے.

t.149: obeyed there and trustworthy.
t.84: the one obeyed there, trusted.
t.85: he is obeyed there and worthy of trust.
t.95: there he is obeyed and held trustworthy.
t.19: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;
t.22: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.
t.203: Obeyed (by the angels in the heavens), and trustworthy.
t.54: جس کی (آسمانوں میں) اطاعت کی جاتی ہے اورامین ہے.

t.149: Thus yourfellow is not a madman,
t.84: Your companion (Muhammad ) is not a madman,
t.85: Your companion is not mad:
t.95: (O people of Makkah), your companion is not mad;
t.19: And your comrade is not mad.
t.22: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;
t.203: And (O people) your companion (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is not a madman.
t.54: اور تمہارا ساتھی دیوانہ نہیں ہے.

t.149: for he most surely saw him on the evident horizon,
t.84: and he did see him (Jibra’īl X) on the clear horizon.
t.85: he did see him on the clear horizon.
t.95: he indeed saw the message-bearer on the clear horizon;
t.19: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
t.22: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.
t.203: And indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw him [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east).
t.54: اس نے اس (فرشتے) کو آسمان کے کھلے کنارے پر دیکھا بھی ہے.

t.149: and he does not stingily withhold (knowledge of) the hidden realm,
t.84: And he (the Prophet) is not stingy about (the news of) the unseen.
t.85: He does not withhold what is revealed to him from beyond.
t.95: nor does he grudge (conveying this knowledge about) the Unseen;
t.19: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
t.22: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.
t.203: And he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen.
t.54: اور یہ غیب کی باتوں کو بتلانے میں بخیل بھی نہیں.

t.149: and it is not the word of an outcast Satan.
t.84: Nor is it the word of an outcast satan (devil).
t.85: This is not the word of an outcast devil.
t.95: nor is it a word of an accursed Satan.
t.19: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
t.22: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.
t.203: And it (the Qur’ân) is not the word of the outcast Shaitân (Satan).
t.54: اور یہ قرآن شیطان مردود کا کلام نہیں.

t.149: So where are yougoing?
t.84: Then where are you going?
t.85: So where are you [people] going?
t.95: Where to are you then heading?
t.19: Whither then go ye?
t.22: When whither go ye?
t.203: Then where are you going?
t.54: پھر تم کہاں جا رہے ہو.

t.149: It is but a Reminder to(all creatures of) all realms,
t.84: It is nothing else but a message of advice for all the worlds,
t.85: This is a message for all people;
t.95: It is nothing but Good Counsel for everyone in the world,
t.19: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
t.22: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:
t.203: Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn)
t.54: یہ تو تمام جہان والوں کے لئے نصیحت نامہ ہے.

t.149: to whomever of you who wills to be upright.
t.84: for the benefit of any one from among you who intends to go straight.
t.85: for those who wish to take the straight path.
t.95: for everyone of you who wishes to follow the Straight Way;
t.19: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
t.22: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
t.203: To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight.
t.54: (بالخصوص) اس کے لئے جو تم میں سے سیدھی راه پر چلنا چاہے.

t.149: But youcannot will unless Allah, the Lord of all realms, wills.
t.84: And you cannot intend (to do anything) unless it is so willed by Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.
t.85: But you will only wish to do so by the will of God, the Lord of all people.
t.95: but your wishing will not avail unless Allah, the Lord of the Universe, so wishes.
t.19: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
t.22: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
t.203: And you cannot will unless (it be) that Allâh wills - the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).
t.54: اور تم بغیر پروردگار عالم کے چاہے کچھ نہیں چاه سکتے.

t.149: When the sky splits apart,
t.84: When the sky will be cleft asunder,
t.85: When the sky is torn apart,
t.95: When the heaven is split asunder,
t.19: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
t.22: When the Sky is cleft asunder;
t.203: When the heaven is cleft asunder.
t.54: جب آسمان پھٹ جائے گا.

t.149: and when the planets are scattered,
t.84: and when the stars will disperse,
t.85: when the stars are scattered,
t.95: when the stars are scattered,
t.19: When the planets are dispersed,
t.22: When the Stars are scattered;
t.203: And when the stars have fallen and scattered.
t.54: اور جب ستارے جھڑ جائیں گے.

t.149: and when the seas are made to burst,
t.84: and when the seas will be burst forth,
t.85: when the seas burst forth,
t.95: when the seas are made to burst forth,
t.19: When the seas are poured forth,
t.22: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;
t.203: And when the seas are burst forth.
t.54: اور جب سمندر بہہ نکلیں گے.

t.149: and when the tombs are strewn around—
t.84: and when the graves will be overturned,
t.85: when graves turn inside out:
t.95: and when graves are laid open,
t.19: And the sepulchres are overturned,
t.22: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-
t.203: And when the graves are turned upside down (and bring out their contents)
t.54: اور جب قبریں (شق کر کے) اکھاڑ دی جائیں گی.

t.149: each self will know what it has put forth and what it has deferred.
t.84: then one will know what he sent ahead and what he left behind.
t.85: each soul will know what it has done and what it has left undone.
t.95: everyone shall know all his deeds, both the earlier and the later.
t.19: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
t.22: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
t.203: (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds).
t.54: (اس وقت) ہر شخص اپنے آگے بھیجے ہوئے اور پیچھے چھوڑے ہوئے (یعنی اگلے پچھلے اعمال) کو معلوم کر لے گا.

t.149: O Man, what deceived you concerning your Noble Lord,
t.84: O man! What has deceived you about your Gracious Lord,
t.85: Mankind, what has lured you away from God,
t.95: O man! What has deceived you about your generous Lord
t.19: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
t.22: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-
t.203: O man! What has made you careless about your Lord, the Most Generous?
t.54: اے انسان! تجھے اپنے رب کریم سے کس چیز نے بہکایا.

t.149: Who created you and formed you and proportioned you?
t.84: who created you, then perfected you, then brought you in due proportion?
t.85: your generous Lord, who created you, shaped you, proportioned you,
t.95: Who created you, shaped you, and made you well-proportioned,
t.19: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
t.22: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;
t.203: Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion.
t.54: جس (رب نے) تجھے پیدا کیا، پھر ٹھیک ٹھاک کیا، پھر (درست اور) برابر بنایا.

t.149: In whatever shape He willed, He assembled you.
t.84: He composed you in whichever form He willed.
t.85: in whatever form He chose?
t.95: and set you in whatever form He pleased?
t.19: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
t.22: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.
t.203: In whatever form He willed, He put you together.
t.54: جس صورت میں چاہا تجھے جوڑ دیا.

t.149: But no, rather youdisbelieve in the Recompense,
t.84: Never! (i.e. one should never be heedless towards him.) But you deny the Requital,
t.85: Yet you still take the Judgement to be a lie!
t.95: No indeed; (the fact is that) you deny the Reckoning, declaring it a lie;
t.19: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
t.22: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!
t.203: Nay! But you deny Ad-Dîn (i.e. the Day of Recompense).
t.54: ہرگز نہیں بلکہ تم تو جزا وسزا کے دن کو جھٹلاتے ہو.

t.149: while indeed, over you are preservers—
t.84: while (appointed) over you there are watchers,
t.85: Over you stand
t.95: you do so the while there are watchers over you;
t.19: Lo! there are above you guardians,
t.22: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-
t.203: But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you,
t.54: یقیناً تم پر نگہبان عزت والے.

t.149: honorable scribes—
t.84: who are noble, writers (of the deeds),
t.85: watchers, noble recorders
t.95: noble scribes,
t.19: Generous and recording,
t.22: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):
t.203: Kirâman (Honourable) Kâtibîn writing down (your deeds),
t.54: لکھنے والے مقرر ہیں.

t.149: who know whatever you do.
t.84: who know whatever you do.
t.85: who know what you do:
t.95: who know what you do.
t.19: Who know (all) that ye do.
t.22: They know (and understand) all that ye do.
t.203: They know all that you do.
t.54: جوکچھ تم کرتے ہو وه جانتے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, the virtuous are in bliss,
t.84: Surely the righteous will be in bliss,
t.85: the good will live in bliss,
t.95: Surely the virtuous shall be in Bliss,
t.19: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
t.22: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;
t.203: Verily, the Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise);
t.54: یقیناً نیک لوگ (جنت کے عیش وآرام اور) نعمتوں میں ہوں گے.

t.149: while indeed, the wicked are in purgatory;
t.84: and the sinners in Hell,
t.85: and the wicked will burn in the Fire.
t.95: and the wicked shall be in the Blazing Fire.
t.19: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
t.22: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,
t.203: And verily, the Fujjâr (the wicked, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners and evil-doers) will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),
t.54: اور یقیناً بدکار لوگ دوزخ میں ہوں گے.

t.149: they will roast in it on the Day of Recompense,
t.84: in which they will enter on the Day of Requital,
t.85: They will enter it on the Day of Judgement
t.95: They shall enter it on the Day of Recompense
t.19: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
t.22: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,
t.203: Therein they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,
t.54: بدلے والے دن اس میں جائیں گے.

t.149: and in no way will they be absent from it.
t.84: and they will not (be able to) keep away from it.
t.85: and they will find no escape.
t.95: and then shall never come out of it.
t.19: And will not be absent thence.
t.22: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
t.203: And they (Al-Fujjâr) will not be absent therefrom.
t.54: وه اس سے کبھی غائب نہ ہونے پائیں گے.

t.149: But what can make yourealize what the Day of Recompense is?
t.84: And what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?
t.85: What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?
t.95: What do you know what the Day of Recompense is?
t.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
t.22: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
t.203: And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?
t.54: تجھے کچھ خبر بھی ہے کہ بدلے کا دن کیا ہے.

t.149: Again, what can make yourealize what the Day of Recompense is?
t.84: Again, what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?
t.85: Yes! What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?
t.95: Again, what do you know what the Day of Recompense is?
t.19: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
t.22: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
t.203: Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?
t.54: میں پھر (کہتا ہوں کہ) تجھے کیا معلوم کہ جزا (اور سزا) کا دن کیا ہے.

t.149: (They will be recompensed on) a day when no self is able to avail another self in anything, and the command on that day belongs to Allah.
t.84: A Day when no one will have power to do any thing for another! And command, on that Day, will belong to Allah (alone).
t.85: The Day when no soul will be able to do anything for another; on that Day, command will belong to God.
t.95: It is the Day when no one shall have the power to do anything for another, and all command shall be Allah's.
t.19: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
t.22: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
t.203: (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allâh.
t.54: (وه ہے) جس دن کوئی شخص کسی شخص کے لئے کسی چیز کا مختار نہ ہوگا، اور (تمام تر) احکام اس روز اللہ کے ہی ہوں گے.

t.149: Woe to the defrauders:
t.84: Woe to the curtailers
t.85: Woe to those who give short measure,
t.95: Woe to the stinters;
t.19: Woe unto the defrauders:
t.22: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
t.203: Woe to Al-Mutaffifûn (those who give less in measure and weight).
t.54: بڑی خرابی ہے ناپ تول میں کمی کرنے والوں کی.

t.149: those who, when they take a measure from people, take in full;
t.84: who, when they measure something to receive from people, take it in full,
t.85: who demand of other people full measure for themselves,
t.95: those who, when they take from others by measure, take their full share;
t.19: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
t.22: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
t.203: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,
t.54: کہ جب لوگوں سے ناپ کر لیتے ہیں تو پورا پورا لیتے ہیں.

t.149: but when they measure or weigh to others, they give less than they should.
t.84: and when they measure or weigh something to give it to them, give less than due.
t.85: but give less than they should when it is they who weigh or measure for others!
t.95: but who, when they measure or weigh for others, give less than their due.
t.19: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.
t.22: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
t.203: And when they have to give by measure or weight to (other) men, give less than due.
t.54: اور جب انہیں ناپ کر یا تول کر دیتے ہیں تو کم دیتے ہیں.

t.149: Do those not think that they will be resurrected
t.84: Do they not think that they have to be raised up
t.85: Do these people not realize that they will be raised up
t.95: Do they not realise that they will be raised to life
t.19: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
t.22: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
t.203: Do they not think that they will be resurrected (for reckoning),
t.54: کیا انہیں اپنے مرنے کے بعد جی اٹھنے کا خیال نہیں.

t.149: on a great day,
t.84: on a Great Day,
t.85: on a mighty Day,
t.95: on a Great Day,
t.19: Unto an Awful Day,
t.22: On a Mighty Day,
t.203: On a Great Day?
t.54: اس عظیم دن کے لئے.

t.149: a day when mankind stands before the Lord of all realms?
t.84: the Day when all the people will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
t.85: a Day when everyone will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
t.95: a Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Universe?
t.19: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
t.22: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
t.203: The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?
t.54: جس دن سب لوگ رب العالمین کے سامنے کھڑے ہوں گے.

t.149: But no, indeed the recordof the wicked is in Sijjeen.
t.84: Never! (i.e. they should never act in such a way.) Indeed the record of deeds of the sinners is in Sijjīn .
t.85: No indeed! The list of the wicked is in Sijjin––
t.95: No indeed! Verily the deeds of the wicked are in the Record locked up in the prison-house!
t.19: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -
t.22: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
t.203: Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the Fujjâr (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, evil-doers and the wicked) is (preserved) in Sijjîn.
t.54: یقیناً بدکاروں کا نامہٴ اعمال سِجِّينٌ میں ہے.

t.149: And what can make yourealize what Sijjeen is?
t.84: And what may let you know what Sijjīn is?
t.85: what will explain to you what Sijjin is?––
t.95: And how would you know what the Record of the prison-house is?
t.19: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
t.22: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
t.203: And what will make you know what Sijjîn is?
t.54: تجھے کیا معلوم سِجِّينٌ کیا ہے؟

t.149: A written record.
t.84: A register, inscribed!
t.85: a clearly numbered list.
t.95: It is a Book inscribed.
t.19: A written record.
t.22: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed.
t.203: A Register inscribed.
t.54: (یہ تو) لکھی ہوئی کتاب ہے.

t.149: Woe on that day to the disbelievers
t.84: Woe that day to the deniers,
t.85: Woe on that day to the deniers,
t.95: Woe, then, to those that give the lie,
t.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t.22: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
t.203: Woe, that Day, to those who deny.
t.54: اس دن جھٹلانے والوں کی بڑی خرابی ہے.

t.149: who disbelieve in the Day of Recompense,
t.84: who deny the Day of Requital!
t.85: those who deny the Day of Judgement!
t.95: those that give the lie to the Day of Recompense.
t.19: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
t.22: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
t.203: Those who deny the Day of Recompense.
t.54: جو جزا وسزا کے دن کو جھٹلاتے رہے.

t.149: for none disbelieves in it except every sinful transgressor
t.84: And none denies it but every sinful transgressor.
t.85: Only the evil aggressor denies it:
t.95: Yet none gives the lie to it except the transgressor immersed in sin;
t.19: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
t.22: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
t.203: And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allâh) the sinner!
t.54: اسے صرف وہی جھٹلاتا ہےجو حد سے آگے نکل جانے واﻻ (اور) گناه گار ہوتا ہے.

t.149: who, when Our signsare recited to him, says, “Legends of the ancients.”
t.84: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “(These are) tales of the ancients.”
t.85: when Our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘Ancient fables!’
t.95: who, when Our verses are recited to him, says: “Mere tales of olden times!”
t.19: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
t.22: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
t.203: When Our Verses (of the Qur’ân) are recited to him he says: "Tales of the ancients!"
t.54: جب اس کے سامنے ہماری آیتیں پڑھی جاتی ہیں تو کہہ دیتا ہے کہ یہ اگلوں کے افسانے ہیں.

t.149: But no, rather, encrusted over their hearts is what they used to earn.
t.84: No! But that which they used to commit has covered their hearts with rust.
t.85: No indeed! Their hearts are encrusted with what they have done.
t.95: No indeed! The truth is that their hearts have become rusted on account of their evil deeds.
t.19: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.
t.22: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
t.203: Nay! But on their hearts is the Rân (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.
t.54: یوں نہیں بلکہ ان کے دلوں پر ان کےاعمال کی وجہ سے زنگ (چڑھ گیا) ہے.

t.149: But no, indeed on that day they are sure to be screened off from their Lord.
t.84: No! Indeed they will be screened off from their Lord on that Day.
t.85: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from their Lord,
t.95: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from seeing their Lord,
t.19: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
t.22: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
t.203: Nay! Surely they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.
t.54: ہرگز نہیں یہ لوگ اس دن اپنے رب سےاوٹ میں رکھے جائیں گے.

t.149: Then indeed, they are sure to roast in purgatory.
t.84: Then they will have to enter the Hell.
t.85: they will burn in Hell,
t.95: and then they shall enter Hell,
t.19: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
t.22: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
t.203: Then, verily, they will indeed enter (and taste) the burning flame of Hell.
t.54: پھر یہ لوگ بالیقین جہنم میں جھونکے جائیں گے.

t.149: Then it will be said, “This is what you used to disbelieve in.”
t.84: Then it will be said, “This is what you used to deny.”
t.85: and they will be told, ‘This is what you called a lie.’
t.95: whereafter they will be told: “This is what you used to give the lie to.”
t.19: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
t.22: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
t.203: Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!"
t.54: پھر کہہ دیا جائے گا کہ یہی ہے وه جسے تم جھٹلاتے رہے.

t.149: But no, indeed the recordof the virtuous is in Elliyyeen.
t.84: No! The record of deeds of the righteous is in ‘Illiyyūn .
t.85: No indeed! The list of the truly good is in 'Illiyyin––
t.95: No indeed! Verily, the deeds of the virtuous shall be in the record of the exalted ones.
t.19: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -
t.22: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.
t.203: Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) is (preserved) in ‘Illiyyûn
t.54: لرگزنہیں،بےشک نیکوکاروں کے اعمال نامے علییں میں ہیں .

t.149: And what can make yourealize what Elliyyoonis?
t.84: And what may let you know what ‘Illiyyūn is ?
t.85: what will explain to you what 'Illiyyin is?––
t.95: And what do you know what the Record of the exalted ones is?
t.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -
t.22: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
t.203: And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyûn is?
t.54: اورتجھے کیا پتہ کہ عِلِّیین کیا ہے؟

t.149: A written record,
t.84: A register inscribed,
t.85: a clearly written list,
t.95: It is a Book inscribed,
t.19: A written record,
t.22: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed,
t.203: A Register inscribed,
t.54: (وه تو) لکھی ہوئی کتاب ہے.

t.149: witnessed by those brought near.
t.84: attended by those (angels) who are blessed with nearness to Allah!
t.85: witnessed by those brought near.
t.95: which the angels placed near Allah to safeguard.
t.19: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).
t.22: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).
t.203: To which bear witness those nearest (to Allâh, i.e. the angels).
t.54: مقرب (فرشتے) اس کا مشاہده کرتے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, the virtuous are amid bliss,
t.84: Indeed the righteous will be in absolute bliss.
t.85: The truly good will live in bliss,
t.95: Verily the virtuous shall be in Bliss;
t.19: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
t.22: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
t.203: Verily, Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise).
t.54: یقیناً نیک لوگ (بڑی) نعمتوں میں ہوں گے.

t.149: on couches, looking on.
t.84: While (sitting) on thrones they will be watching (the scenes of Paradise).
t.85: seated on couches, gazing around.
t.95: resting on couches, looking around.
t.19: On couches, gazing,
t.22: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
t.203: On thrones, looking (at all things).
t.54: مسہریوں پر بیٹھے دیکھ رہے ہوں گے.

t.149: Youcan recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.
t.84: You will recognize the glamour of bliss on their faces.
t.85: You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.
t.95: You shall see upon their faces the glow of bliss.
t.19: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
t.22: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
t.203: You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight.
t.54: تو ان کے چہروں سے ہی نعمتوں کی تروتازگی پہچان لے گا.

t.149: They are given to drink of a sealed nectar,
t.84: They will be served with a pure sealed wine to drink,
t.85: They will be served a sealed nectar,
t.95: They will be served a drink of the finest sealed wine,
t.19: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,
t.22: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
t.203: They will be given to drink of pure sealed wine.
t.54: یہ لوگ سربمہر خالص شراب پلائے جائیں گے.

t.149: whose end is musk—and this is what competitors should compete for.
t.84: the seal of which will be of musk.-It is this (bliss) in aspiring for which the competitors should race each other.
t.85: its seal [perfumed with] a fragrant herb––let those who strive, strive for this––
t.95: whose seal is musk – so let all aspirants aspire after that –
t.19: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -
t.22: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
t.203: The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of Musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allah).
t.54: جس پر مشک کی مہر ہوگی، سبقت لے جانے والوں کو اسی میں سبقت کرنی چاہئے.

t.149: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
t.84: -and it will be blended with (a drink from) Tasnīm ,
t.85: mixed with the water of Tasnim,
t.95: a wine whose mixture is Tasnim,
t.19: And mixed with water of Tasnim,
t.22: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
t.203: It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnîm:
t.54: اور اس کی آمیزش تسنیم کی ہوگی.

t.149: a spring from which those brought near drink.
t.84: a spring from which will drink those who are blessed with nearness.
t.85: a spring from which those brought near will drink.
t.95: a fountain at which the chosen ones shall drink.
t.19: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.
t.22: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.
t.203: A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allâh.
t.54: (یعنی) وه چشمہ جس کا پانی مقرب لوگ پیئں گے.

t.149: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who had attained faith;
t.84: Indeed those who were guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
t.85: The wicked used to laugh at the believers––
t.95: Behold, the wicked were wont to laugh at the believers:
t.19: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
t.22: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
t.203: Verily, (during the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
t.54: گنہگار لوگ ایمان والوں کی ہنسی اڑایا کرتے تھے.

t.149: and when they passed by them, they would wink at one another;
t.84: and when they passed by them, they used to wink at one another,
t.85: they would wink at one another when the believers passed by them,
t.95: when they passed by them they winked,
t.19: And wink one to another when they passed them;
t.22: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
t.203: And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery).
t.54: اور ان کے پاس سے گزرتے ہوئے آپس میں آنکھ کےاشارے کرتے تھے.

t.149: and when they went back to their families, they would go back jesting;
t.84: and when they went back to their family, they went enjoying their mockery,
t.85: joke about them when they got back to their own people,
t.95: and when they went back to their families, they went back jesting,
t.19: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;
t.22: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
t.203: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
t.54: اور جب اپنے والوں کی طرف لوٹتے تو دل لگیاں کرتے تھے.

t.149: and when they saw them, they would say, “These people are most surely misguided.”
t.84: and when they saw them, they said, “Surely these are the ones who have gone astray”
t.85: and say, when they saw them, ‘These people are misguided,’
t.95: and when they saw the believers, they said: “Lo! These are the erring ones”;
t.19: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
t.22: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
t.203: And when they saw them, they said: "Verily these have indeed gone astray!"
t.54: اور جب انہیں دیکھتے تو کہتے یقیناً یہ لوگ گمراه (بے راه) ہیں.

t.149: Yet they were not sent as preservers over them.
t.84: while they were not sent as watchmen over them.
t.85: though they were not sent to be their keepers-
t.95: (they said so although) they had not been appointed watchers over them.
t.19: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
t.22: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
t.203: But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers).
t.54: یہ ان پر پاسبان بنا کر تو نہیں بھیجے گئے.

t.149: So todaythose who have attained faith are laughing at the deniers,
t.84: So, today those who believed will laugh at the disbelievers.
t.85: so today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers
t.95: But today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers;
t.19: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
t.22: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
t.203: But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers
t.54: پس آج ایمان والے ان کافروں پر ہنسیں گے.

t.149: on couches, looking on.
t.84: While (sitting) on thrones, they will be seeing
t.85: as they sit on couches, gazing around.
t.95: seated upon their couches, they are looking around.
t.19: On high couches, gazing.
t.22: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
t.203: On (high) thrones, looking (at all things).
t.54: تختوں پر بیٹھے دیکھ رہے ہوں گے.

t.149: Have the deniers been recompensed for what they used to do?
t.84: whether the disbelievers have been paid back for what they used to do.
t.85: Have the disbelievers [not] been repaid for their deeds?
t.95: Have the unbelievers been duly rewarded for their deeds?
t.19: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?
t.22: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
t.203: Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do?
t.54: کہ اب ان منکروں نے جیسا یہ کرتے تھے پورا پورا بدلہ پالیا.

t.149: When the sky is ruptured
t.84: When the sky will split apart,
t.85: When the sky is ripped apart,
t.95: When the sky is rent asunder
t.19: When the heaven is split asunder
t.22: When the sky is rent asunder,
t.203: When the heaven is split asunder,
t.54: جب آسمان پھٹ جائے گا.

t.149: and listens to its Lord as it rightly must,
t.84: and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,-
t.85: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,
t.95: and hearkens to the command of its Lord, doing what it should;
t.19: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
t.22: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
t.203: And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.
t.54: اور اپنے رب کے حکم پر کان لگائے گا اور اسی کے ﻻئق وه ہے.

t.149: and when the earth is leveled out
t.84: and when the earth will be stretched (to give room to more people),
t.85: when the earth is levelled out,
t.95: and when the earth is stretched out
t.19: And when the earth is spread out
t.22: And when the earth is flattened out,
t.203: And when the earth is stretched forth,
t.54: اور جب زمین (کھینچ کر) پھیلا دی جائے گی.

t.149: and casts out what is in it and becomes empty
t.84: and it will throw up whatever it contains, and will become empty,
t.85: casts out its contents, and becomes empty,
t.95: and casts out what is within it and is emptied,
t.19: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
t.22: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,
t.203: And has cast out all that was in it and became empty.
t.54: اور اس میں جو ہے اسے وه اگل دے گی اور خالی ہو جائے گی.

t.149: and listens to its Lord as it rightly must—
t.84: and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,- (then man will see the consequences of his deeds.)
t.85: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,
t.95: and hearkens to the command of its Lord, doing what it should.
t.19: And attentive to her Lord in fear!
t.22: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).
t.203: And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.
t.54: اور اپنے رب کے حکم پر کان لگائے گی اور اسی کے ﻻئق وه ہے.

t.149: O man, you are laboring towards your Lord laboriously, then you are bound to meet Him.
t.84: O man, you have to work hard constantly to reach your Lord, and then you have to meet Him.
t.85: you humans, toiling laboriously towards your Lord, will meet Him:
t.95: O man, you are striving unto your Lord and you will meet Him.
t.19: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
t.22: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.
t.203: O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, and you will meet (the results of your deeds which you did).
t.54: اے انسان! تو اپنے رب سے ملنے تک یہ کوشش اور تمام کام اور محنتیں کرکے اس سے ملاقات کرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: So as for the one who was brought his recordin his right hand,
t.84: So, as for him whose book (of deeds) will be given to him in his right hand,
t.85: whoever is given his record in his right hand
t.95: Whoever is given the Record in his right hand
t.19: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
t.22: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,
t.203: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,
t.54: تو (اس وقت) جس شخص کے داہنے ہاتھ میں اعمال نامہ دیا جائے گا.

t.149: he will have an easy reckoning
t.84: he will be called to account in an easy manner,
t.85: will have an easy reckoning
t.95: shall be called to an easy accounting,
t.19: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
t.22: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,
t.203: He surely will receive an easy reckoning,
t.54: اس کا حساب تو بڑی آسانی سے لیا جائے گا.

t.149: and will return to his family joyful.
t.84: and he will go back to his people joyfully.
t.85: and return to his people well pleased,
t.95: and shall return to his people joyfully.
t.19: And will return unto his folk in joy.
t.22: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
t.203: And will return to his family in joy!
t.54: اور وه اپنے اہل کی طرف ہنسی خوشی لوٹ آئے گا.

t.149: But as for the one who was brought his record behind his back,
t.84: As for the one whose book (of deeds) will be given to him from his backside,
t.85: but whoever is given his record from behind his back
t.95: But he who is given the Record behind his back,
t.19: But whoso is given his account behind his back,
t.22: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-
t.203: But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,
t.54: ہاں جس شخص کا اعمال نامہ اس کی پیٹھ کے پیچھے سے دیا جائے گا.

t.149: he will call for demise
t.84: he will pray for death,
t.85: will cry out for destruction––
t.95: shall cry for “perdition,”
t.19: He surely will invoke destruction
t.22: Soon will he cry for perdition,
t.203: He will invoke (for his) destruction,
t.54: تو وه موت کو بلانے لگے گا.

t.149: and will roast at the Blaze.
t.84: and will enter the blazing fire.
t.85: he will burn in the blazing Fire.
t.95: and will enter the Blazing Fire.
t.19: And be thrown to scorching fire.
t.22: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.
t.203: And he shall enter a blazing Fire, and be made to taste its burning.
t.54: اور بھڑکتی ہوئی جہنم میں داخل ہوگا.

t.149: Indeed, he used to be joyful among his family;
t.84: He had been joyful among his people (in the world).
t.85: He used to live among his people well pleased.
t.95: He used to live joyfully among his people,
t.19: He verily lived joyous with his folk,
t.22: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!
t.203: Verily, he was among his people in joy!
t.54: یہ شخص اپنے متعلقین میں (دنیا میں) خوش تھا.

t.149: indeed, he thought he would never return.
t.84: He thought he would never revert (to Allah).
t.85: He thought he would never return [to his Lord]––
t.95: thinking he would never revert (to Us).
t.19: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).
t.22: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!
t.203: Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)!
t.54: اس کا خیال تھا کہ اللہ کی طرف لوٹ کر ہی نہ جائے گا.

t.149: Yes, surely his Lord has always been All-Seeing of him.
t.84: No! Indeed his Lord was watchful over him.
t.85: indeed he will! His Lord was watching him.
t.95: But no; (how would he not revert)? His Lord was ever watching him.
t.19: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
t.22: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
t.203: Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!
t.54: کیوں نہیں، حاﻻنکہ اس کا رب اسے بخوبی دیکھ رہا تھا.

t.149: So, No! I swear by the twilight.
t.84: So, I swear by the twilight (after sunset),
t.85: I swear by the glow of sunset,
t.95: Nay; I swear by the twilight;
t.19: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
t.22: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;
t.203: So I swear by the afterglow of sunset;
t.54: مجھے شفق کی قسم! اور رات کی!

t.149: By the night and what it covers.
t.84: and by the night and what it envelops,
t.85: by the night and what it covers,
t.95: and by the night and what it enfolds,
t.19: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,
t.22: The Night and its Homing;
t.203: And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness,
t.54: اور اس کی جمع کرده چیزوں کی قسم.

t.149: By the moon as it grows full—
t.84: and by the moon when it develops at the full,
t.85: by the full moon,
t.95: and by the moon, when it reaches its fullness:
t.19: And by the moon when she is at the full,
t.22: And the Moon in her fullness:
t.203: And by the moon when it is at the full.
t.54: اور چاند کی جب کہ وه کامل ہو جاتا ہے.

t.149: youwill surely mountstage by stage.
t.84: you shall certainly ascend from stage to stage.
t.85: you will progress from stage to stage.
t.95: you shall proceed onwards from stage to stage.
t.19: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
t.22: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.
t.203: You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter).
t.54: یقیناً تم ایک حالت سے دوسری حالت پر پہنچو گے.

t.149: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe?
t.84: So, what is wrong with them that they do not believe,
t.85: So why do they not believe?
t.95: So, what is the matter with them that they do not believe,
t.19: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
t.22: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-
t.203: What is the matter with them, that they believe not?
t.54: انہیں کیا ہو گیا کہ ایمان نہیں ﻻتے.

t.149: And when the Recitalis recited to them, they do not prostrate themselves?
t.84: and when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not offer sajdah (prostration)?
t.85: Why, when the Quran is read to them, do they not prostrate themselves [to God]?
t.95: and when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate themselves?
t.19: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?
t.22: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
t.203: And when the Qur’ân is recited to them, they fall not prostrate.
t.54: اور جب ان کے پاس قرآن پڑھا جاتا ہے تو سجده نہیں کرتے.

t.149: Rather, the deniers disbelieve,
t.84: Rather, those who disbelieve deny (the truth).
t.85: No! The disbelievers reject the Quran––
t.95: Instead, the unbelievers reject it, calling it a lie.
t.19: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;
t.22: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).
t.203: Nay, those who disbelieve belie (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever he brought, i.e. this Qur’ân and Islâmic Monotheism, etc.).
t.54: بلکہ جنہوں نے کفر کیا وه جھٹلا رہے ہیں.

t.149: but Allah knows better what they hide inside.
t.84: And Allah is most aware of what they store.
t.85: God knows best what they keep hidden inside––
t.95: Allah knows best what they are accumulating (in their Record).
t.19: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
t.22: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
t.203: And Allâh knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),
t.54: اور اللہ تعالیٰ خوب جانتا ہے جو کچھ یہ دلوں میں رکھتے ہیں.

t.149: So give them glad tidingsof a painful punishment—
t.84: So, give him the ‘good news’ of a painful punishment,
t.85: so give them news of a painful torment.
t.95: So give them the good news of a painful chastisement,
t.19: So give them tidings of a painful doom,
t.22: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,
t.203: So announce to them a painful torment.
t.54: انہیں المناک عذابوں کی خوشخبری سنا دو.

t.149: except for those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds; for them is an unfailing reward.
t.84: but those who believed and did righteous deeds will have a reward that will never be interrupted.
t.85: But those who believe and do good deeds will have a never-ending reward.
t.95: except for those who believe and do good deeds. Theirs shall be an unending reward.
t.19: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
t.22: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
t.203: Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise).
t.54: ہاں ایمان والوں اور نیک اعمال والوں کو بے شمار اور نہ ختم ہونے واﻻ اجر ہے.

t.149: By the sky full of constellations.
t.84: I swear by the sky, the one having stellar formations,
t.85: By the sky with its towering constellations,
t.95: By the heaven with its impregnable castles;
t.19: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
t.22: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;
t.203: By the heaven holding the big stars.
t.54: برجوں والے آسمان کی قسم!

t.149: By the Promised Day.
t.84: and by the Promised Day,
t.85: by the promised Day,
t.95: by the Promised Day,
t.19: And by the Promised Day.
t.22: By the promised Day (of Judgment);
t.203: And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).
t.54: وعده کیے ہوئے دن کی قسم!

t.149: By the witness and the witnessed—
t.84: and by that which attends, and that which is attended,
t.85: by the Witness and that which is witnessed,
t.95: and by the witness and what is witnessed:
t.19: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,
t.22: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-
t.203: And by the Witnessing day (i.e. Friday), and by the Witnessed day [i.e. the day of ‘Arafât (Hajj) the ninth of Dhul-Hijjah];
t.54: حاضر ہونے والے اور حاضر کئے گئے کی قسم!

t.149: may they perish: the fellows of the Trench
t.84: cursed were the People of the Trench,
t.85: damned were the makers of the trench,
t.95: the people of the pit were destroyed
t.19: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
t.22: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),
t.203: Cursed were the people of the Ditch (in the story of the Boy and the King).
t.54: (کہ) خندقوں والے ہلاک کیے گئے.

t.149: (of) the fire fed with fuel!
t.84: the (people of the) fire that was rich with fuel,
t.85: the makers of the fuel-stoked fire!
t.95: with fire abounding in fuel,
t.19: Of the fuel-fed fire,
t.22: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel:
t.203: Of fire fed with fuel,
t.54: وه ایک آگ تھی ایندھن والی.

t.149: Recall when they sat around it,
t.84: when they were sitting by it,
t.85: They sat down
t.95: while they sat around it,
t.19: When they sat by it,
t.22: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),
t.203: When they sat by it (fire),
t.54: جب کہ وه لوگ اس کے آس پاس بیٹھے تھے.

t.149: witnessing what they were doing to the believers.
t.84: and were watching what they were doing with the believers.
t.85: to watch what they were doing to the believers.
t.95: and were witnessing what they did to the believers.
t.19: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.
t.22: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.
t.203: And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers (i.e. burning them).
t.54: اور مسلمانوں کے ساتھ جو کر رہے تھے اس کو اپنے سامنے دیکھ رہے تھے.

t.149: And they resented them only for believing in Allah the Almighty, the Praiseworthy,
t.84: They punished them for nothing but that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Worthy of All Praise,
t.85: Their only grievance against them was their faith in God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy,
t.95: Against these they had no grudge except that they believed in Allah, the Most Mighty, the Most Praiseworthy,
t.19: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,
t.22: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-
t.203: And they had no fault except that they believed in Allâh, the All-Mighty, Worthy of all Praise!
t.54: یہ لوگ ان مسلمانوں (کے کسی اور گناه کا) بدلہ نہیں لے رہے تھے، سوائے اس کے کہ وه اللہ غالب ﻻئق حمد کی ذات پر ایمان ﻻئے تھے.

t.149: to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Yet Allah is Witness over everything.
t.84: the One to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is witness over every thing.
t.85: to whom all control over the heavens and earth belongs: God is witness over all things.
t.95: to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Allah witnesses everything.
t.19: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
t.22: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.
t.203: To Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allâh is Witness over everything.
t.54: جس کے لئے آسمان وزمین کا ملک ہے۔ اور اللہ تعالیٰ ہرچیز کو دیکھ رہا ہے.

t.149: Indeed, those who have persecuted the believing men and the believing women, then have not repented—for them is the punishment of Hell, and for them is the punishment of burning.
t.84: Surely, those who persecuted the believing men and the believing women, then did not repent, -for them there is the torment of Jahannam (Hell), and for them there is the torment of burning.
t.85: For those who persecute believing men and women, and do not repent afterwards, there will be the torment of Hell and burning.
t.95: Surely those who tormented the believing men and the believing women and then did not repent, theirs shall be the chastisement of Hell, and theirs shall be the chastisement of burning.
t.19: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
t.22: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
t.203: Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance (to Allâh), then they will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.
t.54: بیشک جن لوگوں نے مسلمان مردوں اور عورتوں کو ستایا پھر توبہ (بھی) نہ کی تو ان کے لئے جہنم کا عذاب ہے اور جلنے کا عذاب ہے.

t.149: Indeed, those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—for them are Gardens beneath which rivers flow; that is the supreme triumph.
t.84: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them there are gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the big achievement.
t.85: But for those who believe and do good deeds there will be Gardens graced with flowing streams: that is the great triumph.
t.95: As for those who believed and acted righteously, theirs shall be Gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great triumph.
