t.19: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.
t.22: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),
t.203: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). That is the great success.
t.54: بیشک ایمان قبول کرنے والوں اور نیک کام کرنے والوں کے لئے وه باغات ہیں۔ جن کے نیچے نہریں بہہ رہی ہیں۔ یہی بڑی کامیابی ہے.

t.149: Indeed, the onslaught of yourLord is surely severe.
t.84: The seizure of your Lord is severe indeed!
t.85: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is truly stern––
t.95: Stern indeed is your Lord's punishment.
t.19: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
t.22: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
t.203: Verily, (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the Seizure (punishment) of your Lord is severe and painful. [See V.11:102].
t.54: یقیناً تیرے رب کی پکڑ بڑی سخت ہے.

t.149: Indeed, it is He who originates and reproduces,
t.84: Surely He originates (creation) and repeats (it after death).
t.85: it is He who brings people to life, and will restore them to life again––
t.95: He it is Who creates for the first time and He it is Who will create again,
t.19: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,
t.22: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).
t.203: Verily, He it is Who begins (punishment) and repeats (punishment in the Hereafter) (or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection).
t.54: وہی پہلی مرتبہ پیدا کرتا ہے اور وہی دوباره پیدا کرے گا.

t.149: and He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Loving,
t.84: And He is the Most-Forgiving, the Most-Loving,
t.85: and He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Loving.
t.95: and He is the Ever Forgiving, the Most Loving
t.19: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
t.22: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
t.203: And He is Oft-Forgiving, full of love (towards the pious who are real true believers of Islâmic Monotheism),
t.54: وه بڑا بخشش کرنے واﻻ اور بہت محبت کرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Possessor of the Throne, the Glorious ,
t.84: the Master of the Throne, the Glorious.
t.85: The Glorious Lord of the Throne,
t.95: – the Lord of the Glorious Throne,
t.19: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
t.22: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
t.203: Owner of the throne, the Glorious,
t.54: عرش کا مالک عظمت واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Doer of whatever He wants.
t.84: He is ever doer of what He intends.
t.85: He does whatever He will.
t.95: the Executor of what He wills.
t.19: Doer of what He will.
t.22: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.
t.203: (He is the) Doer of whatsoever He intends (or wills).
t.54: جو چاہے اسے کر گزرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: Has there come to youthe story of the troops—
t.84: Has there come to you the story of the forces,
t.85: Have you [not] heard the stories of the forces
t.95: Has the story of the armies reached you,
t.19: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
t.22: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-
t.203: Has the story reached you of the hosts,
t.54: تجھے لشکروں کی خبر بھی ملی ہے؟*

t.149: (that of) Pharaoh and Thamûd?
t.84: of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Thamūd?
t.85: of Pharaoh and Thamud?
t.95: the armies of Pharaoh and Thamud?
t.19: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?
t.22: Of Pharaoh and the Thamud?
t.203: Of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Thamûd?
t.54: (یعنی) فرعون اور ثمود کی.

t.149: Rather, the deniers are in(a state of) disbelief,
t.84: But those who disbelieve are (engaged) in denying (the truth).
t.85: Yet still the disbelievers persist in denial.
t.95: The unbelievers are indeed engaged in denying it, calling it a lie,
t.19: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
t.22: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!
t.203: Nay! The disbelievers (persisted) in denying (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and his Message of Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: (کچھ نہیں) بلکہ کافر تو جھٹلانے میں پڑے ہوئے ہیں.

t.149: while beyond them Allah is All-Encompassing.
t.84: Allah has encompassed them from all sides.
t.85: God surrounds them all.
t.95: although Allah surrounds them.
t.19: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.
t.22: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!
t.203: And Allâh encompasses them from behind! (i.e. all their deeds are within His Knowledge, and He will requite them for their deeds).
t.54: اور اللہ تعالیٰ بھی انہیں ہر طرف سے گھیرے ہوئے ہے.

t.149: Rather, it is a Glorious Recital,
t.84: The reality is that it is the glorious Qur’ān,
t.85: This is truly a glorious Quran
t.95: Nay; but this is a glorious Qur'an,
t.19: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.
t.22: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,
t.203: Nay! This is a Glorious Qur’ân,
t.54: بلکہ یہ قرآن ہے بڑی شان واﻻ.

t.149: in a preserved Tablet.
t.84: (recorded) in the Preserved Tablet (LauH MaHfūZ).
t.85: [written] on a preserved Tablet.
t.95: inscribed on a well-guarded Tablet.
t.19: On a guarded tablet.
t.22: (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved!
t.203: (Inscribed) in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz (The Preserved Tablet)!
t.54: لوح محفوظ میں (لکھا ہوا).

t.149: By the sky and the pulsar.
t.84: I swear by the sky and by the Night-Comer,-
t.85: By the sky and the night-comer––
t.95: By the heaven, and the night-visitor,
t.19: By the heaven and the Morning Star
t.22: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-
t.203: By the heaven, and At-Târiq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star);
t.54: قسم ہے آسمان کی اور اندھیرے میں روشن ہونے والے کی.

t.149: But what can make yourealize what the pulsar is?
t.84: -and what may let you know what the Night-Comer is?
t.85: What will explain to you what the night-comer is?
t.95: what do you know what the night-visitor is?
t.19: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
t.22: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
t.203: And what will make you to know what At-Târiq (night-comer) is?
t.54: تجھے معلوم بھی ہے کہ وه رات کو نمودار ہونے والی چیز کیا ہے؟

t.149: The Drilling Star.
t.84: The star of piercing brightness!- -
t.85: The piercing star––
t.95: It is the piercing star.
t.19: - The piercing Star!
t.22: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-
t.203: (It is) the star of piercing brightness;
t.54: وه روشن ستاره ہے.

t.149: There is no self but has a preserver over it.
t.84: -there is no human being, but there is a watcher over him.
t.85: there is a watcher over every soul.
t.95: There is no living being but there is a protector over it.
t.19: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
t.22: There is no soul but has a protector over it.
t.203: There is no human being but has a protector over him (or her) (i.e. angels in charge of each human being guarding him, writing his good and bad deeds)
t.54: کوئی ایسا نہیں جس پر نگہبان فرشتہ نہ ہو.

t.149: Let man look at what he was created from.
t.84: So, let man consider of which stuff he is created.
t.85: Man should reflect on what he was created from.
t.95: So let man consider of what he was created.
t.19: So let man consider from what he is created.
t.22: Now let man but think from what he is created!
t.203: So let man see from what he is created!
t.54: انسان کو دیکھنا چاہئے کہ وه کس چیز سے پیدا کیا گیا ہے.

t.149: He was created from an ejected fluid,
t.84: He is created of spouting water
t.85: He is created from spurting fluid,
t.95: He was created of a gushing fluid,
t.19: He is created from a gushing fluid
t.22: He is created from a drop emitted-
t.203: He is created from a water gushing forth,
t.54: وه ایک اچھلتے پانی سے پیدا کیا گیا ہے.

t.149: coming out from between the backbone and the breastbones.
t.84: that comes out from between the loins and the chest-bones.
t.85: then he emerges from between the backbone and breastbone:
t.95: emanating from between the loins and the ribs.
t.19: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
t.22: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
t.203: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs.
t.54: جو پیٹھ اور سینے کے درمیان سے نکلتا ہے.

t.149: He is certainly able to return him
t.84: Surely He is Powerful to bring him back
t.85: God is certainly able to bring him back to life.
t.95: Surely He (the Creator) has the power to bring him back (to life).
t.19: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
t.22: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!
t.203: Verily, (Allâh) is Able to bring him back (to life)!
t.54: بیشک وه اسے پھیر ﻻنے پر یقیناً قدرت رکھنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: on the day when the secrets are put on trial,
t.84: on a day when all the secrets will be searched out,
t.85: On the Day when secrets are laid bare
t.95: On the Day when man's deepest secrets shall be put to the test
t.19: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
t.22: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,
t.203: The Day when all the secrets (deeds, prayers, fasting, etc.) will be examined (as to their truth).
t.54: جس دن پوشیده بھیدوں کی جانچ پڑتال ہوگی.

t.149: then he will have neither strength nor helper.
t.84: and he will have neither strength (to defend), nor a supporter.
t.85: he will have no power and no one to help him.
t.95: he shall have no power, and no helper.
t.19: Then will he have no might nor any helper.
t.22: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.
t.203: Then he will have no power, nor any helper.
t.54: تو نہ ہوگا اس کے پاس کچھ زور نہ مدددگار.

t.149: By the sky that returns.
t.84: I swear by the sky that rains,
t.85: By the sky and its recurring rain,
t.95: By the heaven with its recurring cycle of rain,
t.19: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
t.22: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),
t.203: By the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again.
t.54: بارش والے آسمان کی قسم!

t.149: By the earth that cracks open—
t.84: and the earth that cracks open (for plants),
t.85: by the earth that cracks open!
t.95: and by the earth ever bursting with verdure,
t.19: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
t.22: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-
t.203: And the earth which splits (with the growth of trees and plants).
t.54: اور پھٹنے والی زمین کی قسم!

t.149: it is most surely a decisive word,
t.84: this is a decisive word,
t.85: This is truly a decisive statement;
t.95: this (Qur'an) is surely a decisive Word,
t.19: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,
t.22: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):
t.203: Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is the Word that separates (the truth from falsehood, and commands strict laws for mankind to cut the roots of evil).
t.54: بیشک یہ (قرآن) البتہ دو ٹوک فیصلہ کرنے واﻻ کلام ہے.

t.149: and it is no joke.
t.84: and it is not a joke.
t.85: it is not something to be taken lightly.
t.95: not a flippant jest.
t.19: It is no pleasantry.
t.22: It is not a thing for amusement.
t.203: And it is not a thing for amusement.
t.54: یہ ہنسی کی (اور بے فائده) بات نہیں.

t.149: Indeed, they are plotting plots,
t.84: They are devising plans,
t.85: They plot and scheme,
t.95: They are devising a guile,
t.19: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
t.22: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,
t.203: Verily, they are but plotting a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).
t.54: البتہ کافر داؤ گھات میں ہیں.

t.149: but I plot plots(as well) .
t.84: and I Am devising plans.
t.85: but so do I:
t.95: and I too am devising a guile.
t.19: And I plot a plot (against them).
t.22: And I am planning a scheme.
t.203: And I (too) am planning a plan.
t.54: اور میں بھی ایک چال چل رہا ہوں.

t.149: So givethe deniers respite; respite them briefly.
t.84: So leave the disbelievers alone at the moment; give them respite for a while.
t.85: [Prophet], let the disbelievers be, let them be for a while.
t.95: So leave the unbelievers to themselves; respite them awhile.
t.19: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
t.22: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
t.203: So give a respite to the disbelievers; deal gently with them for a while.
t.54: تو کافروں کو مہلت دے انہیں تھوڑے دنوں چھوڑ دے.

t.149: Highly exalt the Name of yourLord, the Most High,
t.84: Pronounce the purity of the name of your most exalted Lord,
t.85: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Most High,
t.95: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,
t.19: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
t.22: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,
t.203: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,
t.54: اپنے بہت ہی بلند اللہ کے نام کی پاکیزگی بیان کر.

t.149: Who created and proportioned;
t.84: who created (everything), then made (it) well,
t.85: who created [all things] in due proportion;
t.95: Who created all things and fashioned them in good proportion;
t.19: Who createth, then disposeth;
t.22: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;
t.203: Who has created (everything), and then proportioned it.
t.54: جس نے پیدا کیا اور صحیح سالم بنایا.

t.149: and Who determined and guided;
t.84: and who determined a measure (for everything), then guided (it),
t.85: who determined their destinies and guided them;
t.95: Who determined and guided them,
t.19: Who measureth, then guideth;
t.22: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;
t.203: And Who has measured (preordainments for everything even to be blessed or wretched); and then guided (i.e. showed mankind the right as well as the wrong paths, and guided the animals to pasture).
t.54: اور جس نے (ٹھیک ٹھاک) اندازه کیا اور پھر راه دکھائی.

t.149: and Who brought out the pasture,
t.84: and who brought forth pasturage,
t.85: who brought out the green pasture
t.95: Who brought forth the pasture,
t.19: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,
t.22: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,
t.203: And Who brings out the pasturage,
t.54: اور جس نے تازه گھاس پیدا کی.

t.149: then turned it into dark debris.
t.84: then turned it into a blackening stubble.
t.85: then made it dark debris.
t.95: and then made it into a blackish straw.
t.19: Then turneth it to russet stubble.
t.22: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
t.203: And then makes it dark stubble.
t.54: پھر اس نے اس کو (سکھا کر) سیاه کوڑا کر دیا.

t.149: We shall make yourecite such that you shall not forget—
t.84: We will make you recite, then you will not forget
t.85: [Prophet], We shall teach you [the Quran] and you will not forget––
t.95: We shall make you recite and then you will not forget,
t.19: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
t.22: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,
t.203: We shall make you to recite (the Qur’ân), so you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) shall not forget (it),
t.54: ہم تجھے پڑھائیں گے پھر تو نہ بھولے گا.

t.149: except what Allah wills; indeed, He knows whatever is said aloud and whatever is hidden.
t.84: except that which Allah wills. Indeed He knows what is manifest and what is hidden.
t.85: unless God wishes; He knows both what is open and what is hidden––
t.95: except what Allah should wish. He knows all that is manifest and all that is hidden.
t.19: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
t.22: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.
t.203: Except what Allâh may will. He knows what is apparent and what is hidden.
t.54: مگر جو کچھ اللہ چاہے۔ وه ظاہر اور پوشیده کو جانتا ہے.

t.149: And We shall ease youtowards ease.
t.84: And We will facilitate for you (to reach) the easiest way.
t.85: We shall show you the easy way.
t.95: We shall ease you to follow the way of Ease.
t.19: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
t.22: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).
t.203: And We shall make easy for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the easy way (i.e. the doing of righteous deeds).
t.54: ہم آپ کے لئے آسانی پیدا کر دیں گے.

t.149: So remind, if reminding can be of benefit.
t.84: So, extend advice (to people) if advice is useful.
t.85: So remind, if reminding will help.
t.95: So render good counsel if good counsel will avail.
t.19: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
t.22: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
t.203: Therefore remind (men) in case the reminder profits (them).
t.54: تو آپ نصیحت کرتے رہیں اگر نصیحت کچھ فائده دے.

t.149: The God-fearing will constantly remember,
t.84: The one who fears (Allah) will observe the advice,
t.85: Those who stand in awe of God will heed the reminder,
t.95: He who fears (Allah) shall heed it,
t.19: He will heed who feareth,
t.22: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):
t.203: The reminder will be received by him who fears (Allâh),
t.54: ڈرنے واﻻ تو نصیحت لے گا.

t.149: but the wretched will avoid it—
t.84: and it will be avoided by the most wretched one
t.85: but it will be ignored by the most wicked,
t.95: but the wretched will turn away from it.
t.19: But the most hapless will flout it,
t.22: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
t.203: But it will be avoided by the wretched,
t.54: (ہاں) بد بخت اس سے گریز کرے گا.

t.149: he who will roast in the Gigantic Fire,
t.84: who will enter the Biggest Fire,
t.85: who will enter the Great Fire,
t.95: He will be cast into the Great Fire.
t.19: He who will be flung to the great Fire
t.22: Who will enter the Great Fire,
t.203: Who will enter the great Fire (and will be made to taste its burning).
t.54: جو بڑی آگ میں جائے گا.

t.149: then he neither dies nor lives.
t.84: then he will neither die therein, nor live (a desirable life).
t.85: where they will neither die nor live.
t.95: Then he will neither die in it, nor live.
t.19: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
t.22: In which they will then neither die nor live.
t.203: There he will neither die (to be in rest) nor live (a good living).
t.54: جہاں پھر نہ وه مرے گا نہ جئےگا، (بلکہ حالت نزع میں پڑا رہے گا).

t.149: Surely, successful is the one who has purified himself
t.84: Success is surely achieved by him who purifies himself,
t.85: Prosperous are those who purify themselves,
t.95: He who purified himself shall prosper,
t.19: He is successful who groweth,
t.22: But those will prosper who purify themselves,
t.203: Indeed whosoever purifies himself (by avoiding polytheism and accepting Islâmic Monotheism) shall achieve success,
t.54: بیشک اس نے فلاح پالی جو پاک ہوگیا.

t.149: and remembered the name of his Lord and prayed.
t.84: and pronounces the name of his Lord, then offers prayer.
t.85: remember the name of their Lord, and pray.
t.95: remembering his Lord's name and praying.
t.19: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
t.22: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.
t.203: And remembers (glorifies) the Name of his Lord (worships none but Allâh), and prays (five compulsory prayers and Nawâfil - additional prayers).
t.54: اور جس نے اپنے رب کا نام یاد رکھا اور نماز پڑھتا رہا.

t.149: Rather, youprefer the Earlier Life,
t.84: But you prefer the worldly life,
t.85: Yet you [people] prefer the life of this world,
t.95: No; but you prefer the present life,
t.19: But ye prefer the life of the world
t.22: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;
t.203: Nay, you prefer the life of this world,
t.54: لیکن تم تو دنیا کی زندگی کو ترجیح دیتے ہو.

t.149: though the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
t.84: while the Hereafter is much better and much more durable.
t.85: even though the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
t.95: whereas the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
t.19: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
t.22: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
t.203: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
t.54: اور آخرت بہت بہتر اور بہت بقا والی ہے.

t.149: Most surely, this is in the former scrolls—
t.84: Indeed this is (written) in the earlier divine scripts,
t.85: All this is in the earlier scriptures,
t.95: This, indeed, was in the ancient Scrolls,
t.19: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
t.22: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-
t.203: Verily, this is in the former Scriptures -
t.54: یہ باتیں پہلی کتابوں میں بھی ہیں.

t.149: the Scrolls of Abraham and Moses.
t.84: the scripts of Ibrāhīm and Mūsā.
t.85: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
t.95: the Scrolls of Abraham and Moses.
t.19: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
t.22: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
t.203: The Scriptures of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) and Mûsâ (Moses) (عليهما السلام).
t.54: (یعنی) ابراہیم اور موسیٰ کی کتابوں میں.

t.149: Has there come to youthe news of the Overwhelming(event) ?
t.84: Has there come to you the description of the Overwhelming Event?
t.85: Have you heard tell [Prophet] about the Overwhelming Event?
t.95: Has the news of the overwhelming event reached you?
t.19: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?
t.22: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?
t.203: Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)?
t.54: کیا تجھے بھی چھپا لینے والی (قیامت) کی خبر پہنچی ہے.

t.149: Some faces on that day are(subdued) in reverence,
t.84: Many faces that day will be humbled,
t.85: On that Day, there will be downcast faces,
t.95: Some faces that Day shall be downcast with fear,
t.19: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,
t.22: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,
t.203: Some faces, that Day will be humiliated (in the Hell-fire, i.e. the faces of all disbelievers, Jews and Christians).
t.54: اس دن بہت سے چہرے ذلیل ہوں گے.

t.149: toiling, exhausted,
t.84: laboring, exhausted.
t.85: toiling and weary,
t.95: be toiling and worn-out;
t.19: Toiling, weary,
t.22: Labouring (hard), weary,-
t.203: Labouring (hard in the worldly life by worshipping others besides Allâh), weary (in the Hereafter with humility and disgrace).
t.54: (اور) محنت کرنے والے تھکے ہوئے ہوں گے.

t.149: roasting in a hot fire,
t.84: They will enter into the scorching fire.
t.85: as they enter the blazing Fire
t.95: they shall burn in a Scorching Fire;
t.19: Scorched by burning fire,
t.22: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-
t.203: They will enter in the hot blazing Fire.
t.54: وه دہکتی ہوئی آگ میں جائیں گے.

t.149: given to drink from a boiling spring.
t.84: They will be made to drink water from a boiling spring.
t.85: and are forced to drink from a boiling spring,
t.95: their drink shall be from a boiling spring.
t.19: Drinking from a boiling spring,
t.22: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,
t.203: They will be given to drink from a boiling spring,
t.54: اور نہایت گرم چشمے کا پانی ان کو پلایا جائے گا.

t.149: They have no food except of a thorny bush
t.84: There will be no food for them except from a thorny plant
t.85: with no food for them except bitter dry thorns
t.95: They shall have no food except bitter dry thorns
t.19: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
t.22: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'
t.203: No food will there be for them but a poisonous thorny plant,
t.54: ان کے لئے سوائے کانٹے دار درختوں کے اور کچھ کھانے کو نہ ہوگا.

t.149: which neither nourishes nor satisfies hunger.
t.84: that will neither nourish, nor satisfy hunger.
t.85: that neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
t.95: that will neither nourish nor satisfy their hunger.
t.19: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
t.22: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
t.203: Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.
t.54: جو نہ موٹا کرے گا نہ بھوک مٹائے گا.

t.149: Some faces on that day are blissful,
t.84: Many faces that day will be full of glamour,
t.85: On that Day there will also be faces radiant with bliss,
t.95: On that very Day some faces shall be radiant with joy,
t.19: In that day other faces will be calm,
t.22: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
t.203: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
t.54: بہت سے چہرے اس دن تروتازه اور (آسوده حال) ہوں گے.

t.149: well pleased with their endeavor,
t.84: well pleased with their endeavor,
t.85: well pleased with their labour,
t.95: well-pleased with their striving.
t.19: Glad for their effort past,
t.22: Pleased with their striving,-
t.203: Glad with their endeavour (for their good deeds which they did in this world, along with the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism).
t.54: اپنی کوشش پر خوش ہوں گے.

t.149: in a lofty Garden:
t.84: in a lofty garden,
t.85: in a lofty garden,
t.95: They will be in a lofty Garden
t.19: In a high Garden
t.22: In a Garden on high,
t.203: In a lofty Paradise.
t.54: بلند وباﻻ جنتوں میں ہوں گے.

t.149: in it you hear no nonsense;
t.84: in which they will not hear any absurd talk.
t.85: where they will hear no idle talk,
t.95: wherein they shall hear no vain talk.
t.19: Where they hear no idle speech,
t.22: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:
t.203: Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood.
t.54: جہاں کوئی بیہوده بات نہیں سنیں گے.

t.149: in it is a flowing spring;
t.84: In it there is a flowing spring.
t.85: with a flowing spring,
t.95: In it there shall be a flowing spring,
t.19: Wherein is a gushing spring,
t.22: Therein will be a bubbling spring:
t.203: Therein will be a running spring.
t.54: جہاں بہتا ہوا چشمہ ہوگا.

t.149: in it are raised couches,
t.84: In it there are elevated couches
t.85: raised couches,
t.95: and couches raised high,
t.19: Wherein are couches raised
t.22: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,
t.203: Therein will be thrones raised high.
t.54: (اور) اس میں اونچے اونچے تخت ہوں گے.

t.149: and cups set in place,
t.84: and goblets, well placed,
t.85: goblets placed before them,
t.95: and goblets laid out,
t.19: And goblets set at hand
t.22: Goblets placed (ready),
t.203: And cups set at hand.
t.54: اور آبخورے رکھے ہوئے (ہوں گے).

t.149: and cushions set in rows,
t.84: and cushions, arrayed
t.85: cushions set in rows,
t.95: and cushions arrayed in rows,
t.19: And cushions ranged
t.22: And cushions set in rows,
t.203: And cushions set in rows.
t.54: اور ایک قطار میں لگے ہوئے تکیے ہوں گے.

t.149: and carpets spread around.
t.84: and carpets, spread around.
t.85: and carpets spread.
t.95: and rich carpets levelled out.
t.19: And silken carpets spread.
t.22: And rich carpets (all) spread out.
t.203: And rich carpets (all) spread out.
t.54: اور مخملی مسندیں پھیلی پڑی ہوں گی.

t.149: Do they not look at the camels—how they were created?
t.84: So, do they not look at the camels how they are created,
t.85: Do the disbelievers not see how rain clouds are formed
t.95: Do (these unbelievers) not observe the camels: how they were created?
t.19: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?
t.22: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-
t.203: Do they not look at the camels, how they are created?
t.54: کیا یہ اونٹوں کو نہیں دیکھتے کہ وه کس طرح پیدا کیے گئے ہیں.

t.149: And at the sky—how it was raised?
t.84: and at the sky, how it is raised high,
t.85: how the heavens are lifted,
t.95: And the sky: how it was raised high?
t.19: And the heaven, how it is raised?
t.22: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-
t.203: And at the heaven, how it is raised?
t.54: اور آسمان کو کہ کس طرح اونچا کیا گیا ہے.

t.149: And at the mountains—how they were firmly fixed?
t.84: and at the mountains, how they are installed,
t.85: how the mountains are raised high,
t.95: And the mountains: how they were fixed?
t.19: And the hills, how they are set up?
t.22: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-
t.203: And at the mountains, how they are rooted (and fixed firm)?
t.54: اور پہاڑوں کی طرف کہ کس طرح گاڑ دیئے گئے ہیں.

t.149: And at the earth—how it was spread out?
t.84: and at the earth, how it is spread out?
t.85: how the earth is spread out?
t.95: And the earth: how it was spread out?
t.19: And the earth, how it is spread?
t.22: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?
t.203: And at the earth, how it is outspread?
t.54: اور زمین کی طرف کہ کس طرح بچھائی گئی ہے.

t.149: So remind; youare only a reminder;
t.84: So, (O Prophet,) keep on preaching; you are only a preacher.
t.85: So [Prophet] warn them: your only task is to give warning,
t.95: So render good counsel, for you are simply required to counsel,
t.19: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
t.22: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.
t.203: So remind them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) - you are only one who reminds.
t.54: پس آپ نصیحت کر دیا کریں (کیونکہ) آپ صرف نصیحت کرنے والے ہیں.

t.149: you have no control over them.
t.84: You are not a taskmaster set up over them,
t.85: you are not there to control them.
t.95: and are not invested with the authority to compel them.
t.19: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
t.22: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.
t.203: You are not a dictator over them -
t.54: آپ کچھ ان پر داروغہ نہیں ہیں.

t.149: But whoever turns away and denies,
t.84: but whoever turns away and disbelieves,
t.85: As for those who turn away and disbelieve,
t.95: But whoever will turn away (from the Truth),
t.19: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,
t.22: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-
t.203: Save the one who turns away and disbelieves.
t.54: ہاں! جو شخص روگردانی کرے اور کفر کرے.

t.149: then Allah punishes him with the greatest punishment.
t.84: Allah will punish him with the greatest torment.
t.85: God will inflict the greatest torment upon them.
t.95: Allah will chastise him with the most terrible chastisement.
t.19: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.
t.22: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,
t.203: Then Allâh will punish him with the greatest punishment.
t.54: اسے اللہ تعالیٰ بہت بڑا عذاب دے گا.

t.149: Indeed, to Us is theirreturn,
t.84: Surely towards Us they have to return,
t.85: It is to Us they will return,
t.95: Surely to Us is their return;
t.19: Lo! unto Us is their return
t.22: For to Us will be their return;
t.203: Verily, to Us will be their return;
t.54: بیشک ہماری طرف ان کا لوٹنا ہے.

t.149: then upon Us is their reckoning.
t.84: then it is Our job to call them to account.
t.85: and then it is for Us to call them to account.
t.95: and then it is for Us to call them to account.
t.19: And Ours their reckoning.
t.22: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
t.203: Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning.
t.54: پھر بیشک ہمارے ذمہ ہے ان سے حساب لینا.

t.149: By the dawn.
t.84: I swear by the dawn,
t.85: By the Daybreak,
t.95: By the dawn,
t.19: By the Dawn
t.22: By the break of Day
t.203: By the dawn;
t.54: قسم ہے فجر کی!

t.149: By the ten nights.
t.84: and by Ten Nights,
t.85: by the Ten Nights,
t.95: and the ten nights,
t.19: And ten nights,
t.22: By the Nights twice five;
t.203: By the ten nights (i.e. the first ten days of the month of Dhul-Hijjah),
t.54: اور دس راتوں کی!

t.149: By the even and the odd.
t.84: and by the even and the odd,
t.85: by the even and the odd,
t.95: and the even and the odd,
t.19: And the Even and the Odd,
t.22: By the even and odd (contrasted);
t.203: And by the even and the odd (of all the creations of Allâh).
t.54: اور جفت اور طاق کی!

t.149: By the night as it passes—
t.84: and by the night when it moves away,
t.85: by the passing night––
t.95: and by the night when it departs.
t.19: And the night when it departeth,
t.22: And by the Night when it passeth away;-
t.203: And by the night when it departs.
t.54: اور رات کی جب وه چلنے لگے.

t.149: is there in that a sworn oath for whoever has a mind?
t.84: -Is there (not) in such an oath (enough assurance) for a man of sense?-
t.85: is this oath strong enough for a rational person?
t.95: Is there in this an oath for one endowed with understanding?
t.19: There surely is an oath for thinking man.
t.22: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?
t.203: There is indeed in them (the above oaths) sufficient proofs for men of understanding (and that, they should avoid all kinds of sins and disbeliefs)!
t.54: کیا ان میں عقلمند کے واسطے کافی قسم ہے.

t.149: Have younot seen what your Lord did to ʻĀd—
t.84: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with (the people) of ‘Ād
t.85: Have you [Prophet] considered how your Lord dealt with [the people] of 'Ad,
t.95: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with Ad
t.19: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,
t.22: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people),-
t.203: Saw you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) not how your Lord dealt with ‘Âd (people)
t.54: کیا آپ نے نہیں دیکھا کہ آپ کے رب نے عادیوں کے ساتھ کیا کیا.

t.149: Iram,(the city) of the pillars
t.84: of Iram , the men of tall pillars,
t.85: of Iram, [the city] of lofty pillars,
t.95: of Iram, known for their lofty columns,
t.19: With many-columned Iram,
t.22: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,
t.203: Of Iram (who were very tall) like (lofty) pillars,
t.54: ستونوں والے ارم کے ساتھ.

t.149: whose like has never been created in the lands;
t.84: the like of whom were never created in the lands,
t.85: whose like has never been made in any land,
t.95: the like of whom no nation was ever created in the lands of the world?
t.19: The like of which was not created in the lands;
t.22: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?
t.203: The like of which were not created in the land?
t.54: جس کی مانند (کوئی قوم) ملکوں میں پیدا نہیں کی گئی.

t.149: and Thamûd, who carved the rocks in the valley;
t.84: and (how He dealt) with (the people of) Thamūd who had carved out the rocks in the Valley (of Qurā),
t.85: and the Thamud, who hewed into the rocks in the valley,
t.95: And how did He deal with Thamud who hewed out rocks in the valley?
t.19: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;
t.22: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-
t.203: And (with) Thamûd (people), who hewed out rocks in the valley (to make dwellings)?
t.54: اور ثمودیوں کے ساتھ جنہوں نے وادی میں بڑے بڑے پتھر تراشے تھے.

t.149: and Pharaoh of the stakes?
t.84: and with Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), the man of the stakes,
t.85: and the mighty and powerful Pharaoh?
t.95: And with Pharaoh of the tent pegs
t.19: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,
t.22: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?
t.203: And (with) Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) who had the stakes (to torture men by binding them to the stakes)?
t.54: اور فرعون کے ساتھ جو میخوں واﻻ تھا.

t.149: They(all) exceeded all limits in the lands
t.84: - those who had rebelled in the cities,
t.85: All of them committed excesses in their lands,
t.95: who transgressed in the countries of the world
t.19: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
t.22: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
t.203: Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands (in the disobedience of Allâh).
t.54: ان سبھوں نے شہروں میں سر اٹھا رکھا تھا.

t.149: and spread much corruption therein,
t.84: and spread a lot of mischief therein.
t.85: and spread corruption there:
t.95: spreading in them much corruption?
t.19: And multiplied iniquity therein?
t.22: And heaped therein mischief (on mischief).
t.203: And made therein much mischief.
t.54: اور بہت فساد مچا رکھا تھا.

t.149: so yourLord poured down upon them a scourge of punishment;
t.84: So, your Lord let loose on them the whip of torment.
t.85: your Lord let a scourge of punishment loose on them.
t.95: Then their Lord unloosed upon them the lash of chastisement.
t.19: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
t.22: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
t.203: So your Lord poured on them different kinds of severe torment.
t.54: آخر تیرے رب نے ان سب پر عذاب کا کوڑا برسایا.

t.149: indeed, your Lord is certainly ever-watchful.
t.84: Surely your Lord is ever on the watch.
t.85: Your Lord is always watchful.
t.95: Truly your Lord is ever watchful.
t.19: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
t.22: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
t.203: Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful (over them).
t.54: یقیناً تیرا رب گھات میں ہے.

t.149: So, as for man, whenever his Lord tries him through honoring and blessing him, he says, “My Lord has honored me.”
t.84: As for man, when his Lord tests him, and thus gives him honour and bounties, he says, “My Lord has honoured me.”
t.85: [The nature of] man is that, when his Lord tries him through honour and blessings, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me,’
t.95: As for man, when his Lord tests him by exalting him and bestowing His bounties upon him, he says: “My Lord has exalted me.”
t.19: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
t.22: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
t.203: As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honour and bounties, then he says (in exultation): "My Lord has honoured me."
t.54: انسان (کا یہ حال ہے کہ) جب اسے اس کا رب آزماتا ہے اور عزت ونعمت دیتا ہے تو وه کہنے لگتا ہے کہ میرے رب نے مجھے عزت دار بنایا.

t.149: But whenever He tries him through restricting his provision, he says, “My Lord has insulted me.”
t.84: But when he tests him, and thus straitens his provision for him, he says, “My Lord has disgraced me.”
t.85: but when He tries him through the restriction of his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’
t.95: But when He tests him by straitening his sustenance, he says: “My Lord has humiliated me.”
t.19: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
t.22: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
t.203: But when He tries him by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"
t.54: اور جب وه اس کو آزماتا ہے اس کی روزی تنگ کر دیتا ہے تو وه کہنے لگتا ہے کہ میرے رب نے میری اہانت کی (اور ذلیل کیا).

t.149: But no! Rather, youdo not honor the orphan,
t.84: No! But you do not honour the orphan,
t.85: No indeed! You [people] do not honour orphans,
t.95: But no; you do not treat the orphan honourably,
t.19: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
t.22: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!
t.203: Nay! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity (i.e. you neither treat them well, nor give them their exact right of inheritance)!
t.54: ایسا ہرگز نہیں بلکہ (بات یہ ہے) کہ تم (ہی) لوگ یتیموں کی عزت نہیں کرتے.

t.149: and you do not urge one another to(serve) food to the destitute,
t.84: and do not encourage one another to feed the needy.
t.85: you do not urge one another to feed the poor,
t.95: and do not urge one another to feed the poor,
t.19: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.
t.22: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-
t.203: And urge not one another on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor)!
t.54: اور مسکینوں کے کھلانے کی ایک دوسرے کو ترغیب نہیں دیتے.

t.149: and you devour inheritance(of the vulnerable) greedily,
t.84: And you devour the inheritance with a sweeping gulp,
t.85: you consume inheritance greedily,
t.95: and greedily devour the entire inheritance,
t.19: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.
t.22: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,
t.203: And you devour the inheritance all with greed.
t.54: اور (مردوں کی) میراث سمیٹ سمیٹ کر کھاتے ہو.

t.149: and you lovewealth immensely.
t.84: and love wealth, an excessive love.
t.85: and you love wealth with a passion.
t.95: and love the riches, loving them ardently.
t.19: And love wealth with abounding love.
t.22: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!
t.203: And you love wealth with much love.
t.54: اور مال کو جی بھر کر عزیز رکھتے ہو.

t.149: But no! When the earth is pounded to dust, pounding after pounding;
t.84: No! When the earth will be crushed thoroughly to be turned into bits,
t.85: No indeed! When the earth is pounded to dust, pounded and pounded,
t.95: But no; when the earth is ground to powder,
t.19: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,
t.22: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,
t.203: Nay! When the earth is ground to powder.
t.54: یقیناً جس وقت زمین کوٹ کوٹ کر برابر کر دی جائے گی.

t.149: and yourLord comes with the angels, rank after rank;
t.84: and your Lord will come, and the angels as well, lined up in rows,
t.85: when your Lord comes with the angels, rank upon rank,
t.95: and when your Lord appears with rows upon rows of angels,
t.19: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
t.22: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,
t.203: And your Lord comes with the angels in rows.
t.54: اور تیرا رب (خود) آجائے گا اور فرشتے صفیں باندھ کر (آ جائیں گے).

t.149: and on that day, Hell is made to come forward—on that day man reminds himself, but how will reminding avail him?
t.84: and Jahannam (Hell), on that day, will be brought forward, it will be the day when man will realize the truth, but from where will he take advantage of such realization?
t.85: when Hell is that Day brought near- on that Day man will take heed, but what good will that be to him then?
t.95: and when Hell is brought near that Day. On that Day will man understand, but of what avail will that understanding be?
t.19: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
t.22: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
t.203: And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance (then) avail him?
t.54: اور جس دن جہنم بھی ﻻئی جائے گی اس دن انسان کو سمجھ آئے گی مگر آج اس کے سمجھنے کا فائده کہاں؟

t.149: He says, “If only I had put forth something(good) for my life.”
t.84: He will say, “O Would that I had sent ahead (some good deeds) for (this) my life!”
t.85: He will say, ‘Would that I had provided for this life to come!’
t.95: He will say: “Would that I had sent ahead what would be of avail for this life of mine!”
t.19: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!
t.22: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"
t.203: He will say: "Alas! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my life!"
t.54: وه کہے گا کہ کاش کہ میں نے اپنی اس زندگی کے لئے کچھ پیشگی سامان کیا ہوتا.

t.149: On that day, none can punish as He punishes ,
t.84: So no one can punish like He will punish, that day,
t.85: On that Day, no one will punish as He punishes,
t.95: Then on that Day Allah will chastise as none other can chastise;
t.19: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!
t.22: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,
t.203: So on that Day none will punish as He will punish.
t.54: پس آج اللہ کے عذاب جیسا عذاب کسی کا نہ ہوگا.

t.149: and none can shackle as He shackles.
t.84: nor can anyone shackle like He will shackle.
t.85: and no one will bind as He binds.
t.95: and Allah will bind as none other can bind.
t.19: None bindeth as He then will bind.
t.22: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.
t.203: And none will bind (the wicked, disbelievers and polytheists) as He will bind.
t.54: نہ اسکی قید وبند جیسی کسی کی قید وبند ہوگی.

t.149: O you tranquil self,
t.84: (As for an obedient man, it will be said to him,) “O content soul,
t.85: ‘[But] you, soul at peace:
t.95: (On the other hand it will be said): “O serene soul!
t.19: But ah! thou soul at peace!
t.22: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!
t.203: (It will be said to the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism): "O (you) the one in (complete) rest and satisfaction!
t.54: اے اطمینان والی روح.

t.149: return to your Lord, well pleased and well pleasing;
t.84: come back to your Lord, well-pleased, well-pleasing.
t.85: return to your Lord well pleased and well pleasing;
t.95: Return to your Lord well-pleased (with your blissful destination), well-pleasing (to your Lord).
t.19: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
t.22: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
t.203: "Come back to your Lord well-pleased (yourself) and well-pleasing (unto Him)!
t.54: تو اپنے رب کی طرف لوٹ چل اس طرح کہ تو اس سے راضی وه تجھ سے خوش.

t.149: so enter among My servants,
t.84: So, enter among My (special) servants,
t.85: go in among My servants;
t.95: So enter among My (righteous) servants
t.19: Enter thou among My bondmen!
t.22: "Enter thou, then, among My devotees!
t.203: "Enter you then among My (honoured) slaves,
t.54: پس میرے خاص بندوں میں داخل ہو جا.

t.149: and enter My Garden.
t.84: and enter My Paradise.”
t.85: and into My Garden.’
t.95: and enter My Paradise.”
t.19: Enter thou My Garden!
t.22: "Yea, enter thou My Heaven!
t.203: "And enter you My Paradise!"
t.54: اور میری جنت میں چلی جا.

t.149: No! I swear by this city,
t.84: I swear by this city,
t.85: I swear by this city––
t.95: Nay! I swear by this city
t.19: Nay, I swear by this city -
t.22: I do call to witness this City;-
t.203: I swear by this city (Makkah);
t.54: میں اس شہر کی قسم کھاتا ہوں.

t.149: and youare free of restriction in this city.
t.84: -and (O Prophet,) you are going to be allowed (to fight) in this city-
t.85: and you [Prophet] are an inhabitant of this city––
t.95: – this city wherein you have been rendered violable–
t.19: And thou art an indweller of this city -
t.22: And thou art a freeman of this City;-
t.203: And you are free (from sin, and to punish the enemies of Islâm on the Day of the conquest) in this city (Makkah).
t.54: اور آپ اس شہر میں مقیم ہیں.

t.149: By the begetter and what he has begotten—
t.84: and by the father and all those he begot,
t.85: [I swear] by parent and offspring,
t.95: and I swear by the parent and his offspring:
t.19: And the begetter and that which he begat,
t.22: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-
t.203: And by the begetter (i.e. Adam عليه السلام) and that which he begot (i.e. his progeny).
t.54: اور (قسم ہے) انسانی باپ اور اوﻻد کی.

t.149: We have certainly created man in distress.
t.84: indeed We have created man (to live) in hard struggle.
t.85: that We have created man for toil and trial.
t.95: Verily We have created man into toil and hardship.
t.19: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
t.22: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.
t.203: Verily, We have created man in toil.
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے انسان کو (بڑی) مشقت میں پیدا کیا ہے.

t.149: Does he think that no one will be able to restrain him?
t.84: Does he think that no one has power over him?
t.85: Does he think that no one will have power over him?
t.95: Does he think that no one can overpower him?
t.19: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?
t.22: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
t.203: Does he think that none can overcome him?
t.54: کیا یہ گمان کرتا ہے کہ یہ کسی کے بس میں ہی نہیں؟

t.149: He says, “I have consumed stacks of wealth.”
t.84: He says, “I have spent a lot of wealth.”
t.85: ‘I have squandered great wealth,’ he says.
t.95: He says: “I have squandered enormous wealth.”
t.19: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
t.22: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!
t.203: He says (boastfully): "I have wasted wealth in abundance!"
t.54: کہتا (پھرتا) ہے کہ میں نے تو بہت کچھ مال خرچ کر ڈاﻻ.

t.149: Does he think that no one has seen him?
t.84: Does he think that no one has seen him?
t.85: Does he think no one observes him?
t.95: Does he believe that none has seen him?
t.19: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
t.22: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
t.203: Does he think that none sees him?
t.54: کیا (یوں) سمجھتا ہے کہ کسی نے اسے دیکھا (ہی) نہیں؟

t.149: Have We not made for him two eyes
t.84: Did We not make for him two eyes,
t.85: Did We not give him eyes,
t.95: Did We not grant him two eyes,
t.19: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
t.22: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-
t.203: Have We not made for him two eyes,
t.54: کیا ہم نے اس کی دو آنکھیں نہیں بنائیں.

t.149: and a tongue and two lips,
t.84: and one tongue and two lips,
t.85: a tongue, lips,
t.95: and a tongue and two lips?
t.19: And a tongue and two lips,
t.22: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-
t.203: And a tongue and two lips?
t.54: اور زبان اور دو ہونٹ (نہیں بنائے).

t.149: and showed him the two courses?
t.84: and showed him the two ways?
t.85: and point out to him the two clear ways [of good and evil]?
t.95: And did We not show him the two highroads (of good and evil)?
t.19: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?
t.22: And shown him the two highways?
t.203: And shown him the two ways (good and evil)?
t.54: ہم نے دکھا دیئے اس کو دونوں راستے.

t.149: But he did not brave the difficult route.
t.84: Yet he did not make his way through the steep course,- -
t.85: Yet he has not attempted the steep path.
t.95: But he did not venture to scale the difficult steep.
t.19: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -
t.22: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.
t.203: But he has not attempted to pass on the path that is steep (i.e. the path which will lead to goodness and success).
t.54: سو اس سے نہ ہو سکا کہ گھاٹی میں داخل ہوتا.

t.149: And what can make you realize what the difficult route is?
t.84: - And what may let you know what the steep course is?
t.85: What will explain to you what the steep path is?
t.95: And what do you know what that difficult steep is?
t.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
t.22: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
t.203: And what will make you know the path that is steep?
t.54: اور کیا سمجھا کہ گھاٹی ہے کیا؟.

t.149: (It is) the freeing ofa neck(from the yokes of slavery) ,
t.84: (It is) freeing of the neck of a slave,
t.85: It is to free a slave,
t.95: It is freeing someone's neck from slavery;
t.19: (It is) to free a slave,
t.22: (It is:) freeing the bondman;
t.203: (It is) freeing a neck (slave)
t.54: کسی گردن (غلام ،لونڈی) کو آزاد کرنا.

t.149: or the feeding—on a day of starvation—of
t.84: or giving food in a day of hunger
t.85: to feed at a time of hunger
t.95: or giving food on a day of hunger
t.19: And to feed in the day of hunger.
t.22: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
t.203: Or giving food in a day of hunger (famine),
t.54: یا بھوک والے دن کھانا کھلانا.

t.149: an orphaned relative
t.84: to an orphan near of kin,
t.85: an orphaned relative
t.95: to an orphan near of kin;
t.19: An orphan near of kin,
t.22: To the orphan with claims of relationship,
t.203: To an orphan near of kin.
t.54: کسی رشتہ دار یتیم کو.

t.149: or a destitute person in the dust,
t.84: or to a needy person lying in dust- -
t.85: or a poor person in distress,
t.95: or to a destitute lying in dust;
t.19: Or some poor wretch in misery,
t.22: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.
t.203: Or to a Miskîn (poor) cleaving to dust (out of misery).
t.54: یا خاکسار مسکین کو.

t.149: then becoming of those who attained faith and enjoined upon one another patience and enjoined upon one another compassion—
t.84: - then he did not join those who believe and advise each other to be patient and advise each other to be merciful.
t.85: and to be one of those who believe and urge one another to steadfastness and compassion.
t.95: and, then besides this, he be one of those who believed, and enjoined upon one another steadfastness and enjoined upon one another compassion.
t.19: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
t.22: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.
t.203: Then he became one of those who believed (in the Islamic Monotheism) and recommended one another to perseverance and patience, and (also) recommended one another to pity and compassion.
t.54: پھر ان لوگوں میں سے ہو جاتا جو ایمان ﻻتے اور ایک دوسرے کو صبر کی اور رحم کرنے کی وصیت کرتے ہیں.

t.149: those are the fellows of the rightness.
t.84: Those are the People of the Right Hand. (i.e. their books of deeds will be given in their right hands)
t.85: Those who do this will be on the right-hand side,
t.95: These are the People of the Right Hand.
t.19: Their place will be on the right hand.
t.22: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.
t.203: They are those on the Right Hand (i.e. the dwellers of Paradise),
t.54: یہی لوگ ہیں دائیں بازو والے (خوش بختی والے).

t.149: But those who denied Our revelations—those are the fellows of the ill-omened;
t.84: As for those who reject Our verses, they are the People of the Left Hand. (i.e. their books of deeds will be given in their left hands.)
t.85: but those who disbelieve in Our revelations will be on the left-hand side,
t.95: As for those who rejected Our Signs, they are the People of the Left Hand.
t.19: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
t.22: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
t.203: But those who disbelieved in Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they are those on the Left Hand (the dwellers of Hell).
t.54: اور جن لوگوں نے ہماری آیتوں کے ساتھ کفر کیا یہ کم بختی والے ہیں.

t.149: over them is a fire with no exit.
t.84: Upon them will be the Fire, enveloping them with closed exits.
t.85: and the Fire will close in on them.
t.95: Upon them shall be a Fire that will hem them in.
t.19: Fire will be an awning over them.
t.22: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
t.203: The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet.
t.54: انہی پر آگ ہوگی جو چاروں طرف سے گھیری ہوئی ہوگی.

t.149: By the sun and its morning shine,
t.84: I swear by the sun and his broad light,
t.85: By the sun in its morning brightness
t.95: By the sun and its heat and brightness,
t.19: By the sun and his brightness,
t.22: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;
t.203: By the sun and its brightness.
t.54: قسم ہے سورج کی اور اس کی دھوپ کی.

t.149: and the moon as it follows her,
t.84: and by the moon when she follows him,
t.85: and by the moon as it follows it,
t.95: and by the moon as it follows it;
t.19: And the moon when she followeth him,
t.22: By the Moon as she follows him;
t.203: By the moon as it follows it (the sun).
t.54: قسم ہے چاند کی جب اس کے پیچھے آئے.

t.149: and the daytime as it reveals her,
t.84: and by the day when it shows his brightness,
t.85: by the day as it displays the sun’s glory
t.95: and by the day as it displays the sun's glory,
t.19: And the day when it revealeth him,
t.22: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;
t.203: By the day as it shows up (the sun’s) brightness.
t.54: قسم ہے دن کی جب سورج کو نمایاں کرے.

t.149: and the night as it conceals her.
t.84: and by the night when it envelops him,
t.85: and by the night as it conceals it,
t.95: and by the night as it envelopes the sun;
t.19: And the night when it enshroudeth him,
t.22: By the Night as it conceals it;
t.203: By the night as it conceals it (the sun).
t.54: قسم ہے رات کی جب اسے ڈھانﭗ لے.

t.149: By the sky and He Who built it.
t.84: and by the sky, and the One who built it,
t.85: by the sky and how He built it
t.95: and by the sky and by Him Who made it;
t.19: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
t.22: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;
t.203: By the heaven and Him Who built it.
t.54: قسم ہے آسمان کی اور اس کے بنانے کی.

t.149: By the land and He Who spread it.
t.84: and by the earth, and the One who spread it,
t.85: and by the earth and how He spread it,
t.95: and by the earth and by Him Who stretched it out;
t.19: And the earth and Him Who spread it,
t.22: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:
t.203: By the earth and Him Who spread it.
t.54: قسم ہے زمین کی اور اسے ہموار کرنے کی.

t.149: By the(inner) self and He Who formed it
t.84: and by the soul, and the One who made it well,
t.85: by the soul and how He formed it
t.95: and by the soul and by Him Who perfectly proportioned it,
t.19: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
t.22: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;
t.203: By Nafs (Adam or a person or a soul), and Him Who perfected him in proportion;
t.54: قسم ہے نفس کی اور اسے درست بنانے کی.

t.149: then inspired it its own wickedness and its own mindfulness(of God) —
t.84: then inspired it with its (instincts of) evil and piety,
t.85: and inspired it [to know] its own rebellion and piety!
t.95: and imbued it with (the consciousness of) its evil and its piety:
t.19: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
t.22: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
t.203: Then He showed him what is wrong for him and what is right for him.
t.54: پھر سمجھ دی اس کو بدکاری کی اور بچ کر چلنے کی.

t.149: surely, successful is the one who has purified it,
t.84: success is really attained by him who purifies it,
t.85: The one who purifies his soul succeeds
t.95: He who purifies it will prosper,
t.19: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
t.22: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
t.203: Indeed he succeeds who purifies his ownself (i.e. obeys and performs all that Allâh ordered, by following the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism and by doing righteous good deeds).
t.54: جس نے اسے پاک کیا وه کامیاب ہوا.

t.149: and surely, failing is the one who has stunted it.
t.84: and failure is really suffered by him who pollutes it.
t.85: and the one who corrupts it fails.
t.95: and he who suppresses it will be ruined.
t.19: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
t.22: And he fails that corrupts it!
t.203: And indeed he fails who corrupts his ownself (i.e. disobeys what Allâh has ordered by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism or by following polytheism or by doing every kind of evil wicked deeds).
t.54: اور جس نے اسے خاک میں ملا دیا وه ناکام ہوا.

t.149: Exceeding all limits caused Thamûdto disbelieve,
t.84: (The People of) Thamūd denied the truth because of their transgression,
t.85: In their arrogant cruelty, the people of Thamud called [their messenger] a liar,
t.95: In their presumptuous insolence the Thamud called the Truth a lie
t.19: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,
t.22: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,
t.203: Thamûd (people) denied (their Prophet) through their transgression (by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism, and by following polytheism, and by committing every kind of sin).
t.54: (قوم) ثمود نے اپنی سرکشی کے باعث جھٹلایا.

t.149: when the most wicked man among them was delegated.
t.84: when rose up the one who was most wretched of them.
t.85: when the most wicked man among them rose [against him].
t.95: when their arch-criminal rose up in rage.
t.19: When the basest of them broke forth
t.22: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
t.203: When the most wicked man among them went forth (to kill the she-camel).
t.54: جب ان میں کا بڑا بدبخت اٹھ کھڑا ہوا.

t.149: Then the messenger of Allahsaid to them, “This is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink.”
t.84: So, the Messenger of Allah said to them, “Be careful of Allah’s she-camel and her right to drink.”
t.85: The messenger of God said to them, ‘[Leave] God’s camel to drink,’
t.95: Then Allah's Messenger warned them: “Hands off the she-camel and her drink!”
t.19: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
t.22: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
t.203: But the Messenger of Allâh [Sâlih عليه السلام] said to them: "Be cautious! (Fear the evil end). That is the she-camel of Allâh! (Do not harm it) and bar it not from having its drink!"
t.54: انہیں اللہ کے رسول نے فرما دیا تھا کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کی اونٹنی اور اس کے پینے کی باری کی (حفاظت کرو).

t.149: So they disbelieved him and hamstrung her, so their Lord crushed them for their misdeed and leveled it,
t.84: But they rejected him and killed her, so their Lord sent eradicating torment upon them because of their sin, and made it equal for all.
t.85: but they called him a liar and hamstrung her. Their Lord destroyed them for their crime and levelled them.
t.95: But they rejected his statement as a lie and hamstrung the she-camel. For that crime their Lord rumbled down upon them, utterly razing them to the ground.
t.19: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
t.22: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!
t.203: Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, and made them equal in destruction (i.e. all grades of people, rich and poor, strong and weak, etc.)!
t.54: ان لوگوں نے اپنے پیغمبر کو جھوٹا سمجھ کر اس اونٹنی کی کوچیں کاٹ دیں، پس ان کے رب نے ان کے گناہوں کے باعث ان پر ہلاکت ڈالی اور پھر ہلاکت کو عام کر دیا اور اس بستی کو برابر کردیا.

t.149: and He doesnot fear its ultimate outcome.
t.84: And He has no fear of its consequence.
t.85: He did not hesitate to punish them.
t.95: He has no fear of its sequel.
t.19: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).
t.22: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.
t.203: And He (Allâh) feared not the consequences thereof.
t.54: وه نہیں ڈرتا اس کے تباه کن انجام سے.

t.149: By the night as it covers.
t.84: I swear by the night when it covers (the sun),
t.85: By the enshrouding night,
t.95: By the night when it enshrouds,
t.19: By the night enshrouding
t.22: By the Night as it conceals (the light);
t.203: By the night as it envelops.
t.54: قسم ہے رات کی جب چھا جائے.

t.149: By the day as it reveals.
t.84: and by the day when it unveils itself,
t.85: by the radiant day,
t.95: and by the day when it breaks in its glory,
t.19: And the day resplendent
t.22: By the Day as it appears in glory;
t.203: By the day as it appears in brightness.
t.54: اور قسم ہے دن کی جب روشن ہو.

t.149: By the creation of the male and the female—
t.84: and by the One who created the male and the female,
t.85: by His creation of male and female!
t.95: and by Him Who created the male and the female:
t.19: And Him Who hath created male and female,
t.22: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-
t.203: By Him Who created male and female.
t.54: اور قسم ہے اس ذات کی جس نے نر وماده کو پیدا کیا.

t.149: indeed, yourpursuits are diverse.
t.84: your efforts are diverse:
t.85: The ways you take differ greatly.
t.95: surely your strivings are divergent.
t.19: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).
t.22: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.
t.203: Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse (different in aims and purposes);
t.54: یقیناً تمہاری کوشش مختلف قسم کی ہے.

t.149: So as for the one who has given and has been mindful(of God)
t.84: As for the one who gives (in charity) and fears Allah,
t.85: There is the one who gives, who is mindful of God,
t.95: As for him who gave out his wealth (for Allah's sake) and abstained (from disobeying Him),
t.19: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
t.22: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),
t.203: As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allâh and fears Him,
t.54: جس نے دیا (اللہ کی راه میں) اور ڈرا (اپنے رب سے).

t.149: and has believed in ultimate goodness—
t.84: and believes in the best (religion),
t.85: who testifies to goodness––
t.95: and affirmed the Truth of goodness:
t.19: And believeth in goodness;
t.22: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-
t.203: And believes in Al-Husnâ.
t.54: اور نیک بات کی تصدیق کرتا رہے گا.

t.149: We will ease his way towards ease.
t.84: We will facilitate for him the way to extreme ease (i.e. the comforts of Paradise).
t.85: We shall smooth his way towards ease.
t.95: We shall facilitate for him the Way to Bliss.
t.19: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
t.22: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.
t.203: We will make smooth for him the path of ease (goodness).
t.54: تو ہم بھی اس کو آسان راستے کی سہولت دیں گے.

t.149: But as for the one who has been stingy and complacent
t.84: But the one who is miser and deems himself self-sufficient,
t.85: There is the one who is miserly, who is self-satisfied,
t.95: As for him who was a miser and behaved with aversion (to Allah),
t.19: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
t.22: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,
t.203: But he who is greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient.
t.54: لیکن جس نے بخیلی کی اور بے پرواہی برتی.

t.149: and has disbelieved in ultimate goodness—
t.84: and rejects the best (religion),
t.85: who denies goodness––
t.95: and denied the Truth of goodness:
t.19: And disbelieveth in goodness;
t.22: And gives the lie to the best,-
t.203: And belies Al-Husnâ (See the footnote of the Verse No.6)
t.54: اور نیک بات کی تکذیب کی.

t.149: We will ease his way towards difficulty,
t.84: We will facilitate for him the way to extreme distress.
t.85: We shall smooth his way towards hardship
t.95: We shall facilitate for him the way to Hardship,
t.19: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
t.22: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
t.203: We will make smooth for him the path for evil.
t.54: تو ہم بھی اس کی تنگی ومشکل کے سامان میسر کر دیں گے.

t.149: and his money will not avail him when he plummets.
t.84: And his wealth will not help him when he will fall down (into Hell).
t.85: and his wealth will not help him as he falls.
t.95: and his wealth shall be of no avail to him when he perishes.
t.19: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
t.22: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).
t.203: And what will his wealth avail him when he goes down (in destruction)?.
t.54: اس کا مال اسے (اوندھا) گرنے کے وقت کچھ کام نہ آئے گا.

t.149: Indeed, guidance is upon Us,
t.84: Of course, it is undertaken by Us to guide,
t.85: Our part is to provide guidance––
t.95: Surely it is for Us to show the Right Way,
t.19: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
t.22: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
t.203: Truly! On Us is (to give) guidance.
t.54: بیشک راه دکھا دینا ہمارے ذمہ ہے.

t.149: and indeed, unto Us belong the Last and the First(life) .
t.84: and in Our control is the Hereafter and the worldly life.
t.85: this world and the next belong to Us––
t.95: and to Us belong the Next Life and the present.
t.19: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
t.22: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.
t.203: And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world).
t.54: اور ہمارے ہی ہاتھ آخرت اور دنیا ہے.

t.149: So I have warned youof a fierce fire,
t.84: So I have warned you of a blazing fire.
t.85: so I warn you about the raging Fire,
t.95: I have now warned you of a Blazing Fire,
t.19: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
t.22: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;
t.203: Therefore I have warned you of a blazing Fire (Hell).
t.54: میں نے تو تمہیں شعلے مارتی ہوئی آگ سے ڈرا دیا ہے.

t.149: in which none roasts except the most wicked—
t.84: None will enter it but the wretched one,
t.85: in which none but the most wicked one will burn,
t.95: where none shall burn except the most wicked,
t.19: Which only the most wretched must endure,
t.22: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
t.203: None shall enter it save the most wretched.
t.54: جس میں صرف وہی بدبخت داخل ہوگا.

t.149: the onewho disbelieved and turned away.
t.84: who rejected (the truth) and turned away (from it).
t.85: who denied [the truth], and turned away.
t.95: who rejected the Truth, calling it falsehood and turned his back on it.
t.19: He who denieth and turneth away.
t.22: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.
t.203: Who denies and turns away.
t.54: جس نے جھٹلایا اور (اس کی پیروی سے) منھ پھیر لیا.

t.149: But the most mindful(of God) will be kept away from it—
t.84: And saved from it will be the most God-fearing one,
t.85: The most pious one will be spared this––
t.95: But the God-fearing shall be kept away from it,
t.19: Far removed from it will be the righteous
t.22: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-
t.203: And Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) will be far removed from it (Hell).
t.54: اور اس سے ایسا شخص دور رکھا جائے گا جو بڑا پرہیزگار ہو گا.

t.149: the one who bringshis wealth to purify himself,
t.84: who gives his wealth (in charity) to become purified,
t.85: who gives his wealth away as self-purification,
t.95: the Godfearing who spends his wealth to purify himself;
t.19: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
t.22: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
t.203: He who spends his wealth for increase in self-purification,
t.54: جو پاکی حاصل کرنے کے لئے اپنا مال دیتا ہے.

t.149: and not in return for any favor to anyone,
t.84: while no one has conferred any favour on him for which he would give a return,
t.85: not to return a favour to anyone
t.95: not as payment for any favours that he received,
t.19: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
t.22: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
t.203: And who has (in mind) no favour from anyone to be paid back,
t.54: کسی کا اس پر کوئی احسان نہیں کہ جس کا بدلہ دیا جا رہا ہو.

t.149: except for seeking the countenance of his Lord, the Most High.
t.84: but (he gave his wealth in charity) only to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High.
t.85: but for the sake of his Lord the Most High––
t.95: but only to seek the good pleasure of his Lord Most High.
t.19: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
t.22: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
t.203: Except to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High.
t.54: بلکہ صرف اپنے پروردگار بزرگ وبلند کی رضا چاہنے کے لئے.

t.149: And he will certainly be well pleased.
t.84: And surely he will soon be happy.
t.85: and he will be well pleased.
t.95: He will surely be well-pleased (with him).
t.19: He verily will be content.
t.22: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
t.203: He surely will be pleased (when he enters Paradise).
t.54: یقیناً وه (اللہ بھی) عنقریب رضامند ہو جائے گا.

t.149: By the morning shine.
t.84: I swear by the forenoon,
t.85: By the morning brightness
t.95: By the bright forenoon,
t.19: By the morning hours
t.22: By the Glorious Morning Light,
t.203: By the forenoon (after sunrise).
t.54: قسم ہے چاشت کے وقت کی.

t.149: By the night as it settles—
t.84: and by the night when it becomes peaceful,
t.85: and by the night when it grows still,
t.95: and by the night when it covers the world with peace:
t.19: And by the night when it is stillest,
t.22: And by the Night when it is still,-
t.203: By the night when it darkens (and stand still).
t.54: اور قسم ہے رات کی جب چھا جائے.

t.149: your Lord has not abandoned you, nor has He despised(you) .
t.84: your Lord (O Prophet,) has neither forsaken you, nor has become displeased.
t.85: your Lord has not forsaken you [Prophet], nor does He hate you,
t.95: (O Prophet), your Lord has neither forsaken you, nor is He displeased.
t.19: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
t.22: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
t.203: Your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has neither forsaken you nor hates you.
t.54: نہ تو تیرے رب نے تجھے چھوڑا ہے اور نہ وه بیزار ہو گیا ہے.

t.149: And indeed the Last is better for youthan the First,
t.84: Surely the Hereafter is much better for you than the present life.
t.85: and the future will be better for you than the past;
t.95: Indeed what is to come will be better for you than what has gone by.
t.19: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
t.22: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
t.203: And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present (life of this world).
t.54: یقیناً تیرے لئے انجام آغاز سے بہتر ہوگا.

t.149: and your Lord will certainly give you so that you will be well pleased.
t.84: And of course, your Lord will give you so much that you will be pleased.
t.85: your Lord is sure to give you so much that you will be well satisfied.
t.95: Verily your Lord will soon give you so amply that you will be well-pleased.
t.19: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
t.22: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
t.203: And verily, your Lord will give you (all good) so that you shall be well-pleased.
t.54: تجھے تیرا رب بہت جلد (انعام) دے گا اور تو راضی (وخوش) ہو جائے گا.

t.149: Did He not find youan orphan, so He sheltered(you) ;
t.84: Did He not find you an orphan, and give you shelter?
t.85: Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you?
t.95: Did He not find you an orphan and then gave you shelter?
t.19: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
t.22: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
t.203: Did He not find you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) an orphan and gave you a refuge?
t.54: کیا اس نے تجھے یتیم پا کر جگہ نہیں دی.

t.149: and found you wandering, so He guided(you) ;
t.84: And He found you unaware of the way (the Sharī‘ah ), then He guided you.
t.85: Did He not find you lost and guide you?
t.95: Did He not find you unaware of the Right Way, and then directed you to it?
t.19: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
t.22: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
t.203: And He found you unaware (of the Qur’ân, its laws, and Prophethood) and guided you?
t.54: اور تجھے راه بھوﻻ پا کر ہدایت نہیں دی.

t.149: and found you in need, so He enriched(you) ?
t.84: and He found you in need, then made you need-free.
t.85: Did He not find you in need and make you self-sufficient?
t.95: And did He not find you in want, and then enriched you?
t.19: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
t.22: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
t.203: And He found you poor and made you rich (self-sufficient with self-contentment)?
t.54: اور تجھے نادار پاکر تونگر نہیں بنا دیا؟

t.149: So as for the orphan, donot subdue;
t.84: Therefore, as for orphan, do not oppress him,
t.85: So do not be harsh with the orphan
t.95: Therefore, be not harsh with the orphan;
t.19: Therefor the orphan oppress not,
t.22: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
t.203: Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression.
t.54: پس یتیم پر تو بھی سختی نہ کیا کر.

t.149: and as for the asker, do not rebuke;
t.84: and as for the beggar, do not scold him.
t.85: and do not chide the one who asks for help;
t.95: and chide not him who asks,
t.19: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
t.22: Nor repulse the petitioner (unheard);
t.203: And repulse not the beggar.
t.54: اور نہ سوال کرنے والے کو ڈانٹ ڈپٹ.

t.149: and as for the blessing of your Lord, do talk about it.
t.84: And about the bounty of your Lord, do talk.
t.85: talk about the blessings of your Lord.
t.95: and proclaim the bounty of your Lord.
t.19: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
t.22: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
t.203: And proclaim the Grace of your Lord (i.e. the Prophethood and all other Graces).
t.54: اور اپنے رب کی نعمتوں کو بیان کرتا ره.

t.149: Did We not expand yourchest,
t.84: Have We not caused your bosom to be wide open for you?
t.85: Did We not relieve your heart for you [Prophet],
t.95: (O Prophet), Did We not lay open your breast
t.19: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
t.22: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
t.203: Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)?
t.54: کیا ہم نے تیرا سینہ نہیں کھول دیا.

t.149: and lift from you your burden
t.84: And We removed from you your burden
t.85: and remove the burden
t.95: and relieve you of the burden
t.19: And eased thee of the burden
t.22: And removed from thee thy burden
t.203: And removed from you your burden.
t.54: اور تجھ پر سے تیرا بوجھ ہم نے اتار دیا.

t.149: which weighed down your back,
t.84: that had (almost) broken your back,
t.85: that weighed so heavily on your back,
t.95: that had well-nigh broken your back?
t.19: Which weighed down thy back;
t.22: The which did gall thy back?-
t.203: Which weighed down your back?
t.54: جس نے تیری پیٹھ توڑ دی تھی.

t.149: and raised for you your remembrance?
t.84: and We raised high your name.
t.85: and raise your reputation high?
t.95: And did We not exalt your fame?
t.19: And exalted thy fame?
t.22: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?
t.203: And have We not raised high your fame?
t.54: اور ہم نے تیرا ذکر بلند کر دیا.

t.149: So indeed, with hardship comes ease;
t.84: So, undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.
t.85: So truly where there is hardship there is also ease;
t.95: Indeed, there is ease with hardship.
t.19: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,
t.22: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
t.203: Verily, along with every hardship is relief,
t.54: پس یقیناً مشکل کے ساتھ آسانی ہے.

t.149: indeed, with hardship comes ease.
t.84: Undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.
t.85: truly where there is hardship there is also ease.
t.95: Most certainly, there is ease with hardship.
t.19: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;
t.22: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
t.203: Verily, along with every hardship is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs).
t.54: بیشک مشکل کے ساتھ آسانی ہے.

t.149: So whenever youare done(from work) , stand up,
t.84: So, when you are free (from collective services), toil hard (in worship),
t.85: The moment you are freed [of one task] work on,
t.95: So, whenever you are free, strive in devotion,
t.19: So when thou art relieved, still toil
t.22: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
t.203: So when you have finished (your occupation), devote yourself for Allâh’s worship.
t.54: پس جب تو فارغ ہو تو عبادت میں محنت کر.

t.149: and to your Lord turn wishfully.
t.84: and towards your Lord turn with eagerness.
t.85: and turn to your Lord for everything.
t.95: and turn to your Lord with longing.
t.19: And strive to please thy Lord.
t.22: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
t.203: And to your Lord (Alone) turn (all your) intentions and hopes.
t.54: اور اپنے پروردگار ہی کی طرف دل لگا.

t.149: By the fig and the olive.
t.84: I swear by the Fig and the Olive,
t.85: By the fig, by the olive,
t.95: By the fig and the olive;
t.19: By the fig and the olive,
t.22: By the Fig and the Olive,
t.203: By the fig, and the olive.
t.54: قسم ہے انجیر کی اور زیتون کی.

t.149: By Mount Tûr of Sinai.
t.84: and by Tūr, the mount of Sinai,
t.85: by Mount Sinai,
t.95: and by the Mount Sinai,
t.19: By Mount Sinai,
t.22: And the Mount of Sinai,
t.203: By Mount Sinai.
t.54: اور طور سِینِین کی.

t.149: By this safe city—
t.84: and by this peaceful city,
t.85: by this safe town,
t.95: and by this city (of Makkah), a haven of peace:
t.19: And by this land made safe;
t.22: And this City of security,-
t.203: By this city of security (Makkah).
t.54: اور اس امن والے شہر کی.

t.149: surely, We created man in the best state,
t.84: We have created man in the best composition,
t.85: We create man in the finest state
t.95: surely We created man in the best mould;
t.19: Surely We created man of the best stature
t.22: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,
