t.203: Verily, We created man in the best stature (mould).
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے انسان کو بہترین صورت میں پیدا کیا.

t.149: then We returned him to the lowest of the low,
t.84: then We turned him into the lowest of the low,
t.85: then reduce him to the lowest of the low,
t.95: then We reverted him to the lowest of the low,
t.19: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,
t.22: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-
t.203: Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low.
t.54: پھر اسے نیچوں سے نیچا کر دیا.

t.149: except those who attained faith and did righteous deeds, for for them is an unfailing reward.
t.84: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, because for them there is a reward never ending.
t.85: except those who believe and do good deeds–– they will have an unfailing reward.
t.95: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds. Theirs is a never ending reward.
t.19: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.
t.22: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.
t.203: Save those who believe (in Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds. Then they shall have a reward without end (Paradise).
t.54: لیکن جو لوگ ایمان ﻻئے اور (پھر) نیک عمل کیے تو ان کے لئے ایسا اجر ہے جو کبھی ختم نہ ہوگا.

t.149: So what makes youstill deny the recompense?
t.84: So, what can make you, after all this, to deny the Requital?
t.85: After this, what makes you [man] deny the Judgement?
t.95: Who, then, can give the lie to you, (O Prophet), about the Reward and the Punishment?
t.19: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?
t.22: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?
t.203: Then what (or who) causes you (O disbelievers) to deny the Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)?
t.54: پس تجھے اب روز جزا کے جھٹلانے پر کون سی چیز آماده کرتی ہے.

t.149: Is Allah not the Wisest of judges?
t.84: Is Allah not the Greatest Ruler of all the rulers?
t.85: Is God not the most decisive of judges?
t.95: Is not Allah the Greatest of all sovereigns?
t.19: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?
t.22: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?
t.203: Is not Allâh the Best of judges?
t.54: کیا اللہ تعالیٰ (سب) حاکموں کا حاکم نہیں ہے.

t.149: Recite: In the name of yourLord Who created—
t.84: Read with the name of your Lord who created (every thing),
t.85: Read! In the name of your Lord who created:
t.95: Recite in the name of your Lord Who created,
t.19: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
t.22: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-
t.203: Read! In the Name of your Lord Who has created (all that exists).
t.54: پڑھ اپنے رب کے نام سے جس نے پیدا کیا.

t.149: created man from a clinging form.
t.84: He created man from a clot of blood.
t.85: He created manfrom a clinging form.
t.95: created man from a clot of congealed blood.
t.19: Createth man from a clot.
t.22: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:
t.203: He has created man from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood).
t.54: جس نے انسان کو خون کے لوتھڑے سے پیدا کیا.

t.149: Recite: And yourLord is the Most Noble,
t.84: Read, and your Lord is the most gracious,
t.85: Read! Your Lord is the Most Bountiful One
t.95: Recite: and your Lord is Most Generous,
t.19: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
t.22: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-
t.203: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous.
t.54: تو پڑھتا ره تیرا رب بڑے کرم واﻻ ہے.

t.149: the OneWho taught by the pen—
t.84: who imparted knowledge by means of the pen.
t.85: who taught by [means of] the pen,
t.95: Who taught by the pen,
t.19: Who teacheth by the pen,
t.22: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-
t.203: Who has taught (the writing) by the pen.
t.54: جس نے قلم کے ذریعے (علم) سکھایا.

t.149: taught man what he never knew.
t.84: He taught man what he did not know.
t.85: who taught man what he did not know.
t.95: taught man what he did not know.
t.19: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
t.22: Taught man that which he knew not.
t.203: He has taught man that which he knew not.
t.54: جس نے انسان کو وه سکھایا جسے وه نہیں جانتا تھا.

t.149: But no! Indeed, man surely exceeds all limits,
t.84: In fact, man crosses the limits,
t.85: But man exceeds all bounds
t.95: Nay, surely man transgresses;
t.19: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
t.22: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,
t.203: Nay! Verily, man does transgress (in disbelief and evil deed).
t.54: سچ مچ انسان تو آپے سے باہر ہو جاتا ہے.

t.149: for he sees himself self-sufficient.
t.84: because he deems himself to be free of need.
t.85: when he thinks he is self-sufficient:
t.95: for he believes himself to be self-sufficient.
t.19: That he thinketh himself independent!
t.22: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.
t.203: Because he considers himself self-sufficient.
t.54: اس لئے کہ وه اپنے آپ کو بے پروا (یا تونگر) سمجھتا ہے.

t.149: Indeed, to yourLord is the ultimate return.
t.84: Surely to your Lord is the return.
t.85: [Prophet], all will return to your Lord.
t.95: Surely to your Lord is your return.
t.19: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
t.22: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).
t.203: Surely, unto your Lord is the return.
t.54: یقیناً لوٹنا تیرے رب کی طرف ہے.

t.149: Have youseen the one who forbids
t.84: Have you seen him who forbids
t.85: Have you seen the man who forbids
t.95: Did you see him who forbids
t.19: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
t.22: Seest thou one who forbids-
t.203: Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) seen him (i.e. Abû Jahl) who prevents
t.54: (بھلا) اسے بھی تو نے دیکھا جو بندے کو روکتا ہے.

t.149: a servant when he prays?
t.84: a servant of Allah when he prays?
t.85: [Our] servant to pray?
t.95: a servant (of Allah) when he prays?
t.19: A slave when he prayeth?
t.22: A votary when he (turns) to pray?
t.203: A slave (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when he prays?
t.54: جبکہ وه بنده نماز ادا کرتا ہے.

t.149: Have youseen whether he was rightly guided
t.84: Tell me, if he is on the right path,
t.85: Have you seen whether he is rightly guided,
t.95: Did you consider: what if he is on the Right Way,
t.19: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
t.22: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-
t.203: Tell me if he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is on the guidance (of Allâh)
t.54: بھلا بتلا تو اگر وه ہدایت پر ہو.

t.149: or commanded to mindfulness(of God) ?
t.84: or bids piety, (would the former still forbid him?)
t.85: or encourages true piety?
t.95: and enjoins piety?
t.19: Or enjoineth piety?
t.22: Or enjoins Righteousness?
t.203: Or enjoins piety!
t.54: یا پرہیز گاری کا حکم دیتا ہو.

t.149: Have youseen whether he disbelieved and turned away?
t.84: Tell me, if he rejects (the true faith) and turns away,
t.85: Have you seen whether he denies the truth and turns away from it?
t.95: Did you consider: what if he gives the lie (to the Truth) and turns away (from it)?
t.19: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?
t.22: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?
t.203: Tell me if he (Abû Jahl) denies (the truth, i.e. this Qur’ân) and turns away?
t.54: بھلا دیکھو تو اگر یہ جھٹلاتا ہو اور منھ پھیرتا ہو تو.

t.149: Has he not realized that Allah sees?
t.84: does he not know that Allah is watching (him)?
t.85: Does he not realize that God sees all?
t.95: Does he not know that Allah sees everything?
t.19: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?
t.22: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?
t.203: Knows he not that Allâh does see (what he does)?
t.54: کیا اس نے نہیں جانا کہ اللہ تعالیٰ اسے خوب دیکھ رہا ہے.

t.149: But no! Surely, if he does not desist, We will drag(him) by the forelock—
t.84: No! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag (him) by forelock,
t.85: No! If he does not stop, We shall drag him by his forehead––
t.95: No indeed; if he does not desist, We shall drag him by the forelock;
t.19: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -
t.22: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-
t.203: Nay! If he (Abû Jahl) ceases not, We will catch him by the forelock -
t.54: یقیناً اگر یہ باز نہ رہا تو ہم اس کی پیشانی کے بال پکڑ کر گھسیٹیں گے.

t.149: a lying, wrongful forelock.
t.84: a lying, sinful forelock.
t.85: his lying, sinful forehead.
t.95: by the lying forelock steeped in sin.
t.19: The lying, sinful forelock -
t.22: A lying, sinful forelock!
t.203: A lying, sinful forelock!
t.54: ایسی پیشانی جو جھوٹی خطا کار ہے.

t.149: Let him call on his gang;
t.84: So let him call the men of his council,
t.85: Let him summon his comrades;
t.95: So let him summon his helpmates;
t.19: Then let him call upon his henchmen!
t.22: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):
t.203: Then let him call upon his council (of helpers).
t.54: یہ اپنی مجلس والوں کو بلالے.

t.149: We will call the guards of Hell.
t.84: We will call the soldiers of the Hell.
t.85: We shall summon the guards of Hell.
t.95: We too shall summon the guards of Hell.
t.19: We will call the guards of hell.
t.22: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!
t.203: We will call out the guards of Hell (to deal with him)!
t.54: ہم بھی (دوزخ کے) پیادوں کو بلالیں گے.

t.149: But no! Do not obey him, but prostrate yourself and draw near.
t.84: No! Never obey him, and bow down in sajdah, and come close to Me.
t.85: No! Do not obey him [Prophet]: bow down in worship and draw close.
t.95: No, not at all. Never obey him. But prostrate yourself and become nigh (to your Lord).
t.19: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
t.22: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!
t.203: Nay! (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)! Do not obey him (Abû Jahl). Fall prostrate and draw near to Allâh!
t.54: خبردار! اس کا کہنا ہرگز نہ ماننا اور سجده کر اور قریب ہو جا.*

t.149: We sent itdown on the Night of Determination.
t.84: We have sent it (the Qur’ān) down in the Night of Qadr.
t.85: We sent it down on the Night of Glory.
t.95: Behold, We revealed this (Qur'an) on the Night of Power.
t.19: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.
t.22: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:
t.203: Verily, We have sent it (this Qur’ân) down in the night of Al-Qadr (Decree).
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے اسے شب قدر میں نازل فرمایا.

t.149: But what can make yourealize what the Night of Determination is?
t.84: And what may let you know what the Night of Qadr is?
t.85: What will explain to you what that Night of Glory is?
t.95: And what do you know what the Night of Power is?
t.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!
t.22: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?
t.203: And what will make you know what the night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is?
t.54: تو کیا سمجھا کہ شب قدر کیا ہے؟

t.149: The Night of Determination is better than a thousand months—
t.84: The Night of Qadr is much better than one thousand months.
t.85: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months;
t.95: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
t.19: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
t.22: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
t.203: The night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is better than a thousand months (i.e. worshipping Allâh in that night is better than worshipping Him a thousand months, i.e. 83 years and 4 months).
t.54: شب قدر ایک ہزار مہینوں سے بہتر ہے.

t.149: in it descend the angels, with the Spiritamong them, by the leave of their Lord with every command.
t.84: The angels and the Spirit descend in it, with the leave of your Lord, along with every command.
t.85: on that night the angels and the Spirit descend again and again with their Lord’s permission on every task;
t.95: The angels along with the Spirit descend in it by the permission of their Lord with all kinds of decrees.
t.19: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
t.22: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:
t.203: Therein descend the angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabrîl)] by Allâh’s Permission with all Decrees,
t.54: اس (میں ہر کام) کے سر انجام دینے کو اپنے رب کے حکم سے فرشتے اور روح (جبرائیل) اترتے ہیں.

t.149: Peace! It is until the rise of dawn.
t.84: Peace it is till the debut of dawn.
t.85: [there is] peace that night until the break of dawn.
t.95: All peace is that night until the rise of dawn.
t.19: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
t.22: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!
t.203: (All that night), there is Peace (and Goodness from Allâh to His believing slaves) until the appearance of dawn.
t.54: یہ رات سراسر سلامتی کی ہوتی ہے اور فجر کے طلوع ہونے تک (رہتی ہے).

t.149: Those who have denied from among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted(from disbelief) until the evident proof came to them—
t.84: Those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not (expected) to desist (from their wrong beliefs) unless there comes to them a clear proof,
t.85: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters were not about to change their ways until they were sent clear evidence,
t.95: Those who disbelieved – be they from the People of the Book or from those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity – will not desist from unbelief until the Clear Proof should come to them;
t.19: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,
t.22: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, were not going to depart (from their ways) until there should come to them Clear Evidence,-
t.203: Those who disbelieve from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and Al-Mushrikûn, were not going to leave (their disbelief) until there came to them clear evidence.
t.54: اہل کتاب کے کافر اور مشرک لوگ جب تک کہ ان کے پاس ظاہر دلیل نہ آجائے باز رہنے والے نہ تھے (وه دلیل یہ تھی کہ).

t.149: a messenger from Allah reading purified Scrolls;
t.84: a messenger from Allah who recites the purified scrolls
t.85: a messenger from God, reading out pages [blessed with] purity,
t.95: a Messenger from Allah, reciting from Purified Scrolls;
t.19: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages
t.22: An messenger from Allah, rehearsing scriptures kept pure and holy:
t.203: A Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from Allâh, reciting (the Qur’ân) purified pages [purified from Al-Bâtil (falsehood)].
t.54: اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک رسول جو پاک صحیفے پڑھے.

t.149: in them are valuable scriptures.
t.84: containing (right and) straight writings.
t.85: containing true scriptures.
t.95: in writings wherein are scriptures, absolutely true and unerring.
t.19: Containing correct scriptures.
t.22: Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight.
t.203: Wherein are correct and straight laws from Allâh.
t.54: جن میں صحیح اور درست احکام ہوں.

t.149: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided except after the evident proof came to them.
t.84: And those who were given the Book did not disagree but after the clear proof came to them,
t.85: [Yet] those who were given the Scripture became divided only after they were sent [such] clear evi-dence
t.95: Nor did those to whom the Book had been given split up until after the Proof (of the Right Way) had come to them.
t.19: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.
t.22: Nor did the People of the Book make schisms, until after there came to them Clear Evidence.
t.203: And the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) differed not until after there came to them clear evidence (i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever was revealed to him).
t.54: اہل کتاب اپنے پاس ظاہر دلیل آجانے کے بعد ہی (اختلاف میں پڑ کر) متفرق ہوگئے.

t.149: And they were only commanded to worship Allah—devoting religion to Him, turning away from all that is false—and to establish the prayer and to bringthe purifying charity, and that is the religionmost upright.
t.84: while they were not ordered but to worship Allah, making their submission exclusive for him with no deviation, and to establish Salāh and pay Zakāh. That is the way of the straight religion.
t.85: though all they are ordered to do is worship God alone, sincerely devoting their religion to Him as people of true faith, keep up the prayer, and pay the prescribed alms, for that is the true religion.
t.95: Yet all that they had been commanded was that they serve Allah, with utter sincerity, devoting themselves exclusively to Him, and that they establish Prayer and pay Zakah. That is the Right Faith.
t.19: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.
t.22: And they have been commanded no more than this: To worship Allah, offering Him sincere devotion, being true (in faith); to establish regular prayer; and to practise regular charity; and that is the Religion Right and Straight.
t.203: And they were commanded not, but that they should worship Allâh, and worship none but Him Alone (abstaining from ascribing partners to Him), and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) and give Zakât, and that is the right religion.
t.54: انہیں اس کے سوا کوئی حکم نہیں دیا گیا کہ صرف اللہ کی عبادت کریں اسی کے لئے دین کو خالص رکھیں۔ ابراہیم حنیف کے دین پر اور نماز کو قائم رکھیں اور زکوٰة دیتے رہیں یہی ہے دین سیدھی ملت کا.

t.149: Indeed, those who have denied among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists are in the fire of Hell, abiding therein; those are the worst of all beings.
t.84: Surely those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of Jahannam , in which they will be living forever. Those are the worst of all human beings.
t.85: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters will have the Fire of Hell, there to remain. They are the worst of creation.
t.95: Those who disbelieved – be they from among the People of the Book or among those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity– shall be in the Fire, and will abide in it. They are the worst of creatures.
t.19: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.
t.22: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, will be in Hell-Fire, to dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures.
t.203: Verily, those who disbelieve (in the religion of Islâm, the Qur’ân and Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and Al-Mushrikûn will abide in the Fire of Hell. They are the worst of creatures.
t.54: بیشک جو لوگ اہل کتاب میں کافر ہوئے اور مشرکین سب دوزخ کی آگ میں (جائیں گے) جہاں وه ہمیشہ (ہمیشہ) رہیں گے۔ یہ لوگ بدترین خلائق ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, those who have attained faith and have done righteous deeds—those are the best of all beings.
t.84: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, they are the best of all human beings.
t.85: Those who believe and do good deeds are the best of creation.
t.95: But those that believe and work righteous deeds, they are the best of creatures.
t.19: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.
t.22: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds,- they are the best of creatures.
t.203: Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) including all obligations ordered by Islâm] and do righteous good deeds, they are the best of creatures.
t.54: بیشک جو لوگ ایمان ﻻئےاور نیک عمل کیے یہ لوگ بہترین خلائق ہیں.

t.149: Their repayment with their Lord: Gardens of Eternity beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. Allah became well pleased with them and they became well pleased with Him. That is for whoever was in awe of his Lord.
t.84: Their reward, with their Lord, is gardens of eternity beneath which rivers flow, in which they will be abiding forever. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. That (reward) is for him who has awe of his Lord.
t.85: Their reward with their Lord is everlasting Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will stay forever. God is well pleased with them and they with Him. All this is for those who stand in awe of their Lord.
t.95: Their recompense lies with their Lord: Gardens of eternity beneath which rivers flow; therein they shall dwell, forever and ever. Allah is well-pleased with them, and they are well-pleased with Him. All this is for him who fears his Lord.
t.19: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
t.22: Their reward is with Allah: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which rivers flow; they will dwell therein for ever; Allah well pleased with them, and they with Him: all this for such as fear their Lord and Cherisher.
t.203: Their reward with their Lord is ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (Gardens of Eternity), underneath which rivers flow. They will abide therein forever, Allâh will be pleased with them, and they with Him. That is for him who fears his Lord.
t.54: ان کا بدلہ ان کے رب کے پاس ہمیشگی والی جنتیں ہیں جن کے نیچے نہریں بہہ رہی ہیں جن میں وه ہمیشہ ہمیشہ رہیں گے۔ اللہ تعالیٰ ان سے راضی ہوا اور یہ اس سے راضی ہوئے۔ یہ ہے اس کے لئے جو اپنے پروردگار سے ڈرے.

t.149: When the earth is made to quake with its earthquake,
t.84: When the earth will be trembled with its quake,
t.85: When the earth is shaken violently in its [last] quaking,
t.95: When the earth will be shaken with a mighty shaking,
t.19: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
t.22: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
t.203: When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake.
t.54: جب زمین پوری طرح جھنجھوڑ دی جائے گی.

t.149: and the earth brings out its heavy burdens,
t.84: and the earth will bring forth its burdens,
t.85: when the earth throws out its burdens,
t.95: and the earth will throw up all her burdens,
t.19: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
t.22: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
t.203: And when the earth throws out its burdens.
t.54: اور اپنے بوجھ باہر نکال پھینکے گی.

t.149: and man says, “What is the matter with it?”—
t.84: and man will say, “What has happened to it?”
t.85: when man cries, ‘What is happening to it?’;
t.95: and man will cry out: “What is the matter with her?”
t.19: And man saith: What aileth her?
t.22: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-
t.203: And man will say: "What is the matter with it?"
t.54: انسان کہنے لگے گا کہ اسے کیا ہوگیا؟

t.149: On that day, it tells its tales,
t.84: That day it will describe all its happenings,
t.85: on that Day, it will tell all
t.95: On that Day it will relate all her news,
t.19: That day she will relate her chronicles,
t.22: On that Day will she declare her tidings:
t.203: That Day it will declare its information (about all that happened over it of good or evil).
t.54: اس دن زمین اپنی سب خبریں بیان کردے گی.

t.149: because yourLord has revealed to it.
t.84: because its Lord will have so commanded it.
t.85: because your Lord will inspire it [to do so].
t.95: for your Lord will have commanded her (to do so).
t.19: Because thy Lord inspireth her.
t.22: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.
t.203: Because your Lord will inspire it.
t.54: اس لئے کہ تیرے رب نے اسے حکم دیا ہوگا.

t.149: On that day, mankind emerge in droves to be shown their deeds.
t.84: That day the people will come back (from the place of reckoning) in different groups, so that they may be shown (the fruits of) their deeds.
t.85: On that Day, people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds:
t.95: On that Day people will go forth in varying states so that they be shown their deeds.
t.19: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
t.22: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
t.203: That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds.
t.54: اس روز لوگ مختلف جماعتیں ہو کر (واپس) لوٹیں گے تاکہ انہیں ان کے اعمال دکھا دیئے جائیں.

t.149: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good sees it,
t.84: So, whoever does any good act (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.
t.85: whoever has done an atom’s-weight of good will see it,
t.95: So, whoever does an atom's weight of good shall see it;
t.19: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
t.22: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!
t.203: So whosoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it.
t.54: پس جس نے ذره برابر نیکی کی ہوگی وه اسے دیکھ لے گا.

t.149: and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil sees it.
t.84: And whoever does evil (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.
t.85: but whoever has done an atom’s-weight of evil will see that.
t.95: and whoever does an atom's weight of evil shall see it.
t.19: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.
t.22: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.
t.203: And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it.
t.54: اور جس نے ذره برابر برائی کی ہوگی وه اسے دیکھ لے گا.

t.149: By thosethat run panting,
t.84: (I swear) by those (horses) that run snorting,
t.85: By the charging steeds that pant
t.95: By (the horses) that charge snorting,
t.19: By the snorting courses,
t.22: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
t.203: By the (steeds) that run, with panting.
t.54: ہانپتے ہوئے دوڑنے والے گھوڑوں کی قسم!

t.149: then by those igniting sparks,
t.84: then those that create sparks by striking (their hoofs) on the stones,
t.85: and strike sparks with their hooves,
t.95: then raise sparks of fire (by their hoofs),
t.19: Striking sparks of fire
t.22: And strike sparks of fire,
t.203: Striking sparks of fire (by their hooves).
t.54: پھر ٹاپ مار کر آگ جھاڑنے والوں کی قسم!

t.149: then by those raiding at dawn,
t.84: then those that invade at morning,
t.85: who make dawn raids,
t.95: then raid by the dawn,
t.19: And scouring to the raid at dawn,
t.22: And push home the charge in the morning,
t.203: And scouring to the raid at dawn.
t.54: پھر صبح کے وقت دھاوا بولنے والوں کی قسم.

t.149: raising clouds of dust
t.84: then raise, at the same time, a trail of dust,
t.85: raising a cloud of dust,
t.95: and blaze a trail of dust,
t.19: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
t.22: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
t.203: And raise the dust in clouds the while.
t.54: پس اس وقت گرد وغبار اڑاتے ہیں

t.149: and storming into the midst of the crowd—
t.84: then enter, at the same time, into the centre of the (opposing) host,
t.85: and plunging into the midst of the enemy,
t.95: and penetrate deep into a host.
t.19: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
t.22: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
t.203: And penetrating forthwith as one into the midst (of the foe).
t.54: پھر اسی کے ساتھ فوجیوں کے درمیان گھس جاتے ہیں.

t.149: indeed, man is certainly ungrateful to his Lord;
t.84: man is, indeed, very ungrateful to his Lord,
t.85: man is ungrateful to his Lord––
t.95: Verily man is most ungrateful to his Lord;
t.19: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
t.22: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
t.203: Verily, man (disbeliever) is ungrateful to his Lord.
t.54: یقیناً انسان اپنے رب کا بڑا ناشکرا ہے.

t.149: and indeed, he certainly bears witness to that;
t.84: and he himself is a witness to that fact,
t.85: and He is witness to this––
t.95: and he himself is a witness to that,
t.19: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
t.22: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
t.203: And to that he bears witness (by his deeds).
t.54: اور یقیناً وه خود بھی اس پر گواه ہے.

t.149: and indeed, in his love for wealth he is certainly fierce.
t.84: and in his love for wealth, he is very intense.
t.85: he is truly excessive in his love of wealth.
t.95: and surely he loves riches with a passionate loving.
t.19: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
t.22: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
t.203: And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.
t.54: یہ مال کی محبت میں بھی بڑا سخت ہے.

t.149: Does he not know that when whatever lies within the graves is scattered around,
t.84: Does he not then know (what will happen) when all that is contained in the graves will be overturned,
t.85: Does he not know that when the contents of graves burst forth,
t.95: Is he not aware that when whatever lies (buried) in the graves is overthrown;
t.19: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
t.22: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
t.203: Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are poured forth (all mankind is resurrected)?
t.54: کیا اسے وه وقت معلوم نہیں جب قبروں میں جو (کچھ) ہے نکال لیا جائے گا.

t.149: and when whatever lies within the hearts is obtained—
t.84: and all that is contained in the hearts will be exposed.
t.85: when the secrets of hearts are uncovered, on that Day,
t.95: and the secrets of the hearts are laid bare (and examined)?
t.19: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
t.22: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
t.203: And that which is in the breasts (of men) is made known?
t.54: اور سینوں کی پوشیده باتیں ظاہر کر دی جائیں گی.

t.149: indeed, on that day, their Lord is most surely aware of them.
t.84: Surely your Lord, that day, is fully aware of them.
t.85: their Lord will be fully aware of them all?
t.95: Surely on that Day will their Lord be fully informed about them.
t.19: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
t.22: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
t.203: Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds and will reward them for their deeds).
t.54: بیشک ان کا رب اس دن ان کے حال سے پورا باخبر ہوگا.

t.149: The Shocking Event!
t.84: The Striking Event!
t.85: The Crashing Blow!
t.95: The Calamity!
t.19: The Calamity!
t.22: The (Day) of Noise and Clamour:
t.203: Al-Qâri‘ah (the striking Hour i.e. the Day of Resurrection).
t.54: کھڑکھڑا دینے والی.*

t.149: What is the Shocking Event?
t.84: What is the Striking Event?
t.85: What is the Crashing Blow?
t.95: What is the Calamity?
t.19: What is the Calamity?
t.22: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?
t.203: What is the striking (Hour)?
t.54: کیا ہے وه کھڑکھڑا دینے والی.

t.149: And what can make yourealize what the Shocking Event is?
t.84: And what may let you know what the Striking Event is?
t.85: What will explain to you what the Crashing Blow is?
t.95: And what do you know what the Calamity is?
t.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!
t.22: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?
t.203: And what will make you know what the striking (Hour) is?
t.54: تجھے کیا معلوم کہ وه کھڑ کھڑا دینے والی کیا ہے.

t.149: A day when mankind become like scattered moths,
t.84: (It will happen) on a day when people will be like scattered moths,
t.85: On a Day when people will be like scattered moths
t.95: On that Day human beings shall be like scattered moths,
t.19: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
t.22: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,
t.203: It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about.
t.54: جس دن انسان بکھرے ہوئے پروانوں کی طرح ہو جائیں گے.

t.149: and the mountains become like tufted wool.
t.84: and the mountains will be like carded wool.
t.85: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
t.95: and the mountains shall be like fluffs of carded wool in varying colours.
t.19: And the mountains will become as carded wool.
t.22: And the mountains will be like carded wool.
t.203: And the mountains will be like carded wool.
t.54: اور پہاڑ دھنے ہوئے رنگین اون کی طرح ہو جائیں گے.

t.149: So, as for the one whose scales were heavy—
t.84: Then, as for him whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy,
t.85: the one whose good deeds are heavy on the scales
t.95: Then he whose scales weigh heavier
t.19: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),
t.22: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,
t.203: Then as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be heavy,
t.54: پھر جس کے پلڑے بھاری ہوں گے.

t.149: he is in a pleasant life.
t.84: he will be in a happy life.
t.85: will have a pleasant life,
t.95: shall have a blissful life;
t.19: He will live a pleasant life.
t.22: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.
t.203: He will live a pleasant life (in Paradise).
t.54: وه تو دل پسند آرام کی زندگی میں ہوگا.

t.149: But as for the one whose scales were light—
t.84: But he whose scales are light,
t.85: but the one whose good deeds are light
t.95: but he whose scales weigh lighter,
t.19: But as for him whose scales are light,
t.22: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-
t.203: But as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be light,
t.54: اور جس کے پلڑے ہلکے ہوں گے.

t.149: his homeis an Abyss.
t.84: -his abode will be Abyss.
t.85: will have the Bottomless Pit for his home––
t.95: his shall be the deep pit for a dwelling.
t.19: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,
t.22: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.
t.203: He will have his home in Hâwiyah (pit, i.e. Hell).
t.54: اس کا ٹھکانا ہاویہ ہے.

t.149: And what can make yourealize what it is?
t.84: And what may let you know what that (Abyss) is?
t.85: what will explain to you what that is?––
t.95: And what do you know what that is?
t.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
t.22: And what will explain to thee what this is?
t.203: And what will make you know what it is?
t.54: تجھے کیا معلوم کہ وه کیا ہے.

t.149: A raging fire.
t.84: A blazing Fire!
t.85: a blazing fire.
t.95: A Blazing Fire!
t.19: Raging Fire.
t.22: (It is) a Fire Blazing fiercely!
t.203: (It is) a fiercely blazing Fire!
t.54: وه تند وتیز آگ (ہے).

t.149: Vying for more distracted you
t.84: You are distracted by mutual competition in amassing (worldly benefits),
t.85: Striving for more distracts you
t.95: The craving for ever-greater worldly gains and to excel others in that regard keeps you occupied
t.19: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
t.22: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),
t.203: The mutual rivalry (for piling up of worldly things) diverts you,
t.54: زیادتی کی چاہت نے تمہیں غافل کردیا.

t.149: until you visited the graves.
t.84: until you reach the graves.
t.85: until you go into your graves.
t.95: until you reach your graves.
t.19: Until ye come to the graves.
t.22: Until ye visit the graves.
t.203: Until you visit the graves (i.e. till you die).
t.54: یہاں تک کہ تم قبرستان جا پہنچے.

t.149: But no! Youwill come to know.
t.84: No! (This is not a correct attitude.) You will soon know (the reality).
t.85: No indeed! You will come to know.
t.95: Nay, you will soon come to know;
t.19: Nay, but ye will come to know!
t.22: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
t.203: Nay! You shall come to know!
t.54: ہرگز نہیں تم عنقریب معلوم کر لو گے.

t.149: Once again: But no! Youwill come to know.
t.84: Again, you will soon know.
t.85: No indeed! In the end you will come to know.
t.95: nay, again, you shall soon come to know.
t.19: Nay, but ye will come to know!
t.22: Again, ye soon shall know!
t.203: Again nay! You shall come to know!
t.54: ہرگز نہیں پھر تمہیں جلد علم ہو جائے گا.

t.149: But no! If only youknew with the knowledge of certitude:
t.84: No! Only if you knew (it) with a sure knowledge!
t.85: No indeed! If only you knew for certain.
t.95: Nay, would that you knew with certainty of knowledge (what your attitude will lead to, you would never have acted the way you do).
t.19: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
t.22: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
t.203: Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge (the end result of piling up, you would not have been occupied yourselves in worldly things).
t.54: ہرگز نہیں اگر تم یقینی طور پر جان لو.

t.149: you will certainly see purgatory.
t.84: You will certainly see the Hell,
t.85: You will most definitely see Hellfire,
t.95: You will surely end up seeing Hell;
t.19: For ye will behold hell-fire.
t.22: Ye shall certainly see Hell-Fire!
t.203: Verily, You shall see the blazing Fire (Hell)!
t.54: تو بیشک تم جہنم دیکھ لو گے.

t.149: Then youwill certainly see it with the eye of certitude.
t.84: then you will see it with full certitude.
t.85: you will see it with the eye of certainty.
t.95: again, you shall most certainly end up seeing it with absolute certainty.
t.19: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
t.22: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
t.203: And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight!
t.54: اور تم اسے یقین کی آنکھ سے دیکھ لو گے.

t.149: Then, on that day, youwill certainly be asked about(worldly) bliss.
t.84: Then you will be asked about all the pleasures (you enjoyed in the world).
t.85: On that Day, you will be asked about your pleasures.
t.95: Then, on that Day, you will be called to account for all the bounties you enjoyed.
t.19: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
t.22: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
t.203: Then on that Day you shall be asked about the delights (you indulged in, in this world)!
t.54: پھر اس دن تم سے ضرور بالضرور نعمتوں کا سوال ہوگا.

t.149: By Time—
t.84: (I swear) by the Time,
t.85: By the declining day,
t.95: By the time!
t.19: By the declining day,
t.22: By (the Token of) Time (through the ages),
t.203: By Al-‘Asr (the time).
t.54: زمانے کی قسم.

t.149: man is most surely in a continuous state of loss,
t.84: man is in a state of loss indeed,
t.85: man is [deep] in loss,
t.95: Lo! Man is in a state of loss;
t.19: Lo! man is a state of loss,
t.22: Verily Man is in loss,
t.203: Verily, man is in loss,
t.54: بیشک (بالیقین) انسان سرتا سر نقصان میں ہے.

t.149: except those who attained faith and did righteous deeds, and enjoined upon one another keeping to the truth, and enjoined upon one another patience.
t.84: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, and exhorted each other to follow truth, and exhorted each other to observe patience.
t.85: except for those who believe, do good deeds, urge one another to the truth, and urge one another to steadfastness.
t.95: save those who have faith and do righteous deeds, and counsel each other to hold on to truth and counsel each other to be steadfast.
t.19: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.
t.22: Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.
t.203: Except those who believe (in Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, and recommend one another to the truth [i.e. order one another to perform all kinds of good deeds (Al-Ma‘ruf) which Allâh has ordained, and abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds (Al-Munkar which Allâh has forbidden], and recommend one another to patience (for the sufferings, harms, and injuries which one may encounter in Allâh’s Cause during preaching His religion of Islâmic Monotheism or Jihâd).
t.54: سوائے ان لوگوں کے جو ایمان ﻻئے اور نیک عمل کیے اور (جنہوں نے) آپس میں حق کی وصیت کی اور ایک دوسرے کو صبر کی نصیحت کی.

t.149: Woe to every slandering backbiter,
t.84: Woe to every backbiter, derider
t.85: Woe to every fault-finding backbiter
t.95: Woe to every fault-finding backbiter;
t.19: Woe unto every slandering traducer,
t.22: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,
t.203: Woe to every slanderer and backbiter.
t.54: بڑی خرابی ہے ہر ایسے شخص کی جو عیب ٹٹولنے واﻻ غیبت کرنے واﻻ ہو.

t.149: who hoarded wealth and counted it over,
t.84: who accumulates wealth and counts it.
t.85: who amasses riches, counting them over,
t.95: who amasses wealth and counts it over and again.
t.19: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.
t.22: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,
t.203: Who has gathered wealth and counted it.
t.54: جو مال کو جمع کرتا جائے اور گنتا جائے.

t.149: thinking that his wealth has made him immortal.
t.84: He thinks that his wealth has made him eternal.
t.85: thinking they will make him live for ever.
t.95: He thinks that his wealth will immortalise him forever.
t.19: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
t.22: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!
t.203: He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!
t.54: وه سمجھتا ہے کہ اس کا مال اس کے پاس سدا رہے گا.

t.149: But no! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
t.84: Never! He will certainly be thrown into the Crushing Fire.
t.85: No indeed! He will be thrust into the Crusher!
t.95: Nay, he shall be thrown into the Crusher.
t.19: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
t.22: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,
t.203: Nay! Verily, he will be thrown into the crushing Fire.
t.54: ہرگز نہیں یہ تو ضرور توڑ پھوڑ دینے والی آگ میں پھینک دیا جائے گا.

t.149: And what can make you realize what the Crusher is?
t.84: And what may let you know what the Crushing Fire is?
t.85: What will explain to you what the Crusher is?
t.95: And what do you know what the Crusher is?
t.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
t.22: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
t.203: And what will make you know what the crushing Fire is?
t.54: اور تجھے کیا معلوم کہ ایسی آگ کیا ہوگی؟

t.149: Allah’s kindled Fire
t.84: It is Allah’s kindled fire
t.85: It is God’s Fire, made to blaze,
t.95: It is the Fire kindled by Allah,
t.19: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,
t.22: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),
t.203: The fire of Allâh kindled,
t.54: وه اللہ تعالیٰ کی سلگائی ہوئی آگ ہوگی.

t.149: that mounts over burning hearts.
t.84: that will peep into the hearts.
t.85: which rises over people’s hearts.
t.95: the Fire that shall rise to the hearts (of criminals).
t.19: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).
t.22: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:
t.203: Which leaps up over the hearts,
t.54: جو دلوں پر چڑھتی چلی جائے گی.

t.149: Indeed, it is over them with no exit,
t.84: It will be closed on them,
t.85: It closes in on them
t.95: Verily it will close in upon them,
t.19: Lo! it is closed in on them
t.22: It shall be made into a vault over them,
t.203: Verily, it shall be closed upon them,
t.54: وہ ان پر ہر طرف سے بند کی ہوئی ہوگی.

t.149: in extended columns.
t.84: in outstretched columns.
t.85: in towering columns.
t.95: in outstretched columns.
t.19: In outstretched columns.
t.22: In columns outstretched.
t.203: In pillars stretched forth (i.e. they will be punished in the Fire with pillars).
t.54: بڑے بڑے ستونوں میں.

t.149: Have younot seen how your Lord dealt with the fellows of the Elephant?
t.84: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?
t.85: Do you [Prophet] not see how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephant?
t.95: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the people of the elephants?
t.19: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
t.22: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?
t.203: Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) not seen how your Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant? [The Elephant army which came from Yemen under the command of Abrahah Al-Ashram intending to destroy the Ka‘bah at Makkah].
t.54: کیا تو نے نہ دیکھا کہ تیرے رب نے ہاتھی والوں کے ساتھ کیا کیا؟

t.149: Did He not make their plot go into great error?
t.84: Has He not turned their plan into nullity?
t.85: Did He not utterly confound their plans?
t.95: Did He not bring their plan to naught?
t.19: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
t.22: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?
t.203: Did He not make their plot go astray?
t.54: کیا ان کے مکر کو بےکار نہیں کردیا؟

t.149: And He sent against them swarms of birds,
t.84: And He sent upon them flying birds in flocks,
t.85: He sent ranks of birds against them,
t.95: And He sent against them swarms of birds
t.19: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,
t.22: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,
t.203: And He sent against them birds, in flocks,
t.54: اور ان پر پرندوں کے جھنڈ کے جھنڈ بھیج دیئے.

t.149: throwing at them rocks of baked clay—
t.84: throwing upon them stones of baked clay,
t.85: pelting them with pellets of hard-baked clay:
t.95: which smote them with stones of baked clay,
t.19: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
t.22: Striking them with stones of baked clay.
t.203: Striking them with stones of Sijjîl (baked clay).
t.54: جو انہیں مٹی اور پتھر کی کنکریاں مار رہے تھے.

t.149: thus He made them like eaten leaves
t.84: and thus He turned them into an eaten-up chaff.
t.85: He made them [like] cropped stubble.
t.95: and made them like straw eaten up (by cattle).
t.19: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?
t.22: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
t.203: And He made them like (an empty field of) stalks (of which the corn has been eaten up by cattle).
t.54: پس انہیں کھائے ہوئے بھوسے کی طرح کردیا.

t.149: for the lasting security of Quraysh—
t.84: Because of the familiarity of the Quraish,
t.85: [He did this] to make the Quraysh feel secure,
t.95: Since the Quraysh became accustomed,
t.19: For the taming of Qureysh.
t.22: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,
t.203: (It is a great Grace from Allâh) for the protection of the Quraish,
t.54: قریش کے مانوس کرنے کے لئے.

t.149: their lasting security during winter and summer journeys—
t.84: that is, their familiarity with the trips of winter and summer,
t.85: secure in their winter and summer journeys.
t.95: accustomed to the journey of winter and summer,
t.19: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
t.22: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-
t.203: (And with all those Allâh’s Grace and Protections, We cause) the (Quraish) caravans to set forth safe in winter (to the south) and in summer (to the north without any fear),
t.54: (یعنی) انہیں جاڑے اور گرمی کے سفر سے مانوس کرنے کے لئے۔ (اس کے شکریہ میں).

t.149: so let them worship the Lord of this House,
t.84: they must worship the Lord of this House,
t.85: So let them worship the Lord of this House:
t.95: therefore, let them worship the Lord of this House;
t.19: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
t.22: Let them adore the Lord of this House,
t.203: So let them worship (Allâh) the Lord of this House (the Ka‘bah in Makkah),
t.54: پس انہیں چاہئے کہ اسی گھر کے رب کی عبادت کرتے رہیں.

t.149: who has fed them to ward off hunger and has secured them to ward off fear.
t.84: who gave them food against hunger, and gave them security against fear.
t.85: who provides them with food to ward off hunger, safety to ward off fear.
t.95: Who fed them against hunger, and secured them against fear.
t.19: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
t.22: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).
t.203: (He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear.
t.54: جس نے انہیں بھوک میں کھانا دیا اور ڈر (اور خوف) میں امن (وامان) دیا.

t.149: Have youseen the one who denies the Recompense?
t.84: Have you seen him who denies the Requital?
t.85: [Prophet], have you considered the person who denies the Judgement?
t.95: Did you see him who gives the lie to the Reward and Punishment of the Hereafter?
t.19: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?
t.22: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?
t.203: Have you seen him who denies the Recompense?
t.54: کیا تو نے (اسے بھی) دیکھا جو (روز) جزا کو جھٹلاتا ہے؟

t.149: It is the one who mistreats the orphan
t.84: So, he is the one who pushes away the orphan,
t.85: It is he who pushes aside the orphan
t.95: Such is the one who repulses the orphans away,
t.19: That is he who repelleth the orphan,
t.22: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),
t.203: That is he who repulses the orphan (harshly),
t.54: یہی وه ہے جو یتیم کو دھکے دیتا ہے.

t.149: and does not urge(others to serve) food to the destitute.
t.84: and does not persuade (others) to feed the needy.
t.85: and does not urge others to feed the needy.
t.95: and urges not the feeding of the needy.
t.19: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.
t.22: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.
t.203: And urges not on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor),
t.54: اور مسکین کو کھلانے کی ترغیب نہیں دیتا.

t.149: So woe to the ones who pray—
t.84: So, Woe to those performers of Salāh,
t.85: So woe to those who pray
t.95: Woe, then, to those who pray,
t.19: Ah, woe unto worshippers
t.22: So woe to the worshippers
t.203: So woe unto those performers of Salât (prayers) (hypocrites),
t.54: ان نمازیوں کے لئے افسوس (اور ویل نامی جہنم کی جگہ) ہے.

t.149: those who are heedless of their prayers,
t.84: who are neglectful of their Salāh,
t.85: but are heedless of their prayer;
t.95: but are heedless in their Prayers,
t.19: Who are heedless of their prayer;
t.22: Who are neglectful of their prayers,
t.203: Those who delay their Salât (prayer from their stated fixed times).
t.54: جو اپنی نماز سے غافل ہیں.

t.149: those who make show(of their deeds)
t.84: who (do good only to) show off,
t.85: those who are all show
t.95: those who do good (in order) to be seen,
t.19: Who would be seen (at worship)
t.22: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),
t.203: Those who do good deeds only to be seen (of men),
t.54: جو ریاکاری کرتے ہیں.

t.149: yet withhold(little) kindnesses.
t.84: and refuse (to give even) small gifts.
t.85: and forbid common kindnesses.
t.95: and deny people the articles of common necessity.
t.19: Yet refuse small kindnesses!
t.22: But refuse (to supply) (even) neighbourly needs.
t.203: And prevent Al-Mâ‘ûn (small kindnesses like salt, sugar, water).
t.54: اور برتنے کی چیز روکتے ہیں.

t.149: Indeed, We have given youplenty.
t.84: (O Prophet,) surely We have given to you Al-Kauthar.
t.85: We have truly given abundance to you [Prophet]––
t.95: (O Prophet), We have surely bestowed upon you good in abundance.
t.19: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
t.22: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
t.203: Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) Al-Kauthar (a river in Paradise).
t.54: یقیناً ہم نے تجھے (حوض) کوﺛر (اور بہت کچھ) دیا ہے.

t.149: So pray to yourLord and sacrifice.
t.84: So, offer Salāh (prayer) to your Lord, and sacrifice.
t.85: so pray to your Lord and make your sacrifice to Him alone––
t.95: So offer Prayer and sacrifice to your Lord alone.
t.19: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
t.22: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.
t.203: Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice (to Him only).
t.54: پس تو اپنے رب کے لئے نماز پڑھ اور قربانی کر.

t.149: Indeed, it is the one who hates youwho has been cut off.
t.84: Surely it is your enemy whose traces are cut off.
t.85: it is the one who hates you who has been cut off.
t.95: Verily your enemy alone has been cut off from the roots.
t.19: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.
t.22: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).
t.203: For he who hates you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), he will be cut off (from posterity and every good thing in this world and in the Hereafter).
t.54: یقیناً تیرا دشمن ہی ﻻوارث اور بے نام ونشان ہے.

t.149: Say, “O deniers,
t.84: Say, “O disbelievers,
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Disbelievers:
t.95: Say: “O unbelievers!”
t.19: Say: O disbelievers!
t.22: Say: O ye that reject Faith!
t.203: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to these Mushrikûn and Kâfirûn): "O Al-Kafirûn (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, in His Angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Resurrection, and in Al-Qadar)!
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ اے کافرو!

t.149: I do not worship what youworship,
t.84: I do not worship that which you worship,
t.85: I do not worship what you worship,
t.95: I do not worship those that you worship
t.19: I worship not that which ye worship;
t.22: I worship not that which ye worship,
t.203: "I worship not that which you worship,
t.54: نہ میں عبادت کرتا ہوں اس کی جس کی تم عبادت کرتے ہو.

t.149: nor do you worship what I worship,
t.84: nor do you worship the One whom I worship.
t.85: you do not worship what I worship,
t.95: neither do you worship Him Whom I worship;
t.19: Nor worship ye that which I worship.
t.22: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
t.203: "Nor will you worship that which I worship.
t.54: نہ تم عبادت کرنے والے ہو اس کی جس کی میں عبادت کرتا ہوں.

t.149: nor shall I ever worship what you worship,
t.84: And neither I am going to worship that which you have worshipped,
t.85: I will never worship what you worship,
t.95: nor will I worship those whom you have worshipped;
t.19: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.
t.22: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,
t.203: "And I shall not worship that which you are worshipping.
t.54: اور نہ میں عبادت کروں گا جس کی تم عبادت کرتے ہو.

t.149: nor shall you ever worship what I worship—
t.84: nor will you worship the One whom I worship.
t.85: you will never worship what I worship:
t.95: nor are you going to worship Him Whom I worship.
t.19: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
t.22: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
t.203: "Nor will you worship that which I worship.
t.54: اور نہ تم اس کی عبادت کرنے والے ہو جس کی میں عبادت کر رہا ہوں.

t.149: you have your religion, and I have my religion.”
t.84: For you is your faith, and for me, my faith.”
t.85: you have your religion and I have mine.’
t.95: To you is your religion, and to me, my religion.
t.19: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.
t.22: To you be your Way, and to me mine.
t.203: "To you be your religion, and to me my religion (Islâmic Monotheism)."
t.54: تمہارے لئے تمہارا دین ہے اور میرے لئے میرا دین ہے.

t.149: When there comes Allah’s support and the conquest,
t.84: (O Prophet,) When there comes Allah’s help and the Victory,
t.85: When God’s help comes and He opens up your way [Prophet],
t.95: When the help comes from Allah, and victory (is granted),
t.19: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh
t.22: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory,
t.203: When there comes the Help of Allâh (to you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم against your enemies) and the conquest (of Makkah).
t.54: جب اللہ کی مدد اور فتح آجائے.*

t.149: and yousee mankind entering Allah’s religion in crowds,
t.84: and you see people entering Allah’s (approved) religion in multitudes,
t.85: when you see people embracing God’s faith in crowds,
t.95: and you see people entering Allah's religion in multitudes,
t.19: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
t.22: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds,
t.203: And you see that the people enter Allah’s religion (Islâm) in crowds.
t.54: اور تو لوگوں کو اللہ کے دین میں جوق در جوق آتا دیکھ لے.

t.149: then highly exalt your Lord with praise and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He has always been Granting and Accepting of repentance.
t.84: then pronounce the purity and praise of your Lord, and seek forgiveness from Him. Surely He is Ever-Relenting.
t.85: celebrate the praise of your Lord and ask His forgiveness: He is always ready to accept repentance.
t.95: then extol the praise of your Lord and pray to Him for forgiveness. For He indeed is ever disposed to accept repentance.
t.19: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
t.22: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).
t.203: So glorify the Praises of your Lord, and ask His Forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts the repentance and Who forgives.
t.54: تو اپنے رب کی تسبیح کرنے لگ حمد کے ساتھ اور اس سے مغفرت کی دعا مانگ، بیشک وه بڑا ہی توبہ قبول کرنے واﻻ ہے.

t.149: May the hands of Abi Lahabbe ruined, and may he be ruined!
t.84: Perish the two hands of Abū Lahab, and perish he!
t.85: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined! May he be ruined too!
t.95: Destroyed were the hands of Abu Lahab, and he lay utterly doomed.
t.19: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.
t.22: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!
t.203: Perish the two hands of Abû Lahab (an uncle of the Prophet) and perish he!
t.54: ابولہب کے دونوں ہاتھ ٹوٹ گئے اور وه (خود) ہلاک ہو گیا.

t.149: His wealth didnot avail him, nor did what he earned.
t.84: Neither his wealth benefited him, nor what he earned.
t.85: Neither his wealth nor his gains will help him:
t.95: His wealth did not avail him, nor his acquisitions.
t.19: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
t.22: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!
t.203: His wealth and his children will not benefit him!
t.54: نہ تو اس کا مال اس کے کام آیا اور نہ اس کی کمائی.

t.149: He will roast in a flaming fire,
t.84: He will soon enter a Fire, full of flames,
t.85: he will burn in the Flaming Fire––
t.95: Surely, he will be cast into a Flaming Fire
t.19: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
t.22: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
t.203: He will be burnt in a Fire of blazing flames!
t.54: وه عنقریب بھڑکنے والی آگ میں جائے گا.

t.149: while his wife, that firewood carrier —
t.84: and his wife as well,-the wicked carrier of firewood.
t.85: and so will his wife, the firewood-carrier,
t.95: along with his wife, that carrier of slanderous tales;
t.19: And his wife, the wood-carrier,
t.22: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
t.203: And his wife, too, who carries wood (thorns of Sa‘dân which she used to put on the way of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, or use to slander him).
t.54: اور اس کی بیوی بھی (جائے گی،) جو لکڑیاں ڈھونے والی ہے.

t.149: around her neck is a rope of palm fiber.
t.84: Around her neck, there is (a collar of iron, like) a well-twisted rope.
t.85: with a palm-fibre rope around her neck.
t.95: upon her neck shall be a rope of palm-fibre.
t.19: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
t.22: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!
t.203: In her neck is a twisted rope of Masad (palm fibre).
t.54: اس کی گردن میں پوست کھجور کی بٹی ہوئی رسی ہوگی.

t.149: Say, “He is Allah, the Uniquely One.
t.84: Say, “The truth is that Allah is One.
t.85: Say, ‘He is God the One,
t.95: Say: “He is Allah, the One and Unique;
t.19: Say: He is Allah, the One!
t.22: Say: He is Allah, the One and Only;
t.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "He is Allâh, (the) One.
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے کہ وه اللہ تعالیٰ ایک (ہی) ہے.

t.149: Allah, the Indivisible.
t.84: Allah is Besought of all, needing none.
t.85: God the eternal.
t.95: Allah, Who is in need of none and of Whom all are in need;
t.19: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!
t.22: Allah, the Eternal, Absolute;
t.203: "Allâh-us-Samad (السيد الذي يصمد إليه في الحاجات) [Allâh the Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, (He neither eats nor drinks)].
t.54: اللہ تعالیٰ بے نیاز ہے.

t.149: He begot no one nor was He begotten,
t.84: He neither begot anyone, nor was he begotten.
t.85: He begot no one nor was He begotten.
t.95: He neither begot any nor was He begotten,
t.19: He begetteth not nor was begotten.
t.22: He begetteth not, nor is He begotten;
t.203: "He begets not, nor was He begotten.
t.54: نہ اس سے کوئی پیدا ہوا نہ وه کسی سے پیدا ہوا.

t.149: and never has there been to Him anyone equivalent.”
t.84: And equal to Him has never been any one.”
t.85: No one is comparable to Him.’
t.95: and none is comparable to Him.”
t.19: And there is none comparable unto Him.
t.22: And there is none like unto Him.
t.203: "And there is none co-equal or comparable unto Him."
t.54: اور نہ کوئی اس کا ہمسر ہے.

t.149: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak
t.84: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak
t.85: Say [Prophet], ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak
t.95: Say: “I seek refuge with the Lord of the rising day;
t.19: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak
t.22: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
t.203: Say: "I seek refuge with (Allâh), the Lord of the daybreak,
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! کہ میں صبح کے رب کی پناه میں آتا ہوں.

t.149: from the evil of whatever He created,
t.84: from the evil of everything He has created,
t.85: against the harm in what He has created,
t.95: from the evil of all that He created;
t.19: From the evil of that which He created;
t.22: From the mischief of created things;
t.203: "From the evil of what He has created,
t.54: ہر اس چیز کے شر سے جو اس نے پیدا کی ہے.

t.149: and from the evil of a dusky night when it darkens,
t.84: and from the evil of the dark night when it penetrates,
t.85: the harm in the night when darkness gathers,
t.95: from the evil of night's darkness when it spreads around;
t.19: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,
t.22: From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads;
t.203: "And from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness; (or the moon as it sets or goes away),
t.54: اور اندھیری رات کی تاریکی کے شر سے جب اس کا اندھیرا پھیل جائے.

t.149: and from the evil of sorceresses who blow upon knots,
t.84: and from the evil of the women who blow on the knots,
t.85: the harm in witches when they blow on knots,
t.95: from the evil of the women who blow on knots;
t.19: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,
t.22: From the mischief of those who practise secret arts;
t.203: "And from the evil of those who practise witchcraft when they blow in the knots,
t.54: اور گره (لگا کر ان) میں پھونکنے والیوں کے شر سے (بھی).

t.149: and from the evil of an envier when he envies.”
t.84: and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
t.85: the harm in the envier when he envies.’
t.95: and from the evil of the envier when he envies.”
t.19: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.
t.22: And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy.
t.203: "And from the evil of the envier when he envies."
t.54: اور حسد کرنے والے کی برائی سے بھی جب وه حسد کرے.

t.149: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,
t.84: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,
t.85: Say, ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of people,
t.95: Say: “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind;
t.19: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
t.22: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind,
t.203: Say: "I seek refuge with (Allâh) the Lord of mankind,
t.54: آپ کہہ دیجئے! کہ میں لوگوں کے پروردگار کی پناه میں آتا ہوں.

t.149: the King of mankind,
t.84: the King of mankind,
t.85: the Controller of people,
t.95: the King of mankind,
t.19: The King of mankind,
t.22: The King (or Ruler) of Mankind,
t.203: "The King of mankind -
t.54: لوگوں کے مالک کی (اور).

t.149: the God of mankind,
t.84: the God of mankind,
t.85: the God of people,
t.95: the True God of mankind,
t.19: The God of mankind,
t.22: The God (or Judge) of Mankind
t.203: "The Ilâh (God) of mankind,
t.54: لوگوں کے معبود کی (پناه میں).

t.149: from the evil of the sneaky whisperer
t.84: from the evil of the whisperer who withdraws (when Allah’s name is pronounced),
t.85: against the harm of the slinking whisperer––
t.95: from the mischief of the whispering, elusive prompter who returns again and again,
t.19: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,
t.22: From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper),-
t.203: "From the evil of the whisperer (devil who whispers evil in the hearts of men) who withdraws (from his whispering in one’s heart after one remembers Allâh).
t.54: وسوسہ ڈالنے والے پیچھے ہٹ جانے والے کے شر سے.

t.149: who whispers into the chests of mankind—
t.84: the one who whispers in the hearts of people,
t.85: who whispers into the hearts of people––
t.95: who whispers in the hearts of people;
t.19: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,
t.22: (The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind,-
t.203: "Who whispers in the breasts of mankind.
t.54: جو لوگوں کے سینوں میں وسوسہ ڈالتا ہے.

t.149: (from the whisperers) among the race of unseen beingsand mankind.”
t.84: whether from among the Jinn or Mankind.
t.85: whether they be jinn or people.’
t.95: whether he be from the jinn or humans.”
t.19: Of the jinn and of mankind.
t.22: Among Jinns and among men.
t.203: "Of jinn and men."
t.54: (خواه) وه جن میں سے ہو یا انسان میں سے.
